1140:     assert.strictEqual(resVerifySusp.body.error.code, 'FORBIDDEN');
1141: 
1142:     const res21j = await request(app.getHttpServer())
1143:       .post('/auth/reset-password')
1144:       .set('x-forwarded-for', '203.0.113.16')
1145:       .send({

1152:     console.log('  PASS: Verify and reset for suspended account rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN');
1153:

1156:       where: { id: userForSuspension!.id },
1157:       data: { status: 'active' },
1158:     });
1159: 
1160:     // 21k. Verify session revocation and audit logging
1161:     rateLimitService.clear();
1162:     await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/auth/forgot-password').send({ identifier: email1 });
1163:     const revokeMsg = mockDeliveryAdapter.getLastMessage();

1165: 
1166:     await prisma.deviceSession.create({

1177: 
1178:     const sessionsBefore = await prisma.deviceSession.findMany({
1179:       where: { user_id: userForSuspension!.id, is_revoked: false },

1181:     assert.ok(sessionsBefore.length > 0, 'Should have active sessions before reset');
1182: 
1183:     const res21k = await request(app.getHttpServer())
1184:       .post('/auth/reset-password')
1185:       .set('x-forwarded-for', '203.0.113.17')
1186:       .send({
1187:         token: revokeToken,
1188:         password: 'RevokePassword123!',
1189:         password_confirm: 'RevokePassword123!',
1190:       })
1191:       .expect(200);
1192: 
1193:     const sessionsAfter = await prisma.deviceSession.findMany({

1195:     });
1196:     assert.ok(

1198:       'All sessions should be revoked after reset'
1199:     );
1200: 
1201:     const auditLogs = await prisma.auditLog.findMany({
1202:       where: { user_id: userForSuspension!.id, action: 'AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_SESSIONS_REVOKED' },
1203:     });
1204:     assert.ok(auditLogs.length > 0, 'Audit log for password reset must be persisted');
1205:     console.log('  PASS: Sessions revoked and audit logs verified in database');
1206:   } finally {

1208:   }
1209: }
1210: 
1211: runAuthSupertestSuite()

<file path="apps/api/src/auth/canonical-exception.filter.ts">
 1: import { ExceptionFilter, Catch, ArgumentsHost, HttpException } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { Response } from 'express';
 3: import { CanonicalApiException } from './auth.service';
 4: 
 5: @Catch(CanonicalApiException)
 6: export class CanonicalExceptionFilter implements ExceptionFilter {
 7:   catch(exception: CanonicalApiException, host: ArgumentsHost) {
 8:     const ctx = host.switchToHttp();
 9:     const response = ctx.getResponse<Response>();
10:     const status = exception.getStatus();
11:     const payload = exception.getResponse();
12: 
13:     if (exception.retryAfterSeconds !== undefined) {
14:       response.setHeader('Retry-After', exception.retryAfterSeconds.toString());
15:     }
16: 
17:     response.status(status).json(payload);
18:   }
19: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/auth/default-verification-adapter.ts">

 2: import type { IVerificationDeliveryAdapter, VerificationMessage } from '@shipde/contracts';
 3: 
 4: @Injectable()
 5: export class DefaultVerificationAdapter implements IVerificationDeliveryAdapter {
 6:   private readonly logger = new Logger(DefaultVerificationAdapter.name);
 7: 
 8:   async sendVerification(
 9:     message: Omit<VerificationMessage, 'sentAt'>
10:   ): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId: string }> {
11:     const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
12:     if (isProd) {
13:       this.logger.warn(
14:         `[PRODUCTION] External SMS/Email provider not wired. Mock dispatch to ${message.recipient} on channel ${message.channel}.`
15:       );
16:     } else {
17:       this.logger.log(
18:         `[DEV/FALLBACK] Verification dispatch to ${message.recipient} via ${message.channel}. Token: ${message.token || 'N/A'}, OTP: ${message.otp || 'N/A'}`
19:       );
20:     }
21: 
22:     return {
23:       success: true,
24:       messageId: `default-dispatch-${Date.now()}`,
25:     };

<file path="apps/api/src/auth/password.util.ts">
 1: import { scrypt, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
 2: 
 3: const SCRYPT_N = 16384;
 4: const SCRYPT_R = 8;
 5: const SCRYPT_P = 1;
 6: const KEY_LEN = 64;
 7: 
 8: function scryptPromise(
 9:   password: string | Buffer,
10:   salt: string | Buffer,
11:   keylen: number,
12:   options: { N: number; r: number; p: number }
13: ): Promise<Buffer> {
14:   return new Promise<Buffer>((resolve, reject) => {
15:     scrypt(password, salt, keylen, options, (err, derivedKey) => {
16:       if (err) return reject(err);
17:       resolve(derivedKey);
18:     });
19:   });
20: }
21: 
22: export async function hashPassword(password: string): Promise<string> {
23:   const salt = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
24:   const derivedKey = await scryptPromise(password, salt, KEY_LEN, {
25:     N: SCRYPT_N,
26:     r: SCRYPT_R,
27:     p: SCRYPT_P,
28:   });
29:   return `scrypt$${SCRYPT_N}$${SCRYPT_R}$${SCRYPT_P}$${salt}$${derivedKey.toString('hex')}`;
30: }
31: 
32: export async function verifyPassword(password: string, storedHash: string): Promise<boolean> {
33:   if (storedHash.startsWith('scrypt$')) {
34:     const parts = storedHash.split('$');
35:     if (parts.length !== 6) return false;
36:     const [, nStr, rStr, pStr, salt, hashHex] = parts;
37:     const N = parseInt(nStr, 10);
38:     const r = parseInt(rStr, 10);
39:     const p = parseInt(pStr, 10);
40:     const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex');
41:     const derivedKey = await scryptPromise(password, salt, expectedBuffer.length, { N, r, p });
42:     if (derivedKey.length !== expectedBuffer.length) return false;
43:     return timingSafeEqual(derivedKey, expectedBuffer);
44:   }
45:   return false;
46: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/correlation/correlation.middleware.ts">
 1: import { Injectable, NestMiddleware } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
 3: import { CORRELATION_ID_HEADER, normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
 4: 
 5: @Injectable()
 6: export class CorrelationMiddleware implements NestMiddleware {
 7:   use(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
 8:     const rawHeader = req.headers[CORRELATION_ID_HEADER];
 9:     const candidate = Array.isArray(rawHeader) ? rawHeader[0] : rawHeader;
10:     const correlationId = normalizeCorrelationId(candidate);
11: 
12:     (req as any).correlationId = correlationId;
13:     res.setHeader(CORRELATION_ID_HEADER, correlationId);
14:     next();
15:   }
16: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/health/health.controller.ts">
 1: import { Controller, Get, Req, Res, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { Request, Response } from 'express';
 3: import { HealthService } from './health.service';
 4: import { LivenessResponse, ReadinessResponse } from '@shipde/contracts';
 5: import { normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
 6: 
 7: @Controller('health')
 8: export class HealthController {
 9:   constructor(@Inject(HealthService) private readonly healthService: HealthService) {}
10: 
11:   @Get('live')
12:   getLive(@Req() req: Request): LivenessResponse {
13:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
14:     return {
15:       status: 'ok',
16:       service: 'api',
17:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
18:       correlationId,
19:     };
20:   }
21: 
22:   @Get('ready')
23:   async getReady(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): Promise<Response> {
24:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
25:     const { isReady, checks } = await this.healthService.checkReadiness();
26: 
27:     const responseBody: ReadinessResponse = {
28:       status: isReady ? 'ok' : 'error',
29:       service: 'api',
30:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
31:       correlationId,
32:       checks,
33:     };
34: 
35:     const httpStatus = isReady ? 200 : 503;
36:     return res.status(httpStatus).json(responseBody);
37:   }
38: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/outbox/outbox.service.ts">
  1: import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
  2: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
  3: import { Prisma, OutboxEvent, OutboxStatusEnum } from '@prisma/client';
  4: import { QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE } from '@shipde/contracts';
  5: import { normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
  6: 
  7: @Injectable()
  8: export class OutboxService {
  9:   constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}
 10: 
 11:   /**
 12:    * Persists an outbox event within an existing database transaction client.
 13:    * Proves atomic commit / rollback with application entity mutations.
 14:    * Strictly enforces event allowlist to prevent unprocessable events (Finding 6).
 15:    * Normalizes correlationId before persisting to maintain consistent correlation chain (Round 6 Finding 5).
 16:    */
 17:   async createWithinTransaction(
 18:     tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
 19:     data: {
 20:       eventType: string;
 21:       payload: Prisma.InputJsonValue;
 22:       correlationId: string;
 23:       idempotencyKey?: string;
 24:     }
 25:   ): Promise<OutboxEvent> {
 26:     if (data.eventType !== QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE) {
 27:       throw new Error(
 28:         `Unsupported outbox event type: '${data.eventType}'. Foundation dispatcher only processes '${QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE}'.`
 29:       );
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     const correlationId = normalizeCorrelationId(data.correlationId);
 33: 
 34:     return tx.outboxEvent.create({
 35:       data: {
 36:         event_type: data.eventType,
 37:         payload: data.payload,
 38:         correlation_id: correlationId,
 39:         idempotency_key: data.idempotencyKey,
 40:         status: OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING,
 41:       },
 42:     });
 43:   }
 44: 
 45:   /**
 46:    * Directly creates an outbox event using default client transaction.
 47:    * Strictly enforces event allowlist to prevent unprocessable events (Finding 6).
 48:    * Normalizes correlationId before persisting to maintain consistent correlation chain (Round 6 Finding 5).
 49:    */
 50:   async createOutboxEvent(data: {
 51:     eventType: string;
 52:     payload: Prisma.InputJsonValue;
 53:     correlationId: string;
 54:     idempotencyKey?: string;
 55:   }): Promise<OutboxEvent> {
 56:     if (data.eventType !== QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE) {
 57:       throw new Error(
 58:         `Unsupported outbox event type: '${data.eventType}'. Foundation dispatcher only processes '${QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE}'.`
 59:       );
 60:     }
 61: 
 62:     const correlationId = normalizeCorrelationId(data.correlationId);
 63: 
 64:     return this.prisma.outboxEvent.create({
 65:       data: {
 66:         event_type: data.eventType,
 67:         payload: data.payload,
 68:         correlation_id: correlationId,
 69:         idempotency_key: data.idempotencyKey,
 70:         status: OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING,
 71:       },
 72:     });
 73:   }
 74: 
 75:   async getPendingEvents(limit = 10): Promise<OutboxEvent[]> {
 76:     return this.prisma.outboxEvent.findMany({
 77:       where: {
 78:         status: OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING,
 79:         scheduled_at: { lte: new Date() },
 80:       },
 81:       take: limit,
 82:       orderBy: { scheduled_at: 'asc' },
 83:     });
 84:   }
 85: 
 86:   /**
 87:    * Atomically transitions an outbox event to PUBLISHED state.
 88:    * Strictly requires in-flight status (PENDING or PROCESSING) to prevent regressing or corrupting states (Finding 3).
 89:    */
 90:   async markPublished(id: string): Promise<OutboxEvent> {
 91:     const updateResult = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
 92:       where: {
 93:         id,
 94:         status: { in: [OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING, OutboxStatusEnum.PROCESSING] },
 95:       },
 96:       data: {
 97:         status: OutboxStatusEnum.PUBLISHED,
 98:         published_at: new Date(),
 99:         last_error: null,
100:       },
101:     });
102: 
103:     if (updateResult.count === 0) {
104:       const existing = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.findUnique({ where: { id } });
105:       if (!existing) {
106:         throw new Error(`Outbox event ${id} not found`);
107:       }
108:       if (existing.status === OutboxStatusEnum.PUBLISHED) {
109:         return existing;
110:       }
111:       throw new Error(
112:         `Cannot mark outbox event ${id} as PUBLISHED from invalid status ${existing.status}`
113:       );
114:     }
115: 
116:     return this.prisma.outboxEvent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
117:   }
118: 
119:   /**
120:    * Records failure and schedules bounded retry.
121:    * Uses atomic conditional predicate requiring in-flight status to ensure that a late failure
122:    * can NEVER regress a concurrently PUBLISHED event to PENDING or FAILED (Finding 3).
123:    */
124:   async recordFailure(id: string, error: string, maxAttempts = 3): Promise<OutboxEvent> {
125:     const existing = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.findUnique({ where: { id } });
126:     if (!existing) {
127:       throw new Error(`Outbox event ${id} not found`);
128:     }
129:     if (existing.status === OutboxStatusEnum.PUBLISHED) {
130:       throw new Error(`Cannot record failure for outbox event ${id}: already PUBLISHED`);
131:     }
132: 
133:     const nextAttempts = existing.attempts + 1;
134:     const isExhausted = nextAttempts >= maxAttempts;
135: 
136:     const updateResult = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
137:       where: {
138:         id,
139:         status: { in: [OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING, OutboxStatusEnum.PROCESSING] },
140:         attempts: existing.attempts,
141:       },
142:       data: {
143:         attempts: nextAttempts,
144:         last_error: error,
145:         status: isExhausted ? OutboxStatusEnum.FAILED : OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING,
146:       },
147:     });
148: 
149:     if (updateResult.count === 0) {
150:       const current = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
151:       if (current.status === OutboxStatusEnum.PUBLISHED) {
152:         throw new Error(`Cannot record failure for outbox event ${id}: already PUBLISHED`);
153:       }
154:       throw new Error(
155:         `Failed to record failure for outbox event ${id} due to concurrent state transition`
156:       );
157:     }
158: 
159:     return this.prisma.outboxEvent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
160:   }
161: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts">
 1: import { Injectable, OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
 3: 
 4: @Injectable()
 5: export class PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
 6:   async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
 7:     // Non-blocking initial connection: do not await $connect() during module bootstrap.
 8:     // A slow, unreachable, or blackholed database must never block Nest bootstrap
 9:     // or prevent the HTTP server from immediately serving /health/live (Finding 1).
10:     void this.$connect().catch(() => {
11:       // Detached connect failure is handled gracefully; readiness probe will report down.
12:     });
13:   }
14: 
15:   async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
16:     try {
17:       await this.$disconnect();
18:     } catch {
19:       // Ignore disconnect errors during teardown
20:     }
21:   }
22: 
23:   /**
24:    * Bounded database readiness check.
25:    * Executes a lightweight SELECT 1 with an internal timeout.
26:    */
27:   async checkReadiness(timeoutMs = 2000): Promise<'up' | 'down'> {
28:     try {
29:       const queryPromise = this.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
30:       const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
31:         setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Database check timeout')), timeoutMs)
32:       );
33: 
34:       await Promise.race([queryPromise, timeoutPromise]);
35:       return 'up';
36:     } catch {
37:       return 'down';
38:     }
39:   }
40: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/redis/redis.service.ts">
 1: import { Injectable, Inject, OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import Redis from 'ioredis';
 3: import { AppConfig } from '@shipde/config';
 4: import { APP_CONFIG } from '../config.token';
 5: 
 6: @Injectable()
 7: export class RedisService implements OnModuleDestroy {
 8:   private client: Redis | null = null;
 9:   private readonly config: AppConfig;
10: 
11:   constructor(@Inject(APP_CONFIG) config: AppConfig) {
12:     this.config = config;
13:   }
14: 
15:   getClient(): Redis {
16:     if (!this.client) {
17:       this.client = new Redis({
18:         host: this.config.REDIS_HOST,
19:         port: this.config.REDIS_PORT,
20:         password: this.config.REDIS_PASSWORD,
21:         lazyConnect: true,
22:         maxRetriesPerRequest: 1,
23:         connectTimeout: 2000,
24:         retryStrategy: () => null, // Do not hang indefinitely on health check
25:       });
26:       this.client.on('error', () => {
27:         // Prevent unhandled error event on connection loss/refusal
28:       });
29:     }
30:     return this.client;
31:   }
32: 
33:   async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
34:     if (this.client) {
35:       try {
36:         await this.client.quit();
37:       } catch {
38:         this.client.disconnect();
39:       }
40:       this.client = null;
41:     }
42:   }
43: 
44:   /**
45:    * Bounded Redis readiness check.
46:    * Executes PING with an internal timeout.
47:    */
48:   async checkReadiness(timeoutMs = 2000): Promise<'up' | 'down'> {
49:     try {
50:       const redis = this.getClient();
51:       if (redis.status !== 'ready') {
52:         await redis.connect();
53:       }
54: 
55:       const pingPromise = redis.ping();
56:       const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
57:         setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Redis check timeout')), timeoutMs)
58:       );
59: 
60:       const res = await Promise.race([pingPromise, timeoutPromise]);
61:       return res === 'PONG' ? 'up' : 'down';
62:     } catch {
63:       return 'down';
64:     }
65:   }
66: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/session/session-id.pipe.ts">

 2: 
 3: @Injectable()
 4: export class SessionIdPipe implements PipeTransform<string, string> {
 5:   transform(value: string): string {
 6:     if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(value)) {
 7:       throw new NotFoundException({
 8:         error: {
 9:           code: 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND',
10:           message: 'Không tìm thấy phiên làm việc',
11:           retryable: false,
12:         },
13:       });
14:     }
15:     return value;
16:   }
17: }

<file path="apps/api/src/session/session.controller.ts">
 1: import {
 2:   Controller,
 3:   Inject,
 4:   Get,
 5:   Delete,
 6:   Patch,
 7:   Body,
 8:   Param,
 9:   Post,
10:   Req,
11:   HttpCode,
12:   HttpStatus,
13:   UseGuards,
14: } from '@nestjs/common';
15: import { SessionService, RevokeAllDto } from './session.service';
16: import { normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
17: import { SessionGuard } from './session.guard';
18: import { SessionIdPipe } from './session-id.pipe';
19: import { extractClientIp } from '../utils/ip.util';
20: 
21: /**
22:  * FEAT-AUTH-06 — Session management controller.
23:  */
24: @Controller('api/v1/sessions')
25: @UseGuards(SessionGuard)
26: export class SessionController {
27:   constructor(@Inject(SessionService) private readonly sessionService: SessionService) {}
28: 
29:   /** GET /api/v1/sessions — List active sessions for current user */
30:   @Get()
31:   async list(@Req() req: any) {
32:     const userId = req.userId as string;
33:     const merchantId = req.merchantId as string;
34:     const currentSessionHash = req.sessionTokenHash as string | undefined;
35:     const correlationId = req.headers['x-correlation-id'] || normalizeCorrelationId();
36:     return this.sessionService.list(userId, merchantId, currentSessionHash, correlationId);
37:   }
38: 
39:   /** DELETE /api/v1/sessions/:sessionId — Revoke a single session */
40:   @Delete(':sessionId')
41:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
42:   async revoke(@Param('sessionId', SessionIdPipe) sessionId: string, @Req() req: any) {
43:     const userId = req.userId as string;
44:     const merchantId = req.merchantId as string;
45:     const correlationId = req.headers['x-correlation-id'] || normalizeCorrelationId();
46:     const ip = extractClientIp(req);
47:     return this.sessionService.revoke(sessionId, userId, merchantId, correlationId, undefined, ip);
48:   }
49: 
50:   /** POST /api/v1/sessions/revoke-all — Revoke all sessions (logout everywhere) */
51:   @Post('revoke-all')
52:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
53:   async revokeAll(@Body() dto: RevokeAllDto, @Req() req: any) {
54:     const userId = req.userId as string;
55:     const merchantId = req.merchantId as string;
56:     const currentSessionId = req.sessionId as string | undefined;
57:     const correlationId = req.headers['x-correlation-id'] || normalizeCorrelationId();
58:     const ip = extractClientIp(req);
59:     return this.sessionService.revokeAll(
60:       userId,
61:       merchantId,
62:       currentSessionId,
63:       dto,
64:       correlationId,
65:       ip
66:     );
67:   }
68: 
69:   /** PATCH /api/v1/sessions/:sessionId/heartbeat — Update last activity */
70:   @Patch(':sessionId/heartbeat')
71:   async heartbeat(@Param('sessionId', SessionIdPipe) sessionId: string, @Req() req: any) {
72:     const userId = req.userId as string;
73:     const merchantId = req.merchantId as string;
74:     const currentSessionId = req.sessionId as string | undefined;
75:     return this.sessionService.heartbeat(sessionId, userId, merchantId, currentSessionId);
76:   }
77: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/session/session.module.ts">
 1: import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';

<file path="apps/api/src/storage/storage.service.ts">
 1: import { Injectable, Inject, OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { S3Client, HeadBucketCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
 3: import { AppConfig } from '@shipde/config';
 4: import { APP_CONFIG } from '../config.token';
 5: 
 6: @Injectable()
 7: export class StorageService implements OnModuleDestroy {
 8:   private client: S3Client | null = null;
 9:   private readonly config: AppConfig;
10: 
11:   constructor(@Inject(APP_CONFIG) config: AppConfig) {
12:     this.config = config;
13:   }
14: 
15:   getClient(): S3Client {
16:     if (!this.client) {
17:       this.client = new S3Client({
18:         endpoint: this.config.S3_ENDPOINT,
19:         region: this.config.S3_REGION,
20:         credentials: {
21:           accessKeyId: this.config.S3_ACCESS_KEY,
22:           secretAccessKey: this.config.S3_SECRET_KEY,
23:         },
24:         forcePathStyle: this.config.S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE,
25:       });
26:     }
27:     return this.client;
28:   }
29: 
30:   async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
31:     if (this.client) {
32:       this.client.destroy();
33:       this.client = null;
34:     }
35:   }
36: 
37:   /**
38:    * Bounded S3 storage readiness check.
39:    * Executes HeadBucketCommand scoped to the configured bucket with an internal timeout (Finding 9).
40:    */
41:   async checkReadiness(timeoutMs = 2000): Promise<'up' | 'down'> {
42:     try {
43:       const s3 = this.getClient();
44:       const checkPromise = s3.send(
45:         new HeadBucketCommand({
46:           Bucket: this.config.S3_BUCKET,
47:         })
48:       );
49:       const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
50:         setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('S3 check timeout')), timeoutMs)
51:       );
52: 
53:       await Promise.race([checkPromise, timeoutPromise]);
54:       return 'up';
55:     } catch {
56:       return 'down';
57:     }
58:   }
59: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/main.ts">
 1: import * as path from 'path';
 2: import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
 3: import { NestExpressApplication } from '@nestjs/platform-express';
 4: import { AppModule } from './app.module';
 5: import {
 6:   validateConfig,
 7:   formatStructuredLog,
 8:   ConfigValidationError,
 9:   initTelemetry,
10: } from '@shipde/config';
11: 
12: export async function bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
13:   initTelemetry('shipde-api');
14: 
15:   // Explicitly load .env file from root monorepo or local directory (Node 24 native, Finding 2)
16:   if (typeof (process as any).loadEnvFile === 'function') {
17:     const candidateEnvPaths = [
18:       path.resolve(process.cwd(), '../../.env'),
19:       path.resolve(__dirname, '../../.env'),
20:       path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../.env'),
21:       path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env'),
22:     ];
23:     for (const envPath of candidateEnvPaths) {
24:       try {
25:         (process as any).loadEnvFile(envPath);
26:       } catch (err: any) {
27:         if (err.code !== 'ENOENT') {
28:           console.warn(
29:             formatStructuredLog({
30:               level: 'warn',
31:               service: 'api',
32:               message: `Failed to load .env from ${envPath}: ${err.message}`,
33:             })
34:           );
35:         }
36:       }
37:     }
38:   }
39: 
40:   let config;
41:   try {
42:     config = validateConfig();
43:   } catch (err: any) {
44:     if (err instanceof ConfigValidationError) {
45:       console.error(
46:         formatStructuredLog({
47:           level: 'error',
48:           service: 'api',
49:           message: `Fatal configuration error on startup: ${err.message}`,
50:         })
51:       );
52:     } else {
53:       console.error(
54:         formatStructuredLog({
55:           level: 'error',
56:           service: 'api',
57:           message: 'Unknown error validating environment configuration',
58:         })
59:       );
60:     }
61:     process.exit(1);
62:   }
63: 
64:   const app = await NestFactory.create<NestExpressApplication>(AppModule, {
65:     logger: false, // Structured JSON logs are handled directly
66:   });
67: 
68:   app.set('trust proxy', config.TRUST_PROXY_HOPS);
69: 
70:   app.enableShutdownHooks();
71: 
72:   await app.listen(config.PORT);
73: 
74:   console.log(
75:     formatStructuredLog({
76:       level: 'info',
77:       service: 'api',
78:       message: `Ship Dễ API service started successfully on port ${config.PORT}`,
79:       metadata: {
80:         port: config.PORT,
81:         nodeEnv: config.NODE_ENV,
82:         carrierMode: config.CARRIER_MODE,
83:       },
84:     })
85:   );
86: }
87: 
88: if (require.main === module) {
89:   bootstrap().catch((err) => {
90:     console.error(
91:       formatStructuredLog({
92:         level: 'error',
93:         service: 'api',
94:         message: `Unhandled exception during API bootstrap: ${err.message}`,
95:       })
96:     );
97:     process.exit(1);
98:   });
99: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/adapters/base.carrier.ts">
 1: // ============================================================================
 2: // Ship Dễ — Base Carrier Adapter Contract (Tập 1 Mục 5, Tập 2 CN-04..06)
 3: // Phân tầng năng lực L0/L1/L2 & Xử lý mã lỗi chuẩn
 4: // ============================================================================
 5: 
 6: import {
 7:   CarrierCapabilityTier,
 8:   CarrierCode,
 9:   ShipmentStatus,
10:   CurrencyAmount,
11:   WeightGram,
12: } from '../types/domain';
13: import { ERROR_CATALOG, ShipDeAppError } from '../types/error-codes';
14: 
15: export interface CarrierTrackingResult {
16:   tracking_code: string;
17:   raw_status: string;
18:   normalized_status: ShipmentStatus;
19:   occurred_at: Date;
20:   location?: string;
21:   raw_reason?: string;
22:   charged_weight_g?: WeightGram;
23:   charged_fee?: CurrencyAmount;
24:   cod_amount?: CurrencyAmount;
25:   cod_collected?: CurrencyAmount;
26:   raw_payload: Record<string, unknown>;
27: }
28: 
29: export interface ReattemptRequestPayload {
30:   tracking_code: string;
31:   scheduled_date?: Date;
32:   new_recipient_phone?: string;
33:   note: string;
34:   idempotency_key: string;
35: }
36: 
37: export interface ReattemptResponse {
38:   success: boolean;
39:   reference_id?: string;
40:   scheduled_at?: Date;
41:   tier_executed: CarrierCapabilityTier;
42:   instruction_note?: string; // Dành cho L1 khi xuất hồ sơ hỗ trợ
43: }
44: 
45: export interface CreateTicketRequestPayload {
46:   tracking_code: string;
47:   claim_type: string;
48:   requested_amount: CurrencyAmount;
49:   description: string;
50:   evidence_urls: string[];
51: }
52: 
53: export interface CreateTicketResponse {
54:   ticket_id?: string;
55:   status: string;
56:   tier_executed: CarrierCapabilityTier;
57:   portal_export_package_url?: string;
58: }
59: 
60: export abstract class BaseCarrierAdapter {
61:   public abstract readonly carrierCode: CarrierCode;
62:   public abstract readonly defaultTier: CarrierCapabilityTier;
63: 
64:   /**
65:    * Tra cứu trạng thái chi tiết theo mã vận đơn
66:    */
67:   public abstract trackShipment(
68:     trackingCode: string,
69:     credentials: Record<string, string>
70:   ): Promise<CarrierTrackingResult>;
71: 
72:   /**
73:    * Yêu cầu giao lại đơn hàng (Reattempt)
74:    * Với L2 (GHN): Gọi API trực tiếp
75:    * Với L1 (GHTK): Trả về hồ sơ chuẩn bị kèm 501 / hướng dẫn xuất cổng hãng (BR-26, BR-44)
76:    */
77:   public abstract requestReattempt(
78:     payload: ReattemptRequestPayload,
79:     credentials: Record<string, string>,
80:     overrideTier?: CarrierCapabilityTier
81:   ): Promise<ReattemptResponse>;
82: 
83:   /**
84:    * Tạo khiếu nại / ticket
85:    */
86:   public abstract createTicket(
87:     payload: CreateTicketRequestPayload,
88:     credentials: Record<string, string>,
89:     overrideTier?: CarrierCapabilityTier
90:   ): Promise<CreateTicketResponse>;
91: 
92:   /**
93:    * Chuẩn hóa mã trạng thái hãng sang trạng thái chuẩn Ship Dễ (BR-03, BR-04)
94:    */
95:   public abstract normalizeStatus(rawStatus: string): ShipmentStatus;
96: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/adapters/csv.adapter.ts">
  1: // ============================================================================
  2: // Ship Dễ — CSV/Excel Statement Parser (Tập 2 CN-13, BR-02, BR-36)
  3: // Bất biến, tính Checksum SHA-256, chuẩn hóa dòng vào buffer đối soát
  4: // ============================================================================
  5: 
  6: import * as crypto from 'crypto';
  7: import { StatementRow, MatchingStatus } from '../types/domain';
  8: import { ERROR_CATALOG, ShipDeAppError } from '../types/error-codes';
  9: 
 10: export interface RawStatementRowInput {
 11:   tracking_code: string;
 12:   order_code?: string;
 13:   fee_type: string;
 14:   charged_weight_g: number;
 15:   charged_fee: number;
 16:   cod_collected: number;
 17:   cod_paid_at?: string | Date;
 18:   extra?: Record<string, unknown>;
 19: }
 20: 
 21: export interface StatementParseResult {
 22:   checksum: string;
 23:   total_rows: number;
 24:   total_fees: number;
 25:   total_cod: number;
 26:   rows: StatementRow[];
 27: }
 28: 
 29: export function calculateSHA256(content: string | Buffer): string {
 30:   return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
 31: }
 32: 
 33: export class StatementCsvAdapter {
 34:   private registeredChecksums = new Set<string>();
 35: 
 36:   /**
 37:    * Tính mã SHA-256 checksum của file sao kê
 38:    */
 39:   public calculateChecksum(fileContent: string | Buffer): string {
 40:     return calculateSHA256(fileContent);
 41:   }
 42: 
 43:   /**
 44:    * Phân tích và chuẩn hóa danh sách dòng sao kê thô
 45:    */
 46:   public parseStatement(
 47:     statementId: string,
 48:     merchantId: string,
 49:     fileContent: string | Buffer,
 50:     rawRows: RawStatementRowInput[]
 51:   ): StatementParseResult {
 52:     const checksum = this.calculateChecksum(fileContent);
 53: 
 54:     // Kiểm tra trùng lặp checksum file sao kê (CN-13 E2)
 55:     if (this.registeredChecksums.has(checksum)) {
 56:       throw new ShipDeAppError(ERROR_CATALOG.STATEMENT_DUPLICATE, {
 57:         checksum,
 58:         reason: 'File sao kê này đã được tải lên trước đó trong cùng nguồn.',
 59:       });
 60:     }
 61: 
 62:     if (!rawRows || rawRows.length === 0) {
 63:       throw new ShipDeAppError(ERROR_CATALOG.VALIDATION_ERROR, {
 64:         reason: 'File sao kê rỗng hoặc không đọc được dòng dữ liệu nào.',
 65:       });
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     this.registeredChecksums.add(checksum);
 69: 
 70:     let totalFees = 0;
 71:     let totalCod = 0;
 72:     const rows: StatementRow[] = [];
 73: 
 74:     rawRows.forEach((raw, index) => {
 75:       const lineNum = index + 1;
 76:       const normalizedTracking = (raw.tracking_code || '')
 77:         .toUpperCase()
 78:         .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '')
 79:         .trim();
 80: 
 81:       const fee = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(raw.charged_fee) || 0));
 82:       const cod = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(raw.cod_collected) || 0));
 83:       const weight = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(raw.charged_weight_g) || 0));
 84: 
 85:       totalFees += fee;
 86:       totalCod += cod;
 87: 
 88:       let paidAtDate: Date | undefined;
 89:       if (raw.cod_paid_at) {
 90:         paidAtDate = new Date(raw.cod_paid_at);
 91:         if (isNaN(paidAtDate.getTime())) paidAtDate = undefined;
 92:       }
 93: 
 94:       rows.push({
 95:         id: `row_${statementId}_${lineNum}`,
 96:         statement_id: statementId,
 97:         line_number: lineNum,
 98:         tracking_code: normalizedTracking,
 99:         order_code: raw.order_code ? String(raw.order_code).trim() : undefined,
100:         fee_type: raw.fee_type ? String(raw.fee_type).trim().toUpperCase() : 'MAIN_FREIGHT',
101:         charged_weight_g: weight,
102:         charged_fee: fee,
103:         cod_collected: cod,
104:         cod_paid_at: paidAtDate,
105:         match_status: MatchingStatus.UNMATCHED,
106:         raw_data: { ...raw },
107:       });
108:     });
109: 
110:     return {
111:       checksum,
112:       total_rows: rows.length,
113:       total_fees: totalFees,
114:       total_cod: totalCod,
115:       rows,
116:     };
117:   }
118: }
119: 
120: export const CsvStatementParser = StatementCsvAdapter;
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/adapters/ghn.adapter.ts">
  1: // ============================================================================
  2: // Ship Dễ — GHN Carrier Adapter (Giao Hàng Nhanh - Tier L2 Execute)
  3: // Tập 1 Mục 5, Tập 2 CN-04, CN-06, CN-10, CN-17
  4: // ============================================================================
  5: 
  6: import {
  7:   BaseCarrierAdapter,
  8:   CarrierTrackingResult,
  9:   ReattemptRequestPayload,
 10:   ReattemptResponse,
 11:   CreateTicketRequestPayload,
 12:   CreateTicketResponse,
 13: } from './base.carrier';
 14: import { CarrierCapabilityTier, CarrierCode, ShipmentStatus } from '../types/domain';
 15: import { ERROR_CATALOG, ShipDeAppError } from '../types/error-codes';
 16: 
 17: export class GhnCarrierAdapter extends BaseCarrierAdapter {
 18:   public readonly carrierCode = CarrierCode.GHN;
 19:   public readonly defaultTier = CarrierCapabilityTier.L2_EXECUTE;
 20: 
 21:   // In-memory idempotency cache for simulation / testing
 22:   private idempotencyRequests = new Map<string, ReattemptRequestPayload>();
 23: 
 24:   public normalizeStatus(rawStatus: string): ShipmentStatus {
 25:     const s = rawStatus.toLowerCase().trim();
 26:     switch (s) {
 27:       case 'ready_to_pick':
 28:       case 'picking':
 29:       case 'money_collect_picking':
 30:         return ShipmentStatus.PICKING;
 31: 
 32:       case 'storing':
 33:       case 'sorting':
 34:       case 'transporting':
 35:         return ShipmentStatus.IN_TRANSIT;
 36: 
 37:       case 'delivering':
 38:       case 'money_collect_delivering':
 39:         return ShipmentStatus.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY;
 40: 
 41:       case 'delivered':
 42:         return ShipmentStatus.DELIVERED;
 43: 
 44:       case 'delivery_fail':
 45:       case 'waiting_to_return':
 46:       case 'return':
 47:         return ShipmentStatus.RETURNING;
 48: 
 49:       case 'returned':
 50:         return ShipmentStatus.RETURNED;
 51: 
 52:       case 'cancel':
 53:         return ShipmentStatus.CANCELLED;
 54: 
 55:       case 'lost':
 56:         return ShipmentStatus.LOST;
 57: 
 58:       case 'damage':
 59:         return ShipmentStatus.DAMAGED;
 60: 
 61:       default:
 62:         // Mã trạng thái lạ -> không đoán mò (BR-18)
 63:         return ShipmentStatus.IN_TRANSIT;
 64:     }
 65:   }
 66: 
 67:   public async trackShipment(
 68:     trackingCode: string,
 69:     credentials: Record<string, string>
 70:   ): Promise<CarrierTrackingResult> {
 71:     if (!credentials.token) {
 72:       throw new ShipDeAppError(ERROR_CATALOG.CARRIER_AUTH_FAILED, {
 73:         carrier: 'GHN',
 74:         reason: 'Missing GHN API Token',
 75:       });
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     // Giả lập dữ liệu trả về từ API GHN
 79:     const occurredAt = new Date();
 80:     return {
 81:       tracking_code: trackingCode,
 82:       raw_status: 'delivering',
 83:       normalized_status: ShipmentStatus.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY,
 84:       occurred_at: occurredAt,
 85:       location: 'Kho GHN Tân Bình, TP.HCM',
 86:       raw_payload: {
 87:         order_code: trackingCode,
 88:         status: 'delivering',
 89:         updated_date: occurredAt.toISOString(),
 90:       },
 91:     };
 92:   }
 93: 
 94:   public async requestReattempt(
 95:     payload: ReattemptRequestPayload,
 96:     credentials: Record<string, string>,
 97:     activeTier: CarrierCapabilityTier = this.defaultTier
 98:   ): Promise<ReattemptResponse> {
 99:     // 1. Kiểm tra nếu hãng bị hạ cấp xuống L1 (BR-26, BR-44, E2E-10)
100:     if (activeTier === CarrierCapabilityTier.L1_ASSIST) {
101:       return {
102:         success: true,
103:         tier_executed: CarrierCapabilityTier.L1_ASSIST,
104:         instruction_note: `[GHN L1 Mode] Xuất hồ sơ yêu cầu giao lại cho đơn ${payload.tracking_code}. Vui lòng gửi tại khachhang.ghn.vn`,
105:       };
106:     }
107: 
108:     if (activeTier === CarrierCapabilityTier.L0_OBSERVE) {
109:       throw new ShipDeAppError(ERROR_CATALOG.CARRIER_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED, {
110:         carrier: 'GHN',
111:         tier: 'L0',
112:         action: 'requestReattempt',
113:       });
114:     }
115: 
116:     // 2. Kiểm tra Idempotency (BR-01)
117:     if (this.idempotencyRequests.has(payload.idempotency_key)) {
118:       const existing = this.idempotencyRequests.get(payload.idempotency_key)!;
119:       if (existing.tracking_code !== payload.tracking_code || existing.note !== payload.note) {
120:         throw new ShipDeAppError(ERROR_CATALOG.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, {
121:           idempotency_key: payload.idempotency_key,
122:         });
123:       }
124:       return {
125:         success: true,
126:         reference_id: `GHN_RE_${payload.tracking_code}_CACHED`,
127:         scheduled_at: payload.scheduled_date || new Date(),
128:         tier_executed: CarrierCapabilityTier.L2_EXECUTE,
129:       };
130:     }
131: 
132:     this.idempotencyRequests.set(payload.idempotency_key, payload);
133: 
134:     // 3. Thực thi gọi API GHN L2 Execute
135:     return {
136:       success: true,
137:       reference_id: `GHN_RE_${Date.now()}_${payload.tracking_code}`,
138:       scheduled_at: payload.scheduled_date || new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600 * 1000),
139:       tier_executed: CarrierCapabilityTier.L2_EXECUTE,
140:     };
141:   }
142: 
143:   public async createTicket(
144:     payload: CreateTicketRequestPayload,
145:     credentials: Record<string, string>,
146:     activeTier: CarrierCapabilityTier = this.defaultTier
147:   ): Promise<CreateTicketResponse> {
148:     if (activeTier === CarrierCapabilityTier.L1_ASSIST) {
149:       return {
150:         status: 'ASSIST_PACKAGE_READY',
151:         tier_executed: CarrierCapabilityTier.L1_ASSIST,
152:         portal_export_package_url: `https://storage.shipde.net/evidence/ghn_ticket_${payload.tracking_code}.zip`,
153:       };
154:     }
155: 
156:     return {
157:       ticket_id: `GHN_TICKET_${Date.now()}`,
158:       status: 'SUBMITTED_VIA_API',
159:       tier_executed: CarrierCapabilityTier.L2_EXECUTE,
160:     };
161:   }
162: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/adapters/ghtk.adapter.ts">
  1: // ============================================================================
  2: // Ship Dễ — GHTK Carrier Adapter (Giao Hàng Tiết Kiệm - Tier L1 Assist)
  3: // Tập 1 Mục 5, Tập 2 CN-04, CN-06, CN-10, CN-17
  4: // ============================================================================
  5: 
  6: import {
  7:   BaseCarrierAdapter,
  8:   CarrierTrackingResult,
  9:   ReattemptRequestPayload,
 10:   ReattemptResponse,
 11:   CreateTicketRequestPayload,
 12:   CreateTicketResponse,
 13: } from './base.carrier';
 14: import { CarrierCapabilityTier, CarrierCode, ShipmentStatus } from '../types/domain';
 15: import { ERROR_CATALOG, ShipDeAppError } from '../types/error-codes';
 16: 
 17: export class GhtkCarrierAdapter extends BaseCarrierAdapter {
 18:   public readonly carrierCode = CarrierCode.GHTK;
 19:   public readonly defaultTier = CarrierCapabilityTier.L1_ASSIST;
 20: 
 21:   public normalizeStatus(rawStatus: string): ShipmentStatus {
 22:     const code = rawStatus.toString().trim();
 23:     switch (code) {
 24:       case '1': // Chưa tiếp nhận
 25:       case '2': // Đã tiếp nhận
 26:         return ShipmentStatus.PICKING;
 27: 
 28:       case '3': // Đã lấy hàng / Đang lưu kho
 29:       case '12': // Đang luân chuyển
 30:         return ShipmentStatus.IN_TRANSIT;
 31: 
 32:       case '4': // Đang giao hàng
 33:       case '7': // Không liên lạc được
 34:       case '8': // Delay giao hàng
 35:         return ShipmentStatus.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY;
 36: 
 37:       case '5': // Đã giao hàng
 38:       case '6': // Đã đối soát
 39:         return ShipmentStatus.DELIVERED;
 40: 
 41:       case '9': // Không giao được / Chờ duyệt hoàn
 42:       case '10': // Delay trả hàng
 43:       case '11': // Đang trả hàng
 44:         return ShipmentStatus.RETURNING;
 45: 
 46:       case '21': // Đã trả hàng
 47:         return ShipmentStatus.RETURNED;
 48: 
 49:       case '-1': // Hủy đơn
 50:         return ShipmentStatus.CANCELLED;
 51: 
 52:       case '20': // Thất lạc
 53:         return ShipmentStatus.LOST;
 54: 
 55:       case '13': // Hư hỏng
 56:         return ShipmentStatus.DAMAGED;
 57: 
 58:       default:
 59:         return ShipmentStatus.IN_TRANSIT;
 60:     }
 61:   }
 62: 
 63:   public async trackShipment(
 64:     trackingCode: string,
 65:     credentials: Record<string, string>
 66:   ): Promise<CarrierTrackingResult> {
 67:     if (!credentials.token) {
 68:       throw new ShipDeAppError(ERROR_CATALOG.CARRIER_AUTH_FAILED, {
 69:         carrier: 'GHTK',
 70:         reason: 'Missing GHTK API Token',
 71:       });
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     const occurredAt = new Date();
 75:     return {
 76:       tracking_code: trackingCode,
 77:       raw_status: '4',
 78:       normalized_status: ShipmentStatus.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY,
 79:       occurred_at: occurredAt,
 80:       location: 'Kho GHTK Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội',
 81:       raw_payload: {
 82:         order: {
 83:           label_id: trackingCode,
 84:           status: '4',
 85:           status_text: 'Đang giao hàng',
 86:           created: occurredAt.toISOString(),
 87:         },
 88:       },
 89:     };
 90:   }
 91: 
 92:   public async requestReattempt(
 93:     payload: ReattemptRequestPayload,
 94:     credentials: Record<string, string>,
 95:     activeTier: CarrierCapabilityTier = this.defaultTier
 96:   ): Promise<ReattemptResponse> {
 97:     // GHTK ở R1 là L1 Assist: Không gọi API reattempt vì API công khai không có endpoint này.
 98:     // Trả về gói hồ sơ hỗ trợ và hướng dẫn cho shop thực hiện tại portal khachhang.giaohangtietkiem.vn (BR-44)
 99:     return {
100:       success: true,
101:       tier_executed: CarrierCapabilityTier.L1_ASSIST,
102:       instruction_note: `[GHTK L1 Assist] Đã chuẩn bị hồ sơ hẹn giao lại cho đơn ${payload.tracking_code} (Lý do: ${payload.note}). Vui lòng bấm gửi tại khachhang.giaohangtietkiem.vn`,
103:     };
104:   }
105: 
106:   public async createTicket(
107:     payload: CreateTicketRequestPayload,
108:     credentials: Record<string, string>,
109:     activeTier: CarrierCapabilityTier = this.defaultTier
110:   ): Promise<CreateTicketResponse> {
111:     // GHTK L1: Xuất gói chứng từ hồ sơ chuẩn bị sẵn
112:     return {
113:       status: 'ASSIST_PACKAGE_GENERATED',
114:       tier_executed: CarrierCapabilityTier.L1_ASSIST,
115:       portal_export_package_url: `https://storage.shipde.net/evidence/ghtk_claim_${payload.tracking_code}.zip`,
116:     };
117:   }
118: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/carrier-accounts/route.ts">
 1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
 2: import { db } from '@/server/db';
 3: import { CarrierAccount, CarrierCode, CarrierCapabilityTier } from '@/types/domain';
 4: 
 5: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
 6:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: db.carrierAccounts });
 7: }
 8: 
 9: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
10:   try {
11:     const body = await req.json();
12:     const { action, carrier_code, account_name, token, client_id, capability_tier, account_id } =
13:       body;
14: 
15:     // Toggle / Update Capability Tier (E2E-10, BR-19)
16:     if (action === 'TOGGLE_TIER') {
17:       const acc = db.carrierAccounts.find(
18:         (a) => a.id === account_id || a.carrier_code === carrier_code
19:       );
20:       if (!acc) {
21:         return NextResponse.json(
22:           { error: { code: 'account_not_found', message: 'Không tìm thấy tài khoản hãng' } },
23:           { status: 404 }
24:         );
25:       }
26: 
27:       acc.capability_tier =
28:         acc.capability_tier === CarrierCapabilityTier.L2_EXECUTE
29:           ? CarrierCapabilityTier.L1_ASSIST
30:           : CarrierCapabilityTier.L2_EXECUTE;
31: 
32:       return NextResponse.json({
33:         success: true,
34:         message: `Đã cập nhật mức năng lực ${acc.carrier_code} sang [${acc.capability_tier}] tức thì mà không cần deploy code.`,
35:         data: acc,
36:       });
37:     }
38: 
39:     // Add New Carrier Account / Test Connection
40:     if (action === 'CONNECT_CARRIER') {
41:       if (!carrier_code || !token) {
42:         return NextResponse.json(
43:           {
44:             error: { code: 'validation_error', message: 'Vui lòng cung cấp mã hãng và API Token' },
45:           },
46:           { status: 400 }
47:         );
48:       }
49: 
50:       const maskedToken = `${carrier_code.toLowerCase()}_token_••••••••••••${token.slice(-4) || '9999'}`;
51: 
52:       const newAccount: CarrierAccount = {
53:         id: `acc_${carrier_code.toLowerCase()}_${Date.now()}`,
54:         merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
55:         carrier_code: carrier_code as CarrierCode,
56:         account_name: account_name || `${carrier_code} Express - Mới`,
57:         capability_tier:
58:           carrier_code === 'GHN'
59:             ? CarrierCapabilityTier.L2_EXECUTE
60:             : CarrierCapabilityTier.L1_ASSIST,
61:         is_active: true,
62:         credentials_masked: maskedToken,
63:         created_at: new Date(),
64:       };
65: 
66:       db.carrierAccounts.push(newAccount);
67: 
68:       return NextResponse.json({
69:         success: true,
70:         message: `Kết nối thành công tài khoản ${carrier_code} với mức năng lực ${newAccount.capability_tier}`,
71:         data: newAccount,
72:       });
73:     }
74: 
75:     return NextResponse.json(
76:       { error: { code: 'bad_request', message: 'Hành động không hợp lệ' } },
77:       { status: 400 }
78:     );
79:   } catch (error: any) {
80:     return NextResponse.json(
81:       { error: { code: 'server_error', message: error.message } },
82:       { status: 500 }
83:     );
84:   }
85: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/exceptions/route.ts">
  1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  2: import { db } from '@/server/db';
  3: import { ExceptionEngine } from '@/core/exception-engine';
  4: import { GhnCarrierAdapter } from '@/adapters/ghn.adapter';
  5: import { GhtkCarrierAdapter } from '@/adapters/ghtk.adapter';
  6: import { CarrierCapabilityTier, ExceptionCaseStatus, ShipmentStatus } from '@/types/domain';
  7: 
  8: const excEngine = new ExceptionEngine();
  9: const ghnAdapter = new GhnCarrierAdapter();
 10: const ghtkAdapter = new GhtkCarrierAdapter();
 11: 
 12: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
 13:   try {
 14:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
 15:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
 16:     const search = searchParams.get('q')?.toLowerCase();
 17: 
 18:     let list = db.exceptionCases.map((exc) => {
 19:       const shipment = db.shipments.find(
 20:         (s) => s.id === exc.shipment_id || s.tracking_code === exc.tracking_code
 21:       );
 22:       const order = shipment
 23:         ? db.orders.find((o) => o.id === shipment.order_id || o.order_code === shipment.order_code)
 24:         : undefined;
 25:       return {
 26:         ...exc,
 27:         order_code: shipment?.order_code || `ORD_${exc.tracking_code}`,
 28:         carrier_code:
 29:           shipment?.carrier_code || (exc.tracking_code.startsWith('GHN') ? 'GHN' : 'GHTK'),
 30:         customer_name: order?.recipient_name || 'Khách hàng',
 31:         customer_phone: order?.recipient_phone || '0912345678',
 32:         customer_address: order?.recipient_address || 'Địa chỉ giao hàng',
 33:         cod_amount: shipment?.cod_amount || order?.cod_amount || 450000,
 34:       };
 35:     });
 36: 
 37:     if (status) {
 38:       list = list.filter((e) => e.status === status);
 39:     }
 40:     if (search) {
 41:       list = list.filter(
 42:         (e) =>
 43:           e.tracking_code.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 44:           e.order_code.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 45:           e.customer_name.toLowerCase().includes(search)
 46:       );
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, total: list.length, data: list });
 50:   } catch (error: any) {
 51:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
 52:   }
 53: }
 54: 
 55: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
 56:   try {
 57:     const body = await req.json();
 58:     const {
 59:       action,
 60:       case_id,
 61:       tracking_code,
 62:       carrier_code,
 63:       note,
 64:       new_phone,
 65:       scheduled_date,
 66:       user_id,
 67:       user_name,
 68:       override_tier,
 69:       call_result,
 70:     } = body;
 71: 
 72:     const targetCase = db.exceptionCases.find(
 73:       (e) => e.id === case_id || e.tracking_code === tracking_code
 74:     );
 75:     if (!targetCase) {
 76:       return NextResponse.json(
 77:         { error: { code: 'case_not_found', message: 'Không tìm thấy hồ sơ ngoại lệ' } },
 78:         { status: 404 }
 79:       );
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     const targetShipment = db.shipments.find(
 83:       (s) => s.id === targetCase.shipment_id || s.tracking_code === targetCase.tracking_code
 84:     );
 85:     if (!targetShipment) {
 86:       return NextResponse.json(
 87:         { error: { code: 'shipment_not_found', message: 'Không tìm thấy vận đơn tương ứng' } },
 88:         { status: 404 }
 89:       );
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     // DISPATCH REATTEMPT (CN-10)
 93:     if (action === 'DISPATCH_REATTEMPT' || !action) {
 94:       const carrierAccount = db.carrierAccounts.find(
 95:         (a) => a.carrier_code === targetShipment.carrier_code
 96:       );
 97:       const adapter = targetShipment.carrier_code === 'GHN' ? ghnAdapter : ghtkAdapter;
 98:       const currentTier = override_tier || carrierAccount?.capability_tier || adapter.defaultTier;
 99: 
100:       const result = await excEngine.dispatchReattempt(
101:         targetCase,
102:         targetShipment,
103:         adapter,
104:         { token: 'valid_carrier_token' },
105:         {
106:           userId: user_id || 'usr_02',
107:           userName: user_name || 'Trần Thị Hoa (CSKH)',
108:           note: note || 'Khách hẹn giao lại ca chiều',
109:           scheduledDate: scheduled_date ? new Date(scheduled_date) : undefined,
110:           newPhone: new_phone,
111:           overrideTier: currentTier as CarrierCapabilityTier,
112:         }
113:       );
114: 
115:       // Update Database State
116:       targetCase.status = ExceptionCaseStatus.REATTEMPT_REQUESTED;
117:       targetCase.version += 1;
118:       targetShipment.last_modified_by = user_id || 'usr_02';
119:       targetShipment.version += 1;
120: 
121:       // Add timeline event
122:       db.shipmentEvents.unshift({
123:         id: `evt_${Date.now()}`,
124:         shipment_id: targetShipment.id,
125:         raw_status: 'reattempt_scheduled',
126:         normalized_status: ShipmentStatus.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY,
127:         occurred_at: new Date(),
128:         received_at: new Date(),
129:         source: 'POLLING',
130:         raw_payload: {
131:           action: 'DISPATCH_REATTEMPT',
132:           executed_by: user_name || 'CSKH',
133:           tier: result.tier_executed,
134:           note: note || 'Khách hẹn giao lại',
135:           reference_id: result.reference_id,
136:         },
137:       });
138: 
139:       return NextResponse.json({
140:         success: true,
141:         message:
142:           result.tier_executed === CarrierCapabilityTier.L2_EXECUTE
143:             ? 'Đã gửi yêu cầu hẹn giao lại trực tiếp qua API hãng thành công (GHN L2)'
144:             : 'Đã tạo và xuất trọn gói hồ sơ hỗ trợ CSKH gửi cổng hãng (GHTK L1 Assist)',
145:         data: {
146:           case: targetCase,
147:           shipment: targetShipment,
148:           reattempt_result: result,
149:         },
150:       });
151:     }
152: 
153:     // RECORD CONTACT LOG (CN-09)
154:     if (action === 'RECORD_CONTACT') {
155:       db.shipmentEvents.unshift({
156:         id: `evt_${Date.now()}`,
157:         shipment_id: targetShipment.id,
158:         raw_status: 'cskh_contact_logged',
159:         normalized_status: targetShipment.current_status,
160:         occurred_at: new Date(),
161:         received_at: new Date(),
162:         source: 'POLLING',
163:         raw_payload: {
164:           call_result: call_result || 'CONNECTED',
165:           note: note || 'Đã liên hệ với khách hàng',
166:           staff: user_name || 'CSKH Staff',
167:         },
168:       });
169: 
170:       return NextResponse.json({
171:         success: true,
172:         message: 'Ghi nhận nhật ký liên hệ khách hàng thành công (CN-09)',
173:         data: targetCase,
174:       });
175:     }
176: 
177:     return NextResponse.json(
178:       { error: { code: 'bad_request', message: 'Hành động không hợp lệ' } },
179:       { status: 400 }
180:     );
181:   } catch (error: any) {
182:     const status = error.httpStatus || 500;
183:     return NextResponse.json(
184:       {
185:         error: {
186:           code: error.code || 'server_error',
187:           message: error.message,
188:           details: error.details,
189:         },
190:       },
191:       { status }
192:     );
193:   }
194: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/ledgers/route.ts">
 1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
 2: import { db } from '@/server/db';
 3: import { ThreeLedgersCalculator } from '@/core/ledger-calculator';
 4: import { ExceptionCaseStatus } from '@/types/domain';
 5: 
 6: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
 7:   try {
 8:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
 9:     const format = searchParams.get('format'); // 'json' | 'csv'
10: 
11:     const calculator = new ThreeLedgersCalculator();
12: 
13:     const rescuedCases = db.exceptionCases
14:       .filter((e) => e.status === ExceptionCaseStatus.RESCUED)
15:       .map((caseRecord) => {
16:         const shipment = db.shipments.find(
17:           (s) => s.id === caseRecord.shipment_id || s.tracking_code === caseRecord.tracking_code
18:         );
19:         return {
20:           caseRecord,
21:           shipment: shipment || (db.shipments[0] as any),
22:           returnFee: 15000, // BR-50
23:         };
24:       });
25: 
26:     // If no rescued cases yet, supply sample verified rescue item
27:     if (rescuedCases.length === 0) {
28:       rescuedCases.push({
29:         caseRecord: {
30:           id: 'case_res_01',
31:           merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
32:           shipment_id: 'ship_04',
33:           tracking_code: 'GHN88291255',
34:           exception_type: 'DELIVERY_FAIL' as any,
35:           status: ExceptionCaseStatus.RESCUED,
36:           deadline_at: new Date(),
37:           priority_score: 70,
38:           version: 1,
39:           can_reattempt: false,
40:           created_at: new Date(),
41:         },
42:         shipment: db.shipments[3] || db.shipments[0],
43:         returnFee: 15000,
44:       });
45:     }
46: 
47:     const report = calculator.generateReport(
48:       db.merchant.id,
49:       new Date('2026-08-01'),
50:       new Date('2026-08-31'),
51:       db.claims,
52:       rescuedCases as any,
53:       db.shipments,
54:       5
55:     );
56: 
57:     // CSV EXPORT FORMAT (CN-18)
58:     if (format === 'csv') {
59:       const csvHeader = 'Sổ,Chỉ mục,Giá trị (VND / Chỉ số),Ghi chú quy tắc\n';
60:       const csvRows = [
61:         `Sổ 1 (Tiền thực nhận),Tổng tiền bồi thường đã về tài khoản,${report.ledger1_real_cash.total_recovered_amount},Tiền thực nhận qua bank/cấn trừ kỳ sau`,
62:         `Sổ 1 (Tiền thực nhận),Tiền hãng đã chấp thuận (chờ đối soát),${report.ledger1_real_cash.pending_acceptance_amount},Cột riêng không cộng dồn`,
63:         `Sổ 2 (Đơn cứu được),Số đơn cứu thành công,${report.ledger2_rescued_orders.rescued_orders_count},Đơn giao lại thành công`,
64:         `Sổ 2 (Đơn cứu được),Phí chiều hoàn tránh được,${report.ledger2_rescued_orders.total_return_fee_saved},BR-50: Không cộng cước đi`,
65:         `Sổ 2 (Đơn cứu được),Giá trị hàng hóa cứu được (GMV),${report.ledger2_rescued_orders.rescued_gmv},Chỉ số theo dõi riêng`,
66:         `Sổ 3 (Độ phủ kiểm soát),Tỷ lệ đơn cập nhật trong 24h,${report.ledger3_control_metrics.realtime_tracking_coverage_pct}%,Chỉ số minh bạch vận hành`,
67:         `Sổ 3 (Độ phủ kiểm soát),Giờ công kế toán tiết kiệm,${report.ledger3_control_metrics.accounting_hours_saved} giờ,Thời gian đối soát tự động hóa`,
68:       ].join('\n');
69: 
70:       return new NextResponse(csvHeader + csvRows, {
71:         headers: {
72:           'Content-Type': 'text/csv; charset=utf-8',
73:           'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="shipde_ba_so_gia_tri_${Date.now()}.csv"`,
74:         },
75:       });
76:     }
77: 
78:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: report });
79:   } catch (error: any) {
80:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
81:   }
82: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/rate-cards/route.ts">
 1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
 2: import { db } from '@/server/db';
 3: import { RateCard, RateTier } from '@/types/domain';
 4: 
 5: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
 6:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data: db.rateCards });
 7: }
 8: 
 9: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
10:   try {
11:     const body = await req.json();
12:     const { carrier_account_id, volumetric_divisor, cod_payout_sla_days, tiers } = body;
13: 
14:     if (!tiers || !Array.isArray(tiers) || tiers.length === 0) {
15:       return NextResponse.json(
16:         { error: { code: 'validation_error', message: 'Biểu giá phải có ít nhất 1 bậc cước' } },
17:         { status: 400 }
18:       );
19:     }
20: 
21:     const rateCardId = `rc_${Date.now()}`;
22:     const newTiers: RateTier[] = tiers.map((t: any, idx: number) => ({
23:       id: `tier_${rateCardId}_${idx + 1}`,
24:       rate_card_id: rateCardId,
25:       route_type: t.route_type || 'INTRA_PROVINCE',
26:       weight_from_g: Number(t.weight_from_g) || 0,
27:       weight_to_g: Number(t.weight_to_g) || 500,
28:       base_fee: Number(t.base_fee) || 22000,
29:       step_fee: Number(t.step_fee) || 5000,
30:       step_weight_g: Number(t.step_weight_g) || 500,
31:     }));
32: 
33:     const newRateCard: RateCard = {
34:       id: rateCardId,
35:       merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
36:       carrier_account_id: carrier_account_id || db.carrierAccounts[0]?.id || 'acc_ghn_01',
37:       version: 1,
38:       effective_from: new Date(),
39:       effective_to: null,
40:       volumetric_divisor: Number(volumetric_divisor) || 5000,
41:       cod_payout_sla_days: Number(cod_payout_sla_days) || 3,
42:       checksum: `sha256_rc_${Date.now()}`,
43:       tiers: newTiers,
44:     };
45: 
46:     db.rateCards.unshift(newRateCard);
47: 
48:     return NextResponse.json({
49:       success: true,
50:       message: 'Cấu hình biểu giá hợp đồng thành công (CN-25)',
51:       data: newRateCard,
52:     });
53:   } catch (error: any) {
54:     return NextResponse.json(
55:       { error: { code: 'server_error', message: error.message } },
56:       { status: 500 }
57:     );
58:   }
59: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/reconciliation/route.ts">
  1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  2: import { db } from '@/server/db';
  3: import { ReconciliationEngine } from '@/core/reconciliation';
  4: import { MakerCheckerEngine } from '@/core/maker-checker';
  5: import { CsvStatementParser } from '@/adapters/csv.adapter';
  6: import { DiscrepancyResolution, ShipmentStatus } from '@/types/domain';
  7: 
  8: const reconEngine = new ReconciliationEngine();
  9: const mcEngine = new MakerCheckerEngine();
 10: const csvParser = new CsvStatementParser();
 11: 
 12: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
 13:   try {
 14:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
 15:     const search = searchParams.get('q')?.toLowerCase();
 16:     const type = searchParams.get('type');
 17:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
 18: 
 19:     let list = db.discrepancies.map((d) => {
 20:       const ship = db.shipments.find((s) => s.tracking_code === d.tracking_code);
 21:       return {
 22:         ...d,
 23:         order_code: ship?.order_code || `ORD_${d.tracking_code}`,
 24:         carrier: ship?.carrier_code || (d.tracking_code.startsWith('GHN') ? 'GHN' : 'GHTK'),
 25:         created_by_user: ship?.last_modified_by,
 26:         charged_amount: ship?.charged_fee || 29000,
 27:         contract_amount: ship?.quoted_fee || 22000,
 28:         discrepancy_amount: d.amount,
 29:       };
 30:     });
 31: 
 32:     if (search) {
 33:       list = list.filter(
 34:         (d) =>
 35:           d.tracking_code.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 36:           d.order_code.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 37:           (d.reason && d.reason.toLowerCase().includes(search))
 38:       );
 39:     }
 40:     if (type) {
 41:       list = list.filter((d) => d.type === type);
 42:     }
 43:     if (status) {
 44:       list = list.filter((d) => d.status === status);
 45:     }
 46: 
 47:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, total: list.length, data: list });
 48:   } catch (error: any) {
 49:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
 50:   }
 51: }
 52: 
 53: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
 54:   try {
 55:     const body = await req.json();
 56:     const {
 57:       action,
 58:       discrepancy_id,
 59:       resolution,
 60:       reason,
 61:       user_id,
 62:       user_name,
 63:       expected_version,
 64:       is_period_closed,
 65:       csv_content,
 66:       statement_name,
 67:     } = body;
 68: 
 69:     // RESOLVE DISCREPANCY (BR-12, BR-11, BR-27)
 70:     if (action === 'RESOLVE_DISCREPANCY') {
 71:       const targetDisc = db.discrepancies.find((d) => d.id === discrepancy_id);
 72:       if (!targetDisc) {
 73:         return NextResponse.json(
 74:           { error: { code: 'discrepancy_not_found', message: 'Không tìm thấy dòng sai lệch' } },
 75:           { status: 404 }
 76:         );
 77:       }
 78: 
 79:       const targetShipment = db.shipments.find(
 80:         (s) => s.id === targetDisc.shipment_id || s.tracking_code === targetDisc.tracking_code
 81:       ) || {
 82:         id: `ship_${targetDisc.tracking_code}`,
 83:         merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
 84:         tracking_code: targetDisc.tracking_code,
 85:         order_code: `ORD_${targetDisc.tracking_code}`,
 86:         carrier_code: 'GHN',
 87:         carrier_account_id: 'acc_ghn_01',
 88:         current_status: ShipmentStatus.DELIVERED,
 89:         declared_weight_g: 500,
 90:         quoted_fee: 22000,
 91:         cod_amount: 500000,
 92:         created_at: new Date(),
 93:         version: 1,
 94:         last_modified_by: undefined,
 95:       };
 96: 
 97:       const updated = mcEngine.resolveDiscrepancy(
 98:         targetDisc,
 99:         targetShipment as any,
100:         {
101:           discrepancy_id,
102:           resolution: (resolution as DiscrepancyResolution) || DiscrepancyResolution.CONFIRMED,
103:           reason: reason || 'Đã đối soát xong',
104:           user_id: user_id || 'usr_03',
105:           user_name: user_name || 'Lê Minh Kế Toán',
106:           expected_version: expected_version || targetDisc.version,
107:         },
108:         Boolean(is_period_closed)
109:       );
110: 
111:       // Auto-create claim if user selected DISPUTE
112:       if (resolution === DiscrepancyResolution.DISPUTE) {
113:         db.claims.unshift({
114:           id: `clm_${Date.now()}`,
115:           merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
116:           shipment_id: targetShipment.id,
117:           discrepancy_id: targetDisc.id,
118:           claim_type: targetDisc.type,
119:           carrier_ticket: `TCK_${targetDisc.tracking_code}_${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
120:           requested_amount: targetDisc.amount,
121:           accepted_amount: 0,
122:           recovered_amount: 0,
123:           status: 'SUBMITTED',
124:           deadline_at: new Date(Date.now() + 48 * 3600 * 1000), // 48h SLA
125:           created_at: new Date(),
126:           updated_at: new Date(),
127:         });
128:       }
129: 
130:       return NextResponse.json({
131:         success: true,
132:         message: 'Xử lý chênh lệch thành công (Tuân thủ tách quyền tài chính BR-12)',
133:         data: updated,
134:       });
135:     }
136: 
137:     // UPLOAD & RUN STATEMENT 6-RULE RECONCILIATION (CN-13, CN-14, D1..D7)
138:     if (action === 'UPLOAD_STATEMENT') {
139:       const rateCard = db.rateCards[0];
140:       const statementId = `stmt_${Date.now()}`;
141: 
142:       // Simulate parsing statement rows
143:       const parsedRows = [
144:         {
145:           id: `row_${Date.now()}_1`,
146:           statement_id: statementId,
147:           line_number: 1,
148:           tracking_code: 'GHN88290500',
149:           fee_type: 'MAIN_FREIGHT',
150:           charged_weight_g: 800,
151:           charged_fee: 29000,
152:           cod_collected: 320000,
153:           match_status: 'MATCHED_EXACT' as any,
154:           matched_shipment_id: 'ship_03',
155:         },
156:       ];
157: 
158:       const reconResult = reconEngine.runReconciliation(
159:         statementId,
160:         db.merchant.id,
161:         parsedRows as any,
162:         db.shipments,
163:         rateCard
164:       );
165: 
166:       // Merge newly discovered discrepancies into DB
167:       reconResult.discrepancies.forEach((newD) => {
168:         if (
169:           !db.discrepancies.some(
170:             (d) => d.tracking_code === newD.tracking_code && d.type === newD.type
171:           )
172:         ) {
173:           db.discrepancies.unshift(newD);
174:         }
175:       });
176: 
177:       return NextResponse.json({
178:         success: true,
179:         message: `Đã nạp sao kê ${statement_name || 'kỳ mới'} và chạy xong 6 phép dò sai lệch D1-D7`,
180:         data: {
181:           statement_id: statementId,
182:           summary: reconResult.summary,
183:           discrepancies_found: reconResult.discrepancies.length,
184:         },
185:       });
186:     }
187: 
188:     // CLOSE RECONCILIATION PERIOD (BR-11)
189:     if (action === 'CLOSE_PERIOD') {
190:       const validation = mcEngine.validatePeriodClosure(db.discrepancies);
191:       return NextResponse.json({
192:         success: true,
193:         message:
194:           'Đã chốt sổ kỳ đối soát thành công. Số liệu kế toán đã được khóa bất biến (BR-11).',
195:         data: validation,
196:       });
197:     }
198: 
199:     return NextResponse.json(
200:       { error: { code: 'bad_request', message: 'Hành động không hợp lệ' } },
201:       { status: 400 }
202:     );
203:   } catch (error: any) {
204:     const status = error.httpStatus || 500;
205:     return NextResponse.json(
206:       {
207:         error: {
208:           code: error.code || 'server_error',
209:           message: error.message,
210:           details: error.details,
211:         },
212:       },
213:       { status }
214:     );
215:   }
216: }
</file>

  1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  2: import { db } from '@/server/db';
  3: import { OfflineScanQueueManager, OfflineScanCommand } from '@/core/offline-queue';
  4: import { ReturnRecord, ShipmentStatus } from '@/types/domain';
  5: 
  6: const queueManager = new OfflineScanQueueManager();
  7: 
  8: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  9:   try {
 10:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
 11:     const search = searchParams.get('q')?.toLowerCase();
 12: 
 13:     let list = db.returnRecords.map((r) => {
 14:       const ship = db.shipments.find((s) => s.tracking_code === r.tracking_code);
 15:       const order = ship ? db.orders.find((o) => o.order_code === ship.order_code) : undefined;
 16:       return {
 17:         ...r,
 18:         order_code: ship?.order_code || `ORD_${r.tracking_code}`,
 19:         carrier: ship?.carrier_code || (r.tracking_code.startsWith('GHN') ? 'GHN' : 'GHTK'),
 20:         customer_name: order?.recipient_name || 'Khách hàng',
 21:         cod_amount: ship?.cod_amount || order?.cod_amount || 0,
 22:       };
 23:     });
 24: 
 25:     if (search) {
 26:       list = list.filter(
 27:         (r) =>
 28:           r.tracking_code.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 29:           r.order_code.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 30:           r.customer_name.toLowerCase().includes(search)
 31:       );
 32:     }
 33: 
 34:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, total: list.length, data: list });
 35:   } catch (error: any) {
 36:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
 37:   }
 38: }
 39: 
 40: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
 41:   try {
 42:     const body = await req.json();
 43:     const {
 44:       action,
 45:       tracking_code,
 46:       warehouse_id,
 47:       condition,
 48:       evidence_urls,
 49:       scanned_by,
 50:       commands,
 51:       is_device_revoked,
 52:     } = body;
 53: 
 54:     // BATCH SYNC OFFLINE COMMANDS (BR-40)
 55:     if (action === 'SYNC_OFFLINE_BATCH' || commands) {
 56:       const result = queueManager.syncOfflineBatch(
 57:         (commands || []) as OfflineScanCommand[],
 58:         Boolean(is_device_revoked)
 59:       );
 60: 
 61:       // Persist newly scanned receipts into DB
 62:       commands?.forEach((cmd: OfflineScanCommand) => {
 63:         if (!db.returnRecords.some((r) => r.tracking_code === cmd.barcode)) {
 64:           const newReturn: ReturnRecord = {
 65:             id: `ret_${Date.now()}_${Math.floor(Math.random() * 999)}`,
 66:             merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
 67:             shipment_id: `ship_${cmd.barcode}`,
 68:             tracking_code: cmd.barcode,
 69:             warehouse_id: cmd.warehouse_id || 'wh_tanbinh',
 70:             condition: (cmd.condition as any) || 'intact',
 71:             scanned_at: new Date(cmd.captured_at),
 72:             scanned_by: cmd.user_id || 'usr_04',
 73:             evidence_urls: cmd.evidence_urls || [],
 74:           };
 75:           db.returnRecords.unshift(newReturn);
 76: 
 77:           const matchedShip = db.shipments.find((s) => s.tracking_code === cmd.barcode);
 78:           if (matchedShip) {
 79:             matchedShip.current_status = ShipmentStatus.RETURNED;
 80:           }
 81:         }
 82:       });
 83: 
 84:       return NextResponse.json({
 85:         success: true,
 86:         message: `Đồng bộ hoàn tất: ${result.newly_created} kiện mới ghi nhận, ${result.duplicates_skipped} lệnh trùng đã bỏ qua an toàn.`,
 87:         data: result,
 88:       });
 89:     }
 90: 
 91:     // SINGLE SCAN RECEIPT (CN-12)
 92:     if (!tracking_code) {
 93:       return NextResponse.json(
 94:         { error: { code: 'validation_error', message: 'Vui lòng quét hoặc nhập mã vận đơn' } },
 95:         { status: 400 }
 96:       );
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     const normCode = tracking_code.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
100: 
101:     // Mandatory Evidence Rule (BR-36)
102:     if (condition && condition !== 'intact' && (!evidence_urls || evidence_urls.length === 0)) {
103:       return NextResponse.json(
104:         {
105:           error: {
106:             code: 'evidence_required',
107:             message:
108:               'Hàng hoàn bị hư hỏng hoặc sai lệch bắt buộc phải đính kèm ảnh chụp chứng cứ (BR-36).',
109:           },
110:         },
111:         { status: 422 }
112:       );
113:     }
114: 
115:     const newRecord: ReturnRecord = {
116:       id: `ret_${Date.now()}`,
117:       merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
118:       shipment_id: `ship_${normCode}`,
119:       tracking_code: normCode,
120:       warehouse_id: warehouse_id || 'wh_tanbinh',
121:       condition: condition || 'intact',
122:       scanned_at: new Date(),
123:       scanned_by: scanned_by || 'usr_04',
124:       evidence_urls: evidence_urls || [],
125:     };
126: 
127:     db.returnRecords.unshift(newRecord);
128: 
129:     const matchedShipment = db.shipments.find((s) => s.tracking_code === normCode);
130:     if (matchedShipment) {
131:       matchedShipment.current_status = ShipmentStatus.RETURNED;
132:       matchedShipment.version += 1;
133:     }
134: 
135:     return NextResponse.json({
136:       success: true,
137:       message: `Đã quét nhận kiện hoàn ${normCode} vào kho thành công`,
138:       data: newRecord,
139:     });
140:   } catch (error: any) {
141:     const status = error.httpStatus || 500;
142:     return NextResponse.json(
143:       {
144:         error: {
145:           code: error.code || 'server_error',
146:           message: error.message,
147:           details: error.details,
148:         },
149:       },
150:       { status }
151:     );
152:   }
153: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/users/route.ts">
 1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
 2: import { db } from '@/server/db';
 3: import { User, Role } from '@/types/domain';
 4: 
 5: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
 6:   return NextResponse.json({
 7:     success: true,
 8:     data: {
 9:       users: db.users,
10:       device_sessions: db.deviceSessions,
11:     },
12:   });
13: }
14: 
15: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
16:   try {
17:     const body = await req.json();
18:     const { action, full_name, email, phone, role, device_id } = body;
19: 
20:     // INVITE MEMBER (CN-24)
21:     if (action === 'INVITE_USER') {
22:       if (!full_name || !email || !role) {
23:         return NextResponse.json(
24:           {
25:             error: {
26:               code: 'validation_error',
27:               message: 'Vui lòng cung cấp họ tên, email và vai trò',
28:             },
29:           },
30:           { status: 400 }
31:         );
32:       }
33: 
34:       const newUser: User = {
35:         id: `usr_${Date.now()}`,
36:         merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
37:         full_name,
38:         email,
39:         phone: phone || 'Chờ cập nhật',
40:         role: role as Role,
41:         status: 'ACTIVE',
42:         created_at: new Date(),
43:       };
44: 
45:       db.users.push(newUser);
46: 
47:       return NextResponse.json({
48:         success: true,
49:         message: `Đã gửi mã mời 7 ngày tới ${email} với vai trò ${role} (CN-24)`,
50:         data: newUser,
51:       });
52:     }
53: 
54:     // REMOTE REVOKE DEVICE SESSION (FR-IAM-004, NFR-08, E2E-08)
55:     if (action === 'REVOKE_DEVICE') {
56:       const dev = db.deviceSessions.find((d) => d.id === device_id);
57:       if (!dev) {
58:         return NextResponse.json(
59:           { error: { code: 'device_not_found', message: 'Không tìm thấy thiết bị' } },
60:           { status: 404 }
61:         );
62:       }
63: 
64:       dev.is_revoked = true;
65: 
66:       return NextResponse.json({
67:         success: true,
68:         message: `Đã thu hồi phiên đăng nhập thiết bị ${dev.device} thành công. Lượt gọi API tiếp theo sẽ trả về mã 401 device_revoked và xóa dữ liệu cục bộ.`,
69:         data: dev,
70:       });
71:     }
72: 
73:     return NextResponse.json(
74:       { error: { code: 'bad_request', message: 'Hành động không hợp lệ' } },
75:       { status: 400 }
76:     );
77:   } catch (error: any) {
78:     return NextResponse.json(
79:       { error: { code: 'server_error', message: error.message } },
80:       { status: 500 }
81:     );
82:   }
83: }
