<file path="apps/web/src/app/paseo/page.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import Link from 'next/link';
  5: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
  6: import { AlertCircle, Clock, ShieldAlert, Wifi, WifiOff } from 'lucide-react';
  7: 
  8: interface Source {
  9:   id: string | number;
 10:   label: string;
 11:   kind: string;
 12:   servesModels: boolean;
 13:   harness: string;
 14:   endpoint: string;
 15: }
 16: 
 17: type FetchStatus = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'empty' | 'validation' | 'error' | 'forbidden' | 'success';
 18: 
 19: const PASEO_API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PASEO_API_BASE || 'http://127.0.0.1:6767';
 20: const PASEO_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
 21: 
 22: function getTokenScopes(token: string | null): string[] {
 23:   if (!token) return [];
 24:   try {
 25:     const parts = token.split('.');
 26:     if (parts.length < 2) return [];
 27:     const payload = JSON.parse(atob(parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')));
 28:     const scope =
 29:       (payload as { scope?: string; scopes?: string[] }).scope ??
 30:       (payload as { scope?: string; scopes?: string[] }).scopes;
 31:     if (typeof scope === 'string') return scope.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
 32:     if (Array.isArray(scope)) return scope.map(String).filter(Boolean);
 33:     return [];
 34:   } catch {
 35:     return [];
 36:   }
 37: }
 38: 
 39: function asSource(item: unknown): Source | null {
 40:   if (typeof item !== 'object' || item === null) return null;
 41:   const row = item as Record<string, unknown>;
 42:   if (
 43:     (typeof row.id !== 'string' && typeof row.id !== 'number') ||
 44:     typeof row.label !== 'string' ||
 45:     typeof row.kind !== 'string' ||
 46:     typeof row.servesModels !== 'boolean' ||
 47:     typeof row.harness !== 'string'
 48:   ) {
 49:     return null;
 50:   }
 51:   return {
 52:     id: row.id as string | number,
 53:     label: row.label as string,
 54:     kind: row.kind as string,
 55:     servesModels: row.servesModels as boolean,
 56:     harness: row.harness as string,
 57:     endpoint: typeof row.endpoint === 'string' ? row.endpoint : '',
 58:   };
 59: }
 60: 
 61: const PaseoPage = () => {
 62:   const { isHydrating, isAuthenticated, token } = useAuth();
 63:   const [sources, setSources] = useState<Source[]>([]);
 64:   const [harnesses, setHarnesses] = useState<string[]>([]);
 65:   const [writers, setWriters] = useState(0);
 66:   const [status, setStatus] = useState<FetchStatus>('idle');
 67:   const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
 68: 
 69:   const hasPaseoAdminScope = isAuthenticated && getTokenScopes(token).includes('paseo.admin');
 70: 
 71:   const fetchData = async () => {
 72:     if (!isAuthenticated || !hasPaseoAdminScope) return;
 73:     setStatus('loading');
 74:     setMessage(null);
 75:     setSources([]);
 76:     setHarnesses([]);
 77:     setWriters(0);
 78:     const abort = new AbortController();
 79:     const timeout = setTimeout(() => abort.abort(), PASEO_TIMEOUT_MS);
 80:     try {
 81:       const headers: HeadersInit = token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {};
 82:       const [sourcesRes, harnessesRes, writersRes] = await Promise.all([
 83:         fetch(`${PASEO_API_BASE}/sources`, { signal: abort.signal, headers }),
 84:         fetch(`${PASEO_API_BASE}/harnesses`, { signal: abort.signal, headers }),
 85:         fetch(`${PASEO_API_BASE}/writers`, { signal: abort.signal, headers }),
 86:       ]);
 87: 
 88:       if (sourcesRes.status === 403 || harnessesRes.status === 403 || writersRes.status === 403) {
 89:         setStatus('forbidden');
 90:         setMessage('The Paseo daemon rejected this request (HTTP 403).');
 91:         return;
 92:       }
 93:       if (!sourcesRes.ok || !harnessesRes.ok || !writersRes.ok) {
 94:         setStatus('error');
 95:         setMessage('The Paseo daemon returned an error. Retry when it is reachable.');
 96:         return;
 97:       }
 98: 
 99:       const sourcesData: unknown = await sourcesRes.json();
100:       const harnessesData: unknown = await harnessesRes.json();
101:       const writersData: unknown = await writersRes.json();
102: 
103:       if (!Array.isArray(sourcesData) || !Array.isArray(harnessesData)) {
104:         setStatus('validation');
105:         setMessage('The daemon response did not match the expected shape (JSON arrays).');
106:         return;
107:       }
108:       if (typeof writersData !== 'number' && !Array.isArray(writersData)) {
109:         setStatus('validation');
110:         setMessage('Writers response did not match the expected shape (number or array).');
111:         return;
112:       }
113: 
114:       const parsed: Source[] = [];
115:       for (const item of sourcesData) {
116:         const source = asSource(item);
117:         if (!source) {
118:           setStatus('validation');
119:           setMessage('A source row was missing id, label, kind, servesModels or harness.');
120:           return;
121:         }
122:         parsed.push(source);
123:       }
124: 
125:       const names = harnessesData.map((entry) => {
126:         if (typeof entry === 'string') return entry;
127:         if (entry && typeof entry === 'object') {
128:           const row = entry as { id?: unknown; name?: unknown };
129:           if (row.id != null) return String(row.id);
130:           if (row.name != null) return String(row.name);
131:         }
132:         return String(entry);
133:       });
134: 
135:       setSources(parsed);
136:       setHarnesses(names);
137:       setWriters(typeof writersData === 'number' ? writersData : writersData.length);
138:       setStatus(parsed.length === 0 && names.length === 0 ? 'empty' : 'success');
139:     } catch (err) {
140:       if (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === 'AbortError') {
141:         setMessage('Paseo daemon request timed out. Verify the daemon is running and retry.');
142:       } else {
143:         setMessage('Failed to connect to the Paseo daemon. Verify it is running and retry.');
144:       }
145:       setStatus('error');
146:     } finally {
147:       clearTimeout(timeout);
148:     }
149:   };
150: 
151:   if (isHydrating) return null;
152: 
153:   if (!isAuthenticated) {
154:     return (
155:       <div className="min-h-[20vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center">
156:         <WifiOff className="mb-4 h-10 w-10 text-slate-400" />
157:         <p className="mb-2 text-lg font-semibold">Sign in required</p>
158:         <p className="text-muted-foreground">
159:           The Paseo dispatch adapter status requires a signed-in session. Open the console and sign
160:           in, then return to this page.
161:         </p>
162:         <Link href="/" className="mt-4 underline text-primary hover:text-primary/80">
163:           Go to sign in
164:         </Link>
165:       </div>
166:     );
167:   }
168: 
169:   if (!hasPaseoAdminScope) {
170:     return (
171:       <div className="min-h-[20vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center">
172:         <div className="mb-4 rounded-full bg-red-100 p-3">
173:           <ShieldAlert className="h-8 w-8 text-red-600" />
174:         </div>
175:         <p className="mb-2 text-lg font-semibold">Access denied</p>
176:         <p className="text-muted-foreground">
177:           You are signed in but do not have the <code>paseo.admin</code> scope required to view the
178:           Paseo dispatch adapter status.
179:         </p>
180:         <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
181:           Ask an administrator to grant that scope, then sign in again.
182:         </p>
183:       </div>
184:     );
185:   }
186: 
187:   return (
188:     <div className="container mx-auto p-4 space-y-6">
189:       <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Paseo Dispatch Adapter Status</h1>
190: 
191:       {status === 'idle' && (
192:         <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-md">
193:           <p className="text-muted-foreground">
194:             No status has been loaded yet. Load the source registry, harness adapters and open
195:             writers from the local Paseo daemon.
196:           </p>
197:           <button
198:             type="button"
199:             onClick={() => void fetchData()}
200:             className="mt-3 px-4 py-2 bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-white rounded-md transition-colors"
201:           >
202:             Load status
203:           </button>
204:         </div>
205:       )}
206: 
207:       {status === 'loading' && (
208:         <div className="flex h-[20vh] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3" role="status">
209:           <Clock className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-primary" />
210:           <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading Paseo status…</p>
211:         </div>
212:       )}
213: 
214:       {status === 'validation' && (
215:         <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-md text-yellow-800">
216:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
217:             <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
218:             <span className="font-semibold">Data validation error</span>
219:           </div>
220:           <p className="mt-1">{message}</p>
221:           <button
222:             type="button"
223:             onClick={() => void fetchData()}
224:             className="mt-3 px-4 py-2 bg-yellow-100 hover:bg-yellow-200 text-yellow-800 rounded-md transition-colors"
225:           >
226:             Retry
227:           </button>
228:         </div>
229:       )}
230: 
231:       {status === 'error' && (
232:         <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md text-red-800">
233:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
234:             <Wifi className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
235:             <span className="font-semibold">Connection error</span>
236:           </div>
237:           <p className="mt-1">{message}</p>
238:           <button
239:             type="button"
240:             onClick={() => void fetchData()}
241:             className="mt-3 px-4 py-2 bg-red-100 hover:bg-red-200 text-red-800 rounded-md transition-colors"
242:           >
243:             Retry
244:           </button>
245:         </div>
246:       )}
247: 
248:       {status === 'forbidden' && (
249:         <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md text-red-800">
250:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
251:             <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
252:             <span className="font-semibold">Forbidden</span>
253:           </div>
254:           <p className="mt-1">{message}</p>
255:           <button
256:             type="button"
257:             onClick={() => void fetchData()}
258:             className="mt-3 px-4 py-2 bg-red-100 hover:bg-red-200 text-red-800 rounded-md transition-colors"
259:           >
260:             Retry
261:           </button>
262:         </div>
263:       )}
264: 
265:       {(status === 'success' || status === 'empty') && (
266:         <>
267:           <div className="space-y-4">
268:             <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Sources</h2>
269:             {sources.length > 0 ? (
270:               <div className="overflow-x-auto">
271:                 <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-gray-200">
272:                   <thead>
273:                     <tr className="bg-gray-50">
274:                       <th className="p-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
275:                         ID
276:                       </th>
277:                       <th className="p-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
278:                         Label
279:                       </th>
280:                       <th className="p-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
281:                         Kind
282:                       </th>
283:                       <th className="p-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
284:                         Serves Models?
285:                       </th>
286:                       <th className="p-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
287:                         Harness
288:                       </th>
289:                       <th className="p-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
290:                         Endpoint
291:                       </th>
292:                     </tr>
293:                   </thead>
294:                   <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
295:                     {sources.map((source) => (
296:                       <tr key={String(source.id)} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
297:                         <td className="p-3 text-sm font-mono">{source.id}</td>
298:                         <td className="p-3 text-sm">{source.label}</td>
299:                         <td className="p-3 text-sm">{source.kind}</td>
300:                         <td className="p-3 text-sm text-center">
301:                           {source.servesModels ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
302:                         </td>
303:                         <td className="p-3 text-sm font-mono">{source.harness}</td>
304:                         <td className="p-3 text-sm break-all max-w-[200px]">
305:                           {source.endpoint || '-'}
306:                         </td>
307:                       </tr>
308:                     ))}
309:                   </tbody>
310:                 </table>
311:               </div>
312:             ) : (
313:               <p className="text-muted-foreground">No sources are registered.</p>
314:             )}
315:           </div>
316: 
317:           <div className="space-y-4">
318:             <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Harness Adapters</h2>
319:             {harnesses.length > 0 ? (
320:               <ul className="space-y-1">
321:                 {harnesses.map((name) => (
322:                   <li key={name} className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-gray-50 rounded-md">
323:                     <div className="h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-primary rounded"></div>
324:                     <span className="text-sm font-mono">{name}</span>
325:                   </li>
326:                 ))}
327:               </ul>
328:             ) : (
329:               <p className="text-muted-foreground">No harness adapters are registered.</p>
330:             )}
331:           </div>
332: 
333:           <div className="space-y-4">
334:             <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Open Writers</h2>
335:             <p className="text-lg font-mono">
336:               {writers} active writer{writers === 1 ? '' : 's'}
337:             </p>
338:             {writers === 0 && (
339:               <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No decision-log writer is open.</p>
340:             )}
341:           </div>
342: 
343:           <div className="flex justify-end">
344:             <button
345:               type="button"
346:               onClick={() => void fetchData()}
347:               className="px-4 py-2 bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-white rounded-md transition-colors"
348:             >
349:               Refresh
350:             </button>
351:           </div>
352:         </>
353:       )}
354:     </div>
355:   );
356: };
357: 
358: export default PaseoPage;
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/reset-password/page.tsx">
 1: 'use client';
 2: 
 3: import React, { Suspense } from 'react';
 4: import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
 5: import { ResetPasswordView } from '@/components/auth/ResetPasswordView';
 6: 
 7: /**
 8:  * ResetPasswordView reads the token from the query string with
 9:  * useSearchParams(), which Next cannot resolve while prerendering: the build
10:  * failed with "useSearchParams() should be wrapped in a suspense boundary" and
11:  * refused to export this route at all. The boundary is what lets the page be
12:  * prerendered and then filled in on the client once the URL is known.
13:  *
14:  * The fallback is the same "verifying" state the view itself shows first, so a
15:  * visitor sees one continuous message rather than a blank frame that swaps.
16:  */
17: function ResetPasswordFallback() {
18:   return (
19:     <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center p-6">
20:       <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">Đang kiểm tra liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu…</p>
21:     </div>
22:   );
23: }
24: 
25: function ResetPasswordContent() {
26:   const router = useRouter();
27: 
28:   return (
29:     <ResetPasswordView
30:       onBackToLogin={() => {
31:         router.push('/');
32:       }}
33:     />
34:   );
35: }
36: 
37: export default function ResetPasswordPage() {
38:   return (
39:     <Suspense fallback={<ResetPasswordFallback />}>
40:       <ResetPasswordContent />
41:     </Suspense>
42:   );
43: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/forms/ConnectCarrierModal.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import { Truck, X, Key, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
  5: 
  6: interface Props {
  7:   isOpen: boolean;
  8:   onClose: () => void;
  9:   onConnected: (account: any) => void;
 10: }
 11: 
 12: export const ConnectCarrierModal: React.FC<Props> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onConnected }) => {
 13:   const [carrierCode, setCarrierCode] = useState<'GHN' | 'GHTK' | 'VTP'>('GHN');
 14:   const [accountName, setAccountName] = useState('GHN Express - Kho Chính');
 15:   const [token, setToken] = useState('tok_ghn_live_sec_9918239');
 16:   const [clientId, setClientId] = useState('189201');
 17:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
 18:   const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
 19: 
 20:   if (!isOpen) return null;
 21: 
 22:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 23:     e.preventDefault();
 24:     if (!token) {
 25:       setErrorMsg('Vui lòng nhập API Token từ cổng tài khoản hãng.');
 26:       return;
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     setLoading(true);
 30:     setErrorMsg(null);
 31: 
 32:     try {
 33:       const res = await fetch('/api/carrier-accounts', {
 34:         method: 'POST',
 35:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 36:         body: JSON.stringify({
 37:           action: 'CONNECT_CARRIER',
 38:           carrier_code: carrierCode,
 39:           account_name: accountName,
 40:           token,
 41:           client_id: clientId,
 42:         }),
 43:       });
 44: 
 45:       const data = await res.json();
 46:       if (!res.ok) {
 47:         throw new Error(data.error?.message || 'Không thể kết nối tài khoản');
 48:       }
 49: 
 50:       onConnected(data.data);
 51:       onClose();
 52:     } catch (err: any) {
 53:       setErrorMsg(err.message);
 54:     } finally {
 55:       setLoading(false);
 56:     }
 57:   };
 58: 
 59:   return (
 60:     <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
 61:       <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-lg w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-xs animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
 62:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
 63:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 64:             <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
 65:               <Key className="w-5 h-5" />
 66:             </div>
 67:             <div>
 68:               <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">
 69:                 Kết Nối Tài Khoản Hãng Vận Chuyển
 70:               </h3>
 71:               <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
 72:                 Sử dụng API Token tài khoản riêng của Shop (BYO Account)
 73:               </p>
 74:             </div>
 75:           </div>
 76:           <button
 77:             type="button"
 78:             onClick={onClose}
 79:             className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
 80:           >
 81:             ✕
 82:           </button>
 83:         </div>
 84: 
 85:         {errorMsg && (
 86:           <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold">
 87:             {errorMsg}
 88:           </div>
 89:         )}
 90: 
 91:         <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3">
 92:           <div>
 93:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Chọn Hãng Vận Chuyển:</label>
 94:             <select
 95:               value={carrierCode}
 96:               onChange={(e: any) => {
 97:                 setCarrierCode(e.target.value);
 98:                 setAccountName(`${e.target.value} Express - Kho Chính`);
 99:               }}
100:               className="modern-input w-full text-xs font-semibold"
101:             >
102:               <option value="GHN">Giao Hàng Nhanh (GHN) — Mức L2 Execute (API Trực Tiếp)</option>
103:               <option value="GHTK">
104:                 Giao Hàng Tiết Kiệm (GHTK) — Mức L1 Assist (Hồ Sơ Hỗ Trợ)
105:               </option>
106:               <option value="VTP">Viettel Post (VTP) — Mức L2 Execute (API Trực Tiếp)</option>
107:             </select>
108:           </div>
109: 
110:           <div>
111:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Tên Gợi Nhớ Tài Khoản:</label>
112:             <input
113:               type="text"
114:               value={accountName}
115:               onChange={(e) => setAccountName(e.target.value)}
116:               className="modern-input w-full text-xs"
117:               required
118:             />
119:           </div>
120: 
121:           <div>
122:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">
123:               API Token / Secret Key Hãng:
124:             </label>
125:             <input
126:               type="password"
127:               value={token}
128:               onChange={(e) => setToken(e.target.value)}
129:               placeholder="Nhập chuỗi token..."
130:               className="modern-input w-full font-mono text-xs"
131:               required
132:             />
133:           </div>
134: 
135:           <div>
136:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">
137:               Shop ID / Client ID (Tùy chọn):
138:             </label>
139:             <input
140:               type="text"
141:               value={clientId}
142:               onChange={(e) => setClientId(e.target.value)}
143:               placeholder="Ví dụ: 189201"
144:               className="modern-input w-full font-mono text-xs"
145:             />
146:           </div>
147: 
148:           <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-end gap-2.5">
149:             <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="btn-secondary text-xs">
150:               Hủy
151:             </button>
152:             <button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="btn-primary text-xs">
153:               {loading ? 'Đang kết nối...' : 'Lưu & Kích Hoạt'}
154:             </button>
155:           </div>
156:         </form>
157:       </div>
158:     </div>
159:   );
160: };
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/forms/CreateClaimModal.tsx">
  1: 'use client';

  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';

  5: 
  6: interface Props {

  8:   onClose: () => void;
  9:   onClaimCreated: (claim: any) => void;
 10: }
 11: 
 12: export const CreateClaimModal: React.FC<Props> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onClaimCreated }) => {
 13:   const [trackingCode, setTrackingCode] = useState('GHN88290500');
 14:   const [claimType, setClaimType] = useState('FEE');

 47: 
 48:   return (
 49:     <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
 50:       <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-xs animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
 51:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
 52:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 53:             <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
 54:               <FileText className="w-5 h-5" />
 55:             </div>
 56:             <div>
 57:               <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">Tạo Hồ Sơ Khiếu Nại Hãng (CN-16)</h3>
 58:               <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
 59:                 Tự động tập hợp chứng cứ và giám sát thời hiệu 48h (BR-37)
 60:               </p>
 61:             </div>
 62:           </div>
 63:           <button
 64:             type="button"
 65:             onClick={onClose}
 66:             className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
 67:           >
 68:             ✕
 69:           </button>
 70:         </div>
 71: 
 72:         <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3">

<file path="apps/web/src/components/forms/RateCardFormModal.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import { Scale, X } from 'lucide-react';
  5: import { Money } from '../ui/OperationalComponents';
  6: 
  7: interface Props {
  8:   isOpen: boolean;
  9:   onClose: () => void;
 10:   onSaved: (rateCard: any) => void;
 11: }
 12: 
 13: export const RateCardFormModal: React.FC<Props> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onSaved }) => {
 14:   const [carrierCode, setCarrierCode] = useState<'GHN' | 'GHTK' | 'VTP'>('GHN');
 15:   const [intraProvinceFee, setIntraProvinceFee] = useState('22000');
 16:   const [interProvinceFee, setInterProvinceFee] = useState('32000');
 17:   const [additionalKgFee, setAdditionalKgFee] = useState('5000');
 18:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
 19: 
 20:   if (!isOpen) return null;
 21: 
 22:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 23:     e.preventDefault();
 24:     setLoading(true);
 25: 
 26:     try {
 27:       const res = await fetch('/api/rate-cards', {
 28:         method: 'POST',
 29:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 30:         body: JSON.stringify({
 31:           carrier_code: carrierCode,
 32:           tier_name: `Hợp đồng VIP ${carrierCode} 2026`,
 33:           intra_province_base_fee: Number(intraProvinceFee),
 34:           inter_province_base_fee: Number(interProvinceFee),
 35:           additional_kg_fee: Number(additionalKgFee),
 36:         }),
 37:       });
 38: 
 39:       const data = await res.json();
 40:       onSaved(data.data);

 45:       setLoading(false);
 46:     }

 49:   return (
 50:     <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">

 52:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">

 54:             <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
 55:               <Scale className="w-5 h-5" />
 56:             </div>
 57:             <div>
 58:               <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">
 59:                 Cài Đặt Biểu Giá Hợp Đồng (CN-23)
 60:               </h3>
 61:               <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
 62:                 Cơ sở tính cước chuẩn phát hiện sai lệch phép dò D2 (BR-51)
 63:               </p>
 64:             </div>
 65:           </div>
 66:           <button
 67:             type="button"
 68:             onClick={onClose}
 69:             className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
 70:           >
 71:             ✕
 72:           </button>
 73:         </div>
 74: 
 75:         <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3">
 76:           <div>
 77:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Hãng Áp Dụng:</label>
 78:             <select
 79:               value={carrierCode}
 80:               onChange={(e: any) => setCarrierCode(e.target.value)}
 81:               className="modern-input w-full text-xs font-semibold"
 82:             >
 83:               <option value="GHN">Giao Hàng Nhanh (GHN Express)</option>
 84:               <option value="GHTK">Giao Hàng Tiết Kiệm (GHTK)</option>
 85:               <option value="VTP">Viettel Post (VTP)</option>
 86:             </select>
 87:           </div>
 88: 
 89:           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
 90:             <div>
 91:               <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">
 92:                 Cước Nội Tỉnh (&lt;1kg):
 93:               </label>
 94:               <input
 95:                 type="number"
 96:                 value={intraProvinceFee}
 97:                 onChange={(e) => setIntraProvinceFee(e.target.value)}
 98:                 className="modern-input w-full font-mono text-xs"
 99:                 required
100:               />
101:             </div>
102: 
103:             <div>
104:               <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">
105:                 Cước Liên Tỉnh (&lt;1kg):
106:               </label>
107:               <input
108:                 type="number"
109:                 value={interProvinceFee}
110:                 onChange={(e) => setInterProvinceFee(e.target.value)}
111:                 className="modern-input w-full font-mono text-xs"
112:                 required
113:               />
114:             </div>
115:           </div>
116: 
117:           <div>
118:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">
119:               Phụ Phí Mỗi 0.5kg Tiếp Theo:
120:             </label>
121:             <input
122:               type="number"
123:               value={additionalKgFee}

126:               required
127:             />
128:           </div>
129: 
130:           <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-end gap-2.5">
131:             <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="btn-secondary text-xs">
132:               Hủy

134:             <button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="btn-primary text-xs">

138:         </form>
139:       </div>
140:     </div>
141:   );
142: };

<file path="apps/web/src/components/forms/ReattemptFormModal.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import { Send, X, Phone, Calendar, Clock, AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
  5: import { AutomationBadge } from '../ui/OperationalComponents';
  6: 
  7: interface Props {
  8:   isOpen: boolean;
  9:   onClose: () => void;
 10:   exceptionItem: any;
 11:   carrierGhnTier: 'L2' | 'L1';
 12:   onReattemptDispatched: (result: any) => void;
 13: }
 14: 
 15: export const ReattemptFormModal: React.FC<Props> = ({
 16:   isOpen,
 17:   onClose,
 18:   exceptionItem,
 19:   carrierGhnTier,
 20:   onReattemptDispatched,
 21: }) => {
 22:   const [scheduledDate, setScheduledDate] = useState('2026-08-18');
 23:   const [note, setNote] = useState('Khách hẹn giao lại ca chiều');
 24:   const [newPhone, setNewPhone] = useState('');
 25:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
 26:   const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
 27: 
 28:   if (!isOpen || !exceptionItem) return null;
 29: 
 30:   const currentTier = exceptionItem.carrier_code === 'GHN' ? carrierGhnTier : 'L1';
 31: 
 32:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 33:     e.preventDefault();
 34:     setLoading(true);
 35:     setErrorMsg(null);
 36: 
 37:     try {
 38:       const res = await fetch('/api/exceptions', {
 39:         method: 'POST',
 40:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 41:         body: JSON.stringify({
 42:           action: 'DISPATCH_REATTEMPT',
 43:           exception_id: exceptionItem.id,
 44:           tracking_code: exceptionItem.tracking_code,
 45:           carrier_code: exceptionItem.carrier_code,
 46:           scheduled_date: scheduledDate,
 47:           note,
 48:           new_phone: newPhone || undefined,
 49:           user_id: 'usr_02',
 50:           user_name: 'Trần Thị Hoa (CSKH)',
 51:           current_version: exceptionItem.version || 1,
 52:         }),
 53:       });
 54: 
 55:       const data = await res.json();
 56:       if (!res.ok) {
 57:         throw new Error(data.error?.message || 'Lỗi gửi yêu cầu giao lại');
 58:       }
 59: 
 60:       onReattemptDispatched(data.data);
 61:       onClose();
 62:     } catch (err: any) {
 63:       setErrorMsg(err.message);
 64:     } finally {
 65:       setLoading(false);
 66:     }
 67:   };
 68: 
 69:   return (
 70:     <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
 71:       <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-xs animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
 72:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
 73:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 74:             <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
 75:               <Send className="w-5 h-5" />
 76:             </div>
 77:             <div>
 78:               <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 79:                 <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">Gửi Lệnh Giao Lại / Đổi SĐT</h3>
 80:                 <AutomationBadge
 81:                   tier={currentTier as any}
 82:                   carrierCode={exceptionItem.carrier_code}
 83:                 />
 84:               </div>
 85:               <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
 86:                 Mã: {exceptionItem.tracking_code}
 87:               </p>
 88:             </div>
 89:           </div>
 90:           <button
 91:             type="button"
 92:             onClick={onClose}
 93:             className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
 94:           >
 95:             ✕
 96:           </button>
 97:         </div>
 98: 
 99:         {errorMsg && (
100:           <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold">
101:             {errorMsg}
102:           </div>
103:         )}
104: 
105:         <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3">
106:           <div>
107:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">
108:               Số Điện Thoại Mới (Nếu khách đổi):
109:             </label>
110:             <input
111:               type="tel"
112:               value={newPhone}
113:               onChange={(e) => setNewPhone(e.target.value)}
114:               placeholder="0912345678"
115:               className="modern-input w-full font-mono text-xs"
116:             />
117:           </div>
118: 
119:           <div>
120:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Ngày Hẹn Giao Lại:</label>
121:             <input
122:               type="date"
123:               value={scheduledDate}
124:               onChange={(e) => setScheduledDate(e.target.value)}
125:               className="modern-input w-full text-xs font-semibold"
126:               required
127:             />
128:           </div>
129: 
130:           <div>
131:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Ghi Chú Cho Shipper:</label>
132:             <textarea
133:               value={note}
134:               onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
135:               className="modern-input w-full text-xs h-16 resize-none"
136:               required
137:             />
138:           </div>
139: 
140:           <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-end gap-2.5">
141:             <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="btn-secondary text-xs">
142:               Hủy
143:             </button>
144:             <button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="btn-primary text-xs">
145:               {loading
146:                 ? 'Đang gửi...'
147:                 : currentTier === 'L2'
148:                   ? 'Bắn Lệnh Giao Lại (L2 API)'
149:                   : 'Tạo Hồ Sơ Hỗ Trợ (L1 Assist)'}
150:             </button>
151:           </div>
152:         </form>
153:       </div>
154:     </div>
155:   );
156: };
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/forms/ResolveDiscrepancyModal.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import { ShieldCheck, X, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
  5: import { DiscrepancyResolution } from '@/types/domain';
  6: import { Money } from '../ui/OperationalComponents';
  7: 
  8: interface Props {
  9:   isOpen: boolean;
 10:   onClose: () => void;
 11:   discrepancyItem: any;
 12:   role: string;
 13:   onResolved: (result: any) => void;
 14: }
 15: 
 16: export const ResolveDiscrepancyModal: React.FC<Props> = ({
 17:   isOpen,
 18:   onClose,
 19:   discrepancyItem,
 20:   role,
 21:   onResolved,
 22: }) => {
 23:   const [resolution, setResolution] = useState<DiscrepancyResolution>(
 24:     DiscrepancyResolution.DISPUTE
 25:   );
 26:   const [reason, setReason] = useState('Khấu trừ cước sai biểu giá hợp đồng cam kết');
 27:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
 28:   const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
 29: 
 30:   if (!isOpen || !discrepancyItem) return null;
 31: 
 32:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 33:     e.preventDefault();
 34: 
 35:     // Maker-Checker Check (BR-12)
 36:     if (discrepancyItem.created_by_user === 'usr_02' && role === 'OPS_CSKH') {
 37:       setErrorMsg(
 38:         '[Quy tắc BR-12]: Bạn là nhân viên CSKH đã xử lý đơn này, nên không được quyền tự duyệt chênh lệch. Vui lòng chuyển cho Kế toán viên độc lập duyệt.'
 39:       );
 40:       return;
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     if (!reason || reason.trim().length < 5) {
 44:       setErrorMsg('Bắt buộc nhập lý do giải trình tối thiểu 5 ký tự (BR-22).');
 45:       return;
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     setLoading(true);
 49:     setErrorMsg(null);
 50: 
 51:     try {
 52:       const res = await fetch('/api/reconciliation', {
 53:         method: 'POST',
 54:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 55:         body: JSON.stringify({
 56:           action: 'RESOLVE_DISCREPANCY',
 57:           discrepancy_id: discrepancyItem.id,
 58:           resolution,
 59:           reason,
 60:           user_id: role === 'ACCOUNTANT' ? 'usr_03' : 'usr_01',
 61:           user_name: role === 'ACCOUNTANT' ? 'Lê Minh Kế Toán' : 'Nguyễn Văn An (Chủ Shop)',
 62:           expected_version: discrepancyItem.version || 1,
 63:         }),
 64:       });
 65: 
 66:       const data = await res.json();
 67:       if (!res.ok) {
 68:         throw new Error(data.error?.message || 'Lỗi xử lý sai lệch');
 69:       }
 70: 
 71:       onResolved(data.data);
 72:       onClose();
 73:     } catch (err: any) {
 74:       setErrorMsg(err.message);
 75:     } finally {
 76:       setLoading(false);
 77:     }
 78:   };
 79: 
 80:   return (
 81:     <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
 82:       <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-xs animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
 83:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
 84:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 85:             <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
 86:               <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5" />
 87:             </div>
 88:             <div>
 89:               <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">Duyệt Sai Lệch Đối Soát (BR-12)</h3>
 90:               <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
 91:                 Mã: {discrepancyItem.tracking_code}
 92:               </p>
 93:             </div>
 94:           </div>
 95:           <button
 96:             type="button"
 97:             onClick={onClose}
 98:             className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
 99:           >
100:             ✕
101:           </button>
102:         </div>
103: 
104:         {errorMsg && (
105:           <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold">
106:             {errorMsg}
107:           </div>
108:         )}
109: 
110:         <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl space-y-1 text-xs">
111:           <div className="flex justify-between">
112:             <span className="text-slate-600">Loại sai lệch:</span>
113:             <strong className="text-slate-900">{discrepancyItem.type}</strong>
114:           </div>
115:           <div className="flex justify-between">
116:             <span className="text-slate-600">Số tiền chênh lệch:</span>
117:             <strong className="text-rose-600 font-mono font-bold">
118:               <Money
119:                 amount={discrepancyItem.discrepancy_amount || discrepancyItem.amount || 0}
120:                 state="confirmed"
121:                 showSign
122:               />
123:             </strong>
124:           </div>
125:         </div>
126: 
127:         <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3">
128:           <div>
129:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Quyết Định Xử Lý:</label>
130:             <select
131:               value={resolution}
132:               onChange={(e: any) => setResolution(e.target.value)}
133:               className="modern-input w-full text-xs font-semibold"
134:             >
135:               <option value={DiscrepancyResolution.DISPUTE}>
136:                 1. Khởi tạo khiếu nại đòi tiền hãng (DISPUTE)
137:               </option>
138:               <option value={DiscrepancyResolution.CONFIRMED}>
139:                 2. Chấp thuận khấu trừ (CONFIRMED)
140:               </option>
141:               <option value={DiscrepancyResolution.WAIVE}>3. Bỏ qua chênh lệch nhỏ (WAIVE)</option>
142:               <option value={DiscrepancyResolution.CARRY_FORWARD}>
143:                 4. Chuyển sang kỳ sau tiếp tục đối chiếu (CARRY_FORWARD)
144:               </option>
145:             </select>
146:           </div>
147: 
148:           <div>
149:             <label className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">
150:               Lý Do Giải Trình (Bắt Buộc BR-22):
151:             </label>
152:             <textarea
153:               value={reason}
154:               onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
155:               className="modern-input w-full text-xs h-16 resize-none"
156:               required
157:             />
158:           </div>
159: 
160:           <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-end gap-2.5">
161:             <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="btn-secondary text-xs">
162:               Hủy
163:             </button>
164:             <button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="btn-primary text-xs">
165:               {loading ? 'Đang lưu...' : 'Xác Nhận Quyết Định'}
166:             </button>
167:           </div>
168:         </form>
169:       </div>
170:     </div>
171:   );
172: };
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/ui/DataTable.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React from 'react';
  4: import { EmptyState } from './OperationalComponents';
  5: import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
  6: 
  7: export interface ColumnDef<T> {
  8:   header: string;
  9:   accessorKey?: keyof T | string;
 10:   cell?: (item: T, index: number) => React.ReactNode;
 11:   align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right';
 12:   width?: string;
 13: }
 14: 
 15: interface DataTableProps<T> {
 16:   data: T[];
 17:   columns: ColumnDef<T>[];
 18:   keyExtractor: (item: T) => string;
 19:   selectedIds?: Set<string>;
 20:   onToggleSelect?: (id: string, shiftKey: boolean) => void;
 21:   onSelectAll?: () => void;

 23:   loading?: boolean;
 24:   emptyTitle?: string;
 25:   emptyReason?: string;
 26:   emptyActionLabel?: string;
 27:   onEmptyAction?: () => void;
 28:   // Cursor Pagination Props
 29:   hasPrev?: boolean;
 30:   hasNext?: boolean;
 31:   onPrevPage?: () => void;
 32:   onNextPage?: () => void;
 33:   totalRecords?: number;
 34: }
 35: 
 36: export function DataTable<T>({
 37:   data,
 38:   columns,
 39:   keyExtractor,
 40:   selectedIds,
 41:   onToggleSelect,
 42:   onSelectAll,
 43:   onRowClick,
 44:   loading = false,
 45:   emptyTitle = 'Không tìm thấy bản ghi nào',
 46:   emptyReason = 'Hãy kiểm tra lại bộ lọc tìm kiếm hoặc nạp thêm đơn hàng từ nguồn POS.',
 47:   emptyActionLabel,
 48:   onEmptyAction,
 49:   hasPrev = false,
 50:   hasNext = false,
 51:   onPrevPage,
 52:   onNextPage,
 53:   totalRecords,
 54: }: DataTableProps<T>) {
 55:   const isAllSelected =
 56:     data.length > 0 && selectedIds && data.every((item) => selectedIds.has(keyExtractor(item)));
 57: 
 58:   return (
 59:     <div className="w-full bg-[var(--surface)] border border-[var(--line)] rounded-[5px] flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
 60:       {/* Table Viewport */}
 61:       <div className="overflow-x-auto overflow-y-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-280px)] custom-scrollbar">
 62:         <table className="op-table">
 63:           <thead className="sticky top-0 z-10">
 64:             <tr>
 65:               {onToggleSelect && (
 66:                 <th style={{ width: '36px' }} className="text-center">
 67:                   <input
 68:                     type="checkbox"
 69:                     checked={isAllSelected}
 70:                     onChange={onSelectAll}
 71:                     className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-[2px] border-[var(--line-str)] text-[var(--accent)] focus:ring-0 cursor-pointer"
 72:                   />
 73:                 </th>
 74:               )}
 75:               {columns.map((col, idx) => (
 76:                 <th
 77:                   key={idx}
 78:                   style={{ width: col.width }}
 79:                   className={
 80:                     col.align === 'right'
 81:                       ? 'text-right'
 82:                       : col.align === 'center'
 83:                         ? 'text-center'
 84:                         : 'text-left'
 85:                   }
 86:                 >
 87:                   {col.header}
 88:                 </th>
 89:               ))}
 90:             </tr>
 91:           </thead>
 92:           <tbody>
 93:             {loading ? (
 94:               // Static gray loading cells (No blinking skeleton)
 95:               Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, rIdx) => (
 96:                 <tr key={rIdx}>
 97:                   {onToggleSelect && (
 98:                     <td className="text-center">
 99:                       <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-[var(--line)] mx-auto rounded-[2px]" />
100:                     </td>
101:                   )}
102:                   {columns.map((_, cIdx) => (
103:                     <td key={cIdx}>
104:                       <div className="h-4 bg-[var(--line)] rounded-[2px] w-3/4" />
105:                     </td>
106:                   ))}
107:                 </tr>
108:               ))
109:             ) : data.length === 0 ? (
110:               <tr>
111:                 <td colSpan={columns.length + (onToggleSelect ? 1 : 0)} className="p-0">
112:                   <EmptyState
113:                     title={emptyTitle}
114:                     reason={emptyReason}
115:                     actionLabel={emptyActionLabel}
116:                     onAction={onEmptyAction}
117:                   />
118:                 </td>
119:               </tr>
120:             ) : (
121:               data.map((item, index) => {
122:                 const id = keyExtractor(item);
123:                 const isSelected = selectedIds?.has(id);
124:                 return (
125:                   <tr
126:                     key={id}
127:                     onClick={() => onRowClick && onRowClick(item)}
128:                     className={`${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''} ${onRowClick ? 'cursor-pointer' : ''}`}
129:                   >
130:                     {onToggleSelect && (
131:                       <td
132:                         className="text-center"
133:                         onClick={(e) => {
134:                           e.stopPropagation();
135:                           onToggleSelect(id, e.shiftKey);
136:                         }}
137:                       >
138:                         <input
139:                           type="checkbox"
140:                           checked={isSelected}
141:                           onChange={() => {}}
142:                           className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-[2px] border-[var(--line-str)] text-[var(--accent)] focus:ring-0 cursor-pointer"
143:                         />
144:                       </td>
145:                     )}
146:                     {columns.map((col, cIdx) => (
147:                       <td
148:                         key={cIdx}
149:                         className={
150:                           col.align === 'right'
151:                             ? 'text-right'
152:                             : col.align === 'center'
153:                               ? 'text-center'
154:                               : 'text-left'
155:                         }
156:                       >
157:                         {col.cell
158:                           ? col.cell(item, index)
159:                           : (item as any)[col.accessorKey as string]}
160:                       </td>
161:                     ))}
162:                   </tr>
163:                 );
164:               })
165:             )}
166:           </tbody>
167:         </table>
168:       </div>
169: 
170:       {/* Cursor Pagination Bar (P2) */}
171:       <div className="h-10 border-t border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--canvas)] px-3 flex items-center justify-between text-[12px] text-[var(--ink-600)]">
172:         <div>
173:           {totalRecords !== undefined ? (
174:             <span>
175:               Tổng số:{' '}
176:               <strong className="text-[var(--ink-900)] tabular-nums">{totalRecords}</strong> bản ghi
177:             </span>
178:           ) : (
179:             <span>
180:               Hiển thị <strong className="text-[var(--ink-900)] tabular-nums">{data.length}</strong>{' '}
181:               dòng
182:             </span>
183:           )}
184:         </div>
185: 
186:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
187:           <button
188:             type="button"
189:             disabled={!hasPrev}
190:             onClick={onPrevPage}
191:             className="op-btn h-[26px] px-2 text-[11px] disabled:opacity-40"
192:             title="Trang trước"
193:           >
194:             <ChevronLeft className="w-3 h-3 mr-0.5" /> Trước
195:           </button>
196: 
197:           <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[var(--ink-400)]">
198:             Phân trang bằng con trỏ
199:           </span>
200: 
201:           <button
202:             type="button"
203:             disabled={!hasNext}
204:             onClick={onNextPage}
205:             className="op-btn h-[26px] px-2 text-[11px] disabled:opacity-40"
206:             title="Trang sau"
207:           >
208:             Sau <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3 ml-0.5" />
209:           </button>
210:         </div>
211:       </div>
212:     </div>
213:   );
214: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/AdminSystemTab.tsx">
  1: 'use client';

  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';

 21: 
 22: export const AdminSystemTab: React.FC<Props> = ({

 45:       setInternalTier(nextTier);

 48:       `✓ Đã cập nhật ma trận năng lực GHN sang [${nextTier === 'L2' ? 'L2 EXECUTE (Gọi API trực tiếp)' : 'L1 ASSIST (Tạo hồ sơ hỗ trợ dán cổng)'}]. Phản ánh tức thì có phiên bản (BR-19, BR-44).`
 49:     );
 50:     setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 5000);
 51:   };
 52: 
 53:   const showMatrix = activeSection === 'all' || activeSection === 'carrier_matrix';
 54:   const showUnmapped = activeSection === 'all' || activeSection === 'unmapped_queue';

 56:   return (

 66: 
 67:       {/* Header Bar */}

 73:               <span>Bàn Điều Khiển Quản Trị Hệ Thống (Backoffice Ship Dễ)</span>
 74:             </h2>

 82:           </p>
 83:         </div>

 85: 
 86:       {/* Section 1: Carrier Capability Matrix */}

 92:                 <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />

106:               <span>Chuyển Đổi Năng Lực GHN ({activeTier === 'L2' ? 'L2 → L1' : 'L1 → L2'})</span>
107:             </button>
108:           </div>
109: 
110:           <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

195:                     <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
196:                       <span className="badge-warn font-mono text-[11px]">{item.mapped_to}</span>
197:                     </td>
198:                     <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">
199:                       <button
200:                         type="button"
201:                         onClick={() => {

204:                           );
205:                           setUnmappedStatuses([]);
206:                         }}
207:                         className="btn-primary text-xs py-1 px-2.5"
208:                       >
209:                         Phê Duyệt Ánh Xạ
210:                       </button>
211:                     </td>
212:                   </tr>
213:                 ))}
214:                 {unmappedStatuses.length === 0 && (
215:                   <tr>
216:                     <td colSpan={5} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
217:                       ✓ Hàng chờ trống. Toàn bộ mã trạng thái từ hãng đều đã được ánh xạ chuẩn xác.
218:                     </td>
219:                   </tr>
220:                 )}
221:               </tbody>
222:             </table>
223:           </div>
224:         </div>
225:       )}
226:     </div>
227:   );
228: };

<file path="apps/web/src/components/NotificationMatrixTab.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import { Bell, Sliders, Check, Send, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
  5: 
  6: export const NotificationMatrixTab: React.FC = () => {
  7:   const [digestWindow, setDigestWindow] = useState('15');
  8:   const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  9: 
 10:   const [matrix, setMatrix] = useState([
 11:     {
 12:       event: 'Giao hàng thất bại (Delivery Fail)',
 13:       ownerPush: true,
 14:       opsPush: true,
 15:       accountantPush: false,
 16:       email: false,
 17:       urgent: true,
 18:     },
 19:     {
 20:       event: 'Phát hiện lệch cước > 50.000 đ',
 21:       ownerPush: false,
 22:       opsPush: false,
 23:       accountantPush: true,
 24:       email: true,
 25:       urgent: false,
 26:     },
 27:     {
 28:       event: 'COD quá hạn thanh toán theo SLA',
 29:       ownerPush: true,
 30:       opsPush: false,
 31:       accountantPush: true,
 32:       email: true,
 33:       urgent: true,
 34:     },
 35:     {
 36:       event: 'Hồ sơ khiếu nại còn < 48h tới hạn',
 37:       ownerPush: true,
 38:       opsPush: true,
 39:       accountantPush: true,
 40:       email: true,
 41:       urgent: true,
 42:     },
 43:     {
 44:       event: 'Kiện hàng hoàn về kho bất thường (hư/thiếu)',
 45:       ownerPush: false,
 46:       opsPush: true,
 47:       accountantPush: false,
 48:       email: false,
 49:       urgent: false,
 50:     },
 51:   ]);
 52: 
 53:   const toggleCheck = (idx: number, field: string) => {
 54:     setMatrix((prev) =>
 55:       prev.map((item, i) =>
 56:         i === idx ? { ...item, [field]: !item[field as keyof typeof item] } : item
 57:       )
 58:     );
 59:   };
 60: 
 61:   const handleSave = () => {
 62:     setToast(
 63:       `✓ Đã lưu cấu hình ma trận thông báo & ngưỡng gộp tin ${digestWindow} phút thành công (CN-19, BR-23).`
 64:     );
 65:     setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
 66:   };
 67: 
 68:   const handleTestNotification = () => {
 69:     setToast(
 70:       '✓ Đã gửi thông báo thử nghiệm mẫu tới thiết bị đã liên kết qua FCM/APNS (BR-42 Masked).'
 71:     );
 72:     setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
 73:   };
 74: 
 75:   return (
 76:     <div className="w-full space-y-6">
 77:       {toast && (
 78:         <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm animate-in fade-in">
 79:           <span>{toast}</span>
 80:           <button type="button" onClick={() => setToast(null)} className="font-bold">
 81:             ✕
 82:           </button>
 83:         </div>
 84:       )}
 85: 
 86:       {/* Header Bar */}
 87:       <div className="modern-card p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
 88:         <div>
 89:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 90:             <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
 91:               <Bell className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
 92:               Ma Trận Cấu Hình Thông Báo & Chống Dội Tin (CN-19 · BR-23)
 93:             </h2>
 94:             <span className="badge-ok text-xs">FCM / APNS Multi-channel</span>
 95:           </div>
 96:           <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
 97:             Cấu hình phân phối thông báo đa kênh theo vai trò và kích hoạt cơ chế gộp tin chống dội
 98:             chuông liên tục
 99:           </p>
100:         </div>
101: 
102:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
103:           <button type="button" onClick={handleTestNotification} className="btn-secondary text-xs">
104:             <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
105:             <span>Bắn Test Thử</span>
106:           </button>
107:           <button type="button" onClick={handleSave} className="btn-primary text-xs">
108:             <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
109:             <span>Lưu Cấu Hình</span>
110:           </button>
111:         </div>
112:       </div>
113: 
114:       {/* Digest Window Setting Card */}
115:       <div className="modern-card p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
116:         <div className="space-y-1">
117:           <span className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
118:             <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
119:             Cửa Sổ Gộp Tin Chống Dội Chuông (BR-23):
120:           </span>
121:           <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
122:             Tự động gộp các thông báo không khẩn thành 1 bản tin tóm tắt trong khung giờ cao điểm để
123:             tránh làm phiền nhân viên.
124:           </p>
125:         </div>
126: 
127:         <select
128:           value={digestWindow}
129:           onChange={(e) => setDigestWindow(e.target.value)}
130:           className="modern-input text-xs font-semibold w-60"
131:         >
132:           <option value="0">Gửi ngay tức thì (Không gộp)</option>
133:           <option value="15">Gộp định kỳ 15 phút (Khuyên dùng)</option>
134:           <option value="30">Gộp định kỳ 30 phút</option>
135:           <option value="60">Gộp định kỳ 1 giờ</option>
136:         </select>
137:       </div>
138: 
139:       {/* Matrix Table */}
140:       <div className="modern-card overflow-hidden">
141:         <div className="overflow-x-auto">
142:           <table className="modern-table">
143:             <thead>
144:               <tr>
145:                 <th>Sự Kiện Nghiệp Vụ</th>
146:                 <th className="text-center" style={{ width: '130px' }}>
147:                   App Chủ Shop
148:                 </th>
149:                 <th className="text-center" style={{ width: '130px' }}>
150:                   App CSKH
151:                 </th>
152:                 <th className="text-center" style={{ width: '130px' }}>
153:                   App Kế Toán
154:                 </th>
155:                 <th className="text-center" style={{ width: '130px' }}>
156:                   Email Báo Cáo
157:                 </th>
158:                 <th className="text-center" style={{ width: '130px' }}>
159:                   Mức Khẩn Cấp
160:                 </th>
161:               </tr>
162:             </thead>
163:             <tbody>
164:               {matrix.map((row, idx) => (
165:                 <tr key={idx}>
166:                   <td className="font-semibold text-slate-800 text-xs">{row.event}</td>
167:                   <td className="text-center">
168:                     <input
169:                       type="checkbox"
170:                       checked={row.ownerPush}
171:                       onChange={() => toggleCheck(idx, 'ownerPush')}
172:                       className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-blue-600 cursor-pointer"
173:                     />
174:                   </td>
175:                   <td className="text-center">
176:                     <input
177:                       type="checkbox"
178:                       checked={row.opsPush}
179:                       onChange={() => toggleCheck(idx, 'opsPush')}
180:                       className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-blue-600 cursor-pointer"
181:                     />
182:                   </td>
183:                   <td className="text-center">
184:                     <input
185:                       type="checkbox"
186:                       checked={row.accountantPush}
187:                       onChange={() => toggleCheck(idx, 'accountantPush')}
188:                       className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-blue-600 cursor-pointer"
189:                     />
190:                   </td>
191:                   <td className="text-center">
192:                     <input
193:                       type="checkbox"
194:                       checked={row.email}
195:                       onChange={() => toggleCheck(idx, 'email')}
196:                       className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-blue-600 cursor-pointer"
197:                     />
198:                   </td>
199:                   <td className="text-center">
200:                     <span
201:                       className={row.urgent ? 'badge-risk text-[10px]' : 'badge-muted text-[10px]'}
202:                     >
203:                       {row.urgent ? 'Khẩn (Gửi ngay)' : 'Thường'}
204:                     </span>
205:                   </td>
206:                 </tr>
207:               ))}
208:             </tbody>
209:           </table>
210:         </div>
211:       </div>
212:     </div>
213:   );
214: };
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/SourceMatchingTab.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import { TrackingCode, Money, ConfirmDialog } from './ui/OperationalComponents';
  5: import {
  6:   Database,
  7:   RefreshCw,

 14: } from 'lucide-react';
 15: 
 16: export const SourceMatchingTab: React.FC = () => {
 17:   const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
 18:   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
 19:   const [selectedRow, setSelectedRow] = useState<any | null>(null);
 20:   const [manualOrderCode, setManualOrderCode] = useState('');
 21:   const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
 22: 
 23:   const [unmatchedRows, setUnmatchedRows] = useState([
 24:     {
 25:       id: 'u_1',
 26:       statement_tracking: 'GHN88290999',
 27:       statement_fee: 25000,
 28:       cod: 300000,
 29:       date: '15/08/2026',
 30:       carrier: 'GHN',
 31:     },
 32:     {
 33:       id: 'u_2',
 34:       statement_tracking: 'GHTK77128888',
 35:       statement_fee: 32000,
 36:       cod: 450000,
 37:       date: '16/08/2026',
 38:       carrier: 'GHTK',
 39:     },
 40:   ]);
 41: 
 42:   const handleSyncPancake = () => {
 43:     setIsSyncing(true);
 44:     setTimeout(() => {
 45:       setIsSyncing(false);
 46:       setToastMessage('✓ Đã đồng bộ 24 đơn mới từ Pancake POS Open API (CN-01).');
 47:       setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3500);
 48:     }, 1000);
 49:   };
 50: 
 51:   const handleConfirmManualMatch = (reason: string) => {
 52:     if (!selectedRow) return;
 53:     setUnmatchedRows((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== selectedRow.id));
 54:     setToastMessage(
 55:       `✓ Đã ghép tay ${selectedRow.statement_tracking} -> Đơn ${manualOrderCode || 'ORD_ANAN_101'} (Ghi nhận audit: ${reason}).`
 56:     );
 57:     setSelectedRow(null);
 58:     setManualOrderCode('');
 59:     setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 4000);
 60:   };
 61: 
 62:   const filteredUnmatched = unmatchedRows.filter((r) =>
 63:     r.statement_tracking.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
 64:   );
 65: 
 66:   return (
 67:     <div className="w-full space-y-6">
 68:       {toastMessage && (
 69:         <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm animate-in fade-in">
 70:           <span>{toastMessage}</span>
 71:           <button type="button" onClick={() => setToastMessage(null)} className="font-bold">
 72:             ✕
 73:           </button>
 74:         </div>
 75:       )}
 76: 
 77:       {/* Header & Sync Trigger */}
 78:       <div className="modern-card p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
 79:         <div>
 80:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 81:             <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
 82:               <Database className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
 83:               Nguồn Đơn Pancake POS & Engine Ghép Mã 3 Tầng (CN-01..03)
 84:             </h2>
 85:             <span className="badge-ok text-xs">Chuẩn NFR-04 (&gt;95%)</span>
 86:           </div>
 87:           <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
 88:             Đồng bộ đơn hàng tự động và đối chiếu sao kê qua Khóa 1 (Mã vận đơn), Khóa 2 (Mã đơn),
 89:             Khóa 3 (Khớp mờ COD ±3 ngày)
 90:           </p>
 91:         </div>
 92: 
 93:         <button

 95:           onClick={handleSyncPancake}
 96:           disabled={isSyncing}

100:           <span>{isSyncing ? 'Đang đồng bộ...' : 'Đồng Bộ Pancake POS'}</span>
101:         </button>
102:       </div>

104:       {/* 3-Tier Matching Metrics */}
105:       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
106:         <div className="modern-card p-5 space-y-2">
107:           <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
108:             <span className="font-bold text-slate-700">Khóa 1 & 2 · Khớp Tuyệt Đối</span>
109:             <span className="badge-ok text-[11px]">NFR-04</span>

134:           </div>
135:           <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
136:             Cần CSKH đối chiếu thủ công và giải trình lý do (BR-22)
137:           </p>
138:         </div>
139:       </div>
140: 
141:       {/* Manual Matching Queue Table */}
142:       <div className="modern-card overflow-hidden">
143:         <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/50 flex justify-between items-center">
144:           <div>
145:             <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">
146:               Hàng Đợi Dòng Sao Kê Chưa Ghép Được (CN-03)
147:             </h3>
148:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
149:               Nhấp để liên kết với đơn hàng trong hệ thống
150:             </p>
151:           </div>
152: 
153:           <div className="relative min-w-[220px]">
154:             <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
155:             <input
156:               type="text"
157:               value={searchQuery}
158:               onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
159:               placeholder="Lọc mã vận đơn..."
160:               className="modern-input pl-9 w-full text-xs"
161:             />
162:           </div>
163:         </div>
164: 
165:         <div className="overflow-x-auto">
166:           <table className="modern-table">
167:             <thead>
168:               <tr>
169:                 <th>Mã Vận Đơn Sao Kê</th>
170:                 <th>Hãng</th>
171:                 <th className="text-right">Cước Sao Kê</th>
172:                 <th className="text-right">Tiền COD</th>
173:                 <th>Ngày Giao</th>
174:                 <th>Trạng Thái</th>
175:                 <th className="text-right">Thao Tác Ghép Tay</th>
176:               </tr>
177:             </thead>
178:             <tbody>
179:               {filteredUnmatched.length === 0 ? (
180:                 <tr>
181:                   <td colSpan={7} className="text-center py-10 text-slate-400 text-xs">
182:                     Toàn bộ dòng sao kê đã được ghép mã tự động 100%.
183:                   </td>
184:                 </tr>
185:               ) : (
186:                 filteredUnmatched.map((r) => (
187:                   <tr key={r.id}>
188:                     <td>
189:                       <TrackingCode code={r.statement_tracking} />
190:                     </td>
191:                     <td className="font-semibold text-xs">{r.carrier}</td>
192:                     <td className="text-right text-xs">
193:                       <Money amount={r.statement_fee} state="confirmed" />
194:                     </td>
195:                     <td className="text-right font-bold text-xs">
196:                       <Money amount={r.cod} state="confirmed" />
197:                     </td>
198:                     <td className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-500">{r.date}</td>
199:                     <td>
200:                       <span className="badge-warn text-[10px]">Chưa ghép</span>
201:                     </td>
202:                     <td className="text-right">
203:                       <button
204:                         type="button"
205:                         onClick={() => setSelectedRow(r)}
206:                         className="btn-primary text-[11px] py-1 px-3"
207:                       >
208:                         <Link2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
209:                         <span>Ghép với đơn</span>
210:                       </button>
211:                     </td>
212:                   </tr>
213:                 ))
214:               )}
215:             </tbody>
216:           </table>
217:         </div>
218:       </div>
219: 
220:       {/* Manual Matching Dialog */}
221:       {selectedRow && (
222:         <ConfirmDialog
223:           isOpen={!!selectedRow}
224:           title={`Ghép tay dòng sao kê ${selectedRow.statement_tracking}`}
225:           description={`Tiền COD: ${selectedRow.cod.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ · Cước: ${selectedRow.statement_fee.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ. Bắt buộc nhập lý do giải trình để ghi nhật ký kiểm toán (BR-22).`}
226:           requireReason={true}
227:           confirmLabel="Xác Nhận Ghép Mã"
228:           onConfirm={handleConfirmManualMatch}
229:           onClose={() => setSelectedRow(null)}
230:         />
231:       )}
232:     </div>
233:   );
234: };
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/ThreeLedgersTab.tsx">
  1: 'use client';

  3: import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

  5: import { Money, TrackingCode } from './ui/OperationalComponents';
  6: import {
  7:   Download,
  8:   AlertTriangle,
  9:   CheckCircle2,
 10:   ShieldAlert,
 11:   ArrowUpRight,
 12:   TrendingUp,
 13:   Clock,
 14:   ShieldCheck,

 16: } from 'lucide-react';
 17: 
 18: export const ThreeLedgersTab: React.FC = () => {
 19:   const [report, setReport] = useState<ThreeValueLedgersReport | null>(null);
 20:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

 22: 
 23:   const fetchLedgers = async () => {

 29:         setReport(data.data);

 68:             </h2>
 69:             <span className="badge-ok text-xs">Chuẩn Kế Toán BR-45</span>
 70:           </div>
 71:           <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
 72:             Kỳ hạch toán: 01/08/2026 – 31/08/2026 · Ba sổ được phân tách tuyệt đối, minh bạch dòng
 73:             tiền thực nhận và chi phí hoàn tránh được
 74:           </p>
 75:         </div>

 77:         <button type="button" onClick={handleExportCsv} className="btn-primary text-xs">
 78:           <Download className="w-4 h-4" />

 81:       </div>
 82: 
 83:       {/* THREE DISTINCT INDEPENDENT VALUE BLOCKS */}
 84:       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
 85:         {/* SỔ 1: TIỀN THỰC NHẬN */}
 86:         <div className="modern-card p-6 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-5 border-t-4 border-t-emerald-600">
 87:           <div className="space-y-4">
 88:             <div className="flex justify-between items-start">

 90:                 <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
 91:                   Sổ 1 · Tiền Thực Nhận
 92:                 </span>
 93:                 <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
 94:                   Tiền bồi thường đã về tài khoản ngân hàng
 95:                 </span>
 96:               </div>
 97:               <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 flex items-center justify-center">
 98:                 <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5" />

100:             </div>
101: 
102:             <div>
103:               <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-semibold block mb-1">
104:                 Tổng tiền thực nhận (Bank/Cấn trừ):
105:               </span>
106:               <div className="text-3xl font-black font-mono text-emerald-700">
107:                 <Money amount={s1.total_recovered_amount} state="confirmed" />
108:               </div>
109:             </div>
110: 
111:             {/* Separate Column for Pending Acceptance */}
112:             <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/70 space-y-1 text-xs">
113:               <span className="text-slate-600 font-medium block">
114:                 Hãng đã chấp thuận (chờ kỳ sau):

121:               </p>
122:             </div>
123:           </div>
124: 
125:           <button
126:             type="button"
127:             onClick={() => setActiveDrilldown('S1')}
128:             className="btn-secondary w-full text-xs justify-between"
129:           >
