<file path="apps/web/src/tests/preservation-smoke.test.ts">
  1: // ============================================================================
  2: // Ship Dễ — Bộ Kiểm Thử Khói Bảo Toàn Năng Lực (Preservation Smoke Harness)
  3: // Work Item: TASK-FOUND-01 (Baseline Freeze & Protection)
  4: // Xác minh sự hiện diện của 10 bề mặt điều hành trọng yếu, kết nối 2 chiều giữa định tuyến vai trò
  5: // (Role Navigation Menu) & nhánh render giao diện (Viewport Rendering), cùng các động cơ nghiệp vụ lõi.
  6: // Đảm bảo không thất thoát năng lực hoặc giao diện khi thực hiện di chuyển TASK-FOUND-02.
  7: // ============================================================================
  8: 
  9: import * as fs from 'fs';
 10: import * as path from 'path';
 11: 
 12: import { LoginView } from '../components/auth/LoginView';
 13: import { RegisterView } from '../components/auth/RegisterView';
 14: import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
 15: import ShipDeConsoleApp from '../app/page';
 16: import { ControlTowerTab } from '../components/ControlTowerTab';
 17: import { ShipmentListTab } from '../components/ShipmentListTab';
 18: import { UnifiedTrackingModal } from '../components/UnifiedTrackingModal';
 19: import { CreateOrderModal } from '../components/CreateOrderModal';
 20: import { ExceptionWorkboxTab } from '../components/ExceptionWorkboxTab';
 21: import { ReconciliationTab } from '../components/ReconciliationTab';
 22: import { UploadStatementModal } from '../components/UploadStatementModal';
 23: import { ThreeLedgersTab } from '../components/ThreeLedgersTab';
 24: import { ReturnScanTab } from '../components/ReturnScanTab';
 25: import { MobileSimulatorTab } from '../components/MobileSimulatorTab';
 26: import { ClaimCasesTab } from '../components/ClaimCasesTab';
 27: import { SettingsWorkspace } from '../components/SettingsWorkspace';
 28: import { UserManagementTab } from '../components/UserManagementTab';
 29: import { ShopSettingsModal } from '../components/ShopSettingsModal';
 30: import { AdminSystemTab } from '../components/AdminSystemTab';
 31: 
 32: import {
 33:   MASTER_SHIPMENTS,
 34:   MASTER_EXCEPTIONS,
 35:   MASTER_DISCREPANCIES,
 36:   MASTER_CLAIMS,
 37:   getUnifiedMetrics,
 38: } from '../services/unifiedDataStore';
 39: import { ExceptionEngine } from '../core/exception-engine';
 40: import { MatchingEngine } from '../core/matching-engine';
 41: import { ReconciliationEngine } from '../core/reconciliation';
 42: import { OfflineScanQueueManager } from '../core/offline-queue';
 43: import { ThreeLedgersCalculator } from '../core/ledger-calculator';
 44: import { MakerCheckerEngine } from '../core/maker-checker';
 45: import { PancakePosAdapter } from '../adapters/pancake.adapter';
 46: import {
 47:   CarrierCode,
 48:   ShipmentStatus,
 49:   ExceptionType,
 50:   MatchingStatus,
 51:   DiscrepancyType,
 52:   DiscrepancyResolution,
 53: } from '../types/domain';
 54: 
 55: export interface SmokeTestResult {
 56:   surfaceId: string;
 57:   surfaceName: string;
 58:   category: string;
 59:   behaviorType: 'DEMO_MOCK' | 'CORE_LOGIC';
 60:   passed: boolean;
 61:   notes: string;
 62: }
 63: 
 64: export interface AppShellNavigationSpec {
 65:   hasAuthGate: boolean;
 66:   roleTabs: Record<string, string[]>;
 67:   viewportComponents: Record<string, string>;
 68:   modalMounts: string[];
 69:   modalOpeners: {
 70:     createOrder: boolean;
 71:     unifiedTracking: boolean;
 72:   };
 73: }
 74: 
 75: export interface SurfaceReachabilityResult {
 76:   reachable: boolean;
 77:   isRenderedInViewport: boolean;
 78:   mappedRoles: string[];
 79:   renderedComponent?: string;
 80:   reason?: string;
 81: }
 82: 
 83: /**
 84:  * Parse and validate the committed app shell navigation structure from page.tsx.
 85:  */
 86: export function analyzeAppShellSource(pageSource: string): AppShellNavigationSpec {
 87:   // 1. Auth Gate
 88:   const hasAuthGate =
 89:     pageSource.includes('!isAuthenticated') &&
 90:     pageSource.includes('<LoginView') &&
 91:     pageSource.includes('<RegisterView');
 92: 
 93:   // 2. Role tab mapping
 94:   const roleTabs: Record<string, string[]> = {};
 95:   const roleBlocks = ['OPS_CSKH', 'ACCOUNTANT', 'WAREHOUSE', 'BACKOFFICE', 'OWNER'];
 96: 
 97:   for (const role of roleBlocks) {
 98:     const roleRegex = new RegExp(`case\\s+'${role}':[\\s\\S]*?return\\s*\\[([\\s\\S]*?)\\];`);
 99:     const defaultRegex =
100:       role === 'OWNER' ? /case\s+'OWNER':[\s\S]*?default:[\s\S]*?return\s*\[([\s\S]*?)\];/ : null;
101: 
102:     const match =
103:       pageSource.match(roleRegex) || (defaultRegex ? pageSource.match(defaultRegex) : null);
104:     if (match) {
105:       const tabIds: string[] = [];
106:       const idRegex = /id:\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g;
107:       let idMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
108:       while ((idMatch = idRegex.exec(match[1])) !== null) {
109:         tabIds.push(idMatch[1]);
110:       }
111:       roleTabs[role] = tabIds;
112:     }
113:   }
114: 
115:   // 3. Viewport conditional component rendering
116:   const viewportComponents: Record<string, string> = {};
117:   const viewportRegex = /activeTab\s*===\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]\s*&&\s*\(?\s*<([A-Za-z0-9]+)/g;
118:   let vpMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
119:   while ((vpMatch = viewportRegex.exec(pageSource)) !== null) {
120:     viewportComponents[vpMatch[1]] = vpMatch[2];
121:   }
122: 
123:   // 4. Modal mounts & Opener Wiring
124:   const modalMounts: string[] = [];
125:   if (pageSource.includes('<CreateOrderModal')) modalMounts.push('CreateOrderModal');
126:   if (pageSource.includes('<UploadStatementModal')) modalMounts.push('UploadStatementModal');
127:   if (pageSource.includes('<UnifiedTrackingModal')) modalMounts.push('UnifiedTrackingModal');
128: 
129:   const modalOpeners = {
130:     createOrder:
131:       pageSource.includes('setCreateOrderOpen(true)') &&
132:       pageSource.includes('isOpen={createOrderOpen}'),
133:     unifiedTracking:
134:       pageSource.includes('setSelectedGlobalTracking(') &&
135:       pageSource.includes('trackingCode={selectedGlobalTracking}'),
136:   };
137: 
138:   return {
139:     hasAuthGate,
140:     roleTabs,
141:     viewportComponents,
142:     modalMounts,
143:     modalOpeners,
144:   };
145: }
146: 
147: /**
148:  * Verify two-way reachability for a critical surface:
149:  * 1. Present in EXACT set of role navigation tabs in getTabsForRole (strict bidirectional set equality: no missing and no extra roles)
150:  * 2. Rendered in activeTab === tabId conditional viewport branch in page.tsx
151:  */
152: export function verifySurfaceReachability(
153:   shellSpec: AppShellNavigationSpec,
154:   tabId: string,
155:   expectedComponent: string,
156:   expectedRoles: string[]
157: ): SurfaceReachabilityResult {
158:   const renderedComponent = shellSpec.viewportComponents[tabId];
159:   const isRenderedInViewport = renderedComponent === expectedComponent;
160: 
161:   const mappedRoles: string[] = [];
162:   for (const [role, tabs] of Object.entries(shellSpec.roleTabs)) {
163:     if (tabs.includes(tabId)) {
164:       mappedRoles.push(role);
165:     }
166:   }
167: 
168:   const missingRoles = expectedRoles.filter((role) => !mappedRoles.includes(role));
169:   const extraRoles = mappedRoles.filter((role) => !expectedRoles.includes(role));
170:   const isExactRoleMatch = missingRoles.length === 0 && extraRoles.length === 0;
171: 
172:   if (!isRenderedInViewport && mappedRoles.length === 0) {
173:     return {
174:       reachable: false,
175:       isRenderedInViewport: false,
176:       mappedRoles,
177:       renderedComponent,
178:       reason: `Bề mặt "${tabId}" vừa không có trong menu vai trò nào (yêu cầu chính xác: [${expectedRoles.join(
179:         ', '
180:       )}]), vừa không được gắn render trong viewport!`,
181:     };
182:   }
183: 
184:   if (!isRenderedInViewport) {
185:     return {
186:       reachable: false,
187:       isRenderedInViewport: false,
188:       mappedRoles,
189:       renderedComponent,
190:       reason: `Tab "${tabId}" có trong menu (${mappedRoles.join(
191:         ', '
192:       )}) nhưng thiếu nhánh viewport render: activeTab === '${tabId}' && <${expectedComponent} />`,
193:     };
194:   }
195: 
196:   if (!isExactRoleMatch) {
197:     const errorDetails: string[] = [];
198:     if (missingRoles.length > 0) {
199:       errorDetails.push(`thiếu vai trò bắt buộc [${missingRoles.join(', ')}]`);
200:     }
201:     if (extraRoles.length > 0) {
202:       errorDetails.push(`thừa vai trò không được cấp quyền [${extraRoles.join(', ')}]`);
203:     }
204:     return {
205:       reachable: false,
206:       isRenderedInViewport: true,
207:       mappedRoles,
208:       renderedComponent,
209:       reason: `Nhánh viewport <${expectedComponent} /> tồn tại nhưng phân quyền menu tab "${tabId}" không khớp tập vai trò chính xác: ${errorDetails.join(
210:         '; '
211:       )} (hiện có: [${mappedRoles.join(', ')}], yêu cầu chuẩn: [${expectedRoles.join(', ')}])!`,
212:     };
213:   }
214: 
215:   return {
216:     reachable: true,
217:     isRenderedInViewport: true,
218:     mappedRoles,
219:     renderedComponent,
220:   };
221: }
222: 
223: export function runPreservationSmokeTests(customPageSource?: string): {
224:   totalSurfaces: number;
225:   passedCount: number;
226:   failedCount: number;
227:   results: SmokeTestResult[];
228: } {
229:   const results: SmokeTestResult[] = [];
230:   const pagePath = path.join(__dirname, '../app/page.tsx');
231:   const pageSource = customPageSource ?? fs.readFileSync(pagePath, 'utf-8');
232:   const shellSpec = analyzeAppShellSource(pageSource);
233: 
234:   const recordSmoke = (
235:     surfaceId: string,
236:     surfaceName: string,
237:     category: string,
238:     behaviorType: 'DEMO_MOCK' | 'CORE_LOGIC',
239:     passed: boolean,
240:     notes: string
241:   ) => {
242:     results.push({ surfaceId, surfaceName, category, behaviorType, passed, notes });
243:   };
244: 
245:   // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
246:   // 1. Authentication Entry Surface (UI + Context + App Shell Auth Gate)
247:   // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
248:   try {
249:     const hasLoginView = typeof LoginView === 'function';
250:     const hasRegisterView = typeof RegisterView === 'function';
251:     const hasAuthProvider = typeof AuthProvider === 'function';
252:     const hasUseAuth = typeof useAuth === 'function';
253:     const hasAuthGate = shellSpec.hasAuthGate;
254: 
255:     const authSurfacesValid =
256:       hasLoginView && hasRegisterView && hasAuthProvider && hasUseAuth && hasAuthGate;
257: 
258:     recordSmoke(
259:       'SMOKE-AUTH-01',
260:       'Cổng xác thực & phân quyền (LoginView, RegisterView, AuthContext, App Shell Gate)',
261:       'Authentication',
262:       'DEMO_MOCK',
263:       authSurfacesValid,
264:       authSurfacesValid
265:         ? 'Sẵn sàng 4 vai trò chuẩn (OWNER, OPS_CSKH, WAREHOUSE, ACCOUNTANT), AuthContext, và cổng chặn unauthenticated trong page.tsx'
266:         : 'Lỗi: Bề mặt xác thực hoặc cổng điều hướng unauthenticated bị thiếu trong page.tsx'
267:     );
268:   } catch (err: any) {
269:     recordSmoke(
270:       'SMOKE-AUTH-01',
271:       'Cổng xác thực',
272:       'Authentication',
273:       'DEMO_MOCK',
274:       false,
275:       err.message
276:     );
277:   }
278: 
279:   // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
280:   // 2. Navigation Shell & Role-Aware App Shell Surface (UI Shell + 5 Roles Routing)
281:   // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
282:   try {
283:     const hasAppShell = typeof ShipDeConsoleApp === 'function';
284:     const hasAdminTab = typeof AdminSystemTab === 'function';
285:     const hasAllRolesMapped =
286:       shellSpec.roleTabs['OWNER']?.length > 0 &&
287:       shellSpec.roleTabs['OPS_CSKH']?.length > 0 &&
288:       shellSpec.roleTabs['ACCOUNTANT']?.length > 0 &&
289:       shellSpec.roleTabs['WAREHOUSE']?.length > 0 &&
290:       shellSpec.roleTabs['BACKOFFICE']?.length > 0;
291: 
292:     const shellValid = hasAppShell && hasAdminTab && hasAllRolesMapped;
293: 
294:     recordSmoke(
295:       'SMOKE-SHELL-01',
296:       'Khung điều hướng trung tâm & Điều phối vai trò (ShipDeConsoleApp, AdminSystemTab, 5 Role Tabsets)',
297:       'App Shell',
298:       'DEMO_MOCK',
299:       shellValid,
300:       shellValid
301:         ? 'Khung ứng dụng App Router sẵn sàng điều phối 5 vai trò vận hành và 9 không gian làm việc'
302:         : 'Lỗi: Thiếu cấu hình định tuyến cho một hoặc nhiều vai trò vận hành trong getTabsForRole'
303:     );
304:   } catch (err: any) {
305:     recordSmoke(
306:       'SMOKE-SHELL-01',
307:       'Khung điều hướng trung tâm',
308:       'App Shell',
309:       'DEMO_MOCK',
310:       false,
311:       err.message
312:     );
313:   }
314: 
315:   // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
316:   // 3. Control Tower / Dashboard Surface (UI Component + Metric Calculator + Viewport + Roles)
317:   // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
318:   try {
319:     const hasDashboardUI = typeof ControlTowerTab === 'function';
320:     const reachResult = verifySurfaceReachability(shellSpec, 'dashboard', 'ControlTowerTab', [
321:       'OPS_CSKH',
322:       'ACCOUNTANT',
323:       'OWNER',
324:     ]);
325:     const metrics = getUnifiedMetrics();
326:     const hasCoreMetrics =
327:       metrics.totalShipments >= 50 &&
328:       metrics.deliveredShipments >= 0 &&
329:       metrics.openExceptionsCount >= 0 &&
330:       metrics.openDiscrepanciesCount >= 0 &&
331:       metrics.totalDiscrepancyAmount >= 0;
332: 
333:     const dashValid = hasDashboardUI && reachResult.reachable && hasCoreMetrics;
334: 
335:     recordSmoke(
336:       'SMOKE-DASH-01',
337:       'Bảng điều khiển Tháp chỉ huy (ControlTowerTab + Viewport Reachability + Control Tower Metrics)',
338:       'Dashboard',
339:       'CORE_LOGIC',
340:       dashValid,
341:       dashValid
342:         ? `Component ControlTowerTab gắn đúng viewport 'dashboard' (vai trò: ${reachResult.mappedRoles.join(', ')}), chỉ số: ${metrics.totalShipments} vận đơn, ${metrics.openExceptionsCount} sự cố mở, ${metrics.openDiscrepanciesCount} khoản lệch`
343:         : `Lỗi: ${reachResult.reason || 'Dữ liệu chỉ số tháp chỉ huy không hợp lệ'}`
344:     );
345:   } catch (err: any) {
346:     recordSmoke(
347:       'SMOKE-DASH-01',
348:       'Bảng điều khiển Tháp chỉ huy',
349:       'Dashboard',
350:       'CORE_LOGIC',
351:       false,
352:       err.message
353:     );
354:   }
355: 
356:   // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
357:   // 4. Shipment & Tracking Surface (UI Table + Timeline Modal + Master Data + Viewport + Roles + Modal Opener)
358:   // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
359:   try {
360:     const hasShipmentListUI = typeof ShipmentListTab === 'function';
361:     const hasTrackingModalUI = typeof UnifiedTrackingModal === 'function';
362:     const reachResult = verifySurfaceReachability(shellSpec, 'shipments', 'ShipmentListTab', [
363:       'OPS_CSKH',
364:       'ACCOUNTANT',
365:       'WAREHOUSE',
366:       'OWNER',
367:     ]);
368:     const isTrackingModalMounted =
369:       shellSpec.modalMounts.includes('UnifiedTrackingModal') &&
370:       shellSpec.modalOpeners.unifiedTracking;
371:     const hasShipments = MASTER_SHIPMENTS && MASTER_SHIPMENTS.length >= 50;
372:     const sampleShipment = MASTER_SHIPMENTS[0];
373:     const hasRequiredFields =
374:       sampleShipment &&
375:       sampleShipment.tracking_code &&
376:       sampleShipment.carrier_code &&
377:       sampleShipment.status &&
378:       sampleShipment.timeline &&
379:       sampleShipment.timeline.length > 0;
380: 
381:     const shipmentSurfaceValid =
382:       hasShipmentListUI &&
383:       hasTrackingModalUI &&
384:       reachResult.reachable &&
385:       isTrackingModalMounted &&
386:       hasShipments &&
387:       hasRequiredFields;
388: 
389:     recordSmoke(
390:       'SMOKE-SHP-01',
391:       'Danh sách vận đơn & Tra cứu hành trình (ShipmentListTab + UnifiedTrackingModal + Reachability & Opener)',
392:       'Shipments',
393:       'DEMO_MOCK',
394:       Boolean(shipmentSurfaceValid),
395:       shipmentSurfaceValid
396:         ? `ShipmentListTab gắn đúng viewport 'shipments' (vai trò: ${reachResult.mappedRoles.join(', ')}) và UnifiedTrackingModal gắn modal root với trigger tra cứu hợp lệ (${MASTER_SHIPMENTS.length} vận đơn mẫu)`
397:         : `Lỗi: ${reachResult.reason || 'Thiếu modal tra cứu, trigger tra cứu hoặc dữ liệu vận đơn'}`

915:       `Kết quả SMOKE-EXC-01 khi gỡ render viewport: ${excVpResult?.passed ? '❌ LỌT LỖI (VẪN PASS)' : '✅ BẮT THẤT BẠI CHÍNH XÁC'}`
916:     );
917:     console.log(`Chi tiết: ${excVpResult?.notes}\n`);
918: 
919:     // Test Case 5: Modal Opener Severance (Removes setCreateOrderOpen(true) trigger while CreateOrderModal JSX remains mounted)
920:     console.log(
921:       '--- [KIỂM THỬ ÂM TÍNH 5]: Ngắt trigger mở modal tạo đơn (Modal Opener Trigger Severance) ---'
922:     );
923:     const modalOpenerSeveredSource = realPageSource.replace(
924:       /setCreateOrderOpen\(true\)/g,
925:       '/* Severed create order modal trigger */'
926:     );
927:     verifyMutationApplied(
928:       'Modal Opener Trigger Severance',
929:       modalOpenerSeveredSource,
930:       realPageSource
931:     );
932: 
933:     const modalOpenerTestRun = runPreservationSmokeTests(modalOpenerSeveredSource);
934:     const ordModalResult = modalOpenerTestRun.results.find((r) => r.surfaceId === 'SMOKE-ORD-01');
935: 
936:     console.log(
937:       `Kết quả SMOKE-ORD-01 khi ngắt trigger mở modal: ${ordModalResult?.passed ? '❌ LỌT LỖI (VẪN PASS)' : '✅ BẮT THẤT BẠI CHÍNH XÁC'}`
938:     );
939:     console.log(`Chi tiết: ${ordModalResult?.notes}\n`);
940: 
941:     const allNegativeTestsDetected =
942:       !excNavResult?.passed &&
943:       !excPartialResult?.passed &&
944:       !rbacExtraResult?.passed &&
945:       !excVpResult?.passed &&
946:       !ordModalResult?.passed;
947: 
948:     console.log('================================================================');
949:     console.log(
950:       `KẾT QUẢ KIỂM THỬ ÂM TÍNH BẢO TOÀN ĐIỀU HƯỚNG, VAI TRÒ & VIEWPORT/MODAL: ${allNegativeTestsDetected ? 'ĐẠT CHUẨN (5/5 BẮT LỖI THÀNH CÔNG)' : 'THẤT BẠI'}`
951:     );
952:     console.log('================================================================\n');
953: 
954:     if (allNegativeTestsDetected) {
955:       console.error(

957:       );
958:       console.error(

961:       process.exit(1);
962:     } else {

965:       );
966:       process.exit(2);
967:     }
968:   }
969: 
970:   const { results, passedCount, totalSurfaces, failedCount } = runPreservationSmokeTests();
971:

974:     console.log(

976:     );

982:   );

220:     message_en: 'Carrier request sent, result pending reconciliation.',
221:     httpStatus: 202,
222:   },
223: } as const;
224: 
225: export class ShipDeAppError extends Error {
226:   public readonly code: string;
227:   public readonly httpStatus: number;
228:   public readonly messageEn: string;
229:   public readonly details?: Record<string, unknown>;
230: 
231:   constructor(errorDef: ShipDeErrorDetail, details?: Record<string, unknown>) {
232:     super(errorDef.message);
233:     this.code = errorDef.code;
234:     this.httpStatus = errorDef.httpStatus;
235:     this.messageEn = errorDef.message_en;
236:     this.details = details || errorDef.details;
237:     Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);
238:   }
239: 
240:   public toResponse(requestId: string = `req_${Date.now()}`) {
241:     return {
242:       error: {
243:         code: this.code,
244:         message: this.message,
245:         message_en: this.messageEn,
246:         details: this.details,
247:       },
248:       request_id: requestId,
249:     };
250:   }
251: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/types/ledger.ts">
 1: // ============================================================================
 2: // Ship Dễ — Ba Sổ Giá Trị Độc Lập (Tập 1 Mục 7.2, BR-45, BR-50, CN-18)
 3: // Cấm tuyệt đối cộng dồn ba sổ lại với nhau
 4: // ============================================================================
 5: 
 6: import { CurrencyAmount } from './domain';
 7: 
 8: /**
 9:  * Sổ 1: Tiền Thực Nhận (Recovered Cash)
10:  * Bằng chứng ROI thực tế từ các khoản đòi bồi thường / hoàn phí thành công đã về tài khoản ngân hàng.
11:  */
12: export interface Ledger1_RealCash {
13:   total_recovered_amount: CurrencyAmount; // Tổng tiền thực nhận (VNĐ)
14:   claim_count: number; // Số lượng hồ sơ khiếu nại đã nhận tiền
15:   pending_acceptance_amount: CurrencyAmount; // Tiền hãng đã chấp thuận nhưng chưa về (cột riêng)
16:   records: Array<{
17:     claim_id: string;
18:     tracking_code: string;
19:     carrier_code: string;
20:     accepted_amount: CurrencyAmount;
21:     recovered_amount: CurrencyAmount;
22:     bank_reference?: string;
23:     paid_at: Date;
24:   }>;
25: }
26: 
27: /**
28:  * Sổ 2: Đơn Cứu Được (Rescued Orders)
29:  * Chỉ số hiệu quả vận hành: Số đơn gặp sự cố giao thất bại được CSKH can thiệp cứu thành công.
30:  * Tiết kiệm phí hoàn đơn cho shop (BR-50: Không cộng phí chiều đi vì đơn đã giao shop vẫn trả phí đó).
31:  */
32: export interface Ledger2_RescuedOrders {
33:   rescued_orders_count: number; // Số lượng đơn cứu thành công
34:   total_return_fee_saved: CurrencyAmount; // Tổng phí hoàn tránh được (VNĐ)
35:   rescued_gmv: CurrencyAmount; // Tổng giá trị hàng hóa (GMV) cứu được (ghi riêng, không quy thành tiền mặt)
36:   records: Array<{
37:     case_id: string;
38:     tracking_code: string;
39:     order_code: string;
40:     delivery_attempts: number;
41:     intervention_channel: string;
42:     return_fee_saved: CurrencyAmount;
43:     gmv: CurrencyAmount;
44:     rescued_at: Date;
45:   }>;
46: }
47: 
48: /**
49:  * Sổ 3: Khả Năng Kiểm Soát (Operational Control)
50:  * Đo lường độ phủ dữ liệu, thời gian phản hồi và giờ công kế toán tiết kiệm được.
51:  * Đây là cơ sở thuyết phục shop trả thuê bao SaaS cố định (BR-46).
52:  */
53: export interface Ledger3_ControlMetrics {
54:   total_active_shipments: number; // Tổng số vận đơn trong kỳ
55:   realtime_tracking_coverage_pct: number; // % đơn cập nhật trạng thái trong 24h
56:   reconciled_cod_coverage_pct: number; // % COD đã được đối soát chính xác
57:   discrepancies_detected_count: number; // Số lượng sai lệch cước/COD phát hiện & ngăn chặn
58:   accounting_hours_saved: number; // Số giờ công đối soát thủ công tiết kiệm được (ước tính: 500 đơn = 1h kế toán)
59:   carrier_health_score: Record<string, { uptime_pct: number; on_time_delivery_pct: number }>;
60: }
61: 
62: /**
63:  * Báo cáo Ba Sổ Tổng Hợp Chuẩn (CN-18)
64:  * Tuyệt đối KHÔNG có trường `total_combined_value` (BR-45).
65:  */
66: export interface ThreeValueLedgersReport {
67:   merchant_id: string;
68:   period_start: Date;
69:   period_end: Date;
70:   generated_at: Date;
71: 
72:   // Ba sổ độc lập
73:   ledger1_real_cash: Ledger1_RealCash;
74:   ledger2_rescued_orders: Ledger2_RescuedOrders;
75:   ledger3_control_metrics: Ledger3_ControlMetrics;
76: }
77: 
78: /**
79:  * Kiểm tra ràng buộc BR-45: Đảm bảo không tồn tại trường tính tổng ba sổ
80:  */
81: export function validateThreeLedgersSeparation(report: ThreeValueLedgersReport): boolean {
82:   const keys = Object.keys(report);
83:   const forbiddenKeywords = ['total_value', 'combined_amount', 'grand_total', 'roi_total'];
84:   for (const key of keys) {
85:     if (forbiddenKeywords.some((forbidden) => key.toLowerCase().includes(forbidden))) {
86:       throw new Error(`BR-45 VIOLATION: Forbidden combined field detected: "${key}"`);
87:     }
88:   }
89:   return true;
90: }
</file>

14:       "@shipde/config": ["../../packages/config/src/index.ts"],
15:       "@shipde/testkit": ["../../packages/testkit/src/index.ts"],
16:       "@shipde/ui": ["../../packages/ui/src/index.ts"]
17:     }
18:   },
19:   "include": [
20:     "next-env.d.ts",
21:     "**/*.ts",
22:     "**/*.tsx",
23:     ".next/types/**/*.ts",
24:     ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"
25:   ],
26:   "exclude": ["node_modules"]
27: }
</file>

<file path="apps/worker/src/dispatcher/outbox.dispatcher.ts">
  1: import { Injectable, Inject, OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
  2: import { Queue } from 'bullmq';
  3: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
  4: import {
  5:   AppConfig,
  6:   formatStructuredLog,
  7:   normalizeCorrelationId,
  8:   redactSensitiveData,
  9:   sanitizeErrorMessage,
 10:   getTracer,
 11:   withSpan,
 12:   injectTraceContext,
 13: } from '@shipde/config';
 14: import { APP_CONFIG } from '../config.token';
 15: import { SMOKE_QUEUE_NAME, QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE } from '@shipde/contracts';
 16: import { OutboxStatusEnum, OutboxEvent } from '@prisma/client';
 17: import { SmokeJobData } from '../queue/smoke.worker';
 18: 
 19: @Injectable()
 20: export class OutboxDispatcher implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
 21:   private queue: Queue<SmokeJobData> | null = null;
 22:   private pollInterval: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
 23:   private isTickRunning = false;
 24:   private readonly config: AppConfig;
 25: 
 26:   constructor(
 27:     @Inject(APP_CONFIG) config: AppConfig,
 28:     private readonly prisma: PrismaService
 29:   ) {
 30:     this.config = config;
 31:   }
 32: 
 33:   async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
 34:     this.queue = new Queue<SmokeJobData>(SMOKE_QUEUE_NAME, {
 35:       connection: {
 36:         host: this.config.REDIS_HOST,
 37:         port: this.config.REDIS_PORT,
 38:         password: this.config.REDIS_PASSWORD,
 39:       },
 40:       defaultJobOptions: {
 41:         attempts: 3,
 42:         backoff: {
 43:           type: 'exponential',
 44:           delay: 1000,
 45:         },
 46:         removeOnComplete: false,
 47:         removeOnFail: false,
 48:       },
 49:     });
 50: 
 51:     // Serialize interval ticks to prevent overlapping execution (Finding 5)
 52:     this.pollInterval = setInterval(async () => {
 53:       if (this.isTickRunning) {
 54:         return;
 55:       }
 56:       this.isTickRunning = true;
 57:       try {
 58:         await this.dispatchPending();
 59:         await this.recoverStaleProcessing();
 60:       } catch {
 61:         // Errors logged internally in dispatchPending / recoverStaleProcessing
 62:       } finally {
 63:         this.isTickRunning = false;
 64:       }
 65:     }, 1000);
 66:   }
 67: 
 68:   getQueue(): Queue<SmokeJobData> {
 69:     if (!this.queue) {
 70:       throw new Error('OutboxDispatcher queue is not initialized');
 71:     }
 72:     return this.queue;
 73:   }
 74: 
 75:   /**
 76:    * Scans for pending outbox events and dispatches them to BullMQ.
 77:    * Guarantees at-least-once dispatch with bounded retries and OpenTelemetry distributed tracing (Finding 10).
 78:    */
 79:   async dispatchPending(limit = 10): Promise<{ dispatched: number; failed: number }> {
 80:     const tracer = getTracer('shipde-worker');
 81:     return withSpan(tracer, 'outbox.dispatch_pending', async () => {
 82:       const now = new Date();
 83:       const pendingEvents = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.findMany({
 84:         where: {
 85:           event_type: QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE,
 86:           status: OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING,
 87:           scheduled_at: { lte: now },
 88:         },
 89:         take: limit,
 90:         orderBy: { scheduled_at: 'asc' },
 91:       });
 92: 
 93:       let dispatched = 0;
 94:       let failed = 0;
 95: 
 96:       for (const event of pendingEvents) {
 97:         const correlationId = normalizeCorrelationId(event.correlation_id);
 98:         try {
 99:           // Atomically claim only PENDING record to PROCESSING and record processing-start timestamp
100:           const claimResult = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
101:             where: {
102:               id: event.id,
103:               status: OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING,
104:             },
105:             data: {
106:               status: OutboxStatusEnum.PROCESSING,
107:               scheduled_at: new Date(),
108:             },
109:           });
110: 
111:           if (claimResult.count === 0) {
112:             // Event was concurrently claimed or completed, skip
113:             continue;
114:           }
115: 
116:           const queue = this.getQueue();
117:           const payloadObj = event.payload as Record<string, unknown>;
118:           const attemptJobId = `${event.idempotency_key || event.id}-del-${event.attempts}-${Date.now()}`;
119: 
120:           // Inject active trace context into job carrier
121:           const traceCarrier: Record<string, string> = {};
122:           injectTraceContext(traceCarrier);
123: 
124:           await queue.add(
125:             'smoke-job',
126:             {
127:               outboxId: event.id,
128:               smokeId: (payloadObj?.smokeId as string) || event.id,
129:               correlationId,
130:               eventType: event.event_type,
131:               payload: payloadObj,
132:               idempotencyKey: event.idempotency_key || undefined,
133:               traceContext: traceCarrier,
134:             },
135:             {
136:               jobId: attemptJobId,
137:             }
138:           );
139: 
140:           dispatched++;
141:           console.log(
142:             formatStructuredLog({
143:               level: 'info',
144:               service: 'worker',
145:               correlationId,
146:               message: `Outbox event ${event.id} (${event.event_type}) dispatched to BullMQ queue ${SMOKE_QUEUE_NAME}`,
147:               metadata: {
148:                 outboxId: event.id,
149:                 eventType: event.event_type,
150:                 queue: SMOKE_QUEUE_NAME,
151:                 jobId: attemptJobId,
152:               },
153:             })
154:           );
155:         } catch (err: unknown) {
156:           failed++;
157:           const errorMessage = sanitizeErrorMessage(err);
158:           console.error(
159:             formatStructuredLog({
160:               level: 'error',
161:               service: 'worker',
162:               correlationId,
163:               message: `Failed to dispatch outbox event ${event.id}: ${errorMessage}`,
164:               metadata: { outboxId: event.id, error: errorMessage },
165:             })
166:           );
167: 
168:           try {
169:             const nextAttempts = event.attempts + 1;
170:             const isExhausted = nextAttempts >= 3;
171:             await this.prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
172:               where: {
173:                 id: event.id,
174:                 status: OutboxStatusEnum.PROCESSING,
175:               },
176:               data: {
177:                 status: isExhausted ? OutboxStatusEnum.FAILED : OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING,
178:                 attempts: nextAttempts,
179:                 last_error: errorMessage,
180:                 scheduled_at: new Date(
181:                   Date.now() + Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(2, nextAttempts), 30000)
182:                 ),
183:               },
184:             });
185:           } catch (updateErr: unknown) {
186:             console.error(
187:               formatStructuredLog({
188:                 level: 'error',
189:                 service: 'worker',
190:                 correlationId,
191:                 message: `Failed to revert outbox event ${event.id} status after dispatch failure: ${sanitizeErrorMessage(updateErr)}`,
192:                 metadata: { outboxId: event.id, error: sanitizeErrorMessage(updateErr) },
193:               })
194:             );
195:           }
196:         }
197:       }
198: 
199:       return { dispatched, failed };
200:     });
201:   }
202: 
203:   /**
204:    * Recovers records stranded in PROCESSING beyond a visibility window.
205:    * Includes observed scheduled_at and attempts in the conditional update to prevent regressing
206:    * fresh claims or concurrent publications (Finding 5).
207:    */
208:   async recoverStaleProcessing(
209:     olderThanMs = 60000
210:   ): Promise<{ recovered: number; failed: number }> {
211:     const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - olderThanMs);
212:     const staleEvents = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.findMany({
213:       where: {
214:         event_type: QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE,
215:         status: OutboxStatusEnum.PROCESSING,
216:         scheduled_at: { lte: cutoff },
217:       },
218:     });
219: 
220:     let recovered = 0;
221:     let failed = 0;
222: 
223:     for (const event of staleEvents) {
224:       const nextAttempts = event.attempts + 1;
225:       const isExhausted = nextAttempts >= 3;
226:       // Atomically transition ONLY if still in PROCESSING state with observed scheduled_at and attempts (Finding 5)
227:       const updateResult = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
228:         where: {
229:           id: event.id,
230:           status: OutboxStatusEnum.PROCESSING,
231:           scheduled_at: event.scheduled_at,
232:           attempts: event.attempts,
233:         },
234:         data: {
235:           status: isExhausted ? OutboxStatusEnum.FAILED : OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING,
236:           attempts: nextAttempts,
237:           last_error: isExhausted
238:             ? event.last_error || 'Exhausted processing attempts'
239:             : 'Recovered from stale processing state',
240:           scheduled_at: isExhausted
241:             ? new Date()
242:             : new Date(Date.now() + Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(2, nextAttempts), 30000)),
243:         },
244:       });
245: 
246:       if (updateResult.count > 0) {
247:         if (isExhausted) {
248:           failed++;
249:         } else {
250:           recovered++;
251:         }
252:       }
253:     }
254: 
255:     return { recovered, failed };
256:   }
257: 
258:   /**
259:    * Manually resets a FAILED outbox event back to PENDING.
260:    * Uses an atomic conditional FAILED-to-PENDING claim to prevent republishing completed events (Finding 1).
261:    * Uses exact match or delimited prefix cleanup to avoid prefix collisions (Finding 4).
262:    */
263:   async retryFailed(outboxId: string): Promise<OutboxEvent> {
264:     // 1. Atomically claim FAILED -> PENDING
265:     const claim = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
266:       where: {
267:         id: outboxId,
268:         status: OutboxStatusEnum.FAILED,
269:       },
270:       data: {
271:         status: OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING,
272:         attempts: 0,
273:         last_error: null,
274:         scheduled_at: new Date(),
275:       },
276:     });
277: 
278:     if (claim.count === 0) {
279:       const existing = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.findUnique({
280:         where: { id: outboxId },
281:       });
282:       if (!existing) {
283:         throw new Error(`Outbox event ${outboxId} not found`);
284:       }
285:       throw new Error(
286:         `Cannot retry outbox event ${outboxId} with status ${existing.status}; only FAILED events can be retried`
287:       );
288:     }
289: 
290:     // 2. Safely purge retained jobs from BullMQ queue using exact match or delimited prefix (Finding 4)
291:     try {
292:       const queue = this.getQueue();
293:       const existing = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.findUnique({
294:         where: { id: outboxId },
295:       });
296:       if (existing) {
297:         const baseKey = existing.idempotency_key || existing.id;
298:         const jobs = await queue.getJobs(['failed', 'completed', 'waiting', 'active', 'delayed']);
299:         for (const j of jobs) {
300:           // Exact match or delimited prefix (e.g. order-1-del-... or order-1:...)
301:           // NEVER match order-10 when baseKey is order-1
302:           const isExactOrDelimited =
303:             j.id === baseKey ||
304:             j.id?.startsWith(`${baseKey}-del-`) ||
305:             j.id?.startsWith(`${baseKey}:`);
306:           if (
307:             isExactOrDelimited ||
308:             j.data?.outboxId === existing.id ||
309:             (j.data?.idempotencyKey && j.data.idempotencyKey === baseKey)
310:           ) {
311:             await j.remove();
312:           }
313:         }
314:       }
315:     } catch {
316:       // Best-effort cleanup
317:     }
318: 
319:     // Note: The returned record is a best-effort snapshot; the event may be claimed concurrently by dispatchPending().
320:     const record = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.findUnique({
321:       where: { id: outboxId },
322:     });
323:     if (!record) {
324:       throw new Error(`Outbox event ${outboxId} not found`);
325:     }
326:     return record;
327:   }
328: 
329:   async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
330:     if (this.pollInterval) {
331:       clearInterval(this.pollInterval);
332:       this.pollInterval = null;
333:     }
334:     if (this.queue) {
335:       await this.queue.close();
336:       this.queue = null;
337:     }
338:   }
339: }
</file>

<file path="apps/worker/src/health/health.controller.ts">
 1: import { Controller, Get, Req, Res, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { Request, Response } from 'express';
 3: import { HealthService } from './health.service';
 4: import { LivenessResponse, ReadinessResponse } from '@shipde/contracts';
 5: import { normalizeCorrelationId, CORRELATION_ID_HEADER } from '@shipde/config';
 6: 
 7: @Controller('health')
 8: export class HealthController {
 9:   constructor(@Inject(HealthService) private readonly healthService: HealthService) {}
10: 
11:   @Get('live')
12:   getLive(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): Response {
13:     const rawHeader = req.headers[CORRELATION_ID_HEADER];
14:     const candidate = Array.isArray(rawHeader) ? rawHeader[0] : rawHeader;
15:     const correlationId = normalizeCorrelationId(candidate);
16: 
17:     res.setHeader(CORRELATION_ID_HEADER, correlationId);
18:     const body: LivenessResponse = {
19:       status: 'ok',
20:       service: 'worker',
21:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
22:       correlationId,
23:     };
24:     return res.status(200).json(body);
25:   }
26: 
27:   @Get('ready')
28:   async getReady(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): Promise<Response> {
29:     const rawHeader = req.headers[CORRELATION_ID_HEADER];
30:     const candidate = Array.isArray(rawHeader) ? rawHeader[0] : rawHeader;
31:     const correlationId = normalizeCorrelationId(candidate);
32: 
33:     res.setHeader(CORRELATION_ID_HEADER, correlationId);
34:     const { isReady, checks } = await this.healthService.checkReadiness();
35: 
36:     const responseBody: ReadinessResponse = {
37:       status: isReady ? 'ok' : 'error',
38:       service: 'worker',
39:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
40:       correlationId,
41:       checks,
42:     };
43: 
44:     const httpStatus = isReady ? 200 : 503;
45:     return res.status(httpStatus).json(responseBody);
46:   }
47: }
</file>

<file path="apps/worker/src/health/health.service.ts">
 1: import { Injectable, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
 3: import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
 4: import { StorageService } from '../storage/storage.service';
 5: import { ReadinessDependencyChecks } from '@shipde/contracts';
 6: 
 7: @Injectable()
 8: export class HealthService {
 9:   constructor(
10:     @Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
11:     @Inject(RedisService) private readonly redis: RedisService,
12:     @Inject(StorageService) private readonly storage: StorageService
13:   ) {}
14: 
15:   async checkReadiness(): Promise<{ isReady: boolean; checks: ReadinessDependencyChecks }> {
16:     const [database, redis, storage] = await Promise.all([
17:       this.prisma.checkReadiness(),
18:       this.redis.checkReadiness(),
19:       this.storage.checkReadiness(),
20:     ]);
21: 
22:     const checks: ReadinessDependencyChecks = {
23:       database,
24:       redis,
25:       storage,
26:     };
27: 
28:     const isReady = database === 'up' && redis === 'up' && storage === 'up';
29:     return { isReady, checks };
30:   }
31: }
</file>

<file path="apps/worker/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts">
 1: import { Injectable, OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
 3: 
 4: @Injectable()
 5: export class PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
 6:   async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
 7:     // Non-blocking initial connection: do not await $connect() during worker bootstrap.
 8:     // A slow, unreachable, or blackholed database must never block Nest bootstrap
 9:     // or prevent the HTTP health server from immediately serving /health/live (Finding 2).
10:     void this.$connect().catch(() => {
11:       // Detached connect failure is handled gracefully; readiness probe will report down.
12:     });
13:   }
14: 
15:   async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
16:     try {
17:       await this.$disconnect();
18:     } catch {
19:       // Ignore disconnect errors during teardown
20:     }
21:   }
22: 
23:   /**
24:    * Bounded database readiness check.
25:    */
26:   async checkReadiness(timeoutMs = 2000): Promise<'up' | 'down'> {
27:     try {
28:       const queryPromise = this.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
29:       const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
30:         setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Database check timeout')), timeoutMs)
31:       );
32: 
33:       await Promise.race([queryPromise, timeoutPromise]);
34:       return 'up';
35:     } catch {
36:       return 'down';
37:     }
38:   }
39: }
</file>

<file path="apps/worker/src/queue/smoke.worker.ts">
  1: import { Injectable, Inject, Optional, OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
  2: import { Worker, Job } from 'bullmq';
  3: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
  4: import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
  5: import {
  6:   AppConfig,
  7:   formatStructuredLog,
  8:   normalizeCorrelationId,
  9:   redactSensitiveData,
 10:   getTracer,
 11:   withSpan,
 12:   extractTraceContext,
 13: } from '@shipde/config';
 14: import { APP_CONFIG } from '../config.token';
 15: import { SMOKE_QUEUE_NAME, QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE } from '@shipde/contracts';
 16: import { OutboxStatusEnum } from '@prisma/client';
 17: 
 18: export interface SmokeJobData {
 19:   outboxId: string;
 20:   smokeId: string;
 21:   correlationId: string;
 22:   eventType?: string;
 23:   payload?: Record<string, unknown>;
 24:   idempotencyKey?: string;
 25:   traceContext?: Record<string, string>;
 26: }
 27: 
 28: @Injectable()
 29: export class SmokeWorker implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
 30:   private worker: Worker<SmokeJobData> | null = null;
 31:   private readonly config: AppConfig;
 32:   public processedCount = 0;
 33:   public duplicateCount = 0;
 34: 
 35:   constructor(
 36:     @Inject(APP_CONFIG) config: AppConfig,
 37:     private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
 38:     @Optional() private readonly redisService?: RedisService
 39:   ) {
 40:     this.config = config;
 41:   }
 42: 
 43:   async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
 44:     this.worker = new Worker<SmokeJobData>(
 45:       SMOKE_QUEUE_NAME,
 46:       async (job: Job<SmokeJobData>) => {
 47:         return this.processJob(job);
 48:       },
 49:       {
 50:         connection: {
 51:           host: this.config.REDIS_HOST,
 52:           port: this.config.REDIS_PORT,
 53:           password: this.config.REDIS_PASSWORD,
 54:         },
 55:         concurrency: 1,
 56:       }
 57:     );
 58: 
 59:     this.worker.on('failed', async (job, err) => {
 60:       await this.handleJobFailure(job, err);
 61:     });
 62:   }
 63: 
 64:   async processJob(job: Job<SmokeJobData>): Promise<{ success: boolean; duplicate: boolean }> {
 65:     const data = job.data;
 66:     const initialCorrelationId = normalizeCorrelationId(data?.correlationId);
 67: 
 68:     // 1. Restrict foundation worker strictly to QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE (Finding 4)
 69:     if (data?.eventType !== QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE) {
 70:       console.warn(
 71:         formatStructuredLog({
 72:           level: 'warn',
 73:           service: 'worker',
 74:           correlationId: initialCorrelationId,
 75:           message: `SmokeWorker ignoring unsupported or missing event type '${data?.eventType}' for job ${job.id}`,
 76:           metadata: {
 77:             jobId: job.id,
 78:             eventType: data?.eventType,
 79:             outboxId: data?.outboxId,
 80:           },
 81:         })
 82:       );
 83:       return { success: false, duplicate: false };
 84:     }
 85: 
 86:     // 2. Strictly require durable outboxId (Finding 2)
 87:     if (!data?.outboxId) {
 88:       console.error(
 89:         formatStructuredLog({
 90:           level: 'error',
 91:           service: 'worker',
 92:           correlationId: initialCorrelationId,
 93:           message: `SmokeWorker rejected job ${job.id}: missing required durable outboxId`,
 94:           metadata: {
 95:             jobId: job.id,
 96:             outboxId: 'missing',
 97:           },
 98:         })
 99:       );
100:       return { success: false, duplicate: false };
101:     }
102: 
103:     // 3. Load durable outbox record from database (Finding 2)
104:     let outboxRecord = null;
105:     try {
106:       outboxRecord = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.findUnique({
107:         where: { id: data.outboxId },
108:       });
109:     } catch {
110:       // Invalid UUID or database query error
111:       outboxRecord = null;
112:     }
113: 
114:     if (!outboxRecord) {
115:       console.error(
116:         formatStructuredLog({
117:           level: 'error',
118:           service: 'worker',
119:           correlationId: initialCorrelationId,
120:           message: `SmokeWorker rejected job ${job.id}: durable outbox event ${data.outboxId} not found in database`,
121:           metadata: {
122:             jobId: job.id,
123:             outboxId: data.outboxId,
124:           },
125:         })
126:       );
127:       return { success: false, duplicate: false };
128:     }
129: 
130:     if (outboxRecord.event_type !== QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE) {
131:       console.error(
132:         formatStructuredLog({
133:           level: 'error',
134:           service: 'worker',
135:           correlationId: initialCorrelationId,
136:           message: `SmokeWorker rejected job ${job.id}: durable outbox event ${data.outboxId} has unsupported type '${outboxRecord.event_type}'`,
137:           metadata: {
138:             jobId: job.id,
139:             outboxId: data.outboxId,
140:             eventType: outboxRecord.event_type,
141:           },
142:         })
143:       );
144:       return { success: false, duplicate: false };
145:     }
146: 
147:     // Derive correlationId and payload strictly from durable outbox record (Finding 2)
148:     const correlationId = normalizeCorrelationId(outboxRecord.correlation_id || data.correlationId);
149:     const payload = (outboxRecord.payload as Record<string, unknown>) || data.payload;
150: 
151:     const tracer = getTracer('shipde-worker');
152:     const parentContext = data.traceContext ? extractTraceContext(data.traceContext) : undefined;
153:     return withSpan(
154:       tracer,
155:       'smoke.process',
156:       async () => {
157:         console.log(
158:           formatStructuredLog({
159:             level: 'info',
160:             service: 'worker',
161:             correlationId,
162:             message: `Processing smoke job ${job.id} for outbox event ${data.outboxId}`,
163:             metadata: {
164:               jobId: job.id,
165:               smokeId: data.smokeId,
166:               outboxId: data.outboxId,
167:             },
168:           })
169:         );
170: 
171:         const jobId = job.id || data.smokeId;
172:         const dedupKey = `smoke:dedup:${jobId}`;
173: 
174:         // 4. Redis Deduplication Guard (AC-FOUND-03-10)
175:         if (this.redisService) {
176:           try {
177:             const redis = this.redisService.getClient();
178:             if (redis.status !== 'ready') {
179:               await redis.connect();
180:             }
181:             const acquired = await redis.set(dedupKey, '1', 'EX', 86400, 'NX');
182:             if (!acquired) {
183:               // Reconcile against durable database state before acknowledging duplicate
184:               if (outboxRecord.status === OutboxStatusEnum.PUBLISHED) {
185:                 this.duplicateCount++;
186:                 console.log(
187:                   formatStructuredLog({
188:                     level: 'warn',
189:                     service: 'worker',
190:                     correlationId,
191:                     message: `Duplicate job ${job.id} skipped via Redis deduplication key ${dedupKey}.`,
192:                     metadata: {
193:                       jobId: job.id,
194:                       dedupKey,
195:                     },
196:                   })
197:                 );
198:                 return { success: true, duplicate: true };
199:               }
200:             }
201:           } catch {
202:             // Fall through to database guard if Redis fails
203:           }
204:         }
205: 
206:         try {
207:           // 5. Database Outbox State Deduplication Guard
208:           if (outboxRecord.status === OutboxStatusEnum.PUBLISHED) {
209:             this.duplicateCount++;
210:             console.log(
211:               formatStructuredLog({
212:                 level: 'warn',
213:                 service: 'worker',
214:                 correlationId,
215:                 message: `Duplicate job ${job.id} received for already published outbox event ${data.outboxId}. Acknowledged without duplicating side effects.`,
216:                 metadata: {
217:                   outboxId: data.outboxId,
218:                   status: outboxRecord.status,
219:                 },
220:               })
221:             );
222:             return { success: true, duplicate: true };
223:           }
224: 
225:           // Execute deterministic smoke side effect: transition outbox event to PUBLISHED atomically
226:           const claimEffect = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
227:             where: {
228:               id: data.outboxId,
229:               event_type: QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE,
230:               status: { in: [OutboxStatusEnum.PROCESSING, OutboxStatusEnum.PENDING] },
231:             },
232:             data: {
233:               status: OutboxStatusEnum.PUBLISHED,
234:               published_at: new Date(),
235:               attempts: { increment: 1 },
236:               last_error: null,
237:             },
238:           });
239: 
240:           if (claimEffect.count === 0) {
241:             // Another concurrent delivery already committed the effect to PUBLISHED
242:             this.duplicateCount++;
243:             console.log(
244:               formatStructuredLog({
245:                 level: 'warn',
246:                 service: 'worker',
247:                 correlationId,
248:                 message: `Duplicate job ${job.id} detected via atomic database claim guard for outbox event ${data.outboxId}. Side effects already committed.`,
249:                 metadata: {
250:                   outboxId: data.outboxId,
251:                 },
252:               })
253:             );
254:             return { success: true, duplicate: true };
255:           }
256: 
257:           this.processedCount++;
258:           console.log(
259:             formatStructuredLog({
260:               level: 'info',
261:               service: 'worker',
262:               correlationId,
263:               message: `Successfully executed deterministic smoke effect for job ${job.id}`,
264:               metadata: {
265:                 jobId: job.id,
266:                 smokeId: data.smokeId,
267:                 outboxId: data.outboxId,
268:               },
269:             })
270:           );
271: 
272:           return { success: true, duplicate: false };
273:         } catch (err) {
274:           // Clear Redis dedup key on failure so retry attempt can acquire it
275:           if (this.redisService) {
276:             try {
277:               await this.redisService.getClient().del(dedupKey);
278:             } catch {
279:               // ignore
280:             }
281:           }
282:           throw err;
283:         }
284:       },
285:       {
286:         'job.id': job.id || '',
287:         'outbox.id': data.outboxId || '',
288:         correlation_id: correlationId,
289:       },
290:       parentContext
291:     );
292:   }
293: 
294:   /**
295:    * Handles job failure lifecycle: records bounded attempts and sanitized error metadata,
296:    * leaves transient retries in PROCESSING (or recoverable), and transitions exhausted failures to FAILED.
297:    */
298:   async handleJobFailure(job: Job<SmokeJobData> | undefined, err: Error): Promise<void> {
299:     if (!job) return;
300:     const correlationId = job.data?.correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
301:     const maxAttempts = job.opts?.attempts ?? 3;
302:     const attempts = job.attemptsMade || 1;
303:     const isExhausted = attempts >= maxAttempts;
304:     const rawError = err?.message || 'Unknown handler failure';
305:     const sanitizedError = (redactSensitiveData(rawError) as string) || rawError;
306: 
307:     console.error(
308:       formatStructuredLog({
309:         level: 'error',
310:         service: 'worker',
311:         correlationId,
312:         message: `Job ${job.id} in ${SMOKE_QUEUE_NAME} failed (attempt ${attempts}/${maxAttempts}): ${sanitizedError}`,
313:         metadata: {
314:           jobId: job.id,
315:           outboxId: job.data?.outboxId,
316:           attempts,
317:           isExhausted,
318:         },
319:       })
320:     );
321: 
322:     // If transient failure, clean up Redis dedup key so retry can proceed
323:     if (!isExhausted && this.redisService) {
324:       try {
325:         const dedupKey = `smoke:dedup:${job.id || job.data?.smokeId}`;
326:         await this.redisService.getClient().del(dedupKey);
327:       } catch {
328:         // ignore
329:       }
330:     }
331: 
332:     if (job.data?.outboxId) {
333:       try {
334:         const updateResult = await this.prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
335:           where: {
336:             id: job.data.outboxId,
337:             event_type: QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE,
338:             status: OutboxStatusEnum.PROCESSING,
339:           },
340:           data: {
341:             attempts,
342:             last_error: sanitizedError,
343:             status: isExhausted ? OutboxStatusEnum.FAILED : OutboxStatusEnum.PROCESSING,
344:           },
345:         });
346: 
347:         if (updateResult.count === 0) {
348:           console.log(
349:             formatStructuredLog({
350:               level: 'warn',
351:               service: 'worker',
352:               correlationId,
353:               message: `Ignoring late failure update for outbox event ${job.data.outboxId}: already transitioned out of PROCESSING`,
354:               metadata: {
355:                 outboxId: job.data.outboxId,
356:                 jobId: job.id,
357:               },
358:             })
359:           );
360:         }
361:       } catch (dbErr: any) {
362:         console.error(
363:           formatStructuredLog({
364:             level: 'error',
365:             service: 'worker',
366:             correlationId,
367:             message: `Failed to update outbox event failure state for ${job.data.outboxId}: ${dbErr.message}`,
368:           })
369:         );
370:       }
371:     }
372:   }
373: 
374:   async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
375:     if (this.worker) {
376:       await this.worker.close();
377:       this.worker = null;
378:     }
379:   }
380: }
</file>

<file path="apps/worker/src/redis/redis.service.ts">
 1: import { Injectable, Inject, OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import Redis from 'ioredis';
 3: import { AppConfig } from '@shipde/config';
 4: import { APP_CONFIG } from '../config.token';
 5: 
 6: @Injectable()
 7: export class RedisService implements OnModuleDestroy {
 8:   private client: Redis | null = null;
 9:   private readonly config: AppConfig;
10: 
11:   constructor(@Inject(APP_CONFIG) config: AppConfig) {
12:     this.config = config;
13:   }
14: 
15:   getClient(): Redis {
16:     if (!this.client) {
17:       this.client = new Redis({
18:         host: this.config.REDIS_HOST,
19:         port: this.config.REDIS_PORT,
20:         password: this.config.REDIS_PASSWORD,
21:         lazyConnect: true,
22:         maxRetriesPerRequest: 1,
23:         connectTimeout: 2000,
24:         retryStrategy: () => null,
25:       });
26:       this.client.on('error', () => {
27:         // Prevent unhandled error event on connection loss/refusal
28:       });
29:     }
30:     return this.client;
31:   }
32: 
33:   async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
34:     if (this.client) {
35:       try {
36:         await this.client.quit();
37:       } catch {
38:         this.client.disconnect();
39:       }
40:       this.client = null;
41:     }
42:   }
43: 
44:   /**
45:    * Bounded Redis readiness check.
46:    */
47:   async checkReadiness(timeoutMs = 2000): Promise<'up' | 'down'> {
48:     try {
49:       const redis = this.getClient();
50:       if (redis.status !== 'ready') {
51:         await redis.connect();
52:       }
53: 
54:       const pingPromise = redis.ping();
55:       const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
56:         setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Redis check timeout')), timeoutMs)
57:       );
58: 
59:       const res = await Promise.race([pingPromise, timeoutPromise]);
60:       return res === 'PONG' ? 'up' : 'down';
61:     } catch {
62:       return 'down';
63:     }
64:   }
65: }
</file>

<file path="apps/worker/src/storage/storage.service.ts">
 1: import { Injectable, Inject, OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { S3Client, HeadBucketCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
 3: import { AppConfig } from '@shipde/config';
 4: import { APP_CONFIG } from '../config.token';
 5: 
 6: @Injectable()
 7: export class StorageService implements OnModuleDestroy {
 8:   private client: S3Client | null = null;
 9:   private readonly config: AppConfig;
10: 
11:   constructor(@Inject(APP_CONFIG) config: AppConfig) {
12:     this.config = config;
13:   }
14: 
15:   getClient(): S3Client {
16:     if (!this.client) {
17:       this.client = new S3Client({
18:         endpoint: this.config.S3_ENDPOINT,
19:         region: this.config.S3_REGION,
20:         credentials: {
21:           accessKeyId: this.config.S3_ACCESS_KEY,
22:           secretAccessKey: this.config.S3_SECRET_KEY,
23:         },
24:         forcePathStyle: this.config.S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE,
25:       });
26:     }
27:     return this.client;
28:   }
29: 
30:   async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
31:     if (this.client) {
32:       this.client.destroy();
33:       this.client = null;
34:     }
35:   }
36: 
37:   /**
38:    * Bounded S3 storage readiness check.
39:    * Executes HeadBucketCommand scoped to the configured bucket with an internal timeout (Finding 9).
40:    */
41:   async checkReadiness(timeoutMs = 2000): Promise<'up' | 'down'> {
42:     try {
43:       const s3 = this.getClient();
44:       const checkPromise = s3.send(
45:         new HeadBucketCommand({
46:           Bucket: this.config.S3_BUCKET,
47:         })
48:       );
49:       const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
50:         setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('S3 check timeout')), timeoutMs)
51:       );
52: 
53:       await Promise.race([checkPromise, timeoutPromise]);
54:       return 'up';
55:     } catch {
56:       return 'down';
57:     }
58:   }
59: }
</file>

<file path="apps/worker/src/main.ts">
 1: import * as path from 'path';
 2: import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
 3: import { WorkerAppModule } from './app.module';
 4: import {
 5:   validateConfig,
 6:   formatStructuredLog,
 7:   ConfigValidationError,
 8:   initTelemetry,
 9: } from '@shipde/config';
10: 
11: export async function bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
12:   initTelemetry('shipde-worker');
13: 
14:   // Explicitly load .env file from root monorepo or local directory (Node 24 native, Finding 2)
15:   if (typeof (process as any).loadEnvFile === 'function') {
16:     const candidateEnvPaths = [
17:       path.resolve(process.cwd(), '../../.env'),
18:       path.resolve(__dirname, '../../.env'),
19:       path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../.env'),
20:       path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env'),
21:     ];
22:     for (const envPath of candidateEnvPaths) {
23:       try {
24:         (process as any).loadEnvFile(envPath);
25:       } catch (err: any) {
26:         if (err.code !== 'ENOENT') {
27:           console.warn(
28:             formatStructuredLog({
29:               level: 'warn',
30:               service: 'worker',
31:               message: `Failed to load .env from ${envPath}: ${err.message}`,
32:             })
33:           );
34:         }
35:       }
36:     }
37:   }
38: 
39:   let config;
40:   try {
41:     config = validateConfig();
42:   } catch (err: any) {
43:     if (err instanceof ConfigValidationError) {
44:       console.error(
45:         formatStructuredLog({
46:           level: 'error',
47:           service: 'worker',
48:           message: `Fatal configuration error on startup: ${err.message}`,
49:         })
50:       );
51:     } else {
52:       console.error(
53:         formatStructuredLog({
54:           level: 'error',
55:           service: 'worker',
56:           message: 'Unknown error validating environment configuration',
57:         })
58:       );
59:     }
60:     process.exit(1);
61:   }
62: 
63:   const app = await NestFactory.create(WorkerAppModule, {
64:     logger: false,
65:   });
66: 
67:   app.enableShutdownHooks();
68: 
69:   await app.listen(config.WORKER_HEALTH_PORT);
70: 
71:   console.log(
72:     formatStructuredLog({
73:       level: 'info',
74:       service: 'worker',
75:       message: `Ship Dễ Worker service and health listener started on port ${config.WORKER_HEALTH_PORT}`,
76:       metadata: {
77:         workerHealthPort: config.WORKER_HEALTH_PORT,
78:         nodeEnv: config.NODE_ENV,
79:       },
80:     })
81:   );
82: }
83: 
84: if (require.main === module) {
85:   bootstrap().catch((err) => {
86:     console.error(
87:       formatStructuredLog({
88:         level: 'error',
89:         service: 'worker',
90:         message: `Unhandled exception during Worker bootstrap: ${err.message}`,
91:       })
92:     );
93:     process.exit(1);
94:   });
95: }
</file>

 15:   console.log('================================================================');

 18:

 33:

 35:     imports: [WorkerAppModule],
 36:   })
 37:     .overrideProvider(APP_CONFIG)
 38:     .useValue(mockConfig)
 39:     .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
 40:     .useValue({
 41:       checkReadiness: async () => 'up',

 43:       $disconnect: async () => {},
 44:     })
 45:     .overrideProvider(RedisService)
 46:     .useValue({

 49:       onModuleDestroy: async () => {},

 51:     .overrideProvider(StorageService)
 52:     .useValue({
 53:       checkReadiness: async () => 'up',
 54:     })
 55:     .overrideProvider(SmokeWorker)
 56:     .useValue({

 61:     .useValue({

 68:   await app.init();
 69:

 71:     // 1. Test GET /health/live
 72:     console.log('[TEST 1] GET /health/live returns 200 OK with valid worker liveness payload');
 73:     const liveRes = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/health/live').expect(200);
 74:     assert.strictEqual(liveRes.body.status, 'ok', 'Status must be ok');
 75:     assert.strictEqual(liveRes.body.service, 'worker', 'Service must be worker');
 76:     assert.ok(liveRes.body.timestamp, 'Timestamp must be present');
 77:     console.log('  PASS: /health/live responded 200 OK');

 81:     const readyRes = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/health/ready').expect(200);
 82:     assert.strictEqual(readyRes.body.status, 'ok', 'Status must be ok');
 83:     assert.strictEqual(readyRes.body.service, 'worker', 'Service must be worker');
 84:     assert.strictEqual(readyRes.body.checks.database, 'up', 'Database check must be up');
 85:     assert.strictEqual(readyRes.body.checks.redis, 'up', 'Redis check must be up');
 86:     assert.strictEqual(readyRes.body.checks.storage, 'up', 'Storage check must be up');
 87:     console.log('  PASS: /health/ready responded 200 with all dependencies up');
 88: 
 89:     // 3. Test Correlation ID propagation

 91:     const customCorrelationId = 'worker-correl-uuid-12345';
 92:     const corrRes = await request(app.getHttpServer())

 95:       .expect(200);
 96:     assert.strictEqual(

100:     );
101:     assert.strictEqual(
102:       corrRes.body.correlationId,
103:       customCorrelationId,
104:       'Response body correlationId must match incoming request'
105:     );
106:     console.log('  PASS: Correlation ID propagated correctly in HTTP header and body');
107: 
108:     // 4. Test Dependency Outage / Fail-Closed behavior
109:     console.log('[TEST 4] GET /health/ready fails closed (503) when database is down');
110:     const brokenModule: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
111:       imports: [WorkerAppModule],
112:     })
113:       .overrideProvider(APP_CONFIG)
114:       .useValue(mockConfig)
115:       .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
116:       .useValue({

118:         $connect: async () => {},
119:         $disconnect: async () => {},

124:         getClient: () => ({ status: 'ready', connect: async () => {} }),
125:         onModuleDestroy: async () => {},
126:       })
127:       .overrideProvider(StorageService)
128:       .useValue({
129:         checkReadiness: async () => 'up',
130:       })
131:       .overrideProvider(SmokeWorker)
132:       .useValue({
133:         onModuleInit: async () => {},
134:         onModuleDestroy: async () => {},
135:       })
136:       .overrideProvider(OutboxDispatcher)
137:       .useValue({
138:         onModuleInit: async () => {},
139:         onModuleDestroy: async () => {},
140:       })
141:       .compile();
142: 
143:     const brokenApp: INestApplication = brokenModule.createNestApplication();
144:     await brokenApp.init();
145: 
146:     const degradedRes = await request(brokenApp.getHttpServer()).get('/health/ready').expect(503);
147:     assert.strictEqual(degradedRes.body.status, 'error', 'Status must be error');
148:     assert.strictEqual(degradedRes.body.service, 'worker', 'Service must be worker');
149:     assert.strictEqual(degradedRes.body.checks.database, 'down', 'Database must be down');
150:     console.log('  PASS: Worker outage simulation correctly returned 503 degraded');
151:     await brokenApp.close();
152: 
153:     console.log('\n================================================================');
154:     console.log('ALL WORKER SUPERTEST & NESTJS HARNESS TESTS PASSED 100%');
155:     console.log('================================================================');
156:   } finally {
157:     await app.close();
158:   }
159: }

163:   process.exit(1);
164: });

73: ## Completeness test
74: 
75: For every feature marked CORE, the traceability matrix must eventually provide:
76: 
77: Feature ID → Actor → Rule → Use case → Screen → API/Job → Entity → State transition → Test → Backlog item.
78: 
79: The validator checks structural links and duplicate identifiers. Semantic sign-off remains a product/BA responsibility.

<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/00-control/GLOSSARY.md">
 1: # Glossary
 2: 
 3: | Term | Definition |
 4: |---|---|
 5: | Shop | Customer organization using Ship Dễ |
 6: | Tenant | Technical isolation boundary, normally one shop organization |
 7: | Branch | Business unit under a shop |
 8: | Warehouse | Pickup/return operating location |
 9: | Carrier account | Shop-owned account/contract at a carrier |
10: | Source order | Order received from OMS/POS or created manually |
11: | Quote | Time-bound carrier response for service, fee and SLA |
12: | Quote snapshot | Immutable request/response selected before shipment creation |
13: | Shipment | Ship Dễ delivery object linked to a source order |
14: | Waybill | Carrier-issued tracking code scoped by carrier account |
15: | Serviceability | Whether a carrier/service can serve a route and parcel |
16: | Carrier capability | An action supported for a specific carrier account/integration |
17: | Tracking event | Immutable raw/canonical movement or status event |
18: | Exception | Operational issue requiring attention |
19: | Return receipt | Warehouse evidence that returned goods were received and inspected |
20: | Rate contract | Approved structured version of the shop’s actual carrier agreement |
21: | Settlement policy | Eligibility, batch, threshold and COD transfer rules |
22: | Claim policy | Claim type, deadline, evidence and submission rules |
23: | Settlement statement | Carrier-provided line/batch report |
24: | Settlement batch | Carrier settlement/remittance grouping of many waybills |
25: | Finding | One audit observation; a waybill may have zero to many |
26: | Discrepancy case | Workflow/evidence record for one finding |
27: | Suspected amount | Machine-detected value not yet internally verified |
28: | Internally verified amount | Shop/Ship Dễ verified; carrier has not accepted |
29: | Carrier-accepted amount | Carrier acknowledged value, possibly unpaid |
30: | Actually received amount | Value proven by bank/payment evidence |
31: | Carry-forward | Balance/case relation continuing into a later period |
32: | Idempotency key | Client key preventing duplicate command effects |
33: | Unknown outcome | Command timed out and remote success/failure is not yet known |
</file>

<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/01-product/ACTORS-PERSONAS.md">
 1: # Actors and Personas
 2: 
 3: | Actor | Primary jobs | Sensitive access |
 4: |---|---|---|
 5: | SHOP_OWNER | Configure shop, approve policies, see all outcomes | All shop financial and PII data |
 6: | OPS_MANAGER | Manage routing, orders, exceptions and carrier performance | Operational data; configurable finance access |
 7: | ORDER_OPERATOR | Create/import orders, quote, create/cancel shipments, print labels | Recipient data and assigned carrier accounts |
 8: | CUSTOMER_SERVICE | View tracking, contact context, request redelivery under permission | Masked/limited recipient data |
 9: | WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR | Pickup handover, label, return scanning and evidence | Warehouse-scoped PII |
10: | FINANCE | Rates, statements, bank allocations, COD, cases and billing | Full financial data; limited operational PII |
11: | RATE_AUTHOR | Normalize contract/policies | Contract documents |
12: | RATE_REVIEWER | Approve/reject versions | Contract documents; cannot approve own version |
13: | SHIPDE_OPERATOR | Support imports, mappings, review and claims under granted access | Time-bound tenant support scope |
14: | SYSTEM_ADMIN | Platform configuration and incident response | No default business-data browsing |
15: | RECIPIENT | Track own shipment and authorized delivery actions | Only token/OTP-scoped shipment |
16: | CARRIER_SYSTEM | Serviceability, quote, shipment and tracking provider | External system |
17: | OMS_SYSTEM | Source order/status provider | External system |
18: | BANK_SOURCE | Receipt evidence provider | External system |
19: 
20: ## Persona principles
21: 
22: - Operators need speed, bulk actions and precise recovery guidance.
23: - Finance needs immutable evidence and reproducible calculations.
24: - Owners need decisions and exceptions, not raw integration noise.
25: - Warehouse users need scan-first screens and minimal typing.
26: - Recipients should not be forced to install an app.
27: - Support users never receive implicit permanent tenant access.
</file>

<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/01-product/BUSINESS-MODEL-KPIS.md">
 1: # Business Model and KPI Catalog
 2: 
 3: ## Initial pricing
 4: 
 5: - Pilot and initial production billing is based on reconciled waybills.
 6: - A waybill becomes billable once, at its first conclusive audit result.
 7: - Uniqueness key: tenant + carrier account + waybill.
 8: - Reruns, corrected imports, carry-forward and claim follow-up do not rebill.
 9: - No percentage-of-recovery fee.
10: - Shipping operations are included in the initial package to minimize customer friction; packaging can be revisited after usage data.
11: 
12: ## Product KPIs
13: 
14: | Area | KPI |
15: |---|---|
16: | Onboarding | Time to first connected account; time to first successful shipment |
17: | Quote | Carrier response coverage; quote latency; no-option rate |
18: | Shipment | Creation success; unknown-outcome rate; duplicate waybills |
19: | Tracking | Event freshness; unmapped status rate |
20: | Exception | Time to acknowledge; rescue success; prevented returns |
21: | Return | Scan completeness; duplicate receipt prevented; evidence completeness |
22: | Audit | Auditable coverage; auto-match rate; false-positive rate |
23: | Money | Suspected, internally verified, carrier accepted and received values, separately |
24: | Claim | Cases submitted before deadline; carrier acceptance; recovery aging |
25: | Reliability | Connector availability by carrier; job failure/retry rate |
26: | User value | Manual hours saved; active users; willingness to pay |
27: 
28: ## Release gates
29: 
30: - Duplicate shipment count must be zero in deterministic tests.
31: - No high-severity cross-tenant or authorization issue.
32: - No financial result without reproducible evidence.
33: - Carrier production capability must be partner-confirmed.
34: - Business KPI target values must be set before a pilot, not after.
</file>
