<file path="packages/testkit/src/auth/mock-verification-adapter.ts">
 1: import type { VerificationMessage, IVerificationDeliveryAdapter } from '@shipde/contracts';
 2: 
 3: export type { VerificationMessage, IVerificationDeliveryAdapter };
 4: 
 5: export class MockVerificationDeliveryAdapter implements IVerificationDeliveryAdapter {
 6:   private sentMessages: VerificationMessage[] = [];
 7:   private shouldFail = false;
 8:   private failureReason = 'Delivery service unavailable';
 9: 
10:   async sendVerification(
11:     message: Omit<VerificationMessage, 'sentAt'>
12:   ): Promise<{ success: boolean; messageId: string }> {
13:     if (this.shouldFail) {
14:       throw new Error(this.failureReason);
15:     }
16:     const record: VerificationMessage = {
17:       ...message,
18:       sentAt: new Date(),
19:     };
20:     this.sentMessages.push(record);
21:     return {
22:       success: true,
23:       messageId: `mock-msg-${this.sentMessages.length}`,
24:     };
25:   }
26: 
27:   getSentMessages(): VerificationMessage[] {
28:     return [...this.sentMessages];
29:   }
30: 
31:   getLastMessage(): VerificationMessage | undefined {
32:     return this.sentMessages[this.sentMessages.length - 1];
33:   }
34: 
35:   findMessagesByRecipient(recipient: string): VerificationMessage[] {
36:     return this.sentMessages.filter((m) => m.recipient === recipient);
37:   }
38: 
39:   setFailureMode(fail: boolean, reason = 'Delivery service unavailable'): void {
40:     this.shouldFail = fail;
41:     this.failureReason = reason;
42:   }
43: 
44:   clear(): void {
45:     this.sentMessages = [];
46:     this.shouldFail = false;
47:   }
48: }
49: 
50: export const globalMockVerificationAdapter = new MockVerificationDeliveryAdapter();
</file>

<file path="packages/testkit/src/carriers/base-mock.ts">
 1: import type {
 2:   ICarrierMockAdapter,
 3:   CarrierMockMode,
 4:   CarrierQuoteParams,
 5:   CarrierQuoteResult,
 6:   CarrierOrderParams,
 7:   CarrierOrderResult,
 8:   CarrierTrackingResult,
 9:   CarrierCancelResult,
10: } from './types.js';
11: 
12: export class CarrierMockError extends Error {
13:   constructor(
14:     public readonly code: string,
15:     message: string,
16:     public readonly statusCode: number = 400
17:   ) {
18:     super(message);
19:     this.name = 'CarrierMockError';
20:   }
21: }
22: 
23: export abstract class BaseCarrierMockAdapter implements ICarrierMockAdapter {
24:   protected mode: CarrierMockMode = 'SUCCESS';
25: 
26:   constructor(public readonly carrierCode: string) {}
27: 
28:   public setMode(mode: CarrierMockMode): void {
29:     this.mode = mode;
30:   }
31: 
32:   public getMode(): CarrierMockMode {
33:     return this.mode;
34:   }
35: 
36:   protected checkMockMode(): void {
37:     switch (this.mode) {
38:       case 'VALIDATION_ERROR':
39:         throw new CarrierMockError(
40:           'CARRIER_VALIDATION_ERROR',
41:           `[${this.carrierCode}] Invalid address or unsupported route: destination postal code unrecognized`,
42:           422
43:         );
44:       case 'RATE_LIMIT':
45:         throw new CarrierMockError(
46:           'CARRIER_RATE_LIMIT',
47:           `[${this.carrierCode}] Rate limit exceeded. Please retry after backoff.`,
48:           429
49:         );
50:       case 'TIMEOUT':
51:         throw new CarrierMockError(
52:           'CARRIER_TIMEOUT',
53:           `[${this.carrierCode}] Carrier gateway connection timed out after 10000ms`,
54:           504
55:         );
56:       case 'SUCCESS':
57:       default:
58:         break;
59:     }
60:   }
61: 
62:   abstract calculateQuote(params: CarrierQuoteParams): Promise<CarrierQuoteResult>;
63:   abstract createOrder(params: CarrierOrderParams): Promise<CarrierOrderResult>;
64:   abstract getTracking(trackingCode: string): Promise<CarrierTrackingResult>;
65:   abstract cancelOrder(trackingCode: string): Promise<CarrierCancelResult>;
66: }
</file>

<file path="packages/testkit/src/carriers/carrier-mock-factory.ts">
 1: import { MockGhnAdapter } from './mock-ghn.js';
 2: import { MockGhtkAdapter } from './mock-ghtk.js';
 3: import { MockViettelPostAdapter } from './mock-viettelpost.js';
 4: import type { ICarrierMockAdapter, CarrierMockMode } from './types.js';
 5: 
 6: export class CarrierMockFactory {
 7:   private static instances = new Map<string, ICarrierMockAdapter>();
 8: 
 9:   public static getCarrier(code: string): ICarrierMockAdapter {
10:     const normalized = code.toUpperCase();
11:     if (!this.instances.has(normalized)) {
12:       switch (normalized) {
13:         case 'GHN':
14:           this.instances.set(normalized, new MockGhnAdapter());
15:           break;
16:         case 'GHTK':
17:           this.instances.set(normalized, new MockGhtkAdapter());
18:           break;
19:         case 'VIETTEL_POST':
20:         case 'VTP':
21:           this.instances.set(normalized, new MockViettelPostAdapter());
22:           break;
23:         default:
24:           throw new Error(`Carrier ${code} not supported in CarrierMockFactory`);
25:       }
26:     }
27:     return this.instances.get(normalized)!;
28:   }
29: 
30:   public static setAllModes(mode: CarrierMockMode): void {
31:     for (const carrier of ['GHN', 'GHTK', 'VIETTEL_POST']) {
32:       this.getCarrier(carrier).setMode(mode);
33:     }
34:   }
35: 
36:   public static resetAll(): void {
37:     this.setAllModes('SUCCESS');
38:   }
39: }
</file>

<file path="packages/testkit/src/carriers/carrier-mock.test.ts">
  1: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
  2: import { CarrierMockFactory } from './carrier-mock-factory.js';
  3: import { CarrierMockError } from './base-mock.js';
  4: 
  5: async function runCarrierMockTests() {
  6:   console.log('🧪 Testing Carrier Mocks (GHN, GHTK, VIETTEL_POST)...');
  7: 
  8:   const carriers = ['GHN', 'GHTK', 'VIETTEL_POST'];
  9: 
 10:   for (const code of carriers) {
 11:     const carrier = CarrierMockFactory.getCarrier(code);
 12:     carrier.setMode('SUCCESS');
 13: 
 14:     // 1. Success Quote
 15:     const quote = await carrier.calculateQuote({
 16:       carrierCode: code,
 17:       origin: {
 18:         name: 'Shop A',
 19:         phone: '0901234567',
 20:         address: '123 Le Loi',
 21:         ward: 'Ben Nghe',
 22:         district: 'Quan 1',
 23:         province: 'TP. Ho Chi Minh',
 24:       },
 25:       destination: {
 26:         name: 'Khach B',
 27:         phone: '0987654321',
 28:         address: '456 Tran Phu',
 29:         ward: 'Dien Bien',
 30:         district: 'Ba Dinh',
 31:         province: 'Ha Noi',
 32:       },
 33:       parcel: { weightGrams: 500 },
 34:       codAmountVnd: 250000,
 35:     });
 36: 
 37:     assert.equal(quote.carrierCode, code);
 38:     assert.ok(quote.totalFeeVnd > 0);
 39:     assert.ok(quote.serviceName.length > 0);
 40: 
 41:     // 2. Success Order Creation
 42:     const order = await carrier.createOrder({
 43:       carrierCode: code,
 44:       clientOrderCode: `ORD_${Date.now()}`,
 45:       sender: {
 46:         name: 'Shop A',
 47:         phone: '0901234567',
 48:         address: '123 Le Loi',
 49:         ward: 'Ben Nghe',
 50:         district: 'Quan 1',
 51:         province: 'TP. Ho Chi Minh',
 52:       },
 53:       recipient: {
 54:         name: 'Khach B',
 55:         phone: '0987654321',
 56:         address: '456 Tran Phu',
 57:         ward: 'Dien Bien',
 58:         district: 'Ba Dinh',
 59:         province: 'Ha Noi',
 60:       },
 61:       parcel: { weightGrams: 500 },
 62:       codAmountVnd: 250000,
 63:     });
 64: 
 65:     assert.ok(order.trackingCode.length > 0);
 66:     assert.ok(order.carrierOrderId.length > 0);
 67: 
 68:     // 3. Success Tracking
 69:     const tracking = await carrier.getTracking(order.trackingCode);
 70:     assert.equal(tracking.trackingCode, order.trackingCode);
 71:     assert.ok(tracking.events.length > 0);
 72: 
 73:     // 4. Success Cancellation
 74:     const cancel = await carrier.cancelOrder(order.trackingCode);
 75:     assert.equal(cancel.cancelled, true);
 76: 
 77:     // 5. Validation Error Mode
 78:     carrier.setMode('VALIDATION_ERROR');
 79:     await assert.rejects(
 80:       async () => {
 81:         await carrier.calculateQuote({
 82:           carrierCode: code,
 83:           origin: { name: '', phone: '', address: '', ward: '', district: '', province: '' },
 84:           destination: { name: '', phone: '', address: '', ward: '', district: '', province: '' },
 85:           parcel: { weightGrams: 500 },
 86:         });
 87:       },
 88:       (err: any) =>
 89:         err instanceof CarrierMockError &&
 90:         err.code === 'CARRIER_VALIDATION_ERROR' &&
 91:         err.statusCode === 422
 92:     );
 93: 
 94:     // 6. Rate Limit Mode
 95:     carrier.setMode('RATE_LIMIT');
 96:     await assert.rejects(
 97:       async () => {
 98:         await carrier.getTracking('dummy');
 99:       },
100:       (err: any) =>
101:         err instanceof CarrierMockError &&
102:         err.code === 'CARRIER_RATE_LIMIT' &&
103:         err.statusCode === 429
104:     );
105: 
106:     // 7. Timeout Mode
107:     carrier.setMode('TIMEOUT');
108:     await assert.rejects(
109:       async () => {
110:         await carrier.cancelOrder('dummy');
111:       },
112:       (err: any) =>
113:         err instanceof CarrierMockError && err.code === 'CARRIER_TIMEOUT' && err.statusCode === 504
114:     );
115: 
116:     // Reset mode
117:     carrier.setMode('SUCCESS');
118:   }
119: 
120:   console.log('✅ All Carrier Mock tests passed successfully.');
121: }
122: 
123: runCarrierMockTests().catch((err) => {
124:   console.error('❌ Carrier Mock test failed:', err);
125:   process.exit(1);
126: });
</file>

<file path="packages/testkit/src/carriers/mock-ghn.ts">
 1: import { BaseCarrierMockAdapter, CarrierMockError } from './base-mock.js';
 2: import type {
 3:   CarrierQuoteParams,
 4:   CarrierQuoteResult,
 5:   CarrierOrderParams,
 6:   CarrierOrderResult,
 7:   CarrierTrackingResult,
 8:   CarrierCancelResult,
 9: } from './types.js';
10: 
11: export class MockGhnAdapter extends BaseCarrierMockAdapter {
12:   constructor() {
13:     super('GHN');
14:   }
15: 
16:   async calculateQuote(params: CarrierQuoteParams): Promise<CarrierQuoteResult> {
17:     this.checkMockMode();
18:     if (params.parcel.weightGrams <= 0) {
19:       throw new CarrierMockError('INVALID_PARCEL_WEIGHT', 'Weight must be greater than 0', 400);
20:     }
21: 
22:     // Exact integer VND calculations
23:     const baseFee = params.parcel.weightGrams > 2000 ? 45000 : 22000;
24:     const insuranceFee = params.insuranceDeclaredVnd
25:       ? Math.floor(params.insuranceDeclaredVnd * 0.005)
26:       : 0;
27:     const codFee = params.codAmountVnd && params.codAmountVnd > 1000000 ? 10000 : 0;
28: 
29:     return {
30:       carrierCode: this.carrierCode,
31:       serviceName: 'GHN Tiết Kiệm',
32:       feeBaseVnd: baseFee,
33:       feeInsuranceVnd: insuranceFee,
34:       feeCodVnd: codFee,
35:       totalFeeVnd: baseFee + insuranceFee + codFee,
36:       estimatedDeliveryDate: new Date(Date.now() + 2 * 86400000).toISOString(),
37:     };
38:   }
39: 
40:   async createOrder(params: CarrierOrderParams): Promise<CarrierOrderResult> {
41:     this.checkMockMode();
42:     if (!params.recipient.phone || !params.recipient.address) {
43:       throw new CarrierMockError('INVALID_RECIPIENT', 'Recipient address and phone required', 422);
44:     }
45: 
46:     const quote = await this.calculateQuote({
47:       carrierCode: this.carrierCode,
48:       origin: params.sender,
49:       destination: params.recipient,
50:       parcel: params.parcel,
51:       codAmountVnd: params.codAmountVnd,
52:       insuranceDeclaredVnd: params.insuranceDeclaredVnd,
53:     });
54: 
55:     const trackingCode = `GHN${Math.floor(100000000 + Math.random() * 900000000)}`;
56: 
57:     return {
58:       carrierCode: this.carrierCode,
59:       trackingCode,
60:       carrierOrderId: `GHN_ORDER_${params.clientOrderCode}`,
61:       status: 'ready_to_pick',
62:       totalFeeVnd: quote.totalFeeVnd,
63:       expectedPickupDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString(),
64:     };
65:   }
66: 
67:   async getTracking(trackingCode: string): Promise<CarrierTrackingResult> {
68:     this.checkMockMode();
69:     return {
70:       carrierCode: this.carrierCode,
71:       trackingCode,
72:       currentStatus: 'in_transit',
73:       events: [
74:         {
75:           status: 'ready_to_pick',
76:           location: 'Kho gửi GHN',
77:           timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000).toISOString(),
78:           description: 'Đã tiếp nhận đơn hàng',
79:         },
80:         {
81:           status: 'in_transit',
82:           location: 'Kho trung chuyển GHN',
83:           timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
84:           description: 'Đang luân chuyển hàng',
85:         },
86:       ],
87:     };
88:   }
89: 
90:   async cancelOrder(trackingCode: string): Promise<CarrierCancelResult> {
91:     this.checkMockMode();
92:     return {
93:       carrierCode: this.carrierCode,
94:       trackingCode,
95:       cancelled: true,
96:       message: 'Hủy đơn hàng thành công trên hệ thống GHN',
97:     };
98:   }
99: }
</file>

<file path="packages/testkit/src/carriers/server.ts">
 1: import http from 'node:http';
 2: import { CarrierMockFactory } from './carrier-mock-factory.js';
 3: 
 4: const PORT = process.env.MOCK_CARRIER_PORT ? parseInt(process.env.MOCK_CARRIER_PORT, 10) : 4000;
 5: 
 6: export function createMockCarrierServer() {
 7:   return http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
 8:     res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
 9: 
10:     const url = new URL(req.url || '/', `http://${req.headers.host || 'localhost'}`);
11:     const parts = url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
12: 
13:     // Route: /carriers/:carrierCode/:action
14:     if (parts[0] === 'carriers' && parts[1]) {
15:       const carrierCode = parts[1].toUpperCase();
16:       const action = parts[2];
17: 
18:       try {
19:         const carrier = CarrierMockFactory.getCarrier(carrierCode);
20: 
21:         if (action === 'quote' && req.method === 'POST') {
22:           let body = '';
23:           req.on('data', (chunk) => (body += chunk));
24:           req.on('end', async () => {
25:             try {
26:               const params = body ? JSON.parse(body) : {};
27:               const quote = await carrier.calculateQuote(params);
28:               res.writeHead(200);
29:               res.end(JSON.stringify(quote));
30:             } catch (err: any) {
31:               res.writeHead(err.statusCode || 400);
32:               res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message, code: err.code }));
33:             }
34:           });
35:           return;
36:         }
37: 
38:         if (action === 'orders' && req.method === 'POST') {
39:           let body = '';
40:           req.on('data', (chunk) => (body += chunk));
41:           req.on('end', async () => {
42:             try {
43:               const params = body ? JSON.parse(body) : {};
44:               const order = await carrier.createOrder(params);
45:               res.writeHead(201);
46:               res.end(JSON.stringify(order));
47:             } catch (err: any) {
48:               res.writeHead(err.statusCode || 400);
49:               res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message, code: err.code }));
50:             }
51:           });
52:           return;
53:         }
54: 
55:         if (action === 'tracking' && req.method === 'GET') {
56:           const code = url.searchParams.get('code') || 'DEFAULT';
57:           const tracking = await carrier.getTracking(code);
58:           res.writeHead(200);
59:           res.end(JSON.stringify(tracking));
60:           return;
61:         }
62:       } catch (err: any) {
63:         res.writeHead(400);
64:         res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }));
65:         return;
66:       }
67:     }
68: 
69:     // Health / info
70:     if (url.pathname === '/health' || url.pathname === '/') {
71:       res.writeHead(200);
72:       res.end(
73:         JSON.stringify({
74:           status: 'ok',
75:           service: 'mock-carriers',
76:           carriers: ['GHN', 'GHTK', 'VIETTEL_POST'],
77:         })
78:       );
79:       return;
80:     }
81: 
82:     res.writeHead(404);
83:     res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Not found' }));
84:   });
85: }
86: 
87: if (process.argv[1] && process.argv[1].endsWith('server.ts')) {
88:   const server = createMockCarrierServer();
89:   server.listen(PORT, () => {
90:     console.log(`🚚 Mock Carrier Gateway is running at http://localhost:${PORT}`);
91:     console.log(`   Carriers supported: GHN, GHTK, VIETTEL_POST`);
92:   });
93: }
</file>

<file path="packages/testkit/src/carriers/types.ts">
 1: /**
 2:  * @shipde/testkit - Carrier Mock Types
 3:  * Deterministic carrier mock interfaces conforming to target specifications.
 4:  */
 5: 
 6: export type CarrierMockMode = 'SUCCESS' | 'VALIDATION_ERROR' | 'RATE_LIMIT' | 'TIMEOUT';
 7: 
 8: export interface CarrierAddress {
 9:   name: string;
10:   phone: string;
11:   address: string;
12:   ward: string;
13:   district: string;
14:   province: string;
15:   postalCode?: string;
16: }
17: 
18: export interface CarrierParcel {
19:   weightGrams: number;
20:   lengthCm?: number;
21:   widthCm?: number;
22:   heightCm?: number;
23: }
24: 
25: export interface CarrierQuoteParams {
26:   carrierCode: string;
27:   origin: CarrierAddress;
28:   destination: CarrierAddress;
29:   parcel: CarrierParcel;
30:   codAmountVnd?: number;
31:   insuranceDeclaredVnd?: number;
32: }
33: 
34: export interface CarrierQuoteResult {
35:   carrierCode: string;
36:   serviceName: string;
37:   feeBaseVnd: number;
38:   feeInsuranceVnd: number;
39:   feeCodVnd: number;
40:   totalFeeVnd: number;
41:   estimatedDeliveryDate: string;
42: }
43: 
44: export interface CarrierOrderParams {
45:   carrierCode: string;
46:   clientOrderCode: string;
47:   sender: CarrierAddress;
48:   recipient: CarrierAddress;
49:   parcel: CarrierParcel;
50:   codAmountVnd?: number;
51:   insuranceDeclaredVnd?: number;
52:   note?: string;
53: }
54: 
55: export interface CarrierOrderResult {
56:   carrierCode: string;
57:   trackingCode: string;
58:   carrierOrderId: string;
59:   status: string;
60:   totalFeeVnd: number;
61:   expectedPickupDate: string;
62: }
63: 
64: export interface CarrierTrackingEvent {
65:   status: string;
66:   location: string;
67:   timestamp: string;
68:   description: string;
69: }
70: 
71: export interface CarrierTrackingResult {
72:   carrierCode: string;
73:   trackingCode: string;
74:   currentStatus: string;
75:   events: CarrierTrackingEvent[];
76: }
77: 
78: export interface CarrierCancelResult {
79:   carrierCode: string;
80:   trackingCode: string;
81:   cancelled: boolean;
82:   message: string;
83: }
84: 
85: export interface ICarrierMockAdapter {
86:   readonly carrierCode: string;
87:   setMode(mode: CarrierMockMode): void;
88:   getMode(): CarrierMockMode;
89:   calculateQuote(params: CarrierQuoteParams): Promise<CarrierQuoteResult>;
90:   createOrder(params: CarrierOrderParams): Promise<CarrierOrderResult>;
91:   getTracking(trackingCode: string): Promise<CarrierTrackingResult>;
92:   cancelOrder(trackingCode: string): Promise<CarrierCancelResult>;
93: }

<file path="packages/testkit/src/msw/msw.test.ts">
  1: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
  2: import { setupServer } from 'msw/node';
  3: import { handlers, setMswScenario, resetMswScenario, BASE_API_URL } from './handlers.js';
  4: 
  5: const server = setupServer(...handlers);
  6: 
  7: async function runMswTests() {
  8:   console.log('🧪 Testing MSW Canonical State Handlers...');
  9: 
 10:   server.listen({ onUnhandledRequest: 'error' });
 11: 
 12:   try {
 13:     // 1. Test SUCCESS State
 14:     resetMswScenario();
 15:     const resSuccess = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/orders`);
 16:     assert.equal(resSuccess.status, 200);
 17:     const dataSuccess: any = await resSuccess.json();
 18:     assert.equal(dataSuccess.length, 2);
 19: 
 20:     // 2. Test EMPTY State
 21:     setMswScenario({ state: 'EMPTY' });
 22:     const resEmpty = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/orders`);
 23:     assert.equal(resEmpty.status, 200);
 24:     const dataEmpty: any = await resEmpty.json();
 25:     assert.equal(dataEmpty.length, 0);
 26: 
 27:     // 3. Test ERROR State
 28:     setMswScenario({ state: 'ERROR' });
 29:     const resError = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/orders`);
 30:     assert.equal(resError.status, 500);
 31:     const dataError: any = await resError.json();
 32:     assert.equal(dataError.code, 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR');
 33: 
 34:     // 4. Test FORBIDDEN State
 35:     setMswScenario({ state: 'FORBIDDEN' });
 36:     const resForbidden = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/orders`);
 37:     assert.equal(resForbidden.status, 403);
 38:     const dataForbidden: any = await resForbidden.json();
 39:     assert.equal(dataForbidden.code, 'FORBIDDEN');
 40: 
 41:     // 5. Test PARTIAL State
 42:     setMswScenario({ state: 'PARTIAL' });
 43:     const resPartial = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/shipping/quotes`, { method: 'POST' });
 44:     assert.equal(resPartial.status, 200);
 45:     const dataPartial: any = await resPartial.json();
 46:     assert.equal(dataPartial.length, 2); // only GHN & VTP returned
 47: 
 48:     // 6. Test RECOVERY State
 49:     setMswScenario({ state: 'RECOVERY', recoveryAttemptsBeforeSuccess: 1 });
 50:     // First attempt fails with 503
 51:     const resAttempt1 = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/orders`);
 52:     assert.equal(resAttempt1.status, 503);
 53:     // Second attempt recovers with 200
 54:     const resAttempt2 = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/orders`);
 55:     assert.equal(resAttempt2.status, 200);
 56:     const dataRecovered: any = await resAttempt2.json();
 57:     assert.equal(dataRecovered.length, 2);
 58: 
 59:     // 7. Test Auth Registration via MSW
 60:     resetMswScenario();
 61:     const regRes = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/auth/register`, {
 62:       method: 'POST',
 63:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 64:       body: JSON.stringify({
 65:         merchant_name: 'MSW Shop',
 66:         full_name: 'MSW User',
 67:         email: 'msw@shipde.vn',
 68:         password: 'Password123!',
 69:         terms_accepted: true,
 70:         terms_version: '2026.1',
 71:       }),
 72:     });
 73:     assert.equal(regRes.status, 200);
 74:     const regData: any = await regRes.json();
 75:     assert.equal(regData.data.status, 'PENDING_VERIFICATION');
 76: 
 77:     // 8. Test Auth Registration Duplicate via MSW
 78:     const dupRes = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/auth/register`, {
 79:       method: 'POST',
 80:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 81:       body: JSON.stringify({ email: 'duplicate@shipde.vn' }),
 82:     });
 83:     assert.equal(dupRes.status, 400);
 84:     const dupData: any = await dupRes.json();
 85:     assert.equal(dupData.error.code, 'VALIDATION_ERROR');
 86: 
 87:     // 9. Test Auth Registration Rate Limited via MSW
 88:     const limitRes = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/auth/register`, {
 89:       method: 'POST',
 90:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 91:       body: JSON.stringify({ email: 'ratelimit@shipde.vn' }),
 92:     });
 93:     assert.equal(limitRes.status, 429);
 94:     const limitData: any = await limitRes.json();
 95:     assert.equal(limitData.error.code, 'RATE_LIMITED');
 96: 
 97:     // 10. Test Auth Verify Expired Token via MSW
 98:     const expRes = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/auth/verify-email`, {
 99:       method: 'POST',
100:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
101:       body: JSON.stringify({ token: 'test-token-expired' }),
102:     });
103:     assert.equal(expRes.status, 410);
104:     const expData: any = await expRes.json();
105:     assert.equal(expData.error.code, 'TOKEN_EXPIRED');
106: 
107:     // 11. Test Auth Verify Consumed Token via MSW
108:     const conRes = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/auth/verify-email`, {
109:       method: 'POST',
110:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
111:       body: JSON.stringify({ token: 'test-token-consumed' }),
112:     });
113:     assert.equal(conRes.status, 410);
114:     const conData: any = await conRes.json();
115:     assert.equal(conData.error.code, 'TOKEN_ALREADY_CONSUMED');
116: 
117:     // 12. Test Auth Resend Cooldown via MSW
118:     const resendRes = await fetch(`${BASE_API_URL}/api/v1/auth/verify/resend`, {
119:       method: 'POST',
120:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
121:       body: JSON.stringify({ identifier: 'ratelimit@shipde.vn', channel: 'email' }),
122:     });
123:     assert.equal(resendRes.status, 429);
124: 
125:     console.log('✅ All MSW Canonical State Handler and Auth tests passed successfully.');
126:   } finally {
127:     server.close();
128:   }
129: }
130: 
131: runMswTests().catch((err) => {
132:   console.error('❌ MSW test failed:', err);
133:   process.exit(1);
134: });
</file>

<file path="packages/testkit/src/index.test.ts">
  1: import * as fs from 'node:fs';
  2: import * as path from 'node:path';
  3: import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
  4: import {
  5:   assertValidMonorepoPackage,
  6:   createMockId,
  7:   resolveMonorepoPackage,
  8:   assertValidLivenessResponse,
  9:   assertValidReadinessResponse,
 10:   assertNoSensitiveData,
 11:   createValidTestConfig,
 12: } from './index';
 13: import {
 14:   UserRole,
 15:   PrototypePersona,
 16:   CarrierCode,
 17:   CarrierCapabilityTier,
 18:   ShipmentStatus,
 19: } from '@shipde/contracts';
 20: 
 21: const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
 22: 
 23: function testTestkit() {
 24:   // Test mock ID generation
 25:   const id = createMockId('test');
 26:   if (!id.startsWith('test_')) {
 27:     throw new Error('createMockId failed');
 28:   }
 29: 
 30:   // Test real package export resolution for all workspace packages
 31:   if (!assertValidMonorepoPackage('@shipde/contracts')) {
 32:     throw new Error('assertValidMonorepoPackage failed to resolve @shipde/contracts');
 33:   }
 34:   if (!assertValidMonorepoPackage('@shipde/config')) {
 35:     throw new Error('assertValidMonorepoPackage failed to resolve @shipde/config');
 36:   }
 37:   if (!assertValidMonorepoPackage('@shipde/ui')) {
 38:     throw new Error('assertValidMonorepoPackage failed to resolve @shipde/ui');
 39:   }
 40:   if (!assertValidMonorepoPackage('@shipde/testkit')) {
 41:     throw new Error('assertValidMonorepoPackage failed to resolve @shipde/testkit');
 42:   }
 43: 
 44:   // Negative tests: fake names must FAIL resolution even with @shipde/ prefix
 45:   if (assertValidMonorepoPackage('@shipde/not-real')) {
 46:     throw new Error('assertValidMonorepoPackage falsely succeeded for fake @shipde/not-real');
 47:   }
 48:   if (assertValidMonorepoPackage('unscoped-package')) {
 49:     throw new Error('assertValidMonorepoPackage falsely succeeded for unscoped package');
 50:   }
 51: 
 52:   // Verify resolveMonorepoPackage returns valid entrypoint path
 53:   const contractsPath = resolveMonorepoPackage('@shipde/contracts');
 54:   if (!contractsPath || typeof contractsPath !== 'string') {
 55:     throw new Error('resolveMonorepoPackage did not return valid path for @shipde/contracts');
 56:   }
 57: 
 58:   // Verify canonical UserRole contains exactly the 4 persisted/domain roles
 59:   const canonicalRoleKeys = Object.keys(UserRole).sort();
 60:   const expectedRoleKeys = ['ACCOUNTANT', 'OPS_CSKH', 'OWNER', 'WAREHOUSE'].sort();
 61:   if (JSON.stringify(canonicalRoleKeys) !== JSON.stringify(expectedRoleKeys)) {
 62:     throw new Error(`UserRole keys mismatch: got ${canonicalRoleKeys.join(',')}`);
 63:   }
 64:   if ('BACKOFFICE' in UserRole) {
 65:     throw new Error('BACKOFFICE must not be part of canonical UserRole contract');
 66:   }
 67: 
 68:   // Verify PrototypePersona models navigation persona
 69:   if (PrototypePersona.BACKOFFICE !== 'BACKOFFICE') {
 70:     throw new Error('PrototypePersona.BACKOFFICE must equal BACKOFFICE');
 71:   }
 72: 
 73:   // Verify runtime imports and contract values from @shipde/contracts
 74:   if (UserRole.OWNER !== 'OWNER') {
 75:     throw new Error(`Unexpected UserRole.OWNER: ${UserRole.OWNER}`);
 76:   }
 77:   if (CarrierCode.GHN !== 'GHN' || CarrierCode.GHTK !== 'GHTK') {
 78:     throw new Error('Unexpected CarrierCode values');
 79:   }
 80:   if (CarrierCapabilityTier.L0_OBSERVE !== 'L0') {
 81:     throw new Error('Unexpected CarrierCapabilityTier value');
 82:   }
 83:   if (ShipmentStatus.DELIVERED !== 'delivered') {
 84:     throw new Error('Unexpected ShipmentStatus value');
 85:   }
 86: 
 87:   // Verify type: "module" in all shared package manifests
 88:   const sharedPackages = ['contracts', 'config', 'testkit', 'ui'];
 89:   for (const pkg of sharedPackages) {
 90:     const pkgJsonPath = path.resolve(__dirname, `../../${pkg}/package.json`);
 91:     if (fs.existsSync(pkgJsonPath)) {
 92:       const pkgJson = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pkgJsonPath, 'utf-8'));
 93:       if (pkgJson.type !== 'module') {
 94:         throw new Error(`Package @shipde/${pkg} package.json missing "type": "module" declaration`);
 95:       }
 96:     }
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   // Verify health assertion helpers
100:   const validLiveResponse = {

  1: /**
  2:  * End-to-end Integration Test Runner for Ship Dễ Foundation (TASK-FOUND-03)
  3:  *
  4:  * Verifies:
  5:  * - Local Docker infrastructure connectivity (PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO)
  6:  * - API & Worker independent startup, liveness and readiness HTTP probes
  7:  * - Correlation ID header propagation across services
  8:  * - Process-level dependency outage resilience
  9:  * - Live dependency restoration without process restart (AC-FOUND-03-06, Finding 11)
 10:  * - Durable outbox insert within transaction -> BullMQ dispatch -> Smoke worker processing -> Published state
 11:  * - Strict structured JSON log schema parsing, correlation propagation, and zero connection-string leakage (Finding 12)
 12:  * - Clean shutdown of background child processes
 13:  */
 14: import { spawn, ChildProcess, execSync } from 'node:child_process';
 15: import * as path from 'node:path';
 16: import * as fs from 'node:fs';
 17: import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
 18: import { S3Client, HeadBucketCommand, CreateBucketCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
 19: import { assertValidLivenessResponse, assertValidReadinessResponse } from './index';
 20: import { QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE } from '@shipde/contracts';
 21: 
 22: const ROOT_DIR = process.cwd();
 23: 
 24: const API_PORT = process.env.PORT || '3001';
 25: const WORKER_PORT = process.env.WORKER_HEALTH_PORT || '3002';
 26: const DATABASE_URL =
 27:   process.env.DATABASE_URL ||
 28:   'postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5433/shipde_dev?schema=public';
 29: const REDIS_HOST = process.env.REDIS_HOST || 'localhost';
 30: const REDIS_PORT = process.env.REDIS_PORT || '6379';
 31: const S3_ENDPOINT = process.env.S3_ENDPOINT || 'http://localhost:9000';
 32: const S3_REGION = process.env.S3_REGION || 'us-east-1';
 33: const S3_ACCESS_KEY = process.env.S3_ACCESS_KEY || 'minioadmin';
 34: const S3_SECRET_KEY = process.env.S3_SECRET_KEY || 'minioadmin';
 35: const S3_BUCKET = process.env.S3_BUCKET || 'shipde-test';
 36: const CARRIER_MODE = process.env.CARRIER_MODE || 'disabled';
 37: 
 38: const childEnv = {
 39:   ...process.env,
 40:   PORT: API_PORT,
 41:   WORKER_HEALTH_PORT: WORKER_PORT,
 42:   DATABASE_URL,
 43:   REDIS_HOST,
 44:   REDIS_PORT,
 45:   S3_ENDPOINT,
 46:   S3_REGION,
 47:   S3_ACCESS_KEY,
 48:   S3_SECRET_KEY,
 49:   S3_BUCKET,
 50:   CARRIER_MODE,
 51:   NODE_ENV: 'test',
 52: };

 54: async function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
 55:   return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
 56: }
 57: 
 58: async function waitForHttpOk(url: string, timeoutMs = 20000): Promise<void> {
 59:   const start = Date.now();
 60:   while (Date.now() - start < timeoutMs) {
 61:     try {
 62:       const res = await fetch(url);
 63:       if (res.status === 200) {
 64:         return;
 65:       }
 66:     } catch {
 67:       // service not ready yet
 68:     }
 69:     await sleep(300);
 70:   }
 71:   throw new Error(`Timeout waiting for ${url} to respond with 200 OK`);
 72: }
 73: 
 74: function stopProcess(proc: ChildProcess): Promise<void> {
 75:   return new Promise((resolve) => {
 76:     if (!proc || proc.killed) {
 77:       return resolve();
 78:     }
 79:     proc.on('exit', () => resolve());
 80:     proc.kill('SIGINT');
 81:     setTimeout(() => {
 82:       try {
 83:         proc.kill('SIGKILL');
 84:       } catch {
 85:         // ignore
 86:       }
 87:       resolve();
 88:     }, 2000);
 89:   });
 90: }

 92: async function testDependencyOutage(
 93:   serviceType: 'api' | 'worker',
 94:   brokenEnv: Record<string, string>,
 95:   expectedDownCheck: 'database' | 'redis' | 'storage',
 96:   testPort: number
 97: ): Promise<void> {
 98:   const entry = path.join(
 99:     ROOT_DIR,
100:     serviceType === 'api' ? 'apps/api/dist/main.js' : 'apps/worker/dist/main.js'
101:   );
102:   const proc = spawn(process.execPath, [entry], {
103:     cwd: path.join(ROOT_DIR, serviceType === 'api' ? 'apps/api' : 'apps/worker'),
104:     env: {
105:       ...childEnv,
106:       PORT: String(testPort),
107:       WORKER_HEALTH_PORT: String(testPort),
108:       ...brokenEnv,
109:     },
110:     stdio: 'ignore',
111:   });
112: 
113:   try {
114:     await waitForHttpOk(`http://localhost:${testPort}/health/live`, 15000);
115:     const liveRes = await fetch(`http://localhost:${testPort}/health/live`);
116:     if (liveRes.status !== 200) {
117:       throw new Error(
118:         `Process failed liveness check when ${expectedDownCheck} is down: status ${liveRes.status}`
119:       );
120:     }
121: 
122:     const readyRes = await fetch(`http://localhost:${testPort}/health/ready`);
123:     if (readyRes.status !== 503) {
124:       throw new Error(
125:         `Expected readiness 503 when ${expectedDownCheck} is down, got ${readyRes.status}`
126:       );
127:     }
128:     const readyJson: any = await readyRes.json();
129:     assertValidReadinessResponse(readyJson, 'error');
130:     if (readyJson.checks[expectedDownCheck] !== 'down') {
131:       throw new Error(
132:         `Expected check ${expectedDownCheck} to be 'down', got: ${readyJson.checks[expectedDownCheck]}`
133:       );
134:     }
135:     console.log(
136:       `✅ Process-level outage verified: ${serviceType} retains liveness (200) and reports 503 when ${expectedDownCheck} is down`
137:     );
138:   } finally {
139:     await stopProcess(proc);
140:   }
141: }

143: /**
144:  * Validates and parses every non-empty line of captured application logs (Finding 12).
145:  * Strictly verifies schema, absence of database connection strings, and correlation.
146:  */
147: function validateAndParseStructuredLogs(
148:   rawChunks: string[],
149:   serviceName: 'api' | 'worker'
150: ): Array<Record<string, unknown>> {
151:   const combined = rawChunks.join('');
152:   const lines = combined
153:     .split('\n')
154:     .map((l) => l.trim())
155:     .filter(Boolean);
156: 
157:   const parsedRecords: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
158: 
159:   for (const line of lines) {
160:     // Prohibition: Raw database connection string or unredacted passwords must NEVER appear in logs
161:     if (line.includes('postgresql://') || line.includes('postgres://')) {
162:       throw new Error(
163:         `[SECURITY LEAK] Raw database connection string detected in ${serviceName} logs: ${line}`
164:       );
165:     }
166:     if (line.includes('testPassword') || line.includes('supersecret')) {
167:       throw new Error(`[SECURITY LEAK] Secret credential detected in ${serviceName} logs: ${line}`);
168:     }
169: 
170:     // Inspect JSON application log records
171:     if (line.startsWith('{') && line.endsWith('}')) {
172:       let parsed: Record<string, unknown>;
173:       try {
174:         parsed = JSON.parse(line);
175:       } catch (err: any) {
176:         throw new Error(
177:           `Malformed JSON in ${serviceName} structured log: ${line} (${err.message})`
178:         );
179:       }
180: 
181:       if (!['debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error'].includes(parsed.level as string)) {
182:         throw new Error(`Invalid log level '${parsed.level}' in ${serviceName} log: ${line}`);
183:       }
184:       if (parsed.service !== serviceName) {
185:         throw new Error(
186:           `Mismatched service '${parsed.service}' (expected '${serviceName}') in log: ${line}`
187:         );
188:       }
189:       if (!parsed.message || typeof parsed.message !== 'string') {
190:         throw new Error(`Missing or non-string message in ${serviceName} log: ${line}`);
191:       }
192:       if (!parsed.time || isNaN(Date.parse(parsed.time as string))) {
193:         throw new Error(`Invalid or missing ISO timestamp in ${serviceName} log: ${line}`);
194:       }
195: 
196:       parsedRecords.push(parsed);
197:     }
198:   }
199: 
200:   return parsedRecords;
201: }

510:     );
511: 
512:     // Test 8.6.2: Live MinIO outage and recovery on the same running processes
513:     try {
514:       console.log('Pausing MinIO container (shipde-minio)...');
515:       execSync('docker pause shipde-minio', { stdio: 'ignore' });
516:       const minioOutageStart = Date.now();
517:       let apiMinioDown = false;
518:       let workerMinioDown = false;
519:       while (Date.now() - minioOutageStart < 12000) {
520:         try {
521:           const aRes = await fetch(`http://localhost:${API_PORT}/health/ready`);
522:           const aJson: any = await aRes.json();
523:           if (aRes.status === 503 && aJson.checks?.storage === 'down') apiMinioDown = true;
524: 
525:           const wRes = await fetch(`http://localhost:${WORKER_PORT}/health/ready`);
526:           const wJson: any = await wRes.json();
527:           if (wRes.status === 503 && wJson.checks?.storage === 'down') workerMinioDown = true;
528: 
529:           if (apiMinioDown && workerMinioDown) break;
530:         } catch {
531:           // retry
532:         }
533:         await sleep(300);
534:       }
535:       if (!apiMinioDown || !workerMinioDown) {
536:         throw new Error(
537:           `Live API/Worker failed to detect MinIO outage: apiDown=${apiMinioDown}, workerDown=${workerMinioDown}`
538:         );
539:       }
540:       console.log(
541:         '✅ Live API and Worker reported 503 error with storage: down without process restart'
542:       );
543:     } finally {
544:       execSync('docker unpause shipde-minio', { stdio: 'ignore' });
545:     }
546: 
547:     // Verify MinIO recovery without restarting API or Worker
548:     const minioRecoverStart = Date.now();
549:     let minioRecovered = false;
550:     while (Date.now() - minioRecoverStart < 15000) {
551:       try {
552:         const aRes = await fetch(`http://localhost:${API_PORT}/health/ready`);
553:         const wRes = await fetch(`http://localhost:${WORKER_PORT}/health/ready`);
554:         const aJson: any = await aRes.json();
555:         const wJson: any = await wRes.json();
556:         if (
557:           aRes.status === 200 &&
558:           aJson.checks?.storage === 'up' &&
559:           wRes.status === 200 &&
560:           wJson.checks?.storage === 'up'
561:         ) {
562:           minioRecovered = true;
563:           break;
564:         }
565:       } catch {
566:         // retry
567:       }
568:       await sleep(500);
569:     }
570:     if (!minioRecovered) {
571:       throw new Error(
572:         'Live API and Worker failed to recover readiness after MinIO restoration without restart'
573:       );
574:     }
575:     console.log(
576:       '✅ MinIO restoration verified: same live API and Worker returned to 200 OK without restart'
577:     );
578: 
579:     // 9. End-to-End Durable Outbox Dispatch to BullMQ and Worker Execution
580:     console.log('9. Testing durable Outbox -> BullMQ -> SmokeWorker end-to-end flow...');
581:     const smokeId = `smoke_e2e_${Date.now()}`;
582:     const correlationId = `corr_e2e_${Date.now()}`;
583:     const idempotencyKey = `idemp_e2e_${Date.now()}`;
584: 
585:     // Create OutboxEvent in database (simulates API committing business work + outbox atomically)
586:     const outboxRecord = await prisma.outboxEvent.create({
587:       data: {
588:         event_type: QUEUE_SMOKE_EVENT_TYPE,
589:         payload: {
590:           smokeId,
591:           message: 'End-to-end queue smoke event',
592:           timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
593:         },
594:         correlation_id: correlationId,
595:         idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
596:         status: 'PENDING',
597:       },
598:     });
599:     console.log(`Created test outbox event ${outboxRecord.id} with status PENDING`);
600: 
601:     // The Worker background OutboxDispatcher polls every 1s and dispatches to BullMQ;
602:     // SmokeWorker processes the job and transitions the event to PUBLISHED.
603:     console.log('Waiting for Worker OutboxDispatcher and SmokeWorker to process the event...');
604:     let isPublished = false;
605:     const pollStart = Date.now();
606:     while (Date.now() - pollStart < 15000) {
607:       const current = await prisma.outboxEvent.findUnique({
608:         where: { id: outboxRecord.id },
609:       });
610:       if (current && current.status === 'PUBLISHED') {
611:         isPublished = true;
612:         if (!current.published_at) {
613:           throw new Error('Outbox event marked PUBLISHED but published_at is missing');
614:         }
615:         break;
616:       }
617:       await sleep(500);
618:     }
619: 
620:     if (!isPublished) {
621:       throw new Error(
622:         `Outbox event ${outboxRecord.id} failed to transition to PUBLISHED within 15s`
623:       );
624:     }
625:     console.log(
626:       `✅ Outbox event ${outboxRecord.id} transitioned to PUBLISHED with published_at timestamp`
627:     );
628: 
629:     // 10. Verify Structured Log Parsing, Correlation, and Redaction (Finding 12)
630:     console.log(
631:       '10. Verifying structured JSON logs for API and Worker (schema, correlation, redaction)...'
632:     );
633:     const apiRecords = validateAndParseStructuredLogs(apiRawLogs, 'api');
634:     const workerRecords = validateAndParseStructuredLogs(workerRawLogs, 'worker');
635: 
636:     if (apiRecords.length === 0) {
637:       throw new Error('No structured JSON logs captured for API service');
638:     }
639:     if (workerRecords.length === 0) {
640:       throw new Error('No structured JSON logs captured for Worker service');
641:     }
642: 
643:     // Verify correlation ID propagation in Worker logs
644:     const matchingWorkerRecord = workerRecords.find(
645:       (r) =>
646:         r.correlationId === correlationId &&
647:         typeof r.message === 'string' &&
648:         r.message.includes('Successfully executed deterministic smoke effect')
649:     );
650:     if (!matchingWorkerRecord) {
651:       throw new Error(
652:         `Worker structured logs did not capture correlation ID propagation: expected correlationId ${correlationId}`
653:       );
654:     }
655:     console.log(
656:       `✅ Worker structured log confirmed correlation ID ${correlationId} propagation: ${JSON.stringify(matchingWorkerRecord)}`
657:     );
658:     console.log(
659:       `✅ Log inspection complete: verified ${apiRecords.length} API and ${workerRecords.length} Worker records without leaks or format errors`
660:     );
661: 
662:     // Clean up test record
663:     await prisma.outboxEvent.delete({ where: { id: outboxRecord.id } });
664: 
665:     console.log('====================================================');
666:     console.log('🎉 All foundation integration tests passed successfully!');
667:     console.log('====================================================');
668:   } finally {
669:     console.log('Cleaning up integration test processes...');
670:     if (apiProc) {
671:       await stopProcess(apiProc);
672:     }
673:     if (workerProc) {
674:       await stopProcess(workerProc);
675:     }
676:     await prisma.$disconnect();
677:     console.log('Cleanup complete.');
678:   }
679: }
680: 
681: main().catch((err) => {
682:   console.error('❌ Integration test suite failed:', err);
683:   process.exit(1);
684: });
</file>

  2: import * as fs from 'fs';
  3: import * as path from 'path';
  4: import { scanFileForA11y } from '../../../scripts/verify-a11y.js';

  9: import { seedDatabase } from '../../../infra/docker/seed.js';
 10: 
 11: function findMonorepoRoot(dir: string = process.cwd()): string {
 12:   let curr = dir;
 13:   while (curr && curr !== path.dirname(curr)) {
 14:     if (
 15:       fs.existsSync(path.join(curr, '.gitleaks.toml')) ||
 16:       fs.existsSync(path.join(curr, 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'))
 17:     ) {
 18:       return curr;
 19:     }
 20:     curr = path.dirname(curr);
 21:   }
 22:   return dir;
 23: }
 24: 
 25: async function runQualityGatesNegativeFixtureTests() {
 26:   console.log('🧪 Testing Fail-Closed Quality Gates (Negative Fixtures)...');
 27:   const monorepoRoot = findMonorepoRoot();
 28: 
 29:   // 1. Deliberately broken OpenAPI spec fails validateOpenApiSpec
 30:   const tempBrokenSpec = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'temp-broken-openapi.yaml');
 31:   try {
 32:     fs.writeFileSync(
 33:       tempBrokenSpec,
 34:       'openapi: 2.0\ninfo:\n  title: Broken Spec\npaths: {}\n',
 35:       'utf8'
 36:     );
 37:     const specResult = await validateOpenApiSpec(tempBrokenSpec);
 38:     assert.equal(specResult.valid, false, 'Broken OpenAPI spec must fail validation');
 39:     assert.ok(
 40:       specResult.errors.some((e) => e.includes('Spec must be OpenAPI 3.x')),
 41:       'Must flag non-3.x spec'
 42:     );
 43:   } finally {
 44:     if (fs.existsSync(tempBrokenSpec)) fs.unlinkSync(tempBrokenSpec);
 45:   }
 46: 
 47:   // 2. Deliberate contract drift fails checkContractDrift
 48:   const tempDriftTypes = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'temp-drift-types.ts');
 49:   try {
 50:     fs.writeFileSync(tempDriftTypes, 'export interface Outdated { foo: string; }', 'utf8');
 51:     const driftResult = await checkContractDrift(undefined, tempDriftTypes);
 52:     assert.equal(driftResult.drift, true, 'Contract drift must be detected and fail');
 53:   } finally {
 54:     if (fs.existsSync(tempDriftTypes)) fs.unlinkSync(tempDriftTypes);
 55:   }
 56: 
 57:   // 3. Accessibility negative fixture: <img> without alt attribute
 58:   const tempA11yViolation = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'temp-a11y-fixture.tsx');
 59:   try {
 60:     fs.writeFileSync(
 61:       tempA11yViolation,
 62:       'export const BadImg = () => <img src="/logo.png" />;',
 63:       'utf8'
 64:     );
 65:     const violations = scanFileForA11y(tempA11yViolation);
 66:     assert.ok(
 67:       violations.length > 0,
 68:       'Accessibility scanner must catch <img> without alt attribute'
 69:     );
 70:   } finally {
 71:     if (fs.existsSync(tempA11yViolation)) fs.unlinkSync(tempA11yViolation);
 72:   }
 73: 
 74:   // 4. Accessibility negative fixture: empty <button> without text/label
 75:   const tempEmptyBtn = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'temp-empty-btn.tsx');
 76:   try {
 77:     fs.writeFileSync(
 78:       tempEmptyBtn,
 79:       'export const BadBtn = () => <button className="icon-btn"></button>;',
 80:       'utf8'
 81:     );
 82:     const btnViolations = scanFileForA11y(tempEmptyBtn);
 83:     assert.ok(btnViolations.length > 0, 'Accessibility scanner must catch empty <button>');
 84:   } finally {
 85:     if (fs.existsSync(tempEmptyBtn)) fs.unlinkSync(tempEmptyBtn);
 86:   }
 87: 
 88:   // 5. Secret scan negative fixture: simulated live secret caught and failed (AC-FOUND-04-08)
 89:   const tempSecretFile = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'temp-secret-fixture.txt');
 90:   try {
 91:     fs.writeFileSync(
 92:       tempSecretFile,
 93:       'carrier_api_key = "ghn_secret_token_1234567890abcdef1234567890"',
 94:       'utf8'
 95:     );
 96:     const config = parseGitleaksConfig(path.resolve(monorepoRoot, '.gitleaks.toml'));
 97:     const findings = scanFile(tempSecretFile, config.rules);
 98:     assert.ok(findings.length > 0, 'Secret scanner must catch leaked secret in negative fixture');
 99:     assert.equal(findings[0].ruleId, 'generic-api-key');
100:   } finally {
101:     if (fs.existsSync(tempSecretFile)) fs.unlinkSync(tempSecretFile);
102:   }
103: 
104:   // 6. Performance budget negative fixture: exceeded budget fails closed (AC-FOUND-04-08)
105:   const tempManifestDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'temp-perf-fixture');
106:   const tempManifestPath = path.join(tempManifestDir, 'build-manifest.json');
107:   const tempChunkPath = path.join(tempManifestDir, 'chunk.js');
108:   try {
109:     fs.mkdirSync(tempManifestDir, { recursive: true });
110:     fs.writeFileSync(
111:       tempChunkPath,
112:       'console.log("giant chunk payload for budget overrun");'.repeat(50),
113:       'utf8'
114:     );
115:     fs.writeFileSync(
116:       tempManifestPath,
117:       JSON.stringify({
118:         rootMainFiles: ['chunk.js'],
119:         polyfillFiles: [],
120:       }),
121:       'utf8'
122:     );
123:     const perfResult = verifyPerformanceBudgets({
124:       manifestPath: tempManifestPath,
125:       budgets: [{ route: '/', maxInitialJsBytes: 100 }], // 100 bytes budget vs >1000 bytes chunk
126:     });
127:     assert.equal(
128:       perfResult.passed,
129:       false,
130:       'Performance gate must fail closed when budget is exceeded'
131:     );
132:     assert.ok(
133:       perfResult.errors.some((e) => e.includes('exceeded JS performance budget')),
134:       'Must report exact performance budget overrun'
135:     );
136:   } finally {
137:     if (fs.existsSync(tempManifestDir))
138:       fs.rmSync(tempManifestDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
139:   }
140: 
141:   // 7. Visual regression negative fixture: missing visual token fails closed (AC-FOUND-04-08)
142:   const tempVisualCatalog = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'temp-visual-baseline.json');
143:   try {
144:     fs.writeFileSync(
145:       tempVisualCatalog,
146:       JSON.stringify({
147:         version: '1.0.0',
148:         generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
149:         surfaces: [
150:           {
151:             id: 'SMOKE-CORRUPTED',
152:             component: 'NonExistentComponent',
153:             filePath: 'apps/web/src/components/NonExistentComponent.tsx',
154:             viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 },
155:             requiredVisualTokens: ['TOKEN_NEVER_PRESENT'],
156:             layoutType: 'test',
157:           },
158:         ],
159:       }),
160:       'utf8'
161:     );
162:     const visualResult = runVisualVerification(tempVisualCatalog);
163:     assert.equal(
164:       visualResult.passed,
165:       false,
166:       'Visual regression gate must fail closed on missing surface/token'
167:     );
168:     assert.ok(visualResult.errors.length > 0, 'Must record visual regression error');
169:   } finally {
170:     if (fs.existsSync(tempVisualCatalog)) fs.unlinkSync(tempVisualCatalog);
171:   }
172: 
173:   // 8. Database seed fixture verification (AC-FOUND-04-06)
174:   const mockPrismaClient: any = {
175:     merchant: {
176:       upsert: async () => ({}),
177:       count: async () => 1,
178:     },
179:     user: {
180:       upsert: async () => ({}),
181:       count: async () => 3,
182:     },
183:     carrierAccount: {
184:       upsert: async () => ({}),
185:       count: async () => 3,
186:     },
187:   };
188:   const seedResult = await seedDatabase(mockPrismaClient);
189:   assert.equal(seedResult.merchantsCount, 1, 'Seeded merchants count must match');
190:   assert.equal(seedResult.usersCount, 3, 'Seeded users count must match');
191:   assert.equal(seedResult.accountsCount, 3, 'Seeded carrier accounts count must match');
192: 
193:   console.log(
194:     '✅ All Negative Quality Gate tests correctly failed closed (Contracts, A11y, Secrets, Perf, Visual, Seed).'
195:   );
196: }
197: 
198: runQualityGatesNegativeFixtureTests().catch((err) => {
199:   console.error('❌ Quality Gate negative fixture test failed:', err);
200:   process.exit(1);
201: });
</file>

<file path="packages/testkit/README.md">
 1: # @shipde/testkit
 2: 
 3: Shared test harness helpers, assertion utilities, deterministic fixtures, and workspace boundary validators for Ship Dễ.
 4: 
 5: ## Purpose
 6: 
 7: - Provide reusable test fixtures and assertions across applications and packages.
 8: - Verify monorepo package boundary integrity without relying on ad-hoc test scripts.
 9: 
10: ## Boundary
11: 
12: - Contains test-only utilities and fixtures.
13: - Must not be included in production build dependencies.
</file>

<file path="prisma/migrations/20260911000000_feat_auth_01_self_registration/migration.sql">
 1: -- DropIndex: replace tenant-scoped uniqueness with a platform-wide constraint (BR-AUTH-03:
 2: -- self-registration mints a brand-new tenant per account, so email/phone must be unique
 3: -- across the whole platform, not merely within one merchant).
 4: DROP INDEX "users_merchant_id_email_key";
 5: 
 6: -- AlterTable
 7: ALTER TABLE "users" ALTER COLUMN "email" DROP NOT NULL;
 8: ALTER TABLE "users" ALTER COLUMN "phone" DROP NOT NULL;
 9: ALTER TABLE "users" ALTER COLUMN "status" SET DEFAULT 'pending_verification';
10: ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN "email_verified_at" TIMESTAMPTZ;
11: ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN "phone_verified_at" TIMESTAMPTZ;
12: ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN "terms_accepted_at" TIMESTAMPTZ;
13: ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN "terms_version" VARCHAR(32);
14: 
15: -- CreateTable
16: CREATE TABLE "verification_tokens" (
17:     "id" UUID NOT NULL,
18:     "user_id" UUID NOT NULL,
19:     "token" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
20:     "channel" VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
21:     "identifier" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
22:     "otp" VARCHAR(64),
23:     "expires_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
24:     "consumed_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
25:     "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
26: 
27:     CONSTRAINT "verification_tokens_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
28: );
29: 
30: -- CreateIndex
31: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "verification_tokens_token_key" ON "verification_tokens"("token");
32: 
33: -- CreateIndex
34: CREATE INDEX "verification_tokens_user_id_idx" ON "verification_tokens"("user_id");
35: 
36: -- CreateIndex
37: CREATE INDEX "verification_tokens_identifier_channel_idx" ON "verification_tokens"("identifier", "channel");
38: 
39: -- CreateIndex: platform-wide uniqueness on the login identifiers (Postgres treats each NULL
40: -- as distinct, so phone-only or email-only accounts remain unaffected).
41: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "users_email_key" ON "users"("email");
42: 
43: -- CreateIndex
44: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "users_phone_key" ON "users"("phone");
45: 
46: -- AddForeignKey
47: ALTER TABLE "verification_tokens" ADD CONSTRAINT "verification_tokens_user_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES "users"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE;

<file path="prisma/migrations/20260921000000_feat_auth_04_password_recovery/migration.sql">
 1: -- FEAT-AUTH-04: password recovery.
 2: --
 3: -- The PasswordResetToken model was added to schema.prisma but no migration ever
 4: -- created its table, so `prisma migrate deploy` left the database without it and
 5: -- every forgot-password request answered 500 with
 6: -- "The table `public.password_reset_tokens` does not exist in the current database."
 7: -- The auth supertest suite failed on that, not on anything it was testing.
 8: --
 9: -- This mirrors the model exactly, including the @db types: a reset token is
10: -- matched by its hash, so `token` is unique; `consumed_at` is nullable because a
11: -- token that was never used has not been consumed, which is different from one
12: -- consumed at an unknown time.
13: 
14: CREATE TABLE "password_reset_tokens" (
15:     "id" UUID NOT NULL,
16:     "user_id" UUID NOT NULL,
17:     "token" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
18:     "channel" VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
19:     "identifier" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
20:     "expires_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
21:     "consumed_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
22:     "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
23: 
24:     CONSTRAINT "password_reset_tokens_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
25: );
26: 
27: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "password_reset_tokens_token_key" ON "password_reset_tokens"("token");
28: 
29: CREATE INDEX "password_reset_tokens_user_id_idx" ON "password_reset_tokens"("user_id");
30: 
31: -- Recovery looks a token up by the identifier and channel it was sent to, which
32: -- is also how the rate limiter counts requests per address.
33: CREATE INDEX "password_reset_tokens_identifier_channel_idx" ON "password_reset_tokens"("identifier", "channel");
34: 
35: -- Cascade: a deleted user leaves no way to use their reset tokens, and keeping
36: -- them would keep a live path to an account that no longer exists.
37: ALTER TABLE "password_reset_tokens"
38:     ADD CONSTRAINT "password_reset_tokens_user_id_fkey"
39:     FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES "users"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE;
</file>

<file path="prisma/migrations/20260922000000_feat_auth_06_session_management/migration.sql">
 1: -- FEAT-AUTH-06: Session management migration
 2: -- Adds session lifecycle fields to device_sessions table
 3: 
 4: -- CreateEnum
 5: CREATE TYPE "SessionStatusEnum" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'REVOKED', 'EXPIRED', 'INACTIVE');
 6: 
 7: -- AlterTable: add new columns to device_sessions
 8: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ADD COLUMN "merchant_id" UUID;
 9: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ADD COLUMN "session_token_hash" VARCHAR(512);
10: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ADD COLUMN "user_agent" TEXT;
11: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ADD COLUMN "ip_address" VARCHAR(64);
12: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ADD COLUMN "status" "SessionStatusEnum" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE';
13: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ADD COLUMN "expires_at" TIMESTAMPTZ;
14: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ADD COLUMN "revoked_at" TIMESTAMPTZ;
15: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ADD COLUMN "revoked_by" VARCHAR(255);
16: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ADD COLUMN "revoke_reason" VARCHAR(255);
17: 
18: -- Backfill merchant_id from user's merchant_id for any existing rows
19: UPDATE "device_sessions" SET "merchant_id" = (
20:   SELECT "users"."merchant_id" FROM "users" WHERE "users"."id" = "device_sessions"."user_id"
21: ) WHERE "merchant_id" IS NULL;
22: 
23: -- Make merchant_id NOT NULL after backfill
24: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ALTER COLUMN "merchant_id" SET NOT NULL;
25: 
26: -- Migrate existing rows: generate token hashes and set expiry for legacy sessions.
27: --
28: -- gen_random_bytes() belongs to the pgcrypto extension, which this database does
29: -- not enable, so the migration aborted with 42883 and nothing after it ran.
30: -- gen_random_uuid() is built in from PostgreSQL 13 and gives 32 hex characters of
31: -- the same v4 randomness; two of them fill the 64-character hash this column
32: -- holds, with no extension to install and no privilege to grant.
33: --
34: -- The value is deliberately unguessable rather than derived from anything: a
35: -- legacy row has no token anybody could present, so its hash must match nothing.
36: UPDATE "device_sessions" SET
37:   "session_token_hash" =
38:     replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '') || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''),
39:   "expires_at" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '90 days'
40: WHERE "session_token_hash" IS NULL;
41: 
42: -- Make session_token_hash NOT NULL
43: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ALTER COLUMN "session_token_hash" SET NOT NULL;
44: 
45: -- Make expires_at NOT NULL
46: UPDATE "device_sessions" SET "expires_at" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '90 days' WHERE "expires_at" IS NULL;
47: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ALTER COLUMN "expires_at" SET NOT NULL;
48: 
49: -- Migrate old is_revoked=true rows to REVOKED status
50: UPDATE "device_sessions" SET "status" = 'REVOKED' WHERE "is_revoked" = true;
51: 
52: -- CreateIndex
53: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "device_sessions_session_token_hash_key" ON "device_sessions"("session_token_hash");
54: CREATE INDEX "device_sessions_merchant_id_user_id_status_idx" ON "device_sessions"("merchant_id", "user_id", "status");
55: CREATE INDEX "device_sessions_user_id_status_idx" ON "device_sessions"("user_id", "status");
56: 
57: -- AddForeignKey
58: ALTER TABLE "device_sessions" ADD CONSTRAINT "device_sessions_merchant_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("merchant_id") REFERENCES "merchants"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE;
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/auth/admin-auth.guard.ts">
 1: import { CanActivate, ExecutionContext, Injectable, Inject, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { Request } from 'express';
 3: import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
 4: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
 5: import { SessionStatusEnum, RoleEnum } from '@prisma/client';
 6: import { CanonicalApiException } from './auth.service';
 7: import { verifyAccessToken, resolveAccessTokenSecret } from './token.util';
 8: 
 9: @Injectable()
10: export class AdminAuthGuard implements CanActivate {
11:   constructor(@Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}
12: 
13:   async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
14:     const req = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<Request>();
15: 
16:     const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
17:     if (!authHeader || typeof authHeader !== 'string' || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
18:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
19:         HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
20:         'SESSION_INVALID',
21:         'Phiên đăng nhập không tồn tại hoặc đã hết hạn',
22:         false,
23:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập với tài khoản Quản trị viên nền tảng'
24:       );
25:     }
26: 
27:     const rawToken = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
28:     if (!rawToken) {
29:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
30:         HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
31:         'SESSION_INVALID',
32:         'Phiên đăng nhập không hợp lệ',
33:         false,
34:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
35:       );
36:     }
37: 
38:     let jwtClaims: any = null;
39:     if (rawToken.startsWith('v1.')) {
40:       try {
41:         const secret = resolveAccessTokenSecret(process.env.AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET);
42:         jwtClaims = verifyAccessToken(rawToken, secret);
43:       } catch {
44:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
45:           HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
46:           'SESSION_INVALID',
47:           'Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn hoặc không hợp lệ',
48:           false,
49:           'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
50:         );
51:       }
52:     }
53: 
54:     // Always validate session against database (no JWT-only fallback)
55:     const now = new Date();
56:     const tokenHash = createHash('sha256').update(rawToken).digest('hex');
57: 
58:     const session = await this.prisma.deviceSession.findFirst({
59:       where: {
60:         OR: [{ session_token_hash: tokenHash }, ...(jwtClaims?.sid ? [{ id: jwtClaims.sid }] : [])],
61:         status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,
62:         expires_at: { gt: now },
63:       },
64:       include: {
65:         user: true,
66:       },
67:     });
68: 
69:     if (!session || !session.user) {
70:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
71:         HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
72:         'SESSION_INVALID',
73:         'Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn hoặc bị thu hồi',
74:         false,
75:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
76:       );
77:     }
78: 
79:     if (session.user.role !== RoleEnum.PLATFORM_ADMIN) {
80:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
81:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
82:         'FORBIDDEN',
83:         'Truy cập bị từ chối: Yêu cầu quyền quản trị viên nền tảng (PLATFORM_ADMIN)',
84:         false,
85:         'Chỉ quản trị viên nền tảng mới có quyền truy cập khu vực này'
86:       );
87:     }
88: 
89:     (req as any).userId = session.user.id;
90:     (req as any).adminActor = session.user.id;
91:     (req as any).user = session.user;
92:     (req as any).session = session;
93:     return true;
94:   }
95: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/auth/admin-shops.controller.ts">
 1: import {
 2:   Controller,
 3:   Post,
 4:   Get,
 5:   Body,
 6:   Query,
 7:   Req,
 8:   Res,
 9:   HttpCode,
10:   HttpStatus,
11:   UseGuards,
12:   UseFilters,
13:   Inject,
14: } from '@nestjs/common';
15: import { Request, Response } from 'express';
16: import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
17: import { AdminAuthGuard } from './admin-auth.guard';
18: import { CanonicalExceptionFilter } from './canonical-exception.filter';
19: import { AdminCreateShopDto, AdminListShopsQuery } from './admin-shops.dto';
20: import { extractClientIp } from '../utils/ip.util';
21: import { normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
22: 
23: @Controller('admin/shops')
24: @UseGuards(AdminAuthGuard)
25: @UseFilters(CanonicalExceptionFilter)
26: export class AdminShopsController {
27:   constructor(@Inject(AuthService) private readonly authService: AuthService) {}
28: 
29:   @Post()
30:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
31:   async createShop(
32:     @Body() dto: AdminCreateShopDto,
33:     @Req() req: Request,
34:     @Res() res: Response
35:   ): Promise<Response> {
36:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
37:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
38:     const actor = (req as any).userId || (req as any).adminActor || 'operator';
39:     const result = await this.authService.adminCreateShop(dto, clientIp, correlationId, actor);
40:     return res.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).json(result);
41:   }
42: 
43:   @Get()
44:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
45:   async listShops(
46:     @Query() query: AdminListShopsQuery,
47:     @Req() req: Request,
48:     @Res() res: Response
49:   ): Promise<Response> {
50:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
51:     const result = await this.authService.adminListShops(query, correlationId);
52:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);
53:   }
54: }
</file>

  1: import { test, describe, it } from 'node:test';
  2: import * as assert from 'node:assert';
  3: import { AuthService, CanonicalApiException } from './auth.service';
  4: import { AdminAuthGuard } from './admin-auth.guard';
  5: import { signAccessToken, resolveAccessTokenSecret } from './token.util';
  6: import { AdminCreateShopDto } from './admin-shops.dto';
  7: import { RoleEnum, SessionStatusEnum } from '@prisma/client';

  9: import { MockVerificationDeliveryAdapter } from '@shipde/testkit';
 10: import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
 11: 
 12: // In-memory mock Prisma for offline unit tests
 13: function createMockPrismaService() {
 14:   const merchants: any[] = [];
 15:   const users: any[] = [];
 16:   const auditLogs: any[] = [];
 17:   const passwordResetTokens: any[] = [];
 18:   const deviceSessions: any[] = [];
 19: 
 20:   const mockTx = {
 21:     merchant: {
 22:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
 23:         const record = { id: `m-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`, ...data, created_at: new Date() };
 24:         merchants.push(record);
 25:         return record;
 26:       },
 27:     },
 28:     user: {
 29:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
 30:         const record = { id: `u-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`, ...data, created_at: new Date() };
 31:         users.push(record);
 32:         return record;
 33:       },
 34:     },
 35:     passwordResetToken: {
 36:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
 37:         const record = {
 38:           id: `prt-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`,
 39:           ...data,
 40:           created_at: new Date(),
 41:         };
 42:         passwordResetTokens.push(record);
 43:         return record;
 44:       },
 45:     },
 46:   };
 47: 
 48:   return {
 49:     merchants,
 50:     users,
 51:     auditLogs,
 52:     passwordResetTokens,
 53:     deviceSessions,
 54:     merchant: {
 55:       findMany: async () => merchants,
 56:       count: async () => merchants.length,
 57:       create: async ({ data }: any) => mockTx.merchant.create({ data }),
 58:     },
 59:     passwordResetToken: {
 60:       create: async ({ data }: any) => mockTx.passwordResetToken.create({ data }),
 61:     },
 62:     deviceSession: {
 63:       findFirst: async ({ where, include }: any) => {
 64:         const found = deviceSessions.find((s) => {
 65:           if (where.status && s.status !== where.status) return false;
 66:           if (where.expires_at?.gt && !(s.expires_at > where.expires_at.gt)) return false;
 67:           if (where.OR) {
 68:             const matchesOr = where.OR.some((cond: any) => {
 69:               if (cond.session_token_hash && s.session_token_hash === cond.session_token_hash)
 70:                 return true;
 71:               if (cond.id && s.id === cond.id) return true;
 72:               return false;
 73:             });
 74:             if (!matchesOr) return false;
 75:           }
 76:           return true;
 77:         });
 78:         if (!found) return null;
 79:         return {
 80:           ...found,
 81:           user: include?.user ? users.find((u) => u.id === found.user_id) : undefined,
 82:         };
 83:       },
 84:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
 85:         const record = {
 86:           id: `sess-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`,
 87:           ...data,
 88:           created_at: new Date(),
 89:         };
 90:         deviceSessions.push(record);
 91:         return record;
 92:       },
 93:     },
 94:     user: {
 95:       findMany: async ({ where, include }: any) => {
 96:         if (!where?.OR) return [];
 97:         return users
 98:           .filter((u) =>
 99:             where.OR.some((condition: any) => {
100:               if (
101:                 condition.email &&
102:                 u.email &&
103:                 condition.email.toLowerCase() === u.email.toLowerCase()
104:               )
105:                 return true;
106:               if (condition.phone && u.phone && condition.phone === u.phone) return true;
107:               return false;
108:             })
109:           )
110:           .map((u) => ({
111:             ...u,
112:             merchant: include?.merchant ? merchants.find((m) => m.id === u.merchant_id) : undefined,
113:           }));
114:       },
115:     },
116:     auditLog: {
117:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
118:         const record = { ...data, actor: data.actor || data.user_id, details: data.new_value };
119:         auditLogs.push(record);
120:         return record;
121:       },
122:     },
123:     $transaction: async (cb: any) => {
124:       const snapshotMerchants = [...merchants];
125:       const snapshotUsers = [...users];
126:       const snapshotTokens = [...passwordResetTokens];
127:       try {
128:         return await cb(mockTx);
129:       } catch (err) {
130:         merchants.length = 0;
131:         merchants.push(...snapshotMerchants);
132:         users.length = 0;
133:         users.push(...snapshotUsers);
134:         passwordResetTokens.length = 0;
135:         passwordResetTokens.push(...snapshotTokens);
136:         throw err;
137:       }
138:     },
139:   } as any;
140: }

 38: @Controller('auth')

  1: import 'reflect-metadata';

 26: /**
 27:  * FEAT-AUTH-03 — Login (password or OTP) supertest suite (UC-AUTH-01).
 28:  * Covers AC-AUTH-01-01..15; AC-AUTH-01-16 is covered by `pnpm contract:check` in CI.

 30: const TEST_PASSWORD = 'TestPassword123!'; // Documented test-only seed credential (see work item)
 31: // FEAT-AUTH-05: OWNER logins now require MFA enrollment (BR-AUTH-18), so the primary-login
 32: // fixture is an optional-role (no forced MFA) user that this suite creates itself.
 33: const OWNER_ID = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1';
 34: const OWNER_EMAIL = 'login-subject@shipde.vn';
 35: const OWNER_PHONE = '0909999501';
 36: const PENDING_EMAIL = 'pending@shipde.vn';
 37: const OPS_EMAIL = 'ops@shipde.vn';
 38: const ACCOUNTANT_EMAIL = 'accountant@shipde.vn';
 39: 
 40: async function runAuthLoginSupertestSuite() {
 41:   console.log('================================================================');
 42:   console.log('SHIP DE - LOGIN SUPERTEST SUITE (FEAT-AUTH-03 / UC-AUTH-01)');
 43:   console.log('================================================================');
 44: 
 45:   const envPaths = [
 46:     path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env'),
 47:     path.resolve(process.cwd(), '../../.env'),
 48:     path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../.env'),
 49:   ];
 50:   for (const envPath of envPaths) {
 51:     if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
 52:       const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8');
 53:       for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
 54:         const trimmed = line.trim();
 55:         if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
 56:           const [key, ...rest] = trimmed.split('=');
 57:           const cleanKey = key.trim();
 58:           let val = rest.join('=').trim();
 59:           if (
 60:             (val.startsWith('"') && val.endsWith('"')) ||
 61:             (val.startsWith("'") && val.endsWith("'"))
 62:           ) {
 63:             val = val.slice(1, -1);
 64:           }
 65:           if (!process.env[cleanKey]) {
 66:             process.env[cleanKey] = val;
 67:           }
 68:         }
 69:       }
 70:       break;
 71:     }
 72:   }
 73: 
 74:   let databaseUrl =
 75:     process.env.DATABASE_URL ||
 76:     'postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5433/shipde_dev?schema=public';
 77:   if (
 78:     (databaseUrl.startsWith('"') && databaseUrl.endsWith('"')) ||
 79:     (databaseUrl.startsWith("'") && databaseUrl.endsWith("'"))
 80:   ) {
 81:     databaseUrl = databaseUrl.slice(1, -1);
 82:   }
 83:   process.env.DATABASE_URL = databaseUrl;
 84: 
 85:   // Shared config object: AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED is flipped to true after TEST 8
 86:   // (the service reads this reference per request, mirroring CD-4's operator gate).
 87:   const testConfig: AppConfig = {
 88:     NODE_ENV: 'test',
 89:     PORT: 3099,
 90:     WORKER_HEALTH_PORT: 3098,
 91:     DATABASE_URL: databaseUrl,
 92:     REDIS_HOST: process.env.REDIS_HOST || 'localhost',
 93:     REDIS_PORT: Number(process.env.REDIS_PORT || 6379),
 94:     S3_ENDPOINT: process.env.S3_ENDPOINT || 'http://localhost:9000',
 95:     S3_REGION: 'us-east-1',
 96:     S3_ACCESS_KEY: 'minioadmin',
 97:     S3_SECRET_KEY: 'minioadmin',
 98:     S3_BUCKET: 'test-bucket',
 99:     S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: true,
100:     CARRIER_MODE: 'disabled',
101:     LOG_LEVEL: 'info',
102:     AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS: 43200,
103:     AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED: false,
104:     PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECONDS: 3600,
105:     FRONTEND_URL: 'http://localhost:3000',
106:     AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY: 'test-key-32-chars',
107:     TRUST_PROXY_HOPS: 1,
108:   };

110:   const mockDeliveryAdapter = new MockVerificationDeliveryAdapter();
111: 
112:   const moduleFixture: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
113:     imports: [AppModule],
114:   })
115:     .overrideProvider(APP_CONFIG)
116:     .useValue(testConfig)
117:     .overrideProvider(VERIFICATION_ADAPTER)
118:     .useValue(mockDeliveryAdapter)

121:   const app = moduleFixture.createNestApplication<NestExpressApplication>();
122:   app.set('trust proxy', 1);
123:   await app.init();
124: 
125:   const prisma = app.get(PrismaService);
126:   const rateLimitService = app.get(RateLimitService);
127: 
128:   const dbStatus = await prisma.checkReadiness();
129:   if (dbStatus !== 'up') {
130:     if (process.env.CI) {
131:       throw new Error(`Database must be reachable in CI environment at ${databaseUrl}`);
132:     }
133:     console.warn(

135:     );
136:     await app.close();
137:     console.log('🎉 Login supertest suite skipped offline safely!');
138:     return;
139:   }

141:   // Deterministic fixtures: owner@shipde.vn (active, verified email+phone), pending@shipde.vn, etc.
142:   await seedDatabase(prisma);

144:   const subjectData = {
145:     merchant_id: SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
146:     email: OWNER_EMAIL,
147:     phone: OWNER_PHONE,
148:     full_name: 'Login Subject',
149:     password_hash: await hashPassword(TEST_PASSWORD),
150:     role: RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH,
151:     status: 'active',
152:     email_verified_at: verifiedAt,
153:     phone_verified_at: verifiedAt,
154:     terms_accepted_at: verifiedAt,
155:     terms_version: '2026.1',
156:   };
157:   await prisma.user.upsert({
158:     where: { id: OWNER_ID },

160:     create: { id: OWNER_ID, ...subjectData },
161:   });
162: 
163:   const testSuffix = `${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}${Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100)}`;
164:   const ipFor = (n: number) => `203.0.113.${n}`;
165:   const collectedBodies: unknown[] = [];

200:     assert.strictEqual(res1.body.data.user.id, OWNER_ID);
201:     assert.strictEqual(res1.body.data.user.role, 'OPS_CSKH');

263:       .post('/auth/login')

265:       .send({ identifier: `ghost.${testSuffix}@shipde.vn`, password: 'Whatever123!' })
266:       .expect(401);
267:     collectedBodies.push(res3a.body, res3b.body);
