  1: import { describe, it } from 'node:test';
  2: import * as assert from 'node:assert';
  3: import { createHash, randomBytes, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
  4: import {
  5:   generateTotpSecret,
  6:   generateTotpCode,
  7:   verifyTotpCode,
  8:   generateProvisioningUri,
  9:   encryptMfaSecret,
 10:   decryptMfaSecret,
 11:   generateRecoveryCodes,
 12:   hashRecoveryCode,
 13:   normalizeRecoveryCode,
 14: } from './totp.util.ts';
 15: import { signAccessToken, verifyAccessToken, resolveAccessTokenSecret } from './token.util.ts';
 16: 
 17: describe('TOTP Utility (RFC 6238 / RFC 4226 / AES-256-GCM)', () => {
 18:   const testKey = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
 19: 
 20:   it('generates a 32-character base32 secret with high entropy', () => {
 21:     const secret = generateTotpSecret();
 22:     assert.strictEqual(typeof secret, 'string');
 23:     assert.strictEqual(secret.length, 32);
 24:     assert.match(secret, /^[A-Z2-7]+$/);
 25:   });
 26: 
 27:   it('generates a 6-digit TOTP code matching RFC 6238 vector', () => {
 28:     // RFC 6238 Test Vector:
 29:     // Secret for SHA1: "12345678901234567890" -> Base32: GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ
 30:     // At T = 59s (step = 1): TOTP = "287082"
 31:     // At T = 1111111109s (step = 37037036): TOTP = "081804"
 32:     const rfcSecret = ['GEZDGNBV', 'GY3TQOJQ'].join('').repeat(2);
 33:     const code1 = generateTotpCode(rfcSecret, 59 * 1000);
 34:     assert.strictEqual(code1, '287082');
 35: 
 36:     const code2 = generateTotpCode(rfcSecret, 1111111109 * 1000);
 37:     assert.strictEqual(code2, '081804');
 38:   });
 39: 
 40:   it('verifies TOTP code within current, previous, and next 30s window', () => {
 41:     const secret = generateTotpSecret();
 42:     const now = 1700000000 * 1000;
 43: 
 44:     const currentCode = generateTotpCode(secret, now);
 45:     const pastCode = generateTotpCode(secret, now - 30 * 1000);
 46:     const futureCode = generateTotpCode(secret, now + 30 * 1000);
 47:     const tooOldCode = generateTotpCode(secret, now - 60 * 1000);
 48:     const tooNewCode = generateTotpCode(secret, now + 60 * 1000);
 49: 
 50:     const resCurrent = verifyTotpCode(currentCode, secret, null, now);
 51:     assert.strictEqual(resCurrent.valid, true);

 53: 
 54:     const resPast = verifyTotpCode(pastCode, secret, null, now);
 55:     assert.strictEqual(resPast.valid, true);
 56: 
 57:     const resFuture = verifyTotpCode(futureCode, secret, null, now);

<file path="apps/api/src/auth/totp.util.ts">
  1: import { createHmac, randomBytes, createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, createHash } from 'node:crypto';
  2: 
  3: // RFC 4648 Base32 alphabet
  4: const BASE32_ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567';
  5: 
  6: export function base32Encode(buffer: Buffer): string {
  7:   let bits = 0;
  8:   let value = 0;
  9:   let output = '';
 10: 
 11:   for (let i = 0; i < buffer.length; i++) {
 12:     value = (value << 8) | buffer[i];
 13:     bits += 8;
 14: 
 15:     while (bits >= 5) {
 16:       output += BASE32_ALPHABET[(value >>> (bits - 5)) & 31];
 17:       bits -= 5;
 18:     }
 19:   }
 20: 
 21:   if (bits > 0) {
 22:     output += BASE32_ALPHABET[(value << (5 - bits)) & 31];
 23:   }
 24: 
 25:   return output;
 26: }
 27: 
 28: export function base32Decode(input: string): Buffer {
 29:   const cleanInput = input.toUpperCase().replace(/[=\s-]/g, '');
 30:   let bits = 0;
 31:   let value = 0;
 32:   const bytes: number[] = [];
 33: 
 34:   for (let i = 0; i < cleanInput.length; i++) {
 35:     const char = cleanInput[i];
 36:     const index = BASE32_ALPHABET.indexOf(char);
 37:     if (index === -1) {
 38:       throw new Error(`Invalid Base32 character: ${char}`);
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     value = (value << 5) | index;
 42:     bits += 5;
 43: 
 44:     if (bits >= 8) {
 45:       bytes.push((value >>> (bits - 8)) & 255);
 46:       bits -= 8;
 47:     }
 48:   }
 49: 
 50:   return Buffer.from(bytes);
 51: }
 52: 
 53: /**
 54:  * Generates a 20-byte (160-bit) cryptographically secure random Base32 secret.
 55:  * Output length is 32 Base32 characters.
 56:  */
 57: export function generateTotpSecret(): string {
 58:   const bytes = randomBytes(20);
 59:   return base32Encode(bytes);
 60: }
 61: 
 62: /**
 63:  * Generates a standard 6-digit TOTP code for the given Base32 secret and timestamp (RFC 6238).
 64:  * Period = 30 seconds, Algorithm = SHA1.
 65:  */
 66: export function generateTotpCode(secret: string, timestampMs: number = Date.now()): string {
 67:   const key = base32Decode(secret);
 68:   const epochSeconds = Math.floor(timestampMs / 1000);
 69:   const timeStep = Math.floor(epochSeconds / 30);
 70: 
 71:   const counterBuffer = Buffer.alloc(8);
 72:   counterBuffer.writeBigInt64BE(BigInt(timeStep));
 73: 
 74:   const hmac = createHmac('sha1', key).update(counterBuffer).digest();
 75:   const offset = hmac[hmac.length - 1] & 0x0f;
 76: 
 77:   const binaryCode =
 78:     ((hmac[offset] & 0x7f) << 24) |
 79:     ((hmac[offset + 1] & 0xff) << 16) |
 80:     ((hmac[offset + 2] & 0xff) << 8) |
 81:     (hmac[offset + 3] & 0xff);
 82: 
 83:   const otp = binaryCode % 1000000;
 84:   return otp.toString().padStart(6, '0');
 85: }
 86: 
 87: export interface VerifyTotpResult {
 88:   valid: boolean;
 89:   acceptedStep?: bigint;
 90:   error?: 'INVALID_CODE' | 'STEP_REPLAYED' | 'EXPIRED';
 91: }
 92: 
 93: /**
 94:  * Verifies a 6-digit TOTP code within an allowed window of [-1, 0, +1] 30s steps (RFC 6238).
 95:  * Rejects any step <= lastAcceptedStep to prevent replay attacks (BR-AUTH-15, AC-AUTH-05-03).
 96:  */
 97: export function verifyTotpCode(
 98:   code: string,
 99:   secret: string,
100:   lastAcceptedStep: bigint | null = null,
101:   timestampMs: number = Date.now()
102: ): VerifyTotpResult {
103:   const normalizedCode = code.trim();
104:   if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(normalizedCode)) {
105:     return { valid: false, error: 'INVALID_CODE' };
106:   }
107: 
108:   const key = base32Decode(secret);
109:   const epochSeconds = Math.floor(timestampMs / 1000);
110:   const currentStep = BigInt(Math.floor(epochSeconds / 30));
111: 
112:   // Check window: currentStep - 1, currentStep, currentStep + 1
113:   const candidateSteps = [currentStep, currentStep - 1n, currentStep + 1n];
114: 
115:   for (const step of candidateSteps) {
116:     const counterBuffer = Buffer.alloc(8);
117:     counterBuffer.writeBigInt64BE(step);
118: 
119:     const hmac = createHmac('sha1', key).update(counterBuffer).digest();
120:     const offset = hmac[hmac.length - 1] & 0x0f;
121: 
122:     const binaryCode =
123:       ((hmac[offset] & 0x7f) << 24) |
124:       ((hmac[offset + 1] & 0xff) << 16) |
125:       ((hmac[offset + 2] & 0xff) << 8) |
126:       (hmac[offset + 3] & 0xff);
127: 
128:     const candidateOtp = (binaryCode % 1000000).toString().padStart(6, '0');
129: 
130:     if (candidateOtp === normalizedCode) {
131:       if (lastAcceptedStep !== null && step <= lastAcceptedStep) {
132:         return { valid: false, error: 'STEP_REPLAYED' };
133:       }
134:       return { valid: true, acceptedStep: step };
135:     }
136:   }
137: 
138:   return { valid: false, error: 'INVALID_CODE' };
139: }
140: 
141: /**
142:  * Generates an otpauth:// provisioning URI for QR code generation (BR-AUTH-14).
143:  */
144: export function generateProvisioningUri(options: {
145:   secret: string;
146:   accountName: string;
147:   issuer?: string;
148: }): string {
149:   const issuer = options.issuer || 'Ship Dễ';
150:   const label = `${encodeURIComponent(issuer)}:${encodeURIComponent(options.accountName)}`;
151:   return `otpauth://totp/${label}?secret=${encodeURIComponent(options.secret)}&issuer=${encodeURIComponent(issuer)}&algorithm=SHA1&digits=6&period=30`;
152: }
153: 
154: /**
155:  * Derives a 32-byte key from string or buffer for AES-256-GCM encryption.
156:  */
157: function deriveEncryptionKey(keyInput: string | Buffer): Buffer {
158:   if (Buffer.isBuffer(keyInput) && keyInput.length === 32) {
159:     return keyInput;
160:   }
161:   if (typeof keyInput === 'string' && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(keyInput)) {
162:     return Buffer.from(keyInput, 'hex');
163:   }
164:   return createHash('sha256').update(keyInput).digest();
165: }
166: 
167: /**
168:  * Encrypts a plaintext secret using AES-256-GCM.
169:  * Output format: `v1:<iv_hex>:<auth_tag_hex>:<ciphertext_hex>`.
170:  */
171: export function encryptMfaSecret(plaintext: string, keyInput: string | Buffer): string {
172:   const key = deriveEncryptionKey(keyInput);
173:   const iv = randomBytes(12); // 96-bit IV standard for GCM
174:   const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
175: 
176:   let ciphertext = cipher.update(plaintext, 'utf8', 'hex');
177:   ciphertext += cipher.final('hex');
178: 
179:   const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();
180: 
181:   return `v1:${iv.toString('hex')}:${authTag.toString('hex')}:${ciphertext}`;
182: }
183: 
184: /**
185:  * Decrypts an AES-256-GCM encrypted secret.
186:  */
187: export function decryptMfaSecret(payload: string, keyInput: string | Buffer): string {
188:   const parts = payload.split(':');
189:   if (parts.length !== 4 || parts[0] !== 'v1') {
190:     throw new Error('Unsupported or malformed MFA secret ciphertext');
191:   }
192: 
193:   const [, ivHex, tagHex, ciphertextHex] = parts;
194:   const key = deriveEncryptionKey(keyInput);
195:   const iv = Buffer.from(ivHex, 'hex');
196:   const tag = Buffer.from(tagHex, 'hex');
197: 
198:   const decipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
199:   decipher.setAuthTag(tag);
200: 
201:   let decrypted = decipher.update(ciphertextHex, 'hex', 'utf8');
202:   decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');
203: 
204:   return decrypted;
205: }
206: 
207: /**
208:  * Normalizes a recovery code by stripping whitespace, hyphens, and converting to uppercase.
209:  */
210: export function normalizeRecoveryCode(code: string): string {
211:   return code.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
212: }
213: 
214: /**
215:  * Computes a non-reversible SHA-256 verifier for a recovery code (BR-AUTH-17).
216:  */
217: export function hashRecoveryCode(code: string): string {
218:   const normalized = normalizeRecoveryCode(code);
219:   return createHash('sha256').update(normalized).digest('hex');
220: }
221: 
222: /**
223:  * Generates exactly `count` (default 10) high-entropy single-use recovery codes.
224:  * Returns plaintext formatted as `XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX` (64 bits of entropy) and their irreversible SHA-256 hashes.
225:  */
226: export function generateRecoveryCodes(count: number = 10): {
227:   plaintext: string[];
228:   hashes: string[];
229: } {
230:   const plaintext: string[] = [];
231:   const hashes: string[] = [];
232: 
233:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
234:     // 8 random bytes (64 bits) -> 16 hex characters formatted as 4-4-4-4
235:     const bytes = randomBytes(8).toString('hex').toUpperCase();
236:     const formatted = bytes.match(/.{4}/g)!.join('-');
237:     plaintext.push(formatted);
238:     hashes.push(hashRecoveryCode(formatted));
239:   }
240: 
241:   return { plaintext, hashes };
242: }
</file>

 38:   private async resolveActor(req: any): Promise<ActorContext> {
 39:     if (req.actorContext) {
 40:       return req.actorContext;
 41:     }
 42:     const actor = await this.rbacService.resolveActorFromSession(req);
 43:     req.actorContext = actor;
 44:     return actor;
 45:   }

 47:   /**

 49:    */
 50:   private assertTenantMembership(actor: ActorContext): void {
 51:     if (!actor.merchantId) {
 52:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 53:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 54:         'FORBIDDEN',
 55:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
 56:         false,
 57:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
 58:       );
 59:     }
 60:   }
 61: 
 62:   /**
 63:    * Resolve view and configuration capabilities through the authoritative RBAC
 64:    * registry. Role codes and display names never grant branch access directly.
 65:    */
 66:   private async assertCanViewBranches(actor: ActorContext): Promise<void> {
 67:     const hasPerm = await this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actor, ['iam:shop_config']);
 68:     if (hasPerm) {
 69:       return;
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     if (!(await this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actor, ['iam:shop_view']))) {
 73:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 74:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 75:         'FORBIDDEN',
 76:         'Bạn không có quyền xem danh sách chi nhánh',
 77:         false,
 78:         'Vui lòng liên hệ Chủ Shop để được cấp quyền'
 79:       );
 80:     }
 81:   }
 82: 
 83:   /**
 84:    * GET /api/v1/branches (AC-ORG-02-01, AC-ORG-02-02)
 85:    */
 86:   @Get()
 87:   async listBranches(
 88:     @Query('status') status: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' | undefined,
 89:     @Req() req: Request,
 90:     @Res() res: Response
 91:   ): Promise<Response> {
 92:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
 93:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 94:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
 95:     await this.assertCanViewBranches(actor);
 96: 
 97:     const result = await this.branchesService.listBranches(
 98:       actor.merchantId,
 99:       actor,
100:       { status },
101:       correlationId
102:     );
103:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);

127:     );
128:     return res.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).json(result);

  1: import type { CanonicalFieldError } from '../auth/auth.service';
  2: 
  3: export interface CreateBranchDto {
  4:   name: string;
  5:   code: string;
  6:   address?: string | null;
  7:   phone?: string | null;
  8:   is_default?: boolean;
  9:   status?: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE';
 10: }
 11: 
 12: export interface UpdateBranchDto {
 13:   name?: string;
 14:   code?: string;
 15:   address?: string | null;
 16:   phone?: string | null;
 17:   is_default?: boolean;
 18:   status?: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE';
 19: }

 21: export interface FormattedBranch {
 22:   id: string;
 23:   merchant_id: string;
 24:   name: string;
 25:   code: string;
 26:   address: string | null;
 27:   phone: string | null;
 28:   is_default: boolean;
 29:   status: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE';
 30:   created_at: string;
 31:   updated_at: string;
 32: }
 33: 
 34: const BRANCH_CODE_REGEX = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,64}$/;
 35: const PHONE_REGEX = /^(0|\+84)[35789][0-9]{8}$/;
 36: 
 37: export function validateCreateBranchDto(dto: CreateBranchDto): CanonicalFieldError[] {
 38:   const fields: CanonicalFieldError[] = [];
 39: 
 40:   if (!dto.name || typeof dto.name !== 'string' || dto.name.trim().length < 2) {
 41:     fields.push({
 42:       field: 'name',
 43:       code: 'REQUIRED',
 44:       message: 'Tên chi nhánh là bắt buộc và phải có ít nhất 2 ký tự',
 45:     });
 46:   } else if (dto.name.trim().length > 255) {
 47:     fields.push({
 48:       field: 'name',
 49:       code: 'MAX_LENGTH',
 50:       message: 'Tên chi nhánh không được vượt quá 255 ký tự',
 51:     });
 52:   }
 53: 
 54:   if (!dto.code || typeof dto.code !== 'string' || !BRANCH_CODE_REGEX.test(dto.code.trim())) {
 55:     fields.push({
 56:       field: 'code',
 57:       code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
 58:       message:
 59:         'Mã chi nhánh là bắt buộc, từ 2 đến 64 ký tự chữ, số, gạch ngang (-) hoặc gạch dưới (_)',
 60:     });
 61:   }
 62: 
 63:   if (dto.address !== undefined && dto.address !== null) {
 64:     if (typeof dto.address !== 'string') {
 65:       fields.push({
 66:         field: 'address',
 67:         code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
 68:         message: 'Địa chỉ chi nhánh phải là chuỗi ký tự',
 69:       });
 70:     } else {
 71:       const trimmed = dto.address.trim();
 72:       if (trimmed.length > 1000) {
 73:         fields.push({
 74:           field: 'address',
 75:           code: 'MAX_LENGTH',
 76:           message: 'Địa chỉ không được vượt quá 1000 ký tự',
 77:         });
 78:       }
 79:     }
 80:   }
 81: 
 82:   if (dto.phone !== undefined && dto.phone !== null) {
 83:     if (typeof dto.phone !== 'string') {
 84:       fields.push({
 85:         field: 'phone',
 86:         code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
 87:         message: 'Số điện thoại chi nhánh phải là chuỗi ký tự',
 88:       });
 89:     } else {
 90:       const rawPhone = dto.phone.trim().replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
 91:       if (rawPhone.length > 0 && !PHONE_REGEX.test(rawPhone)) {
 92:         fields.push({
 93:           field: 'phone',
 94:           code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
 95:           message: 'Số điện thoại chi nhánh không hợp lệ theo định dạng Việt Nam',
 96:         });
 97:       }
 98:     }
 99:   }
100: 
101:   if (
102:     dto.is_default !== undefined &&
103:     dto.is_default !== null &&
104:     typeof dto.is_default !== 'boolean'
105:   ) {
106:     fields.push({
107:       field: 'is_default',
108:       code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
109:       message: 'Trạng thái mặc định phải là giá trị boolean',
110:     });
111:   }
112: 
113:   if (dto.status !== undefined && dto.status !== null) {
114:     if (dto.status !== 'ACTIVE' && dto.status !== 'INACTIVE') {
115:       fields.push({
116:         field: 'status',
117:         code: 'INVALID_VALUE',
118:         message: 'Trạng thái chi nhánh chỉ có thể là ACTIVE hoặc INACTIVE',
119:       });
120:     }
121:   }
122: 
123:   return fields;
124: }
125: 
126: export function validateUpdateBranchDto(dto: UpdateBranchDto): CanonicalFieldError[] {
127:   const fields: CanonicalFieldError[] = [];
128: 
129:   if (dto.name !== undefined) {
130:     if (typeof dto.name !== 'string') {
131:       fields.push({
132:         field: 'name',
133:         code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
134:         message: 'Tên chi nhánh phải là chuỗi ký tự',
135:       });
136:     } else {
137:       const trimmed = dto.name.trim();
138:       if (trimmed.length < 2 || trimmed.length > 255) {
139:         fields.push({
140:           field: 'name',
141:           code: 'INVALID_LENGTH',
142:           message: 'Tên chi nhánh phải từ 2 đến 255 ký tự',
143:         });
144:       }
145:     }
146:   }
147: 
148:   if (dto.code !== undefined) {
149:     if (typeof dto.code !== 'string') {
150:       fields.push({
151:         field: 'code',
152:         code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
153:         message: 'Mã chi nhánh phải là chuỗi ký tự',
154:       });
155:     } else {
156:       const trimmed = dto.code.trim();
157:       if (!BRANCH_CODE_REGEX.test(trimmed)) {
158:         fields.push({
159:           field: 'code',
160:           code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
161:           message: 'Mã chi nhánh phải từ 2 đến 64 ký tự chữ, số, gạch ngang (-) hoặc gạch dưới (_)',
162:         });
163:       }
164:     }
165:   }
166: 
167:   if (dto.address !== undefined && dto.address !== null) {
168:     if (typeof dto.address !== 'string') {
169:       fields.push({
170:         field: 'address',
171:         code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
172:         message: 'Địa chỉ chi nhánh phải là chuỗi ký tự',
173:       });
174:     } else {
175:       const trimmed = dto.address.trim();
176:       if (trimmed.length > 1000) {
177:         fields.push({
178:           field: 'address',
179:           code: 'MAX_LENGTH',
180:           message: 'Địa chỉ không được vượt quá 1000 ký tự',
181:         });
182:       }
183:     }
184:   }
185: 
186:   if (dto.phone !== undefined && dto.phone !== null) {
187:     if (typeof dto.phone !== 'string') {
188:       fields.push({
189:         field: 'phone',
190:         code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
191:         message: 'Số điện thoại chi nhánh phải là chuỗi ký tự',
192:       });
193:     } else {
194:       const rawPhone = dto.phone.trim().replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
195:       if (rawPhone.length > 0 && !PHONE_REGEX.test(rawPhone)) {
196:         fields.push({
197:           field: 'phone',
198:           code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
199:           message: 'Số điện thoại chi nhánh không hợp lệ theo định dạng Việt Nam',
200:         });
201:       }
202:     }
203:   }
204: 
205:   if (
206:     dto.is_default !== undefined &&
207:     dto.is_default !== null &&
208:     typeof dto.is_default !== 'boolean'
209:   ) {
210:     fields.push({
211:       field: 'is_default',
212:       code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
213:       message: 'Trạng thái mặc định phải là giá trị boolean',
214:     });
215:   }
216: 
217:   if (dto.status !== undefined && dto.status !== null) {
218:     if (dto.status !== 'ACTIVE' && dto.status !== 'INACTIVE') {
219:       fields.push({
220:         field: 'status',
221:         code: 'INVALID_VALUE',
222:         message: 'Trạng thái chi nhánh chỉ có thể là ACTIVE hoặc INACTIVE',
223:       });
224:     }
225:   }
226: 
227:   return fields;
228: }

  9:   UseFilters,
 10:   Inject,
 11: } from '@nestjs/common';
 12: import { Request } from 'express';
 13: import { CarrierCatalogService } from './carrier-catalog.service';
 14: import { SessionGuard } from '../session/session.guard';
 15: import { RbacSeedGuard, PermissionsGuard, RequirePermissions } from '../rbac/rbac.guard';
 16: import { CanonicalExceptionFilter } from '../auth/canonical-exception.filter';
 17: import { RbacService } from '../rbac/rbac.service';
 18: import type { ActorContext } from '../rbac/rbac.dto';
 19: import { CanonicalApiException } from '../auth/auth.service';
 20: import {
 21:   CarrierListResponse,
 22:   CarrierDetailResponseEnvelope,
 23:   CanonicalStatusListResponse,
 24:   FeeComponentListResponse,
 25:   CompatibilityMappingListResponse,
 26: } from './carrier-catalog.dto';
 27: 
 28: @Controller(['api/v1/carrier-catalog', 'carrier-catalog'])
 29: @UseGuards(RbacSeedGuard, SessionGuard, PermissionsGuard)
 30: @UseFilters(CanonicalExceptionFilter)
 31: @RequirePermissions('iam:carrier_catalog:read')
 32: export class CarrierCatalogController {
 33:   constructor(
 34:     @Inject(CarrierCatalogService) private readonly catalogService: CarrierCatalogService,
 35:     @Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService: RbacService
 36:   ) {}
 37: 
 38:   private async resolveActor(req: any): Promise<ActorContext> {
 39:     if (req.actorContext) {
 40:       return req.actorContext;
 41:     }
 42:     const actor = await this.rbacService.resolveActorFromSession(req);
 43:     req.actorContext = actor;
 44:     return actor;
 45:   }
 46: 
 47:   private assertTenantMembership(actor: ActorContext): void {
 48:     if (!actor || !actor.merchantId) {
 49:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 50:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 51:         'FORBIDDEN',
 52:         'Yêu cầu phiên làm việc của cửa hàng'
 53:       );
 54:     }
 55:   }
 56: 
 57:   @Get('carriers')
 58:   async listCarriers(
 59:     @Req() req: Request,
 60:     @Query('is_active') isActiveRaw?: string
 61:   ): Promise<CarrierListResponse> {
 62:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 63:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
 64: 
 65:     let isActive: boolean | undefined = undefined;
 66:     if (isActiveRaw !== undefined) {
 67:       if (isActiveRaw === 'true' || isActiveRaw === '1') {
 68:         isActive = true;
 69:       } else if (isActiveRaw === 'false' || isActiveRaw === '0') {
 70:         isActive = false;
 71:       }
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     return this.catalogService.listCarriers(isActive);
 75:   }
 76: 
 77:   @Get('carriers/:code')
 78:   async getCarrierDetail(
 79:     @Req() req: Request,
 80:     @Param('code') code: string
 81:   ): Promise<CarrierDetailResponseEnvelope> {
 82:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 83:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
 84: 
 85:     return this.catalogService.getCarrierDetail(code);
 86:   }
 87: 
 88:   @Get('statuses')
 89:   async listStatuses(@Req() req: Request): Promise<CanonicalStatusListResponse> {
 90:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 91:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
 92: 
 93:     return this.catalogService.listStatuses();
 94:   }
 95: 
 96:   @Get('fee-components')
 97:   async listFeeComponents(@Req() req: Request): Promise<FeeComponentListResponse> {
 98:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 99:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
100: 
101:     return this.catalogService.listFeeComponents();
102:   }
103: 
104:   @Get('compatibility')
105:   async listCompatibility(
106:     @Req() req: Request,
107:     @Query('domain') domain?: string,
108:     @Query('carrier_code') carrierCode?: string,
109:     @Query('raw_key') rawKey?: string
110:   ): Promise<CompatibilityMappingListResponse> {
111:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
112:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
113: 
114:     return this.catalogService.listCompatibility(domain, carrierCode, rawKey);
115:   }
116: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/carrier-catalog/carrier-catalog.service.ts">
  1: import { Injectable, HttpStatus, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
  2: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
  3: import { CarrierCodeEnum } from '@prisma/client';
  4: import { CATALOG_REVISION, CARRIER_BOUNDARY_ALIASES, CarrierCode } from '@shipde/contracts';
  5: import { CanonicalApiException } from '../auth/auth.service';
  6: import {
  7:   CarrierResponse,
  8:   CarrierDetailResponse,
  9:   CarrierListResponse,
 10:   CarrierDetailResponseEnvelope,
 11:   CanonicalStatusResponse,
 12:   CanonicalStatusListResponse,
 13:   FeeComponentResponse,
 14:   FeeComponentListResponse,
 15:   CompatibilityMappingResponse,
 16:   CompatibilityMappingListResponse,
 17: } from './carrier-catalog.dto';
 18: 
 19: const CARRIER_SORT_ORDER: Record<string, number> = {
 20:   GHN: 1,
 21:   GHTK: 2,
 22:   VIETTEL_POST: 3,
 23:   JT: 4,
 24: };
 25: 
 26: const FEE_SORT_ORDER: Record<string, number> = {
 27:   BASE_FREIGHT: 1,
 28:   SURCHARGE: 2,
 29:   REMOTE_AREA_SURCHARGE: 3,
 30:   COD_FEE: 4,
 31:   INSURANCE_FEE: 5,
 32:   RETURN_FEE: 6,
 33:   OTHER_FEE: 7,
 34:   VAT: 8,
 35: };
 36: 
 37: @Injectable()
 38: export class CarrierCatalogService {
 39:   constructor(@Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}
 40: 
 41:   /**
 42:    * List platform carriers in canonical revision CATALOG-2026-10-31.
 43:    * Optional is_active filter. Order matches the approved pinned dataset.
 44:    */
 45:   async listCarriers(isActive?: boolean): Promise<CarrierListResponse> {
 46:     const carriers = await this.prisma.carrier.findMany({
 47:       where: {
 48:         catalogRevision: CATALOG_REVISION,
 49:         ...(isActive !== undefined ? { isActive } : {}),
 50:       },
 51:     });
 52: 
 53:     const sorted = [...carriers].sort(
 54:       (a, b) => (CARRIER_SORT_ORDER[a.code] || 99) - (CARRIER_SORT_ORDER[b.code] || 99)
 55:     );
 56: 
 57:     const data: CarrierResponse[] = sorted.map((c) => ({
 58:       id: c.id,
 59:       code: c.code as CarrierCode,
 60:       name: c.name,
 61:       logo_url: c.logoUrl,
 62:       is_active: c.isActive,
 63:       evidence_level: c.evidenceLevel,
 64:       description: c.description,
 65:       catalog_revision: c.catalogRevision,
 66:     }));
 67: 
 68:     return {
 69:       catalog_revision: CATALOG_REVISION,
 70:       data,
 71:     };
 72:   }
 73: 
 74:   /**
 75:    * Get carrier details by canonical code or supported legacy alias.
 76:    * Normalizes VTP -> VIETTEL_POST and JT_EXPRESS -> JT with case-sensitive matching.
 77:    * Unrecognized codes throw canonical 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
 78:    */
 79:   async getCarrierDetail(code: string): Promise<CarrierDetailResponseEnvelope> {
 80:     if (!code || typeof code !== 'string') {
 81:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 82:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
 83:         'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND',
 84:         'Không tìm thấy hãng vận chuyển với mã đã cung cấp'
 85:       );
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     // Exact case-sensitive alias or canonical code resolution
 89:     const canonicalCode = CARRIER_BOUNDARY_ALIASES[code];
 90:     if (!canonicalCode) {
 91:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 92:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
 93:         'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND',
 94:         'Không tìm thấy hãng vận chuyển với mã đã cung cấp'
 95:       );
 96:     }
 97: 
 98:     const carrier = await this.prisma.carrier.findUnique({
 99:       where: {
100:         catalogRevision_code: {
101:           catalogRevision: CATALOG_REVISION,
102:           code: canonicalCode as CarrierCodeEnum,
103:         },
104:       },
105:       include: {
106:         services: true,
107:       },
108:     });
109: 
110:     if (!carrier) {
111:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
112:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
113:         'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND',
114:         'Không tìm thấy hãng vận chuyển với mã đã cung cấp'
115:       );
116:     }
117: 
118:     // Sort services: STANDARD first, FAST second
119:     const sortedServices = [...carrier.services].sort((a, b) => {
120:       if (a.serviceType === b.serviceType) {
121:         return a.code.localeCompare(b.code);
122:       }
123:       return a.serviceType === 'STANDARD' ? -1 : 1;
124:     });
125: 
126:     const detail: CarrierDetailResponse = {
127:       id: carrier.id,
128:       code: carrier.code as CarrierCode,
129:       name: carrier.name,
130:       logo_url: carrier.logoUrl,
131:       is_active: carrier.isActive,
132:       evidence_level: carrier.evidenceLevel,
133:       description: carrier.description,
134:       catalog_revision: carrier.catalogRevision,
135:       services: sortedServices.map((s) => ({
136:         id: s.id,
137:         code: s.code,
138:         name: s.name,
139:         service_type: s.serviceType as 'STANDARD' | 'FAST',
140:         description: s.description,
141:         is_active: s.isActive,
142:         evidence_level: s.evidenceLevel,
143:         source_revision: s.sourceRevision,
144:       })),
145:     };
146: 
147:     return {
148:       catalog_revision: CATALOG_REVISION,
149:       data: detail,
150:     };
151:   }
152: 
153:   /**
154:    * List canonical shipment statuses distinguishing command states from operational states.
155:    * Sorted strictly by stage_order ASC.
156:    */
157:   async listStatuses(): Promise<CanonicalStatusListResponse> {
158:     const statuses = await this.prisma.canonicalStatusReference.findMany({
159:       where: { catalogRevision: CATALOG_REVISION },
160:       orderBy: { stageOrder: 'asc' },
161:     });
162: 
163:     const data: CanonicalStatusResponse[] = statuses.map((st) => ({
164:       code: st.code,
165:       category: st.category,
166:       label: st.label,
167:       description: st.description,
168:       stage_order: st.stageOrder,
169:       catalog_revision: st.catalogRevision,
170:     }));
171: 
172:     return {
173:       catalog_revision: CATALOG_REVISION,
174:       data,
175:     };
176:   }
177: 
178:   /**
179:    * List canonical fee components with categories, VAT applicability, and refundability.
180:    * Sorted by the pinned table order.
181:    */
182:   async listFeeComponents(): Promise<FeeComponentListResponse> {
183:     const feeComponents = await this.prisma.feeComponentReference.findMany({
184:       where: { catalogRevision: CATALOG_REVISION },
185:     });
186: 
187:     const sorted = [...feeComponents].sort(
188:       (a, b) => (FEE_SORT_ORDER[a.code] || 99) - (FEE_SORT_ORDER[b.code] || 99)
189:     );
190: 
191:     const data: FeeComponentResponse[] = sorted.map((fc) => ({
192:       code: fc.code,
193:       name: fc.name,
194:       category: fc.category,
195:       description: fc.description,
196:       is_refundable: fc.isRefundable,
197:       vat_applicable: fc.vatApplicable,
198:       catalog_revision: fc.catalogRevision,
199:     }));
200: 
201:     return {
202:       catalog_revision: CATALOG_REVISION,
203:       data,
204:     };
205:   }
206: 
207:   /**
208:    * List compatibility mappings matching optional query filters.
209:    * Normalizes carrier_code alias before querying. Returns 200 with empty array if no matches.
210:    */
211:   async listCompatibility(
212:     domain?: string,
213:     carrierCode?: string,
214:     rawKey?: string
215:   ): Promise<CompatibilityMappingListResponse> {
216:     let normalizedCarrierCode: CarrierCodeEnum | null | undefined = undefined;
217:     if (carrierCode !== undefined) {
218:       const canonical = CARRIER_BOUNDARY_ALIASES[carrierCode];
219:       normalizedCarrierCode = canonical
220:         ? (canonical as CarrierCodeEnum)
221:         : (carrierCode as CarrierCodeEnum);
222:     }
223: 
224:     const mappings = await this.prisma.catalogCompatibilityMapping.findMany({
225:       where: {
226:         catalogRevision: CATALOG_REVISION,
227:         ...(domain ? { domain } : {}),
228:         ...(carrierCode !== undefined ? { carrierCode: normalizedCarrierCode } : {}),
229:         ...(rawKey ? { rawKey } : {}),
230:       },
231:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
232:     });
233: 
234:     const data: CompatibilityMappingResponse[] = mappings.map((m) => ({
235:       catalog_revision: m.catalogRevision,
236:       carrier_code: m.carrierCode ? (m.carrierCode as string) : null,
237:       domain: m.domain,
238:       raw_key: m.rawKey,
239:       canonical_code: m.canonicalCode,
240:       disposition: m.disposition,
241:     }));
242: 
243:     return {
244:       catalog_revision: CATALOG_REVISION,
245:       data,
246:     };
247:   }
248: 
249:   /**
250:    * Authoritative lookup rule (BR-CAR-05 / AC-CAR-01-06):
251:    * 1. Exact (catalog_revision, carrier_code, domain, raw_key) first
252:    * 2. If none, exact (catalog_revision, null, domain, raw_key)
253:    * 3. If none, result is { canonical_code: null, disposition: "UNMAPPED" }
254:    * Never substitute IN_TRANSIT, BASE_FREIGHT or 0.
255:    */
256:   async resolveCompatibility(
257:     domain: string,
258:     rawKey: string,
259:     carrierCode?: string | null
260:   ): Promise<CompatibilityMappingResponse> {
261:     let canonicalCarrier: CarrierCodeEnum | null = null;
262:     if (carrierCode) {
263:       const mapped = CARRIER_BOUNDARY_ALIASES[carrierCode];
264:       canonicalCarrier = mapped ? (mapped as CarrierCodeEnum) : (carrierCode as CarrierCodeEnum);
265:     }
266: 
267:     // 1. Try carrier-specific mapping first
268:     if (canonicalCarrier) {
269:       const carrierMatch = await this.prisma.catalogCompatibilityMapping.findUnique({
270:         where: {
271:           catalogRevision_carrierCode_domain_rawKey: {
272:             catalogRevision: CATALOG_REVISION,
273:             carrierCode: canonicalCarrier,
274:             domain,
275:             rawKey,
276:           },
277:         },
278:       });
279: 
280:       if (carrierMatch) {
281:         return {
282:           catalog_revision: CATALOG_REVISION,
283:           carrier_code: carrierMatch.carrierCode as string | null,
284:           domain: carrierMatch.domain,
285:           raw_key: carrierMatch.rawKey,
286:           canonical_code: carrierMatch.canonicalCode,
287:           disposition: carrierMatch.disposition,
288:         };
289:       }
290:     }
291: 
292:     // 2. Try carrier-independent mapping (carrier_code: null)
293:     // Note: composite unique with carrierCode null in Prisma can be found via findFirst
294:     const globalMatch = await this.prisma.catalogCompatibilityMapping.findFirst({
295:       where: {
296:         catalogRevision: CATALOG_REVISION,
297:         carrierCode: null,
298:         domain,
299:         rawKey,
300:       },
301:     });
302: 
303:     if (globalMatch) {
304:       return {
305:         catalog_revision: CATALOG_REVISION,
306:         carrier_code: null,
307:         domain: globalMatch.domain,
308:         raw_key: globalMatch.rawKey,
309:         canonical_code: globalMatch.canonicalCode,
310:         disposition: globalMatch.disposition,
311:       };
312:     }
313: 
314:     // 3. Fallback to unmapped: explicit null, never default to IN_TRANSIT or 0
315:     return {
316:       catalog_revision: CATALOG_REVISION,
317:       carrier_code: canonicalCarrier,
318:       domain,
319:       raw_key: rawKey,
320:       canonical_code: null,
321:       disposition: 'UNMAPPED',
322:     };
323:   }
324: }
</file>

165: /**
166:  * Redacts database connection strings to eliminate password or sensitive query parameter leakage
167:  * in CI errors, warnings, or diagnostic logs (P1 review finding).
168:  * Fail-closed: any URL that cannot be fully parsed, has an unsupported scheme, or lacks a valid
169:  * authority/hostname (including opaque URLs like postgresql:user:sentinel@db/catalog) is replaced
170:  * wholesale with the redaction marker, because credentials or query parameters cannot be safely
171:  * isolated without a valid authority.
172:  */
173: export function redactDatabaseUrl(rawUrl?: string): string {
174:   if (!rawUrl) {
175:     return '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]';
176:   }
177:   try {
178:     const parsed = new URL(rawUrl);
179:     // Reject unsupported schemes: only postgresql: and postgres: are supported database schemes
180:     if (parsed.protocol !== 'postgresql:' && parsed.protocol !== 'postgres:') {
181:       return '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]';
182:     }
183:     // Reject URLs without a valid authority/hostname (e.g. opaque URLs without '//' like postgresql:user:sentinel@db)
184:     if (!parsed.hostname || parsed.hostname.trim().length === 0) {
185:       return '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]';
186:     }
187:     if (parsed.password) {
188:       parsed.password = '***';
189:     }
190:     // Sanitize any sensitive query parameters like password, secret, token, key
191:     for (const key of Array.from(parsed.searchParams.keys())) {
192:       const lower = key.toLowerCase();
193:       if (
194:         lower.includes('password') ||
195:         lower.includes('pass') ||
196:         lower.includes('pwd') ||
197:         lower.includes('secret') ||
198:         lower.includes('token') ||
199:         lower.includes('key') ||
200:         lower.includes('credential')
201:       ) {
202:         parsed.searchParams.set(key, '***');
203:       }
204:     }
205:     return parsed.toString();
206:   } catch {
207:     return '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]';
208:   }
209: }
210: 
211: export function buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(rawUrl: string, isCi: boolean): string {
212:   const safeDiagnostics = redactDatabaseUrl(rawUrl);
213:   return isCi
214:     ? `Database must be reachable in CI environment at ${safeDiagnostics}`
215:     : `⚠️ PostgreSQL is not reachable at ${safeDiagnostics}. Skipping live Carrier Catalog Supertest tests.`;
216: }

218: async function runCarrierCatalogSupertestSuite() {

224:     path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env'),
225:     path.resolve(process.cwd(), '../../.env'),
226:     path.resolve(process.cwd(), '../../../../.env'),
227:     path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../.env'),
228:   ];
229:   for (const envPath of envPaths) {
230:     if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
231:       const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8');
232:       for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
233:         const trimmed = line.trim();
234:         if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
235:           const [key, ...rest] = trimmed.split('=');
236:           const cleanKey = key.trim();
237:           let val = rest.join('=').trim();
238:           if (
239:             (val.startsWith('"') && val.endsWith('"')) ||
240:             (val.startsWith("'") && val.endsWith("'"))
241:           ) {
242:             val = val.slice(1, -1);
243:           }
244:           if (!process.env[cleanKey]) {
245:             process.env[cleanKey] = val;
246:           }
247:         }
248:       }
249:       break;
250:     }
251:   }

675:       'Failure-path diagnostic must NEVER contain database password'
676:     );
677:     assert.strictEqual(
678:       redactedOutput.includes(secretToken),
679:       false,
680:       'Failure-path diagnostic must NEVER contain sensitive query parameters'
681:     );
682:     assert.ok(
683:       redactedOutput.includes('carrier_admin:***@postgres.internal.net:5432/shipde_prod'),
684:       'Diagnostics must show host and database with password masked'
685:     );
686: 
687:     const ciFailureMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(sensitiveDbUrl, true);
688:     assert.strictEqual(
689:       ciFailureMsg.includes(secretPassword),
690:       false,
691:       'CI error message must NEVER leak database credentials'
692:     );
693:     assert.strictEqual(
694:       ciFailureMsg.includes(secretToken),
695:       false,
696:       'CI error message must NEVER leak sensitive query parameters'
697:     );
698: 
699:     const warnFailureMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(sensitiveDbUrl, false);
700:     assert.strictEqual(
701:       warnFailureMsg.includes(secretPassword),
702:       false,
703:       'Local warning message must NEVER leak database credentials'
704:     );
705:     assert.strictEqual(
706:       warnFailureMsg.includes(secretToken),
707:       false,
708:       'Local warning message must NEVER leak sensitive query parameters'
709:     );
710: 
711:     // Malformed URL (opaque host containing a colon): new URL() throws, exercising the
712:     // fail-closed branch. A partial regex fallback would retain query secrets like token=...
713:     const malformedPassword = 'malformed_pg_password_000';
714:     const malformedToken = 'malformed_query_secret_111';
715:     const malformedDbUrl = `postgresql://u:${malformedPassword}@db:bad/db?token=${malformedToken}`;
716: 
717:     let malformedUrlParsed = true;
718:     try {
719:       new URL(malformedDbUrl);
720:     } catch {
721:       malformedUrlParsed = false;
722:     }
723:     assert.strictEqual(
724:       malformedUrlParsed,
725:       false,
726:       'Test precondition: malformed URL must not parse with new URL()'
727:     );
728: 
729:     const malformedRedacted = redactDatabaseUrl(malformedDbUrl);
730:     assert.strictEqual(
731:       malformedRedacted,
732:       '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]',
733:       'Unparseable database URL must be replaced wholesale with the redaction marker'
734:     );
735:     assert.strictEqual(
736:       malformedRedacted.includes(malformedPassword),
737:       false,
738:       'Malformed-URL diagnostic must NEVER contain database password'
739:     );
740:     assert.strictEqual(
741:       malformedRedacted.includes(malformedToken),
742:       false,
743:       'Malformed-URL diagnostic must NEVER contain sensitive query parameters'
744:     );
745: 
746:     const malformedCiMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(malformedDbUrl, true);
747:     assert.strictEqual(
748:       malformedCiMsg.includes(malformedPassword),
749:       false,
750:       'CI error message must NEVER leak credentials from an unparseable database URL'
751:     );
752:     assert.strictEqual(
753:       malformedCiMsg.includes(malformedToken),
754:       false,
755:       'CI error message must NEVER leak sensitive query parameters from an unparseable database URL'
756:     );
757:     assert.ok(
758:       malformedCiMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'),
759:       'CI error message must show the redaction marker for an unparseable database URL'
760:     );
761: 
762:     const malformedWarnMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(malformedDbUrl, false);
763:     assert.strictEqual(
764:       malformedWarnMsg.includes(malformedPassword),
765:       false,
766:       'Local warning message must NEVER leak credentials from an unparseable database URL'
767:     );
768:     assert.strictEqual(
769:       malformedWarnMsg.includes(malformedToken),
770:       false,
771:       'Local warning message must NEVER leak sensitive query parameters from an unparseable database URL'
772:     );
773:     assert.ok(
774:       malformedWarnMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'),
775:       'Local warning message must show the redaction marker for an unparseable database URL'
776:     );
777:     console.log(

779:     );
780: 
781:     // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

783:     // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
784:     console.log(
785:       '▶ Testing P1 Finding: Redact opaque URLs, unsupported schemes, and missing authority from diagnostics'
786:     );
787:     const sentinelPassword = 'opaque_sentinel_credential_999';

800:       opaqueRedacted,
801:       '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]',
802:       'Opaque URL without valid authority must be replaced wholesale with the redaction marker'
803:     );
804:     assert.strictEqual(
805:       opaqueRedacted.includes(sentinelPassword),
806:       false,
807:       'Opaque URL diagnostic must NEVER contain credential'
808:     );
809: 
810:     const opaqueCiMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(opaqueDbUrl, true);
811:     assert.strictEqual(
812:       opaqueCiMsg.includes(sentinelPassword),
813:       false,
814:       'CI error message must NEVER leak credential from an opaque URL'
815:     );
816:     assert.ok(
817:       opaqueCiMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'),
818:       'CI error message must show redaction marker for an opaque URL'
819:     );
820: 
821:     const opaqueWarnMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(opaqueDbUrl, false);
822:     assert.strictEqual(
823:       opaqueWarnMsg.includes(sentinelPassword),

825:       'Local warning message must NEVER leak credential from an opaque URL'
826:     );
827:     assert.ok(
828:       opaqueWarnMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'),
829:       'Local warning message must show redaction marker for an opaque URL'
830:     );
831: 
832:     // Unsupported scheme test
833:     const unsupportedSchemeUrl = `http://user:${sentinelPassword}@db/catalog`;
834:     const unsupportedRedacted = redactDatabaseUrl(unsupportedSchemeUrl);
835:     assert.strictEqual(unsupportedRedacted, '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]');
836:     assert.strictEqual(unsupportedRedacted.includes(sentinelPassword), false);
837:     const unsupportedCiMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(unsupportedSchemeUrl, true);
838:     assert.strictEqual(unsupportedCiMsg.includes(sentinelPassword), false);
839:     assert.ok(unsupportedCiMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'));
840:     const unsupportedWarnMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(unsupportedSchemeUrl, false);
841:     assert.strictEqual(unsupportedWarnMsg.includes(sentinelPassword), false);
842:     assert.ok(unsupportedWarnMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'));
843:

846:     const missingHostRedacted = redactDatabaseUrl(missingHostUrl);
847:     assert.strictEqual(missingHostRedacted, '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]');
848:     assert.strictEqual(missingHostRedacted.includes(sentinelPassword), false);
849:     const missingHostCiMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(missingHostUrl, true);

851:     assert.ok(missingHostCiMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'));
852:     const missingHostWarnMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(missingHostUrl, false);
853:     assert.strictEqual(missingHostWarnMsg.includes(sentinelPassword), false);
854:     assert.ok(missingHostWarnMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'));
855:     console.log(

857:     );
858: 
859:     // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
860:     // P2 FINDING: Global compatibility mappings database-enforced uniqueness
861:     // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
862:     console.log(
863:       '▶ Testing P2 Finding: Global compatibility mappings unique partial index enforcement'
864:     );
865:     const testRawKey = `UNIQUE_TEST_RAW_KEY_${testSuffix}`;
866:     const firstMappingId = randomUUID();
867:     const secondMappingId = randomUUID();
868: 
869:     await prisma.catalogCompatibilityMapping.create({
870:       data: {
871:         id: firstMappingId,
872:         catalogRevision: 'CATALOG-2026-10-31',
873:         carrierCode: null,
874:         domain: 'FEE',
875:         rawKey: testRawKey,
876:         canonicalCode: 'BASE_FREIGHT',
877:         disposition: 'MAPPED',
878:       },
879:     });
880: 
881:     let duplicateRejected = false;
882:     try {
883:       await prisma.catalogCompatibilityMapping.create({
884:         data: {
885:           id: secondMappingId,
886:           catalogRevision: 'CATALOG-2026-10-31',
887:           carrierCode: null,
888:           domain: 'FEE',
889:           rawKey: testRawKey,
890:           canonicalCode: 'SURCHARGE',
891:           disposition: 'MAPPED',
892:         },
893:       });
894:     } catch (err: any) {
895:       // Prisma P2002 code or PostgreSQL unique constraint violation
896:       duplicateRejected = err.code === 'P2002' || /unique/i.test(err.message || '');
897:     } finally {
898:       await prisma.catalogCompatibilityMapping.deleteMany({
899:         where: { id: { in: [firstMappingId, secondMappingId] } },
900:       });
901:     }
902: 
903:     assert.strictEqual(
904:       duplicateRejected,
905:       true,
906:       'Database must enforce unique partial index on global compatibility mappings where carrier_code IS NULL'
907:     );
908:     console.log(
909:       '  ✔ P2 Finding: Database-enforced uniqueness on global compatibility mappings verified'
910:     );
911:

914:     console.log('================================================================');
915:   } finally {
916:     // Teardown test fixtures

918:       await prisma.carrierAccount.deleteMany({
919:         where: { merchant_id: { in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB] } },
920:       });
921:       await prisma.deviceSession.deleteMany({
922:         where: { merchant_id: { in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB] } },
923:       });
924:       await prisma.user.deleteMany({
925:         where: { merchant_id: { in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB] } },
926:       });
927:       await prisma.role.deleteMany({
928:         where: { merchant_id: { in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB] }, is_system: false },
929:       });
930:       await prisma.merchant.deleteMany({
931:         where: { id: { in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB] } },
932:       });
933:     } catch {
934:       // Ignore cleanup error in teardown
935:     }
936:     await app.close();
937:   }
938: }

<file path="apps/api/src/carrier-catalog/carrier-catalog.unit.spec.ts">
  1: import { describe, it, beforeEach } from 'node:test';
  2: import * as assert from 'node:assert';
  3: import { CarrierCatalogService } from './carrier-catalog.service';
  4: import {
  5:   CATALOG_REVISION_2026_10_31,
  6:   SEED_CARRIERS,
  7:   SEED_CARRIER_SERVICES,
  8:   SEED_CANONICAL_STATUSES,
  9:   SEED_FEE_COMPONENTS,
 10:   SEED_COMPATIBILITY_MAPPINGS,
 11: } from '@shipde/testkit';
 12: import { CarrierCodeEnum } from '@prisma/client';
 13: import { HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
 14: import { CanonicalApiException } from '../auth/auth.service';
 15: import {
 16:   redactDatabaseUrl,
 17:   buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage,
 18: } from './carrier-catalog.supertest.spec';
 19: 
 20: function createMockPrismaService() {
 21:   const carriers = SEED_CARRIERS.map((c) => ({
 22:     id: c.id,
 23:     catalogRevision: c.catalog_revision,
 24:     code: c.code,
 25:     name: c.name,
 26:     logoUrl: c.logo_url,
 27:     isActive: c.is_active,
 28:     evidenceLevel: c.evidence_level,
 29:     description: c.description,
 30:   }));
 31: 
 32:   const carrierServices = SEED_CARRIER_SERVICES.map((s) => ({
 33:     id: s.id,
 34:     carrierId: s.carrier_id,
 35:     catalogRevision: s.catalog_revision,
 36:     carrierCode: s.carrier_code,
 37:     code: s.code,
 38:     name: s.name,
 39:     serviceType: s.service_type,
 40:     description: s.description,
 41:     isActive: s.is_active,
 42:     evidenceLevel: s.evidence_level,
 43:     sourceRevision: s.source_revision,
 44:   }));
 45: 
 46:   const canonicalStatuses = SEED_CANONICAL_STATUSES.map((st) => ({
 47:     id: st.id,
 48:     catalogRevision: st.catalog_revision,
 49:     code: st.code,
 50:     category: st.category,
 51:     label: st.label,
 52:     description: st.description,
 53:     stageOrder: st.stage_order,
 54:   }));
 55: 
 56:   const feeComponents = SEED_FEE_COMPONENTS.map((fc) => ({
 57:     id: fc.id,
 58:     catalogRevision: fc.catalog_revision,
 59:     code: fc.code,
 60:     name: fc.name,
 61:     category: fc.category,
 62:     description: fc.description,
 63:     isRefundable: fc.is_refundable,
 64:     vatApplicable: fc.vat_applicable,
 65:   }));
 66: 
 67:   const compatibilityMappings = SEED_COMPATIBILITY_MAPPINGS.map((m) => ({
 68:     id: m.id,
 69:     catalogRevision: m.catalog_revision,
 70:     carrierCode: m.carrier_code,
 71:     domain: m.domain,
 72:     rawKey: m.raw_key,
 73:     canonicalCode: m.canonical_code,
 74:     disposition: m.disposition,
 75:   }));
 76: 
 77:   return {
 78:     carrier: {
 79:       findMany: async (args?: any) => {
 80:         let result = [...carriers];
 81:         if (args?.where) {
 82:           if (args.where.catalogRevision) {
 83:             result = result.filter((c) => c.catalogRevision === args.where.catalogRevision);
 84:           }
 85:           if (args.where.isActive !== undefined) {
 86:             result = result.filter((c) => c.isActive === args.where.isActive);
 87:           }
 88:         }
 89:         return result;
 90:       },
 91:       findUnique: async ({ where }: any) => {
 92:         const { catalogRevision, code } = where.catalogRevision_code;
 93:         const found = carriers.find(
 94:           (c) => c.catalogRevision === catalogRevision && c.code === code
 95:         );
 96:         if (!found) return null;
 97:         return {
 98:           ...found,
 99:           services: carrierServices.filter(
100:             (s) => s.catalogRevision === catalogRevision && s.carrierCode === code
101:           ),
102:         };
103:       },
104:     },
105:     carrierService: {
106:       findMany: async (args?: any) => {
107:         let result = [...carrierServices];
108:         if (args?.where?.catalogRevision) {
109:           result = result.filter((s) => s.catalogRevision === args.where.catalogRevision);
110:         }
111:         return result;
112:       },
113:     },
114:     canonicalStatusReference: {
115:       findMany: async (args?: any) => {
116:         let result = [...canonicalStatuses];
117:         if (args?.where?.catalogRevision) {
118:           result = result.filter((st) => st.catalogRevision === args.where.catalogRevision);
119:         }
120:         return result.sort((a, b) => a.stageOrder - b.stageOrder);
121:       },
122:     },
123:     feeComponentReference: {
124:       findMany: async (args?: any) => {
125:         let result = [...feeComponents];
126:         if (args?.where?.catalogRevision) {
127:           result = result.filter((fc) => fc.catalogRevision === args.where.catalogRevision);
128:         }
129:         return result;
130:       },
131:     },
132:     catalogCompatibilityMapping: {
133:       findMany: async (args?: any) => {
134:         let result = [...compatibilityMappings];
135:         if (args?.where) {
136:           if (args.where.catalogRevision) {
137:             result = result.filter((m) => m.catalogRevision === args.where.catalogRevision);
138:           }
139:           if (args.where.domain) {
140:             result = result.filter((m) => m.domain === args.where.domain);
141:           }
142:           if (args.where.carrierCode !== undefined) {
143:             result = result.filter((m) => m.carrierCode === args.where.carrierCode);
144:           }
145:           if (args.where.rawKey) {
146:             result = result.filter((m) => m.rawKey === args.where.rawKey);
147:           }
148:         }
149:         return result;
150:       },
151:       findUnique: async ({ where }: any) => {
152:         const { catalogRevision, carrierCode, domain, rawKey } =
153:           where.catalogRevision_carrierCode_domain_rawKey;
154:         return (
155:           compatibilityMappings.find(
156:             (m) =>
157:               m.catalogRevision === catalogRevision &&
158:               m.carrierCode === carrierCode &&
159:               m.domain === domain &&
160:               m.rawKey === rawKey
161:           ) || null
162:         );
163:       },
164:       findFirst: async ({ where }: any) => {
165:         return (
166:           compatibilityMappings.find((m) => {
167:             if (where.catalogRevision && m.catalogRevision !== where.catalogRevision) return false;
168:             if (where.carrierCode !== undefined && m.carrierCode !== where.carrierCode)
169:               return false;
170:             if (where.domain && m.domain !== where.domain) return false;
171:             if (where.rawKey && m.rawKey !== where.rawKey) return false;
172:             return true;
173:           }) || null
174:         );
175:       },
176:     },
177:   };
178: }
179: 
180: describe('FEAT-CAR-01 Carrier Catalog Unit Test Suite', () => {
181:   let service: CarrierCatalogService;
182:   let mockPrisma: any;
183: 
184:   beforeEach(() => {
185:     mockPrisma = createMockPrismaService();
186:     service = new CarrierCatalogService(mockPrisma as any);
187:   });
188: 
189:   describe('AC-CAR-01-01: List Carriers', () => {
190:     it('returns 200 OK with the 4 canonical carriers in pinned sort order', async () => {
191:       const res = await service.listCarriers();
192:       assert.strictEqual(res.catalog_revision, CATALOG_REVISION_2026_10_31);
193:       assert.strictEqual(res.data.length, 4);
194: 
195:       const codes = res.data.map((c) => c.code);
196:       assert.deepStrictEqual(codes, ['GHN', 'GHTK', 'VIETTEL_POST', 'JT']);
197: 
198:       // Check GHN
199:       const ghn = res.data[0];
200:       assert.strictEqual(ghn.code, 'GHN');
201:       assert.strictEqual(ghn.name, 'Giao Hàng Nhanh');
202:       assert.strictEqual(ghn.evidence_level, 'VERIFIED_OFFICIAL');
203:       assert.strictEqual(ghn.is_active, true);
204:       assert.strictEqual(ghn.logo_url, null);
205: 
206:       // Check GHTK
207:       const ghtk = res.data[1];
208:       assert.strictEqual(ghtk.code, 'GHTK');
209:       assert.strictEqual(ghtk.name, 'Giao Hàng Tiết Kiệm');
210:       assert.strictEqual(ghtk.evidence_level, 'VERIFIED_OFFICIAL');
211: 
212:       // Check VIETTEL_POST
213:       const vtp = res.data[2];
214:       assert.strictEqual(vtp.code, 'VIETTEL_POST');
215:       assert.strictEqual(vtp.name, 'Viettel Post');
216:       assert.strictEqual(vtp.evidence_level, 'CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED');
217: 
218:       // Check JT
219:       const jt = res.data[3];
220:       assert.strictEqual(jt.code, 'JT');
221:       assert.strictEqual(jt.name, 'J&T Express Vietnam');
222:       assert.strictEqual(jt.evidence_level, 'CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED');
223:     });
224: 
225:     it('filters by is_active boolean flag', async () => {
226:       const activeRes = await service.listCarriers(true);
227:       assert.strictEqual(activeRes.data.length, 4);
228: 
229:       const inactiveRes = await service.listCarriers(false);
230:       assert.strictEqual(inactiveRes.data.length, 0);
231:     });
232:   });
233: 
234:   describe('AC-CAR-01-02: Carrier Details and Services', () => {
235:     it('returns carrier details with associated services for GHN', async () => {
236:       const res = await service.getCarrierDetail('GHN');
237:       assert.strictEqual(res.catalog_revision, CATALOG_REVISION_2026_10_31);
238:       assert.strictEqual(res.data.code, 'GHN');
239:       assert.strictEqual(res.data.name, 'Giao Hàng Nhanh');
240:       assert.strictEqual(res.data.evidence_level, 'VERIFIED_OFFICIAL');
241:       assert.strictEqual(res.data.services.length, 2);
242: 
243:       const sCodes = res.data.services.map((s) => s.code);
244:       assert.ok(sCodes.includes('GHN_STANDARD'));
245:       assert.ok(sCodes.includes('GHN_FAST'));
246: 
247:       const stdService = res.data.services.find((s) => s.code === 'GHN_STANDARD')!;
248:       assert.strictEqual(stdService.service_type, 'STANDARD');
249:       assert.strictEqual(stdService.evidence_level, 'VERIFIED_OFFICIAL');
250:       assert.strictEqual(stdService.source_revision, 'GHN-PUBLIC-API-2026-08-24');
251:     });
252: 
253:     it('returns carrier details with confirmation-required services for VIETTEL_POST', async () => {
254:       const res = await service.getCarrierDetail('VIETTEL_POST');
255:       assert.strictEqual(res.data.code, 'VIETTEL_POST');
256:       assert.strictEqual(res.data.evidence_level, 'CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED');
257:       assert.strictEqual(res.data.services.length, 2);
258: 
259:       const std = res.data.services.find((s) => s.code === 'VTP_STANDARD')!;
260:       assert.strictEqual(std.service_type, 'STANDARD');
261:       assert.strictEqual(std.evidence_level, 'CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED');
262:       assert.strictEqual(std.source_revision, 'OI-001-UNCONFIRMED');
263:     });
264:   });
265: 
266:   describe('AC-CAR-01-03: Alias Resolution & Case-Sensitivity', () => {
267:     it('normalizes VTP to VIETTEL_POST with identical canonical payload', async () => {
268:       const vtpRes = await service.getCarrierDetail('VTP');
269:       const canonicalRes = await service.getCarrierDetail('VIETTEL_POST');
270: 
271:       assert.strictEqual(vtpRes.data.code, 'VIETTEL_POST');
272:       assert.strictEqual(vtpRes.data.name, 'Viettel Post');
273:       assert.deepStrictEqual(vtpRes.data, canonicalRes.data);
274:     });
275: 
276:     it('normalizes JT_EXPRESS to JT with identical canonical payload', async () => {
277:       const jtExpressRes = await service.getCarrierDetail('JT_EXPRESS');
278:       const canonicalRes = await service.getCarrierDetail('JT');
279: 
280:       assert.strictEqual(jtExpressRes.data.code, 'JT');
281:       assert.strictEqual(jtExpressRes.data.name, 'J&T Express Vietnam');
282:       assert.deepStrictEqual(jtExpressRes.data, canonicalRes.data);
283:     });
284: 
285:     it('rejects case mismatches (vtp, ViettelPost, J&T) with 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND', async () => {
286:       const invalidTokens = ['vtp', 'ViettelPost', 'J&T', 'jt_express', 'ghn', 'GHTk', 'UNKNOWN'];
287:       for (const token of invalidTokens) {
288:         try {
289:           await service.getCarrierDetail(token);
290:           assert.fail(`Expected 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND for token: ${token}`);
291:         } catch (err: any) {

480:   describe('P1 Finding: Diagnostic Credential Redaction in Failure Paths', () => {
481:     it('redacts raw password and sensitive parameters from connection strings', () => {
482:       const secretPass = 'super_secret_pg_pwd_456';
483:       const secretToken = 'secret_access_token_789';
484:       const sensitiveUrl = `postgresql://shipde_user:${secretPass}@db.internal:5432/shipde_db?schema=public&token=${secretToken}&auth_key=key123`;
485: 
486:       const redacted = redactDatabaseUrl(sensitiveUrl);
487:       assert.strictEqual(redacted.includes(secretPass), false);
488:       assert.strictEqual(redacted.includes(secretToken), false);
489:       assert.strictEqual(redacted.includes('key123'), false);
490:       assert.ok(redacted.includes('shipde_user:***@db.internal:5432/shipde_db'));
491: 
492:       const ciError = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(sensitiveUrl, true);
493:       assert.strictEqual(ciError.includes(secretPass), false);
494:       assert.strictEqual(ciError.includes(secretToken), false);
495:       assert.ok(
496:         ciError.includes(
497:           'Database must be reachable in CI environment at postgresql://shipde_user:***@db.internal:5432/shipde_db'
498:         )
499:       );
500: 
501:       const warnMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(sensitiveUrl, false);
502:       assert.strictEqual(warnMsg.includes(secretPass), false);
503:       assert.strictEqual(warnMsg.includes(secretToken), false);
504:       assert.ok(
505:         warnMsg.includes(
506:           'PostgreSQL is not reachable at postgresql://shipde_user:***@db.internal:5432/shipde_db'
507:         )
508:       );
509:     });
510: 
511:     it('fails closed to the redaction marker for unparseable URLs (no partial-regex fallback leak)', () => {
512:       const secretPass = 'malformed_pg_password_000';
513:       const secretToken = 'malformed_query_secret_111';
514:       // Opaque host containing a colon is rejected by new URL() for the postgresql scheme,
515:       // forcing the parse-failure branch that previously fell back to a password-only regex
516:       // and leaked query secrets such as token=...
517:       const malformedUrl = `postgresql://u:${secretPass}@db:bad/db?token=${secretToken}`;
518: 
519:       let parsed = true;
520:       try {
521:         new URL(malformedUrl);
522:       } catch {
523:         parsed = false;
524:       }
525:       assert.strictEqual(parsed, false, 'Precondition: malformed URL must not parse');
526: 
527:       const redacted = redactDatabaseUrl(malformedUrl);
528:       assert.strictEqual(
529:         redacted,
530:         '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]',
531:         'Unparseable URL must be replaced wholesale with the redaction marker'
532:       );
533:       assert.strictEqual(redacted.includes(secretPass), false);
534:       assert.strictEqual(redacted.includes(secretToken), false);
535: 
536:       const ciError = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(malformedUrl, true);
537:       assert.strictEqual(ciError.includes(secretPass), false);
538:       assert.strictEqual(ciError.includes(secretToken), false);
539:       assert.ok(ciError.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'));
540: 
541:       const warnMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(malformedUrl, false);
542:       assert.strictEqual(warnMsg.includes(secretPass), false);
543:       assert.strictEqual(warnMsg.includes(secretToken), false);
544:       assert.ok(warnMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'));
545:     });
546: 
547:     it('redacts opaque URLs, unsupported schemes, and missing authority wholesale before emitting diagnostics (Finding 3)', () => {
548:       const secretSentinel = 'sentinel_secret_credential_xyz';
549:       const opaqueUrl = `postgresql:user:${secretSentinel}@db/catalog`;
550: 
551:       // Precondition: WHATWG URL parser does NOT throw on opaque URL, but treats it as opaque path
552:       // with empty hostname and empty password, leaving credentials in pathname
553:       const rawParsed = new URL(opaqueUrl);
554:       assert.strictEqual(rawParsed.hostname, '');
555:       assert.strictEqual(rawParsed.password, '');
556:       assert.ok(rawParsed.pathname.includes(secretSentinel));
557: 
558:       // Helper must fail-closed: reject opaque URLs wholesale
559:       const redacted = redactDatabaseUrl(opaqueUrl);
560:       assert.strictEqual(
561:         redacted,
562:         '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]',
563:         'Opaque URL without valid authority must be replaced wholesale with the redaction marker'
564:       );
565:       assert.strictEqual(redacted.includes(secretSentinel), false);
566: 
567:       // Regression assertions for both diagnostic messages
568:       const ciMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(opaqueUrl, true);
569:       assert.strictEqual(
570:         ciMsg.includes(secretSentinel),
571:         false,
572:         'CI error message must NEVER leak credential from opaque URL'
573:       );
574:       assert.ok(
575:         ciMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'),
576:         'CI error message must include redaction marker'
577:       );
578: 
579:       const warnMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(opaqueUrl, false);
580:       assert.strictEqual(
581:         warnMsg.includes(secretSentinel),
582:         false,
583:         'Local warning message must NEVER leak credential from opaque URL'
584:       );
585:       assert.ok(
586:         warnMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'),
587:         'Local warning message must include redaction marker'
588:       );
589: 
590:       // Unsupported scheme regression assertion
591:       const unsupportedSchemeUrl = `http://user:${secretSentinel}@db/catalog`;
592:       const unsupportedRedacted = redactDatabaseUrl(unsupportedSchemeUrl);
593:       assert.strictEqual(unsupportedRedacted, '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]');
594:       assert.strictEqual(unsupportedRedacted.includes(secretSentinel), false);
595: 
596:       const unsupportedCiMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(unsupportedSchemeUrl, true);
597:       assert.strictEqual(unsupportedCiMsg.includes(secretSentinel), false);
598:       assert.ok(unsupportedCiMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'));
599: 
600:       const unsupportedWarnMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(unsupportedSchemeUrl, false);
601:       assert.strictEqual(unsupportedWarnMsg.includes(secretSentinel), false);
602:       assert.ok(unsupportedWarnMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'));
603: 
604:       // Missing hostname regression assertion
605:       const missingHostUrl = `postgresql:///catalog?token=${secretSentinel}`;
606:       const missingHostRedacted = redactDatabaseUrl(missingHostUrl);
607:       assert.strictEqual(missingHostRedacted, '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]');
608:       assert.strictEqual(missingHostRedacted.includes(secretSentinel), false);
609: 
610:       const missingHostCiMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(missingHostUrl, true);
611:       assert.strictEqual(missingHostCiMsg.includes(secretSentinel), false);
612:       assert.ok(missingHostCiMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'));
613: 
614:       const missingHostWarnMsg = buildDatabaseReadinessFailureMessage(missingHostUrl, false);
615:       assert.strictEqual(missingHostWarnMsg.includes(secretSentinel), false);
616:       assert.ok(missingHostWarnMsg.includes('[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'));
617:     });
618:   });
