<file path="apps/api/src/health/health.service.ts">
 1: import { Injectable, Inject, Optional } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
 3: import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
 4: import { StorageService } from '../storage/storage.service';
 5: import { RbacService } from '../rbac/rbac.service';
 6: import { ReadinessDependencyChecks } from '@shipde/contracts';
 7: 
 8: @Injectable()
 9: export class HealthService {
10:   constructor(
11:     @Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
12:     @Inject(RedisService) private readonly redis: RedisService,
13:     @Inject(StorageService) private readonly storage: StorageService,
14:     @Optional() @Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService?: RbacService
15:   ) {}
16: 
17:   async checkReadiness(): Promise<{ isReady: boolean; checks: ReadinessDependencyChecks }> {
18:     const [database, redis, storage] = await Promise.all([
19:       this.prisma.checkReadiness(),
20:       this.redis.checkReadiness(),
21:       this.storage.checkReadiness(),
22:     ]);
23: 
24:     const checks: ReadinessDependencyChecks = {
25:       database,
26:       redis,
27:       storage,
28:     };
29: 
30:     let isRbacReady = false;
31:     if (this.rbacService) {
32:       if (!this.rbacService.isReady() && (this.rbacService as any).inFlightSeedPromise) {
33:         try {
34:           await (this.rbacService as any).inFlightSeedPromise;
35:         } catch {
36:           // in-flight seed failed; fail closed
37:         }
38:       }
39:       isRbacReady = this.rbacService.isReady();
40:       checks.rbac = isRbacReady ? 'up' : 'down';
41:     } else {
42:       checks.rbac = 'down';
43:     }
44: 
45:     const isReady = database === 'up' && redis === 'up' && storage === 'up' && isRbacReady;
46:     return { isReady, checks };
47:   }
48: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/invitations/invitation-url.util.ts">
 1: import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
 2: 
 3: const STRICT_UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
 4: 
 5: /**
 6:  * Strict correlation ID sanitizer for invitation flows (BR-INV-09 / AC-USR-01-18 / Round 9 Finding 1).
 7:  * Accepts ONLY strict UUID strings (length exactly 36).
 8:  * Any non-UUID (e.g. passwords, tokens, oversized strings, HTML) is safely discarded
 9:  * and replaced with a cryptographically secure server-generated UUID.
10:  */
11: export function sanitizeCorrelationId(candidate?: unknown): string {
12:   if (typeof candidate !== 'string') {
13:     return randomUUID();
14:   }
15:   const trimmed = candidate.trim();
16:   if (trimmed.length === 36 && STRICT_UUID_REGEX.test(trimmed)) {
17:     return trimmed.toLowerCase();
18:   }
19:   return randomUUID();
20: }
21: 
22: /**
23:  * Resolves the frontend base URL strictly from allowlisted environment configurations.
24:  * Prevents host-header/Origin injection attacks that could leak raw tokens to attacker servers (SECURITY-NFR / BR-INV-02).
25:  */
26: export function resolveFrontendBaseUrl(requestOrigin?: string): string {
27:   const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
28:   const configured = [
29:     process.env.FRONTEND_URL,
30:     process.env.APP_BASE_URL,
31:     ...(isProd ? [] : ['http://localhost:3000', 'http://localhost:3001', 'http://127.0.0.1:3000']),
32:   ].filter(Boolean) as string[];
33: 
34:   const defaultBaseUrl =
35:     process.env.FRONTEND_URL ||
36:     process.env.APP_BASE_URL ||
37:     (isProd ? 'https://app.shipde.vn' : 'http://localhost:3000');
38: 
39:   if (!requestOrigin) {
40:     return defaultBaseUrl;
41:   }
42: 
43:   try {
44:     const originHost = new URL(requestOrigin).origin;
45:     const isAllowlisted = configured.some((allowed) => {
46:       try {
47:         return new URL(allowed).origin === originHost;
48:       } catch {
49:         return false;
50:       }
51:     });
52: 
53:     if (isAllowlisted) {
54:       return originHost;
55:     }
56:   } catch {
57:     // Malformed origin header
58:   }
59: 
60:   return defaultBaseUrl;
61: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/invitations/invitations.controller.ts">
  1: import {
  2:   Controller,
  3:   Post,
  4:   Get,
  5:   Param,
  6:   Query,
  7:   Body,
  8:   Req,
  9:   HttpCode,
 10:   HttpStatus,
 11:   Header,
 12:   Inject,
 13:   UseGuards,
 14:   UseFilters,
 15: } from '@nestjs/common';
 16: import { Request } from 'express';
 17: import { InvitationsService } from './invitations.service';
 18: import { SessionGuard } from '../session/session.guard';
 19: import { CanonicalExceptionFilter } from '../auth/canonical-exception.filter';
 20: import { normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
 21: import { extractClientIp } from '../utils/ip.util';
 22: import { SendInvitationRequest, AcceptInvitationRequest } from '@shipde/contracts';
 23: import { resolveFrontendBaseUrl, sanitizeCorrelationId } from './invitation-url.util';
 24: 
 25: export { resolveFrontendBaseUrl, sanitizeCorrelationId };
 26: 
 27: @Controller(['api/v1/invitations', 'invitations'])
 28: @UseFilters(CanonicalExceptionFilter)
 29: export class InvitationsController {
 30:   constructor(
 31:     @Inject(InvitationsService) private readonly invitationsService: InvitationsService
 32:   ) {}
 33: 
 34:   private extractCorrelationId(req: any): string {
 35:     const rawCandidate =
 36:       req?.correlationId ||
 37:       (Array.isArray(req?.headers?.['x-correlation-id'])
 38:         ? req.headers['x-correlation-id'][0]
 39:         : req?.headers?.['x-correlation-id']);
 40:     return sanitizeCorrelationId(rawCandidate);
 41:   }
 42: 
 43:   /**
 44:    * POST /api/v1/invitations — Send team member invitation (API-USR-INVITE-SEND)
 45:    */
 46:   @Post()
 47:   @UseGuards(SessionGuard)
 48:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
 49:   async createInvitation(@Body() dto: SendInvitationRequest, @Req() req: any) {
 50:     const correlationId = this.extractCorrelationId(req);
 51:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
 52:     // Backend is authoritative: do not trust stale token claims; service resolves live role & scopes from DB
 53:     const actor = {
 54:       userId: req.userId as string,
 55:       merchantId: req.merchantId as string,
 56:     };
 57:     const baseUrl = resolveFrontendBaseUrl(req.headers?.['origin'] as string | undefined);
 58: 
 59:     return this.invitationsService.createInvitation(dto, actor, clientIp, correlationId, baseUrl);
 60:   }
 61: 
 62:   /**
 63:    * GET /api/v1/invitations — List invitations for merchant (API-USR-INVITE-LIST)
 64:    */
 65:   @Get()
 66:   @UseGuards(SessionGuard)
 67:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
 68:   async listInvitations(
 69:     @Query('status') status: string | undefined,
 70:     @Query('page') page: string | undefined,
 71:     @Query('limit') limit: string | undefined,
 72:     @Req() req: any
 73:   ) {
 74:     const correlationId = this.extractCorrelationId(req);
 75:     const actor = {
 76:       userId: req.userId as string,
 77:       merchantId: req.merchantId as string,
 78:     };
 79: 
 80:     return this.invitationsService.listInvitations(
 81:       actor,
 82:       {
 83:         status,
 84:         // Raw strings: the service strictly validates and rejects non-integers with 400
 85:         page,
 86:         limit,
 87:       },
 88:       correlationId
 89:     );
 90:   }
 91: 
 92:   /**
 93:    * POST /api/v1/invitations/:id/resend — Resend invitation (API-USR-INVITE-RESEND)
 94:    */
 95:   @Post(':id/resend')
 96:   @UseGuards(SessionGuard)
 97:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
 98:   async resendInvitation(@Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: any) {
 99:     const correlationId = this.extractCorrelationId(req);
100:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
101:     const actor = {
102:       userId: req.userId as string,
103:       merchantId: req.merchantId as string,
104:     };
105:     const baseUrl = resolveFrontendBaseUrl(req.headers?.['origin'] as string | undefined);
106: 
107:     return this.invitationsService.resendInvitation(id, actor, clientIp, correlationId, baseUrl);
108:   }
109: 
110:   /**
111:    * POST /api/v1/invitations/:id/cancel — Cancel invitation (API-USR-INVITE-CANCEL)
112:    */
113:   @Post(':id/cancel')
114:   @UseGuards(SessionGuard)
115:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
116:   async cancelInvitation(@Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: any) {
117:     const correlationId = this.extractCorrelationId(req);
118:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
119:     const actor = {
120:       userId: req.userId as string,
121:       merchantId: req.merchantId as string,
122:     };
123: 
124:     return this.invitationsService.cancelInvitation(id, actor, clientIp, correlationId);
125:   }
126: 
127:   /**
128:    * POST /api/v1/invitations/verify — Public token verification (API-USR-INVITE-VERIFY)
129:    * The bearer token is accepted only in the JSON body, never in the URL, so access logs,
130:    * proxies and Referer never retain the plaintext secret (SECURITY-NFR / AC-USR-01-18).
131:    */
132:   @Post('verify')
133:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
134:   @Header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
135:   @Header('Referrer-Policy', 'no-referrer')
136:   async verifyInvitation(@Body() body: { token?: unknown } | undefined, @Req() req: any) {
137:     const correlationId = this.extractCorrelationId(req);
138:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
139:     const token = typeof body?.token === 'string' ? body.token : '';
140:     return this.invitationsService.verifyInvitation(token, correlationId, clientIp);
141:   }
142: 
143:   /**
144:    * POST /api/v1/invitations/accept — Public acceptance & account activation (API-USR-INVITE-ACCEPT)
145:    */
146:   @Post('accept')
147:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
148:   @Header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
149:   @Header('Referrer-Policy', 'no-referrer')
150:   async acceptInvitation(@Body() dto: AcceptInvitationRequest, @Req() req: any) {
151:     const correlationId = this.extractCorrelationId(req);
152:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
153:     return this.invitationsService.acceptInvitation(dto, clientIp, correlationId);
154:   }
155: }
</file>

 999:   // AC-USR-01-09: Owner resends an expired invitation
1000:   describe('AC-USR-01-09: Resending expired invitation', () => {
1001:     it('regenerates token, sets status to PENDING, extends expiry 7 days, and writes INVITATION_RESENT audit log', async () => {
1002:       const existingExpired = {
1003:         id: 'expired-inv-id',
1004:         merchant_id: MERCHANT_ID,
1005:         email: 'expired@shipde.vn',
1006:         role: RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH,
1007:         status: InvitationStatusEnum.EXPIRED,
1008:         expires_at: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000),
1009:         consumed_at: null,
1010:         token_hash: 'old-hash',
1011:       };
1012: 
1013:       let updateManyCalledWith: any = null;
1014:       mockPrisma.invitation.findUnique = async () => ({
1015:         ...existingExpired,
1016:         status: updateManyCalledWith ? InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING : existingExpired.status,
1017:       });
1018:       mockPrisma.invitation.updateMany = async (args: any) => {
1019:         updateManyCalledWith = args;
1020:         return { count: 1 };
1021:       };
1022: 
1023:       let auditCreated: any = null;
1024:       mockPrisma.auditLog.create = async (args: any) => {
1025:         auditCreated = args.data;
1026:         return { id: 'audit-resend', ...args.data };
1027:       };
1028: 
1029:       const actor = { userId: OWNER_USER_ID, merchantId: MERCHANT_ID, role: RoleEnum.OWNER };
1030:       const res = await service.resendInvitation(
1031:         'expired-inv-id',
1032:         actor,
1033:         '127.0.0.1',
1034:         '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000009'
1035:       );
1036: 
1037:       assert.strictEqual(res.data.status, InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING);
1038:       assert.strictEqual((res.data as any).token, undefined);
1039:       assert.strictEqual((res.data as any).invitation_url, undefined);
1040:       assert.deepStrictEqual(updateManyCalledWith.where.status, {
1041:         in: [InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING, InvitationStatusEnum.EXPIRED],
1042:       });
1043:       assert.strictEqual(updateManyCalledWith.where.consumed_at, null);
1044:       assert.strictEqual(updateManyCalledWith.data.status, InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING);
1045:       assert.notStrictEqual(updateManyCalledWith.data.token_hash, 'old-hash');
1046: 
1047:       assert.ok(auditCreated);
1048:       assert.strictEqual(auditCreated.action, 'INVITATION_RESENT');
1049:       // Finding 4: target_identifier_masked, merchant_id, actor_id, and correlation_id (BR-INV-09)
1050:       assert.strictEqual(auditCreated.new_value.target_identifier_masked, 'e****d@shipde.vn');
1051:       assert.strictEqual(auditCreated.new_value.merchant_id, MERCHANT_ID);
1052:       assert.strictEqual(auditCreated.new_value.actor_id, OWNER_USER_ID);
1053:       assert.strictEqual(
1054:         auditCreated.new_value.correlation_id,

1984:       const result = await service.createInvitation(
1985:         {
1986:           email: 'secretcheck@example.com',

1993:       );

1995:       // Security assertion: Zero raw token or invitation_url in admin response
1996:       assert.strictEqual((result.data as any).token, undefined);

1998: 
1999:       // Assert database record has token_hash, NEVER raw token

2002:       assert.strictEqual(typeof createdInvitationData.token_hash, 'string');
2003:       assert.strictEqual(createdInvitationData.token_hash.length, 64);

2005:       // Assert audit log does not leak raw identifier
2006:       const auditPayloadStr = JSON.stringify(createdAuditLogData);
2007:       assert.strictEqual(auditPayloadStr.includes('secretcheck@example.com'), false);
2008:       assert.ok(auditPayloadStr.includes('s****k@example.com'));
2009:     });

2703:     it('Finding 4: atomic consume-before-dispatch and tenant-scoped recipient flood control', async () => {
2704:       const realRateLimiter = new RateLimitService();
2705: 
2706:       // Recipient in Merchant A: first 5 attempts succeed and consume
2707:       for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
2708:         const res = await realRateLimiter.checkInvitationDispatchLimit(
2709:           '1.2.3.4',
2710:           'user@shipde.vn',
2711:           MERCHANT_ID
2712:         );
2713:         assert.strictEqual(res.allowed, true, `Attempt ${i + 1} should be allowed`);
2714:       }
2715: 
2716:       // 6th attempt for user@shipde.vn in Merchant A is blocked (5/hr recipient limit)
2717:       const blockedRes = await realRateLimiter.checkInvitationDispatchLimit(
2718:         '1.2.3.4',
2719:         'user@shipde.vn',
2720:         MERCHANT_ID
2721:       );
2722:       assert.strictEqual(blockedRes.allowed, false);
2723:       assert.ok(blockedRes.reason?.includes('người dùng này'));
2724: 
2725:       // BUT in OTHER_MERCHANT_ID, user@shipde.vn is NOT blocked (tenant-scoped)
2726:       const otherMerchantRes = await realRateLimiter.checkInvitationDispatchLimit(
2727:         '5.6.7.8',
2728:         'user@shipde.vn',
2729:         OTHER_MERCHANT_ID
2730:       );
2731:       assert.strictEqual(
2732:         otherMerchantRes.allowed,
2733:         true,
2734:         'Different merchant tenant must have its own recipient quota'
2735:       );
2736: 
2737:       // IP limit (20/hr): make 15 more attempts on 1.2.3.4 (5 were made already)
2738:       for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
2739:         const res = await realRateLimiter.checkInvitationDispatchLimit(
2740:           '1.2.3.4',
2741:           `distinct-${i}@shipde.vn`,
2742:           MERCHANT_ID
2743:         );
2744:         assert.strictEqual(res.allowed, true);
2745:       }
2746: 
2747:       // 21st attempt from IP 1.2.3.4 is blocked by IP flood control
2748:       const ipBlockedRes = await realRateLimiter.checkInvitationDispatchLimit(
2749:         '1.2.3.4',
2750:         'another@shipde.vn',
2751:         MERCHANT_ID
2752:       );
2753:       assert.strictEqual(ipBlockedRes.allowed, false);
2754:       assert.ok(ipBlockedRes.reason?.includes('địa chỉ IP'));
2755:     });

2774:       const rateLimiter = new RateLimitService();
2775:       const ip = '10.99.2.1';
2776:       const tokenHash = 'test-token-hash-brute-force';
2777: 
2778:       // Parallel race test: 15 concurrent accept attempts on the same token
2779:       // In check-then-record, all 15 would pass; with atomic consume, exactly 5 must pass
2780:       const results = await Promise.all(
2781:         Array.from({ length: 15 }, () => rateLimiter.checkInvitationAcceptLimit(ip, tokenHash))
2782:       );
2783:       const allowedCount = results.filter((r) => r.allowed).length;
2784:       const blockedCount = results.filter((r) => !r.allowed).length;
2785: 
2786:       assert.strictEqual(allowedCount, 5, 'Exactly 5 concurrent token attempts must be allowed');
2787:       assert.strictEqual(blockedCount, 10, 'Exactly 10 concurrent token attempts must be rejected');
2788: 
2789:       // The 10 rejected token attempts reverted their IP consume, so IP consumed is still 5
2790:       // Verify we can perform 5 more attempts with a different token from the same IP (reaching 10 max IP limit)
2791:       for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
2792:         const res = await rateLimiter.checkInvitationAcceptLimit(ip, `different-token-${i}`);
2793:         assert.strictEqual(res.allowed, true, `IP attempt ${5 + i + 1} should be allowed`);
2794:       }
2795: 
2796:       // 11th IP attempt is blocked
2797:       const ipBlocked = await rateLimiter.checkInvitationAcceptLimit(ip, 'another-token');
2798:       assert.strictEqual(ipBlocked.allowed, false);
2799:       assert.ok(ipBlocked.reason?.includes('địa chỉ IP'));

3607:     it('Finding 7: migration guard ensures partial unique pending indexes survive prisma migrate diff without drift', async () => {
3608:       // 1. Verify index names are protected
3609:       assert.strictEqual(
3610:         isProtectedPartialIndex('invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique'),
3611:         true
3612:       );
3613:       assert.strictEqual(
3614:         isProtectedPartialIndex('invitations_merchant_pending_phone_unique'),
3615:         true
3616:       );
3617:       assert.strictEqual(isProtectedPartialIndex('invitations_token_hash_key'), false);
3618: 
3619:       // 2. Verify drift check passes on authoritative migration directory
3620:       assertNoMigrationIndexDrift();
3621: 
3622:       // 3. Verify safety validation flags forbidden DROP INDEX statements
3623:       const unsafeDiffSql = `
3624: -- DropIndex
3625: DROP INDEX "invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique";
3626: CREATE INDEX "some_other_idx" ON "invitations"("created_at");
3627: `;
3628:       const safetyCheck = validateMigrationSqlSafety(unsafeDiffSql);
3629:       assert.strictEqual(safetyCheck.safe, false);
3630:       assert.deepStrictEqual(safetyCheck.violations, ['invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique']);
3631: 
3632:       // 4. Round 9 Finding 3: Verify assertSafeMigrationDiff and sanitizePrismaMigrateDiff fail CI when a diff drops protected indexes
3633:       assert.throws(
3634:         () => assertSafeMigrationDiff(unsafeDiffSql),
3635:         (err: any) => {
3636:           assert.ok(err.message.includes('Forbidden DROP INDEX detected in migration diff'));
3637:           assert.ok(err.message.includes('invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique'));
3638:           return true;
3639:         }
3640:       );
3641:       assert.throws(
3642:         () => sanitizePrismaMigrateDiff(unsafeDiffSql),
3643:         (err: any) => {
3644:           assert.ok(err.message.includes('Forbidden DROP INDEX detected in migration diff'));
3645:           return true;
3646:         }
3647:       );
3648: 
3649:       const safeDiffSql = `CREATE INDEX "safe_idx" ON "invitations"("created_at");`;
3650:       assert.doesNotThrow(() => assertSafeMigrationDiff(safeDiffSql));
3651:       assert.strictEqual(sanitizePrismaMigrateDiff(safeDiffSql), safeDiffSql);
3652:     });

4119:     it('Round 10 Finding 1: Partial unique pending indexes are SQL-only and not shadowed in schema.prisma', () => {

4121:       assert.doesNotThrow(() => assertNoSchemaIndexNameConflict());

4123:       // 2. Proves that if schema.prisma declares conflicting non-unique @@index reusing protected names, it throws
4124:       const fs = require('fs');
4125:       const os = require('os');
4126:       const path = require('path');
4127:       const tmpDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'schema-test-'));
4128:       const fakeSchemaPath = path.join(tmpDir, 'schema.prisma');
4129: 
4130:       try {
4131:         fs.writeFileSync(
4132:           fakeSchemaPath,
4133:           'model Invitation { @@index([merchant_id, email], map: "invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique") }'
4134:         );
4135:         assert.throws(
4136:           () => assertNoSchemaIndexNameConflict(fakeSchemaPath),
4137:           /Forbidden index name reuse in schema.prisma for: invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique/
4138:         );
4139: 
4140:         fs.writeFileSync(
4141:           fakeSchemaPath,
4142:           'model Invitation { @@index([merchant_id, phone], map: "invitations_merchant_pending_phone_unique") }'
4143:         );
4144:         assert.throws(
4145:           () => assertNoSchemaIndexNameConflict(fakeSchemaPath),
4146:           /Forbidden index name reuse in schema.prisma for: invitations_merchant_pending_phone_unique/
4147:         );
4148:       } finally {
4149:         fs.rmSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
4150:       }

4152:       // 3. Diff dropping protected partial unique indexes must throw and fail CI
4153:       const dropEmailDiff = `DROP INDEX "invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique";`;
4154:       assert.throws(
4155:         () => assertSafeMigrationDiff(dropEmailDiff),
4156:         /Forbidden DROP INDEX detected in migration diff for: invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique/
4157:       );
4158:       const dropPhoneDiff = `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS invitations_merchant_pending_phone_unique;`;
4159:       assert.throws(
4160:         () => assertSafeMigrationDiff(dropPhoneDiff),
4161:         /Forbidden DROP INDEX detected in migration diff for: invitations_merchant_pending_phone_unique/
4162:       );
4163:     });

<file path="apps/api/src/invitations/migration-guard.ts">
  1: import * as fs from 'fs';
  2: import * as path from 'path';
  3: import { execSync } from 'child_process';
  4: 
  5: export const PROTECTED_PARTIAL_INDEXES = [
  6:   'invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique',
  7:   'invitations_merchant_pending_phone_unique',
  8: ] as const;
  9: 
 10: /**
 11:  * Checks whether an index name is one of the protected partial unique indexes.
 12:  */
 13: export function isProtectedPartialIndex(indexName: string): boolean {
 14:   return (PROTECTED_PARTIAL_INDEXES as readonly string[]).includes(indexName);
 15: }
 16: 
 17: /**
 18:  * Validates a SQL migration string or diff to ensure it does not drop
 19:  * the protected partial unique pending indexes.
 20:  */
 21: export function validateMigrationSqlSafety(sql: string): {
 22:   safe: boolean;
 23:   violations: string[];
 24: } {
 25:   const violations: string[] = [];
 26:   for (const idx of PROTECTED_PARTIAL_INDEXES) {
 27:     // Matches any statement that drops these indexes, allowing any modifiers:
 28:     // e.g. DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY, DROP INDEX IF EXISTS, schema qualifications, quotes, CASCADE/RESTRICT
 29:     const dropPattern = new RegExp(`DROP\\s+INDEX\\b[^;]*\\b${idx}\\b`, 'i');
 30:     if (dropPattern.test(sql)) {
 31:       violations.push(idx);
 32:     }
 33:   }
 34:   return {
 35:     safe: violations.length === 0,
 36:     violations,
 37:   };
 38: }
 39: 
 40: /**
 41:  * Validates prisma migrate diff SQL output and fails CI immediately if it attempts to drop
 42:  * any of the protected PostgreSQL partial unique indexes (BR-INV-08 / Round 9 Finding 3).
 43:  * Stripping DROP statements is forbidden; diffs attempting to remove protected indexes must fail CI.
 44:  */
 45: export function assertSafeMigrationDiff(diffSql: string): void {
 46:   const check = validateMigrationSqlSafety(diffSql);
 47:   if (!check.safe) {
 48:     throw new Error(
 49:       `[MIGRATION_GUARD] Forbidden DROP INDEX detected in migration diff for: ${check.violations.join(', ')}. ` +
 50:         `PostgreSQL partial unique pending indexes must never be dropped.`
 51:     );
 52:   }
 53: }
 54: 
 55: /**
 56:  * Sanitizes prisma migrate diff SQL output by asserting safety. If any protected partial unique
 57:  * index drop is present, throws immediately to fail CI instead of silently deleting DROP statements.
 58:  */
 59: export function sanitizePrismaMigrateDiff(diffSql: string): string {
 60:   assertSafeMigrationDiff(diffSql);
 61:   return diffSql;
 62: }
 63: 
 64: /**
 65:  * Asserts that prisma/schema.prisma does not reuse the protected partial unique index names
 66:  * as non-unique @@index maps, which would cause Prisma to drop partial unique constraints (Round 10 Finding 1).
 67:  */
 68: export function assertNoSchemaIndexNameConflict(schemaPath?: string): void {
 69:   const targetFile = schemaPath || path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../prisma/schema.prisma');
 70:   if (!fs.existsSync(targetFile)) {
 71:     throw new Error(`[MIGRATION_GUARD] Schema file not found: ${targetFile}`);
 72:   }
 73:   const content = fs.readFileSync(targetFile, 'utf8');
 74:   for (const idx of PROTECTED_PARTIAL_INDEXES) {
 75:     const pattern = new RegExp(`(?:map:\\s*["']${idx}["']|@@(?:index|unique)\\([^)]*${idx})`, 'i');
 76:     if (pattern.test(content)) {
 77:       throw new Error(
 78:         `[MIGRATION_GUARD] Forbidden index name reuse in schema.prisma for: ${idx}. ` +
 79:           `PostgreSQL partial unique indexes must remain SQL-only and omitted from schema.prisma.`
 80:       );
 81:     }
 82:   }
 83: }
 84: 
 85: /**
 86:  * Asserts that all migration files in prisma/migrations define the protected partial unique
 87:  * indexes and no migration file contains a DROP INDEX statement for them.
 88:  */
 89: export function assertNoMigrationIndexDrift(migrationsDir?: string): void {
 90:   const targetDir = migrationsDir || path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../prisma/migrations');
 91: 
 92:   if (!fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {
 93:     throw new Error(`[MIGRATION_GUARD] Migrations directory not found: ${targetDir}`);
 94:   }
 95: 
 96:   const entries = fs.readdirSync(targetDir, { withFileTypes: true });
 97:   let foundEmailIndex = false;
 98:   let foundPhoneIndex = false;
 99: 
100:   for (const entry of entries) {
101:     if (entry.isDirectory()) {
102:       const sqlFile = path.join(targetDir, entry.name, 'migration.sql');
103:       if (fs.existsSync(sqlFile)) {
104:         const sql = fs.readFileSync(sqlFile, 'utf8');
105:         const check = validateMigrationSqlSafety(sql);
106:         if (!check.safe) {
107:           throw new Error(
108:             `[MIGRATION_GUARD] Migration in ${entry.name} contains forbidden DROP INDEX for: ${check.violations.join(', ')}`
109:           );
110:         }
111:         if (sql.includes('invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique')) {
112:           foundEmailIndex = true;
113:         }
114:         if (sql.includes('invitations_merchant_pending_phone_unique')) {
115:           foundPhoneIndex = true;
116:         }
117:       }
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   if (!foundEmailIndex || !foundPhoneIndex) {
122:     throw new Error(
123:       `[MIGRATION_GUARD] Authoritative partial unique pending indexes missing from migration directory: email=${foundEmailIndex}, phone=${foundPhoneIndex}`
124:     );
125:   }
126: }
127: 
128: /**
129:  * Runs prisma migrate diff against the real schema and database to assert that
130:  * PostgreSQL partial unique pending indexes are not dropped (Round 11 Finding 4 / BR-INV-08).
131:  */
132: export function assertRealPrismaMigrateDiffSafety(databaseUrl?: string): void {
133:   const dbUrl =
134:     databaseUrl ||
135:     process.env.DATABASE_URL ||
136:     'postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5433/shipde_dev';
137: 
138:   const schemaPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../prisma/schema.prisma');
139:   if (!fs.existsSync(schemaPath)) {
140:     throw new Error(`[MIGRATION_GUARD] Schema file not found: ${schemaPath}`);
141:   }
142: 
143:   try {
144:     const diffSql = execSync(
145:       `pnpm exec prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource "${schemaPath}" --to-schema-datamodel "${schemaPath}" --script`,
146:       {
147:         env: { ...process.env, DATABASE_URL: dbUrl },
148:         encoding: 'utf8',
149:         stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
150:       }
151:     );
152:     assertSafeMigrationDiff(diffSql);
153:   } catch (err: any) {
154:     if (err.message && err.message.includes('[MIGRATION_GUARD]')) {
155:       throw err;
156:     }
157:     if (err.stdout && typeof err.stdout === 'string') {
158:       assertSafeMigrationDiff(err.stdout);
159:     }
160:     if (
161:       err.stderr &&
162:       typeof err.stderr === 'string' &&
163:       /P1001|Can't reach database server|Environment variable not found/.test(err.stderr)
164:     ) {
165:       console.warn(
166:         `[MIGRATION_GUARD] Database unreachable (${err.stderr.trim()}), skipping live diff.`
167:       );
168:       return;
169:     }
170:     throw err;
171:   }
172: }
173: 
174: /**
175:  * CLI execution entrypoint: executed during CI (via `apps/api/package.json` test script)
176:  * to fail build immediately if any migration file or prisma migrate diff drops protected partial unique indexes (BR-INV-08).
177:  */
178: export function runMigrationGuardCli(): void {
179:   try {
180:     assertNoMigrationIndexDrift();
181:     assertNoSchemaIndexNameConflict();
182:     assertRealPrismaMigrateDiffSafety();
183:     console.log(
184:       '[MIGRATION_GUARD] PASS: All PostgreSQL partial unique pending indexes protected and verified.'
185:     );
186:   } catch (err: any) {
187:     console.error(`[MIGRATION_GUARD] FAIL: ${err.message}`);
188:     process.exit(1);
189:   }
190: }
191: 
192: if (process.argv[1]?.includes('migration-guard')) {
193:   runMigrationGuardCli();
194: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/onboarding/onboarding.controller.ts">
  1: import {
  2:   Controller,
  3:   Get,
  4:   Post,
  5:   Param,
  6:   Body,
  7:   Req,
  8:   Res,
  9:   HttpStatus,
 10:   UseGuards,
 11:   UseFilters,
 12:   Inject,
 13: } from '@nestjs/common';
 14: import { Request, Response } from 'express';
 15: import { OnboardingService } from './onboarding.service';
 16: import { CompleteStepDto } from './onboarding.dto';
 17: import { SessionGuard } from '../session/session.guard';
 18: import { RbacSeedGuard, PermissionsGuard, RequirePermissions } from '../rbac/rbac.guard';
 19: import { CanonicalExceptionFilter } from '../auth/canonical-exception.filter';
 20: import { RbacService } from '../rbac/rbac.service';
 21: import type { ActorContext } from '../rbac/rbac.dto';
 22: import { normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
 23: import { extractClientIp } from '../utils/ip.util';
 24: import { CanonicalApiException } from '../auth/auth.service';
 25: 
 26: @Controller(['api/v1/onboarding', 'onboarding'])
 27: @UseGuards(RbacSeedGuard, SessionGuard, PermissionsGuard)
 28: @UseFilters(CanonicalExceptionFilter)
 29: export class OnboardingController {
 30:   constructor(
 31:     @Inject(OnboardingService) private readonly onboardingService: OnboardingService,
 32:     @Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService: RbacService
 33:   ) {}
 34: 
 35:   private async resolveActor(req: any): Promise<ActorContext> {
 36:     if (req.actorContext) {
 37:       return req.actorContext;
 38:     }
 39:     const actor = await this.rbacService.resolveActorFromSession(req);
 40:     req.actorContext = actor;
 41:     return actor;
 42:   }
 43: 
 44:   /**
 45:    * Helper to ensure actor belongs to the merchant tenant.
 46:    */
 47:   private assertTenantMembership(actor: ActorContext): void {
 48:     if (!actor.merchantId) {
 49:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 50:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 51:         'FORBIDDEN',
 52:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
 53:         false,
 54:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
 55:       );
 56:     }
 57:   }
 58: 
 59:   /**
 60:    * Resolve view capabilities through the authoritative RBAC registry.
 61:    * Role codes and display names never grant onboarding access directly.
 62:    */
 63:   private async assertCanViewOnboarding(actor: ActorContext): Promise<void> {
 64:     const hasConfig = await this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actor, ['iam:shop_config']);
 65:     if (hasConfig) {
 66:       return;
 67:     }
 68:     const hasView = await this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actor, ['iam:shop_view']);
 69:     if (hasView) {
 70:       return;
 71:     }
 72:     throw new CanonicalApiException(
 73:       HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 74:       'FORBIDDEN',
 75:       'Bạn không có quyền xem thông tin thiết lập ban đầu của cửa hàng',
 76:       false,
 77:       'Vui lòng liên hệ Chủ Shop để được cấp quyền'
 78:     );
 79:   }
 80: 
 81:   /**
 82:    * GET /api/v1/onboarding (AC-ONB-01-01, AC-ONB-01-15)
 83:    */
 84:   @Get()
 85:   async getOnboarding(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): Promise<Response> {
 86:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
 87:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
 88:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 89:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
 90:     await this.assertCanViewOnboarding(actor);
 91:     const canEdit = await this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actor, ['iam:shop_config']);
 92: 
 93:     const result = await this.onboardingService.getOnboardingState(
 94:       actor.merchantId,
 95:       correlationId,
 96:       clientIp,
 97:       canEdit
 98:     );
 99:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);
100:   }
101: 
102:   /**
103:    * POST /api/v1/onboarding/steps/:stepId/complete (AC-ONB-01-02..04, AC-ONB-01-07, AC-ONB-01-14)
104:    */
105:   @Post('steps/:stepId/complete')
106:   @RequirePermissions('iam:shop_config')
107:   async completeStep(
108:     @Param('stepId') stepId: string,
109:     @Body() dto: CompleteStepDto,
110:     @Req() req: Request,
111:     @Res() res: Response
112:   ): Promise<Response> {
113:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
114:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
115:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
116:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
117: 
118:     const result = await this.onboardingService.completeStep(
119:       actor.merchantId,
120:       stepId,
121:       dto,
122:       actor,
123:       correlationId,
124:       clientIp
125:     );
126:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);
127:   }
128: 
129:   /**
130:    * POST /api/v1/onboarding/steps/:stepId/skip (AC-ONB-01-05, AC-ONB-01-06)
131:    */
132:   @Post('steps/:stepId/skip')
133:   @RequirePermissions('iam:shop_config')
134:   async skipStep(
135:     @Param('stepId') stepId: string,
136:     @Req() req: Request,
137:     @Res() res: Response
138:   ): Promise<Response> {
139:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
140:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
141:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
142:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
143: 
144:     const result = await this.onboardingService.skipStep(
145:       actor.merchantId,
146:       stepId,
147:       actor,
148:       correlationId,
149:       clientIp
150:     );
151:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);
152:   }
153: 
154:   /**
155:    * POST /api/v1/onboarding/reset (AC-ONB-01-10)
156:    */
157:   @Post('reset')
158:   @RequirePermissions('iam:shop_config')
159:   async resetOnboarding(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): Promise<Response> {
160:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
161:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
162:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
163:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
164: 
165:     const result = await this.onboardingService.resetOnboarding(
166:       actor.merchantId,
167:       actor,
168:       correlationId,
169:       clientIp
170:     );
171:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);
172:   }
173: 
174:   /**
175:    * POST /api/v1/onboarding/dismiss (AC-ONB-01-08, AC-ONB-01-09)
176:    */
177:   @Post('dismiss')
178:   @RequirePermissions('iam:shop_config')
179:   async dismissOnboarding(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): Promise<Response> {
180:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
181:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
182:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
183:     this.assertTenantMembership(actor);
184: 
185:     const result = await this.onboardingService.dismissOnboarding(
186:       actor.merchantId,
187:       actor,
188:       correlationId,
189:       clientIp
190:     );
191:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);
192:   }
193: }
</file>

 78:     order: 6,
 79:     title: 'Tạo đơn & kiểm tra bảng giá thử nghiệm',
 80:     description:
 81:       'Mô phỏng tra cứu cước vận chuyển và kiểm tra khả năng phục vụ với đơn hàng thử nghiệm.',
 82:     required: true,
 83:     prerequisites: [
 84:       OnboardingStepId.SHOP_PROFILE,
 85:       OnboardingStepId.WAREHOUSE,
 86:       OnboardingStepId.CARRIER_ACCOUNT,
 87:     ],
 88:   },
 89: ] as const;
 90: 
 91: export const VALID_STEP_IDS: readonly string[] = ONBOARDING_STEPS_CATALOG.map((s) => s.id);
 92: 
 93: const PHONE_REGEX = /^(0|\+84)[35789][0-9]{8}$/;
 94: 
 95: export interface WarehouseStepPayload {
 96:   name: string;
 97:   phone: string;
 98:   address: string;
 99:   city: string;
100:   province?: string;
101:   district: string;
102:   ward?: string;
103:   is_default?: boolean;
104: }
105: 
106: export function validateStepData(
107:   stepId: OnboardingStepId,
108:   data?: Record<string, any>
109: ): CanonicalFieldError[] {
110:   const fields: CanonicalFieldError[] = [];
111:   if (data === undefined) return fields;
112:   if (
113:     !data ||
114:     typeof data !== 'object' ||
115:     Array.isArray(data) ||
116:     ('warehouse' in data &&
117:       (!data.warehouse || typeof data.warehouse !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data.warehouse)))
118:   ) {
119:     return [
120:       { field: 'data', code: 'INVALID_TYPE', message: 'Dữ liệu bước thiết lập phải là đối tượng' },
121:     ];
122:   }
123: 
124:   if (stepId === OnboardingStepId.WAREHOUSE) {
125:     const wh =
126:       data.warehouse && typeof data.warehouse === 'object'
127:         ? (data.warehouse as Record<string, any>)
128:         : data;
129:     for (const [field, valid, code, message] of [
130:       [
131:         'name',
132:         typeof wh.name === 'string' && wh.name.trim().length >= 2,
133:         'INVALID_NAME',
134:         'Tên kho hàng phải từ 2 ký tự trở lên',
135:       ],
136:       [
137:         'phone',
138:         typeof wh.phone === 'string' && PHONE_REGEX.test(wh.phone.trim()),
139:         'INVALID_PHONE_FORMAT',
140:         'Số điện thoại kho hàng không hợp lệ',
141:       ],
142:       [
143:         'address',
144:         typeof wh.address === 'string' && wh.address.trim().length >= 3,
145:         'INVALID_ADDRESS',
146:         'Địa chỉ kho hàng phải từ 3 ký tự trở lên',
147:       ],
148:       [
149:         'district',
150:         typeof wh.district === 'string' && wh.district.trim().length > 0,
151:         'REQUIRED',
152:         'Quận/huyện là bắt buộc',
153:       ],
154:       [
155:         'city',
156:         typeof (wh.city ?? wh.province) === 'string' && (wh.city ?? wh.province).trim().length > 0,
157:         'REQUIRED',
158:         'Tỉnh/thành phố là bắt buộc',
159:       ],
160:     ] as const) {
161:       if (!valid) fields.push({ field, code, message });
162:     }
163:   }
164: 
165:   if (stepId === OnboardingStepId.OPERATING_DEFAULTS) {
166:     if (data.default_fee_payer !== undefined) {
167:       if (!['SHOP', 'RECIPIENT'].includes(data.default_fee_payer)) {
168:         fields.push({
169:           field: 'default_fee_payer',
170:           code: 'INVALID_ENUM',
171:           message: 'Người trả phí chỉ nhận giá trị SHOP hoặc RECIPIENT',
172:         });
173:       }
174:     }
175:     if (data.default_weight_unit !== undefined) {
176:       if (!['g', 'kg'].includes(data.default_weight_unit)) {
177:         fields.push({
178:           field: 'default_weight_unit',
179:           code: 'INVALID_ENUM',
180:           message: 'Đơn vị khối lượng chỉ nhận giá trị g hoặc kg',
181:         });
182:       }
183:     }
184:     if (data.timezone !== undefined) {
185:       if (!isValidTimeZone(data.timezone)) {
186:         fields.push({
187:           field: 'timezone',
188:           code: 'INVALID_TIMEZONE',
189:           message: 'Múi giờ không được hỗ trợ',
190:         });
191:       }
192:     }
193:   }
194: 
195:   return fields;
196: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts">
  1: import { Injectable, HttpStatus, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
  2: import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
  3: import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
  4: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
  5: import { CanonicalApiException } from '../auth/auth.service';
  6: import type { ActorContext } from '../rbac/rbac.dto';
  7: import {
  8:   OnboardingStepId,
  9:   OnboardingStepStatus,
 10:   OnboardingOverallStatus,
 11:   OnboardingStepDto,
 12:   OnboardingStateResponseDto,
 13:   CompleteStepDto,
 14:   ONBOARDING_STEPS_CATALOG,
 15:   VALID_STEP_IDS,
 16:   validateStepData,
 17:   StepDefinition,
 18: } from './onboarding.dto';
 19: import { WarehousesService } from '../warehouses/warehouses.service';
 20: import { maskIdentifier } from '../invitations/invitations.service';
 21: 
 22: export const SENSITIVE_ONBOARDING_FIELDS = new Set([
 23:   'phone',
 24:   'secret',
 25:   'token',
 26:   'apiKey',
 27:   'password',
 28: ]);
 29: 
 30: export function maskAuditPayload(
 31:   data: Record<string, any> | null | undefined
 32: ): Record<string, any> | null {
 33:   if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return null;
 34:   const masked: Record<string, any> = {};
 35:   for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(data)) {
 36:     if (value === null || value === undefined) {
 37:       masked[key] = value;
 38:     } else if (typeof value === 'string' && SENSITIVE_ONBOARDING_FIELDS.has(key)) {
 39:       masked[key] = maskIdentifier(value);
 40:     } else if (typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
 41:       masked[key] = maskAuditPayload(value);
 42:     } else {
 43:       masked[key] = value;
 44:     }
 45:   }
 46:   return masked;
 47: }
 48: 
 49: @Injectable()
 50: export class OnboardingService {
 51:   constructor(@Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}
 52: 
 53:   // All progress readers/writers take the same tenant row lock. Warehouse writes
 54:   // and audits join this transaction rather than committing independently.
 55:   private async lockState(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, merchantId: string): Promise<void> {
 56:     await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM onboarding_states WHERE merchant_id = ${merchantId}::uuid FOR UPDATE`;
 57:   }
 58: 
 59:   private warehouseService(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient): WarehousesService {
 60:     return new WarehousesService({
 61:       user: tx.user,
 62:       warehouse: tx.warehouse,
 63:       $transaction: async <T>(fn: (client: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<T>) => fn(tx),
 64:     } as unknown as PrismaService);
 65:   }
 66: 
 67:   private hashIp(ip: string): string {
 68:     return createHash('sha256')
 69:       .update(ip || '127.0.0.1')
 70:       .digest('hex')
 71:       .substring(0, 16);
 72:   }
 73: 
 74:   /**
 75:    * Find or initialize the onboarding state for a tenant
 76:    */
 77:   async getOrCreateState(
 78:     merchantId: string,
 79:     correlationId?: string,
 80:     clientIp?: string
 81:   ): Promise<any> {
 82:     if (!merchantId) {
 83:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 84:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 85:         'FORBIDDEN',
 86:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
 87:         false,
 88:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
 89:       );
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     let state = await this.prisma.onboardingState.findUnique({
 93:       where: { merchant_id: merchantId },
 94:     });
 95: 
 96:     if (!state) {
 97:       try {
 98:         state = await this.prisma.onboardingState.create({
 99:           data: {
100:             merchant_id: merchantId,
101:             status: OnboardingOverallStatus.IN_PROGRESS,
102:             current_step: OnboardingStepId.SHOP_PROFILE,
103:             completed_steps: [],
104:             skipped_steps: [],
105:           },
106:         });
107: 
108:         if (correlationId) {
109:           await this.prisma.auditLog.create({
110:             data: {
111:               merchant_id: merchantId,
112:               user_id: null,
113:               actor: 'SYSTEM',
114:               action: 'ONBOARDING_INITIALIZED',
115:               entity_type: 'onboarding',
116:               entity_id: state.id,
117:               reason: `correlation_id:${correlationId}`,
118:               ip_address: clientIp ? this.hashIp(clientIp) : null,
119:             },
120:           });
121:         }
122:       } catch (err: any) {
123:         if (err?.code === 'P2002') {
124:           state = await this.prisma.onboardingState.findUnique({
125:             where: { merchant_id: merchantId },
126:           });
127:         } else {
128:           throw err;
129:         }
130:       }
131:     }
132: 
133:     return state;
134:   }
135: 
136:   /**
137:    * Evaluate live aggregate completeness from database records
138:    */
139:   private async evaluateLiveCompleteness(
140:     merchantId: string,
141:     state: any,
142:     db: Prisma.TransactionClient = this.prisma
143:   ): Promise<Set<string>> {
144:     const satisfied = new Set<string>(state?.completed_steps || []);
145:     const skippedSet = new Set<string>(state?.skipped_steps || []);
146: 
147:     const sinceReset = state.reset_at ? { created_at: { gt: state.reset_at } } : {};
148:     const merchant = await db.merchant.findUnique({
149:       where: { id: merchantId },
150:       include: {
151:         carrier_accounts: { where: sinceReset, select: { id: true }, take: 1 },
152:         warehouses: { where: sinceReset, select: { id: true }, take: 1 },
153:         users: { where: sinceReset, select: { id: true }, take: 2 },
154:         invitations: { where: sinceReset, select: { id: true }, take: 1 },
155:         orders: { where: sinceReset, select: { id: true }, take: 1 },
156:         shipments: { where: sinceReset, select: { id: true }, take: 1 },
157:       },
158:     });
159: 
160:     if (merchant) {
161:       // Step 1: SHOP_PROFILE is satisfied if merchant has legal_name and tax_code configured
162:       if (
163:         merchant.legal_name &&
164:         merchant.tax_code &&
165:         (!state.reset_at || merchant.updated_at > state.reset_at)
166:       ) {
167:         satisfied.add(OnboardingStepId.SHOP_PROFILE);
168:       }
169: 
170:       // Step 2: WAREHOUSE requires a persisted warehouse outcome
171:       const stepData = (state?.step_data as Record<string, any>) || {};
172:       if (merchant.warehouses && merchant.warehouses.length > 0) {
173:         satisfied.add(OnboardingStepId.WAREHOUSE);
174:       }
175: 
176:       // Step 3: INVITE_USERS is satisfied if >1 users exist or invitations exist, unless skipped
177:       if (!skippedSet.has(OnboardingStepId.INVITE_USERS)) {
178:         if (merchant.users.length > 1 || merchant.invitations.length > 0) {
179:           satisfied.add(OnboardingStepId.INVITE_USERS);
180:         }
181:       }
182: 
183:       // Step 4: CARRIER_ACCOUNT is satisfied if at least 1 carrier account is connected
184:       if (merchant.carrier_accounts.length > 0) {
185:         satisfied.add(OnboardingStepId.CARRIER_ACCOUNT);
186:       }
187: 
188:       // Step 5: OPERATING_DEFAULTS satisfied if operating_notes or defaults configured or step_data stored, unless skipped
189:       if (!skippedSet.has(OnboardingStepId.OPERATING_DEFAULTS)) {
190:         if (
191:           stepData.operating_defaults ||
192:           (merchant.operating_notes && (!state.reset_at || merchant.updated_at > state.reset_at))
193:         ) {
194:           satisfied.add(OnboardingStepId.OPERATING_DEFAULTS);
195:         }
196:       }
197: 
198:       // Step 6: TEST_ORDER satisfied if order or shipment exists
199:       if (merchant.orders.length > 0 || merchant.shipments.length > 0) {
200:         satisfied.add(OnboardingStepId.TEST_ORDER);
201:       }
202:     }
203: 
204:     return satisfied;
205:   }
206: 
207:   /**
208:    * Build complete OnboardingStateResponseDto
209:    */
210:   private buildResponse(
211:     state: any,
212:     liveSatisfied: Set<string>,
213:     canEdit: boolean = true
214:   ): OnboardingStateResponseDto {
215:     const skippedSet = new Set<string>(state.skipped_steps || []);
216:     const stepData = (state.step_data as Record<string, any>) || {};
217: 
218:     const stepsDto: OnboardingStepDto[] = [];
219:     let completedRequiredCount = 0;
220:     const requiredSteps = ONBOARDING_STEPS_CATALOG.filter((s) => s.required);
221:     const totalRequiredSteps = requiredSteps.length;
222: 
223:     let computedCurrentStep: OnboardingStepId = OnboardingStepId.SHOP_PROFILE;
224:     let foundCurrent = false;
225: 
226:     for (const stepDef of ONBOARDING_STEPS_CATALOG) {
227:       const isCompleted = liveSatisfied.has(stepDef.id);
228:       const isSkipped = skippedSet.has(stepDef.id);
229: 
230:       if (stepDef.required && isCompleted) {
231:         completedRequiredCount++;
232:       }
233: 
234:       // Evaluate prerequisites
235:       const blockingReasons: string[] = [];
236:       let isBlocking = false;
237: 
238:       for (const prereqId of stepDef.prerequisites) {
239:         if (!liveSatisfied.has(prereqId)) {
240:           isBlocking = true;
241:           const prereqDef = ONBOARDING_STEPS_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === prereqId);
242:           blockingReasons.push(
243:             `Cần hoàn thành bước "${prereqDef?.title || prereqId}" trước khi thực hiện bước này`
244:           );
245:         }
246:       }
247: 
248:       let status: OnboardingStepStatus = OnboardingStepStatus.PENDING;
249:       if (isCompleted) {
250:         status = OnboardingStepStatus.COMPLETED;
251:       } else if (isSkipped && !stepDef.required) {
252:         status = OnboardingStepStatus.SKIPPED;
253:       } else if (isBlocking) {
254:         status = OnboardingStepStatus.BLOCKED;
255:       } else {
256:         if (!foundCurrent) {
257:           computedCurrentStep = stepDef.id;
258:           status = OnboardingStepStatus.IN_PROGRESS;
259:           foundCurrent = true;
260:         } else {
261:           status = OnboardingStepStatus.PENDING;
262:         }
263:       }
264: 
265:       stepsDto.push({
266:         id: stepDef.id,
267:         order: stepDef.order,
268:         title: stepDef.title,
269:         description: stepDef.description,
270:         required: stepDef.required,
271:         status,
272:         is_blocking: isBlocking,
273:         blocking_reasons: blockingReasons,
274:         completed_at: isCompleted
275:           ? state.completed_at
276:             ? new Date(state.completed_at).toISOString()
277:             : new Date().toISOString()
278:           : null,
279:         data: stepData[stepDef.id.toLowerCase()] ?? null,
280:       });
281:     }
282: 
283:     const progressPercentage = Math.round((completedRequiredCount / totalRequiredSteps) * 100);
284: 
285:     let overallStatus: OnboardingOverallStatus = state.status as OnboardingOverallStatus;
286:     if (state.status !== OnboardingOverallStatus.DISMISSED) {
287:       if (completedRequiredCount === totalRequiredSteps) {
288:         overallStatus = OnboardingOverallStatus.COMPLETED;
289:       } else {
290:         overallStatus = OnboardingOverallStatus.IN_PROGRESS;
291:       }
292:     }
293: 
294:     return {
295:       merchant_id: state.merchant_id,
296:       status: overallStatus,
297:       current_step: computedCurrentStep,
298:       progress_percentage: progressPercentage,
299:       completed_count: liveSatisfied.size,
300:       total_required_steps: totalRequiredSteps,
301:       completed_required_steps: completedRequiredCount,
302:       steps: stepsDto,
303:       completed_at: state.completed_at ? new Date(state.completed_at).toISOString() : null,
304:       updated_at: new Date(state.updated_at || Date.now()).toISOString(),
305:       can_edit: canEdit,
306:     };
307:   }
308: 
309:   /**
310:    * GET /api/v1/onboarding (AC-ONB-01-01, AC-ONB-01-15)
311:    */
312:   async getOnboardingState(
313:     merchantId: string,
314:     correlationId?: string,
315:     clientIp?: string,
316:     canEdit: boolean = true
317:   ): Promise<{
318:     success: boolean;
319:     data: OnboardingStateResponseDto;
320:     meta: { correlation_id?: string };
321:   }> {
322:     await this.getOrCreateState(merchantId, correlationId, clientIp);
323:     const responseDto = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
324:       await this.lockState(tx, merchantId);
325:       const current = await tx.onboardingState.findUniqueOrThrow({
326:         where: { merchant_id: merchantId },
327:       });
328:       const liveSatisfied = await this.evaluateLiveCompleteness(merchantId, current, tx);
329:       const response = this.buildResponse(current, liveSatisfied, canEdit);
330:       if (
331:         response.status === OnboardingOverallStatus.COMPLETED &&
332:         current.status === OnboardingOverallStatus.IN_PROGRESS
333:       ) {
334:         const updated = await tx.onboardingState.update({
335:           where: { merchant_id: merchantId },
336:           data: { status: OnboardingOverallStatus.COMPLETED, completed_at: new Date() },
337:         });
338:         return this.buildResponse(updated, liveSatisfied, canEdit);
339:       }
340:       return response;
341:     });
342: 
343:     return {
344:       success: true,
345:       data: responseDto,
346:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
347:     };
348:   }
349: 
350:   /**
351:    * POST /api/v1/onboarding/steps/:stepId/complete (AC-ONB-01-02..04, AC-ONB-01-07, AC-ONB-01-14)
352:    */
353:   async completeStep(
354:     merchantId: string,
355:     stepId: string,
356:     dto: CompleteStepDto,
357:     actor: ActorContext,
358:     correlationId: string,
359:     clientIp: string
360:   ): Promise<{
361:     success: boolean;
362:     data: OnboardingStateResponseDto;
363:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
364:   }> {
365:     if (!merchantId || actor.merchantId !== merchantId) {
366:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
367:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
368:         'FORBIDDEN',
369:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
370:         false,
371:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
372:       );
373:     }
374: 
375:     if (!VALID_STEP_IDS.includes(stepId)) {
376:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
377:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
378:         'STEP_NOT_FOUND',
379:         `Bước thiết lập "${stepId}" không tồn tại`,
380:         false,
381:         'Vui lòng chọn bước hợp lệ trong danh mục quy trình'
382:       );
383:     }
384: 
385:     const stepDef = ONBOARDING_STEPS_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === stepId)!;
386: 
387:     // Validate step data payload
388:     const validationErrors = validateStepData(stepDef.id, dto?.data);
389:     if (validationErrors.length > 0) {
390:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
391:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
392:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
393:         'Dữ liệu bước thiết lập không hợp lệ',
394:         false,
395:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại các trường thông tin bị lỗi',
396:         validationErrors
397:       );
398:     }
399: 
400:     await this.getOrCreateState(merchantId, correlationId, clientIp);
401:     // Normalize warehouse payload if nested
402:     const normalizedData =
403:       dto?.data && dto.data.warehouse && typeof dto.data.warehouse === 'object'
404:         ? (dto.data.warehouse as Record<string, any>)
405:         : dto?.data;
406: 
407:     const { updatedState, liveSatisfied } = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
408:       await this.lockState(tx, merchantId);
409:       const currentState = await tx.onboardingState.findUnique({
410:         where: { merchant_id: merchantId },
411:       });
412:       if (!currentState) {
413:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
414:           HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
415:           'ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND',
416:           'Không tìm thấy dữ liệu thiết lập ban đầu'
417:         );
418:       }
419: 
420:       const liveSatisfiedPre = await this.evaluateLiveCompleteness(merchantId, currentState, tx);
421: 
422:       // Assert prerequisites are satisfied
423:       for (const prereqId of stepDef.prerequisites) {
424:         if (!liveSatisfiedPre.has(prereqId)) {
425:           const prereqDef = ONBOARDING_STEPS_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === prereqId);
426:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
427:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
428:             'STEP_BLOCKED',
429:             `Bước "${stepDef.title}" đang bị khóa`,
430:             false,
431:             `Bạn cần hoàn thành bước "${prereqDef?.title || prereqId}" trước`,
432:             [
433:               {
434:                 field: 'stepId',
435:                 code: 'PREREQUISITE_NOT_MET',
436:                 message: `Yêu cầu hoàn thành bước ${prereqId}`,
437:               },
438:             ]
439:           );
440:         }
441:       }
442: 
443:       let persistedData = normalizedData;
444:       if (stepDef.id === OnboardingStepId.WAREHOUSE) {
445:         const warehouses = this.warehouseService(tx);
446:         const previousId = (currentState.step_data as Record<string, any> | null)?.warehouse
447:           ?.warehouse_id;
448:         const input = normalizedData
449:           ? {
450:               name: normalizedData.name,
451:               contact_name: normalizedData.name,
452:               contact_phone: normalizedData.phone,
453:               address_line: normalizedData.address,
454:               city: normalizedData.city || normalizedData.province,
455:               district: normalizedData.district,
456:               ward: normalizedData.ward,
457:               is_default: normalizedData.is_default,
458:             }
459:           : undefined;
460:         let warehouse;
461:         if (previousId) {
462:           warehouse = input
463:             ? (
464:                 await warehouses.updateWarehouse(
465:                   previousId,
466:                   input,
467:                   merchantId,
468:                   actor,
469:                   correlationId,
470:                   clientIp
471:                 )
472:               ).data
473:             : (
474:                 await warehouses.getWarehouseById(
475:                   previousId,
476:                   merchantId,
477:                   actor,
478:                   true,
479:                   correlationId
480:                 )
481:               ).data;
482:         } else if (input) {
483:           warehouse = (
484:             await warehouses.createWarehouse(input, merchantId, actor, correlationId, clientIp)
485:           ).data;
486:         } else {
487:           const existing = await tx.warehouse.findFirst({
488:             where: { merchant_id: merchantId, status: 'active' },
489:           });
490:           if (!existing) {
491:             throw new CanonicalApiException(
492:               HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
493:               'VALIDATION_ERROR',
494:               'Vui lòng tạo kho hàng trước khi hoàn thành bước này'
495:             );
496:           }
497:           warehouse = (
498:             await warehouses.getWarehouseById(existing.id, merchantId, actor, true, correlationId)
499:           ).data;
500:         }
501:         persistedData = {
502:           warehouse_id: warehouse.id,
503:           name: warehouse.name,
504:           phone: warehouse.contact_phone,
505:           address: warehouse.address_line,
506:           city: warehouse.city,
507:           district: warehouse.district,
508:         };
509:       }
510: 
511:       const currentCompleted = new Set<string>(currentState.completed_steps || []);
512:       currentCompleted.add(stepDef.id);
513:       const currentSkipped = new Set<string>(currentState.skipped_steps || []);
514:       currentSkipped.delete(stepDef.id);
515: 
516:       const stepData = (currentState.step_data as Record<string, any>) || {};
517:       if (persistedData) {
518:         stepData[stepDef.id.toLowerCase()] = persistedData;
519:       }
520: 
521:       const tempState = {
522:         ...currentState,
523:         completed_steps: Array.from(currentCompleted),
524:         skipped_steps: Array.from(currentSkipped),
525:         step_data: stepData,
526:       };
527: 
528:       const evaluatedLive = await this.evaluateLiveCompleteness(merchantId, tempState, tx);
529:       evaluatedLive.add(stepDef.id);
530:       const requiredSteps = ONBOARDING_STEPS_CATALOG.filter((s) => s.required);
531:       const allRequiredCompleted = requiredSteps.every((s) => evaluatedLive.has(s.id));
532: 
533:       const updated = await tx.onboardingState.update({
534:         where: { id: currentState.id },
535:         data: {
536:           completed_steps: Array.from(currentCompleted),
537:           skipped_steps: Array.from(currentSkipped),
538:           step_data: stepData,
539:           status: allRequiredCompleted
540:             ? OnboardingOverallStatus.COMPLETED
541:             : OnboardingOverallStatus.IN_PROGRESS,
542:           completed_at: allRequiredCompleted
543:             ? currentState.completed_at || new Date()
544:             : currentState.completed_at,
545:         },
546:       });
547: 
548:       await tx.auditLog.create({
549:         data: {
550:           merchant_id: merchantId,
551:           user_id: actor.userId,
552:           actor: actor.role || 'OWNER',
553:           action: 'ONBOARDING_STEP_COMPLETED',
554:           entity_type: 'onboarding',
555:           entity_id: currentState.id,
556:           new_value: {
557:             step_id: stepDef.id,
558:             data:
559:               stepDef.id === OnboardingStepId.WAREHOUSE
560:                 ? { warehouse_id: persistedData?.warehouse_id }
561:                 : maskAuditPayload(normalizedData),
562:           },
563:           reason: correlationId ? `correlation_id:${correlationId}` : null,
564:           ip_address: this.hashIp(clientIp),
565:         },
566:       });
567: 
568:       return { updatedState: updated, liveSatisfied: evaluatedLive };
569:     });
570: 
571:     const responseDto = this.buildResponse(updatedState, liveSatisfied);
572:     return {
573:       success: true,
574:       data: responseDto,
575:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
576:     };
577:   }

579:   /**
580:    * POST /api/v1/onboarding/steps/:stepId/skip (AC-ONB-01-05, AC-ONB-01-06)
581:    */
582:   async skipStep(
583:     merchantId: string,
584:     stepId: string,
585:     actor: ActorContext,
586:     correlationId: string,
587:     clientIp: string
588:   ): Promise<{
589:     success: boolean;
590:     data: OnboardingStateResponseDto;
591:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
592:   }> {
593:     if (!merchantId || actor.merchantId !== merchantId) {
594:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
595:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
596:         'FORBIDDEN',
597:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
598:         false,
599:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
600:       );
601:     }
602: 
603:     if (!VALID_STEP_IDS.includes(stepId)) {
604:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
605:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
606:         'STEP_NOT_FOUND',
607:         `Bước thiết lập "${stepId}" không tồn tại`,
608:         false,
609:         'Vui lòng chọn bước hợp lệ trong danh mục quy trình'
610:       );
611:     }
612: 
613:     const stepDef = ONBOARDING_STEPS_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === stepId)!;
614: 
615:     if (stepDef.required) {
616:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
617:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
618:         'CANNOT_SKIP_REQUIRED_STEP',
619:         `Không thể bỏ qua bước bắt buộc "${stepDef.title}"`,
620:         false,
621:         'Bước này là điều kiện bắt buộc để khởi tạo tài khoản và kích hoạt giao vận'
622:       );
623:     }
624: 
625:     await this.getOrCreateState(merchantId, correlationId, clientIp);
626: 
627:     const { updatedState, liveSatisfied } = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
628:       await this.lockState(tx, merchantId);
629:       const currentState = await tx.onboardingState.findUnique({
630:         where: { merchant_id: merchantId },
631:       });
632:       if (!currentState) {
633:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
634:           HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
635:           'ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND',
636:           'Không tìm thấy dữ liệu thiết lập ban đầu'
637:         );
638:       }
639: 
640:       const currentCompleted = new Set<string>(currentState.completed_steps || []);
641:       currentCompleted.delete(stepDef.id);
642:       const currentSkipped = new Set<string>(currentState.skipped_steps || []);
643:       currentSkipped.add(stepDef.id);
644: 
645:       const updated = await tx.onboardingState.update({
646:         where: { id: currentState.id },
647:         data: {
648:           completed_steps: Array.from(currentCompleted),
649:           skipped_steps: Array.from(currentSkipped),
650:         },
651:       });
652: 
653:       await tx.auditLog.create({
654:         data: {
655:           merchant_id: merchantId,
656:           user_id: actor.userId,
657:           actor: actor.role || 'OWNER',
658:           action: 'ONBOARDING_STEP_SKIPPED',
659:           entity_type: 'onboarding',
660:           entity_id: currentState.id,
661:           new_value: { step_id: stepDef.id },
662:           reason: correlationId ? `correlation_id:${correlationId}` : null,
663:           ip_address: this.hashIp(clientIp),
664:         },
665:       });
666: 
667:       const evaluatedLive = await this.evaluateLiveCompleteness(merchantId, updated, tx);
668:       evaluatedLive.delete(stepDef.id);
669:       return { updatedState: updated, liveSatisfied: evaluatedLive };
670:     });
671: 
672:     const responseDto = this.buildResponse(updatedState, liveSatisfied);
673:     return {
674:       success: true,
675:       data: responseDto,
676:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
677:     };
678:   }

682:    */
683:   async resetOnboarding(

741:         },
742:       });
743: 
744:       return {
745:         updatedState: updated,
746:         liveSatisfied: await this.evaluateLiveCompleteness(merchantId, updated, tx),
747:       };

750:     const responseDto = this.buildResponse(updatedState, liveSatisfied);

758:   /**
759:    * POST /api/v1/onboarding/dismiss (AC-ONB-01-08, AC-ONB-01-09)
760:    */
761:   async dismissOnboarding(
762:     merchantId: string,
763:     actor: ActorContext,
764:     correlationId: string,
765:     clientIp: string
766:   ): Promise<{
767:     success: boolean;
768:     data: OnboardingStateResponseDto;
769:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
770:   }> {
771:     if (!merchantId || actor.merchantId !== merchantId) {
772:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
773:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
774:         'FORBIDDEN',
775:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
776:         false,
777:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
778:       );
779:     }
780: 
781:     await this.getOrCreateState(merchantId, correlationId, clientIp);
782:     const { updatedState, liveSatisfied } = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
783:       await this.lockState(tx, merchantId);
784:       const currentState = await tx.onboardingState.findUnique({
785:         where: { merchant_id: merchantId },
786:       });
787:       if (!currentState) {
788:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
789:           HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
790:           'ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND',
791:           'Không tìm thấy dữ liệu thiết lập ban đầu'
792:         );
793:       }
794: 
795:       const liveSatisfied = await this.evaluateLiveCompleteness(merchantId, currentState, tx);
796: 
797:       const requiredSteps = ONBOARDING_STEPS_CATALOG.filter((s) => s.required);
798:       const incompleteRequired = requiredSteps.filter((s) => !liveSatisfied.has(s.id));
799: 
800:       if (incompleteRequired.length > 0) {
801:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
802:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
803:           'ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE',
804:           'Chưa thể đóng hướng dẫn thiết lập',
805:           false,
806:           'Bạn cần hoàn thành các bước bắt buộc trước khi đóng hướng dẫn',
807:           incompleteRequired.map((s) => ({
808:             field: s.id,
809:             code: 'REQUIRED_STEP_INCOMPLETE',
810:             message: `Bước "${s.title}" chưa được hoàn thành`,
811:           }))
812:         );
813:       }
814: 
815:       const updated = await tx.onboardingState.update({
816:         where: { id: currentState.id },
817:         data: {
818:           status: OnboardingOverallStatus.DISMISSED,
819:         },
820:       });
821: 
822:       await tx.auditLog.create({
823:         data: {
824:           merchant_id: merchantId,
825:           user_id: actor.userId,
826:           actor: actor.role || 'OWNER',
827:           action: 'ONBOARDING_DISMISSED',
828:           entity_type: 'onboarding',
829:           entity_id: currentState.id,
830:           reason: correlationId ? `correlation_id:${correlationId}` : null,
831:           ip_address: this.hashIp(clientIp),
832:         },
833:       });
834: 
835:       return {
836:         updatedState: updated,
837:         liveSatisfied: await this.evaluateLiveCompleteness(merchantId, updated, tx),
838:       };
839:     });
840: 
841:     const responseDto = this.buildResponse(updatedState, liveSatisfied);
842:     return {
843:       success: true,
844:       data: responseDto,
845:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
846:     };
847:   }
848: }

 16: async function runOnboardingSupertestSuite() {

 21:   const envPaths = [
 22:     path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env'),

 31:       for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
 32:         const trimmed = line.trim();
 33:         if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
 34:           const [key, ...rest] = trimmed.split('=');
 35:           const cleanKey = key.trim();
 36:           let val = rest.join('=').trim();
 37:           if (
 38:             (val.startsWith('"') && val.endsWith('"')) ||
 39:             (val.startsWith("'") && val.endsWith("'"))
 40:           ) {
 41:             val = val.slice(1, -1);
 42:           }
 43:           if (!process.env[cleanKey]) {
 44:             process.env[cleanKey] = val;
 45:           }
 46:         }
 47:       }
 48:       break;

227:     const resInit = await request(server)

 48:   ];
 49: 
 50:   const onboardingStates: any[] = [];
 51:   const auditLogs: any[] = [];
 52:   const warehouses: any[] = [];
 53:   const warehouseScopes = ['*'];
 54:   const warehouse = {
 55:     findFirst: async ({ where }: any) =>
 56:       warehouses.find(
 57:         (w) => w.merchant_id === where.merchant_id && (!where.id || w.id === where.id)
 58:       ) ?? null,
 59:     findUnique: async ({ where }: any) =>
 60:       warehouses.find(
 61:         (w) =>
 62:           w.merchant_id === where.merchant_id_code.merchant_id &&
 63:           w.code === where.merchant_id_code.code
 64:       ) ?? null,
 65:     count: async ({ where }: any) =>
 66:       warehouses.filter((w) => w.merchant_id === where.merchant_id).length,
 67:     updateMany: async () => ({ count: 0 }),
 68:     update: async ({ where, data }: any) => {
 69:       const existing = warehouses.find(
 70:         (w) =>
 71:           w.id === where.id_merchant_id.id && w.merchant_id === where.id_merchant_id.merchant_id
 72:       );
 73:       if (!existing) throw new Error('Warehouse not found');
 74:       Object.assign(existing, data);
 75:       return existing;
 76:     },
 77:     create: async ({ data }: any) => {
 78:       const record = { id: `warehouse-${warehouses.length}`, ...data, created_at: new Date() };
 79:       warehouses.push(record);
 80:       return record;
 81:     },
 82:   };
 83:   const merchant = {
 84:     findUnique: async ({ where, include }: any) => {
 85:       const m = merchants.find((m) => m.id === where.id);
 86:       if (!m) return null;
 87:       const result: any = { ...m, warehouses: warehouses.filter((w) => w.merchant_id === m.id) };
 88:       for (const relation of [
 89:         'carrier_accounts',
 90:         'warehouses',
 91:         'users',
 92:         'invitations',
 93:         'orders',
 94:         'shipments',
 95:       ]) {
 96:         const resetAt = include?.[relation]?.where?.created_at?.gt;
 97:         if (resetAt)
 98:           result[relation] = result[relation].filter((row: any) => row.created_at > resetAt);
 99:       }
100:       return result;
101:     },
102:   };
103: 
104:   const mockTx = {
105:     $queryRaw: async () => [],
106:     merchant,
107:     warehouse,
108:     user: { findFirst: async () => ({ warehouse_scopes: warehouseScopes }) },
109:     onboardingState: {
110:       findUnique: async ({ where }: any) => {
111:         return (
112:           onboardingStates.find((s) =>
113:             where.id ? s.id === where.id : s.merchant_id === where.merchant_id
114:           ) || null
115:         );
116:       },
117:       findUniqueOrThrow: async ({ where }: any) =>
118:         onboardingStates.find((s) => s.merchant_id === where.merchant_id),
119:       update: async ({ where, data }: any) => {
120:         const idx = onboardingStates.findIndex((s) =>
121:           where.id ? s.id === where.id : s.merchant_id === where.merchant_id
122:         );
123:         if (idx === -1) throw new Error('OnboardingState not found');
124:         const updated = {
125:           ...onboardingStates[idx],
126:           ...data,
127:           updated_at: new Date(),
128:         };
129:         onboardingStates[idx] = updated;
130:         return updated;
131:       },
132:     },
133:     auditLog: {
134:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
135:         const record = { id: `audit-${auditLogs.length + 1}`, ...data, created_at: new Date() };
136:         auditLogs.push(record);
137:         return record;
138:       },
139:     },
140:   };
141: 
142:   return {
143:     merchants,
144:     onboardingStates,
145:     auditLogs,
146:     merchant,
147:     warehouses,
148:     warehouseScopes,
149:     onboardingState: {
150:       findUnique: async ({ where }: any) => {
151:         return (
152:           onboardingStates.find((s) =>
153:             where.id ? s.id === where.id : s.merchant_id === where.merchant_id
154:           ) || null
155:         );
156:       },
157:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
158:         const record = {
159:           id: `onb-${onboardingStates.length + 1}`,
160:           ...data,
161:           created_at: new Date(),
162:           updated_at: new Date(),
163:         };
164:         onboardingStates.push(record);
165:         return record;
166:       },
167:       findUniqueOrThrow: async ({ where }: any) =>
168:         onboardingStates.find((s) => s.merchant_id === where.merchant_id),
169:       update: async ({ where, data }: any) => {
170:         const idx = onboardingStates.findIndex((s) =>
171:           where.id ? s.id === where.id : s.merchant_id === where.merchant_id
172:         );
173:         if (idx === -1) throw new Error('OnboardingState not found');
174:         const updated = {
175:           ...onboardingStates[idx],
176:           ...data,
177:           updated_at: new Date(),
178:         };
179:         onboardingStates[idx] = updated;
180:         return updated;
181:       },
182:     },
183:     auditLog: {
184:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
185:         const record = { id: `audit-${auditLogs.length + 1}`, ...data, created_at: new Date() };
186:         auditLogs.push(record);
187:         return record;
188:       },
189:     },
190:     $transaction: async (fn: (tx: any) => Promise<any>) => fn(mockTx),
191:   };
192: }

<file path="apps/api/src/rbac/rbac-exception.filter.ts">
 1: import { ExceptionFilter, Catch, ArgumentsHost } from '@nestjs/common';
 2: import { Response } from 'express';
 3: import { CanonicalApiException } from '../auth/auth.service';
 4: 
 5: /**
 6:  * RBAC-scoped canonical exception filter.
 7:  * Preserves canonical error contract while mapping `fields` to `details`
 8:  * exclusively for RBAC endpoints without mutating global CanonicalApiException.
 9:  */
10: @Catch(CanonicalApiException)
11: export class RbacExceptionFilter implements ExceptionFilter {
12:   catch(exception: CanonicalApiException, host: ArgumentsHost) {
13:     const ctx = host.switchToHttp();
14:     const response = ctx.getResponse<Response>();
15:     const status = exception.getStatus();
16:     const payload: any = exception.getResponse();
17: 
18:     if (exception.retryAfterSeconds !== undefined) {
19:       response.setHeader('Retry-After', exception.retryAfterSeconds.toString());
20:     }
21: 
22:     if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && payload.error) {
23:       const errorObj = { ...payload.error };
24:       if (errorObj.fields && errorObj.details === undefined) {
25:         errorObj.details = errorObj.fields;
26:       }
27:       return response.status(status).json({
28:         ...payload,
29:         error: errorObj,
30:       });
31:     }
32: 
33:     response.status(status).json(payload);
34:   }
35: }
</file>
