  1: import { PipeTransform, Injectable, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
  2: import { CanonicalApiException, hasForbiddenRoleTextCharacters } from './rbac.service';
  3: import { CreateRoleDto, UpdateRoleDto } from './rbac.dto';
  4: 
  5: const ALLOWED_ROLE_FIELDS = new Set(['name', 'description', 'permissions']);
  6: 
  7: /**
  8:  * Validates CreateRoleDto at controller boundary (Finding P2-03).
  9:  * Rejects non-object bodies, unexpected extra fields, and format violations with 400 field errors.
 10:  */
 11: @Injectable()
 12: export class CreateRolePipe implements PipeTransform<any, CreateRoleDto> {
 13:   transform(value: any): CreateRoleDto {
 14:     if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
 15:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 16:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 17:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 18:         'Dữ liệu yêu cầu không hợp lệ',
 19:         false,
 20:         'Vui lòng gửi đối tượng JSON hợp lệ',
 21:         [{ field: 'body', code: 'INVALID_BODY', message: 'Dữ liệu yêu cầu phải là đối tượng JSON' }]
 22:       );
 23:     }
 24: 
 25:     // Extra unexpected fields rejection
 26:     const extraFields = Object.keys(value).filter((k) => !ALLOWED_ROLE_FIELDS.has(k));
 27:     if (extraFields.length > 0) {
 28:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 29:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 30:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 31:         `Trường không được hỗ trợ: ${extraFields.join(', ')}`,
 32:         false,
 33:         'Vui lòng loại bỏ các trường không hợp lệ',
 34:         extraFields.map((f) => ({
 35:           field: f,
 36:           code: 'UNEXPECTED_FIELD',
 37:           message: `Trường '${f}' không được hỗ trợ`,
 38:         }))
 39:       );
 40:     }
 41: 
 42:     // Name validation
 43:     if (typeof value.name !== 'string' || value.name.trim().length === 0) {
 44:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 45:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 46:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 47:         'Tên vai trò là bắt buộc',
 48:         false,
 49:         'Vui lòng nhập tên vai trò hợp lệ',
 50:         [{ field: 'name', code: 'REQUIRED', message: 'Tên vai trò không được để trống' }]
 51:       );
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     if (value.name.trim().length > 255) {
 55:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 56:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 57:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 58:         'Tên vai trò không được vượt quá 255 ký tự',
 59:         false,
 60:         'Vui lòng nhập tên vai trò ngắn hơn 255 ký tự',
 61:         [
 62:           {
 63:             field: 'name',
 64:             code: 'MAX_LENGTH',
 65:             message: 'Tên vai trò không được vượt quá 255 ký tự',
 66:           },
 67:         ]
 68:       );
 69:     }
 70: 
 71:     if (hasForbiddenRoleTextCharacters(value.name)) {
 72:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 73:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 74:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 75:         'Tên vai trò không được chứa ký tự <, > hoặc ký tự điều khiển',
 76:         false,
 77:         'Vui lòng nhập tên vai trò hợp lệ không chứa ký tự đặc biệt',
 78:         [
 79:           {
 80:             field: 'name',
 81:             code: 'INVALID_CHARACTERS',
 82:             message: 'Tên vai trò không được chứa ký tự <, > hoặc ký tự điều khiển',
 83:           },
 84:         ]
 85:       );
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     // Description validation
 89:     if (value.description !== undefined && value.description !== null) {
 90:       if (typeof value.description !== 'string') {
 91:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 92:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 93:           'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 94:           'Mô tả vai trò phải là chuỗi ký tự',
 95:           false,
 96:           'Vui lòng nhập mô tả hợp lệ',
 97:           [
 98:             {
 99:               field: 'description',
100:               code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
101:               message: 'Mô tả vai trò phải là chuỗi ký tự',
102:             },
103:           ]
104:         );
105:       }
106:       if (value.description.length > 1000) {
107:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
108:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
109:           'VALIDATION_ERROR',
110:           'Mô tả vai trò không được vượt quá 1000 ký tự',
111:           false,
112:           'Vui lòng nhập mô tả ngắn hơn 1000 ký tự',
113:           [
114:             {
115:               field: 'description',
116:               code: 'MAX_LENGTH',
117:               message: 'Mô tả vai trò không được vượt quá 1000 ký tự',
118:             },
119:           ]
120:         );
121:       }
122:       if (hasForbiddenRoleTextCharacters(value.description)) {
123:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
124:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
125:           'VALIDATION_ERROR',
126:           'Mô tả vai trò không được chứa ký tự <, > hoặc ký tự điều khiển',
127:           false,
128:           'Vui lòng nhập mô tả hợp lệ không chứa ký tự đặc biệt',
129:           [

133:               message: 'Mô tả vai trò không được chứa ký tự <, > hoặc ký tự điều khiển',
134:             },
135:           ]
136:         );
137:       }
138:     }
139: 
140:     // Permissions validation
141:     if (!value.permissions || !Array.isArray(value.permissions) || value.permissions.length === 0) {
142:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
143:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
144:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
145:         'Cần chọn ít nhất một quyền hạn',
146:         false,
147:         'Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một quyền hạn từ danh mục',
148:         [{ field: 'permissions', code: 'REQUIRED', message: 'Danh sách quyền không được để trống' }]
149:       );
150:     }
151:     if (value.permissions.length > 50) {
152:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
153:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
154:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
155:         'Danh sách quyền hạn không được vượt quá 50 mục',
156:         false,
157:         'Vui lòng chọn tối đa 50 quyền hạn',
158:         [
159:           {
160:             field: 'permissions',
161:             code: 'MAX_ITEMS',
162:             message: 'Danh sách quyền hạn không được vượt quá 50 mục',
163:           },
164:         ]
165:       );
166:     }
167:     for (let i = 0; i < value.permissions.length; i++) {
168:       if (typeof value.permissions[i] !== 'string' || value.permissions[i].trim().length === 0) {
169:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
170:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
171:           'VALIDATION_ERROR',
172:           'Mã quyền hạn phải là chuỗi ký tự hợp lệ',
173:           false,
174:           'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại danh sách quyền hạn',
175:           [
176:             {
177:               field: `permissions[${i}]`,
178:               code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
179:               message: 'Mã quyền hạn phải là chuỗi ký tự',
180:             },
181:           ]
182:         );
183:       }
184:     }
185: 
186:     return value as CreateRoleDto;
187:   }
188: }

363:               {
364:                 field: `permissions[${i}]`,
365:                 code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
366:                 message: 'Mã quyền hạn phải là chuỗi ký tự',
367:               },

369:           );
370:         }
371:       }

 19: import { SessionGuard } from '../session/session.guard';
 20: import { RbacSeedGuard } from './rbac.guard';
 21: import { RbacExceptionFilter } from './rbac-exception.filter';
 22: import { normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
 23: import { extractClientIp } from '../utils/ip.util';
 24: 
 25: @Controller('api/v1')
 26: @UseGuards(RbacSeedGuard, SessionGuard)
 27: @UseFilters(RbacExceptionFilter)
 28: export class RbacController {
 29:   constructor(@Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService: RbacService) {}
 30: 
 31:   private async resolveActor(req: any): Promise<ActorContext> {
 32:     return this.rbacService.resolveActorFromSession(req);
 33:   }
 34: 
 35:   /**
 36:    * GET /api/v1/permissions (AC-RBAC-01-01)
 37:    * Enforces actor resolution so only active authenticated tenant members can read permissions catalog (P1-02 / defense-in-depth).
 38:    */
 39:   @Get('permissions')
 40:   async getPermissions(@Req() req: any) {
 41:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
 42:     await this.resolveActor(req);
 43:     return this.rbacService.getPermissions(correlationId);
 44:   }
 45: 
 46:   /**
 47:    * GET /api/v1/roles (AC-RBAC-01-02)
 48:    */
 49:   @Get('roles')
 50:   async getRoles(@Req() req: any) {
 51:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
 52:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 53:     return this.rbacService.getRoles(actor.merchantId, correlationId, actor);
 54:   }
 55: 
 56:   /**
 57:    * GET /api/v1/roles/:id (AC-RBAC-01-11)
 58:    */
 59:   @Get('roles/:id')
 60:   async getRoleById(@Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: any) {
 61:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
 62:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 63:     return this.rbacService.getRoleById(id, actor, correlationId);
 64:   }
 65: 
 66:   /**
 67:    * POST /api/v1/roles (AC-RBAC-01-03, 04, 05, 12, 13, 14, 15)
 68:    */
 69:   @Post('roles')
 70:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
 71:   async createRole(@Body(CreateRolePipe) dto: CreateRoleDto, @Req() req: any) {
 72:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
 73:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
 74:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 75:     return this.rbacService.createRole(dto, actor, clientIp, correlationId);
 76:   }
 77: 
 78:   /**
 79:    * PATCH /api/v1/roles/:id (AC-RBAC-01-06, 08, 11)
 80:    */
 81:   @Patch('roles/:id')
 82:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
 83:   async updateRole(
 84:     @Param('id') id: string,
 85:     @Body(UpdateRolePipe) dto: UpdateRoleDto,
 86:     @Req() req: any
 87:   ) {
 88:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
 89:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
 90:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 91:     return this.rbacService.updateRole(id, dto, actor, clientIp, correlationId);
 92:   }
 93: 
 94:   /**
 95:    * DELETE /api/v1/roles/:id (AC-RBAC-01-07, 09, 10, 11)
 96:    */
 97:   @Delete('roles/:id')
 98:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
 99:   async deleteRole(@Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: any) {
100:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
101:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
102:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
103:     return this.rbacService.deleteRole(id, actor, clientIp, correlationId);
104:   }
105: }

<file path="apps/api/src/rbac/rbac.guard.ts">
 1: import {
 2:   Injectable,
 3:   CanActivate,
 4:   ExecutionContext,
 5:   SetMetadata,
 6:   HttpStatus,
 7:   Inject,
 8: } from '@nestjs/common';
 9: import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
10: import { RbacService, CanonicalApiException } from './rbac.service';
11: 
12: export const PERMISSIONS_KEY = 'rbac_required_permissions';
13: export const RequirePermissions = (...permissions: string[]) =>
14:   SetMetadata(PERMISSIONS_KEY, permissions);
15: 
16: @Injectable()
17: export class RbacSeedGuard implements CanActivate {
18:   constructor(@Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService: RbacService) {}
19: 
20:   canActivate(): boolean {
21:     this.rbacService.assertPlatformSeedReady();
22:     return true;
23:   }
24: }
25: 
26: @Injectable()
27: export class PermissionsGuard implements CanActivate {
28:   constructor(
29:     @Inject(Reflector) private readonly reflector: Reflector,
30:     @Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService: RbacService
31:   ) {}
32: 
33:   async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
34:     this.rbacService.assertPlatformSeedReady();
35: 
36:     const requiredPermissions = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<string[]>(PERMISSIONS_KEY, [
37:       context.getHandler(),
38:       context.getClass(),
39:     ]);
40: 
41:     if (!requiredPermissions || requiredPermissions.length === 0) {
42:       return true;
43:     }
44: 
45:     const req = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
46:     const actor = await this.rbacService.resolveActorFromSession(req);
47: 
48:     const hasAll = await this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actor, requiredPermissions);
49:     if (!hasAll) {
50:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
51:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
52:         'FORBIDDEN',
53:         'Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này',
54:         false,
55:         'Vui lòng liên hệ Chủ Shop để được cấp quyền'
56:       );
57:     }
58: 
59:     req.actorContext = actor;
60:     return true;
61:   }
62: }
</file>

   1: import {
   2:   Injectable,

   9: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
  10: import { RoleEnum } from '@prisma/client';
  11: import { CanonicalApiException as BaseCanonicalApiException } from '../auth/auth.service';
  12: import {
  13:   formatStructuredLog,
  14:   sanitizeErrorMessage,
  15:   AppConfig,
  16:   WORKSPACE_ENV,
  17: } from '@shipde/config';
  18: import { APP_CONFIG } from '../config.token';
  19: 
  20: export class CanonicalApiException extends BaseCanonicalApiException {
  21:   constructor(
  22:     statusCode: HttpStatus,
  23:     code: string,
  24:     message: string,
  25:     retryable: boolean = false,
  26:     nextAction?: string,
  27:     fields?: any[],
  28:     retryAfterSeconds?: number,
  29:     extra?: Record<string, any>
  30:   ) {
  31:     super(statusCode, code, message, retryable, nextAction, fields, retryAfterSeconds, extra);
  32:     this.message = message;
  33:   }
  34: }
  35: import {
  36:   PLATFORM_PERMISSIONS,
  37:   SYSTEM_ROLES,
  38:   CanonicalPermissionDefinition,
  39: } from './rbac.constants';
  40: import { CreateRoleDto, UpdateRoleDto, ActorContext } from './rbac.dto';
  41: export type { ActorContext } from './rbac.dto';
  42: 
  43: const isRoleEnumValue = (code: string | null): code is RoleEnum => {
  44:   return Boolean(code && Object.values(RoleEnum).includes(code as any));
  45: };
  46: 
  47: export const ACTIVE_USER_STATUS_FILTER = {
  48:   equals: 'active',
  49:   mode: 'insensitive' as const,
  50: };
  51: 
  52: export function isUserActiveStatus(status?: string | null): boolean {
  53:   return typeof status === 'string' && status.trim().toLowerCase() === 'active';
  54: }
  55: 
  56: export function isRoleNameUniqueViolation(err: any): boolean {
  57:   if (err?.code !== 'P2002') return false;
  58:   const target = err?.meta?.target;
  59:   if (Array.isArray(target)) {
  60:     return (
  61:       target.includes('name_lower') || (target.includes('merchant_id') && target.includes('name'))
  62:     );
  63:   }
  64:   if (typeof target === 'string') {
  65:     return target.includes('name_lower') || target.includes('roles_merchant_id_name_lower_key');
  66:   }
  67:   const message = String(err?.message || '');
  68:   return (
  69:     message.includes('roles_merchant_id_name_lower_key') ||
  70:     (message.includes('name_lower') && message.includes('merchant_id'))
  71:   );
  72: }
  73: 
  74: export function isDeadlockOrSerializationError(err: any): boolean {
  75:   if (!err) return false;
  76:   const code = String(err.code || err.statusCode || '');
  77:   const msg = String(err.message || '');
  78:   return (
  79:     code === '40P01' || // PostgreSQL deadlock_detected
  80:     code === '40001' || // PostgreSQL serialization_failure
  81:     code === 'P2034' || // Prisma transaction conflict / deadlock
  82:     /deadlock detected/i.test(msg) ||
  83:     /could not serialize access/i.test(msg) ||
  84:     /concurrent update/i.test(msg) ||
  85:     /deadlock/i.test(msg)
  86:   );
  87: }
  88: 
  89: export function createConcurrencyConflictException(): CanonicalApiException {
  90:   return new CanonicalApiException(
  91:     HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
  92:     'CONFLICT',
  93:     'Xung đột giao dịch đồng thời khi xử lý vai trò phân quyền',
  94:     true,
  95:     'Vui lòng thử lại thao tác'
  96:   );
  97: }
  98: 
  99: // Validation helper rejecting angle brackets (<, >) and ASCII control characters (Finding / P2-01)
 100: // Defense-in-depth: backend rejects dangerous characters with VALIDATION_ERROR; React handles standard output escaping.
 101: export const FORBIDDEN_CHARACTERS_REGEX = /[<>\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/;
 102: 
 103: export function hasForbiddenRoleTextCharacters(text?: string | null): boolean {
 104:   if (typeof text !== 'string') return false;
 105:   return FORBIDDEN_CHARACTERS_REGEX.test(text);
 106: }
 107: 
 108: // Deterministic UUID generator for canonical platform permissions & system roles
 109: function deterministicUuid(prefix: string, index: number): string {
 110:   const hex = index.toString(16).padStart(12, '0');
 111:   return `${prefix}-0000-0000-0000-${hex}`;
 112: }
 113: 
 114: const PERMISSION_UUID_PREFIX = '11111111';
 115: const SYSTEM_ROLE_UUID_PREFIX = '22222222';
 116: 
 117: const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
 118: 
 119: function buildPermissionFilter(permissions: string[]) {
 120:   const uuidIds = permissions.filter((p) => UUID_REGEX.test(p));
 121:   const orConditions: any[] = [{ code: { in: permissions } }];
 122:   if (uuidIds.length > 0) {
 123:     orConditions.push({ id: { in: uuidIds } });
 124:   }
 125:   return { OR: orConditions };
 126: }
 127: 
 128: export const SYSTEM_ROLE_IDS: Record<string, string> = {
 129:   OWNER: deterministicUuid(SYSTEM_ROLE_UUID_PREFIX, 1),
 130:   OPS_CSKH: deterministicUuid(SYSTEM_ROLE_UUID_PREFIX, 2),
 131:   WAREHOUSE: deterministicUuid(SYSTEM_ROLE_UUID_PREFIX, 3),
 132:   ACCOUNTANT: deterministicUuid(SYSTEM_ROLE_UUID_PREFIX, 4),
 133:   FINANCE: deterministicUuid(SYSTEM_ROLE_UUID_PREFIX, 5),
 134: };
 135: 
 136: export const SENSITIVE_CAPABILITY_PERMISSIONS = new Set([
 137:   'pii:unmask',
 138:   'iam:grant_action_permission',
 139:   'reconciliation:approve_rate_policy',
 140: ]);
 141: 
 142: export const MFA_FRESH_WINDOW_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes
 143: 
 144: export function isMfaAssuranceFresh(
 145:   authAssurance?: string,
 146:   mfaVerifiedAt?: Date | string | null
 147: ): boolean {
 148:   if (authAssurance !== 'MFA' || !mfaVerifiedAt) {
 149:     return false;
 150:   }
 151:   const verifiedTime = new Date(mfaVerifiedAt).getTime();
 152:   if (Number.isNaN(verifiedTime)) {
 153:     return false;
 154:   }
 155:   const ageMs = Date.now() - verifiedTime;
 156:   return ageMs >= -60000 && ageMs <= MFA_FRESH_WINDOW_MS;
 157: }
 158: 
 159: export const NODE_MAX_TIMER_MS = 2_147_483_647;
 160: export const MAX_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS = 30_000;
 161: 
 162: @Injectable()
 163: export class RbacService implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
 164:   private isSeeded = false;
 165:   private isDestroyed = false;
 166:   private retryTimeoutHandle: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
 167:   private retryResolve: (() => void) | null = null;
 168:   public inFlightSeedPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;
 169:   public seedPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;
 170: 
 171:   constructor(
 172:     @Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
 173:     @Optional() @Inject(APP_CONFIG) private readonly config?: AppConfig
 174:   ) {}
 175: 
 176:   isReady(): boolean {
 177:     return this.isSeeded;
 178:   }
 179: 
 180:   assertPlatformSeedReady(): void {
 181:     if (!this.isReady()) {
 182:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 183:         HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
 184:         'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE',
 185:         'Danh mục phân quyền hệ thống đang được khởi tạo, vui lòng thử lại sau',
 186:         true,
 187:         'Vui lòng thử lại sau'
 188:       );
 189:     }
 190:   }
 191: 
 192:   private resolveRetryIntervalMs(): number {
 193:     const val =
 194:       this.config?.RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS ?? WORKSPACE_ENV.DEFAULT_RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS;
 195:     return Math.min(Math.max(1, val), NODE_MAX_TIMER_MS);
 196:   }
 197: 
 198:   private resolveMaxAttempts(): number {
 199:     return this.config?.RBAC_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS ?? WORKSPACE_ENV.DEFAULT_RBAC_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS;
 200:   }
 201: 
 202:   private resolveBackoffFactor(): number {
 203:     return this.config?.RBAC_SEED_BACKOFF_FACTOR ?? WORKSPACE_ENV.DEFAULT_RBAC_SEED_BACKOFF_FACTOR;
 204:   }
 205: 
 206:   async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
 207:     if (typeof this.prisma?.$transaction !== 'function') {
 208:       this.isSeeded = false;
 209:       return;
 210:     }
 211:     // Startup is non-blocking (AC-FOUND-03-04, AC-FOUND-03-06).
 212:     // Bounded retry loop runs in background until platform seed succeeds.
 213:     this.seedPromise = this.executePlatformSeedWithRetry();
 214:     void this.seedPromise.catch(() => {
 215:       // Unhandled rejection safety
 216:     });
 217:   }
 218: 
 219:   async executePlatformSeedWithRetry(): Promise<void> {
 220:     if (this.isSeeded) return;
 221: 
 222:     const retryIntervalMs = this.resolveRetryIntervalMs();
 223:     const maxAttempts = this.resolveMaxAttempts();
 224:     const backoffFactor = this.resolveBackoffFactor();
 225: 
 226:     let currentDelayMs = retryIntervalMs;
 227: 
 228:     for (
 229:       let attempt = 1;
 230:       attempt <= maxAttempts && !this.isSeeded && !this.isDestroyed;
 231:       attempt++
 232:     ) {
 233:       try {
 234:         await this.ensurePlatformSeed();
 235:         console.info(
 236:           formatStructuredLog({
 237:             level: 'info',
 238:             service: 'api',
 239:             message: 'RBAC platform permissions and system roles seeded successfully',
 240:             metadata: { attempt },
 241:           })
 242:         );
 243:         return;
 244:       } catch (err: unknown) {
 245:         // A failed attempt never clears a newer success (Finding 2)
 246:         const isLastAttempt = attempt >= maxAttempts;
 247:         const originalError = (err as any)?.originalError ?? err;
 248:         const sanitizedCause = sanitizeErrorMessage(originalError);
 249: 
 250:         console.error(
 251:           formatStructuredLog({
 252:             level: 'error',
 253:             service: 'api',
 254:             message: `RBAC platform seed attempt ${attempt}/${maxAttempts} failed: ${sanitizedCause}`,
 255:             metadata: {
 256:               attempt,
 257:               maxAttempts,
 258:               retryable: !isLastAttempt,
 259:               nextRetryDelayMs: isLastAttempt ? null : currentDelayMs,
 260:             },
 261:           })
 262:         );
 263: 
 264:         if (!isLastAttempt && !this.isDestroyed && !this.isSeeded) {
 265:           await this.delay(currentDelayMs);
 266:           currentDelayMs = Math.min(
 267:             Math.round(currentDelayMs * backoffFactor),
 268:             MAX_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS
 269:           );
 270:         }
 271:       }
 272:     }
 273: 
 274:     if (!this.isSeeded && !this.isDestroyed) {
 275:       console.error(
 276:         formatStructuredLog({
 277:           level: 'error',
 278:           service: 'api',
 279:           message:
 280:             'RBAC platform seed exhausted initial retry attempts; continuing background retries with capped backoff',
 281:           metadata: { maxAttempts },
 282:         })
 283:       );
 284: 
 285:       // Keep retrying in background with capped backoff instead of giving up permanently (Residual risk recovery)
 286:       void this.continueIndefiniteBackgroundRetry(currentDelayMs, backoffFactor, maxAttempts).catch(
 287:         () => {}
 288:       );
 289:     }
 290:   }
 291: 
 292:   private async continueIndefiniteBackgroundRetry(
 293:     initialDelayMs: number,
 294:     backoffFactor: number,
 295:     initialAttempts: number
 296:   ): Promise<void> {
 297:     let currentDelayMs = Math.min(Math.round(initialDelayMs * backoffFactor), MAX_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS);
 298:     let attempt = initialAttempts + 1;
 299: 
 300:     while (!this.isSeeded && !this.isDestroyed) {
 301:       await this.delay(currentDelayMs);
 302:       if (this.isSeeded || this.isDestroyed) break;
 303: 
 304:       try {
 305:         await this.ensurePlatformSeed();
 306:         console.info(
 307:           formatStructuredLog({
 308:             level: 'info',
 309:             service: 'api',
 310:             message: 'RBAC platform permissions and system roles seeded successfully',
 311:             metadata: { attempt },
 312:           })
 313:         );
 314:         return;
 315:       } catch (err: unknown) {
 316:         const originalError = (err as any)?.originalError ?? err;
 317:         const sanitizedCause = sanitizeErrorMessage(originalError);
 318:         console.error(
 319:           formatStructuredLog({
 320:             level: 'error',
 321:             service: 'api',
 322:             message: `RBAC platform seed background retry attempt ${attempt} failed: ${sanitizedCause}`,
 323:             metadata: {
 324:               attempt,
 325:               retryable: true,
 326:               nextRetryDelayMs: currentDelayMs,
 327:             },
 328:           })
 329:         );
 330:         currentDelayMs = Math.min(Math.round(currentDelayMs * backoffFactor), MAX_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS);
 331:         attempt++;
 332:       }
 333:     }
 334:   }
 335: 
 336:   private async delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {
 337:     const clampedMs = Math.min(Math.max(0, ms), NODE_MAX_TIMER_MS);
 338:     return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
 339:       this.retryResolve = resolve;
 340:       this.retryTimeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => {
 341:         this.retryTimeoutHandle = null;
 342:         this.retryResolve = null;
 343:         resolve();
 344:       }, clampedMs);
 345:     });
 346:   }
 347: 
 348:   onModuleDestroy(): void {
 349:     this.isDestroyed = true;
 350:     if (this.retryTimeoutHandle) {
 351:       clearTimeout(this.retryTimeoutHandle);
 352:       this.retryTimeoutHandle = null;
 353:     }
 354:     if (this.retryResolve) {
 355:       const resolve = this.retryResolve;
 356:       this.retryResolve = null;
 357:       resolve();
 358:     }
 359:   }
 360: 
 361:   /**
 362:    * Ensures platform permissions and system roles are populated in the database.
 363:    * Runs as a single atomic transaction reconciling system roles and permissions (Finding 8 / BR-RBAC-01).
 364:    * Shares a single in-flight promise to prevent concurrent duplicate execution (Finding 2).
 365:    */
 366:   async ensurePlatformSeed(): Promise<void> {
 367:     if (this.isSeeded) return;
 368: 
 369:     if (this.inFlightSeedPromise) {
 370:       return this.inFlightSeedPromise;
 371:     }
 372: 
 373:     const runSeed = async (): Promise<void> => {
 374:       try {
 375:         if (typeof this.prisma?.$transaction !== 'function') {
 376:           throw new Error('Prisma $transaction is not available');
 377:         }
 378: 
 379:         await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 380:           // 1. Upsert all canonical platform permissions
 381:           for (let i = 0; i < PLATFORM_PERMISSIONS.length; i++) {
 382:             const p = PLATFORM_PERMISSIONS[i];
 383:             const permId = deterministicUuid(PERMISSION_UUID_PREFIX, i + 1);
 384:             await tx.permission.upsert({
 385:               where: { code: p.code },
 386:               update: {
 387:                 name: p.name,
 388:                 description: p.description,
 389:                 category: p.category,
 390:               },
 391:               create: {
 392:                 id: permId,
 393:                 code: p.code,
 394:                 name: p.name,
 395:                 description: p.description,
 396:                 category: p.category,
 397:               },
 398:             });
 399:           }
 400: 
 401:           // Fetch all permission mappings by code within the transaction
 402:           const allPerms = await tx.permission.findMany();
 403:           const permMap = new Map<string, string>(allPerms.map((p) => [p.code, p.id]));
 404: 
 405:           // 2. Reconcile all built-in system roles transactionally
 406:           for (let i = 0; i < SYSTEM_ROLES.length; i++) {
 407:             const sr = SYSTEM_ROLES[i];
 408:             const roleId =
 409:               SYSTEM_ROLE_IDS[sr.code] || deterministicUuid(SYSTEM_ROLE_UUID_PREFIX, i + 1);
 410: 
 411:             const role = await tx.role.upsert({
 412:               where: { code: sr.code },
 413:               update: {
 414:                 name: sr.name,
 415:                 name_lower: sr.name.toLowerCase(),
 416:                 description: sr.description,
 417:                 is_system: true,
 418:               },
 419:               create: {
 420:                 id: roleId,
 421:                 code: sr.code,
 422:                 name: sr.name,
 423:                 name_lower: sr.name.toLowerCase(),
 424:                 description: sr.description,
 425:                 is_system: true,
 426:                 merchant_id: null,
 427:               },
 428:             });
 429: 
 430:             // Reconcile role_permissions: add missing, delete obsolete
 431:             const desiredPermIds = new Set(
 432:               sr.permissions.map((code) => permMap.get(code)).filter(Boolean) as string[]
 433:             );
 434:             const existingRolePerms = await tx.rolePermission.findMany({
 435:               where: { role_id: role.id },
 436:             });
 437: 
 438:             // Delete permissions no longer in SYSTEM_ROLES
 439:             const toDelete = existingRolePerms.filter(
 440:               (rp) => !desiredPermIds.has(rp.permission_id)
 441:             );
 442:             if (toDelete.length > 0) {
 443:               await tx.rolePermission.deleteMany({
 444:                 where: {
 445:                   role_id: role.id,
 446:                   permission_id: { in: toDelete.map((rp) => rp.permission_id) },
 447:                 },
 448:               });
 449:             }
 450: 
 451:             // Insert missing permissions
 452:             const existingPermIdSet = new Set(existingRolePerms.map((rp) => rp.permission_id));
 453:             const toInsert = Array.from(desiredPermIds).filter(
 454:               (pid) => !existingPermIdSet.has(pid)
 455:             );
 456:             for (const pId of toInsert) {
 457:               await tx.rolePermission.create({
 458:                 data: {
 459:                   role_id: role.id,
 460:                   permission_id: pId,
 461:                 },
 462:               });
 463:             }
 464: 
 465:             // Append audit record for every system-role permission change (Finding 1 / Round 12 / BR-RBAC-07 / BR-RBAC-04)
 466:             // Platform seed audit must not depend on a customer merchant; uses nullable platform actor matching audit schema
 467:             if (toDelete.length > 0 || toInsert.length > 0) {
 468:               await tx.auditLog.create({
 469:                 data: {
 470:                   merchant_id: null,
 471:                   user_id: null,
 472:                   action: 'SYSTEM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS_RECONCILED',
 473:                   entity_type: 'Role',
 474:                   entity_id: role.id,
 475:                   old_value: {
 476:                     code: sr.code,
 477:                     permissions: existingRolePerms.map((rp) => rp.permission_id),
 478:                   },
 479:                   new_value: {
 480:                     code: sr.code,
 481:                     permissions: Array.from(desiredPermIds),
 482:                   },
 483:                   reason: 'System role seed reconciliation',
 484:                 },
 485:               });
 486:             }
 487:           }
 488:         });
 489: 
 490:         this.isSeeded = true;
 491:       } catch (err: any) {
 492:         // Finding 2 & Finding 5:
 493:         // A failed attempt NEVER clears an existing success (e.g. if another caller committed)!
 494:         // Preserve original error cause sanitized for observability.
 495:         const originalError = err;
 496:         const sanitizedCause = sanitizeErrorMessage(originalError);
 497:         const canonicalEx = new CanonicalApiException(
 498:           HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
 499:           'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE',
 500:           'Không thể khởi tạo danh mục quyền hệ thống',
 501:           true,
 502:           'Vui lòng thử lại sau',
 503:           undefined,
 504:           undefined,
 505:           { originalCause: sanitizedCause }
 506:         );
 507:         (canonicalEx as any).originalError = originalError;
 508:         throw canonicalEx;
 509:       } finally {
 510:         this.inFlightSeedPromise = null;
 511:       }
 512:     };
 513: 
 514:     const promise = runSeed();
 515:     this.inFlightSeedPromise = promise;
 516:     return promise;
 517:   }

 519:   /**
 520:    * GET /api/v1/permissions (AC-RBAC-01-01)
 521:    */
 522:   async getPermissions(correlationId: string) {
 523:     try {
 524:       const dbPermissions = await this.prisma.permission.findMany({
 525:         orderBy: [{ category: 'asc' }, { code: 'asc' }],
 526:       });
 527: 
 528:       const categories = Array.from(new Set(dbPermissions.map((p) => p.category)));
 529: 
 530:       return {
 531:         data: {
 532:           permissions: dbPermissions.map((p) => ({
 533:             id: p.id,
 534:             code: p.code,
 535:             name: p.name,
 536:             description: p.description,
 537:             category: p.category,
 538:           })),
 539:           categories,
 540:         },
 541:         meta: {
 542:           correlation_id: correlationId,
 543:         },
 544:       };
 545:     } catch (err: any) {
 546:       if (err instanceof CanonicalApiException) throw err;
 547:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 548:         HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 549:         'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
 550:         'Không thể tải danh mục quyền hạn',
 551:         true,
 552:         'Vui lòng thử lại sau hoặc liên hệ hỗ trợ'
 553:       );
 554:     }
 555:   }

 557:   /**
 558:    * Resolves the authoritative actor context from the server session userId.
 559:    * Discards client/JWT-supplied roles to prevent privilege escalation via stale claims.
 560:    */
 561:   async resolveActorFromSession(req: {
 562:     userId?: string;
 563:     merchantId?: string;
 564:     sessionId?: string;
 565:     authAssurance?: string;
 566:     mfaVerifiedAt?: any;
 567:     jwtClaims?: any;
 568:     userRole?: string;
 569:     customRoleId?: string;
 570:   }): Promise<ActorContext> {
 571:     if (!req.userId) {
 572:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 573:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 574:         'FORBIDDEN',
 575:         'Phiên làm việc không có định danh người dùng hợp lệ',
 576:         false,
 577:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
 578:       );
 579:     }
 580: 
 581:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
 582:       where: { id: req.userId },
 583:       select: {
 584:         id: true,
 585:         role: true,
 586:         custom_role_id: true,
 587:         merchant_id: true,
 588:         status: true,
 589:       },
 590:     });
 591: 
 592:     if (!user) {
 593:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 594:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 595:         'FORBIDDEN',
 596:         'Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc đã bị thu hồi quyền',
 597:         false,
 598:         'Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên'
 599:       );
 600:     }
 601: 
 602:     if (!isUserActiveStatus(user.status)) {
 603:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 604:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 605:         'FORBIDDEN',
 606:         'Tài khoản người dùng đã bị vô hiệu hóa hoặc chưa kích hoạt',
 607:         false,
 608:         'Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên'
 609:       );
 610:     }
 611: 
 612:     if (!user.merchant_id) {
 613:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 614:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 615:         'FORBIDDEN',
 616:         'Người dùng không thuộc tổ chức hợp lệ',
 617:         false,
 618:         'Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên'
 619:       );
 620:     }
 621: 
 622:     if (req.merchantId && user.merchant_id !== req.merchantId) {
 623:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 624:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 625:         'FORBIDDEN',
 626:         'Người dùng không thuộc tổ chức hiện tại',
 627:         false,
 628:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại quyền truy cập'
 629:       );
 630:     }
 631: 
 632:     // Finding 1 / Round 13 / Finding 3 / Round 14 (P1-03): Only accept server-resolved sessionId; populate authAssurance and mfaVerifiedAt from active device_session
 633:     const sessionId = req.sessionId ? req.sessionId : undefined;
 634:     let authAssurance: string | undefined = undefined;
 635:     let mfaVerifiedAt: Date | string | null | undefined = undefined;
 636: 
 637:     if (sessionId) {
 638:       try {
 639:         const sessionRow = await (this.prisma as any).deviceSession?.findUnique?.({
 640:           where: { id: sessionId },
 641:           select: {
 642:             id: true,
 643:             user_id: true,
 644:             status: true,
 645:             expires_at: true,
 646:             auth_assurance: true,
 647:             mfa_verified_at: true,
 648:           },
 649:         });
 650:         if (
 651:           sessionRow &&
 652:           sessionRow.user_id === user.id &&
 653:           sessionRow.status === 'ACTIVE' &&
 654:           new Date(sessionRow.expires_at) > new Date()
 655:         ) {
 656:           authAssurance = sessionRow.auth_assurance;
 657:           mfaVerifiedAt = sessionRow.mfa_verified_at;
 658:         }
 659:       } catch {
 660:         // Fall back to undefined; in-transaction lockAndAuthorizeActor will query device_sessions under FOR UPDATE
 661:       }
 662:     }
 663: 
 664:     return {
 665:       userId: user.id,
 666:       merchantId: user.merchant_id,
 667:       role: user.role,
 668:       customRoleId: user.custom_role_id ?? undefined,
 669:       sessionId,
 670:       authAssurance,
 671:       mfaVerifiedAt,
 672:     };
 673:   }

 675:   /**
 676:    * Resolves effective permission codes held by the given actor.
 677:    */
 678:   async getActorPermissions(actor: ActorContext, txClient?: any): Promise<string[]> {
 679:     const db = txClient || this.prisma;
 680: 
 681:     let customRoleId = actor.customRoleId;
 682:     let role = actor.role;
 683:     let merchantId = actor.merchantId;
 684: 
 685:     if (actor.userId) {
 686:       try {
 687:         const user = await db.user.findUnique({
 688:           where: { id: actor.userId },
 689:           select: { role: true, custom_role_id: true, merchant_id: true, status: true },
 690:         });
 691:         if (!user) {
 692:           return [];
 693:         }
 694:         if (!isUserActiveStatus(user.status)) {
 695:           return [];
 696:         }
 697:         role = user.role;
 698:         customRoleId = user.custom_role_id ?? undefined;
 699:         merchantId = user.merchant_id || merchantId;
 700:       } catch (err) {
 701:         if (err instanceof CanonicalApiException) throw err;
 702:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 703:           HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
 704:           'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE',
 705:           'Không thể tải thông tin người dùng lúc này',
 706:           true
 707:         );
 708:       }
 709:     }
 710: 
 711:     // Custom role ceiling takes precedence over enum role
 712:     if (customRoleId) {
 713:       let customRole: any = null;
 714:       try {
 715:         customRole = await db.role.findFirst({
 716:           where: { id: customRoleId, merchant_id: merchantId },
 717:           include: {
 718:             permissions: {
 719:               include: { permission: true },
 720:             },
 721:           },
 722:         });
 723:       } catch (err) {
 724:         if (err instanceof CanonicalApiException) throw err;
 725:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 726:           HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
 727:           'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE',
 728:           'Không thể tải thông tin vai trò tùy chỉnh lúc này',
 729:           true
 730:         );
 731:       }
 732:       if (!customRole) {
 733:         return [];
 734:       }
 735:       return customRole.permissions.map((rp: any) => rp.permission.code);
 736:     }
 737: 
 738:     // System role resolution directly from reconciled DB rows (Finding 8 / BR-RBAC-01)
 739:     if (role) {
 740:       let sysRole: any = null;
 741:       try {
 742:         sysRole = await db.role.findFirst({
 743:           where: { code: role, is_system: true },
 744:           include: {
 745:             permissions: {
 746:               include: { permission: true },
 747:             },
 748:           },
 749:         });
 750:       } catch (err) {
 751:         if (err instanceof CanonicalApiException) throw err;
 752:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 753:           HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
 754:           'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE',
 755:           'Không thể tải thông tin vai trò hệ thống lúc này',
 756:           true
 757:         );
 758:       }
 759:       if (sysRole) {
 760:         return sysRole.permissions.map((rp: any) => rp.permission.code);
 761:       }
 762:     }
 763: 
 764:     return [];
 765:   }
 766: 
 767:   /**
 768:    * Checks whether the actor possesses all required permissions.
 769:    */
 770:   async actorHasPermissions(actor: ActorContext, requiredPermissions: string[]): Promise<boolean> {
 771:     const actorPerms = await this.getActorPermissions(actor);
 772:     const actorPermSet = new Set(actorPerms);
 773:     return requiredPermissions.every((p) => actorPermSet.has(p));
 774:   }
 775: 
 776:   /**
 777:    * Locks and reloads the actor row in transaction, locks actor's role and role_permissions
 778:    * in consistent order with targetRoleId, and re-reads permissions under the locked snapshot (Finding 2 / Round 8).
 779:    */
 780:   async lockAndAuthorizeActor(
 781:     tx: any,
 782:     actor: ActorContext,
 783:     requiredPermissions: string[] = ['iam:manage_users'],
 784:     targetRoleId?: string
 785:   ): Promise<{
 786:     actorSnapshot: ActorContext;
 787:     effectivePerms: string[];
 788:     permSet: Set<string>;
 789:   }> {
 790:     if (!actor.userId) {
 791:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 792:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 793:         'FORBIDDEN',
 794:         'Thiếu thông tin người thực hiện'
 795:       );
 796:     }
 797: 
 798:     const lockedActors = await tx.$queryRaw<
 799:       Array<{
 800:         id: string;
 801:         status: string;
 802:         role: RoleEnum;
 803:         custom_role_id: string | null;
 804:         merchant_id: string;
 805:       }>
 806:     >`SELECT id, status, role, custom_role_id, merchant_id FROM users WHERE id = ${actor.userId}::uuid FOR UPDATE`;
 807: 
 808:     if (!lockedActors || lockedActors.length === 0) {
 809:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 810:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 811:         'FORBIDDEN',
 812:         'Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa'
 813:       );
 814:     }
 815: 
 816:     const actorRow = lockedActors[0];
 817:     if (!isUserActiveStatus(actorRow.status)) {
 818:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 819:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 820:         'FORBIDDEN',
 821:         'Tài khoản người dùng đã bị khóa hoặc không hoạt động'
 822:       );
 823:     }
 824: 
 825:     if (actor.merchantId && actorRow.merchant_id !== actor.merchantId) {
 826:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 827:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 828:         'FORBIDDEN',
 829:         'Người dùng không thuộc tổ chức hiện tại'
 830:       );
 831:     }
 832: 
 833:     // Assurance is only loaded from active, unexpired device_sessions under FOR UPDATE (Finding 2 / Round 12)
 834:     let authAssurance: string | undefined = undefined;
 835:     let mfaVerifiedAt: Date | null = null;
 836: 
 837:     if (actor.sessionId) {
 838:       const sessions = await tx.$queryRaw<
 839:         Array<{
 840:           id: string;
 841:           auth_assurance: string;
 842:           mfa_verified_at: Date | null;
 843:           status: string;
 844:           expires_at: Date;
 845:         }>
 846:       >`SELECT id, auth_assurance, mfa_verified_at, status, expires_at FROM device_sessions WHERE id = ${actor.sessionId}::uuid AND user_id = ${actor.userId}::uuid FOR UPDATE`;
 847: 
 848:       if (sessions && sessions.length > 0) {
 849:         const s = sessions[0];
 850:         // Finding 1 / Round 13: If session is missing, not active, or expired, abort with 401 SESSION_INVALID before any role or audit write
 851:         if (s.status !== 'ACTIVE' || new Date(s.expires_at) <= new Date()) {
 852:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 853:             HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
 854:             'SESSION_INVALID',
 855:             'Phiên làm việc đã hết hạn hoặc bị thu hồi'
 856:           );
 857:         }
 858:         authAssurance = s.auth_assurance;
 859:         mfaVerifiedAt = s.mfa_verified_at;
 860:       } else {
 861:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 862:           HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
 863:           'SESSION_INVALID',
 864:           'Phiên làm việc không tồn tại hoặc đã bị thu hồi'
 865:         );
 866:       }
 867:     }
 868: 
 869:     const actorSnapshot: ActorContext = {
 870:       ...actor,
 871:       merchantId: actorRow.merchant_id,
 872:       role: actorRow.role,
 873:       customRoleId: actorRow.custom_role_id ?? undefined,
 874:       authAssurance,
 875:       mfaVerifiedAt,
 876:     };
 877: 
 878:     // Determine actor's role ID (custom role or system role)
 879:     let actorRoleId = actorRow.custom_role_id;
 880:     if (!actorRoleId && actorRow.role) {
 881:       const sysRole = await tx.role.findFirst({
 882:         where: { code: actorRow.role, is_system: true },
 883:         select: { id: true },
 884:       });
 885:       actorRoleId = sysRole?.id;
 886:     }
 887: 
 888:     // Lock in ONE global order: actor user -> actor role -> role_permissions -> target role (Finding 2 / Round 9)
 889:     if (actorRoleId) {
 890:       await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id, merchant_id, is_system, name, description, code FROM roles WHERE id = ${actorRoleId}::uuid FOR UPDATE`;
 891:       await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id, role_id, permission_id FROM role_permissions WHERE role_id = ${actorRoleId}::uuid FOR UPDATE`;
 892:     }
 893: 
 894:     if (targetRoleId && targetRoleId !== actorRoleId) {
 895:       await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id, merchant_id, is_system, name, description, code FROM roles WHERE id = ${targetRoleId}::uuid FOR UPDATE`;
 896:       await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id, role_id, permission_id FROM role_permissions WHERE role_id = ${targetRoleId}::uuid FOR UPDATE`;
 897:     }
 898: 
 899:     // Re-read actor permissions under locked snapshot
 900:     const effectivePerms = await this.getActorPermissions(actorSnapshot, tx);
 901:     const permSet = new Set(effectivePerms);
 902: 
 903:     for (const required of requiredPermissions) {
 904:       if (!permSet.has(required)) {
 905:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 906:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 907:           'FORBIDDEN',
 908:           'Bạn không có quyền quản lý vai trò và phân quyền'
 909:         );
 910:       }
 911:     }
 912: 
 913:     return { actorSnapshot, effectivePerms, permSet };
 914:   }
 915: 
 916:   /**
 917:    * GET /api/v1/roles (AC-RBAC-01-02)
 918:    */
 919:   async getRoles(merchantId: string, correlationId: string, actor?: ActorContext) {
 920:     const canManageRoles = actor
 921:       ? await this.actorHasPermissions(actor, ['iam:manage_users'])
 922:       : false;
 923: 
 924:     try {
 925:       // Fetch system roles and merchant custom roles from database
 926:       const roles = await this.prisma.role.findMany({
 927:         where: {
 928:           OR: [{ is_system: true }, { merchant_id: merchantId }],
 929:         },
 930:         include: {
 931:           permissions: {
 932:             include: { permission: true },
 933:           },
 934:         },
 935:         orderBy: [{ is_system: 'desc' }, { created_at: 'asc' }],
 936:       });
 937: 
 938:       // Single grouped query fetching active user counts across all roles for this merchant (P2-04)
 939:       const userCounts = await this.prisma.user.groupBy({
 940:         by: ['role', 'custom_role_id'],
 941:         where: {
 942:           merchant_id: merchantId,
 943:           status: ACTIVE_USER_STATUS_FILTER,
 944:         },
 945:         _count: {
 946:           _all: true,
 947:         },
 948:       });
 949: 
 950:       const systemUserCounts = new Map<string, number>();
 951:       const customUserCounts = new Map<string, number>();
 952: 
 953:       for (const entry of userCounts) {
 954:         const count = entry._count?._all || 0;
 955:         if (entry.custom_role_id) {
 956:           customUserCounts.set(
 957:             entry.custom_role_id,
 958:             (customUserCounts.get(entry.custom_role_id) || 0) + count
 959:           );
 960:         } else if (entry.role) {
 961:           systemUserCounts.set(entry.role, (systemUserCounts.get(entry.role) || 0) + count);
 962:         }
 963:       }
 964: 
 965:       const roleItems = roles.map((role) => {
 966:         let userCount = 0;
 967:         if (role.is_system) {
 968:           if (role.code) {
 969:             userCount = systemUserCounts.get(role.code) || 0;
 970:           }
 971:         } else {
 972:           userCount = customUserCounts.get(role.id) || 0;
 973:         }
 974: 
 975:         const perms = (role.permissions || []).map((rp: any) => ({
 976:           id: rp.permission.id,
 977:           code: rp.permission.code,
 978:           name: rp.permission.name,
 979:           description: rp.permission.description,
 980:           category: rp.permission.category,
 981:         }));
 982: 
 983:         return {
 984:           id: role.id,
 985:           code: role.code || null,
 986:           name: role.name,
 987:           description: role.description || null,
 988:           is_system: Boolean(role.is_system),
 989:           merchant_id: role.merchant_id || null,

1296:               },
1297:             ]
1298:           );
1299:         }
1300: 
1301:         // In-transaction privilege ceiling re-check (Finding 1 / Round 7)
1302:         const unauthorizedInTx = permissionsInDb

1316:         // Sensitive grants must load auth_assurance and mfa_verified_at only from caller's active, unexpired device_sessions row under FOR UPDATE, and reject when that row is missing
1317:         const hasSensitiveGrants = permissionsInDb.some((p) =>
1318:           SENSITIVE_CAPABILITY_PERMISSIONS.has(p.code)
1319:         );
1320:         if (hasSensitiveGrants) {

1322:             !actorSnapshot.sessionId ||

1360:             is_system: false,

1362:         });

1364:         // Insert role_permissions
1365:         for (const perm of permissionsInDb) {
1366:           await tx.rolePermission.create({

1384:               name: role.name,
1385:               description: role.description,
1386:               permissions: permissionsInDb.map((p) => p.code),
1387:               correlation_id: correlationId,
1388:             },
1389:             ip_address: clientIp,
1390:           },
1391:         });
1392: 
1393:         return { role, permissionsInDb, actorSnapshot };
1394:       });
1395:     } catch (err: any) {

1398:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
1399:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,

1734:         const touchesSensitiveGrantsInTx =

1754:         if (dto.name !== undefined) {

1774: 
1775:         const updated = await tx.role.update({

1784:         if (dto.permissions !== undefined) {

1899:   /**
1900:    * DELETE /api/v1/roles/:id (AC-RBAC-01-07, 09, 10, 11)
1901:    */
1902:   async deleteRole(roleId: string, actor: ActorContext, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
1903:     // All database reads, decisions, privilege checks, and assignment checks are inside the transaction after row locks (P1-02)
1904:     let validatedActorSnapshot: ActorContext | undefined;
1905:     try {
1906:       await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
1907:         // 1. Lock in ONE global order: actor user -> actor role -> role_permissions -> target role (Finding 2 / Round 9)
1908:         const { actorSnapshot, permSet: actorPermSetInTx } = await this.lockAndAuthorizeActor(
1909:           tx,
1910:           actor,
1911:           ['iam:manage_users'],
1912:           roleId
1913:         );
1914:         validatedActorSnapshot = actorSnapshot;
1915: 
1916:         // 2. Re-read current role under lock (Finding 1 / Round 9)
1917:         const lockedTargetRole = await tx.role.findUnique({
1918:           where: { id: roleId },
1919:           include: {
1920:             permissions: {
1921:               include: { permission: true },
1922:             },
1923:           },
1924:         });
1925: 
1926:         if (!lockedTargetRole) {
1927:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
1928:             HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
1929:             'ROLE_NOT_FOUND',
1930:             'Không tìm thấy vai trò phân quyền'
1931:           );
1932:         }
1933: 
1934:         if (lockedTargetRole.is_system) {
1935:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
1936:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1937:             'SYSTEM_ROLE_IMMUTABLE',
1938:             'Không thể xóa vai trò mặc định của hệ thống',
1939:             false,
1940:             'Chỉ có thể xóa các vai trò tùy chỉnh do cửa hàng tạo'
1941:           );
1942:         }
1943: 
1944:         if (
1945:           !lockedTargetRole.merchant_id ||
1946:           lockedTargetRole.merchant_id !== actorSnapshot.merchantId
1947:         ) {
1948:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
1949:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1950:             'FORBIDDEN',
1951:             'Không có quyền truy cập vai trò của đơn vị khác'
1952:           );
1953:         }
1954: 
1955:         const currentRolePermsInTx = lockedTargetRole.permissions || [];
1956:         const currentRolePermCodes = currentRolePermsInTx.map((rp: any) => rp.permission.code);
1957:         const customPermCodes = new Set(currentRolePermCodes);
1958: 
1959:         // Verify actor holds all current permissions of the role under the lock
1960:         const unauthorizedRoleCodes = currentRolePermCodes.filter(
1961:           (code) => !actorPermSetInTx.has(code)
1962:         );
1963:         if (unauthorizedRoleCodes.length > 0) {
1964:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
1965:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1966:             'PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED',
1967:             'Không thể xóa vai trò có quyền hạn vượt quá thẩm quyền của bạn',
1968:             false,
1969:             `Bạn không có các quyền hiện tại của vai trò: ${unauthorizedRoleCodes.join(', ')}`
1970:           );
1971:         }
1972: 
1973:         // Lock all current assignees for this role across the database (Finding 2 / Round 7)
1974:         const assignees = await tx.$queryRaw<
1975:           Array<{
1976:             id: string;
1977:             status: string;
1978:             role: string;
1979:             custom_role_id: string;
1980:             merchant_id: string;
1981:           }>
1982:         >`SELECT id, status, role, custom_role_id, merchant_id FROM users WHERE custom_role_id = ${roleId}::uuid FOR UPDATE`;
1983: 
1984:         const crossTenantAssignees = assignees.filter(
1985:           (u) => u.merchant_id !== actorSnapshot.merchantId
1986:         );
1987:         if (crossTenantAssignees.length > 0) {
1988:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
1989:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1990:             'ROLE_IN_USE',
1991:             `Không thể xóa vai trò đang được gán cho ${crossTenantAssignees.length} người dùng thuộc đơn vị khác`,
1992:             false,
1993:             'Vui lòng gỡ vai trò của tất cả người dùng trước khi xóa',
1994:             [
1995:               {
1996:                 field: 'role_id',
1997:                 code: 'IN_USE',
1998:                 message: `Vai trò đang được gán cho ${crossTenantAssignees.length} người dùng thuộc đơn vị khác`,
1999:               },
2000:             ]
2001:           );
2002:         }
2003: 
2004:         const activeAssignees = assignees.filter((u) => isUserActiveStatus(u.status));
2005:         if (activeAssignees.length > 0) {
2006:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
2007:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2008:             'ROLE_IN_USE',
2009:             `Không thể xóa vai trò đang được gán cho ${activeAssignees.length} người dùng đang hoạt động`,
2010:             false,
2011:             'Vui lòng chuyển vai trò của các người dùng sang vai trò khác trước khi xóa',
2012:             [
2013:               {
2014:                 field: 'role_id',
2015:                 code: 'IN_USE',
2016:                 message: `Vai trò đang được gán cho ${activeAssignees.length} người dùng`,
2017:               },
2018:             ]
2019:           );
2020:         }
2021: 
2022:         // Inactive assignees handling:
2023:         // Under lock, resolve enum fallback permissions directly from DB and check:
2024:         // 1. Enum fallback must not expand beyond custom role permissions (!hasBroaderPerms)
2025:         // 2. Enum fallback must be a subset of actor's DB permissions (Finding 1 / Round 6)
2026:         const inactiveAssignees = assignees.filter((u) => !isUserActiveStatus(u.status));
2027:         if (inactiveAssignees.length > 0) {
2028:           const broaderUsers: string[] = [];
2029: 
2030:           for (const u of inactiveAssignees) {
2031:             let enumPerms: string[] = [];
2032:             const sysRole = await tx.role.findFirst({
2033:               where: { code: u.role, is_system: true },
2034:               include: { permissions: { include: { permission: true } } },
2035:             });
2036:             if (sysRole) {
2037:               enumPerms = sysRole.permissions.map((rp: any) => rp.permission.code);
2038:             } else {
2039:               const enumDef = SYSTEM_ROLES.find((sr) => sr.code === u.role);
2040:               enumPerms = enumDef ? enumDef.permissions : [];
2041:             }
2042: 
2043:             const hasBroaderPerms = enumPerms.some((code: string) => !customPermCodes.has(code));
2044:             const exceedsActorPerms = enumPerms.some((code: string) => !actorPermSetInTx.has(code));
2045: 
2046:             if (hasBroaderPerms || exceedsActorPerms) {
2047:               broaderUsers.push(u.id);
2048:             }
2049:           }
2050: 
2051:           if (broaderUsers.length > 0) {
2052:             throw new CanonicalApiException(
2053:               HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2054:               'ROLE_IN_USE',
2055:               `Không thể xóa vai trò đang được gán cho ${broaderUsers.length} người dùng không hoạt động vì việc gỡ vai trò sẽ mở rộng quyền hạn hoặc vượt quá thẩm quyền của bạn`,
2056:               false,
2057:               'Vui lòng chuyển vai trò của người dùng sang vai trò thích hợp trước khi xóa',
2058:               [
2059:                 {
2060:                   field: 'role_id',
2061:                   code: 'IN_USE',
2062:                   message: `Vai trò đang được gán cho ${broaderUsers.length} người dùng không hoạt động`,
2063:                 },
2064:               ],
2065:               undefined,
2066:               {
2067:                 broaderUsers,
2068:                 actorMerchantId: actorSnapshot.merchantId,
2069:               }
2070:             );
2071:           }
2072: 
2073:           // If not broader, safely detach each inactive user and audit each membership change (BR-RBAC-07)
2074:           for (const u of inactiveAssignees) {
2075:             await tx.user.update({
2076:               where: { id: u.id },
2077:               data: { custom_role_id: null },
2078:             });
2079: 
2080:             await tx.auditLog.create({
2081:               data: {
2082:                 merchant_id: actorSnapshot.merchantId,
2083:                 user_id: actorSnapshot.userId,
2084:                 action: 'USER_ROLE_DETACHED',
2085:                 entity_type: 'User',
2086:                 entity_id: u.id,
2087:                 old_value: {
2088:                   custom_role_id: roleId,
2089:                   role: u.role,
2090:                   correlation_id: correlationId,
2091:                 },
2092:                 new_value: {
2093:                   custom_role_id: null,
2094:                   role: u.role,
2095:                   correlation_id: correlationId,
2096:                 },
2097:                 ip_address: clientIp,
2098:               },
2099:             });
2100:           }
2101:         }
2102: 
2103:         // Remove role_permissions
2104:         await tx.rolePermission.deleteMany({
2105:           where: { role_id: roleId },
2106:         });
2107: 
2108:         // Remove role
2109:         await tx.role.delete({
2110:           where: { id: roleId },
2111:         });
2112: 
2113:         // Write immutable audit log with locked before-image (Finding 1 / Round 9)
2114:         await tx.auditLog.create({
2115:           data: {
2116:             merchant_id: actorSnapshot.merchantId,
2117:             user_id: actorSnapshot.userId,
2118:             action: 'ROLE_DELETED',
2119:             entity_type: 'Role',
2120:             entity_id: roleId,
2121:             old_value: {
2122:               id: lockedTargetRole.id,
2123:               name: lockedTargetRole.name,
2124:               description: lockedTargetRole.description,
2125:               permissions: currentRolePermCodes,
2126:               correlation_id: correlationId,
2127:             },
2128:             ip_address: clientIp,
2129:           },
2130:         });
2131:       });
2132:     } catch (err: any) {
2133:       if (err instanceof CanonicalApiException) {
2134:         if (err.code === 'ROLE_IN_USE' && err.extra?.broaderUsers) {
2135:           const broaderUsers = err.extra.broaderUsers as string[];
2136:           const auditMerchantId =
2137:             (typeof err.extra.actorMerchantId === 'string' && err.extra.actorMerchantId.trim()) ||
2138:             (validatedActorSnapshot?.merchantId && validatedActorSnapshot.merchantId.trim()) ||
2139:             (actor.merchantId && actor.merchantId.trim());
2140: 
2141:           if (!auditMerchantId) {
2142:             throw new CanonicalApiException(
2143:               HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
2144:               'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
2145:               'Không thể xác định đơn vị hợp lệ cho vết kiểm toán bảo mật',
2146:               true
2147:             );
2148:           }
2149: 
2150:           try {
2151:             await this.prisma.$transaction(async (auditTx: any) => {
2152:               await auditTx.auditLog.create({
2153:                 data: {
2154:                   merchant_id: auditMerchantId,
2155:                   user_id: actor.userId,
2156:                   action: 'ROLE_DELETE_BLOCKED_INACTIVE_WIDENING',
2157:                   entity_type: 'Role',
2158:                   entity_id: roleId,
2159:                   reason: 'DETACH_WOULD_WIDEN_PRIVILEGES',
2160:                   old_value: {
2161:                     role_id: roleId,
2162:                     broader_user_count: broaderUsers.length,
2163:                     broader_user_ids: broaderUsers,
2164:                     correlation_id: correlationId,
2165:                   },
2166:                   ip_address: clientIp,
2167:                 },
2168:               });
2169:             });
2170:           } catch (auditErr: any) {
2171:             if (auditErr instanceof CanonicalApiException) throw auditErr;
2172:             throw new CanonicalApiException(
2173:               HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
2174:               'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
2175:               'Không thể lưu vết kiểm toán bảo mật khi chặn xóa vai trò',
2176:               true
2177:             );
2178:           }
2179:         }
2180:         throw err;
2181:       }
2182:       if (isDeadlockOrSerializationError(err)) {
2183:         throw createConcurrencyConflictException();
2184:       }
2185:       if (err?.code === 'P2003' || /foreign key/i.test(err?.message || '')) {
2186:         const fallbackCount = await this.prisma.user
2187:           .count({
2188:             where: {
2189:               merchant_id: validatedActorSnapshot?.merchantId || actor.merchantId,
2190:               custom_role_id: roleId,
2191:               status: ACTIVE_USER_STATUS_FILTER,
2192:             },
2193:           })
2194:           .catch(() => 0);
2195:         if (fallbackCount > 0) {
2196:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
2197:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2198:             'ROLE_IN_USE',
2199:             `Không thể xóa vai trò đang được gán cho ${fallbackCount} người dùng đang hoạt động`,
2200:             false,
2201:             'Vui lòng chuyển vai trò của các người dùng sang vai trò khác trước khi xóa',
2202:             [
2203:               {
2204:                 field: 'role_id',
2205:                 code: 'IN_USE',
2206:                 message: `Vai trò đang được gán cho ${fallbackCount} người dùng`,
2207:               },
2208:             ]
2209:           );
2210:         }
2211:       }
2212:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2213:         HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
2214:         'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
2215:         'Lỗi hệ thống khi xóa vai trò',
2216:         false,
2217:         'Vui lòng thử lại sau hoặc liên hệ hỗ trợ'
2218:       );
2219:     }
2220: 
2221:     return {
2222:       data: {
2223:         id: roleId,
2224:         deleted: true,
2225:         message: 'Đã xóa vai trò tùy chỉnh thành công',
2226:       },
2227:       meta: {
2228:         correlation_id: correlationId,
2229:       },
2230:     };
2231:   }
2232: }

<file path="apps/api/src/search/search.controller.ts">
 1: import {
 2:   Controller,
 3:   Get,
 4:   Query,
 5:   Req,
 6:   Res,
 7:   HttpStatus,
 8:   UseGuards,
 9:   UseFilters,
10:   Inject,
11: } from '@nestjs/common';
12: import { Request, Response } from 'express';
13: import { SearchService } from './search.service';
14: import { SearchQueryDto } from './search.dto';
15: import { SessionGuard } from '../session/session.guard';
16: import { RbacSeedGuard, PermissionsGuard } from '../rbac/rbac.guard';
17: import { CanonicalExceptionFilter } from '../auth/canonical-exception.filter';
18: import { RbacService } from '../rbac/rbac.service';
19: import type { ActorContext } from '../rbac/rbac.dto';
20: import { normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
21: import { extractClientIp } from '../utils/ip.util';
22: 
23: @Controller(['api/v1/search', 'search'])
24: @UseGuards(RbacSeedGuard, SessionGuard, PermissionsGuard)
25: @UseFilters(CanonicalExceptionFilter)
26: export class SearchController {
27:   constructor(
28:     @Inject(SearchService) private readonly searchService: SearchService,
29:     @Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService: RbacService
30:   ) {}
31: 
32:   private async resolveActor(req: any): Promise<ActorContext> {
33:     if (req.actorContext) {
34:       return req.actorContext;
35:     }
36:     const actor = await this.rbacService.resolveActorFromSession(req);
37:     req.actorContext = actor;
38:     return actor;
39:   }
40: 
41:   /**
42:    * GET /api/v1/search (AC-COM-01-01..15)
43:    * Unified global search across orders, waybills, batches, cases, and transactions.
44:    */
45:   @Get()
46:   async search(
47:     @Query() query: SearchQueryDto,
48:     @Req() req: Request,
49:     @Res() res: Response
50:   ): Promise<Response> {
51:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
52:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
53:     const correlationId = normalizeCorrelationId(
54:       (req.headers['x-correlation-id'] as string) || (req.headers['correlation-id'] as string)
55:     );
56: 
57:     const result = await this.searchService.search(actor, query, clientIp, correlationId);
58: 
59:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);
60:   }
61: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/search/search.dto.ts">
 1: import type { CanonicalFieldError } from '../auth/auth.service';
 2: import { SearchEntityType } from '@shipde/contracts';
 3: 
 4: export interface SearchQueryDto {
 5:   q?: string;
 6:   type?: string;
 7:   limit?: string | number;
 8: }
 9: 
10: export interface ParsedSearchQuery {
11:   q: string;
12:   type: SearchEntityType;
13:   limit: number;
14: }
15: 
16: export const VALID_SEARCH_TYPES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(Object.values(SearchEntityType));
17: 
18: export const DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT = 20;
19: export const MAX_SEARCH_LIMIT = 50;
20: export const MIN_SEARCH_LIMIT = 1;
21: export const MIN_QUERY_LENGTH = 2;
22: export const MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 100;
23: 
24: export function validateSearchQueryDto(query: SearchQueryDto): {
25:   errors: CanonicalFieldError[];
26:   parsed?: ParsedSearchQuery;
27: } {
28:   const errors: CanonicalFieldError[] = [];
29: 
30:   const rawQ = query?.q;
31:   if (!rawQ || typeof rawQ !== 'string' || rawQ.trim().length < MIN_QUERY_LENGTH) {
32:     errors.push({
33:       field: 'q',
34:       code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
35:       message: `Từ khóa tìm kiếm phải có ít nhất ${MIN_QUERY_LENGTH} ký tự`,
36:     });
37:   } else if (rawQ.trim().length > MAX_QUERY_LENGTH) {
38:     errors.push({
39:       field: 'q',
40:       code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
41:       message: `Từ khóa tìm kiếm không được vượt quá ${MAX_QUERY_LENGTH} ký tự`,
42:     });
43:   }
44: 
45:   const rawType = query?.type ? String(query.type).trim().toUpperCase() : SearchEntityType.ALL;
46:   if (!VALID_SEARCH_TYPES.has(rawType)) {
47:     errors.push({
48:       field: 'type',
49:       code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
50:       message: `Loại thực thể tìm kiếm không hợp lệ (hỗ trợ ${Array.from(VALID_SEARCH_TYPES).join(', ')})`,
51:     });
52:   }
53: 
54:   let limitNum = DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT;
55:   if (query?.limit !== undefined && query?.limit !== null && query?.limit !== '') {
56:     const parsed = Number(query.limit);
57:     if (!Number.isInteger(parsed) || parsed < MIN_SEARCH_LIMIT || parsed > MAX_SEARCH_LIMIT) {
58:       errors.push({
59:         field: 'limit',
60:         code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
61:         message: `Số lượng kết quả (limit) phải là số nguyên từ ${MIN_SEARCH_LIMIT} đến ${MAX_SEARCH_LIMIT}`,
62:       });
63:     } else {
64:       limitNum = parsed;
65:     }
66:   }
67: 
68:   if (errors.length > 0) {
69:     return { errors };
70:   }
71: 
72:   return {
73:     errors: [],
74:     parsed: {
75:       q: (rawQ as string).trim(),
76:       type: rawType as SearchEntityType,
77:       limit: limitNum,
78:     },
79:   };
80: }
</file>

 41:           const [key, ...rest] = trimmed.split('=');
 42:           const cleanKey = key.trim();

 44:           if (

 117:   // Finding 3: Concurrency safety in session revocation (BR-SESS-06 / AC-SESS-08)

 119:   describe('SessionService Concurrency Safety (BR-SESS-06 / AC-SESS-08 / Finding 3)', () => {
 120:     it('concurrent revocations result in atomic state update and exactly ONE audit log', async () => {
 121:       process.env.AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY = getTestHmacKey();
 122: 
 123:       const sessionId = 'session-uuid-concurrent-1';
 124:       const userId = 'user-uuid-1';
 125:       const merchantId = 'merchant-uuid-1';
 126:       let auditLogCalls = 0;
 127:       let sessionState: SessionStatusEnum = SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE;
 128: 
 129:       // Mock Prisma that simulates two transactions competing on the active session
 130:       const mockPrisma: any = {
 131:         deviceSession: {
 132:           findUnique: async () => ({
 133:             id: sessionId,
 134:             user_id: userId,
 135:             merchant_id: merchantId,
 136:             status: sessionState,
 137:             device_id: 'test-device-1',
 138:           }),
 139:         },
 140:         $transaction: async (callback: any) => {
 141:           const tx: any = {
 142:             deviceSession: {
 143:               updateMany: async (args: any) => {
 144:                 // If status: ACTIVE is requested and session is ACTIVE, atomically transition
 145:                 if (args.where.status === SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE) {
 146:                   if (sessionState === SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE) {
 147:                     sessionState = SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED;
 148:                     return { count: 1 };
 149:                   }
 150:                   return { count: 0 };
 151:                 }
 152:                 return { count: 0 };
 153:               },
 154:               findUnique: async () => ({
 155:                 id: sessionId,
 156:                 status: sessionState,
 157:               }),
 158:             },
 159:             auditLog: {
 160:               create: async () => {
 161:                 auditLogCalls += 1;
 162:                 return { id: `audit-${auditLogCalls}` };
 163:               },
 164:             },
 165:           };
 166:           return callback(tx);
 167:         },
 168:       };
 169: 
 170:       const service = new SessionService(mockPrisma);
 171: 
 172:       // Simulate 2 simultaneous revocation requests
 173:       const [result1, result2] = await Promise.all([
 174:         service.revoke(sessionId, userId, merchantId, 'corr-conc-1', 'Revoke 1', '1.2.3.4'),
 175:         service.revoke(sessionId, userId, merchantId, 'corr-conc-2', 'Revoke 2', '1.2.3.4'),
 176:       ]);
 177: 
 178:       assert.strictEqual(result1.status, SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED);
 179:       assert.strictEqual(result2.status, SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED);
 180: 
 181:       // Exactly ONE audit log must have been created
 182:       assert.strictEqual(
 183:         auditLogCalls,
 184:         1,
 185:         'Only 1 audit record must be inserted across concurrent revocations'
 186:       );
 187: 
 188:       // One must be primary revoked, one must be idempotent message
 189:       const messages = [result1.message, result2.message];
 190:       assert.ok(messages.includes('Phiên đã được thu hồi'));
 191:       assert.ok(messages.includes('Phiên đã được thu hồi trước đó'));
 192:     });
 193: 
 194:     it('locks session row with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE within transaction and abort leaves session ACTIVE without double-write (P1 / BR-SESS-07 / AC-SESS-07)', async () => {
 195:       const sessionId = 'sess-lock-1';
 196:       const userId = 'user-lock-1';
 197:       const merchantId = 'merchant-lock-1';
 198:       const sessionInDb = {
 199:         id: sessionId,
 200:         user_id: userId,
 201:         merchant_id: merchantId,
 202:         status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,
 203:         device_id: 'dev-lock',
 204:       };
 205:       let rawQueryExecuted: string | null = null;
 206:       let tempStatus = sessionInDb.status;
 207: 
 208:       const mockPrisma: any = {
 209:         deviceSession: {
 210:           findUnique: async () => ({ ...sessionInDb }),
 211:         },
 212:         $transaction: async (callback: any) => {
 213:           const tx: any = {
 214:             $queryRaw: async (strings: TemplateStringsArray, ..._values: any[]) => {
 215:               rawQueryExecuted = strings.join('?');
 216:               return [{ id: sessionId, status: tempStatus }];
 217:             },
 218:             deviceSession: {
 219:               findUnique: async () => ({ ...sessionInDb, status: tempStatus }),
 220:               updateMany: async (args: any) => {
 221:                 if (
 222:                   args.where.status === SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE &&
 223:                   tempStatus === SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE
 224:                 ) {
 225:                   tempStatus = SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED;
 226:                   return { count: 1 };
 227:                 }
 228:                 return { count: 0 };
 229:               },
 230:             },
 231:             auditLog: {
 232:               create: async () => {
 233:                 // Aborted transaction mid-write: simulated failure while inserting audit log
 234:                 throw new Error('Simulated audit failure inside transaction');
 235:               },
 236:             },
 237:           };
 238: 
 239:           try {
 240:             return await callback(tx);
 241:           } catch (err) {
 242:             // Abort rolls back in-memory transaction state: leaves database session ACTIVE!
 243:             tempStatus = sessionInDb.status;
 244:             throw err;
 245:           }
 246:         },
 247:       };
 248: 
 249:       const service = new SessionService(mockPrisma);
 250: 
 251:       await assert.rejects(
 252:         async () => {
 253:           await service.revoke(sessionId, userId, merchantId, 'corr-lock-1', 'Revoke lock test');
 254:         },
 255:         (err: any) => {
 256:           assert.match(err.message, /Simulated audit failure inside transaction/);
 257:           return true;
 258:         }
 259:       );
 260: 
 261:       // Verify row lock was requested via $queryRaw SELECT ... FOR UPDATE
 262:       assert.ok(rawQueryExecuted, '$queryRaw must be called for exclusive lock');
 263:       assert.match(rawQueryExecuted, /FOR UPDATE/i, 'Query must specify FOR UPDATE');
 264: 
 265:       // Verify that aborted transaction leaves the session row ACTIVE
 266:       assert.strictEqual(
 267:         sessionInDb.status,
 268:         SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,
 269:         'Aborted transaction must leave session row ACTIVE in database'
 270:       );
 271:     });
 272:   });
