 586:   describe('Audit IP Keyed Pseudonymization (AC-SESS-21 / Finding 6)', () => {
 587:     it('verifies that IP pseudonymization strictly uses keyed HMAC-SHA256', async () => {
 588:       const key1 = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
 589:       const key2 = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
 590:       const rawIp = '203.0.113.195';
 591: 
 592:       process.env.AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY = key1;
 593: 
 594:       let loggedIp1: string | null = null;
 595:       let loggedIp2: string | null = null;
 596: 
 597:       const createMockService = (capture: (ip: string) => void) => {
 598:         const mockPrisma: any = {
 599:           deviceSession: {
 600:             findUnique: async () => ({
 601:               id: 'sess-k',
 602:               user_id: 'user-k',
 603:               merchant_id: 'merchant-k',
 604:               status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,
 605:               device_id: 'dev-k',
 606:             }),
 607:           },
 608:           $transaction: async (callback: any) => {
 609:             const tx: any = {
 610:               deviceSession: {
 611:                 updateMany: async () => ({ count: 1 }),
 612:               },
 613:               auditLog: {
 614:                 create: async (args: any) => {
 615:                   capture(args.data.ip_address);
 616:                   return { id: 'audit-k' };
 617:                 },
 618:               },
 619:             };
 620:             return callback(tx);
 621:           },
 622:         };
 623:         return new SessionService(mockPrisma);
 624:       };
 625: 
 626:       const service1 = createMockService((ip) => {
 627:         loggedIp1 = ip;
 628:       });
 629:       await service1.revoke('sess-k', 'user-k', 'merchant-k', 'c-1', 'Revoke', rawIp);
 630: 
 631:       process.env.AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY = key2;
 632:       const service2 = createMockService((ip) => {
 633:         loggedIp2 = ip;
 634:       });
 635:       await service2.revoke('sess-k', 'user-k', 'merchant-k', 'c-2', 'Revoke', rawIp);
 636: 
 637:       const expectedHmac1 = createHmac('sha256', key1).update(rawIp).digest('hex');
 638:       const expectedHmac2 = createHmac('sha256', key2).update(rawIp).digest('hex');
 639:       const plainSha256 = createHash('sha256').update(rawIp).digest('hex');
 640: 
 641:       assert.strictEqual(loggedIp1, expectedHmac1, 'Must strictly match HMAC with key 1');
 642:       assert.strictEqual(loggedIp2, expectedHmac2, 'Must strictly match HMAC with key 2');
 643:       assert.notStrictEqual(loggedIp1, loggedIp2, 'Different keys must yield different pseudonyms');
 644:       assert.notStrictEqual(loggedIp1, plainSha256, 'Must not be plain unkeyed SHA-256');
 645:       assert.notStrictEqual(loggedIp1, rawIp, 'Must not be raw IP');
 646:     });
 647:   });

1841:           'sess-lock-sqlite',
1842:           'user-sqlite',
1843:           'merch-sqlite',
1844:           'corr-sqlite'
1845:         );
1846: 
1847:         assert.strictEqual(updateCalled, true);
1848:         assert.strictEqual(res.status, SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED);
1849:       } finally {
1850:         if (prevDbUrl !== undefined) {
1851:           process.env.DATABASE_URL = prevDbUrl;
1852:         } else {
1853:           delete process.env.DATABASE_URL;
1854:         }
1855:       }
1856:     });
1857:   });
1858: });

  37:         const trimmed = line.trim();
  38:         if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
  39:           const [key, ...rest] = trimmed.split('=');
  40:           const cleanKey = key.trim();
  41:           let val = rest.join('=').trim();
  42:           if (
  43:             (val.startsWith('"') && val.endsWith('"')) ||
  44:             (val.startsWith("'") && val.endsWith("'"))
  45:           ) {
  46:             val = val.slice(1, -1);
  47:           }
  48:           if (!process.env[cleanKey]) {
  49:             process.env[cleanKey] = val;
  50:           }
  51:         }
  52:       }
  53:       break;
  54:     }
  55:   }

 176:   function createSessionToken(

 192:       },
 193:       secret,
 194:       43200
 195:     );
 196:     const hash = createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
 197:     return { raw: token, hash };

 989:     const originalLogAudit = (sessionService as any).logAudit;

 993:     const origConsoleError = console.error;

 995:     console.log = (...args: any[]) => {

 997:       origConsoleLog(...args);
 998:     };
 999:     console.error = (...args: any[]) => {

1001:       origConsoleError(...args);

1004:     (sessionService as any).logAudit = async () => {
1005:       throw new Error('Simulated audit persistence failure');
1006:     };
1007: 
1008:     try {

1011:         .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${tok20Caller.raw}`)

1034:       );
1035:       assert.ok(

1037:         'stderr must explicitly record AUDIT_ROLLBACK when transaction fails'
1038:       );
1039: 
1040:       console.log(

 27: @Controller(['api/v1/shops', 'shops'])
 28: @UseGuards(RbacSeedGuard, SessionGuard, PermissionsGuard)
 29: @UseFilters(CanonicalExceptionFilter)
 30: export class ShopsController {

 33:     @Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService: RbacService,

 37:   private async resolveActor(req: any): Promise<ActorContext> {
 38:     if (req.actorContext) {
 39:       return req.actorContext;
 40:     }
 41:     const actor = await this.rbacService.resolveActorFromSession(req);
 42:     req.actorContext = actor;
 43:     return actor;

 46:   private async assertCanViewShopConfig(actor: ActorContext): Promise<void> {
 47:     const hasPerm = await this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actor, ['iam:shop_config']);
 48:     const allowedRoles = ['OWNER', 'OPS_CSKH', 'FINANCE'];
 49:     let roleCode = actor.role;
 50:     if (actor.customRoleId) {
 51:       const customRole = await this.prisma.role.findUnique({
 52:         where: { id: actor.customRoleId },
 53:         select: { code: true, name: true },
 54:       });
 55:       if (customRole?.code) {
 56:         roleCode = customRole.code;
 57:       } else if (
 58:         customRole?.name &&
 59:         (customRole.name.toUpperCase().includes('FINANCE') ||
 60:           customRole.name.toUpperCase().includes('TÀI CHÍNH'))
 61:       ) {
 62:         roleCode = 'FINANCE';
 63:       }
 64:     }
 65:     if (!hasPerm && (!roleCode || !allowedRoles.includes(roleCode))) {
 66:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 67:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 68:         'FORBIDDEN',
 69:         'Bạn không có quyền xem cấu hình cửa hàng',
 70:         false,
 71:         'Vui lòng liên hệ Chủ Shop để được cấp quyền'
 72:       );
 73:     }
 74:   }

 50: const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
 51: // Vietnamese tax code: 10 digits or 13 digits (10 digits + hyphen + 3 digits)
 52: const TAX_CODE_REGEX = /^[0-9]{10}(-[0-9]{3})?$/;
 53: // Vietnamese phone: 10 digits starting with 03, 05, 07, 08, 09 or +84
 54: const PHONE_REGEX = /^(0|\+84)[35789][0-9]{8}$/;
 55: // Bank account number: 6 to 30 alphanumeric characters
 56: const BANK_ACCOUNT_REGEX = /^[0-9A-Za-z]{6,30}$/;
 57: 
 58: import { isValidTimeZone, SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES, SUPPORTED_TIMEZONE_VALUES } from '@shipde/contracts';
 59:

 62: export function validateUpdateShopProfileDto(dto: UpdateShopProfileDto): CanonicalFieldError[] {
 63:   const fields: CanonicalFieldError[] = [];
 64: 
 65:   if (dto.name !== undefined) {
 66:     const trimmedName = dto.name.trim();
 67:     if (trimmedName.length < 2 || trimmedName.length > 255) {
 68:       fields.push({
 69:         field: 'name',
 70:         code: 'INVALID_LENGTH',
 71:         message: 'Tên cửa hàng phải từ 2 đến 255 ký tự',
 72:       });
 73:     }
 74:   }
 75: 
 76:   if (dto.legal_name !== undefined && dto.legal_name !== null) {
 77:     const trimmed = dto.legal_name.trim();
 78:     if (trimmed.length > 255) {
 79:       fields.push({
 80:         field: 'legal_name',
 81:         code: 'MAX_LENGTH',
 82:         message: 'Tên pháp lý không được vượt quá 255 ký tự',
 83:       });
 84:     }
 85:   }
 86: 
 87:   if (dto.tax_code !== undefined && dto.tax_code !== null) {
 88:     const trimmedTax = dto.tax_code.trim();
 89:     if (trimmedTax.length > 0 && !TAX_CODE_REGEX.test(trimmedTax)) {
 90:       fields.push({
 91:         field: 'tax_code',
 92:         code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
 93:         message:
 94:           'Mã số thuế không hợp lệ theo chuẩn Việt Nam (10 số hoặc 13 số định dạng 0123456789-001)',
 95:       });
 96:     }
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   if (dto.contact_email !== undefined && dto.contact_email !== null) {
100:     const trimmed = dto.contact_email.trim();
101:     if (trimmed.length > 0 && !EMAIL_REGEX.test(trimmed)) {
102:       fields.push({
103:         field: 'contact_email',
104:         code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
105:         message: 'Email liên hệ không hợp lệ',
106:       });
107:     }
108:   }
109: 
110:   if (dto.contact_phone !== undefined && dto.contact_phone !== null) {
111:     const rawPhone = dto.contact_phone.trim().replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
112:     if (rawPhone.length > 0 && !PHONE_REGEX.test(rawPhone)) {
113:       fields.push({
114:         field: 'contact_phone',
115:         code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
116:         message: 'Số điện thoại liên hệ không hợp lệ theo định dạng Việt Nam',
117:       });
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   if (dto.billing_email !== undefined && dto.billing_email !== null) {
122:     const trimmed = dto.billing_email.trim();
123:     if (trimmed.length > 0 && !EMAIL_REGEX.test(trimmed)) {
124:       fields.push({
125:         field: 'billing_email',
126:         code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
127:         message: 'Email nhận hóa đơn không hợp lệ',
128:       });
129:     }
130:   }
131: 
132:   if (dto.bank_account_number !== undefined && dto.bank_account_number !== null) {
133:     const rawAcc = dto.bank_account_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
134:     if (rawAcc.length > 0 && !BANK_ACCOUNT_REGEX.test(rawAcc)) {
135:       fields.push({
136:         field: 'bank_account_number',
137:         code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
138:         message: 'Số tài khoản ngân hàng không hợp lệ (từ 6 đến 30 ký tự)',
139:       });
140:     }
141:   }
142: 
143:   if (dto.bank_account_name !== undefined && dto.bank_account_name !== null) {
144:     const trimmed = dto.bank_account_name.trim();
145:     if (trimmed.length > 255) {
146:       fields.push({
147:         field: 'bank_account_name',
148:         code: 'MAX_LENGTH',
149:         message: 'Tên chủ tài khoản ngân hàng không được vượt quá 255 ký tự',
150:       });
151:     }
152:   }
153: 
154:   if (dto.bank_name !== undefined && dto.bank_name !== null) {
155:     const trimmed = dto.bank_name.trim();
156:     if (trimmed.length > 128) {
157:       fields.push({
158:         field: 'bank_name',
159:         code: 'MAX_LENGTH',
160:         message: 'Tên ngân hàng không được vượt quá 128 ký tự',
161:       });
162:     }
163:   }
164: 
165:   if (dto.timezone !== undefined) {
166:     const trimmedTz = typeof dto.timezone === 'string' ? dto.timezone.trim() : '';
167:     if (!isValidTimeZone(trimmedTz)) {
168:       fields.push({
169:         field: 'timezone',
170:         code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
171:         message: 'Múi giờ không hợp lệ theo chuẩn IANA (ví dụ: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh hoặc UTC)',
172:       });
173:     }
174:   }
175: 
176:   if (dto.currency !== undefined) {
177:     if (dto.currency !== 'VND') {
178:       fields.push({
179:         field: 'currency',
180:         code: 'INVALID_ENUM',
181:         message: 'Đơn vị tiền tệ mặc định phải là VND',
182:       });
183:     }
184:   }
185: 
186:   if (dto.default_fee_payer !== undefined) {
187:     if (dto.default_fee_payer !== 'SHOP' && dto.default_fee_payer !== 'RECIPIENT') {
188:       fields.push({
189:         field: 'default_fee_payer',
190:         code: 'INVALID_ENUM',
191:         message: 'Bên trả phí vận chuyển mặc định phải là SHOP hoặc RECIPIENT',
192:       });
193:     }
194:   }
195: 
196:   if (dto.default_weight_unit !== undefined) {
197:     if (dto.default_weight_unit !== 'g' && dto.default_weight_unit !== 'kg') {
198:       fields.push({
199:         field: 'default_weight_unit',
200:         code: 'INVALID_ENUM',
201:         message: 'Đơn vị khối lượng mặc định phải là g hoặc kg',
202:       });
203:     }
204:   }
205: 
206:   if (dto.operating_notes !== undefined && dto.operating_notes !== null) {
207:     if (dto.operating_notes.length > 1000) {
208:       fields.push({
209:         field: 'operating_notes',
210:         code: 'MAX_LENGTH',
211:         message: 'Ghi chú vận hành không được vượt quá 1000 ký tự',
212:       });
213:     }
214:   }
215: 
216:   return fields;
217: }

 13: export const SENSITIVE_AUDIT_FIELDS = new Set([
 14:   'bank_account_number',
 15:   'bank_account_name',
 16:   'contact_phone',
 17:   'contact_email',
 18:   'billing_email',

 21: export function maskAuditValue(field: string, val: unknown): unknown {
 22:   if (val === null || val === undefined) return val;
 23:   if (typeof val === 'string' && SENSITIVE_AUDIT_FIELDS.has(field)) {
 24:     return maskIdentifier(val);
 25:   }
 26:   return val;

 29: @Injectable()
 30: export class ShopsService {

 32: 
 33:   private hashIp(ip: string): string {
 34:     return createHash('sha256')
 35:       .update(ip || '127.0.0.1')
 36:       .digest('hex')
 37:       .substring(0, 16);
 38:   }

 40:   private formatProfile(merchant: any): FormattedShopProfile {
 41:     return {
 42:       id: merchant.id,
 43:       name: merchant.name,
 44:       code: merchant.code,
 45:       status: merchant.status,
 46:       legal_name: merchant.legal_name ?? null,
 47:       tax_code: merchant.tax_code ?? null,
 48:       contact_email: merchant.contact_email ?? null,
 49:       contact_phone: merchant.contact_phone ?? null,
 50:       legal_address: merchant.legal_address ?? null,
 51:       billing_email: merchant.billing_email ?? null,
 52:       billing_address: merchant.billing_address ?? null,
 53:       bank_name: merchant.bank_name ?? null,
 54:       bank_account_number: merchant.bank_account_number ?? null,
 55:       bank_account_name: merchant.bank_account_name ?? null,
 56:       bank_branch: merchant.bank_branch ?? null,
 57:       timezone: merchant.timezone || 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
 58:       currency: merchant.currency || 'VND',
 59:       default_fee_payer: (merchant.default_fee_payer as 'SHOP' | 'RECIPIENT') || 'SHOP',
 60:       default_weight_unit: (merchant.default_weight_unit as 'g' | 'kg') || 'g',
 61:       auto_routing_enabled: Boolean(merchant.auto_routing_enabled),
 62:       operating_notes: merchant.operating_notes ?? null,
 63:       created_at: merchant.created_at
 64:         ? new Date(merchant.created_at).toISOString()
 65:         : new Date().toISOString(),
 66:       updated_at: merchant.updated_at
 67:         ? new Date(merchant.updated_at).toISOString()
 68:         : new Date().toISOString(),
 69:     };
 70:   }
 71: 
 72:   /**
 73:    * GET /api/v1/shops/profile (AC-ORG-01-01)
 74:    * Retrieves current authenticated merchant's shop profile.
 75:    */
 76:   async getShopProfile(
 77:     merchantId: string,
 78:     correlationId: string
 79:   ): Promise<{
 80:     success: boolean;
 81:     data: FormattedShopProfile;
 82:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
 83:   }> {
 84:     if (!merchantId) {
 85:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 86:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 87:         'FORBIDDEN',
 88:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
 89:         false,
 90:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
 91:       );
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     const merchant = await this.prisma.merchant.findUnique({
 95:       where: { id: merchantId },
 96:     });
 97: 
 98:     if (!merchant) {
 99:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
100:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
101:         'SHOP_NOT_FOUND',
102:         'Không tìm thấy thông tin cửa hàng',
103:         false,
104:         'Cửa hàng không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa'
105:       );
106:     }
107: 
108:     return {
109:       success: true,
110:       data: this.formatProfile(merchant),
111:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
112:     };
113:   }
114: 
115:   /**
116:    * PATCH /api/v1/shops/profile (AC-ORG-01-02..08)
117:    * Updates current authenticated merchant's shop profile.
118:    */
119:   async updateShopProfile(
120:     merchantId: string,
121:     actor: ActorContext,
122:     dto: UpdateShopProfileDto,
123:     clientIp: string,
124:     correlationId: string
125:   ): Promise<{
126:     success: boolean;
127:     data: FormattedShopProfile;
128:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
129:   }> {
130:     if (!merchantId) {
131:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
132:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
133:         'FORBIDDEN',
134:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
135:         false,
136:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại'
137:       );
138:     }
139: 
140:     // 1. Validation check
141:     const validationErrors = validateUpdateShopProfileDto(dto);
142:     if (validationErrors.length > 0) {
143:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
144:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
145:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
146:         'Dữ liệu hồ sơ shop không hợp lệ',
147:         false,
148:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại các trường thông tin bị lỗi',
149:         validationErrors
150:       );
151:     }
152: 
153:     // 2. Fetch existing merchant for before snapshot
154:     const existing = await this.prisma.merchant.findUnique({
155:       where: { id: merchantId },
156:     });
157: 
158:     if (!existing) {
159:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
160:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
161:         'SHOP_NOT_FOUND',
162:         'Không tìm thấy thông tin cửa hàng',
163:         false,
164:         'Cửa hàng không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa'
165:       );
166:     }
167: 
168:     // 3. Prepare update payload
169:     const dataToUpdate: any = {};
170:     if (dto.name !== undefined) dataToUpdate.name = dto.name.trim();
171:     if (dto.legal_name !== undefined)
172:       dataToUpdate.legal_name = dto.legal_name ? dto.legal_name.trim() : null;
173:     if (dto.tax_code !== undefined)
174:       dataToUpdate.tax_code = dto.tax_code ? dto.tax_code.trim() : null;
175:     if (dto.contact_email !== undefined)
176:       dataToUpdate.contact_email = dto.contact_email
177:         ? dto.contact_email.trim().toLowerCase()
178:         : null;
179:     if (dto.contact_phone !== undefined)
180:       dataToUpdate.contact_phone = dto.contact_phone ? dto.contact_phone.trim() : null;
181:     if (dto.legal_address !== undefined)
182:       dataToUpdate.legal_address = dto.legal_address ? dto.legal_address.trim() : null;
183:     if (dto.billing_email !== undefined)
184:       dataToUpdate.billing_email = dto.billing_email
185:         ? dto.billing_email.trim().toLowerCase()
186:         : null;
187:     if (dto.billing_address !== undefined)
188:       dataToUpdate.billing_address = dto.billing_address ? dto.billing_address.trim() : null;
189:     if (dto.bank_name !== undefined)
190:       dataToUpdate.bank_name = dto.bank_name ? dto.bank_name.trim() : null;
191:     if (dto.bank_account_number !== undefined)
192:       dataToUpdate.bank_account_number = dto.bank_account_number
193:         ? dto.bank_account_number.trim()
194:         : null;
195:     if (dto.bank_account_name !== undefined)
196:       dataToUpdate.bank_account_name = dto.bank_account_name
197:         ? dto.bank_account_name.trim().toUpperCase()
198:         : null;
199:     if (dto.bank_branch !== undefined)
200:       dataToUpdate.bank_branch = dto.bank_branch ? dto.bank_branch.trim() : null;
201:     if (dto.timezone !== undefined) dataToUpdate.timezone = dto.timezone.trim();
202:     if (dto.currency !== undefined) dataToUpdate.currency = dto.currency.trim();
203:     if (dto.default_fee_payer !== undefined) dataToUpdate.default_fee_payer = dto.default_fee_payer;
204:     if (dto.default_weight_unit !== undefined)
205:       dataToUpdate.default_weight_unit = dto.default_weight_unit;
206:     if (dto.auto_routing_enabled !== undefined)
207:       dataToUpdate.auto_routing_enabled = Boolean(dto.auto_routing_enabled);
208:     if (dto.operating_notes !== undefined)
209:       dataToUpdate.operating_notes = dto.operating_notes ? dto.operating_notes.trim() : null;
210: 
211:     // 4. Execute update & audit logging in transaction
212:     const updated = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
213:       const result = await tx.merchant.update({
214:         where: { id: merchantId },
215:         data: dataToUpdate,
216:       });
217: 
218:       // Build before/after change diff for audit
219:       const updatedFields = Object.keys(dataToUpdate);
220:       const beforeDiff: Record<string, any> = {};
221:       const afterDiff: Record<string, any> = {};
222: 
223:       for (const field of updatedFields) {
224:         beforeDiff[field] = maskAuditValue(field, (existing as any)[field]);
225:         afterDiff[field] = maskAuditValue(field, (result as any)[field]);
226:       }
227: 
228:       await tx.auditLog.create({
229:         data: {
230:           merchant_id: merchantId,
231:           user_id: actor.userId,
232:           actor: actor.role || 'OWNER',
233:           action: 'SHOP_PROFILE_UPDATED',
234:           entity_type: 'merchant',
235:           entity_id: merchantId,
236:           old_value: beforeDiff,
237:           new_value: afterDiff,
238:           reason: correlationId ? `correlation_id:${correlationId}` : null,
239:           ip_address: this.hashIp(clientIp),
240:         },
241:       });
242: 
243:       return result;
244:     });
245: 
246:     return {
247:       success: true,
248:       data: this.formatProfile(updated),
249:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
250:     };
251:   }
252: 
253:   /**
254:    * GET /api/v1/shops (AC-ORG-01-12)
255:    * Lists authorized shops in scope for the session.
256:    */
257:   async listShops(
258:     merchantId: string,
259:     correlationId: string
260:   ): Promise<{
261:     success: boolean;
262:     data: { shops: FormattedShopProfile[] };
263:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
264:   }> {
265:     const profile = await this.getShopProfile(merchantId, correlationId);
266:     return {
267:       success: true,
268:       data: {
269:         shops: [profile.data],
270:       },
271:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
272:     };
273:   }
274: 
275:   /**
276:    * GET /api/v1/shops/:id (AC-ORG-01-10)
277:    * Strictly scopes to caller's merchant. Cross-tenant access is rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN.
278:    */
279:   async getShopById(
280:     targetId: string,
281:     actor: ActorContext,
282:     correlationId: string
283:   ): Promise<{
284:     success: boolean;
285:     data: FormattedShopProfile;
286:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
287:   }> {
288:     if (targetId !== actor.merchantId && targetId !== 'profile' && targetId !== 'me') {
289:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
290:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
291:         'FORBIDDEN',
292:         'Bạn không có quyền truy cập hồ sơ của shop khác',
293:         false,
294:         'Thao tác bị từ chối do vi phạm phạm vi gian hàng'
295:       );
296:     }
297: 
298:     return this.getShopProfile(actor.merchantId, correlationId);
299:   }
300: 
301:   /**
302:    * PATCH /api/v1/shops/:id (AC-ORG-01-10)
303:    * Strictly scopes to caller's merchant. Cross-tenant update is rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN.
304:    */
305:   async updateShopById(
306:     targetId: string,
307:     actor: ActorContext,
308:     dto: UpdateShopProfileDto,
309:     clientIp: string,
310:     correlationId: string
311:   ): Promise<{
312:     success: boolean;
313:     data: FormattedShopProfile;
314:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
315:   }> {
316:     if (targetId !== actor.merchantId && targetId !== 'profile' && targetId !== 'me') {
317:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
318:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
319:         'FORBIDDEN',
320:         'Bạn không có quyền cập nhật hồ sơ của shop khác',
321:         false,
322:         'Thao tác bị từ chối do vi phạm phạm vi gian hàng'
323:       );
324:     }
325: 
326:     return this.updateShopProfile(actor.merchantId, actor, dto, clientIp, correlationId);
327:   }
328: }

434:   describe('Audit Log Masking: maskAuditValue', () => {
435:     it('masks sensitive fields including bank account number, phone, email, and bank account name', () => {
436:       assert.strictEqual(maskAuditValue('bank_account_number', '0071001234567'), '007****567');
437:       assert.strictEqual(maskAuditValue('bank_account_name', 'CTY CP GUMAC'), 'CTY****MAC');
438:       assert.strictEqual(maskAuditValue('contact_phone', '0901234567'), '090****567');
439:       assert.strictEqual(maskAuditValue('contact_email', 'support@gumac.vn'), 's****t@gumac.vn');
440:       assert.strictEqual(maskAuditValue('billing_email', 'finance@gumac.vn'), 'f****e@gumac.vn');
441:     });
442: 
443:     it('preserves non-sensitive fields and null/undefined values unmasked', () => {
444:       assert.strictEqual(maskAuditValue('name', 'Gumac Flagship'), 'Gumac Flagship');
445:       assert.strictEqual(maskAuditValue('timezone', 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh');
446:       assert.strictEqual(maskAuditValue('bank_name', 'Vietcombank'), 'Vietcombank');
447:       assert.strictEqual(maskAuditValue('bank_account_number', null), null);
448:       assert.strictEqual(maskAuditValue('bank_account_number', undefined), undefined);
449:     });
450:   });
451: });
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/users/me.controller.ts">
 1: import {
 2:   Controller,
 3:   Get,
 4:   Patch,
 5:   Body,
 6:   Req,
 7:   HttpCode,
 8:   HttpStatus,
 9:   Inject,
10:   UseGuards,
11:   UseFilters,
12: } from '@nestjs/common';
13: import { MeService } from './me.service';
14: import { UpdateMeDto, UpdatePreferencesDto } from './me.dto';
15: import { SessionGuard } from '../session/session.guard';
16: import { CanonicalExceptionFilter } from '../auth/canonical-exception.filter';
17: import { normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
18: import { extractClientIp } from '../utils/ip.util';
19: 
20: @Controller(['api/v1/me', 'me'])
21: @UseGuards(SessionGuard)
22: @UseFilters(CanonicalExceptionFilter)
23: export class MeController {
24:   constructor(@Inject(MeService) private readonly meService: MeService) {}
25: 
26:   /**
27:    * GET /api/v1/me & /me
28:    * Retrieve current user profile and preferences (AC-PRO-01-01)
29:    */
30:   @Get()
31:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
32:   async getMe(@Req() req: any) {
33:     const correlationId = req.correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
34:     const userId = req.userId as string;
35: 
36:     return this.meService.getMe(userId, correlationId);
37:   }
38: 
39:   /**
40:    * PATCH /api/v1/me & /me
41:    * Update personal profile and/or preferences (AC-PRO-01-02 to AC-PRO-01-08)
42:    */
43:   @Patch()
44:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
45:   async updateMe(@Body() dto: UpdateMeDto, @Req() req: any) {
46:     const correlationId = req.correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
47:     const userId = req.userId as string;
48:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
49: 
50:     return this.meService.updateMe(userId, dto, clientIp, correlationId);
51:   }
52: 
53:   /**
54:    * GET /api/v1/me/preferences & /me/preferences
55:    * Retrieve current user personal preferences (AC-PRO-01-06)
56:    */
57:   @Get('preferences')
58:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
59:   async getMyPreferences(@Req() req: any) {
60:     const correlationId = req.correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
61:     const userId = req.userId as string;
62: 
63:     return this.meService.getMyPreferences(userId, correlationId);
64:   }
65: 
66:   /**
67:    * PATCH /api/v1/me/preferences & /me/preferences
68:    * Update personal preferences (AC-PRO-01-06, AC-PRO-01-07, AC-PRO-01-08)
69:    */
70:   @Patch('preferences')
71:   @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
72:   async updateMyPreferences(@Body() dto: UpdatePreferencesDto, @Req() req: any) {
73:     const correlationId = req.correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
74:     const userId = req.userId as string;
75:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
76: 
77:     return this.meService.updateMyPreferences(userId, dto, clientIp, correlationId);
78:   }
79: }

<file path="apps/api/src/users/me.service.ts">
  1: import { Injectable, HttpStatus, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
  2: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
  3: import { CanonicalApiException } from '../auth/auth.service';
  4: import { UpdateMeDto, UpdatePreferencesDto, NotificationPreferencesDto } from './me.dto';
  5: 
  6: const VIETNAMESE_PHONE_REGEX = /^(0|\+84)[3|5|7|8|9][0-9]{8}$/;
  7: const SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = new Set(['vi', 'en']);
  8: 
  9: export const DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES = {
 10:   channels: {
 11:     email: true,
 12:     in_app: true,
 13:     push: false,
 14:   },
 15:   digest_window_minutes: 15,
 16:   subscriptions: {
 17:     delivery_fail: true,
 18:     rate_discrepancy: true,
 19:     cod_overdue: true,
 20:     claim_deadline_warning: true,
 21:     abnormal_return: true,
 22:     security_alerts: true,
 23:     create_unknown: true,
 24:   },
 25: };
 26: 
 27: export function isValidIanaTimezone(tz: string): boolean {
 28:   try {
 29:     Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { timeZone: tz });
 30:     return true;
 31:   } catch {
 32:     return false;
 33:   }
 34: }
 35: 
 36: @Injectable()
 37: export class MeService {
 38:   constructor(@Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}
 39: 
 40:   /**
 41:    * GET /api/v1/me
 42:    * Retrieve authenticated user profile, merchant metadata, and personal preferences (AC-PRO-01-01)
 43:    */
 44:   async getMe(userId: string, correlationId: string) {
 45:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
 46:       where: { id: userId },
 47:       include: {
 48:         merchant: {
 49:           select: {
 50:             id: true,
 51:             name: true,
 52:           },
 53:         },
 54:       },
 55:     });
 56: 
 57:     if (!user) {
 58:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 59:         HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
 60:         'SESSION_INVALID',
 61:         'Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc phiên đăng nhập không hợp lệ'
 62:       );
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     const notificationPreferences =
 66:       (user.notification_preferences as any) || DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES;
 67: 
 68:     return {
 69:       data: {
 70:         id: user.id,
 71:         merchant_id: user.merchant_id,
 72:         email: user.email,
 73:         phone: user.phone,
 74:         full_name: user.full_name,
 75:         role: user.role,
 76:         status: user.status,
 77:         avatar_url: user.avatar_url,
 78:         language: user.language || 'vi',
 79:         timezone: user.timezone || 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
 80:         default_warehouse_id: user.default_warehouse_id,
 81:         store_scopes: user.store_scopes || [],
 82:         warehouse_scopes: user.warehouse_scopes || [],
 83:         custom_role_id: user.custom_role_id,
 84:         notification_preferences: notificationPreferences,
 85:         merchant: user.merchant
 86:           ? {
 87:               id: user.merchant.id,
 88:               name: user.merchant.name,
 89:             }
 90:           : null,
 91:         created_at: user.created_at.toISOString(),
 92:       },
 93:       meta: {
 94:         correlation_id: correlationId,
 95:       },
 96:     };
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   /**
100:    * PATCH /api/v1/me
101:    * Update personal profile with privilege escalation prevention & audit log (AC-PRO-01-02 to AC-PRO-01-08)
102:    */
103:   async updateMe(userId: string, dto: UpdateMeDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
104:     // BR-PRO-02: Privilege escalation prevention (AC-PRO-01-05)
105:     const forbiddenFields = [
106:       'role',
107:       'custom_role_id',
108:       'merchant_id',
109:       'store_scopes',
110:       'warehouse_scopes',
111:       'status',
112:     ];
113:     for (const field of forbiddenFields) {
114:       if ((dto as any)[field] !== undefined) {
115:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
116:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
117:           'PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED',
118:           'Không được phép thay đổi vai trò hoặc phạm vi quản trị qua thông tin cá nhân'
119:         );
120:       }
121:     }
122: 
123:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
124:       where: { id: userId },
125:       include: {
126:         merchant: {
127:           select: {
128:             id: true,
129:             name: true,
130:           },
131:         },
132:       },
133:     });
134: 
135:     if (!user) {
136:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
137:         HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
138:         'SESSION_INVALID',
139:         'Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc phiên đăng nhập không hợp lệ'
140:       );
141:     }
142: 
143:     // Validation
144:     const updates: any = {};
145: 
146:     // 1. Full name
147:     if (dto.full_name !== undefined) {
148:       const trimmedName = dto.full_name.trim();
149:       if (!trimmedName || trimmedName.length > 255) {
150:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
151:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
152:           'INVALID_INPUT',
153:           'Họ và tên không được để trống và tối đa 255 ký tự'
154:         );
155:       }
156:       updates.full_name = trimmedName;
157:     }
158: 
159:     // 2. Phone
160:     if (dto.phone !== undefined) {
161:       if (dto.phone === null || dto.phone === '') {
162:         updates.phone = null;
163:       } else {
164:         const trimmedPhone = dto.phone.trim();
165:         if (!VIETNAMESE_PHONE_REGEX.test(trimmedPhone)) {
166:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
167:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
168:             'INVALID_INPUT',
169:             'Số điện thoại không đúng định dạng Việt Nam'
170:           );
171:         }
172:         // Check uniqueness across other users
173:         const existing = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
174:           where: {
175:             phone: trimmedPhone,
176:             id: { not: userId },
177:           },
178:         });
179:         if (existing) {
180:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
181:             HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
182:             'PHONE_ALREADY_EXISTS',
183:             'Số điện thoại này đã được sử dụng bởi tài khoản khác'
184:           );
185:         }
186:         updates.phone = trimmedPhone;
187:       }
188:     }
189: 
190:     // 3. Avatar URL
191:     if (dto.avatar_url !== undefined) {
192:       if (dto.avatar_url === null || dto.avatar_url === '') {
193:         updates.avatar_url = null;
194:       } else {
195:         const trimmedUrl = dto.avatar_url.trim();
196:         if (trimmedUrl.length > 512) {
197:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
198:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
199:             'INVALID_INPUT',
200:             'Đường dẫn ảnh đại diện tối đa 512 ký tự'
201:           );
202:         }
203:         updates.avatar_url = trimmedUrl;
204:       }
205:     }
206: 
207:     // 4. Language
208:     if (dto.language !== undefined) {
209:       if (!SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.has(dto.language)) {
210:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
211:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
212:           'INVALID_INPUT',
213:           'Ngôn ngữ không được hỗ trợ. Vui lòng chọn vi hoặc en'
214:         );
215:       }
216:       updates.language = dto.language;
217:     }
218: 
219:     // 5. Timezone
220:     if (dto.timezone !== undefined) {
221:       if (!isValidIanaTimezone(dto.timezone)) {
222:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
223:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
224:           'INVALID_INPUT',
225:           'Múi giờ không hợp lệ theo chuẩn IANA'
226:         );
227:       }
228:       updates.timezone = dto.timezone;
229:     }
230: 
231:     // 6. Default warehouse (BR-PRO-06, AC-PRO-01-08)
232:     if (dto.default_warehouse_id !== undefined) {
233:       if (dto.default_warehouse_id === null || dto.default_warehouse_id === '') {
234:         updates.default_warehouse_id = null;
235:       } else {
236:         const scopes = user.warehouse_scopes || [];
237:         const hasWildcard = scopes.includes('*');
238:         if (!hasWildcard && !scopes.includes(dto.default_warehouse_id)) {
239:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
240:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
241:             'WAREHOUSE_SCOPE_UNAUTHORIZED',
242:             'Kho mặc định không thuộc phạm vi kho được phân quyền của bạn'
243:           );
244:         }
245:         updates.default_warehouse_id = dto.default_warehouse_id;
246:       }
247:     }
248: 
249:     // 7. Notification preferences (BR-PRO-03, AC-PRO-01-07)
250:     if (dto.notification_preferences !== undefined) {
251:       const mergedPrefs = this.mergeAndValidateNotificationPreferences(
252:         user.notification_preferences,
253:         dto.notification_preferences
254:       );
255:       updates.notification_preferences = mergedPrefs;
256:     }
257: 
258:     // Execute update in transaction with immutable audit log
259:     const oldSnapshot = {
260:       full_name: user.full_name,
261:       phone: user.phone,
262:       avatar_url: user.avatar_url,
263:       language: user.language,
264:       timezone: user.timezone,
265:       default_warehouse_id: user.default_warehouse_id,
266:       notification_preferences: user.notification_preferences,
267:     };
268: 
269:     const updatedUser = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
270:       const updated = await tx.user.update({
271:         where: { id: userId },
272:         data: updates,
273:         include: {
274:           merchant: {
275:             select: {
276:               id: true,
277:               name: true,
278:             },
279:           },
280:         },
281:       });
282: 
283:       const newSnapshot = {
284:         full_name: updated.full_name,
285:         phone: updated.phone,
286:         avatar_url: updated.avatar_url,
287:         language: updated.language,
288:         timezone: updated.timezone,
289:         default_warehouse_id: updated.default_warehouse_id,
290:         notification_preferences: updated.notification_preferences,
291:       };
292: 
293:       await tx.auditLog.create({
294:         data: {
295:           merchant_id: updated.merchant_id,
296:           user_id: updated.id,
297:           actor: updated.full_name || updated.email || updated.id,
298:           action: 'PROFILE_UPDATED',
299:           entity_type: 'User',
300:           entity_id: updated.id,
301:           old_value: oldSnapshot,
302:           new_value: newSnapshot,
303:           ip_address: clientIp,
304:           reason: 'Cập nhật thông tin cá nhân',
305:         },
306:       });
307: 
308:       return updated;
309:     });
310: 
311:     return {
312:       data: {
313:         id: updatedUser.id,
314:         merchant_id: updatedUser.merchant_id,
315:         email: updatedUser.email,
316:         phone: updatedUser.phone,
317:         full_name: updatedUser.full_name,
318:         role: updatedUser.role,
319:         status: updatedUser.status,
320:         avatar_url: updatedUser.avatar_url,
321:         language: updatedUser.language || 'vi',
322:         timezone: updatedUser.timezone || 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
323:         default_warehouse_id: updatedUser.default_warehouse_id,
324:         store_scopes: updatedUser.store_scopes || [],
325:         warehouse_scopes: updatedUser.warehouse_scopes || [],
326:         custom_role_id: updatedUser.custom_role_id,
327:         notification_preferences:
328:           updatedUser.notification_preferences || DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES,
329:         merchant: updatedUser.merchant
330:           ? {
331:               id: updatedUser.merchant.id,
332:               name: updatedUser.merchant.name,
333:             }
334:           : null,
335:         created_at: updatedUser.created_at.toISOString(),
336:       },
337:       meta: {
338:         correlation_id: correlationId,
339:       },
340:     };
341:   }
342: 
343:   /**
344:    * GET /api/v1/me/preferences
345:    * Retrieve personal preferences (AC-PRO-01-06)
346:    */
347:   async getMyPreferences(userId: string, correlationId: string) {
348:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
349:       where: { id: userId },
350:     });
351: 
352:     if (!user) {
353:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
354:         HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
355:         'SESSION_INVALID',
356:         'Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc phiên đăng nhập không hợp lệ'
357:       );
358:     }
359: 
360:     return {
361:       data: {
362:         language: user.language || 'vi',
363:         timezone: user.timezone || 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
364:         default_warehouse_id: user.default_warehouse_id,
365:         notification_preferences: user.notification_preferences || DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES,
366:       },
367:       meta: {
368:         correlation_id: correlationId,
369:       },
370:     };
371:   }
372: 
373:   /**
374:    * PATCH /api/v1/me/preferences
375:    * Update personal preferences (AC-PRO-01-06, AC-PRO-01-07, AC-PRO-01-08)
376:    */
377:   async updateMyPreferences(
378:     userId: string,
379:     dto: UpdatePreferencesDto,
380:     clientIp: string,
381:     correlationId: string
382:   ) {
383:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
384:       where: { id: userId },
385:     });
386: 
387:     if (!user) {
388:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
389:         HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
390:         'SESSION_INVALID',
391:         'Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc phiên đăng nhập không hợp lệ'
392:       );
393:     }
394: 
395:     const updates: any = {};
396: 
397:     if (dto.language !== undefined) {
398:       if (!SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.has(dto.language)) {
399:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
400:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
401:           'INVALID_INPUT',
402:           'Ngôn ngữ không được hỗ trợ. Vui lòng chọn vi hoặc en'
403:         );
404:       }
405:       updates.language = dto.language;
406:     }
407: 
408:     if (dto.timezone !== undefined) {
409:       if (!isValidIanaTimezone(dto.timezone)) {
410:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
411:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
412:           'INVALID_INPUT',
413:           'Múi giờ không hợp lệ theo chuẩn IANA'
414:         );
415:       }
416:       updates.timezone = dto.timezone;
417:     }
418: 
419:     if (dto.default_warehouse_id !== undefined) {
420:       if (dto.default_warehouse_id === null || dto.default_warehouse_id === '') {
421:         updates.default_warehouse_id = null;
422:       } else {
423:         const scopes = user.warehouse_scopes || [];
424:         const hasWildcard = scopes.includes('*');
425:         if (!hasWildcard && !scopes.includes(dto.default_warehouse_id)) {
426:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
427:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
428:             'WAREHOUSE_SCOPE_UNAUTHORIZED',
429:             'Kho mặc định không thuộc phạm vi kho được phân quyền của bạn'
430:           );
431:         }
432:         updates.default_warehouse_id = dto.default_warehouse_id;
433:       }
434:     }
435: 
436:     if (dto.notification_preferences !== undefined) {
437:       const mergedPrefs = this.mergeAndValidateNotificationPreferences(
438:         user.notification_preferences,
439:         dto.notification_preferences
440:       );
441:       updates.notification_preferences = mergedPrefs;
442:     }
443: 
444:     const oldSnapshot = {
445:       language: user.language,
446:       timezone: user.timezone,
447:       default_warehouse_id: user.default_warehouse_id,
448:       notification_preferences: user.notification_preferences,
449:     };
450: 
451:     const updatedUser = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
452:       const updated = await tx.user.update({
453:         where: { id: userId },
454:         data: updates,
455:       });
456: 
457:       const newSnapshot = {
458:         language: updated.language,
459:         timezone: updated.timezone,
460:         default_warehouse_id: updated.default_warehouse_id,
461:         notification_preferences: updated.notification_preferences,
462:       };
463: 
464:       await tx.auditLog.create({
465:         data: {
466:           merchant_id: updated.merchant_id,
467:           user_id: updated.id,
468:           actor: updated.full_name || updated.email || updated.id,
469:           action: 'PREFERENCES_UPDATED',
470:           entity_type: 'User',
471:           entity_id: updated.id,
472:           old_value: oldSnapshot,
473:           new_value: newSnapshot,
474:           ip_address: clientIp,
475:           reason: 'Cập nhật tùy chọn cá nhân',
476:         },
477:       });
478: 
479:       return updated;
480:     });
481: 
482:     return {
483:       data: {
484:         language: updatedUser.language || 'vi',
485:         timezone: updatedUser.timezone || 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
486:         default_warehouse_id: updatedUser.default_warehouse_id,
487:         notification_preferences:
488:           updatedUser.notification_preferences || DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES,
489:       },
490:       meta: {
491:         correlation_id: correlationId,
492:       },
493:     };
494:   }
495: 
496:   /**
497:    * Helper to merge and strictly validate notification preferences per BR-PRO-03 / NOTIFICATIONS-REPORTS.md
498:    */
499:   private mergeAndValidateNotificationPreferences(
500:     current: any,
501:     incoming: NotificationPreferencesDto
502:   ) {
503:     const base = current || DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES;
504:     const channels = {
505:       ...base.channels,
506:       ...(incoming.channels || {}),
507:     };
508: 
509:     const digest_window_minutes =
510:       incoming.digest_window_minutes !== undefined
511:         ? incoming.digest_window_minutes
512:         : base.digest_window_minutes || 15;
513: 
514:     const subscriptions = {
515:       ...base.subscriptions,
516:       ...(incoming.subscriptions || {}),
517:     };
518: 
519:     // BR-PRO-03 & AC-PRO-01-07: Critical alert inviolability
520:     if (incoming.subscriptions) {
521:       if (
522:         incoming.subscriptions.security_alerts === false ||
523:         incoming.subscriptions.create_unknown === false ||
524:         incoming.subscriptions.claim_deadline_warning === false
525:       ) {
526:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
527:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
528:           'CANNOT_DISABLE_CRITICAL_NOTIFICATIONS',
529:           'Không thể tắt cảnh báo bảo mật, sự cố tạo đơn và hạn chót khiếu nại (bắt buộc theo quy định an toàn vận hành)'
530:         );
531:       }
532:     }
533: 
534:     // Always guarantee critical alerts remain true
535:     subscriptions.security_alerts = true;
536:     subscriptions.create_unknown = true;
537:     subscriptions.claim_deadline_warning = true;
538: 
539:     return {
540:       channels,
541:       digest_window_minutes,
542:       subscriptions,
543:     };
544:   }
545: }
</file>

  5: 
  6: function createMockPrismaService() {
  7:   const users: any[] = [];
  8:   const auditLogs: any[] = [];
  9:   const merchants: any[] = [];
 10: 
 11:   const mockTx = {
 12:     user: {
 13:       update: async ({ where, data, include }: any) => {
 14:         const idx = users.findIndex((u) => u.id === where.id);
 15:         if (idx === -1) throw new Error('User not found');
 16:         users[idx] = { ...users[idx], ...data, updated_at: new Date() };
 17:         const result = { ...users[idx] };
 18:         if (include?.merchant) {
 19:           result.merchant = merchants.find((m) => m.id === result.merchant_id) || null;
 20:         }
 21:         return result;
 22:       },
 23:     },
 24:     auditLog: {
 25:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
 26:         const entry = {
 27:           id: `audit-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`,
 28:           ...data,
 29:           created_at: new Date(),
 30:         };
 31:         auditLogs.push(entry);
 32:         return entry;
 33:       },
 34:     },
 35:   };
 36: 
 37:   return {
 38:     users,
 39:     auditLogs,
 40:     merchants,
 41:     user: {
 42:       findUnique: async ({ where, include }: any) => {
 43:         const u = users.find((user) => user.id === where.id);
 44:         if (!u) return null;
 45:         const res = { ...u };
 46:         if (include?.merchant) {
 47:           res.merchant = merchants.find((m) => m.id === res.merchant_id) || null;
 48:         }
 49:         return res;
 50:       },
 51:       findFirst: async ({ where }: any) => {
 52:         return (
 53:           users.find((user) => {
 54:             if (where.phone && user.phone !== where.phone) return false;
 55:             if (where.id?.not && user.id === where.id.not) return false;
 56:             return true;
 57:           }) || null
 58:         );
 59:       },
 60:       update: mockTx.user.update,
 61:     },
 62:     auditLog: {
 63:       create: mockTx.auditLog.create,
 64:     },
 65:     $transaction: async (fn: any) => fn(mockTx),
 66:   };
 67: }
 68: 
 69: describe('MeService Unit Tests (FEAT-PRO-01)', () => {

180:       (err: any) => {
181:         assert.ok(err instanceof CanonicalApiException);
182:         assert.strictEqual(err.getStatus(), 400);
183:         assert.strictEqual(err.code, 'INVALID_INPUT');
184:         return true;
185:       }
186:     );

189:   it('AC-PRO-01-05: Rejects privilege escalation attempts (role, store_scopes) with 403 PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED', async () => {
190:     await assert.rejects(
191:       async () => {
192:         await meService.updateMe(TEST_USER_ID, { role: 'OWNER' } as any, '127.0.0.1', 'corr-5');
193:       },
194:       (err: any) => {
195:         assert.ok(err instanceof CanonicalApiException);
196:         assert.strictEqual(err.getStatus(), 403);
197:         assert.strictEqual(err.code, 'PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED');
198:         return true;
199:       }
200:     );
201: 
202:     // Verify user role was NOT changed
203:     const user = mockPrisma.users.find((u) => u.id === TEST_USER_ID);
204:     assert.strictEqual(user.role, 'OPS_CSKH');
205:   });
206: 
207:   it('AC-PRO-01-06: Updates language, timezone, and non-critical notification preferences', async () => {
208:     const res = await meService.updateMyPreferences(
209:       TEST_USER_ID,
210:       {
211:         language: 'en',
212:         timezone: 'Asia/Bangkok',
213:         notification_preferences: {
214:           channels: { email: true, in_app: false, push: true },
215:           digest_window_minutes: 30,
216:           subscriptions: {
217:             delivery_fail: false,
218:             rate_discrepancy: false,
219:           },
220:         },
221:       },
222:       '127.0.0.1',
223:       'corr-6'

227:     assert.strictEqual(res.data.timezone, 'Asia/Bangkok');

229:     assert.strictEqual(res.data.notification_preferences.digest_window_minutes, 30);

231:     // Critical alert remains true

233: 
234:     // Verify audit log

236:     assert.ok(log, 'PREFERENCES_UPDATED audit log must be recorded');
237:   });

265:     await assert.rejects(

278:         return true;

174:       status: 'active',

274:   // Session helper
275:   const createSessionToken = async (
276:     userId: string,
277:     merchantId: string,
278:     role: RoleEnum
279:   ): Promise<string> => {
280:     const sid = randomUUID();
281:     const secret = resolveAccessTokenSecret(process.env.AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET);
282:     const { token } = signAccessToken(
283:       {
284:         sub: userId,
285:         sid,
286:         mid: merchantId,
287:         role,
288:         st: 'ACTIVE',
289:         auth_assurance: 'PASSWORD',
290:       },
291:       secret,
292:       43200
293:     );
294:     const hash = createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
295:     await prisma.deviceSession.upsert({
296:       where: { session_token_hash: hash },
297:       update: {
298:         status: 'ACTIVE',
299:         last_active_at: new Date(),
300:         expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
301:       },
302:       create: {
303:         id: sid,
304:         user_id: userId,
305:         merchant_id: merchantId,
306:         session_token_hash: hash,
307:         device_id: 'test_supertest_device',
308:         device_model: 'Supertest',
309:         user_agent: 'Supertest',
310:         ip_address: '127.0.0.1',
311:         status: 'ACTIVE',
312:         expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
313:       },
314:     });
315:     return token;
316:   };

318:   const ownerToken = await createSessionToken(OWNER_ID, SEED_MERCHANT_ID, RoleEnum.OWNER);

320:   const delegatedAdminToken = await createSessionToken(
321:     DELEGATED_ADMIN_ID,
322:     SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
323:     RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH
324:   );
325:   const warehouseToken = await createSessionToken(
326:     WAREHOUSE_USER_ID,
327:     SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
328:     RoleEnum.WAREHOUSE
329:   );
330:   const targetToken = await createSessionToken(
331:     TARGET_USER_ID,
332:     SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
333:     RoleEnum.WAREHOUSE
334:   );

336:     WILDCARD_USER_ID,

351:   console.log('--- Starting FEAT-RBAC-02 Supertest HTTP Scenarios ---');

353:   // AC-RBAC-02-01: Authenticated owner requests list of tenant users
354:   {
355:     const res = await request(server)
356:       .get('/api/v1/users')

359:     assert.strictEqual(res.status, 200);

381:     assert.deepStrictEqual(res.body.data.store_scopes, []);
382:     assert.deepStrictEqual(res.body.data.carrier_account_scopes, []);
383:     console.log('PASS: AC-RBAC-02-02 Get user scopes');
384:   }

387:   {
388:     const res = await request(server)
389:       .patch(`/api/v1/users/${TARGET_USER_ID}/scopes`)
390:       .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)

394:         carrier_account_scopes: [VALID_CARRIER_ACCOUNT_ID],
395:       });
396: 
397:     assert.strictEqual(res.status, 200);
398:     assert.deepStrictEqual(res.body.data.store_scopes, ['store-hcm-01']);
399:     assert.deepStrictEqual(res.body.data.warehouse_scopes, ['wh-hcm-01', 'wh-hcm-02']);
400:     assert.deepStrictEqual(res.body.data.carrier_account_scopes, [VALID_CARRIER_ACCOUNT_ID]);
401: 
402:     // Verify DB persistence
403:     const dbUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: TARGET_USER_ID } });
404:     assert.deepStrictEqual(dbUser?.store_scopes, ['store-hcm-01']);
405:     assert.deepStrictEqual(dbUser?.warehouse_scopes, ['wh-hcm-01', 'wh-hcm-02']);
406:     assert.deepStrictEqual(dbUser?.carrier_account_scopes, [VALID_CARRIER_ACCOUNT_ID]);
407:

418:     assert.strictEqual(audit.user_id, OWNER_ID);

420:   }

422:   // AC-RBAC-02-04: Owner assigns wildcard * to store, warehouse, and carrier-account scopes
423:   {
424:     const res = await request(server)
425:       .patch(`/api/v1/users/${TARGET_USER_ID}/scopes`)
426:       .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)
427:       .send({
428:         store_scopes: ['*'],
429:         warehouse_scopes: ['*'],
430:         carrier_account_scopes: ['*'],
431:       });
432: 
433:     assert.strictEqual(res.status, 200);
434:     assert.deepStrictEqual(res.body.data.store_scopes, ['*']);
435:     assert.deepStrictEqual(res.body.data.warehouse_scopes, ['*']);
436:     assert.deepStrictEqual(res.body.data.carrier_account_scopes, ['*']);
437:     console.log('PASS: AC-RBAC-02-04 Owner assigns wildcard * scopes');
438:   }
439: 
440:   // Reset target user scopes for subsequent tests
441:   await prisma.user.update({
442:     where: { id: TARGET_USER_ID },
443:     data: {
444:       store_scopes: ['store-hcm-01'],
445:       warehouse_scopes: ['wh-hcm-01'],
446:       carrier_account_scopes: [VALID_CARRIER_ACCOUNT_ID],
447:     },
448:   });
449: 
450:   // AC-RBAC-02-05: Non-owner actor with restricted scope attempts to grant scopes outside their ceiling
451:   {
452:     // DELEGATED_ADMIN_ID has iam:manage_users but only has store-hcm-01, wh-hcm-01
453:     const res = await request(server)
454:       .patch(`/api/v1/users/${TARGET_USER_ID}/scopes`)
455:       .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${delegatedAdminToken}`)
456:       .send({
457:         store_scopes: ['store-hcm-01', 'store-hanoi-unauthorized'],
458:       });

623:   {

625:     const viewRes = await request(server)
626:       .get(`/api/v1/users/${TARGET_USER_ID}/scopes`)
627:       .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${otherOwnerToken}`);
628: 
629:     assert.strictEqual(viewRes.status, 404);
630:     assert.strictEqual(viewRes.body.error.code, 'USER_NOT_FOUND');
631: 
632:     // otherOwnerToken attempts to patch TARGET_USER_ID
633:     const patchRes = await request(server)
634:       .patch(`/api/v1/users/${TARGET_USER_ID}/scopes`)
635:       .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${otherOwnerToken}`)
636:       .send({ store_scopes: ['*'] });
637: 
638:     assert.strictEqual(patchRes.status, 404);
639:     assert.strictEqual(patchRes.body.error.code, 'USER_NOT_FOUND');
640:     console.log('PASS: AC-RBAC-02-18 Cross-tenant user access fails closed');
641:   }
642: 
643:   // AC-RBAC-02-19: Audit failure during scope update rolls back transaction
644:   {
645:     const targetUserId = TARGET_USER_ID;
646:     const initialUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
647:       where: { id: targetUserId },
648:       select: {
649:         store_scopes: true,
650:         warehouse_scopes: true,
651:         carrier_account_scopes: true,
652:       },
653:     });
654:     assert.ok(initialUser);
655: 
656:     const usersService = app.get(UsersService);
657:     const servicePrisma = (usersService as any).prisma;
658: 
659:     // Force auditLog.create to fail inside the transaction
660:     const originalTransaction = servicePrisma.$transaction.bind(servicePrisma);
661:     servicePrisma.$transaction = (async (arg: any, options?: any) => {
662:       if (typeof arg === 'function') {
663:         return originalTransaction(async (tx: any) => {
664:           tx.auditLog.create = async () => {
665:             throw new Error('INJECTED_AUDIT_LOG_DATABASE_FAILURE');
666:           };
667:           return arg(tx);
668:         }, options);
669:       }
670:       return originalTransaction(arg, options);
671:     }) as any;
672: 
673:     try {
674:       const res = await request(server)
675:         .patch(`/api/v1/users/${targetUserId}/scopes`)
676:         .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)
677:         .send({
678:           store_scopes: ['store-rollback-test'],
679:           warehouse_scopes: ['wh-rollback-test'],
680:           carrier_account_scopes: [VALID_CARRIER_ACCOUNT_ID],
681:         });
682: 
683:       assert.strictEqual(res.status, 500);
684:       assert.strictEqual(res.body.error.code, 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR');
685:     } finally {
686:       servicePrisma.$transaction = originalTransaction;
687:     }
688: 
689:     // Assert scopes in database remain completely unchanged
690:     const postRollbackUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
691:       where: { id: targetUserId },
692:       select: {
693:         store_scopes: true,
694:         warehouse_scopes: true,
695:         carrier_account_scopes: true,
696:       },
697:     });
698:     assert.deepStrictEqual(postRollbackUser?.store_scopes, initialUser.store_scopes);
699:     assert.deepStrictEqual(postRollbackUser?.warehouse_scopes, initialUser.warehouse_scopes);
700:     assert.deepStrictEqual(
701:       postRollbackUser?.carrier_account_scopes,
702:       initialUser.carrier_account_scopes
703:     );
704:     console.log(
705:       'PASS: AC-RBAC-02-19 Real updateUserScopes transaction rolls back on audit failure and returns 500'
706:     );
707:   }
708: 
709:   await app.close();
710:   console.log('=== All FEAT-RBAC-02 Supertest Scenarios Passed Successfully ===');
711: }
712: 
713: main().catch((err) => {
714:   console.error('Supertest suite error:', err);
715:   process.exit(1);
716: });
</file>

  1: import { describe, it } from 'node:test';

 27: const OPERATOR_ID = randomUUID();
 28: const DELEGATED_ADMIN_ID = randomUUID();

 30: const OTHER_TENANT_OWNER_ID = randomUUID();
 31: const OTHER_TENANT_USER_ID = randomUUID();
 32: const OTHER_MERCHANT_ID = randomUUID();
 33: 
 34: const DEFAULT_PASSWORD = 'UserSupertestPass123!';
 35: 
 36: /**
 37:  * Sensitive key patterns that must never appear as object keys in responses or logs.
 38:  * Scans strictly for password, hash, secret, token, authorization, and apikey fields.
 39:  */
 40: const SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERNS = [
 41:   /password/i,
 42:   /hash/i,
 43:   /secret/i,
 44:   /token/i,
 45:   /authorization/i,
 46:   /apikey/i,
 47: ];
 48: 
 49: /**
 50:  * Infrastructure connection patterns that must never appear in values.
 51:  */
 52: const INFRA_VALUE_PATTERNS = [
 53:   /connection.*string/i,
 54:   /postgres:\/\//i,
 55:   /redis:\/\//i,
 56:   /minioadmin/i,
 57: ];
 58: 
 59: /**
 60:  * Asserts that a payload contains no sensitive information:
 61:  * - Detects leakage by sensitive KEYS (password/hash/secret/token/authorization/apikey fields).
 62:  * - Detects leakage by the actual secret values created by the test (password hash, session tokens/hashes, TOTP secrets).
 63:  * - Detects infrastructure secret patterns (postgres://, redis://, minioadmin).
 64:  * - Does NOT perform regex over arbitrary display-name values (e.g. /token/i), preventing false positives
 65:  *   when other suites or fixtures create users whose full_name contains words like 'token'.
 66:  */
 67: function assertNoSensitiveDisclosures(data: unknown, secretValues: string[], path = ''): void {
 68:   if (data === null || data === undefined) {
 69:     return;
 70:   }
 71:   if (typeof data === 'string') {
 72:     for (const secret of secretValues) {
 73:       if (secret && data.includes(secret)) {
 74:         throw new Error(
 75:           `Sensitive secret value leaked at "${path}": created secret was found in value`
 76:         );
 77:       }
 78:     }
 79:     for (const pattern of INFRA_VALUE_PATTERNS) {
 80:       if (pattern.test(data)) {
 81:         throw new Error(
 82:           `Sensitive infrastructure pattern leaked at "${path}": matches pattern ${pattern}`
 83:         );
 84:       }
 85:     }
 86:     return;
 87:   }
 88:   if (Array.isArray(data)) {
 89:     for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
 90:       assertNoSensitiveDisclosures(data[i], secretValues, path ? `${path}.${i}` : `${i}`);
 91:     }
 92:     return;
 93:   }
 94:   if (typeof data === 'object') {
 95:     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(data as Record<string, unknown>)) {
 96:       const currentPath = path ? `${path}.${key}` : key;
 97:       for (const pattern of SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERNS) {
 98:         if (pattern.test(key)) {
 99:           throw new Error(
100:             `Sensitive key leaked at "${currentPath}": key matches pattern ${pattern}`
101:           );
102:         }
103:       }
104:       for (const secret of secretValues) {
105:         if (secret && key.includes(secret)) {
106:           throw new Error(
107:             `Sensitive secret value leaked in key at "${currentPath}": created secret found in key`
108:           );
109:         }
110:       }
111:       assertNoSensitiveDisclosures(value, secretValues, currentPath);
112:     }
113:   }
114: }

289:   // Helper to create active device session and return signed v1. token
290:   const createSession = async (

292:     merchantId: string,
293:     role?: RoleEnum
294:   ): Promise<{ token: string; hash: string }> => {
295:     let effectiveRole = role;
296:     if (!effectiveRole) {
297:       const u = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId }, select: { role: true } });
298:       effectiveRole = u?.role ?? RoleEnum.OWNER;
299:     }
300:     const sid = randomUUID();
301:     const secret = resolveAccessTokenSecret(process.env.AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET);
302:     const { token } = signAccessToken(
303:       {
304:         sub: userId,
305:         sid,
306:         mid: merchantId,
307:         role: effectiveRole,
308:         st: 'ACTIVE',
309:         auth_assurance: 'PASSWORD',
310:       },
311:       secret,
312:       43200
313:     );
314:     const hash = createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
315:     createdSecretValues.push(token, hash);
316:     await prisma.deviceSession.upsert({
317:       where: { session_token_hash: hash },
318:       update: {
319:         status: 'ACTIVE',
320:         auth_assurance: 'PASSWORD',
321:         last_active_at: new Date(),
322:         expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
323:       },
324:       create: {
325:         id: sid,
326:         user_id: userId,
327:         merchant_id: merchantId,
328:         session_token_hash: hash,
329:         device_id: 'supertest-device',
330:         device_model: 'Supertest Model',
331:         status: 'ACTIVE',
332:         auth_assurance: 'PASSWORD',
333:         last_active_at: new Date(),
334:         expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
335:       },
336:     });
337:     return { token, hash };
338:   };

594:

613:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

622:     // If another actor or role attempts to demote sole owner:

703:

705:       DELEGATED_ADMIN_ID,
706:       SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
707:       RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH
708:     );
709: 
710:     const resPrivEsc = await request(server)
711:       .patch(`/api/v1/users/${OPERATOR_ID}`)
712:       .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${delegatedSession.token}`)
713:       .send({ role: RoleEnum.OWNER })

724:     const resCrossGet = await request(server)

744:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
745:     console.log('[TEST AC-USR-02-16] Missing iam:manage_users permission');
746:     // Create plain operator without custom role
747:     const plainOpsId = randomUUID();
748:     await prisma.user.create({
749:       data: {
750:         id: plainOpsId,
751:         merchant_id: SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
752:         email: `plain.ops.${SUITE_SUFFIX}@shipde.vn`,
753:         full_name: 'Plain Ops No Perm',
754:         password_hash: passwordHash,

760:

762:       .get('/api/v1/users')
763:       .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${plainOpsSession.token}`)
764:       .expect(403);
765: 
766:     responsesToInspect.push(resNoPerm.body);
767:     assert.strictEqual(resNoPerm.body.error?.code, 'FORBIDDEN');
768:     console.log('  PASS: AC-USR-02-16 User lacking iam:manage_users blocked with 403 FORBIDDEN');
769: 
770:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
771:     // AC-USR-02-17: Transaction rollback on audit failure -> 500 error; user status & session preserved
772:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
773:     console.log('[TEST AC-USR-02-17] Transaction rollback on audit failure');
774:     const victimUserId = randomUUID();
775:     await prisma.user.create({
776:       data: {
777:         id: victimUserId,
778:         merchant_id: SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
779:         email: `victim.${SUITE_SUFFIX}@shipde.vn`,
780:         full_name: 'Victim User Rollback Test',
781:         password_hash: passwordHash,
782:         role: RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH,
783:         status: 'active',
784:       },
785:     });
786:     const victimSession = await createSession(victimUserId, SEED_MERCHANT_ID, RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH);
787: 
788:     // Spy on $transaction to throw when creating audit log
789:     const usersService = app.get(UsersService);
790:     const targetPrisma = (usersService as any).prisma || prisma;
791:     const origTransaction = targetPrisma.$transaction.bind(targetPrisma);
792:     targetPrisma.$transaction = async (fn: any, options?: any) => {
793:       return origTransaction(async (tx: any) => {
794:         const origAuditCreate = tx.auditLog.create.bind(tx.auditLog);
795:         tx.auditLog.create = async (args: any) => {
796:           if (args?.data?.entity_id === victimUserId || args?.data?.action === 'USER_SUSPENDED') {
797:             throw new Error('Simulated auditLog database disk failure');
798:           }
799:           return origAuditCreate(args);
800:         };
801:         return fn(tx);
802:       }, options);
803:     };
804: 
805:     try {
806:       const resAuditFailure = await request(server)
807:         .post(`/api/v1/users/${victimUserId}/suspend`)
808:         .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerSession.token}`)
809:         .send({ reason: 'Audit rollback check' })
810:         .expect(500);
811: 
812:       responsesToInspect.push(resAuditFailure.body);
813:       assert.strictEqual(resAuditFailure.body.error?.code, 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR');
814: 
815:       // Assert user status rolled back and remains ACTIVE
816:       const dbVictim = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: victimUserId } });
817:       assert.strictEqual(
818:         dbVictim?.status.toLowerCase(),
819:         'active',
820:         'User status must remain active following transaction rollback'
821:       );
822: 
823:       // Assert session rolled back and remains ACTIVE
824:       const dbVictimSess = await prisma.deviceSession.findUnique({
825:         where: { session_token_hash: victimSession.hash },
826:       });
827:       assert.strictEqual(
828:         dbVictimSess?.status,
829:         'ACTIVE',
830:         'Device session status must remain ACTIVE following transaction rollback'
831:       );
832:       console.log(
833:         '  PASS: AC-USR-02-17 Transaction rolls back on audit failure; user & sessions preserved'
834:       );
835:     } finally {
836:       (targetPrisma as any).$transaction = origTransaction;
837:     }
838: 
839:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
840:     // AC-USR-02-18: Zero secret disclosure across all responses
841:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
842:     console.log('[TEST AC-USR-02-18] Security & secret disclosure check');
843:     const validSecrets = createdSecretValues.filter((s) => typeof s === 'string' && s.length >= 6);
844: 
845:     for (const body of responsesToInspect) {
846:       assertNoSensitiveDisclosures(body, validSecrets);
847:       assertNoSecretValues(JSON.stringify(body), validSecrets);
848:     }
849:     const userAuditLogs = await prisma.auditLog.findMany({
850:       where: {
851:         merchant_id: SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
852:         entity_id: {
853:           in: [OPERATOR_ID, OWNER_ID, SECOND_OWNER_ID, DELEGATED_ADMIN_ID, victimUserId],
854:         },
855:         action: { in: ['USER_UPDATED', 'USER_SUSPENDED', 'USER_ACTIVATED', 'USER_DEACTIVATED'] },
856:       },
857:     });
858:     for (const log of userAuditLogs) {
859:       if (log.old_value) {
860:         assertNoSensitiveDisclosures(log.old_value, validSecrets);
861:         assertNoSecretValues(JSON.stringify(log.old_value), validSecrets);
862:       }
863:       if (log.new_value) {
864:         assertNoSensitiveDisclosures(log.new_value, validSecrets);
865:         assertNoSecretValues(JSON.stringify(log.new_value), validSecrets);
866:       }
867:     }
868:     console.log(
869:       '  PASS: AC-USR-02-18 Zero secret disclosure validated across all user endpoint payloads & audit logs'
870:     );
871: 
872:     console.log('================================================================');
873:     console.log('🎉 ALL 18 FEAT-USR-02 ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA PASSED SUCCESSFULLY!');
874:     console.log('================================================================');
875:   } finally {
876:     await prisma.mfaFactor.deleteMany({
877:       where: {
878:         user_id: {
879:           in: [OWNER_ID, SECOND_OWNER_ID, OPERATOR_ID, DELEGATED_ADMIN_ID, TOKEN_USER_ID],
880:         },
881:       },
882:     });
883:     await app.close();
884:   }
885: }
886:

888:   runUsersSupertestSuite().catch((err) => {
889:     console.error('FAILED USERS SUPERTEST SUITE:', err);
890:     process.exit(1);
891:   });
892: }

  1: import * as assert from 'node:assert';

  7: /**
  8:  * Mock Prisma Client for UsersService unit testing.
  9:  */
 10: class MockPrismaService {
 11:   users: any[] = [];
 12:   auditLogs: any[] = [];
 13:   deviceSessions: any[] = [];
 14:   shouldFailAudit = false;
 15:   shouldFailUpdate = false;
 16: 
 17:   user = {
 18:     findFirst: async ({ where }: any) => {
 19:       const u = this.users.find((u) => {
 20:         if (where.id && u.id !== where.id) return false;
 21:         if (where.merchant_id && u.merchant_id !== where.merchant_id) return false;
 22:         return true;
 23:       });
 24:       if (!u) return null;
 25:       return {
 26:         ...u,
 27:         created_at: u.created_at || new Date(),
 28:         updated_at: u.updated_at || new Date(),
 29:         device_sessions: this.deviceSessions
 30:           .filter((ds) => ds.user_id === u.id)
 31:           .sort((a, b) => b.last_active_at.getTime() - a.last_active_at.getTime())
 32:           .slice(0, 1),
 33:       };
 34:     },
 35:     findMany: async ({ where, skip = 0, take = 20 }: any) => {
 36:       let filtered = this.users.filter((u) => {
 37:         if (where.merchant_id && u.merchant_id !== where.merchant_id) return false;
 38:         if (where.role && u.role !== where.role) return false;
 39:         if (
 40:           where.status &&
 41:           (u.status || '').toLowerCase() !== (where.status.equals || '').toLowerCase()
 42:         )
 43:           return false;
 44:         if (where.OR && Array.isArray(where.OR)) {
 45:           const match = where.OR.some((clause: any) => {
 46:             if (
 47:               clause.full_name?.contains &&
 48:               u.full_name?.toLowerCase().includes(clause.full_name.contains.toLowerCase())
 49:             )
 50:               return true;
 51:             if (
 52:               clause.email?.contains &&
 53:               u.email?.toLowerCase().includes(clause.email.contains.toLowerCase())
 54:             )
 55:               return true;
 56:             if (
 57:               clause.phone?.contains &&
 58:               u.phone?.toLowerCase().includes(clause.phone.contains.toLowerCase())
 59:             )
 60:               return true;
 61:             return false;
 62:           });
 63:           if (!match) return false;
 64:         }
 65:         return true;
 66:       });
 67:       return filtered.slice(skip, skip + take).map((u) => ({
 68:         ...u,
 69:         created_at: u.created_at || new Date(),
 70:         updated_at: u.updated_at || new Date(),
 71:         device_sessions: this.deviceSessions
 72:           .filter((ds) => ds.user_id === u.id)
 73:           .sort((a, b) => b.last_active_at.getTime() - a.last_active_at.getTime())
 74:           .slice(0, 1),
 75:       }));
 76:     },
 77:     count: async ({ where }: any) => {
 78:       return this.users.filter((u) => {
 79:         if (where.merchant_id && u.merchant_id !== where.merchant_id) return false;
 80:         if (where.role && u.role !== where.role) return false;
 81:         if (where.status?.in) {
 82:           const lowerList = where.status.in.map((s: string) => s.toLowerCase());
 83:           if (!lowerList.includes((u.status || '').toLowerCase())) return false;
 84:         }
 85:         return true;
 86:       }).length;
 87:     },
 88:     update: async ({ where, data }: any) => {
 89:       if (this.shouldFailUpdate) {
 90:         throw new Error('Database update failure simulation');
 91:       }
 92:       const idx = this.users.findIndex((u) => u.id === where.id);
 93:       if (idx === -1) throw new Error('User not found');
 94:       this.users[idx] = { ...this.users[idx], ...data, updated_at: new Date() };
 95:       return this.users[idx];
 96:     },
 97:   };
 98: 
 99:   auditLog = {
100:     create: async ({ data }: any) => {
101:       if (this.shouldFailAudit) {
102:         throw new Error('Audit log database error simulation');
103:       }
104:       const row = { id: `audit-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`, created_at: new Date(), ...data };
105:       this.auditLogs.push(row);
106:       return row;
107:     },
108:   };
109: 
110:   $transaction = async (fn: (tx: any) => Promise<any>) => {
111:     // Execute function with current mock instance acting as tx
112:     return await fn(this);
113:   };
114: }
