  1: import {
  2:   Controller,
  3:   Get,
  4:   Post,
  5:   Patch,
  6:   Delete,
  7:   Param,
  8:   Body,
  9:   Req,
 10:   Res,
 11:   HttpStatus,
 12:   UseGuards,
 13:   UseFilters,
 14:   Inject,
 15: } from '@nestjs/common';
 16: import { Request, Response } from 'express';
 17: import { WarehousesService } from './warehouses.service';
 18: import { CreateWarehouseDto, UpdateWarehouseDto } from './warehouses.dto';
 19: import { SessionGuard } from '../session/session.guard';
 20: import { RbacSeedGuard, PermissionsGuard, RequirePermissions } from '../rbac/rbac.guard';
 21: import { CanonicalExceptionFilter } from '../auth/canonical-exception.filter';
 22: import { RbacService } from '../rbac/rbac.service';
 23: import type { ActorContext } from '../rbac/rbac.dto';
 24: import { normalizeCorrelationId } from '@shipde/config';
 25: import { extractClientIp } from '../utils/ip.util';
 26: 
 27: @Controller(['api/v1/warehouses', 'warehouses'])
 28: @UseGuards(RbacSeedGuard, SessionGuard, PermissionsGuard)
 29: @UseFilters(CanonicalExceptionFilter)
 30: export class WarehousesController {
 31:   constructor(
 32:     @Inject(WarehousesService) private readonly warehousesService: WarehousesService,
 33:     @Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService: RbacService
 34:   ) {}
 35: 
 36:   private async resolveActor(req: any): Promise<ActorContext> {
 37:     if (req.actorContext) {
 38:       return req.actorContext;
 39:     }
 40:     const actor = await this.rbacService.resolveActorFromSession(req);
 41:     req.actorContext = actor;
 42:     return actor;
 43:   }
 44: 
 45:   /**
 46:    * GET /api/v1/warehouses (AC-WH-01-01, AC-WH-01-02)
 47:    */
 48:   @Get()
 49:   async listWarehouses(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): Promise<Response> {
 50:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
 51:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 52:     const hasConfigPermission = await this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actor, [
 53:       'iam:shop_config',
 54:     ]);
 55:     const result = await this.warehousesService.listWarehouses(
 56:       actor.merchantId,
 57:       actor,
 58:       hasConfigPermission,
 59:       correlationId
 60:     );
 61:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);
 62:   }
 63: 
 64:   /**
 65:    * POST /api/v1/warehouses (AC-WH-01-06..11)
 66:    */
 67:   @Post()
 68:   @RequirePermissions('iam:shop_config')
 69:   async createWarehouse(
 70:     @Body() dto: CreateWarehouseDto,
 71:     @Req() req: Request,
 72:     @Res() res: Response
 73:   ): Promise<Response> {
 74:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
 75:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
 76:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 77:     const result = await this.warehousesService.createWarehouse(
 78:       dto,
 79:       actor.merchantId,
 80:       actor,
 81:       correlationId,
 82:       clientIp
 83:     );
 84:     return res.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).json(result);
 85:   }
 86: 
 87:   /**
 88:    * GET /api/v1/warehouses/:id (AC-WH-01-03..05)
 89:    */
 90:   @Get(':id')
 91:   async getWarehouseById(
 92:     @Param('id') id: string,
 93:     @Req() req: Request,
 94:     @Res() res: Response
 95:   ): Promise<Response> {
 96:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
 97:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
 98:     const hasConfigPermission = await this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actor, [
 99:       'iam:shop_config',
100:     ]);
101:     const result = await this.warehousesService.getWarehouseById(
102:       id,
103:       actor.merchantId,
104:       actor,
105:       hasConfigPermission,
106:       correlationId
107:     );
108:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);
109:   }

112:    * PATCH /api/v1/warehouses/:id (AC-WH-01-12)
113:    */
114:   @Patch(':id')

116:   async updateWarehouseById(
117:     @Param('id') id: string,
118:     @Body() dto: UpdateWarehouseDto,
119:     @Req() req: Request,
120:     @Res() res: Response
121:   ): Promise<Response> {
122:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();
123:     const clientIp = extractClientIp(req);
124:     const actor = await this.resolveActor(req);
125:     const result = await this.warehousesService.updateWarehouse(
126:       id,
127:       dto,
128:       actor.merchantId,
129:       actor,
130:       correlationId,
131:       clientIp
132:     );
133:     return res.status(HttpStatus.OK).json(result);
134:   }

136:   /**
137:    * POST /api/v1/warehouses/:id/default (AC-WH-01-13)
138:    */
139:   @Post(':id/default')
140:   @RequirePermissions('iam:shop_config')
141:   async setDefaultWarehouse(
142:     @Param('id') id: string,
143:     @Req() req: Request,
144:     @Res() res: Response
145:   ): Promise<Response> {
146:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();

105: export const CUTOFF_TIME_REGEX = /^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$/;

490: export function validateUpdateWarehouseDto(dto: UpdateWarehouseDto): CanonicalFieldError[] {

492: 
493:   if (dto.name !== undefined && dto.name !== null) {

496:         field: 'name',

522:         fields.push({

539:       fields.push({
540:         field: 'status',
541:         code: 'INVALID_ENUM',

  1: import { Injectable, HttpStatus, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
  2: import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
  3: import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
  4: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
  5: import { CanonicalApiException } from '../auth/auth.service';
  6: import type { ActorContext } from '../rbac/rbac.dto';
  7: import {
  8:   CreateWarehouseDto,
  9:   UpdateWarehouseDto,
 10:   FormattedWarehouse,
 11:   validateCreateWarehouseDto,
 12:   validateUpdateWarehouseDto,
 13: } from './warehouses.dto';
 14: import { maskIdentifier } from '../invitations/invitations.service';
 15: import { WarehouseAuditEvent } from '@shipde/contracts';
 16: 
 17: export const SENSITIVE_WAREHOUSE_AUDIT_FIELDS = new Set([
 18:   'contact_phone',
 19:   'contact_email',
 20:   'return_contact_phone',
 21:   'return_contact_email',
 22:   'phone',
 23:   'email',
 24: ]);
 25: 
 26: export function maskWarehouseAuditValue(field: string, val: unknown): unknown {
 27:   if (val === null || val === undefined) return val;
 28:   if (typeof val === 'string' && SENSITIVE_WAREHOUSE_AUDIT_FIELDS.has(field)) {
 29:     return maskIdentifier(val);
 30:   }
 31:   if (Array.isArray(val)) {
 32:     return val.map((item) =>
 33:       typeof item === 'object' && item !== null
 34:         ? maskWarehouseAuditObject(item as Record<string, unknown>)
 35:         : item
 36:     );
 37:   }
 38:   if (typeof val === 'object') {
 39:     return maskWarehouseAuditObject(val as Record<string, unknown>);
 40:   }
 41:   return val;
 42: }
 43: 
 44: export function maskWarehouseAuditObject(obj: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
 45:   if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
 46:   const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
 47:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
 48:     result[k] = maskWarehouseAuditValue(k, v);
 49:   }
 50:   return result;
 51: }

 53: @Injectable()
 54: export class WarehousesService {
 55:   constructor(@Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}
 56: 
 57:   private hashIp(ip: string): string {
 58:     return createHash('sha256')
 59:       .update(ip || '127.0.0.1')
 60:       .digest('hex')
 61:       .substring(0, 16);
 62:   }
 63: 
 64:   public formatWarehouse(w: any): FormattedWarehouse {
 65:     return {
 66:       id: w.id,
 67:       merchant_id: w.merchant_id,
 68:       name: w.name,
 69:       code: w.code,
 70:       status: w.status,
 71:       is_default: w.is_default,
 72:       contact_name: w.contact_name,
 73:       contact_phone: w.contact_phone,
 74:       contact_email: w.contact_email ?? null,
 75:       address_line: w.address_line,
 76:       ward: w.ward ?? null,
 77:       district: w.district,
 78:       city: w.city,
 79:       postal_code: w.postal_code ?? null,
 80:       address_json: (w.address_json as Record<string, unknown>) || {},
 81:       use_different_return_address: w.use_different_return_address,
 82:       return_contact_name: w.return_contact_name ?? null,
 83:       return_contact_phone: w.return_contact_phone ?? null,
 84:       return_address_line: w.return_address_line ?? null,
 85:       return_ward: w.return_ward ?? null,
 86:       return_district: w.return_district ?? null,
 87:       return_city: w.return_city ?? null,
 88:       return_address_json: (w.return_address_json as Record<string, unknown>) ?? null,
 89:       operating_hours: (w.operating_hours as Record<string, unknown>) ?? null,
 90:       cutoff_time: w.cutoff_time ?? null,
 91:       schedule_notes: w.schedule_notes ?? null,
 92:       contacts_json: (w.contacts_json as Record<string, unknown> | unknown[]) ?? null,
 93:       printer_paper_size: w.printer_paper_size || 'A6',
 94:       printer_dpi: w.printer_dpi || 203,
 95:       printer_name: w.printer_name ?? null,
 96:       printer_auto_print: w.printer_auto_print ?? false,
 97:       printer_config: (w.printer_config as Record<string, unknown>) ?? null,
 98:       created_at: w.created_at instanceof Date ? w.created_at.toISOString() : w.created_at,
 99:       updated_at: w.updated_at instanceof Date ? w.updated_at.toISOString() : w.updated_at,
100:     };
101:   }

103:   /**
104:    * Fetches the actor's live warehouse scopes from the database
105:    */
106:   public async getActorWarehouseScopes(actor: ActorContext): Promise<string[]> {
107:     if (!actor.userId) {
108:       return [];
109:     }
110:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
111:       where: { id: actor.userId, merchant_id: actor.merchantId },
112:       select: { role: true, warehouse_scopes: true },
113:     });
114:     return user?.warehouse_scopes || [];
115:   }
116: 
117:   /**
118:    * Evaluates if the actor is permitted to access a specific warehouse
119:    */
120:   public hasWarehouseAccess(scopes: string[], warehouse: { id: string; code: string }): boolean {
121:     if (scopes.includes('*')) {
122:       return true;
123:     }
124:     return scopes.includes(warehouse.id) || scopes.includes(warehouse.code);
125:   }
126: 
127:   /**
128:    * List authorized warehouses for merchant (AC-WH-01-01, AC-WH-01-02)
129:    */
130:   async listWarehouses(
131:     merchantId: string,
132:     actor: ActorContext,
133:     hasConfigPermission: boolean,
134:     correlationId: string
135:   ) {
136:     const scopes = await this.getActorWarehouseScopes(actor);
137:     const hasUniversalAccess = scopes.includes('*');
138: 
139:     let whereClause: any = {
140:       merchant_id: merchantId,
141:     };
142: 
143:     if (!hasUniversalAccess) {
144:       if (scopes.length === 0) {
145:         return {
146:           success: true,
147:           data: [],
148:           meta: { correlation_id: correlationId, total: 0 },
149:         };
150:       }
151:       whereClause = {
152:         merchant_id: merchantId,
153:         OR: [{ id: { in: scopes } }, { code: { in: scopes } }],
154:       };
155:     }
156: 
157:     const warehouses = await this.prisma.warehouse.findMany({
158:       where: whereClause,
159:       orderBy: [{ is_default: 'desc' }, { created_at: 'asc' }],
160:     });
161: 
162:     const formatted = warehouses.map((w) => this.formatWarehouse(w));
163:     return {
164:       success: true,
165:       data: formatted,
166:       meta: {
167:         correlation_id: correlationId,
168:         total: formatted.length,
169:       },
170:     };
171:   }
172: 
173:   /**
174:    * Get warehouse by ID with scope and tenant boundary check (AC-WH-01-03..05)
175:    */
176:   async getWarehouseById(
177:     id: string,
178:     merchantId: string,
179:     actor: ActorContext,
180:     hasConfigPermission: boolean,
181:     correlationId: string
182:   ) {
183:     const warehouse = await this.prisma.warehouse.findFirst({
184:       where: {
185:         id,
186:         merchant_id: merchantId,
187:       },
188:     });
189: 
190:     if (!warehouse) {
191:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
192:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
193:         'WAREHOUSE_NOT_FOUND',
194:         'Kho hàng không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc cửa hàng này',
195:         false
196:       );
197:     }
198: 
199:     const scopes = await this.getActorWarehouseScopes(actor);
200:     const hasUniversalAccess = scopes.includes('*');
201: 
202:     if (!hasUniversalAccess && !this.hasWarehouseAccess(scopes, warehouse)) {
203:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
204:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
205:         'WAREHOUSE_SCOPE_UNAUTHORIZED',
206:         'Người dùng không có quyền truy cập kho hàng được yêu cầu',
207:         false
208:       );
209:     }
210: 
211:     return {
212:       success: true,
213:       data: this.formatWarehouse(warehouse),
214:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
215:     };
216:   }
217: 
218:   /**
219:    * Create a new warehouse (AC-WH-01-06..11)
220:    */
221:   async createWarehouse(
222:     dto: CreateWarehouseDto,
223:     merchantId: string,
224:     actor: ActorContext,
225:     correlationId: string,
226:     clientIp: string
227:   ) {
228:     const fieldErrors = validateCreateWarehouseDto(dto);
229:     if (fieldErrors.length > 0) {
230:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
231:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
232:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
233:         'Thông tin kho hàng không hợp lệ',
234:         false,
235:         undefined,
236:         fieldErrors
237:       );
238:     }
239: 
240:     // Generate or normalize code
241:     let code = dto.code ? dto.code.trim().toUpperCase() : '';
242:     if (!code) {
243:       const slug = dto.name
244:         .trim()
245:         .normalize('NFD')
246:         .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
247:         .replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '')
248:         .toUpperCase()
249:         .substring(0, 10);
250:       const randomSuffix = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
251:       code = `WH-${slug || 'KHO'}-${randomSuffix}`;
252:     }
253: 
254:     // Check scope: non-wildcard actors cannot create outside permitted warehouse scopes
255:     const scopes = await this.getActorWarehouseScopes(actor);
256:     if (!scopes.includes('*') && (!dto.code || !scopes.includes(code))) {
257:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
258:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
259:         'WAREHOUSE_SCOPE_UNAUTHORIZED',
260:         'Người dùng không có quyền tạo kho hàng ngoài phạm vi kho được phân công',
261:         false
262:       );
263:     }
264: 
265:     // Check unique code in tenant
266:     const existingCode = await this.prisma.warehouse.findUnique({
267:       where: {
268:         merchant_id_code: {
269:           merchant_id: merchantId,
270:           code,
271:         },
272:       },
273:     });
274: 
275:     if (existingCode) {
276:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
277:         HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
278:         'WAREHOUSE_CODE_EXISTS',
279:         `Mã kho hàng '${code}' đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng`,
280:         false,
281:         undefined,
282:         [{ field: 'code', code: 'DUPLICATE', message: `Mã kho hàng '${code}' đã tồn tại` }]
283:       );
284:     }
285: 
286:     const addressJson = {
287:       contact_name: dto.contact_name.trim(),

843:       data: this.formatWarehouse(updated),
844:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
845:     };
846:   }
847: }

536:     // ========================================================================

538:     // ========================================================================
539:     console.log('🧪 Testing alias route /warehouses...');
540:     const aliasRes = await request(app.getHttpServer())
541:       .get('/warehouses')
542:       .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerA.token}`)
543:       .expect(200);
544:     assert.strictEqual(aliasRes.body.data.length, 2);
545:     console.log('  PASS: Verified alias route /warehouses.');
546: 
547:     // ========================================================================
548:     // AC-WH-01-17: Audit log security & PII masking verification
549:     // ========================================================================
550:     console.log('🧪 Testing AC-WH-01-17: Audit log security & PII inspection...');
551:     const allWhAudits = await prisma.auditLog.findMany({
552:       where: { merchant_id: merchantIdA, entity_type: 'warehouse' },
553:     });
554:     assert.ok(allWhAudits.length >= 4, 'Expected at least 4 audit logs');
555:     for (const log of allWhAudits) {
556:       assert.strictEqual(log.merchant_id, merchantIdA);
557:       const str = JSON.stringify(log);
558:       assert.ok(!str.includes('password_hash'));
559:       assert.ok(!str.includes('session_token'));
560:       // Raw PII must never be present in audit diffs (Finding 1)
561:       assert.ok(!str.includes('0901234567'), 'Raw phone 0901234567 leaked in audit log');
562:       assert.ok(!str.includes('0919123456'), 'Raw phone 0919123456 leaked in audit log');
563:       assert.ok(!str.includes('kho.tanbinh@gumac.vn'), 'Raw email leaked in audit log');
564:     }
565:     console.log(
566:       `  PASS: AC-WH-01-17 verified ${allWhAudits.length} audit logs clean of secrets and PII.`
567:     );
568: 
569:     console.log('================================================================');
570:     console.log('🎉 ALL FEAT-WH-01 SUPERTEST CHECKS PASSED (AC-01..17)!');
571:     console.log('================================================================');
572:   } finally {
573:     // Finding 5: Clean up all tenant rows created during the test run
574:     try {
575:       if (merchantIdA && merchantIdB) {
576:         const tenantIds = [merchantIdA, merchantIdB];
577:         await prisma.auditLog.deleteMany({ where: { merchant_id: { in: tenantIds } } });
578:         await prisma.warehouse.deleteMany({ where: { merchant_id: { in: tenantIds } } });
579:         await prisma.deviceSession.deleteMany({ where: { merchant_id: { in: tenantIds } } });
580:         await prisma.user.deleteMany({ where: { merchant_id: { in: tenantIds } } });
581:         await prisma.merchant.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: tenantIds } } });
582:       }
583:     } catch (cleanupErr) {
584:       console.warn('⚠️ Test cleanup warning:', cleanupErr);
585:     }
586:     await app.close();
587:   }
588: }
589: 
590: runWarehousesSupertestSuite().catch((err) => {
591:   console.error('❌ Warehouses supertest suite failed:', err);
592:   process.exit(1);
593: });

  4: import { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
  5: import request from 'supertest';
  6: import { AppModule } from './app.module';
  7: import { PrismaService } from './prisma/prisma.service';
  8: import { RedisService } from './redis/redis.service';
  9: import { StorageService } from './storage/storage.service';
 10: import { APP_CONFIG } from './config.token';
 11: 
 12: function createMockPrismaForHarness(readiness: 'up' | 'down' = 'up') {
 13:   const permissions: any[] = [];
 14:   const roles: any[] = [];
 15:   const rolePermissions: any[] = [];
 16:   const auditLogs: any[] = [];
 17: 
 18:   const tx = {
 19:     permission: {
 20:       upsert: async ({ where, create, update }: any) => {
 21:         let p = permissions.find((x) => x.code === where?.code);
 22:         if (!p) {
 23:           p = { id: create?.id, ...create };
 24:           permissions.push(p);
 25:         } else {
 26:           Object.assign(p, update);
 27:         }
 28:         return p;
 29:       },
 30:       findMany: async () => [...permissions],
 31:     },
 32:     role: {
 33:       upsert: async ({ where, create, update }: any) => {
 34:         let r = roles.find((x) => x.code === where?.code);
 35:         if (!r) {
 36:           r = { id: create?.id, ...create };
 37:           roles.push(r);
 38:         } else {
 39:           Object.assign(r, update);
 40:         }
 41:         return r;
 42:       },
 43:     },
 44:     rolePermission: {
 45:       findMany: async ({ where }: any) =>
 46:         rolePermissions.filter((rp) => rp.role_id === where?.role_id),
 47:       deleteMany: async ({ where }: any) => {
 48:         const ids = where?.permission_id?.in || [];
 49:         for (let i = rolePermissions.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
 50:           if (
 51:             rolePermissions[i].role_id === where?.role_id &&
 52:             ids.includes(rolePermissions[i].permission_id)
 53:           ) {
 54:             rolePermissions.splice(i, 1);
 55:           }
 56:         }
 57:       },
 58:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
 59:         const record = { id: `rp-${data.role_id}-${data.permission_id}`, ...data };
 60:         rolePermissions.push(record);
 61:         return record;
 62:       },
 63:     },
 64:     auditLog: {
 65:       create: async ({ data }: any) => {
 66:         const record = { id: `audit-${auditLogs.length + 1}`, ...data };
 67:         auditLogs.push(record);
 68:         return record;
 69:       },
 70:     },
 71:   };
 72: 
 73:   return {
 74:     checkReadiness: async () => readiness,
 75:     $connect: async () => {},
 76:     $disconnect: async () => {},
 77:     $transaction: async (fn: (client: any) => Promise<any>) => {
 78:       if (readiness === 'down') {
 79:         throw new Error('Database connection failed');
 80:       }
 81:       return fn(tx);
 82:     },
 83:   };
 84: }
 85: 
 86: async function runSupertestSuite() {
 87:   console.log('================================================================');
 88:   console.log('SHIP DE - SUPERTEST & NESTJS TESTING HARNESS (AC-FOUND-04-05)');
 89:   console.log('================================================================');
 90: 
 91:   const mockConfig = {
 92:     env: 'test' as const,
 93:     port: 3099,
 94:     databaseUrl: 'postgresql://test:test@localhost:5432/test',
 95:     redis: { host: 'localhost', port: 6379 },
 96:     s3: {
 97:       endpoint: 'http://localhost:9000',
 98:       region: 'us-east-1',
 99:       accessKey: 'minioadmin',
100:       secretKey: 'minioadmin',
101:       bucket: 'test-bucket',
102:     },
103:     carrierMode: 'disabled' as const,
104:   };
105: 
106:   const moduleFixture: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
107:     imports: [AppModule],
108:   })
109:     .overrideProvider(APP_CONFIG)
110:     .useValue(mockConfig)
111:     .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
112:     .useValue(createMockPrismaForHarness('up'))
113:     .overrideProvider(RedisService)
114:     .useValue({
115:       checkReadiness: async () => 'up',
116:       onModuleDestroy: async () => {},
117:     })
118:     .overrideProvider(StorageService)
119:     .useValue({
120:       checkReadiness: async () => 'up',
121:     })
122:     .compile();
123: 
124:   const app: INestApplication = moduleFixture.createNestApplication();
125:   await app.init();
126: 
127:   try {
128:     // 1. Test GET /health/live
129:     console.log('[TEST 1] GET /health/live returns 200 OK with valid liveness payload');
130:     const liveRes = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/health/live').expect(200);
131:     assert.strictEqual(liveRes.body.status, 'ok', 'Status must be ok');
132:     assert.ok(liveRes.body.timestamp, 'Timestamp must be present');
133:     console.log('  PASS: /health/live responded 200 OK');
134: 
135:     // 2. Test GET /health/ready
136:     console.log('[TEST 2] GET /health/ready returns 200 OK when dependencies are up');
137:     const readyRes = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/health/ready').expect(200);
138:     assert.strictEqual(readyRes.body.status, 'ok', 'Status must be ok');
139:     assert.strictEqual(readyRes.body.checks.database, 'up', 'Database check must be up');
140:     assert.strictEqual(readyRes.body.checks.redis, 'up', 'Redis check must be up');
141:     assert.strictEqual(readyRes.body.checks.storage, 'up', 'Storage check must be up');
142:     assert.strictEqual(readyRes.body.checks.rbac, 'up', 'RBAC check must be up');
143:     console.log('  PASS: /health/ready responded 200 with all dependencies up');
144: 
145:     // 3. Test Correlation ID propagation
146:     console.log('[TEST 3] Propagates x-correlation-id through NestJS middleware');
147:     const customCorrelationId = 'c0rrel-test-uuid-98765';
148:     const corrRes = await request(app.getHttpServer())
149:       .get('/health/live')
150:       .set('x-correlation-id', customCorrelationId)
151:       .expect(200);
152:     assert.strictEqual(
153:       corrRes.headers['x-correlation-id'],
154:       customCorrelationId,
155:       'Response header x-correlation-id must match incoming request'
156:     );
157:     console.log('  PASS: Correlation ID propagated correctly in HTTP header');
158: 
159:     // 4. Test Dependency Outage / Fail-Closed behavior
160:     console.log('[TEST 4] GET /health/ready fails closed (503) when database is down');
161:     const brokenModule: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
162:       imports: [AppModule],
163:     })
164:       .overrideProvider(APP_CONFIG)
165:       .useValue(mockConfig)
166:       .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
167:       .useValue(createMockPrismaForHarness('down'))
168:       .overrideProvider(RedisService)
169:       .useValue({
170:         checkReadiness: async () => 'up',
171:         onModuleDestroy: async () => {},
172:       })
173:       .overrideProvider(StorageService)
174:       .useValue({
175:         checkReadiness: async () => 'up',
176:       })
177:       .compile();
178: 
179:     const brokenApp: INestApplication = brokenModule.createNestApplication();
180:     await brokenApp.init();
181: 
182:     const degradedRes = await request(brokenApp.getHttpServer()).get('/health/ready').expect(503);
183:     assert.strictEqual(degradedRes.body.status, 'error', 'Status must be error');
184:     assert.strictEqual(degradedRes.body.checks.database, 'down', 'Database must be down');
185:     assert.strictEqual(
186:       degradedRes.body.checks.rbac,
187:       'down',
188:       'RBAC check must be down when DB is down'
189:     );
190:     console.log('  PASS: Outage simulation correctly returned 503 degraded');
191:     await brokenApp.close();
192: 
193:     console.log('\n================================================================');
194:     console.log('ALL SUPERTEST & NESTJS HARNESS TESTS PASSED 100%');
195:     console.log('================================================================');
196:   } finally {
197:     await app.close();
198:   }
199: }
200: 
201: runSupertestSuite().catch((err) => {
202:   console.error('Supertest suite failed:', err);
203:   process.exit(1);
204: });

<file path="apps/api/AGENTS.md">
 1: # apps/api — Author checklist
 2: 
 3: Mandatory before a NestJS API change is reviewable. Root `AGENTS.md` still wins on conflict.
 4: 
 5: ## Review P1 gates
 6: 
 7: - Scope every tenant-owned Prisma query server-side by the session `merchantId` (`merchant_id`). Never trust a client-supplied tenant or merchant id.
 8: - An empty scope array denies. `where: { id: { in: [] } }` and any empty `IN` must return nothing, not every row.
 9: - Every endpoint has an auth guard plus an RBAC guard (`SessionGuard` and `PermissionsGuard` / `RequirePermissions`). A public route must be an explicit exception in the Work Item.
10: - Audit metadata is always masked. Phone, email, bank account, token and secret fields go through the module mask helper before they are written or logged.
11: - Each new endpoint has a cross-tenant negative supertest: merchant A’s session cannot read or mutate merchant B’s row.
12: - Update `docs/product-spec/contracts/openapi.yaml` in the same change as the route.
13: 
14: ## NestJS (condensed)
15: 
16: Source: PatrickJS/awesome-cursorrules `rules/typescript-nestjs-best-practices-cursorrules-promp.mdc` (CC0-1.0). Condensed, not copied.
17: 
18: - One module per domain: one controller for the route, `class-validator` DTOs for input, a service for business logic and persistence.
19: - Shared filters, guards and interceptors live in the core module; cross-module helpers live in shared.
20: - PascalCase classes, camelCase members, kebab-case files. Type every parameter and return. Do not use `any`.
21: - Short single-purpose functions. Early return over nested blocks. One level of abstraction.
22: - Throw `CanonicalApiException` for expected failures. Catch only to add context; otherwise let the global exception filter handle it.
23: - Tests follow Arrange-Act-Assert and Given-When-Then. Cover each new controller and service behavior, including the forbidden and cross-tenant cases above.
24: 
25: ## Prisma (condensed)
26: 
27: - Read and write only through `PrismaService`. Put `merchant_id` in the same `where` as the entity id on every tenant-owned query, including `update` and `delete`.
28: - Interactive `$transaction` for multi-row writes. No unbounded `findMany`; paginate.
29: - Do not edit generated client output or hand-apply SQL outside `prisma/migrations`.
</file>

<file path="apps/web/e2e/a11y.spec.ts">
 1: import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';
 2: import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
 3: 
 4: // Public routes that render without a signed-in session.
 5: const ROUTES = ['/', '/register', '/forgot-password', '/reset-password'];
 6: 
 7: for (const route of ROUTES) {
 8:   test(`${route} has no WCAG 2.1 A/AA violations`, async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
 9:     const response = await page.goto(route);
10:     expect(response?.ok(), `GET ${route} returned ${response?.status()}`).toBeTruthy();
11:     const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
12:       .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa'])
13:       .analyze();
14:     await testInfo.attach('axe-results', {
15:       body: JSON.stringify(
16:         { violations: results.violations, incomplete: results.incomplete },
17:         null,
18:         2
19:       ),
20:       contentType: 'application/json',
21:     });
22:     const summary = results.violations.map(
23:       (v) => `${v.id} (${v.impact}): ${v.nodes.length} node(s) — ${v.help}`
24:     );
25:     expect(summary, summary.join('\n')).toEqual([]);
26:   });
27: }

<file path="apps/web/e2e/mfa.spec.ts">
  1: import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';
  2: import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
  3: import { expect, test, type Page, type Route, type TestInfo } from '@playwright/test';
  4: 
  5: /**
  6:  * FEAT-AUTH-05 / AC-AUTH-05-17 — browser acceptance of the MFA UI:
  7:  *   owner login -> enrollment required -> setup -> activation -> sign-out -> MFA login challenge.
  8:  *
  9:  * The browser talks to a stateful in-test fake of the auth API (page.route) that enforces the same
 10:  * contract rules as the real service (6-digit TOTP, +/-1 step window, replayed step rejected,
 11:  * single-use challenge). The real API and database behaviour of the same flow is proved by the
 12:  * Nest supertest suites; this spec proves the UI wiring, state coverage, keyboard flow and axe.
 13:  */
 14: const API = /\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1):3001\/auth\//;
 15: const SECRET = 'JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP';
 16: const PASSWORD = 'TestPassword123!';
 17: const RECOVERY_CODES = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => `A1B${i}-C2D${i}-E3F${i}-9A8${i}`);
 18: 
 19: function base32Decode(input: string): Buffer {
 20:   const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567';
 21:   let bits = 0;
 22:   let value = 0;
 23:   const out: number[] = [];
 24:   for (const ch of input) {
 25:     value = (value << 5) | alphabet.indexOf(ch);
 26:     bits += 5;
 27:     if (bits >= 8) {
 28:       out.push((value >>> (bits - 8)) & 255);
 29:       bits -= 8;
 30:     }
 31:   }
 32:   return Buffer.from(out);
 33: }
 34: 
 35: function totpAtStep(step: number): string {
 36:   const counter = Buffer.alloc(8);
 37:   counter.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(step));
 38:   const hmac = createHmac('sha1', base32Decode(SECRET)).update(counter).digest();
 39:   const offset = hmac[hmac.length - 1] & 0x0f;
 40:   const bin =
 41:     ((hmac[offset] & 0x7f) << 24) |
 42:     (hmac[offset + 1] << 16) |
 43:     (hmac[offset + 2] << 8) |
 44:     hmac[offset + 3];
 45:   return String(bin % 1_000_000).padStart(6, '0');
 46: }
 47: const stepNow = () => Math.floor(Date.now() / 30_000);
 48: 
 49: const USER = {
 50:   id: 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000005e1',
 51:   merchant_id: 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
 52:   email: 'owner@shipde.vn',
 53:   phone: null,
 54:   full_name: 'Chủ Shop Demo',
 55:   role: 'OWNER',
 56:   status: 'ACTIVE',
 57:   email_verified_at: '2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z',
 58:   phone_verified_at: null,
 59:   created_at: '2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z',
 60:   auth_assurance: 'MFA',
 61:   mfa_verified_at: '2026-10-23T00:00:00.000Z',
 62: };
 63: const MERCHANT = {
 64:   id: USER.merchant_id,
 65:   name: 'Shop Demo',
 66:   business_code: 'SHOP_DEMO_01',
 67:   status: 'active',
 68:   created_at: '2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z',
 69: };
 70: // Structural placeholders (header.payload.signature) built at runtime; not credentials.
 71: const fakeJwt = (claims: Record<string, unknown>) =>
 72:   ['e30', Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(claims)).toString('base64url'), 'placeholder'].join('.');
 73: const FAR_FUTURE_EXP = 4_102_444_800;
 74: const FULL_TOKEN = fakeJwt({ scope: 'full', exp: FAR_FUTURE_EXP });
 75: const SETUP_TOKEN = fakeJwt({ scope: 'setup', exp: FAR_FUTURE_EXP });
 76: 
 77: const json = (route: Route, status: number, body: unknown) =>
 78:   route.fulfill({
 79:     status,
 80:     contentType: 'application/json',
 81:     headers: { 'access-control-allow-origin': '*', 'access-control-allow-headers': '*' },
 82:     body: JSON.stringify(body),
 83:   });
 84: 
 85: async function installFakeAuthApi(page: Page, opts: { enrolled?: boolean } = {}) {
 86:   const state = {
 87:     active: Boolean(opts.enrolled),
 88:     setupStarted: false,
 89:     lastAcceptedStep: -1,
 90:     challengeUsed: false,
 91:   };
 92:   const accept = (code: string): boolean => {
 93:     for (const step of [stepNow(), stepNow() - 1, stepNow() + 1]) {
 94:       if (code === totpAtStep(step) && step > state.lastAcceptedStep) {
 95:         state.lastAcceptedStep = step;
 96:         return true;
 97:       }
 98:     }
 99:     return false;
100:   };
101: 
102:   await page.route(API, async (route) => {
103:     const req = route.request();
104:     const path = new URL(req.url()).pathname;
105:     if (req.method() === 'OPTIONS') return json(route, 204, {});
106:     const body = (req.postDataJSON() ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
107: 
108:     if (path === '/auth/login') {
109:       if (body.password !== PASSWORD) {
110:         return json(route, 401, {
111:           error: { code: 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', message: 'Thông tin đăng nhập không đúng' },
112:         });
113:       }
114:       if (state.active) {
115:         state.challengeUsed = false;
116:         return json(route, 200, {
117:           data: { status: 'MFA_REQUIRED', challenge_id: 'chal-opaque-1', expires_in: 300 },
118:           meta: { correlation_id: 'c-1' },
119:         });
120:       }
121:       return json(route, 403, {
122:         error: {
123:           code: 'MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED',
124:           message: 'Tài khoản yêu cầu thiết lập xác thực hai yếu tố (MFA).',
125:           setup_token: SETUP_TOKEN,
126:           expires_in: 600,
127:         },
128:       });
129:     }
130:     if (path === '/auth/mfa/status') {
131:       return json(route, 200, {
132:         data: {
133:           status: state.active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'NOT_ENROLLED',
134:           required: true,
135:           recovery_codes_remaining: state.active ? 10 : 0,
136:           mfa_verified_at: state.active ? '2026-10-23T00:00:00.000Z' : null,
137:         },
138:         meta: { correlation_id: 'c-2' },
139:       });
140:     }
141:     if (path === '/auth/mfa/setup') {
142:       if (body.password !== PASSWORD) {
143:         return json(route, 401, {
144:           error: { code: 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', message: 'Mật khẩu không chính xác' },
145:         });
146:       }
147:       state.setupStarted = true;
148:       return json(route, 200, {
149:         data: {
150:           secret_key: SECRET,
151:           provisioning_uri: `otpauth://totp/Ship%20De:owner%40shipde.vn?secret=${SECRET}&issuer=Ship%20De`,
152:           expires_at: '2099-01-01T00:10:00.000Z',
153:           expires_in_seconds: 600,
154:         },
155:         meta: { correlation_id: 'c-3' },
156:       });
157:     }
158:     if (path === '/auth/mfa/setup/verify') {
159:       if (!state.setupStarted || !accept(String(body.code))) {
160:         return json(route, 400, {
161:           error: {
162:             code: 'MFA_CODE_INVALID',
163:             message: 'Mã xác thực không chính xác hoặc đã hết hạn',
164:           },
165:         });
166:       }
167:       state.active = true;
168:       return json(route, 200, {
169:         data: {
170:           status: 'AUTHENTICATED',
171:           recovery_codes: RECOVERY_CODES,
172:           access_token: FULL_TOKEN,
173:           expires_in: 43200,
174:           user: USER,
175:           merchant: MERCHANT,
176:         },
177:         meta: { correlation_id: 'c-4' },
178:       });
179:     }
180:     if (path === '/auth/mfa/challenge/verify') {
181:       if (
182:         body.challenge_id !== 'chal-opaque-1' ||
183:         state.challengeUsed ||
184:         !accept(String(body.code))
185:       ) {
186:         return json(route, 400, {
187:           error: { code: 'MFA_CODE_INVALID', message: 'Mã xác thực không chính xác.' },
188:         });
189:       }
190:       state.challengeUsed = true;
191:       return json(route, 200, {
192:         data: {
193:           status: 'AUTHENTICATED',
194:           access_token: FULL_TOKEN,
195:           expires_in: 43200,
196:           user: USER,
197:           merchant: MERCHANT,
198:         },
199:         meta: { correlation_id: 'c-5' },
200:       });
201:     }
202:     return json(route, 404, { error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `unmocked ${path}` } });
203:   });
204: }
205: 
206: async function expectNoAxeViolations(page: Page, testInfo: TestInfo, name: string) {
207:   const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
208:     .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa'])
209:     .analyze();
210:   await testInfo.attach(`axe-${name}`, {
211:     body: JSON.stringify({ violations: results.violations }, null, 2),
212:     contentType: 'application/json',
213:   });
214:   const summary = results.violations.map(
215:     (v) =>
216:       `${v.id} (${v.impact}): ${v.nodes.length} node(s) — ${v.help} :: ${v.nodes.map((n) => n.html.slice(0, 160)).join(' | ')}`
217:   );
218:   expect(summary, `${name}\n${summary.join('\n')}`).toEqual([]);
219: }
220: 
221: async function shot(page: Page, testInfo: TestInfo, name: string) {
222:   const file = testInfo.outputPath(`${name}.png`);
223:   await page.screenshot({ path: file, fullPage: true });
224:   await testInfo.attach(name, { path: file, contentType: 'image/png' });
225: }
226: 
227: async function submitPasswordLogin(page: Page) {
228:   await page.goto('/');
229:   await page.getByPlaceholder('email@cuahang.vn hoặc 09xx.xxx.xxx').fill('owner@shipde.vn');
230:   await page.getByPlaceholder('••••••••').fill(PASSWORD);
231:   await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Đăng Nhập', exact: true }).click();
232: }
233: 
234: test.describe('FEAT-AUTH-05 MFA UI (AC-AUTH-05-17)', () => {
235:   test('owner enrolls, activates, then passes the MFA login challenge', async ({
236:     page,
237:   }, testInfo) => {
238:     await installFakeAuthApi(page);
239: 
240:     // 1. Owner password login -> enrollment required notice
241:     await submitPasswordLogin(page);
242:     await expect(page.getByTestId('mfa-enrollment-notice')).toBeVisible();
243:     await expectNoAxeViolations(page, testInfo, 'enrollment-notice');
244:     await shot(page, testInfo, '01-enrollment-required');
245: 
246:     // 2. Security settings: setup-only token reaches the page; start setup
247:     await page.getByRole('link', { name: /Kích Hoạt Bảo Mật 2FA Ngay/ }).click();
248:     await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Bảo mật tài khoản' })).toBeVisible();
249:     await expect(page.getByText('Chưa kích hoạt')).toBeVisible();
250:     await expectNoAxeViolations(page, testInfo, 'security-not-enrolled');
251:     await shot(page, testInfo, '02-security-not-enrolled');
252: 
253:     await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Bắt đầu thiết lập MFA/ }).click();
254:     await page.getByLabel('Mật khẩu tài khoản').fill('wrong-password');
255:     await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Tiếp tục' }).click();
256:     await expect(page.locator('div[role="alert"][aria-live="polite"]')).toContainText(
257:       'Mật khẩu không chính xác'
258:     );
259:     await expectNoAxeViolations(page, testInfo, 'security-setup-auth-error');
260:     await shot(page, testInfo, '03-setup-password-error');
261: 
262:     await page.getByLabel('Mật khẩu tài khoản').fill(PASSWORD);
263:     await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Tiếp tục' }).click();
264:     await expect(page.getByText(SECRET)).toBeVisible();
265:     await expectNoAxeViolations(page, testInfo, 'security-setup-verify');
266:     await shot(page, testInfo, '04-setup-verify-manual-key');
267: 
268:     // A code outside the accepted window is rejected by the server and stays on the step.
269:     const codeInput = page.getByLabel('Nhập mã 6 chữ số từ ứng dụng');
270:     await codeInput.fill(totpAtStep(stepNow() + 40));
271:     await codeInput.press('Enter');
272:     await expect(page.locator('div[role="alert"][aria-live="polite"]')).toContainText(
273:       'không chính xác'
274:     );
275:     await shot(page, testInfo, '05-setup-code-rejected');
276: 
277:     await codeInput.fill(totpAtStep(stepNow()));
278:     await codeInput.press('Enter');
279: 
280:     // 3. Activation: recovery codes shown once, acknowledgement required
281:     await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Lưu mã dự phòng của bạn' })).toBeVisible();
282:     for (const code of RECOVERY_CODES) {
283:       await expect(page.getByText(code, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
284:     }
285:     const finish = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Hoàn tất thiết lập' });
286:     await expect(finish).toBeDisabled();
287:     await expectNoAxeViolations(page, testInfo, 'security-recovery-codes');
288:     await shot(page, testInfo, '06-recovery-codes');
289:     await page.getByRole('checkbox').check();
290:     await finish.click();
291:     await expect(page.getByText('Đã kích hoạt', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
292:     await expect(page.getByText('Còn lại: 10/10 mã chưa sử dụng')).toBeVisible();
293:     await expectNoAxeViolations(page, testInfo, 'security-active');
294:     await shot(page, testInfo, '07-security-active');
295: 
296:     // 4. Sign out (drop persisted session) and log in again -> MFA challenge
297:     await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear());
298:     await submitPasswordLogin(page);
299:     await expect(page.getByTestId('mfa-challenge-form')).toBeVisible();
300:     await expectNoAxeViolations(page, testInfo, 'mfa-challenge');
301:     await shot(page, testInfo, '08-mfa-challenge');
302: 
303:     await page.locator('#mfa-totp-code').fill('000000');
304:     await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Xác Nhận Đăng Nhập' }).click();
305:     await expect(
306:       page.getByRole('alert').filter({ hasText: 'Mã xác thực không chính xác' })
307:     ).toBeVisible();
308:     await shot(page, testInfo, '09-mfa-challenge-error');
309: 
310:     // The activation step is spent (replay rejected), so the next step's code is used.
311:     await page.locator('#mfa-totp-code').fill(totpAtStep(stepNow() + 1));
312:     await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Xác Nhận Đăng Nhập' }).click();
313:     await expect(page.getByTestId('mfa-challenge-form')).toBeHidden();
314:     expect(await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('shipde_token'))).toBe(FULL_TOKEN);
315:   });
316: 
317:   test('recovery-code challenge view is accessible and keyboard focused', async ({
318:     page,
319:   }, testInfo) => {
320:     await installFakeAuthApi(page, { enrolled: true });
321:     await submitPasswordLogin(page);
322:     await expect(page.getByTestId('mfa-challenge-form')).toBeVisible();
323:     await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Sử dụng mã dự phòng/ }).click();
324:     await expect(page.getByTestId('mfa-recovery-form')).toBeVisible();
325:     await expect(page.locator('#mfa-recovery-code')).toBeFocused();
326:     await expectNoAxeViolations(page, testInfo, 'mfa-recovery');
327:     await shot(page, testInfo, '10-mfa-recovery');
328:   });
329: 
330:   test('an expired stored token is dropped on load instead of replayed', async ({ page }) => {
331:     await installFakeAuthApi(page);
332:     const expired = fakeJwt({ scope: 'setup', exp: 1 });
333:     await page.addInitScript((value) => localStorage.setItem('shipde_token', value), expired);
334:     await page.goto('/');
335:     await expect(page.getByPlaceholder('••••••••')).toBeVisible();
336:     expect(await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('shipde_token'))).toBeNull();
337:   });
338: });

<file path="apps/web/src/adapters/pancake.adapter.ts">
 1: // ============================================================================
 2: // Ship Dễ — Pancake POS Source Adapter (Tập 1 Mục 2.2, Tập 2 CN-01..03)
 3: // ============================================================================
 4: 
 5: import { Order, WeightGram, CurrencyAmount } from '../types/domain';
 6: import { ERROR_CATALOG, ShipDeAppError } from '../types/error-codes';
 7: 
 8: export interface PancakeRawOrder {
 9:   id: string | number;
10:   order_number: string;
11:   inserted_at: string;
12:   total_price: number;
13:   cod: number;
14:   weight?: number; // gram
15:   partner?: {
16:     partner_id?: string;
17:     partner_name?: string;
18:     tracking_number?: string;
19:     status?: string;
20:   };
21:   bill_phone_number?: string;
22:   bill_full_name?: string;
23:   shipping_address?: {
24:     province?: string;
25:     district?: string;
26:     full_address?: string;
27:   };
28: }
29: 
30: export class PancakePosAdapter {
31:   /**
32:    * Chuẩn hóa đơn hàng thô từ Pancake POS sang Order Entity chuẩn của Ship Dễ
33:    */
34:   public normalizeOrder(
35:     raw: PancakeRawOrder,
36:     merchantId: string
37:   ): { order: Order; rawTrackingCode?: string } {
38:     if (!raw.order_number && !raw.id) {
39:       throw new ShipDeAppError(ERROR_CATALOG.VALIDATION_ERROR, {
40:         reason: 'Pancake payload missing order_number or id',
41:       });
42:     }
43: 
44:     const orderCode = String(raw.order_number || raw.id).trim();
45:     const createdAt = raw.inserted_at ? new Date(raw.inserted_at) : new Date();
46:     const codAmount = Math.max(0, Math.round(raw.cod || 0));
47:     const declaredWeight = Math.max(0, Math.round(raw.weight || 300));
48:     const rawTracking = raw.partner?.tracking_number?.trim();
49: 
50:     const order: Order = {
51:       id: `ord_${merchantId.slice(0, 8)}_${orderCode}`,
52:       merchant_id: merchantId,
53:       branch_id: (raw as any).branch_id || 'default_branch',
54:       warehouse_id: (raw as any).warehouse_id || 'default_wh',
55:       order_code: orderCode,
56:       created_at: createdAt,
57:       cod_amount: codAmount,
58:       declared_weight_g: declaredWeight,
59:       recipient_name: raw.bill_full_name || 'Khách hàng',
60:       recipient_phone: raw.bill_phone_number || '',
61:       recipient_province: raw.shipping_address?.province || 'Hà Nội',
62:       recipient_address: raw.shipping_address?.full_address || '',
63:       item_value: Math.max(0, Math.round(raw.total_price || codAmount)),
64:     };
65: 
66:     return {
67:       order,
68:       rawTrackingCode: rawTracking,
69:     };
70:   }
71: 
72:   /**
73:    * Giả lập nạp lịch sử đơn hàng phân trang (CN-01)
74:    */
75:   public async backfillOrders(
76:     merchantId: string,
77:     apiKey: string,
78:     fromDate: Date,
79:     pageSize: number = 100,
80:     cursor?: string
81:   ): Promise<{
82:     orders: Array<{ order: Order; rawTrackingCode?: string }>;
83:     nextCursor?: string;
84:     hasMore: boolean;
85:   }> {
86:     if (!apiKey) {
87:       throw new ShipDeAppError(ERROR_CATALOG.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, {
88:         source: 'Pancake POS',
89:         reason: 'Missing API Key',
90:       });
91:     }
92: 
93:     // Giả lập trả về danh sách đơn nạp theo lô
94:     return {
95:       orders: [],
96:       hasMore: false,
97:     };
98:   }
99: }
</file>

359: export default function AdminNewShopPage() {
360:   const router = useRouter();
361:   const { user, token, isAuthenticated, isHydrating } = useAuth();
362: 
363:   const isPlatformAdmin = Boolean(user && (user.role as string) === 'PLATFORM_ADMIN');
364: 
365:   const [merchantName, setMerchantName] = useState('');
366:   const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('');
367:   const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
368:   const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
369:   const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
370:   const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
371:   const [formErrors, setFormErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
372:   const [createError, setCreateError] = useState<string | null>(null);
373:   const [createdSuccess, setCreatedSuccess] = useState<CreatedShopSuccessData | null>(null);
374: 
375:   const handleCreateShop = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
376:     e.preventDefault();
377:     setCreateError(null);
378:     setFormErrors({});
379: 
380:     const errors = validateShopForm(merchantName, email, phone, password);
381:     if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
382:       setFormErrors(errors);
383:       return;
384:     }
385: 
386:     setIsSubmitting(true);
387:     try {
388:       const res = await fetch('/api/admin/shops', {
389:         method: 'POST',
390:         headers: {
391:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
392:           Accept: 'application/json',
393:           ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
394:         },
395:         body: JSON.stringify({
396:           merchant_name: merchantName.trim(),
397:           full_name: fullName.trim() || merchantName.trim(),
398:           email: email.trim() || undefined,
399:           phone: phone.trim() || undefined,
400:           password: password || undefined,
401:         }),
402:       });
403: 
404:       const json = await res.json();
405: 
406:       if (!res.ok) {
407:         if (json?.error?.fields && Array.isArray(json.error.fields)) {
408:           const fieldMap: Record<string, string> = {};
409:           json.error.fields.forEach((f: any) => {
410:             fieldMap[f.field] = f.message;
411:           });
412:           setFormErrors(fieldMap);
413:         }
414:         throw new Error(json?.error?.message || `Khởi tạo thất bại (HTTP ${res.status})`);
415:       }
416: 
417:       setCreatedSuccess(json.data);
418:     } catch (err: any) {
419:       setCreateError(err.message || 'Lỗi khi khởi tạo cửa hàng');
420:     } finally {
421:       setIsSubmitting(false);
422:     }
423:   };
424: 
425:   return (
426:     <AdminNewShopView
427:       isAuthenticated={isAuthenticated}
428:       user={user}
429:       isPlatformAdmin={isPlatformAdmin}
430:       isHydrating={isHydrating}
431:       merchantName={merchantName}
432:       setMerchantName={setMerchantName}
433:       fullName={fullName}
434:       setFullName={setFullName}
435:       email={email}
436:       setEmail={setEmail}
437:       phone={phone}
438:       setPhone={setPhone}
439:       password={password}
440:       setPassword={setPassword}
441:       isSubmitting={isSubmitting}
442:       formErrors={formErrors}
443:       createError={createError}
444:       createdSuccess={createdSuccess}
445:       onSubmit={handleCreateShop}
446:     />
447:   );
448: }

 28:   owner?: {

 46: export interface CreatedShopSuccessData {
 47:   merchant: { id: string; name: string; code: string; status: string; created_at: string };
 48:   user: {
 49:     id: string;
 50:     merchant_id: string;
 51:     full_name: string;
 52:     email: string | null;
 53:     phone: string | null;
 54:     role: string;
 55:     status: string;
 56:     email_verified_at: string | null;
 57:     phone_verified_at: string | null;
 58:   };
 59:   password_is_temporary: boolean;

 62: export function validateShopForm(
 63:   merchantName: string,
 64:   email: string,
 65:   phone: string,
 66:   password?: string
 67: ): Record<string, string> {
 68:   const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
 69: 
 70:   if (!merchantName.trim() || merchantName.trim().length < 2) {
 71:     errors.merchant_name = 'Tên cửa hàng phải có ít nhất 2 ký tự';
 72:   } else if (merchantName.trim().length > 255) {
 73:     errors.merchant_name = 'Tên cửa hàng không được vượt quá 255 ký tự';
 74:   }
 75: 
 76:   const trimmedEmail = email.trim();
 77:   const trimmedPhone = phone.trim();
 78: 
 79:   if (!trimmedEmail && !trimmedPhone) {
 80:     errors.email = 'Phải cung cấp ít nhất email hoặc số điện thoại';
 81:     errors.phone = 'Phải cung cấp ít nhất email hoặc số điện thoại';
 82:   }
 83: 
 84:   if (trimmedEmail && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmedEmail)) {
 85:     errors.email = 'Định dạng email không hợp lệ';
 86:   }
 87: 
 88:   if (trimmedPhone) {
 89:     if (/[^0-9+\s.-]/.test(trimmedPhone)) {
 90:       errors.phone = 'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ theo định dạng Việt Nam';
 91:     } else {
 92:       const cleanDigits = trimmedPhone.replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
 93:       let normalized = cleanDigits;
 94:       if (cleanDigits.startsWith('+84')) {
 95:         normalized = `0${cleanDigits.slice(3)}`;
 96:       } else if (cleanDigits.startsWith('84') && cleanDigits.length === 11) {
 97:         normalized = `0${cleanDigits.slice(2)}`;
 98:       }
 99:       if (!/^0[35789][0-9]{8}$/.test(normalized)) {
100:         errors.phone = 'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ theo định dạng Việt Nam';
101:       }
102:     }
103:   }
104: 
105:   if (password && password.length < 8) {
106:     errors.password = 'Mật khẩu phải có độ dài tối thiểu 8 ký tự';
107:   }
108: 
109:   return errors;
110: }

670: export default function AdminShopsPage() {
671:   const { user, token, isAuthenticated, isHydrating } = useAuth();
672: 
673:   const isPlatformAdmin = Boolean(user && (user.role as string) === 'PLATFORM_ADMIN');
674: 
675:   const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
676:   const [shops, setShops] = useState<ShopRecord[]>([]);
677:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
678:   const [listError, setListError] = useState<string | null>(null);
679:   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
680: 
681:   const [merchantName, setMerchantName] = useState('');
682:   const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('');
683:   const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
684:   const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
685:   const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
686:   const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
687:   const [formErrors, setFormErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
688:   const [createError, setCreateError] = useState<string | null>(null);
689:   const [createdSuccess, setCreatedSuccess] = useState<CreatedShopSuccessData | null>(null);
690: 
691:   const fetchShops = useCallback(async () => {
692:     setIsLoading(true);
693:     setListError(null);
694:     try {
695:       const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/shops?search=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery)}`, {
696:         headers: {
697:           Accept: 'application/json',
698:           ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
699:         },
700:       });
701: 
702:       if (!res.ok) {
703:         const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
704:         throw new Error(
705:           errData?.error?.message || `Lỗi tải danh sách cửa hàng (HTTP ${res.status})`
706:         );
707:       }
708: 
709:       const json = await res.json();
710:       setShops(json?.data?.shops || []);
711:     } catch (err: any) {
712:       setListError(err.message || 'Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ');
713:     } finally {
714:       setIsLoading(false);
715:     }
716:   }, [searchQuery, token]);
717: 
718:   useEffect(() => {
719:     if (isAuthenticated && user && isPlatformAdmin) {
720:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- initial fetch
721:       void fetchShops();
722:     }
723:   }, [isAuthenticated, user, isPlatformAdmin, fetchShops]);
724: 
725:   const handleCreateShop = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
726:     e.preventDefault();
727:     setCreateError(null);
728:     setFormErrors({});
729: 
730:     const errors = validateShopForm(merchantName, email, phone, password);
731:     if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
732:       setFormErrors(errors);
733:       return;
734:     }
735: 
736:     setIsSubmitting(true);
737:     try {
738:       const res = await fetch('/api/admin/shops', {
739:         method: 'POST',
740:         headers: {
741:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
742:           Accept: 'application/json',
743:           ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
744:         },
745:         body: JSON.stringify({
746:           merchant_name: merchantName.trim(),
747:           full_name: fullName.trim() || merchantName.trim(),
748:           email: email.trim() || undefined,
749:           phone: phone.trim() || undefined,
750:           password: password || undefined,
751:         }),
752:       });
753: 
754:       const json = await res.json();
755: 
756:       if (!res.ok) {
757:         if (json?.error?.fields && Array.isArray(json.error.fields)) {
758:           const fieldMap: Record<string, string> = {};
759:           json.error.fields.forEach((f: any) => {
760:             fieldMap[f.field] = f.message;
761:           });
762:           setFormErrors(fieldMap);
763:         }
764:         throw new Error(json?.error?.message || `Khởi tạo thất bại (HTTP ${res.status})`);
765:       }
766: 
767:       setCreatedSuccess(json.data);
768:       setMerchantName('');
769:       setFullName('');
770:       setEmail('');
771:       setPhone('');
772:       setPassword('');
773:       setFormErrors({});
774: 
775:       void fetchShops();
776:     } catch (err: any) {
777:       setCreateError(err.message || 'Lỗi khi khởi tạo cửa hàng');
778:     } finally {
779:       setIsSubmitting(false);
780:     }
781:   };
782: 
783:   return (
784:     <AdminShopsView
785:       isAuthenticated={isAuthenticated}
786:       user={user}
787:       isPlatformAdmin={isPlatformAdmin}
788:       isHydrating={isHydrating}
789:       shops={shops}
790:       isLoading={isLoading}
791:       listError={listError}
792:       searchQuery={searchQuery}
793:       setSearchQuery={setSearchQuery}
794:       showCreateModal={showCreateModal}
795:       setShowCreateModal={setShowCreateModal}
796:       merchantName={merchantName}
797:       setMerchantName={setMerchantName}
798:       fullName={fullName}
799:       setFullName={setFullName}
800:       email={email}
801:       setEmail={setEmail}
802:       phone={phone}
803:       setPhone={setPhone}
804:       password={password}
805:       setPassword={setPassword}
806:       isSubmitting={isSubmitting}
807:       formErrors={formErrors}
808:       createError={createError}
809:       createdSuccess={createdSuccess}
810:       onRefresh={fetchShops}
811:       onCreateSubmit={handleCreateShop}
812:     />
813:   );
814: }
</file>
