<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/admin/shops/route.ts">
  1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  2: import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
  3: 
  4: const API_BASE =
  5:   process.env.API_BASE_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
  6: 
  7: export interface AuthResult {
  8:   authorized: boolean;
  9:   statusCode: number;
 10:   token?: string;
 11:   message: string;
 12: }
 13: 
 14: export function verifyAdminAuthorization(req: NextRequest, isMutation = false): AuthResult {
 15:   // State-changing requests must not be authorized by cookies alone (CSRF/origin protection)
 16:   if (isMutation) {
 17:     const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
 18:     const host = req.headers.get('host');
 19:     if (origin && host) {
 20:       try {
 21:         const originHost = new URL(origin).host;
 22:         if (originHost !== host) {
 23:           return {
 24:             authorized: false,
 25:             statusCode: 403,
 26:             message: 'Truy cập bị từ chối do vi phạm bảo vệ Cross-Origin (CSRF)',
 27:           };
 28:         }
 29:       } catch {
 30:         return {
 31:           authorized: false,
 32:           statusCode: 403,
 33:           message: 'Origin không hợp lệ',
 34:         };
 35:       }
 36:     }
 37:   }
 38: 
 39:   // Validate signed session token (Bearer token only for mutations; cookies disallowed for mutations)
 40:   let rawToken: string | undefined;
 41:   const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
 42:   if (authHeader && authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
 43:     rawToken = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
 44:   } else if (!isMutation) {
 45:     rawToken = req.cookies.get('token')?.value?.trim() || req.cookies.get('session')?.value?.trim();
 46:   } else {
 47:     return {
 48:       authorized: false,
 49:       statusCode: 403,
 50:       message:
 51:         'Yêu cầu thay đổi trạng thái quản trị viên không được phép xác thực chỉ bằng cookie (CSRF)',
 52:     };
 53:   }
 54: 
 55:   if (!rawToken) {
 56:     return {
 57:       authorized: false,
 58:       statusCode: 403,
 59:       message: 'Truy cập bị từ chối: Yêu cầu đăng nhập quản trị viên',
 60:     };
 61:   }
 62: 
 63:   const tokenSecret = process.env.AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET?.trim();
 64:   if (!tokenSecret) {
 65:     return {
 66:       authorized: false,
 67:       statusCode: 403,
 68:       message: 'Khóa ký phiên chưa được cấu hình trên máy chủ (fail-closed)',
 69:     };
 70:   }
 71: 
 72:   const parts = rawToken.split('.');
 73:   if (parts.length !== 3) {
 74:     return {
 75:       authorized: false,
 76:       statusCode: 403,
 77:       message: 'Phiên đăng nhập không hợp lệ',
 78:     };
 79:   }
 80: 
 81:   const [version, payload, signature] = parts;
 82:   if (version !== 'v1') {
 83:     return {
 84:       authorized: false,
 85:       statusCode: 403,
 86:       message: 'Phiên bản phiên đăng nhập không được hỗ trợ',
 87:     };
 88:   }
 89: 
 90:   const expectedSig = createHmac('sha256', tokenSecret).update(`${version}.${payload}`).digest();
 91:   const providedSig = Buffer.from(signature, 'base64url');
 92: 
 93:   if (providedSig.length !== expectedSig.length || !timingSafeEqual(providedSig, expectedSig)) {
 94:     return {
 95:       authorized: false,
 96:       statusCode: 403,
 97:       message: 'Chữ ký phiên đăng nhập không hợp lệ',
 98:     };
 99:   }
100: 
101:   let claims: any;
102:   try {
103:     claims = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(payload, 'base64url').toString('utf8'));
104:   } catch {
105:     return {
106:       authorized: false,
107:       statusCode: 403,
108:       message: 'Dữ liệu phiên đăng nhập không hợp lệ',
109:     };
110:   }
111: 
112:   const nowSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
113:   if (typeof claims.exp !== 'number' || claims.exp <= nowSeconds) {
114:     return {
115:       authorized: false,
116:       statusCode: 403,
117:       message: 'Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn',
118:     };
119:   }
120: 
121:   if (claims.role !== 'PLATFORM_ADMIN') {
122:     return {
123:       authorized: false,
124:       statusCode: 403,
125:       message: 'Truy cập bị từ chối: Yêu cầu quyền quản trị viên nền tảng (PLATFORM_ADMIN)',
126:     };
127:   }
128: 
129:   return { authorized: true, statusCode: 200, token: rawToken, message: 'OK' };
130: }
131: 
132: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
133:   const auth = verifyAdminAuthorization(req);
134:   if (!auth.authorized) {
135:     return NextResponse.json(
136:       {
137:         error: {
138:           code: 'FORBIDDEN',
139:           message: auth.message,
140:         },
141:       },
142:       { status: auth.statusCode }
143:     );
144:   }
145: 
146:   const searchParams = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
147:   const limit = searchParams.get('limit') || '20';
148:   const offset = searchParams.get('offset') || '0';
149:   const search = searchParams.get('search') || '';
150: 
151:   try {
152:     const query = new URLSearchParams({ limit, offset, ...(search ? { search } : {}) });
153:     const forwardHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
154:       Accept: 'application/json',
155:     };
156:     if (auth.token) {
157:       forwardHeaders['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${auth.token}`;
158:     }
159: 
160:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/admin/shops?${query.toString()}`, {
161:       headers: forwardHeaders,
162:       cache: 'no-store',
163:     });
164: 
165:     const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
166:     return NextResponse.json(data, { status: res.status });
167:   } catch (err: any) {
168:     return NextResponse.json(
169:       {
170:         error: {
171:           code: 'UPSTREAM_ERROR',
172:           message: err?.message || 'Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ quản trị',
173:         },
174:       },
175:       { status: 502 }
176:     );
177:   }
178: }
179: 
180: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
181:   const auth = verifyAdminAuthorization(req, true);
182:   if (!auth.authorized) {
183:     return NextResponse.json(
184:       {
185:         error: {
186:           code: 'FORBIDDEN',
187:           message: auth.message,
188:         },
189:       },
190:       { status: auth.statusCode }
191:     );
192:   }
193: 
194:   try {
195:     const body = await req.json();
196:     const forwardHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
197:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
198:       Accept: 'application/json',
199:     };
200:     if (auth.token) {
201:       forwardHeaders['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${auth.token}`;
202:     }
203: 
204:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/admin/shops`, {
205:       method: 'POST',
206:       headers: forwardHeaders,
207:       body: JSON.stringify(body),
208:     });
209: 
210:     const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
211:     return NextResponse.json(data, { status: res.status });
212:   } catch (err: any) {
213:     return NextResponse.json(
214:       {
215:         error: {
216:           code: 'UPSTREAM_ERROR',
217:           message: err?.message || 'Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ quản trị',
218:         },
219:       },
220:       { status: 502 }
221:     );
222:   }
223: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/claims/route.ts">
  1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  2: import { db } from '@/server/db';
  3: import { Claim } from '@/types/domain';
  4: 
  5: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  6:   try {
  7:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  8:     const search = searchParams.get('q')?.toLowerCase();
  9:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
 10: 
 11:     let list = db.claims.map((clm) => {
 12:       const ship = db.shipments.find(
 13:         (s) => s.id === clm.shipment_id || s.tracking_code.includes(clm.carrier_ticket || '')
 14:       );
 15:       const order = ship ? db.orders.find((o) => o.id === ship.order_id) : undefined;
 16:       const now = Date.now();
 17:       const hoursRemaining = Math.max(
 18:         0,
 19:         Math.round((new Date(clm.deadline_at).getTime() - now) / (3600 * 1000))
 20:       );
 21: 
 22:       return {
 23:         ...clm,
 24:         tracking_code: ship?.tracking_code || 'GHN88290500',
 25:         order_code: ship?.order_code || 'ORD_ANAN_103',
 26:         carrier: ship?.carrier_code || (clm.carrier_ticket?.startsWith('GHN') ? 'GHN' : 'GHTK'),
 27:         hours_remaining: hoursRemaining,
 28:         is_urgent: hoursRemaining <= 48 && hoursRemaining > 0 && clm.status !== 'CLOSED',
 29:       };
 30:     });
 31: 
 32:     if (search) {
 33:       list = list.filter(
 34:         (c) =>
 35:           c.tracking_code.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 36:           c.order_code.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 37:           (c.carrier_ticket && c.carrier_ticket.toLowerCase().includes(search))
 38:       );
 39:     }
 40:     if (status) {
 41:       list = list.filter((c) => c.status === status);
 42:     }
 43: 
 44:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, total: list.length, data: list });
 45:   } catch (error: any) {
 46:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
 47:   }
 48: }
 49: 
 50: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
 51:   try {
 52:     const body = await req.json();
 53:     const { action, tracking_code, claim_type, requested_amount, evidence_pack_url } = body;
 54: 
 55:     if (action === 'CREATE_CLAIM' || !action) {
 56:       if (!tracking_code || !claim_type || !requested_amount) {
 57:         return NextResponse.json(
 58:           {
 59:             error: {
 60:               code: 'validation_error',
 61:               message: 'Vui lòng điền đầy đủ mã vận đơn, loại khiếu nại và số tiền yêu cầu',
 62:             },
 63:           },
 64:           { status: 400 }
 65:         );
 66:       }
 67: 
 68:       const normCode = tracking_code.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
 69:       const ship = db.shipments.find((s) => s.tracking_code === normCode);
 70: 
 71:       const newClaim: Claim = {
 72:         id: `clm_${Date.now()}`,
 73:         merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
 74:         branch_id: ship?.branch_id || 'default_branch',
 75:         warehouse_id: ship?.warehouse_id || 'default_wh',
 76:         shipment_id: ship?.id || `ship_${normCode}`,
 77:         claim_type,
 78:         carrier_ticket: `${normCode.startsWith('GHN') ? 'GHN' : 'GHTK'}_TCK_${Math.floor(Math.random() * 89999) + 10000}`,
 79:         requested_amount: Number(requested_amount),
 80:         accepted_amount: 0,
 81:         recovered_amount: 0,
 82:         status: 'SUBMITTED',
 83:         deadline_at: new Date(Date.now() + 48 * 3600 * 1000), // 48h SLA
 84:         evidence_pack_url:
 85:           evidence_pack_url || `https://storage.shipde.net/evidence/${normCode}.zip`,
 86:         created_at: new Date(),
 87:         updated_at: new Date(),
 88:       };
 89: 
 90:       db.claims.unshift(newClaim);
 91: 
 92:       return NextResponse.json({
 93:         success: true,
 94:         message: `Đã mở hồ sơ khiếu nại mã ${newClaim.carrier_ticket} thành công (CN-16)`,
 95:         data: newClaim,
 96:       });
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     return NextResponse.json(
100:       { error: { code: 'bad_request', message: 'Hành động không hợp lệ' } },
101:       { status: 400 }
102:     );
103:   } catch (error: any) {
104:     return NextResponse.json(
105:       { error: { code: 'server_error', message: error.message } },
106:       { status: 500 }
107:     );
108:   }
109: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/orders/route.ts">
  1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  2: import { db } from '@/server/db';
  3: import { Order, Shipment, ShipmentStatus, CarrierCode } from '@/types/domain';
  4: 
  5: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  6:   try {
  7:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  8:     const search = searchParams.get('q')?.toLowerCase();
  9: 
 10:     let list = db.orders;
 11:     if (search) {
 12:       list = list.filter(
 13:         (o) =>
 14:           o.order_code.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 15:           o.recipient_name.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 16:           o.recipient_phone.includes(search)
 17:       );
 18:     }
 19: 
 20:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, total: list.length, data: list });
 21:   } catch (error: any) {
 22:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
 23:   }
 24: }
 25: 
 26: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
 27:   try {
 28:     const body = await req.json();
 29:     const {
 30:       order_code,
 31:       cod_amount,
 32:       declared_weight_g,
 33:       recipient_name,
 34:       recipient_phone,
 35:       recipient_province,
 36:       recipient_address,
 37:       carrier_code,
 38:       tracking_code,
 39:     } = body;
 40: 
 41:     if (!order_code || !recipient_name || !recipient_phone) {
 42:       return NextResponse.json(
 43:         {
 44:           error: {
 45:             code: 'validation_error',
 46:             message: 'Vui lòng điền đầy đủ mã đơn, tên và SĐT người nhận',
 47:           },
 48:         },
 49:         { status: 400 }
 50:       );
 51:     }
 52: 
 53:     // Check duplicate
 54:     if (db.orders.some((o) => o.order_code.toUpperCase() === order_code.toUpperCase())) {
 55:       return NextResponse.json(
 56:         {
 57:           error: {
 58:             code: 'order_duplicate',
 59:             message: `Mã đơn hàng ${order_code} đã tồn tại trên hệ thống`,
 60:           },
 61:         },
 62:         { status: 409 }
 63:       );
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     const newOrder: Order = {
 67:       id: `ord_${Date.now()}`,
 68:       merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
 69:       branch_id: body.branch_id || 'default_branch',
 70:       warehouse_id: body.warehouse_id || 'default_wh',
 71:       order_code: order_code.toUpperCase(),
 72:       created_at: new Date(),
 73:       cod_amount: Number(cod_amount) || 0,
 74:       declared_weight_g: Number(declared_weight_g) || 500,
 75:       recipient_name,
 76:       recipient_phone,
 77:       recipient_province: recipient_province || 'TP. Hồ Chí Minh',
 78:       recipient_address: recipient_address || 'Chưa cập nhật địa chỉ',
 79:       item_value: Number(cod_amount) || 0,
 80:     };
 81: 
 82:     db.orders.unshift(newOrder);
 83: 
 84:     // Auto-create shipment if tracking code provided
 85:     if (tracking_code) {
 86:       const newShipment: Shipment = {
 87:         id: `ship_${Date.now()}`,
 88:         merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
 89:         branch_id: newOrder.branch_id,
 90:         warehouse_id: newOrder.warehouse_id,
 91:         order_id: newOrder.id,
 92:         order_code: newOrder.order_code,
 93:         carrier_code: (carrier_code as CarrierCode) || CarrierCode.GHN,
 94:         carrier_account_id: carrier_code === 'GHTK' ? 'acc_ghtk_01' : 'acc_ghn_01',
 95:         tracking_code: tracking_code.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, ''),
 96:         current_status: ShipmentStatus.DRAFT,
 97:         declared_weight_g: newOrder.declared_weight_g,
 98:         quoted_fee: 22000,
 99:         cod_amount: newOrder.cod_amount,
100:         created_at: new Date(),
101:         version: 1,
102:       };
103:       db.shipments.unshift(newShipment);
104:     }
105: 
106:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Tạo đơn hàng thành công', data: newOrder });
107:   } catch (error: any) {
108:     return NextResponse.json(
109:       { error: { code: 'server_error', message: error.message } },
110:       { status: 500 }
111:     );
112:   }
113: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/shipments/route.ts">
  1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  2: import { db } from '@/server/db';
  3: import { MatchingEngine } from '@/core/matching-engine';
  4: import { PancakePosAdapter } from '@/adapters/pancake.adapter';
  5: 
  6: const matchingEngine = new MatchingEngine();
  7: const pancakeAdapter = new PancakePosAdapter();
  8: 
  9: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
 10:   try {
 11:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
 12:     const search = searchParams.get('q')?.toLowerCase();
 13:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
 14:     const carrier = searchParams.get('carrier');
 15: 
 16:     let list = db.shipments;
 17: 
 18:     if (search) {
 19:       list = list.filter(
 20:         (s) =>
 21:           s.tracking_code.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
 22:           s.order_code.toLowerCase().includes(search)
 23:       );
 24:     }
 25:     if (status) {
 26:       list = list.filter((s) => s.current_status === status);
 27:     }
 28:     if (carrier) {
 29:       list = list.filter((s) => s.carrier_code === carrier);
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     return NextResponse.json({
 33:       success: true,
 34:       total: list.length,
 35:       data: list,
 36:     });
 37:   } catch (error: any) {
 38:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
 39:   }
 40: }
 41: 
 42: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
 43:   try {
 44:     const body = await req.json();
 45:     const { action } = body;
 46: 
 47:     // Simulate Pancake POS Sync
 48:     if (action === 'SYNC_PANCAKE') {
 49:       const trackingNum = `GHN8829${Math.floor(Math.random() * 8999) + 1000}`;
 50:       const mockPancakePayload = {
 51:         id: `pancake_${Date.now()}`,
 52:         order_number: `ORD_PANCAKE_${Math.floor(Math.random() * 8999) + 1000}`,
 53:         inserted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
 54:         total_price: 550000,
 55:         cod: 550000,
 56:         weight: 400,
 57:         bill_full_name: 'Khách hàng Pancake POS',
 58:         bill_phone_number: '0909112233',
 59:         shipping_address: {
 60:           province: 'TP. Hồ Chí Minh',
 61:           district: 'Quận 1',
 62:           full_address: '55 Lê Lợi, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1',
 63:         },
 64:         partner: {
 65:           partner_name: 'GHN',
 66:           tracking_number: trackingNum,
 67:         },
 68:       };
 69: 
 70:       const normalized = pancakeAdapter.normalizeOrder(mockPancakePayload, db.merchant.id);
 71:       db.orders.unshift(normalized.order);
 72: 
 73:       let createdShipment = undefined;
 74:       if (normalized.rawTrackingCode) {
 75:         createdShipment = {
 76:           id: `ship_${Date.now()}`,
 77:           merchant_id: db.merchant.id,
 78:           branch_id: normalized.order.branch_id || 'default_branch',
 79:           warehouse_id: normalized.order.warehouse_id || 'default_wh',
 80:           order_id: normalized.order.id,
 81:           order_code: normalized.order.order_code,
 82:           carrier_code: 'GHN' as any,
 83:           carrier_account_id: 'acc_ghn_01',
 84:           tracking_code: normalized.rawTrackingCode,
 85:           current_status: 'out_for_delivery' as any,
 86:           declared_weight_g: normalized.order.declared_weight_g,
 87:           quoted_fee: 22000,
 88:           cod_amount: normalized.order.cod_amount,
 89:           created_at: new Date(),
 90:           version: 1,
 91:         };
 92:         db.shipments.unshift(createdShipment);
 93:       }
 94: 
 95:       return NextResponse.json({
 96:         success: true,
 97:         message: 'Đồng bộ đơn hàng từ Pancake POS Open API thành công',
 98:         data: {
 99:           synced_orders: 1,
100:           order: normalized.order,
101:           shipment: createdShipment,
102:         },
103:       });
104:     }
105: 
106:     return NextResponse.json(
107:       { error: { code: 'bad_request', message: 'Hành động không hợp lệ' } },
108:       { status: 400 }
109:     );
110:   } catch (error: any) {
111:     return NextResponse.json(
112:       { error: { code: 'server_error', message: error.message } },
113:       { status: 500 }
114:     );
115:   }
116: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/invite/accept/page.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect, Suspense, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
  4: import { useSearchParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
  5: import Link from 'next/link';
  6: import {
  7:   CheckCircle2,
  8:   AlertCircle,
  9:   Loader2,
 10:   Lock,
 11:   User,
 12:   Shield,
 13:   Building2,
 14:   Store,
 15:   Warehouse,
 16:   ArrowRight,
 17:   Eye,
 18:   EyeOff,
 19:   RefreshCw,
 20: } from 'lucide-react';
 21: 
 22: const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 23: 
 24: export interface PasswordValidationRules {
 25:   length: boolean;
 26:   upper: boolean;
 27:   lower: boolean;
 28:   digit: boolean;
 29:   special: boolean;
 30:   match: boolean;
 31:   isValid: boolean;
 32: }
 33: 
 34: export function validateAcceptPassword(
 35:   password: string,
 36:   passwordConfirm: string
 37: ): PasswordValidationRules {
 38:   const length = Boolean(password && password.length >= 8 && password.length <= 128);
 39:   const upper = /[A-Z]/.test(password);
 40:   const lower = /[a-z]/.test(password);
 41:   const digit = /[0-9]/.test(password);
 42:   const special = /[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]{};':"\\|,.<>\/?]/.test(password);
 43:   const match = Boolean(password && password === passwordConfirm);
 44:   const isValid = length && upper && lower && digit && special && match;
 45:   return { length, upper, lower, digit, special, match, isValid };
 46: }
 47: 
 48: export function canRetryAcceptVerification(
 49:   token?: string | null,
 50:   verifyError?: string | null
 51: ): boolean {
 52:   return Boolean(token && verifyError);
 53: }
 54: 
 55: export function extractInvitationToken(params: {
 56:   hash?: string | null;
 57:   searchToken?: string | null;
 58: }): string | null {
 59:   // AC-USR-01-18 / SECURITY-NFR / BR-INV-02: Honor ONLY the URL fragment (#token=...).
 60:   // Query parameters are deliberately ignored to prevent token leakage in web server access logs,
 61:   // document requests, and Referer headers.
 62:   const hash = (params.hash || '').replace(/^#/, '');
 63:   if (hash) {
 64:     if (hash.startsWith('token=')) {
 65:       return decodeURIComponent(hash.slice('token='.length));
 66:     }
 67:     const search = new URLSearchParams(hash);
 68:     const tok = search.get('token');
 69:     if (tok) return tok;
 70:     if (!hash.includes('=')) return hash;
 71:   }
 72:   return null;
 73: }
 74: 
 75: export function stripTokenFromAddressBar(windowObj?: {
 76:   history?: { replaceState: (data: any, unused: string, url?: string | URL | null) => void };
 77:   location?: { pathname: string };
 78: }) {
 79:   if (windowObj?.history?.replaceState && windowObj?.location?.pathname) {
 80:     windowObj.history.replaceState(null, '', windowObj.location.pathname);
 81:   }
 82: }
 83: 
 84: /**
 85:  * Resolves invitation token keeping in-memory reference across React Strict Mode remounts (Round 10 Finding 4).
 86:  * If the token has already been extracted into memory/ref before the URL hash was stripped,
 87:  * keeps the resolved token and avoids re-triggering strip or falsy empty-hash errors.
 88:  */
 89: export function resolveTokenWithMemoryFallback(params: {
 90:   rawHash: string | null;
 91:   memoryToken: string | null;
 92: }): { token: string | null; shouldStrip: boolean } {
 93:   if (params.memoryToken) {
 94:     return { token: params.memoryToken, shouldStrip: false };
 95:   }
 96:   const resolved = extractInvitationToken({ hash: params.rawHash });
 97:   return { token: resolved, shouldStrip: Boolean(resolved) };
 98: }

100: export type AcceptInviteUIState = 'verifying' | 'verify_error' | 'submitting' | 'success' | 'form';
101: 
102: export function resolveAcceptInviteUIState(params: {
103:   verifying: boolean;
104:   verifyError: string | null;
105:   submitting: boolean;
106:   success: boolean;
107:   hasInvitation: boolean;
108: }): AcceptInviteUIState {
109:   if (params.verifying) return 'verifying';
110:   if (params.verifyError) return 'verify_error';
111:   if (params.success) return 'success';
112:   if (params.submitting) return 'submitting';
113:   if (params.hasInvitation) return 'form';
114:   return 'verifying';
115: }

117: interface InvitationDetails {
118:   valid: boolean;
119:   tenant_name: string;
120:   role: string;
121:   identifier: string;
122:   store_scopes?: string[];
123:   warehouse_scopes?: string[];
124: }
125: 
126: function AcceptInvitationContent() {
127:   const searchParams = useSearchParams();
128:   const router = useRouter();
129:   const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
130:   const tokenRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
131: 
132:   const [verifying, setVerifying] = useState(true);
133:   const [invitation, setInvitation] = useState<InvitationDetails | null>(null);
134:   const [verifyError, setVerifyError] = useState<string | null>(null);
135: 
136:   // Form state
137:   const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('');
138:   const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
139:   const [passwordConfirm, setPasswordConfirm] = useState('');
140:   const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
141:   const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
142:   const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState<string | null>(null);
143:   const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
144:   const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
145: 
146:   const verifyToken = useCallback(async (tok: string) => {
147:     setVerifying(true);
148:     setVerifyError(null);
149:     try {
150:       // Token travels in the POST body, never in the API URL (SECURITY-NFR / AC-USR-01-18)
151:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/invitations/verify`, {
152:         method: 'POST',
153:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
154:         body: JSON.stringify({ token: tok }),
155:         referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer',
156:       });
157:       const data = await res.json();
158:       if (!res.ok) {
159:         throw new Error(data.error?.message || 'Liên kết lời mời không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn.');
160:       }
161:       setInvitation(data.data);
162:     } catch (err: any) {
163:       setVerifyError(err.message || 'Liên kết lời mời không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn.');
164:     } finally {
165:       setVerifying(false);
166:     }
167:   }, []);
168: 
169:   useEffect(() => {
170:     // Round 10 Finding 4: In React Strict Mode (dev), effects run twice on mount.
171:     // Preserve token in memory/ref across remount so the second run (which sees an empty hash
172:     // because stripTokenFromAddressBar already ran) does NOT destroy the valid token or show an invalid-link error.
173:     if (tokenRef.current) {
174:       return;
175:     }
176: 
177:     const rawHash = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.hash : null;
178:     const { token: resolved, shouldStrip } = resolveTokenWithMemoryFallback({
179:       rawHash,
180:       memoryToken: tokenRef.current,
181:     });
182: 
183:     if (resolved) {
184:       tokenRef.current = resolved;
185:       setToken(resolved);
186:       if (shouldStrip && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
187:         stripTokenFromAddressBar(window);
188:       }
189:       void verifyToken(resolved);
190:     } else {
191:       setVerifying(false);
192:       setVerifyError(
193:         'Mã lời mời không tồn tại trong đường dẫn. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại liên kết trong email hoặc tin nhắn của bạn.'
194:       );
195:     }
196:   }, [verifyToken]);
197: 
198:   // Password rules helper
199:   const rules = validateAcceptPassword(password, passwordConfirm);
200: 
201:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
202:     e.preventDefault();
203:     const activeToken = token || tokenRef.current;
204:     if (!activeToken) return;
205: 
206:     setSubmitting(true);
207:     setSubmitError(null);
208:     setFieldErrors({});
209: 
210:     const clientErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
211:     if (!fullName.trim()) {
212:       clientErrors.full_name = 'Vui lòng nhập họ và tên của bạn';
213:     }
214:     if (!rules.length || !rules.upper || !rules.lower || !rules.digit || !rules.special) {
215:       clientErrors.password = 'Mật khẩu chưa đáp ứng đủ các tiêu chuẩn bảo mật';
216:     }
217:     if (password !== passwordConfirm) {
218:       clientErrors.password_confirm = 'Mật khẩu xác nhận không trùng khớp';
219:     }
220: 
221:     if (Object.keys(clientErrors).length > 0) {
222:       setFieldErrors(clientErrors);
223:       setSubmitting(false);
224:       return;
225:     }
226: 
227:     try {
228:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/invitations/accept`, {
229:         method: 'POST',
230:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
231:         referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer',
232:         body: JSON.stringify({
233:           token: activeToken,
234:           full_name: fullName.trim(),
235:           password,
236:           password_confirm: passwordConfirm,
237:         }),
238:       });
239: 
240:       const data = await res.json();
241:       if (!res.ok) {
242:         if (data.error?.fields && Array.isArray(data.error.fields)) {
243:           const mapped: Record<string, string> = {};
244:           for (const f of data.error.fields) {
245:             mapped[f.field] = f.message;
246:           }
247:           setFieldErrors(mapped);
248:         }
249:         throw new Error(data.error?.message || 'Không thể kích hoạt tài khoản. Vui lòng thử lại.');
250:       }
251: 
252:       setSuccess(true);
253:     } catch (err: any) {
254:       setSubmitError(err.message || 'Lỗi kết nối máy chủ');
255:     } finally {
256:       setSubmitting(false);
257:     }
258:   };

410: 
411:               <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
412:                 <div>
413:                   <label htmlFor="accept-name" className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">
414:                     Họ và Tên Của Bạn:

420:                     onChange={(e) => setFullName(e.target.value)}
421:                     placeholder="Nguyễn Văn A"
422:                     disabled={submitting}
423:                     className={`w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-xl outline-none transition ${
424:                       fieldErrors.full_name
425:                         ? 'border-red-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-500'
426:                         : 'border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-500'
427:                     }`}
428:                   />
429:                   {fieldErrors.full_name && (
430:                     <p className="text-red-500 text-[11px] mt-1">{fieldErrors.full_name}</p>
431:                   )}
432:                 </div>
433: 
434:                 <div>
435:                   <label htmlFor="accept-password" className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">
436:                     Thiết Lập Mật Khẩu:
437:                   </label>
438:                   <div className="relative">
439:                     <input
440:                       id="accept-password"
441:                       type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
442:                       value={password}
443:                       onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
444:                       placeholder="••••••••••••"
445:                       disabled={submitting}
446:                       className={`w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-xl outline-none pr-9 transition ${
447:                         fieldErrors.password
448:                           ? 'border-red-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-500'
449:                           : 'border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-500'
450:                       }`}
451:                     />
452:                     <button
453:                       type="button"
454:                       onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
455:                       aria-label={showPassword ? 'Ẩn mật khẩu' : 'Hiển thị mật khẩu'}
456:                       className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
457:                     >
458:                       {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
459:                     </button>
460:                   </div>
461:                   {fieldErrors.password && (
462:                     <p className="text-red-500 text-[11px] mt-1">{fieldErrors.password}</p>
463:                   )}
464: 
465:                   {/* Password checklist */}
466:                   <div className="mt-2 p-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 rounded-lg space-y-1 text-[11px]">
467:                     <div className="font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">
468:                       Tiêu chuẩn mật khẩu an toàn:
469:                     </div>
470:                     <div
471:                       className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${rules.length ? 'text-emerald-600 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-400'}`}
472:                     >
473:                       <span>{rules.length ? '✓' : '○'}</span> Tối thiểu 8 ký tự
474:                     </div>
475:                     <div
476:                       className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${rules.upper ? 'text-emerald-600 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-400'}`}
477:                     >
478:                       <span>{rules.upper ? '✓' : '○'}</span> Chứa ít nhất 1 chữ in hoa (A-Z)
479:                     </div>
480:                     <div
481:                       className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${rules.lower ? 'text-emerald-600 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-400'}`}
482:                     >
483:                       <span>{rules.lower ? '✓' : '○'}</span> Chứa ít nhất 1 chữ in thường (a-z)
484:                     </div>
485:                     <div
486:                       className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${rules.digit ? 'text-emerald-600 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-400'}`}
487:                     >
488:                       <span>{rules.digit ? '✓' : '○'}</span> Chứa ít nhất 1 chữ số (0-9)
489:                     </div>
490:                     <div
491:                       className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${rules.special ? 'text-emerald-600 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-400'}`}
492:                     >
493:                       <span>{rules.special ? '✓' : '○'}</span> Chứa ít nhất 1 ký tự đặc biệt
494:                       (!@#$%...)
495:                     </div>
496:                   </div>
497:                 </div>
498: 
499:                 <div>
500:                   <label
501:                     htmlFor="accept-password-confirm"
502:                     className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1"
503:                   >
504:                     Nhập Lại Mật Khẩu:
505:                   </label>
506:                   <input
507:                     id="accept-password-confirm"
508:                     type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
509:                     value={passwordConfirm}
510:                     onChange={(e) => setPasswordConfirm(e.target.value)}
511:                     placeholder="••••••••••••"
512:                     disabled={submitting}
513:                     className={`w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-xl outline-none transition ${
514:                       fieldErrors.password_confirm
515:                         ? 'border-red-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-500'
516:                         : 'border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-500'
517:                     }`}
518:                   />
519:                   {fieldErrors.password_confirm && (
520:                     <p className="text-red-500 text-[11px] mt-1">{fieldErrors.password_confirm}</p>
521:                   )}
522:                   {passwordConfirm && rules.match && (
523:                     <p className="text-emerald-600 text-[11px] mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
524:                       <span>✓</span> Mật khẩu xác nhận khớp
525:                     </p>
526:                   )}
527:                 </div>
528: 
529:                 <div className="pt-2">
530:                   <button
531:                     type="submit"
532:                     disabled={submitting}
533:                     className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs shadow-md transition disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
534:                   >
535:                     {submitting && <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />}
536:                     <span>
537:                       {submitting ? 'Đang kích hoạt...' : 'Kích Hoạt Tài Khoản & Bắt Đầu'}
538:                     </span>
539:                   </button>
540:                 </div>
541:               </form>
542:             </div>
543:           ) : null}
544:         </div>
545:       </div>
546:     </div>
547:   );
548: }
549: 
550: function AcceptInvitationFallback() {
551:   return (
552:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center p-6">
553:       <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-500">
554:         <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-blue-600" />
555:         <span>Đang kiểm tra liên kết lời mời...</span>
556:       </div>
557:     </div>
558:   );
559: }
560: 
561: export default function AcceptInvitationPage() {
562:   return (
563:     <Suspense fallback={<AcceptInvitationFallback />}>
564:       <AcceptInvitationContent />
565:     </Suspense>
566:   );
567: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/onboarding/page.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
  4: import Link from 'next/link';
  5: import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
  6: import { OnboardingFlow } from '@/components/OnboardingFlow';
  7: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
  8: import { OnboardingStepId, type OnboardingStateResponseDto } from '@shipde/contracts';
  9: 
 10: const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 11: 
 12: export interface OnboardingPageProps {
 13:   initialState?: OnboardingStateResponseDto | null;
 14:   initialLoading?: boolean;
 15:   initialCanEdit?: boolean;
 16:   initialError?: string | null;
 17:   initialToken?: string | null;
 18: }
 19: 
 20: export default function OnboardingPage({
 21:   initialState = null,
 22:   initialLoading = false,
 23:   initialCanEdit,
 24:   initialError = null,
 25:   initialToken = null,
 26: }: OnboardingPageProps) {
 27:   const { user } = useAuth();
 28:   const token =
 29:     initialToken !== null
 30:       ? initialToken
 31:       : typeof window !== 'undefined'
 32:         ? localStorage.getItem('shipde_token')
 33:         : null;
 34: 
 35:   const [state, setState] = useState<OnboardingStateResponseDto | null>(initialState);
 36:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(initialState ? false : (initialLoading ?? true));
 37:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(initialError);
 38: 
 39:   const fetchOnboardingState = useCallback(async () => {
 40:     setLoading(true);
 41:     setError(null);
 42:     try {
 43:       const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 44:         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 45:       };
 46:       if (token) {
 47:         headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
 48:       }
 49: 
 50:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/onboarding`, { headers });
 51:       if (!res.ok) {
 52:         if (res.status === 403) {
 53:           throw new Error('Bạn không có quyền truy cập quy trình thiết lập của cửa hàng.');
 54:         }
 55:         if (res.status === 401) {
 56:           throw new Error('Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.');
 57:         }
 58:         const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 59:         throw new Error(
 60:           errJson?.error?.message || errJson?.message || 'Không thể tải quy trình thiết lập'
 61:         );
 62:       }
 63: 
 64:       const json = await res.json();
 65:       if (json.success && json.data) {
 66:         setState(json.data);
 67:       }
 68:     } catch (err: any) {
 69:       setError(err?.message || 'Lỗi khi tải thông tin thiết lập ban đầu');
 70:     } finally {
 71:       setLoading(false);
 72:     }
 73:   }, [token]);
 74: 
 75:   useEffect(() => {
 76:     if (!initialState) {
 77:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- initial onboarding state fetch
 78:       void fetchOnboardingState();
 79:     }
 80:   }, [initialState, fetchOnboardingState]);
 81: 
 82:   const handleCompleteStep = async (stepId: OnboardingStepId, data?: Record<string, any>) => {
 83:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 84:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 85:     };
 86:     if (token) {
 87:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/onboarding/steps/${stepId}/complete`, {
 91:       method: 'POST',
 92:       headers,
 93:       body: JSON.stringify({ data }),
 94:     });
 95: 
 96:     if (!res.ok) {
 97:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 98:       throw new Error(
 99:         errJson?.error?.message || errJson?.message || `Không thể hoàn thành bước ${stepId}`
100:       );
101:     }
102: 
103:     const json = await res.json();
104:     if (json.success && json.data) {
105:       setState(json.data);
106:     }
107:   };
108: 
109:   const handleSkipStep = async (stepId: OnboardingStepId) => {
110:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
111:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
112:     };
113:     if (token) {
114:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
115:     }
116: 
117:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/onboarding/steps/${stepId}/skip`, {
118:       method: 'POST',
119:       headers,
120:     });
121: 
122:     if (!res.ok) {
123:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
124:       throw new Error(
125:         errJson?.error?.message || errJson?.message || `Không thể bỏ qua bước ${stepId}`
126:       );
127:     }
128: 
129:     const json = await res.json();
130:     if (json.success && json.data) {
131:       setState(json.data);
132:     }
133:   };
134: 
135:   const handleReset = async () => {
136:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
137:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
138:     };
139:     if (token) {
140:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
141:     }
142: 
143:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/onboarding/reset`, {
144:       method: 'POST',
145:       headers,
146:     });
147: 
148:     if (!res.ok) {
149:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
150:       throw new Error(
151:         errJson?.error?.message || errJson?.message || 'Không thể khởi tạo lại quy trình'
152:       );
153:     }
154: 
155:     const json = await res.json();
156:     if (json.success && json.data) {
157:       setState(json.data);
158:     }
159:   };
160: 
161:   const handleDismiss = async () => {
162:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
163:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
164:     };
165:     if (token) {
166:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
167:     }
168: 
169:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/onboarding/dismiss`, {
170:       method: 'POST',
171:       headers,
172:     });
173: 
174:     if (!res.ok) {
175:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
176:       throw new Error(
177:         errJson?.error?.message || errJson?.message || 'Không thể đóng hướng dẫn thiết lập'
178:       );
179:     }
180: 
181:     const json = await res.json();
182:     if (json.success && json.data) {
183:       setState(json.data);
184:     }
185:   };
186: 
187:   return (
188:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-8 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
189:       <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
190:         {/* Navigation Breadcrumb */}
191:         <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
192:           <Link
193:             href="/"
194:             className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 transition"
195:           >
196:             <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
197:             <span>Quay lại Bảng Điều Khiển</span>
198:           </Link>
199:           <span className="text-slate-300">/</span>
200:           <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">Thiết Lập Ban Đầu (SCR-ONB-01)</span>
201:         </div>
202: 
203:         {/* Main Flow Component */}
204:         <OnboardingFlow
205:           state={state}
206:           loading={loading}
207:           error={error}
208:           initialState={state}
209:           initialLoading={loading}
210:           initialError={error}
211:           initialCanEdit={initialCanEdit}
212:           onRefresh={fetchOnboardingState}
213:           onCompleteStep={handleCompleteStep}
214:           onSkipStep={handleSkipStep}
215:           onReset={handleReset}
216:           onDismiss={handleDismiss}
217:         />
218:       </div>
219:     </div>
220:   );
221: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/search/page.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { Suspense } from 'react';
  4: import { useSearchParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
  5: import { GlobalSearchContent } from '@/components/GlobalSearchModal';
  6: import { SearchEntityType, SearchResultItem } from '@shipde/contracts';
  7: import { Search } from 'lucide-react';
  8: 
  9: export interface SearchPageProps {
 10:   initialQuery?: string;
 11:   initialType?: SearchEntityType;
 12:   initialLoading?: boolean;
 13:   initialError?: string | null;
 14:   initialForbidden?: boolean;
 15:   initialItems?: SearchResultItem[];
 16:   initialTotal?: number;
 17:   initialValidationMessage?: string | null;
 18:   initialIsPartial?: boolean;
 19:   initialHasSearched?: boolean;
 20:   onNavigate?: (url: string) => void;
 21: }
 22: 
 23: export const SearchPageContent: React.FC<SearchPageProps> = ({
 24:   initialQuery = '',
 25:   initialType = 'ALL',
 26:   initialLoading,
 27:   initialError,
 28:   initialForbidden,
 29:   initialItems,
 30:   initialTotal,
 31:   initialValidationMessage,
 32:   initialIsPartial,
 33:   initialHasSearched,
 34:   onNavigate,
 35: }) => {
 36:   return (
 37:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#FDFCFB] text-slate-900 selection:bg-[#c23807] selection:text-white p-4 sm:p-8">
 38:       <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-6">
 39:         {/* Navigation Breadcrumb & Header */}
 40:         <header className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-[#EAE7E4] gap-4">
 41:           <div>
 42:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 43:               <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-[#c23807] text-white flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs shadow-2xs">
 44:                 S
 45:               </span>
 46:               <h1 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
 47:                 Tìm Kiếm Toàn Hệ Thống (FEAT-COM-01)
 48:               </h1>
 49:             </div>
 50:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
 51:               Tra cứu đồng thời đơn hàng, vận đơn, bảng kê đối soát, khiếu nại ngoại lệ và lệch cước
 52:               tài chính
 53:             </p>
 54:           </div>
 55: 
 56:           <button
 57:             type="button"
 58:             onClick={() => onNavigate?.('/')}
 59:             className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[#EAE7E4] hover:bg-[#F6F5F3] transition self-start sm:self-auto cursor-pointer"
 60:           >
 61:             ← Trở về Bảng Điều Khiển
 62:           </button>
 63:         </header>
 64: 
 65:         {/* Global Search Component in Standalone Mode */}
 66:         <main>
 67:           <GlobalSearchContent
 68:             standalone={true}
 69:             initialQuery={initialQuery}
 70:             initialType={initialType}
 71:             initialLoading={initialLoading}
 72:             initialError={initialError}
 73:             initialForbidden={initialForbidden}
 74:             initialItems={initialItems}
 75:             initialTotal={initialTotal}
 76:             initialValidationMessage={initialValidationMessage}
 77:             initialIsPartial={initialIsPartial}
 78:             initialHasSearched={initialHasSearched}
 79:             onSelectResult={(item) => {
 80:               if (item.url) {
 81:                 onNavigate?.(item.url);
 82:               }
 83:             }}
 84:           />
 85:         </main>
 86:       </div>
 87:     </div>
 88:   );
 89: };
 90: 
 91: export const SearchPageInner: React.FC<SearchPageProps> = (props) => {
 92:   const searchParams = useSearchParams();
 93:   const router = useRouter();
 94: 
 95:   const queryFromUrl = searchParams ? searchParams.get('q') || '' : '';
 96:   const typeFromUrl =
 97:     (searchParams ? (searchParams.get('type') as SearchEntityType) : null) || 'ALL';
 98: 
 99:   return (
100:     <SearchPageContent
101:       {...props}
102:       initialQuery={props.initialQuery !== undefined ? props.initialQuery : queryFromUrl}
103:       initialType={props.initialType !== undefined ? props.initialType : typeFromUrl}
104:       onNavigate={props.onNavigate || ((url: string) => router.push(url))}
105:     />
106:   );
107: };
108: 
109: export const SearchPage: React.FC<SearchPageProps> = (props = {}) => {
110:   return (
111:     <Suspense
112:       fallback={
113:         <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#FDFCFB] flex items-center justify-center p-8 text-xs text-slate-400">
114:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
115:             <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#c23807] animate-pulse" />
116:             <span>Đang chuẩn bị trang tìm kiếm...</span>
117:           </div>
118:         </div>
119:       }
120:     >
121:       <SearchPageInner {...props} />
122:     </Suspense>
123:   );
124: };
125: 
126: export default SearchPage;
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/settings/branches/page.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
  4: import Link from 'next/link';
  5: import { ArrowLeft, Store, GitBranch, Users, Shield } from 'lucide-react';
  6: import { BranchManagementView } from '@/components/BranchManagementView';
  7: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
  8: import type { Branch, CreateBranchInput, UpdateBranchInput } from '@shipde/contracts';
  9: 
 10: const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 11: 
 12: export interface BranchesSettingsPageProps {
 13:   initialBranches?: Branch[] | null;
 14:   initialLoading?: boolean;
 15:   initialCanEdit?: boolean;
 16:   initialError?: string | null;
 17:   initialScopedStores?: string[] | null;
 18: }
 19: 
 20: export default function BranchesSettingsPage({
 21:   initialBranches = null,
 22:   initialLoading,
 23:   initialCanEdit,
 24:   initialError = null,
 25:   initialScopedStores = null,
 26: }: BranchesSettingsPageProps) {
 27:   const { user } = useAuth();
 28:   const token = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('shipde_token') : null;
 29: 
 30:   // Edit rights are server-authoritative: the branches list endpoint returns
 31:   // `can_edit`, derived from the actor's `iam:shop_config` permission. We never
 32:   // infer capability from hardcoded role names, and we fail closed (false) until
 33:   // the server resolves the actor's permissions.
 34:   const derivedScopedStores =
 35:     initialScopedStores !== null ? initialScopedStores : user?.store_scopes || null;
 36: 
 37:   const [branches, setBranches] = useState<Branch[]>(initialBranches || []);
 38:   const [canEdit, setCanEdit] = useState<boolean>(initialCanEdit ?? false);
 39:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(initialLoading ?? initialBranches === null);
 40:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(initialError);
 41: 
 42:   const fetchBranches = useCallback(async () => {
 43:     setLoading(true);
 44:     setError(null);
 45:     try {
 46:       const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 47:         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 48:       };
 49:       if (token) {
 50:         headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
 51:       }
 52: 
 53:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/branches`, { headers });
 54:       if (!res.ok) {
 55:         if (res.status === 403) {
 56:           throw new Error('Bạn không có quyền truy cập danh sách chi nhánh.');
 57:         }
 58:         if (res.status === 401) {
 59:           throw new Error('Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.');
 60:         }
 61:         const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 62:         throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể tải danh sách chi nhánh');
 63:       }
 64: 
 65:       const json = await res.json();
 66:       if (json.success && json.data?.branches) {
 67:         setBranches(json.data.branches);
 68:         setCanEdit(Boolean(json.data.can_edit));
 69:       }
 70:     } catch (err: any) {
 71:       setError(err?.message || 'Lỗi khi kết nối với máy chủ quản lý chi nhánh');
 72:     } finally {
 73:       setLoading(false);
 74:     }
 75:   }, [token]);
 76: 
 77:   useEffect(() => {
 78:     if (!initialBranches) {
 79:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- initial branches fetch
 80:       void fetchBranches();
 81:     }
 82:   }, [initialBranches, fetchBranches]);
 83: 
 84:   // Create Branch Handler
 85:   const handleCreate = async (input: CreateBranchInput) => {
 86:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 87:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 88:     };
 89:     if (token) {
 90:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/branches`, {
 94:       method: 'POST',
 95:       headers,
 96:       body: JSON.stringify(input),
 97:     });
 98: 
 99:     if (!res.ok) {
100:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
101:       throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể tạo mới chi nhánh');
102:     }
103: 
104:     // Refresh list to preserve single default ordering and tenant consistency
105:     await fetchBranches();
106:   };
107: 
108:   // Update Branch Handler
109:   const handleUpdate = async (id: string, input: UpdateBranchInput) => {
110:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
111:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
112:     };
113:     if (token) {
114:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
115:     }
116: 
117:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/branches/${id}`, {
118:       method: 'PATCH',
119:       headers,
120:       body: JSON.stringify(input),
121:     });
122: 
123:     if (!res.ok) {
124:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
125:       throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể cập nhật chi nhánh');
126:     }
127: 
128:     await fetchBranches();
129:   };
130: 
131:   // Activate Branch Handler
132:   const handleActivate = async (id: string) => {
133:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
134:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
135:     };
136:     if (token) {
137:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
138:     }
139: 
140:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/branches/${id}/activate`, {
141:       method: 'POST',
142:       headers,
143:     });
144: 
145:     if (!res.ok) {
146:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
147:       throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể kích hoạt chi nhánh');
148:     }
149: 
150:     await fetchBranches();
151:   };
152: 
153:   // Deactivate Branch Handler
154:   const handleDeactivate = async (id: string) => {
155:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
156:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
157:     };
158:     if (token) {
159:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
160:     }
161: 
162:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/branches/${id}/deactivate`, {
163:       method: 'POST',
164:       headers,
165:     });
166: 
167:     if (!res.ok) {
168:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
169:       throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể tạm ngưng chi nhánh');
170:     }
171: 
172:     await fetchBranches();
173:   };
174: 
175:   return (
176:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-8 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
177:       <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">
178:         {/* Navigation Breadcrumb and Sub-nav */}
179:         <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
180:           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
181:             <Link
182:               href="/"
183:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 transition"
184:             >
185:               <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
186:               <span>Quay lại Bảng Điều Khiển</span>
187:             </Link>
188:             <span className="text-slate-300">/</span>
189:             <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
190:               Chi nhánh &amp; Điểm gửi hàng (SCR-WH-01 / FEAT-ORG-02)
191:             </span>
192:           </div>
193: 
194:           {/* Quick Settings Switcher Tabs */}
195:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
196:             <Link
197:               href="/settings/shop"
198:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition font-medium"
199:             >
200:               <Store className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
201:               <span>Hồ sơ Shop</span>
202:             </Link>
203:             <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-orange-50 border border-orange-200 text-orange-700 font-bold">
204:               <GitBranch className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-600" />
205:               <span>Chi nhánh</span>
206:             </span>
207:             <Link
208:               href="/settings/users"
209:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition font-medium"
210:             >
211:               <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
212:               <span>Nhân sự</span>
213:             </Link>
214:             <Link
215:               href="/settings/roles"
216:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition font-medium"
217:             >
218:               <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
219:               <span>Phân quyền</span>
220:             </Link>
221:           </div>
222:         </div>
223: 
224:         {/* Main Branches Management View */}
225:         <BranchManagementView
226:           branches={branches}
227:           loading={loading}
228:           canEdit={canEdit}
229:           scopedStores={derivedScopedStores}
230:           error={error}
231:           onRefresh={fetchBranches}
232:           onCreate={handleCreate}
233:           onUpdate={handleUpdate}
234:           onActivate={handleActivate}
235:           onDeactivate={handleDeactivate}
236:         />
237:       </div>
238:     </div>
239:   );
240: }
</file>
