<file path="apps/web/src/app/settings/roles/page.tsx">
   1: 'use client';
   2: 
   3: import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
   4: import Link from 'next/link';
   5: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
   6: import {
   7:   Shield,
   8:   ShieldCheck,
   9:   ShieldAlert,
  10:   Lock,
  11:   Plus,
  12:   Edit2,
  13:   Trash2,
  14:   Users,
  15:   Check,
  16:   Loader2,
  17:   AlertTriangle,
  18:   ArrowLeft,
  19:   RefreshCw,
  20:   Search,
  21:   CheckCircle2,
  22:   X,
  23:   Sliders,
  24: } from 'lucide-react';
  25: import { PermissionItem, RoleItem, CanonicalPermissionCode } from '@shipde/contracts';
  26: 
  27: interface FormState {
  28:   name: string;
  29:   description: string;
  30:   permissions: string[];
  31: }
  32: 
  33: export interface RolesSettingsPageProps {
  34:   initialRoles?: RoleItem[];
  35:   initialPermissions?: PermissionItem[];
  36:   initialCategories?: string[];
  37:   initialLoading?: boolean;
  38:   initialCanManageRoles?: boolean;
  39:   initialError?: string | null;
  40:   initialSuccess?: string | null;
  41:   initialCreateOpen?: boolean;
  42:   initialEditingRole?: RoleItem | null;
  43:   initialViewingRole?: RoleItem | null;
  44:   initialDeletingRole?: RoleItem | null;
  45:   initialModalError?: string | null;
  46:   initialDeleteModalError?: string | null;
  47:   initialFormState?: FormState;
  48:   initialHasLoadedSuccessfully?: boolean;
  49: }
  50: 
  51: export function validateRoleForm(
  52:   name: string,
  53:   permissions: string[],
  54:   existingRoles: RoleItem[] = [],
  55:   editingRoleId?: string
  56: ): { isValid: boolean; errors: { name?: string; permissions?: string } } {
  57:   const errors: { name?: string; permissions?: string } = {};
  58:   if (!name.trim()) {
  59:     errors.name = 'Vui lòng nhập tên vai trò';
  60:   } else {
  61:     const duplicate = existingRoles.find(
  62:       (r) => r.name.trim().toLowerCase() === name.trim().toLowerCase() && r.id !== editingRoleId
  63:     );
  64:     if (duplicate) {
  65:       errors.name = 'Tên vai trò đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng';
  66:     }
  67:   }
  68: 
  69:   if (permissions.length === 0) {
  70:     errors.permissions = 'Cần chọn ít nhất một quyền hạn từ danh mục';
  71:   }
  72: 
  73:   return { isValid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0, errors };
  74: }
  75: 
  76: export default function RolesSettingsPage({
  77:   initialRoles,
  78:   initialPermissions,
  79:   initialCategories,
  80:   initialLoading,
  81:   initialCanManageRoles,
  82:   initialError,
  83:   initialSuccess,
  84:   initialCreateOpen,
  85:   initialEditingRole,
  86:   initialViewingRole,
  87:   initialDeletingRole,
  88:   initialModalError,
  89:   initialDeleteModalError,
  90:   initialFormState,
  91:   initialHasLoadedSuccessfully,
  92: }: RolesSettingsPageProps = {}) {
  93:   const { user, merchant } = useAuth();
  94:   const token = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('shipde_token') : null;
  95:   const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
  96: 
  97:   // Role & permission catalog data
  98:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(initialLoading ?? initialRoles === undefined);
  99:   const [hasLoadedSuccessfully, setHasLoadedSuccessfully] = useState<boolean>(
 100:     initialHasLoadedSuccessfully ?? (initialRoles !== undefined && !initialError)
 101:   );
 102:   const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);
 103:   const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(initialError ?? null);
 104:   const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(initialSuccess ?? null);
 105: 
 106:   const [roles, setRoles] = useState<RoleItem[]>(initialRoles ?? []);
 107:   const [permissions, setPermissions] = useState<PermissionItem[]>(initialPermissions ?? []);
 108:   const [categories, setCategories] = useState<string[]>(initialCategories ?? []);
 109: 
 110:   // Search & filter
 111:   const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');
 112:   const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('ALL');
 113: 
 114:   // Modals state
 115:   const [isCreateOpen, setIsCreateOpen] = useState<boolean>(initialCreateOpen ?? false);
 116:   const [editingRole, setEditingRole] = useState<RoleItem | null>(initialEditingRole ?? null);
 117:   const [viewingRole, setViewingRole] = useState<RoleItem | null>(initialViewingRole ?? null);
 118:   const [deletingRole, setDeletingRole] = useState<RoleItem | null>(initialDeletingRole ?? null);
 119:   const [modalError, setModalError] = useState<string | null>(initialModalError ?? null);
 120:   const [deleteModalError, setDeleteModalError] = useState<string | null>(
 121:     initialDeleteModalError ?? null
 122:   );
 123: 
 124:   // Form input state
 125:   const [formState, setFormState] = useState<FormState>(
 126:     initialFormState ?? {
 127:       name: '',
 128:       description: '',
 129:       permissions: [],
 130:     }
 131:   );
 132:   const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{ name?: string; permissions?: string }>({});
 133:   const [canManageRoles, setCanManageRoles] = useState<boolean>(initialCanManageRoles ?? false);
 134: 
 135:   // Fetch roles and permissions catalog
 136:   const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
 137:     setLoading(true);
 138:     setErrorMsg(null);
 139: 
 140:     try {
 141:       const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 142:         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 143:       };
 144:       if (token) {
 145:         headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
 146:       }
 147: 
 148:       const [permsRes, rolesRes] = await Promise.all([
 149:         fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/permissions`, { headers }),
 150:         fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/roles`, { headers }),
 151:       ]);
 152: 
 153:       if (!permsRes.ok) {
 154:         const errJson = await permsRes.json().catch(() => null);
 155:         throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể tải danh mục quyền hạn');
 156:       }
 157: 
 158:       if (!rolesRes.ok) {
 159:         const errJson = await rolesRes.json().catch(() => null);
 160:         throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể tải danh sách vai trò');
 161:       }
 162: 
 163:       const permsJson = await permsRes.json();
 164:       const rolesJson = await rolesRes.json();
 165: 
 166:       setPermissions(permsJson.data.permissions || []);
 167:       setCategories(permsJson.data.categories || []);
 168:       setRoles(rolesJson.data.roles || []);
 169:       // Trust only the server-authoritative boolean (Finding 3 / Round 7)
 170:       setCanManageRoles(Boolean(rolesJson.data?.can_manage_roles));
 171:       setHasLoadedSuccessfully(true);
 172:     } catch (err: any) {
 173:       setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Lỗi kết nối máy chủ khi tải dữ liệu phân quyền');
 174:       // Do not reset hasLoadedSuccessfully to false on refresh error (Finding 3 / Round 7);
 175:       // keeps the last successful list and form values mounted beside the error banner with retry.
 176:     } finally {
 177:       setLoading(false);
 178:     }
 179:   }, [API_BASE, token]);
 180: 
 181:   useEffect(() => {
 182:     if (initialRoles === undefined) {
 183:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- initial roles and permissions catalog fetch
 184:       void fetchData();
 185:     }
 186:   }, [fetchData, initialRoles]);
 187: 
 188:   const handleOpenCreate = () => {
 189:     if (!canManageRoles) {
 190:       setErrorMsg('Bạn không có quyền quản lý vai trò và phân quyền (Cần quyền iam:manage_users)');
 191:       return;
 192:     }
 193:     setFormState({
 194:       name: '',
 195:       description: '',
 196:       permissions: [],
 197:     });
 198:     setFieldErrors({});
 199:     setErrorMsg(null);
 200:     setSuccessMsg(null);
 201:     setIsCreateOpen(true);
 202:   };
 203: 
 204:   const handleOpenEdit = (role: RoleItem) => {
 205:     if (role.is_system) {
 206:       setErrorMsg('Vai trò mặc định của hệ thống không thể chỉnh sửa hoặc xóa');
 207:       return;
 208:     }
 209:     if (!canManageRoles) {
 210:       setErrorMsg('Bạn không có quyền quản lý vai trò và phân quyền (Cần quyền iam:manage_users)');
 211:       return;
 212:     }
 213:     setEditingRole(role);
 214:     setFormState({
 215:       name: role.name,
 216:       description: role.description || '',
 217:       permissions: role.permissions.map((p) => p.code),
 218:     });
 219:     setFieldErrors({});
 220:     setErrorMsg(null);
 221:     setSuccessMsg(null);
 222:   };
 223: 
 224:   const handleTogglePermission = (code: string) => {
 225:     setFormState((prev) => {
 226:       const exists = prev.permissions.includes(code);
 227:       return {
 228:         ...prev,
 229:         permissions: exists
 230:           ? prev.permissions.filter((c) => c !== code)
 231:           : [...prev.permissions, code],
 232:       };
 233:     });
 234:     if (fieldErrors.permissions) {
 235:       setFieldErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, permissions: undefined }));
 236:     }
 237:   };
 238: 
 239:   const handleSelectAllCategory = (cat: string) => {
 240:     const catCodes = permissions.filter((p) => p.category === cat).map((p) => p.code);
 241:     const allSelected = catCodes.every((c) => formState.permissions.includes(c));
 242: 
 243:     setFormState((prev) => ({
 244:       ...prev,
 245:       permissions: allSelected
 246:         ? prev.permissions.filter((c) => !catCodes.includes(c))
 247:         : Array.from(new Set([...prev.permissions, ...catCodes])),
 248:     }));
 249:   };
 250: 
 251:   const validateForm = (): boolean => {
 252:     const { isValid, errors } = validateRoleForm(
 253:       formState.name,
 254:       formState.permissions,
 255:       roles,
 256:       editingRole?.id
 257:     );
 258:     setFieldErrors(errors);
 259:     return isValid;
 260:   };
 261: 
 262:   const handleSaveRole = async (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
 263:     e?.preventDefault?.();
 264:     if (!validateForm()) return;
 265: 
 266:     setSubmitting(true);
 267:     setModalError(null);
 268:     setSuccessMsg(null);
 269: 
 270:     try {
 271:       const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 272:         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 273:       };
 274:       if (token) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
 275: 
 276:       const isEdit = Boolean(editingRole);
 277:       const url = isEdit
 278:         ? `${API_BASE}/api/v1/roles/${editingRole!.id}`
 279:         : `${API_BASE}/api/v1/roles`;
 280:       const method = isEdit ? 'PATCH' : 'POST';
 281: 
 282:       const res = await fetch(url, {
 283:         method,
 284:         headers,
 285:         body: JSON.stringify({
 286:           name: formState.name.trim(),
 287:           description: formState.description.trim() || undefined,
 288:           permissions: formState.permissions,
 289:         }),
 290:       });
 291: 
 292:       const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 293: 
 294:       if (!res.ok) {
 295:         const errorFields =
 296:           json?.error?.fields || (Array.isArray(json?.error?.details) ? json.error.details : null);
 297:         if (errorFields && Array.isArray(errorFields)) {
 298:           const fieldMap: Record<string, string> = {};
 299:           errorFields.forEach((f: any) => {
 300:             if (f.field) fieldMap[f.field] = f.message;
 301:           });
 302:           setFieldErrors(fieldMap);
 303:         }
 304:         throw new Error(json?.error?.message || 'Không thể lưu vai trò phân quyền');
 305:       }
 306: 
 307:       setSuccessMsg('Đã lưu vai trò phân quyền thành công');
 308:       setIsCreateOpen(false);
 309:       setEditingRole(null);
 310:       setModalError(null);
 311:       void fetchData();
 312:     } catch (err: any) {
 313:       setModalError(err.message || 'Lỗi khi lưu vai trò');
 314:     } finally {
 315:       setSubmitting(false);
 316:     }
 317:   };
 318: 
 319:   const handleDeleteRole = async () => {
 320:     if (!deletingRole) return;
 321:     setSubmitting(true);
 322:     setDeleteModalError(null);
 323:     setSuccessMsg(null);
 324: 
 325:     try {
 326:       const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 327:         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 328:       };
 329:       if (token) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
 330: 
 331:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/roles/${deletingRole.id}`, {
 332:         method: 'DELETE',
 333:         headers,
 334:       });
 335: 
 336:       const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 337: 
 338:       if (!res.ok) {
 339:         throw new Error(json?.error?.message || 'Không thể xóa vai trò phân quyền');
 340:       }
 341: 
 342:       setSuccessMsg('Đã xóa vai trò tùy chỉnh thành công');
 343:       setDeletingRole(null);
 344:       setDeleteModalError(null);
 345:       void fetchData();
 346:     } catch (err: any) {
 347:       setDeleteModalError(err.message || 'Lỗi khi xóa vai trò');
 348:     } finally {
 349:       setSubmitting(false);
 350:     }
 351:   };
 352: 
 353:   const filteredRoles = roles.filter((role) => {
 354:     const matchesSearch =
 355:       role.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
 356:       (role.description && role.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));
 357:     return matchesSearch;
 358:   });
 359: 
 360:   const totalCustomRoles = roles.filter((r) => !r.is_system);
 361:   const totalSystemRoles = roles.filter((r) => r.is_system);
 362:   const customRoles = filteredRoles.filter((r) => !r.is_system);
 363:   const systemRoles = filteredRoles.filter((r) => r.is_system);
 364: 
 365:   return (
 366:     <div className="space-y-6">
 367:       {/* Header & Navigation */}
 368:       <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
 369:         <div>
 370:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
 371:             <Link
 372:               href="/settings"
 373:               className="text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 font-medium"
 374:             >
 375:               <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
 376:               <span>Cài đặt hệ thống</span>
 377:             </Link>
 378:           </div>
 379:           <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
 380:             <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
 381:             <span>Vai Trò & Phân Quyền (Roles & RBAC)</span>
 382:           </h1>
 383:           <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
 384:             Quản lý vai trò mặc định của hệ thống và thiết lập các vai trò tùy chỉnh theo nguyên tắc
 385:             đặc quyền tối thiểu (Least Privilege).
 386:           </p>
 387:         </div>
 388: 
 389:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 390:           <button
 391:             type="button"
 392:             onClick={fetchData}
 393:             disabled={loading}
 394:             className="btn-secondary text-xs py-2 px-3 flex items-center gap-1.5"
 395:             title="Làm mới dữ liệu"
 396:           >
 397:             <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
 398:             <span>Làm mới</span>
 399:           </button>
 400: 
 401:           {canManageRoles && (
 402:             <button
 403:               type="button"
 404:               onClick={handleOpenCreate}
 405:               className="btn-primary text-xs py-2 px-3.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg font-semibold shadow-sm"
 406:             >
 407:               <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
 408:               <span>Tạo vai trò mới</span>
 409:             </button>
 410:           )}
 411:         </div>
 412:       </div>
 413: 
 414:       {/* Persistent Feedback Banners */}
 415:       {errorMsg && (
 416:         <div
 417:           role="alert"
 418:           className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 text-xs flex items-start justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in"
 419:         >
 420:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 421:             <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
 422:             <span>{errorMsg}</span>
 423:           </div>
 424:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 425:             <button
 426:               type="button"
 427:               onClick={fetchData}
 428:               className="font-bold underline text-rose-700 hover:text-rose-900"
 429:             >
 430:               Thử lại
 431:             </button>
 432:             <button
 433:               type="button"
 434:               onClick={() => setErrorMsg(null)}
 435:               className="text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-600 font-bold ml-2"
 436:             >
 437:               ✕
 438:             </button>
 439:           </div>
 440:         </div>
 441:       )}
 442: 
 443:       {successMsg && (
 444:         <div
 445:           role="status"
 446:           className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in"
 447:         >
 448:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 449:             <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
 450:             <span>{successMsg}</span>
 451:           </div>
 452:           <button
 453:             type="button"
 454:             onClick={() => setSuccessMsg(null)}
 455:             className="text-emerald-500 hover:text-emerald-700 font-bold"
 456:           >
 457:             ✕
 458:           </button>
 459:         </div>
 460:       )}
 461: 
 462:       {/* Non-authorized Warning Callout (Finding 4 / Round 8: hide until successful load) */}
 463:       {!loading && hasLoadedSuccessfully && !canManageRoles && (
 464:         <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-800 text-xs flex items-center gap-2.5">
 465:           <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
 466:           <span>
 467:             Bạn chỉ có quyền <strong>xem</strong> danh mục vai trò. Thao tác tạo hoặc chỉnh sửa
 468:             quyền hạn yêu cầu quyền <strong>iam:manage_users</strong> hoặc tài khoản{' '}
 469:             <strong>Chủ Shop (Owner)</strong>.
 470:           </span>
 471:         </div>
 472:       )}
 473: 
 474:       {/* Search & Filter Toolbar */}
 475:       <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 justify-between items-center bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm text-xs">
 476:         <div className="relative w-full sm:w-72">
 477:           <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
 478:           <input
 479:             type="text"
 480:             value={searchTerm}
 481:             onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
 482:             placeholder="Tìm theo tên vai trò, mô tả..."
 483:             className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
 484:           />
 485:         </div>
 486: 
 487:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-500 text-xs">
 488:           <span>Tổng số:</span>
 489:           <strong className="text-slate-900 font-bold">{roles.length} vai trò</strong>
 490:           <span>
 491:             ({totalSystemRoles.length} vai trò hệ thống, {totalCustomRoles.length} tùy chỉnh)
 492:           </span>
 493:         </div>
 494:       </div>
 495: 
 496:       {/* Main Content Area */}
 497:       {loading ? (
 498:         // UI State: LOADING (Skeleton)
 499:         <div className="space-y-4 animate-pulse">
 500:           <div className="h-28 bg-slate-100 rounded-xl border border-slate-200" />
 501:           <div className="h-28 bg-slate-100 rounded-xl border border-slate-200" />
 502:           <div className="h-28 bg-slate-100 rounded-xl border border-slate-200" />
 503:         </div>
 504:       ) : (
 505:         <div className="space-y-6">
 506:           {/* Section 1: Custom Roles */}
 507:           <div className="space-y-3">
 508:             <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
 509:               <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
 510:                 <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
 511:                 <span>Vai Trò Tùy Chỉnh Của Cửa Hàng</span>
 512:               </h2>
 513:             </div>
 514: 
 515:             {!hasLoadedSuccessfully && errorMsg ? null : totalCustomRoles.length === 0 ? (
 516:               // UI State: EMPTY
 517:               <div className="modern-card p-8 text-center bg-slate-50/60 border border-dashed border-slate-200 rounded-xl space-y-3">
 518:                 <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
 519:                   <Shield className="w-5 h-5" />
 520:                 </div>
 521:                 <div className="space-y-1">
 522:                   <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
 523:                     Chưa có vai trò tùy chỉnh nào
 524:                   </h3>
 525:                   <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-md mx-auto">
 526:                     Cửa hàng của bạn hiện đang dùng các vai trò mặc định của hệ thống. Bạn có thể
 527:                     tạo vai trò tùy chỉnh mới để phân quyền chi tiết cho từng nghiệp vụ.
 528:                   </p>
 529:                 </div>
 530:                 {canManageRoles && (
 531:                   <button
 532:                     type="button"
 533:                     onClick={handleOpenCreate}
 534:                     className="btn-primary text-xs py-2 px-3.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg font-semibold shadow-sm"
 535:                   >
 536:                     <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
 537:                     <span>Tạo vai trò tùy chỉnh đầu tiên</span>
 538:                   </button>
 539:                 )}
 540:               </div>
 541:             ) : customRoles.length === 0 ? (
 542:               // UI State: SEARCH EMPTY (custom roles exist, but search filter produced zero matches)
 543:               <div className="modern-card p-8 text-center bg-slate-50/40 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-500 text-xs space-y-1">
 544:                 <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700">
 545:                   Không tìm thấy vai trò tùy chỉnh nào phù hợp với từ khóa &ldquo;{searchTerm}
 546:                   &rdquo;
 547:                 </p>
 548:                 <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
 549:                   Tổng cộng có {totalCustomRoles.length} vai trò tùy chỉnh trong cửa hàng.
 550:                 </p>
 551:               </div>
 552:             ) : (
 553:               <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
 554:                 {customRoles.map((role) => (
 555:                   <div
 556:                     key={role.id}
 557:                     className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3"
 558:                   >
 559:                     <div className="space-y-2">
 560:                       <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
 561:                         <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">{role.name}</h4>
 562:                         <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 text-[10px] font-bold shrink-0">
 563:                           Tùy chỉnh
 564:                         </span>
 565:                       </div>
 566:                       <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 line-clamp-2">
 567:                         {role.description || 'Không có mô tả chi tiết'}
 568:                       </p>
 569:                     </div>
 570: 
 571:                     <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-2 text-xs">
 572:                       <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-slate-600">
 573:                         <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-500">
 574:                           <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
 575:                           <span>Người dùng gán:</span>
 576:                         </span>
 577:                         <strong className="font-bold text-slate-900">
 578:                           {role.user_count} tài khoản
 579:                         </strong>
 580:                       </div>
 581: 
 582:                       <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-slate-600">
 583:                         <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-500">
 584:                           <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
 585:                           <span>Quyền kích hoạt:</span>
 586:                         </span>
 587:                         <strong className="font-bold text-blue-600">
 588:                           {role.permissions_count} quyền
 589:                         </strong>
 590:                       </div>
 591: 
 592:                       <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5 pt-2">
 593:                         <button
 594:                           type="button"
 595:                           onClick={() => setViewingRole(role)}
 596:                           className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] rounded bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 font-medium"
 597:                         >
 598:                           Chi tiết
 599:                         </button>
 600:                         {canManageRoles && (
 601:                           <>
 602:                             <button
 603:                               type="button"
 604:                               onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(role)}
 605:                               className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] rounded bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 font-medium flex items-center gap-1"
 606:                             >
 607:                               <Edit2 className="w-3 h-3" />
 608:                               <span>Sửa</span>
 609:                             </button>
 610:                             <button
 611:                               type="button"
 612:                               onClick={() => setDeletingRole(role)}
 613:                               className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] rounded bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 font-medium flex items-center gap-1"
 614:                             >
 615:                               <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
 616:                               <span>Xóa</span>
 617:                             </button>
 618:                           </>
 619:                         )}
 620:                       </div>
 621:                     </div>
 622:                   </div>
 623:                 ))}
 624:               </div>
 625:             )}
 626:           </div>
 627: 
 628:           {/* Section 2: Built-in System Roles */}
 629:           <div className="space-y-3">
 630:             <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
 631:               <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
 632:                 <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
 633:                 <span>Vai Trò Mặc Định Của Hệ Thống (Bất biến)</span>
 634:               </h2>
 635:             </div>
 636: 
 637:             <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
 638:               {systemRoles.map((role) => (
 639:                 <div
 640:                   key={role.id}
 641:                   className="bg-slate-50/60 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3"
 642:                 >
 643:                   <div className="space-y-2">
 644:                     <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
 645:                       <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
 646:                         <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
 647:                         <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">{role.name}</h4>
 648:                       </div>
 649:                       <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-[10px] font-bold shrink-0">
 650:                         Hệ thống
 651:                       </span>
 652:                     </div>
 653:                     <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 line-clamp-2">
 654:                       {role.description || 'Vai trò bảo vệ cốt lõi của nền tảng'}
 655:                     </p>
 656:                   </div>
 657: 
 658:                   <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200/60 space-y-2 text-xs">
 659:                     <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-slate-600">
 660:                       <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-500">
 661:                         <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
 662:                         <span>Người dùng:</span>
 663:                       </span>
 664:                       <strong className="font-bold text-slate-900">
 665:                         {role.user_count} tài khoản
 666:                       </strong>
 667:                     </div>
 668: 
 669:                     <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-slate-600">
 670:                       <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-500">
 671:                         <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
 672:                         <span>Quyền hạn:</span>
 673:                       </span>
 674:                       <strong className="font-bold text-purple-700">
 675:                         {role.permissions_count} quyền
 676:                       </strong>
 677:                     </div>
 678: 
 679:                     <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5 pt-2">
 680:                       <button
 681:                         type="button"
 682:                         onClick={() => setViewingRole(role)}
 683:                         className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] rounded bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 font-medium"
 684:                       >
 685:                         Xem chi tiết
 686:                       </button>
 687:                     </div>
 688:                   </div>
 689:                 </div>
 690:               ))}
 691:             </div>
 692:           </div>
 693:         </div>
 694:       )}
 695: 
 696:       {/* MODAL: VIEW ROLE DETAILS */}
 697:       {viewingRole && (
 698:         <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in">
 699:           <div
 700:             role="dialog"
 701:             aria-modal="true"
 702:             aria-labelledby="view-role-title"
 703:             className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-2xl w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-xs max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col animate-in zoom-in-95"
 704:           >
 705:             <div className="flex justify-between items-start pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
 706:               <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 707:                 <div
 708:                   className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center ${
 709:                     viewingRole.is_system
 710:                       ? 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-600'
 711:                       : 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600'
 712:                   }`}
 713:                 >
 714:                   {viewingRole.is_system ? (
 715:                     <Lock className="w-5 h-5" />
 716:                   ) : (
 717:                     <Sliders className="w-5 h-5" />
 718:                   )}
 719:                 </div>
 720:                 <div>
 721:                   <h3 id="view-role-title" className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
 722:                     {viewingRole.name}
 723:                   </h3>
 724:                   <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
 725:                     {viewingRole.is_system
 726:                       ? 'Vai trò bảo vệ hệ thống'
 727:                       : 'Vai trò tùy chỉnh cửa hàng'}{' '}
 728:                     · {viewingRole.permissions.length} quyền được gán
 729:                   </p>
 730:                 </div>
 731:               </div>
 732:               <button
 733:                 type="button"
 734:                 onClick={() => setViewingRole(null)}
 735:                 aria-label="Đóng chi tiết vai trò"
 736:                 className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
 737:               >
 738:                 ✕
 739:               </button>
 740:             </div>
 741: 
 742:             <div className="overflow-y-auto space-y-4 pr-1 flex-1">
 743:               <div>
 744:                 <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Mô tả nhiệm vụ:</h4>
 745:                 <p className="text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-100">
 746:                   {viewingRole.description || 'Không có mô tả chi tiết'}
 747:                 </p>
 748:               </div>
 749: 
 750:               <div>
 751:                 <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">Danh sách quyền hạn đã kích hoạt:</h4>
 752:                 <div className="space-y-3">
 753:                   {categories.map((cat) => {
 754:                     const permsInCat = viewingRole.permissions.filter((p) => p.category === cat);
 755:                     if (permsInCat.length === 0) return null;
 756: 
 757:                     return (
 758:                       <div key={cat} className="space-y-1.5">
 759:                         <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">
 760:                           Phân hệ {cat} ({permsInCat.length})
 761:                         </span>
 762:                         <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
 763:                           {permsInCat.map((p) => (
 764:                             <div
 765:                               key={p.code}
 766:                               className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 flex items-start gap-2"
 767:                             >
 768:                               <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
 769:                               <div className="space-y-0.5">
 770:                                 <strong className="text-slate-900 block font-semibold">
 771:                                   {p.name}
 772:                                 </strong>
 773:                                 <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block leading-tight">
 774:                                   {p.description}
 775:                                 </span>
 776:                               </div>
 777:                             </div>
 778:                           ))}
 779:                         </div>
 780:                       </div>
 781:                     );
 782:                   })}
 783:                 </div>
 784:               </div>
 785:             </div>
 786: 
 787:             <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-end">
 788:               <button
 789:                 type="button"
 790:                 onClick={() => setViewingRole(null)}
 791:                 className="btn-secondary text-xs py-1.5 px-4"
 792:               >
 793:                 Đóng
 794:               </button>
 795:             </div>
 796:           </div>
 797:         </div>
 798:       )}
 799: 
 800:       {/* MODAL: CREATE OR EDIT CUSTOM ROLE */}
 801:       {(isCreateOpen || editingRole) && (
 802:         <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in">
 803:           <div
 804:             role="dialog"
 805:             aria-modal="true"
 806:             aria-labelledby="create-edit-role-title"
 807:             className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-3xl w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-xs max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col animate-in zoom-in-95"
 808:           >
 809:             <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
 810:               <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 811:                 <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
 812:                   <Sliders className="w-5 h-5" />
 813:                 </div>
 814:                 <div>
 815:                   <h3 id="create-edit-role-title" className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
 816:                     {editingRole ? 'Chỉnh Sửa Vai Trò Tùy Chỉnh' : 'Tạo Vai Trò Tùy Chỉnh Mới'}
 817:                   </h3>
 818:                   <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
 819:                     Chọn các quyền hạn phù hợp với phạm vi trách nhiệm của vị trí công việc
 820:                   </p>
 821:                 </div>
 822:               </div>
 823:               <button
 824:                 type="button"
 825:                 onClick={() => {
 826:                   setIsCreateOpen(false);
 827:                   setEditingRole(null);
 828:                 }}
 829:                 aria-label="Đóng cửa sổ vai trò"
 830:                 className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
 831:               >
 832:                 ✕
 833:               </button>
 834:             </div>
 835: 
 836:             <form onSubmit={handleSaveRole} className="overflow-y-auto pr-1 flex-1 space-y-4">
 837:               {/* Modal Save Error Banner with In-Dialog Resubmit Retry */}
 838:               {modalError && (
 839:                 <div
 840:                   role="alert"
 841:                   className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl text-rose-800 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 text-xs"
 842:                 >
 843:                   <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
 844:                     <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
 845:                     <div>

1000:                 >

1018:           >
1019:             <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1 border-b border-slate-100">

1024:                 <div>

1039:               >
1040:                 ✕

1043: 
1044:             {/* Delete Modal Error Banner with In-Dialog Retry */}

1052:                   <div>

1057:                 <button

1059:                   onClick={handleDeleteRole}

1062:                 >
1063:                   Thử lại
1064:                 </button>
1065:               </div>

1067: 
1068:             <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 space-y-1.5 text-slate-600">

1082:                   Thao tác này sẽ xóa vĩnh viễn vai trò khỏi hệ thống và lưu vết kiểm toán bất biến

1084:                 </p>

1087: 
1088:             <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
1089:               <button

1107:                 <span>Xác nhận xóa</span>

  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
  4: import Link from 'next/link';
  5: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
  6: import {
  7:   Shield,
  8:   ShieldAlert,
  9:   ShieldCheck,
 10:   Key,
 11:   Copy,
 12:   Check,
 13:   Download,
 14:   AlertTriangle,
 15:   ArrowLeft,
 16:   Loader2,
 17:   RefreshCw,
 18:   QrCode,
 19: } from 'lucide-react';
 20: 
 21: export default function SecuritySettingsPage() {
 22:   const {
 23:     user,
 24:     getMfaStatus,
 25:     startMfaSetup,
 26:     verifyMfaSetup,
 27:     regenerateMfaRecoveryCodes: regenerateRecoveryCodes,
 28:   } = useAuth();
 29: 
 30:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
 31:   const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
 32:   const [mfaStatus, setMfaStatus] = useState<'NOT_ENROLLED' | 'PENDING' | 'ACTIVE' | 'RESET'>(
 33:     'NOT_ENROLLED'
 34:   );
 35:   const [isRequired, setIsRequired] = useState(false);
 36:   const [codesRemaining, setCodesRemaining] = useState(0);
 37:   const [verifiedAt, setVerifiedAt] = useState<string | null>(null);
 38: 
 39:   // Flow views: 'STATUS' | 'SETUP_AUTH' | 'SETUP_VERIFY' | 'SUCCESS_CODES' | 'REGENERATE_MODAL'
 40:   const [view, setView] = useState<
 41:     'STATUS' | 'SETUP_AUTH' | 'SETUP_VERIFY' | 'SUCCESS_CODES' | 'REGENERATE_MODAL'
 42:   >('STATUS');
 43: 
 44:   // Setup state
 45:   const [passwordInput, setPasswordInput] = useState('');
 46:   const [totpCodeInput, setTotpCodeInput] = useState('');
 47:   const [setupData, setSetupData] = useState<{
 48:     secret_key: string;
 49:     provisioning_uri: string;
 50:     expires_at: string;
 51:     expires_in_seconds: number;
 52:   } | null>(null);
 53: 
 54:   // Recovery codes display
 55:   const [newRecoveryCodes, setNewRecoveryCodes] = useState<string[]>([]);
 56:   const [confirmedSaved, setConfirmedSaved] = useState(false);
 57:   const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
 58: 
 59:   // Feedback and errors
 60:   const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
 61:   const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
 62:   const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{ password?: string; code?: string }>({});
 63: 
 64:   const loadStatus = useCallback(async () => {
 65:     setLoading(true);
 66:     setErrorMsg(null);
 67:     const res = await getMfaStatus();
 68:     setLoading(false);
 69:     if (res.success && res.data) {
 70:       setMfaStatus(res.data.status);
 71:       setIsRequired(res.data.required);
 72:       setCodesRemaining(res.data.recovery_codes_remaining);
 73:       setVerifiedAt(res.data.mfa_verified_at);
 74:     } else {
 75:       setErrorMsg(res.error || 'Không thể tải trạng thái xác thực hai yếu tố');
 76:     }
 77:   }, [getMfaStatus]);
 78: 
 79:   useEffect(() => {
 80:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- initial MFA status fetch
 81:     void loadStatus();
 82:   }, [loadStatus]);
 83: 
 84:   const handleStartSetupClick = () => {
 85:     setErrorMsg(null);
 86:     setFieldErrors({});
 87:     setPasswordInput('');
 88:     setView('SETUP_AUTH');
 89:   };
 90: 
 91:   const handlePasswordSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 92:     e.preventDefault();
 93:     if (!passwordInput) {
 94:       setFieldErrors({ password: 'Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu đăng nhập' });
 95:       return;
 96:     }
 97:     setFieldErrors({});
 98:     setSubmitting(true);
 99:     setErrorMsg(null);
100: 
101:     const res = await startMfaSetup(passwordInput);
102:     setSubmitting(false);
103: 
104:     if (res.success && res.data) {
105:       setSetupData(res.data);
106:       setTotpCodeInput('');
107:       setView('SETUP_VERIFY');
108:     } else {
109:       setErrorMsg(res.error || 'Xác thực mật khẩu không thành công');
110:     }
111:   };
112: 
113:   const handleVerifySetupSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
114:     e.preventDefault();
115:     if (!totpCodeInput || totpCodeInput.length !== 6) {
116:       setFieldErrors({ code: 'Vui lòng nhập mã gồm 6 chữ số' });
117:       return;
118:     }
119:     setFieldErrors({});
120:     setSubmitting(true);
121:     setErrorMsg(null);
122: 
123:     const res = await verifyMfaSetup(totpCodeInput);
124:     setSubmitting(false);
125: 
126:     if (res.success && res.data?.recovery_codes) {
127:       setNewRecoveryCodes(res.data.recovery_codes);
128:       setConfirmedSaved(false);
129:       setView('SUCCESS_CODES');
130:       setMfaStatus('ACTIVE');
131:       setCodesRemaining(10);
132:     } else {
133:       setErrorMsg(res.error || 'Mã xác thực không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn');
134:     }
135:   };
136: 
137:   const handleRegenerateSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
138:     e.preventDefault();
139:     const errors: { password?: string; code?: string } = {};
140:     if (!passwordInput) errors.password = 'Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu';
141:     if (!totpCodeInput || totpCodeInput.length !== 6) errors.code = 'Vui lòng nhập mã gồm 6 chữ số';
142:     if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
143:       setFieldErrors(errors);
144:       return;
145:     }
146: 
147:     setFieldErrors({});
148:     setSubmitting(true);
149:     setErrorMsg(null);
150: 
151:     const res = await regenerateRecoveryCodes(passwordInput, totpCodeInput);
152:     setSubmitting(false);
153: 
154:     if (res.success && res.data?.recovery_codes) {
155:       setNewRecoveryCodes(res.data.recovery_codes);
156:       setConfirmedSaved(false);
157:       setView('SUCCESS_CODES');
158:       setCodesRemaining(10);
159:     } else {
160:       setErrorMsg(res.error || 'Không thể tạo lại mã dự phòng');
161:     }
162:   };
163: 
164:   const handleCopyCodes = () => {
165:     const text = newRecoveryCodes.join('\n');
166:     navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
167:     setCopied(true);
168:     setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
169:   };
170: 
171:   const handleDownloadCodes = () => {
172:     const text =
173:       `SHIP DỄ - MÃ KHÔI PHỤC DỰ PHÒNG XÁC THỰC HAI YẾU TỐ (MFA)\n` +
174:       `Tài khoản: ${user?.email || user?.phone || user?.full_name}\n` +
175:       `Ngày tạo: ${new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN')}\n\n` +
176:       `LƯU Ý: Mỗi mã chỉ có giá trị sử dụng một lần duy nhất.\n\n` +
177:       newRecoveryCodes.map((code, idx) => `${idx + 1}. ${code}`).join('\n') +
178:       `\n`;
179: 
180:     const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
181:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
182:     const link = document.createElement('a');
183:     link.href = url;
184:     link.download = `shipde-recovery-codes-${Date.now()}.txt`;
185:     link.click();
186:     URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
187:   };
188: 
189:   const handleFinishSaveCodes = () => {
190:     setView('STATUS');
191:     setSuccessMsg('Đã lưu mã dự phòng và kích hoạt xác thực hai yếu tố thành công');
192:     loadStatus();
193:   };
194: 
195:   if (loading) {
196:     return (
197:       <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
198:         <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 text-slate-500">
199:           <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-emerald-600" />
200:           <span>Đang tải thông tin bảo mật...</span>
201:         </div>
202:       </div>
203:     );
204:   }
205: 
206:   return (
207:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-8 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
208:       <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto space-y-6">
209:         {/* Back Link */}
210:         <div>
211:           <Link
212:             href="/dashboard"
213:             className="inline-flex items-center text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors"
214:           >
215:             <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
216:             Quay lại bảng điều khiển
217:           </Link>
218:         </div>
219: 
220:         {/* Header */}
221:         <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 p-6">
222:           <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
223:             <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
224:               <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 rounded-lg text-emerald-600">
225:                 <Shield className="w-6 h-6" />
226:               </div>
227:               <div>
228:                 <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Bảo mật tài khoản</h1>
229:                 <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
230:                   Quản lý xác thực hai yếu tố (MFA) và mã khôi phục dự phòng
231:                 </p>
232:               </div>
233:             </div>
234:             {isRequired && (
235:               <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">
236:                 Bắt buộc cho Chủ shop
237:               </span>
238:             )}
239:           </div>
240:         </div>
241: 
242:         {/* Global Alert Messages */}
243:         {errorMsg && (
244:           <div
245:             role="alert"
246:             aria-live="polite"
247:             className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-lg p-4 flex items-start space-x-3 text-rose-800 text-sm"
248:           >
249:             <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 text-rose-600 mt-0.5" />
250:             <div>{errorMsg}</div>
251:           </div>
252:         )}
253: 
254:         {successMsg && (
255:           <div
256:             role="alert"
257:             aria-live="polite"

582:                 >

<file path="apps/web/src/app/settings/warehouses/page.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
  4: import Link from 'next/link';
  5: import {
  6:   ArrowLeft,
  7:   Store,
  8:   GitBranch,
  9:   Users,
 10:   Shield,
 11:   Warehouse as WarehouseIcon,
 12: } from 'lucide-react';
 13: import { WarehouseManagementView } from '@/components/WarehouseManagementView';
 14: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
 15: import type { Warehouse, CreateWarehouseInput, UpdateWarehouseInput } from '@shipde/contracts';
 16: 
 17: const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 18: 
 19: export interface WarehousesSettingsPageProps {
 20:   initialWarehouses?: Warehouse[] | null;
 21:   initialLoading?: boolean;
 22:   initialCanEdit?: boolean;
 23:   initialError?: string | null;
 24:   initialScopedWarehouses?: string[] | null;
 25: }
 26: 
 27: export default function WarehousesSettingsPage({
 28:   initialWarehouses = null,
 29:   initialLoading = false,
 30:   initialCanEdit,
 31:   initialError = null,
 32:   initialScopedWarehouses = null,
 33: }: WarehousesSettingsPageProps) {
 34:   const { user } = useAuth();
 35:   const token = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('shipde_token') : null;
 36: 
 37:   // Mutation access strictly requires the iam:shop_config permission, never defaults to true
 38:   const derivedCanEdit =
 39:     initialCanEdit !== undefined
 40:       ? initialCanEdit
 41:       : Boolean(
 42:           user &&
 43:           Array.isArray((user as any).permissions) &&
 44:           (user as any).permissions.includes('iam:shop_config')
 45:         );
 46: 
 47:   const derivedScopedWarehouses =
 48:     initialScopedWarehouses !== null ? initialScopedWarehouses : user?.warehouse_scopes || null;
 49: 
 50:   const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState<Warehouse[]>(initialWarehouses || []);
 51:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(
 52:     initialWarehouses ? false : (initialLoading ?? true)
 53:   );
 54:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(initialError);
 55: 
 56:   const fetchWarehouses = useCallback(async () => {
 57:     setLoading(true);
 58:     setError(null);
 59:     try {
 60:       const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 61:         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 62:       };
 63:       if (token) {
 64:         headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
 65:       }
 66: 
 67:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/warehouses`, { headers });
 68:       if (!res.ok) {
 69:         if (res.status === 403) {
 70:           throw new Error('Bạn không có quyền truy cập danh sách kho hàng.');
 71:         }
 72:         if (res.status === 401) {
 73:           throw new Error('Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.');
 74:         }
 75:         const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 76:         throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể tải danh sách kho hàng');
 77:       }
 78: 
 79:       const json = await res.json();
 80:       if (json.success && json.data) {
 81:         setWarehouses(json.data);
 82:       }
 83:     } catch (err: any) {
 84:       setError(err?.message || 'Lỗi khi kết nối với máy chủ quản lý kho hàng');
 85:     } finally {
 86:       setLoading(false);
 87:     }
 88:   }, [token]);
 89: 
 90:   useEffect(() => {
 91:     if (!initialWarehouses) {
 92:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- initial warehouses fetch
 93:       void fetchWarehouses();
 94:     }
 95:   }, [initialWarehouses, fetchWarehouses]);
 96: 
 97:   // Create Warehouse Handler
 98:   const handleCreate = async (input: CreateWarehouseInput) => {
 99:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
100:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
101:     };
102:     if (token) {
103:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
104:     }
105: 
106:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/warehouses`, {
107:       method: 'POST',
108:       headers,
109:       body: JSON.stringify(input),
110:     });
111: 
112:     if (!res.ok) {
113:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
114:       throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể tạo mới kho hàng');
115:     }
116: 
117:     await fetchWarehouses();
118:   };
119: 
120:   // Update Warehouse Handler
121:   const handleUpdate = async (id: string, input: UpdateWarehouseInput) => {
122:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
123:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
124:     };
125:     if (token) {
126:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
127:     }
128: 
129:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/warehouses/${id}`, {
130:       method: 'PATCH',
131:       headers,
132:       body: JSON.stringify(input),
133:     });
134: 
135:     if (!res.ok) {
136:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
137:       throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể cập nhật kho hàng');
138:     }
139: 
140:     await fetchWarehouses();
141:   };
142: 
143:   // Set Default Warehouse Handler
144:   const handleSetDefault = async (id: string) => {
145:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
146:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
147:     };
148:     if (token) {
149:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
150:     }
151: 
152:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/warehouses/${id}/default`, {
153:       method: 'POST',
154:       headers,
155:     });
156: 
157:     if (!res.ok) {
158:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
159:       throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể đặt kho mặc định');
160:     }
161: 
162:     await fetchWarehouses();
163:   };
164: 
165:   // Deactivate Warehouse Handler
166:   const handleDeactivate = async (id: string) => {
167:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
168:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
169:     };
170:     if (token) {
171:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
172:     }
173: 
174:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/warehouses/${id}`, {
175:       method: 'DELETE',
176:       headers,
177:     });
178: 
179:     if (!res.ok) {
180:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
181:       throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể tạm ngưng kho hàng');
182:     }
183: 
184:     await fetchWarehouses();
185:   };
186: 
187:   // Activate Warehouse Handler
188:   const handleActivate = async (id: string) => {
189:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
190:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
191:     };
192:     if (token) {
193:       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
194:     }
195: 
196:     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/warehouses/${id}`, {
197:       method: 'PATCH',
198:       headers,
199:       body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'active' }),
200:     });
201: 
202:     if (!res.ok) {
203:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
204:       throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể kích hoạt lại kho hàng');
205:     }
206: 
207:     await fetchWarehouses();
208:   };
209: 
210:   return (
211:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-8 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
212:       <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">
213:         {/* Navigation Breadcrumb and Sub-nav */}
214:         <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
215:           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
216:             <Link
217:               href="/"
218:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 transition"
219:             >
220:               <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
221:               <span>Quay lại Bảng Điều Khiển</span>
222:             </Link>
223:             <span className="text-slate-300">/</span>
224:             <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
225:               Chi nhánh &amp; Kho hàng (SCR-WH-01 / FEAT-WH-01)
226:             </span>
227:           </div>
228: 
229:           {/* Quick Settings Switcher Tabs */}
230:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
231:             <Link
232:               href="/settings/shop"
233:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition font-medium"
234:             >
235:               <Store className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
236:               <span>Hồ sơ Shop</span>
237:             </Link>
238:             <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-orange-50 border border-orange-200 text-orange-700 font-bold">
239:               <WarehouseIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-600" />
240:               <span>Kho hàng</span>
241:             </span>
242:             <Link
243:               href="/settings/users"
244:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition font-medium"
245:             >
246:               <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
247:               <span>Nhân sự</span>
248:             </Link>
249:             <Link
250:               href="/settings/roles"
251:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition font-medium"
252:             >
253:               <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
254:               <span>Phân quyền</span>
255:             </Link>
256:           </div>
257:         </div>
258: 
259:         {/* Main Warehouse Management View */}
260:         <WarehouseManagementView
261:           warehouses={warehouses}
262:           loading={loading}
263:           canEdit={derivedCanEdit}
264:           scopedWarehouses={derivedScopedWarehouses}
265:           error={error}
266:           onRefresh={fetchWarehouses}
267:           onCreate={handleCreate}
268:           onUpdate={handleUpdate}
269:           onSetDefault={handleSetDefault}
270:           onActivate={handleActivate}
271:           onDeactivate={handleDeactivate}
272:         />
273:       </div>
274:     </div>
275:   );
276: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/auth/ForgotPasswordView.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
  4: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
  5: import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
  6: import {
  7:   ShieldCheck,
  8:   Mail,
  9:   Phone,
 10:   Lock,
 11:   ArrowRight,
 12:   AlertCircle,
 13:   CheckCircle2,
 14:   Loader2,
 15:   ChevronLeft,
 16: } from 'lucide-react';
 17: 
 18: interface Props {
 19:   onBackToLogin: () => void;
 20: }
 21: 
 22: type ForgotPasswordState = 'IDLE' | 'LOADING' | 'SUCCESS' | 'RATE_LIMITED' | 'FORBIDDEN';
 23: 
 24: export const ForgotPasswordView: React.FC<Props> = ({ onBackToLogin }) => {
 25:   const { forgotPassword } = useAuth();
 26:   const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState('');
 27:   const [state, setState] = useState<ForgotPasswordState>('IDLE');
 28:   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
 29:   const [rateLimitRetryAfter, setRateLimitRetryAfter] = useState<number | null>(null);
 30:   const [submittedIdentifier, setSubmittedIdentifier] = useState<string | null>(null);
 31:   const [submittedChannel, setSubmittedChannel] = useState<'email' | 'phone' | null>(null);
 32: 
 33:   // Countdown timer for rate limit
 34:   useEffect(() => {
 35:     if (!rateLimitRetryAfter || rateLimitRetryAfter <= 0) return;
 36:     const timer = setInterval(() => {
 37:       setRateLimitRetryAfter((prev) => (prev && prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : 0));
 38:     }, 1000);
 39:     return () => clearInterval(timer);
 40:   }, [rateLimitRetryAfter]);
 41: 
 42:   const isEmail = identifier.includes('@');
 43:   const channel = isEmail ? 'email' : 'phone';
 44:   const isValidFormat = isEmail
 45:     ? /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(identifier.trim())
 46:     : /^(0|\+84)[3|5|7|8|9][0-9]{8}$/.test(identifier.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ''));
 47: 
 48:   const isEmpty = !identifier.trim();
 49:   const isDisabled = state === 'LOADING' || state === 'SUCCESS' || isEmpty || !isValidFormat;
 50: 
 51:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 52:     e.preventDefault();
 53:     if (isDisabled) return;
 54: 
 55:     setState('LOADING');
 56:     setErrorMessage(null);
 57: 
 58:     try {
 59:       const res = await forgotPassword(identifier.trim());
 60:       if (!res.success) {
 61:         if (res.code === 'RATE_LIMITED') {
 62:           setState('RATE_LIMITED');
 63:           setRateLimitRetryAfter(res.cooldownSeconds || 60);
 64:           setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu. Vui lòng thử lại sau.');
 65:         } else if (res.code === 'FORBIDDEN') {
 66:           setState('FORBIDDEN');
 67:           setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Tài khoản bị khóa, không thể yêu cầu đặt lại mật khẩu.');
 68:         } else {
 69:           setState('IDLE');
 70:           setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Có lỗi xảy ra. Vui lòng thử lại.');
 71:         }
 72:         return;
 73:       }
 74: 
 75:       // Success - token sent
 76:       setState('SUCCESS');
 77:       setSubmittedIdentifier(identifier.trim());
 78:       setSubmittedChannel((res.data?.channel || channel) as 'email' | 'phone' | null);
 79:     } catch {
 80:       setState('IDLE');
 81:       setErrorMessage('Lỗi kết nối máy chủ. Vui lòng thử lại sau.');
 82:     }
 83:   };
 84: 
 85:   const handleTryAgain = () => {
 86:     setState('IDLE');
 87:     setErrorMessage(null);
 88:     setRateLimitRetryAfter(null);
 89:     setSubmittedIdentifier(null);
 90:     setSubmittedChannel(null);
 91:   };
 92: 
 93:   const handleBackToLogin = () => {
 94:     onBackToLogin();
 95:   };
 96: 
 97:   return (
 98:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#FDFCFB] text-slate-900 flex flex-col justify-center py-12 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 font-sans selection:bg-[#c23807] selection:text-white relative">
 99:       <div className="sm:mx-auto sm:w-full sm:max-w-md relative z-10">
100:         <div className="text-center space-y-2 mb-8">
101:           <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-[#c23807] text-white flex items-center justify-center font-black text-2xl mx-auto shadow-md shadow-[#c23807]/20">
102:             S
103:           </div>
104:           <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
105:             Khôi Phục Mật Khẩu
106:           </h1>
107:           <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
108:             Nhập email hoặc số điện thoại để đặt lại mật khẩu
109:           </p>
110:         </div>
111:         <div className="modern-card p-8 space-y-6 shadow-xl">
112:           {state === 'LOADING' && (
113:             <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-8 space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
114:               <Loader2 className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-[#c23807] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
115:               <span className="text-sm text-slate-600 font-medium">Đang gửi liên kết...</span>
116:             </div>
117:           )}
118:           {state === 'IDLE' && isEmpty && (
119:             <div className="p-3.5 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in">
120:               <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
121:               <span>Vui lòng nhập email hoặc số điện thoại</span>
122:             </div>
123:           )}
124:           {state === 'IDLE' && errorMessage && !isEmpty && (
125:             <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in">
126:               <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-rose-600 shrink-0" />
127:               <span>{errorMessage}</span>
128:             </div>
129:           )}
130:           {state === 'IDLE' && !isEmpty && !isValidFormat && !errorMessage && (
131:             <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in">
132:               <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-rose-600 shrink-0" />
133:               <span>Email hoặc số điện thoại không hợp lệ</span>
134:             </div>
135:           )}
136:           {state === 'RATE_LIMITED' && (
137:             <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
138:               <div className="p-3.5 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2">
139:                 <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
140:                 <div>
141:                   <p className="font-bold">Quá nhiều yêu cầu</p>
142:                   <p className="text-amber-700 mt-1">Thử lại sau {rateLimitRetryAfter} giây</p>
143:                 </div>
144:               </div>
145:               {rateLimitRetryAfter === 0 ? (
146:                 <button
147:                   type="button"
148:                   onClick={handleTryAgain}
149:                   className="btn-primary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3"
150:                 >
151:                   Thử lại
152:                 </button>
153:               ) : (
154:                 <button
155:                   type="button"
156:                   disabled
157:                   className="btn-primary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3 opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed"
158:                 >
159:                   Đang chờ...
160:                 </button>
161:               )}
162:             </div>
163:           )}
164:           {state === 'FORBIDDEN' && (
165:             <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
166:               <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2">
167:                 <Lock className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
168:                 <div>
169:                   <p className="font-bold">Tài khoản bị khóa</p>
170:                   <p className="text-rose-700 mt-1">
171:                     {errorMessage || 'Tài khoản này không thể đặt lại mật khẩu.'}
172:                   </p>
173:                 </div>
174:               </div>
175:               <button
176:                 type="button"
177:                 onClick={handleBackToLogin}
178:                 className="btn-secondary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3"
179:               >
180:                 Quay lại đăng nhập
181:               </button>
182:             </div>
183:           )}
184:           {state === 'SUCCESS' && (
185:             <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
186:               <div className="flex flex-col items-center py-4 space-y-3">
187:                 <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 flex items-center justify-center">
188:                   <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-600" />
189:                 </div>
190:                 <div className="text-center space-y-1">
191:                   <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Liên kết đã được gửi</p>
192:                   <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
193:                     Kiểm tra {submittedChannel === 'email' ? 'email' : 'SMS'}
194:                   </p>
195:                 </div>
196:               </div>
197:               <div className="p-3.5 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium">
198:                 Nếu tài khoản tồn tại và đã xác thực, liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu đã được gửi.
199:               </div>
200:               <button
201:                 type="button"
202:                 onClick={handleBackToLogin}
203:                 className="btn-primary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3"
204:               >
205:                 Quay lại đăng nhập
206:               </button>
207:             </div>
208:           )}
209:           {state === 'IDLE' && (
210:             <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
211:               <div>
212:                 <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1.5">
213:                   Email hoặc Số Điện Thoại
214:                 </label>
215:                 <div className="relative">
216:                   {isEmail ? (
217:                     <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3.5" />
218:                   ) : (
219:                     <Phone className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3.5" />
220:                   )}
221:                   <input
222:                     type="text"
223:                     value={identifier}
224:                     onChange={(e) => {
225:                       setIdentifier(e.target.value);
226:                       if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
227:                     }}
228:                     placeholder="owner@ananboutique.vn hoặc 0901234567"
229:                     className="modern-input pl-10 h-11 text-sm font-medium"
230:                     autoFocus
231:                   />
232:                 </div>
233:               </div>
234:               <button
235:                 type="submit"
236:                 disabled={isDisabled}
237:                 className="btn-primary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3 font-bold"
238:               >
239:                 Gửi liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu
240:               </button>
241:             </form>
242:           )}
243:         </div>
244:         <div className="text-center mt-6 text-xs text-slate-500">
245:           Nhớ mật khẩu?{' '}
246:           <button
247:             type="button"
248:             onClick={handleBackToLogin}
249:             className="text-[#c23807] font-bold hover:underline"
250:           >
251:             Quay lại đăng nhập
252:           </button>
253:         </div>
254:       </div>
255:     </div>
256:   );
257: };
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/auth/RegisterView.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
  4: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
  5: import {
  6:   ShieldCheck,
  7:   Store,
  8:   Phone,
  9:   Mail,
 10:   Lock,
 11:   ArrowRight,
 12:   User,
 13:   CheckCircle2,
 14:   AlertTriangle,
 15:   Clock,
 16:   RefreshCw,
 17:   KeyRound,
 18: } from 'lucide-react';
 19: 
 20: interface Props {
 21:   onSwitchToLogin: () => void;
 22: }
 23: 
 24: type RegistrationStep = 'FORM' | 'PENDING_VERIFICATION' | 'VERIFIED_SUCCESS';
 25: 
 26: export const RegisterView: React.FC<Props> = ({ onSwitchToLogin }) => {
 27:   const { register, verifyEmail, verifyPhone, resendVerification } = useAuth();
 28: 
 29:   // Form State
 30:   const [merchantName, setMerchantName] = useState('');
 31:   const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('');
 32:   const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
 33:   const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
 34:   const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
 35:   const [termsAccepted, setTermsAccepted] = useState(false);
 36: 
 37:   // Status & Error States
 38:   const [step, setStep] = useState<RegistrationStep>('FORM');
 39:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
 40:   const [generalError, setGeneralError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 41:   const [rateLimitMessage, setRateLimitMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
 42:   const [duplicateIdentifier, setDuplicateIdentifier] = useState<string | null>(null);
 43:   const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
 44: 
 45:   // Verification Step States
 46:   const [registeredEmail, setRegisteredEmail] = useState('');
 47:   const [registeredPhone, setRegisteredPhone] = useState('');
 48:   const [verificationCode, setVerificationCode] = useState('');
 49:   const [verifyLoading, setVerifyLoading] = useState(false);
 50:   const [verifyError, setVerifyError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 51:   const [resendCooldown, setResendCooldown] = useState(0);
 52:   const [resendMessage, setResendMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
 53: 
 54:   // Countdown timer for resend cooldown
 55:   useEffect(() => {
 56:     if (resendCooldown <= 0) return;
 57:     const timer = setInterval(() => {
 58:       setResendCooldown((prev) => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : 0));
 59:     }, 1000);
 60:     return () => clearInterval(timer);
 61:   }, [resendCooldown]);
 62: 
 63:   // Dirty form warning
 64:   const isDirty =
 65:     Boolean(merchantName || fullName || email || phone || password) && step === 'FORM';
 66: 
 67:   useEffect(() => {
 68:     const handleBeforeUnload = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
 69:       if (isDirty) {
 70:         e.preventDefault();
 71:         e.returnValue = '';
 72:       }
 73:     };
 74:     window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
 75:     return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
 76:   }, [isDirty]);
 77: 
 78:   const handleRegister = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 79:     e.preventDefault();
 80:     setGeneralError(null);
 81:     setRateLimitMessage(null);
 82:     setDuplicateIdentifier(null);
 83:     setFieldErrors({});
 84: 
 85:     if (!termsAccepted) {
 86:       setFieldErrors({
 87:         terms_accepted: 'Vui lòng đồng ý với Điều khoản dịch vụ và Chính sách bảo mật.',
 88:       });
 89:       return;
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     setLoading(true);
 93: 
 94:     const res = await register({
 95:       merchantName: merchantName.trim(),
 96:       fullName: fullName.trim(),
 97:       email: email.trim() || undefined,
 98:       phone: phone.trim() || undefined,
 99:       password,
100:       termsAccepted: true,
101:       termsVersion: '2026.1',
102:     });
103: 
104:     setLoading(false);
105: 
106:     if (!res.success) {
107:       if (res.code === 'RATE_LIMITED') {
108:         setRateLimitMessage(
109:           res.nextAction ||
110:             res.error ||
111:             'Quá nhiều yêu cầu đăng ký từ địa chỉ của bạn. Vui lòng thử lại sau.'
112:         );
113:       } else if (
114:         res.fields?.some((f) => f.code === 'DUPLICATE') ||
115:         res.error?.includes('đã được đăng ký')
116:       ) {
117:         const dupField = res.fields?.find((f) => f.code === 'DUPLICATE')?.field || 'thông tin';
118:         setDuplicateIdentifier(
119:           dupField === 'email'
120:             ? 'Email này đã được đăng ký tài khoản.'
121:             : 'Số điện thoại này đã được đăng ký tài khoản.'
122:         );
123:       } else if (res.fields && res.fields.length > 0) {
124:         const errMap: Record<string, string> = {};
125:         res.fields.forEach((f) => {
126:           errMap[f.field] = f.message;
127:         });
128:         setFieldErrors(errMap);
129:       } else {
130:         setGeneralError(res.error || 'Đăng ký thất bại. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại thông tin.');
131:       }
132:       return;
133:     }
134: 
135:     // Success -> Transition to verification pending screen
136:     setRegisteredEmail(res.data?.email || email);
137:     setRegisteredPhone(res.data?.phone || phone);
138:     setResendCooldown(60);
139:     setStep('PENDING_VERIFICATION');
140:   };
141: 
142:   const handleVerify = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
143:     e.preventDefault();
144:     if (!verificationCode.trim()) {
145:       setVerifyError('Vui lòng nhập mã xác thực');
146:       return;
147:     }
148: 
149:     setVerifyLoading(true);
150:     setVerifyError(null);
151: 
152:     let res: { success: boolean; error?: string; code?: string; nextAction?: string };
153: 
154:     if (registeredPhone && /^\d{6}$/.test(verificationCode.trim())) {
155:       res = await verifyPhone(registeredPhone, verificationCode.trim());
156:     } else {
157:       res = await verifyEmail(verificationCode.trim());
158:     }
159: 
160:     setVerifyLoading(false);
161: 
162:     if (res.success) {
163:       setStep('VERIFIED_SUCCESS');
164:     } else {
165:       setVerifyError(
166:         res.error ||
167:           res.nextAction ||
168:           'Mã xác thực không đúng hoặc đã hết hạn. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.'
169:       );
170:     }
171:   };
172: 
173:   const handleResend = async () => {
174:     if (resendCooldown > 0) return;
175:     const identifier = registeredEmail || registeredPhone;
176:     const channel = registeredEmail ? 'email' : 'phone';
177: 
178:     const res = await resendVerification(identifier, channel);
179:     if (res.success) {
180:       setResendCooldown(res.cooldownSeconds || 60);
181:       setResendMessage(
182:         `Đã gửi lại mã xác thực tới ${channel === 'email' ? 'email' : 'số điện thoại'}.`
183:       );
184:       setVerifyError(null);
185:     } else {
186:       setVerifyError(res.error || 'Gửi lại mã thất bại. Vui lòng thử lại.');
187:     }
188:   };

190:   const maskIdentifier = (val: string): string => {
191:     if (!val) return '';
192:     if (val.includes('@')) {
193:       const [name, domain] = val.split('@');
194:       return `${name.slice(0, 2)}***@${domain}`;
195:     }
196:     return `${val.slice(0, 4)}****${val.slice(-3)}`;
197:   };

207:             S
