591:               type="button"
592:               onClick={onSwitchToLogin}
593:               className="w-full h-12 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/25"
594:             >
595:               <span>Tiến Hành Đăng Nhập</span>
596:               <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
597:             </button>
598:           </div>
599:         )}
600: 
601:         {/* Security / Tenant Isolation Note */}
602:         <div className="text-center mt-6 text-xs text-slate-500 space-y-1">
603:           <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-700 font-semibold">
604:             <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
605:             <span>Mỗi cửa hàng là một cơ sở dữ liệu phân vùng độc lập (Tenant Isolation)</span>
606:           </div>
607:         </div>
608:       </div>
609:     </div>
610:   );
611: };
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/auth/ResetPasswordView.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
  4: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
  5: import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
  6: import { Lock, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Loader2, Eye, EyeOff, ChevronLeft } from 'lucide-react';
  7: 
  8: interface Props {
  9:   onBackToLogin: () => void;
 10: }
 11: type ResetPasswordState =
 12:   | 'VERIFYING'
 13:   | 'VALID_TOKEN'
 14:   | 'LOADING'
 15:   | 'INVALID_TOKEN'
 16:   | 'TOKEN_EXPIRED'
 17:   | 'TOKEN_USED'
 18:   | 'SUCCESS'
 19:   | 'FORBIDDEN'
 20:   | 'ERROR';
 21: 
 22: export const ResetPasswordView: React.FC<Props> = ({ onBackToLogin }) => {
 23:   const { verifyResetToken, resetPassword } = useAuth();
 24:   const router = useRouter();
 25:   const searchParams = useSearchParams();
 26:   const tokenFromUrl = searchParams.get('token') || '';
 27: 
 28:   const [state, setState] = useState<ResetPasswordState>('VERIFYING');
 29:   const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
 30:   const [passwordConfirm, setPasswordConfirm] = useState('');
 31:   const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
 32:   const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(false);
 33:   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
 34:   const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Array<{ field: string; message: string }>>([]);
 35:   const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState<string | null>(null);
 36:   const [channel, setChannel] = useState<string | null>(null);
 37:   const [passwordStrength, setPasswordStrength] = useState(0);
 38:   const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
 39: 
 40:   // Verify token on mount
 41:   useEffect(() => {
 42:     if (!tokenFromUrl) {
 43:       // A link with no token can be answered without asking the server, so this
 44:       // one state is set straight away. Same exemption and reason as
 45:       // ShipmentListTab, ThreeLedgersTab and AuthContext.
 46:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- no token to verify
 47:       setState('INVALID_TOKEN');
 48:       return;
 49:     }
 50:     const verify = async () => {
 51:       setState('VERIFYING');
 52:       setErrorMessage(null);
 53:       setFieldErrors([]);
 54:       try {
 55:         const res = await verifyResetToken(tokenFromUrl);
 56:         if (!res.success) {
 57:           if (res.code === 'TOKEN_EXPIRED') {
 58:             setState('TOKEN_EXPIRED');
 59:           } else if (res.code === 'TOKEN_ALREADY_USED') {
 60:             setState('TOKEN_USED');
 61:           } else if (res.code === 'FORBIDDEN') {
 62:             setState('FORBIDDEN');
 63:           } else {
 64:             setState('INVALID_TOKEN');
 65:           }
 66:           setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Liên kết không hợp lệ.');
 67:           return;
 68:         }
 69:         setState('VALID_TOKEN');
 70:         setIdentifier(res.data?.identifier || null);
 71:         setChannel(res.data?.channel || null);
 72:       } catch {
 73:         setState('ERROR');
 74:         setErrorMessage('Lỗi kết nối máy chủ. Vui lòng thử lại.');
 75:       }
 76:     };
 77:     verify();
 78:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- verifyResetToken is stable from context
 79:   }, [tokenFromUrl]);
 80: 
 81:   const handlePasswordChange = (val: string) => {
 82:     setPassword(val);
 83:     let strength = 0;
 84:     if (val.length >= 6) strength++;
 85:     if (val.length >= 10) strength++;
 86:     if (/[A-Z]/.test(val)) strength++;
 87:     if (/[0-9]/.test(val)) strength++;
 88:     if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(val)) strength++;
 89:     setPasswordStrength(strength);
 90:     setFieldErrors((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.field !== 'newPassword'));
 91:   };
 92: 
 93:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 94:     e.preventDefault();
 95:     setErrorMessage(null);
 96:     setFieldErrors([]);
 97: 
 98:     if (password !== passwordConfirm) {
 99:       setFieldErrors([{ field: 'newPassword', message: 'Mật khẩu không khớp.' }]);
100:       return;
101:     }
102: 
103:     setState('LOADING');
104:     try {
105:       const res = await resetPassword({
106:         token: tokenFromUrl,
107:         password,
108:         password_confirm: passwordConfirm,
109:       });
110:       if (!res.success) {
111:         if (res.code === 'TOKEN_EXPIRED') {
112:           setState('TOKEN_EXPIRED');
113:           setErrorMessage(res.error || null);
114:         } else if (res.code === 'TOKEN_ALREADY_USED') {
115:           setState('TOKEN_USED');
116:           setErrorMessage(res.error || null);
117:         } else if (res.code === 'FORBIDDEN') {
118:           setState('FORBIDDEN');
119:           setErrorMessage(res.error || null);
120:         } else if (res.code === 'INVALID_TOKEN') {
121:           setState('INVALID_TOKEN');
122:           setErrorMessage(res.error || null);
123:           setFieldErrors(res.fields || []);
124:         } else if (res.code === 'VALIDATION_ERROR') {
125:           const mismatchField = res.fields?.find((f) => f.code === 'MISMATCH');
126:           if (mismatchField) {
127:             setState('VALID_TOKEN');
128:             setFieldErrors(res.fields || []);
129:           } else {
130:             setState('VALID_TOKEN');
131:             setFieldErrors(res.fields || []);
132:             setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Dữ liệu không hợp lệ');
133:           }
134:         } else {
135:           setState('ERROR');
136:           setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Có lỗi xảy ra.');
137:         }
138:         return;
139:       }
140:       setState('SUCCESS');
141:       timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
142:         onBackToLogin();
143:       }, 5000);
144:     } catch {
145:       setState('ERROR');
146:       setErrorMessage('Lỗi kết nối máy chủ. Vui lòng thử lại.');
147:     }
148:   };
149: 
150:   const handleBackToLogin = () => {
151:     if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
152:     router.push('/');
153:   };
154: 
155:   const strengthLabels = ['Rất yếu', 'Yếu', 'Trung bình', 'Mạnh', 'Rất mạnh'];
156: 
157:   return (
158:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#FDFCFB] text-slate-900 flex flex-col justify-center py-12 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 font-sans selection:bg-[#c23807] selection:text-white relative">
159:       <div className="sm:mx-auto sm:w-full sm:max-w-md relative z-10">
160:         <div className="text-center space-y-2 mb-8">
161:           <button
162:             type="button"
163:             onClick={handleBackToLogin}
164:             aria-label="Quay lại đăng nhập"
165:             title="Quay lại đăng nhập"
166:             className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 transition-colors"
167:           >
168:             <ChevronLeft className="w-6 h-6 mx-auto" />
169:           </button>
170:           <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
171:             Đặt Lại Mật Khẩu
172:           </h1>
173:           <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Nhập mật khẩu mới an toàn</p>
174:         </div>
175:         <div className="modern-card p-8 space-y-6 shadow-xl">
176:           {state === 'VERIFYING' && (
177:             <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-8 space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
178:               <Loader2 className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-[#c23807] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
179:               <span className="text-sm text-slate-600 font-medium">Đang xác minh liên kết...</span>
180:             </div>
181:           )}
182:           {state === 'ERROR' && (
183:             <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
184:               <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2">
185:                 <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
186:                 <div>
187:                   <p className="font-bold">Lỗi</p>
188:                   <p className="text-rose-700 mt-1">{errorMessage}</p>
189:                 </div>
190:               </div>
191:               <button
192:                 type="button"
193:                 onClick={handleBackToLogin}
194:                 className="btn-secondary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3"
195:               >
196:                 Quay lại đăng nhập
197:               </button>
198:             </div>
199:           )}
200:           {state === 'INVALID_TOKEN' && (
201:             <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
202:               <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2">
203:                 <Lock className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
204:                 <div>
205:                   <p className="font-bold">Liên kết không hợp lệ</p>
206:                   <p className="text-rose-700 mt-1">
207:                     {errorMessage || 'Liên kết đã được sử dụng hoặc không đúng định dạng.'}
208:                   </p>
209:                 </div>
210:               </div>
211:               {fieldErrors.length > 0 && (
212:                 <div className="text-xs text-rose-600 space-y-1">
213:                   {fieldErrors.map((fe, i) => (
214:                     <p key={i}>{fe.message}</p>
215:                   ))}
216:                 </div>
217:               )}
218:               <button
219:                 type="button"
220:                 onClick={handleBackToLogin}
221:                 className="btn-secondary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3"
222:               >
223:                 Quay lại đăng nhập
224:               </button>
225:             </div>
226:           )}
227: 
228:           {state === 'TOKEN_EXPIRED' && (
229:             <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
230:               <div className="p-3.5 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2">
231:                 <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
232:                 <div>
233:                   <p className="font-bold">Liên kết đã hết hạn</p>
234:                   <p className="text-amber-700 mt-1">
235:                     {errorMessage || 'Vui lòng yêu cầu liên kết mới.'}
236:                   </p>
237:                 </div>
238:               </div>
239:               <button
240:                 type="button"
241:                 onClick={handleBackToLogin}
242:                 className="btn-primary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3"
243:               >
244:                 Quay lại đăng nhập
245:               </button>
246:             </div>
247:           )}
248:           {state === 'TOKEN_USED' && (
249:             <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
250:               <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2">
251:                 <Lock className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
252:                 <div>
253:                   <p className="font-bold">Liên kết đã được sử dụng</p>
254:                   <p className="text-rose-700 mt-1">
255:                     {errorMessage || 'Mật khẩu đã được thay đổi. Vui lòng đăng nhập.'}
256:                   </p>
257:                 </div>
258:               </div>
259:               <button
260:                 type="button"
261:                 onClick={handleBackToLogin}
262:                 className="btn-primary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3"
263:               >
264:                 Đăng nhập
265:               </button>
266:             </div>
267:           )}
268:           {state === 'FORBIDDEN' && (
269:             <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
270:               <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2">
271:                 <Lock className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
272:                 <div>
273:                   <p className="font-bold">Tài khoản bị khóa</p>
274:                   <p className="text-rose-700 mt-1">
275:                     {errorMessage || 'Tài khoản này không thể đặt lại mật khẩu.'}
276:                   </p>
277:                 </div>
278:               </div>
279:               <button
280:                 type="button"
281:                 onClick={handleBackToLogin}
282:                 className="btn-secondary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3"
283:               >
284:                 Quay lại đăng nhập
285:               </button>
286:             </div>
287:           )}
288: 
289:           {state === 'VALID_TOKEN' && (
290:             <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
291:               <div>
292:                 <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1.5">
293:                   Mật khẩu mới
294:                 </label>
295:                 <div className="relative">
296:                   <input
297:                     type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
298:                     value={password}
299:                     onChange={(e) => handlePasswordChange(e.target.value)}
300:                     placeholder="Nhập mật khẩu mới"
301:                     className="modern-input pr-10 h-11 text-sm font-medium"
302:                   />
303:                   <button
304:                     type="button"
305:                     onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
306:                     aria-label={showPassword ? 'Ẩn mật khẩu' : 'Hiện mật khẩu'}
307:                     title={showPassword ? 'Ẩn mật khẩu' : 'Hiện mật khẩu'}
308:                     className="absolute right-3 top-3 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
309:                   >
310:                     {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
311:                   </button>
312:                 </div>
313:               </div>
314:               {passwordStrength > 0 && (
315:                 <div className="space-y-1.5">
316:                   <div className="flex gap-1">
317:                     {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((bar) => (
318:                       <div
319:                         key={bar}
320:                         className={`h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full ${bar <= passwordStrength ? (passwordStrength <= 2 ? 'bg-red-500' : passwordStrength <= 3 ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-emerald-500') : 'bg-slate-200'}`}
321:                       />
322:                     ))}
323:                   </div>
324:                   <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
325:                     Độ mạnh: {strengthLabels[passwordStrength - 1]}
326:                   </p>
327:                 </div>
328:               )}
329:               <div>
330:                 <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1.5">
331:                   Xác nhận mật khẩu
332:                 </label>
333:                 <div className="relative">
334:                   <input
335:                     type={showConfirm ? 'text' : 'password'}
336:                     value={passwordConfirm}
337:                     onChange={(e) => {
338:                       setPasswordConfirm(e.target.value);
339:                       setFieldErrors((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.field !== 'newPassword'));
340:                     }}
341:                     placeholder="Nhập lại mật khẩu"
342:                     className="modern-input pr-10 h-11 text-sm font-medium"
343:                   />
344:                   <button
345:                     type="button"
346:                     onClick={() => setShowConfirm(!showConfirm)}
347:                     aria-label={showConfirm ? 'Ẩn xác nhận mật khẩu' : 'Hiện xác nhận mật khẩu'}
348:                     title={showConfirm ? 'Ẩn xác nhận mật khẩu' : 'Hiện xác nhận mật khẩu'}
349:                     className="absolute right-3 top-3 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
350:                   >
351:                     {showConfirm ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
352:                   </button>
353:                 </div>
354:               </div>
355:               {fieldErrors.map((fe, i) => (
356:                 <div
357:                   key={i}
358:                   className="text-xs text-rose-600 font-semibold bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 animate-in fade-in"
359:                 >
360:                   {fe.message}
361:                 </div>
362:               ))}
363:               <button
364:                 type="submit"
365:                 disabled={!password || password.length < 8 || password !== passwordConfirm}
366:                 className="btn-primary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3 font-bold disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
367:               >
368:                 Đặt lại mật khẩu
369:               </button>
370:             </form>
371:           )}
372: 
373:           {state === 'LOADING' && (
374:             <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-8 space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
375:               <Loader2 className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-[#c23807] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
376:               <span className="text-sm text-slate-600 font-medium">Đang đặt lại mật khẩu...</span>
377:             </div>
378:           )}
379:           {state === 'SUCCESS' && (
380:             <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-4 space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
381:               <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 flex items-center justify-center">
382:                 <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-600" />
383:               </div>
384:               <div className="text-center space-y-1">
385:                 <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Đặt lại mật khẩu thành công</p>
386:                 <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Vui lòng đăng nhập lại với mật khẩu mới.</p>
387:               </div>
388:               <button
389:                 type="button"
390:                 onClick={handleBackToLogin}
391:                 className="btn-primary w-full justify-center text-sm py-3"
392:               >
393:                 Quay lại đăng nhập
394:               </button>
395:             </div>
396:           )}
397:         </div>
398:         <div className="text-center mt-6 text-xs text-slate-500">
399:           Nhớ mật khẩu?{' '}
400:           <button
401:             type="button"
402:             onClick={handleBackToLogin}
403:             className="text-[#c23807] font-bold hover:underline"
404:           >
405:             Quay lại đăng nhập
406:           </button>
407:         </div>
408:       </div>
409:     </div>
410:   );
411: };
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/forms/InviteUserModal.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import {
  5:   UserPlus,
  6:   X,
  7:   Loader2,
  8:   AlertCircle,
  9:   Mail,
 10:   Phone,
 11:   ShieldCheck,
 12:   MapPin,
 13:   Warehouse,
 14:   RefreshCw,
 15: } from 'lucide-react';
 16: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
 17: 
 18: interface Props {
 19:   isOpen: boolean;
 20:   onClose: () => void;
 21:   onUserInvited: (user: any) => void;
 22: }
 23: 
 24: const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 25: 
 26: export function parseScopeInput(input: string): string[] {
 27:   return input
 28:     .split(',')
 29:     .map((s) => s.trim())
 30:     .filter(Boolean);
 31: }
 32: 
 33: export function canRetryInviteSubmission(params: {
 34:   loading: boolean;
 35:   errorMsg: string | null;
 36: }): boolean {
 37:   return !params.loading && Boolean(params.errorMsg);
 38: }
 39: 
 40: export interface GrantableRoleOption {
 41:   value: 'OPS_CSKH' | 'WAREHOUSE' | 'ACCOUNTANT' | 'OWNER';
 42:   label: string;
 43: }
 44: 
 45: export const ALL_ROLES: GrantableRoleOption[] = [
 46:   { value: 'OPS_CSKH', label: 'CSKH / Vận Hành (Cứu đơn & xử lý sự cố)' },
 47:   { value: 'WAREHOUSE', label: 'Thủ Kho (Xuất nhập kho, quét hoàn)' },
 48:   { value: 'ACCOUNTANT', label: 'Kế Toán (Đối soát COD, ký nhận công nợ)' },
 49:   { value: 'OWNER', label: 'Chủ Cửa Hàng (Toàn quyền quản trị)' },
 50: ];
 51: 
 52: /**
 53:  * BR-INV-01 Privilege Ceiling helper: Returns only roles and scopes at or below actor's live role.
 54:  * Non-owners cannot grant roles they do not possess.
 55:  */
 56: export function getGrantableRoles(actorRole?: string | null): GrantableRoleOption[] {
 57:   if (actorRole === 'OWNER') {
 58:     return ALL_ROLES;
 59:   }
 60:   if (actorRole === 'OPS_CSKH') {
 61:     return [{ value: 'OPS_CSKH', label: 'CSKH / Vận Hành (Cứu đơn & xử lý sự cố)' }];
 62:   }
 63:   if (actorRole === 'WAREHOUSE') {
 64:     return [{ value: 'WAREHOUSE', label: 'Thủ Kho (Xuất nhập kho, quét hoàn)' }];
 65:   }
 66:   if (actorRole === 'ACCOUNTANT') {
 67:     return [{ value: 'ACCOUNTANT', label: 'Kế Toán (Đối soát COD, ký nhận công nợ)' }];
 68:   }
 69:   return [];
 70: }
 71: 
 72: export function validateInviteForm(params: {
 73:   channel: 'email' | 'phone';
 74:   email: string;
 75:   phone: string;
 76: }): { isValid: boolean; errors: Record<string, string> } {
 77:   const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
 78:   if (params.channel === 'email') {
 79:     if (!params.email.trim()) {
 80:       errors.email = 'Vui lòng nhập địa chỉ email';
 81:     } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(params.email.trim())) {
 82:       errors.email = 'Địa chỉ email không đúng định dạng';
 83:     }
 84:   } else {
 85:     if (!params.phone.trim()) {
 86:       errors.phone = 'Vui lòng nhập số điện thoại';
 87:     } else if (!/^(?:\+84|0)(?:3|5|7|8|9)\d{8}$/.test(params.phone.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, ''))) {
 88:       errors.phone = 'Số điện thoại không đúng định dạng Việt Nam';
 89:     }
 90:   }
 91:   return { isValid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0, errors };
 92: }

114:   const effectiveRole = grantableRoles.some((r) => r.value === role)
115:     ? role

117:

   1: 'use client';
   2: 
   3: import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
   4: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
   5: import {
   6:   ShieldCheck,
   7:   AlertTriangle,
   8:   AlertCircle,
   9:   Lock,
  10:   RefreshCw,
  11:   Trash2,
  12:   X,
  13:   Smartphone,
  14:   Monitor,
  15:   Tablet,
  16:   LogOut,
  17:   Clock,
  18:   Globe,
  19:   Radio,
  20:   Loader2,
  21: } from 'lucide-react';
  22: 
  23: export interface SessionItem {
  24:   session_id: string;
  25:   device_id: string;
  26:   device_model: string | null;
  27:   user_agent: string | null;
  28:   ip_address: string | null;
  29:   status: 'ACTIVE' | 'REVOKED' | 'EXPIRED' | 'INACTIVE';
  30:   last_active_at: string;
  31:   expires_at: string;
  32:   created_at: string;
  33:   is_current: boolean;
  34: }
  35: 
  36: export interface SessionsTabProps {
  37:   onToast?: (msg: string) => void;
  38:   initialSessions?: SessionItem[];
  39:   initialState?:
  40:     'loading' | 'empty' | 'error' | 'forbidden' | 'unauthenticated' | 'validation' | 'success';
  41:   initialErrorMessage?: string;
  42:   initialValidationMessage?: string;
  43:   initialRevokingId?: string | null;
  44:   initialRevokeAllOpen?: boolean;
  45:   initialRevokeAllLoading?: boolean;
  46:   initialIsFetching?: boolean;
  47:   apiUrl?: string;
  48:   authToken?: string;
  49: }
  50: 
  51: function getDeviceIcon(deviceModel: string | null, userAgent: string | null) {
  52:   const text = `${deviceModel || ''} ${userAgent || ''}`.toLowerCase();
  53:   if (text.includes('ipad') || text.includes('tablet')) {
  54:     return <Tablet className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />;
  55:   }
  56:   if (
  57:     text.includes('iphone') ||
  58:     text.includes('android') ||
  59:     text.includes('mobile') ||
  60:     text.includes('phone')
  61:   ) {
  62:     return <Smartphone className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />;
  63:   }
  64:   return <Monitor className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-700" />;
  65: }
  66: 
  67: function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  68:   try {
  69:     const d = new Date(iso);
  70:     if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  71:     return d.toLocaleString('vi-VN', {
  72:       hour: '2-digit',
  73:       minute: '2-digit',
  74:       day: '2-digit',
  75:       month: '2-digit',
  76:       year: 'numeric',
  77:     });
  78:   } catch {
  79:     return iso;
  80:   }
  81: }
  82: 
  83: export function formatDisplayIp(ip: string | undefined | null): string | null {
  84:   if (!ip) return null;
  85:   // If it's a 64-character hex hash, omit from user display to avoid confusion and PII disclosure (Finding 2 / Finding 9)
  86:   if (/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(ip.trim())) {
  87:     return null;
  88:   }
  89:   return ip;
  90: }
  91: 
  92: export async function executeFetchSessions(options: {
  93:   baseUrl: string;
  94:   token?: string | null;
  95:   sessions?: SessionItem[];
  96:   isFetching?: boolean;
  97:   isFetchingRef?: React.MutableRefObject<boolean> | { current: boolean };
  98:   setFetchState: (
  99:     state: 'loading' | 'error' | 'forbidden' | 'unauthenticated' | 'validation' | 'success'
 100:   ) => void;
 101:   setSessions: (sessions: SessionItem[]) => void;
 102:   setErrorMessage: (msg: string | null) => void;
 103:   setValidationMessage: (msg: string | null) => void;
 104:   setActionError: (msg: string | null) => void;
 105:   setIsFetching: (fetching: boolean) => void;
 106: }): Promise<{ executed: boolean; locked?: boolean; success?: boolean; error?: string }> {
 107:   const isFetchingNow = Boolean(options.isFetching) || Boolean(options.isFetchingRef?.current);
 108:   if (isFetchingNow) {
 109:     return { executed: false, locked: true };
 110:   }
 111:   if (options.isFetchingRef) {
 112:     options.isFetchingRef.current = true;
 113:   }
 114:   const currentSessions = options.sessions ?? [];
 115:   if (!options.token) {
 116:     if (currentSessions.length === 0) {
 117:       options.setErrorMessage('Vui lòng đăng nhập để tiếp tục.');
 118:       options.setFetchState('unauthenticated');
 119:     } else {
 120:       options.setActionError('Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.');
 121:     }
 122:     if (options.isFetchingRef) {
 123:       options.isFetchingRef.current = false;
 124:     }
 125:     return { executed: true, success: false, error: 'UNAUTHENTICATED' };
 126:   }
 127: 
 128:   try {
 129:     options.setIsFetching(true);
 130:     if (currentSessions.length === 0) {
 131:       options.setFetchState('loading');
 132:     }
 133:     options.setErrorMessage(null);
 134:     options.setValidationMessage(null);
 135:     options.setActionError(null);
 136: 
 137:     const res = await fetch(`${options.baseUrl}/api/v1/sessions`, {
 138:       headers: {
 139:         Authorization: `Bearer ${options.token}`,
 140:         Accept: 'application/json',
 141:       },
 142:     });
 143: 
 144:     if (res.status === 401) {
 145:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 146:       const errCode = errJson?.error?.code || 'UNAUTHENTICATED';
 147:       const errMsg =
 148:         errJson?.error?.message ||
 149:         (errCode === 'SESSION_INVALID'
 150:           ? 'Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn hoặc không hợp lệ. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.'
 151:           : 'Vui lòng đăng nhập để tiếp tục.');
 152: 
 153:       if (currentSessions.length === 0) {
 154:         options.setErrorMessage(errMsg);
 155:         options.setFetchState('unauthenticated');
 156:       } else {
 157:         options.setActionError(errMsg);
 158:       }
 159:       return { executed: true, success: false, error: errCode };
 160:     }
 161: 
 162:     if (res.status === 403) {
 163:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 164:       const errMsg =
 165:         errJson?.error?.message || 'Không có quyền truy cập vào danh sách phiên làm việc.';
 166: 
 167:       if (currentSessions.length === 0) {
 168:         options.setErrorMessage(errMsg);
 169:         options.setFetchState('forbidden');
 170:       } else {
 171:         options.setActionError('Không có quyền truy cập (403 FORBIDDEN).');
 172:       }
 173:       return { executed: true, success: false, error: 'FORBIDDEN' };
 174:     }
 175: 
 176:     if (!res.ok) {
 177:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 178:       if (errJson?.error?.code === 'VALIDATION_ERROR') {
 179:         options.setValidationMessage(errJson.error.message || 'Lỗi kiểm tra dữ liệu');
 180:         options.setFetchState('validation');
 181:         return { executed: true, success: false, error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR' };
 182:       }
 183:       throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể tải danh sách phiên đăng nhập');
 184:     }
 185: 
 186:     const data = await res.json();
 187:     options.setSessions(data.data || []);
 188:     options.setFetchState('success');
 189:     return { executed: true, success: true };
 190:   } catch (err: any) {
 191:     options.setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Đã xảy ra lỗi khi tải danh sách phiên làm việc.');
 192:     options.setFetchState('error');
 193:     return { executed: true, success: false, error: err?.message };
 194:   } finally {
 195:     if (options.isFetchingRef) {
 196:       options.isFetchingRef.current = false;
 197:     }
 198:     options.setIsFetching(false);
 199:   }
 200: }
 201: 
 202: export async function executeRevokeSession(options: {
 203:   sessionId: string;
 204:   baseUrl: string;
 205:   token?: string | null;
 206:   revokingId: string | null;
 207:   revokingIdRef?: React.MutableRefObject<string | null> | { current: string | null };
 208:   revokeAllLoading: boolean;
 209:   revokeAllLoadingRef?: React.MutableRefObject<boolean> | { current: boolean };
 210:   isFetching: boolean;
 211:   isFetchingRef?: React.MutableRefObject<boolean> | { current: boolean };
 212:   fetchState?: 'loading' | 'error' | 'forbidden' | 'unauthenticated' | 'validation' | 'success';
 213:   setRevokingId: (id: string | null) => void;
 214:   setActionError: (msg: string | null) => void;
 215:   setValidationMessage: (msg: string | null) => void;
 216:   setSessions: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<SessionItem[]>>;
 217:   onToast?: (msg: string) => void;
 218: }): Promise<{ executed: boolean; locked?: boolean; success?: boolean; message?: string }> {
 219:   const isRevokingLocked = options.revokingIdRef
 220:     ? Boolean(options.revokingIdRef.current)
 221:     : Boolean(options.revokingId);
 222:   const isRevokeAllLocked = options.revokeAllLoadingRef
 223:     ? Boolean(options.revokeAllLoadingRef.current)
 224:     : Boolean(options.revokeAllLoading);
 225:   const isFetchLocked = options.isFetchingRef
 226:     ? Boolean(options.isFetchingRef.current)
 227:     : Boolean(options.isFetching);
 228: 
 229:   if (isRevokingLocked || isRevokeAllLocked || isFetchLocked || options.fetchState === 'loading') {
 230:     return { executed: false, locked: true };
 231:   }
 232:   if (options.revokingIdRef) {
 233:     options.revokingIdRef.current = options.sessionId;
 234:   }
 235:   options.setRevokingId(options.sessionId);
 236:   options.setActionError(null);
 237: 
 238:   try {
 239:     const res = await fetch(`${options.baseUrl}/api/v1/sessions/${options.sessionId}`, {
 240:       method: 'DELETE',
 241:       headers: {
 242:         Authorization: `Bearer ${options.token}`,
 243:         Accept: 'application/json',
 244:       },
 245:     });
 246: 
 247:     if (res.status === 401) {
 248:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 249:       const errMsg =
 250:         errJson?.error?.message || 'Phiên làm việc đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.';
 251:       options.setActionError(errMsg);
 252:       options.onToast?.('Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn');
 253:       return { executed: true, success: false, message: errMsg };
 254:     }
 255: 
 256:     if (res.status === 403) {
 257:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 258:       const errMsg =
 259:         errJson?.error?.message || 'Không có quyền thu hồi phiên làm việc này (403 FORBIDDEN).';
 260:       options.setActionError(errMsg);
 261:       options.onToast?.('Không có quyền thu hồi phiên làm việc');
 262:       return { executed: true, success: false, message: errMsg };
 263:     }
 264: 
 265:     const resData = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 266: 
 267:     if (!res.ok) {
 268:       if (
 269:         resData?.error?.code === 'VALIDATION_ERROR' ||
 270:         resData?.error?.code === 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND'
 271:       ) {
 272:         options.setValidationMessage(resData?.error?.message || 'Không tìm thấy phiên làm việc');
 273:       }
 274:       throw new Error(resData?.error?.message || 'Thu hồi phiên thất bại');
 275:     }
 276: 
 277:     options.setSessions((prev) =>
 278:       prev.map((s) => (s.session_id === options.sessionId ? { ...s, status: 'REVOKED' } : s))
 279:     );
 280:     const successMsg = resData?.message || 'Đã thu hồi 1 phiên làm việc';
 281:     options.onToast?.(successMsg);
 282:     return { executed: true, success: true, message: successMsg };
 283:   } catch (err: any) {
 284:     const errMsg = err?.message || 'Lỗi hệ thống khi thu hồi phiên. Vui lòng thử lại.';
 285:     options.setActionError(errMsg);
 286:     options.onToast?.(err?.message || 'Lỗi khi thu hồi phiên');
 287:     return { executed: true, success: false, message: errMsg };
 288:   } finally {
 289:     if (options.revokingIdRef) {
 290:       options.revokingIdRef.current = null;
 291:     }
 292:     options.setRevokingId(null);
 293:   }
 294: }
 295: 
 296: export async function executeRevokeAll(options: {
 297:   baseUrl: string;
 298:   token?: string | null;
 299:   includeCurrent: boolean;
 300:   revokeAllLoading: boolean;
 301:   revokeAllLoadingRef?: React.MutableRefObject<boolean> | { current: boolean };
 302:   revokingId: string | null;
 303:   revokingIdRef?: React.MutableRefObject<string | null> | { current: string | null };
 304:   isFetching: boolean;
 305:   isFetchingRef?: React.MutableRefObject<boolean> | { current: boolean };
 306:   fetchState?: 'loading' | 'error' | 'forbidden' | 'unauthenticated' | 'validation' | 'success';
 307:   setRevokeAllLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
 308:   setActionError: (msg: string | null) => void;
 309:   setSessions: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<SessionItem[]>>;
 310:   setFetchState: (
 311:     state: 'loading' | 'error' | 'forbidden' | 'unauthenticated' | 'validation' | 'success'
 312:   ) => void;
 313:   setRevokeAllOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
 314:   onToast?: (msg: string) => void;
 315: }): Promise<{
 316:   executed: boolean;
 317:   locked?: boolean;
 318:   success?: boolean;
 319:   revokedCount?: number;
 320:   message?: string;
 321: }> {
 322:   const isRevokeAllLocked = options.revokeAllLoadingRef
 323:     ? Boolean(options.revokeAllLoadingRef.current)
 324:     : Boolean(options.revokeAllLoading);
 325:   const isRevokingLocked = options.revokingIdRef
 326:     ? Boolean(options.revokingIdRef.current)
 327:     : Boolean(options.revokingId);
 328:   const isFetchLocked = options.isFetchingRef
 329:     ? Boolean(options.isFetchingRef.current)
 330:     : Boolean(options.isFetching);
 331: 
 332:   if (isRevokeAllLocked || isRevokingLocked || isFetchLocked || options.fetchState === 'loading') {
 333:     return { executed: false, locked: true };
 334:   }
 335:   if (options.revokeAllLoadingRef) {
 336:     options.revokeAllLoadingRef.current = true;
 337:   }
 338:   options.setRevokeAllLoading(true);
 339:   options.setActionError(null);
 340: 
 341:   try {
 342:     const res = await fetch(`${options.baseUrl}/api/v1/sessions/revoke-all`, {
 343:       method: 'POST',
 344:       headers: {
 345:         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 346:         Authorization: `Bearer ${options.token}`,
 347:         Accept: 'application/json',
 348:       },
 349:       body: JSON.stringify({ include_current: options.includeCurrent }),
 350:     });
 351: 
 352:     if (res.status === 401) {
 353:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 354:       const errMsg =
 355:         errJson?.error?.message || 'Phiên làm việc đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.';
 356:       options.setActionError(errMsg);
 357:       options.onToast?.('Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn');
 358:       return { executed: true, success: false, message: errMsg };
 359:     }
 360: 
 361:     if (res.status === 403) {
 362:       const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 363:       const errMsg =
 364:         errJson?.error?.message || 'Không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này (403 FORBIDDEN).';
 365:       options.setActionError(errMsg);
 366:       options.onToast?.('Không có quyền thu hồi tất cả phiên');
 367:       return { executed: true, success: false, message: errMsg };
 368:     }
 369: 
 370:     const resData = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 371: 
 372:     if (!res.ok) {
 373:       throw new Error(resData?.error?.message || 'Thu hồi tất cả phiên thất bại');
 374:     }
 375: 
 376:     const count = resData?.revoked_count ?? 0;
 377:     const msg =
 378:       resData?.message ||
 379:       (count === 0 ? 'Không có phiên nào cần thu hồi' : `Đã thu hồi ${count} phiên làm việc`);
 380:     options.onToast?.(msg);
 381: 
 382:     if (count > 0) {
 383:       if (options.includeCurrent) {
 384:         options.setSessions(() => []);
 385:         options.setFetchState('unauthenticated');
 386:       } else {
 387:         options.setSessions((prev) =>
 388:           prev.map((s) => {
 389:             if (!s.is_current && s.status === 'ACTIVE') {
 390:               return { ...s, status: 'REVOKED' };
 391:             }
 392:             return s;
 393:           })
 394:         );
 395:       }
 396:     }
 397:     options.setRevokeAllOpen(false);
 398:     return { executed: true, success: true, revokedCount: count, message: msg };
 399:   } catch (err: any) {
 400:     const errMsg = err?.message || 'Lỗi hệ thống khi thu hồi tất cả phiên. Vui lòng thử lại.';
 401:     options.setActionError(errMsg);
 402:     options.onToast?.(err?.message || 'Lỗi khi thu hồi tất cả phiên');
 403:     return { executed: true, success: false, message: errMsg };
 404:   } finally {
 405:     if (options.revokeAllLoadingRef) {
 406:       options.revokeAllLoadingRef.current = false;
 407:     }
 408:     options.setRevokeAllLoading(false);
 409:   }
 410: }
 411: 
 412: export function createSessionHandlers(options: {
 413:   baseUrl: string;
 414:   token?: string | null;
 415:   includeCurrent?: boolean;
 416:   revokeAllIncludeCurrent?: boolean;
 417:   revokingId?: string | null;
 418:   revokingIdRef: React.MutableRefObject<string | null> | { current: string | null };
 419:   revokeAllLoading?: boolean;
 420:   revokeAllLoadingRef: React.MutableRefObject<boolean> | { current: boolean };
 421:   isFetching?: boolean;
 422:   isFetchingRef: React.MutableRefObject<boolean> | { current: boolean };
 423:   fetchState?: 'loading' | 'error' | 'forbidden' | 'unauthenticated' | 'validation' | 'success';
 424:   setRevokingId: (id: string | null) => void;
 425:   setRevokeAllLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
 426:   setActionError: (msg: string | null) => void;
 427:   setValidationMessage: (msg: string | null) => void;
 428:   setSessions: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<SessionItem[]>>;
 429:   setFetchState: (
 430:     state: 'loading' | 'error' | 'forbidden' | 'unauthenticated' | 'validation' | 'success'
 431:   ) => void;
 432:   setRevokeAllOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
 433:   onToast?: (msg: string) => void;
 434: }) {
 435:   const handleRevoke = async (sessionId: string) => {
 436:     return await executeRevokeSession({
 437:       sessionId,
 438:       baseUrl: options.baseUrl,
 439:       token: options.token,
 440:       revokingId: options.revokingId ?? options.revokingIdRef.current,
 441:       revokingIdRef: options.revokingIdRef,
 442:       revokeAllLoading: options.revokeAllLoading ?? options.revokeAllLoadingRef.current,
 443:       revokeAllLoadingRef: options.revokeAllLoadingRef,
 444:       isFetching: options.isFetching ?? options.isFetchingRef.current,
 445:       isFetchingRef: options.isFetchingRef,
 446:       fetchState: options.fetchState,
 447:       setRevokingId: options.setRevokingId,
 448:       setActionError: options.setActionError,
 449:       setValidationMessage: options.setValidationMessage,
 450:       setSessions: options.setSessions,
 451:       onToast: options.onToast,
 452:     });
 453:   };
 454: 
 455:   const handleRevokeAll = async () => {
 456:     return await executeRevokeAll({
 457:       baseUrl: options.baseUrl,
 458:       token: options.token,
 459:       includeCurrent: options.includeCurrent ?? options.revokeAllIncludeCurrent ?? false,
 460:       revokeAllLoading: options.revokeAllLoading ?? options.revokeAllLoadingRef.current,
 461:       revokeAllLoadingRef: options.revokeAllLoadingRef,
 462:       revokingId: options.revokingId ?? options.revokingIdRef.current,
 463:       revokingIdRef: options.revokingIdRef,
 464:       isFetching: options.isFetching ?? options.isFetchingRef.current,
 465:       isFetchingRef: options.isFetchingRef,
 466:       fetchState: options.fetchState,
 467:       setRevokeAllLoading: options.setRevokeAllLoading,
 468:       setActionError: options.setActionError,
 469:       setSessions: options.setSessions,
 470:       setFetchState: options.setFetchState,
 471:       setRevokeAllOpen: options.setRevokeAllOpen,
 472:       onToast: options.onToast,
 473:     });
 474:   };
 475: 
 476:   return { handleRevoke, handleRevokeAll };
 477: }

 479: export function SessionsTab({
 480:   onToast,
 481:   initialSessions,
 482:   initialState,
 483:   initialErrorMessage,
 484:   initialValidationMessage,
 485:   initialRevokingId,
 486:   initialRevokeAllOpen,
 487:   initialRevokeAllLoading,
 488:   initialIsFetching,
 489:   apiUrl,
 490:   authToken,
 491: }: SessionsTabProps) {
 492:   const { token: contextToken } = useAuth();
 493:   const token = authToken !== undefined ? authToken : contextToken;
 494: 
 495:   const [fetchState, setFetchState] = useState<
 496:     'loading' | 'error' | 'forbidden' | 'unauthenticated' | 'validation' | 'success'
 497:   >(initialState === 'empty' ? 'success' : (initialState ?? 'loading'));
 498:   const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<SessionItem[]>(initialSessions ?? []);
 499:   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(initialErrorMessage ?? null);
 500:   const [validationMessage, setValidationMessage] = useState<string | null>(
 501:     initialValidationMessage ?? null
 502:   );
 503: 
 504:   const [isFetching, setIsFetching] = useState(initialIsFetching ?? false);
 505:   const isFetchingRef = useRef(initialIsFetching ?? false);
 506:   const sessionsRef = useRef(sessions);
 507:   useEffect(() => {
 508:     sessionsRef.current = sessions;
 509:   }, [sessions]);
 510: 
 511:   const [revokingId, setRevokingId] = useState<string | null>(initialRevokingId ?? null);
 512:   const revokingIdRef = useRef<string | null>(initialRevokingId ?? null);
 513:   const [revokeAllOpen, setRevokeAllOpen] = useState(initialRevokeAllOpen ?? false);
 514:   const [revokeAllLoading, setRevokeAllLoading] = useState(initialRevokeAllLoading ?? false);
 515:   const revokeAllLoadingRef = useRef<boolean>(initialRevokeAllLoading ?? false);
 516:   const [revokeAllIncludeCurrent, setRevokeAllIncludeCurrent] = useState(false);
 517:   const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 518: 
 519:   useEffect(() => {
 520:     revokingIdRef.current = revokingId;
 521:   }, [revokingId]);
 522:   useEffect(() => {
 523:     revokeAllLoadingRef.current = revokeAllLoading;
 524:   }, [revokeAllLoading]);
 525:   useEffect(() => {
 526:     isFetchingRef.current = isFetching;
 527:   }, [isFetching]);
 528: 
 529:   const baseUrl = apiUrl || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 530: 
 531:   const fetchSessions = useCallback(async () => {
 532:     if (isFetchingRef.current) return;
 533:     await executeFetchSessions({
 534:       baseUrl,
 535:       token,
 536:       sessions: sessionsRef.current,
 537:       isFetching: isFetchingRef.current,
 538:       isFetchingRef,
 539:       setFetchState,
 540:       setSessions,
 541:       setErrorMessage,
 542:       setValidationMessage,
 543:       setActionError,
 544:       setIsFetching,
 545:     });
 546:   }, [baseUrl, token]);
 547: 
 548:   useEffect(() => {
 549:     if (!initialSessions && !initialState) {
 550:       void fetchSessions();
 551:     }
 552:   }, [fetchSessions, initialSessions, initialState]);
 553: 
 554:   const handleRevoke = async (sessionId: string) => {
 555:     return await executeRevokeSession({
 556:       sessionId,
 557:       baseUrl,
 558:       token,
 559:       revokingId,
 560:       revokingIdRef,
 561:       revokeAllLoading,
 562:       revokeAllLoadingRef,
 563:       isFetching,
 564:       isFetchingRef,
 565:       fetchState,
 566:       setRevokingId,
 567:       setActionError,
 568:       setValidationMessage,
 569:       setSessions,
 570:       onToast,
 571:     });
 572:   };
 573: 
 574:   const handleRevokeAll = async () => {
 575:     return await executeRevokeAll({
 576:       baseUrl,
 577:       token,
 578:       includeCurrent: revokeAllIncludeCurrent,
 579:       revokeAllLoading,
 580:       revokeAllLoadingRef,
 581:       revokingId,
 582:       revokingIdRef,
 583:       isFetching,
 584:       isFetchingRef,
 585:       fetchState,
 586:       setRevokeAllLoading,
 587:       setActionError,
 588:       setSessions,
 589:       setFetchState,
 590:       setRevokeAllOpen,
 591:       onToast,
 592:     });
 593:   };
 594: 
 595:   // Derive current and remote sessions
 596:   const currentSession = sessions.find((s) => s.is_current);
 597:   const remoteActiveSessions = sessions.filter((s) => !s.is_current && s.status === 'ACTIVE');
 598:   const remoteRevokedSessions = sessions.filter((s) => !s.is_current && s.status !== 'ACTIVE');
 599: 
 600:   // Loading skeleton component
 601:   const renderLoadingSkeleton = () => (
 602:     <div
 603:       role="status"
 604:       aria-label="Đang tải danh sách thiết bị"
 605:       aria-busy="true"
 606:       data-testid="sessions-loading-skeleton"
 607:       className="space-y-4"
 608:     >
 609:       <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-xs animate-pulse">
 610:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 611:           <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
 612:             <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-200" />
 613:             <div className="space-y-2">
 614:               <div className="w-48 h-4 rounded bg-slate-200" />
 615:               <div className="w-72 h-3 rounded bg-slate-200" />
 616:             </div>
 617:           </div>
 618:           <div className="w-24 h-6 rounded-full bg-slate-200" />
 619:         </div>
 620:       </div>
 621:       <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-xs animate-pulse">
 622:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 623:           <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
 624:             <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-200" />
 625:             <div className="space-y-2">
 626:               <div className="w-40 h-4 rounded bg-slate-200" />
 627:               <div className="w-64 h-3 rounded bg-slate-200" />
 628:             </div>
 629:           </div>
 630:           <button
 631:             type="button"
 632:             disabled
 633:             className="w-20 h-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-200 opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed"
 634:           />
 635:         </div>
 636:       </div>
 637:     </div>
 638:   );
 639: 
 640:   return (
 641:     <div className="space-y-6" data-testid="sessions-manager">
 642:       {/* Header bar */}
 643:       <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 pb-5">
 644:         <div>
 645:           <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
 646:             <Radio className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600" />
 647:             Quản Lý Phiên Đăng Nhập & Thiết Bị
 648:           </h2>
 649:           <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
 650:             Kiểm soát các phiên truy cập trên máy tính, điện thoại và thu hồi phiên từ xa an toàn.
 651:           </p>
 652:         </div>
 653: 
 654:         {remoteActiveSessions.length > 0 && (
 655:           <button
 656:             type="button"
 657:             data-testid="revoke-all-button"
 658:             disabled={
 659:               fetchState === 'loading' || isFetching || revokeAllLoading || revokingId !== null
 660:             }
 661:             onClick={() => setRevokeAllOpen(true)}
 662:             className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 active:bg-red-800 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors shadow-xs"
 663:           >
 664:             <LogOut className="w-4 h-4" />
 665:             Đăng xuất thiết bị khác ({remoteActiveSessions.length})
 666:           </button>
 667:         )}
 668:       </div>
 669: 
 670:       {/* Action / Recovery Error Banner */}
 671:       {actionError && (
 672:         <div
 673:           role="alert"
 674:           data-testid="action-error-alert"
 675:           className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-xs"
 676:         >
 677:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs font-medium">
 678:             <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 shrink-0" />
 679:             <span>{actionError}</span>
 680:           </div>
 681:           <button
 682:             type="button"
 683:             onClick={() => setActionError(null)}
 684:             className="text-xs text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 font-medium underline"
 685:           >
 686:             Đóng
 687:           </button>
 688:         </div>
 689:       )}
 690: 
 691:       {/* Validation Banner */}
 692:       {validationMessage && (
 693:         <div
 694:           role="alert"
 695:           data-testid="validation-alert"
 696:           className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4 text-amber-800 flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs font-medium shadow-xs"
 697:         >
 698:           <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
 699:           <span>{validationMessage}</span>
 700:         </div>
 701:       )}
 702: 
 703:       {/* Forbidden State */}
 704:       {fetchState === 'forbidden' && (
 705:         <div
 706:           role="alert"
 707:           data-testid="forbidden-alert"
 708:           className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-6 text-center text-amber-800 space-y-2 shadow-xs"
 709:         >
 710:           <Lock className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-600 mx-auto" />
 711:           <h3 className="text-sm font-bold">Không có quyền truy cập</h3>
 712:           <p className="text-xs text-amber-700">
 713:             {errorMessage ||
 714:               'Phiên đăng nhập của bạn không có quyền truy cập hoặc quyền đã bị từ chối.'}
 715:           </p>
 716:         </div>
 717:       )}
 718: 
 719:       {/* Unauthenticated / Login Recovery State (AC-SESS-06, AC-SESS-19) */}
 720:       {fetchState === 'unauthenticated' && (
 721:         <div
 722:           role="alert"
 723:           data-testid="unauthenticated-alert"
 724:           className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-6 text-center text-amber-800 space-y-3 shadow-xs"
 725:         >
 726:           <Lock className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-600 mx-auto" />
 727:           <h3 className="text-sm font-bold">Phiên đăng nhập hết hạn hoặc không hợp lệ</h3>
 728:           <p className="text-xs text-amber-700">
 729:             {errorMessage ||
 730:               'Phiên làm việc của bạn đã hết hạn hoặc chưa được xác thực. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.'}
 731:           </p>
 732:           <a
 733:             href="/auth/login"
 734:             data-testid="login-recovery-button"
 735:             className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-600 text-white hover:bg-amber-700 active:bg-amber-800 transition-colors shadow-xs"
 736:           >
 737:             Đăng nhập lại
 738:           </a>
 739:         </div>
 740:       )}
 741: 
 742:       {/* Error State with Recovery Button */}
 743:       {fetchState === 'error' && (
 744:         <div
 745:           role="alert"
 746:           data-testid="error-alert"
 747:           className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-5 text-red-800 space-y-3 shadow-xs"
 748:         >
 749:           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
 750:             <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 shrink-0" />
 751:             <p className="text-xs font-medium">
 752:               {errorMessage || 'Đã xảy ra lỗi khi tải danh sách phiên làm việc.'}
 753:             </p>
 754:           </div>
 755:           <button
 756:             type="button"
 757:             data-testid="retry-fetch-button"
 758:             disabled={isFetching}
 759:             onClick={() => void fetchSessions()}
 760:             className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-red-100 hover:bg-red-200 text-red-800 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
 761:           >
 762:             {isFetching ? (
 763:               <>
 764:                 <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
 765:                 <span>Đang thử lại...</span>
 766:               </>
 767:             ) : (
 768:               <>
 769:                 <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
 770:                 <span>Thử lại</span>
 771:               </>
 772:             )}
 773:           </button>
 774:         </div>
 775:       )}
 776: 
 777:       {/* Loading state - only show full skeleton on initial empty load */}
 778:       {fetchState === 'loading' && sessions.length === 0 && renderLoadingSkeleton()}
 779: 
 780:       {/* Loaded sessions view - never blanked during retry or error if sessions exist */}
 781:       {(sessions.length > 0 ||
 782:         (fetchState !== 'loading' &&
 783:           fetchState !== 'forbidden' &&
 784:           fetchState !== 'unauthenticated')) && (
 785:         <div className="space-y-6">
 786:           {/* Section 1: Current Active Device */}
 787:           <div className="space-y-3">
 788:             <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
 789:               Thiết Bị Hiện Tại
 790:             </h3>
 791:             {currentSession ? (
 792:               <div
 793:                 data-testid="current-session-card"
 794:                 className="rounded-xl border-2 border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-50/20 p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 shadow-xs"
 795:               >
 796:                 <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3.5">
 797:                   <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
 798:                     {getDeviceIcon(currentSession.device_model, currentSession.user_agent)}
 799:                   </div>
 800:                   <div className="space-y-1">
 801:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 802:                       <strong className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
 803:                         {currentSession.device_model ||
 804:                           currentSession.device_id ||
 805:                           'Trình duyệt hiện tại'}
 806:                       </strong>
 807:                       <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200">
 808:                         <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" />
 809:                         Thiết bị này
 810:                       </span>
 811:                     </div>
 812:                     <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
 813:                       {formatDisplayIp(currentSession.ip_address) && (
 814:                         <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
 815:                           <Globe className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
 816:                           IP: {formatDisplayIp(currentSession.ip_address)}
 817:                         </span>
 818:                       )}
 819:                       <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
 820:                         <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
 821:                         Hoạt động: {formatDate(currentSession.last_active_at)}
 822:                       </span>
 823:                     </div>
 824:                   </div>
 825:                 </div>
 826:               </div>
 827:             ) : (
 828:               <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 italic p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white">
 829:                 Chưa xác định thiết bị hiện tại
 830:               </div>
 831:             )}
 832:           </div>
 833: 
 834:           {/* Section 2: Remote Devices */}
 835:           <div className="space-y-3">
 836:             <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
 837:               Các Thiết Bị Khác ({remoteActiveSessions.length})
 838:             </h3>
 839: 
 840:             {/* Empty Remote Sessions State (AC-SESS-03) */}
 841:             {remoteActiveSessions.length === 0 ? (
 842:               <div
 843:                 data-testid="empty-remote-sessions"
 844:                 className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 p-8 text-center space-y-1.5"
 845:               >
 846:                 <ShieldCheck className="mx-auto h-8 w-8 text-emerald-500 mb-1" />
 847:                 <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
 848:                   Không có thiết bị đăng nhập nào khác
 849:                 </h4>
 850:                 <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-sm mx-auto">
 851:                   Tài khoản của bạn hiện chỉ đang hoạt động trên thiết bị này. Khi bạn đăng nhập từ
 852:                   điện thoại hoặc máy khác, phiên sẽ xuất hiện tại đây.
 853:                 </p>
 854:               </div>
 855:             ) : (
 856:               <div className="space-y-3" data-testid="remote-sessions-list">
 857:                 {remoteActiveSessions.map((session) => (
 858:                   <div
 859:                     key={session.session_id}
 860:                     data-testid={`session-card-${session.session_id}`}
 861:                     className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 shadow-xs hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors"
 862:                   >
 863:                     <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3.5">
 864:                       <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
 865:                         {getDeviceIcon(session.device_model, session.user_agent)}
 866:                       </div>
 867:                       <div className="space-y-1">
 868:                         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 869:                           <strong className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
 870:                             {session.device_model || session.device_id}
 871:                           </strong>
 872:                           <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200">
 873:                             Đang hoạt động
 874:                           </span>
 875:                         </div>
 876:                         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
 877:                           {formatDisplayIp(session.ip_address) && (
 878:                             <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[10px]">
 879:                               <Globe className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
 880:                               {formatDisplayIp(session.ip_address)}
 881:                             </span>
 882:                           )}
 883:                           <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
 884:                             <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
 885:                             Gần nhất: {formatDate(session.last_active_at)}
 886:                           </span>
 887:                           {session.user_agent && (
 888:                             <span
 889:                               className="text-slate-400 max-w-[200px] truncate"
 890:                               title={session.user_agent}
 891:                             >
 892:                               {session.user_agent}
 893:                             </span>
 894:                           )}
 895:                         </div>
 896:                       </div>
 897:                     </div>
 898: 
 899:                     <button
 900:                       type="button"
 901:                       data-testid={`revoke-btn-${session.session_id}`}
 902:                       disabled={
 903:                         revokingId !== null ||
 904:                         revokeAllLoading ||
 905:                         isFetching ||
 906:                         fetchState === 'loading'
 907:                       }
 908:                       onClick={() => handleRevoke(session.session_id)}
 909:                       className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold border border-red-200 bg-red-50/50 text-red-700 hover:bg-red-100 active:bg-red-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors self-end sm:self-center"
 910:                     >
 911:                       {revokingId === session.session_id ? (
 912:                         <>
 913:                           <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-red-600" />
 914:                           <span>Đang thu hồi...</span>
 915:                         </>
 916:                       ) : (
 917:                         <>
 918:                           <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-600" />
 919:                           <span>Thu hồi</span>
 920:                         </>
 921:                       )}
 922:                     </button>
 923:                   </div>
 924:                 ))}
 925:               </div>
 926:             )}
 927: 
 928:             {/* Previously Revoked History (if any) */}
 929:             {remoteRevokedSessions.length > 0 && (
 930:               <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
 931:                 <details className="text-xs text-slate-500">
 932:                   <summary className="cursor-pointer font-medium hover:text-slate-700">
 933:                     Phiên đã hết hạn hoặc thu hồi trước đó ({remoteRevokedSessions.length})
 934:                   </summary>
 935:                   <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
 936:                     {remoteRevokedSessions.map((s) => (
 937:                       <div
 938:                         key={s.session_id}
 939:                         className="rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 p-3 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400"
 940:                       >
 941:                         <div>
 942:                           <span>{s.device_model || s.device_id}</span>
 943:                           <span className="ml-2 font-mono">{formatDate(s.last_active_at)}</span>
 944:                         </div>
 945:                         <span className="font-semibold text-slate-500">{s.status}</span>
 946:                       </div>
 947:                     ))}
 948:                   </div>
 949:                 </details>
 950:               </div>
 951:             )}
 952:           </div>
 953:         </div>
 954:       )}
 955: 
 956:       {/* Revoke All Confirmation Modal */}
 957:       {revokeAllOpen && (
 958:         <div
 959:           role="dialog"
 960:           aria-modal="true"
 961:           aria-labelledby="revoke-all-modal-title"
 962:           data-testid="revoke-all-dialog"
 963:           className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xs p-4"
 964:         >
 965:           <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-xl border border-slate-200 space-y-5 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
 966:             <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
 967:               <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
 968:                 <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-red-100 text-red-600 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
 969:                   <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />
 970:                 </div>
 971:                 <div>
 972:                   <h3 id="revoke-all-modal-title" className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
 973:                     Đăng xuất các thiết bị khác
 974:                   </h3>
 975:                   <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
 976:                     Hành động này sẽ thu hồi quyền truy cập ngay lập tức.
 977:                   </p>
 978:                 </div>
 979:               </div>
 980:               <button
 981:                 type="button"
 982:                 onClick={() => setRevokeAllOpen(false)}
 983:                 disabled={revokeAllLoading}
 984:                 className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-1 rounded-lg"
 985:               >
 986:                 <X className="w-4 h-4" />
 987:               </button>
 988:             </div>
 989: 
 990:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
 991:               Bạn có chắc chắn muốn thu hồi <strong>{remoteActiveSessions.length}</strong> phiên
 992:               đăng nhập trên các thiết bị khác không? Các thiết bị đó sẽ phải đăng nhập lại để tiếp
 993:               tục sử dụng.
 994:             </p>
 995: 
 996:             <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-xs text-slate-700 cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors">
 997:               <input
 998:                 type="checkbox"
 999:                 data-testid="include-current-checkbox"
1000:                 checked={revokeAllIncludeCurrent}
1001:                 onChange={(e) => setRevokeAllIncludeCurrent(e.target.checked)}
1002:                 className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-red-600 focus:ring-red-500 border-slate-300"
1003:               />
1004:               <span className="font-medium">
1005:                 Bao gồm thiết bị hiện tại (Đăng xuất toàn bộ tài khoản)
1006:               </span>
1007:             </label>
1008: 
1009:             <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 pt-2">
1010:               <button
1011:                 type="button"
1012:                 onClick={() => setRevokeAllOpen(false)}
1013:                 disabled={revokeAllLoading}
1014:                 className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
1015:               >
1016:                 Hủy
1017:               </button>
1018:               <button
1019:                 type="button"
1020:                 data-testid="confirm-revoke-all-button"
1021:                 disabled={revokeAllLoading || isFetching || fetchState === 'loading'}
1022:                 onClick={handleRevokeAll}
1023:                 className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 active:bg-red-800 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors shadow-xs"
1024:               >
1025:                 {revokeAllLoading ? (
1026:                   <>
1027:                     <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
1028:                     <span>Đang thu hồi...</span>
1029:                   </>
1030:                 ) : (
1031:                   <span>Xác nhận thu hồi</span>
1032:                 )}
1033:               </button>
1034:             </div>
1035:           </div>
1036:         </div>
1037:       )}
1038:     </div>
1039:   );
1040: }
</file>

  1: /**

  7: 'use client';
  8: 
  9: import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
 10: import Link from 'next/link';
 11: import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
 12: import { Search, LogOut, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
 13: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
 14: import {
 15:   Sidebar,
 16:   SidebarContent,
 17:   SidebarGroup,
 18:   SidebarMenu,
 19:   SidebarProvider,
 20:   SidebarTrigger,
 21:   useSidebar,
 22: } from '../ui/sidebar';
 23: import { CommandPalette } from './CommandPalette';
 24: import {
 25:   currentHref,
 26:   deriveBreadcrumbs,

 30:   type Crumb,

 32:   type RoleConfiguration,
