 35: 
 36: export function ShellSkeleton() {
 37:   return (
 38:     <div role="status" aria-label="Đang tải ứng dụng" aria-busy="true" className="shell-skeleton">
 39:       <div className="hidden md:block space-y-4 p-4">
 40:         <div className="h-10 rounded bg-(--bg-subtle)" />
 41:         {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => (
 42:           <div key={i} className="h-8 rounded bg-(--bg-subtle)" />
 43:         ))}
 44:       </div>
 45:       <div className="p-4 space-y-6">
 46:         <div className="h-12 rounded bg-(--bg-subtle)" />
 47:         <div className="h-64 rounded bg-(--bg-subtle)" />
 48:         <span className="sr-only">Đang tải ứng dụng</span>
 49:       </div>
 50:     </div>
 51:   );
 52: }
 53: export function ShellNavigation({
 54:   targets,
 55:   activeHref,
 56:   onNavigate,
 57: }: {
 58:   targets: NavTarget[];
 59:   activeHref: string;
 60:   onNavigate?: () => void;
 61: }) {
 62:   const groups = Array.from(new Set(targets.map((t) => t.group)));
 63:   return (
 64:     <nav aria-label="Điều hướng chính">
 65:       <SidebarContent>
 66:         {groups.map((group) => (
 67:           <SidebarGroup key={group} label={group}>
 68:             <SidebarMenu>
 69:               {targets
 70:                 .filter((t) => t.group === group)
 71:                 .map((target) => (
 72:                   <li key={target.id}>
 73:                     <Link
 74:                       href={target.href}
 75:                       onClick={onNavigate}
 76:                       className="shell-nav-link"
 77:                       aria-label={target.label}
 78:                       title={target.label}
 79:                       aria-current={activeHref === target.href ? 'page' : undefined}
 80:                     >
 81:                       <target.icon size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
 82:                       <span className="shell-nav-label">{target.label}</span>
 83:                     </Link>
 84:                   </li>
 85:                 ))}
 86:             </SidebarMenu>
 87:           </SidebarGroup>
 88:         ))}
 89:         {!targets.length && (
 90:           <p role="status" className="p-3 text-(--text-secondary)">
 91:             Chưa có mục điều hướng. Liên hệ quản trị viên để được cấp quyền.
 92:           </p>
 93:         )}
 94:       </SidebarContent>
 95:     </nav>
 96:   );
 97: }
 98: export function ShellBreadcrumbs({ crumbs }: { crumbs: Crumb[] }) {
 99:   return (
100:     <nav aria-label="Đường dẫn trang" className="min-w-0">
101:       <ol className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 text-sm">
102:         {crumbs.map((crumb, index) => (
103:           <li
104:             key={index}
105:             className={
106:               'flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 ' +
107:               (index < crumbs.length - 1 ? 'hidden sm:flex' : '')
108:             }
109:           >
110:             {index > 0 && <ChevronRight size={14} aria-hidden="true" className="shrink-0" />}
111:             {index === crumbs.length - 1 ? (
112:               <span className="truncate" aria-current="page">
113:                 {crumb.label}
114:               </span>
115:             ) : crumb.href ? (
116:               <Link className="truncate" href={crumb.href}>
117:                 {crumb.label}
118:               </Link>
119:             ) : (
120:               <span className="truncate text-(--text-secondary)">{crumb.label}</span>
121:             )}
122:           </li>
123:         ))}
124:       </ol>
125:     </nav>
126:   );
127: }
128: function ShellChrome({ targets, children }: { targets: NavTarget[]; children: React.ReactNode }) {
129:   const { user, logout } = useAuth();
130:   const pathname = usePathname();
131:   const query = useSearchParams().toString();
132:   const [paletteOpen, setPaletteOpen] = useState(false);
133:   const { setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();
134:   useEffect(() => {
135:     const handleKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
136:       if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
137:         // Do not stack a new modal over an existing business form.
138:         if (event.shiftKey || document.querySelector('dialog[open], [role="dialog"]')) return;
139:         event.preventDefault();
140:         setPaletteOpen(true);
141:       }
142:     };
143:     window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
144:     return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
145:   }, []);
146:   return (
147:     <>
148:       <a href="#shell-content" className="shell-skip-link">
149:         Đến nội dung chính
150:       </a>
151:       <Sidebar>
152:         <Link href="/" className="shell-brand" onClick={() => setOpenMobile(false)}>
153:           <span className="shell-brand-icon" aria-hidden="true">
154:             S
155:           </span>
156:           <span className="shell-nav-label">Ship Dễ</span>
157:         </Link>
158:         <ShellNavigation
159:           targets={targets}
160:           activeHref={currentHref(pathname, query)}
161:           onNavigate={() => setOpenMobile(false)}
162:         />
163:       </Sidebar>
164:       <div className="shell-inset">
165:         <header className="shell-header">
166:           <SidebarTrigger />
167:           <ShellBreadcrumbs crumbs={deriveBreadcrumbs(pathname, query, targets)} />
168:           <div className="ml-auto flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
169:             <button
170:               type="button"
171:               className="shell-icon-button"
172:               aria-label="Chuyển đến trang (Ctrl hoặc Command K) ⌘K"
173:               aria-keyshortcuts="Control+K Meta+K"
174:               onClick={() => setPaletteOpen(true)}
175:             >
176:               <Search size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
177:               <kbd aria-hidden="true" className="hidden lg:inline text-xs">
178:                 ⌘K
179:               </kbd>
180:             </button>
181:             <details
182:               className="shell-user-menu"
183:               onKeyDown={(event) => {
184:                 if (event.key === 'Escape') {
185:                   event.currentTarget.open = false;
186:                   event.currentTarget.querySelector('summary')?.focus();
187:                 }
188:               }}
189:             >
190:               <summary className="shell-icon-button">
191:                 <span className="sr-only">Menu tài khoản</span>
192:                 <span className="shell-avatar">{user?.full_name?.charAt(0) || 'U'}</span>
193:                 <span className="hidden lg:inline max-w-32 truncate">{user?.full_name}</span>
194:               </summary>
195:               <div className="shell-user-content">
196:                 <p className="px-3 py-2 font-semibold">{user?.full_name}</p>
197:                 <p className="px-3 pb-2 text-xs text-(--text-secondary)">{user?.role}</p>
198:                 {personalTargets.map((target) => (
199:                   <Link
200:                     key={target.href}
201:                     href={target.href}
202:                     className="shell-nav-link"
203:                     onClick={(event) => {
204:                       event.currentTarget.closest('details')?.removeAttribute('open');
205:                     }}
206:                   >
207:                     <target.icon size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
208:                     {target.label}
209:                   </Link>
210:                 ))}
211:                 <Link
212:                   href="/onboarding"
213:                   className="shell-nav-link"
214:                   onClick={(event) =>
215:                     event.currentTarget.closest('details')?.removeAttribute('open')
216:                   }
217:                 >
218:                   Thiết lập ban đầu
219:                 </Link>
220:                 <button
221:                   type="button"
222:                   className="shell-nav-link w-full text-(--status-risk-text)"
223:                   onClick={logout}
224:                 >
225:                   <LogOut size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
226:                   Đăng xuất
227:                 </button>
228:               </div>
229:             </details>
230:           </div>
231:         </header>
232:         <div id="shell-content" tabIndex={-1} className="min-w-0">
233:           {children}
234:         </div>
235:       </div>
236:       {paletteOpen && <CommandPalette targets={targets} onClose={() => setPaletteOpen(false)} />}
237:     </>
238:   );
239: }
240: 
241: export function AppShell({
242:   defaultOpen,
243:   children,
244: }: {
245:   defaultOpen: boolean;
246:   children: React.ReactNode;
247: }) {
248:   const { isAuthenticated, isHydrating, token } = useAuth();
249:   const pathname = usePathname();
250:   const [navigation, setNavigation] = useState<{
251:     token: string;
252:     targets: NavTarget[];
253:     error?: 'forbidden' | 'error';
254:     setupOnly?: boolean;
255:     retrying?: boolean;
256:   } | null>(null);
257:   const [retry, setRetry] = useState(0);
258:   const publicRoute = [
259:     '/register',
260:     '/forgot-password',
261:     '/reset-password',
262:     '/invite/accept',
263:     '/paseo',
264:   ].some((p) => pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(p + '/'));
265:   useEffect(() => {
266:     if (!token || publicRoute) {
267:       // A sign-out must not leave the previous account's navigation behind.
268:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- session transition cleanup
269:       setNavigation(null);
270:       return;
271:     }
272:     if (!isAuthenticated) {
273:       // Setup-scoped session (MFA enrollment): live APIs answer 403 until setup completes.
274:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- session transition cleanup
275:       setNavigation({ token, targets: [], setupOnly: true });
276:       return;
277:     }
278:     const abort = new AbortController();
279:     const api = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
280:     const load = async () => {
281:       try {
282:         const options = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token }, signal: abort.signal };
283:         const [profileResponse, rolesResponse] = await Promise.all([
284:           fetch(api + '/api/v1/me', options),
285:           fetch(api + '/api/v1/roles', options),
286:         ]);
287:         if (!profileResponse.ok || !rolesResponse.ok) {
288:           if (!abort.signal.aborted)
289:             setNavigation({
290:               token,
291:               targets: [],
292:               error: [profileResponse.status, rolesResponse.status].some(
293:                 (status) => status === 401 || status === 403
294:               )
295:                 ? 'forbidden'
296:                 : 'error',
297:             });
298:           return;
299:         }
300:         const profile = (await profileResponse.json()).data as ShellProfile;
301:         const roles = (await rolesResponse.json()).data.roles as RoleConfiguration[];
302:         if (!Array.isArray(roles) || !profile?.role) throw new Error('Invalid navigation response');
303:         if (!abort.signal.aborted)
304:           setNavigation({ token, targets: getNavigation(resolveRolePermissions(profile, roles)) });
305:       } catch {
306:         if (!abort.signal.aborted) setNavigation({ token, targets: [], error: 'error' });
307:       }
308:     };
309:     void load();
310:     return () => abort.abort();
311:   }, [isAuthenticated, token, retry, publicRoute]);
312:   // Wrapping follows the session token, not the user object: the MFA setup-to-full
313:   // upgrade flips the user mid-flow and must never remount the active page.
314:   // The console route itself stays unframed until a full session exists so the
315:   // login/enrollment views keep their chromeless presentation and local state.
316:   const sessionScoped = pathname === '/' ? isAuthenticated : !!token;
317:   if (publicRoute || (!isHydrating && !sessionScoped)) return <>{children}</>;
318:   // While navigation (re)loads the last known navigation stays rendered so the
319:   // current page and its unsaved state remain mounted.
320:   if (isHydrating || !navigation) return <ShellSkeleton />;
321:   return (
322:     <SidebarProvider defaultOpen={defaultOpen}>
323:       <ShellChrome targets={navigation.targets}>
324:         {navigation.error && (
325:           <section role="alert" className="m-4 modern-card p-4">
326:             <h1 className="font-semibold">
327:               {navigation.error === 'forbidden'
328:                 ? 'Bạn không có quyền tải điều hướng (403)'
329:                 : 'Không thể tải điều hướng'}
330:             </h1>
331:             <p className="my-2">
332:               {navigation.error === 'forbidden'
333:                 ? 'Đăng nhập lại hoặc liên hệ quản trị viên. Dữ liệu chưa được thay đổi.'
334:                 : 'Kiểm tra kết nối và thử lại. Dữ liệu chưa được thay đổi.'}
335:             </p>
336:             <button
337:               className="btn-secondary"
338:               type="button"
339:               disabled={navigation.retrying}
340:               onClick={() => {
341:                 // Retain the current page and unsaved form state during a navigation retry.
342:                 setNavigation({ ...navigation, retrying: true });
343:                 setRetry((value) => value + 1);
344:               }}
345:             >
346:               {navigation.retrying ? 'Đang tải…' : 'Thử lại'}
347:             </button>
348:           </section>
349:         )}
350:         {navigation.setupOnly && (
351:           <section role="status" className="m-4 modern-card p-4">
352:             <p className="font-semibold">
353:               Tài khoản cần hoàn tất thiết lập xác thực hai yếu tố trước khi truy cập ứng dụng.
354:             </p>
355:             <Link href="/settings/security" className="btn-secondary mt-2 inline-flex">
356:               Thiết lập ngay
357:             </Link>
358:           </section>
359:         )}
360:         {children}
361:       </ShellChrome>
362:     </SidebarProvider>
363:   );
364: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/shell/CommandPalette.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
  4: import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
  5: import { Sheet } from '../ui/sheet';
  6: import type { NavTarget } from './navigation';
  7: 
  8: export function CommandTargets({
  9:   targets,
 10:   query,
 11:   onSelect,
 12: }: {
 13:   targets: NavTarget[];
 14:   query: string;
 15:   onSelect: (target: NavTarget) => void;
 16: }) {
 17:   const normalize = (text: string) =>
 18:     text
 19:       .normalize('NFD')
 20:       .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
 21:       .toLocaleLowerCase('vi')
 22:       .replace(/đ/g, 'd');
 23:   const matching = targets.filter((t) =>
 24:     normalize(t.label + ' ' + t.group).includes(normalize(query.trim()))
 25:   );
 26:   return (
 27:     <div
 28:       className="shell-command-results"
 29:       onKeyDown={(event) => {
 30:         if (!['ArrowDown', 'ArrowUp', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
 31:         const buttons = Array.from(
 32:           event.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button')
 33:         );
 34:         if (!buttons.length) return;
 35:         event.preventDefault();
 36:         const index = buttons.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement);
 37:         const next =
 38:           event.key === 'Home'
 39:             ? 0
 40:             : event.key === 'End'
 41:               ? buttons.length - 1
 42:               : (index + (event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1) + buttons.length) % buttons.length;
 43:         buttons[next].focus();
 44:       }}
 45:     >
 46:       <ul aria-label="Trang có thể truy cập">
 47:         {matching.map((target) => (
 48:           <li key={target.id}>
 49:             <button type="button" className="shell-command-target" onClick={() => onSelect(target)}>
 50:               <target.icon size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
 51:               <span>
 52:                 {target.label}
 53:                 <small className="block text-(--text-muted)">{target.group}</small>
 54:               </span>
 55:             </button>
 56:           </li>
 57:         ))}
 58:       </ul>
 59:       {!matching.length && (
 60:         <p role="status" className="p-4 text-(--text-secondary)">
 61:           {targets.length
 62:             ? 'Không tìm thấy trang phù hợp. Thử từ khóa khác.'
 63:             : 'Chưa có mục điều hướng. Liên hệ quản trị viên để được cấp quyền.'}
 64:         </p>
 65:       )}
 66:     </div>
 67:   );
 68: }
 69: export function CommandPalette({
 70:   targets,
 71:   onClose,
 72: }: {
 73:   targets: NavTarget[];
 74:   onClose: () => void;
 75: }) {
 76:   const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
 77:   const router = useRouter();
 78:   useEffect(() => {
 79:     // Sheet opens after mount; place focus in its labelled search field.
 80:     document.getElementById('shell-command-query')?.focus();
 81:   }, []);
 82:   return (
 83:     <Sheet
 84:       open
 85:       onOpenChange={(open) => {
 86:         if (!open) onClose();
 87:       }}
 88:       title="Chuyển đến trang"
 89:       variant="command"
 90:     >
 91:       <div className="p-4">
 92:         <label htmlFor="shell-command-query" className="sr-only">
 93:           Tìm trang
 94:         </label>
 95:         <input
 96:           id="shell-command-query"
 97:           className="modern-input"
 98:           type="search"
 99:           placeholder="Tìm trang…"
100:           value={query}
101:           onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
102:           onKeyDown={(event) => {
103:             if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' || event.key === 'Enter') {
104:               const first = event.currentTarget
105:                 .closest('dialog')
106:                 ?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.shell-command-target');
107:               if (first) {
108:                 event.preventDefault();
109:                 if (event.key === 'Enter') first.click();
110:                 else first.focus();
111:               }
112:             }
113:           }}
114:         />
115:       </div>
116:       <CommandTargets
117:         targets={targets}
118:         query={query}
119:         onSelect={(target) => {
120:           onClose();
121:           router.push(target.href);
122:         }}
123:       />
124:     </Sheet>
125:   );
126: }
</file>

142:     href: '/?view=settings&section=integrations',
143:     group: 'Cấu hình',
144:     icon: Key,
145:     permissions: ['iam:connect_observe_token'],
146:   },
147: ];
148: 
149: export function getNavigation(permissions: readonly string[]): NavTarget[] {
150:   return targets.filter((t) => t.permissions.some((p) => permissions.includes(p)));
151: }
152: 
153: export interface RoleConfiguration {
154:   id: string;
155:   code: string | null;
156:   is_system: boolean;
157:   permissions: { code: string }[];
158: }
159: export interface ShellProfile {
160:   role: string;
161:   custom_role_id?: string | null;
162: }
163: export function resolveRolePermissions(
164:   profile: ShellProfile,
165:   roles: RoleConfiguration[]
166: ): string[] {
167:   const role = profile.custom_role_id
168:     ? roles.find((r) => !r.is_system && r.id === profile.custom_role_id)
169:     : roles.find((r) => r.is_system && r.code === profile.role);
170:   return role?.permissions.map((p) => p.code) ?? [];
171: }
172: 
173: export const personalTargets = [
174:   { href: '/settings/profile', label: 'Hồ sơ cá nhân', icon: User },
175:   { href: '/settings/security', label: 'Bảo mật tài khoản', icon: Shield },
176:   { href: '/sessions', label: 'Phiên đăng nhập', icon: Lock },
177: ];
178: 
179: export function currentHref(pathname: string, query: string): string {
180:   if (pathname !== '/') return pathname;
181:   const params = new URLSearchParams(query);
182:   const view = params.get('view') || 'dashboard';
183:   return '/?view=' + view + (params.get('section') ? '&section=' + params.get('section') : '');
184: }
185: 
186: export interface Crumb {
187:   label: string;
188:   href?: string;
189: }
190: export function deriveBreadcrumbs(
191:   pathname: string,
192:   query: string,
193:   permitted: NavTarget[]
194: ): Crumb[] {
195:   const href = currentHref(pathname, query);
196:   const target =
197:     permitted.find((t) => t.href === href) ??
198:     permitted
199:       .filter((t) => !t.href.includes('?') && pathname.startsWith(t.href + '/'))
200:       .sort((a, b) => b.href.length - a.href.length)[0];
201:   const personal = personalTargets.find((t) => t.href === pathname);
202:   if (!target)
203:     return [{ label: 'Ship Dễ', href: '/' }, { label: personal?.label ?? 'Trang hiện tại' }];
204:   return [
205:     { label: 'Ship Dễ', href: '/' },
206:     { label: target.group },
207:     { label: target.label, ...(target.href !== href ? { href: target.href } : {}) },
208:     ...(target.href !== href ? [{ label: 'Chi tiết' }] : []),
209:   ];
210: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/ui/OperationalComponents.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import { Copy, Check, Info, ShieldAlert, AlertTriangle, ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react';
  5: import { ShipmentStatus, CarrierCapabilityTier } from '@/types/domain';
  6: 
  7: // ============================================================================
  8: // 1. Money Component (Tabular Figures, Precise Formatting)
  9: // ============================================================================
 10: interface MoneyProps {
 11:   amount: number | bigint;
 12:   state?: 'confirmed' | 'pending' | 'estimated';
 13:   showSign?: boolean;
 14:   className?: string;
 15: }
 16: 
 17: export const Money: React.FC<MoneyProps> = ({
 18:   amount,
 19:   state = 'confirmed',
 20:   showSign = false,
 21:   className = '',
 22: }) => {
 23:   const num = Number(amount) || 0;
 24:   const isNegative = num < 0;
 25:   const absNum = Math.abs(num);
 26:   const formatted = absNum.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' đ';
 27: 
 28:   const signStr = isNegative ? '- ' : showSign && num > 0 ? '+ ' : '';
 29: 
 30:   let stateStyle = 'font-mono tabular-nums text-right ';
 31:   if (state === 'confirmed') {
 32:     stateStyle += isNegative ? 'text-rose-600 font-bold' : 'text-slate-900 font-semibold';
 33:   } else if (state === 'pending') {
 34:     stateStyle += 'text-slate-500 italic';
 35:   } else if (state === 'estimated') {
 36:     stateStyle += 'text-slate-500 italic';
 37:   }
 38: 
 39:   return (
 40:     <span
 41:       className={`${stateStyle} ${className}`}
 42:       title={state !== 'confirmed' ? `Trạng thái: ${state}` : undefined}
 43:     >
 44:       {signStr}
 45:       {formatted}
 46:     </span>
 47:   );
 48: };
 49: 
 50: // ============================================================================
 51: // 2. TrackingCode Component (1-Touch Copy with Immediate Visual Feedback)
 52: // ============================================================================
 53: interface TrackingCodeProps {
 54:   code: string;
 55:   onClick?: () => void;
 56:   className?: string;
 57: }
 58: 
 59: export const TrackingCode: React.FC<TrackingCodeProps> = ({ code, onClick, className = '' }) => {
 60:   const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
 61: 
 62:   const handleCopy = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
 63:     e.stopPropagation();
 64:     navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
 65:     setCopied(true);
 66:     setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
 67:   };
 68: 
 69:   return (
 70:     <span
 71:       onClick={onClick}
 72:       className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-[13px] font-bold text-slate-900 hover:text-[#c23807] cursor-pointer group select-all transition-colors ${className}`}
 73:       title="Bấm để sao chép hoặc mở chi tiết hành trình"
 74:     >
 75:       <span>{code}</span>
 76:       <button
 77:         type="button"
 78:         onClick={handleCopy}
 79:         className="text-slate-400 hover:text-[#c23807] p-1 rounded-md transition"
 80:         title={copied ? 'Đã sao chép mã' : 'Sao chép mã'}
 81:       >
 82:         {copied ? (
 83:           <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
 84:         ) : (
 85:           <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
 86:         )}
 87:       </button>
 88:     </span>
 89:   );
 90: };
 91: 
 92: // ============================================================================
 93: // 3. StatusBadge Component (Vietnamese Business Language)
 94: // ============================================================================
 95: interface StatusBadgeProps {
 96:   status: ShipmentStatus | string;
 97:   className?: string;
 98: }
 99: 
100: export const StatusBadge: React.FC<StatusBadgeProps> = ({ status, className = '' }) => {
101:   const s = String(status).toUpperCase();
102: 
103:   let badgeClass = 'badge-info';
104:   let label = status;
105:   let dotColor = 'bg-slate-400';
106: 
107:   if (
108:     s === 'DELIVERED' ||
109:     s === 'RESOLVED' ||
110:     s === 'MATCHED' ||
111:     s === 'ACCEPTED' ||
112:     s === 'ACTIVE'
113:   ) {
114:     badgeClass = 'badge-ok';
115:     dotColor = 'bg-emerald-600';
116:     if (s === 'DELIVERED') label = 'Giao Thành Công';
117:     else if (s === 'RESOLVED') label = 'Đã Đối Soát';
118:     else if (s === 'MATCHED') label = 'Đã Khớp Mã';
119:     else if (s === 'ACCEPTED') label = 'Hãng Đã Chấp Thuận';
120:   } else if (s === 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY') {
121:     badgeClass = 'badge-warn';
122:     dotColor = 'bg-amber-600';
123:     label = 'Đang Giao Hàng';
124:   } else if (s === 'IN_TRANSIT') {
125:     badgeClass = 'badge-info';
126:     dotColor = 'bg-slate-500';
127:     label = 'Đang Trung Chuyển';
128:   } else if (s === 'PICKING' || s === 'PICKED' || s === 'READY_TO_PICK' || s === 'CREATED') {
129:     badgeClass = 'badge-info';
130:     dotColor = 'bg-slate-500';
131:     label = s === 'PICKED' ? 'Đã Lấy Hàng' : 'Chờ Lấy Hàng';
132:   } else if (s === 'RETURNING') {
133:     badgeClass = 'badge-warn';
134:     dotColor = 'bg-amber-600';
135:     label = 'Đang Chuyển Hoàn';
136:   } else if (s === 'RETURNED') {
137:     badgeClass = 'badge-info';
138:     dotColor = 'bg-slate-600';
139:     label = 'Đã Nhập Hoàn Kho';
140:   } else if (s === 'DRAFT') {
141:     badgeClass = 'badge-info';
142:     dotColor = 'bg-slate-400';
143:     label = 'Bản Nháp';
144:   } else if (s === 'CANCELLED') {
145:     badgeClass = 'badge-info';
146:     dotColor = 'bg-slate-400';
147:     label = 'Đã Hủy';
148:   } else if (
149:     s.includes('FAIL') ||
150:     s.includes('DISPUTE') ||
151:     s.includes('REJECTED') ||
152:     s.includes('DAMAGED') ||
153:     s.includes('LOST') ||
154:     s.startsWith('D')
155:   ) {
156:     badgeClass = 'badge-risk';
157:     dotColor = 'bg-rose-600';
158:     if (s === 'DELIVERY_FAIL') label = 'Giao Thất Bại';
159:     else if (s === 'DISPUTED') label = 'Đang Khiếu Nại';
160:     else if (s === 'DAMAGED') label = 'Hàng Hư Hỏng';
161:     else if (s === 'LOST') label = 'Thất Lạc Hàng';
162:     else if (s === 'D1_WEIGHT') label = 'Lệch Cân Tính Phí';
163:     else if (s === 'D2_FREIGHT') label = 'Lệch Cước Hợp Đồng';
164:     else if (s === 'D4_DUPLICATE' || s.includes('D4')) label = 'Trừ Cước Trùng';
165:     else if (s === 'D5_COD_MISMATCH' || s.includes('D5')) label = 'Lệch Tiền COD';
166:     else if (s === 'D6_OVERDUE_COD' || s.includes('D6')) label = 'COD Quá Hạn';
167:     else if (s === 'D7_MISSING' || s.includes('D7')) label = 'Thiếu Dòng Sao Kê';
168:   } else if (
169:     s.includes('DELAY') ||
170:     s.includes('PENDING') ||
171:     s.includes('OPEN') ||
172:     s.includes('ASSIGNED') ||
173:     s.includes('SUBMITTED')
174:   ) {
175:     badgeClass = 'badge-warn';
176:     dotColor = 'bg-amber-600';
177:     if (s === 'PICKUP_DELAY') label = 'Chậm Lấy Hàng';
178:     else if (s === 'OPEN') label = 'Chờ Xử Lý';
179:     else if (s === 'ASSIGNED') label = 'Đã Phân Công';
180:     else if (s === 'SUBMITTED') label = 'Đã Gửi Hãng';
181:     else if (s === 'PENDING') label = 'Chờ Duyệt';
182:   } else if (s.includes('REATTEMPT')) {
183:     badgeClass = 'badge-info';
184:     dotColor = 'bg-emerald-600';
185:     label = 'Đã Gửi Lệnh Giao Lại';
186:   }
187: 
188:   return (
189:     <span className={`${badgeClass} ${className}`}>
190:       <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${dotColor}`} />
191:       <span>{label}</span>
192:     </span>
193:   );
194: };
195: 
196: // ============================================================================
197: // 4. AutomationBadge Component (Clear Operational Description)
198: // ============================================================================
199: interface AutomationBadgeProps {
200:   tier: CarrierCapabilityTier | 'L2' | 'L1' | 'L0';
201:   carrierCode?: string;
202:   className?: string;
203: }
204: 
205: export const AutomationBadge: React.FC<AutomationBadgeProps> = ({
206:   tier,
207:   carrierCode = '',
208:   className = '',
209: }) => {
210:   const t = String(tier).toUpperCase();
211: 
212:   if (t === 'L2' || t.includes('EXECUTE')) {
213:     return (
214:       <span
215:         className={`badge-ok font-semibold text-xs ${className}`}
216:         title="Tự động gọi API hãng trực tiếp"
217:       >
218:         <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 animate-pulse" />
219:         <span>{carrierCode ? `${carrierCode} · ` : ''}Tự Động Qua API</span>
220:       </span>
221:     );
222:   }
223: 
224:   if (t === 'L1' || t.includes('ASSIST')) {
225:     return (
226:       <span
227:         className={`badge-warn font-semibold text-xs ${className}`}
228:         title="Tạo hồ sơ chuẩn mẫu để nhân viên dán lên cổng hãng"
229:       >
230:         <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-600" />
231:         <span>{carrierCode ? `${carrierCode} · ` : ''}Hỗ Trợ Cổng Hãng</span>
232:       </span>
233:     );
234:   }
235: 
236:   return (
237:     <span
238:       className={`badge-info font-medium text-xs ${className}`}
239:       title="Thao tác hoàn toàn thủ công"
240:     >
241:       <span>{carrierCode ? `${carrierCode} · ` : ''}Thủ Công</span>
242:     </span>
243:   );
244: };
245: 
246: // ============================================================================
247: // 5. EmptyState Component (Clean & Helpful)

249: interface EmptyStateProps {

253:   actionLabel?: string;
254:   onAction?: () => void;
255:   icon?: React.ReactNode;

259:   title,
260:   description,
261:   reason,
262:   actionLabel,
263:   onAction,
264:   icon,
265: }) => {
266:   return (

268:       <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center text-xl">
269:         {icon || <Info className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-400" />}
270:       </div>
271:       <div className="space-y-1 max-w-md">
272:         <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">{title}</h4>
273:         {(description || reason) && (
274:           <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{description || reason}</p>
275:         )}
276:       </div>
277:       {actionLabel && onAction && (
278:         <button type="button" onClick={onAction} className="btn-primary mt-2">
279:           {actionLabel}
280:         </button>
281:       )}
282:     </div>
283:   );

285: 
286: // ============================================================================
287: // 6. ConfirmDialog Modal (Focus Trapped, Accessible)
288: // ============================================================================
289: interface ConfirmDialogProps {
290:   isOpen: boolean;
291:   title: string;
292:   message?: string;
293:   description?: string;
294:   confirmLabel?: string;
295:   cancelLabel?: string;
296:   isDanger?: boolean;
297:   requireReason?: boolean;
298:   onConfirm: (reason: string) => void;
299:   onCancel?: () => void;
300:   onClose?: () => void;
301: }
302: 
303: export const ConfirmDialog: React.FC<ConfirmDialogProps> = ({
304:   isOpen,
305:   title,
306:   message,
307:   description,
308:   confirmLabel = 'Xác Nhận',
309:   cancelLabel = 'Hủy Bỏ',
310:   isDanger = false,
311:   requireReason = false,
312:   onConfirm,
313:   onCancel,
314:   onClose,
315: }) => {
316:   const handleClose = () => {
317:     if (onCancel) onCancel();
318:     if (onClose) onClose();
319:   };
320:   const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
321:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
322: 
323:   if (!isOpen) return null;
324: 
325:   const handleConfirm = () => {
326:     if (requireReason && !reason.trim()) {
327:       setError('Vui lòng nhập lý do giải trình bắt buộc.');
328:       return;
329:     }
330:     setError(null);
331:     onConfirm(reason);
332:     setReason('');
333:   };
334: 
335:   return (
336:     <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
337:       <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
338:         <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
339:           <div
340:             className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${isDanger ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-600' : 'bg-[#FFF5F0] text-[#c23807]'}`}
341:           >
342:             {isDanger ? <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />}
343:           </div>
344:           <div>
345:             <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-base">{title}</h3>
346:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{message}</p>
347:           </div>
348:         </div>
349: 
350:         {requireReason && (
351:           <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-2">
352:             <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 block">
353:               Lý do giải trình (Bắt buộc theo quy tắc tài chính):
354:             </label>
355:             <textarea
356:               value={reason}
357:               onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
358:               placeholder="Nhập chi tiết căn cứ giải trình..."
359:               className="modern-input text-xs h-20 resize-none"
360:               autoFocus
361:             />
362:             {error && <p className="text-xs text-rose-600 font-semibold">{error}</p>}
363:           </div>
364:         )}
365: 
366:         <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
367:           <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className="btn-secondary text-xs">
368:             {cancelLabel}
369:           </button>
370:           <button
371:             type="button"
372:             onClick={handleConfirm}
373:             className={isDanger ? 'btn-danger text-xs' : 'btn-primary text-xs'}
374:           >
375:             {confirmLabel}
376:           </button>
377:         </div>
378:       </div>
379:     </div>
380:   );
381: };
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx">
 1: 'use client';
 2: 
 3: import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
 4: import { X } from 'lucide-react';
 5: 
 6: // Native modal dialog supplies an inert background and Escape handling.
 7: // This narrow sheet primitive uses the existing brand tokens without new runtime dependencies.
 8: export function Sheet({
 9:   open,
10:   onOpenChange,
11:   title,
12:   children,
13:   variant = 'sheet',
14: }: {
15:   open: boolean;
16:   onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
17:   title: string;
18:   children: React.ReactNode;
19:   variant?: 'sheet' | 'command';
20: }) {
21:   const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
22:   useEffect(() => {
23:     const dialog = ref.current;
24:     if (!open || !dialog) return;
25:     const previousFocus = document.activeElement;
26:     dialog.showModal();
27:     return () => {
28:       dialog.close();
29:       if (previousFocus instanceof HTMLElement && previousFocus.isConnected) previousFocus.focus();
30:     };
31:   }, [open]);
32:   return (
33:     <dialog
34:       ref={ref}
35:       className={'shell-modal shell-modal-' + variant}
36:       aria-label={title}
37:       onKeyDown={(event) => {
38:         if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
39:         const controls = Array.from(
40:           event.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
41:             'a[href], button:not(:disabled), input:not(:disabled), select:not(:disabled), [tabindex="0"]'
42:           )
43:         ).filter((element) => element.getClientRects().length > 0);
44:         const first = controls[0];
45:         const last = controls.at(-1);
46:         // Keep the loop inside the sheet instead of allowing focus into browser chrome.
47:         if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
48:           event.preventDefault();
49:           last?.focus();
50:         } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
51:           event.preventDefault();
52:           first?.focus();
53:         }
54:       }}
55:       onCancel={(event) => {
56:         event.preventDefault();
57:         onOpenChange(false);
58:       }}
59:       onClick={(event) => {
60:         if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
61:           const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
62:           if (
63:             event.clientX < rect.left ||
64:             event.clientX > rect.right ||
65:             event.clientY < rect.top ||
66:             event.clientY > rect.bottom
67:           )
68:             onOpenChange(false);
69:         }
70:       }}
71:     >
72:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-(--border-subtle) p-4">
73:         <h2 className="font-semibold">{title}</h2>
74:         <button
75:           type="button"
76:           className="shell-icon-button"
77:           aria-label={'Đóng ' + title}
78:           onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
79:         >
80:           <X aria-hidden="true" size={18} />
81:         </button>
82:       </div>
83:       {children}
84:     </dialog>
85:   );
86: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx">
  1: /**
  2:  * Adapted from shadcn/ui sidebar (MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 shadcn).
  3:  * https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/sidebar.tsx
  4:  * Retains provider, icon collapse, cookie and mobile sheet patterns; only needed primitives.
  5:  * MIT permission notice: ../shell/REFERENCE-LICENSE.md.
  6:  */
  7: 'use client';
  8: 
  9: import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
 10: import { PanelLeft } from 'lucide-react';
 11: import { Sheet } from './sheet';
 12: 
 13: const SidebarContext = createContext<{
 14:   open: boolean;
 15:   openMobile: boolean;
 16:   isMobile: boolean;
 17:   setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void;
 18:   toggleSidebar: () => void;
 19: } | null>(null);
 20: export function useSidebar() {
 21:   const context = useContext(SidebarContext);
 22:   if (!context) throw new Error('useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider');
 23:   return context;
 24: }
 25: export function SidebarProvider({
 26:   defaultOpen,
 27:   children,
 28: }: {
 29:   defaultOpen: boolean;
 30:   children: React.ReactNode;
 31: }) {
 32:   const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen);
 33:   const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = useState(false);
 34:   const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);
 35:   useEffect(() => {
 36:     const media = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)');
 37:     const update = () => {
 38:       setIsMobile(media.matches);
 39:       setOpenMobile(false);
 40:     };
 41:     update();
 42:     media.addEventListener('change', update);
 43:     return () => media.removeEventListener('change', update);
 44:   }, []);
 45:   const toggleSidebar = () => {
 46:     if (isMobile) {
 47:       setOpenMobile(!openMobile);
 48:       return;
 49:     }
 50:     const next = !open;
 51:     setOpen(next);
 52:     document.cookie =
 53:       'sidebar_state=' +
 54:       next +
 55:       '; path=/; max-age=604800; SameSite=Lax' +
 56:       (location.protocol === 'https:' ? '; Secure' : '');
 57:   };
 58:   return (
 59:     <SidebarContext.Provider value={{ open, openMobile, isMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar }}>
 60:       <div className="shell-frame" data-state={open ? 'expanded' : 'collapsed'}>
 61:         {children}
 62:       </div>
 63:     </SidebarContext.Provider>
 64:   );
 65: }
 66: export function Sidebar({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
 67:   const { openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();
 68:   return (
 69:     <>
 70:       <aside className="shell-sidebar" aria-label="Điều hướng ứng dụng">
 71:         {children}
 72:       </aside>
 73:       <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} title="Điều hướng ứng dụng">
 74:         <div className="shell-mobile-nav">{children}</div>
 75:       </Sheet>
 76:     </>
 77:   );
 78: }
 79: export function SidebarTrigger() {
 80:   const { open, openMobile, isMobile, toggleSidebar } = useSidebar();
 81:   return (
 82:     <button
 83:       type="button"
 84:       className="shell-icon-button"
 85:       aria-label={isMobile ? 'Mở điều hướng' : 'Thu gọn hoặc mở rộng điều hướng'}
 86:       aria-expanded={isMobile ? openMobile : open}
 87:       onClick={toggleSidebar}
 88:     >
 89:       <PanelLeft size={20} aria-hidden="true" />
 90:     </button>
 91:   );
 92: }
 93: export function SidebarContent({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
 94:   return (
 95:     <div data-sidebar="content" className="shell-sidebar-content">
 96:       {children}
 97:     </div>
 98:   );
 99: }
100: export function SidebarGroup({ label, children }: { label: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
101:   return (
102:     <section data-sidebar="group" aria-label={label}>
103:       <h2 className="shell-group-label">{label}</h2>
104:       {children}
105:     </section>
106:   );
107: }
108: export function SidebarMenu({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
109:   return (
110:     <ul data-sidebar="menu" className="space-y-1">
111:       {children}
112:     </ul>
113:   );
114: }
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/BranchManagementView.tsx">
  1: 'use client';

 24: 
 25: export interface BranchManagementViewProps {
 26:   branches?: Branch[];
 27:   loading?: boolean;
 28:   canEdit?: boolean;
 29:   scopedStores?: string[] | null;
 30:   error?: string | null;

 36:   onRefresh?: () => void;
 37:   onCreate?: (input: CreateBranchInput) => Promise<void>;
 38:   onUpdate?: (id: string, input: UpdateBranchInput) => Promise<void>;
 39:   onActivate?: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
 40:   onDeactivate?: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
 41: }
 42: 
 43: export function BranchManagementView({
 44:   branches = [],
 45:   loading = false,
 46:   canEdit = false,
 47:   scopedStores = null,
 48:   error = null,
 49:   success = null,
 50:   initialFormOpen = false,
 51:   initialEditingBranch = null,
 52:   initialFormState = {},
 53:   initialValidationErrors = {},
 54:   onRefresh,
 55:   onCreate,
 56:   onUpdate,
 57:   onActivate,
 58:   onDeactivate,
 59: }: BranchManagementViewProps) {
 60:   // Filter & Search states
 61:   const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE'>('ALL');
 62:   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
 63: 
 64:   // Modal / Form state
 65:   const [isFormOpen, setIsFormOpen] = useState(initialFormOpen);
 66:   const [editingBranch, setEditingBranch] = useState<Branch | null>(initialEditingBranch);
 67:   const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
 68:   const [actionLoadingId, setActionLoadingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
 69: 
 70:   // Form field states
 71:   const [formState, setFormState] = useState<BranchFormState>({
 72:     name: initialEditingBranch?.name || initialFormState.name || '',
 73:     code: initialEditingBranch?.code || initialFormState.code || '',
 74:     address: initialEditingBranch?.address || initialFormState.address || '',
 75:     phone: initialEditingBranch?.phone || initialFormState.phone || '',
 76:     is_default: initialEditingBranch?.is_default ?? initialFormState.is_default ?? false,
 77:     status: initialEditingBranch?.status || initialFormState.status || 'ACTIVE',
 78:   });
 79: 
 80:   const [validationErrors, setValidationErrors] =
 81:     useState<Record<string, string>>(initialValidationErrors);
 82:   const [modalError, setModalError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 83:   const [localError, setLocalError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 84:   const [localSuccess, setLocalSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
 85: 
 86:   const viewError = localError ?? error;
 87:   const viewSuccess = localSuccess ?? success;
 88:   const setViewError = (val: string | null) => setLocalError(val);
 89:   const setViewSuccess = (val: string | null) => setLocalSuccess(val);
 90: 
 91:   // Derived filtered branches
 92:   const filteredBranches = useMemo(() => {
 93:     return branches.filter((branch) => {
 94:       // Status filter
 95:       if (statusFilter !== 'ALL' && branch.status !== statusFilter) {
 96:         return false;
 97:       }
 98:       // Search query
 99:       if (searchQuery.trim()) {
100:         const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
101:         const matchName = branch.name.toLowerCase().includes(query);
102:         const matchCode = branch.code.toLowerCase().includes(query);
103:         const matchAddress = branch.address ? branch.address.toLowerCase().includes(query) : false;
104:         const matchPhone = branch.phone ? branch.phone.includes(query) : false;
105:         return matchName || matchCode || matchAddress || matchPhone;
106:       }
107:       return true;
108:     });
109:   }, [branches, statusFilter, searchQuery]);
110: 
111:   const activeCount = useMemo(
112:     () => branches.filter((b) => b.status === 'ACTIVE').length,
113:     [branches]
114:   );
115:   const inactiveCount = useMemo(
116:     () => branches.filter((b) => b.status === 'INACTIVE').length,
117:     [branches]
118:   );
119: 
120:   const isRestrictedScope = useMemo(() => {
121:     return Array.isArray(scopedStores) && scopedStores.length > 0 && !scopedStores.includes('*');
122:   }, [scopedStores]);
123: 
124:   // Open Create Form
125:   const handleOpenCreate = () => {
126:     if (!canEdit) return;
127:     setEditingBranch(null);
128:     setFormState({
129:       name: '',
130:       code: '',
131:       address: '',
132:       phone: '',
133:       is_default: branches.length === 0, // Auto-default if first branch
134:       status: 'ACTIVE',
135:     });
136:     setValidationErrors({});
137:     setModalError(null);
138:     setIsFormOpen(true);
139:   };
140: 
141:   // Open Edit Form
142:   const handleOpenEdit = (branch: Branch) => {
143:     if (!canEdit) return;
144:     setEditingBranch(branch);
145:     setFormState({
146:       name: branch.name,
147:       code: branch.code,
148:       address: branch.address || '',
149:       phone: branch.phone || '',
150:       is_default: branch.is_default,
151:       status: branch.status,
152:     });
153:     setValidationErrors({});
154:     setModalError(null);
155:     setIsFormOpen(true);
156:   };
157: 
158:   const handleCloseForm = () => {
159:     setIsFormOpen(false);
160:     setEditingBranch(null);
161:     setValidationErrors({});
162:     setModalError(null);
163:   };
164: 
165:   const handleFormFieldChange = (field: keyof BranchFormState, value: any) => {
166:     setFormState((prev) => ({
167:       ...prev,
168:       [field]: field === 'code' && typeof value === 'string' ? value.toUpperCase().trim() : value,
169:     }));
170:     if (validationErrors[field]) {
171:       setValidationErrors((prev) => {
172:         const next = { ...prev };
173:         delete next[field];
174:         return next;
175:       });
176:     }
177:   };
178: 
179:   // Submit Create or Update
180:   const handleFormSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
181:     e.preventDefault();
182:     setModalError(null);
183: 
184:     const { isValid, errors } = validateBranchForm(formState);
185:     if (!isValid) {
186:       setValidationErrors(errors);
187:       return;
188:     }
189: 
190:     setSubmitting(true);
191:     try {
192:       if (editingBranch) {
193:         if (onUpdate) {
194:           await onUpdate(editingBranch.id, {
195:             name: formState.name.trim(),
196:             code: formState.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
197:             address: formState.address.trim() || null,
198:             phone: formState.phone.trim() || null,
199:             is_default: formState.is_default,
200:             status: formState.status,
201:           });
202:           setViewSuccess(`Đã cập nhật chi nhánh "${formState.name}" thành công`);
203:         }
204:       } else {
205:         if (onCreate) {
206:           await onCreate({
207:             name: formState.name.trim(),
208:             code: formState.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
209:             address: formState.address.trim() || null,
210:             phone: formState.phone.trim() || null,
211:             is_default: formState.is_default,
212:             status: formState.status,
213:           });
214:           setViewSuccess(`Đã tạo mới chi nhánh "${formState.name}" thành công`);
215:         }
216:       }
217:       handleCloseForm();
218:     } catch (err: any) {
219:       setModalError(err?.message || 'Có lỗi xảy ra khi lưu chi nhánh. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.');
220:     } finally {
221:       setSubmitting(false);
222:     }
223:   };
224: 
225:   // Toggle Activate / Deactivate
226:   const handleToggleStatus = async (branch: Branch) => {
227:     if (!canEdit) return;
228: 
229:     if (branch.status === 'ACTIVE') {
230:       if (branch.is_default) {
231:         setViewError(
232:           'Không thể tạm ngưng hoạt động của chi nhánh mặc định. Vui lòng chỉ định một chi nhánh khác làm mặc định trước.'
233:         );
234:         return;
235:       }
236:       setActionLoadingId(branch.id);
237:       setViewError(null);
238:       try {
239:         if (onDeactivate) {
240:           await onDeactivate(branch.id);
241:           setViewSuccess(`Đã tạm ngưng hoạt động chi nhánh "${branch.name}"`);
242:         }
243:       } catch (err: any) {
244:         setViewError(err?.message || 'Không thể tạm ngưng chi nhánh');
245:       } finally {
246:         setActionLoadingId(null);
247:       }
248:     } else {
249:       setActionLoadingId(branch.id);
250:       setViewError(null);
251:       try {
252:         if (onActivate) {
253:           await onActivate(branch.id);
254:           setViewSuccess(`Đã kích hoạt hoạt động chi nhánh "${branch.name}"`);
255:         }
256:       } catch (err: any) {
257:         setViewError(err?.message || 'Không thể kích hoạt chi nhánh');
258:       } finally {
259:         setActionLoadingId(null);
260:       }
261:     }
262:   };
263: 
264:   // Quick action: Set as default
265:   const handleSetDefault = async (branch: Branch) => {
266:     if (!canEdit || branch.is_default) return;
267:     setActionLoadingId(branch.id);
268:     setViewError(null);
269:     try {
270:       if (onUpdate) {
271:         await onUpdate(branch.id, { is_default: true });
272:         setViewSuccess(`Đã đặt chi nhánh "${branch.name}" làm mặc định`);
273:       }
274:     } catch (err: any) {
275:       setViewError(err?.message || 'Không thể đặt chi nhánh làm mặc định');
276:     } finally {
277:       setActionLoadingId(null);
278:     }
279:   };
280: 
281:   // 1. Loading State
282:   if (loading) {
283:     return (
284:       <div className="space-y-6 animate-pulse" data-testid="branch-loading-state">
285:         <div className="h-24 bg-slate-200 rounded-2xl w-full" />
286:         <div className="h-12 bg-slate-200 rounded-xl w-72" />
287:         <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
288:           <div className="h-48 bg-slate-200 rounded-2xl" />
289:           <div className="h-48 bg-slate-200 rounded-2xl" />
290:           <div className="h-48 bg-slate-200 rounded-2xl" />
291:         </div>
292:         <div className="text-center text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">
293:           Đang tải danh sách chi nhánh...
294:         </div>
295:       </div>
296:     );
297:   }
298: 
299:   return (
300:     <div className="space-y-6" data-testid="branch-management-container">
301:       {/* Top Header Banner */}
302:       <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xs flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
303:         <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
304:           <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
305:             <GitBranch className="w-6 h-6" />
306:           </div>
307:           <div>
308:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
309:               <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900" data-testid="branch-header-title">
310:                 Quản lý Chi nhánh &amp; Điểm gửi hàng
311:               </h1>
312:               <span className="text-xs font-semibold bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border border-orange-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
313:                 {branches.length} chi nhánh
314:               </span>
315:             </div>
316:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
317:               Quản lý danh sách chi nhánh, kho gửi hàng, mã định danh và phạm vi vận hành của từng
318:               đơn vị.
319:             </p>
320:           </div>
321:         </div>
322: 
323:         {/* Action Controls */}
324:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end">
325:           {onRefresh && (
326:             <button
327:               type="button"
328:               onClick={onRefresh}
329:               data-testid="refresh-branches-button"
330:               aria-label="Làm mới danh sách"
331:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer"
332:               title="Làm mới danh sách"
333:             >
334:               <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
335:               <span className="hidden sm:inline">Làm mới</span>
336:             </button>
337:           )}
338: 
339:           {canEdit && (
340:             <button
341:               type="button"
342:               onClick={handleOpenCreate}
343:               data-testid="create-branch-button"
344:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white rounded-xl shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"
345:             >
346:               <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
347:               <span>Thêm chi nhánh</span>
348:             </button>
349:           )}
350:         </div>
351:       </div>
352: 
353:       {/* Forbidden Warning Banner */}
354:       {!canEdit && (
355:         <div
356:           className="bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-start gap-3"
357:           data-testid="branch-forbidden-banner"
358:         >
359:           <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
360:           <div>
361:             <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-900">Giới hạn quyền cấu hình chi nhánh</h4>
362:             <p className="text-xs text-amber-700 mt-0.5">
363:               Tài khoản của bạn chỉ có quyền xem danh sách chi nhánh. Cần quyền cấu hình cửa hàng
364:               (iam:shop_config) để thêm hoặc chỉnh sửa chi nhánh.
365:             </p>
366:           </div>
367:         </div>
368:       )}
369: 
370:       {/* Store Scoped Info Banner */}
371:       {isRestrictedScope && (
372:         <div
373:           className="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-start gap-3"
374:           data-testid="branch-scoped-banner"
375:         >
376:           <Info className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
377:           <div>
378:             <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-900">Phạm vi truy cập theo phân quyền</h4>
379:             <p className="text-xs text-blue-700 mt-0.5">
380:               Bạn đang xem các chi nhánh được phân quyền theo tài khoản ({scopedStores?.join(', ')}
381:               ). Các chi nhánh ngoài danh sách phân quyền đã được ẩn server-side.
382:             </p>
383:           </div>
384:         </div>
385:       )}
386: 
387:       {/* Server Error Banner with Retry */}
388:       {viewError && (
389:         <div
390:           className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
391:           data-testid="branch-error-banner"
392:         >
393:           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
394:             <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
395:             <div>
396:               <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-900">Thông báo lỗi</h4>
397:               <p className="text-xs text-rose-700 mt-0.5">{viewError}</p>
398:             </div>
399:           </div>
400:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
401:             {onRefresh && (
402:               <button
403:                 type="button"
404:                 onClick={onRefresh}
405:                 data-testid="retry-error-button"
406:                 className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold bg-white text-rose-700 border border-rose-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-rose-100 transition cursor-pointer"
407:               >
408:                 <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
409:                 <span>Thử lại</span>
410:               </button>
411:             )}
412:             <button
413:               type="button"
414:               onClick={() => setViewError(null)}
415:               data-testid="dismiss-error-button"
416:               aria-label="Đóng thông báo lỗi"
417:               title="Đóng thông báo lỗi"
418:               className="p-1 text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 transition cursor-pointer"
419:             >
420:               <X className="w-4 h-4" />
421:             </button>
422:           </div>
423:         </div>
424:       )}
425: 
426:       {/* Success Banner */}
427:       {viewSuccess && (
428:         <div
429:           className="bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
430:           data-testid="branch-success-banner"
431:         >
432:           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
433:             <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
434:             <p className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-900">{viewSuccess}</p>
435:           </div>
436:           <button
437:             type="button"
438:             onClick={() => setViewSuccess(null)}
439:             data-testid="dismiss-success-button"
440:             aria-label="Đóng thông báo thành công"
441:             title="Đóng thông báo thành công"
442:             className="p-1 text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-800 transition cursor-pointer"
443:           >
444:             <X className="w-4 h-4" />
445:           </button>
446:         </div>
447:       )}
448: 
449:       {/* Filter and Search Bar */}
450:       <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
451:         {/* Status Tabs */}
452:         <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-xl">
453:           <button
454:             type="button"
455:             onClick={() => setStatusFilter('ALL')}
456:             data-testid="filter-tab-all"
457:             className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer ${
458:               statusFilter === 'ALL'
459:                 ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs'
460:                 : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
461:             }`}
462:           >
463:             Tất cả ({branches.length})
464:           </button>
465:           <button
466:             type="button"
467:             onClick={() => setStatusFilter('ACTIVE')}
468:             data-testid="filter-tab-active"
469:             className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer ${
470:               statusFilter === 'ACTIVE'
471:                 ? 'bg-white text-emerald-700 shadow-xs font-bold'
472:                 : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
473:             }`}
474:           >
475:             Đang hoạt động ({activeCount})
476:           </button>
477:           <button
478:             type="button"
479:             onClick={() => setStatusFilter('INACTIVE')}
480:             data-testid="filter-tab-inactive"
481:             className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer ${
482:               statusFilter === 'INACTIVE'
483:                 ? 'bg-white text-slate-700 shadow-xs font-bold'
484:                 : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
485:             }`}
486:           >
487:             Tạm ngưng ({inactiveCount})
488:           </button>
489:         </div>
490: 
491:         {/* Search Input */}
492:         <div className="relative w-full sm:w-72">
493:           <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
494:           <input
495:             id="branch-search-input"
496:             type="text"
497:             value={searchQuery}
498:             onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
499:             placeholder="Tìm theo tên, mã, SĐT..."
500:             aria-label="Tìm kiếm chi nhánh theo tên, mã hoặc số điện thoại"
501:             data-testid="branch-search-input"
502:             className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/20 focus:border-orange-500 transition"
503:           />
504:           {searchQuery && (
505:             <button
506:               type="button"
507:               onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
508:               aria-label="Xóa từ khóa tìm kiếm"
509:               title="Xóa từ khóa tìm kiếm"
510:               className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
511:             >
512:               <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
513:             </button>
514:           )}
515:         </div>
516:       </div>
517: 
518:       {/* Branch List or Empty State */}
519:       {filteredBranches.length === 0 ? (
520:         <div
521:           className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-12 text-center shadow-xs space-y-4"
522:           data-testid="branch-empty-state"
523:         >
524:           <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
525:             <Building2 className="w-8 h-8" />
526:           </div>
527:           <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
528:             <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
529:               {searchQuery || statusFilter !== 'ALL'
530:                 ? 'Không tìm thấy chi nhánh phù hợp'
531:                 : 'Chưa có chi nhánh nào'}
532:             </h3>
533:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
534:               {searchQuery || statusFilter !== 'ALL'
535:                 ? 'Thử thay đổi bộ lọc trạng thái hoặc từ khóa tìm kiếm để tìm chi nhánh cần thiết.'
536:                 : 'Tạo chi nhánh đầu tiên để thiết lập điểm lấy hàng, kho lưu trữ và giới hạn quyền vận hành.'}
537:             </p>
538:           </div>
539:           {canEdit && (
540:             <div>
541:               <button
542:                 type="button"
543:                 onClick={handleOpenCreate}
544:                 data-testid="empty-create-branch-button"
545:                 className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white rounded-xl shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"
546:               >
547:                 <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
548:                 <span>Tạo chi nhánh đầu tiên</span>
549:               </button>
550:             </div>
551:           )}
552:         </div>
553:       ) : (
554:         <div
555:           className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6"
556:           data-testid="branch-list-grid"
557:         >
558:           {filteredBranches.map((branch) => {
559:             const isDefault = branch.is_default;
560:             const isActive = branch.status === 'ACTIVE';
561:             const isOperating = actionLoadingId === branch.id;
562: 
563:             return (
564:               <div
565:                 key={branch.id}
566:                 data-testid={`branch-item-${branch.id}`}
567:                 className={`bg-white border rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xs transition flex flex-col justify-between ${
568:                   isDefault
569:                     ? 'border-orange-300 ring-1 ring-orange-400/30'
570:                     : 'border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300'
571:                 }`}
572:               >
573:                 <div className="space-y-3">
574:                   {/* Card Header: Badges & Code */}
575:                   <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
576:                     <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
577:                       {branch.code}
578:                     </span>
579:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
580:                       {isDefault && (
581:                         <span
582:                           data-testid={`default-badge-${branch.id}`}
583:                           className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border border-orange-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md"
584:                         >
585:                           <Star className="w-3 h-3 fill-orange-500 text-orange-500" />
586:                           Mặc định
587:                         </span>
588:                       )}
589:                       <span
590:                         data-testid={`status-badge-${branch.id}`}
591:                         className={`text-[11px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border ${
592:                           isActive
593:                             ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
594:                             : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200'
595:                         }`}
596:                       >
597:                         {isActive ? 'Đang hoạt động' : 'Tạm ngưng'}
598:                       </span>
599:                     </div>
600:                   </div>
601: 
602:                   {/* Branch Name */}
603:                   <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 line-clamp-1" title={branch.name}>
604:                     {branch.name}
605:                   </h3>
606:

666:                       className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed ${

829:                     {validationErrors.phone}

834:               {/* Address */}

848:                   data-testid="input-branch-address"
849:                   className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-white border rounded-xl focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/20 focus:border-orange-500 transition ${
850:                     validationErrors.address ? 'border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/20' : 'border-slate-300'
851:                   }`}
852:                 />
853:                 {validationErrors.address && (
854:                   <p
855:                     className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-600 mt-1"
856:                     data-testid="error-branch-address"
857:                   >
858:                     {validationErrors.address}
859:                   </p>
860:                 )}
861:               </div>
862: 
863:               {/* Options: Default & Status */}
864:               <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-3">
865:                 <label

874:                     data-testid="input-branch-default"
875:                     className="w-4 h-4 rounded-sm border-slate-300 text-orange-600 focus:ring-orange-500"
876:                   />
877:                   <div>
878:                     <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
879:                       Đặt làm chi nhánh mặc định
880:                     </span>
881:                     <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
882:                       Chi nhánh mặc định sẽ được chọn tự động khi tạo đơn hàng mới nếu không chỉ
883:                       định.
884:                     </p>
885:                   </div>
886:                 </label>
887: 
888:                 <div>
889:                   <label
890:                     htmlFor="input-branch-status"
891:                     className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1"
892:                   >
893:                     Trạng thái hoạt động

895:                   <select

903:                   >
904:                     <option value="ACTIVE">Đang hoạt động (ACTIVE)</option>
