<file path="apps/web/src/components/ClaimCasesTab.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import { UIClaimItem } from './types';
  5: import { TrackingCode, Money, StatusBadge, AutomationBadge } from './ui/OperationalComponents';
  6: import {
  7:   FileText,
  8:   Clock,
  9:   Download,
 10:   Plus,
 11:   Search,
 12:   ShieldCheck,
 13:   AlertTriangle,
 14:   Send,
 15:   Archive,
 16: } from 'lucide-react';
 17: 
 18: interface Props {
 19:   claims: UIClaimItem[];
 20:   onUpdateClaim: (updated: UIClaimItem) => void;
 21:   selectedClaimId?: string | null;
 22:   selectedClaimCode?: string | null;
 23:   onClearSelection?: () => void;
 24: }
 25: 
 26: export const ClaimCasesTab: React.FC<Props> = ({
 27:   claims,
 28:   onUpdateClaim,
 29:   selectedClaimId,
 30:   selectedClaimCode,
 31:   onClearSelection,
 32: }) => {
 33:   const [dismissedClaim, setDismissedClaim] = useState(false);
 34:   const [prevSelectedClaimCode, setPrevSelectedClaimCode] = useState(selectedClaimCode);
 35:   const [prevSelectedClaimId, setPrevSelectedClaimId] = useState(selectedClaimId);
 36: 
 37:   if (prevSelectedClaimCode !== selectedClaimCode || prevSelectedClaimId !== selectedClaimId) {
 38:     setPrevSelectedClaimCode(selectedClaimCode);
 39:     setPrevSelectedClaimId(selectedClaimId);
 40:     setDismissedClaim(false);
 41:   }
 42: 
 43:   const activeClaimId = dismissedClaim ? null : selectedClaimId;
 44:   const activeClaimCode = dismissedClaim ? null : selectedClaimCode;
 45: 
 46:   const [userSearchQuery, setUserSearchQuery] = useState<string | null>(null);
 47:   const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
 48: 
 49:   const handleDownloadProofZip = (claim: UIClaimItem) => {
 50:     setToastMessage(
 51:       `✓ Đang tải gói chứng cứ tự động [claim_${claim.tracking_code}_sha256.zip] gồm: Lịch sử hành trình, ghi âm CSKH, ảnh chụp nhận kho và sao kê (CN-16).`
 52:     );
 53:     setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 4500);
 54:   };
 55: 
 56:   const handleAcceptClaim = (claim: UIClaimItem) => {
 57:     const updated = {
 58:       ...claim,
 59:       status: 'ACCEPTED' as any,
 60:       accepted_amount: claim.requested_amount,
 61:     };
 62:     onUpdateClaim(updated);
 63:     setToastMessage(
 64:       `✓ Hãng đã chấp thuận bồi thường ${claim.requested_amount.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ cho đơn ${claim.tracking_code}.`
 65:     );
 66:     setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 4000);
 67:   };
 68: 
 69:   const allClaims = [...claims];
 70:   const isClaimActivated = Boolean(activeClaimId || activeClaimCode);
 71:   const matchedClaim = isClaimActivated
 72:     ? allClaims.find(
 73:         (c) =>
 74:           (activeClaimId && c.id === activeClaimId) ||
 75:           (activeClaimCode &&
 76:             (c.tracking_code === activeClaimCode || c.carrier_ticket === activeClaimCode))
 77:       )
 78:     : null;
 79:   const isClaimNotFound = isClaimActivated && !matchedClaim;
 80: 
 81:   const effectiveQuery = userSearchQuery ?? (activeClaimCode || '');
 82:   const setSearchQuery = (term: string) => setUserSearchQuery(term);
 83: 
 84:   const handleClearClaimSelection = () => {
 85:     setDismissedClaim(true);
 86:     setUserSearchQuery('');
 87:     onClearSelection?.();
 88:   };
 89: 
 90:   const filteredClaims = allClaims.filter(
 91:     (c) =>
 92:       c.tracking_code.toLowerCase().includes(effectiveQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
 93:       (c.carrier_ticket && c.carrier_ticket.toLowerCase().includes(effectiveQuery.toLowerCase()))
 94:   );
 95: 
 96:   return (
 97:     <div className="w-full space-y-6">
 98:       {toastMessage && (
 99:         <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm animate-in fade-in">
100:           <span>{toastMessage}</span>
101:           <button type="button" onClick={() => setToastMessage(null)} className="font-bold">
102:             ✕
103:           </button>
104:         </div>
105:       )}
106: 
107:       {/* Activated Claim Not Found Alert (Real Not-Found State with Recovery) */}
108:       {isClaimNotFound && (
109:         <div
110:           data-testid="activated-claim-not-found"
111:           className="p-4 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-amber-900"
112:         >
113:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
114:             <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
115:             <div>
116:               <div className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm">
117:                 Không tìm thấy hồ sơ khiếu nại{' '}
118:                 <span className="font-mono underline">{selectedClaimCode || selectedClaimId}</span>
119:               </div>
120:               <div className="text-xs text-amber-700">
121:                 Hồ sơ không tồn tại trong danh sách khiếu nại hiện tại hoặc nằm ngoài phạm vi truy
122:                 cập của bạn.
123:               </div>
124:             </div>
125:           </div>
126:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
127:             <button
128:               type="button"
129:               onClick={handleClearClaimSelection}
130:               className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-amber-300 text-amber-900 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-amber-100 transition"
131:             >
132:               Quay lại danh sách
133:             </button>
134:           </div>
135:         </div>
136:       )}
137: 
138:       {/* Header Bar */}
139:       <div className="modern-card p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
140:         <div>
141:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
142:             <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
143:               <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
144:               Quản Lý Hồ Sơ Khiếu Nại Hãng (CN-16 · CN-17)
145:             </h2>
146:             <span className="badge-ok text-xs">Thời Hiệu BR-37</span>
147:           </div>
148:           <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
149:             Tự động tập hợp chứng cứ và giám sát hạn chót khiếu nại trước thời hiệu 48 giờ để không
150:             bị mất quyền đòi tiền
151:           </p>
152:         </div>
153: 
154:         <div className="relative min-w-[260px]">
155:           <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
156:           <input
157:             type="text"
158:             value={effectiveQuery}
159:             onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
160:             placeholder="Tìm theo mã vận đơn hoặc ticket..."
161:             className="modern-input pl-9 w-full text-xs"
162:           />
163:         </div>
164:       </div>
165: 
166:       {/* Main Claims Table */}
167:       <div className="modern-card overflow-hidden">
168:         <div className="overflow-x-auto">
169:           <table className="modern-table">
170:             <thead>
171:               <tr>
172:                 <th>Mã Vận Đơn</th>
173:                 <th>Mã Ticket Hãng</th>
174:                 <th>Loại Khiếu Nại</th>
175:                 <th className="text-right">Tiền Yêu Cầu</th>
176:                 <th className="text-right">Hãng Chấp Thuận</th>
177:                 <th>Thời Hiệu Còn Lại (BR-37)</th>
178:                 <th>Trạng Thái</th>
179:                 <th className="text-right">Thao Tác Chứng Cứ</th>
180:               </tr>
181:             </thead>
182:             <tbody>
183:               {filteredClaims.map((c) => {
184:                 const isUrgent = c.hours_left <= 48 && c.status !== 'CLOSED';
185:                 const isSelected = Boolean(
186:                   matchedClaim &&
187:                   ((activeClaimId && c.id === activeClaimId) ||
188:                     (activeClaimCode &&
189:                       (c.tracking_code === activeClaimCode ||
190:                         c.carrier_ticket === activeClaimCode)))
191:                 );
192:                 const selectedKey = activeClaimId || activeClaimCode;
193:                 return (
194:                   <tr
195:                     key={c.id}
196:                     data-selected={isSelected ? 'true' : undefined}
197:                     data-testid={isSelected ? `selected-claim-${selectedKey}` : undefined}
198:                     className={
199:                       isSelected ? 'bg-orange-50/70 border-l-4 border-l-[#c23807]' : undefined
200:                     }
201:                   >
202:                     <td>
203:                       <TrackingCode code={c.tracking_code} />
204:                     </td>
205:                     <td className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
206:                       {c.carrier_ticket || 'Chờ sinh ticket'}
207:                     </td>
208:                     <td>
209:                       <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-800">
210:                         {c.claim_type === 'FEE'
211:                           ? 'Lệch cước hợp đồng'
212:                           : c.claim_type === 'DAMAGED'
213:                             ? 'Hàng hoàn hư hỏng'
214:                             : c.claim_type === 'LOST'
215:                               ? 'Thất lạc kiện'
216:                               : 'Lệch COD'}
217:                       </span>
218:                     </td>
219:                     <td className="text-right font-bold text-xs">
220:                       <Money amount={c.requested_amount} state="confirmed" />
221:                     </td>
222:                     <td className="text-right text-xs">
223:                       <Money amount={c.accepted_amount} state="pending" />
224:                     </td>
225:                     <td>
226:                       <span
227:                         className={
228:                           isUrgent
229:                             ? 'badge-risk font-mono font-bold text-[10px]'
230:                             : 'badge-muted font-mono text-[10px]'
231:                         }
232:                       >
233:                         {isUrgent ? `CÒN ${c.hours_left}H (!)` : `Còn ${c.hours_left}h`}
234:                       </span>
235:                     </td>
236:                     <td>
237:                       <StatusBadge status={c.status} />
238:                     </td>
239:                     <td className="text-right">
240:                       <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
241:                         <button
242:                           type="button"
243:                           onClick={() => handleDownloadProofZip(c)}
244:                           className="btn-secondary text-[11px] py-1"
245:                           title="Tải gói file ZIP bằng chứng SHA-256 (CN-16)"
246:                         >
247:                           <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
248:                           <span>Tải ZIP</span>
249:                         </button>
250: 
251:                         {c.status === 'SUBMITTED' && (
252:                           <button
253:                             type="button"
254:                             onClick={() => handleAcceptClaim(c)}
255:                             className="btn-primary text-[11px] py-1 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 border-emerald-700"
256:                           >
257:                             Hãng chấp thuận
258:                           </button>
259:                         )}
260:                       </div>
261:                     </td>
262:                   </tr>
263:                 );
264:               })}
265:             </tbody>
266:           </table>
267:         </div>
268:       </div>
269:     </div>
270:   );
271: };
</file>

271:                 </button>

273:             ))}
274:           </div>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/CreateOrderModal.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import {
  5:   PackagePlus,
  6:   X,
  7:   Check,
  8:   Truck,
  9:   DollarSign,
 10:   Clock,
 11:   ShieldCheck,
 12:   MapPin,
 13:   Scale,
 14:   Sparkles,
 15:   ArrowRight,
 16:   Info,
 17:   Store,
 18: } from 'lucide-react';
 19: import { Money, AutomationBadge } from './ui/OperationalComponents';
 20: import { MASTER_SHIPMENTS, UnifiedShipment } from '@/services/unifiedDataStore';
 21: 
 22: interface Props {
 23:   isOpen: boolean;
 24:   onClose: () => void;
 25:   onOrderCreated: (newShipment: UnifiedShipment) => void;
 26: }
 27: 
 28: export const CreateOrderModal: React.FC<Props> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onOrderCreated }) => {
 29:   // Order information
 30:   // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/purity -- Legacy prototype random order code generator
 31:   const [orderCode, setOrderCode] = useState(`ORD_${Math.floor(Math.random() * 89999) + 10000}`);
 32:   const [pickupWarehouse, setPickupWarehouse] = useState('store_01');
 33:   const [recipientName, setRecipientName] = useState('Nguyễn Văn Khách');
 34:   const [recipientPhone, setRecipientPhone] = useState('0901234567');
 35:   const [recipientProvince, setRecipientProvince] = useState<'HCM' | 'HN' | 'OTHER'>('HCM');
 36:   const [recipientDistrict, setRecipientDistrict] = useState('Quận 3');
 37:   const [recipientAddress, setRecipientAddress] = useState('128 Nguyễn Trãi, Phường 3');
 38:   const [itemName, setItemName] = useState('Váy lụa thiết kế cao cấp (Size M)');
 39: 
 40:   // Package specifications
 41:   const [weightGram, setWeightGram] = useState<number>(350);
 42:   const [lengthCm, setLengthCm] = useState<number>(20);
 43:   const [widthCm, setWidthCm] = useState<number>(15);
 44:   const [heightCm, setHeightCm] = useState<number>(5);
 45:   const [codAmount, setCodAmount] = useState<number>(450000);
 46:   const [insuranceValue, setInsuranceValue] = useState<number>(450000);
 47:   const [payer, setPayer] = useState<'SENDER' | 'RECEIVER'>('RECEIVER');
 48:   const [inspectionNote, setInspectionNote] = useState<
 49:     'CHO_XEM_HANG' | 'CHO_THU_HANG' | 'KHONG_CHO_XEM'
 50:   >('CHO_XEM_HANG');
 51: 
 52:   // Selected Carrier
 53:   const [selectedCarrier, setSelectedCarrier] = useState<'GHN' | 'GHTK'>('GHN');
 54:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
 55:   const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
 56: 
 57:   if (!isOpen) return null;
 58: 
 59:   // Volumetric weight formula: (L x W x H) / 5000 * 1000 (in grams)
 60:   const volumetricWeightGram = Math.round(((lengthCm * widthCm * heightCm) / 5000) * 1000);
 61:   const chargeableWeightGram = Math.max(weightGram, volumetricWeightGram);
 62: 
 63:   // Dynamic Rate Comparison Engine across Connected Carriers
 64:   const isIntraProvince = recipientProvince === 'HCM';
 65: 
 66:   const carriersComparison = [
 67:     {
 68:       id: 'GHN' as const,
 69:       name: 'Giao Hàng Nhanh (GHN Express)',
 70:       baseFee: isIntraProvince ? 22000 : 32000,
 71:       addWeightFee:
 72:         chargeableWeightGram > 1000 ? Math.ceil((chargeableWeightGram - 1000) / 500) * 5000 : 0,
 73:       insuranceFee: insuranceValue > 1000000 ? Math.round(insuranceValue * 0.005) : 0,
 74:       codFee: 0,
 75:       deliveryTime: isIntraProvince ? 'Hỏa tốc trong 24h (Sáng mai)' : '1 - 2 ngày làm việc',
 76:       tier: 'L2' as const,
 77:       tierLabel: 'Tự động gọi API (L2)',
 78:       badge: '⚡ Giao Nhanh Nhất',
 79:       badgeColor: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200',
 80:       logoBg: 'bg-[#FFF5F0] text-[#c23807]',
 81:     },
 82:     {
 83:       id: 'GHTK' as const,
 84:       name: 'Giao Hàng Tiết Kiệm (GHTK)',
 85:       baseFee: isIntraProvince ? 24000 : 34000,
 86:       addWeightFee:
 87:         chargeableWeightGram > 1000 ? Math.ceil((chargeableWeightGram - 1000) / 500) * 6000 : 0,
 88:       insuranceFee: insuranceValue > 1000000 ? Math.round(insuranceValue * 0.005) : 0,
 89:       codFee: 0,
 90:       deliveryTime: isIntraProvince ? '1 - 2 ngày làm việc' : '2 - 3 ngày làm việc',
 91:       tier: 'L1' as const,
 92:       tierLabel: 'Hỗ trợ cổng hãng (L1)',
 93:       badge: 'Phổ Biến Tuyến Huyện',
 94:       badgeColor: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200',
 95:       logoBg: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700',
 96:     },
 97:   ].map((c) => ({
 98:     ...c,
 99:     totalFee: c.baseFee + c.addWeightFee + c.insuranceFee + c.codFee,
100:   }));
101: 
102:   const activeCarrierInfo =
103:     carriersComparison.find((c) => c.id === selectedCarrier) || carriersComparison[0];
104: 
105:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
106:     e.preventDefault();
107:     if (!recipientName.trim() || !recipientPhone.trim()) {
108:       setErrorMsg('Vui lòng điền họ tên và số điện thoại người nhận.');
109:       return;
110:     }
111: 
112:     setLoading(true);
113:     setErrorMsg(null);
114: 
115:     const generatedTracking = `${selectedCarrier}8829${Math.floor(Math.random() * 89999) + 10000}`;
116:     const provinceName =
117:       recipientProvince === 'HCM'
118:         ? 'TP. Hồ Chí Minh'
119:         : recipientProvince === 'HN'
120:           ? 'Hà Nội'
121:           : 'Đà Nẵng';
122: 
123:     const newShipment: UnifiedShipment = {
124:       id: `shp_${Date.now()}`,
125:       tracking_code: generatedTracking,
126:       order_code: orderCode,
127:       carrier_code: selectedCarrier,
128:       carrier_account: selectedCarrier === 'GHN' ? 'acc_ghn_01' : 'acc_ghtk_01',
129:       recipient_name: recipientName,
130:       recipient_phone: recipientPhone,
131:       recipient_address: `${recipientAddress}, ${recipientDistrict}`,
132:       destination_province: provinceName,
133:       cod_amount: Number(codAmount),
134:       quoted_fee: activeCarrierInfo.totalFee,
135:       declared_weight_g: Number(chargeableWeightGram),
136:       status: 'picking',
137:       match_status: 'matched_exact',
138:       warehouse_id: pickupWarehouse,
139:       created_at:
140:         new Date().toLocaleDateString('vi-VN') + ' ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN'),
141:       updated_at:

143:       has_open_exception: false,
144:       has_open_discrepancy: false,

507:                               {carrier.badge}
508:                             </span>
509:                           </div>
510:                         </div>
511: 
512:                         {/* Fee breakdown on selected */}

515:                             <span>
516:                               Cước gốc:{' '}
517:                               <Money

531:                             <AutomationBadge tier={carrier.tier} />

533:                         )}

536:                   })}

538:               </div>

541:               <div className="p-5 bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl space-y-4 shadow-lg">

561:                     </div>

563: 
564:                   <div className="text-right">
565:                     <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">
566:                       Tiền Thu Hộ COD:
567:                     </span>
568:                     <div className="font-mono text-lg font-bold text-white">
569:                       <Money amount={codAmount} state="confirmed" className="text-white text-lg" />
570:                     </div>

572:                 </div>

574:                 <button

588:                       <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />

<file path="apps/web/src/components/GlobalSearchModal.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';

  5:   Search,
  6:   Package,
  7:   Truck,
  8:   FileSpreadsheet,

 10:   DollarSign,

 25:   initialQuery?: string;

 40: 
 41: const FILTER_TABS: Array<{
 42:   id: SearchEntityType;
 43:   label: string;
 44:   icon: React.FC<{ className?: string }>;
 45: }> = [
 46:   { id: 'ALL', label: 'Tất cả', icon: Search },
 47:   { id: 'ORDER', label: 'Đơn hàng', icon: Package },
 48:   { id: 'WAYBILL', label: 'Vận đơn', icon: Truck },
 49:   { id: 'BATCH', label: 'Bảng kê', icon: FileSpreadsheet },
 50:   { id: 'CASE', label: 'Khiếu nại / Ngoại lệ', icon: AlertTriangle },
 51:   { id: 'TRANSACTION', label: 'Lệch cước', icon: DollarSign },
 52: ];
 53: 
 54: function getItemIcon(type: string) {
 55:   switch (type) {
 56:     case 'ORDER':
 57:       return { icon: Package, color: 'text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 border-blue-200' };
 58:     case 'WAYBILL':
 59:       return { icon: Truck, color: 'text-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-200' };
 60:     case 'BATCH':
 61:       return { icon: FileSpreadsheet, color: 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200' };
 62:     case 'CASE':
 63:       return { icon: AlertTriangle, color: 'text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 border-amber-200' };
 64:     case 'TRANSACTION':
 65:       return { icon: DollarSign, color: 'text-teal-600 bg-teal-50 border-teal-200' };
 66:     default:
 67:       return { icon: Package, color: 'text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 border-slate-200' };
 68:   }
 69: }
 70: 
 71: export const GlobalSearchContent: React.FC<GlobalSearchProps> = ({
 72:   onClose,
 73:   onSelectResult,

 75:   initialType = 'ALL',

 77:   initialItems,
 78:   initialTotal,
