 80:   initialForbidden = false,
 81:   initialForbiddenMessage = null,
 82:   initialValidationMessage = null,
 83:   initialHasSearched,
 84:   initialIsPartial = false,
 85:   initialCanAccessRecon = true,
 86:   apiBase,
 87:   standalone = false,
 88: }) => {
 89:   const [query, setQuery] = useState<string>(initialQuery);
 90:   const [activeType, setActiveType] = useState<SearchEntityType>(initialType);
 91:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(initialLoading);
 92:   const [items, setItems] = useState<SearchResultItem[]>(initialItems ?? []);
 93:   const [total, setTotal] = useState<number>(
 94:     initialTotal ?? (initialItems ? initialItems.length : 0)
 95:   );
 96:   const [hasSearched, setHasSearched] = useState<boolean>(
 97:     initialHasSearched ?? (initialItems !== undefined || initialError !== null || initialForbidden)
 98:   );
 99:   const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState<string | null>(initialValidationMessage);
100:   const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(initialError);
101:   const [isForbidden, setIsForbidden] = useState<boolean>(initialForbidden);
102:   const [forbiddenMsg, setForbiddenMsg] = useState<string | null>(initialForbiddenMessage);
103:   const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState<number>(0);
104:   const [isPartialNotice, setIsPartialNotice] = useState<boolean>(initialIsPartial);
105: 
106:   const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
107:   const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
108:   const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
109: 
110:   const resolvedApiBase =
111:     apiBase ||
112:     (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env?.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL) ||
113:     'http://localhost:3001';
114: 
115:   // Execute search API request
116:   const executeSearch = useCallback(
117:     async (searchTerm: string, filterType: SearchEntityType) => {
118:       const trimmed = searchTerm.trim();
119:       if (!trimmed) {
120:         setItems([]);
121:         setTotal(0);
122:         setValidationError(null);
123:         setErrorMsg(null);
124:         setIsForbidden(false);
125:         setHasSearched(false);
126:         setLoading(false);
127:         return;
128:       }
129: 
130:       if (trimmed.length < 2) {
131:         setValidationError('Vui lòng nhập ít nhất 2 ký tự để bắt đầu tìm kiếm');
132:         setItems([]);
133:         setTotal(0);
134:         setLoading(false);
135:         return;
136:       }
137: 
138:       setValidationError(null);
139:       setErrorMsg(null);
140:       setIsForbidden(false);
141:       setForbiddenMsg(null);
142:       setLoading(true);
143: 
144:       if (abortControllerRef.current) {
145:         abortControllerRef.current.abort();
146:       }
147:       const controller = new AbortController();
148:       abortControllerRef.current = controller;
149: 
150:       try {
151:         const token = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('shipde_token') : null;
152:         const url = new URL(`${resolvedApiBase}/api/v1/search`);
153:         url.searchParams.set('q', trimmed);
154:         if (filterType && filterType !== 'ALL') {
155:           url.searchParams.set('type', filterType);
156:         }
157: 
158:         const headers: Record<string, string> = {
159:           Accept: 'application/json',
160:         };
161:         if (token) {
162:           headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
163:         }
164: 
165:         const res = await fetch(url.toString(), {
166:           headers,
167:           signal: controller.signal,
168:         });
169: 
170:         if (res.status === 403) {
171:           const errData = await res.json().catch(() => null);
172:           setIsForbidden(true);
173:           setForbiddenMsg(
174:             errData?.error?.message ||
175:               'Bạn không có quyền truy cập dữ liệu đối soát bảng kê hoặc lệch cước tài chính (yêu cầu quyền reconciliation:view_contract_rates hoặc reconciliation:run_review_audit).'
176:           );
177:           setItems([]);
178:           setTotal(0);
179:           setHasSearched(true);
180:           return;
181:         }
182: 
183:         if (!res.ok) {
184:           const errData = await res.json().catch(() => null);
185:           setErrorMsg(
186:             errData?.error?.message ||
187:               'Không thể tải kết quả tìm kiếm từ máy chủ. Vui lòng thử lại.'
188:           );
189:           setItems([]);
190:           setTotal(0);
191:           setHasSearched(true);
192:           return;
193:         }
194: 
195:         const data: SearchResponse = await res.json();
196:         const returnedItems = data.data?.items || [];
197:         const returnedTotal = data.data?.total || returnedItems.length;
198: 
199:         setItems(returnedItems);
200:         setTotal(returnedTotal);
201:         setHasSearched(true);
202:         setSelectedIndex(0);
203: 
204:         // Check if partial results notice is appropriate
205:         const isLimited = returnedTotal > returnedItems.length;
206:         setIsPartialNotice(isLimited);
207:       } catch (err: any) {
208:         if (err?.name === 'AbortError') return;
209:         setErrorMsg(
210:           'Lỗi kết nối mạng khi tìm kiếm. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại đường truyền và thử lại.'
211:         );
212:         setItems([]);
213:         setTotal(0);
214:         setHasSearched(true);
215:       } finally {
216:         setLoading(false);
217:       }
218:     },
219:     [resolvedApiBase]
220:   );
221: 
222:   // Debounced input change
223:   useEffect(() => {
224:     // Skip automatic live query when initial values are provided in test mode without user interaction
225:     if (initialItems !== undefined || initialError !== null || initialForbidden) {
226:       return;
227:     }
228: 
229:     const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
230:       const trimmed = query.trim();
231:       if (!trimmed) {
232:         setItems([]);
233:         setTotal(0);
234:         setValidationError(null);
235:         setErrorMsg(null);
236:         setIsForbidden(false);
237:         setHasSearched(false);
238:         return;
239:       }
240: 
241:       if (trimmed.length < 2) {
242:         setValidationError('Vui lòng nhập ít nhất 2 ký tự để bắt đầu tìm kiếm');
243:         setItems([]);
244:         setTotal(0);
245:         return;
246:       }
247: 
248:       setValidationError(null);
249:       executeSearch(query, activeType);
250:     }, 250);
251: 
252:     return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
253:   }, [query, activeType, executeSearch, initialItems, initialError, initialForbidden]);
254: 
255:   // Handle item click / enter activation
256:   const handleSelectItem = (item: SearchResultItem) => {
257:     if (onSelectResult) {
258:       onSelectResult(item);
259:     } else if (item.url && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
260:       window.location.assign(item.url);
261:     }
262:   };
263: 
264:   // Keyboard navigation
265:   const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
266:     if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
267:       e.preventDefault();
268:       setSelectedIndex((prev) => (items.length > 0 ? (prev + 1) % items.length : 0));
269:     } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
270:       e.preventDefault();
271:       setSelectedIndex((prev) => (items.length > 0 ? (prev - 1 + items.length) % items.length : 0));
272:     } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
273:       e.preventDefault();
274:       if (items.length > 0 && selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < items.length) {
275:         handleSelectItem(items[selectedIndex]);
276:       } else if (query.trim().length >= 2) {
277:         executeSearch(query, activeType);
278:       }
279:     } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
280:       e.preventDefault();
281:       onClose?.();
282:     }
283:   };
284: 
285:   // Scroll active item into view
286:   useEffect(() => {
287:     if (listRef.current && selectedIndex >= 0) {
288:       const activeEl = listRef.current.children[selectedIndex] as HTMLElement;
289:       if (activeEl?.scrollIntoView) {
290:         activeEl.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
291:       }
292:     }
293:   }, [selectedIndex]);
294: 
295:   // Handle retry recovery action
296:   const handleRetry = () => {
297:     executeSearch(query, activeType);
298:   };
299: 
300:   // Handle forbidden recovery action (reset to ALL)
301:   const handleResetToAll = () => {
302:     setActiveType('ALL');
303:     setIsForbidden(false);
304:     setForbiddenMsg(null);
305:     executeSearch(query, 'ALL');
306:   };
307: 
308:   // Handle clear query
309:   const handleClearQuery = () => {
310:     setQuery('');
311:     setValidationError(null);
312:     setErrorMsg(null);
313:     setIsForbidden(false);
314:     setItems([]);
315:     setTotal(0);
316:     setHasSearched(false);
317:     inputRef.current?.focus();
318:   };
319: 
320:   return (
321:     <div
322:       data-testid="search-dialog"
323:       className={`flex flex-col bg-white overflow-hidden text-xs ${
324:         standalone
325:           ? 'rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xl'
326:           : 'rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-2xl max-w-2xl w-full'
327:       }`}
328:       onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
329:       role="dialog"
330:       aria-modal={!standalone ? 'true' : undefined}
331:       aria-label="Tìm kiếm toàn hệ thống"
332:     >
333:       {/* Search Header & Input */}
334:       <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70">
335:         <div className="relative flex items-center">
336:           <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#c23807] absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 shrink-0 pointer-events-none" />
337:           <input
338:             ref={inputRef}
339:             data-testid="search-input"
340:             type="text"
341:             role="searchbox"
342:             aria-label="Từ khóa tìm kiếm toàn hệ thống"
343:             aria-invalid={validationError ? 'true' : 'false'}
344:             aria-autocomplete="list"
345:             aria-controls="search-results-list"
346:             aria-activedescendant={
347:               items.length > 0 && selectedIndex >= 0
348:                 ? `search-item-${items[selectedIndex]?.id}`
349:                 : undefined
350:             }
351:             value={query}
352:             onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
353:             placeholder="Tìm theo mã đơn hàng, mã vận đơn, bảng kê, ngoại lệ, khách hàng..."
354:             className="w-full pl-10 pr-20 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#c23807]/20 focus:border-[#c23807] text-xs font-medium transition shadow-2xs"
355:             autoFocus
356:           />
357: 
358:           <div className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
359:             {query && (
360:               <button
361:                 type="button"
362:                 data-testid="search-clear-button"
363:                 onClick={handleClearQuery}
364:                 aria-label="Xóa từ khóa tìm kiếm"
365:                 className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer"
366:               >
367:                 <X className="w-3 h-3" />
368:               </button>
369:             )}
370: 
371:             {!standalone && (
372:               <button
373:                 type="button"
374:                 data-testid="search-close-button"
375:                 onClick={() => onClose?.()}
376:                 aria-label="Đóng hộp thoại tìm kiếm"
377:                 className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded border border-slate-200 transition cursor-pointer"
378:               >
379:                 Esc
380:               </button>
381:             )}
382:           </div>
383:         </div>
384: 
385:         {/* Validation Error Feedback */}
386:         {validationError && (
387:           <div
388:             data-testid="search-validation-error"
389:             role="alert"
390:             className="mt-2.5 px-3 py-2 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg text-amber-800 text-[11px] font-medium flex items-center justify-between animate-in fade-in duration-100"
391:           >
392:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
393:               <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
394:               <span>{validationError}</span>
395:             </div>
396:             <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-600 font-normal">Tối thiểu 2 ký tự</span>
397:           </div>
398:         )}
399: 
400:         {/* Entity Category Filter Tabs */}
401:         <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-3 overflow-x-auto pb-1 no-scrollbar">
402:           {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
403:             const Icon = tab.icon;
404:             const isActive = activeType === tab.id;
405:             return (
406:               <button
407:                 key={tab.id}
408:                 type="button"
409:                 data-testid={`type-filter-${tab.id}`}
410:                 aria-pressed={isActive}
411:                 onClick={() => {
412:                   setActiveType(tab.id);
413:                   if (query.trim().length >= 2) {
414:                     executeSearch(query, tab.id);
415:                   }
416:                 }}
417:                 className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer ${
418:                   isActive
419:                     ? 'bg-[#c23807] text-white shadow-2xs'
420:                     : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200'
421:                 }`}
422:               >
423:                 <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
424:                 <span>{tab.label}</span>
425:               </button>
426:             );
427:           })}
428:         </div>
429:       </div>
430: 
431:       {/* Main Content Area: Driven by Current UI State */}
432:       <div className="p-4 max-h-[460px] overflow-y-auto" aria-busy={loading ? 'true' : 'false'}>
433:         {/* 1. LOADING STATE */}
434:         {loading && (
435:           <div
436:             data-testid="search-loading-state"
437:             className="space-y-3 py-4 animate-in fade-in duration-100"
438:           >
439:             <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-slate-500 text-xs font-medium pb-2">
440:               <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 text-[#c23807] animate-spin" />
441:               <span>Đang tìm kiếm dữ liệu trên toàn hệ thống...</span>
442:             </div>
443:             {[1, 2, 3].map((n) => (
444:               <div
445:                 key={n}
446:                 data-testid="search-loading-skeleton"
447:                 className="p-3 border border-slate-100 rounded-xl bg-slate-50/50 flex items-center gap-3 animate-pulse"
448:               >
449:                 <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-slate-200 shrink-0" />
450:                 <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5">
451:                   <div className="h-3.5 bg-slate-200 rounded w-1/3" />
452:                   <div className="h-3 bg-slate-200 rounded w-2/3" />
453:                 </div>
454:                 <div className="h-5 w-16 bg-slate-200 rounded-full" />
455:               </div>
456:             ))}
457:           </div>
458:         )}
459: 
460:         {/* 2. FORBIDDEN STATE (403) */}
461:         {!loading && isForbidden && (
462:           <div
463:             data-testid="search-forbidden-state"
464:             role="alert"
465:             className="p-5 bg-rose-50/60 border border-rose-200 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-3 animate-in fade-in duration-150"
466:           >
467:             <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
468:               <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5" />
469:             </div>
470:             <div>
471:               <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs">Quyền Truy Cập Bị Từ Chối (403)</h3>
472:               <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 mt-1 max-w-md mx-auto">
473:                 {forbiddenMsg ||
474:                   'Bạn không có quyền truy cập dữ liệu đối soát bảng kê hoặc lệch cước tài chính (yêu cầu quyền reconciliation:view_contract_rates hoặc reconciliation:run_review_audit).'}
475:               </p>
476:             </div>
477:             {/* Recovery Action: Reset Filter */}
478:             <div className="pt-1">
479:               <button
480:                 type="button"
481:                 data-testid="forbidden-reset-filter-button"
482:                 onClick={handleResetToAll}
483:                 className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#c23807] hover:bg-[#a02e06] text-white font-semibold rounded-lg text-xs transition cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
484:               >
485:                 Quay lại danh mục Tất Cả
486:               </button>
487:             </div>
488:           </div>
489:         )}
490: 
491:         {/* 3. SERVER / NETWORK ERROR STATE */}
492:         {!loading && !isForbidden && errorMsg && (
493:           <div
494:             data-testid="search-error-state"
495:             role="alert"
496:             className="p-5 bg-amber-50/60 border border-amber-200 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-3 animate-in fade-in duration-150"
497:           >
498:             <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
499:               <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />
500:             </div>
501:             <div>
502:               <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs">Lỗi Truy Vấn Dữ Liệu</h3>
503:               <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 mt-1 max-w-md mx-auto">{errorMsg}</p>
504:             </div>
505:             {/* Recovery Action: Retry Button */}
506:             <div className="pt-1">
507:               <button
508:                 type="button"
509:                 data-testid="search-retry-button"
510:                 onClick={handleRetry}
511:                 className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-[#c23807] hover:bg-[#a02e06] text-white font-semibold rounded-lg text-xs transition cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs"
512:               >
513:                 <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
514:                 <span>Thử Lại</span>
515:               </button>
516:             </div>
517:           </div>
518:         )}
519: 
520:         {/* 4. EMPTY INITIAL STATE (No query entered yet) */}
521:         {!loading && !isForbidden && !errorMsg && !hasSearched && query.trim().length === 0 && (
522:           <div data-testid="search-empty-state" className="py-6 px-4 text-center space-y-4">
523:             <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-2xl bg-[#FFF5F0] text-[#c23807] flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-2xs border border-[#FDE8E0]">
524:               <Search className="w-5 h-5" />
525:             </div>
526:             <div className="space-y-1">
527:               <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">Tra Cứu Nhanh Toàn Hệ Thống</h3>
528:               <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs max-w-md mx-auto">
529:                 Nhập ít nhất 2 ký tự để tìm kiếm tức thì theo mã đơn, mã vận đơn hãng, bảng kê đối
530:                 soát, ngoại lệ giao hàng và lệch cước tài chính.
531:               </p>
532:             </div>
533: 
534:             {/* Quick Suggestions / Sample Tags */}
535:             <div className="pt-2">
536:               <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block mb-2">
537:                 Gợi ý tra cứu nhanh:
538:               </span>
539:               <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
540:                 {['ORD-', 'GHN', 'GHTK', 'Bảng kê', 'Ngoại lệ'].map((chip) => (
541:                   <button
542:                     key={chip}
543:                     type="button"
544:                     onClick={() => {
545:                       setQuery(chip);
546:                       inputRef.current?.focus();
547:                     }}
548:                     className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-xs font-medium transition cursor-pointer"
549:                   >
550:                     {chip}
551:                   </button>
552:                 ))}
553:               </div>
554:             </div>
555: 
556:             {/* Keyboard Guide */}
557:             <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center gap-4 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
558:               <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
559:                 <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 font-mono text-[10px]">
560:                   ↑
561:                 </kbd>
562:                 <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 font-mono text-[10px]">
563:                   ↓
564:                 </kbd>
565:                 <span>chọn kết quả</span>
566:               </span>
567:               <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
568:                 <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 font-mono text-[10px]">
569:                   Enter
570:                 </kbd>
571:                 <span>mở hồ sơ</span>
572:               </span>
573:               <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
574:                 <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 font-mono text-[10px]">
575:                   Esc
576:                 </kbd>
577:                 <span>đóng</span>
578:               </span>
579:             </div>
580:           </div>
581:         )}
582: 
583:         {/* 5. NO-RESULTS STATE (Search completed with 0 matches) */}
584:         {!loading &&
585:           !isForbidden &&
586:           !errorMsg &&
587:           hasSearched &&
588:           items.length === 0 &&
589:           !validationError && (
590:             <div data-testid="search-no-results-state" className="py-8 px-4 text-center space-y-3">
591:               <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
592:                 <Search className="w-5 h-5" />
593:               </div>
594:               <div>
595:                 <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs">
596:                   Không tìm thấy kết quả phù hợp cho &quot;{query}&quot;
597:                 </h3>
598:                 <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 max-w-sm mx-auto">
599:                   Kiểm tra lại chính tả từ khóa hoặc thử chuyển bộ lọc sang danh mục khác.
600:                 </p>
601:               </div>
602: 
603:               {/* Recovery Action: Clear Filter or Query */}
604:               <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-2">
605:                 {activeType !== 'ALL' && (
606:                   <button
607:                     type="button"
608:                     onClick={() => {
609:                       setActiveType('ALL');
610:                       executeSearch(query, 'ALL');
611:                     }}
612:                     className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-medium rounded-lg text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
613:                   >
614:                     Tìm trong Tất Cả danh mục
615:                   </button>
616:                 )}
617:                 <button
618:                   type="button"
619:                   onClick={handleClearQuery}
620:                   className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-medium rounded-lg text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
621:                 >
622:                   Xóa từ khóa
623:                 </button>
624:               </div>
625:             </div>
626:           )}
627: 
628:         {/* 6. SUCCESS & PARTIAL STATES (Results found) */}
629:         {!loading && !isForbidden && !errorMsg && items.length > 0 && (
630:           <div
631:             data-testid="search-success-state"
632:             className="space-y-3 animate-in fade-in duration-100"
633:           >
634:             {/* Results Header with Counts & Partial Indicator */}
635:             <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1 text-slate-500 text-[11px] font-medium border-b border-slate-100">
636:               <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
637:                 <span>
638:                   Tìm thấy <strong className="text-slate-900">{total}</strong> kết quả cho &quot;
639:                   {query}&quot;
640:                 </span>
641:                 {/* 7. PARTIAL STATE INDICATOR */}
642:                 {isPartialNotice && (
643:                   <span
644:                     data-testid="search-partial-state"
645:                     className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 text-[10px] font-semibold"
646:                   >
647:                     <span>
648:                       Hiển thị {items.length}/{total} kết quả
649:                     </span>
650:                   </span>
651:                 )}
652:               </div>
653:               <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Dùng ↑ ↓ để duyệt</span>
654:             </div>
655: 
656:             {/* Results List */}
657:             <div
658:               ref={listRef}
659:               data-testid="search-results-list"
660:               id="search-results-list"
661:               role="listbox"
662:               aria-label="Danh sách kết quả tìm kiếm"
663:               className="space-y-1.5"
664:             >
665:               {items.map((item, index) => {
666:                 const { icon: ItemIcon, color: iconStyle } = getItemIcon(item.type);
667:                 const isSelected = index === selectedIndex;
668: 
669:                 return (
670:                   <div
671:                     key={item.id}
672:                     data-testid={`search-item-${item.id}`}
673:                     id={`search-item-${item.id}`}
674:                     role="option"
675:                     aria-selected={isSelected}
676:                     onClick={() => handleSelectItem(item)}
677:                     onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(index)}
678:                     className={`p-3 rounded-xl border transition flex items-center justify-between gap-3 cursor-pointer select-none ${
679:                       isSelected
680:                         ? 'bg-[#FFF5F0] border-[#c23807] ring-1 ring-[#c23807]'
681:                         : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border-slate-100'
682:                     }`}
683:                   >
684:                     {/* Left Icon */}
685:                     <div
686:                       className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-lg border flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${iconStyle}`}
687:                     >
688:                       <ItemIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
689:                     </div>
690: 
691:                     {/* Middle Details */}
692:                     <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
693:                       <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
694:                         <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 truncate text-xs">
695:                           {item.title}
696:                         </span>
697:                         <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded shrink-0">
698:                           {item.code}
699:                         </span>
700:                       </div>
701:                       <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate mt-0.5">
702:                         {item.subtitle}
703:                       </div>
704:                     </div>
705: 
706:                     {/* Right Status & Action */}
707:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
708:                       <StatusBadge status={item.status} />
709:                       <div className="text-slate-400">
710:                         {isSelected ? (
711:                           <CornerDownLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#c23807]" />
712:                         ) : (
713:                           <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-60" />
714:                         )}
715:                       </div>
716:                     </div>
717:                   </div>
718:                 );
719:               })}
720:             </div>
721:           </div>
722:         )}
723:       </div>
724: 
725:       {/* Footer Status & Recovery Guide */}
726:       <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-50/80 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500">
727:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
728:           <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
729:           <span>Cách ly đa người thuê: Tự động lọc theo Shop đang đăng nhập</span>
730:         </div>
731:         <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
732:           <span>Bảo vệ PII</span>
733:           <span>Kiểm soát phân quyền</span>
734:         </div>
735:       </div>
736:     </div>
737:   );
738: };
739: 
740: export const GlobalSearchModal: React.FC<GlobalSearchProps> = (props) => {
741:   const { isOpen = false, onClose } = props;
742: 
743:   // Close on Escape or click outside
744:   useEffect(() => {
745:     if (!isOpen) return;
746:     const handleGlobalKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
747:       if (e.key === 'Escape') {
748:         onClose?.();
749:       }
750:     };
751:     window.addEventListener('keydown', handleGlobalKeyDown);
752:     return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleGlobalKeyDown);
753:   }, [isOpen, onClose]);
754: 
755:   if (!isOpen) return null;
756: 
757:   return (
758:     <div
759:       className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150"
760:       onClick={onClose}
761:     >
762:       <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} className="w-full max-w-2xl">
763:         <GlobalSearchContent {...props} standalone={false} />
764:       </div>
765:     </div>
766:   );
767: };
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/OnboardingFlow.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import Link from 'next/link';
  5: import {
  6:   CheckCircle2,
  7:   Clock,
  8:   Lock,
  9:   ArrowRight,
 10:   ExternalLink,
 11:   RefreshCw,
 12:   RotateCcw,
 13:   AlertCircle,
 14:   AlertTriangle,
 15:   Store,
 16:   Warehouse as WarehouseIcon,
 17:   Users,
 18:   Truck,
 19:   Sliders,
 20:   PackageCheck,
 21:   ChevronDown,
 22:   ChevronUp,
 23:   X,
 24:   ShieldAlert,
 25: } from 'lucide-react';
 26: import {
 27:   OnboardingStepId,
 28:   OnboardingStepStatus,
 29:   OnboardingOverallStatus,
 30:   type OnboardingStateResponseDto,
 31:   type OnboardingStepDto,
 32: } from '@shipde/contracts';
 33: 
 34: export interface WarehouseFormData {
 35:   name: string;
 36:   phone: string;
 37:   address: string;
 38:   city: string;
 39:   district: string;
 40: }
 41: 
 42: export function validateWarehouseInput(input: WarehouseFormData): {
 43:   isValid: boolean;
 44:   errors: Record<string, string>;
 45: } {
 46:   const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
 47:   if (!input.name || input.name.trim().length < 2) {
 48:     errors.name = 'Tên kho phải có ít nhất 2 ký tự';
 49:   }
 50:   const cleanPhone = (input.phone || '').trim().replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
 51:   const vnPhoneRegex = /^(0|\+84)(3|5|7|8|9)[0-9]{8}$/;
 52:   if (!cleanPhone || !vnPhoneRegex.test(cleanPhone)) {
 53:     errors.phone = 'Số điện thoại kho không đúng định dạng Việt Nam (VD: 0901234567)';
 54:   }
 55:   if (!input.address || input.address.trim().length < 3) {
 56:     errors.address = 'Địa chỉ kho phải có ít nhất 3 ký tự';
 57:   }
 58:   for (const field of ['city', 'district'] as const) {
 59:     if (!input[field]?.trim())
 60:       errors[field] =
 61:         field === 'city' ? 'Vui lòng nhập tỉnh/thành phố' : 'Vui lòng nhập quận/huyện';
 62:   }
 63:   return {
 64:     isValid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0,
 65:     errors,
 66:   };
 67: }
 68: 
 69: export interface OnboardingFlowProps {
 70:   state?: OnboardingStateResponseDto | null;
 71:   loading?: boolean;
 72:   error?: string | null;
 73:   initialState?: OnboardingStateResponseDto | null;
 74:   initialLoading?: boolean;
 75:   initialError?: string | null;
 76:   initialSuccess?: string | null;
 77:   initialCanEdit?: boolean;
 78:   initialWarehouseFormOpen?: boolean;
 79:   initialResetConfirmOpen?: boolean;
 80:   onRefresh?: () => Promise<void> | void;
 81:   onCompleteStep?: (stepId: OnboardingStepId, data?: Record<string, any>) => Promise<void>;
 82:   onSkipStep?: (stepId: OnboardingStepId) => Promise<void>;
 83:   onReset?: () => Promise<void>;
 84:   onDismiss?: () => Promise<void>;
 85: }
 86: 
 87: export function OnboardingFlow({
 88:   state: propState,
 89:   loading: propLoading,
 90:   error: propError,
 91:   initialState = null,
 92:   initialLoading = false,
 93:   initialError = null,
 94:   initialSuccess = null,
 95:   initialCanEdit,
 96:   initialWarehouseFormOpen = false,
 97:   initialResetConfirmOpen = false,
 98:   onRefresh,
 99:   onCompleteStep,
100:   onSkipStep,
101:   onReset,
102:   onDismiss,
103: }: OnboardingFlowProps) {
104:   const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
105:   const [submittingStep, setSubmittingStep] = useState<string | null>(null);
106:   const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
107:   const [localError, setLocalError] = useState<string | null>(null);
108:   const [errorDismissed, setErrorDismissed] = useState<boolean>(false);
109:   const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(initialSuccess);
110: 
111:   // Directly derive live server state, loading and error from props
112:   const state = propState !== undefined ? propState : initialState;
113:   const loading = (propLoading !== undefined ? propLoading : initialLoading) || refreshing;
114: 
115:   const rawError =
116:     localError !== null ? localError : propError !== undefined ? propError : initialError;
117:   const errorMessage = errorDismissed ? null : rawError;
118: 
119:   const setErrorMessage = (msg: string | null) => {
120:     setLocalError(msg);
121:     setErrorDismissed(false);
122:   };
123: 
124:   const dismissErrorMessage = () => {
125:     setErrorDismissed(true);
126:     setLocalError(null);
127:   };
128: 
129:   // Edit rights: server-authoritative boolean from API response or prop.
130:   // Unknown or undefined user/state fails closed to false (no edit).
131:   const canEdit =
132:     initialCanEdit !== undefined
133:       ? initialCanEdit
134:       : state?.can_edit !== undefined
135:         ? Boolean(state.can_edit)
136:         : false;
137: 
138:   // Warehouse inline form state
139:   const [warehouseFormOpen, setWarehouseFormOpen] = useState<boolean>(initialWarehouseFormOpen);
140:   const [warehouseData, setWarehouseData] = useState<WarehouseFormData>({
141:     name: '',
142:     phone: '',
143:     address: '',
144:     city: 'Hồ Chí Minh',
145:     district: '',
146:   });
147:   const [warehouseFieldErrors, setWarehouseFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
148: 
149:   // Reset confirmation modal state
150:   const [showResetConfirm, setShowResetConfirm] = useState<boolean>(initialResetConfirmOpen);
151: 
152:   // Map step IDs to navigation links & icons
153:   const getStepMetadata = (stepId: OnboardingStepId) => {
154:     switch (stepId) {
155:       case OnboardingStepId.SHOP_PROFILE:
156:         return {
157:           icon: Store,
158:           linkText: 'Cài đặt Hồ sơ Cửa hàng',
159:           href: '/settings/shop',
160:         };
161:       case OnboardingStepId.WAREHOUSE:
162:         return {
163:           icon: WarehouseIcon,
164:           linkText: 'Quản lý Chi nhánh & Kho vận',
165:           href: '/settings/shop',
166:         };
167:       case OnboardingStepId.INVITE_USERS:
168:         return {
169:           icon: Users,
170:           linkText: 'Quản lý Thành viên & Phân quyền',
171:           href: '/settings/users',
172:         };
173:       case OnboardingStepId.CARRIER_ACCOUNT:
174:         return {
175:           icon: Truck,
176:           linkText: 'Kết nối Hãng vận chuyển (SCR-CAR-01)',
177:           href: '/paseo',
178:         };
179:       case OnboardingStepId.OPERATING_DEFAULTS:
180:         return {
181:           icon: Sliders,
182:           linkText: 'Cấu hình Vận hành & Cước phí',
183:           href: '/settings/shop',
184:         };
185:       case OnboardingStepId.TEST_ORDER:
186:         return {
187:           icon: PackageCheck,
188:           linkText: 'Tạo đơn thử nghiệm (SCR-ORD-02)',
189:           href: '/',
190:         };
191:       default:
192:         return {
193:           icon: Store,
194:           linkText: 'Đi đến cài đặt',
195:           href: '/settings/shop',
196:         };
197:     }
198:   };
199: 
200:   const handleRefresh = async () => {
201:     if (onRefresh) {
202:       setRefreshing(true);
203:       setErrorMessage(null);
204:       try {
205:         await onRefresh();
206:       } catch (err: any) {
207:         setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Lỗi khi tải lại dữ liệu thiết lập ban đầu');
208:       } finally {
209:         setRefreshing(false);
210:       }
211:     }
212:   };
213: 
214:   const handleComplete = async (stepId: OnboardingStepId, data?: Record<string, any>) => {
215:     if (!canEdit) {
216:       setErrorMessage('Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này (cần quyền iam:shop_config).');
217:       return;
218:     }
219:     setSubmittingStep(stepId);
220:     setErrorMessage(null);
221:     setSuccessMessage(null);
222:     try {
223:       if (onCompleteStep) {
224:         await onCompleteStep(stepId, data);
225:         setSuccessMessage(`Đã đánh dấu hoàn thành bước ${stepId}!`);
226:         if (stepId === OnboardingStepId.WAREHOUSE) {
227:           setWarehouseFormOpen(false);
228:         }
229:       }
230:     } catch (err: any) {
231:       setErrorMessage(err?.message || `Không thể hoàn thành bước ${stepId}`);
232:     } finally {
233:       setSubmittingStep(null);
234:     }
235:   };
236: 
237:   const handleWarehouseSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
238:     e.preventDefault();
239:     if (!canEdit) {
240:       setErrorMessage('Bạn không có quyền thêm kho hàng (cần quyền iam:shop_config).');
241:       return;
242:     }
243:     const { isValid, errors } = validateWarehouseInput(warehouseData);
244:     if (!isValid) {
245:       setWarehouseFieldErrors(errors);
246:       return;
247:     }
248:     setWarehouseFieldErrors({});
249:     await handleComplete(OnboardingStepId.WAREHOUSE, warehouseData);
250:   };
251: 
252:   const handleSkip = async (stepId: OnboardingStepId) => {
253:     if (!canEdit) {
254:       setErrorMessage('Bạn không có quyền bỏ qua bước này (cần quyền iam:shop_config).');
255:       return;
256:     }
257:     setSubmittingStep(stepId);
258:     setErrorMessage(null);
259:     setSuccessMessage(null);
260:     try {
261:       if (onSkipStep) {
262:         await onSkipStep(stepId);
263:         setSuccessMessage(`Đã bỏ qua bước ${stepId}. Bạn có thể thiết lập lại bất cứ lúc nào.`);
264:       }
265:     } catch (err: any) {
266:       setErrorMessage(err?.message || `Không thể bỏ qua bước ${stepId}`);
267:     } finally {
268:       setSubmittingStep(null);
269:     }
270:   };
271: 
272:   const handleResetConfirm = async () => {
273:     if (!canEdit) {
274:       setErrorMessage('Bạn không có quyền khởi tạo lại (cần quyền iam:shop_config).');
275:       return;
276:     }
277:     setActionLoading(true);
278:     setErrorMessage(null);
279:     setSuccessMessage(null);
280:     try {
281:       if (onReset) {
282:         await onReset();
283:         setSuccessMessage('Đã khởi tạo lại tiến trình thiết lập ban đầu thành công!');
284:         setShowResetConfirm(false);
285:       }
286:     } catch (err: any) {
287:       setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Không thể khởi tạo lại tiến trình');
288:     } finally {
289:       setActionLoading(false);
290:     }
291:   };
292: 
293:   const handleDismiss = async () => {
294:     if (!canEdit) {
295:       setErrorMessage('Bạn không có quyền đóng hướng dẫn (cần quyền iam:shop_config).');
296:       return;
297:     }
298:     setActionLoading(true);
299:     setErrorMessage(null);
300:     setSuccessMessage(null);
301:     try {
302:       if (onDismiss) {
303:         await onDismiss();
304:         setSuccessMessage('Đã đóng hướng dẫn thiết lập ban đầu!');
305:       }
306:     } catch (err: any) {
307:       setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Không thể đóng hướng dẫn thiết lập');
308:     } finally {
309:       setActionLoading(false);
310:     }
311:   };
312: 
313:   // 1. Loading State
314:   if (loading) {
315:     return (
316:       <div
317:         className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto p-8 modern-card space-y-6"
318:         role="status"
319:         aria-live="polite"
320:         data-testid="onboarding-loading"
321:       >
322:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between animate-pulse">
323:           <div className="space-y-2">
324:             <div className="h-6 w-64 bg-slate-200 rounded-md" />
325:             <div className="h-4 w-96 bg-slate-100 rounded-md" />
326:           </div>
327:           <div className="h-10 w-24 bg-slate-200 rounded-lg" />
328:         </div>
329:         <div className="h-4 w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
330:         <div className="grid gap-4 mt-6">
331:           {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
332:             <div
333:               key={i}
334:               className="p-5 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl bg-slate-50/50 animate-pulse flex items-center justify-between"
335:             >
336:               <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
337:                 <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-200" />
338:                 <div className="space-y-2">
339:                   <div className="h-4 w-48 bg-slate-200 rounded" />
340:                   <div className="h-3 w-72 bg-slate-100 rounded" />
341:                 </div>
342:               </div>
343:               <div className="h-8 w-28 bg-slate-200 rounded-lg" />
344:             </div>
345:           ))}
346:         </div>
347:         <span className="sr-only">Đang tải danh sách thiết lập ban đầu...</span>
348:       </div>
349:     );
350:   }
351: 
352:   // 2. Empty State
353:   if (!state && !errorMessage) {
354:     return (
355:       <div
356:         className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto p-12 modern-card text-center space-y-4"
357:         data-testid="onboarding-empty"
358:       >
359:         <div className="w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 flex items-center justify-center">
360:           <Store className="w-7 h-7" />
361:         </div>
362:         <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Chưa Khởi Tạo Quy Trình Thiết Lập</h2>
363:         <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 max-w-md mx-auto">
364:           Cửa hàng của bạn chưa có thông tin quy trình thiết lập ban đầu. Nhấn nút bên dưới để bắt
365:           đầu tải dữ liệu hoặc cấu hình shop.
366:         </p>
367:         <div className="pt-2">
368:           <button
369:             type="button"
370:             onClick={handleRefresh}
371:             className="btn-primary text-xs px-5 py-2.5"
372:             aria-label="Khởi tạo thiết lập ban đầu"
373:           >
374:             <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5" />
375:             <span>Khởi tạo thiết lập ban đầu</span>
376:           </button>
377:         </div>
378:       </div>
379:     );
380:   }
381: 
382:   const steps = state?.steps || [];
383:   const progressPercentage = state?.progress_percentage ?? 0;
384:   const isCompletedOverall = state?.status === OnboardingOverallStatus.COMPLETED;
385:   const isDismissed = state?.status === OnboardingOverallStatus.DISMISSED;
386: 
387:   return (
388:     <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6" data-testid="onboarding-container">
389:       {/* View-Only / Forbidden Banner when user lacks iam:shop_config */}
390:       {!canEdit && (
391:         <div
392:           role="alert"
393:           aria-live="polite"
394:           data-testid="onboarding-forbidden-banner"
395:           className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 flex items-start gap-3 shadow-xs"
396:         >
397:           <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
398:           <div className="text-xs space-y-1">
399:             <div className="font-bold">Chế độ Chỉ Xem (View-Only)</div>
400:             <div>
401:               Tài khoản của bạn không có quyền cập nhật cấu hình cửa hàng (yêu cầu quyền{' '}
402:               <code className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-amber-100 rounded text-amber-800 font-mono font-bold">
403:                 iam:shop_config
404:               </code>
405:               ). Bạn có thể xem tiến độ và liên kết hướng dẫn nhưng không thể hoàn thành hoặc bỏ qua
406:               các bước.
407:             </div>
408:           </div>
409:         </div>
410:       )}
411: 
412:       {/* Error Alert Banner with Recovery */}
413:       {errorMessage && (
414:         <div
415:           role="alert"
416:           aria-live="assertive"
417:           data-testid="onboarding-error-banner"
418:           className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-900 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 shadow-xs"
419:         >
420:           <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
421:             <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
422:             <div className="text-xs space-y-1">
423:               <div className="font-bold">Không thể hoàn tất thao tác</div>
424:               <div>{errorMessage}</div>
425:             </div>
426:           </div>
427:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
428:             <button
429:               type="button"
430:               onClick={handleRefresh}
431:               className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded bg-rose-100 hover:bg-rose-200 text-rose-800 transition"
432:               aria-label="Thử lại tải dữ liệu"
433:             >
434:               Thử lại
435:             </button>
436:             <button
437:               type="button"
438:               onClick={() => setErrorMessage(null)}
439:               className="p-1 rounded text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-800"
440:               aria-label="Đóng thông báo lỗi"
441:             >
442:               <X className="w-4 h-4" />
443:             </button>
444:           </div>
445:         </div>
446:       )}
447: 
448:       {/* Success Alert Banner */}
449:       {successMessage && (
450:         <div
451:           role="status"
452:           aria-live="polite"
453:           data-testid="onboarding-success-banner"
454:           className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 shadow-xs"
455:         >
456:           <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
457:             <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
458:             <div className="text-xs space-y-1">
459:               <div className="font-bold">Thao tác thành công</div>
460:               <div>{successMessage}</div>
461:             </div>
462:           </div>
463:           <button
464:             type="button"
465:             onClick={() => setSuccessMessage(null)}
466:             className="p-1 rounded text-emerald-500 hover:text-emerald-800"
467:             aria-label="Đóng thông báo thành công"
468:           >
469:             <X className="w-4 h-4" />
470:           </button>
471:         </div>
472:       )}
473: 
474:       {/* Overall Completed Celebration Banner */}
475:       {isCompletedOverall && !isDismissed && (
476:         <div
477:           className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-700 text-white shadow-lg space-y-4"
478:           data-testid="onboarding-completed-banner"
479:         >
480:           <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
481:             <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
482:               <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white/20 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg">
483:                 🎉
484:               </div>
485:               <div>
486:                 <h2 className="text-base font-bold">Chúc Mừng! Cửa Hàng Đã Sẵn Sàng Vận Hành</h2>
487:                 <p className="text-xs text-white/80 mt-0.5">
488:                   Tất cả các bước thiết lập bắt buộc đã hoàn tất. Bạn có thể bắt đầu tạo đơn hàng
489:                   hoặc đóng hướng dẫn này.
490:                 </p>
491:               </div>
492:             </div>
493:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
494:               <Link
495:                 href="/"
496:                 className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-white text-emerald-800 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition shadow-xs"
497:               >
498:                 Tạo Đơn Ngay
499:               </Link>
500:               {canEdit && (
501:                 <button
502:                   type="button"
503:                   onClick={handleDismiss}
504:                   disabled={actionLoading}
505:                   className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition"
506:                   aria-label="Đóng hướng dẫn thiết lập"
507:                 >
508:                   Đóng Hướng Dẫn
509:                 </button>
510:               )}
511:             </div>
512:           </div>
513:         </div>
514:       )}
515: 
516:       {/* Header & Progress Card */}
517:       <div className="modern-card p-6 space-y-5">
518:         <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
519:           <div className="space-y-1">
520:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
521:               <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#c23807] uppercase tracking-wider">
522:                 SCR-ONB-01
523:               </span>
524:               <span className="text-slate-300">•</span>
525:               <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Thiết Lập Ban Đầu (Onboarding)</h1>
526:             </div>
527:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
528:               Hoàn thành các bước chuẩn bị bên dưới để kích hoạt đầy đủ khả năng so sánh cước và tạo
529:               vận đơn tự động.
530:             </p>
531:           </div>
532: 
533:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
534:             <button
535:               type="button"
536:               onClick={handleRefresh}
537:               disabled={loading}
538:               className="btn-secondary text-xs px-3 py-1.5"
539:               aria-label="Làm mới tiến trình thiết lập"
540:               title="Cập nhật lại trạng thái thực tế từ hệ thống"
541:             >
542:               <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
543:               <span>Làm mới</span>
544:             </button>
545:             {canEdit && (
546:               <button
547:                 type="button"
548:                 onClick={() => setShowResetConfirm(true)}
549:                 className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-rose-600 border border-slate-200 hover:border-rose-200 rounded-lg transition"
550:                 aria-label="Khởi tạo lại toàn bộ quy trình"
551:               >
552:                 <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1" />
553:                 <span>Khởi tạo lại</span>
554:               </button>
555:             )}
556:           </div>
557:         </div>
558: 
559:         {/* Progress Bar & Summary */}
560:         <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
561:           <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold">
562:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
563:               <span className="text-slate-700">Tiến độ hoàn thành:</span>
564:               <span className="font-bold text-[#c23807]">{progressPercentage}%</span>
565:             </div>
566:             <div className="text-slate-500">
567:               Đã hoàn thành {state?.completed_count || 0} / {steps.length} bước (
568:               {state?.completed_required_steps || 0} / {state?.total_required_steps || 0} bắt buộc)
569:             </div>
570:           </div>
571:           <div
572:             className="w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-2.5 overflow-hidden"
573:             role="progressbar"
574:             aria-valuenow={progressPercentage}
575:             aria-valuemin={0}
576:             aria-valuemax={100}
577:             aria-label="Tiến độ thiết lập ban đầu"
578:           >
579:             <div
580:               className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
581:                 progressPercentage === 100
582:                   ? 'bg-emerald-500'
583:                   : progressPercentage > 50
584:                     ? 'bg-[#c23807]'
585:                     : 'bg-amber-500'
586:               }`}
587:               style={{ width: `${progressPercentage}%` }}
588:             />
589:           </div>
590:         </div>
591:       </div>
592: 
593:       {/* Step Cards List */}
594:       <div className="space-y-4" data-testid="onboarding-steps-list">
595:         {steps.map((step: OnboardingStepDto, index: number) => {
596:           const meta = getStepMetadata(step.id);
597:           const IconComp = meta.icon;
598:           const isCurrent = step.status === OnboardingStepStatus.IN_PROGRESS;
599:           const isCompleted = step.status === OnboardingStepStatus.COMPLETED;
600:           const isSkipped = step.status === OnboardingStepStatus.SKIPPED;
601:           const isBlocked = step.status === OnboardingStepStatus.BLOCKED;
602:           const isSubmitting = submittingStep === step.id;
603: 
604:           return (
605:             <div
606:               key={step.id}
607:               data-testid={`step-card-${step.id}`}
608:               className={`modern-card p-5 transition border ${
609:                 isCurrent
610:                   ? 'border-[#c23807]/30 ring-2 ring-[#c23807]/10 bg-white'
611:                   : isCompleted
612:                     ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/20'
613:                     : isBlocked
614:                       ? 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/10'
615:                       : 'border-slate-200 bg-white'
616:               }`}
617:             >
618:               <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start justify-between gap-4">
619:                 {/* Step Info & Header */}
620:                 <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5">
621:                   <div
622:                     className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5 ${
623:                       isCompleted
624:                         ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'
625:                         : isCurrent
626:                           ? 'bg-[#FFF5F0] text-[#c23807] font-bold'
627:                           : isBlocked
628:                             ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'
629:                             : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-500'
630:                     }`}
631:                   >
632:                     {isCompleted ? (
633:                       <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5" />
634:                     ) : isBlocked ? (
635:                       <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
636:                     ) : (
637:                       <IconComp className="w-4 h-4" />
638:                     )}
639:                   </div>
640: 
641:                   <div className="space-y-1">
642:                     <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
643:                       <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
644:                         Bước {step.order}:
645:                       </span>
646:                       <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">{step.title}</h2>
647: 
648:                       {/* Required / Optional Badge */}
649:                       <span
650:                         className={`text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
651:                           step.required
652:                             ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200'
653:                             : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200'
654:                         }`}
655:                       >
656:                         {step.required ? 'Bắt buộc' : 'Tùy chọn'}
657:                       </span>
658: 
659:                       {/* Status Badge */}
660:                       {isCompleted && (
661:                         <span className="badge-ok text-xs font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1">
662:                           <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
663:                           <span>Đã Hoàn Thành</span>
664:                         </span>
665:                       )}
666:                       {isCurrent && (
667:                         <span className="badge-info text-xs font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 border border-sky-200">
668:                           <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
669:                           <span>Đang Thực Hiện</span>
670:                         </span>
671:                       )}
672:                       {isSkipped && (
673:                         <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-200">
674:                           Đã Bỏ Qua
675:                         </span>
676:                       )}
677:                       {isBlocked && (
678:                         <span className="badge-warning text-xs font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200">
679:                           <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3" />
680:                           <span>Bị Khóa (Thiếu Tiền Đề)</span>
681:                         </span>
682:                       )}
683:                     </div>
684:                     <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">{step.description}</p>
685:                   </div>
686:                 </div>
687: 
688:                 {/* Step Actions */}
689:                 <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-center shrink-0">
690:                   {/* Link to related settings */}
691:                   <Link
692:                     href={meta.href}
693:                     className="btn-secondary text-xs px-3 py-1.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1"
694:                     aria-label={`Đi đến ${meta.linkText}`}
695:                   >
696:                     <span>{meta.linkText}</span>
697:                     <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
698:                   </Link>
699: 
700:                   {/* Warehouse specific toggle */}
701:                   {step.id === OnboardingStepId.WAREHOUSE && !isCompleted && canEdit && (
702:                     <button
703:                       type="button"
704:                       onClick={() => setWarehouseFormOpen(!warehouseFormOpen)}
705:                       className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 transition"
706:                       aria-label="Nhập thông tin kho hàng nhanh"
707:                     >
708:                       {warehouseFormOpen ? (
709:                         <>
710:                           <span>Thu gọn</span>
711:                           <ChevronUp className="w-3 h-3 inline ml-1" />
712:                         </>
713:                       ) : (
714:                         <>
715:                           <span>Nhập kho nhanh</span>
716:                           <ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3 inline ml-1" />
717:                         </>
718:                       )}
719:                     </button>
720:                   )}
721: 
722:                   {/* Mark complete button */}
723:                   {!isCompleted && canEdit && (
724:                     <button
725:                       type="button"
726:                       disabled={isBlocked || isSubmitting}
727:                       onClick={() => handleComplete(step.id)}
728:                       className={`btn-primary text-xs px-3 py-1.5 ${
729:                         isBlocked ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : ''
730:                       }`}
731:                       aria-label={`Đánh dấu hoàn thành bước ${step.title}`}
732:                     >
733:                       {isSubmitting ? (
734:                         <>
735:                           <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin mr-1 inline" />
736:                           <span>Đang lưu...</span>
737:                         </>
738:                       ) : (
739:                         <span>Hoàn thành</span>
740:                       )}
741:                     </button>
742:                   )}
743: 
744:                   {/* Skip button for optional steps */}
745:                   {!step.required && !isCompleted && !isSkipped && canEdit && (
746:                     <button
747:                       type="button"
748:                       disabled={isSubmitting}
749:                       onClick={() => handleSkip(step.id)}
750:                       className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 transition"
751:                       aria-label={`Bỏ qua bước ${step.title}`}
752:                     >
753:                       Bỏ qua
754:                     </button>
755:                   )}
756:                 </div>
757:               </div>
758: 
759:               {/* Blocking Dependencies Alert */}
760:               {isBlocked && step.blocking_reasons && step.blocking_reasons.length > 0 && (
761:                 <div
762:                   role="alert"
763:                   className="mt-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 text-xs space-y-1"
764:                   data-testid={`blocking-alert-${step.id}`}
765:                 >
766:                   <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-800">
767:                     <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
768:                     <span>Điều kiện tiên quyết chưa đáp ứng:</span>
769:                   </div>
770:                   <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-0.5 text-amber-700 pl-1">
771:                     {step.blocking_reasons.map((reason, rIdx) => (
772:                       <li key={rIdx}>{reason}</li>
773:                     ))}
774:                   </ul>
775:                 </div>
776:               )}
777: 
778:               {/* Inline Warehouse Form */}
779:               {step.id === OnboardingStepId.WAREHOUSE && warehouseFormOpen && !isCompleted && (
780:                 <form
781:                   onSubmit={handleWarehouseSubmit}
782:                   className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-4"
783:                   data-testid="inline-warehouse-form"
784:                 >
785:                   <div className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-800 pb-1 border-b border-slate-200">
786:                     Thêm Nhanh Kho Hàng Đầu Tiên (AC-ONB-01-03, AC-ONB-01-14)
787:                   </div>
788: 
789:                   <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
790:                     {/* Warehouse Name */}
791:                     <div className="space-y-1">
792:                       <label
793:                         htmlFor="wh-name"
794:                         className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700"
795:                       >
796:                         Tên kho hàng <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
797:                       </label>
798:                       <input
799:                         id="wh-name"
800:                         type="text"
801:                         value={warehouseData.name}
802:                         onChange={(e) => {
803:                           setWarehouseData((prev) => ({ ...prev, name: e.target.value }));
804:                           if (warehouseFieldErrors.name) {
805:                             setWarehouseFieldErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, name: '' }));
806:                           }
807:                         }}
808:                         placeholder="VD: Kho Tân Bình (Trụ sở)"
809:                         className={`w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs ${
810:                           warehouseFieldErrors.name
811:                             ? 'border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/50'
812:                             : 'border-slate-300 bg-white'
813:                         }`}
814:                       />
815:                       {warehouseFieldErrors.name && (
816:                         <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 font-medium">
817:                           {warehouseFieldErrors.name}
818:                         </p>
819:                       )}
820:                     </div>
821: 
822:                     {/* Warehouse Contact Phone */}
823:                     <div className="space-y-1">
824:                       <label
825:                         htmlFor="wh-phone"
826:                         className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700"
827:                       >
828:                         Số điện thoại liên hệ <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
829:                       </label>
830:                       <input
831:                         id="wh-phone"
832:                         type="tel"
833:                         value={warehouseData.phone}
834:                         onChange={(e) => {
835:                           setWarehouseData((prev) => ({ ...prev, phone: e.target.value }));
836:                           if (warehouseFieldErrors.phone) {
837:                             setWarehouseFieldErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, phone: '' }));
838:                           }
839:                         }}
840:                         placeholder="VD: 0901234567"
841:                         className={`w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs ${
842:                           warehouseFieldErrors.phone
843:                             ? 'border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/50'
844:                             : 'border-slate-300 bg-white'
845:                         }`}
846:                       />
847:                       {warehouseFieldErrors.phone && (
848:                         <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 font-medium">
849:                           {warehouseFieldErrors.phone}
850:                         </p>
851:                       )}
852:                     </div>
853: 
854:                     {/* Warehouse Address */}
855:                     <div className="space-y-1 sm:col-span-2">
856:                       <label
857:                         htmlFor="wh-address"
858:                         className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700"
859:                       >
860:                         Địa chỉ chi tiết kho (Lấy hàng & Trả hàng){' '}
861:                         <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
862:                       </label>
863:                       <input
864:                         id="wh-address"
865:                         type="text"
866:                         value={warehouseData.address}
867:                         onChange={(e) => {
868:                           setWarehouseData((prev) => ({ ...prev, address: e.target.value }));
869:                           if (warehouseFieldErrors.address) {
870:                             setWarehouseFieldErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, address: '' }));
871:                           }
872:                         }}
873:                         placeholder="VD: 128 Nguyễn Trãi, Phường 3, Quận 5"
874:                         className={`w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs ${
875:                           warehouseFieldErrors.address
876:                             ? 'border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/50'
877:                             : 'border-slate-300 bg-white'
878:                         }`}
879:                       />
880:                       {warehouseFieldErrors.address && (
881:                         <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 font-medium">
882:                           {warehouseFieldErrors.address}
883:                         </p>
884:                       )}
885:                     </div>
886:                   </div>
887: 
888:                   {(['city', 'district'] as const).map((field) => (
889:                     <div key={field} className="space-y-1">
890:                       <label
891:                         htmlFor={`wh-${field}`}
892:                         className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700"
893:                       >
894:                         {field === 'city' ? 'Tỉnh/thành phố' : 'Quận/huyện'}{' '}
895:                         <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
896:                       </label>
897:                       <input
898:                         id={`wh-${field}`}
899:                         type="text"
900:                         required
901:                         value={warehouseData[field]}
902:                         onChange={(e) =>
903:                           setWarehouseData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: e.target.value }))
904:                         }
905:                         aria-invalid={Boolean(warehouseFieldErrors[field])}
906:                         aria-describedby={
907:                           warehouseFieldErrors[field] ? `wh-${field}-error` : undefined
908:                         }
909:                         className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs border-slate-300 bg-white"
910:                       />
911:                       {warehouseFieldErrors[field] && (
912:                         <p id={`wh-${field}-error`} className="text-[11px] text-rose-600">
913:                           {warehouseFieldErrors[field]}
914:                         </p>
915:                       )}
916:                     </div>
917:                   ))}
918: 
919:                   <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
920:                     <button
921:                       type="button"
922:                       onClick={() => setWarehouseFormOpen(false)}
923:                       className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-lg"
924:                       aria-label="Hủy nhập nhanh kho hàng"
925:                     >
926:                       Đóng
927:                     </button>
928:                     <button
929:                       type="submit"
930:                       disabled={isSubmitting}
931:                       className="btn-primary text-xs px-4 py-1.5"
932:                       aria-label="Lưu và hoàn thành bước kho hàng"
933:                     >
934:                       {isSubmitting ? 'Đang lưu...' : 'Lưu Kho & Hoàn Thành Bước'}
935:                     </button>
936:                   </div>
937:                 </form>
938:               )}
939:             </div>
940:           );
941:         })}
942:       </div>
943: 
944:       {/* Reset Confirmation Modal */}
945:       {showResetConfirm && (
946:         <div
947:           className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-100"
948:           role="dialog"
949:           aria-modal="true"
950:           aria-labelledby="reset-modal-title"
951:         >
952:           <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl space-y-4 border border-slate-100">
953:             <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-rose-600">
954:               <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 flex items-center justify-center">
955:                 <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />
956:               </div>
957:               <h2 id="reset-modal-title" className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
958:                 Khởi tạo lại Quy trình Thiết lập?
959:               </h2>
960:             </div>
961:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
962:               Thao tác này sẽ đặt lại tiến trình các bước thiết lập ban đầu về 0% và ghi nhận nhật
963:               ký kiểm toán. Dữ liệu hồ sơ shop và người dùng đã lưu sẽ không bị xóa.
964:             </p>
965:             <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
966:               <button
967:                 type="button"
968:                 onClick={() => setShowResetConfirm(false)}
969:                 disabled={actionLoading}
970:                 className="px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg transition"
971:                 aria-label="Hủy bỏ khởi tạo lại"
972:               >
973:                 Hủy bỏ
974:               </button>
975:               <button
976:                 type="button"
977:                 onClick={handleResetConfirm}
978:                 disabled={actionLoading}
979:                 className="px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 rounded-lg transition shadow-xs"
980:                 aria-label="Xác nhận khởi tạo lại"
981:               >
982:                 {actionLoading ? 'Đang xử lý...' : 'Xác nhận Đặt lại'}
983:               </button>
984:             </div>
985:           </div>
986:         </div>
987:       )}
988:     </div>
989:   );
990: }
</file>
