  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
  4: import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';
  5: import {
  6:   User as UserIcon,
  7:   Phone,
  8:   Mail,
  9:   Shield,
 10:   Globe,
 11:   Clock,
 12:   Warehouse,
 13:   Bell,
 14:   Save,
 15:   CheckCircle2,
 16:   AlertTriangle,
 17:   Loader2,
 18:   RotateCcw,
 19:   Lock,
 20: } from 'lucide-react';
 21: 
 22: const VIETNAMESE_PHONE_REGEX = /^(0|\+84)[3|5|7|8|9][0-9]{8}$/;
 23: 
 24: interface NotificationSubscriptionsState {
 25:   delivery_fail: boolean;
 26:   rate_discrepancy: boolean;
 27:   cod_overdue: boolean;
 28:   abnormal_return: boolean;
 29:   security_alerts: boolean;
 30:   create_unknown: boolean;
 31:   claim_deadline_warning: boolean;
 32: }
 33: 
 34: interface NotificationPreferencesState {
 35:   channels: {
 36:     email: boolean;
 37:     in_app: boolean;
 38:     push: boolean;
 39:   };
 40:   digest_window_minutes: number;
 41:   subscriptions: NotificationSubscriptionsState;
 42: }
 43: 
 44: interface ProfileFormState {
 45:   full_name: string;
 46:   phone: string;
 47:   avatar_url: string;
 48:   language: string;
 49:   timezone: string;
 50:   default_warehouse_id: string;
 51:   notification_preferences: NotificationPreferencesState;
 52: }
 53: 
 54: export function validateProfileForm(form: ProfileFormState): {
 55:   isValid: boolean;
 56:   errors: Record<string, string>;
 57: } {
 58:   const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
 59: 
 60:   if (!form.full_name || !form.full_name.trim()) {
 61:     errors.full_name = 'Họ và tên không được để trống';
 62:   } else if (form.full_name.trim().length > 255) {
 63:     errors.full_name = 'Họ và tên tối đa 255 ký tự';
 64:   }
 65: 
 66:   if (form.phone && form.phone.trim()) {
 67:     if (!VIETNAMESE_PHONE_REGEX.test(form.phone.trim())) {
 68:       errors.phone = 'Số điện thoại không đúng định dạng Việt Nam';
 69:     }
 70:   }
 71: 
 72:   if (form.avatar_url && form.avatar_url.trim().length > 512) {
 73:     errors.avatar_url = 'Đường dẫn ảnh đại diện tối đa 512 ký tự';
 74:   }
 75: 
 76:   return {
 77:     isValid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0,
 78:     errors,
 79:   };
 80: }
 81: 
 82: export const ProfileSettingsTab: React.FC<{
 83:   initialProfile?: any;
 84:   mockLoading?: boolean;
 85: }> = ({ initialProfile, mockLoading = false }) => {
 86:   const { user, getProfile, updateProfile } = useAuth();
 87: 
 88:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(mockLoading || (!initialProfile && !user));
 89:   const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
 90:   const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
 91:   const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
 92:   const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
 93: 
 94:   const [formData, setFormData] = useState<ProfileFormState>(() => {
 95:     const u = initialProfile || user || {};
 96:     const prefs = u.notification_preferences || {};
 97:     return {
 98:       full_name: u.full_name || '',
 99:       phone: u.phone || '',
100:       avatar_url: u.avatar_url || '',
101:       language: u.language || 'vi',
102:       timezone: u.timezone || 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
103:       default_warehouse_id: u.default_warehouse_id || '',
104:       notification_preferences: {
105:         channels: {
106:           email: prefs.channels?.email ?? true,
107:           in_app: prefs.channels?.in_app ?? true,
108:           push: prefs.channels?.push ?? false,
109:         },
110:         digest_window_minutes: prefs.digest_window_minutes ?? 15,
111:         subscriptions: {
112:           delivery_fail: prefs.subscriptions?.delivery_fail ?? true,
113:           rate_discrepancy: prefs.subscriptions?.rate_discrepancy ?? true,
114:           cod_overdue: prefs.subscriptions?.cod_overdue ?? true,
115:           abnormal_return: prefs.subscriptions?.abnormal_return ?? true,
116:           security_alerts: true,
117:           create_unknown: true,
118:           claim_deadline_warning: true,
119:         },
120:       },
121:     };
122:   });
123: 
124:   const populateFromUser = useCallback((u: any) => {
125:     const prefs = u.notification_preferences || {};
126:     setFormData({
127:       full_name: u.full_name || '',
128:       phone: u.phone || '',
129:       avatar_url: u.avatar_url || '',
130:       language: u.language || 'vi',
131:       timezone: u.timezone || 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
132:       default_warehouse_id: u.default_warehouse_id || '',
133:       notification_preferences: {
134:         channels: {
135:           email: prefs.channels?.email ?? true,
136:           in_app: prefs.channels?.in_app ?? true,
137:           push: prefs.channels?.push ?? false,
138:         },
139:         digest_window_minutes: prefs.digest_window_minutes ?? 15,
140:         subscriptions: {
141:           delivery_fail: prefs.subscriptions?.delivery_fail ?? true,
142:           rate_discrepancy: prefs.subscriptions?.rate_discrepancy ?? true,
143:           cod_overdue: prefs.subscriptions?.cod_overdue ?? true,
144:           abnormal_return: prefs.subscriptions?.abnormal_return ?? true,
145:           security_alerts: true, // Always enforced
146:           create_unknown: true, // Always enforced
147:           claim_deadline_warning: true, // Always enforced
148:         },
149:       },
150:     });
151:   }, []);
152: 
153:   const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
154:     if (initialProfile) {
155:       populateFromUser(initialProfile);
156:       setLoading(false);
157:       return;
158:     }
159: 
160:     setLoading(true);
161:     setErrorMsg(null);
162:     try {
163:       const res = await getProfile();
164:       if (res.success && res.data) {
165:         populateFromUser(res.data);
166:       } else if (user) {
167:         populateFromUser(user);
168:       } else {
169:         setErrorMsg(res.error || 'Không thể tải thông tin hồ sơ.');
170:       }
171:     } catch {
172:       if (user) {
173:         populateFromUser(user);
174:       } else {
175:         setErrorMsg('Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ. Vui lòng thử lại.');
176:       }
177:     } finally {
178:       setLoading(false);
179:     }
180:   }, [initialProfile, getProfile, user, populateFromUser]);
181: 
182:   useEffect(() => {
183:     if (!mockLoading) {
184:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- initial profile fetch
185:       void loadData();
186:     }
187:   }, [loadData, mockLoading]);
188: 
189:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
190:     e.preventDefault();
191:     setSuccessMsg(null);
192:     setErrorMsg(null);
193: 
194:     const validation = validateProfileForm(formData);
195:     if (!validation.isValid) {
196:       setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
197:       return;
198:     }
199:     setFieldErrors({});
200: 
201:     setSubmitting(true);
202:     try {
203:       const payload: any = {
204:         full_name: formData.full_name.trim(),
205:         phone: formData.phone.trim() || null,
206:         avatar_url: formData.avatar_url.trim() || null,
207:         language: formData.language,
208:         timezone: formData.timezone,
209:         default_warehouse_id: formData.default_warehouse_id || null,
210:         notification_preferences: formData.notification_preferences,
211:       };
212: 
213:       const res = await updateProfile(payload);
214:       if (res.success) {
215:         setSuccessMsg('Đã cập nhật thông tin cá nhân thành công');
216:       } else {
217:         setErrorMsg(res.error || 'Cập nhật thất bại. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.');
218:       }
219:     } catch (err: any) {
220:       setErrorMsg('Đã xảy ra lỗi không xác định khi lưu thông tin.');
221:     } finally {
222:       setSubmitting(false);
223:     }
224:   };
225: 
226:   if (loading) {
227:     return (
228:       <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 p-8 space-y-6 animate-pulse">
229:         <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
230:           <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-slate-200 rounded-full" />
231:           <div className="space-y-2">
232:             <div className="h-5 w-48 bg-slate-200 rounded" />
233:             <div className="h-4 w-32 bg-slate-100 rounded" />
234:           </div>
235:         </div>
236:         <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 pt-4">
237:           <div className="h-10 bg-slate-100 rounded" />
238:           <div className="h-10 bg-slate-100 rounded" />
239:           <div className="h-10 bg-slate-100 rounded" />
240:           <div className="h-10 bg-slate-100 rounded" />
241:         </div>
242:       </div>
243:     );
244:   }
245: 
246:   return (
247:     <div className="space-y-6">
248:       {/* Notifications / Alerts */}
249:       {successMsg && (
250:         <div
251:           role="status"
252:           className="flex items-center gap-3 p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 rounded-lg text-sm"
253:         >
254:           <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
255:           <span className="font-medium">{successMsg}</span>
256:         </div>
257:       )}
258: 
259:       {errorMsg && (
260:         <div
261:           role="alert"
262:           className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 p-4 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-lg text-sm"
263:         >
264:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
265:             <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
266:             <span>{errorMsg}</span>
267:           </div>
268:           <button
269:             type="button"
270:             onClick={loadData}
271:             className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-700 underline hover:text-rose-900"
272:           >
273:             <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
274:             <span>Thử lại</span>
275:           </button>
276:         </div>
277:       )}
278: 
279:       <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-8">
280:         {/* Section 1: Thông tin cơ bản */}
281:         <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
282:           <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-slate-50/50 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
283:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
284:               <UserIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
285:               <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-800">
286:                 Thông tin cá nhân & Liên hệ
287:               </h2>
288:             </div>
289:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
290:               <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200">
291:                 <Shield className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
292:                 {user?.role || 'THÀNH VIÊN'}
293:               </span>
294:             </div>
295:           </div>
296: 
297:           <div className="p-6 space-y-6">

341:                   />
342:                 </div>

  1: 'use client';

 18: export const ReturnScanTab: React.FC = () => {

 33:       id: 'rec_1',

 35:       warehouse: 'Kho Tân Bình, HCM',
 36:       condition: 'intact',
 37:       scanned_at: '17/08/2026 08:15',
 38:       staff: 'Phạm Văn Kho',
 39:     },
 40:     {
 41:       id: 'rec_2',
 42:       tracking_code: 'GHTK77129002',
 43:       warehouse: 'Kho Tân Bình, HCM',
 44:       condition: 'damaged',

 51:   const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

 53:   const handleScanSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {

 61:     // Kiện hàng hư hỏng bắt buộc chụp ảnh làm chứng cứ
 62:     if (conditionInput !== 'intact' && !hasPhoto) {
 63:       setToastMessage({
 64:         type: 'risk',
 65:         msg: 'Kiện hàng hư hỏng hoặc thiếu hàng bắt buộc phải chụp ảnh làm bằng chứng khiếu nại.',
 66:       });

 69: 
 70:     const newItem = {

 77:       staff: 'Phạm Văn Kho (Thủ kho)',
 78:       evidence_url: hasPhoto ? 'https://storage.shipde.net/evidence/photo_proof.jpg' : undefined,
 79:     };

 81:     if (isOfflineMode) {

 86:       });
 87:     } else {
 88:       setHistory((prev) => [newItem, ...prev]);
 89:       setToastMessage({
 90:         type: 'ok',
 91:         msg: `Đã xác nhận nhận kiện hoàn ${code} vào kho Tân Bình thành công.`,
 92:       });
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     setBarcodeInput('');
 96:     setHasPhoto(false);
 97:     setConditionInput('intact');

100: 
101:   const handleSyncOffline = () => {

105:       type: 'ok',

107:     });
108:     setOfflineQueue([]);
109:   };

123:         >

138:           </button>
139:         </div>
140:       )}
141:

143:       <div className="modern-card p-6 md:p-8 space-y-6">

160:               isOfflineMode

260:           <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 flex justify-between items-center">
261:             <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-900">
262:               Có {offlineQueue.length} kiện hàng đang chờ đồng bộ lên máy chủ
263:             </span>
264:             <button type="button" onClick={handleSyncOffline} className="btn-primary text-xs">
265:               <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
266:               <span>Đồng Bộ Ngay</span>
267:             </button>
268:           </div>
269:         )}
270:       </div>
271: 
272:       {/* History Log */}
273:       <div className="modern-card p-6 space-y-4">
274:         <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">Lịch Sử Nhận Hàng Hoàn Gần Đây</h2>
275:         <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
276:           {history.map((item) => (
277:             <div key={item.id} className="py-3 flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
278:               <div className="space-y-0.5">
279:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
280:                   <TrackingCode code={item.tracking_code} />
281:                   <span
282:                     className={
283:                       item.condition === 'intact' ? 'badge-ok text-xs' : 'badge-risk text-xs'
284:                     }
285:                   >
286:                     {item.condition === 'intact' ? 'Nguyên Vẹn' : 'Hư Hỏng'}
287:                   </span>
288:                 </div>
289:                 <div className="text-slate-500">
290:                   {item.warehouse} · {item.staff}
291:                 </div>
292:               </div>
293:               <div className="text-slate-400 font-mono">{item.scanned_at}</div>
294:             </div>
295:           ))}
296:         </div>
297:       </div>
298:     </div>
299:   );
300: };

<file path="apps/web/src/components/ShopProfileForm.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState } from 'react';
  4: import {
  5:   Store,
  6:   Building2,
  7:   Receipt,
  8:   CreditCard,
  9:   Settings,
 10:   Edit3,
 11:   Save,
 12:   X,
 13:   AlertTriangle,
 14:   CheckCircle2,
 15:   RefreshCw,
 16:   ShieldAlert,
 17:   Clock,
 18:   Coins,
 19:   Package,
 20:   FileText,
 21:   Mail,
 22:   Phone,
 23:   MapPin,
 24: } from 'lucide-react';
 25: import type { ShopProfile, UpdateShopProfileInput } from '@shipde/contracts';
 26: import { SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES, isValidTimeZone } from '@shipde/contracts';
 27: 
 28: export interface ShopProfileFormState {
 29:   name: string;
 30:   legal_name: string;
 31:   tax_code: string;
 32:   contact_email: string;
 33:   contact_phone: string;
 34:   legal_address: string;
 35:   billing_email: string;
 36:   billing_address: string;
 37:   bank_name: string;
 38:   bank_account_number: string;
 39:   bank_account_name: string;
 40:   bank_branch: string;
 41:   timezone: string;
 42:   currency: string;
 43:   default_fee_payer: 'SHOP' | 'RECIPIENT';
 44:   default_weight_unit: 'g' | 'kg';
 45:   auto_routing_enabled: boolean;
 46:   operating_notes: string;
 47: }
 48: 
 49: export interface ShopProfileFormProps {
 50:   initialProfile?: ShopProfile | null;
 51:   initialLoading?: boolean;
 52:   initialMode?: 'view' | 'edit';
 53:   initialCanEdit?: boolean;
 54:   initialError?: string | null;
 55:   initialSuccess?: string | null;
 56:   initialValidationErrors?: Record<string, string>;
 57:   initialFormState?: Partial<ShopProfileFormState>;
 58:   onSave?: (data: UpdateShopProfileInput) => Promise<void>;
 59:   onRefresh?: () => void;
 60: }
 61: 
 62: const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
 63: const TAX_CODE_REGEX = /^[0-9]{10}(-[0-9]{3})?$/;
 64: const PHONE_REGEX = /^(0|\+84)[35789][0-9]{8}$/;
 65: const BANK_ACCOUNT_REGEX = /^[0-9A-Za-z]{6,30}$/;
 66: 
 67: export function validateShopProfileForm(form: ShopProfileFormState): {
 68:   isValid: boolean;
 69:   errors: Record<string, string>;
 70: } {
 71:   const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
 72: 
 73:   if (!form.name || form.name.trim().length < 2) {
 74:     errors.name = 'Tên cửa hàng phải có ít nhất 2 ký tự';
 75:   } else if (form.name.trim().length > 255) {
 76:     errors.name = 'Tên cửa hàng không được vượt quá 255 ký tự';
 77:   }
 78: 
 79:   if (form.tax_code && form.tax_code.trim()) {
 80:     const trimmed = form.tax_code.trim();
 81:     if (!TAX_CODE_REGEX.test(trimmed)) {
 82:       errors.tax_code = 'Mã số thuế không hợp lệ (10 số hoặc 13 số định dạng 0123456789-001)';
 83:     }
 84:   }
 85: 
 86:   if (form.contact_email && form.contact_email.trim()) {
 87:     if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(form.contact_email.trim())) {
 88:       errors.contact_email = 'Email liên hệ không hợp lệ';
 89:     }
 90:   }
 91: 
 92:   if (form.contact_phone && form.contact_phone.trim()) {
 93:     const cleanPhone = form.contact_phone.trim().replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
 94:     if (!PHONE_REGEX.test(cleanPhone)) {
 95:       errors.contact_phone = 'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ theo định dạng Việt Nam';
 96:     }
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   if (form.billing_email && form.billing_email.trim()) {
100:     if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(form.billing_email.trim())) {
101:       errors.billing_email = 'Email nhận hóa đơn không hợp lệ';
102:     }
103:   }
104: 
105:   if (form.bank_account_number && form.bank_account_number.trim()) {
106:     const cleanAcc = form.bank_account_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
107:     if (!BANK_ACCOUNT_REGEX.test(cleanAcc)) {
108:       errors.bank_account_number = 'Số tài khoản ngân hàng không hợp lệ (từ 6 đến 30 ký tự)';
109:     }
110:   }
111: 
112:   if (form.timezone && form.timezone.trim()) {
113:     if (!isValidTimeZone(form.timezone)) {
114:       errors.timezone = 'Múi giờ không hợp lệ';
115:     }
116:   }
117: 
118:   if (form.currency && form.currency.trim()) {
119:     const trimmed = form.currency.trim();
120:     if (trimmed !== 'VND') {
121:       errors.currency = 'Đơn vị tiền tệ mặc định phải là VND';
122:     }
123:   }
124: 
125:   if (form.operating_notes && form.operating_notes.length > 1000) {
126:     errors.operating_notes = 'Ghi chú vận hành không được vượt quá 1000 ký tự';
127:   }
128: 
129:   return {
130:     isValid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0,
131:     errors,
132:   };
133: }
134: 
135: export function ShopProfileForm({
136:   initialProfile = null,
137:   initialLoading = false,
138:   initialMode = 'view',
139:   initialCanEdit = true,
140:   initialError = null,
141:   initialSuccess = null,
142:   initialValidationErrors = {},
143:   initialFormState = {},
144:   onSave,
145:   onRefresh,
146: }: ShopProfileFormProps) {
147:   const [mode, setMode] = useState<'view' | 'edit'>(initialMode);
148:   const [profile, setProfile] = useState<ShopProfile | null>(initialProfile);
149:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(initialLoading);
150:   const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);
151:   const [canEdit] = useState<boolean>(initialCanEdit);
152:   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(initialError);
153:   const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(initialSuccess);
154:   const [validationErrors, setValidationErrors] =
155:     useState<Record<string, string>>(initialValidationErrors);
156: 
157:   const defaultState: ShopProfileFormState = {
158:     name: profile?.name || '',
159:     legal_name: profile?.legal_name || '',
160:     tax_code: profile?.tax_code || '',
161:     contact_email: profile?.contact_email || '',
162:     contact_phone: profile?.contact_phone || '',
163:     legal_address: profile?.legal_address || '',
164:     billing_email: profile?.billing_email || '',
165:     billing_address: profile?.billing_address || '',
166:     bank_name: profile?.bank_name || '',
167:     bank_account_number: profile?.bank_account_number || '',
168:     bank_account_name: profile?.bank_account_name || '',
169:     bank_branch: profile?.bank_branch || '',
170:     timezone: profile?.timezone || 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
171:     currency: profile?.currency || 'VND',
172:     default_fee_payer: profile?.default_fee_payer || 'SHOP',
173:     default_weight_unit: profile?.default_weight_unit || 'g',
174:     auto_routing_enabled: profile?.auto_routing_enabled ?? false,
175:     operating_notes: profile?.operating_notes || '',
176:     ...initialFormState,
177:   };
178: 
179:   const [formState, setFormState] = useState<ShopProfileFormState>(defaultState);
180: 
181:   const handleChange = (field: keyof ShopProfileFormState, value: string | boolean) => {
182:     setFormState((prev) => ({
183:       ...prev,
184:       [field]: value,
185:     }));
186:     if (validationErrors[field]) {
187:       setValidationErrors((prev) => {
188:         const next = { ...prev };
189:         delete next[field];
190:         return next;
191:       });
192:     }
193:   };
194: 
195:   const handleCancel = () => {
196:     if (profile) {
197:       setFormState({
198:         name: profile.name || '',
199:         legal_name: profile.legal_name || '',
200:         tax_code: profile.tax_code || '',
201:         contact_email: profile.contact_email || '',
202:         contact_phone: profile.contact_phone || '',
203:         legal_address: profile.legal_address || '',
204:         billing_email: profile.billing_email || '',
205:         billing_address: profile.billing_address || '',
206:         bank_name: profile.bank_name || '',
207:         bank_account_number: profile.bank_account_number || '',
208:         bank_account_name: profile.bank_account_name || '',
209:         bank_branch: profile.bank_branch || '',
210:         timezone: profile.timezone || 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
211:         currency: profile.currency || 'VND',
212:         default_fee_payer: profile.default_fee_payer || 'SHOP',
213:         default_weight_unit: profile.default_weight_unit || 'g',
214:         auto_routing_enabled: profile.auto_routing_enabled ?? false,
215:         operating_notes: profile.operating_notes || '',
216:       });
217:     }
218:     setValidationErrors({});
219:     setErrorMessage(null);
220:     setMode('view');
221:   };
222: 
223:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
224:     e.preventDefault();
225:     setErrorMessage(null);
226:     setSuccessMessage(null);
227: 
228:     const { isValid, errors } = validateShopProfileForm(formState);
229:     if (!isValid) {
230:       setValidationErrors(errors);
231:       return;
232:     }
233: 
234:     setSubmitting(true);
235:     try {
236:       if (onSave) {
237:         await onSave({
238:           name: formState.name,
239:           legal_name: formState.legal_name || null,
240:           tax_code: formState.tax_code || null,
241:           contact_email: formState.contact_email || null,
242:           contact_phone: formState.contact_phone || null,
243:           legal_address: formState.legal_address || null,
244:           billing_email: formState.billing_email || null,
245:           billing_address: formState.billing_address || null,
246:           bank_name: formState.bank_name || null,
247:           bank_account_number: formState.bank_account_number || null,
248:           bank_account_name: formState.bank_account_name
249:             ? formState.bank_account_name.toUpperCase()
250:             : null,
251:           bank_branch: formState.bank_branch || null,
252:           timezone: formState.timezone,
253:           currency: formState.currency,
254:           default_fee_payer: formState.default_fee_payer,
255:           default_weight_unit: formState.default_weight_unit,
256:           auto_routing_enabled: formState.auto_routing_enabled,
257:           operating_notes: formState.operating_notes || null,
258:         });
259:       }
260:       setSuccessMessage('Đã cập nhật hồ sơ shop thành công');
261:       setMode('view');
262:     } catch (err: any) {
263:       setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Không thể lưu hồ sơ shop. Vui lòng thử lại sau.');
264:     } finally {
265:       setSubmitting(false);
266:     }
267:   };
268: 
269:   // 1. Loading Skeleton State
270:   if (loading) {
271:     return (
272:       <div className="space-y-6 animate-pulse" data-testid="shop-profile-loading">
273:         <div className="h-20 bg-slate-200 rounded-2xl w-full" />
274:         <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
275:           <div className="h-64 bg-slate-200 rounded-2xl" />
276:           <div className="h-64 bg-slate-200 rounded-2xl" />
277:         </div>
278:         <div className="h-48 bg-slate-200 rounded-2xl w-full" />
279:         <div className="text-center text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">
280:           Đang tải hồ sơ cửa hàng...
281:         </div>
282:       </div>
283:     );
284:   }
285: 
286:   return (
287:     <div className="space-y-6" data-testid="shop-profile-container">
288:       {/* Top Header Banner */}
289:       <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xs flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
290:         <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
291:           <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
292:             <Store className="w-6 h-6" />
293:           </div>
294:           <div>
295:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
296:               <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900" data-testid="shop-name-title">
297:                 {profile?.name || formState.name || 'Cửa hàng'}
298:               </h1>
299:               {profile?.code && (
300:                 <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200">
301:                   {profile.code}
302:                 </span>
303:               )}
304:               <span className="text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
305:                 {profile?.status === 'active' ? 'Đang hoạt động' : profile?.status || 'Active'}
306:               </span>
307:             </div>
308:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
309:               Hồ sơ pháp lý doanh nghiệp, tài khoản nhận đối soát COD và cấu hình giao vận mặc định.
310:             </p>
311:           </div>
312:         </div>
313: 
314:         {/* Action Controls */}
315:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end">
316:           {mode === 'view' && canEdit && (
317:             <button
318:               type="button"
319:               onClick={() => setMode('edit')}
320:               data-testid="edit-shop-button"
321:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white rounded-xl shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"
322:             >
323:               <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
324:               <span>Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ</span>
325:             </button>
326:           )}
327: 
328:           {mode === 'edit' && (
329:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
330:               <button
331:                 type="button"
332:                 onClick={handleCancel}
333:                 data-testid="cancel-edit-button"
334:                 disabled={submitting}
335:                 className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
336:               >
337:                 <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
338:                 <span>Hủy bỏ</span>
339:               </button>
340:               <button
341:                 type="submit"
342:                 form="shop-profile-form"
343:                 data-testid="save-shop-button"
344:                 disabled={submitting}
345:                 className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white rounded-xl shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
346:               >
347:                 {submitting ? (

349:                 ) : (

351:                 )}
352:                 <span>Lưu thay đổi</span>
353:               </button>
354:             </div>
355:           )}
356:         </div>
357:       </div>
358: 
359:       {/* Forbidden Notice when non-authorized role accesses */}
360:       {!canEdit && (
361:         <div
362:           className="bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-start gap-3"
363:           data-testid="shop-profile-forbidden-banner"
364:         >
365:           <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
366:           <div>
367:             <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-900">Giới hạn quyền cấu hình cửa hàng</h4>
368:             <p className="text-xs text-amber-700 mt-0.5">
369:               Tài khoản của bạn chỉ có quyền xem thông tin. Vui lòng liên hệ Chủ Shop để được cấp
370:               quyền thực hiện thay đổi hồ sơ tổ chức.
371:             </p>
372:           </div>
373:         </div>
374:       )}
375: 
376:       {/* Persistent Server Error Banner with Retry */}
377:       {errorMessage && (
378:         <div
379:           className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
380:           data-testid="shop-profile-error-banner"
381:         >
382:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
383:             <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
384:             <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-rose-800">{errorMessage}</span>
385:           </div>
386:           {onRefresh && (

389:               onClick={onRefresh}

392:             >
393:               <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" />
394:               <span>Thử lại</span>
395:             </button>

397:         </div>

399: 
400:       {/* Success Notification Banner */}
401:       {successMessage && (
402:         <div

406:           <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />

408:         </div>
409:       )}
410: 
411:       {/* Main Content: View Mode vs Edit Form */}
412:       {mode === 'view' ? (
413:         <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6" data-testid="shop-profile-view-grid">
414:           {/* Section 1: Legal Profile */}

418:               <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider">
419:                 1. Thông Tin Pháp Lý

422: 
423:             <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
424:               <div>
425:                 <span className="text-slate-400 block font-medium">
426:                   Tên thương hiệu / Cửa hàng:

429:                   {profile?.name || '—'}
430:                 </span>

466:           </div>

469:           <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
470:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">

472:               <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider">
473:                 2. Thanh Toán & Đối Soát COD

477:             <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
478:               <div>
479:                 <span className="text-slate-400 block font-medium">Email nhận hóa đơn GTGT:</span>

481:                   <Receipt className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />

 13:   | 'claims'
 14:   | 'source_matching'
 15:   | 'public_tracking'
 16:   | 'notifications'

 19:   | 'mobile_preview';

<file path="apps/web/src/components/WarehouseManagementView.tsx">
   1: 'use client';
   2: 
   3: import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
   4: import {
   5:   Warehouse as WarehouseIcon,
   6:   Plus,
   7:   Edit3,
   8:   CheckCircle2,
   9:   AlertTriangle,
  10:   ShieldAlert,
  11:   RefreshCw,
  12:   X,
  13:   Save,
  14:   Star,
  15:   Phone,
  16:   Mail,
  17:   MapPin,
  18:   Clock,
  19:   Printer,
  20:   Search,
  21:   Power,
  22:   RotateCcw,
  23:   FileText,
  24: } from 'lucide-react';
  25: import type {
  26:   Warehouse,
  27:   CreateWarehouseInput,
  28:   UpdateWarehouseInput,
  29:   WarehouseFormState,
  30: } from '@shipde/contracts';
  31: import {
  32:   validateWarehouseForm,
  33:   ALLOWED_WAREHOUSE_PAPER_SIZES,
  34:   ALLOWED_WAREHOUSE_DPIS,
  35: } from '@shipde/contracts';
  36: 
  37: export interface WarehouseManagementViewProps {
  38:   warehouses?: Warehouse[];
  39:   loading?: boolean;
  40:   canEdit?: boolean;
  41:   scopedWarehouses?: string[] | null;
  42:   error?: string | null;
  43:   success?: string | null;
  44:   initialFormOpen?: boolean;
  45:   initialEditingWarehouse?: Warehouse | null;
  46:   initialFormState?: Partial<WarehouseFormState>;
  47:   initialValidationErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  48:   initialActiveTab?: 'pickup' | 'return' | 'schedule' | 'printer';
  49:   onRefresh?: () => void;
  50:   onCreate?: (input: CreateWarehouseInput) => Promise<void>;
  51:   onUpdate?: (id: string, input: UpdateWarehouseInput) => Promise<void>;
  52:   onSetDefault?: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  53:   onActivate?: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  54:   onDeactivate?: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  55: }
  56: 
  57: export function WarehouseManagementView({
  58:   warehouses = [],
  59:   loading = false,
  60:   canEdit = false,
  61:   scopedWarehouses = null,
  62:   error = null,
  63:   success = null,
  64:   initialFormOpen = false,
  65:   initialEditingWarehouse = null,
  66:   initialFormState = {},
  67:   initialValidationErrors = {},
  68:   initialActiveTab = 'pickup',
  69:   onRefresh,
  70:   onCreate,
  71:   onUpdate,
  72:   onSetDefault,
  73:   onActivate,
  74:   onDeactivate,
  75: }: WarehouseManagementViewProps) {
  76:   // Filter & Search states
  77:   const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'active' | 'inactive'>('ALL');
  78:   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  79: 
  80:   // Modal / Form state
  81:   const [isFormOpen, setIsFormOpen] = useState(initialFormOpen);
  82:   const [editingWarehouse, setEditingWarehouse] = useState<Warehouse | null>(
  83:     initialEditingWarehouse
  84:   );
  85:   const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'pickup' | 'return' | 'schedule' | 'printer'>(
  86:     initialActiveTab
  87:   );
  88:   const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  89:   const [actionLoadingId, setActionLoadingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  90: 
  91:   // Form field states
  92:   const [formState, setFormState] = useState<WarehouseFormState>({
  93:     name: initialEditingWarehouse?.name || initialFormState.name || '',
  94:     code: initialEditingWarehouse?.code || initialFormState.code || '',
  95:     status:
  96:       (initialEditingWarehouse?.status as 'active' | 'inactive') ||
  97:       initialFormState.status ||
  98:       'active',
  99:     is_default:
 100:       initialEditingWarehouse?.is_default ?? initialFormState.is_default ?? warehouses.length === 0,
 101:     contact_name: initialEditingWarehouse?.contact_name || initialFormState.contact_name || '',
 102:     contact_phone: initialEditingWarehouse?.contact_phone || initialFormState.contact_phone || '',
 103:     contact_email: initialEditingWarehouse?.contact_email || initialFormState.contact_email || '',
 104:     address_line: initialEditingWarehouse?.address_line || initialFormState.address_line || '',
 105:     ward: initialEditingWarehouse?.ward || initialFormState.ward || '',
 106:     district: initialEditingWarehouse?.district || initialFormState.district || '',
 107:     city: initialEditingWarehouse?.city || initialFormState.city || '',
 108:     postal_code: initialEditingWarehouse?.postal_code || initialFormState.postal_code || '',
 109:     use_different_return_address:
 110:       initialEditingWarehouse?.use_different_return_address ??
 111:       initialFormState.use_different_return_address ??
 112:       false,
 113:     return_contact_name:
 114:       initialEditingWarehouse?.return_contact_name || initialFormState.return_contact_name || '',
 115:     return_contact_phone:
 116:       initialEditingWarehouse?.return_contact_phone || initialFormState.return_contact_phone || '',
 117:     return_address_line:
 118:       initialEditingWarehouse?.return_address_line || initialFormState.return_address_line || '',
 119:     return_ward: initialEditingWarehouse?.return_ward || initialFormState.return_ward || '',
 120:     return_district:
 121:       initialEditingWarehouse?.return_district || initialFormState.return_district || '',
 122:     return_city: initialEditingWarehouse?.return_city || initialFormState.return_city || '',
 123:     cutoff_time: initialEditingWarehouse?.cutoff_time || initialFormState.cutoff_time || '',
 124:     schedule_notes:
 125:       initialEditingWarehouse?.schedule_notes || initialFormState.schedule_notes || '',
 126:     printer_paper_size:
 127:       (initialEditingWarehouse?.printer_paper_size as 'A6' | 'A5' | 'A4' | 'K80') ||
 128:       initialFormState.printer_paper_size ||
 129:       'A6',
 130:     printer_dpi:
 131:       (initialEditingWarehouse?.printer_dpi as 203 | 300) || initialFormState.printer_dpi || 203,
 132:     printer_name: initialEditingWarehouse?.printer_name || initialFormState.printer_name || '',
 133:     printer_auto_print:
 134:       initialEditingWarehouse?.printer_auto_print ?? initialFormState.printer_auto_print ?? false,
 135:   });
 136: 
 137:   const [validationErrors, setValidationErrors] =
 138:     useState<Record<string, string>>(initialValidationErrors);
 139:   const [modalError, setModalError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 140:   const [localError, setLocalError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 141:   const [localSuccess, setLocalSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
 142: 
 143:   const viewError = localError ?? error;
 144:   const viewSuccess = localSuccess ?? success;
 145:   const setViewError = (val: string | null) => setLocalError(val);
 146:   const setViewSuccess = (val: string | null) => setLocalSuccess(val);
 147: 
 148:   // Filtered warehouses
 149:   const filteredWarehouses = useMemo(() => {
 150:     return warehouses.filter((wh) => {
 151:       if (statusFilter !== 'ALL' && wh.status !== statusFilter) {
 152:         return false;
 153:       }
 154:       if (searchQuery.trim()) {
 155:         const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
 156:         const matchName = wh.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 157:         const matchCode = wh.code.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 158:         const matchContact = wh.contact_name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 159:         const matchPhone = wh.contact_phone.includes(q);
 160:         const matchCity = wh.city.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 161:         const matchDistrict = wh.district.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 162:         const matchAddress = wh.address_line.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 163:         return (
 164:           matchName ||
 165:           matchCode ||
 166:           matchContact ||
 167:           matchPhone ||
 168:           matchCity ||
 169:           matchDistrict ||
 170:           matchAddress
 171:         );
 172:       }
 173:       return true;
 174:     });
 175:   }, [warehouses, statusFilter, searchQuery]);
 176: 
 177:   const activeCount = useMemo(
 178:     () => warehouses.filter((w) => w.status === 'active').length,
 179:     [warehouses]
 180:   );
 181:   const inactiveCount = useMemo(
 182:     () => warehouses.filter((w) => w.status === 'inactive').length,
 183:     [warehouses]
 184:   );
 185: 
 186:   const isRestrictedScope = useMemo(() => {
 187:     return (
 188:       Array.isArray(scopedWarehouses) &&
 189:       scopedWarehouses.length > 0 &&
 190:       !scopedWarehouses.includes('*')
 191:     );
 192:   }, [scopedWarehouses]);
 193: 
 194:   // Open Create Form
 195:   const handleOpenCreate = () => {
 196:     if (!canEdit) return;
 197:     setEditingWarehouse(null);
 198:     setActiveTab('pickup');
 199:     setFormState({
 200:       name: '',
 201:       code: '',
 202:       status: 'active',
 203:       is_default: warehouses.length === 0,
 204:       contact_name: '',
 205:       contact_phone: '',
 206:       contact_email: '',
 207:       address_line: '',
 208:       ward: '',
 209:       district: '',
 210:       city: '',
 211:       postal_code: '',
 212:       use_different_return_address: false,
 213:       return_contact_name: '',
 214:       return_contact_phone: '',
 215:       return_address_line: '',
 216:       return_ward: '',
 217:       return_district: '',
 218:       return_city: '',
 219:       cutoff_time: '',
 220:       schedule_notes: '',
 221:       printer_paper_size: 'A6',
 222:       printer_dpi: 203,
 223:       printer_name: '',
 224:       printer_auto_print: false,
 225:     });
 226:     setValidationErrors({});
 227:     setModalError(null);
 228:     setIsFormOpen(true);
 229:   };
 230: 
 231:   // Open Edit Form
 232:   const handleOpenEdit = (wh: Warehouse) => {
 233:     if (!canEdit) return;
 234:     setEditingWarehouse(wh);
 235:     setActiveTab('pickup');
 236:     setFormState({
 237:       name: wh.name,
 238:       code: wh.code,
 239:       status: wh.status as 'active' | 'inactive',
 240:       is_default: wh.is_default,
 241:       contact_name: wh.contact_name,
 242:       contact_phone: wh.contact_phone,
 243:       contact_email: wh.contact_email || '',
 244:       address_line: wh.address_line,
 245:       ward: wh.ward || '',
 246:       district: wh.district,
 247:       city: wh.city,
 248:       postal_code: wh.postal_code || '',
 249:       use_different_return_address: wh.use_different_return_address,
 250:       return_contact_name: wh.return_contact_name || '',
 251:       return_contact_phone: wh.return_contact_phone || '',
 252:       return_address_line: wh.return_address_line || '',
 253:       return_ward: wh.return_ward || '',
 254:       return_district: wh.return_district || '',
 255:       return_city: wh.return_city || '',
 256:       cutoff_time: wh.cutoff_time || '',
 257:       schedule_notes: wh.schedule_notes || '',
 258:       printer_paper_size: (wh.printer_paper_size as 'A6' | 'A5' | 'A4' | 'K80') || 'A6',
 259:       printer_dpi: (wh.printer_dpi as 203 | 300) || 203,
 260:       printer_name: wh.printer_name || '',
 261:       printer_auto_print: wh.printer_auto_print,
 262:     });
 263:     setValidationErrors({});
 264:     setModalError(null);
 265:     setIsFormOpen(true);
 266:   };
 267: 
 268:   const handleCloseForm = () => {
 269:     setIsFormOpen(false);
 270:     setEditingWarehouse(null);
 271:     setValidationErrors({});
 272:     setModalError(null);
 273:   };
 274: 
 275:   const handleFormFieldChange = <K extends keyof WarehouseFormState>(
 276:     field: K,
 277:     value: WarehouseFormState[K]
 278:   ) => {
 279:     setFormState((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
 280:     if (validationErrors[field]) {
 281:       setValidationErrors((prev) => {
 282:         const next = { ...prev };
 283:         delete next[field];
 284:         return next;
 285:       });
 286:     }
 287:   };
 288: 
 289:   const handleSubmitForm = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 290:     e.preventDefault();
 291:     if (!canEdit) return;
 292: 
 293:     const validation = validateWarehouseForm(formState);
 294:     if (!validation.isValid) {
 295:       setValidationErrors(validation.errors);
 296:       // Switch to tab with first error
 297:       if (
 298:         validation.errors.name ||
 299:         validation.errors.code ||
 300:         validation.errors.contact_name ||
 301:         validation.errors.contact_phone ||
 302:         validation.errors.contact_email ||
 303:         validation.errors.address_line ||
 304:         validation.errors.district ||
 305:         validation.errors.city
 306:       ) {
 307:         setActiveTab('pickup');
 308:       } else if (
 309:         validation.errors.return_contact_name ||
 310:         validation.errors.return_contact_phone ||
 311:         validation.errors.return_address_line ||
 312:         validation.errors.return_district ||
 313:         validation.errors.return_city
 314:       ) {
 315:         setActiveTab('return');
 316:       } else if (validation.errors.cutoff_time) {
 317:         setActiveTab('schedule');
 318:       } else if (validation.errors.printer_paper_size || validation.errors.printer_dpi) {
 319:         setActiveTab('printer');
 320:       }
 321:       return;
 322:     }
 323: 
 324:     setSubmitting(true);
 325:     setModalError(null);
 326: 
 327:     try {
 328:       if (editingWarehouse) {
 329:         const updatePayload: UpdateWarehouseInput = {
 330:           name: formState.name.trim(),
 331:           code: formState.code.trim() || undefined,
 332:           status: formState.status,
 333:           is_default: formState.is_default,
 334:           contact_name: formState.contact_name.trim(),
 335:           contact_phone: formState.contact_phone.trim(),
 336:           contact_email: formState.contact_email.trim() || null,
 337:           address_line: formState.address_line.trim(),
 338:           ward: formState.ward.trim() || null,
 339:           district: formState.district.trim(),
 340:           city: formState.city.trim(),
 341:           postal_code: formState.postal_code.trim() || null,
 342:           use_different_return_address: formState.use_different_return_address,
 343:           return_contact_name: formState.use_different_return_address
 344:             ? formState.return_contact_name.trim() || null
 345:             : null,
 346:           return_contact_phone: formState.use_different_return_address
 347:             ? formState.return_contact_phone.trim() || null
 348:             : null,
 349:           return_address_line: formState.use_different_return_address
 350:             ? formState.return_address_line.trim() || null
 351:             : null,
 352:           return_ward: formState.use_different_return_address
 353:             ? formState.return_ward.trim() || null
 354:             : null,
 355:           return_district: formState.use_different_return_address
 356:             ? formState.return_district.trim() || null
 357:             : null,
 358:           return_city: formState.use_different_return_address
 359:             ? formState.return_city.trim() || null
 360:             : null,
 361:           cutoff_time: formState.cutoff_time.trim() || null,
 362:           schedule_notes: formState.schedule_notes.trim() || null,
 363:           printer_paper_size: formState.printer_paper_size,
 364:           printer_dpi: formState.printer_dpi,
 365:           printer_name: formState.printer_name.trim() || null,
 366:           printer_auto_print: formState.printer_auto_print,
 367:         };
 368: 
 369:         if (!onUpdate) {
 370:           throw new Error('Chức năng cập nhật kho hàng chưa được hỗ trợ.');
 371:         }
 372:         await onUpdate(editingWarehouse.id, updatePayload);
 373:         setViewSuccess(`Đã cập nhật kho hàng "${formState.name}" thành công.`);
 374:       } else {
 375:         const createPayload: CreateWarehouseInput = {
 376:           name: formState.name.trim(),
 377:           code: formState.code.trim() || undefined,
 378:           is_default: formState.is_default,
 379:           contact_name: formState.contact_name.trim(),
 380:           contact_phone: formState.contact_phone.trim(),
 381:           contact_email: formState.contact_email.trim() || null,
 382:           address_line: formState.address_line.trim(),
 383:           ward: formState.ward.trim() || null,
 384:           district: formState.district.trim(),
 385:           city: formState.city.trim(),
 386:           postal_code: formState.postal_code.trim() || null,
 387:           use_different_return_address: formState.use_different_return_address,
 388:           return_contact_name: formState.use_different_return_address
 389:             ? formState.return_contact_name.trim() || null
 390:             : null,
 391:           return_contact_phone: formState.use_different_return_address
 392:             ? formState.return_contact_phone.trim() || null
 393:             : null,
 394:           return_address_line: formState.use_different_return_address
 395:             ? formState.return_address_line.trim() || null
 396:             : null,
 397:           return_ward: formState.use_different_return_address
 398:             ? formState.return_ward.trim() || null
 399:             : null,
 400:           return_district: formState.use_different_return_address
 401:             ? formState.return_district.trim() || null
 402:             : null,
 403:           return_city: formState.use_different_return_address
 404:             ? formState.return_city.trim() || null
 405:             : null,
 406:           cutoff_time: formState.cutoff_time.trim() || null,
 407:           schedule_notes: formState.schedule_notes.trim() || null,
 408:           printer_paper_size: formState.printer_paper_size,
 409:           printer_dpi: formState.printer_dpi,
 410:           printer_name: formState.printer_name.trim() || null,
 411:           printer_auto_print: formState.printer_auto_print,
 412:         };
 413: 
 414:         if (!onCreate) {
 415:           throw new Error('Chức năng thêm mới kho hàng chưa được hỗ trợ.');
 416:         }
 417:         await onCreate(createPayload);
 418:         setViewSuccess(`Đã thêm mới kho hàng "${formState.name}" thành công.`);
 419:       }
 420: 
 421:       handleCloseForm();
 422:     } catch (err: any) {
 423:       setModalError(err?.message || 'Có lỗi xảy ra khi lưu kho hàng.');
 424:     } finally {
 425:       setSubmitting(false);
 426:     }
 427:   };
 428: 
 429:   const handleSetDefaultAction = async (wh: Warehouse) => {
 430:     if (!canEdit || wh.is_default || !onSetDefault) return;
 431:     setActionLoadingId(wh.id);
 432:     setViewError(null);
 433:     try {
 434:       await onSetDefault(wh.id);
 435:       setViewSuccess(`Đã đặt kho "${wh.name}" làm kho mặc định.`);
 436:     } catch (err: any) {
 437:       setViewError(err?.message || 'Không thể đặt kho mặc định.');
 438:     } finally {
 439:       setActionLoadingId(null);
 440:     }
 441:   };
 442: 
 443:   const handleToggleStatusAction = async (wh: Warehouse) => {
 444:     if (!canEdit) return;
 445:     setActionLoadingId(wh.id);
 446:     setViewError(null);
 447:     try {
 448:       if (wh.status === 'active') {
 449:         if (onDeactivate) {
 450:           await onDeactivate(wh.id);
 451:           setViewSuccess(`Đã tạm ngưng kho hàng "${wh.name}".`);
 452:         }
 453:       } else {
 454:         if (onActivate) {
 455:           await onActivate(wh.id);
 456:           setViewSuccess(`Đã kích hoạt kho hàng "${wh.name}".`);
 457:         }
 458:       }
 459:     } catch (err: any) {
 460:       setViewError(err?.message || 'Không thể thay đổi trạng thái kho hàng.');
 461:     } finally {
 462:       setActionLoadingId(null);
 463:     }
 464:   };
 465: 
 466:   return (
 467:     <div className="space-y-6">
 468:       {/* Notifications: Server Error Banner */}
 469:       {viewError && (
 470:         <div
 471:           data-testid="warehouse-error-banner"
 472:           className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 p-4 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-2xl text-rose-800"
 473:         >
 474:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 475:             <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
 476:             <div className="text-xs">
 477:               <span className="font-bold">Lỗi vận hành: </span>
 478:               <span>{viewError}</span>
 479:             </div>
 480:           </div>
 481:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 482:             {onRefresh && (
 483:               <button
 484:                 type="button"
 485:                 onClick={onRefresh}
 486:                 data-testid="retry-error-button"
 487:                 className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold bg-white border border-rose-300 rounded-lg text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-100 transition cursor-pointer"
 488:               >
 489:                 <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
 490:                 <span>Thử lại</span>
 491:               </button>
 492:             )}
 493:             <button
 494:               type="button"
 495:               onClick={() => setViewError(null)}
 496:               data-testid="dismiss-error-button"
 497:               className="p-1 hover:bg-rose-100 rounded-lg text-rose-600 transition cursor-pointer"
 498:               aria-label="Đóng thông báo lỗi"
 499:               title="Đóng thông báo lỗi"
 500:             >
 501:               <X className="w-4 h-4" />
 502:             </button>
 503:           </div>
 504:         </div>
 505:       )}
 506: 
 507:       {/* Notifications: Success Notification Banner */}
 508:       {viewSuccess && (
 509:         <div
 510:           data-testid="warehouse-success-banner"
 511:           className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-2xl text-emerald-800"
 512:         >
 513:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 514:             <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
 515:             <div className="text-xs font-semibold">{viewSuccess}</div>
 516:           </div>
 517:           <button
 518:             type="button"
 519:             onClick={() => setViewSuccess(null)}
 520:             data-testid="dismiss-success-button"
 521:             className="p-1 hover:bg-emerald-100 rounded-lg text-emerald-600 transition cursor-pointer"
 522:             aria-label="Đóng thông báo thành công"
 523:             title="Đóng thông báo thành công"
 524:           >
 525:             <X className="w-4 h-4" />
 526:           </button>
 527:         </div>
 528:       )}
 529: 
 530:       {/* Scoped Access Banner */}
 531:       {isRestrictedScope && (
 532:         <div
 533:           data-testid="warehouse-scoped-banner"
 534:           className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3.5 bg-sky-50 border border-sky-200 rounded-2xl text-sky-800 text-xs"
 535:         >
 536:           <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600 shrink-0" />
 537:           <div>
 538:             <span className="font-bold">Phạm vi kho hàng theo phân quyền: </span>
 539:             <span>
 540:               Tài khoản của bạn được giới hạn thao tác trong danh sách kho được phân quyền (
 541:               {scopedWarehouses?.join(', ')}).
 542:             </span>
 543:           </div>
 544:         </div>
 545:       )}
 546: 
 547:       {/* Forbidden Banner (View-Only Mode) */}
 548:       {!canEdit && (
 549:         <div
 550:           data-testid="warehouse-forbidden-banner"
 551:           className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3.5 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-2xl text-amber-800 text-xs"
 552:         >
 553:           <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
 554:           <div>
 555:             <span className="font-bold">Giới hạn quyền cấu hình kho hàng: </span>
 556:             <span>
 557:               Bạn chỉ có quyền xem danh sách kho. Quyền tạo, cập nhật hoặc thay đổi kho mặc định yêu
 558:               cầu quyền quản trị viên hoặc iam:shop_config.
 559:             </span>
 560:           </div>
 561:         </div>
 562:       )}
 563: 
 564:       {/* Header and Controls */}
 565:       <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs">
 566:         <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
 567:           <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-orange-100 text-orange-600 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
 568:             <WarehouseIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
 569:           </div>
 570:           <div>
 571:             <h1 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800">Quản lý Chi nhánh &amp; Kho hàng</h1>
 572:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
 573:               Thiết lập địa chỉ lấy hàng, địa chỉ hoàn, lịch lấy hàng và cấu hình in nhãn bưu gửi
 574:             </p>
 575:           </div>
 576:         </div>
 577: 
 578:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 579:           {onRefresh && (
 580:             <button
 581:               type="button"
 582:               onClick={onRefresh}
 583:               data-testid="refresh-warehouses-button"
 584:               disabled={loading}
 585:               className="p-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
 586:               aria-label="Làm mới danh sách kho hàng"
 587:               title="Làm mới danh sách"
 588:             >
 589:               <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
 590:             </button>
 591:           )}
 592: 
 593:           {canEdit && (
 594:             <button
 595:               type="button"
 596:               onClick={handleOpenCreate}
 597:               data-testid="create-warehouse-button"
 598:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white rounded-xl shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"
 599:             >
 600:               <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
 601:               <span>Thêm kho mới</span>
 602:             </button>
 603:           )}
 604:         </div>
 605:       </div>
 606: 
 607:       {/* Search & Filter Bar */}
 608:       <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs">
 609:         <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-md">
 610:           <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
 611:           <input
 612:             type="text"
 613:             id="input-search-warehouse"
 614:             aria-label="Tìm kiếm kho hàng"
 615:             value={searchQuery}
 616:             onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
 617:             placeholder="Tìm theo tên kho, mã kho, người liên hệ, địa chỉ..."
 618:             data-testid="input-search-warehouse"
 619:             className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/20 focus:border-orange-500 transition"
 620:           />
 621:         </div>
 622: 
 623:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 624:           <label htmlFor="filter-status" className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
 625:             Trạng thái:
 626:           </label>
 627:           <select
 628:             id="filter-status"
 629:             aria-label="Lọc theo trạng thái kho hàng"
 630:             value={statusFilter}
 631:             onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value as any)}
 632:             data-testid="filter-status"
 633:             className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-700 font-medium focus:bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:border-orange-500 transition"
 634:           >
 635:             <option value="ALL">Tất cả ({warehouses.length})</option>
 636:             <option value="active">Đang hoạt động ({activeCount})</option>
 637:             <option value="inactive">Tạm ngưng ({inactiveCount})</option>
 638:           </select>
 639:         </div>
 640:       </div>
 641: 
 642:       {/* Loading Skeleton State */}
 643:       {loading && (
 644:         <div data-testid="warehouse-loading-state" className="space-y-4">
 645:           <div className="p-8 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3">
 646:             <RefreshCw className="w-8 h-8 text-orange-500 animate-spin" />
 647:             <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">Đang tải danh sách kho hàng...</p>
 648:           </div>
 649:           <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
 650:             {[1, 2].map((i) => (
 651:               <div
 652:                 key={i}
 653:                 className="p-5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl space-y-3 animate-pulse"
 654:               >
 655:                 <div className="h-4 bg-slate-200 rounded-md w-1/3" />
 656:                 <div className="h-3 bg-slate-100 rounded-md w-2/3" />
 657:                 <div className="h-3 bg-slate-100 rounded-md w-1/2" />
 658:               </div>
 659:             ))}
 660:           </div>
 661:         </div>
 662:       )}
 663: 
 664:       {/* Empty State */}
 665:       {!loading && filteredWarehouses.length === 0 && (
 666:         <div
 667:           data-testid="warehouse-empty-state"
 668:           className="p-12 bg-white border border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-4"
 669:         >
 670:           <div className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto rounded-full bg-orange-50 text-orange-500 flex items-center justify-center">
 671:             <WarehouseIcon className="w-6 h-6" />
 672:           </div>
 673:           <div className="space-y-1">
 674:             <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
 675:               {searchQuery || statusFilter !== 'ALL'
 676:                 ? 'Không tìm thấy kho hàng phù hợp'
 677:                 : 'Chưa có kho hàng nào được thiết lập'}
 678:             </h3>
 679:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-sm mx-auto">
 680:               {searchQuery || statusFilter !== 'ALL'
 681:                 ? 'Thử thay đổi từ khóa tìm kiếm hoặc bỏ bộ lọc trạng thái để xem đầy đủ.'
 682:                 : 'Tạo kho hàng đầu tiên để bắt đầu tạo vận đơn, thiết lập điểm lấy hàng và địa chỉ hoàn trả.'}
 683:             </p>
 684:           </div>
 685:           {canEdit && !searchQuery && statusFilter === 'ALL' && (
 686:             <button
 687:               type="button"
 688:               onClick={handleOpenCreate}
 689:               data-testid="empty-create-warehouse-button"
 690:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white rounded-xl shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"
 691:             >
 692:               <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
 693:               <span>Thêm kho hàng đầu tiên</span>
 694:             </button>
 695:           )}
 696:         </div>
 697:       )}
 698: 
 699:       {/* List / Grid Cards */}
 700:       {!loading && filteredWarehouses.length > 0 && (
 701:         <div data-testid="warehouse-list-state" className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
 702:           {filteredWarehouses.map((wh) => {
 703:             const isActionBusy = actionLoadingId === wh.id;
 704:             return (
 705:               <div
 706:                 key={wh.id}
 707:                 data-testid={`warehouse-card-${wh.id}`}
 708:                 className={`bg-white border rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xs transition space-y-4 ${
 709:                   wh.is_default
 710:                     ? 'border-orange-300/80 ring-1 ring-orange-200/50'
 711:                     : 'border-slate-200/80 hover:border-slate-300'
 712:                 }`}
 713:               >
 714:                 {/* Card Header */}
 715:                 <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
 716:                   <div className="space-y-1">
 717:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
 718:                       <span className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">{wh.name}</span>
 719:                       <span className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 rounded-md">
 720:                         {wh.code}
 721:                       </span>
 722:                       {wh.is_default && (
 723:                         <span
 724:                           data-testid={`badge-default-warehouse-${wh.id}`}
 725:                           className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 rounded-md"
 726:                         >
 727:                           <Star className="w-3 h-3 fill-orange-500 text-orange-500" />
 728:                           <span>Kho mặc định</span>
 729:                         </span>
 730:                       )}
 731:                     </div>
 732:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 733:                       <span
 734:                         data-testid={`badge-status-warehouse-${wh.id}`}
 735:                         className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold rounded-md ${
 736:                           wh.status === 'active'
 737:                             ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200'
 738:                             : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border border-slate-200'
 739:                         }`}
 740:                       >
 741:                         <span
 742:                           className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
 743:                             wh.status === 'active' ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-slate-400'
 744:                           }`}
 745:                         />
 746:                         <span>{wh.status === 'active' ? 'Đang hoạt động' : 'Tạm ngưng'}</span>
 747:                       </span>
 748:                     </div>
 749:                   </div>
 750: 
 751:                   {/* Top Action Buttons */}
 752:                   {canEdit && (
 753:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
 754:                       <button
 755:                         type="button"
 756:                         onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(wh)}
 757:                         data-testid={`edit-warehouse-button-${wh.id}`}
 758:                         className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer"
 759:                         aria-label={`Chỉnh sửa kho ${wh.name}`}
 760:                         title="Chỉnh sửa kho"
 761:                       >
 762:                         <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4" />
 763:                       </button>
 764:                     </div>
 765:                   )}
 766:                 </div>
 767: 
 768:                 {/* Pickup Address Section */}
 769:                 <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
 770:                   <div className="font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
 771:                     <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-600" />
 772:                     <span>Địa chỉ lấy hàng (Pickup):</span>
 773:                   </div>
 774:                   <p className="pl-5 text-slate-700 font-medium">
 775:                     {wh.address_line}
 776:                     {wh.ward ? `, ${wh.ward}` : ''}, {wh.district}, {wh.city}
 777:                     {wh.postal_code ? ` (Mã bưu chính: ${wh.postal_code})` : ''}
 778:                   </p>
 779:                   <div className="pl-5 flex items-center gap-4 text-slate-500 flex-wrap">
 780:                     <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
 781:                       <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">{wh.contact_name}</span>
 782:                     </span>
 783:                     <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
 784:                       <Phone className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
 785:                       <span>{wh.contact_phone}</span>
 786:                     </span>
 787:                     {wh.contact_email && (
 788:                       <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
 789:                         <Mail className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
 790:                         <span>{wh.contact_email}</span>
 791:                       </span>
 792:                     )}
 793:                   </div>
 794:                 </div>
 795: 
 796:                 {/* Return Address Section */}
 797:                 <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
 798:                   <div className="font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
 799:                     <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
 800:                     <span>Địa chỉ nhận hoàn (Return):</span>
 801:                   </div>
 802:                   {wh.use_different_return_address ? (
 803:                     <div className="pl-5 space-y-1">
 804:                       <p className="text-slate-700 font-medium">
 805:                         {wh.return_address_line}
 806:                         {wh.return_ward ? `, ${wh.return_ward}` : ''}, {wh.return_district},{' '}
 807:                         {wh.return_city}
 808:                       </p>
 809:                       <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-slate-500">
 810:                         {wh.return_contact_name && (
 811:                           <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
 812:                             {wh.return_contact_name}
 813:                           </span>
 814:                         )}
 815:                         {wh.return_contact_phone && (
 816:                           <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
 817:                             <Phone className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
 818:                             <span>{wh.return_contact_phone}</span>
 819:                           </span>
 820:                         )}
 821:                       </div>
 822:                     </div>
 823:                   ) : (
 824:                     <p className="pl-5 text-slate-500 italic">Cùng địa chỉ với điểm lấy hàng</p>
 825:                   )}
 826:                 </div>
 827: 
 828:                 {/* Schedule & Printer Settings Overview */}
 829:                 <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
 830:                   {/* Schedule */}
 831:                   <div className="space-y-1">
 832:                     <div className="font-semibold text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1">
 833:                       <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
 834:                       <span>Lịch lấy hàng:</span>
 835:                     </div>
 836:                     <div>
 837:                       {wh.cutoff_time ? (
 838:                         <span>
 839:                           Giờ cắt ca lấy:{' '}
 840:                           <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{wh.cutoff_time}</span>
 841:                         </span>
 842:                       ) : (
 843:                         <span className="italic">Chưa cài đặt giờ cắt ca</span>
 844:                       )}
 845:                     </div>
 846:                     {wh.schedule_notes && (
 847:                       <p className="text-slate-600 line-clamp-1" title={wh.schedule_notes}>
 848:                         Ghi chú: {wh.schedule_notes}
 849:                       </p>
 850:                     )}
 851:                   </div>
 852: 
 853:                   {/* Printer */}
 854:                   <div className="space-y-1">
 855:                     <div className="font-semibold text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1">
 856:                       <Printer className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
 857:                       <span>In nhãn nhiệt:</span>
 858:                     </div>
 859:                     <div>
 860:                       Khổ giấy:{' '}
 861:                       <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{wh.printer_paper_size}</span> (
 862:                       {wh.printer_dpi} DPI)
 863:                       {wh.printer_name && (
 864:                         <span className="text-slate-500 font-normal"> - {wh.printer_name}</span>
 865:                       )}
 866:                     </div>
 867:                     {wh.printer_auto_print && (
 868:                       <div className="text-emerald-600 font-semibold">Tự động in khi duyệt đơn</div>
 869:                     )}
 870:                   </div>
 871:                 </div>
 872: 
 873:                 {/* Card Actions Footer */}
 874:                 {canEdit && (
 875:                   <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
 876:                     <div>
 877:                       {!wh.is_default && (
 878:                         <button
 879:                           type="button"
 880:                           onClick={() => handleSetDefaultAction(wh)}
 881:                           data-testid={`set-default-warehouse-button-${wh.id}`}
 882:                           disabled={isActionBusy}
 883:                           className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-orange-700 bg-orange-50 hover:bg-orange-100 rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
 884:                         >
 885:                           <Star className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
 886:                           <span>Đặt làm mặc định</span>
 887:                         </button>
 888:                       )}
 889:                     </div>
 890: 
 891:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 892:                       <button
 893:                         type="button"
 894:                         onClick={() => handleToggleStatusAction(wh)}
 895:                         data-testid={
 896:                           wh.status === 'active'
 897:                             ? `deactivate-warehouse-button-${wh.id}`
 898:                             : `activate-warehouse-button-${wh.id}`
 899:                         }
 900:                         disabled={isActionBusy}
 901:                         className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 ${
 902:                           wh.status === 'active'
 903:                             ? 'text-slate-600 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50'
 904:                             : 'text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100'
 905:                         }`}
 906:                       >
 907:                         <Power className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
 908:                         <span>{wh.status === 'active' ? 'Tạm ngưng' : 'Kích hoạt lại'}</span>
 909:                       </button>
 910:                     </div>
 911:                   </div>
 912:                 )}
 913:               </div>
 914:             );
 915:           })}
 916:         </div>
 917:       )}
 918: 
 919:       {/* Modal Dialog Form (Create / Edit) */}
 920:       {isFormOpen && (
 921:         <div
 922:           role="dialog"
 923:           aria-modal="true"
 924:           aria-labelledby="warehouse-modal-title"
 925:           data-testid="warehouse-modal"
 926:           className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4 overflow-y-auto"
 927:         >
 928:           <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden my-8">
