<file path="apps/web/src/core/reconciliation.ts">
  1: // ============================================================================
  2: // Ship Dễ — Discrepancy Detection & Reconciliation Engine (Tập 1 Mục 7.1, Tập 2 CN-14)
  3: // Chạy 6 phép dò chuẩn R1: D1, D2, D4, D5, D6, D7 (D3 dời R2)
  4: // Tuân thủ: BR-16, BR-28, BR-51 (Thiếu biểu giá thì không kết luận)
  5: // ============================================================================
  6: 
  7: import {
  8:   Shipment,
  9:   StatementRow,
 10:   RateCard,
 11:   RateTier,
 12:   Discrepancy,
 13:   DiscrepancyType,
 14:   DiscrepancyResolution,
 15:   MatchingStatus,
 16:   ShipmentStatus,
 17:   WeightGram,
 18:   CurrencyAmount,
 19: } from '../types/domain';
 20: import { MatchingEngine } from './matching-engine';
 21: 
 22: export interface ReconciliationOptions {
 23:   weight_tolerance_g?: number; // Dung sai cân nặng (mặc định 20g)
 24:   fee_tolerance_vnd?: number; // Dung sai tiền cước (mặc định 0 VNĐ)
 25: }
 26: 
 27: export interface ReconciliationResult {
 28:   statement_id: string;
 29:   reconciled_at: Date;
 30:   total_statement_rows: number;
 31:   matched_rows_count: number;
 32:   discrepancies: Discrepancy[];
 33:   missing_rate_card_warning: boolean; // Cờ thiếu biểu giá hợp đồng (BR-51)
 34:   summary: {
 35:     d1_weight_count: number;
 36:     d1_weight_amount: CurrencyAmount;
 37:     d2_freight_count: number;
 38:     d2_freight_amount: CurrencyAmount;
 39:     d4_duplicate_count: number;
 40:     d4_duplicate_amount: CurrencyAmount;
 41:     d5_cod_mismatch_count: number;
 42:     d5_cod_mismatch_amount: CurrencyAmount;
 43:     d6_overdue_cod_count: number;
 44:     d6_overdue_cod_amount: CurrencyAmount;
 45:     d7_missing_rows_count: number;
 46:   };
 47: }
 48: 
 49: export class ReconciliationEngine {
 50:   /**
 51:    * Tính cân nặng quy đổi thể tích: (Dài x Rộng x Cao) / Hệ số quy đổi (5000 hoặc 6000) * 1000 ra gram
 52:    */
 53:   public static calculateVolumetricWeight(
 54:     dimensions?: { length: number; width: number; height: number },
 55:     divisor: number = 5000
 56:   ): WeightGram {
 57:     if (!dimensions || !dimensions.length || !dimensions.width || !dimensions.height) {
 58:       return 0;
 59:     }
 60:     // (L x W x H cm) / divisor = kg -> * 1000 = gram
 61:     const kg = (dimensions.length * dimensions.width * dimensions.height) / divisor;
 62:     return Math.round(kg * 1000);
 63:   }
 64: 
 65:   /**
 66:    * Tra cứu cước phí dự kiến từ biểu giá hợp đồng (CN-25, FR-RATE-003)
 67:    */
 68:   public static calculateExpectedFreight(
 69:     billableWeightG: WeightGram,
 70:     routeType: 'INTRA_PROVINCE' | 'INTER_PROVINCE' | 'SPECIAL',
 71:     rateCard?: RateCard
 72:   ): CurrencyAmount | null {
 73:     if (!rateCard || !rateCard.tiers || rateCard.tiers.length === 0) {
 74:       return null; // Không có biểu giá (BR-51)
 75:     }
 76: 
 77:     const matchingTier = rateCard.tiers.find(
 78:       (t) =>
 79:         t.route_type === routeType &&
 80:         billableWeightG >= t.weight_from_g &&
 81:         billableWeightG <= t.weight_to_g
 82:     );
 83: 
 84:     if (!matchingTier) {
 85:       // Nếu vượt khung cao nhất, tính theo bậc cước lũy tiến
 86:       const baseTier = rateCard.tiers
 87:         .filter((t) => t.route_type === routeType)
 88:         .sort((a, b) => b.weight_to_g - a.weight_to_g)[0];
 89: 
 90:       if (!baseTier || baseTier.step_weight_g <= 0) return null;
 91: 
 92:       const extraWeight = billableWeightG - baseTier.weight_to_g;
 93:       const steps = Math.ceil(extraWeight / baseTier.step_weight_g);
 94:       return Number(baseTier.base_fee) + steps * Number(baseTier.step_fee);
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     return Number(matchingTier.base_fee);
 98:   }
 99: 
100:   /**
101:    * Thực thi toàn bộ 6 phép dò đối soát
102:    */
103:   public runReconciliation(
104:     statementId: string,
105:     merchantId: string,
106:     statementRows: StatementRow[],
107:     shipments: Shipment[],
108:     rateCard?: RateCard,
109:     options: ReconciliationOptions = {}
110:   ): ReconciliationResult {
111:     const weightTolerance = options.weight_tolerance_g ?? 20;
112:     const feeTolerance = options.fee_tolerance_vnd ?? 0;
113:     const discrepancies: Discrepancy[] = [];
114:     const missingRateCard = !rateCard;
115: 
116:     // Index shipments by ID & Normalized Tracking
117:     const shipmentById = new Map<string, Shipment>();
118:     const shipmentByTracking = new Map<string, Shipment>();
119:     for (const s of shipments) {
120:       shipmentById.set(s.id, s);
121:       const norm = MatchingEngine.normalizeTrackingCode(s.tracking_code);
122:       if (norm) shipmentByTracking.set(norm, s);
123:     }
124: 
125:     // --- PHÉP DÒ D4: Khấu trừ trùng (Cùng tracking_code & fee_type xuất hiện >= 2 lần) ---
126:     const feeTypeOccurrences = new Map<string, StatementRow[]>();
127:     for (const row of statementRows) {
128:       const key = `${row.tracking_code}__${row.fee_type}`;
129:       const list = feeTypeOccurrences.get(key) || [];
130:       list.push(row);
131:       feeTypeOccurrences.set(key, list);
132:     }
133: 
134:     for (const [key, duplicateRows] of feeTypeOccurrences.entries()) {
135:       if (duplicateRows.length >= 2) {
136:         // Dòng đầu tiên là hợp lệ, từ dòng thứ 2 trở đi là trùng lặp
137:         for (let i = 1; i < duplicateRows.length; i++) {
138:           const dupRow = duplicateRows[i];
139:           const matchedShip = shipments.find(
140:             (s) => s.id === dupRow.matched_shipment_id || s.tracking_code === dupRow.tracking_code
141:           );
142:           discrepancies.push({
143:             id: `disc_D4_${dupRow.id}`,
144:             merchant_id: merchantId,
145:             branch_id: matchedShip?.branch_id || 'default_branch',
146:             warehouse_id: matchedShip?.warehouse_id || 'default_wh',
147:             statement_row_id: dupRow.id,
148:             shipment_id: dupRow.matched_shipment_id || '',
149:             tracking_code: dupRow.tracking_code,
150:             type: DiscrepancyType.D4_DUPLICATE_DEDUCTION,
151:             amount: dupRow.charged_fee,
152:             status: DiscrepancyResolution.OPEN,
153:             reason: `Phát hiện dòng khấu trừ cước phí trùng lặp lần thứ ${i + 1} cho cùng mã vận đơn và loại phí ${dupRow.fee_type}.`,
154:             version: 1,
155:             created_at: new Date(),
156:           });
157:         }
158:       }
159:     }
160: 
161:     // --- XỬ LÝ TỪNG DÒNG SAO KÊ CHO D1, D2, D5 ---
162:     let matchedCount = 0;
163:     const matchedShipmentIdsInStatement = new Set<string>();
164: 
165:     for (const row of statementRows) {
166:       if (
167:         row.match_status !== MatchingStatus.MATCHED_EXACT &&
168:         row.match_status !== MatchingStatus.MATCHED_FUZZY
169:       ) {
170:         continue;
171:       }
172: 
173:       const shipment = row.matched_shipment_id
174:         ? shipmentById.get(row.matched_shipment_id)
175:         : undefined;
176:       if (!shipment) continue;
177: 
178:       matchedCount++;
179:       matchedShipmentIdsInStatement.add(shipment.id);
180: 
181:       const divisor = rateCard?.volumetric_divisor || 5000;
182:       const volWeight = ReconciliationEngine.calculateVolumetricWeight(
183:         shipment.dimensions_cm,
184:         divisor
185:       );
186:       const expectedBillableWeight = Math.max(shipment.declared_weight_g, volWeight);
187: 
188:       // --- PHÉP DÒ D1: Lệch cân tính phí ---
189:       if (row.charged_weight_g > expectedBillableWeight + weightTolerance) {
190:         const weightDiffG = row.charged_weight_g - expectedBillableWeight;
191:         discrepancies.push({
192:           id: `disc_D1_${row.id}`,
193:           merchant_id: merchantId,
194:           branch_id: shipment.branch_id || 'default_branch',
195:           warehouse_id: shipment.warehouse_id || 'default_wh',
196:           statement_row_id: row.id,
197:           shipment_id: shipment.id,
198:           tracking_code: row.tracking_code,
199:           type: DiscrepancyType.D1_WEIGHT,
200:           amount: 0, // Cân lệch tạo cơ sở tính lệch tiền cước ở D2
201:           status: DiscrepancyResolution.OPEN,
202:           reason: `Cân hãng tính phí (${row.charged_weight_g}g) vượt quá cân khai báo & quy đổi (${expectedBillableWeight}g) là +${weightDiffG}g (Dung sai: ${weightTolerance}g).`,
203:           version: 1,
204:           created_at: new Date(),
205:         });
206:       }
207: 
208:       // --- PHÉP DÒ D2: Lệch cước vận chuyển (BR-51: Chỉ chạy khi có biểu giá) ---
209:       if (rateCard) {
210:         const expectedFee = ReconciliationEngine.calculateExpectedFreight(
211:           expectedBillableWeight,
212:           'INTRA_PROVINCE', // Giả lập tuyến
213:           rateCard
214:         );
215: 
216:         if (expectedFee !== null && Math.abs(row.charged_fee - expectedFee) > feeTolerance) {
217:           const diffFee = row.charged_fee - expectedFee;
218:           discrepancies.push({
219:             id: `disc_D2_${row.id}`,
220:             merchant_id: merchantId,
221:             branch_id: shipment.branch_id || 'default_branch',
222:             warehouse_id: shipment.warehouse_id || 'default_wh',
223:             statement_row_id: row.id,
224:             shipment_id: shipment.id,
225:             tracking_code: row.tracking_code,
226:             type: DiscrepancyType.D2_FREIGHT,
227:             amount: diffFee > 0 ? diffFee : 0,
228:             status: DiscrepancyResolution.OPEN,
229:             reason: `Cước thực thu (${row.charged_fee.toLocaleString()} đ) sai lệch so với biểu giá hợp đồng (${expectedFee.toLocaleString()} đ). Chênh lệch: ${diffFee.toLocaleString()} đ.`,
230:             version: 1,
231:             created_at: new Date(),
232:           });
233:         }
234:       }
235: 
236:       // --- PHÉP DÒ D5: Lệch COD thu hộ ---
237:       if (row.cod_collected > 0 || shipment.cod_amount > 0) {
238:         if (row.cod_collected !== shipment.cod_amount) {
239:           const codDiff = shipment.cod_amount - row.cod_collected;
240:           discrepancies.push({
241:             id: `disc_D5_${row.id}`,
242:             merchant_id: merchantId,
243:             branch_id: shipment.branch_id || 'default_branch',
244:             warehouse_id: shipment.warehouse_id || 'default_wh',
245:             statement_row_id: row.id,
246:             shipment_id: shipment.id,
247:             tracking_code: row.tracking_code,
248:             type: DiscrepancyType.D5_COD_MISMATCH,
249:             amount: Math.abs(codDiff),
250:             status: DiscrepancyResolution.OPEN,
251:             reason: `Tiền COD hãng ghi nhận (${row.cod_collected.toLocaleString()} đ) lệch so với đơn khai báo (${shipment.cod_amount.toLocaleString()} đ).`,
252:             version: 1,
253:             created_at: new Date(),
254:           });
255:         }
256:       }
257:     }
258: 
259:     // --- PHÉP DÒ D6 & D7: Kiểm tra ngược từ Sổ cái Vận đơn sang Sao kê ---
260:     const now = new Date();
261:     const codSlaDays = rateCard?.cod_payout_sla_days || 3;
262: 
263:     for (const shipment of shipments) {
264:       // D6: COD quá hạn thanh toán
265:       if (
266:         shipment.current_status === ShipmentStatus.DELIVERED &&
267:         shipment.cod_amount > 0 &&
268:         !shipment.cod_paid_at &&
269:         shipment.delivered_at
270:       ) {
271:         const daysSinceDelivered = Math.floor(
272:           (now.getTime() - shipment.delivered_at.getTime()) / (24 * 3600 * 1000)
273:         );
274:         if (daysSinceDelivered > codSlaDays) {
275:           discrepancies.push({
276:             id: `disc_D6_${shipment.id}`,
277:             merchant_id: merchantId,
278:             branch_id: shipment.branch_id || 'default_branch',
279:             warehouse_id: shipment.warehouse_id || 'default_wh',
280:             shipment_id: shipment.id,
281:             tracking_code: shipment.tracking_code,
282:             type: DiscrepancyType.D6_OVERDUE_COD,
283:             amount: shipment.cod_amount,
284:             status: DiscrepancyResolution.OPEN,
285:             reason: `Đơn đã giao thành công ${daysSinceDelivered} ngày trước (vượt SLA ${codSlaDays} ngày) nhưng chưa nhận được dòng thanh toán COD từ hãng.`,
286:             version: 1,
287:             created_at: new Date(),
288:           });
289:         }
290:       }
291: 
292:       // D7: Đơn đã giao nhưng thiếu dòng sao kê trong kỳ
293:       if (
294:         shipment.current_status === ShipmentStatus.DELIVERED &&
295:         !matchedShipmentIdsInStatement.has(shipment.id)
296:       ) {
297:         discrepancies.push({
298:           id: `disc_D7_${shipment.id}`,
299:           merchant_id: merchantId,
300:           branch_id: shipment.branch_id || 'default_branch',
301:           warehouse_id: shipment.warehouse_id || 'default_wh',
302:           shipment_id: shipment.id,
303:           tracking_code: shipment.tracking_code,
304:           type: DiscrepancyType.D7_MISSING_STATEMENT_ROW,
305:           amount: shipment.quoted_fee || 0,
306:           status: DiscrepancyResolution.OPEN,
307:           reason: `Vận đơn đã giao thành công trong kỳ nhưng không có dòng đối soát nào trong file sao kê.`,
308:           version: 1,
309:           created_at: new Date(),
310:         });
311:       }
312:     }
313: 
314:     // Tổng hợp thống kê 6 phép dò
315:     const summary = {
316:       d1_weight_count: discrepancies.filter((d) => d.type === DiscrepancyType.D1_WEIGHT).length,
317:       d1_weight_amount: 0,
318:       d2_freight_count: discrepancies.filter((d) => d.type === DiscrepancyType.D2_FREIGHT).length,
319:       d2_freight_amount: discrepancies
320:         .filter((d) => d.type === DiscrepancyType.D2_FREIGHT)
321:         .reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.amount, 0),
322:       d4_duplicate_count: discrepancies.filter(
323:         (d) => d.type === DiscrepancyType.D4_DUPLICATE_DEDUCTION
324:       ).length,
325:       d4_duplicate_amount: discrepancies
326:         .filter((d) => d.type === DiscrepancyType.D4_DUPLICATE_DEDUCTION)
327:         .reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.amount, 0),
328:       d5_cod_mismatch_count: discrepancies.filter((d) => d.type === DiscrepancyType.D5_COD_MISMATCH)
329:         .length,
330:       d5_cod_mismatch_amount: discrepancies
331:         .filter((d) => d.type === DiscrepancyType.D5_COD_MISMATCH)
332:         .reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.amount, 0),
333:       d6_overdue_cod_count: discrepancies.filter((d) => d.type === DiscrepancyType.D6_OVERDUE_COD)
334:         .length,
335:       d6_overdue_cod_amount: discrepancies
336:         .filter((d) => d.type === DiscrepancyType.D6_OVERDUE_COD)
337:         .reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.amount, 0),
338:       d7_missing_rows_count: discrepancies.filter(
339:         (d) => d.type === DiscrepancyType.D7_MISSING_STATEMENT_ROW
340:       ).length,
341:     };
342: 
343:     return {
344:       statement_id: statementId,
345:       reconciled_at: new Date(),
346:       total_statement_rows: statementRows.length,
347:       matched_rows_count: matchedCount,
348:       discrepancies,
349:       missing_rate_card_warning: missingRateCard,
350:       summary,
351:     };
352:   }
353: }
</file>

491:   constructor() {
492:     for (const o of this.orders) {
493:       o.branch_id = o.branch_id || 'default_branch';
494:       o.warehouse_id = o.warehouse_id || 'default_wh';
495:     }
496:     for (const s of this.shipments) {
497:       s.branch_id = s.branch_id || 'default_branch';
498:       s.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id || 'default_wh';
499:     }
500:     for (const e of this.exceptionCases) {
501:       e.branch_id = e.branch_id || 'default_branch';
502:       e.warehouse_id = e.warehouse_id || 'default_wh';
503:     }
504:     for (const d of this.discrepancies) {
505:       d.branch_id = d.branch_id || 'default_branch';
506:       d.warehouse_id = d.warehouse_id || 'default_wh';
507:     }
508:     for (const cl of this.claims) {
509:       cl.branch_id = cl.branch_id || 'default_branch';
510:       cl.warehouse_id = cl.warehouse_id || 'default_wh';
511:     }
512:   }
513: 
514:   public static getInstance(): ShipDeDatabase {
515:     if (!ShipDeDatabase.instance) {
516:       ShipDeDatabase.instance = new ShipDeDatabase();
517:     }
518:     return ShipDeDatabase.instance;
519:   }
520: }
521: 
522: export const db = ShipDeDatabase.getInstance();

739: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
740: // SUMMARY METRICS HELPER (Always deterministic & unified)
741: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
742: export function getUnifiedMetrics() {
743:   const totalShipments = MASTER_SHIPMENTS.length; // 50
744:   const activeShipments = MASTER_SHIPMENTS.filter(
745:     (s) => s.status !== 'delivered' && s.status !== 'returned'
746:   ).length;
747:   const deliveredShipments = MASTER_SHIPMENTS.filter((s) => s.status === 'delivered').length;
748:   const failShipments = MASTER_SHIPMENTS.filter((s) => s.status === 'delivery_fail').length;
749:   const openExceptionsCount = MASTER_EXCEPTIONS.filter(
750:     (e) => e.status === 'OPEN' || e.status === 'ASSIGNED'
751:   ).length; // 4
752:   const openDiscrepanciesCount = MASTER_DISCREPANCIES.filter((d) => d.status === 'OPEN').length; // 6
753:   const totalDiscrepancyAmount = MASTER_DISCREPANCIES.filter((d) => d.status === 'OPEN').reduce(
754:     (sum, d) => sum + d.discrepancy_amount,
755:     0
756:   ); // 1,978,000 đ
757:   const urgentClaimsCount = MASTER_CLAIMS.filter(
758:     (c) => c.status === 'SUBMITTED' || c.status === 'IN_REVIEW'
759:   ).length; // 1
760: 
761:   return {
762:     totalShipments,
763:     activeShipments,
764:     deliveredShipments,
765:     failShipments,
766:     openExceptionsCount,
767:     openDiscrepanciesCount,
768:     totalDiscrepancyAmount,
769:     urgentClaimsCount,
770:   };
771: }

  1: // ============================================================================
  2: // Ship Dễ — Admin Shops Route & View Test Suite (FEAT-AUTH-02)
  3: // Comprehensive acceptance testing: Auth, Role Enforcement, Upstream Errors,
  4: // Creation Flow, and Real Component State Rendering (AC-ADMIN-14, AC-ADMIN-15)
  5: // ============================================================================
  6: 
  7: import * as assert from 'node:assert';
  8: import { createHmac, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
  9: import React from 'react';
 10: import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
 11: import { NextRequest } from 'next/server';
 12: import { GET, POST, verifyAdminAuthorization } from '../app/api/admin/shops/route';
 13: import {
 14:   AdminShopsView,
 15:   validateShopForm,
 16:   ShopRecord,
 17:   CreatedShopSuccessData,
 18: } from '../app/admin/shops/page';
 19: import { AdminNewShopView } from '../app/admin/shops/new/page';
 20: 
 21: /**
 22:  * Generates a signed v1 token format (v1.<payload>.<signature>) for testing
 23:  */
 24: function generateTestV1Token(
 25:   claims: {
 26:     sub?: string;
 27:     sid?: string;
 28:     mid?: string;
 29:     role?: string;
 30:     exp?: number;
 31:   },
 32:   secret: string
 33: ): string {
 34:   const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
 35:   const payloadData = {
 36:     sub: claims.sub || 'u-admin-test',
 37:     sid: claims.sid || 's-admin-test',
 38:     mid: claims.mid || 'm-admin-test',
 39:     role: claims.role || 'PLATFORM_ADMIN',
 40:     st: 'active',
 41:     iat: now,
 42:     exp: claims.exp !== undefined ? claims.exp : now + 3600,
 43:     jti: randomUUID(),
 44:   };
 45: 
 46:   const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payloadData)).toString('base64url');
 47:   const signature = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`v1.${payload}`).digest('base64url');
 48: 
 49:   return `v1.${payload}.${signature}`;
 50: }
 51: 
 52: async function runAdminShopsFrontendSuite() {
 53:   console.log('================================================================');
 54:   console.log('SHIP DỄ — ADMIN SHOPS UI & API ACCEPTANCE TEST SUITE (FEAT-AUTH-02)');
 55:   console.log('================================================================\n');
 56: 
 57:   const TEST_AUTH_SECRET = 'test-token-secret-must-be-long-32-chars-at-least';
 58: 
 59:   process.env.AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET = TEST_AUTH_SECRET;
 60: 
 61:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 62:   // 1. AC-ADMIN-15: Signed-out access to /api/admin/shops returns 403 Forbidden
 63:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 64:   console.log('🧪 Testing AC-ADMIN-15: Signed-out requests reach forbidden state immediately...');
 65:   const unauthGetReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
 66:     method: 'GET',
 67:     headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
 68:   });
 69:   const unauthGetRes = await GET(unauthGetReq);
 70:   assert.strictEqual(unauthGetRes.status, 403, 'Signed-out GET must return 403 Forbidden');
 71:   const unauthGetJson = await unauthGetRes.json();
 72:   assert.strictEqual(unauthGetJson?.error?.code, 'FORBIDDEN');
 73: 
 74:   const unauthPostReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
 75:     method: 'POST',
 76:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
 77:     body: JSON.stringify({ merchant_name: 'Shop Unauth' }),
 78:   });
 79:   const unauthPostRes = await POST(unauthPostReq);
 80:   assert.strictEqual(unauthPostRes.status, 403, 'Signed-out POST must return 403 Forbidden');
 81:   const unauthPostJson = await unauthPostRes.json();
 82:   assert.strictEqual(unauthPostJson?.error?.code, 'FORBIDDEN');
 83:   console.log('✅ AC-ADMIN-15: Signed-out requests rejected with 403 Forbidden');
 84: 
 85:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 86:   // 2. Finding 1 / Security: Arbitrary Authorization headers & cookies are rejected
 87:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 88:   console.log('🧪 Testing Finding 1: Arbitrary or fabricated tokens are rejected...');
 89:   const arbitraryTokens = [
 90:     'Bearer invalid-random-token-string',
 91:     'Bearer v1.invalidjson.invalidsignature',
 92:     'Bearer some-jwt-header.payload.signature',
 93:   ];
 94: 
 95:   for (const authHeader of arbitraryTokens) {
 96:     const fakeReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
 97:       method: 'GET',
 98:       headers: { Authorization: authHeader, Accept: 'application/json' },
 99:     });
100:     const fakeRes = await GET(fakeReq);
101:     assert.strictEqual(
102:       fakeRes.status,
103:       403,
104:       `Arbitrary Authorization header "${authHeader}" must return 403 Forbidden`
105:     );
106:   }
107: 
108:   // Arbitrary cookie
109:   const fakeCookieReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
110:     method: 'GET',
111:     headers: {
112:       Cookie: 'token=arbitrary-token-cookie',
113:       Accept: 'application/json',
114:     },
115:   });
116:   const fakeCookieRes = await GET(fakeCookieReq);
117:   assert.strictEqual(fakeCookieRes.status, 403, 'Arbitrary cookie must return 403 Forbidden');
118: 
119:   // Finding 3: Cookie-only POST must NOT be authorized (CSRF defense)
120:   const validTokenForCookie = generateTestV1Token({ role: 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' }, TEST_AUTH_SECRET);
121:   const cookieOnlyPostReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
122:     method: 'POST',
123:     headers: {
124:       Cookie: `token=${validTokenForCookie}`,
125:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
126:       Accept: 'application/json',
127:     },
128:     body: JSON.stringify({ merchant_name: 'Cookie Alone Post' }),
129:   });
130:   const cookieOnlyPostRes = await POST(cookieOnlyPostReq);
131:   assert.strictEqual(
132:     cookieOnlyPostRes.status,
133:     403,
134:     'Finding 3: State-changing POST must not be authorized by cookies alone'
135:   );
136: 
137:   // Finding 3: Origin mismatch on POST must return 403 (CSRF defense)
138:   const originMismatchReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
139:     method: 'POST',
140:     headers: {
141:       Authorization: `Bearer ${validTokenForCookie}`,
142:       Origin: 'https://attacker.evil.com',
143:       Host: 'localhost:3000',
144:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
145:       Accept: 'application/json',
146:     },
147:     body: JSON.stringify({ merchant_name: 'Origin Mismatch Post' }),
148:   });
149:   const originMismatchRes = await POST(originMismatchReq);
150:   assert.strictEqual(
151:     originMismatchRes.status,
152:     403,
153:     'Finding 3: Origin mismatch on state-changing request must return 403'
154:   );
155: 
156:   // Tampered signature on valid payload
157:   const validToken = generateTestV1Token({ role: 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' }, TEST_AUTH_SECRET);
158:   const [ver, pay] = validToken.split('.');
159:   const tamperedToken = `${ver}.${pay}.tampered_signature_bytes`;
160:   const tamperedReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
161:     method: 'GET',
162:     headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${tamperedToken}`, Accept: 'application/json' },
163:   });
164:   const tamperedRes = await GET(tamperedReq);
165:   assert.strictEqual(tamperedRes.status, 403, 'Tampered token signature must return 403 Forbidden');
166: 
167:   // Expired token
168:   const expiredToken = generateTestV1Token(
169:     { role: 'PLATFORM_ADMIN', exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) - 100 },
170:     TEST_AUTH_SECRET
171:   );
172:   const expiredReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
173:     method: 'GET',
174:     headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${expiredToken}`, Accept: 'application/json' },
175:   });
176:   const expiredRes = await GET(expiredReq);
177:   assert.strictEqual(expiredRes.status, 403, 'Expired token must return 403 Forbidden');
178:   console.log('✅ Finding 1: Arbitrary, tampered, and expired tokens fail closed');
179: 
180:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
181:   // 3. Finding 1 / Role Enforcement: Non-platform-admin roles are rejected
182:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
183:   console.log(
184:     '🧪 Testing Finding 1 & 4: Non-platform-admin roles (OWNER, BACKOFFICE, ADMIN, etc.) are rejected...'
185:   );
186:   const nonPlatformRoles = ['OWNER', 'OPS_CSKH', 'WAREHOUSE', 'ACCOUNTANT', 'BACKOFFICE', 'ADMIN'];
187:   for (const role of nonPlatformRoles) {
188:     const roleToken = generateTestV1Token({ role }, TEST_AUTH_SECRET);
189:     const roleReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
190:       method: 'GET',
191:       headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${roleToken}`, Accept: 'application/json' },
192:     });
193:     const roleRes = await GET(roleReq);
194:     assert.strictEqual(
195:       roleRes.status,
196:       403,
197:       `User with role "${role}" must be rejected with 403 Forbidden from admin endpoints`
198:     );
199:     const roleJson = await roleRes.json();
200:     assert.strictEqual(roleJson?.error?.code, 'FORBIDDEN');
201:   }
202: 
203:   // Only PLATFORM_ADMIN role is authorized
204:   const platformAdminToken = generateTestV1Token({ role: 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' }, TEST_AUTH_SECRET);
205:   const platformAdminReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
206:     headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${platformAdminToken}` },
207:   });
208:   const platformAdminAuth = verifyAdminAuthorization(platformAdminReq);
209:   assert.strictEqual(platformAdminAuth.authorized, true, 'PLATFORM_ADMIN role must be authorized');
210:   console.log('✅ Finding 1 & 4: Only PLATFORM_ADMIN role is authorized; other roles rejected');
211: 
212:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
213:   // 4. Legacy static header rejection: header alone is rejected, requires session
214:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
215:   console.log('🧪 Testing legacy header rejection: static key rejected without session...');
216:   const keyOnlyReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
217:     headers: { 'x-admin-key': 'legacy-deprecated-key' },
218:   });
219:   assert.strictEqual(verifyAdminAuthorization(keyOnlyReq).authorized, false);
220:   console.log('✅ Legacy static key rejected, session authorization required');
221: 
222:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
223:   // 5. Finding 4 / AC-ADMIN-14: Upstream Failure Preservation (Never fabricated 200)
224:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
225:   console.log(
226:     '🧪 Testing Finding 4: Upstream list failures are preserved as canonical errors (502)...'
227:   );
228:   // With API backend offline on port 3001, GET /api/admin/shops must return 502 UPSTREAM_ERROR, NOT 200
229:   const authGetReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
230:     method: 'GET',
231:     headers: {
232:       Authorization: `Bearer ${platformAdminToken}`,
233:       Accept: 'application/json',
234:     },
235:   });
236:   const authGetRes = await GET(authGetReq);
237:   assert.notStrictEqual(
238:     authGetRes.status,
239:     200,
240:     'AC-ADMIN-14: Failed upstream request must NEVER return a fabricated 200 empty state'
241:   );
242:   assert.strictEqual(
243:     authGetRes.status,
244:     502,
245:     'Upstream network failure must return 502 Bad Gateway'
246:   );
247:   const authGetJson = await authGetRes.json();
248:   assert.strictEqual(authGetJson?.error?.code, 'UPSTREAM_ERROR');
249: 
250:   // POST upstream failure also returns 502
251:   const authPostReq = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/admin/shops', {
252:     method: 'POST',
253:     headers: {
254:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
255:       Authorization: `Bearer ${platformAdminToken}`,
256:       Accept: 'application/json',
257:     },
258:     body: JSON.stringify({ merchant_name: 'Shop Upstream Test' }),
259:   });
260:   const authPostRes = await POST(authPostReq);
261:   assert.strictEqual(authPostRes.status, 502, 'POST upstream network failure must return 502');
262:   console.log(
263:     '✅ Finding 4: Upstream failures preserved as canonical errors (status 502, UPSTREAM_ERROR)'
264:   );
265: 
266:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

268:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
269:   console.log('🧪 Testing Creation Flow: Form validation logic...');

309:   assert.strictEqual(

<file path="apps/web/src/tests/app-shell.test.tsx">
 1: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
 2: import React from 'react';
 3: import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
 4: import {
 5:   deriveBreadcrumbs,
 6:   getNavigation,
 7:   resolveRolePermissions,
 8: } from '../components/shell/navigation';
 9: import { ShellNavigation, ShellBreadcrumbs, ShellSkeleton } from '../components/shell/AppShell';
10: import { CommandTargets } from '../components/shell/CommandPalette';
11: 
12: const roles = [
13:   {
14:     id: 'owner',
15:     code: 'OWNER',
16:     is_system: true,
17:     permissions: [{ code: 'iam:shop_config' }, { code: 'order:view_create' }],
18:   },
19:   {
20:     id: 'custom',
21:     code: null,
22:     is_system: false,
23:     permissions: [{ code: 'shipment:receive_return' }],
24:   },
25: ];
26: assert.deepEqual(resolveRolePermissions({ role: 'OWNER', custom_role_id: 'custom' }, roles), [
27:   'shipment:receive_return',
28: ]);
29: assert.deepEqual(resolveRolePermissions({ role: 'UNKNOWN' }, roles), []);
30: assert.deepEqual(resolveRolePermissions({ role: 'OWNER', custom_role_id: 'missing' }, roles), []);
31: const targets = getNavigation(['shipment:receive_return']);
32: assert(targets.some((t) => t.id === 'returns'));
33: assert(!targets.some((t) => t.id === 'settings' || t.id === 'claims'));
34: assert.deepEqual(getNavigation([]), []);
35: const nav = renderToStaticMarkup(<ShellNavigation targets={targets} activeHref="/?view=returns" />);
36: assert(nav.includes('aria-current="page"'));
37: assert(!nav.includes('Cài Đặt'));
38: assert(
39:   renderToStaticMarkup(<ShellNavigation targets={[]} activeHref="/" />).includes(
40:     'Chưa có mục điều hướng'
41:   )
42: );
43: const crumbs = deriveBreadcrumbs('/settings/branches', '', getNavigation(['iam:shop_config']));
44: assert.deepEqual(
45:   crumbs.map((c) => c.label),
46:   ['Ship Dễ', 'Cấu hình', 'Chi nhánh']
47: );
48: assert.equal(deriveBreadcrumbs('/', 'view=returns', targets).at(-1)?.label, 'Quản Lý Nhập Hoàn');
49: assert.equal(
50:   deriveBreadcrumbs('/settings/branches-old', '', targets).at(-1)?.label,
51:   'Trang hiện tại'
52: );
53: assert(renderToStaticMarkup(<ShellBreadcrumbs crumbs={crumbs} />).includes('aria-current="page"'));
54: const palette = renderToStaticMarkup(
55:   <CommandTargets targets={targets} query="hoàn" onSelect={() => {}} />
56: );
57: assert(palette.includes('Quản Lý Nhập Hoàn'));
58: assert(!palette.includes('Cài Đặt'));
59: assert(
60:   renderToStaticMarkup(
61:     <CommandTargets
62:       targets={getNavigation(['order:view_create'])}
63:       query="don"
64:       onSelect={() => {}}
65:     />
66:   ).includes('Quản Lý Vận Đơn'),
67:   'Vietnamese navigation search also matches unaccented đ'
68: );
69: assert.deepEqual(
70:   deriveBreadcrumbs('/settings/branches/branch-id', '', getNavigation(['iam:shop_config'])).slice(
71:     -2
72:   ),
73:   [{ label: 'Chi nhánh', href: '/settings/branches' }, { label: 'Chi tiết' }]
74: );
75: assert.equal(
76:   deriveBreadcrumbs(
77:     '/',
78:     'section=integrations&view=settings',
79:     getNavigation(['iam:connect_observe_token'])
80:   ).at(-1)?.label,
81:   'Tài khoản hãng'
82: );
83: assert(
84:   renderToStaticMarkup(
85:     <CommandTargets targets={targets} query="không khớp" onSelect={() => {}} />
86:   ).includes('Không tìm thấy')
87: );
88: assert(
89:   renderToStaticMarkup(<CommandTargets targets={[]} query="" onSelect={() => {}} />).includes(
90:     'Chưa có mục điều hướng'
91:   )
92: );
93: assert(renderToStaticMarkup(<ShellSkeleton />).includes('aria-busy="true"'));
94: console.log(
95:   'PASS: TASK-AI-159 permission filtering, navigation, breadcrumbs, palette and loading/empty components'
96: );

  1: import * as assert from 'node:assert';

  67: 
  68: const auditLog: TestResult[] = [];
  69: 
  70: function assertTest(
  71:   group: string,
  72:   ruleId: string,
  73:   name: string,
  74:   condition: boolean,
  75:   message: string
  76: ) {
  77:   auditLog.push({
  78:     group,
  79:     ruleId,
  80:     name,
  81:     passed: condition,
  82:     message: condition ? message : `THẤT BẠI: ${message}`,
  83:   });
  84:   const icon = condition ? '✅ PASS' : '❌ FAIL';
  85:   console.log(`${icon} [${ruleId}] [${group}] ${name} -> ${message}`);
  86:   if (!condition) {
  87:     throw new Error(`Kiểm toán thất bại tại [${ruleId}] ${name}: ${message}`);
  88:   }
  89: }
  90:

1744:     let replacedUrl: string | null = null;
1745:     const fakeWindow = {

1752:     };
1753:     stripTokenFromAddressBar(fakeWindow as any);
1754: 
1755:     const nextConfigModule = (await import('../../next.config.mjs')) as any;
1756:     const customHeaders = nextConfigModule.default.headers
1757:       ? await nextConfigModule.default.headers()
1758:       : [];
1759:     const acceptHeaderEntry = customHeaders.find((h: any) => h.source === '/invite/accept');
1760:     const hasNoReferrerHeader = acceptHeaderEntry?.headers?.some(
1761:       (h: any) => h.key === 'Referrer-Policy' && h.value === 'no-referrer'
1762:     );
1763:     const hasNoStoreHeader = acceptHeaderEntry?.headers?.some(
1764:       (h: any) => h.key === 'Cache-Control' && h.value === 'no-store'
1765:     );

1774:         extractInvitationToken({ hash: '#token=secret_frag_token', searchToken: 'query_tok' }) ===
1775:           'secret_frag_token' &&
1776:         replacedUrl === '/invite/accept' &&
1777:         Boolean(hasNoReferrerHeader) &&
1778:         Boolean(hasNoStoreHeader),
1779:       'Trích xuất token chỉ từ fragment, lờ đi query param, xóa khỏi address bar và áp dụng document headers bảo mật'
1780:     );
1781: 
1782:     // Round 10 Finding 4: In React Strict Mode, first run extracts token and strips hash; second run sees empty hash but memory fallback preserves token
1783:     const firstRun = resolveTokenWithMemoryFallback({
1784:       rawHash: '#token=strict_mode_tok_123',
1785:       memoryToken: null,
1786:     });
1787:     const secondRun = resolveTokenWithMemoryFallback({

1789:       memoryToken: firstRun.token,

1791:     const missingRun = resolveTokenWithMemoryFallback({

1793:       memoryToken: null,
1794:     });
1795: 
1796:     assertTest(

1800:       firstRun.token === 'strict_mode_tok_123' &&
1801:         firstRun.shouldStrip === true &&
1802:         secondRun.token === 'strict_mode_tok_123' &&

1807:     );
1808: 
1809:     // Round 10 Finding 5: getGrantableRoles bounds non-owners to roles at or below live actor role (BR-INV-01)
1810:     const ownerRoles = getGrantableRoles('OWNER');
1811:     const opsRoles = getGrantableRoles('OPS_CSKH');
1812:     const whRoles = getGrantableRoles('WAREHOUSE');
1813:     const accountantRoles = getGrantableRoles('ACCOUNTANT');
1814:     const guestRoles = getGrantableRoles(null);
1815: 
1816:     assertTest(

1819:       'Giới hạn danh sách vai trò có thể mời không vượt quá vai trò của tài khoản đang đăng nhập (BR-INV-01)',
1820:       ownerRoles.length === 4 &&
1821:         ownerRoles.some((r) => r.value === 'OWNER') &&
1822:         ownerRoles.some((r) => r.value === 'OPS_CSKH') &&
1823:         opsRoles.length === 1 &&
1824:         opsRoles[0].value === 'OPS_CSKH' &&
1825:         whRoles.length === 1 &&
1826:         whRoles[0].value === 'WAREHOUSE' &&
1827:         accountantRoles.length === 1 &&
1828:         accountantRoles[0].value === 'ACCOUNTANT' &&
1829:         guestRoles.length === 0,
1830:       'Chỉ hiển thị các vai trò bằng hoặc thấp hơn quyền của actor, không hiển thị vai trò vượt cấp'
1831:     );
1832:   }
1833: 
1834:   // ==========================================================================
1835:   // TỔNG KẾT KIỂM TOÁN
1836:   // ==========================================================================
1837:   console.log('\n================================================================================');
1838:   const passedCount = auditLog.filter((r) => r.passed).length;
1839:   const failedCount = auditLog.length - passedCount;
1840:   console.log(
1841:     `🏁 KẾT QUẢ KIỂM TOÁN: ${passedCount}/${auditLog.length} QUY TẮC ĐẠT CHUẨN (${Math.round((passedCount / auditLog.length) * 100)}%)`
1842:   );
1843:   console.log('================================================================================\n');
1844: 
1845:   return {
1846:     total: auditLog.length,
1847:     passed: passedCount,
1848:     failed: failedCount,
1849:     results: auditLog,
1850:   };
1851: }
1852: 
1853: // Chạy trực tiếp nếu execute CLI
1854: if (require.main === module) {
1855:   runComprehensiveRulesAudit()
1856:     .then((res) => {
1857:       if (res.failed > 0) {
1858:         process.exit(1);
1859:       }
1860:     })
1861:     .catch((err) => {
1862:       console.error('FATAL AUDIT ERROR:', err);
1863:       process.exit(1);
1864:     });
1865: }

<file path="apps/web/src/tests/profile-page-states.test.ts">
  1: import * as assert from 'node:assert';
  2: import React from 'react';
  3: import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
  4: import { ProfileSettingsTab, validateProfileForm } from '@/components/ProfileSettingsTab';
  5: import { AuthProvider } from '@/context/AuthContext';
  6: 
  7: /**
  8:  * FEAT-PRO-01 Web Component UI States & Contract Tests
  9:  * Verifies Loading, Default Populated Profile, Form Validation, Critical Notification Inviolability,
 10:  * Error Banner, and Success Toast states.
 11:  */
 12: async function runTest() {
 13:   console.log('--- Running FEAT-PRO-01 Profile Settings UI States Proving Test ---');
 14: 
 15:   const mockUser = {
 16:     id: 'user-001',
 17:     merchant_id: 'merchant-001',
 18:     email: 'admin@shipde.vn',
 19:     full_name: 'Nguyễn Văn Chủ Shop',
 20:     phone: '0901234567',
 21:     role: 'OWNER',
 22:     avatar_url: 'https://example.com/avatar.jpg',
 23:     language: 'vi',
 24:     timezone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
 25:     default_warehouse_id: 'wh-001',
 26:     notification_preferences: {
 27:       channels: {
 28:         email: true,
 29:         in_app: true,
 30:         push: false,
 31:       },
 32:       digest_window_minutes: 15,
 33:       subscriptions: {
 34:         delivery_fail: true,
 35:         rate_discrepancy: true,
 36:         cod_overdue: true,
 37:         abnormal_return: true,
 38:         security_alerts: true,
 39:         create_unknown: true,
 40:         claim_deadline_warning: true,
 41:       },
 42:     },
 43:     created_at: new Date(),
 44:   };
 45: 
 46:   // 1. Loading State
 47:   console.log('1. Testing Loading State...');
 48:   const loadingHtml = renderToStaticMarkup(
 49:     React.createElement(
 50:       AuthProvider,
 51:       null,
 52:       React.createElement(ProfileSettingsTab, { mockLoading: true })
 53:     )
 54:   );
 55:   assert.ok(
 56:     loadingHtml.includes('animate-pulse'),
 57:     'Loading state must render pulse skeleton placeholders'
 58:   );
 59:   console.log('PASS: Loading state skeleton rendered');
 60: 
 61:   // 2. Default Populated Profile State
 62:   console.log('2. Testing Populated Profile State...');
 63:   const populatedHtml = renderToStaticMarkup(
 64:     React.createElement(
 65:       AuthProvider,
 66:       null,
 67:       React.createElement(ProfileSettingsTab, { initialProfile: mockUser })
 68:     )
 69:   );
 70:   assert.ok(
 71:     populatedHtml.includes('Nguyễn Văn Chủ Shop'),
 72:     'Must display full name in populated profile'
 73:   );
 74:   assert.ok(populatedHtml.includes('0901234567'), 'Must display phone number in populated profile');
 75:   assert.ok(
 76:     populatedHtml.includes('Thông tin cá nhân &amp; Liên hệ') ||
 77:       populatedHtml.includes('Thông tin cá nhân & Liên hệ'),
 78:     'Must display section heading'
 79:   );
 80:   assert.ok(
 81:     populatedHtml.includes('Giờ Việt Nam (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, UTC+7)'),
 82:     'Must display timezone options'
 83:   );
 84:   assert.ok(populatedHtml.includes('Bắt buộc'), 'Critical alerts must display "Bắt buộc" tag');
 85:   console.log('PASS: Populated profile and preferences rendered accurately');
 86: 
 87:   // 3. Form Validation Unit Tests
 88:   console.log('3. Testing Form Validation Logic...');
 89: 
 90:   // 3a: Empty name
 91:   const emptyNameResult = validateProfileForm({
 92:     full_name: '',
 93:     phone: '0901234567',
 94:     avatar_url: '',
 95:     language: 'vi',
 96:     timezone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
 97:     default_warehouse_id: '',
 98:     notification_preferences: mockUser.notification_preferences,
 99:   });
100:   assert.strictEqual(emptyNameResult.isValid, false);
101:   assert.ok(
102:     emptyNameResult.errors.full_name?.includes('Họ và tên không được để trống'),
103:     'Empty name must trigger validation error'
104:   );
105: 
106:   // 3b: Invalid Vietnamese phone format
107:   const invalidPhoneResult = validateProfileForm({
108:     full_name: 'Nguyễn Văn B',
109:     phone: '12345',
110:     avatar_url: '',
111:     language: 'vi',
112:     timezone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
113:     default_warehouse_id: '',
114:     notification_preferences: mockUser.notification_preferences,
115:   });
116:   assert.strictEqual(invalidPhoneResult.isValid, false);
117:   assert.ok(
118:     invalidPhoneResult.errors.phone?.includes('không đúng định dạng Việt Nam'),
119:     'Invalid phone must trigger validation error'
120:   );
121: 
122:   // 3c: Valid form
123:   const validResult = validateProfileForm({
124:     full_name: 'Trần Thị Thu',
125:     phone: '0987654321',
126:     avatar_url: 'https://example.com/photo.png',
127:     language: 'vi',
128:     timezone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
129:     default_warehouse_id: '',
130:     notification_preferences: mockUser.notification_preferences,
131:   });
132:   assert.strictEqual(validResult.isValid, true);
133:   assert.strictEqual(Object.keys(validResult.errors).length, 0);
134:   console.log('PASS: Form validation logic verified');
135: 
136:   // 4. Critical Notifications Inviolability Contract
137:   console.log('4. Testing Critical Notifications Inviolability...');
138:   assert.ok(
139:     populatedHtml.includes('Cảnh báo bảo mật &amp; tài khoản') ||
140:       populatedHtml.includes('Cảnh báo bảo mật & tài khoản'),
141:     'Must display Security Alerts row'
142:   );
143:   assert.ok(
144:     populatedHtml.includes('Sự cố tạo đơn chưa rõ kết quả hãng'),
145:     'Must display Unknown Create Outcome row'
146:   );
147:   assert.ok(
148:     populatedHtml.includes('Hạn chót khiếu nại sắp tới hạn'),
149:     'Must display Claim Deadline row'
150:   );
151:   console.log('PASS: Critical notification rows present with inviolability contract');
152: 
153:   console.log('================================================================');
154:   console.log('ALL FEAT-PRO-01 WEB COMPONENT STATE TESTS PASSED!');
155:   console.log('================================================================');
156: }
157: 
158: runTest().catch((err) => {
159:   console.error('Profile page states test failed:', err);
160:   process.exit(1);
161: });

143:       name: 'Cấu hình cửa hàng',
144:       feature: 'Cấu hình cửa hàng',
145:     },
146:     {
147:       id: 'p_export_ledgers',
148:       code: 'reconciliation:allocate_bank_receipt',
149:       name: 'Phân bổ dòng tiền thực nhận',
150:       feature: 'Phân bổ dòng tiền thực nhận',
151:     },
152:   ];
153: 
154:   const resolved = resolveMatrixForLiveRoles(mockLiveRoles, canonicalMatrixRows);
155: 
156:   // 1. OWNER has all canonical capabilities enabled
157:   for (const row of resolved) {
158:     assert.strictEqual(
159:       row.roles['role-owner'],
160:       true,
161:       `Owner must hold canonical permission ${row.code}`
162:     );
163:   }
164: 
165:   // 2. CSKH has rescue (shipment:cancel_redeliver) and PII, but lacks discrepancy approval (Maker-Checker)
166:   const rescueRow = resolved.find((r) => r.id === 'p_reattempt')!;
167:   assert.strictEqual(
168:     rescueRow.roles['role-cskh'],
169:     true,
170:     'CSKH must have shipment:cancel_redeliver'
171:   );
172:   const discrepancyRow = resolved.find((r) => r.id === 'p_discrepancy')!;
173:   assert.strictEqual(
174:     discrepancyRow.roles['role-cskh'],
175:     false,
176:     'CSKH must NOT have reconciliation:approve_rate_policy'
177:   );
178: 
179:   // 3. WAREHOUSE has return scan (shipment:receive_return)
180:   const returnRow = resolved.find((r) => r.id === 'p_return_scan')!;
181:   assert.strictEqual(
182:     returnRow.roles['role-warehouse'],
183:     true,
184:     'Warehouse must have shipment:receive_return'
185:   );
186: 
187:   // 4. Round 3 Finding 1: When liveRoles is empty (in-flight, failed, or empty catalog),
188:   // resolveMatrixForLiveRoles returns 0 role grants. Never paint fallback roles or fake grants.
189:   const emptyResolved = resolveMatrixForLiveRoles([], canonicalMatrixRows);
190:   assert.strictEqual(emptyResolved.length, canonicalMatrixRows.length);
191:   for (const row of emptyResolved) {
192:     assert.strictEqual(
193:       Object.keys(row.roles).length,
194:       0,
195:       `Row ${row.code} must not contain any role grants when live roles are empty`
196:     );
197:   }
198: 
199:   // 5. Round 7 Finding 4: Canonical capability mapping verification from seed/spec
200:   const auditRow = resolved.find((r) => r.code === 'reconciliation:run_review_audit')!;
201:   assert.strictEqual(auditRow.feature, 'Chạy và đối chiếu kiểm toán');
202:   assert.strictEqual(auditRow.name, 'Chạy và đối chiếu kiểm toán');
203: 
204:   const bankRow = resolved.find((r) => r.code === 'reconciliation:allocate_bank_receipt')!;
205:   assert.strictEqual(bankRow.feature, 'Phân bổ dòng tiền thực nhận');
206:   assert.strictEqual(bankRow.name, 'Phân bổ dòng tiền thực nhận');
207: 
208:   const policyRow = resolved.find((r) => r.code === 'reconciliation:approve_rate_policy')!;
209:   assert.strictEqual(policyRow.feature, 'Phê duyệt chính sách đối soát');
210:   assert.strictEqual(policyRow.name, 'Phê duyệt chính sách đối soát');
211: 
212:   console.log(
213:     '✅ Finding 4 (Round 7): Matrix rows bound to canonical RBAC catalog names and codes proved successfully!'
214:   );
215: 
216:   console.log(
217:     '✅ Finding 1 (Round 3): Zero fake grants painted when live roles are empty/in-flight.'
218:   );
219:   console.log('✅ Finding 2 & 10: Canonical RBAC Matrix live resolution proved successfully!');
220: }
221: 
222: runTest().catch((err) => {
223:   console.error(err);
224:   process.exit(1);
225: });
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/tests/regression-audit.test.ts">
   1: // ============================================================================
   2: // Ship Dễ — Regression Audit Test Suite
   3: // Kiểm toán hồi quy tính nhất quán dữ liệu, phân quyền và luật nghiệp vụ
   4: // ============================================================================
   5: 
   6: import {
   7:   MASTER_SHIPMENTS,
   8:   MASTER_EXCEPTIONS,
   9:   MASTER_DISCREPANCIES,
  10:   MASTER_CLAIMS,
  11:   getUnifiedMetrics,
  12: } from '../services/unifiedDataStore';
  13: import { MakerCheckerEngine } from '../core/maker-checker';
  14: import { DiscrepancyResolution } from '../types/domain';
  15: 
  16: function assert(condition: boolean, message: string) {
  17:   if (!condition) {
  18:     throw new Error(`❌ FAILED: ${message}`);
  19:   }
  20:   console.log(`✅ PASS: ${message}`);
  21: }
  22: 
  23: async function runRegressionSuite() {
  24:   console.log('\n================================================================');
  25:   console.log('🏁 CHẠY KIỂM TOÁN HỒI QUY DỮ LIỆU & QUY TẮC NGHIỆP VỤ SHIP DỄ');
  26:   console.log('================================================================\n');
  27: 
  28:   // Test 1: Data Count Invariants
  29:   const metrics = getUnifiedMetrics();
  30:   assert(
  31:     metrics.totalShipments === 50,
  32:     `Tổng số bưu kiện trong kho dữ liệu chuẩn là 50 (Thực tế: ${metrics.totalShipments})`
  33:   );
  34:   assert(
  35:     MASTER_SHIPMENTS.length === 50,
  36:     `Danh sách bưu kiện đồng bộ 100% với metrics (50 bản ghi)`
  37:   );
  38:   assert(
  39:     metrics.openExceptionsCount ===
  40:       MASTER_EXCEPTIONS.filter((e) => e.status === 'OPEN' || e.status === 'ASSIGNED').length,
  41:     `Badge Hộp việc và danh sách sự cố mở khớp số lượng (${metrics.openExceptionsCount})`
  42:   );
  43:   assert(
  44:     metrics.openDiscrepanciesCount ===
  45:       MASTER_DISCREPANCIES.filter((d) => d.status === 'OPEN').length,
  46:     `Badge Khoản lệch và bảng đối soát khớp số lượng (${metrics.openDiscrepanciesCount})`
  47:   );
  48: 
  49:   // Test 2: Maker-Checker Segregation of Duties (BR-12)
  50:   const mcEngine = new MakerCheckerEngine();
  51:   const disc1 = MASTER_DISCREPANCIES[0]; // created_by_user = 'usr_02' (CSKH Hoa)
  52: 
  53:   // Case 2a: User CSKH Hoa cố gắng tự duyệt chênh lệch do chính mình tạo -> Bị chặn
  54:   let selfApprovalBlocked = false;
  55:   const mockShipment = {
  56:     id: 'shp_001',
  57:     merchant_id: 'merc_01',
  58:     order_id: 'ord_01',
  59:     order_code: 'ORD_01',
  60:     carrier_code: 'GHN' as any,
  61:     carrier_account_id: 'acc_01',
  62:     tracking_code: disc1.tracking_code,
  63:     current_status: 'delivered' as any,
  64:     declared_weight_g: 350,
  65:     quoted_fee: 22000,
  66:     cod_amount: 450000,
  67:     created_at: new Date(),
  68:     version: 1,
  69:     last_modified_by: 'usr_02',
  70:   };
  71: 
  72:   try {
  73:     mcEngine.resolveDiscrepancy(
  74:       {
  75:         id: disc1.id,
  76:         merchant_id: 'merc_01',
  77:         shipment_id: 'shp_001',
  78:         statement_row_id: 'stmt_01',
  79:         type: disc1.type as any,
  80:         tracking_code: disc1.tracking_code,
  81:         amount: 7000,
  82:         status: DiscrepancyResolution.OPEN,
  83:         created_by_user: 'usr_02',
  84:         version: 1,
  85:         created_at: new Date(),
  86:       },
  87:       mockShipment,
  88:       {
  89:         discrepancy_id: disc1.id,
  90:         resolution: DiscrepancyResolution.CONFIRMED,
  91:         reason: 'Tôi tự duyệt',
  92:         user_id: 'usr_02', // Cố tình tự duyệt
  93:         user_name: 'Trần Thị Hoa',
  94:         expected_version: 1,
  95:       }
  96:     );
  97:   } catch (err: any) {
  98:     if (
  99:       err.code === 'self_approval_forbidden' ||
 100:       err.message?.includes('tách quyền') ||
 101:       err.message?.includes('không thể tự duyệt')
 102:     ) {
 103:       selfApprovalBlocked = true;
 104:     }
 105:   }
 106:   assert(
 107:     selfApprovalBlocked,
 108:     'Quy tắc BR-12: Chặn tuyệt đối người tạo (CSKH) tự duyệt khoản chênh lệch tài chính'
 109:   );
 110: 
 111:   // Case 2b: Kế toán viên độc lập (usr_03) duyệt chênh lệch -> Thành công
 112:   const testDiscrepancy = {
 113:     id: disc1.id,
 114:     merchant_id: 'merc_01',
 115:     shipment_id: 'shp_001',
 116:     tracking_code: disc1.tracking_code,
 117:     type: disc1.type as any,
 118:     amount: 7000,
 119:     status: DiscrepancyResolution.OPEN,
 120:     created_by_user: 'usr_02',
 121:     version: 1,
 122:     created_at: new Date(),
 123:   };
 124: 
 125:   const resolved = mcEngine.resolveDiscrepancy(testDiscrepancy as any, mockShipment, {
 126:     discrepancy_id: disc1.id,
 127:     resolution: DiscrepancyResolution.CONFIRMED,
 128:     reason: 'Đã xác minh bảng kê hợp đồng',
 129:     user_id: 'usr_03', // Kế toán duyệt
 130:     user_name: 'Lê Minh Kế Toán',
 131:     expected_version: 1,
 132:   });
 133:   assert(
 134:     resolved.status === DiscrepancyResolution.CONFIRMED && resolved.version === 2,
 135:     'Kế toán viên độc lập duyệt chênh lệch thành công và tăng version lên 2'
 136:   );
 137: 
 138:   // Test 3: Total Discrepancy Sum Consistency
 139:   const sumAmount = MASTER_DISCREPANCIES.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.discrepancy_amount, 0);
 140:   assert(
 141:     sumAmount === 1978000,
 142:     `Tổng số tiền lệch D1..D7 tính toán chính xác từ từng dòng: 1.978.000 đ (Thực tế: ${sumAmount.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ)`
 143:   );
 144: 
 145:   // Test 4: Build artifact preservation invariant
 146:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
 147:     const fs = await import('fs');
 148:     const path = await import('path');
 149:     let webDir = process.cwd();
 150:     if (
 151:       !fs.existsSync(path.join(webDir, '.next')) &&
 152:       fs.existsSync(path.join(webDir, 'apps', 'web', '.next'))
 153:     ) {
 154:       webDir = path.join(webDir, 'apps', 'web');
 155:     }
 156:     const nextDir = path.join(webDir, '.next');
 157:     assert(fs.existsSync(nextDir), 'apps/web/.next build directory must exist and be preserved');
 158:     const prerenderManifest = path.join(nextDir, 'prerender-manifest.json');
 159:     assert(
 160:       fs.existsSync(prerenderManifest),
 161:       'apps/web/.next/prerender-manifest.json must exist and remain uncorrupted'
 162:     );
 163:     const buildManifest = path.join(nextDir, 'build-manifest.json');
 164:     assert(
 165:       fs.existsSync(buildManifest),
 166:       'apps/web/.next/build-manifest.json must exist and remain uncorrupted'
 167:     );
 168:   }
 169: 
 170:   // Test 5: Secret Scanner Robustness, Shell-Metacharacter Safety, Fail-Closed & Mock-Injected Negative Proofs
 171:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
 172:     const fs = await import('fs');
 173:     const path = await import('path');
 174:     const os = await import('os');
 175:     let rootDir = process.cwd();
 176:     if (fs.existsSync(path.join(rootDir, '../../scripts/verify-secrets.ts'))) {
 177:       rootDir = path.resolve(rootDir, '../..');
 178:     }
 179:     const verifySecretsScript = path.join(rootDir, 'scripts', 'verify-secrets.ts');
 180:     const rootConfigPath = path.join(rootDir, '.gitleaks.toml');
 181: 
 182:     assert(
 183:       fs.existsSync(verifySecretsScript) && fs.existsSync(rootConfigPath),
 184:       'verify-secrets.ts and .gitleaks.toml must exist in repository root'
 185:     );
 186: 
 187:     const { pathToFileURL } = await import('url');
 188:     const {
 189:       executeGitleaks,
 190:       isIgnoredScanName,
 191:       getGitleaksScanTargets,
 192:       cleanTemporaryFiles,
 193:       runCliVerification,
 194:       runNegativeCliTest,
 195:       walkDir,
 196:     } = await import(pathToFileURL(verifySecretsScript).href);
 197: 
 198:     // Snapshot initial temporary files in root directory to distinguish pre-existing artifacts from newly created ones
 199:     const initialTempReports = new Set(
 200:       fs
 201:         .readdirSync(rootDir)
 202:         .filter(
 203:           (entry: string) =>
 204:             entry.startsWith('.temp-gitleaks') || entry.startsWith('test-negative-secret-fixture')
 205:         )
 206:     );
 207: 
 208:     // Create an isolated temporary directory for running all CLI and scanner regression tests
 209:     const isolatedTempDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'shipde-scanner-test-'));
 210:     const isolatedConfigPath = path.join(isolatedTempDir, '.gitleaks.toml');
 211:     fs.copyFileSync(rootConfigPath, isolatedConfigPath);
 212:     // Create a dummy safe source file in isolatedTempDir so target scanning finds safe targets
 213:     fs.mkdirSync(path.join(isolatedTempDir, 'src'), { recursive: true });
 214:     fs.writeFileSync(
 215:       path.join(isolatedTempDir, 'src', 'safe.ts'),
 216:       'export const safeValue = 123;\n',
 217:       'utf-8'
 218:     );
 219: 
 220:     try {
 221:       // 5a. Shell-metacharacter path safety (No command injection)
 222:       const metacharFixture = path.join(
 223:         isolatedTempDir,
 224:         '.temp-gitleaks-test-$(echo_safe)-fixture.js'
 225:       );
 226:       const metacharReport = path.join(isolatedTempDir, '.temp-gitleaks-test-metachar-report.json');
 227:       fs.writeFileSync(
 228:         metacharFixture,
 229:         '// Safe file with shell metacharacters in filename\nconst safeConst = 12345;\n',
 230:         'utf-8'
 231:       );
 232:       try {
 233:         let capturedArgs: string[] = [];
 234:         let capturedOptions: any = {};
 235:         const mockSafeSpawn = (bin: string, args: string[], options: any) => {
 236:           capturedArgs = args;
 237:           capturedOptions = options;
 238:           return {
 239:             status: 0,
 240:             stdout: '',
 241:             stderr: '',
 242:             error: undefined,
 243:           };
 244:         };
 245:         const metacharResult = executeGitleaks(
 246:           'mock-gitleaks',
 247:           [
 248:             'dir',
 249:             metacharFixture,
 250:             '-c',
 251:             isolatedConfigPath,
 252:             '--report-path',
 253:             metacharReport,
 254:             '--report-format',
 255:             'json',
 256:             '--redact',
 257:           ],
 258:           metacharReport,
 259:           mockSafeSpawn as any
 260:         );
 261:         assert(
 262:           metacharResult.success &&
 263:             metacharResult.exitCode === 0 &&
 264:             capturedOptions.shell === false &&
 265:             capturedArgs.includes(metacharFixture),
 266:           'Gitleaks CLI executes safely on paths containing shell metacharacters without command injection (shell: false)'
 267:         );
 268:       } finally {
 269:         cleanTemporaryFiles([metacharFixture, metacharReport]);
 270:       }
 271: 
 272:       // 5b. Deterministic fail-closed on directory enumeration failure (DI mock)
 273:       let readdirThrown = false;
 274:       try {
 275:         const mockFailingFs = {
 276:           readdirSync: () => {
 277:             throw new Error('EACCES: permission denied, scan directory unreadable');
 278:           },
 279:         };
 280:         getGitleaksScanTargets(isolatedTempDir, mockFailingFs as any);
 281:       } catch (err: any) {
 282:         if (err.message.includes('EACCES')) {
 283:           readdirThrown = true;
 284:         }
 285:       }
 286:       assert(
 287:         readdirThrown,
 288:         'getGitleaksScanTargets fails closed and throws operational error when directory enumeration fails'
 289:       );
 290: 
 291:       // 5c. Deterministic fail-closed on walkDir failure (DI mock)
 292:       let walkDirThrown = false;
 293:       try {
 294:         const mockFailingFs = {
 295:           readdirSync: () => {
 296:             throw new Error('ENOENT: directory missing during walk');
 297:           },
 298:         };
 299:         walkDir(isolatedTempDir, isolatedTempDir, [], [], mockFailingFs as any);
 300:       } catch (err: any) {
 301:         if (err.message.includes('ENOENT')) {
 302:           walkDirThrown = true;
 303:         }
 304:       }
 305:       assert(
 306:         walkDirThrown,
 307:         'walkDir fails closed and throws operational error when directory enumeration fails'
 308:       );
 309: 
 310:       // 5d. Scanner operational failure handling (fail-closed on spawn error)
 311:       const failResult = executeGitleaks(
 312:         'nonexistent-gitleaks-binary-xyz',
 313:         ['dir', '.'],
 314:         path.join(isolatedTempDir, '.temp-nonexistent-report.json')
 315:       );
 316:       assert(
 317:         !failResult.success && typeof failResult.operationalError === 'string',
 318:         'executeGitleaks fails closed when scanner binary fails to spawn'
 319:       );
 320: 
 321:       // 5e. Scanner operational failure on invalid flags (non-zero exit code)
 322:       const mockSpawnExit2 = () => ({
 323:         status: 2,
 324:         stdout: '',
 325:         stderr: 'unknown flag --invalid-flag-that-does-not-exist-xyz',
 326:         error: undefined,
 327:       });
 328:       const invalidFlagResult = executeGitleaks(
 329:         'mock-gitleaks',
 330:         ['--invalid-flag-that-does-not-exist-xyz'],
 331:         path.join(isolatedTempDir, '.temp-invalid-flag-report.json'),
 332:         mockSpawnExit2 as any
 333:       );
 334:       assert(
 335:         !invalidFlagResult.success && typeof invalidFlagResult.operationalError === 'string',
 336:         'executeGitleaks fails closed on non-zero operational exit codes'
 337:       );
 338: 
 339:       // 5f. Missing report file when scanner exits code 1 (fail-closed)
 340:       const missingReportPath = path.join(isolatedTempDir, '.temp-nonexistent-finding-report.json');
 341:       const mockSpawnExit1 = () => ({
 342:         status: 1,
 343:         stdout: '',
 344:         stderr: 'simulated finding output',
 345:         error: undefined,
 346:       });
 347:       const missingReportResult = executeGitleaks(
 348:         'mock-gitleaks',
 349:         ['dir', '.'],
 350:         missingReportPath,
 351:         mockSpawnExit1 as any,
 352:         { existsSync: () => false, readFileSync: () => '' } as any
 353:       );
 354:       assert(
 355:         !missingReportResult.success &&
 356:           Boolean(missingReportResult.operationalError?.includes('report file was not created')),
 357:         'executeGitleaks fails closed when exit code 1 occurs but report file is missing'
 358:       );
 359: 
 360:       // 5g. Empty report file when scanner exits code 1 (fail-closed)
 361:       const emptyReportResult = executeGitleaks(
 362:         'mock-gitleaks',
 363:         ['dir', '.'],
 364:         path.join(isolatedTempDir, '.temp-empty-report.json'),
 365:         mockSpawnExit1 as any,
 366:         { existsSync: () => true, readFileSync: () => '   ' } as any
 367:       );
 368:       assert(
 369:         !emptyReportResult.success &&
 370:           Boolean(emptyReportResult.operationalError?.includes('empty')),
 371:         'executeGitleaks fails closed when exit code 1 occurs but report file is empty'
 372:       );
 373: 
 374:       // 5h. Malformed report JSON handling (fail-closed)
 375:       const malformedReportResult = executeGitleaks(
 376:         'mock-gitleaks',
 377:         ['dir', '.'],
 378:         path.join(isolatedTempDir, '.temp-malformed-report.json'),
 379:         mockSpawnExit1 as any,
 380:         {
 381:           existsSync: () => true,
 382:           readFileSync: () => '{ invalid json :::',
 383:         } as any
 384:       );
 385:       assert(
 386:         !malformedReportResult.success &&
 387:           Boolean(malformedReportResult.operationalError?.includes('Failed to parse')),
 388:         'executeGitleaks fails closed when report file contains malformed JSON'
 389:       );
 390: 
 391:       // 5i. Deterministic cleanup failure handling in cleanTemporaryFiles (fail-closed)
 392:       let cleanupFailedClosed = false;
 393:       try {
 394:         const mockUnlinkFailingFs = {
 395:           existsSync: () => true,
 396:           unlinkSync: () => {
 397:             throw new Error('EBUSY: resource locked');
 398:           },
 399:         };
 400:         cleanTemporaryFiles(['/mock/path/temp.json'], mockUnlinkFailingFs as any);
 401:       } catch (err: any) {
 402:         if (err.message.includes('EBUSY')) {
 403:           cleanupFailedClosed = true;
 404:         }
 405:       }
 406:       assert(
 407:         cleanupFailedClosed,
 408:         'cleanTemporaryFiles fails closed and throws operational error when unlinking reports fails'
 409:       );
 410: 
 411:       // 5j-1. Secret found plus cleanup failure -> operational failure (exit code 2) must override finding (exit code 1)
 412:       const mockSpawnFinding = () => ({
 413:         status: 1,
 414:         stdout: '',
 415:         stderr: '',
 416:         error: undefined,
 417:       });
 418:       const mockFsWithLockedSecretReport = {
 419:         ...fs,
 420:         existsSync: (p: string) => (String(p).includes('.temp-gitleaks') ? true : fs.existsSync(p)),
 421:         readFileSync: (p: string, opt: any) =>
 422:           String(p).includes('.temp-gitleaks')
 423:             ? JSON.stringify([
 424:                 {
 425:                   RuleID: 'shipde-carrier-live-token',
 426:                   Description: 'Live carrier token',
 427:                   File: 'test.js',
 428:                   StartLine: 1,
 429:                 },
 430:               ])
 431:             : fs.readFileSync(p, opt),
 432:         unlinkSync: (p: string) => {
 433:           if (String(p).includes('.temp-gitleaks')) {
 434:             throw new Error('EPERM: cannot delete temporary report on secret finding branch');
 435:           }
 436:           fs.unlinkSync(p);
 437:         },
 438:       };
 439:       const secretFoundCleanupFailResult = runCliVerification(['--test-negative'], {
 440:         fsImpl: mockFsWithLockedSecretReport as any,
 441:         spawnImpl: mockSpawnFinding as any,
 442:         rootDir: isolatedTempDir,
 443:         getBin: () => 'mock-gitleaks',
 444:       });
 445:       assert(
 446:         secretFoundCleanupFailResult.exitCode === 2 &&
 447:           Boolean(secretFoundCleanupFailResult.message?.includes('cannot delete temporary report')),
 448:         'runCliVerification overrides finding (exit code 1) with exit code 2 when report cleanup fails after secret finding'
 449:       );
 450: 
 451:       // 5j-2. Clean scan plus cleanup failure -> operational failure (exit code 2) must override clean result (exit code 0)
 452:       const mockSpawnCleanSuccess = () => ({
 453:         status: 0,
 454:         stdout: '',
 455:         stderr: '',
 456:         error: undefined,
 457:       });
 458:       const mockFsWithLockedCleanReport = {
 459:         ...fs,
 460:         existsSync: (p: string) => (String(p).includes('.temp-gitleaks') ? true : fs.existsSync(p)),
 461:         readFileSync: (p: string, opt: any) =>
 462:           String(p).includes('.temp-gitleaks') ? '[]' : fs.readFileSync(p, opt),
 463:         unlinkSync: (p: string) => {
 464:           if (String(p).includes('.temp-gitleaks')) {
 465:             throw new Error('EBUSY: resource locked on clean scan report cleanup');
 466:           }
 467:           fs.unlinkSync(p);
 468:         },
 469:       };
 470:       const cleanScanCleanupFailResult = runCliVerification([], {
 471:         fsImpl: mockFsWithLockedCleanReport as any,

1097:               const worktreesIdx = parts.lastIndexOf('worktrees');

1109:       const args: string[] = [];
1110:       for (const dir of safeDirs) {
1111:         args.push('-c', `safe.directory=${dir}`);
1112:       }
1113:       return args;
1114:     }

1182:   // Test 8: Standalone Temporary Git Repository & Cryptographic 3-State Cache Isolation (Fail-Closed)
1183:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
1184:     const fs = await import('fs');
1185:     const path = await import('path');
1186:     const os = await import('os');
1187:     const crypto = await import('crypto');
1188:     const cp = await import('child_process');
1189:     let rootDir = process.cwd();
1190:     if (fs.existsSync(path.join(rootDir, '../../turbo.json'))) {
1191:       rootDir = path.resolve(rootDir, '../..');
1192:     }
1193: 
1194:     interface CacheFileRecord {
1195:       relPath: string;
1196:       size: number;
1197:       sha256: string;
1198:     }
1199: 
1200:     // Helper: Recursively record exact relative paths, sizes, and SHA-256 cryptographic hashes for every regular file
1201:     function getRecursiveCacheFileSnapshots(cacheDir: string): CacheFileRecord[] | null {
1202:       if (!fs.existsSync(cacheDir)) return null;
1203:       const records: CacheFileRecord[] = [];
1204:       function walk(dir: string) {
1205:         const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
1206:         for (const entry of entries) {
1207:           const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);
1208:           if (entry.isDirectory()) {
1209:             walk(fullPath);
1210:           } else if (entry.isFile()) {
1211:             const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath);
1212:             const relPath = path.relative(cacheDir, fullPath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
1213:             const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
1214:             records.push({
1215:               relPath,
1216:               size: content.length,
1217:               sha256,
1218:             });
1219:           }
1220:         }
1221:       }
1222:       walk(cacheDir);
1223:       records.sort((a, b) => a.relPath.localeCompare(b.relPath));
1224:       return records;
1225:     }

1227:     // 8a. Focused negative regression proof: Verify SHA-256 detects byte changes with unchanged file size, additions, deletions, nested changes, and renames
1228:     {
1229:       const negTestDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'shipde-cache-hash-test-'));
1230:       try {
1231:         const testCacheDir = path.join(negTestDir, 'cache');
1232:         fs.mkdirSync(path.join(testCacheDir, 'nested'), { recursive: true });
1233:         fs.writeFileSync(path.join(testCacheDir, 'entry1.json'), 'payload-data-alpha');
1234:         fs.writeFileSync(path.join(testCacheDir, 'nested', 'entry2.json'), 'nested-content-1');
1235: 
1236:         const initialSnapshot = getRecursiveCacheFileSnapshots(testCacheDir);
1237:         assert(
1238:           initialSnapshot !== null && initialSnapshot.length === 2,
1239:           'Initial snapshot must have 2 entries'
1240:         );
1241: 
1242:         // Mutation 1: Same byte length (18 bytes), but altered content
1243:         fs.writeFileSync(path.join(testCacheDir, 'entry1.json'), 'payload-data-omega');
1244:         const mutatedSnapshot = getRecursiveCacheFileSnapshots(testCacheDir);
1245:         assert(
1246:           mutatedSnapshot !== null && mutatedSnapshot.length === 2,
1247:           'Mutated snapshot must have 2 entries'
1248:         );
1249: 
1250:         if (!initialSnapshot || !mutatedSnapshot) {
1251:           throw new Error('Snapshots must not be null');
1252:         }
1253: 
1254:         assert(
1255:           initialSnapshot[0].size === mutatedSnapshot[0].size,
1256:           'File size must remain identical (18 bytes) to prove hash sensitivity'
1257:         );
1258:         assert(
1259:           initialSnapshot[0].sha256 !== mutatedSnapshot[0].sha256,
1260:           'SHA-256 hash must detect byte changes when file size is unchanged'
1261:         );
1262: 
1263:         let caughtHashDiscrepancy = false;
1264:         try {
1265:           assert(
1266:             JSON.stringify(initialSnapshot) === JSON.stringify(mutatedSnapshot),
1267:             'Preservation assertion must fail on byte change'
1268:           );
1269:         } catch {
1270:           caughtHashDiscrepancy = true;
1271:         }
1272:         assert(
1273:           caughtHashDiscrepancy,
1274:           'Preservation assertion must fail closed when cache bytes are altered'
1275:         );
1276:       } finally {
1277:         fs.rmSync(negTestDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
1278:       }
1279:     }

1281:     // Safe Git invocation helper: Explicitly configures safe.directory for the specific target directory and any linked gitdir

1283:     function getSafeDirectoryArgs(cwd: string): string[] {
1284:       const normalizedCwd = path.resolve(cwd).replace(/\\/g, '/');
1285:       const safeDirs = new Set<string>([normalizedCwd]);

1287:       try {

1295:               safeDirs.add(gitDirPath);

1319:     ): string {

1324:     // 8b. Discover all registered worktrees via git worktree list (read-only baseline)
1325:     // Parse complete porcelain records and retain only live, existing, non-prunable worktrees
1326:     interface ParsedWorktreeRecord {
1327:       path: string;
1328:       isPrunable: boolean;
1329:       isLocked: boolean;
1330:       exists: boolean;
1331:     }
1332: 
1333:     function parseGitWorktreesPorcelain(output: string): ParsedWorktreeRecord[] {
1334:       const records: ParsedWorktreeRecord[] = [];
1335:       const blocks = output.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/);
1336:       for (const block of blocks) {
1337:         const lines = block
1338:           .split(/\r?\n/)
1339:           .map((l) => l.trim())
1340:           .filter((l) => l.length > 0);
1341:         if (lines.length === 0) continue;
1342: 
1343:         let wtPath = '';
1344:         let isPrunable = false;
1345:         let isLocked = false;
1346: 
1347:         for (const line of lines) {
1348:           if (line.startsWith('worktree ')) {
1349:             wtPath = path.normalize(line.slice(9).trim());
1350:           } else if (line.startsWith('prunable')) {
1351:             isPrunable = true;
1352:           } else if (line.startsWith('locked')) {
1353:             isLocked = true;
1354:           }
1355:         }
1356: 
1357:         if (wtPath) {
1358:           records.push({
1359:             path: wtPath,
1360:             isPrunable,
1361:             isLocked,
1362:             exists: fs.existsSync(wtPath),
1363:           });
1364:         }
1365:       }
1366:       return records;
1367:     }

1373:     }).trim();

1377:       stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1378:     }).trim();
1379:     const realGitCommonDir = path.resolve(rootDir, realGitCommonDirRaw);
