1565:       assert(
1566:         resolvedEphemCommonDir !== realGitCommonDir,
1567:         `Ephemeral worktree Git common directory must not be the real checkout's Git common directory (${realGitCommonDir})`
1568:       );
1569: 
1570:       // 4. Synthetic sibling regression cases inside unified scope
1571:       // Sibling Case A: Non-target sibling with no .turbo directory
1572:       const mockSiblingNoTurbo = path.join(tempBase, 'sibling-case-a-no-turbo');
1573:       fs.mkdirSync(mockSiblingNoTurbo, { recursive: true });
1574: 
1575:       // Sibling Case B: Non-target sibling where .turbo exists but .turbo/cache is absent
1576:       const mockSiblingTurboNoCache = path.join(tempBase, 'sibling-case-b-turbo-no-cache');
1577:       fs.mkdirSync(path.join(mockSiblingTurboNoCache, '.turbo'), {
1578:         recursive: true,
1579:       });
1580:       fs.writeFileSync(
1581:         path.join(mockSiblingTurboNoCache, '.turbo', 'config.json'),
1582:         '{"synthetic":true}',
1583:         'utf-8'
1584:       );
1585: 
1586:       // Sibling Case C: Non-target sibling where .turbo/cache exists with nested files
1587:       const mockSiblingTurboWithCache = path.join(tempBase, 'sibling-case-c-turbo-with-cache');
1588:       fs.mkdirSync(path.join(mockSiblingTurboWithCache, '.turbo', 'cache', 'nested'), {
1589:         recursive: true,
1590:       });
1591:       fs.writeFileSync(
1592:         path.join(mockSiblingTurboWithCache, '.turbo', 'cache', 'mock-existing-cache.json'),
1593:         '{"cached":true}',
1594:         'utf-8'
1595:       );
1596:       fs.writeFileSync(
1597:         path.join(mockSiblingTurboWithCache, '.turbo', 'cache', 'nested', 'nested-cache.json'),
1598:         '{"nested":true}',
1599:         'utf-8'
1600:       );
1601: 
1602:       interface TargetStateSnapshot {
1603:         path: string;
1604:         isGitWorktree: boolean;
1605:         turboDirExists: boolean;
1606:         turboCacheDirExists: boolean;
1607:         cacheFiles: CacheFileRecord[] | null;
1608:         gitStatus: string | null;
1609:       }
1610: 
1611:       const monitoredTargets: { path: string; isGitWorktree: boolean }[] = [
1612:         ...worktreePaths.map((p) => ({ path: p, isGitWorktree: true })),
1613:         { path: mockSiblingNoTurbo, isGitWorktree: false },
1614:         { path: mockSiblingTurboNoCache, isGitWorktree: false },
1615:         { path: mockSiblingTurboWithCache, isGitWorktree: false },
1616:       ];
1617: 
1618:       // 5. Pre-execution snapshots using cryptographic recursive SHA-256
1619:       const preSnapshots: Record<string, TargetStateSnapshot> = {};
1620:       for (const target of monitoredTargets) {
1621:         const turboDir = path.join(target.path, '.turbo');
1622:         const turboCacheDir = path.join(turboDir, 'cache');
1623:         const turboDirExists = fs.existsSync(turboDir);
1624:         const turboCacheDirExists = fs.existsSync(turboCacheDir);
1625:         const cacheFiles = getRecursiveCacheFileSnapshots(turboCacheDir);
1626:         const gitStatus = target.isGitWorktree
1627:           ? execSafeGit(['status', '--porcelain'], {
1628:               cwd: target.path,
1629:               encoding: 'utf-8',
1630:               stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1631:             }).trim()
1632:           : null;
1633:         preSnapshots[target.path] = {
1634:           path: target.path,
1635:           isGitWorktree: target.isGitWorktree,
1636:           turboDirExists,
1637:           turboCacheDirExists,
1638:           cacheFiles,
1639:           gitStatus,
1640:         };
1641:       }
1642: 
1643:       // 6. Dependency setup inside ephemeral linked worktree
1644:       const pnpmCmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'pnpm.cmd' : 'pnpm';
1645:       cp.execSync(`${pnpmCmd} install --frozen-lockfile`, {
1646:         cwd: ephemeralWtPath,
1647:         stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1648:       });
1649: 
1650:       const turboBin = path.join(ephemeralWtPath, 'node_modules', 'turbo', 'bin', 'turbo');
1651:       assert(
1652:         fs.existsSync(turboBin),
1653:         'Turbo binary must exist in ephemeral linked worktree node_modules'
1654:       );
1655: 
1656:       // 7. Real cache-writing Turbo execution inside ephemeral linked worktree
1657:       const turboBuildOutput = cp
1658:         .execFileSync(
1659:           process.execPath,
1660:           [
1661:             turboBin,
1662:             'build',
1663:             '--filter=@shipde/contracts',
1664:             '--filter=@shipde/config',
1665:             '--force',
1666:             '--cache-dir=.turbo/cache',
1667:           ],
1668:           {
1669:             cwd: ephemeralWtPath,
1670:             encoding: 'utf-8',
1671:             stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1672:           }
1673:         )
1674:         .trim();
1675:       assert(
1676:         turboBuildOutput.includes('turbo') || turboBuildOutput.includes('Tasks:'),
1677:         'Turbo execution in ephemeral linked worktree must produce valid task output'
1678:       );
1679: 
1680:       // 8. Assert cache was created strictly inside target ephemeral worktree (.turbo/cache)
1681:       const wtTurboCacheDir = path.join(ephemeralWtPath, '.turbo', 'cache');
1682:       assert(
1683:         fs.existsSync(wtTurboCacheDir),
1684:         'Target ephemeral linked worktree must have .turbo/cache created by Turbo'
1685:       );
1686:       const wtCacheFiles = fs.readdirSync(wtTurboCacheDir);
1687:       assert(
1688:         wtCacheFiles.length > 0,
1689:         'Target ephemeral worktree .turbo/cache must contain real Turbo cache entries'
1690:       );
1691:       const hasRealTurboArtifacts = wtCacheFiles.some(
1692:         (f) => f.endsWith('.tar.zst') || f.endsWith('-manifest.json') || f.endsWith('-meta.json')
1693:       );
1694:       assert(
1695:         hasRealTurboArtifacts,
1696:         'Target ephemeral worktree .turbo/cache must contain real Turbo-generated artifacts (*.tar.zst / *-manifest.json)'
1697:       );
1698: 
1699:       // 9. Assert exact cryptographic 3-state preservation across all non-target siblings and checkouts
1700:       for (const target of monitoredTargets) {
1701:         const pre = preSnapshots[target.path];
1702:         const turboDir = path.join(target.path, '.turbo');
1703:         const turboCacheDir = path.join(turboDir, 'cache');
1704:         const turboDirExists = fs.existsSync(turboDir);
1705:         const turboCacheDirExists = fs.existsSync(turboCacheDir);
1706: 
1707:         // a. Exact .turbo directory existence
1708:         assert(
1709:           turboDirExists === pre.turboDirExists,
1710:           `Non-target path "${target.path}" .turbo existence must match pre-state (expected: ${pre.turboDirExists}, got: ${turboDirExists})`
1711:         );
1712: 
1713:         // b. Exact .turbo/cache directory existence
1714:         assert(
1715:           turboCacheDirExists === pre.turboCacheDirExists,
1716:           `Non-target path "${target.path}" .turbo/cache existence must match pre-state (expected: ${pre.turboCacheDirExists}, got: ${turboCacheDirExists})`
1717:         );
1718: 
1719:         // c. Exact recursive SHA-256 cryptographic file contents when cache exists
1720:         if (pre.turboCacheDirExists) {
1721:           const currentFiles = getRecursiveCacheFileSnapshots(turboCacheDir);
1722:           assert(
1723:             JSON.stringify(currentFiles) === JSON.stringify(pre.cacheFiles),
1724:             `Non-target path "${target.path}" cache contents (SHA-256 and relative paths) must remain 100% identical and unpolluted`
1725:           );
1726:         }
1727: 
1728:         // d. Exact working tree git status for repository checkouts
1729:         if (target.isGitWorktree) {
1730:           const currentGitStatus = execSafeGit(['status', '--porcelain'], {
1731:             cwd: target.path,
1732:             encoding: 'utf-8',
1733:             stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1734:           }).trim();
1735:           assert(
1736:             currentGitStatus === pre.gitStatus,
1737:             `Non-target git worktree "${target.path}" status must remain identical and clean`
1738:           );
1739:         }
1740:       }
1741: 
1742:       // 10. Assert that original repository's registered worktree list is byte-for-byte unchanged before and after the audit
1743:       const postRealWtOutput = execSafeGit(['worktree', 'list', '--porcelain'], {
1744:         cwd: rootDir,
1745:         encoding: 'utf-8',
1746:         stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1747:       }).trim();
1748:       assert(
1749:         postRealWtOutput === initialRealWtOutput,
1750:         'Original repository registered worktree list must remain 100% byte-for-byte identical before and after audit'
1751:       );
1752: 
1753:       // 11. Negative regression proof: Nonexistent Turbo task exits non-zero
1754:       let caughtNegative = false;
1755:       try {
1756:         cp.execFileSync(
1757:           process.execPath,
1758:           [turboBin, 'run', 'nonexistent-worktree-isolation-task', '--cache-dir=.turbo/cache'],
1759:           {
1760:             cwd: ephemeralWtPath,
1761:             encoding: 'utf-8',
1762:             stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1763:           }
1764:         );
1765:       } catch (negativeErr: any) {
1766:         caughtNegative = true;
1767:         assert(
1768:           negativeErr.status !== 0,
1769:           `Negative Turbo execution must fail closed with non-zero exit code (got: ${negativeErr.status})`
1770:         );
1771:       }
1772:       assert(caughtNegative, 'Negative Turbo task execution must exit with non-zero status code');
1773: 
1774:       // 12. Regression coverage representing a permission-isolated linked review workspace:
1775:       // Proves that when the audit is launched from within a linked worktree (where the common Git directory is outside the workspace),
1776:       // the audit does not require write permission to the original/parent common Git metadata and succeeds with full isolation.
1777:       {
1778:         const reviewWsPath = path.join(tempBase, 'linked-review-ws');
1779:         execSafeGit(['worktree', 'add', '--detach', reviewWsPath, 'HEAD'], {
1780:           cwd: standaloneRepo,
1781:           stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1782:         });
1783: 
1784:         const reviewGitCommonRaw = execSafeGit(['rev-parse', '--git-common-dir'], {
1785:           cwd: reviewWsPath,
1786:           encoding: 'utf-8',
1787:           stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1788:         }).trim();
1789:         const resolvedReviewGitCommon = path.resolve(reviewWsPath, reviewGitCommonRaw);
1790: 
1791:         // Verify that reviewWsPath is indeed a linked worktree sharing standaloneRepo's common dir
1792:         assert(
1793:           resolvedReviewGitCommon === path.resolve(standaloneRepo, '.git'),
1794:           'Review workspace must be a linked worktree sharing standalone repo Git common dir'
1795:         );
1796: 
1797:         // Execute audit isolation from within reviewWsPath
1798:         const innerAuditBase = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'shipde-review-audit-'));
1799:         try {
1800:           const innerStandalone = path.join(innerAuditBase, 'inner-standalone');
1801:           const reviewWsUrl = 'file:///' + reviewWsPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
1802:           cp.execFileSync(
1803:             'git',
1804:             [
1805:               ...getSafeDirectoryArgs(reviewWsPath),
1806:               '-c',
1807:               `safe.directory=${path.resolve(innerStandalone).replace(/\\/g, '/')}`,
1808:               'clone',
1809:               '--no-hardlinks',
1810:               '--dissociate',
1811:               '--depth=1',
1812:               reviewWsUrl,
1813:               innerStandalone,
1814:             ],
1815:             { stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }
1816:           );
1817: 
1818:           const innerEphemeral = path.join(innerAuditBase, 'inner-ephemeral');
1819:           execSafeGit(['worktree', 'add', '--detach', innerEphemeral, 'HEAD'], {
1820:             cwd: innerStandalone,
1821:             stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1822:           });
1823: 
1824:           const innerEphemCommonRaw = execSafeGit(['rev-parse', '--git-common-dir'], {
1825:             cwd: innerEphemeral,
1826:             encoding: 'utf-8',
1827:             stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1828:           }).trim();
1829:           const resolvedInnerEphemCommon = path.resolve(innerEphemeral, innerEphemCommonRaw);
1830: 
1831:           assert(
1832:             resolvedInnerEphemCommon.startsWith(innerAuditBase),
1833:             `Inner ephemeral common dir (${resolvedInnerEphemCommon}) must be inside innerAuditBase (${innerAuditBase})`
1834:           );
1835:           assert(
1836:             resolvedInnerEphemCommon !== resolvedReviewGitCommon,
1837:             'Inner ephemeral common dir must NOT be review workspace common dir'
1838:           );
1839:           assert(
1840:             resolvedInnerEphemCommon !== realGitCommonDir,
1841:             'Inner ephemeral common dir must NOT be real repository Git common dir'
1842:           );
1843:         } finally {
1844:           if (fs.existsSync(innerAuditBase)) {
1845:             fs.rmSync(innerAuditBase, { recursive: true, force: true });
1846:           }
1847:         }
1848:       }
1849: 
1850:       // 13. Regression coverage for dubious-ownership & safe-directory execution:
1851:       // Proves that scoped safe.directory per-invocation configuration allows safe Git operations
1852:       // in permission-isolated checkouts without modifying global Git configuration or using broad '*' exemptions.
1853:       {
1854:         const safeArgs = getSafeDirectoryArgs(ephemeralWtPath);
1855:         assert(
1856:           safeArgs.includes('-c') && safeArgs.some((a) => a.startsWith('safe.directory=')),
1857:           'getSafeDirectoryArgs must generate -c safe.directory=<path> arguments'
1858:         );
1859:         assert(
1860:           !safeArgs.some((a) => a === 'safe.directory=*' || a === 'safe.directory=/*'),
1861:           'getSafeDirectoryArgs must NEVER use broad safe.directory=* exemptions'
1862:         );
1863: 
1864:         const globalSafeDirsBefore = (() => {
1865:           try {
1866:             return cp
1867:               .execFileSync('git', ['config', '--global', '--get-all', 'safe.directory'], {
1868:                 encoding: 'utf-8',
1869:                 stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1870:               })
1871:               .trim();
1872:           } catch {
1873:             return '';
1874:           }
1875:         })();
1876: 
1877:         // Execute scoped safe Git status in ephemeral checkout
1878:         const scopedStatus = execSafeGit(['status', '--porcelain'], {
1879:           cwd: ephemeralWtPath,
1880:           encoding: 'utf-8',
1881:           stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1882:         }).trim();
1883:         assert(
1884:           typeof scopedStatus === 'string',
1885:           'Scoped safe Git execution must return valid string output'
1886:         );
1887: 
1888:         const globalSafeDirsAfter = (() => {
1889:           try {
1890:             return cp
1891:               .execFileSync('git', ['config', '--global', '--get-all', 'safe.directory'], {
1892:                 encoding: 'utf-8',
1893:                 stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1894:               })
1895:               .trim();
1896:           } catch {
1897:             return '';
1898:           }
1899:         })();
1900: 
1901:         assert(
1902:           globalSafeDirsAfter === globalSafeDirsBefore,
1903:           'Scoped safe.directory Git invocation must not mutate user global Git configuration'
1904:         );
1905:       }
1906:     } catch (err: any) {
1907:       mainError = err;
1908:       throw err;
1909:     } finally {
1910:       // Scoped cleanup: prune worktree inside standaloneRepo, safely delete tempBase, and preserve dual error context on cleanup failure
1911:       let cleanupError: any = null;
1912:       if (fs.existsSync(standaloneRepo)) {
1913:         try {
1914:           execSafeGit(['worktree', 'prune'], {
1915:             cwd: standaloneRepo,
1916:             stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
1917:           });
1918:         } catch (pruneErr: any) {
1919:           cleanupError = pruneErr;
1920:         }
1921:       }
1922:       if (fs.existsSync(tempBase)) {
1923:         try {
1924:           fs.rmSync(tempBase, { recursive: true, force: true });
1925:         } catch (rmErr: any) {
1926:           if (!cleanupError) cleanupError = rmErr;
1927:         }
1928:       }
1929: 
1930:       if (cleanupError) {
1931:         if (mainError) {
1932:           cleanupError.cause = mainError;
1933:           cleanupError.message = `Cleanup failed (${cleanupError.message}) after operation error: ${mainError.message}`;
1934:         }
1935:         throw cleanupError;
1936:       }
1937:     }
1938:   }
1939: 
1940:   console.log('\n================================================================');
1941:   console.log('🎉 TẤT CẢ CÁC BÀI KIỂM TOÁN HỒI QUY ĐẠT 100%');
1942:   console.log('================================================================\n');
1943: }
1944: 
1945: runRegressionSuite().catch((e) => {
1946:   console.error(e);
1947:   process.exit(1);
1948: });
</file>

  1: import * as assert from 'node:assert';

  7: 
  8: /**

 14: async function runTest() {
 15:   console.log('--- Running Finding 4 Roles Settings Page Component & States Proving Test ---');

164:

166:   const populatedHtml = renderPage({

171:   assert.ok(
172:     populatedHtml.includes('Nhân viên kiểm hàng'),

174:   );
175:   assert.ok(
176:     populatedHtml.includes('Kiểm tra hàng hoàn'),
177:     'Rendered HTML must contain custom role description'
178:   );
179:   assert.ok(
180:     populatedHtml.includes('3 tài khoản'),
181:     'Rendered HTML must contain active user count from payload (3 tài khoản)'
182:   );
183:   assert.ok(
184:     populatedHtml.includes('2 quyền'),
185:     'Rendered HTML must contain permission count from payload (2 quyền)'
186:   );
187: 
188:   // 8. Real Validation Logic (validateRoleForm imported from page.tsx)
189:   const emptyNameResult = validateRoleForm('', ['order:view_create'], mockPayload);
190:   assert.strictEqual(emptyNameResult.isValid, false);
191:   assert.strictEqual(emptyNameResult.errors.name, 'Vui lòng nhập tên vai trò');
192: 
193:   const emptyPermsResult = validateRoleForm('Vai trò mới', [], mockPayload);
194:   assert.strictEqual(emptyPermsResult.isValid, false);
195:   assert.strictEqual(
196:     emptyPermsResult.errors.permissions,
197:     'Cần chọn ít nhất một quyền hạn từ danh mục'
198:   );
199: 
200:   const duplicateNameResult = validateRoleForm(
201:     'nhân viên kiểm hàng',
202:     ['order:view_create'],
203:     mockPayload
204:   );
205:   assert.strictEqual(duplicateNameResult.isValid, false);
206:   assert.strictEqual(duplicateNameResult.errors.name, 'Tên vai trò đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng');
207: 
208:   const validResult = validateRoleForm('Vai trò mới hợp lệ', ['order:view_create'], mockPayload);
209:   assert.strictEqual(validResult.isValid, true);
210:   assert.strictEqual(Object.keys(validResult.errors).length, 0);
211: 
212:   // 9. UI State: Round 5 Finding 2 - Modal In-Dialog Save Error & Resubmit Retry
213:   const modalSaveErrorHtml = renderPage({
214:     initialLoading: false,
215:     initialCanManageRoles: true,
216:     initialRoles: mockPayload,
217:     initialCreateOpen: true,
218:     initialModalError: 'Tên vai trò đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng (400 ROLE_NAME_EXISTS)',
219:     initialFormState: {
220:       name: 'Nhân viên kiểm hàng trùng',
221:       description: 'Mô tả không bị mất',
222:       permissions: ['order:view_create'],
223:     },
224:   });
225:   assert.ok(
226:     modalSaveErrorHtml.includes('role="alert"') &&
227:       modalSaveErrorHtml.includes('Lỗi lưu vai trò') &&
228:       modalSaveErrorHtml.includes('Tên vai trò đã tồn tại'),
229:     'Modal save failure must render alert banner inside the open dialog'
230:   );
231:   assert.ok(
232:     modalSaveErrorHtml.includes('value="Nhân viên kiểm hàng trùng"') &&
233:       modalSaveErrorHtml.includes('Mô tả không bị mất'),
234:     'Modal inputs (name, description, permissions) must be preserved on save error'
235:   );
236:   assert.ok(
237:     modalSaveErrorHtml.includes('Thử lại'),
238:     'Modal must provide retry button to resubmit the failed form'
239:   );
240:   assert.ok(
241:     modalSaveErrorHtml.includes('role="dialog"') &&
242:       modalSaveErrorHtml.includes('aria-modal="true"') &&
243:       modalSaveErrorHtml.includes('aria-label="Đóng cửa sổ vai trò"'),
244:     'Create/edit modal must have role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and accessible close button'
245:   );
246: 
247:   // 10. UI State: Round 5 Finding 2 - Delete Modal Error & Retry
248:   const modalDeleteErrorHtml = renderPage({
249:     initialLoading: false,
250:     initialCanManageRoles: true,
251:     initialRoles: mockPayload,
252:     initialDeletingRole: mockPayload[3],
253:     initialDeleteModalError:
254:       'Không thể xóa vai trò đang được gán cho 3 người dùng (400 ROLE_IN_USE)',
255:   });
256:   assert.ok(
257:     modalDeleteErrorHtml.includes('role="alert"') &&
258:       modalDeleteErrorHtml.includes('Lỗi xóa vai trò') &&
259:       modalDeleteErrorHtml.includes('Không thể xóa vai trò đang được gán'),
260:     'Delete modal error must be displayed inside the open delete dialog'
261:   );
262:   assert.ok(
263:     modalDeleteErrorHtml.includes('Thử lại'),
264:     'Delete modal must provide in-dialog retry button'
265:   );
266:   assert.ok(
267:     modalDeleteErrorHtml.includes('role="dialog"') &&
268:       modalDeleteErrorHtml.includes('aria-modal="true"') &&
269:       modalDeleteErrorHtml.includes('aria-label="Đóng cửa sổ xác nhận xóa"'),
270:     'Delete modal must have role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and accessible close button'
271:   );
272: 
273:   // 11. UI State: Round 7 Finding 3 - Refresh Error preserves custom roles list & shows error banner
274:   const refreshErrorHtml = renderPage({
275:     initialLoading: false,
276:     initialCanManageRoles: true,
277:     initialRoles: mockPayload,
278:     initialHasLoadedSuccessfully: true,
279:     initialError: 'Lỗi kết nối máy chủ khi làm mới dữ liệu phân quyền',
280:   });
281:   assert.ok(
282:     refreshErrorHtml.includes('role="alert"') &&
283:       refreshErrorHtml.includes('Lỗi kết nối máy chủ khi làm mới dữ liệu'),
284:     'Refresh error must display error alert banner with retry'
285:   );
286:   assert.ok(refreshErrorHtml.includes('Thử lại'), 'Refresh error must display retry action');
287:   assert.ok(
288:     refreshErrorHtml.includes('Nhân viên kiểm hàng'),
289:     'Refresh error must keep existing custom roles mounted instead of unmounting to blank/stale state'
290:   );
291:   assert.ok(
292:     refreshErrorHtml.includes('Chủ Shop'),
293:     'Refresh error must keep system roles list mounted'
294:   );
295: 
296:   // 12. UI State: Round 8 Finding 4 - Catalogue fetch in flight does not show false forbidden state to owner
297:   const inFlightFetchHtml = renderPage({
298:     initialLoading: true,
299:     initialCanManageRoles: false,
300:     initialHasLoadedSuccessfully: false,
301:   });
302:   assert.ok(
303:     !inFlightFetchHtml.includes('Bạn chỉ có quyền') &&
304:       !inFlightFetchHtml.includes('iam:manage_users'),
305:     'In-flight catalogue fetch must not render false forbidden callout before load completes (SCR-RBAC-01)'
306:   );
307: 
308:   // 13. UI State: Round 10 Finding 7 - View Modal Accessibility (role="dialog", aria-modal, aria-label)
309:   const viewModalHtml = renderPage({
310:     initialLoading: false,
311:     initialCanManageRoles: true,
312:     initialRoles: mockPayload,
313:     initialViewingRole: mockPayload[0],
314:   });
315:   assert.ok(
316:     viewModalHtml.includes('role="dialog"') &&
317:       viewModalHtml.includes('aria-modal="true"') &&
318:       viewModalHtml.includes('aria-label="Đóng chi tiết vai trò"'),
319:     'View modal must have role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and accessible close button'
320:   );
321: 
322:   console.log(
323:     '✅ Finding 7 (Round 10): Accessible dialog roles, aria-modal, and close button labels proved successfully!'
324:   );
325: 
326:   console.log(
327:     '✅ Finding 4 (Round 8): SCR-RBAC-01 Forbidden callout hidden during loading and only rendered on successful load proved successfully!'
328:   );
329: 
330:   console.log(
331:     '✅ Finding 3 (Round 7): Preserved custom-role list on refresh failure and trusted server boolean proved successfully!'
332:   );
333: 
334:   console.log(
335:     '✅ Finding 2 / Round 5 & Finding 4: SCR-RBAC-01 Roles page real component rendering & UI states proved successfully!'
336:   );
337: }
338: 
339: runTest().catch((err) => {
340:   console.error('❌ Finding 4 Test Failed:', err);
341:   process.exit(1);
342: });
</file>

  1: import * as assert from 'node:assert';

 44:   // 1. Form Validation Unit Tests

152:   assert.ok(editMarkup.includes('data-testid="input-legal-name"'));
153:   assert.ok(editMarkup.includes('data-testid="input-tax-code"'));

170:     })

172:   assert.ok(validationMarkup.includes('Mã số thuế không hợp lệ theo chuẩn Việt Nam'));

174:   console.log('  PASS: Validation errors rendered inline.');

176:   // 6. React Static Markup: Persistent Server Error with Retry

<file path="apps/web/src/tests/user-scopes-states.test.ts">
  1: import * as assert from 'node:assert';
  2: import React from 'react';
  3: import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
  4: import {
  5:   UserManagementTab,
  6:   UserWithStores,
  7:   USERS_EMPTY_STATE_TEXT,
  8:   USERS_FORBIDDEN_TEXT,
  9:   USERS_RETRY_LABEL,
 10:   USERS_SCOPE_SUCCESS_TOAST,
 11:   mapCanonicalFieldErrors,
 12: } from '@/components/UserManagementTab';
 13: import { AuthProvider } from '@/context/AuthContext';
 14: 
 15: /**
 16:  * FEAT-RBAC-02 Acceptance Proving Test: SCR-USR-01 Scope Assignment Real Component UI States
 17:  *
 18:  * Drives real rendering of UserManagementTab across all required UI states:
 19:  * 1. Loading: Skeleton displayed while fetching users; save button shows spinner when submitting
 20:  * 2. Empty: Informative empty state displayed if no team members exist in the shop
 21:  * 3. Forbidden: Unauthorized actors receive 403 callout with iam:manage_users explanation
 22:  * 4. Error with Retry: Persistent error banner allowing immediate retry
 23:  * 5. Ready Table: Displays Store Scopes, Warehouse Scopes, and Carrier Account Scopes
 24:  * 6. Success Toast: Notification banner when scopes are updated
 25:  * 7. Edit Modal: Scope selectors for Branch, Warehouse, and Carrier Account with wildcard support
 26:  * 8. Modal Saving State: Inline spinner on submit button
 27:  * 9. Modal Error & Recovery: Server validation error banner without losing form state
 28:  */
 29: async function runTest() {
 30:   console.log(
 31:     '--- Running FEAT-RBAC-02 User Management & Scope Assignment Component States Test ---'
 32:   );
 33: 
 34:   const mockUsers: UserWithStores[] = [
 35:     {
 36:       id: 'usr_01',
 37:       full_name: 'Nguyễn Văn An',
 38:       email: 'owner@ananboutique.vn',
 39:       phone: '0901234567',
 40:       role: 'OWNER',
 41:       assigned_stores: ['*'],
 42:       warehouse_scopes: ['*'],
 43:       carrier_account_scopes: ['*'],
 44:       status: 'ACTIVE',
 45:       last_login: 'Vừa xong',
 46:       created_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',
 47:     },
 48:     {
 49:       id: 'usr_02',
 50:       full_name: 'Trần Thị Hoa',
 51:       email: 'cskh_hoa@ananboutique.vn',
 52:       phone: '0909876543',
 53:       role: 'OPS_CSKH',
 54:       assigned_stores: ['store_01', 'store_04'],
 55:       warehouse_scopes: ['wh_01'],
 56:       carrier_account_scopes: ['c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'],
 57:       status: 'ACTIVE',
 58:       last_login: '10 phút trước',
 59:       created_at: '2026-01-15T00:00:00Z',
 60:     },
 61:     {
 62:       id: 'usr_03',
 63:       full_name: 'Lê Minh Test',
 64:       email: 'test_minh@ananboutique.vn',
 65:       phone: '0903334444',
 66:       role: 'OPS_CSKH',
 67:       assigned_stores: [],
 68:       warehouse_scopes: [],
 69:       carrier_account_scopes: [],
 70:       status: 'ACTIVE',
 71:       last_login: 'Chưa đăng nhập',
 72:       created_at: '2026-02-01T00:00:00Z',
 73:     },
 74:   ];
 75: 
 76:   const renderComponent = (props?: any) => {
 77:     return renderToStaticMarkup(
 78:       React.createElement(AuthProvider, null, React.createElement(UserManagementTab, props || {}))
 79:     );
 80:   };
 81: 
 82:   // 1. UI State: LOADING
 83:   console.log('Testing 1. UI State: LOADING...');
 84:   const loadingHtml = renderComponent({ initialLoading: true, initialUsers: [] });
 85:   assert.ok(
 86:     loadingHtml.includes('data-testid="users-loading-skeleton"') ||
 87:       loadingHtml.includes('animate-pulse'),
 88:     'Loading state must render loading skeleton with animate-pulse'
 89:   );
 90:   assert.ok(
 91:     !loadingHtml.includes(USERS_FORBIDDEN_TEXT),
 92:     'Loading state must NOT render false forbidden callout before fetch completes'
 93:   );
 94: 
 95:   // 2. UI State: EMPTY
 96:   console.log('Testing 2. UI State: EMPTY...');
 97:   const emptyHtml = renderComponent({
 98:     initialLoading: false,
 99:     initialForbidden: false,
100:     initialUsers: [],
101:   });
102:   assert.ok(
103:     emptyHtml.includes('data-testid="users-empty-state"'),
104:     'Empty state must render users-empty-state container'
105:   );
106:   assert.ok(

<file path="apps/web/AGENTS.md">
 1: # apps/web — Author checklist
 2: 
 3: Mandatory before a Next.js UI change is reviewable. Root `AGENTS.md` still wins on conflict.
 4: 
 5: ## Review P1 gates
 6: 
 7: - Every changed screen covers loading, empty, error, forbidden and success. Validation, partial and recovery states too when the screen spec requires them.
 8: - Forbidden is a dedicated state, not a blank page and not a generic error.
 9: - No fake primary action, placeholder presented as live data, or success toast without a committed outcome.
10: - Data comes from the API. Do not hardcode model, score, provider or tenant data.
11: 
12: ## Next.js (condensed)
13: 
14: Source: PatrickJS/awesome-cursorrules `rules/nextjs-app-router-cursorrules-prompt-file.mdc` (CC0-1.0). Condensed, not copied.
15: 
16: - Server Components by default. Add `'use client'` only for state, events or browser APIs.
17: - Use the App Router file conventions: `layout.tsx` for shared chrome, `loading.tsx` for loading, `error.tsx` for errors, `page.tsx` for the route.
18: - TypeScript for every new file. Configuration from environment variables, never inlined secrets.
19: - `next/image` for images. Route handlers stay thin and call the API; they do not own tenant rules.
</file>

<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/02-business/BUSINESS-RULES-DECISION-TABLES.md">
  1: # Business Rules and Decision Tables
  2: 
  3: ## Authentication and Self-registration
  4: 
  5: - BR-AUTH-01: Registration requires merchant/shop name, owner full name, at least one valid identifier (email or phone), password satisfying policy BR-AUTH-05, and explicit terms acceptance (BR-AUTH-04). Missing required fields return VALIDATION_ERROR with field-level details.
  6: - BR-AUTH-02: New registrations start in PENDING_VERIFICATION state. An account cannot log in until at least one contact channel (email or phone) is verified. Verifying a second channel is optional but tracked.
  7: - BR-AUTH-03: Email and phone are globally unique across the platform. An already-verified identifier returns a field-level VALIDATION_ERROR. Submitting an identifier with an existing unverified account re-issues a new verification token rather than creating duplicate rows.
  8: - BR-AUTH-04: Terms of service and privacy policy acceptance is mandatory. Terms version and timestamp are permanently recorded with the user.
  9: - BR-AUTH-05: Passwords must be at least 8 characters and hashed with a memory-hard algorithm (scrypt/argon2). Plaintext passwords must never be logged or returned.
 10: - BR-AUTH-06: Verification tokens and OTPs are single-use with bounded expiration (15 minutes for OTP, 24 hours for email token). Consumed or expired tokens return an explicit error.
 11: - BR-AUTH-07: Registration attempts are rate-limited per IP (max 5/hour) and per identifier (max 3/hour). Exceeding the threshold returns RATE_LIMITED with retry-after hint.
 12: - BR-AUTH-08: Resend verification is bounded by a dedicated rate limit (1 request per 60 seconds cooldown, max 5/hour per identifier).
 13: - BR-AUTH-09: All registration, verification, and rate-limit events produce immutable audit records containing actor context and hashed IP without leaking passwords or verification tokens.
 14: - BR-AUTH-10: Concurrent submissions with the same unverified identifier must resolve idempotently; exactly one tenant/owner pair persists.
 15: - BR-AUTH-11: Login attempts are rate-limited per IP (max 10/15 min) and per identifier (max 5 failures/15 min); exceeding returns `RATE_LIMITED` with a retry-after hint. Unknown identifier and wrong password return identical `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` responses.
 16: - BR-AUTH-12: OTP login is enabled by configuration only. Login OTPs are single-use, 5 minutes, hashed at rest, bounded (5 requests/hour/identifier, 60 s cooldown, 10 requests/hour/IP, 5 failed verifications/15 min) and delivered only to verified channels. A verification OTP can never authorize a login and vice versa (`purpose` column).
 17: - BR-AUTH-13: Login of a `pending_verification`, `suspended`, `disabled` or `invited` user is rejected with a distinct canonical error and an audit record that never contains the password or OTP.
 18: - BR-AUTH-14: Factor setup: Only an authenticated `ACTIVE` user may start setup, and fresh primary re-authentication is required. Starting setup invalidates any older `PENDING` setup for that user but never replaces an `ACTIVE` factor. The TOTP seed is generated with a cryptographically secure RNG, encrypted at rest with a dedicated configured key, returned only during that setup response, and never returned by status/read endpoints.
 19: - BR-AUTH-15: Activation: A factor becomes `ACTIVE` only after a valid TOTP proves possession. Use interoperable TOTP defaults (6 digits, 30-second period) with a maximum verification window of one step before/current/one step after. A time step already accepted for the same factor cannot be replayed. Setup expires after 10 minutes; expired setup must restart with a new seed.
 20: - BR-AUTH-16: Login challenge: A successful primary credential for a user with an active factor returns an opaque MFA challenge, not a session/access token. The challenge is hashed at rest, bound to user + primary-login transaction + intended tenant, expires after 5 minutes, is single-use and is consumed on success or after 5 failed attempts. At most 5 failures per user and 10 per source IP are allowed per 15 minutes; excess returns `RATE_LIMITED` with a retry hint. TOTP errors do not reveal whether the challenge, user or factor exists.
 21: - BR-AUTH-17: Recovery codes: Activation and regeneration create exactly 10 independent high-entropy codes. Plaintext is shown once; stored values are non-reversible verifiers. Matching and consumption occur atomically so concurrent use of one code creates at most one session. A consumed code cannot be replayed. Successful use returns the number of unused codes remaining and emits a security event; zero remaining codes never silently disables MFA.
 22: - BR-AUTH-18: Required roles and assurance: `OWNER` users require an active factor before tenant access. An unenrolled required user may authenticate only into the bounded setup flow. A session created after MFA carries a server-verifiable `mfa_verified_at` and `auth_assurance=MFA`; client claims alone never satisfy step-up. Suspending/disabling the user or resetting the factor invalidates outstanding MFA challenges and blocks session issuance.
 23: - BR-AUTH-19: Admin reset: Reset is a tenant-scoped, high-risk command. The actor must be a different user, hold current manage-users permission over the target, have an MFA-verified fresh session, and provide a non-blank reason. Reset is atomic and idempotent for the same request key: it removes usable factor/recovery/challenge material, revokes every target session, records immutable before/after state without secrets, and returns only sanitized status. A repeated request with the same key returns the original result; a different request with the same key returns `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`.
 24: 
 25: ### Self-registration decision
 26: 
 27: | Identifier status | Terms accepted | Password valid | Rate limit  | Result                             | Next action                       |
 28: | ----------------- | -------------- | -------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
 29: | New / Available   | Yes            | Yes            | Under limit | 201 Created (PENDING_VERIFICATION) | Send verification token           |
 30: | Already verified  | Yes            | Yes            | Under limit | 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (Conflict)    | Show duplicate error + login link |
 31: | Exists unverified | Yes            | Yes            | Under limit | 200 Re-issued verification         | Resend verification token         |
 32: | Any               | No             | Any            | Any         | 400 VALIDATION_ERROR               | Prompt terms acceptance           |
 33: | Any               | Yes            | No (<8 chars)  | Any         | 400 VALIDATION_ERROR               | Prompt valid password             |
 34: | Any               | Any            | Any            | Exceeded    | 429 RATE_LIMITED                   | Display cooldown window           |
 35: 
 36: ## Address and availability
 37: 
 38: - BR-ADR-01: Canonical administrative address must be confirmed when normalization has multiple candidates.
 39: - BR-AVL-01: Carrier response AVAILABLE is valid only for the exact account, origin, destination, parcel, service and COD inputs.
 40: - BR-AVL-02: Timeout, authentication error and provider outage produce UNKNOWN_ERROR, never UNSUPPORTED.
 41: - BR-AVL-03: An automatic routing policy may select only AVAILABLE and unexpired options.
 42: 
 43: ### Serviceability decision
 44: 
 45: | Carrier response                | Input valid | Result                  | User action      |
 46: | ------------------------------- | ----------: | ----------------------- | ---------------- |
 47: | Supported services returned     |         Yes | AVAILABLE               | Quote            |
 48: | Explicit route/parcel rejection |         Yes | UNSUPPORTED             | Show reason/edit |
 49: | Timeout/5xx                     |         Yes | UNKNOWN_ERROR           | Retry/manual     |
 50: | Authentication/permission error |         Yes | ACCOUNT_ACTION_REQUIRED | Fix connection   |
 51: | Input invalid                   |          No | INPUT_REQUIRED          | Correct fields   |
 52: 
 53: ## Quote and recommendation
 54: 
 55: - BR-QTE-01: Quote components are normalized but raw response remains immutable.
 56: - BR-QTE-02: A changed price-affecting input invalidates existing quotes.
 57: - BR-QTE-03: A selected expired quote must be refreshed before create.
 58: - BR-SEL-01: Cheapest uses total payable cost, not base fee alone.
 59: - BR-SEL-02: Recommendation score and inputs are stored and explainable.
 60: - BR-SEL-03: Historical performance may influence ranking only after minimum sample/configuration; it cannot create availability.
 61: 
 62: ## Shipment commands
 63: 
 64: - BR-IDEM-01: Create idempotency key is tenant + source order + attempt lineage.
 65: - BR-IDEM-02: A retry after timeout must first query remote state using client order reference.
 66: - BR-SHP-01: Update/cancel/switch actions are constrained by canonical and carrier-specific status.
 67: - BR-SHP-02: A price-affecting update triggers serviceability/requote and requires confirmation.
 68: - BR-LBL-01: Cancel/switch invalidates prior label for operational use.
 69: 
 70: ### Create command decision
 71: 
 72: | Local command         | Carrier response        | Remote lookup                                 | Next action                           |
 73: | --------------------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
 74: | New                   | Success with waybill    | Not needed                                    | Confirm created                       |
 75: | New                   | Explicit business error | Not needed                                    | Fail with action                      |
 76: | New                   | Timeout/connection loss | Found by client reference                     | Confirm created                       |
 77: | New                   | Timeout/connection loss | Not found after bounded reconciliation window | Retry same idempotency lineage        |
 78: | Existing completed    | Any duplicate request   | Existing waybill                              | Return existing result                |
 79: | Unknown beyond policy | Unknown                 | Unknown                                       | Manual reconciliation; no blind retry |
 80: 
 81: ## Tracking and exceptions
 82: 
 83: - BR-TRK-01: Raw event ledger is append-only.
 84: - BR-TRK-02: Duplicate provider event does not create a second domain transition.
 85: - BR-TRK-03: Unknown carrier status remains raw and enters mapping work queue.
 86: - BR-EXC-01: Exception priority considers COD, age, attempts, SLA and return risk.
 87: - BR-EXC-02: Redelivery requires action permission, confirmation/policy and idempotency.
 88: 
 89: ## Rate and audit
 90: 
 91: - BR-RATE-01: Only approved effective rules can declare a carrier charge wrong.
 92: - BR-RATE-02: Unapproved/ambiguous rules produce suspected or data-incomplete results.
 93: - BR-AUD-01: Compare each fee component; matching totals do not hide offsetting component errors.
 94: - BR-AUD-02: Missing data affects only checks requiring that data.
 95: - BR-AUD-03: One waybill has exactly one processing status and zero-to-many findings.
 96: - BR-AUD-04: Carrier weight greater than shop weight is suspected weight; rate discrepancy uses carrier weight and still finds incorrect charge.
 97: - BR-AUD-05: Late-delivery fee waiver is only suspected until policy and causal exclusions are verified.
 98: 
 99: ## Missing statement classification
100: 
101: Milestones are predicted from Settlement Policy:
102: 
103: - A: expected eligibility.
104: - B: next expected batch close.
105: - C: expected carrier transfer.
106: 
107: | Condition                                           | Classification                |
108: | --------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
109: | Before A                                            | NOT_ELIGIBLE                  |
110: | A ≤ now < B                                         | ELIGIBLE_WAITING_BATCH        |
111: | B ≤ now < C                                         | BATCH_CLOSED_WAITING_TRANSFER |
112: | now ≥ C, no statement line, no valid exclusion      | OVERDUE_MISSING_COD_SUSPECTED |
113: | Account-level threshold/carry rule proves exclusion | VALID_EXCLUSION               |
114: | Any required milestone cannot be calculated         | DATA_INCOMPLETE               |
115: 
116: BR-MIS-01: Minimum remittance threshold is evaluated at account/batch aggregate plus opening carry-forward, never each waybill independently.
117: 
118: ## Batch and bank
119: 
120: - BR-BAT-01: Carrier transfer status and bank reconciliation status are independent.
121: - BR-BNK-01: Exact batch reference may auto-match; amount/date/counterparty alone is suggestion-only.
122: - BR-BNK-02: Many-to-many links require allocated amount.
123: - BR-BNK-03: Sum allocated from a transaction cannot exceed its amount.
124: - BR-BNK-04: Actually received/recovered amount requires bank/payment evidence.
125: 
126: ## Cases and claims
127: 
128: - BR-CAS-01: Each finding has a separate case unless an explicit merge rule is later approved.
129: - BR-CAS-02: Suspected, internally verified, carrier accepted and actually received values remain separate.
130: - BR-CAS-03: Carry-forward is independent of case status.
131: - BR-CLM-01: Claim deadline uses an effective, sourced policy and correct trigger event; legal periods are not hardcoded without current verification.
132: - BR-CLM-02: Automatic submission requires shop opt-in, eligible claim type, verified rules, complete evidence, monetary limit, unexpired deadline and idempotency.
133: 
134: ### Claim submission decision
135: 
136: | Complete evidence | Policy verified | Within deadline | Auto enabled/limit | Result                          |
137: | ----------------: | --------------: | --------------: | -----------------: | ------------------------------- |
138: |                No |             Any |             Any |                Any | NEEDS_EVIDENCE                  |
139: |               Yes |              No |             Any |                Any | MANUAL_REVIEW                   |
140: |               Yes |             Yes |              No |                Any | EXPIRED_DO_NOT_PROMISE_RECOVERY |
141: |               Yes |             Yes |             Yes |                 No | READY_FOR_CONFIRMATION          |
142: |               Yes |             Yes |             Yes |                Yes | AUTO_SUBMIT_ELIGIBLE            |
143: 
144: ## Billing
145: 
146: - BR-BIL-01: Bill once at first conclusive audit using tenant + carrier account + waybill.
147: - BR-BIL-02: No billing for not-eligible or data-incomplete.
148: - BR-BIL-03: Rerun, revision, carry-forward and claim follow-up do not rebill.
</file>

<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/02-business/USE-CASES.md">
  1: # Use Cases
  2: 
  3: ## Use-case template
  4: 
  5: Every implementation use case includes actor, preconditions, trigger, main flow, alternatives, validation, permissions, outputs, audit and acceptance IDs.
  6: 
  7: ## UC-AUTH-01 Log in
  8: 
  9: - Actor: any registered user.
 10: - Preconditions: active, verified account.
 11: - Trigger: submit credentials or approved OTP.
 12: - Main result: create scoped session and route to permitted home.
 13: - Alternatives: MFA challenge; select organization; forced password change.
 14: - Failures: invalid credentials, lockout, suspended account, expired invite.
 15: - Audit: success/failure metadata without password/OTP.
 16: - Acceptance: AC-AUTH-01.
 17: 
 18: ## UC-AUTH-02 Self-register
 19: 
 20: - Actor: prospective shop owner (anonymous user).
 21: - Preconditions: none (public access).
 22: - Trigger: submit self-registration form (shop name, full name, email/phone, password, terms acceptance).
 23: - Main result: atomically create new Merchant (tenant) and User with role OWNER in PENDING_VERIFICATION state; issue single-use verification token/OTP via configured channels.
 24: - Alternatives: verification via email link; verification via phone OTP; resend verification token.
 25: - Postconditions: upon verifying at least one channel, user transitions to ACTIVE state with verified timestamp; tenant becomes usable for onboarding (FEAT-ONB-01).
 26: - Failures: missing required fields, weak password, unaccepted terms, duplicate verified identifier, rate limit exceeded, expired/consumed verification token.
 27: - Audit: registration event and verification events logged with hashed IP and actor context; never log plaintext passwords, OTPs, or verification tokens.
 28: - Acceptance: AC-AUTH-02.
 29: 
 30: ## UC-AUTH-03 Enroll and use MFA
 31: 
 32: - Actor: active registered user or authorized tenant administrator.
 33: - Preconditions: authenticated active account; fresh primary re-authentication.
 34: - Trigger: initiate MFA setup, verify login challenge, use recovery code, regenerate codes, or admin reset.
 35: - Main result: enroll TOTP factor, issue one-time recovery codes, challenge primary logins, and issue sessions with verified MFA assurance.
 36: - Alternatives: verify using one-time recovery code; admin reset lost factor for in-scope user with mandatory reason.
 37: - Failures: invalid or replayed TOTP, expired setup/challenge, invalid recovery code, rate-limited attempts, self-reset, cross-tenant reset.
 38: - Audit: immutable security events for setup, verify, challenge, recovery, and admin reset without secrets or codes.
 39: - Acceptance: AC-AUTH-05.
 40: 
 41: ## UC-USR-01 Invite and authorize a user
 42: 
 43: - Actor: SHOP_OWNER or authorized administrator.
 44: - Preconditions: actor may manage users in the target scope.
 45: - Main flow: enter identity → assign roles/scopes → send invite → recipient verifies and accepts.
 46: - Rules: cannot remove the last owner; cannot grant permissions the actor does not possess.
 47: - Audit: invite, resend, role/scope change, revoke.
 48: - Acceptance: AC-USR-01.
 49: 
 50: ## UC-SHIP-01 Find shipping options
 51: 
 52: - Actor: ORDER_OPERATOR.
 53: - Preconditions: valid source order, parcel, warehouse and at least one active account.
 54: - Main flow: normalize address → serviceability → quote → normalized option list.
 55: - Alternatives: unsupported route, partial carrier outage, stale quote.
 56: - Output: candidate list with evidence status, price, SLA and reasons.
 57: - Acceptance: AC-AVL-01 and AC-QTE-01.
 58: 
 59: ## UC-SHIP-02 Select a carrier
 60: 
 61: - Actor: ORDER_OPERATOR or approved routing policy.
 62: - Main flow: calculate ranking → explain → choose → persist decision.
 63: - Rules: exclude unavailable/unknown accounts from automatic selection; human may choose only an AVAILABLE candidate.
 64: - Audit: candidate data, algorithm version, chosen option and override reason.
 65: - Acceptance: AC-SEL-01.
 66: 
 67: ## UC-SHIP-03 Create a shipment
 68: 
 69: - Actor: ORDER_OPERATOR.
 70: - Preconditions: selected unexpired quote or explicitly refreshed quote; action permission.
 71: - Main flow: validate → create idempotency record → call adapter → reconcile response → store waybill.
 72: - Unknown outcome: query by client reference; do not blindly call create again.
 73: - Output: shipment/waybill or actionable failure.
 74: - Acceptance: AC-SHP-01.
 75: 
 76: ## UC-SHIP-04 Print labels and request pickup
 77: 
 78: - Actor: ORDER_OPERATOR or WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR.
 79: - Preconditions: shipment created; label/pickup capability.
 80: - Main flow: retrieve/generate label → select printer/format → print → request pickup window.
 81: - Failure: carrier label unavailable uses documented carrier-compliant fallback only.
 82: - Acceptance: AC-LBL-01.
 83: 
 84: ## UC-TRK-01 Track a shipment
 85: 
 86: - Actor: system, shop users and protected recipient.
 87: - Main flow: ingest event → verify → dedupe → canonicalize → update current state → notify.
 88: - Unknown status: preserve raw, mark mapping required, do not guess.
 89: - Acceptance: AC-TRK-01.
 90: 
 91: ## UC-EXC-01 Resolve a delivery exception
 92: 
 93: - Actor: OPS_MANAGER, CUSTOMER_SERVICE or authorized operator.
 94: - Main flow: detect → prioritize → assign → contact/checklist → redelivery/manual action → monitor → resolve.
 95: - Rules: external command requires idempotency and permission.
 96: - Acceptance: AC-EXC-01.
 97: 
 98: ## UC-RET-01 Receive a returned parcel
 99: 
100: - Actor: WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR.
101: - Main flow: scan → validate → checklist → direct evidence → issue case if necessary → confirm.
102: - Rules: duplicate receipt blocked; evidence metadata immutable.
103: - Acceptance: AC-RET-01.
104: 
105: ## UC-RATE-01 Create and approve a rate version
106: 
107: - Actor: RATE_AUTHOR and RATE_REVIEWER.
108: - Main flow: upload source → normalize rules/citations → simulate → submit → approve/reject.
109: - Rules: maker cannot approve; ambiguity is explicit; approved version immutable.
110: - Acceptance: AC-RATE-01.
111: 
112: ## UC-AUD-01 Run settlement audit
113: 
114: - Actor: FINANCE or SHIPDE_OPERATOR with access.
115: - Main flow: validate sources → freeze snapshot → match → calculate → find → summarize.
116: - Rules: no fuzzy auto-match; no conclusion without required evidence; findings are multi-valued.
117: - Acceptance: AC-AUD-01.
118: 
119: ## UC-BNK-01 Allocate bank receipt
120: 
121: - Actor: FINANCE.
122: - Main flow: exact-reference match or review suggestion → allocate amounts → validate totals → confirm.
123: - Rules: many-to-many; total allocation cannot exceed transaction amount.
124: - Acceptance: AC-BNK-01.
125: 
126: ## UC-CLM-01 Submit and track a claim
127: 
128: - Actor: FINANCE/SHOP_OWNER or authorized automation.
129: - Main flow: classify → deadline → evidence → approval/policy → submit → monitor outcome.
130: - Rules: deadline policy versioned; automatic submission must satisfy all guardrails.
131: - Acceptance: AC-CLM-01.
</file>

<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/03-ux/SCREEN-SPECIFICATIONS.md">
  1: # Screen Specifications
  2: 
  3: ## Shared screen contract
  4: 
  5: Every list/detail/form implements:
  6: 
  7: - Loading skeleton, empty state, recoverable error, forbidden and not-found.
  8: - Stable URL for list filters/detail where safe.
  9: - Form-level and field-level validation.
 10: - Dirty-form navigation warning and draft recovery.
 11: - Submit lock/idempotency for commands.
 12: - Permission-aware controls.
 13: - Activity history for business-critical entities.
 14: 
 15: ## SCR-AUTH-01 Login
 16: 
 17: Fields/actions:
 18: 
 19: - Email or phone.
 20: - Password with show/hide.
 21: - Remember trusted device.
 22: - Login, OTP alternative if configured, forgot password.
 23: - MFA challenge and recovery code.
 24:   Success routes to organization selection or role dashboard.
 25: 
 26: State coverage:
 27: 
 28: - **Loading**: Submit button disabled with spinning indicator; fields set to read-only during in-flight network submission.
 29: - **Empty**: Initial clean form with helpful placeholders; zero production-like pre-filled sample text.
 30: - **Validation**: Per-field inline error messages sourced from `ErrorResponse.error.fields`; highlight fields with errors.
 31: - **Error (forbidden)**: Distinct screens for:
 32:   - `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`: "Email/số điện thoại hoặc mật khẩu không chính xác"
 33:   - `AUTH_PENDING_VERIFICATION`: "Tài khoản chưa được xác thực. Vui lòng xác thực qua liên kết email hoặc mã OTP đã gửi."
 34:   - `AUTH_ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED`: "Tài khoản đã bị tạm ngưng. Vui lòng liên hệ bộ phận hỗ trợ Ship Dễ."
 35:   - `AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED`: "Tài khoản đã bị vô hiệu hoá. Vui lòng liên hệ bộ phận hỗ trợ Ship Dễ."
 36:   - `RATE_LIMITED`: Actionable warning with cooldown countdown window hint.
 37: - **Success**: Confirmation screen celebrating successful login, leading into session start or organization selection.
 38: - **MFA challenge**: 6-digit TOTP input, remaining challenge expiry countdown, alternative recovery-code toggle, and return-to-login action.
 39: - **MFA recovery**: 16-character recovery-code input, non-enumerating error for invalid/used codes, remaining recovery code count indicator upon success.
 40: - **MFA enrollment required**: Distinct blocking screen for required roles (Owner/Finance) explaining mandatory MFA setup with action button to begin enrollment flow.
 41: ## SCR-AUTH-02 Self-registration
 42: 
 43: Route: `/register`
 44: 
 45: Fields/actions:
 46: 
 47: - Shop/merchant name (text, required).
 48: - Owner full name (text, required).
 49: - Owner email (email format, required if phone not provided).
 50: - Owner phone (Vietnamese phone regex `^(0|\+84)[3|5|7|8|9][0-9]{8}$`, required if email not provided).
 51: - Password (min 8 chars, with show/hide toggle).
 52: - Terms of service & Privacy policy acceptance (checkbox with link, mandatory).
 53: - "Đăng Ký Cửa Hàng" submit button.
 54: - Link to `/login` ("Đã có tài khoản? Đăng nhập").
 55: 
 56: State coverage:
 57: 
 58: - **Loading**: Submit button disabled with spinning indicator; fields set to read-only during in-flight network submission.
 59: - **Empty**: Initial clean form with helpful placeholders; zero production-like pre-filled sample text.
 60: - **Validation**: Per-field inline error messages sourced from `ErrorResponse.error.fields`; terms checkbox highlight if unchecked upon submit.
 61: - **Duplicate error**: Explicit notice ("Email hoặc Số điện thoại đã được sử dụng") with direct link to login (`/login`).
 62: - **Rate-limited error**: Actionable warning with cooldown countdown window hint (`BR-AUTH-07`).
 63: - **Pending verification**: Success transition displaying "Xác thực tài khoản" instructions with active verification channel details, OTP/link input, and "Gửi lại mã" (Resend) button with 60s cooldown.
 64: - **Verification error**: Distinct screens for expired token ("Mã xác thực đã hết hạn") and consumed token ("Mã xác thực đã được sử dụng") with single-click resend option.
 65: - **Verification success**: Confirmation screen celebrating account activation, leading into session start or login.
 66: - **Recovery**: Unsaved form warning on navigation; network interruptions preserve entered values.
 67: 
 68: ## SCR-AUTH-03 Security settings (MFA)
 69: 
 70: Route: `/settings/security`
 71: 
 72: Fields/actions:
 73: - MFA status badge (NOT_ENROLLED, PENDING, ACTIVE, RESET).
 74: - Role requirement indicator and remaining recovery codes count.
 75: - Setup flow: password re-authentication, QR code display, manual Base32 key with copy, 6-digit TOTP verification.
 76: - Recovery codes modal: display 10 high-entropy codes once with copy and download options; mandatory "I have saved these codes" confirmation.
 77: - Code regeneration flow: password + current TOTP re-authentication; invalidates old codes and displays 10 new codes.
 78: 
 79: State coverage:
 80: - **Loading**: Skeletons for status loading and inline spinner during setup/regeneration/verify actions.
 81: - **Empty/Not enrolled**: Informative banner explaining MFA protection, requirement for Owner role, and "Thiết lập ngay" action.
 82: - **Setup**: QR code with labeled manual key alternative, 10-minute expiry hint, 6-digit verification input, and cancellation warning.
 83: - **Validation**: Per-field validation for password, malformed TOTP (must be 6 digits), and empty reason.
 84: - **Success**: 10 one-time recovery codes displayed in a 2-column grid with copy/download buttons and confirmation checkbox.
 85: - **Active status**: Displays active factor status, setup date, and recovery codes remaining counter; offers code regeneration.
 86: - **Expired**: Actionable notice when setup expires (10 minutes) offering clean restart.
 87: - **Rate limited**: Retry-after countdown indicator preserving entered form state except secrets.
 88: - **Responsive/accessibility**: Mobile-friendly inputs, visible focus indicators, live async announcements, and keyboard navigable controls.
 89: 
 90: ## SCR-ONB-01 Onboarding
 91: 
 92: Steps:
 93: 
 94: 1. Shop/legal and billing profile.
 95: 2. First warehouse/pickup/return address.
 96: 3. Invite users and roles.
 97: 4. Connect carrier account and test capability.
 98: 5. Operating defaults/notifications.
 99: 6. Test order → serviceability → quote → approved test create.
100: 
101: The checklist is resumable. A skipped required dependency remains visibly blocking.
102: 
103: ## SCR-CAR-01 Carrier accounts
104: 
105: List columns:
106: 
107: - Carrier, account alias/code, shop/warehouse scope.
108: - Observe/action permission.
109: - Environment.
110: - Health and last successful call.
111: - Token expiry/rotation status.
112: - Verified capabilities/evidence.
113: 
114: Actions: connect, test, edit scope, rotate/revoke, view sanitized logs, disable.
115: 
116: ## SCR-ORD-02 Source order form
117: 
118: Sections:
119: 
120: - Source reference/channel.
121: - Sender/warehouse.
122: - Recipient/address normalization.
123: - Items/restricted-goods acknowledgment.
124: - Parcel count, weight, dimensions and declared value.
125: - COD, payer, insurance and delivery notes.
126: 
127: Primary action: Save and find shipping options. Validation never clears entered data.
128: 
129: ## SCR-QUOTE-01 Shipping options
130: 
131: Top area shows normalized origin/destination and parcel. Candidate table:
132: 
133: - Carrier/account/service.
134: - Availability state and reason.
135: - Base fee, COD, insurance, VAT, surcharge and total.
136: - Pickup window, SLA/EDD, quote expiry.
137: - Cheapest/fastest/balanced badges.
138: - Historical performance when sufficiently sampled.
139: 
140: Actions:
141: 
142: - Select, refresh, edit affected inputs, view calculation/raw evidence.
143: - Save draft or manual carrier when no option.
144: - UNKNOWN_ERROR offers retry and carrier incident detail, not unsupported text.
145: 
146: ## SCR-SHIP-01 Shipment detail
147: 
148: Displays source order, selected quote snapshot, carrier request/response summary, waybill, label, pickup, timeline, exceptions, return and downstream settlement links.
149: 
150: Actions are status/capability/permission constrained:
151: 
152: - Update allowed fields.
153: - Requote affected changes.
154: - Cancel.
155: - Switch carrier before handover.
156: - Print label.
157: - Request pickup.
158: - Request redelivery.
159: - Open manual fallback checklist.
160: 
161: Unknown create outcome displays a blocking reconciliation banner; it never offers a blind create button.
162: 
163: ## SCR-EXC-01 Exception workbox
164: 
165: Filters: type, carrier, warehouse, age, COD, attempts, owner and due state.
166: 
167: Columns: priority, waybill, canonical/raw status, age, COD, attempt count, owner and recommended action.
168: 
169: Detail drawer: timeline, recipient/shop context, checklist, notes, carrier capability, command confirmation and outcome.
170: 
171: ## SCR-RET-01 Return receiving
172: 
173: Scan-first layout:
174: 
175: - Waybill scan/input.
176: - Ownership/duplicate banner.
177: - Shipment/item expectation.
178: - Condition checklist.
179: - Direct camera media.
180: - Issue type and note.
181: - Confirm receipt.
182: 
183: Media upload from gallery is labeled lower-evidence unless a later approved policy allows it.
184: 
185: ## SCR-RATE-01 Rate and policy
186: 
187: Tabs:
188: 
189: - Source documents.
190: - Structured rules.
191: - Settlement policy.
192: - Claim policy.
193: - Simulator.
194: - Approval/version history.
195: 
196: Every rule displays source page/clause, author, reviewer, status and effective range.
197: 
198: ## SCR-IMPORT-01 Data sources
199: 
200: Cards for source orders, carrier statements, rate/policies and optional bank:
201: 
202: - Upload/select adapter.
203: - Mapping preview.
204: - Validation counts and control totals.
205: - Blocking/non-blocking issues.
206: - Raw file hash/revision.
207: - Promote/supersede history.
208: 
209: No invalid blocking row silently enters an audit snapshot.
210: 
211: ## SCR-AUD-01 Audit results
212: 
213: Summary:
214: 
215: - Data quality.
216: - Processing statuses.
217: - Six missing states.
218: - Findings by type.
219: - Four money levels separately.
220: 
221: Detail table:
222: 
223: - Waybill/source/batch.
224: - Processing status and multiple findings.
225: - Expected vs actual components.
226: - Rule/evidence lineage.
227: - Case status and owner.
228: 
229: Drill-down exposes source rows, calculation and version. It never collapses findings into one destructive label.
230: 
231: ## SCR-BATCH-01 Batch and bank
232: 
233: Displays independent carrier transfer and bank reconciliation statuses, batch totals, member waybills and bank links.
234: 
235: Allocation editor supports many-to-many, validates transaction limits and requires confirmation for suggestions.
236: 
237: ## SCR-CASE-01 Case and claim
238: 
239: Sections:
240: 
241: - Finding/calculation.
242: - Four money levels.
243: - State/timeline/owner.
244: - Evidence and missing checklist.
245: - Deadline/policy.
246: - Submission mode/reference/response.
247: - Recovery installments/bank proof.
248: - Carry-forward periods.
249: 
250: High-impact state transitions require reason/evidence and may require approval.
</file>

<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/04-data/DATA-DICTIONARY.md">
  1: # Data Dictionary
  2: 
  3: This dictionary lists high-value fields. Machine schema and migrations must expand it without changing semantics.
  4: 
  5: ## Tenant and user
  6: 
  7: | Entity.field                  | Type        |    Required | Notes                                                  |
  8: | ----------------------------- | ----------- | ----------: | ------------------------------------------------------ |
  9: | Tenant.id                     | UUID        |         Yes | Isolation key                                          |
 10: | Tenant.name                   | string      |         Yes | Display name                                           |
 11: | User.id                       | UUID        |         Yes | Platform identity                                      |
 12: | User.email/phone              | string      | Conditional | At least one verified login identifier                 |
 13: | User.status                   | enum        |         Yes | PENDING_VERIFICATION/INVITED/ACTIVE/SUSPENDED/DISABLED |
 14: | User.email_verified_at        | timestamp   |          No | Timestamp of confirmed email verification              |
 15: | User.phone_verified_at        | timestamp   |          No | Timestamp of confirmed phone OTP verification          |
 16: | User.terms_accepted_at        | timestamp   |         Yes | Timestamp when Terms & Privacy Policy accepted         |
 17: | User.terms_version            | string      |         Yes | Version of terms accepted (e.g. 2026.1)                |
 18: | VerificationToken.token       | string      |         Yes | Single-use cryptographically random token / OTP        |
 19: | VerificationToken.channel     | enum/string |         Yes | EMAIL/PHONE                                            |
 20: | VerificationToken.expires_at  | timestamp   |         Yes | Token expiry deadline                                  |
 21: | VerificationToken.consumed_at | timestamp   |          No | Null until verified                                    |
 22: | Membership.tenant_id          | UUID        |         Yes | Never inferred from client payload alone               |
 23: | Membership.scope_json         | JSON        |         Yes | Branch/warehouse/carrier-account scope                 |
 24: | DeviceSession.mfa_verified_at | timestamp   |          No | Timestamp of MFA verification in this session          |
 25: | DeviceSession.auth_assurance  | string      |         Yes | PASSWORD or MFA assurance level                        |
 26: 
 27: ## Two-Factor Authentication (MFA)
 28: 
 29: | Entity.field                        | Type        | Required | Notes                                                  |
 30: | ----------------------------------- | ----------- | -------: | ------------------------------------------------------ |
 31: | MfaFactor.id                        | UUID        |      Yes | Factor identifier                                      |
 32: | MfaFactor.user_id                   | UUID        |      Yes | User identity binding                                  |
 33: | MfaFactor.merchant_id               | UUID        |      Yes | Tenant isolation key                                   |
 34: | MfaFactor.type                      | enum/string |      Yes | TOTP                                                   |
 35: | MfaFactor.status                    | enum/string |      Yes | PENDING / ACTIVE / RESET                               |
 36: | MfaFactor.secret_ciphertext         | string      |      Yes | AES-256-GCM encrypted secret at rest                   |
 37: | MfaFactor.key_version               | integer     |      Yes | Key version for secret encryption                      |
 38: | MfaFactor.setup_expires_at          | timestamp   |       No | 10-minute setup expiration                             |
 39: | MfaFactor.activated_at              | timestamp   |       No | Timestamp of valid TOTP activation                     |
 40: | MfaFactor.reset_at                  | timestamp   |       No | Timestamp of administrator reset                       |
 41: | MfaFactor.last_accepted_step        | bigint      |       No | Step replay protection                                 |
 42: | MfaRecoveryCode.id                  | UUID        |      Yes | Recovery code verifier ID                              |
 43: | MfaRecoveryCode.factor_id           | UUID        |      Yes | Foreign key to MfaFactor                               |
 44: | MfaRecoveryCode.code_hash           | string      |      Yes | Non-reversible SHA-256 verifier                        |
 45: | MfaRecoveryCode.consumed_at         | timestamp   |       No | Timestamp when consumed atomically                     |
 46: | MfaChallenge.id                     | UUID        |      Yes | Challenge identifier                                   |
 47: | MfaChallenge.challenge_hash         | string      |      Yes | SHA-256 hash of opaque 32-byte token                   |
 48: | MfaChallenge.user_id                | UUID        |      Yes | Target user reference                                  |
 49: | MfaChallenge.merchant_id            | UUID        |      Yes | Merchant tenant reference                              |
 50: | MfaChallenge.expires_at             | timestamp   |      Yes | 5-minute challenge deadline                            |
 51: | MfaChallenge.failed_attempts        | integer     |      Yes | Failed attempt counter (max 5)                         |
 52: | MfaChallenge.consumed_at            | timestamp   |       No | Timestamp when verified and consumed                   |
 53: | MfaChallenge.invalidated_at         | timestamp   |       No | Timestamp when invalidated by reset/expiry             |
 54: | MfaAdminResetIdempotency.merchant_id | UUID | Yes | Tenant scope; unique with idempotency_key |
 55: | MfaAdminResetIdempotency.idempotency_key | string | Yes | Idempotency-Key header of the admin reset (BR-AUTH-19) |
 56: | MfaAdminResetIdempotency.target_user_id / reason | UUID / text | Yes | Request fingerprint; a different fingerprint with the same key is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT |
 57: | MfaAdminResetIdempotency.response | json | Yes | Original result replayed for the same request; written in the reset transaction |
 58: | MfaFactor unique ACTIVE | index | - | Partial unique index on (user_id) WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' |
 59: 
 60: ## Carrier account
 61: 
 62: | Entity.field                        | Type        | Required | Notes                                         |
 63: | ----------------------------------- | ----------- | -------: | --------------------------------------------- |
 64: | CarrierAccount.carrier_code         | enum/string |      Yes | GHN/GHTK/VTP/JT/custom                        |
 65: | CarrierAccount.external_account_ref | string      |      Yes | Encrypted/limited display if sensitive        |
 66: | CarrierAccount.status               | enum        |      Yes | DRAFT/TESTING/ACTIVE/DEGRADED/EXPIRED/REVOKED |
 67: | CarrierAccount.permission_profile   | enum        |      Yes | OBSERVE/ACTION                                |
 68: | CredentialVersion.secret_ref        | string      |      Yes | Reference to secret store, never token text   |
 69: | CarrierCapability.capability        | enum        |      Yes | SERVICEABILITY/QUOTE/CREATE/...               |
 70: | CarrierCapability.evidence_level    | enum        |      Yes | Official/partner/community/unverified         |
 71: 
 72: ## Source order and parcel
 73: 
 74: | Entity.field                             | Type      |    Required | Notes                                    |
 75: | ---------------------------------------- | --------- | ----------: | ---------------------------------------- |
 76: | SourceOrder.source_system                | string    |         Yes | MANUAL/PANCAKE/...                       |
 77: | SourceOrder.source_order_code            | string    |         Yes | Unique within tenant/source              |
 78: | SourceOrder.status_as_of                 | timestamp | Conditional | Required for freshness-sensitive rules   |
 79: | SourceOrder.expected_cod_vnd             | integer   |         Yes | >= 0                                     |
 80: | SourceOrder.fee_payer                    | enum      |         Yes | SHOP/RECIPIENT/OTHER                     |

 84: | Address.canonical_province/district/ward | string    |         Yes | User-confirmed if ambiguous              |
 85: | Address.line1                            | string    |         Yes | PII; masked by permission                |
 86: 
 87: ## Quote
 88: 
 89: | Entity.field                      | Type      |    Required | Notes                                                       |
 90: | --------------------------------- | --------- | ----------: | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
 91: | QuoteRequest.input_hash           | string    |         Yes | Address/parcel/service/COD version                          |
 92: | CarrierQuote.availability         | enum      |         Yes | AVAILABLE/UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN_ERROR/ACCOUNT_ACTION_REQUIRED |
 93: | CarrierQuote.total_fee_vnd        | integer   | Conditional | Required when AVAILABLE                                     |

 95: | CarrierQuote.raw_response_ref     | string    |         Yes | Immutable evidence                                          |

100: ## Shipment
101: 
102: | Entity.field                     | Type   |    Required | Notes                                   |
103: | -------------------------------- | ------ | ----------: | --------------------------------------- |
104: | Shipment.id                      | UUID   |         Yes | Ship Dễ ID                              |
105: | Shipment.carrier_account_id      | UUID   |         Yes | Scope                                   |
106: | Shipment.waybill                 | string | Conditional | Set after successful create/manual link |
107: | Shipment.normalized_waybill      | string | Conditional | Unique with carrier account             |
108: | Shipment.canonical_status        | enum   |         Yes | Derived lifecycle                       |
109: | Shipment.selected_quote_id       | UUID   | Conditional | Required for API-created shipment       |
110: | ShipmentCommand.idempotency_key  | string |         Yes | Unique within tenant/command type       |
111: | ShipmentCommand.outcome          | enum   |         Yes | PENDING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/UNKNOWN        |
112: | TrackingEvent.provider_event_key | string | Conditional | Dedupe key                              |
113: | TrackingEvent.raw_status         | string |         Yes | Never discarded                         |
114: | TrackingEvent.canonical_status   | enum   | Conditional | Null if unmapped                        |
