 161:   /**
 162:    * Register a new merchant shop and owner user (FEAT-AUTH-01 / BR-AUTH-01..10)
 163:    */
 164:   async register(dto: RegisterDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
 165:     const fields: CanonicalFieldError[] = [];
 166: 
 167:     // 1. Basic field validation (BR-AUTH-01)
 168:     if (!dto.merchant_name || dto.merchant_name.trim().length < 2) {
 169:       fields.push({
 170:         field: 'merchant_name',
 171:         code: 'REQUIRED',
 172:         message: 'Tên cửa hàng phải có ít nhất 2 ký tự',
 173:       });
 174:     }
 175: 
 176:     if (!dto.full_name || dto.full_name.trim().length < 2) {
 177:       fields.push({
 178:         field: 'full_name',
 179:         code: 'REQUIRED',
 180:         message: 'Họ và tên người đại diện phải có ít nhất 2 ký tự',
 181:       });
 182:     }
 183: 
 184:     const email = dto.email ? dto.email.trim().toLowerCase() : undefined;
 185:     const phone = dto.phone ? dto.phone.trim() : undefined;
 186: 
 187:     if (!email && !phone) {
 188:       fields.push({
 189:         field: 'email',
 190:         code: 'REQUIRED',
 191:         message: 'Phải cung cấp ít nhất email hoặc số điện thoại',
 192:       });
 193:     }
 194: 
 195:     if (email && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
 196:       fields.push({
 197:         field: 'email',
 198:         code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
 199:         message: 'Định dạng email không hợp lệ',
 200:       });
 201:     }
 202: 
 203:     if (phone && !/^(0|\+84)[3|5|7|8|9][0-9]{8}$/.test(phone.replace(/\s+/g, ''))) {
 204:       fields.push({
 205:         field: 'phone',
 206:         code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
 207:         message: 'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ theo định dạng Việt Nam',
 208:       });
 209:     }
 210: 
 211:     // Minimum password policy (BR-AUTH-05: >= 8 chars)
 212:     if (!dto.password || dto.password.length < 8) {
 213:       fields.push({
 214:         field: 'password',
 215:         code: 'TOO_SHORT',
 216:         message: 'Mật khẩu phải có độ dài tối thiểu 8 ký tự',
 217:       });
 218:     }
 219: 
 220:     // Terms acceptance check (BR-AUTH-04)
 221:     if (dto.terms_accepted !== true || !dto.terms_version) {
 222:       fields.push({
 223:         field: 'terms_accepted',
 224:         code: 'TERMS_NOT_ACCEPTED',
 225:         message: 'Bạn phải đồng ý với Điều khoản dịch vụ và Chính sách bảo mật',
 226:       });
 227:     }
 228: 
 229:     if (fields.length > 0) {
 230:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 231:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 232:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 233:         'Dữ liệu đăng ký không hợp lệ',
 234:         false,
 235:         'Vui lòng sửa các trường bị lỗi và thử lại',
 236:         fields
 237:       );
 238:     }
 239: 
 240:     // 2. Anti-abuse Rate Limiting (BR-AUTH-07)
 241:     const rateLimitCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkRegistrationLimit(
 242:       clientIp,
 243:       email,
 244:       phone
 245:     );
 246: 
 247:     if (!rateLimitCheck.allowed) {
 248:       await this.logAudit({
 249:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 250:         action: 'AUTH_REGISTER_RATE_LIMITED',
 251:         resource: 'auth/register',
 252:         correlationId,
 253:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 254:       });
 255: 
 256:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 257:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
 258:         'RATE_LIMITED',
 259:         rateLimitCheck.reason || 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu đăng ký. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
 260:         true,
 261:         `Vui lòng chờ ${rateLimitCheck.retryAfterSeconds || 3600} giây trước khi thử lại`,
 262:         undefined,
 263:         rateLimitCheck.retryAfterSeconds
 264:       );
 265:     }
 266: 
 267:     // Record IP registration attempt upfront to bound enumeration probing (BR-AUTH-07)
 268:     await this.rateLimitService.recordRegistrationAttempt(clientIp, undefined, undefined);
 269: 
 270:     // 3. Global Uniqueness Check (BR-AUTH-03)
 271:     const existingUsers = await this.prisma.user.findMany({
 272:       where: {
 273:         OR: [...(email ? [{ email }] : []), ...(phone ? [{ phone }] : [])],
 274:       },
 275:       include: {
 276:         merchant: true,
 277:       },
 278:     });
 279: 
 280:     const conflictResponse = await this.resolveExistingAccountConflict(
 281:       existingUsers,
 282:       email,
 283:       phone,
 284:       clientIp,
 285:       correlationId
 286:     );
 287:     if (conflictResponse) {
 288:       return conflictResponse;
 289:     }
 290: 
 291:     // 5. Atomic Creation of Merchant and User with Merchant Code Collision Retry (BR-AUTH-01, BR-AUTH-02, BR-AUTH-10)
 292:     const passwordHash = await hashPassword(dto.password);
 293:     let merchant: { id: string } | null = null;
 294:     let user: {
 295:       id: string;
 296:       merchant_id: string | null;
 297:       email: string | null;
 298:       phone: string | null;
 299:     } | null = null;
 300:     let lastError: unknown = null;
 301: 
 302:     for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
 303:       try {
 304:         const merchantCode = this.generateMerchantCode(dto.merchant_name);
 305:         const created = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 306:           const newMerchant = await tx.merchant.create({
 307:             data: {
 308:               name: dto.merchant_name.trim(),
 309:               code: merchantCode,
 310:               status: 'active',
 311:             },
 312:           });
 313: 
 314:           const newUser = await tx.user.create({
 315:             data: {
 316:               merchant_id: newMerchant.id,
 317:               full_name: dto.full_name.trim(),
 318:               email: email || null,
 319:               phone: phone || null,
 320:               password_hash: passwordHash,
 321:               role: RoleEnum.OWNER,
 322:               status: 'pending_verification',
 323:               terms_accepted_at: new Date(),
 324:               terms_version: dto.terms_version,
 325:             },
 326:           });
 327: 
 328:           return { merchant: newMerchant, user: newUser };
 329:         });
 330: 
 331:         merchant = created.merchant;
 332:         user = created.user;
 333:         break;
 334:       } catch (err: unknown) {
 335:         lastError = err;
 336:         if (this.isUniqueConstraintViolation(err)) {
 337:           const target = (err as { meta?: { target?: string[] | string } })?.meta?.target;
 338:           const isMerchantCodeCollision =
 339:             (Array.isArray(target) && target.includes('code')) ||
 340:             (typeof target === 'string' && target.includes('merchants_code_key'));
 341: 
 342:           if (isMerchantCodeCollision) {
 343:             // Slug + random code collided on merchant. Retry with fresh random code!
 344:             continue;
 345:           }
 346: 
 347:           // User identifier concurrency race (BR-AUTH-10)
 348:           const raced = await this.prisma.user.findMany({
 349:             where: {
 350:               OR: [...(email ? [{ email }] : []), ...(phone ? [{ phone }] : [])],
 351:             },
 352:           });
 353:           const racedResponse = await this.resolveExistingAccountConflict(
 354:             raced,
 355:             email,
 356:             phone,
 357:             clientIp,
 358:             correlationId
 359:           );
 360:           if (racedResponse) {
 361:             return racedResponse;
 362:           }
 363:         }
 364:         throw err;
 365:       }
 366:     }
 367: 
 368:     if (!merchant || !user) {
 369:       throw (
 370:         lastError ||
 371:         new Error('Failed to create merchant and owner account due to unresolvable code collision.')
 372:       );
 373:     }
 374: 
 375:     // Record rate limit attempt for identifiers on successful creation
 376:     await this.rateLimitService.recordRegistrationAttempt(undefined, email, phone);
 377: 
 378:     // Issue tokens and dispatch
 379:     await this.issueAndSendVerification(user, email, phone, correlationId);
 380: 
 381:     // Audit log (BR-AUTH-09)
 382:     await this.logAudit({
 383:       merchantId: merchant.id,
 384:       userId: user.id,
 385:       actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 386:       action: 'AUTH_REGISTER_SUCCESS',
 387:       resource: `user:${user.id}`,
 388:       details: {
 389:         email: user.email ? this.hashIdentifierForAudit(user.email) : undefined,
 390:         phone: user.phone ? this.hashIdentifierForAudit(user.phone) : undefined,
 391:       },
 392:       correlationId,
 393:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 394:     });
 395: 
 396:     return {
 397:       data: {
 398:         user_id: user.id,
 399:         merchant_id: merchant.id,
 400:         status: 'PENDING_VERIFICATION' as const,
 401:         email: user.email || undefined,
 402:         phone: user.phone || undefined,
 403:         message: 'Đăng ký thành công. Vui lòng xác thực tài khoản qua email hoặc số điện thoại.',
 404:       },
 405:       meta: {
 406:         correlation_id: correlationId,
 407:       },
 408:     };
 409:   }

 411:   /**
 412:    * Verify Email Link Token (BR-AUTH-02, BR-AUTH-06)
 413:    */
 414:   async verifyEmail(dto: VerifyEmailDto, correlationId: string) {
 415:     if (!dto.token || dto.token.trim().length === 0) {
 416:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 417:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 418:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 419:         'Mã token xác thực không được để trống',
 420:         false
 421:       );
 422:     }
 423: 
 424:     const rawToken = dto.token.trim();
 425:     const hashedToken = this.hashSecret(rawToken);
 426: 
 427:     // Look up by raw token or hashed digest (backward compatible with seed fixtures).
 428:     // FEAT-AUTH-03 (BR-AUTH-12): only VERIFICATION-purpose tokens may activate an
 429:     // account; a LOGIN OTP can never be used here and vice versa.
 430:     const tokenRecord = await this.prisma.verificationToken.findFirst({
 431:       where: {
 432:         token: { in: [rawToken, hashedToken] },
 433:         channel: 'email',
 434:         purpose: 'VERIFICATION',
 435:       },
 436:       include: {
 437:         user: true,
 438:       },
 439:     });
 440: 
 441:     if (!tokenRecord) {
 442:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 443:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 444:         'INVALID_TOKEN',
 445:         'Mã xác thực không hợp lệ hoặc không tồn tại',
 446:         false,
 447:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại liên kết hoặc yêu cầu gửi lại mã xác thực'
 448:       );
 449:     }
 450: 
 451:     if (tokenRecord.consumed_at !== null) {
 452:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 453:         HttpStatus.GONE,
 454:         'TOKEN_ALREADY_CONSUMED',
 455:         'Mã xác thực này đã được sử dụng trước đó',
 456:         false,
 457:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập hoặc yêu cầu mã xác thực mới nếu chưa kích hoạt'
 458:       );
 459:     }
 460: 
 461:     if (tokenRecord.expires_at < new Date()) {
 462:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 463:         HttpStatus.GONE,
 464:         'TOKEN_EXPIRED',
 465:         'Mã xác thực đã hết hạn',
 466:         false,
 467:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu gửi lại mã xác thực mới'
 468:       );
 469:     }
 470: 
 471:     const updatedUser = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 472:       await tx.verificationToken.update({
 473:         where: { id: tokenRecord.id },
 474:         data: { consumed_at: new Date() },
 475:       });
 476: 
 477:       return tx.user.update({
 478:         where: { id: tokenRecord.user_id },
 479:         data: {
 480:           email_verified_at: new Date(),
 481:           status: 'active',
 482:         },
 483:       });
 484:     });
 485: 
 486:     await this.logAudit({
 487:       merchantId: updatedUser.merchant_id,
 488:       userId: updatedUser.id,
 489:       actor: `user:${updatedUser.id}`,
 490:       action: 'AUTH_VERIFY_EMAIL_SUCCESS',
 491:       resource: `user:${updatedUser.id}`,
 492:       correlationId,
 493:     });
 494: 
 495:     return {
 496:       data: {
 497:         user_id: updatedUser.id,
 498:         merchant_id: updatedUser.merchant_id,
 499:         status:
 500:           updatedUser.status === 'active' ? ('ACTIVE' as const) : ('PENDING_VERIFICATION' as const),
 501:         channel: 'email' as const,
 502:         verified: true,
 503:       },
 504:       meta: {
 505:         correlation_id: correlationId,
 506:       },
 507:     };
 508:   }
 509: 
 510:   /**
 511:    * Verify Phone OTP with Bounded Attempts (BR-AUTH-02, BR-AUTH-06)
 512:    */
 513:   async verifyPhone(dto: VerifyPhoneDto, correlationId: string) {
 514:     if (!dto.phone || !dto.otp) {
 515:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 516:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 517:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 518:         'Số điện thoại và mã OTP không được để trống',
 519:         false
 520:       );
 521:     }
 522: 
 523:     const phone = dto.phone.trim();
 524:     const rawOtp = dto.otp.trim();
 525: 
 526:     // Check brute-force attempt limits (max 5 failed attempts per window)
 527:     const otpLimit = await this.rateLimitService.checkOtpAttemptLimit(phone);
 528:     if (!otpLimit.allowed) {
 529:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 530:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
 531:         'RATE_LIMITED',
 532:         otpLimit.reason || 'Quá nhiều lần thử mã OTP không chính xác. Vui lòng yêu cầu mã mới.',
 533:         true,
 534:         `Vui lòng chờ ${otpLimit.retryAfterSeconds || 900} giây`,
 535:         undefined,
 536:         otpLimit.retryAfterSeconds
 537:       );
 538:     }
 539: 
 540:     // Look up latest verification token for this phone.
 541:     // FEAT-AUTH-03 (BR-AUTH-12): only VERIFICATION-purpose tokens may verify a
 542:     // channel; a LOGIN OTP can never satisfy account verification.
 543:     const tokenRecord = await this.prisma.verificationToken.findFirst({
 544:       where: {
 545:         identifier: phone,
 546:         channel: 'phone',
 547:         purpose: 'VERIFICATION',
 548:       },
 549:       orderBy: {
 550:         created_at: 'desc',
 551:       },
 552:       include: {
 553:         user: true,
 554:       },
 555:     });
 556: 
 557:     if (!tokenRecord) {
 558:       await this.rateLimitService.recordOtpFailure(phone);
 559:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 560:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 561:         'INVALID_OTP',
 562:         'Mã OTP không chính xác hoặc không tồn tại',
 563:         false,
 564:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại mã OTP vừa nhận qua SMS'
 565:       );
 566:     }
 567: 
 568:     if (tokenRecord.consumed_at !== null) {
 569:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 570:         HttpStatus.GONE,
 571:         'OTP_ALREADY_CONSUMED',
 572:         'Mã OTP này đã được sử dụng',
 573:         false,
 574:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu gửi mã OTP mới'
 575:       );
 576:     }
 577: 
 578:     if (tokenRecord.expires_at < new Date()) {
 579:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 580:         HttpStatus.GONE,
 581:         'OTP_EXPIRED',
 582:         'Mã OTP đã hết hạn',
 583:         false,
 584:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu gửi mã OTP mới'
 585:       );
 586:     }
 587: 
 588:     // Validate OTP match (supports both SHA-256 hashed and plaintext legacy seeds)
 589:     const hashedOtp = this.hashSecret(rawOtp);
 590:     const isMatch = tokenRecord.otp === rawOtp || tokenRecord.otp === hashedOtp;
 591: 
 592:     if (!isMatch) {
 593:       const failCount = await this.rateLimitService.recordOtpFailure(phone);
 594:       if (failCount >= 5) {
 595:         // Invalidate token on 5th failed attempt to prevent further brute force
 596:         await this.prisma.verificationToken.update({
 597:           where: { id: tokenRecord.id },
 598:           data: { consumed_at: new Date() },
 599:         });
 600:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 601:           HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
 602:           'OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED',
 603:           'Đã vượt quá 5 lần nhập sai mã OTP. Mã OTP đã bị hủy, vui lòng yêu cầu mã mới.',
 604:           false,
 605:           'Vui lòng yêu cầu gửi lại mã xác thực mới'
 606:         );
 607:       }
 608:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 609:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 610:         'INVALID_OTP',
 611:         `Mã OTP không chính xác (còn ${5 - failCount} lần thử)`,
 612:         false,
 613:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại mã OTP vừa nhận qua SMS'
 614:       );
 615:     }
 616: 
 617:     // Success! Reset OTP attempt counters
 618:     await this.rateLimitService.resetOtpAttempts(phone);
 619: 
 620:     const updatedUser = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 621:       await tx.verificationToken.update({
 622:         where: { id: tokenRecord.id },
 623:         data: { consumed_at: new Date() },
 624:       });
 625: 
 626:       return tx.user.update({
 627:         where: { id: tokenRecord.user_id },
 628:         data: {
 629:           phone_verified_at: new Date(),
 630:           status: 'active',
 631:         },
 632:       });
 633:     });
 634: 
 635:     await this.logAudit({
 636:       merchantId: updatedUser.merchant_id,
 637:       userId: updatedUser.id,
 638:       actor: `user:${updatedUser.id}`,
 639:       action: 'AUTH_VERIFY_PHONE_SUCCESS',
 640:       resource: `user:${updatedUser.id}`,
 641:       correlationId,
 642:     });
 643: 
 644:     return {
 645:       data: {
 646:         user_id: updatedUser.id,
 647:         merchant_id: updatedUser.merchant_id,
 648:         status:
 649:           updatedUser.status === 'active' ? ('ACTIVE' as const) : ('PENDING_VERIFICATION' as const),
 650:         channel: 'phone' as const,
 651:         verified: true,
 652:       },
 653:       meta: {
 654:         correlation_id: correlationId,
 655:       },
 656:     };
 657:   }

 659:   /**
 660:    * Resend Verification Code with Anti-Enumeration and Channel Validation (BR-AUTH-08)
 661:    */
 662:   async resendVerification(dto: ResendVerificationDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
 663:     if (!dto.identifier || !dto.channel) {
 664:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 665:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 666:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 667:         'Thông tin người nhận và kênh xác thực không được để trống',
 668:         false
 669:       );
 670:     }
 671: 
 672:     const identifier = dto.identifier.trim();
 673:     const channel = dto.channel;
 674: 
 675:     // Resend Rate Limiting (BR-AUTH-08: 60s cooldown and 5/hour cap)
 676:     const rateCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkResendLimit(identifier, channel);
 677:     if (!rateCheck.allowed) {
 678:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 679:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
 680:         'RATE_LIMITED',
 681:         rateCheck.reason || 'Vui lòng chờ trước khi yêu cầu gửi lại mã',
 682:         true,
 683:         `Vui lòng chờ ${rateCheck.retryAfterSeconds || 60} giây`,
 684:         undefined,
 685:         rateCheck.retryAfterSeconds
 686:       );
 687:     }
 688: 
 689:     // Find pending user matching identifier and requested channel
 690:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
 691:       where: {
 692:         OR: [
 693:           ...(channel === 'email' ? [{ email: identifier.toLowerCase() }] : []),
 694:           ...(channel === 'phone' ? [{ phone: identifier }] : []),
 695:         ],
 696:         status: 'pending_verification',
 697:       },
 698:     });
 699: 
 700:     if (!user) {
 701:       // Check if user exists under the other channel (channel mismatch)
 702:       const userOtherChannel = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
 703:         where: {
 704:           OR: [{ email: identifier.toLowerCase() }, { phone: identifier }],
 705:           status: 'pending_verification',
 706:         },
 707:       });
 708: 
 709:       if (userOtherChannel) {
 710:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 711:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 712:           'CHANNEL_MISMATCH',
 713:           `Kênh xác thực '${channel}' không khớp với phương thức đăng ký của tài khoản. Vui lòng chọn kênh phù hợp.`,
 714:           false
 715:         );
 716:       }
 717: 
 718:       // If user does not exist at all: apply cooldown to prevent spam, and return generic 200 to prevent account enumeration
 719:       await this.rateLimitService.recordResendAttempt(identifier, channel, 60);
 720:       return {
 721:         data: {
 722:           status: 'SENT' as const,
 723:           channel,
 724:           cooldown_seconds: 60,
 725:         },
 726:         meta: {
 727:           correlation_id: correlationId,
 728:         },
 729:       };
 730:     }
 731: 
 732:     // Record resend attempt (cooldown + hourly counter)
 733:     await this.rateLimitService.recordResendAttempt(identifier, channel, 60);
 734: 
 735:     // Issue and dispatch new token (storing SHA-256 digest in DB)
 736:     if (channel === 'email' && user.email) {
 737:       const emailToken = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
 738:       const hashedToken = this.hashSecret(emailToken);
 739:       await this.prisma.verificationToken.create({
 740:         data: {
 741:           user_id: user.id,
 742:           token: hashedToken,
 743:           channel: 'email',
 744:           identifier: user.email,
 745:           expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
 746:         },
 747:       });
 748: 
 749:       if (this.deliveryAdapter) {
 750:         await this.deliveryAdapter.sendVerification({
 751:           channel: 'email',
 752:           recipient: user.email,
 753:           token: emailToken,
 754:         });
 755:       }
 756:     } else if (channel === 'phone' && user.phone) {
 757:       const otp = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();
 758:       const hashedOtp = this.hashSecret(otp);
 759:       const phoneToken = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
 760:       const hashedToken = this.hashSecret(phoneToken);
 761: 
 762:       await this.prisma.verificationToken.create({
 763:         data: {
 764:           user_id: user.id,
 765:           token: hashedToken,
 766:           channel: 'phone',
 767:           identifier: user.phone,
 768:           otp: hashedOtp,
 769:           expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000),
 770:         },
 771:       });
 772: 
 773:       if (this.deliveryAdapter) {
 774:         await this.deliveryAdapter.sendVerification({
 775:           channel: 'phone',
 776:           recipient: user.phone,
 777:           otp,
 778:           token: phoneToken,
 779:         });
 780:       }
 781:     }
 782: 
 783:     await this.logAudit({
 784:       merchantId: user.merchant_id,
 785:       userId: user.id,
 786:       actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 787:       action: 'AUTH_RESEND_VERIFICATION',
 788:       resource: `user:${user.id}`,
 789:       correlationId,
 790:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 791:     });
 792: 
 793:     return {
 794:       data: {
 795:         status: 'SENT' as const,
 796:         channel,
 797:         cooldown_seconds: 60,
 798:       },
 799:       meta: {
 800:         correlation_id: correlationId,
 801:       },
 802:     };
 803:   }

 805:   /**
 806:    * FEAT-AUTH-04: Forgot Password - Request Password Reset Token
 807:    * Anti-enumeration: always returns 200 SENT regardless of account existence
 808:    * Rate limited: 5 requests/hour per IP, 3 requests/hour per identifier
 809:    */
 810:   async forgotPassword(dto: ForgotPasswordDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
 811:     const identifier = dto.identifier?.trim();
 812:     if (!identifier) {
 813:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 814:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 815:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 816:         'Email hoặc số điện thoại không được để trống',
 817:         false,
 818:         undefined,
 819:         [
 820:           {
 821:             field: 'identifier',
 822:             code: 'REQUIRED',
 823:             message: 'Vui lòng nhập email hoặc số điện thoại',
 824:           },
 825:         ]
 826:       );
 827:     }
 828: 
 829:     const isEmail = identifier.includes('@');
 830:     const channel = dto.channel || (isEmail ? 'email' : 'phone');
 831:     const normalizedIdentifier = isEmail
 832:       ? identifier.toLowerCase()
 833:       : identifier.replace(/\s+/g, '');
 834: 
 835:     if (channel === 'email' && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(normalizedIdentifier)) {
 836:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 837:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 838:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 839:         'Định dạng email không hợp lệ',
 840:         false,
 841:         undefined,
 842:         [{ field: 'identifier', code: 'INVALID_FORMAT', message: 'Định dạng email không hợp lệ' }]
 843:       );
 844:     }
 845:     if (channel === 'phone' && !/^(0|\+84)[3|5|7|8|9][0-9]{8}$/.test(normalizedIdentifier)) {
 846:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 847:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 848:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 849:         'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ (định dạng Việt Nam: 0xxxxxxxxx hoặc +84xxxxxxxxx)',
 850:         false,
 851:         undefined,
 852:         [{ field: 'identifier', code: 'INVALID_FORMAT', message: 'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ' }]
 853:       );
 854:     }
 855: 
 856:     const ipRateCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkForgotPasswordLimit(clientIp, 'ip');
 857:     if (!ipRateCheck.allowed) {
 858:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 859:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
 860:         'RATE_LIMITED',
 861:         `Quá nhiều yêu cầu. Vui lòng thử lại sau ${ipRateCheck.retryAfterSeconds} giây.`,
 862:         true,
 863:         `Thử lại sau ${ipRateCheck.retryAfterSeconds} giây`,
 864:         undefined,
 865:         ipRateCheck.retryAfterSeconds
 866:       );
 867:     }
 868: 
 869:     const identifierRateCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkForgotPasswordLimit(
 870:       normalizedIdentifier,
 871:       'identifier'
 872:     );
 873:     if (!identifierRateCheck.allowed) {
 874:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 875:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
 876:         'RATE_LIMITED',
 877:         `Quá nhiều yêu cầu cho tài khoản này. Vui lòng thử lại sau ${identifierRateCheck.retryAfterSeconds} giây.`,
 878:         true,
 879:         `Thử lại sau ${identifierRateCheck.retryAfterSeconds} giây`,
 880:         undefined,
 881:         identifierRateCheck.retryAfterSeconds
 882:       );
 883:     }
 884: 
 885:     await this.rateLimitService.recordForgotPasswordAttempt(clientIp, normalizedIdentifier);
 886: 
 887:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
 888:       where:
 889:         channel === 'email' ? { email: normalizedIdentifier } : { phone: normalizedIdentifier },
 890:     });
 891: 
 892:     const genericResponse = {
 893:       data: {
 894:         status: 'SENT' as const,
 895:         message: 'Nếu tài khoản tồn tại và đã xác thực, liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu đã được gửi.',
 896:         channel,
 897:       },
 898:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
 899:     };
 900: 
 901:     const hashedIdentifierRef = this.hashIdentifierForAudit(normalizedIdentifier);
 902: 
 903:     if (!user) {
 904:       await this.logAudit({
 905:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 906:         action: 'AUTH_FORGOT_PASSWORD_NO_USER',
 907:         resource: `identifier:${hashedIdentifierRef}`,
 908:         correlationId,
 909:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 910:         details: { identifier: hashedIdentifierRef, channel, reason: 'user_not_found' },
 911:       });
 912:       return genericResponse;
 913:     }
 914: 
 915:     if (user.status !== 'active') {
 916:       await this.logAudit({
 917:         merchantId: user.merchant_id,
 918:         userId: user.id,
 919:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 920:         action: 'AUTH_FORGOT_PASSWORD_BLOCKED',
 921:         resource: `user:${user.id}`,
 922:         correlationId,
 923:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 924:         details: { reason: user.status },
 925:       });
 926:       return genericResponse;
 927:     }
 928: 
 929:     const isVerified =
 930:       channel === 'email' ? user.email_verified_at !== null : user.phone_verified_at !== null;
 931: 
 932:     if (!isVerified) {
 933:       await this.logAudit({
 934:         merchantId: user.merchant_id,
 935:         userId: user.id,
 936:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 937:         action: 'AUTH_FORGOT_PASSWORD_UNVERIFIED',
 938:         resource: `user:${user.id}`,
 939:         correlationId,
 940:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 941:         details: { identifier: hashedIdentifierRef, channel, reason: 'contact_not_verified' },
 942:       });
 943:       return genericResponse;
 944:     }
 945: 
 946:     const rawToken = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
 947:     const hashedToken = this.hashSecret(rawToken);
 948:     const ttlSeconds = this.config?.PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECONDS || 3600;
 949:     const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + ttlSeconds * 1000);
 950: 
 951:     await this.prisma.passwordResetToken.create({
 952:       data: {
 953:         user_id: user.id,
 954:         token: hashedToken,
 955:         channel,
 956:         identifier: normalizedIdentifier,
 957:         expires_at: expiresAt,
 958:       },
 959:     });
 960: 
 961:     if (this.deliveryAdapter) {
 962:       const baseUrl = this.config?.FRONTEND_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
 963:       await this.deliveryAdapter.sendVerification({
 964:         channel,
 965:         recipient: normalizedIdentifier,
 966:         purpose: 'password_reset',
 967:         link: `${baseUrl}/reset-password?token=${rawToken}`,
 968:       });
 969:     }
 970: 
 971:     await this.logAudit({
 972:       merchantId: user.merchant_id,
 973:       userId: user.id,
 974:       actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 975:       action: 'AUTH_FORGOT_PASSWORD_TOKEN_ISSUED',
 976:       resource: `user:${user.id}`,
 977:       correlationId,
 978:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
 979:       details: { channel, expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString() },
 980:     });
 981: 
 982:     return genericResponse;
 983:   }

 985:   /**
 986:    * FEAT-AUTH-04: Verify Reset Token
 987:    * Validates token exists, not expired, not consumed
 988:    * Returns identifier and channel for UI confirmation
 989:    */
 990:   async verifyResetToken(dto: VerifyResetTokenDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
 991:     const rawToken = dto.token?.trim();
 992:     if (!rawToken) {
 993:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 994:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 995:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 996:         'Token không được để trống',
 997:         false,
 998:         undefined,
 999:         [{ field: 'token', code: 'REQUIRED', message: 'Token không được để trống' }]
1000:       );
1001:     }
1002: 
1003:     const resetLimit = await this.rateLimitService.checkResetTokenLimit(clientIp);
1004:     if (!resetLimit.allowed) {
1005:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1006:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
1007:         'RATE_LIMITED',
1008:         resetLimit.reason || 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
1009:         true,
1010:         `Thử lại sau ${resetLimit.retryAfterSeconds} giây`,
1011:         undefined,
1012:         resetLimit.retryAfterSeconds
1013:       );
1014:     }
1015: 
1016:     const hashedToken = this.hashSecret(rawToken);
1017:     const tokenRecord = await this.prisma.passwordResetToken.findUnique({
1018:       where: { token: hashedToken },
1019:       include: { user: true },
1020:     });
1021: 
1022:     if (!tokenRecord) {
1023:       await this.rateLimitService.recordResetTokenFailure(clientIp);
1024:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1025:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1026:         'INVALID_TOKEN',
1027:         'Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn',
1028:         false,
1029:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu mới'
1030:       );
1031:     }
1032: 
1033:     if (tokenRecord.user.status !== 'active') {
1034:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1035:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1036:         'FORBIDDEN',
1037:         'Tài khoản bị khóa, không thể đặt lại mật khẩu.',
1038:         false,
1039:         'Vui lòng liên hệ bộ phận CSKH để được hỗ trợ'
1040:       );
1041:     }
1042: 
1043:     if (tokenRecord.consumed_at) {
1044:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1045:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1046:         'TOKEN_ALREADY_USED',
1047:         'Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu này đã được sử dụng',
1048:         false,
1049:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu mới'
1050:       );
1051:     }
1052: 
1053:     if (new Date() > tokenRecord.expires_at) {
1054:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1055:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1056:         'TOKEN_EXPIRED',
1057:         'Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu đã hết hạn (hiệu lực 1 giờ)',
1058:         false,
1059:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu mới'
1060:       );
1061:     }
1062: 
1063:     return {
1064:       data: {
1065:         valid: true,
1066:         identifier: tokenRecord.identifier,
1067:         channel: tokenRecord.channel,
1068:       },
1069:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
1070:     };
1071:   }

1073:   /**
1074:    * FEAT-AUTH-04: Reset Password with Token
1075:    * Validates token, updates password, consumes token, revokes all sessions
1076:    */
1077:   async resetPassword(dto: ResetPasswordDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
1078:     const fields: CanonicalFieldError[] = [];
1079:     const rawToken = dto.token?.trim();
1080:     const password = dto.password;
1081:     const passwordConfirm = dto.password_confirm;
1082: 
1083:     if (!rawToken) {
1084:       fields.push({ field: 'token', code: 'REQUIRED', message: 'Token không được để trống' });
1085:     }
1086:     if (!password) {
1087:       fields.push({
1088:         field: 'password',
1089:         code: 'REQUIRED',
1090:         message: 'Mật khẩu mới không được để trống',
1091:       });
1092:     }
1093:     if (!passwordConfirm) {
1094:       fields.push({
1095:         field: 'password_confirm',
1096:         code: 'REQUIRED',
1097:         message: 'Xác nhận mật khẩu không được để trống',
1098:       });
1099:     }
1100:     if (password && password !== passwordConfirm) {
1101:       fields.push({
1102:         field: 'password_confirm',
1103:         code: 'MISMATCH',
1104:         message: 'Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp',
1105:       });
1106:     }
1107:     if (password && password.length < 8) {
1108:       fields.push({
1109:         field: 'password',
1110:         code: 'WEAK_PASSWORD',
1111:         message: 'Mật khẩu phải có ít nhất 8 ký tự',
1112:       });
1113:     }
1114:     if (password && !/[A-Z]/.test(password)) {
1115:       fields.push({
1116:         field: 'password',
1117:         code: 'WEAK_PASSWORD',
1118:         message: 'Mật khẩu phải chứa ít nhất 1 chữ hoa',
1119:       });
1120:     }
1121:     if (password && !/[a-z]/.test(password)) {
1122:       fields.push({
1123:         field: 'password',
1124:         code: 'WEAK_PASSWORD',
1125:         message: 'Mật khẩu phải chứa ít nhất 1 chữ thường',
1126:       });
1127:     }
1128:     if (password && !/[0-9]/.test(password)) {
1129:       fields.push({
1130:         field: 'password',
1131:         code: 'WEAK_PASSWORD',
1132:         message: 'Mật khẩu phải chứa ít nhất 1 số',
1133:       });
1134:     }
1135:     if (password && !/[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]{};':"\\|,.<>\/?]/.test(password)) {
1136:       fields.push({
1137:         field: 'password',
1138:         code: 'WEAK_PASSWORD',
1139:         message: 'Mật khẩu phải chứa ít nhất 1 ký tự đặc biệt',
1140:       });
1141:     }
1142: 
1143:     if (fields.length > 0) {
1144:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1145:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1146:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1147:         'Dữ liệu không hợp lệ',
1148:         false,
1149:         undefined,
1150:         fields
1151:       );
1152:     }
1153: 
1154:     const hashedToken = this.hashSecret(rawToken!);
1155: 
1156:     const resetLimit = await this.rateLimitService.checkResetTokenLimit(clientIp);
1157:     if (!resetLimit.allowed) {
1158:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1159:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
1160:         'RATE_LIMITED',
1161:         resetLimit.reason || 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
1162:         true,
1163:         `Thử lại sau ${resetLimit.retryAfterSeconds} giây`,
1164:         undefined,
1165:         resetLimit.retryAfterSeconds
1166:       );
1167:     }
1168: 
1169:     const tokenRecord = await this.prisma.passwordResetToken.findUnique({
1170:       where: { token: hashedToken },
1171:       include: { user: true },
1172:     });
1173: 
1174:     if (!tokenRecord) {
1175:       await this.rateLimitService.recordResetTokenFailure(clientIp);
1176:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1177:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1178:         'INVALID_TOKEN',
1179:         'Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn',
1180:         false,
1181:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu mới'
1182:       );
1183:     }
1184: 
1185:     if (tokenRecord.user.status !== 'active') {
1186:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1187:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1188:         'FORBIDDEN',
1189:         'Tài khoản bị khóa, không thể đặt lại mật khẩu.',
1190:         false,
1191:         'Vui lòng liên hệ bộ phận CSKH để được hỗ trợ'
1192:       );
1193:     }
1194: 
1195:     if (tokenRecord.consumed_at) {
1196:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1197:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1198:         'TOKEN_ALREADY_USED',
1199:         'Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu này đã được sử dụng',
1200:         false,
1201:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu mới'
1202:       );
1203:     }
1204: 
1205:     if (new Date() > tokenRecord.expires_at) {
1206:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1207:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1208:         'TOKEN_EXPIRED',
1209:         'Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu đã hết hạn (hiệu lực 1 giờ)',
1210:         false,
1211:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu mới'
1212:       );
1213:     }
1214: 
1215:     const newPasswordHash = await hashPassword(password!);
1216: 
1217:     await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
1218:       await tx.user.update({
1219:         where: { id: tokenRecord.user_id },
1220:         data: { password_hash: newPasswordHash, updated_at: new Date() },
1221:       });
1222: 
1223:       const { count } = await tx.passwordResetToken.updateMany({
1224:         where: { id: tokenRecord.id, consumed_at: null },
1225:         data: { consumed_at: new Date() },
1226:       });
1227: 
1228:       if (count === 0) {
1229:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
1230:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1231:           'TOKEN_ALREADY_USED',
1232:           'Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu này đã được sử dụng',
1233:           false,
1234:           'Vui lòng yêu cầu liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu mới'
1235:         );
1236:       }
1237: 
1238:       await tx.deviceSession.updateMany({
1239:         where: { user_id: tokenRecord.user_id, status: 'ACTIVE' },
1240:         data: {
1241:           status: 'REVOKED',
1242:           is_revoked: true,
1243:           revoked_at: new Date(),
1244:           revoked_by: tokenRecord.user_id,
1245:           revoke_reason: 'Password reset',
1246:         },
1247:       });
1248:     });
1249: 
1250:     await this.logAudit({
1251:       merchantId: tokenRecord.user.merchant_id,
1252:       userId: tokenRecord.user_id,
1253:       actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1254:       action: 'AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_CONSUMED',
1255:       resource: `user:${tokenRecord.user_id}`,
1256:       correlationId,
1257:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1258:       details: { channel: tokenRecord.channel },
1259:     });
1260: 
1261:     await this.logAudit({
1262:       merchantId: tokenRecord.user.merchant_id,
1263:       userId: tokenRecord.user_id,
1264:       actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1265:       action: 'AUTH_PASSWORD_CHANGED',
1266:       resource: `user:${tokenRecord.user_id}`,
1267:       correlationId,
1268:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1269:     });
1270: 
1271:     await this.logAudit({
1272:       merchantId: tokenRecord.user.merchant_id,
1273:       userId: tokenRecord.user_id,
1274:       actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1275:       action: 'AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_SESSIONS_REVOKED',
1276:       resource: `user:${tokenRecord.user_id}`,
1277:       correlationId,
1278:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1279:       details: { sessions_revoked: true },
1280:     });
1281: 
1282:     return {
1283:       data: {
1284:         message: 'Mật khẩu đã được đặt lại thành công. Tất cả phiên đăng nhập khác đã bị thu hồi.',
1285:       },
1286:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
1287:     };
1288:   }

1290:   /**
1291: 
1292:    * Request a login OTP (FEAT-AUTH-03 / SCR-AUTH-01 "if configured" / BR-AUTH-12).
1293:    * Gated by AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED; generic OTP_SENT response (CD-4..5, CD-7).
1294:    */
1295:   async requestLoginOtp(dto: LoginOtpRequestDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
1296:     if (this.config && !this.config.AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED) {
1297:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1298:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1299:         'AUTH_OTP_LOGIN_DISABLED',
1300:         'Đăng nhập bằng mã OTP chưa được bật cho hệ thống.',
1301:         false,
1302:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu'
1303:       );
1304:     }
1305: 
1306:     if (!dto.identifier || dto.identifier.trim().length === 0) {
1307:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1308:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1309:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1310:         'Email hoặc số điện thoại không được để trống',
1311:         false,
1312:         undefined,
1313:         [
1314:           {
1315:             field: 'identifier',
1316:             code: 'REQUIRED',
1317:             message: 'Email hoặc số điện thoại không được để trống',
1318:           },
1319:         ]
1320:       );
1321:     }
1322: 
1323:     const normalized = this.normalizeIdentifier(dto.identifier);
1324:     if (!normalized) {
1325:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1326:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1327:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1328:         'Định dạng email hoặc số điện thoại không hợp lệ',
1329:         false,
1330:         undefined,
1331:         [
1332:           {
1333:             field: 'identifier',
1334:             code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
1335:             message: 'Email hoặc số điện thoại không đúng định dạng Việt Nam',
1336:           },
1337:         ]
1338:       );
1339:     }
1340: 
1341:     // BR-AUTH-12 limits: IP max 10/hour; identifier 60s cooldown + max 5/hour (recorded upfront)
1342:     const ipCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkLoginOtpIpLimit(clientIp);
1343:     if (!ipCheck.allowed) {
1344:       await this.logAudit({
1345:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1346:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_RATE_LIMITED',
1347:         resource: 'auth/login',
1348:         correlationId,
1349:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1350:         details: { scope: 'ip' },
1351:       });
1352:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1353:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
1354:         'RATE_LIMITED',
1355:         ipCheck.reason || 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu mã OTP. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
1356:         true,
1357:         `Vui lòng chờ ${ipCheck.retryAfterSeconds || 3600} giây trước khi thử lại`,
1358:         undefined,
1359:         ipCheck.retryAfterSeconds
1360:       );
1361:     }
1362:     const idCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkLoginOtpRequestLimit(normalized.stored);
1363:     if (!idCheck.allowed) {
1364:       await this.logAudit({
1365:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1366:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_RATE_LIMITED',
1367:         resource: 'auth/login',
1368:         correlationId,
1369:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1370:         details: { scope: 'identifier' },
1371:       });
1372:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1373:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
1374:         'RATE_LIMITED',
1375:         idCheck.reason || 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu mã OTP cho tài khoản này.',
1376:         true,
1377:         `Vui lòng chờ ${idCheck.retryAfterSeconds || 60} giây trước khi thử lại`,
1378:         undefined,
1379:         idCheck.retryAfterSeconds
1380:       );
1381:     }
1382:     await this.rateLimitService.recordLoginOtpIpAttempt(clientIp);
1383:     await this.rateLimitService.recordLoginOtpRequest(normalized.stored, 60);
1384: 
1385:     const channel: 'email' | 'phone' = normalized.email ? 'email' : 'phone';
1386:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
1387:       where: normalized.email ? { email: normalized.email } : { phone: normalized.phone },
1388:     });
1389: 
1390:     const genericResponse = {
1391:       data: {
1392:         status: 'OTP_SENT' as const,
1393:         channel,
1394:         recipient_masked: this.maskIdentifier(normalized.stored),
1395:         cooldown_seconds: 60,
1396:         expires_in_seconds: 300,
1397:         message: 'Nếu tài khoản tồn tại, mã OTP đăng nhập đã được gửi đến bạn.',
1398:       },
1399:       meta: {
1400:         correlation_id: correlationId,
1401:       },
1402:     };
1403: 
1404:     // Verified-channel-only delivery (CD-5): unknown identifier or unverified channel
1405:     // receives the identical generic response with no delivery.
1406:     const channelVerified =
1407:       !!user &&
1408:       ((channel === 'email' && !!user.email_verified_at) ||
1409:         (channel === 'phone' && !!user.phone_verified_at));
1410: 
1411:     if (!user || !channelVerified) {
1412:       await this.logAudit({
1413:         merchantId: user?.merchant_id,
1414:         userId: user?.id,
1415:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1416:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_REQUESTED',
1417:         resource: 'auth/login',
1418:         correlationId,
1419:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1420:         details: {
1421:           delivered: false,
1422:           reason: user ? 'channel_unverified' : 'unknown_identifier',
1423:         },
1424:       });
1425:       return genericResponse;
1426:     }
1427: 
1428:     const rawOtp = randomInt(100000, 1000000).toString();
1429:     const hashedOtp = this.hashSecret(rawOtp);
1430:     const tokenValue = this.hashSecret(randomBytes(32).toString('hex'));
1431: 
1432:     await this.prisma.verificationToken.create({
1433:       data: {
1434:         user_id: user.id,
1435:         token: tokenValue,
1436:         channel,
1437:         identifier: normalized.stored,
1438:         otp: hashedOtp,
1439:         purpose: 'LOGIN',
1440:         expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000),
1441:       },
1442:     });
1443: 
1444:     if (this.deliveryAdapter) {
1445:       await this.deliveryAdapter.sendVerification({
1446:         channel,
1447:         recipient: (channel === 'email' ? user.email : user.phone) as string,
1448:         otp: rawOtp,
1449:       });
1450:     }
1451: 
1452:     await this.logAudit({
1453:       merchantId: user.merchant_id,
1454:       userId: user.id,
1455:       actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1456:       action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_REQUESTED',
1457:       resource: `user:${user.id}`,
1458:       correlationId,
1459:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1460:       details: { delivered: true, channel },
1461:     });
1462: 
1463:     return genericResponse;
1464:   }
1465: 
1466:   private maskIdentifier(identifier: string): string {
1467:     if (identifier.includes('@')) {
1468:       const [local, domain] = identifier.split('@');
1469:       const visible = local.slice(0, 1);
1470:       return `${visible}${'*'.repeat(Math.max(3, local.length - 1))}@${domain}`;
1471:     }
1472:     if (identifier.length <= 4) return '*'.repeat(identifier.length);
1473:     return `${identifier.slice(0, 4)}${'*'.repeat(Math.max(3, identifier.length - 8))}${identifier.slice(-4)}`;
1474:   }
1475: 
1476:   /**
1477:    * Verify a login OTP and issue a session (FEAT-AUTH-03 / SCR-AUTH-01 / BR-AUTH-12).
1478:    * Error semantics follow FEAT-AUTH-01: OTP_ALREADY_CONSUMED / OTP_EXPIRED (410),
1479:    * INVALID_OTP (400), OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED (429). Status is re-checked at verify.
1480:    */
1481:   async verifyLoginOtp(dto: LoginOtpVerifyDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
1482:     if (this.config && !this.config.AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED) {
1483:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1484:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1485:         'AUTH_OTP_LOGIN_DISABLED',
1486:         'Đăng nhập bằng mã OTP chưa được bật cho hệ thống.',
1487:         false,
1488:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu'
1489:       );
1490:     }
1491: 
1492:     const fields: CanonicalFieldError[] = [];
1493:     if (!dto.identifier || dto.identifier.trim().length === 0) {
1494:       fields.push({
1495:         field: 'identifier',
1496:         code: 'REQUIRED',
1497:         message: 'Email hoặc số điện thoại không được để trống',
1498:       });
1499:     }
1500:     if (!dto.otp || dto.otp.trim().length === 0) {
1501:       fields.push({ field: 'otp', code: 'REQUIRED', message: 'Mã OTP không được để trống' });
1502:     }
1503:     if (fields.length > 0) {
1504:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1505:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1506:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1507:         'Thông tin xác thực OTP không hợp lệ',
1508:         false,
1509:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại thông tin',
1510:         fields
1511:       );
1512:     }
1513: 
1514:     const normalized = this.normalizeIdentifier(dto.identifier);
1515:     if (!normalized) {
1516:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1517:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1518:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1519:         'Định dạng email hoặc số điện thoại không hợp lệ',
1520:         false,
1521:         undefined,
1522:         [
1523:           {
1524:             field: 'identifier',
1525:             code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
1526:             message: 'Email hoặc số điện thoại không đúng định dạng Việt Nam',
1527:           },
1528:         ]
1529:       );
1530:     }
1531:     const channel: 'email' | 'phone' = normalized.email ? 'email' : 'phone';
1532: 
1533:     const otpLimit = await this.rateLimitService.checkOtpAttemptLimit(normalized.stored);
1534:     if (!otpLimit.allowed) {
1535:       await this.logAudit({
1536:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1537:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_RATE_LIMITED',
1538:         resource: 'auth/login',
1539:         correlationId,
1540:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1541:         details: { scope: 'otp_attempts' },
1542:       });
1543:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1544:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
1545:         'RATE_LIMITED',
1546:         otpLimit.reason || 'Quá nhiều lần thử mã OTP. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
1547:         true,
1548:         `Vui lòng chờ ${otpLimit.retryAfterSeconds || 900} giây trước khi thử lại`,
1549:         undefined,
1550:         otpLimit.retryAfterSeconds
1551:       );
1552:     }
1553: 
1554:     const tokenRecord = await this.prisma.verificationToken.findFirst({
1555:       where: { identifier: normalized.stored, channel, purpose: 'LOGIN' },
1556:       orderBy: { created_at: 'desc' },
1557:       include: { user: { include: { merchant: true } } },
1558:     });
1559: 
1560:     if (!tokenRecord) {
1561:       await this.rateLimitService.recordOtpFailure(normalized.stored);
1562:       await this.logAudit({
1563:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1564:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_FAILED',
1565:         resource: 'auth/login',
1566:         correlationId,
1567:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1568:         details: { reason: 'unknown_or_invalid' },
1569:       });
1570:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1571:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1572:         'INVALID_OTP',
1573:         'Mã OTP không chính xác hoặc không tồn tại',
1574:         false,
1575:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại mã OTP hoặc yêu cầu gửi mã mới'
1576:       );
1577:     }
1578: 
1579:     if (tokenRecord.consumed_at) {
1580:       await this.logAudit({
1581:         merchantId: tokenRecord.user.merchant_id,
1582:         userId: tokenRecord.user.id,
1583:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1584:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_FAILED',
1585:         resource: 'auth/login',
1586:         correlationId,
1587:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1588:         details: { reason: 'already_consumed' },
1589:       });
1590:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1591:         HttpStatus.GONE,
1592:         'OTP_ALREADY_CONSUMED',
1593:         'Mã OTP đã được sử dụng',
1594:         false,
1595:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu gửi mã OTP mới nếu bạn chưa đăng nhập thành công'
1596:       );
1597:     }
1598: 
1599:     if (tokenRecord.expires_at.getTime() <= Date.now()) {
1600:       await this.logAudit({
1601:         merchantId: tokenRecord.user.merchant_id,
1602:         userId: tokenRecord.user.id,
1603:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1604:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_FAILED',
1605:         resource: 'auth/login',
1606:         correlationId,
1607:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1608:         details: { reason: 'expired' },
1609:       });
1610:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1611:         HttpStatus.GONE,
1612:         'OTP_EXPIRED',
1613:         'Mã OTP đã hết hạn',
1614:         false,
1615:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu gửi mã OTP mới'
1616:       );
1617:     }
1618: 
1619:     const hashedOtp = this.hashSecret(dto.otp.trim());
1620:     if (tokenRecord.otp !== hashedOtp) {
1621:       const failCount = await this.rateLimitService.recordOtpFailure(normalized.stored);
1622:       if (failCount >= OTP_MAX_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS) {
1623:         await this.prisma.verificationToken.update({
1624:           where: { id: tokenRecord.id },
1625:           data: { consumed_at: new Date() },
1626:         });
1627:         await this.logAudit({
1628:           merchantId: tokenRecord.user.merchant_id,
1629:           userId: tokenRecord.user.id,
1630:           actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1631:           action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_FAILED',
1632:           resource: 'auth/login',
1633:           correlationId,
1634:           ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1635:           details: { reason: 'max_attempts_exceeded' },
1636:         });
1637:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
1638:           HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
1639:           'OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED',
1640:           'Bạn đã nhập sai mã OTP quá số lần cho phép',
1641:           false,
1642:           'Vui lòng yêu cầu gửi mã OTP mới'
1643:         );
1644:       }
1645:       await this.logAudit({
1646:         merchantId: tokenRecord.user.merchant_id,
1647:         userId: tokenRecord.user.id,
1648:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1649:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_FAILED',
1650:         resource: 'auth/login',
1651:         correlationId,
1652:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1653:         details: { reason: 'invalid_otp' },
1654:       });
1655:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1656:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1657:         'INVALID_OTP',
1658:         'Mã OTP không chính xác',
1659:         false,
1660:         `Vui lòng kiểm tra lại mã OTP (còn ${OTP_MAX_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS - failCount} lần thử)`
1661:       );
1662:     }
1663: 
1664:     // Atomic consume before any session issuance; blocked statuses consume the OTP
1665:     // because channel possession was proven, but no session is created (CD-6).
1666:     await this.prisma.verificationToken.update({
1667:       where: { id: tokenRecord.id },
1668:       data: { consumed_at: new Date() },
1669:     });
1670: 
1671:     await this.assertStatusAllowsLogin(tokenRecord.user, clientIp, correlationId);
1672: 
1673:     await this.rateLimitService.resetOtpAttempts(normalized.stored);
1674: 
1675:     // FEAT-AUTH-05: Check MFA factor enrollment (AC-AUTH-05-06, AC-AUTH-05-12)
1676:     const activeFactor = await this.prisma.mfaFactor.findFirst({
1677:       where: { user_id: tokenRecord.user.id, status: 'ACTIVE' },
1678:     });
1679: 
1680:     if (activeFactor) {
1681:       const rawChallenge = 'mfa_ch_' + randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
1682:       const challengeHash = createHash('sha256').update(rawChallenge).digest('hex');
1683:       const challengeTtlSeconds = 300;
1684: 
1685:       await this.prisma.mfaChallenge.create({
1686:         data: {
1687:           challenge_hash: challengeHash,
1688:           user_id: tokenRecord.user.id,
1689:           merchant_id: tokenRecord.user.merchant_id!,
1690:           login_transaction_ref: correlationId,
1691:           purpose: 'MFA_LOGIN',
1692:           expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + challengeTtlSeconds * 1000),
1693:           correlation_id: correlationId,
1694:         },
1695:       });
1696: 
1697:       return {
1698:         data: {
1699:           status: 'MFA_REQUIRED' as const,
1700:           challenge_id: rawChallenge,
1701:           expires_in: challengeTtlSeconds,
1702:         },
1703:         meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
1704:       };
1705:     }
1706: 
1707:     if (tokenRecord.user.role === RoleEnum.OWNER) {
1708:       const setupTtlSeconds = 600;
1709:       const secret = resolveAccessTokenSecret(this.config?.AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET);
1710:       const { token: setupToken } = signAccessToken(
1711:         {
1712:           sub: tokenRecord.user.id,
1713:           sid: 'mfa-setup-session',
1714:           mid: tokenRecord.user.merchant_id,
1715:           role: tokenRecord.user.role,
1716:           st: tokenRecord.user.status,
1717:           scope: 'setup',
1718:         },
1719:         secret,
1720:         setupTtlSeconds
1721:       );
1722: 
1723:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1724:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1725:         'MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED',
1726:         'Tài khoản Chủ shop (Owner) bắt buộc phải hoàn thành thiết lập xác thực hai yếu tố (MFA)',
1727:         false,
1728:         'Vui lòng hoàn thành thiết lập MFA bằng mã token được cấp',
1729:         undefined,
1730:         undefined,
1731:         {
1732:           setup_token: setupToken,
1733:           access_token: setupToken,
1734:           expires_in: setupTtlSeconds,
1735:         }
1736:       );
1737:     }
1738: 
1739:     return this.createLoginSessionAndResponse(
1740:       tokenRecord.user,
1741:       false,
1742:       clientIp,
1743:       correlationId,
1744:       'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_SUCCESS'
1745:     );
1746:   }
1747: 
1748:   /**
1749:    * Password login (FEAT-AUTH-03 / UC-AUTH-01 / BR-AUTH-11..13).
1750:    * Identical `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` response for unknown identifier and wrong password (CD-7).
1751:    */
1752:   async login(dto: LoginDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
1753:     const fields: CanonicalFieldError[] = [];
1754:     if (!dto.identifier || dto.identifier.trim().length === 0) {
1755:       fields.push({
1756:         field: 'identifier',
1757:         code: 'REQUIRED',
1758:         message: 'Email hoặc số điện thoại không được để trống',
1759:       });
1760:     }
1761:     if (!dto.password) {
1762:       fields.push({ field: 'password', code: 'REQUIRED', message: 'Mật khẩu không được để trống' });
1763:     }
1764:     if (fields.length > 0) {
1765:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1766:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1767:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1768:         'Thông tin đăng nhập không hợp lệ',
1769:         false,
1770:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại thông tin đăng nhập',
1771:         fields
1772:       );
1773:     }
1774: 
1775:     const normalized = this.normalizeIdentifier(dto.identifier);
1776:     if (!normalized) {
1777:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1778:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1779:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1780:         'Định dạng email hoặc số điện thoại không hợp lệ',
1781:         false,
1782:         undefined,
1783:         [
1784:           {
1785:             field: 'identifier',
1786:             code: 'INVALID_FORMAT',
1787:             message: 'Email hoặc số điện thoại không đúng định dạng Việt Nam',
1788:           },
1789:         ]
1790:       );
1791:     }
1792: 
1793:     // BR-AUTH-11: IP gate (max 10 attempts / 15 minutes), recorded upfront
1794:     const ipCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkLoginIpLimit(clientIp);
1795:     if (!ipCheck.allowed) {
1796:       await this.logAudit({
1797:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1798:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED',
1799:         resource: 'auth/login',
1800:         correlationId,
1801:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1802:         details: { scope: 'ip' },
1803:       });
1804:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1805:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
1806:         'RATE_LIMITED',
1807:         ipCheck.reason || 'Quá nhiều lần thử đăng nhập. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
1808:         true,
1809:         `Vui lòng chờ ${ipCheck.retryAfterSeconds || 900} giây trước khi thử lại`,
1810:         undefined,
1811:         ipCheck.retryAfterSeconds
1812:       );
1813:     }
1814:     await this.rateLimitService.recordLoginIpAttempt(clientIp);
1815: 
1816:     // BR-AUTH-11: identifier failure gate (max 5 failures / 15 minutes)
1817:     const identifierCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkLoginIdentifierFailureLimit(
1818:       normalized.stored
1819:     );
1820:     if (!identifierCheck.allowed) {
1821:       await this.logAudit({
1822:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1823:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED',
1824:         resource: 'auth/login',
1825:         correlationId,
1826:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1827:         details: { scope: 'identifier' },
1828:       });
1829:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1830:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
1831:         'RATE_LIMITED',
1832:         identifierCheck.reason || 'Quá nhiều lần đăng nhập thất bại. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
1833:         true,
1834:         `Vui lòng chờ ${identifierCheck.retryAfterSeconds || 900} giây trước khi thử lại`,
1835:         undefined,
1836:         identifierCheck.retryAfterSeconds
1837:       );
1838:     }
1839: 
1840:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
1841:       where: {
1842:         OR: [
1843:           ...(normalized.email ? [{ email: normalized.email }] : []),
1844:           ...(normalized.phone ? [{ phone: normalized.phone }] : []),
1845:         ],
1846:       },
1847:       include: { merchant: true },
1848:     });
1849: 
1850:     const passwordMatches = user
1851:       ? await verifyPassword(dto.password, user.password_hash).catch(() => false)
1852:       : false;
1853: 
1854:     if (!user || !passwordMatches) {
1855:       await this.rateLimitService.recordLoginIdentifierFailure(normalized.stored);
1856:       await this.logAudit({
1857:         merchantId: user?.merchant_id,
1858:         userId: user?.id,
1859:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1860:         action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_FAILED',
1861:         resource: 'auth/login',
1862:         correlationId,
1863:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
1864:         details: { reason: 'invalid_credentials' },
1865:       });
1866:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1867:         HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
1868:         'INVALID_CREDENTIALS',
1869:         'Email/số điện thoại hoặc mật khẩu không chính xác',
1870:         false,
1871:         'Vui lòng thử lại hoặc đặt lại mật khẩu nếu bạn đã quên'
1872:       );
1873:     }
1874: 
1875:     await this.assertStatusAllowsLogin(user, clientIp, correlationId);
1876: 
1877:     // Success resets the identifier failure counter only (the IP counter is not reset, CD-9)
1878:     await this.rateLimitService.resetLoginIdentifierFailures(normalized.stored);
1879: 
1880:     // FEAT-AUTH-05: Check MFA factor enrollment (AC-AUTH-05-05, AC-AUTH-05-12)
1881:     const activeFactor = await this.prisma.mfaFactor.findFirst({
1882:       where: { user_id: user.id, status: 'ACTIVE' },
1883:     });
1884: 
1885:     if (activeFactor) {
1886:       const rawChallenge = 'mfa_ch_' + randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
1887:       const challengeHash = createHash('sha256').update(rawChallenge).digest('hex');
1888:       const challengeTtlSeconds = 300;
1889: 
1890:       await this.prisma.mfaChallenge.create({
1891:         data: {
1892:           challenge_hash: challengeHash,
1893:           user_id: user.id,
1894:           merchant_id: user.merchant_id!,
1895:           login_transaction_ref: correlationId,
1896:           purpose: 'MFA_LOGIN',
1897:           expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + challengeTtlSeconds * 1000),
1898:           correlation_id: correlationId,
1899:         },
1900:       });
1901: 
1902:       return {
1903:         data: {
1904:           status: 'MFA_REQUIRED' as const,
1905:           challenge_id: rawChallenge,
1906:           expires_in: challengeTtlSeconds,
1907:         },
1908:         meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
1909:       };
1910:     }
1911: 
1912:     if (user.role === RoleEnum.OWNER) {
1913:       const setupTtlSeconds = 600;
1914:       const secret = resolveAccessTokenSecret(this.config?.AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET);
1915:       const { token: setupToken } = signAccessToken(
1916:         {
1917:           sub: user.id,
1918:           sid: 'mfa-setup-session',
1919:           mid: user.merchant_id,
1920:           role: user.role,
1921:           st: user.status,
1922:           scope: 'setup',
1923:         },
1924:         secret,
1925:         setupTtlSeconds
1926:       );
1927: 
1928:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1929:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1930:         'MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED',
1931:         'Tài khoản Chủ shop (Owner) bắt buộc phải hoàn thành thiết lập xác thực hai yếu tố (MFA)',
1932:         false,
1933:         'Vui lòng hoàn thành thiết lập MFA bằng mã token được cấp',
1934:         undefined,
1935:         undefined,
1936:         {
1937:           setup_token: setupToken,
1938:           access_token: setupToken,
1939:           expires_in: setupTtlSeconds,
1940:         }
1941:       );
1942:     }
1943: 
1944:     return this.createLoginSessionAndResponse(
1945:       user,
1946:       dto.remember_device === true,
1947:       clientIp,
1948:       correlationId,
1949:       'AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS'
1950:     );
1951:   }

1953:   /**
1954: 
1955:    * BR-AUTH-03 / BR-AUTH-10: resolve duplicate / pending account conflicts
1956:    */
1957:   private async resolveExistingAccountConflict(
1958:     existingUsers: Array<{
1959:       id: string;
1960:       merchant_id: string | null;
1961:       email: string | null;
1962:       phone: string | null;
1963:       status: string;
1964:       email_verified_at: Date | null;
1965:       phone_verified_at: Date | null;
1966:     }>,
1967:     email: string | undefined,
1968:     phone: string | undefined,
1969:     clientIp: string,
1970:     correlationId: string
1971:   ): Promise<{ data: Record<string, unknown>; meta: Record<string, unknown> } | null> {
1972:     const activeConflict = existingUsers.find(
1973:       (u) => u.status === 'active' || u.email_verified_at !== null || u.phone_verified_at !== null
1974:     );
1975: 
1976:     if (activeConflict) {
1977:       const conflictField = email && activeConflict.email === email ? 'email' : 'phone';
1978:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1979:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1980:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1981:         `${conflictField === 'email' ? 'Email' : 'Số điện thoại'} đã được đăng ký trên hệ thống`,
1982:         false,
1983:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập hoặc sử dụng thông tin liên lạc khác',
1984:         [
1985:           {
1986:             field: conflictField,
1987:             code: 'DUPLICATE',
1988:             message: `${conflictField === 'email' ? 'Email' : 'Số điện thoại'} đã được đăng ký`,
1989:           },
1990:         ]
1991:       );
1992:     }
1993: 
1994:     const pendingAccount = existingUsers.find((u) => u.status === 'pending_verification');
1995: 
1996:     if (pendingAccount) {
1997:       await this.rateLimitService.recordRegistrationAttempt(
1998:         undefined,
1999:         pendingAccount.email || undefined,
2000:         pendingAccount.phone || undefined
2001:       );
2002: 
2003:       await this.issueAndSendVerification(
2004:         pendingAccount,
2005:         pendingAccount.email || undefined,
2006:         pendingAccount.phone || undefined,
2007:         correlationId
2008:       );
2009: 
2010:       await this.logAudit({
2011:         merchantId: pendingAccount.merchant_id,
2012:         userId: pendingAccount.id,
2013:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2014:         action: 'AUTH_REGISTER_PENDING_RETRY',
2015:         resource: `user:${pendingAccount.id}`,
2016:         correlationId,
2017:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2018:       });
2019: 
2020:       return {
2021:         data: {
2022:           user_id: pendingAccount.id,
2023:           merchant_id: pendingAccount.merchant_id,
2024:           status: 'PENDING_VERIFICATION' as const,
2025:           email: pendingAccount.email || undefined,
2026:           phone: pendingAccount.phone || undefined,
2027:           message: 'Tài khoản đang chờ xác thực. Mã xác thực mới đã được gửi.',
2028:         },
2029:         meta: {
2030:           correlation_id: correlationId,
2031:         },
2032:       };
2033:     }
2034: 
2035:     return null;
2036:   }

2038:   /**
2039:    * Distinct, spec-mandated 403 outcomes for non-active statuses (BR-AUTH-13 / CD-6).
2040:    * Every blocked attempt is audited without credentials.
2041:    */
2042:   private async assertStatusAllowsLogin(
2043:     user: { id: string; merchant_id: string | null; status: string },
2044:     clientIp: string,
2045:     correlationId: string
2046:   ): Promise<void> {
2047:     if (user.status === 'active') return;
2048: 
2049:     const blockedByStatus: Record<string, { code: string; message: string; next_action: string }> =
2050:       {
2051:         pending_verification: {
2052:           code: 'AUTH_PENDING_VERIFICATION',
2053:           message:
2054:             'Tài khoản chưa được xác thực. Vui lòng xác thực qua liên kết email hoặc mã OTP đã gửi.',
2055:           next_action: 'Mở liên kết xác thực trong email hoặc yêu cầu gửi lại mã xác thực',
2056:         },
2057:         suspended: {
2058:           code: 'AUTH_ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED',
2059:           message: 'Tài khoản đã bị tạm ngưng. Vui lòng liên hệ bộ phận hỗ trợ Ship Dễ.',
2060:           next_action: 'Liên hệ CSKH Ship Dễ để được hỗ trợ kích hoạt lại tài khoản',
2061:         },
2062:         disabled: {
2063:           code: 'AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED',
2064:           message: 'Tài khoản đã bị vô hiệu hóa.',
2065:           next_action: 'Liên hệ chủ cửa hàng hoặc CSKH Ship Dễ để biết thêm chi tiết',
2066:         },
2067:         invited: {
2068:           code: 'AUTH_INVITATION_PENDING',
2069:           message: 'Lời mời tham gia cửa hàng chưa được chấp nhận.',
2070:           next_action: 'Làm theo hướng dẫn trong lời mời để kích hoạt tài khoản',
2071:         },
2072:       };
2073: 
2074:     const blocked = blockedByStatus[user.status];
2075:     if (!blocked) return;
2076: 
2077:     await this.logAudit({
2078:       merchantId: user.merchant_id,
2079:       userId: user.id,
2080:       actor: `user:${user.id}`,
2081:       action: 'AUTH_LOGIN_BLOCKED_STATUS',
2082:       resource: `user:${user.id}`,
2083:       correlationId,
2084:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2085:       details: { status: user.status },
2086:     });
2087: 
2088:     throw new CanonicalApiException(
2089:       HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
2090:       blocked.code,
2091:       blocked.message,
2092:       false,
2093:       blocked.next_action
2094:     );
2095:   }

2097:   /**
2098:    * Normalizes a login identifier to its canonical stored form.
2099:    * Email is lowercased; Vietnamese phone accepts 0/+84/84 prefixes and stores the 0-prefixed form.
2100:    */
2101:   private normalizeIdentifier(raw: string): {
2102:     email?: string;
2103:     phone?: string;
2104:     stored: string;
2105:   } | null {
2106:     const trimmed = raw.trim();
2107:     if (trimmed.includes('@')) {
2108:       const email = trimmed.toLowerCase();
2109:       if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) return null;
2110:       return { email, stored: email };
2111:     }
2112: 
2113:     const digits = trimmed.replace(/[\s.\-()]/g, '');
2114:     let phone: string;
2115:     if (digits.startsWith('+84')) {
2116:       phone = `0${digits.slice(3)}`;
2117:     } else if (digits.startsWith('84') && digits.length === 11) {
2118:       phone = `0${digits.slice(2)}`;
2119:     } else {
2120:       phone = digits;
2121:     }
2122:     if (!/^0[3|5|7|8|9][0-9]{8}$/.test(phone)) return null;
2123:     return { phone, stored: phone };
2124:   }

2126:   /**
2127:    * Creates the device session row, signs the access token, audits and returns the
2128:    * canonical AUTHENTICATED response (CD-1..2).
2129:    */
2130:   private async createLoginSessionAndResponse(
2131:     user: {
2132:       id: string;
2133:       merchant_id: string | null;
2134:       full_name: string;
2135:       email: string | null;
2136:       phone: string | null;
2137:       role: RoleEnum;
2138:       status: string;
2139:       email_verified_at: Date | null;
2140:       phone_verified_at: Date | null;
2141:       created_at: Date;
2142:       merchant: {
2143:         id: string;
2144:         name: string;
2145:         code: string;
2146:         status: string;
2147:         created_at: Date;
2148:       } | null;
2149:     },
2150:     rememberDevice: boolean,
2151:     clientIp: string,
2152:     correlationId: string,
2153:     auditAction: 'AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS' | 'AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_SUCCESS' | 'AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_SUCCEEDED',
2154:     authAssurance: 'PASSWORD' | 'MFA' = 'PASSWORD',
2155:     mfaVerifiedAt: Date | null = null
2156:   ) {
2157:     const ttlSeconds = this.config?.AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS ?? 43200;
2158:     const merchant = user.merchant;
2159: 
2160:     const sessionId = randomUUID();
2161:     const secret = resolveAccessTokenSecret(this.config?.AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET);
2162:     const { token } = signAccessToken(
2163:       {
2164:         sub: user.id,
2165:         sid: sessionId,
2166:         mid: user.merchant_id,
2167:         role: user.role,
2168:         st: user.status,
2169:         auth_assurance: authAssurance,
2170:         mfa_verified_at: mfaVerifiedAt ? mfaVerifiedAt.toISOString() : undefined,
2171:       },
2172:       secret,
2173:       ttlSeconds
2174:     );
2175: 
2176:     const session = await this.prisma.deviceSession.create({
2177:       data: {
2178:         id: sessionId,
2179:         user_id: user.id,
2180:         merchant_id: user.merchant_id,
2181:         session_token_hash: createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex'),
2182:         device_id: rememberDevice ? 'web-remember' : 'web-session',
2183:         last_active_at: new Date(),
2184:         expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
2185:         ip_address: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2186:         auth_assurance: authAssurance,
2187:         mfa_verified_at: mfaVerifiedAt,
2188:       },
2189:     });
2190: 
2191:     await this.logAudit({
2192:       merchantId: user.merchant_id,
2193:       userId: user.id,
2194:       actor: `user:${user.id}`,
2195:       action: auditAction,
2196:       resource: `user:${user.id}`,
2197:       correlationId,
2198:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2199:       details: { session_id: session.id, role: user.role, auth_assurance: authAssurance },
2200:     });
2201: 
2202:     return {
2203:       data: {
2204:         status: 'AUTHENTICATED' as const,
2205:         access_token: token,
2206:         expires_in: ttlSeconds,
2207:         user: {
2208:           id: user.id,
2209:           merchant_id: user.merchant_id,
2210:           full_name: user.full_name,
2211:           email: user.email,
2212:           phone: user.phone,
2213:           role: user.role,
2214:           status: user.status.toUpperCase(),
2215:           email_verified_at: user.email_verified_at ? user.email_verified_at.toISOString() : null,
2216:           phone_verified_at: user.phone_verified_at ? user.phone_verified_at.toISOString() : null,
2217:           created_at: user.created_at.toISOString(),
2218:           auth_assurance: authAssurance,
2219:           mfa_verified_at: mfaVerifiedAt ? mfaVerifiedAt.toISOString() : null,
2220:         },
2221:         merchant: merchant
2222:           ? {
2223:               id: merchant.id,
2224:               name: merchant.name,
2225:               business_code: merchant.code,
2226:               status: merchant.status,
2227:               created_at: merchant.created_at.toISOString(),
2228:             }
2229:           : null,
2230:       },
2231:       meta: {
2232:         correlation_id: correlationId,
2233:       },
2234:     };
2235:   }
2236: 
2237:   private isUniqueConstraintViolation(err: unknown): boolean {
2238:     return typeof err === 'object' && err !== null && (err as { code?: string }).code === 'P2002';
2239:   }

2241:   private async issueAndSendVerification(
2242:     user: { id: string; email: string | null; phone: string | null },
2243:     email?: string,
2244:     phone?: string,
2245:     correlationId?: string
2246:   ): Promise<void> {
2247:     if (email) {
2248:       const rawEmailToken = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
2249:       const hashedToken = this.hashSecret(rawEmailToken);
2250:       await this.prisma.verificationToken.create({
2251:         data: {
2252:           user_id: user.id,
2253:           token: hashedToken,
2254:           channel: 'email',
2255:           identifier: email,
2256:           expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
2257:         },
2258:       });
2259: 
2260:       if (this.deliveryAdapter) {
2261:         await this.deliveryAdapter.sendVerification({
2262:           channel: 'email',
2263:           recipient: email,
2264:           token: rawEmailToken,
2265:         });
2266:       }
2267:     }
2268: 
2269:     if (phone) {
2270:       const rawOtp = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();
2271:       const hashedOtp = this.hashSecret(rawOtp);
2272:       const rawPhoneToken = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
2273:       const hashedToken = this.hashSecret(rawPhoneToken);
2274: 
2275:       await this.prisma.verificationToken.create({
2276:         data: {
2277:           user_id: user.id,
2278:           token: hashedToken,
2279:           channel: 'phone',
2280:           identifier: phone,
2281:           otp: hashedOtp,
2282:           expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000),
2283:         },
2284:       });
2285: 
2286:       if (this.deliveryAdapter) {
2287:         await this.deliveryAdapter.sendVerification({
2288:           channel: 'phone',
2289:           recipient: phone,
2290:           otp: rawOtp,
2291:           token: rawPhoneToken,
2292:         });
2293:       }
2294:     }
2295:   }
