2297:   private generateMerchantCode(merchantName: string): string {
2298:     const slug = merchantName
2299:       .normalize('NFD')
2300:       .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
2301:       .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')
2302:       .toUpperCase()
2303:       .replace(/_+/g, '_')
2304:       .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '')
2305:       .substring(0, 20);
2306:     const rand = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
2307:     return `${slug || 'SHOP'}_${rand}`;
2308:   }
2309: 
2310:   private hashSecret(secret: string): string {
2311:     return createHash('sha256').update(secret).digest('hex');
2312:   }
2313: 
2314:   private hashIdentifierForAudit(identifier: string): string {
2315:     const key =
2316:       this.config?.AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY || 'default-dev-audit-hmac-key-override-32-chars';
2317:     return createHmac('sha256', key).update(identifier).digest('hex').substring(0, 16);
2318:   }
2319: 
2320:   private hashIp(ip: string): string {
2321:     return createHash('sha256').update(ip).digest('hex').substring(0, 16);
2322:   }
2323: 
2324:   private async logAudit(meta: {
2325:     merchantId?: string | null;
2326:     userId?: string | null;
2327:     actor: string;
2328:     action: string;
2329:     resource: string;
2330:     details?: Record<string, unknown>;
2331:     ipAddress?: string;
2332:     correlationId?: string;
2333:   }): Promise<void> {
2334:     console.log(
2335:       formatStructuredLog({
2336:         level: 'info',
2337:         service: 'api',
2338:         message: `AUDIT: ${meta.action} on ${meta.resource} by ${meta.actor}`,
2339:         metadata: {
2340:           ...meta,
2341:           timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
2342:         },
2343:       })
2344:     );
2345: 
2346:     try {
2347:       await this.prisma.auditLog.create({
2348:         data: {
2349:           merchant_id: meta.merchantId || null,
2350:           user_id: meta.userId || null,
2351:           actor: meta.actor || null,
2352:           action: meta.action,
2353:           entity_type: meta.resource.split(':')[0] || 'Auth',
2354:           entity_id: meta.resource.split(':')[1] || meta.userId || 'system',
2355:           new_value: meta.details ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(meta.details)) : null,
2356:           ip_address: meta.ipAddress || null,
2357:         },
2358:       });
2359:     } catch (err) {
2360:       console.error('Failed to persist audit log to database:', err);
2361:     }
2362:   }

2364:   /**
2365:    * GET /auth/mfa/status (API-AUTH-MFA-STATUS, FEAT-AUTH-05)
2366:    */
2367:   async getMfaStatus(userId: string, merchantId: string, role?: string, correlationId?: string) {
2368:     const factor = await this.prisma.mfaFactor.findFirst({
2369:       where: { user_id: userId, status: { in: ['ACTIVE', 'PENDING', 'RESET'] } },
2370:       orderBy: { created_at: 'desc' },
2371:     });
2372: 
2373:     let effectiveStatus: 'NOT_ENROLLED' | 'PENDING' | 'ACTIVE' | 'RESET' = 'NOT_ENROLLED';
2374:     if (factor) {
2375:       if (factor.status === 'ACTIVE') {
2376:         effectiveStatus = 'ACTIVE';
2377:       } else if (factor.status === 'PENDING') {
2378:         if (factor.setup_expires_at && factor.setup_expires_at < new Date()) {
2379:           effectiveStatus = 'NOT_ENROLLED';
2380:         } else {
2381:           effectiveStatus = 'PENDING';
2382:         }
2383:       } else if (factor.status === 'RESET') {
2384:         effectiveStatus = 'RESET';
2385:       }
2386:     }
2387: 
2388:     let recoveryCodesRemaining = 0;
2389:     if (effectiveStatus === 'ACTIVE' && factor) {
2390:       recoveryCodesRemaining = await this.prisma.mfaRecoveryCode.count({
2391:         where: { factor_id: factor.id, consumed_at: null },
2392:       });
2393:     }
2394: 
2395:     const isRequired = role === RoleEnum.OWNER || role === 'OWNER';
2396: 
2397:     return {
2398:       data: {
2399:         status: effectiveStatus,
2400:         required: isRequired,
2401:         recovery_codes_remaining: recoveryCodesRemaining,
2402:         mfa_verified_at: factor?.activated_at ? factor.activated_at.toISOString() : null,
2403:       },
2404:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId() },
2405:     };
2406:   }

2408:   /**
2409:    * POST /auth/mfa/setup (API-AUTH-MFA-SETUP, FEAT-AUTH-05, BR-AUTH-14, AC-AUTH-05-01)
2410:    */
2411:   async startMfaSetup(
2412:     userId: string,
2413:     merchantId: string,
2414:     dto: MfaSetupDto,
2415:     clientIp: string,
2416:     correlationId: string
2417:   ) {
2418:     if (!dto.password) {
2419:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2420:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2421:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
2422:         'Mật khẩu là bắt buộc để bắt đầu thiết lập MFA',
2423:         false,
2424:         'Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu đăng nhập'
2425:       );
2426:     }
2427: 
2428:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
2429:     if (!user) {
2430:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2431:         HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
2432:         'UNAUTHENTICATED',
2433:         'Người dùng không tồn tại'
2434:       );
2435:     }
2436: 
2437:     const passwordMatches = await verifyPassword(dto.password, user.password_hash).catch(
2438:       () => false
2439:     );
2440:     if (!passwordMatches) {
2441:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2442:         HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
2443:         'INVALID_CREDENTIALS',
2444:         'Mật khẩu xác thực không chính xác',
2445:         false
2446:       );
2447:     }
2448: 
2449:     const activeFactor = await this.prisma.mfaFactor.findFirst({
2450:       where: { user_id: userId, status: 'ACTIVE' },
2451:     });
2452:     if (activeFactor) {
2453:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2454:         HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
2455:         'MFA_ALREADY_ENABLED',
2456:         'Tài khoản đã có phương thức xác thực hai yếu tố đang hoạt động',
2457:         false
2458:       );
2459:     }
2460: 
2461:     await this.prisma.mfaFactor.deleteMany({
2462:       where: { user_id: userId, status: 'PENDING' },
2463:     });
2464: 
2465:     const secret = generateTotpSecret();
2466:     const encryptionKey = resolveMfaEncryptionKey(this.config?.MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY);
2467:     const encryptedSecret = encryptMfaSecret(secret, encryptionKey);
2468:     const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000); // 10 minutes
2469: 
2470:     await this.prisma.mfaFactor.create({
2471:       data: {
2472:         user_id: userId,
2473:         merchant_id: merchantId,
2474:         type: 'TOTP',
2475:         status: 'PENDING',
2476:         secret_ciphertext: encryptedSecret,
2477:         key_version: 1,
2478:         setup_expires_at: expiresAt,
2479:         created_by: userId,
2480:       },
2481:     });
2482: 
2483:     await this.logAudit({
2484:       merchantId,
2485:       userId,
2486:       actor: `user:${userId}`,
2487:       action: 'AUTH_MFA_SETUP_STARTED',
2488:       resource: `user:${userId}`,
2489:       correlationId,
2490:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2491:       details: { expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString() },
2492:     });
2493: 
2494:     const accountIdentifier = user.email || user.phone || user.id;
2495:     const uri = generateProvisioningUri({
2496:       secret,
2497:       accountName: accountIdentifier,
2498:       issuer: 'Ship Dễ',
2499:     });
2500: 
2501:     return {
2502:       data: {
2503:         secret_key: secret,
2504:         provisioning_uri: uri,
2505:         expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
2506:         expires_in_seconds: 600,
2507:       },
2508:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
2509:     };
2510:   }

2512:   /**
2513:    * POST /auth/mfa/setup/verify (API-AUTH-MFA-SETUP-VERIFY, FEAT-AUTH-05, BR-AUTH-15, AC-AUTH-05-02..04)
2514:    */
2515:   async verifyMfaSetup(
2516:     userId: string,
2517:     merchantId: string,
2518:     dto: MfaSetupVerifyDto,
2519:     clientIp: string,
2520:     correlationId: string
2521:   ) {
2522:     if (!dto.code || !/^\d{6}$/.test(dto.code.trim())) {
2523:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2524:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2525:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
2526:         'Mã xác thực gồm 6 chữ số',
2527:         false,
2528:         undefined,
2529:         [{ field: 'code', code: 'INVALID_FORMAT', message: 'Mã xác thực phải gồm 6 chữ số' }]
2530:       );
2531:     }
2532: 
2533:     const factor = await this.prisma.mfaFactor.findFirst({
2534:       where: { user_id: userId, status: 'PENDING' },
2535:       orderBy: { created_at: 'desc' },
2536:       include: { user: { include: { merchant: true } } },
2537:     });
2538: 
2539:     if (!factor) {
2540:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2541:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2542:         'MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID',
2543:         'Không tìm thấy phiên thiết lập MFA đang chờ'
2544:       );
2545:     }
2546: 
2547:     if (factor.setup_expires_at && factor.setup_expires_at < new Date()) {
2548:       await this.logAudit({
2549:         merchantId,
2550:         userId,
2551:         actor: `user:${userId}`,
2552:         action: 'AUTH_MFA_SETUP_EXPIRED',
2553:         resource: `user:${userId}`,
2554:         correlationId,
2555:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2556:         details: { expired_at: factor.setup_expires_at.toISOString() },
2557:       });
2558:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2559:         HttpStatus.GONE,
2560:         'MFA_SETUP_EXPIRED',
2561:         'Phiên thiết lập MFA đã hết hạn (10 phút). Vui lòng bắt đầu lại.',
2562:         false,
2563:         'Vui lòng bắt đầu lại thiết lập xác thực hai yếu tố'
2564:       );
2565:     }
2566: 
2567:     const encryptionKey = resolveMfaEncryptionKey(this.config?.MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY);
2568:     const secret = decryptMfaSecret(factor.secret_ciphertext, encryptionKey);
2569:     const verifyResult = verifyTotpCode(dto.code, secret, factor.last_accepted_step);
2570: 
2571:     if (!verifyResult.valid) {
2572:       if (verifyResult.error === 'STEP_REPLAYED') {
2573:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
2574:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2575:           'MFA_CODE_INVALID',
2576:           'Mã xác thực đã được sử dụng. Vui lòng chờ mã mới từ ứng dụng.',
2577:           false
2578:         );
2579:       }
2580:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2581:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2582:         'MFA_CODE_INVALID',
2583:         'Mã xác thực không chính xác',
2584:         false
2585:       );
2586:     }
2587: 
2588:     const { plaintext: recoveryCodes, hashes: recoveryHashes } = generateRecoveryCodes(10);
2589:     const now = new Date();
2590: 
2591:     await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
2592:       const activeCheck = await tx.mfaFactor.findFirst({
2593:         where: { user_id: userId, status: 'ACTIVE' },
2594:       });
2595:       if (activeCheck) {
2596:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
2597:           HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
2598:           'CONFLICT',
2599:           'Tài khoản đã có phương thức xác thực MFA đang hoạt động'
2600:         );
2601:       }
2602: 
2603:       const updateResult = await tx.mfaFactor.updateMany({
2604:         where: { id: factor.id, status: 'PENDING' },
2605:         data: {
2606:           status: 'ACTIVE',
2607:           activated_at: now,
2608:           last_accepted_step: verifyResult.acceptedStep,
2609:           updated_by: userId,
2610:         },
2611:       });
2612: 
2613:       if (updateResult.count === 0) {
2614:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
2615:           HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
2616:           'CONFLICT',
2617:           'Phiên thiết lập đã thay đổi hoặc đang được xử lý'
2618:         );
2619:       }
2620: 
2621:       await tx.mfaRecoveryCode.createMany({
2622:         data: recoveryHashes.map((h) => ({
2623:           factor_id: factor.id,
2624:           code_hash: h,
2625:         })),
2626:       });
2627:     });
2628: 
2629:     await this.logAudit({
2630:       merchantId,
2631:       userId,
2632:       actor: `user:${userId}`,
2633:       action: 'AUTH_MFA_SETUP_COMPLETED',
2634:       resource: `user:${userId}`,
2635:       correlationId,
2636:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2637:       details: { factor_id: factor.id },
2638:     });
2639: 
2640:     const user = factor.user;
2641:     const sessionRes = await this.createLoginSessionAndResponse(
2642:       user,
2643:       false,
2644:       clientIp,
2645:       correlationId,
2646:       'AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS',
2647:       'MFA',
2648:       now
2649:     );
2650: 
2651:     return {
2652:       data: {
2653:         status: 'AUTHENTICATED' as const,
2654:         recovery_codes: recoveryCodes,
2655:         access_token: sessionRes.data.access_token,
2656:         expires_in: sessionRes.data.expires_in,
2657:         user: sessionRes.data.user,
2658:         merchant: sessionRes.data.merchant,
2659:       },
2660:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
2661:     };
2662:   }

2664:   /**
2665:    * POST /auth/mfa/challenge/verify (API-AUTH-MFA-CHALLENGE-VERIFY, FEAT-AUTH-05, BR-AUTH-16, AC-AUTH-05-07..08, AC-AUTH-05-16, AC-AUTH-05-24)
2666:    */
2667:   async verifyMfaChallenge(dto: MfaChallengeVerifyDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
2668:     const ipCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkMfaIpLimit(clientIp);
2669:     if (!ipCheck.allowed) {
2670:       await this.logAudit({
2671:         actor: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2672:         action: 'AUTH_MFA_RATE_LIMITED',
2673:         resource: 'auth/mfa/challenge/verify',
2674:         correlationId,
2675:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2676:         details: { scope: 'ip' },
2677:       });
2678:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2679:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
2680:         'RATE_LIMITED',
2681:         ipCheck.reason || 'Quá nhiều lần thử xác thực hai yếu tố từ IP này.',
2682:         true,
2683:         'Vui lòng thử lại sau',
2684:         undefined,
2685:         ipCheck.retryAfterSeconds
2686:       );
2687:     }
2688: 
2689:     if (!dto.challenge_id || !dto.code || !/^\d{6}$/.test(dto.code.trim())) {
2690:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2691:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2692:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
2693:         'Mã thử thách và mã xác thực 6 chữ số là bắt buộc'
2694:       );
2695:     }
2696: 
2697:     const challengeHash = createHash('sha256').update(dto.challenge_id).digest('hex');
2698: 
2699:     const challengeLimitCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkMfaChallengeLimit(challengeHash);
2700:     if (!challengeLimitCheck.allowed) {
2701:       await this.rateLimitService.recordMfaIpFailure(clientIp);
2702:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2703:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
2704:         'RATE_LIMITED',
2705:         challengeLimitCheck.reason || 'Đã vượt quá số lần thử cho phép.',
2706:         true,
2707:         'Vui lòng thử lại sau',
2708:         undefined,
2709:         challengeLimitCheck.retryAfterSeconds
2710:       );
2711:     }
2712: 
2713:     const challenge = await this.prisma.mfaChallenge.findUnique({
2714:       where: { challenge_hash: challengeHash },
2715:       include: { user: { include: { merchant: true } } },
2716:     });
2717: 
2718:     const now = new Date();
2719:     if (
2720:       !challenge ||
2721:       challenge.consumed_at !== null ||
2722:       challenge.invalidated_at !== null ||
2723:       challenge.expires_at < now ||
2724:       challenge.failed_attempts >= 5
2725:     ) {
2726:       await this.rateLimitService.recordMfaIpFailure(clientIp);
2727:       await this.rateLimitService.recordMfaChallengeFailure(challengeHash);
2728:       if (challenge) {
2729:         await this.logAudit({
2730:           merchantId: challenge.merchant_id,
2731:           userId: challenge.user_id,
2732:           actor: `user:${challenge.user_id}`,
2733:           action: 'AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_FAILED',
2734:           resource: `user:${challenge.user_id}`,
2735:           correlationId,
2736:           ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2737:           details: { reason: 'challenge_expired_or_invalid' },
2738:         });
2739:       }
2740:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2741:         HttpStatus.GONE,
2742:         'MFA_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED',
2743:         'Mã thử thách xác thực đã hết hạn hoặc không hợp lệ. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.'
2744:       );
2745:     }
2746: 
2747:     if (challenge.user.status !== 'active') {
2748:       await this.rateLimitService.recordMfaIpFailure(clientIp);
2749:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2750:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
2751:         'MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID',
2752:         'Tài khoản không ở trạng thái hợp lệ để đăng nhập'
2753:       );
2754:     }
2755: 
2756:     const factor = await this.prisma.mfaFactor.findFirst({
2757:       where: { user_id: challenge.user_id, status: 'ACTIVE' },
2758:     });
2759: 
2760:     if (!factor) {
2761:       await this.rateLimitService.recordMfaIpFailure(clientIp);
2762:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2763:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2764:         'MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID',
2765:         'Không tìm thấy phương thức xác thực hai yếu tố hợp lệ'
2766:       );
2767:     }
2768: 
2769:     const encryptionKey = resolveMfaEncryptionKey(this.config?.MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY);
2770:     const secret = decryptMfaSecret(factor.secret_ciphertext, encryptionKey);
2771:     const verifyResult = verifyTotpCode(dto.code, secret, factor.last_accepted_step);
2772: 
2773:     if (!verifyResult.valid) {
2774:       await this.prisma.mfaChallenge.update({
2775:         where: { id: challenge.id },
2776:         data: { failed_attempts: { increment: 1 } },
2777:       });
2778:       await this.rateLimitService.recordMfaIpFailure(clientIp);
2779:       await this.rateLimitService.recordMfaChallengeFailure(challengeHash);
2780: 
2781:       await this.logAudit({
2782:         merchantId: challenge.merchant_id,
2783:         userId: challenge.user_id,
2784:         actor: `user:${challenge.user_id}`,
2785:         action: 'AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_FAILED',
2786:         resource: `user:${challenge.user_id}`,
2787:         correlationId,
2788:         ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
2789:         details: { reason: verifyResult.error || 'invalid_totp' },
2790:       });
2791: 
2792:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2793:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2794:         'MFA_CODE_INVALID',
2795:         'Mã xác thực không chính xác'
2796:       );
2797:     }
2798: 
2799:     await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
2800:       await tx.mfaChallenge.update({
2801:         where: { id: challenge.id },
2802:         data: { consumed_at: now },
2803:       });
2804:       await tx.mfaFactor.update({
2805:         where: { id: factor.id },
2806:         data: { last_accepted_step: verifyResult.acceptedStep },
2807:       });
2808:     });
2809: 
2810:     await this.rateLimitService.resetMfaChallengeFailures(challengeHash);
2811: 
2812:     return this.createLoginSessionAndResponse(
2813:       challenge.user,
2814:       false,
2815:       clientIp,
2816:       correlationId,
2817:       'AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_SUCCEEDED',
2818:       'MFA',
2819:       now
2820:     );
2821:   }
2822: 
2823:   /**
2824:    * POST /auth/mfa/recovery/verify (API-AUTH-MFA-RECOVERY-VERIFY, FEAT-AUTH-05, BR-AUTH-17, AC-AUTH-05-09..10, AC-AUTH-05-23)
2825:    */
2826:   async verifyMfaRecovery(dto: MfaRecoveryVerifyDto, clientIp: string, correlationId: string) {
2827:     const ipCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkMfaIpLimit(clientIp);
2828:     if (!ipCheck.allowed) {
2829:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2830:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
2831:         'RATE_LIMITED',
2832:         ipCheck.reason || 'Quá nhiều lần thử từ IP này.',
2833:         true,
2834:         undefined,
2835:         undefined,
2836:         ipCheck.retryAfterSeconds
2837:       );
2838:     }
2839: 
2840:     if (!dto.challenge_id || !dto.recovery_code) {
2841:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
2842:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
2843:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
2844:         'Mã thử thách và mã dự phòng là bắt buộc'
2845:       );
2846:     }
2847: 
2848:     const challengeHash = createHash('sha256').update(dto.challenge_id).digest('hex');
2849:     const challenge = await this.prisma.mfaChallenge.findUnique({
2850:       where: { challenge_hash: challengeHash },
2851:       include: { user: { include: { merchant: true } } },
2852:     });
2853: 
2854:     const now = new Date();
2855:     if (
2856:       !challenge ||
2857:       challenge.consumed_at !== null ||
2858:       challenge.invalidated_at !== null ||
2859:       challenge.expires_at < now ||

3073:   /**
3074:    * Generates a strong temporary password (>= 12 characters) using CSPRNG with rejection sampling
3075:    * and Fisher-Yates shuffle (Finding 6).
3076:    */
3077:   public generateTemporaryPassword(): string {
3078:     const upper = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
3079:     const lower = 'abcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';
3080:     const digits = '23456789';
3081:     const special = '!@#$%^&*';
3082: 
3083:     const getChars = (set: string, count: number) => {
3084:       let res = '';
3085:       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
3086:         res += set[randomInt(set.length)];
3087:       }
3088:       return res;
3089:     };
3090: 
3091:     const combined = [
3092:       getChars(upper, 3),
3093:       getChars(lower, 4),
3094:       getChars(digits, 3),
3095:       getChars(special, 2),
3096:     ].join('');
3097: 
3098:     // Uniform Fisher-Yates shuffle using cryptographically secure random integers (CSPRNG)
3099:     const arr = combined.split('');
3100:     for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
3101:       const j = randomInt(i + 1);
3102:       [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
3103:     }
3104:     return arr.join('');
3105:   }

3438: 
3439:     if (!merchant || !user) {
3440:       if (lastError instanceof CanonicalApiException) {
3441:         throw lastError;
3442:       }
3443:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
3444:         HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
3445:         'MERCHANT_CODE_COLLISION',
3446:         'Không thể tạo mã cửa hàng duy nhất sau nhiều lần thử',
3447:         true,
3448:         'Vui lòng thử lại với tên cửa hàng khác'
3449:       );
3450:     }
3451: 
3452:     // 7. Post-commit setup token delivery with reconciliation support (Finding 5)
3453:     // External delivery adapter is invoked outside $transaction after DB commit.
3454:     if (passwordIsTemporary && rawSetupToken && this.deliveryAdapter) {
3455:       const baseUrl = this.config?.FRONTEND_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
3456:       const channel = email ? 'email' : 'phone';
3457:       const identifier = (email || phone)!;
3458:       try {
3459:         await this.deliveryAdapter.sendVerification({
3460:           channel,
3461:           recipient: identifier,
3462:           purpose: 'password_reset',
3463:           link: `${baseUrl}/reset-password?token=${rawSetupToken}`,
3464:         });
3465:       } catch (deliverErr: any) {
3466:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
3467:           HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
3468:           'DELIVERY_FAILED',
3469:           'Không thể gửi liên kết thiết lập tài khoản qua email/số điện thoại',
3470:           true,
3471:           'Vui lòng thử lại sau',
3472:           [
3473:             {
3474:               field: channel,
3475:               code: 'DELIVERY_FAILED',
3476:               message: 'Gửi thông báo thiết lập thất bại',
3477:             },
3478:           ]
3479:         );
3480:       }
3481:     }
3482: 
3483:     // 7. Audit log (No PII)
3484:     await this.logAudit({
3485:       merchantId: merchant.id,
3486:       userId: user.id,
3487:       actor: actor || 'operator',
3488:       action: 'ADMIN_CREATE_SHOP',
3489:       resource: `merchant:${merchant.id}`,
3490:       correlationId,
3491:       ipAddress: this.hashIp(clientIp),
3492:       details: {
3493:         merchant_code: merchant.code,
3494:         password_is_temporary: passwordIsTemporary,
3495:         has_email: Boolean(email),
3496:         has_phone: Boolean(phone),
3497:       },
3498:     });
3499: 
3500:     return {
3501:       success: true,
3502:       data: {
3503:         merchant: {
3504:           id: merchant.id,
3505:           name: merchant.name,
3506:           code: merchant.code,
3507:           status: merchant.status,
3508:           created_at: merchant.created_at,
3509:         },
3510:         user: {
3511:           id: user.id,
3512:           merchant_id: user.merchant_id,
3513:           full_name: user.full_name,
3514:           email: user.email,
3515:           phone: user.phone,
3516:           role: user.role,
3517:           status: user.status,
3518:           email_verified_at: user.email_verified_at,
3519:           phone_verified_at: user.phone_verified_at,
3520:         },
3521:         password_is_temporary: passwordIsTemporary,
3522:       },
3523:       meta: {
3524:         correlation_id: correlationId,
3525:       },
3526:     };
3527:   }
3528: 
3529:   /**
3530:    * FEAT-AUTH-02: Admin list shops
3531:    */
3532:   async adminListShops(
3533:     query: AdminListShopsQuery,
3534:     correlationId: string
3535:   ): Promise<{
3536:     success: boolean;
3537:     data: { shops: any[]; total: number };
3538:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
3539:   }> {
3540:     const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(query.limit) || 20, 1), 100);
3541:     const offset = Math.max(Number(query.offset) || 0, 0);
3542:     const search = query.search?.trim();
3543: 
3544:     const where: any = search
3545:       ? {
3546:           OR: [
3547:             { name: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
3548:             { code: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
3549:           ],
3550:         }
3551:       : {};
3552: 
3553:     const [total, merchants] = await Promise.all([
3554:       this.prisma.merchant.count({ where }),
3555:       this.prisma.merchant.findMany({
3556:         where,
3557:         take: limit,
3558:         skip: offset,
3559:         orderBy: { created_at: 'desc' },
3560:         include: {
3561:           users: {
3562:             where: { role: RoleEnum.OWNER },
3563:             take: 1,
3564:             select: {
3565:               id: true,
3566:               full_name: true,
3567:               email: true,
3568:               phone: true,
3569:               status: true,
3570:             },
3571:           },
3572:           _count: {
3573:             select: { users: true },
3574:           },
3575:         },
3576:       }),
3577:     ]);
3578: 
3579:     const formattedShops = merchants.map((m) => {
3580:       const owner = m.users[0] || null;
3581:       return {
3582:         id: m.id,
3583:         name: m.name,
3584:         code: m.code,
3585:         status: m.status,
3586:         created_at: m.created_at,
3587:         user_count: m._count.users,
3588:         owner: owner
3589:           ? {
3590:               id: owner.id,
3591:               full_name: owner.full_name,
3592:               email: owner.email,
3593:               phone: owner.phone,
3594:             }
3595:           : null,
3596:       };
3597:     });
3598: 
3599:     return {
3600:       success: true,
3601:       data: {
3602:         shops: formattedShops,
3603:         total,
3604:       },
3605:       meta: {
3606:         correlation_id: correlationId,
3607:       },
3608:     };
3609:   }
3610: }
</file>

  1: import { Injectable, Optional, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
  2: import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
  3: 
  4: /**
  5:  * Exact slot consumed by an atomic consume call. Refunds must target this slot only so a
  6:  * concurrent request's slot is never removed (FEAT-USR-01 SECURITY-NFR invitation rate limit).
  7:  */
  8: export interface AttemptReservation {
  9:   key: string;
 10:   member: string;
 11:   timestamp: number;
 12:   backend: 'redis' | 'memory';
 13: }
 14: 
 15: /** Slots consumed by one invitation dispatch quota check; refunded at most once. */
 16: export interface InvitationDispatchReservation {
 17:   attempts: AttemptReservation[];
 18: }
 19: 
 20: export interface RateLimitResult {
 21:   allowed: boolean;
 22:   retryAfterSeconds?: number;
 23:   reason?: string;
 24:   reservation?: InvitationDispatchReservation;
 25: }
 26: 
 27: @Injectable()
 28: export class RateLimitService {
 29:   private readonly memoryStore = new Map<string, number[]>();
 30:   private readonly cooldownStore = new Map<string, number>();
 31: 
 32:   constructor(@Optional() @Inject(RedisService) private readonly redisService?: RedisService) {}
 33: 
 34:   /**
 35:    * Check registration limits (BR-AUTH-07):
 36:    * - IP: max 5 attempts per 3600 seconds
 37:    * - Identifier (email or phone): max 3 attempts per 3600 seconds
 38:    */
 39:   async checkRegistrationLimit(
 40:     ip: string,
 41:     email?: string,
 42:     phone?: string
 43:   ): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
 44:     const windowSeconds = 3600;
 45: 
 46:     // 1. Check IP limit (5 per hour)
 47:     const ipKey = `ratelimit:reg:ip:${ip}`;
 48:     const ipCheck = await this.getAttempts(ipKey, windowSeconds);
 49:     if (ipCheck.count >= 5) {
 50:       return {
 51:         allowed: false,
 52:         retryAfterSeconds: ipCheck.retryAfterSeconds,
 53:         reason: 'Too many registration attempts from this IP address',
 54:       };
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     // 2. Check email limit (3 per hour)
 58:     if (email) {
 59:       const emailKey = `ratelimit:reg:email:${email.toLowerCase().trim()}`;
 60:       const emailCheck = await this.getAttempts(emailKey, windowSeconds);
 61:       if (emailCheck.count >= 3) {
 62:         return {
 63:           allowed: false,
 64:           retryAfterSeconds: emailCheck.retryAfterSeconds,
 65:           reason: 'Too many registration attempts for this email',
 66:         };
 67:       }
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     // 3. Check phone limit (3 per hour)
 71:     if (phone) {
 72:       const phoneKey = `ratelimit:reg:phone:${phone.trim()}`;
 73:       const phoneCheck = await this.getAttempts(phoneKey, windowSeconds);
 74:       if (phoneCheck.count >= 3) {
 75:         return {
 76:           allowed: false,
 77:           retryAfterSeconds: phoneCheck.retryAfterSeconds,
 78:           reason: 'Too many registration attempts for this phone number',
 79:         };
 80:       }
 81:     }
 82: 
 83:     return { allowed: true };
 84:   }
 85: 
 86:   /**
 87:    * Record a registration attempt.
 88:    * Can record IP-only upfront (to prevent enumeration probing) or full identifiers.
 89:    */
 90:   async recordRegistrationAttempt(ip?: string, email?: string, phone?: string): Promise<void> {
 91:     const windowSeconds = 3600;
 92:     if (ip) {
 93:       await this.recordAttemptKey(`ratelimit:reg:ip:${ip}`, windowSeconds);
 94:     }
 95:     if (email) {
 96:       await this.recordAttemptKey(
 97:         `ratelimit:reg:email:${email.toLowerCase().trim()}`,
 98:         windowSeconds
 99:       );
100:     }
101:     if (phone) {
102:       await this.recordAttemptKey(`ratelimit:reg:phone:${phone.trim()}`, windowSeconds);
103:     }
104:   }
105: 
106:   /**
107:    * Check resend verification limits (BR-AUTH-08):
108:    * - 60 seconds cooldown per identifier and channel
109:    * - Maximum 5 resends per hour per identifier
110:    */
111:   async checkResendLimit(identifier: string, channel: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
112:     const cleanId = identifier.toLowerCase().trim();
113:     const cooldownKey = `ratelimit:resend:cooldown:${channel}:${cleanId}`;
114:     const hourlyKey = `ratelimit:resend:hourly:${channel}:${cleanId}`;
115: 
116:     // 1. Check 60s cooldown
117:     const cooldownSeconds = await this.getCooldown(cooldownKey);
118:     if (cooldownSeconds !== null && cooldownSeconds > 0) {
119:       return {
120:         allowed: false,
121:         retryAfterSeconds: cooldownSeconds,
122:         reason: `Please wait ${cooldownSeconds} seconds before requesting another code`,
123:       };
124:     }
125: 
126:     // 2. Check 5 resends per hour (BR-AUTH-08)
127:     const hourlyCheck = await this.getAttempts(hourlyKey, 3600);
128:     if (hourlyCheck.count >= 5) {
129:       return {
130:         allowed: false,
131:         retryAfterSeconds: hourlyCheck.retryAfterSeconds,
132:         reason: `Đã vượt quá số lần yêu cầu mã xác thực trong 1 giờ (tối đa 5 lần/giờ). Vui lòng thử lại sau ${hourlyCheck.retryAfterSeconds} giây.`,
133:       };
134:     }
135: 
136:     return { allowed: true };
137:   }
138: 
139:   /**
140:    * Check forgot password rate limits (FEAT-AUTH-04):
141:    * - IP: max 5 attempts per 3600 seconds
142:    * - Identifier (email or phone): max 3 attempts per 3600 seconds
143:    *
144:    * `subject` says which of the two this is. It used to be guessed from the
145:    * string — "IP addresses typically don't contain @ or ." — and every IPv4
146:    * address contains three dots, so every IP was given the stricter
147:    * identifier limit of 3 instead of the 5 AC-05 specifies. The caller
148:    * already knows which it is passing, so it says so.
149:    */
150:   async checkForgotPasswordLimit(
151:     identifier: string,
152:     subject: 'ip' | 'identifier' = 'identifier'
153:   ): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
154:     const windowSeconds = 3600;
155:     const key = `ratelimit:forgot:${identifier}`;
156: 
157:     const check = await this.getAttempts(key, windowSeconds);
158:     const maxAttempts = subject === 'ip' ? 5 : 3;
159: 
160:     if (check.count >= maxAttempts) {
161:       return {
162:         allowed: false,
163:         retryAfterSeconds: check.retryAfterSeconds,
164:         reason: `Too many forgot password attempts for ${identifier}`,
165:       };
166:     }
167: 
168:     return { allowed: true };
169:   }
170: 
171:   /**
172:    * Record a forgot password attempt.
173:    */
174:   async recordForgotPasswordAttempt(ip: string, identifier: string): Promise<void> {
175:     const windowSeconds = 3600;
176:     await this.recordAttemptKey(`ratelimit:forgot:${ip}`, windowSeconds);
177:     await this.recordAttemptKey(`ratelimit:forgot:${identifier}`, windowSeconds);
178:   }
179: 
180:   /**
181:    * Check reset token verification limits (FEAT-AUTH-04):
182:    * - Maximum 5 failed attempts per 1-hour window per IP
183:    */
184:   async checkResetTokenLimit(ip: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
185:     const key = `ratelimit:reset:fail:${ip}`;
186:     const windowSeconds = 3600;
187:     const check = await this.getAttempts(key, windowSeconds);
188:     if (check.count >= 5) {
189:       return {
190:         allowed: false,
191:         retryAfterSeconds: check.retryAfterSeconds,
192:         reason: 'Quá nhiều lần thử mã không chính xác. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
193:       };
194:     }
195:     return { allowed: true };
196:   }
197: 
198:   async recordResetTokenFailure(ip: string): Promise<number> {
199:     const key = `ratelimit:reset:fail:${ip}`;
200:     const windowSeconds = 3600;
201:     await this.recordAttemptKey(key, windowSeconds);
202:     const check = await this.getAttempts(key, windowSeconds);
203:     return check.count;
204:   }
205: 
206:   async recordResendAttempt(
207:     identifier: string,
208:     channel: string,
209:     cooldownSeconds = 60
210:   ): Promise<void> {
211:     const cleanId = identifier.toLowerCase().trim();
212:     const cooldownKey = `ratelimit:resend:cooldown:${channel}:${cleanId}`;
213:     const hourlyKey = `ratelimit:resend:hourly:${channel}:${cleanId}`;
214: 
215:     await this.setCooldown(cooldownKey, cooldownSeconds);
216:     await this.recordAttemptKey(hourlyKey, 3600);
217:   }
218: 
219:   /**
220:    * Check OTP brute-force limits for phone (BR-AUTH-06):
221:    * - Maximum 5 failed attempts per 15-minute OTP validity window
222:    */
223:   async checkOtpAttemptLimit(phone: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
224:     const key = `ratelimit:otp:fail:${phone.trim()}`;
225:     const windowSeconds = 900; // 15 minutes
226:     const check = await this.getAttempts(key, windowSeconds);
227:     if (check.count >= 5) {
228:       return {
229:         allowed: false,
230:         retryAfterSeconds: check.retryAfterSeconds,
231:         reason: 'Quá nhiều lần thử mã OTP không chính xác. Vui lòng yêu cầu mã xác thực mới.',
232:       };
233:     }
234:     return { allowed: true };
235:   }
236: 
237:   async recordOtpFailure(phone: string): Promise<number> {
238:     const key = `ratelimit:otp:fail:${phone.trim()}`;
239:     const windowSeconds = 900;
240:     await this.recordAttemptKey(key, windowSeconds);
241:     const check = await this.getAttempts(key, windowSeconds);
242:     return check.count;
243:   }
244: 
245:   async resetOtpAttempts(phone: string): Promise<void> {
246:     const key = `ratelimit:otp:fail:${phone.trim()}`;
247:     if (this.redisService) {
248:       try {
249:         const client = this.redisService.getClient();
250:         if (client.status === 'ready') {
251:           await client.del(key);
252:         }
253:       } catch {
254:         // ignore
255:       }
256:     }
257:     this.memoryStore.delete(key);
258:   }
259: 
260:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
261:   // Internal Helpers: Distributed Redis with In-Memory Safe Fallback
262:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
263: 
264:   private async getAttempts(
265:     key: string,
266:     windowSeconds: number
267:   ): Promise<{ count: number; retryAfterSeconds: number }> {
268:     const now = Date.now();
269:     const windowMs = windowSeconds * 1000;
270: 
271:     if (this.redisService) {
272:       try {
273:         const client = this.redisService.getClient();
274:         if (client.status === 'ready') {
275:           const clearBefore = now - windowMs;
276:           const pipeline = client.pipeline();
277:           pipeline.zremrangebyscore(key, '-inf', clearBefore);
278:           pipeline.zcard(key);
279:           pipeline.zrange(key, 0, 0, 'WITHSCORES');
280:           const results = await pipeline.exec();
281:           if (results) {
282:             const count = (results[1][1] as number) || 0;
283:             const oldest = results[2][1] as string[];
284:             let retryAfter = 1;
285:             if (oldest && oldest.length >= 2) {
286:               const earliestTs = parseInt(oldest[1], 10);
287:               retryAfter = Math.ceil((earliestTs + windowMs - now) / 1000);
288:             }
289:             return { count, retryAfterSeconds: Math.max(1, retryAfter) };
290:           }
291:         }
292:       } catch {
293:         // Fallback to in-memory store
294:       }
295:     }
296: 
297:     // In-memory fallback with automatic eviction of expired entries
298:     const existing = this.memoryStore.get(key) || [];
299:     const valid = existing.filter((ts) => now - ts < windowMs);
300:     if (valid.length === 0) {
301:       this.memoryStore.delete(key);
302:       return { count: 0, retryAfterSeconds: 1 };
303:     }
304:     this.memoryStore.set(key, valid);
305:     const earliest = valid[0];
306:     const retryAfter = Math.ceil((earliest + windowMs - now) / 1000);
307:     return { count: valid.length, retryAfterSeconds: Math.max(1, retryAfter) };
308:   }
309: 
310:   private async recordAttemptKey(key: string, windowSeconds: number): Promise<void> {
311:     const now = Date.now();
312: 
313:     if (this.redisService) {
314:       try {
315:         const client = this.redisService.getClient();
316:         if (client.status === 'ready') {
317:           const member = `${now}:${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
318:           const pipeline = client.pipeline();
319:           pipeline.zadd(key, now, member);
320:           pipeline.expire(key, windowSeconds + 60);
321:           await pipeline.exec();
322:         }
323:       } catch {
324:         // Fallback
325:       }
326:     }
327: 
328:     // Record in-memory
329:     const existing = this.memoryStore.get(key) || [];
330:     existing.push(now);
331:     this.memoryStore.set(key, existing);
332:   }
333: 
334:   private async getCooldown(key: string): Promise<number | null> {
335:     if (this.redisService) {
336:       try {
337:         const client = this.redisService.getClient();
338:         if (client.status === 'ready') {
339:           const ttl = await client.ttl(key);
340:           if (ttl > 0) {
341:             return ttl;
342:           }
343:         }
344:       } catch {
345:         // Fallback
346:       }
347:     }
348: 
349:     const lockedUntil = this.cooldownStore.get(key);
350:     if (lockedUntil) {
351:       const now = Date.now();
352:       if (lockedUntil > now) {
353:         return Math.ceil((lockedUntil - now) / 1000);
354:       }
355:       this.cooldownStore.delete(key);
356:     }
357:     return null;
358:   }
359: 
360:   private async setCooldown(key: string, cooldownSeconds: number): Promise<void> {
361:     if (this.redisService) {
362:       try {
363:         const client = this.redisService.getClient();
364:         if (client.status === 'ready') {
365:           await client.set(key, '1', 'EX', cooldownSeconds);
366:         }
367:       } catch {
368:         // Fallback
369:       }
370:     }
371: 
372:     this.cooldownStore.set(key, Date.now() + cooldownSeconds * 1000);
373:   }
374: 
375:   // --- FEAT-AUTH-03: login rate limits (BR-AUTH-11 / CD-9) ---
376: 
377:   /** Password login IP gate: max 10 attempts per 15 minutes per IP. */
378:   async checkLoginIpLimit(ip: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
379:     const windowSeconds = 900;
380:     const check = await this.getAttempts(`ratelimit:login:ip:${ip}`, windowSeconds);
381:     if (check.count >= 10) {
382:       return {
383:         allowed: false,
384:         retryAfterSeconds: check.retryAfterSeconds,
385:         reason: 'Quá nhiều lần thử đăng nhập từ địa chỉ IP này',
386:       };
387:     }
388:     return { allowed: true };
389:   }
390: 
391:   async recordLoginIpAttempt(ip: string): Promise<void> {
392:     await this.recordAttemptKey(`ratelimit:login:ip:${ip}`, 900);
393:   }
394: 
395:   /** Password login identifier gate: max 5 failures per 15 minutes per identifier. */
396:   async checkLoginIdentifierFailureLimit(identifier: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
397:     const windowSeconds = 900;
398:     const cleanId = identifier.toLowerCase().trim();
399:     const check = await this.getAttempts(`ratelimit:login:fail:${cleanId}`, windowSeconds);
400:     if (check.count >= 5) {
401:       return {
402:         allowed: false,
403:         retryAfterSeconds: check.retryAfterSeconds,
404:         reason: 'Quá nhiều lần đăng nhập thất bại cho tài khoản này',
405:       };
406:     }
407:     return { allowed: true };
408:   }
409: 
410:   /** Records a failed login for the identifier and returns the failure count in the window. */
411:   async recordLoginIdentifierFailure(identifier: string): Promise<number> {
412:     const cleanId = identifier.toLowerCase().trim();
413:     await this.recordAttemptKey(`ratelimit:login:fail:${cleanId}`, 900);
414:     const check = await this.getAttempts(`ratelimit:login:fail:${cleanId}`, 900);
415:     return check.count;
416:   }
417: 
418:   /** A successful login resets the identifier failure counter (the IP counter is NOT reset). */
419:   async resetLoginIdentifierFailures(identifier: string): Promise<void> {
420:     await this.resetKey(`ratelimit:login:fail:${identifier.toLowerCase().trim()}`);
421:   }
422: 
423:   /** Login OTP requests per IP: max 10 per hour (BR-AUTH-12). */
424:   async checkLoginOtpIpLimit(ip: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
425:     const windowSeconds = 3600;
426:     const check = await this.getAttempts(`ratelimit:login:otpreq:ip:${ip}`, windowSeconds);
427:     if (check.count >= 10) {
428:       return {
429:         allowed: false,
430:         retryAfterSeconds: check.retryAfterSeconds,
431:         reason: 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu mã OTP từ địa chỉ IP này',
432:       };
433:     }
434:     return { allowed: true };
435:   }
436: 
437:   async recordLoginOtpIpAttempt(ip: string): Promise<void> {
438:     await this.recordAttemptKey(`ratelimit:login:otpreq:ip:${ip}`, 3600);
439:   }
440: 
441:   /** Login OTP requests per identifier: 60s cooldown + max 5 per hour (BR-AUTH-12). */
442:   async checkLoginOtpRequestLimit(identifier: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
443:     const cleanId = identifier.toLowerCase().trim();
444:     const cooldownKey = `ratelimit:login:otpreq:cooldown:${cleanId}`;
445:     const hourlyKey = `ratelimit:login:otpreq:id:${cleanId}`;
446: 
447:     const cooldownSeconds = await this.getCooldown(cooldownKey);
448:     if (cooldownSeconds !== null && cooldownSeconds > 0) {
449:       return {
450:         allowed: false,
451:         retryAfterSeconds: cooldownSeconds,
452:         reason: 'Vui lòng chờ trước khi yêu cầu mã OTP mới',
453:       };
454:     }
455: 
456:     const hourly = await this.getAttempts(hourlyKey, 3600);
457:     if (hourly.count >= 5) {
458:       return {
459:         allowed: false,
460:         retryAfterSeconds: hourly.retryAfterSeconds,
461:         reason: 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu mã OTP cho tài khoản này',
462:       };
463:     }
464: 
465:     return { allowed: true };
466:   }
467: 
468:   async recordLoginOtpRequest(identifier: string, cooldownSeconds = 60): Promise<void> {
469:     const cleanId = identifier.toLowerCase().trim();
470:     await this.setCooldown(`ratelimit:login:otpreq:cooldown:${cleanId}`, cooldownSeconds);
471:     await this.recordAttemptKey(`ratelimit:login:otpreq:id:${cleanId}`, 3600);
472:   }
473: 
474:   private async resetKey(key: string): Promise<void> {
475:     if (this.redisService) {
476:       try {
477:         const client = this.redisService.getClient();
478:         if (client.status === 'ready') {
479:           await client.del(key);
480:         }
481:       } catch {
482:         // Fallback to in-memory reset below
483:       }
484:     }
485:     this.memoryStore.delete(key);
486:   }
487: 
488:   // --- FEAT-AUTH-05: MFA challenge rate limits (BR-AUTH-16 / AC-AUTH-05-08 / AC-AUTH-05-24) ---
489: 
490:   /** MFA challenge IP gate: max 10 failed attempts per 15 minutes across any user. */
491:   async checkMfaIpLimit(ip: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
492:     const windowSeconds = 900;
493:     const check = await this.getAttempts(`ratelimit:mfa:ip:${ip}`, windowSeconds);
494:     if (check.count >= 10) {
495:       return {
496:         allowed: false,
497:         retryAfterSeconds: check.retryAfterSeconds,
498:         reason: 'Quá nhiều lần thử xác thực hai yếu tố từ địa chỉ IP này. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
499:       };
500:     }
501:     return { allowed: true };
502:   }
503: 
504:   async recordMfaIpFailure(ip: string): Promise<void> {
505:     await this.recordAttemptKey(`ratelimit:mfa:ip:${ip}`, 900);
506:   }
507: 
508:   /** MFA challenge failure gate: max 5 failures per challenge / user in 15 minutes. */
509:   async checkMfaChallengeLimit(challengeHash: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
510:     const windowSeconds = 900;
511:     const check = await this.getAttempts(`ratelimit:mfa:challenge:${challengeHash}`, windowSeconds);
512:     if (check.count >= 5) {
513:       return {
514:         allowed: false,
515:         retryAfterSeconds: check.retryAfterSeconds,
516:         reason: 'Mã xác thực không chính xác hoặc đã vượt quá số lần thử cho phép.',
517:       };
518:     }
519:     return { allowed: true };
520:   }
521: 
522:   async recordMfaChallengeFailure(challengeHash: string): Promise<number> {
523:     await this.recordAttemptKey(`ratelimit:mfa:challenge:${challengeHash}`, 900);
524:     const check = await this.getAttempts(`ratelimit:mfa:challenge:${challengeHash}`, 900);
525:     return check.count;
526:   }
527: 
528:   async resetMfaChallengeFailures(challengeHash: string): Promise<void> {
529:     await this.resetKey(`ratelimit:mfa:challenge:${challengeHash}`);
530:   }
531: 
532:   // --- FEAT-USR-01: invitation rate limits (SECURITY-NFR / BR-INV-09) ---
533: 
534:   /**
535:    * Check invitation dispatch limits (create and resend) with atomic consume-before-dispatch:
536:    * - IP: max 20 dispatch requests per hour
537:    * - Recipient identifier (email or phone): max 5 per hour, tenant-scoped
538:    */
539:   async checkInvitationDispatchLimit(
540:     ip: string,
541:     identifier?: string,
542:     merchantId?: string
543:   ): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
544:     const windowSeconds = 3600;
545:     const safeIp = ip && ip.trim() ? ip.trim() : 'unknown';
546:     const ipKey = `ratelimit:invite:dispatch:ip:${safeIp}`;
547: 
548:     // 1. Atomic consume IP limit (20/hour)
549:     const ipConsume = await this.consumeAttemptKey(ipKey, 20, windowSeconds);
550:     if (!ipConsume.allowed) {
551:       return {
552:         allowed: false,
553:         retryAfterSeconds: ipConsume.retryAfterSeconds,
554:         reason:
555:           ipConsume.reason ||
556:           'Quá nhiều yêu cầu gửi lời mời từ địa chỉ IP này. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
557:       };
558:     }
559:     const attempts: AttemptReservation[] = [];
560:     if (ipConsume.reservation) attempts.push(ipConsume.reservation);
561: 
562:     // 2. Atomic consume tenant-scoped recipient limit (5/hour per recipient in merchant)
563:     if (identifier) {
564:       const cleanId = identifier.toLowerCase().trim();
565:       const tenantPrefix = merchantId ? `merchant:${merchantId}:` : '';
566:       const recipientKey = `ratelimit:invite:dispatch:${tenantPrefix}recipient:${cleanId}`;
567:       const recipientConsume = await this.consumeAttemptKey(recipientKey, 5, windowSeconds);
568:       if (!recipientConsume.allowed) {
569:         // Revert only the IP slot just added if recipient quota was exceeded (Finding 4)
570:         await this.revertInvitationDispatchAttempt({ attempts });
571:         return {
572:           allowed: false,
573:           retryAfterSeconds: recipientConsume.retryAfterSeconds,
574:           reason:
575:             recipientConsume.reason ||
576:             'Đã vượt quá số lần gửi lời mời cho người dùng này trong 1 giờ. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
577:         };
578:       }
579:       if (recipientConsume.reservation) attempts.push(recipientConsume.reservation);
580:     }
581: 
582:     return { allowed: true, reservation: { attempts } };
583:   }
584: 
585:   async recordInvitationDispatchAttempt(
586:     ip: string,
587:     identifier?: string,
588:     merchantId?: string
589:   ): Promise<void> {
590:     // No-op to avoid double counting since checkInvitationDispatchLimit atomically consumes quota upfront
591:   }
592: 
593:   /**
594:    * Refund exactly the slots captured by checkInvitationDispatchLimit (Round 6 Finding 2).
595:    * Never removes another request's slot; a reservation is refunded at most once.
596:    */
597:   async revertInvitationDispatchAttempt(
598:     reservation?: InvitationDispatchReservation
599:   ): Promise<void> {
600:     if (!reservation) return;
601:     // Detach slots before awaiting so a concurrent/double refund cannot remove them twice
602:     const attempts = reservation.attempts.splice(0, reservation.attempts.length);
603:     for (const attempt of attempts) {
604:       await this.revertAttemptKey(attempt.key, attempt.member, attempt.timestamp, attempt.backend);
605:     }
606:   }
607: 
608:   private async consumeAttemptKey(
609:     key: string,
610:     limit: number,
611:     windowSeconds: number
612:   ): Promise<{
613:     allowed: boolean;
614:     retryAfterSeconds?: number;
615:     count: number;
616:     member?: string;
617:     timestamp?: number;
618:     reservation?: AttemptReservation;
619:     reason?: string;
620:   }> {
621:     const now = Date.now();
622:     const windowMs = windowSeconds * 1000;
623:     const member = `${now}:${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
624: 
625:     if (this.redisService) {
626:       let client: any = null;
627:       try {
628:         client = this.redisService.getClient();
629:       } catch {
630:         client = null;
631:       }
632:       if (!client) {
633:         // Redis is configured but client cannot be obtained: fail closed across instances (SECURITY-NFR / Round 10 Finding 2)
634:         return {
635:           allowed: false,
636:           retryAfterSeconds: 60,
637:           count: limit,
638:           reason: 'Dịch vụ kiểm soát tần suất gặp sự cố. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
639:         };
640:       }
641:       if (client.status === 'wait') {
642:         try {
643:           await client.connect();
644:         } catch {
645:           // connection failed
646:         }
647:       }
648:       if (client.status === 'ready') {
649:         try {
650:           const clearBefore = now - windowMs;
651:           const lua = `
652:               local key = KEYS[1]
653:               local now = tonumber(ARGV[1])
654:               local clearBefore = tonumber(ARGV[2])
655:               local limit = tonumber(ARGV[3])
656:               local windowSeconds = tonumber(ARGV[4])
657:               local member = ARGV[5]
658: 
659:               redis.call('zremrangebyscore', key, '-inf', clearBefore)
660:               local count = redis.call('zcard', key)
661:               if count >= limit then
662:                 local oldest = redis.call('zrange', key, 0, 0, 'WITHSCORES')
663:                 local earliest = (oldest and oldest[2]) and oldest[2] or now
664:                 return {0, count, earliest}
665:               end
666:               redis.call('zadd', key, now, member)
667:               redis.call('expire', key, windowSeconds + 60)
668:               return {1, count + 1, now}
669:             `;
670:           const res = (await client.eval(
671:             lua,
672:             1,
673:             key,
674:             now.toString(),
675:             clearBefore.toString(),
676:             limit.toString(),
677:             windowSeconds.toString(),
678:             member
679:           )) as [number, number, number];
680:           const allowed = res[0] === 1;
681:           const count = res[1];
682:           const earliest = Number(res[2]);
683:           const retryAfter = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((earliest + windowMs - now) / 1000));
684:           return {
685:             allowed,
686:             retryAfterSeconds: retryAfter,
687:             count,
688:             member,
689:             timestamp: now,
690:             reservation: allowed ? { key, member, timestamp: now, backend: 'redis' } : undefined,
691:           };
692:         } catch {
693:           // Redis execution error while ready: fail closed across instances (SECURITY-NFR / Round 8 Finding 4)
694:           return {
695:             allowed: false,
696:             retryAfterSeconds: 60,
697:             count: limit,
698:             reason: 'Dịch vụ kiểm soát tần suất gặp sự cố. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
699:           };
700:         }
701:       } else {
702:         // Redis is configured but not usable (e.g. status !== 'ready'): fail closed across instances (Round 9 Finding 2)
703:         return {
704:           allowed: false,
705:           retryAfterSeconds: 60,
706:           count: limit,
707:           reason: 'Dịch vụ kiểm soát tần suất gặp sự cố. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
708:         };
709:       }
710:     }
711: 
712:     // In-memory atomic check-and-consume
713:     const existing = this.memoryStore.get(key) || [];
714:     const valid = existing.filter((ts) => now - ts < windowMs);
715:     if (valid.length >= limit) {
716:       const earliest = valid[0];
717:       const retryAfter = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((earliest + windowMs - now) / 1000));
718:       this.memoryStore.set(key, valid);
719:       return { allowed: false, retryAfterSeconds: retryAfter, count: valid.length };
720:     }
721:     valid.push(now);
722:     this.memoryStore.set(key, valid);
723:     return {
724:       allowed: true,
725:       count: valid.length,
726:       member,
727:       timestamp: now,
728:       reservation: { key, member, timestamp: now, backend: 'memory' },
729:     };
730:   }
731: 
732:   /**
733:    * Remove exactly one previously consumed slot. Without a captured member/timestamp nothing is
734:    * removed: refunding "the latest" slot could drop a concurrent request's slot (Round 6 Finding 2).
735:    */
736:   private async revertAttemptKey(
737:     key: string,
738:     member?: string,
739:     timestamp?: number,
740:     backend?: 'redis' | 'memory'
741:   ): Promise<void> {
742:     if (!member && timestamp === undefined) return;
743:     if (backend !== 'redis' && timestamp !== undefined) {
744:       // In-memory slots are stored as timestamps; equal timestamps are interchangeable slots
745:       const existing = this.memoryStore.get(key);
746:       const idx = existing ? existing.lastIndexOf(timestamp) : -1;
747:       if (existing && idx !== -1) {
748:         existing.splice(idx, 1);
749:         if (existing.length === 0) {
750:           this.memoryStore.delete(key);
751:         } else {
752:           this.memoryStore.set(key, existing);
753:         }
754:       }
755:     }
756:     if (backend !== 'memory' && member && this.redisService) {
757:       try {
758:         const client = this.redisService.getClient();
759:         if (client.status === 'ready') {
760:           await client.zrem(key, member);
761:         }
762:       } catch {
763:         // Fallback ignore
764:       }
765:     }
766:   }
767: 
768:   /**
769:    * Check invitation verification check limits:
770:    * - IP: max 30 verification checks per 15 minutes (atomic consume upfront to prevent race conditions)
771:    */
772:   async checkInvitationVerifyLimit(ip: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
773:     const windowSeconds = 900;
774:     const safeIp = ip && ip.trim() ? ip.trim() : 'unknown';
775:     const key = `ratelimit:invite:verify:ip:${safeIp}`;
776:     const ipConsume = await this.consumeAttemptKey(key, 30, windowSeconds);
777:     if (!ipConsume.allowed) {
778:       return {
779:         allowed: false,
780:         retryAfterSeconds: ipConsume.retryAfterSeconds,
781:         reason: 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu kiểm tra lời mời từ địa chỉ IP này. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
782:       };
783:     }
784:     return { allowed: true };
785:   }
786: 
787:   async recordInvitationVerifyAttempt(ip: string): Promise<void> {
788:     // No-op to avoid double counting since checkInvitationVerifyLimit atomically consumes quota upfront (Finding 4)
789:   }
790: 
791:   /**
792:    * Check invitation acceptance rate limits:
793:    * - IP: max 10 accept attempts per 15 minutes (atomic consume)
794:    * - Token: max 5 accept attempts per 15 minutes (atomic consume)
795:    */
796:   async checkInvitationAcceptLimit(ip: string, tokenHash?: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
797:     const windowSeconds = 900;
798:     const safeIp = ip && ip.trim() ? ip.trim() : 'unknown';
799:     const ipKey = `ratelimit:invite:accept:ip:${safeIp}`;
800:     const ipConsume = await this.consumeAttemptKey(ipKey, 10, windowSeconds);
801:     if (!ipConsume.allowed) {
802:       return {
803:         allowed: false,
804:         retryAfterSeconds: ipConsume.retryAfterSeconds,
805:         reason: 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu chấp nhận lời mời từ địa chỉ IP này. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
806:       };
807:     }
808: 
809:     if (tokenHash) {
810:       const tokenKey = `ratelimit:invite:accept:token:${tokenHash}`;
811:       const tokenConsume = await this.consumeAttemptKey(tokenKey, 5, windowSeconds);
812:       if (!tokenConsume.allowed) {
813:         // Revert only the IP attempt just added (Finding 4)
814:         await this.revertAttemptKey(
815:           ipKey,
816:           ipConsume.member,
817:           ipConsume.timestamp,
818:           ipConsume.reservation?.backend
819:         );
820:         return {
821:           allowed: false,
822:           retryAfterSeconds: tokenConsume.retryAfterSeconds,
823:           reason: 'Quá nhiều lần thử kích hoạt lời mời này. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
824:         };
825:       }
826:     }
827: 
828:     return { allowed: true };
829:   }
830: 
831:   async recordInvitationAcceptAttempt(ip: string, tokenHash?: string): Promise<void> {
832:     // No-op to avoid double counting since checkInvitationAcceptLimit atomically consumes quota upfront (Finding 4)
833:   }
834: 
835:   clear(): void {
836:     this.memoryStore.clear();
837:     this.cooldownStore.clear();
838:   }
839: }
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/auth/token.util.ts">
  1: import { createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
  2: 
  3: /**
  4:  * FEAT-AUTH-03 access-token utilities.
  5:  *
  6:  * Stateless `v1.<payload>.<signature>` format:
  7:  * - payload:   base64url JSON claims (JWT-compatible subset: sub, sid, mid, role, st, iat, exp, jti)
  8:  * - signature: base64url HMAC-SHA256(payload) keyed by the configured token secret
  9:  *
 10:  * No new runtime dependencies; `node:crypto` only. Refresh/revocation is owned by FEAT-AUTH-06.
 11:  */
 12: 
 13: const TOKEN_VERSION = 'v1';
 14: const HMAC_ALGORITHM = 'sha256';
 15: 
 16: export interface AccessTokenClaims {
 17:   /** User id */
 18:   sub: string;
 19:   /** Device session id (device_sessions.id) */
 20:   sid: string;
 21:   /** Merchant id (optional/null for platform operators) */
 22:   mid?: string | null;
 23:   /** Canonical role (OWNER | OPS_CSKH | WAREHOUSE | ACCOUNTANT | PLATFORM_ADMIN) */
 24:   role: string;
 25:   /** User status at issuance */
 26:   st: string;
 27:   /** Issued at (epoch seconds) */
 28:   iat: number;
 29:   /** Expiry (epoch seconds) */
 30:   exp: number;
 31:   /** Unique token id */
 32:   jti: string;
 33:   scope?: string;
 34:   auth_assurance?: string;
 35:   mfa_verified_at?: string;
 36: }
 37: 
 38: export type AccessTokenIssuanceInput = Omit<AccessTokenClaims, 'iat' | 'exp' | 'jti'>;
 39: 
 40: export class TokenVerificationError extends Error {
 41:   public readonly reason:
 42:     'MALFORMED' | 'BAD_SIGNATURE' | 'EXPIRED' | 'UNSUPPORTED_VERSION' | 'INCOMPLETE_CLAIMS';
 43: 
 44:   constructor(
 45:     reason: 'MALFORMED' | 'BAD_SIGNATURE' | 'EXPIRED' | 'UNSUPPORTED_VERSION' | 'INCOMPLETE_CLAIMS'
 46:   ) {
 47:     super(`Access token verification failed: ${reason}`);
 48:     this.name = 'TokenVerificationError';
 49:     this.reason = reason;
 50:   }
 51: }
 52: 
 53: function base64UrlEncode(input: Buffer | string): string {
 54:   return Buffer.from(input).toString('base64url');
 55: }
 56: 
 57: function base64UrlDecodeToObject(input: string): Record<string, unknown> {
 58:   const json = Buffer.from(input, 'base64url').toString('utf8');
 59:   return JSON.parse(json) as Record<string, unknown>;
 60: }
 61: 
 62: /**
 63:  * Resolves the signing secret. Production requires an explicit secret via config
 64:  * validation (fail-closed, >= 32 chars); dev/test fall back to an ephemeral
 65:  * process-lifetime secret so local runs never sign with a hard-coded value.
 66:  */
 67: let ephemeralSecret: string | undefined;
 68: export function resolveAccessTokenSecret(configuredSecret?: string): string {
 69:   if (configuredSecret && configuredSecret.trim().length > 0) {
 70:     return configuredSecret.trim();
 71:   }
 72:   if (!ephemeralSecret) {
 73:     ephemeralSecret = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
 74:   }
 75:   return ephemeralSecret;
 76: }
 77: 
 78: export function signAccessToken(
 79:   input: AccessTokenIssuanceInput,
 80:   secret: string,
 81:   ttlSeconds: number
 82: ): { token: string; claims: AccessTokenClaims } {
 83:   const issuedAt = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
 84:   const claims: AccessTokenClaims = {
 85:     ...input,
 86:     iat: issuedAt,
 87:     exp: issuedAt + Math.floor(ttlSeconds),
 88:     jti: randomUUID(),
 89:   };
 90: 
 91:   const payload = base64UrlEncode(JSON.stringify(claims));
 92:   const signature = base64UrlEncode(
 93:     createHmac(HMAC_ALGORITHM, secret).update(`${TOKEN_VERSION}.${payload}`).digest()
 94:   );
 95: 
 96:   return { token: `${TOKEN_VERSION}.${payload}.${signature}`, claims };
 97: }
 98: 
 99: export function verifyAccessToken(token: string, secret: string): AccessTokenClaims {
100:   const parts = token.split('.');
101:   if (parts.length !== 3) {
102:     throw new TokenVerificationError('MALFORMED');
103:   }
104:   const [version, payload, signature] = parts;
105:   if (version !== TOKEN_VERSION) {
106:     throw new TokenVerificationError('UNSUPPORTED_VERSION');
107:   }
108: 
109:   const expectedSignature = createHmac(HMAC_ALGORITHM, secret)
110:     .update(`${version}.${payload}`)
111:     .digest();
112:   const providedSignature = Buffer.from(signature, 'base64url');
113:   if (
114:     providedSignature.length !== expectedSignature.length ||
115:     !timingSafeEqual(providedSignature, expectedSignature)
116:   ) {
117:     throw new TokenVerificationError('BAD_SIGNATURE');
118:   }
119: 
120:   let parsed: Record<string, unknown>;
121:   try {
122:     parsed = base64UrlDecodeToObject(payload);
123:   } catch {
124:     throw new TokenVerificationError('MALFORMED');
125:   }
126: 
127:   const { sub, sid, mid, role, st, iat, exp, jti, scope, auth_assurance, mfa_verified_at } =
128:     parsed as Partial<AccessTokenClaims>;
129:   if (
130:     !sub ||
131:     !sid ||
132:     (!mid && role !== 'PLATFORM_ADMIN') ||
133:     !role ||
134:     !st ||
135:     typeof iat !== 'number' ||
136:     typeof exp !== 'number' ||
137:     !jti
138:   ) {
139:     throw new TokenVerificationError('INCOMPLETE_CLAIMS');
140:   }
141: 
142:   const nowSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
143:   if (exp <= nowSeconds) {
144:     throw new TokenVerificationError('EXPIRED');
145:   }
146: 
147:   return { sub, sid, mid, role, st, iat, exp, jti, scope, auth_assurance, mfa_verified_at };
148: }
</file>

  3: import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

  5: import { RbacService } from '../rbac/rbac.service';

  7: import type { ActorContext } from '../rbac/rbac.dto';
  8: import {
  9:   CreateBranchDto,
 10:   UpdateBranchDto,

 16: 
 17: export const SENSITIVE_AUDIT_FIELDS = ['phone'];
 18: const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
 19: 
 20: export function isUuid(val: string): boolean {
 21:   return typeof val === 'string' && UUID_REGEX.test(val.trim());
 22: }
 23: 
 24: export function maskAuditValue(field: string, val: unknown): any {
 25:   if (val === null || val === undefined) return val;
 26:   if (typeof val !== 'string') return val;
 27:   if (field === 'phone') {
 28:     return maskIdentifier(val);
 29:   }
 30:   return val;

 33: @Injectable()
 34: export class BranchesService {
 35:   constructor(
 36:     @Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
 37:     @Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService: RbacService
 38:   ) {}
 39: 
 40:   private hashIp(ip: string): string {
 41:     if (!ip) return 'unknown';
 42:     return createHash('sha256').update(ip).digest('hex').substring(0, 16);
 43:   }
 44: 
 45:   private async lockMerchantBranches(
 46:     tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
 47:     merchantId: string
 48:   ): Promise<void> {
 49:     // A stable tenant row also serializes first-branch creation, where no branch
 50:     // exists to lock yet. Every create/update must acquire it before reading defaults.
 51:     const merchants = await tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ id: string }>>`
 52:       SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE id = ${merchantId}::uuid FOR NO KEY UPDATE
 53:     `;
 54:     if (merchants.length === 0) {
 55:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 56:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 57:         'FORBIDDEN',
 58:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
 59:         false
 60:       );
 61:     }
 62:   }
 63: 
 64:   private formatBranch(branch: any): FormattedBranch {
 65:     return {
 66:       id: branch.id,
 67:       merchant_id: branch.merchant_id,
 68:       name: branch.name,
 69:       code: branch.code,
 70:       address: branch.address ?? null,
 71:       phone: branch.phone ?? null,
 72:       is_default: Boolean(branch.is_default),
 73:       status: (branch.status as 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE') || 'ACTIVE',
 74:       created_at: branch.created_at
 75:         ? new Date(branch.created_at).toISOString()
 76:         : new Date().toISOString(),
 77:       updated_at: branch.updated_at
 78:         ? new Date(branch.updated_at).toISOString()
 79:         : new Date().toISOString(),
 80:     };
 81:   }
 82: 
 83:   /**
 84:    * Helper to verify if an actor has scope access to a specific branch.
 85:    * If actor is OWNER or has '*', access is unrestricted.
 86:    */
 87:   async checkActorBranchScope(
 88:     actor: ActorContext,
 89:     branch: { id: string; code: string }
 90:   ): Promise<boolean> {
 91:     if (actor.role === 'OWNER') return true;
 92: 
 93:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
 94:       where: { id: actor.userId },
 95:       select: { store_scopes: true, role: true },
 96:     });
 97: 
 98:     if (!user) return false;
 99:     if (user.role === 'OWNER') return true;
100: 
101:     const scopes = user.store_scopes || [];
102:     if (scopes.includes('*')) return true;
103: 
104:     return scopes.includes(branch.id) || scopes.includes(branch.code);
105:   }
106: 
107:   /**
108:    * Helper to get allowed branch identifiers for an actor.
109:    * Returns null if actor has full wildcard access.
110:    */
111:   private async getActorStoreScopes(actor: ActorContext): Promise<string[] | null> {
112:     if (actor.role === 'OWNER') return null;
113: 
114:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
115:       where: { id: actor.userId },
116:       select: { store_scopes: true, role: true },
117:     });
118: 
119:     if (!user || user.role === 'OWNER') return null;
120: 
121:     const scopes = user.store_scopes || [];
122:     if (scopes.includes('*')) return null;
123: 
124:     return scopes;
125:   }

127:   /**
128:    * Server-authoritative capability flag for the web UI (mirrors can_manage_roles
129:    * in FEAT-RBAC-01). True only when the actor holds iam:shop_config; never derived
130:    * from hardcoded role names on the client.
131:    */
132:   private async canActorEditBranches(actor: ActorContext): Promise<boolean> {
133:     if (!this.rbacService) {
134:       return actor.role === 'OWNER';
135:     }
136:     return this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actor, ['iam:shop_config']);
137:   }

139:   /**
140:    * GET /api/v1/branches (AC-ORG-02-01, AC-ORG-02-02)
141:    * Lists branches for the caller's merchant tenant, filtered by store_scopes if scoped.
142:    */
143:   async listBranches(
144:     merchantId: string,
145:     actor: ActorContext,
146:     query: { status?: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' },
147:     correlationId: string
148:   ): Promise<{
149:     success: boolean;
150:     data: { branches: FormattedBranch[]; can_edit: boolean };
151:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
152:   }> {
153:     if (!merchantId) {
154:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
155:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
156:         'FORBIDDEN',
157:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
158:         false
159:       );
160:     }
161: 
162:     const scopedIdentifiers = await this.getActorStoreScopes(actor);
163: 
164:     const whereClause: any = {
165:       merchant_id: merchantId,
166:     };
167: 
168:     if (query?.status) {
169:       if (query.status !== 'ACTIVE' && query.status !== 'INACTIVE') {
170:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
171:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
172:           'VALIDATION_ERROR',
173:           'Trạng thái chi nhánh không hợp lệ. Chỉ chấp nhận ACTIVE hoặc INACTIVE',
174:           false,
175:           'Vui lòng chỉ định trạng thái ACTIVE hoặc INACTIVE',
176:           [
177:             {
178:               field: 'status',
179:               code: 'INVALID_VALUE',
180:               message: 'Trạng thái chi nhánh chỉ có thể là ACTIVE hoặc INACTIVE',
181:             },
182:           ]
183:         );
184:       }
185:       whereClause.status = query.status;
186:     }
187: 
188:     if (scopedIdentifiers !== null) {
189:       const isUuid = (val: string) =>
190:         /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(val);
191:       const uuidScopes = scopedIdentifiers.filter(isUuid);
192:       const codeScopes = scopedIdentifiers.filter((s) => !isUuid(s));
193: 
194:       const orConditions: any[] = [];
195:       if (uuidScopes.length > 0) {
196:         orConditions.push({ id: { in: uuidScopes } });
197:       }
198:       if (codeScopes.length > 0) {
199:         orConditions.push({ code: { in: codeScopes } });
200:       }
201: 
202:       if (orConditions.length > 0) {
203:         whereClause.OR = orConditions;
204:       } else {
205:         whereClause.id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
206:       }
207:     }
208: 
209:     const branches = await this.prisma.branch.findMany({
210:       where: whereClause,
211:       orderBy: [{ is_default: 'desc' }, { created_at: 'asc' }],
212:     });
213: 
214:     const canEdit = await this.canActorEditBranches(actor);
215: 
216:     return {
217:       success: true,
218:       data: {
219:         branches: branches.map((b) => this.formatBranch(b)),
220:         can_edit: canEdit,
221:       },
222:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
223:     };
224:   }

226:   /**
227:    * GET /api/v1/branches/:id (AC-ORG-02-11, AC-ORG-02-12)
228:    * Retrieves branch details by ID with strict tenant and store scope enforcement.
229:    */
230:   async getBranchById(
231:     branchId: string,
232:     actor: ActorContext,
233:     correlationId: string
234:   ): Promise<{
235:     success: boolean;
236:     data: FormattedBranch;
237:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
238:   }> {
239:     if (!actor.merchantId) {
240:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
241:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
242:         'FORBIDDEN',
243:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
244:         false
245:       );
246:     }
247: 
248:     if (!isUuid(branchId)) {
249:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
250:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
251:         'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND',
252:         'Không tìm thấy thông tin chi nhánh',
253:         false,
254:         'Chi nhánh không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa'
255:       );
256:     }
257: 
258:     const branch = await this.prisma.branch.findFirst({
259:       where: {
260:         id: branchId,
261:         merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
262:       },
263:     });
264: 
265:     if (!branch) {
266:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
267:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
268:         'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND',
269:         'Không tìm thấy thông tin chi nhánh',
270:         false,
271:         'Chi nhánh không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa'
272:       );
273:     }
274: 
275:     const hasScope = await this.checkActorBranchScope(actor, branch);
276:     if (!hasScope) {
277:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
278:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
279:         'FORBIDDEN',
280:         'Người dùng không có quyền truy cập chi nhánh được yêu cầu',
281:         false,
282:         'Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên để được phân quyền chi nhánh'
283:       );
284:     }
285: 
286:     return {
287:       success: true,
288:       data: this.formatBranch(branch),
289:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
290:     };
291:   }
