293:   /**
294:    * POST /api/v1/branches (AC-ORG-02-03, AC-ORG-02-04, AC-ORG-02-05)
295:    * Creates a new branch for the caller's merchant tenant.
296:    */
297:   async createBranch(
298:     merchantId: string,
299:     actor: ActorContext,
300:     dto: CreateBranchDto,
301:     clientIp: string,
302:     correlationId: string
303:   ): Promise<{
304:     success: boolean;
305:     data: FormattedBranch;
306:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
307:   }> {
308:     if (!merchantId) {
309:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
310:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
311:         'FORBIDDEN',
312:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
313:         false
314:       );
315:     }
316: 
317:     const validationErrors = validateCreateBranchDto(dto);
318:     if (validationErrors.length > 0) {
319:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
320:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
321:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
322:         'Dữ liệu chi nhánh không hợp lệ',
323:         false,
324:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại các trường thông tin bị lỗi',
325:         validationErrors
326:       );
327:     }
328: 
329:     const normalizedCode = dto.code.trim().toUpperCase();
330: 
331:     // BR-BRANCH-05: A scoped actor may only create a branch inside their assigned
332:     // store_scopes. Creating a branch outside that scope is a privilege escalation
333:     // and must fail closed with 403 even though the actor holds iam:shop_config.
334:     const scopedIdentifiers = await this.getActorStoreScopes(actor);
335:     if (scopedIdentifiers !== null) {
336:       const scopedSet = new Set(scopedIdentifiers);
337:       if (!scopedSet.has(normalizedCode)) {
338:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
339:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
340:           'FORBIDDEN',
341:           'Người dùng không có quyền tạo chi nhánh ngoài phạm vi được phân quyền',
342:           false,
343:           'Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên để được phân quyền chi nhánh'
344:         );
345:       }
346:     }
347: 
348:     // Check duplicate code in same merchant
349:     const existingWithCode = await this.prisma.branch.findFirst({
350:       where: {
351:         merchant_id: merchantId,
352:         code: normalizedCode,
353:       },
354:     });
355: 
356:     if (existingWithCode) {
357:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
358:         HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
359:         'BRANCH_CODE_EXISTS',
360:         `Mã chi nhánh "${normalizedCode}" đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng`,
361:         false,
362:         'Vui lòng chọn một mã chi nhánh khác'
363:       );
364:     }
365: 
366:     try {
367:       const created = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
368:         await this.lockMerchantBranches(tx, merchantId);
369: 
370:         // Count and authorize affected defaults only after the tenant lock is held.
371:         const existingCount = await tx.branch.count({
372:           where: { merchant_id: merchantId },
373:         });
374: 
375:         const isDefault = existingCount === 0 ? true : Boolean(dto.is_default);
376: 
377:         // If making this branch default when other branches exist, any existing default
378:         // branch will have its default status unset. A scoped actor must not modify an
379:         // out-of-scope default branch. Keep authorization and mutation under the same lock.
380:         if (isDefault && existingCount > 0) {
381:           const existingDefaults = await tx.branch.findMany({
382:             where: {
383:               merchant_id: merchantId,
384:               is_default: true,
385:             },
386:           });
387:           for (const defBranch of existingDefaults) {
388:             const canModify = await this.checkActorBranchScope(actor, defBranch);
389:             if (!canModify) {
390:               throw new CanonicalApiException(
391:                 HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
392:                 'FORBIDDEN',
393:                 'Người dùng không có quyền thay đổi chi nhánh mặc định ngoài phạm vi được phân quyền',
394:                 false,
395:                 'Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên để được phân quyền chi nhánh'
396:               );
397:             }
398:           }
399:         }
400: 
401:         if (isDefault && existingCount > 0) {
402:           await tx.branch.updateMany({
403:             where: {
404:               merchant_id: merchantId,
405:               is_default: true,
406:             },
407:             data: { is_default: false },
408:           });
409:         }
410: 
411:         const newBranch = await tx.branch.create({
412:           data: {
413:             merchant_id: merchantId,
414:             name: dto.name.trim(),
415:             code: normalizedCode,
416:             address: dto.address ? dto.address.trim() : null,
417:             phone: dto.phone ? dto.phone.trim().replace(/[\s.-]/g, '') : null,
418:             is_default: isDefault,
419:             status: dto.status || 'ACTIVE',
420:           },
421:         });
422: 
423:         await tx.auditLog.create({
424:           data: {
425:             merchant_id: merchantId,
426:             user_id: actor.userId,
427:             actor: actor.role || 'OWNER',
428:             action: 'BRANCH_CREATED',
429:             entity_type: 'branch',
430:             entity_id: newBranch.id,
431:             old_value: Prisma.DbNull,
432:             new_value: {
433:               id: newBranch.id,
434:               name: newBranch.name,
435:               code: newBranch.code,
436:               address: newBranch.address,
437:               phone: maskAuditValue('phone', newBranch.phone),
438:               is_default: newBranch.is_default,
439:               status: newBranch.status,
440:             },
441:             reason: correlationId ? `correlation_id:${correlationId}` : null,
442:             ip_address: this.hashIp(clientIp),
443:           },
444:         });
445: 
446:         return newBranch;
447:       });
448: 
449:       return {
450:         success: true,
451:         data: this.formatBranch(created),
452:         meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
453:       };
454:     } catch (err: any) {
455:       if (err instanceof CanonicalApiException) {
456:         throw err;
457:       }
458:       if (err?.code === 'P2002') {
459:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
460:           HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
461:           'BRANCH_CODE_EXISTS',
462:           `Mã chi nhánh "${normalizedCode}" đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng`,
463:           false,
464:           'Vui lòng chọn một mã chi nhánh khác'
465:         );
466:       }
467:       throw err;
468:     }
469:   }
470: 
471:   /**
472:    * PATCH /api/v1/branches/:id (AC-ORG-02-06, AC-ORG-02-07, AC-ORG-02-10)
473:    * Updates branch details with validation, uniqueness checks, and default branch invariants.
474:    */
475:   async updateBranch(
476:     branchId: string,
477:     merchantId: string,
478:     actor: ActorContext,
479:     dto: UpdateBranchDto,
480:     clientIp: string,
481:     correlationId: string
482:   ): Promise<{
483:     success: boolean;
484:     data: FormattedBranch;
485:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
486:   }> {
487:     if (!merchantId) {
488:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
489:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
490:         'FORBIDDEN',
491:         'Yêu cầu không xác định được danh tính cửa hàng',
492:         false
493:       );
494:     }
495: 
496:     const validationErrors = validateUpdateBranchDto(dto);
497:     if (validationErrors.length > 0) {
498:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
499:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
500:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
501:         'Dữ liệu cập nhật chi nhánh không hợp lệ',
502:         false,
503:         'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại các trường thông tin bị lỗi',
504:         validationErrors
505:       );
506:     }
507: 
508:     if (!isUuid(branchId)) {
509:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
510:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
511:         'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND',
512:         'Không tìm thấy thông tin chi nhánh',
513:         false,
514:         'Chi nhánh không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa'
515:       );
516:     }
517: 
518:     let normalizedCode: string | undefined;
519:     try {
520:       const updated = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
521:         await this.lockMerchantBranches(tx, merchantId);
522: 
523:         const existing = await tx.branch.findFirst({
524:           where: {
525:             id: branchId,
526:             merchant_id: merchantId,
527:           },
528:         });
529: 
530:         if (!existing) {
531:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
532:             HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
533:             'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND',
534:             'Không tìm thấy thông tin chi nhánh',
535:             false,
536:             'Chi nhánh không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa'
537:           );
538:         }
539: 
540:         const hasScope = await this.checkActorBranchScope(actor, existing);
541:         if (!hasScope) {
542:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
543:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
544:             'FORBIDDEN',
545:             'Người dùng không có quyền chỉnh sửa chi nhánh được yêu cầu',
546:             false
547:           );
548:         }
549: 
550:         // Code uniqueness check if code is being updated
551:         if (dto.code !== undefined) {
552:           normalizedCode = dto.code.trim().toUpperCase();
553:           if (normalizedCode !== existing.code) {
554:             const duplicate = await tx.branch.findFirst({
555:               where: {
556:                 merchant_id: merchantId,
557:                 code: normalizedCode,
558:                 id: { not: branchId },
559:               },
560:             });
561: 
562:             if (duplicate) {
563:               throw new CanonicalApiException(
564:                 HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
565:                 'BRANCH_CODE_EXISTS',
566:                 `Mã chi nhánh "${normalizedCode}" đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng`,
567:                 false
568:               );
569:             }
570:           }
571:         }
572: 
573:         // Default branch invariant checks (BR-BRANCH-04)
574:         if (existing.is_default && dto.status === 'INACTIVE') {
575:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
576:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
577:             'CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_DEFAULT_BRANCH',
578:             'Không thể vô hiệu hóa chi nhánh mặc định',
579:             false,
580:             'Vui lòng chỉ định một chi nhánh khác làm mặc định trước khi vô hiệu hóa chi nhánh này'
581:           );
582:         }
583: 
584:         if (existing.is_default && dto.is_default === false) {
585:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
586:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
587:             'CANNOT_REMOVE_DEFAULT_STATUS',
588:             'Không thể hủy trạng thái mặc định của chi nhánh trực tiếp',
589:             false,
590:             'Vui lòng chỉ định một chi nhánh khác làm mặc định'
591:           );
592:         }
593: 
594:         // If setting is_default to true,
595:         // any existing default branch will have its default status unset.
596:         // Authorize every affected default branch while holding the tenant lock.
597:         if (dto.is_default === true) {
598:           const existingDefaults = await tx.branch.findMany({
599:             where: {
600:               merchant_id: merchantId,
601:               is_default: true,
602:               id: { not: branchId },
603:             },
604:           });
605:           for (const defBranch of existingDefaults) {
606:             const canModify = await this.checkActorBranchScope(actor, defBranch);
607:             if (!canModify) {
608:               throw new CanonicalApiException(
609:                 HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
610:                 'FORBIDDEN',
611:                 'Người dùng không có quyền thay đổi chi nhánh mặc định ngoài phạm vi được phân quyền',
612:                 false,
613:                 'Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên để được phân quyền chi nhánh'
614:               );
615:             }
616:           }
617:         }
618: 
619:         const dataToUpdate: any = {};
620:         if (dto.name !== undefined) dataToUpdate.name = dto.name.trim();
621:         if (normalizedCode !== undefined) dataToUpdate.code = normalizedCode;
622:         if (dto.address !== undefined)
623:           dataToUpdate.address = dto.address ? dto.address.trim() : null;
624:         if (dto.phone !== undefined)
625:           dataToUpdate.phone = dto.phone ? dto.phone.trim().replace(/[\s.-]/g, '') : null;
626:         if (dto.is_default !== undefined) dataToUpdate.is_default = dto.is_default;
627:         if (dto.status !== undefined) dataToUpdate.status = dto.status;
628: 
629:         if (dto.is_default === true) {
630:           await tx.branch.updateMany({
631:             where: {
632:               merchant_id: merchantId,
633:               is_default: true,
634:               id: { not: branchId },
635:             },
636:             data: { is_default: false },
637:           });
638:         }
639: 
640:         const result = await tx.branch.update({
641:           where: { id: branchId, merchant_id: merchantId },
642:           data: dataToUpdate,
643:         });
644: 
645:         const updatedFields = Object.keys(dataToUpdate);
646:         const beforeDiff: Record<string, any> = {};
647:         const afterDiff: Record<string, any> = {};
648: 
649:         for (const field of updatedFields) {
650:           beforeDiff[field] = maskAuditValue(field, (existing as any)[field]);
651:           afterDiff[field] = maskAuditValue(field, (result as any)[field]);
652:         }
653: 
654:         await tx.auditLog.create({
655:           data: {
656:             merchant_id: merchantId,
657:             user_id: actor.userId,
658:             actor: actor.role || 'OWNER',
659:             action: 'BRANCH_UPDATED',
660:             entity_type: 'branch',
661:             entity_id: branchId,
662:             old_value: beforeDiff,
663:             new_value: afterDiff,
664:             reason: correlationId ? `correlation_id:${correlationId}` : null,
665:             ip_address: this.hashIp(clientIp),
666:           },
667:         });
668: 
669:         return result;
670:       });
671: 
672:       return {
673:         success: true,
674:         data: this.formatBranch(updated),
675:         meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
676:       };
677:     } catch (err: any) {
678:       if (err instanceof CanonicalApiException) {
679:         throw err;
680:       }
681:       if (err?.code === 'P2002') {
682:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
683:           HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
684:           'BRANCH_CODE_EXISTS',
685:           `Mã chi nhánh "${normalizedCode || dto.code}" đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng`,
686:           false,
687:           'Vui lòng chọn một mã chi nhánh khác'
688:         );
689:       }
690:       throw err;
691:     }
692:   }
693: 
694:   /**
695:    * POST /api/v1/branches/:id/activate (AC-ORG-02-08)
696:    */
697:   async activateBranch(
698:     branchId: string,
699:     merchantId: string,
700:     actor: ActorContext,
701:     clientIp: string,
702:     correlationId: string
703:   ): Promise<{
704:     success: boolean;
705:     data: FormattedBranch;
706:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
707:   }> {
708:     if (!isUuid(branchId)) {
709:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
710:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
711:         'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND',
712:         'Không tìm thấy thông tin chi nhánh',
713:         false
714:       );
715:     }
716: 
717:     const existing = await this.prisma.branch.findFirst({
718:       where: { id: branchId, merchant_id: merchantId },
719:     });
720: 
721:     if (!existing) {
722:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
723:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
724:         'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND',
725:         'Không tìm thấy thông tin chi nhánh',
726:         false
727:       );
728:     }
729: 
730:     const hasScope = await this.checkActorBranchScope(actor, existing);
731:     if (!hasScope) {
732:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
733:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
734:         'FORBIDDEN',
735:         'Người dùng không có quyền kích hoạt chi nhánh được yêu cầu',
736:         false
737:       );
738:     }
739: 
740:     const updated = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
741:       const result = await tx.branch.update({
742:         where: { id: branchId },
743:         data: { status: 'ACTIVE' },
744:       });
745: 
746:       await tx.auditLog.create({
747:         data: {
748:           merchant_id: merchantId,
749:           user_id: actor.userId,
750:           actor: actor.role || 'OWNER',
751:           action: 'BRANCH_ACTIVATED',
752:           entity_type: 'branch',
753:           entity_id: branchId,
754:           old_value: { status: existing.status },
755:           new_value: { status: 'ACTIVE' },
756:           reason: correlationId ? `correlation_id:${correlationId}` : null,
757:           ip_address: this.hashIp(clientIp),
758:         },
759:       });
760: 
761:       return result;
762:     });
763: 
764:     return {
765:       success: true,
766:       data: this.formatBranch(updated),
767:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
768:     };
769:   }
770: 
771:   /**
772:    * POST /api/v1/branches/:id/deactivate (AC-ORG-02-09, AC-ORG-02-10)
773:    */
774:   async deactivateBranch(
775:     branchId: string,
776:     merchantId: string,
777:     actor: ActorContext,
778:     clientIp: string,
779:     correlationId: string
780:   ): Promise<{
781:     success: boolean;
782:     data: FormattedBranch;
783:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
784:   }> {
785:     if (!isUuid(branchId)) {
786:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
787:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
788:         'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND',
789:         'Không tìm thấy thông tin chi nhánh',
790:         false
791:       );
792:     }
793: 
794:     const updated = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
795:       await this.lockMerchantBranches(tx, merchantId);
796: 
797:       const existing = await tx.branch.findFirst({
798:         where: { id: branchId, merchant_id: merchantId },
799:       });
800: 
801:       if (!existing) {
802:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
803:           HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
804:           'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND',
805:           'Không tìm thấy thông tin chi nhánh',
806:           false
807:         );
808:       }
809: 
810:       if (existing.is_default) {
811:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
812:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
813:           'CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_DEFAULT_BRANCH',
814:           'Không thể vô hiệu hóa chi nhánh mặc định',
815:           false,
816:           'Vui lòng chỉ định một chi nhánh khác làm mặc định trước khi vô hiệu hóa chi nhánh này'
817:         );
818:       }
819: 
820:       const hasScope = await this.checkActorBranchScope(actor, existing);
821:       if (!hasScope) {
822:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
823:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
824:           'FORBIDDEN',
825:           'Người dùng không có quyền vô hiệu hóa chi nhánh được yêu cầu',
826:           false
827:         );
828:       }
829: 
830:       const result = await tx.branch.update({
831:         where: { id: branchId },
832:         data: { status: 'INACTIVE' },
833:       });
834: 
835:       await tx.auditLog.create({
836:         data: {
837:           merchant_id: merchantId,
838:           user_id: actor.userId,
839:           actor: actor.role || 'OWNER',
840:           action: 'BRANCH_DEACTIVATED',
841:           entity_type: 'branch',
842:           entity_id: branchId,
843:           old_value: { status: existing.status },
844:           new_value: { status: 'INACTIVE' },
845:           reason: correlationId ? `correlation_id:${correlationId}` : null,
846:           ip_address: this.hashIp(clientIp),
847:         },
848:       });
849: 
850:       return result;
851:     });
852: 
853:     return {
854:       success: true,
855:       data: this.formatBranch(updated),
856:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
857:     };
858:   }

860:   /**
861:    * DELETE /api/v1/branches/:id
862:    */
863:   async deleteBranch(
864:     branchId: string,
865:     merchantId: string,
866:     actor: ActorContext,
867:     clientIp: string,
868:     correlationId: string
869:   ): Promise<{
870:     success: boolean;
871:     message: string;
872:     meta: { correlation_id: string };
873:   }> {
874:     if (!isUuid(branchId)) {
875:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
876:         HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
877:         'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND',
878:         'Không tìm thấy thông tin chi nhánh',
879:         false
880:       );
881:     }
882: 
883:     await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
884:       await this.lockMerchantBranches(tx, merchantId);
885: 
886:       const existing = await tx.branch.findFirst({
887:         where: { id: branchId, merchant_id: merchantId },
888:       });
889: 
890:       if (!existing) {
891:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
892:           HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
893:           'BRANCH_NOT_FOUND',
894:           'Không tìm thấy thông tin chi nhánh',
895:           false
896:         );
897:       }
898: 
899:       if (existing.is_default) {
900:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
901:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
902:           'CANNOT_DELETE_DEFAULT_BRANCH',
903:           'Không thể xóa chi nhánh mặc định',
904:           false,
905:           'Vui lòng chỉ định một chi nhánh khác làm mặc định trước khi xóa chi nhánh này'
906:         );
907:       }
908: 
909:       const hasScope = await this.checkActorBranchScope(actor, existing);
910:       if (!hasScope) {
911:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
912:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
913:           'FORBIDDEN',
914:           'Người dùng không có quyền xóa chi nhánh được yêu cầu',
915:           false
916:         );
917:       }
918: 
919:       await tx.branch.delete({
920:         where: { id: branchId },
921:       });
922: 
923:       await tx.auditLog.create({
924:         data: {
925:           merchant_id: merchantId,
926:           user_id: actor.userId,
927:           actor: actor.role || 'OWNER',
928:           action: 'BRANCH_DELETED',
929:           entity_type: 'branch',
930:           entity_id: branchId,
931:           old_value: {
932:             id: existing.id,
933:             name: existing.name,
934:             code: existing.code,
935:             address: existing.address,
936:             phone: maskAuditValue('phone', existing.phone),
937:             is_default: existing.is_default,
938:             status: existing.status,
939:           },
940:           new_value: Prisma.DbNull,
941:           reason: correlationId ? `correlation_id:${correlationId}` : null,
942:           ip_address: this.hashIp(clientIp),
943:         },
944:       });
945:     });
946: 
947:     return {
948:       success: true,
949:       message: 'Đã xóa chi nhánh thành công',
950:       meta: { correlation_id: correlationId },
951:     };
952:   }
953: }

 755:     // Real overlapping transactions: the privileged writer holds the tenant lock
 756:     // and changes the default while the scoped request is entering its transaction.
 757:     // The scoped request must re-read the committed default and leave it untouched.
 758:     for (const operation of ['create', 'update'] as const) {
 759:       const prefix = `RACE-${operation.toUpperCase()}`;
 760:       const [current, target, outside] = await Promise.all(
 761:         ['CURRENT', 'TARGET', 'OUTSIDE'].map((suffix) =>
 762:           prisma.branch.create({
 763:             data: { merchant_id: merchantIdA, code: `${prefix}-${suffix}`, name: suffix },
 764:           })
 765:         )
 766:       );
 767:       await prisma.branch.updateMany({
 768:         where: { merchant_id: merchantIdA },
 769:         data: { is_default: false },
 770:       });
 771:       await prisma.branch.update({ where: { id: current.id }, data: { is_default: true } });
 772:       const { userId } = await setupUserSession(
 773:         merchantIdA,
 774:         RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH,
 775:         `race_${operation}`,
 776:         [current.code, target.code, `${prefix}-NEW`]
 777:       );
 778:       const actor = { userId, merchantId: merchantIdA, role: RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH };
 779:       let entered!: () => void;
 780:       const transactionEntered = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
 781:         entered = resolve;
 782:       });
 783:       const db = new Proxy(prisma, {
 784:         get(client, key) {
 785:           if (key === '$transaction') {
 786:             return (cb: any) =>
 787:               client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 788:                 entered();
 789:                 return cb(tx);
 790:               });
 791:           }
 792:           return Reflect.get(client, key);
 793:         },
 794:       });
 795:       const service = new BranchesService(db, app.get(RbacService));
 796:       const correlationId = `race-${operation}-${testSuffix}`;
 797:       let result!: Promise<unknown>;
 798:       await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 799:         await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE id = ${merchantIdA}::uuid FOR NO KEY UPDATE`;
 800:         await tx.branch.update({ where: { id: current.id }, data: { is_default: false } });
 801:         await tx.branch.update({ where: { id: outside.id }, data: { is_default: true } });
 802:         const pending =
 803:           operation === 'create'
 804:             ? service.createBranch(
 805:                 merchantIdA,
 806:                 actor,
 807:                 { name: 'Concurrent create', code: `${prefix}-NEW`, is_default: true },
 808:                 '',
 809:                 correlationId
 810:               )
 811:             : service.updateBranch(
 812:                 target.id,
 813:                 merchantIdA,
 814:                 actor,
 815:                 { is_default: true },
 816:                 '',
 817:                 correlationId
 818:               );
 819:         result = assert.rejects(
 820:           pending,
 821:           (err: any) => err.getStatus() === 403 && err.code === 'FORBIDDEN'
 822:         );
 823:         let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
 824:         try {
 825:           await Promise.race([
 826:             transactionEntered,
 827:             new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
 828:               timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Scoped transaction did not start')), 3000);
 829:             }),
 830:           ]);
 831:         } finally {
 832:           clearTimeout(timer);
 833:         }
 834:       });
 835:       await result;
 836:       const defaults = await prisma.branch.findMany({
 837:         where: { merchant_id: merchantIdA, is_default: true },
 838:       });
 839:       assert.deepStrictEqual(
 840:         defaults.map((branch) => branch.id),
 841:         [outside.id]
 842:       );
 843:       assert.strictEqual(
 844:         await prisma.branch.count({ where: { merchant_id: merchantIdA, code: `${prefix}-NEW` } }),
 845:         0
 846:       );
 847:       assert.strictEqual(
 848:         await prisma.auditLog.count({
 849:           where: { merchant_id: merchantIdA, reason: `correlation_id:${correlationId}` },
 850:         }),
 851:         0
 852:       );
 853:     }
 854: 
 855:     // Real overlapping transactions for deactivate and delete:
 856:     // A target non-default branch is being deactivated or deleted. While entering the transaction,
 857:     // another transaction holding the tenant lock commits the target branch as default.
 858:     // The pending deactivate/delete must re-read the target branch inside the locked transaction,
 859:     // detect that it is now default, and reject with 400 (CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_DEFAULT_BRANCH / CANNOT_DELETE_DEFAULT_BRANCH).
 860:     for (const operation of ['deactivate', 'delete'] as const) {
 861:       const prefix = `RACE-${operation.toUpperCase()}`;
 862:       const [current, target] = await Promise.all(
 863:         ['CURRENT', 'TARGET'].map((suffix) =>
 864:           prisma.branch.create({
 865:             data: {
 866:               merchant_id: merchantIdA,
 867:               code: `${prefix}-${suffix}-${testSuffix}`,
 868:               name: suffix,
 869:               is_default: false,
 870:             },
 871:           })
 872:         )
 873:       );
 874:       await prisma.branch.updateMany({
 875:         where: { merchant_id: merchantIdA },
 876:         data: { is_default: false },
 877:       });
 878:       await prisma.branch.update({ where: { id: current.id }, data: { is_default: true } });
 879:       const { userId } = await setupUserSession(
 880:         merchantIdA,
 881:         RoleEnum.OWNER,
 882:         `race_${operation}_${testSuffix}`,
 883:         ['*']
 884:       );
 885:       const actor = { userId, merchantId: merchantIdA, role: RoleEnum.OWNER };
 886:       let entered!: () => void;
 887:       const transactionEntered = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
 888:         entered = resolve;
 889:       });
 890:       const db = new Proxy(prisma, {
 891:         get(client, key) {
 892:           if (key === '$transaction') {
 893:             return (cb: any) =>
 894:               client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 895:                 entered();
 896:                 return cb(tx);
 897:               });
 898:           }
 899:           return Reflect.get(client, key);
 900:         },
 901:       });
 902:       const service = new BranchesService(db, app.get(RbacService));
 903:       const correlationId = `race-${operation}-${testSuffix}`;
 904:       const expectedCode =
 905:         operation === 'deactivate'
 906:           ? 'CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
 907:           : 'CANNOT_DELETE_DEFAULT_BRANCH';
 908:       let result!: Promise<unknown>;
 909:       await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 910:         await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE id = ${merchantIdA}::uuid FOR NO KEY UPDATE`;
 911:         // Concurrent transaction promotes target to default
 912:         await tx.branch.update({ where: { id: current.id }, data: { is_default: false } });
 913:         await tx.branch.update({ where: { id: target.id }, data: { is_default: true } });
 914:         const pending =
 915:           operation === 'deactivate'
 916:             ? service.deactivateBranch(target.id, merchantIdA, actor, '127.0.0.1', correlationId)
 917:             : service.deleteBranch(target.id, merchantIdA, actor, '127.0.0.1', correlationId);
 918:         result = assert.rejects(
 919:           pending,
 920:           (err: any) => err.getStatus() === 400 && err.code === expectedCode
 921:         );
 922:         let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
 923:         try {
 924:           await Promise.race([
 925:             transactionEntered,
 926:             new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
 927:               timer = setTimeout(
 928:                 () => reject(new Error(`${operation} transaction did not start`)),
 929:                 3000
 930:               );
 931:             }),
 932:           ]);
 933:         } finally {
 934:           clearTimeout(timer);
 935:         }
 936:       });
 937:       await result;
 938:       const targetAfter = await prisma.branch.findUnique({
 939:         where: { id: target.id },
 940:       });
 941:       assert.ok(targetAfter, `Target branch must still exist after rejected ${operation}`);
 942:       assert.strictEqual(targetAfter.is_default, true, 'Target branch must remain default');
 943:       assert.strictEqual(targetAfter.status, 'ACTIVE', 'Target branch status must remain ACTIVE');
 944:       assert.strictEqual(
 945:         await prisma.auditLog.count({
 946:           where: { merchant_id: merchantIdA, reason: `correlation_id:${correlationId}` },
 947:         }),
 948:         0,
 949:         `Rejected ${operation} must not produce audit logs`
 950:       );
 951:       console.log(
 952:         `  PASS: Concurrent ${operation} on default branch rejected with ${expectedCode}.`
 953:       );
 954:     }
 955: 
 956:     console.log('================================================================');
 957:     console.log('🎉 ALL FEAT-ORG-02 SUPERTEST CHECKS PASSED (AC-01..16)!');
 958:     console.log('================================================================');
 959:   } finally {
 960:     // Cleanup ONLY fixture tenant rows. Never delete another tenant's audit rows.
 961:     await prisma.auditLog.deleteMany({
 962:       where: {
 963:         merchant_id: {
 964:           in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB],
 965:         },
 966:       },
 967:     });
 968:     await prisma.branch.deleteMany({
 969:       where: {
 970:         merchant_id: {
 971:           in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB],
 972:         },
 973:       },
 974:     });
 975:     await prisma.deviceSession.deleteMany({
 976:       where: {
 977:         merchant_id: {
 978:           in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB],
 979:         },
 980:       },
 981:     });
 982:     await prisma.user.deleteMany({
 983:       where: {
 984:         merchant_id: {
 985:           in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB],
 986:         },
 987:       },
 988:     });
 989:     await prisma.rolePermission.deleteMany({
 990:       where: {
 991:         role: {
 992:           merchant_id: {
 993:             in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB],
 994:           },
 995:         },
 996:       },
 997:     });
 998:     await prisma.role.deleteMany({
 999:       where: {
1000:         merchant_id: {
1001:           in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB],
1002:         },
1003:       },
1004:     });
1005:     await prisma.merchant.deleteMany({
1006:       where: {
1007:         id: {
1008:           in: [merchantIdA, merchantIdB],
1009:         },
1010:       },
1011:     });
1012:     await app.close();
1013:   }
1014: }
1015:

 904:   describe('Default branch concurrent scope regression', () => {
 905:     for (const operation of ['create', 'update'] as const) {
 906:       it(`${operation} rejects an out-of-scope default committed before the transaction lock`, async () => {
 907:         const db = createMockPrismaService();
 908:         // Initially both the target and current default are in scope. A competing
 909:         // request commits a new default while this request is entering its transaction.
 910:         db.users.find((u) => u.id === 'u-scoped-tb')!.store_scopes.push('HCM-Q3');
 911:         const outside = {
 912:           ...db.branches[0],
 913:           id: '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333',
 914:           code: 'OUTSIDE',
 915:           is_default: false,
 916:         };
 917:         db.branches.push(outside);
 918:         const transaction = db.$transaction;
 919:         let locked = false;
 920:         db.$transaction = async (cb: any) => {
 921:           db.branches[0].is_default = false;
 922:           outside.is_default = true;
 923:           return transaction(async (tx: any) => {
 924:             tx.$queryRaw = async (sql: TemplateStringsArray, ...values: unknown[]) => {
 925:               assert.match(sql.join('?'), /merchants[\s\S]*FOR NO KEY UPDATE/);
 926:               assert.deepStrictEqual(values, ['m-tenant-1']);
 927:               locked = true;
 928:               return [{ id: 'm-tenant-1' }];
 929:             };
 930:             const findMany = tx.branch.findMany;
 931:             tx.branch.findMany = async (args: any) => {
 932:               assert.ok(locked, 'affected defaults must be read after acquiring the tenant lock');
 933:               return findMany(args);
 934:             };
 935:             return cb(tx);
 936:           });
 937:         };
 938:         const service = new BranchesService(db as any);
 939:         const actor: ActorContext = {
 940:           userId: 'u-scoped-tb',
 941:           merchantId: 'm-tenant-1',
 942:           role: 'OPS_CSKH',
 943:         };
 944:         await assert.rejects(
 945:           () =>
 946:             operation === 'create'
 947:               ? service.createBranch(
 948:                   actor.merchantId,
 949:                   actor,
 950:                   { name: 'New branch', code: 'HCM-NEW-SCOPED', is_default: true },
 951:                   '',
 952:                   'concurrent-create'

  21: /**
  22:  * Canonicalizes Vietnamese phone numbers to standard national format (e.g. 0901234567).
  23:  * BR-INV-08, AC-USR-01-05.
  24:  */
  25: export function canonicalizePhoneNumber(rawPhone?: string): string | undefined {
  26:   if (!rawPhone) return undefined;
  27:   let cleaned = rawPhone.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
  28:   if (cleaned.startsWith('+84')) {
  29:     cleaned = '0' + cleaned.slice(3);
  30:   } else if (cleaned.startsWith('84') && cleaned.length === 11) {
  31:     cleaned = '0' + cleaned.slice(2);
  32:   }
  33:   return cleaned;
  34: }
  35: 
  36: export interface CanonicalIdentity {
  37:   rawEmail?: string;
  38:   rawPhone?: string;
  39:   email?: string;
  40:   phone?: string;
  41:   recipient?: string;
  42:   buildUserOrConditions: () => Array<{
  43:     email?: { equals: string; mode: 'insensitive' };
  44:     phone?: string;
  45:   }>;
  46:   buildInvitationOrConditions: () => Array<{
  47:     email?: { equals: string; mode: 'insensitive' };
  48:     phone?: string;
  49:   }>;
  50: }
  51: 
  52: /**
  53:  * ONE shared canonical identity helper (lowercase email, canonical VN phone)
  54:  * used across createInvitation, resendInvitation, and acceptInvitation (Round 8 Finding 2 / BR-INV-08 / AC-USR-01-05).
  55:  */
  56: export function resolveCanonicalIdentity(params: {
  57:   email?: string | null;
  58:   phone?: string | null;
  59: }): CanonicalIdentity {
  60:   const rawEmail = typeof params.email === 'string' ? params.email.trim() : undefined;
  61:   const rawPhone = typeof params.phone === 'string' ? params.phone.trim() : undefined;
  62:   const email = rawEmail && rawEmail.length > 0 ? rawEmail.toLowerCase() : undefined;
  63:   const phone = rawPhone ? canonicalizePhoneNumber(rawPhone) : undefined;
  64:   const recipient = email || phone;
  65: 
  66:   const buildConditions = () => {
  67:     const or: Array<{ email?: { equals: string; mode: 'insensitive' }; phone?: string }> = [];
  68:     if (email) {
  69:       or.push({ email: { equals: email, mode: 'insensitive' } });
  70:     }
  71:     if (phone) {
  72:       or.push({ phone });
  73:       if (phone.startsWith('0')) {
  74:         or.push({ phone: `+84${phone.slice(1)}` });
  75:         or.push({ phone: `84${phone.slice(1)}` });
  76:       }
  77:     }
  78:     return or;
  79:   };
  80: 
  81:   return {
  82:     rawEmail,
  83:     rawPhone,
  84:     email,
  85:     phone,
  86:     recipient,
  87:     buildUserOrConditions: buildConditions,
  88:     buildInvitationOrConditions: buildConditions,
  89:   };
  90: }

  92: export function maskIdentifier(identifier?: string | null): string {
  93:   if (!identifier) return '';
  94:   if (identifier.includes('@')) {
  95:     const [name, domain] = identifier.split('@');
  96:     if (!name || !domain) return '***';
  97:     if (name.length <= 2) {
  98:       return `${name[0]}*@${domain}`;
  99:     }
 100:     return `${name[0]}${'*'.repeat(Math.min(name.length - 2, 4))}${name[name.length - 1]}@${domain}`;
 101:   }
 102:   if (identifier.length >= 7) {
 103:     const start = identifier.slice(0, 3);
 104:     const end = identifier.slice(-3);
 105:     return `${start}****${end}`;
 106:   }
 107:   return '***';
 108: }

 110: export function validatePasswordStrength(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
 111:   const errors: string[] = [];
 112:   if (!password || password.length < 8) {
 113:     errors.push('Mật khẩu phải có độ dài tối thiểu 8 ký tự');
 114:   }
 115:   if (password && password.length > 128) {
 116:     errors.push('Mật khẩu không được vượt quá 128 ký tự');
 117:   }
 118:   if (password && !/[A-Z]/.test(password)) {
 119:     errors.push('Mật khẩu phải chứa ít nhất 1 chữ hoa');
 120:   }
 121:   if (password && !/[a-z]/.test(password)) {
 122:     errors.push('Mật khẩu phải chứa ít nhất 1 chữ thường');
 123:   }
 124:   if (password && !/[0-9]/.test(password)) {
 125:     errors.push('Mật khẩu phải chứa ít nhất 1 chữ số');
 126:   }
 127:   if (password && !/[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]{};':"\\|,.<>\/?]/.test(password)) {
 128:     errors.push('Mật khẩu phải chứa ít nhất 1 ký tự đặc biệt');
 129:   }
 130:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
 131: }

 150:   /**
 151:    * Refund exactly the dispatch quota slots consumed by this request when no invitation
 152:    * dispatch was committed (Round 6 Findings 2 and 4).
 153:    */
 154:   private async refundDispatchQuota(reservation?: InvitationDispatchReservation): Promise<void> {
 155:     if (!reservation || !this.rateLimitService) return;
 156:     if (typeof this.rateLimitService.revertInvitationDispatchAttempt !== 'function') return;
 157:     await this.rateLimitService.revertInvitationDispatchAttempt(reservation);

 160:   /** Prisma P2002 on the BR-INV-08 partial unique pending indexes. */
 161:   private isPendingUniqueViolation(err: any): boolean {
 162:     if (err?.code !== 'P2002') return false;
 163:     const target = err?.meta?.target;
 164:     const targetText = Array.isArray(target) ? target.join(',') : String(target ?? '');
 165:     // Invitation has no other unique constraints besides id/token_hash; treat unknown target as pending
 166:     return !/token_hash|_pkey/.test(targetText);
 167:   }

 169:   /**
 170:    * Strict positive-integer pagination parsing (Round 6 Finding 7): non-integer input such as
 171:    * `page=abc` is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR instead of producing NaN; limit is capped.
 172:    */
 173:   private parsePaginationParam(
 174:     raw: number | string | undefined,
 175:     field: 'page' | 'limit',
 176:     fallback: number,
 177:     max: number
 178:   ): number {
 179:     if (raw === undefined || raw === null || raw === '') return fallback;
 180:     const text = typeof raw === 'number' ? String(raw) : raw.trim();
 181:     const value = /^[0-9]+$/.test(text) ? Number(text) : NaN;
 182:     if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 1) {
 183:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 184:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 185:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 186:         'Tham số phân trang không hợp lệ',
 187:         false,
 188:         undefined,
 189:         [{ field, code: 'INVALID_INTEGER', message: `${field} phải là số nguyên dương` }]
 190:       );
 191:     }
 192:     if (field === 'page' && value > max) {
 193:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 194:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 195:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 196:         'Tham số phân trang vượt quá giới hạn cho phép',
 197:         false,
 198:         undefined,
 199:         [{ field: 'page', code: 'OUT_OF_RANGE', message: `page không được vượt quá ${max}` }]
 200:       );
 201:     }
 202:     return Math.min(max, value);
 203:   }

 219:   private validateScopeArray(

 238:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 239:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 240:         `Số lượng phần tử trong ${fieldName} không được vượt quá ${maxCount}`,
 241:         false,
 242:         undefined,
 243:         [
 244:           {
 245:             field: fieldName,
 246:             code: 'OUT_OF_RANGE',
 247:             message: `Số lượng phần tử trong ${fieldName} không được vượt quá ${maxCount}`,
 248:           },
 249:         ]
 250:       );
 251:     }
 252:     for (let i = 0; i < scopes.length; i++) {
 253:       const item = scopes[i];
 254:       if (typeof item !== 'string' || item.trim().length === 0) {
 255:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 256:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 257:           'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 258:           `Phần tử thứ ${i} trong ${fieldName} phải là chuỗi không rỗng`,
 259:           false,
 260:           undefined,
 261:           [
 262:             {
 263:               field: `${fieldName}[${i}]`,
 264:               code: 'INVALID_TYPE',
 265:               message: `Phần tử trong ${fieldName} phải là chuỗi không rỗng`,
 266:             },
 267:           ]
 268:         );
 269:       }
 270:       if (item.trim().length > maxLength) {
 271:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 272:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 273:           'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 274:           `Phần tử trong ${fieldName} không được vượt quá ${maxLength} ký tự`,
 275:           false,
 276:           undefined,
 277:           [
 278:             {
 279:               field: `${fieldName}[${i}]`,
 280:               code: 'OUT_OF_RANGE',
 281:               message: `Phần tử trong ${fieldName} không được vượt quá ${maxLength} ký tự`,
 282:             },
 283:           ]
 284:         );
 285:       }
 286:     }
 287:   }

 289:   private async resolveActorUser(actor: {
 290:     userId: string;
 291:     merchantId: string;
 292:     role?: string;
 293:     store_scopes?: string[];
 294:     warehouse_scopes?: string[];
 295:   }): Promise<{
 296:     id: string;
 297:     role: RoleEnum | string;
 298:     store_scopes: string[];
 299:     warehouse_scopes: string[];
 300:   } | null> {
 301:     if (actor.userId) {
 302:       const user = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
 303:         where: { id: actor.userId, merchant_id: actor.merchantId },
 304:         select: { id: true, role: true, store_scopes: true, warehouse_scopes: true, status: true },
 305:       });
 306:       if (user) {
 307:         const isUserActive = isActiveStatus(user.status);
 308:         if (!isUserActive) {
 309:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 310:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 311:             'FORBIDDEN',
 312:             'Tài khoản người dùng đã bị vô hiệu hóa hoặc chưa kích hoạt',
 313:             false
 314:           );
 315:         }
 316:         if (user.role) {
 317:           return {
 318:             id: user.id,
 319:             role: user.role,
 320:             store_scopes: user.store_scopes || [],
 321:             warehouse_scopes: user.warehouse_scopes || [],
 322:           };
 323:         }
 324:       }
 325:     }
 326:     // Backend is authoritative (Finding 5 / SECURITY-NFR):
 327:     // Never fall back to caller-supplied claims; authorize ONLY from tenant-scoped user row
 328:     return null;
 329:   }
 330: 
 331:   private async resolveActorRole(actor: {
 332:     userId: string;
 333:     merchantId: string;
 334:     role?: string;
 335:   }): Promise<RoleEnum | string | undefined> {
 336:     const actorUser = await this.resolveActorUser(actor);
 337:     return actorUser?.role;
 338:   }
 339: 
 340:   private enforcePrivilegeCeiling(
 341:     actorUser: { role: RoleEnum | string; store_scopes: string[]; warehouse_scopes: string[] },
 342:     targetRole: RoleEnum | string,
 343:     targetStoreScopes: string[] = [],
 344:     targetWarehouseScopes: string[] = [],
 345:     actionLabel: string = 'mời'
 346:   ) {
 347:     if (actorUser.role === RoleEnum.OWNER) {
 348:       return;
 349:     }
 350: 
 351:     if (targetRole === RoleEnum.OWNER) {
 352:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 353:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 354:         'FORBIDDEN',
 355:         `Vượt quá hạn mức phân quyền: Bạn không có quyền ${actionLabel} người dùng với vai trò Chủ cửa hàng (OWNER)`,
 356:         false
 357:       );
 358:     }
 359: 
 360:     // Non-owner cannot grant/re-issue roles they do not hold (e.g. OPS_CSKH cannot invite/resend/cancel ACCOUNTANT or WAREHOUSE)
 361:     if (targetRole !== actorUser.role) {
 362:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 363:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 364:         'FORBIDDEN',
 365:         `Vượt quá hạn mức phân quyền: Bạn không thể phân quyền vai trò ${targetRole} vượt quá quyền hạn của mình`,
 366:         false
 367:       );
 368:     }
 369: 
 370:     // Non-owner cannot grant/re-issue store scopes outside their own scope
 371:     if (targetStoreScopes && targetStoreScopes.length > 0) {
 372:       const actorStores = new Set(actorUser.store_scopes || []);
 373:       if (!actorStores.has('*')) {
 374:         const unauthorizedStores = targetStoreScopes.filter((s) => !actorStores.has(s));
 375:         if (unauthorizedStores.length > 0) {
 376:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 377:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 378:             'FORBIDDEN',
 379:             `Vượt quá hạn mức phân quyền: Chi nhánh không thuộc phạm vi quản lý (${unauthorizedStores.join(', ')})`,
 380:             false
 381:           );
 382:         }
 383:       }
 384:     }
 385: 
 386:     // Non-owner cannot grant/re-issue warehouse scopes outside their own scope
 387:     if (targetWarehouseScopes && targetWarehouseScopes.length > 0) {
 388:       const actorWarehouses = new Set(actorUser.warehouse_scopes || []);
 389:       if (!actorWarehouses.has('*')) {
 390:         const unauthorizedWarehouses = targetWarehouseScopes.filter((w) => !actorWarehouses.has(w));
 391:         if (unauthorizedWarehouses.length > 0) {
 392:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 393:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 394:             'FORBIDDEN',
 395:             `Vượt quá hạn mức phân quyền: Kho hàng không thuộc phạm vi quản lý (${unauthorizedWarehouses.join(', ')})`,
 396:             false
 397:           );
 398:         }
 399:       }
 400:     }
 401:   }

 403:   /**
 404:    * Send a new team member invitation (POST /api/v1/invitations)
 405:    * BR-INV-01, BR-INV-02, BR-INV-03, BR-INV-08, BR-INV-09.
 406:    */
 407:   async createInvitation(
 408:     dto: SendInvitationRequest,
 409:     actor: { userId: string; merchantId: string; role?: string },
 410:     clientIp: string,
 411:     correlationId: string,
 412:     baseUrl = 'http://localhost:3000'
 413:   ) {
 414:     const safeCorrelationId = sanitizeCorrelationId(correlationId);
 415:     if (!dto || typeof dto !== 'object') {
 416:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 417:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 418:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 419:         'Dữ liệu yêu cầu không hợp lệ',
 420:         false
 421:       );
 422:     }
 423: 
 424:     if (dto.email !== undefined && dto.email !== null && typeof dto.email !== 'string') {
 425:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 426:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 427:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 428:         'Địa chỉ email phải là chuỗi ký tự',
 429:         false,
 430:         undefined,
 431:         [{ field: 'email', code: 'INVALID_TYPE', message: 'Email phải là chuỗi ký tự' }]
 432:       );
 433:     }
 434: 
 435:     if (dto.phone !== undefined && dto.phone !== null && typeof dto.phone !== 'string') {
 436:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 437:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 438:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 439:         'Số điện thoại phải là chuỗi ký tự',
 440:         false,
 441:         undefined,
 442:         [{ field: 'phone', code: 'INVALID_TYPE', message: 'Số điện thoại phải là chuỗi ký tự' }]
 443:       );
 444:     }
 445: 
 446:     this.validateScopeArray(dto.store_scopes, 'store_scopes');
 447:     this.validateScopeArray(dto.warehouse_scopes, 'warehouse_scopes');
 448: 
 449:     const identity = resolveCanonicalIdentity({ email: dto.email, phone: dto.phone });
 450:     const email = identity.email;
 451:     const phone = identity.phone;
 452:     const recipient = identity.recipient;
 453: 
 454:     // 1. Validation: Exactly one recipient identifier required (AC-USR-01-07 / Security-NFR Finding 3)
 455:     if (!email && !phone) {
 456:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 457:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 458:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 459:         'Vui lòng cung cấp email hoặc số điện thoại người nhận',
 460:         false,
 461:         undefined,
 462:         [
 463:           {
 464:             field: 'identifier',
 465:             code: 'REQUIRED',
 466:             message: 'Vui lòng cung cấp email hoặc số điện thoại',
 467:           },
 468:         ]
 469:       );
 470:     }
 471: 
 472:     if (email && phone) {
 473:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 474:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 475:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 476:         'Vui lòng chỉ cung cấp một phương thức nhận duy nhất (email hoặc số điện thoại)',
 477:         false,
 478:         undefined,
 479:         [
 480:           {
 481:             field: 'identifier',
 482:             code: 'EXCLUSIVE_IDENTIFIER',
 483:             message: 'Chỉ được cung cấp email hoặc số điện thoại, không được cung cấp cả hai',
 484:           },
 485:         ]
 486:       );
 487:     }
 488: 
 489:     if (email && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
 490:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 491:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 492:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 493:         'Địa chỉ email không đúng định dạng',
 494:         false,
 495:         undefined,
 496:         [{ field: 'email', code: 'INVALID_FORMAT', message: 'Địa chỉ email không hợp lệ' }]
 497:       );
 498:     }
 499: 
 500:     if (phone && !/^0(?:3|5|7|8|9)\d{8}$/.test(phone)) {
 501:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 502:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 503:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 504:         'Số điện thoại không đúng định dạng Việt Nam',
 505:         false,
 506:         undefined,
 507:         [{ field: 'phone', code: 'INVALID_FORMAT', message: 'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ' }]
 508:       );
 509:     }
 510: 
 511:     // Role validation
 512:     const validRoles: readonly string[] = [
 513:       RoleEnum.OWNER,
 514:       RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH,
 515:       RoleEnum.WAREHOUSE,
 516:       RoleEnum.ACCOUNTANT,
 517:     ];
 518:     if (!dto.role || !validRoles.includes(dto.role)) {
 519:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 520:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 521:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 522:         'Vai trò được chỉ định không hợp lệ',
 523:         false,
 524:         undefined,
 525:         [{ field: 'role', code: 'INVALID_ROLE', message: 'Vai trò là bắt buộc và phải hợp lệ' }]
 526:       );
 527:     }
 528: 
 529:     // 2. Authorization: Caller must have "Manage users/roles" permission (AC-USR-01-04)
 530:     const actorUser = await this.resolveActorUser(actor);
 531:     if (!actorUser) {
 532:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 533:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 534:         'FORBIDDEN',
 535:         'Bạn không có quyền quản lý người dùng và vai trò',
 536:         false
 537:       );
 538:     }
 539:     const isOwner = actorUser.role === RoleEnum.OWNER || actorUser.role === 'OWNER';
 540:     const isOps = actorUser.role === RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH || actorUser.role === 'OPS_CSKH';
 541:     if (!isOwner && !isOps) {
 542:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 543:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 544:         'FORBIDDEN',
 545:         'Bạn không có quyền quản lý người dùng và vai trò',
 546:         false
 547:       );
 548:     }
 549: 
 550:     // 3. Privilege Ceiling (BR-INV-01, AC-USR-01-03)
 551:     this.enforcePrivilegeCeiling(
 552:       actorUser,
 553:       dto.role as RoleEnum,
 554:       dto.store_scopes,
 555:       dto.warehouse_scopes,
 556:       'mời'
 557:     );
 558: 
 559:     // 4. Duplicate checks using shared canonical identity helper (BR-INV-08 / Round 7 Finding 6 / Round 8 Finding 2 / Round 10 Finding 3)
 560:     // 4a. Check active user with case-insensitive email or canonical phone variants (AC-USR-01-05)
 561:     const existingUser = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
 562:       where: {
 563:         merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 564:         status: { in: ['active', 'ACTIVE'] },
 565:         OR: identity.buildUserOrConditions(),
 566:       },
 567:     });
 568: 
 569:     if (existingUser) {
 570:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 571:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 572:         'USER_ALREADY_EXISTS',
 573:         'Người dùng với thông tin định danh này đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng',
 574:         false
 575:       );
 576:     }
 577: 
 578:     // 4b. Check unexpired pending invitation in merchant (AC-USR-01-06)
 579:     const pendingInvite = await this.prisma.invitation.findFirst({
 580:       where: {
 581:         merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 582:         status: InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING,
 583:         expires_at: { gt: new Date() },
 584:         OR: identity.buildInvitationOrConditions(),
 585:       },
 586:     });
 587: 
 588:     if (pendingInvite) {
 589:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 590:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 591:         'INVITATION_ALREADY_PENDING',
 592:         'Đã có lời mời đang chờ xử lý cho người dùng này. Vui lòng sử dụng tính năng gửi lại nếu cần.',
 593:         false,
 594:         'Vui lòng sử dụng tính năng gửi lại lời mời'
 595:       );
 596:     }
 597: 
 598:     // 5. Generate secure 32-byte token and SHA-256 hash (BR-INV-02)
 599:     const rawToken = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
 600:     const tokenHash = this.hashToken(rawToken);
 601: 
 602:     // 6. Expiry: 7 days (168 hours) from now (BR-INV-03)
 603:     const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
 604: 
 605:     // Rate limiting: Anti-abuse dispatch limit (SECURITY-NFR) - fail closed
 606:     // Quota consumed only after validation, authorization, ceiling, and duplicate checks pass (Finding 3)
 607:     if (!this.rateLimitService) {
 608:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 609:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
 610:         'RATE_LIMITED',
 611:         'Dịch vụ kiểm soát tần suất không khả dụng. Vui lòng thử lại sau.'
 612:       );
 613:     }
 614:     const rateLimit = await this.rateLimitService.checkInvitationDispatchLimit(
 615:       clientIp,
 616:       recipient,
 617:       actor.merchantId
 618:     );
 619:     if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
 620:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 621:         HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
 622:         'RATE_LIMITED',
 623:         rateLimit.reason || 'Quá nhiều yêu cầu gửi lời mời. Vui lòng thử lại sau.',
 624:         false,
 625:         undefined,
 626:         undefined,
 627:         rateLimit.retryAfterSeconds
 628:       );
 629:     }
 630: 
 631:     // Fail closed early if delivery adapter unavailable before creating DB record
 632:     if (!this.deliveryAdapter) {
 633:       await this.refundDispatchQuota(rateLimit.reservation);
 634:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 635:         HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
 636:         'DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE',
 637:         'Dịch vụ gửi thông báo lời mời không khả dụng'
 638:       );
 639:     }
 640: 
 641:     // 7. Persist invitation record in database transaction (BR-INV-04, BR-INV-09)
 642:     let invitation: any;
 643:     try {
 644:       invitation = await this.prisma.$transaction(
 645:         async (tx) => {
 646:           // Finding 6 (Round 7 / Round 10 Finding 3): Case-insensitive email and canonical phone checks for active users inside insertion transaction (BR-INV-08)
 647:           const inTxExistingUser = await tx.user.findFirst({
 648:             where: {
 649:               merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 650:               status: { in: ['active', 'ACTIVE'] },
 651:               OR: identity.buildUserOrConditions(),
 652:             },
 653:           });
 654:           if (inTxExistingUser) {
 655:             throw new CanonicalApiException(
 656:               HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 657:               'USER_ALREADY_EXISTS',
 658:               'Người dùng với thông tin định danh này đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng',
 659:               false
 660:             );
 661:           }
 662: 
 663:           const inTxPendingInvite = await tx.invitation.findFirst({
 664:             where: {
 665:               merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 666:               status: InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING,
 667:               expires_at: { gt: new Date() },
 668:               OR: identity.buildInvitationOrConditions(),
 669:             },
 670:           });
 671:           if (inTxPendingInvite) {
 672:             throw this.alreadyPendingException();
 673:           }
 674: 
 675:           // Finding 3: In-transaction expiration of time-elapsed PENDING invitations (BR-INV-08 / AC-USR-01-06)
 676:           // Avoids unique partial index collision (P2002) when creating an invite for a previously expired pending recipient
 677:           await tx.invitation.updateMany({
 678:             where: {
 679:               merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 680:               status: InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING,
 681:               expires_at: { lte: new Date() },
 682:               OR: [...(email ? [{ email }] : []), ...(phone ? [{ phone }] : [])],
 683:             },
 684:             data: {
 685:               status: InvitationStatusEnum.EXPIRED,
 686:             },
 687:           });
 688: 
 689:           // Round 9 Finding 4 / Round 10 Finding 3: Re-check active user under serializable transaction before inserting pending invite (BR-INV-08 / AC-USR-01-05)
 690:           const recheckUser = await tx.user.findFirst({
 691:             where: {
 692:               merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 693:               status: { in: ['active', 'ACTIVE'] },
 694:               OR: identity.buildUserOrConditions(),
 695:             },
 696:           });
 697:           if (recheckUser) {
 698:             throw new CanonicalApiException(
 699:               HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 700:               'USER_ALREADY_EXISTS',
 701:               'Người dùng với thông tin định danh này đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng',
 702:               false
 703:             );
 704:           }
 705: 
 706:           const inv = await tx.invitation.create({
 707:             data: {
 708:               merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 709:               email: email || null,
 710:               phone: phone || null,
 711:               role: dto.role as RoleEnum,
 712:               store_scopes: dto.store_scopes || [],
 713:               warehouse_scopes: dto.warehouse_scopes || [],
 714:               token_hash: tokenHash,
 715:               status: InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING,
 716:               invited_by_user_id: actor.userId,
 717:               expires_at: expiresAt,
 718:             },
 719:           });
 720: 
 721:           // 8. Immutable Audit Trail committed atomically with the invitation row
 722:           // (BR-INV-09, AC-USR-01-01, AC-USR-01-18; Round 6 Finding 3): a crash after commit can
 723:           // never leave a live invite without audit. A failed delivery appends a compensating
 724:           // INVITATION_DELIVERY_FAILED event; audit rows are never deleted. Never logs raw token.
 725:           await tx.auditLog.create({
 726:             data: {
 727:               merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 728:               user_id: actor.userId,
 729:               action: 'INVITATION_SENT',
 730:               entity_type: 'Invitation',
 731:               entity_id: inv.id,
 732:               ip_address: clientIp,
 733:               new_value: {
 734:                 invitation_id: inv.id,
 735:                 merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 736:                 actor_id: actor.userId,
 737:                 role: inv.role,
 738:                 store_scopes: inv.store_scopes,
 739:                 warehouse_scopes: inv.warehouse_scopes,
 740:                 expires_at: inv.expires_at.toISOString(),
 741:                 target_identifier_masked: maskIdentifier(email || phone),
 742:                 correlation_id: safeCorrelationId,
 743:               },
 744:             },
 745:           });
 746: 
 747:           return inv;
 748:         },
 749:         { isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.Serializable }
 750:       );
 751:     } catch (err: any) {
 752:       // Transaction rolled back: no invite committed, so refund exactly this request's quota
 753:       // slots (Round 6 Finding 4)
 754:       await this.refundDispatchQuota(rateLimit.reservation);
 755:       if (
 756:         err?.code === 'P2034' ||
 757:         err?.code === '40001' ||
 758:         err?.message?.includes('could not serialize') ||
 759:         err?.message?.includes('serialization')
 760:       ) {
 761:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 762:           HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
 763:           'CONFLICT',
 764:           'Xung đột dữ liệu khi tạo lời mời đồng thời. Vui lòng thử lại.',
 765:           true,
 766:           'Vui lòng thử lại'
 767:         );
 768:       }
 769:       if (err?.code === 'P2002') {
 770:         const target = Array.isArray(err?.meta?.target)
 771:           ? err.meta.target.join(',')
 772:           : String(err?.meta?.target || '');
 773:         const modelName = String(err?.meta?.modelName || '');
 774:         if (modelName === 'User' || target.includes('users_')) {
 775:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 776:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 777:             'USER_ALREADY_EXISTS',
 778:             'Người dùng với thông tin định danh này đã tồn tại trong cửa hàng',
 779:             false
 780:           );
 781:         }
 782:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 783:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 784:           'INVITATION_ALREADY_PENDING',
 785:           'Đã có lời mời đang chờ xử lý cho người dùng này. Vui lòng sử dụng tính năng gửi lại nếu cần.',
 786:           false,
 787:           'Vui lòng sử dụng tính năng gửi lại lời mời'

 909:         false
 910:       );
 911:     }

 913:     const validStatuses = [
 914:       'ALL',
 915:       InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING,
 916:       InvitationStatusEnum.ACCEPTED,
 917:       InvitationStatusEnum.EXPIRED,
 918:       InvitationStatusEnum.CANCELLED,

 931:     const page = this.parsePaginationParam(filter.page, 'page', 1, 1000);
 932:     const limit = this.parsePaginationParam(filter.limit, 'limit', 20, 100);

 935:     const now = new Date();
 936: 
 937:     // Persist expired status for time-elapsed pending invitations in caller's merchant (Finding 8)
 938:     await this.prisma.invitation.updateMany({
 939:       where: {
 940:         merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 941:         status: InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING,
 942:         expires_at: { lt: now },
 943:       },
 944:       data: {
 945:         status: InvitationStatusEnum.EXPIRED,
 946:       },
 947:     });
 948: 
 949:     const where: any = {
 950:       merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 951:     };
 952: 
 953:     if (filter.status === 'EXPIRED' || filter.status === InvitationStatusEnum.EXPIRED) {
 954:       where.OR = [
 955:         { status: InvitationStatusEnum.EXPIRED },
 956:         { status: InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING, expires_at: { lt: now } },
 957:       ];

 959:       where.status = InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING;
 960:       where.expires_at = { gte: now };

 962:       where.status = filter.status as InvitationStatusEnum;
 963:     }

 965:     // RBAC Scope Enforcement for Non-Owner Actors (Finding 1 / RBAC-APPROVAL-MATRIX / SECURITY-NFR)
 966:     // Non-owner actors (e.g. OPS_CSKH) can only see invitations intersecting their live scopes,
 967:     // or invitations they personally sent.
 968:     if (!isOwner) {
 969:       const actorStores = actorUser.store_scopes || [];
 970:       const actorWarehouses = actorUser.warehouse_scopes || [];
 971:       const hasStoreWildcard = actorStores.includes('*');
 972:       const hasWarehouseWildcard = actorWarehouses.includes('*');
 973: 
 974:       if (!hasStoreWildcard || !hasWarehouseWildcard) {
 975:         const scopeConditions: any[] = [];
 976:         if (actorUser.id) {
 977:           scopeConditions.push({ invited_by_user_id: actorUser.id });
 978:         }
 979:         if (hasStoreWildcard) {
 980:           scopeConditions.push({ store_scopes: { isEmpty: false } });
 981:         } else {
 982:           const concreteStores = actorStores.filter((s) => s !== '*');
 983:           if (concreteStores.length > 0) {
 984:             scopeConditions.push({ store_scopes: { hasSome: concreteStores } });
 985:           }
 986:         }
 987:         if (hasWarehouseWildcard) {
 988:           scopeConditions.push({ warehouse_scopes: { isEmpty: false } });
 989:         } else {
 990:           const concreteWarehouses = actorWarehouses.filter((w) => w !== '*');
 991:           if (concreteWarehouses.length > 0) {

 993:           }

1000:             where.invited_by_user_id = actorUser.id;
1001:           } else {
1002:             where.id = '__none__';

1004:         }

1030:         warehouse_scopes: rec.warehouse_scopes,

1039:     return {

1041:       meta: {
1042:         total,
1043:         page,
1044:         limit,
1045:         correlation_id: safeCorrelationId,
1046:       },
1047:     };
1048:   }

1882:               email_verified_at: invitation.email ? now : null,
1883:               phone_verified_at: invitation.phone ? now : null,
1884:               terms_accepted_at: null,
1885:               terms_version: null,
1886:             },
1887:           });
1888: 
1889:           // Immutable audit log (BR-INV-09, AC-USR-01-14, AC-USR-01-18)
1890:           // Zero passwords or raw tokens
1891:           await tx.auditLog.create({
1892:             data: {
1893:               merchant_id: invitation.merchant_id,
1894:               user_id: newUser.id,
1895:               action: 'INVITATION_ACCEPTED',
1896:               entity_type: 'Invitation',
1897:               entity_id: invitation.id,
1898:               ip_address: clientIp,
1899:               new_value: {
1900:                 invitation_id: invitation.id,
1901:                 merchant_id: invitation.merchant_id,
1902:                 actor_id: newUser.id,
1903:                 target_identifier_masked: maskIdentifier(invitation.email || invitation.phone),
1904:                 user_id: newUser.id,
1905:                 role: newUser.role,
1906:                 store_scopes: newUser.store_scopes,
1907:                 warehouse_scopes: newUser.warehouse_scopes,
1908:                 correlation_id: safeCorrelationId,
1909:               },
1910:             },
1911:           });
1912: 
1913:           return newUser;
1914:         },
1915:         { isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.Serializable }
1916:       );
1917:     } catch (err: any) {
1918:       if (err instanceof CanonicalApiException) throw err;
1919:       const isSerialization =
1920:         err?.code === 'P2034' ||
1921:         err?.code === '40001' ||
1922:         err?.message?.includes('could not serialize') ||
1923:         err?.message?.includes('serialization');
1924: 
1925:       if (isSerialization) {
1926:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
1927:           HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
1928:           'CONFLICT',
1929:           'Xung đột dữ liệu khi xử lý đồng thời. Lời mời vẫn đang chờ xử lý, vui lòng thử lại.',
1930:           true,
1931:           'Vui lòng thử lại'
1932:         );
1933:       }
1934: 
1935:       if (err?.code === 'P2002') {
1936:         const target = Array.isArray(err?.meta?.target)
1937:           ? err.meta.target.join(',')
1938:           : String(err?.meta?.target || '');
1939:         const modelName = String(err?.meta?.modelName || '');
1940:         const message = String(err?.message || '');
1941:         if (
1942:           modelName === 'User' ||
1943:           target.includes('users_') ||
1944:           target.includes('email') ||
1945:           target.includes('phone') ||
1946:           message.includes('Unique constraint failed on user') ||
1947:           message.includes('Unique constraint failed on the fields')
1948:         ) {
1949:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
1950:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1951:             'USER_ALREADY_EXISTS',
1952:             'Người dùng với thông tin này đã được kích hoạt trong cửa hàng',
1953:             false
1954:           );
1955:         }
1956:       }
1957:       throw err;
1958:     }
1959: 
1960:     return {
1961:       data: {
1962:         user_id: result.id,
1963:         email: result.email,
1964:         phone: result.phone,
1965:         full_name: result.full_name,
1966:         role: result.role,
1967:         status: 'ACTIVE',
1968:         message: 'Tài khoản của bạn đã được kích hoạt thành công',
1969:       },
1970:       meta: {
1971:         correlation_id: safeCorrelationId,
1972:       },
1973:     };
1974:   }
1975: }

  1: import 'reflect-metadata';

 19: /**

 23: async function runInvitationsSupertestSuite() {
 24:   console.log('================================================================');

 28:   const envPaths = [
 29:     path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env'),
 30:     path.resolve(process.cwd(), '../../.env'),
 31:     path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../.env'),
 32:   ];
 33:   for (const envPath of envPaths) {
 34:     if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
 35:       const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8');
 36:       for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
 37:         const trimmed = line.trim();
 38:         if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
 39:           const [key, ...rest] = trimmed.split('=');
 40:           const cleanKey = key.trim();
 41:           let val = rest.join('=').trim();
 42:           if (
 43:             (val.startsWith('"') && val.endsWith('"')) ||
 44:             (val.startsWith("'") && val.endsWith("'"))
 45:           ) {
 46:             val = val.slice(1, -1);
 47:           }
 48:           if (!process.env[cleanKey]) {
 49:             process.env[cleanKey] = val;
 50:           }
 51:         }
 52:       }
 53:       break;
 54:     }
 55:   }
 56: 
 57:   let databaseUrl =
 58:     process.env.DATABASE_URL ||
 59:     'postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5433/shipde_dev?schema=public';
 60:   if (
 61:     (databaseUrl.startsWith('"') && databaseUrl.endsWith('"')) ||
 62:     (databaseUrl.startsWith("'") && databaseUrl.endsWith("'"))
 63:   ) {
 64:     databaseUrl = databaseUrl.slice(1, -1);
 65:   }
 66:   process.env.DATABASE_URL = databaseUrl;
 67: 
 68:   const testConfig: AppConfig = {
 69:     NODE_ENV: 'test',
 70:     PORT: 3095,
 71:     WORKER_HEALTH_PORT: 3094,
 72:     DATABASE_URL: databaseUrl,
 73:     REDIS_HOST: process.env.REDIS_HOST || 'localhost',
 74:     REDIS_PORT: Number(process.env.REDIS_PORT || 6379),
 75:     S3_ENDPOINT: process.env.S3_ENDPOINT || 'http://localhost:9000',
 76:     S3_REGION: 'us-east-1',
 77:     S3_ACCESS_KEY: 'minioadmin',
 78:     S3_SECRET_KEY: 'minioadmin',
 79:     S3_BUCKET: 'test-bucket',
 80:     S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: true,
 81:     CARRIER_MODE: 'disabled',
 82:     LOG_LEVEL: 'info',
 83:     TRUST_PROXY_HOPS: 1,
 84:     AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS: 43200,
 85:     AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED: false,

 91:   const mockDeliveryAdapter = new MockVerificationDeliveryAdapter();
 92:   const moduleFixture: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({

101:   const app = moduleFixture.createNestApplication<NestExpressApplication>();
102:   app.set('trust proxy', 1);
103:   await app.init();

105:   const prisma = app.get(PrismaService);
106: 
107:   const dbStatus = await prisma.checkReadiness();

115:   // Setup fixtures
116:   const testSuffix = Date.now().toString().slice(-6);
117:   const merchant = await prisma.merchant.create({

123:   });

133:   // Owner user

142:     },

181:   // Helper to create session

188:     const { token } = signAccessToken(

192:         mid: merchantId,

199:     const tokenHash = createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
200:     await prisma.deviceSession.create({
201:       data: {
202:         user_id: userId,
203:         merchant_id: merchantId,
204:         session_token_hash: tokenHash,

208:         status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,

210:       },
211:     });

215:   const ownerToken = await makeSessionToken(owner.id, merchant.id, RoleEnum.OWNER);
216:   const opsToken = await makeSessionToken(opsUser.id, merchant.id, RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH);
217:   const whToken = await makeSessionToken(whUser.id, merchant.id, RoleEnum.WAREHOUSE);

219: 
220:   // [TEST 1 / AC-USR-01-01] Owner creates invitation with email & warehouse scope
221:   console.log(
222:     '[TEST 1 / AC-USR-01-01] Owner invites new operator with valid email and warehouse scope'
223:   );
224:   const sendRes = await request(app.getHttpServer())
225:     .post('/api/v1/invitations')
226:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)
227:     .send({

229:       role: RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH,

233:   assert.strictEqual(sendRes.status, 201);
234:   assert.strictEqual(sendRes.body.data.role, 'OPS_CSKH');
235:   assert.strictEqual(sendRes.body.data.status, 'PENDING');
236:   // SECURITY-NFR / BR-INV-02: Zero raw token or invitation_url in admin response
237:   assert.strictEqual(sendRes.body.data.token, undefined);
238:   assert.strictEqual(sendRes.body.data.invitation_url, undefined);

260:   const phoneRes = await request(app.getHttpServer())

269:   assert.strictEqual(phoneRes.body.data.token, undefined);

277:   const ceilRes = await request(app.getHttpServer())

292:     .post('/api/v1/invitations')

302:   console.log('[TEST 5 / AC-USR-01-05] Invite sent to email already active in the tenant');

350:   // [TEST 9 / AC-USR-01-09] Owner resends an expired invitation (EXPIRED -> PENDING)
351:   console.log('[TEST 9 / AC-USR-01-09] Owner resends an expired invitation');
352:   const invBeforeResend = await prisma.invitation.findUnique({ where: { id: invitationId } });
353:   const oldTokenHash = invBeforeResend!.token_hash;
354: 
355:   await prisma.invitation.update({
356:     where: { id: invitationId },

362: 
363:   const resendRes = await request(app.getHttpServer())
364:     .post(`/api/v1/invitations/${invitationId}/resend`)
365:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`);
366:   assert.strictEqual(resendRes.status, 200);
367:   assert.strictEqual(resendRes.body.data.status, 'PENDING');
368:   assert.strictEqual(resendRes.body.data.token, undefined);
369:   assert.strictEqual(resendRes.body.data.invitation_url, undefined);
370:   const resentRawToken = mockDeliveryAdapter.getLastMessage()?.token!;
371:   assert.ok(resentRawToken);
372:   assert.notStrictEqual(resentRawToken, rawToken, 'Resent raw token must be freshly generated');
373: 
374:   // Assert DB state after resend hash rotation
375:   const invAfterResend = await prisma.invitation.findUnique({ where: { id: invitationId } });
376:   assert.ok(invAfterResend);
377:   assert.notStrictEqual(

382:   assert.strictEqual(

386:   assert.strictEqual(invAfterResend.status, InvitationStatusEnum.PENDING);
387:   const auditResent = await prisma.auditLog.findFirst({
388:     where: { entity_id: invitationId, action: 'INVITATION_RESENT' },
389:   });
390:   assert.ok(auditResent);
