<file path="apps/web/src/components/ShipmentListTab.tsx">
  1: 'use client';
  2: 
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
  4: import { Money, TrackingCode, StatusBadge, AutomationBadge } from './ui/OperationalComponents';
  5: import { MASTER_SHIPMENTS, UnifiedShipment } from '@/services/unifiedDataStore';
  6: import {
  7:   Search,
  8:   Filter,
  9:   AlertTriangle,
 10:   Eye,
 11:   EyeOff,
 12:   X,
 13:   Package,
 14:   Truck,
 15:   DollarSign,
 16:   CheckCircle2,
 17:   ChevronLeft,
 18:   ChevronRight,
 19:   FileSpreadsheet,
 20:   Calendar,
 21:   MapPin,
 22:   Clock,
 23:   ShieldCheck,
 24:   RefreshCw,
 25:   SlidersHorizontal,
 26:   ExternalLink,
 27: } from 'lucide-react';
 28: 
 29: interface Props {
 30:   onOpenTrackingModal: (trackingCode: string) => void;
 31:   onNavigateToTab?: (tabId: string) => void;
 32:   onCreateOrder?: () => void;
 33:   userRole?: string;
 34:   selectedOrderId?: string | null;
 35:   selectedOrderCode?: string | null;
 36:   onClearSelection?: () => void;
 37: }
 38: 
 39: export const ShipmentListTab: React.FC<Props> = ({
 40:   onOpenTrackingModal,
 41:   onNavigateToTab,
 42:   onCreateOrder,
 43:   userRole = 'OWNER',
 44:   selectedOrderId,
 45:   selectedOrderCode,
 46:   onClearSelection,
 47: }) => {
 48:   const [shipments, setShipments] = useState<UnifiedShipment[]>(MASTER_SHIPMENTS);
 49:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
 50: 
 51:   // Cursor Pagination State
 52:   const [cursorIndex, setCursorIndex] = useState(0);
 53:   const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(20);
 54: 
 55:   // Synchronize search term and reset cursor when selectedOrderCode/selectedOrderId changes
 56:   const [dismissedOrderId, setDismissedOrderId] = useState<string | null>(null);
 57:   const [dismissedOrderCode, setDismissedOrderCode] = useState<string | null>(null);
 58:   const [prevSelectedOrderCode, setPrevSelectedOrderCode] = useState(selectedOrderCode);
 59:   const [prevSelectedOrderId, setPrevSelectedOrderId] = useState(selectedOrderId);
 60:   const [userSearchTerm, setUserSearchTerm] = useState<string | null>(null);
 61: 
 62:   if (prevSelectedOrderCode !== selectedOrderCode || prevSelectedOrderId !== selectedOrderId) {
 63:     setPrevSelectedOrderCode(selectedOrderCode);
 64:     setPrevSelectedOrderId(selectedOrderId);
 65:     setDismissedOrderId(null);
 66:     setDismissedOrderCode(null);
 67:     setUserSearchTerm(null);
 68:     setCursorIndex(0);
 69:   }
 70: 
 71:   const effectiveOrderId =
 72:     selectedOrderId && selectedOrderId !== dismissedOrderId ? selectedOrderId : null;
 73:   const effectiveOrderCode =
 74:     selectedOrderCode && selectedOrderCode !== dismissedOrderCode ? selectedOrderCode : null;
 75: 
 76:   const isOrderActivated = Boolean(effectiveOrderId || effectiveOrderCode);
 77:   const matchedShipment = isOrderActivated
 78:     ? shipments.find(
 79:         (s) =>
 80:           (effectiveOrderCode && s.order_code === effectiveOrderCode) ||
 81:           (effectiveOrderId &&
 82:             (s.id === effectiveOrderId || (s as any).order_id === effectiveOrderId))
 83:       )
 84:     : null;
 85:   const isOrderNotFound = isOrderActivated && !matchedShipment;
 86: 
 87:   const searchTerm = userSearchTerm ?? (effectiveOrderCode || '');
 88:   const setSearchTerm = (term: string) => setUserSearchTerm(term);
 89: 
 90:   // Filter Controls
 91:   const [carrierFilter, setCarrierFilter] = useState('ALL');
 92:   const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('ALL');
 93:   const [warehouseFilter, setWarehouseFilter] = useState('ALL');
 94:   const [matchStatusFilter, setMatchStatusFilter] = useState('ALL');
 95:   const [dateRangeFilter, setDateRangeFilter] = useState('30d');
 96:   const [hasOpenCaseFilter, setHasOpenCaseFilter] = useState(false);
 97:   const [showAdvancedFilters, setShowAdvancedFilters] = useState(false);
 98: 
 99:   // PII Masking State
100:   const [unmaskedRows, setUnmaskedRows] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
101:   const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
102: 
103:   const fetchShipments = async () => {
104:     setLoading(true);
105:     try {
106:       const res = await fetch('/api/shipments');
107:       const data = await res.json();
108:       if (res.ok && data.data && data.data.length > 0) {
109:         // If API returns data, sync, otherwise keep master shipments
110:       }
111:     } catch (e) {
112:       console.error('Failed to load shipments:', e);
113:     } finally {
114:       setLoading(false);
115:     }
116:   };
117: 
118:   useEffect(() => {
119:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- Legacy prototype initial fetch pattern
120:     fetchShipments();
121:   }, []);
122: 
123:   const toggleUnmask = (id: string, trackingCode: string) => {
124:     const isCurrentlyUnmasked = unmaskedRows[id];
125:     setUnmaskedRows((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: !isCurrentlyUnmasked }));
126:     if (!isCurrentlyUnmasked) {
127:       setToast(
128:         `[Audit Log] Đã mở xem thông tin số điện thoại khách hàng cho mã ${trackingCode}. Đã ghi nhật ký kiểm toán.`
129:       );
130:       setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
131:     }
132:   };
133: 
134:   // Filter Pipeline
135:   const filtered = shipments.filter((s) => {
136:     if (searchTerm) {
137:       const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
138:       const matchTracking = s.tracking_code.toLowerCase().includes(term);
139:       const matchOrder = s.order_code.toLowerCase().includes(term);
140:       const matchCustomer = s.recipient_name.toLowerCase().includes(term);
141:       const matchPhone = s.recipient_phone.toLowerCase().includes(term);
142:       if (!matchTracking && !matchOrder && !matchCustomer && !matchPhone) return false;
143:     }
144: 
145:     if (carrierFilter !== 'ALL' && s.carrier_code !== carrierFilter) return false;
146:     if (statusFilter !== 'ALL' && s.status !== statusFilter) return false;
147:     if (warehouseFilter !== 'ALL' && s.warehouse_id !== warehouseFilter) return false;
148: 
149:     if (matchStatusFilter !== 'ALL') {
150:       if (s.match_status !== matchStatusFilter) return false;
151:     }
152: 
153:     if (hasOpenCaseFilter) {
154:       if (!s.has_open_exception && !s.has_open_discrepancy && !s.has_open_claim) return false;
155:     }
156: 
157:     return true;
158:   });
159: 
160:   const paginatedShipments = filtered.slice(cursorIndex, cursorIndex + pageSize);
161:   const totalCount = filtered.length;
162:   const hasNextPage = cursorIndex + pageSize < totalCount;
163:   const hasPrevPage = cursorIndex > 0;
164: 
165:   const handleNextPage = () => {
166:     if (hasNextPage) setCursorIndex((prev) => prev + pageSize);
167:   };
168: 
169:   const handlePrevPage = () => {
170:     if (hasPrevPage) setCursorIndex((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - pageSize));
171:   };
172: 
173:   const handleResetFilters = () => {
174:     if (selectedOrderId) setDismissedOrderId(selectedOrderId);
175:     if (selectedOrderCode) setDismissedOrderCode(selectedOrderCode);
176:     setUserSearchTerm('');
177:     setCarrierFilter('ALL');
178:     setStatusFilter('ALL');
179:     setWarehouseFilter('ALL');
180:     setMatchStatusFilter('ALL');
181:     setDateRangeFilter('30d');
182:     setHasOpenCaseFilter(false);
183:     setCursorIndex(0);
184:     onClearSelection?.();
185:   };
186: 
187:   const hasActiveFilters =
188:     searchTerm !== '' ||
189:     carrierFilter !== 'ALL' ||
190:     statusFilter !== 'ALL' ||
191:     warehouseFilter !== 'ALL' ||
192:     matchStatusFilter !== 'ALL' ||
193:     dateRangeFilter !== '30d' ||
194:     hasOpenCaseFilter;
195: 
196:   return (
197:     <div className="w-full space-y-4">
198:       {/* Activated Order Not Found Alert (Real Not-Found State with Recovery) */}
199:       {isOrderNotFound && (
200:         <div
201:           data-testid="activated-order-not-found"
202:           className="p-4 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-amber-900"
203:         >
204:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
205:             <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
206:             <div>
207:               <div className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm">
208:                 Không tìm thấy đơn hàng{' '}
209:                 <span className="font-mono underline">{selectedOrderCode || selectedOrderId}</span>
210:               </div>
211:               <div className="text-xs text-amber-700">
212:                 Bản ghi không tồn tại trong danh sách vận đơn hiện tại hoặc nằm ngoài phạm vi truy
213:                 cập của bạn.
214:               </div>
215:             </div>
216:           </div>
217:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
218:             <button
219:               type="button"
220:               onClick={handleResetFilters}
221:               className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-amber-300 text-amber-900 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-amber-100 transition"
222:             >
223:               Quay lại danh sách
224:             </button>
225:             <button
226:               type="button"
227:               onClick={fetchShipments}
228:               className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-amber-700 transition"
229:             >
230:               Thử lại
231:             </button>
232:           </div>
233:         </div>
234:       )}
235: 
236:       {/* Toast Notification */}
237:       {toast && (
238:         <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between shadow-lg border border-slate-700 animate-in fade-in">
239:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
240:             <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
241:             <span>{toast}</span>
242:           </div>
243:           <button
244:             type="button"
245:             onClick={() => setToast(null)}
246:             className="font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
247:           >
248:             ✕
249:           </button>
250:         </div>
251:       )}
252: 
253:       {/* Header Bar */}
254:       <div className="modern-card p-5 space-y-4">
255:         <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-3">
256:           <div>
257:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
258:               <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
259:                 <Package className="w-5 h-5 text-[#c23807]" />
260:                 <span>Danh Sách & Tra Cứu Vận Đơn</span>
261:               </h1>
262:               <span className="text-xs font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#FFF5F0] text-[#c23807] border border-[#FDDDD0]">
263:                 {totalCount} bưu kiện
264:               </span>
265:             </div>
266:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
267:               Tra cứu bưu kiện toàn trình, kiểm tra trạng thái khớp mã nguồn và mở Timeline sự kiện
268:               hợp nhất 3 nguồn.
269:             </p>
270:           </div>
271: 
272:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-stretch md:self-auto">
273:             {onCreateOrder && (
274:               <button type="button" onClick={onCreateOrder} className="btn-primary text-xs">
275:                 <span>+ Tạo Vận Đơn</span>
276:               </button>
277:             )}
278: 
279:             <button
280:               type="button"
281:               onClick={() => {
282:                 setToast(
283:                   `✓ Đã xuất file Excel ${totalCount} vận đơn theo đúng tiêu chí lọc hiện hành.`
284:                 );
285:                 setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
286:               }}
287:               className="btn-secondary text-xs"
288:             >
289:               <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
290:               <span>Xuất Excel</span>
291:             </button>
292: 
293:             <button
294:               type="button"
295:               onClick={fetchShipments}
296:               disabled={loading}
297:               className="btn-secondary text-xs"
298:               title="Tải lại dữ liệu mới nhất"
299:             >
300:               <RefreshCw
301:                 className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin text-[#c23807]' : 'text-slate-500'}`}
302:               />
303:               <span className="hidden sm:inline">Làm mới</span>
304:             </button>
305:           </div>
306:         </div>
307: 
308:         {/* Primary Filter Toolbar */}
309:         <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
310:           {/* Search Box */}
311:           <div className="lg:col-span-2 relative">
312:             <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
313:             <input
314:               type="text"
315:               value={searchTerm}
316:               onChange={(e) => {
317:                 setSearchTerm(e.target.value);
318:                 setCursorIndex(0);
319:               }}
320:               placeholder="Tìm mã vận đơn, mã đơn POS, tên, SĐT..."
321:               className="modern-input pl-9 pr-8 text-xs font-medium"
322:             />
323:             {searchTerm && (
324:               <button
325:                 type="button"
326:                 onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
327:                 className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
328:               >
329:                 <X className="w-4 h-4" />
330:               </button>
331:             )}
332:           </div>
333: 
334:           {/* Carrier Selector */}
335:           <div>
336:             <select
337:               value={carrierFilter}
338:               onChange={(e) => {
339:                 setCarrierFilter(e.target.value);
340:                 setCursorIndex(0);
341:               }}
342:               className="modern-input text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800"
343:             >
344:               <option value="ALL">Hãng: Tất cả (GHN, GHTK)</option>
345:               <option value="GHN">GHN Express (Tự động API)</option>
346:               <option value="GHTK">GHTK (Hỗ trợ cổng)</option>
347:             </select>
348:           </div>
349: 
350:           {/* Status Selector */}
351:           <div>
352:             <select
353:               value={statusFilter}
354:               onChange={(e) => {
355:                 setStatusFilter(e.target.value);
356:                 setCursorIndex(0);
357:               }}
358:               className="modern-input text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800"
359:             >
360:               <option value="ALL">Trạng thái: Tất cả</option>
361:               <option value="picking">Chờ lấy hàng</option>
362:               <option value="in_transit">Đang trung chuyển</option>
363:               <option value="out_for_delivery">Đang giao hàng</option>
364:               <option value="delivered">Giao thành công</option>
365:               <option value="delivery_fail">Giao thất bại (Cần cứu)</option>
366:               <option value="returning">Đang chuyển hoàn</option>
367:               <option value="returned">Đã nhập hoàn kho</option>
368:             </select>
369:           </div>
370: 
371:           {/* Time Range Selector */}
372:           <div>
373:             <select
374:               value={dateRangeFilter}
375:               onChange={(e) => {
376:                 setDateRangeFilter(e.target.value);
377:                 setCursorIndex(0);
378:               }}
379:               className="modern-input text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800"
380:             >
381:               <option value="today">Hôm nay</option>
382:               <option value="7d">7 ngày qua</option>
383:               <option value="30d">30 ngày qua</option>
384:               <option value="90d">90 ngày qua (Tối đa)</option>
385:             </select>
386:           </div>
387: 
388:           {/* Advanced Filter Toggle & Reset */}
389:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
390:             <button
391:               type="button"
392:               onClick={() => setShowAdvancedFilters(!showAdvancedFilters)}
393:               className={`flex-1 btn-secondary text-xs justify-center ${
394:                 showAdvancedFilters ||
395:                 hasOpenCaseFilter ||
396:                 matchStatusFilter !== 'ALL' ||
397:                 warehouseFilter !== 'ALL'
398:                   ? 'bg-[#FFF5F0] text-[#c23807] border-[#FDDDD0] font-bold'
399:                   : ''
400:               }`}
401:             >
402:               <SlidersHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
403:               <span>Bộ Lọc</span>
404:             </button>
405: 
406:             {hasActiveFilters && (
407:               <button
408:                 type="button"
409:                 onClick={handleResetFilters}
410:                 className="btn-secondary text-xs px-2.5 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50"
411:                 title="Xóa toàn bộ bộ lọc"
412:               >
413:                 Xóa
414:               </button>
415:             )}
416:           </div>
417:         </div>
418: 
419:         {/* Collapsible Advanced Filters */}
420:         {showAdvancedFilters && (
421:           <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-xs">
422:             <div>
423:               <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase mb-1">
424:                 Trạng thái ghép mã nguồn:
425:               </label>
426:               <select
427:                 value={matchStatusFilter}
428:                 onChange={(e) => {
429:                   setMatchStatusFilter(e.target.value);
430:                   setCursorIndex(0);
431:                 }}
432:                 className="modern-input text-xs"
433:               >
434:                 <option value="ALL">Tất cả trạng thái khớp</option>
435:                 <option value="matched_exact">Khớp chính xác (Mã vận đơn / Mã đơn)</option>
436:                 <option value="matched_fuzzy">Khớp mờ (Theo số tiền COD & ngày)</option>
437:                 <option value="unmatched">Chưa khớp mã</option>
438:               </select>
439:             </div>
440: 
441:             <div>
442:               <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase mb-1">
443:                 Chi nhánh xuất kho:
444:               </label>
445:               <select
446:                 value={warehouseFilter}
447:                 onChange={(e) => {
448:                   setWarehouseFilter(e.target.value);
449:                   setCursorIndex(0);
450:                 }}
451:                 className="modern-input text-xs"
452:               >
453:                 <option value="ALL">Tất cả chi nhánh</option>
454:                 <option value="store_01">Chi Nhánh Quận 3 (HCM-Q3)</option>
455:                 <option value="store_02">Kho Vận Tân Bình (HCM-TB)</option>
456:                 <option value="store_03">Chi Nhánh Hà Nội (HN-CG)</option>
457:                 <option value="store_04">Chi Nhánh Đà Nẵng (DN-HC)</option>
458:               </select>
459:             </div>
460: 
461:             <div className="flex items-center pt-5">
462:               <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none">
463:                 <input
464:                   type="checkbox"
465:                   checked={hasOpenCaseFilter}
466:                   onChange={(e) => {
467:                     setHasOpenCaseFilter(e.target.checked);
468:                     setCursorIndex(0);
469:                   }}
470:                   className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-[#c23807] focus:ring-[#c23807] border-slate-300"
471:                 />
472:                 <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
473:                   <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
474:                   <span>Chỉ đơn có hồ sơ mở (Sự cố / Khoản lệch / Khiếu nại)</span>
475:                 </span>
476:               </label>
477:             </div>
478:           </div>
479:         )}
480:       </div>
481: 
482:       {/* Main Table Viewport (14px Text, High Contrast, Clean Hairline Borders) */}
483:       <div className="modern-card overflow-hidden">
484:         <div className="overflow-x-auto">
485:           <table className="modern-table">
486:             <thead>
487:               <tr>
488:                 <th>Mã Vận Đơn / Mã Đơn POS</th>
489:                 <th>Hãng & Phương Thức</th>
490:                 <th>Người Nhận & Địa Chỉ</th>
491:                 <th>Trạng Thái</th>
492:                 <th>Ghép Mã</th>
493:                 <th className="text-right">Tiền Thu Hộ (COD)</th>
494:                 <th>Hồ Sơ Vận Hành</th>
495:                 <th className="text-right">Thao Tác</th>
496:               </tr>
497:             </thead>
498:             <tbody>
499:               {paginatedShipments.map((shipment) => {
500:                 const isUnmasked = unmaskedRows[shipment.id];
501:                 const rawPhone = shipment.recipient_phone;
502:                 const maskedPhone = isUnmasked
503:                   ? rawPhone
504:                   : rawPhone.slice(0, 3) + '***' + rawPhone.slice(-4);
505: 
506:                 const isSelected = Boolean(
507:                   matchedShipment &&
508:                   ((effectiveOrderCode && shipment.order_code === effectiveOrderCode) ||
509:                     (effectiveOrderId &&
510:                       (shipment.id === effectiveOrderId ||
511:                         (shipment as any).order_id === effectiveOrderId)))
512:                 );
513:                 const selectedKey = effectiveOrderCode || effectiveOrderId;
514: 
515:                 return (
516:                   <tr
517:                     key={shipment.id}
518:                     data-selected={isSelected ? 'true' : undefined}
519:                     data-testid={isSelected ? `selected-order-${selectedKey}` : undefined}
520:                     className={
521:                       isSelected ? 'bg-orange-50/70 border-l-4 border-l-[#c23807]' : undefined
522:                     }
523:                   >
524:                     {/* Column 1: Tracking & Order Code */}
525:                     <td>
526:                       <TrackingCode
527:                         code={shipment.tracking_code}
528:                         onClick={() => onOpenTrackingModal(shipment.tracking_code)}
529:                       />
530:                       <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5">
531:                         Đơn:{' '}
532:                         <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">{shipment.order_code}</span>
533:                       </div>
534:                     </td>
535: 
536:                     {/* Column 2: Carrier & Automation */}
537:                     <td>
538:                       <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
539:                         <Truck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
540:                         <span>{shipment.carrier_code}</span>
541:                       </div>
542:                       <div className="mt-1">
543:                         <AutomationBadge tier={shipment.carrier_code === 'GHN' ? 'L2' : 'L1'} />
544:                       </div>
545:                     </td>
546: 
547:                     {/* Column 3: Customer with PII Masking */}
548:                     <td>
549:                       <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-xs">
550:                         {shipment.recipient_name}
551:                       </div>
552:                       <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
553:                         <span className="font-mono">{maskedPhone}</span>
554:                         <button
555:                           type="button"
556:                           onClick={() => toggleUnmask(shipment.id, shipment.tracking_code)}
557:                           className="text-slate-400 hover:text-[#c23807] transition"
558:                           title={
559:                             isUnmasked
560:                               ? 'Ẩn số điện thoại'
561:                               : 'Mở xem số điện thoại (Có ghi log kiểm toán)'
562:                           }
563:                         >
564:                           {isUnmasked ? (
565:                             <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#c23807]" />
566:                           ) : (
567:                             <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
568:                           )}
569:                         </button>
570:                       </div>
571:                       <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[200px]">
572:                         {shipment.destination_province}
573:                       </div>
574:                     </td>
575: 
576:                     {/* Column 4: Status */}
577:                     <td>
578:                       <StatusBadge status={shipment.status} />
579:                     </td>
580: 
581:                     {/* Column 5: Match Status */}
582:                     <td>
583:                       {shipment.match_status === 'matched_exact' && (
584:                         <span className="badge-ok text-xs">
585:                           <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
586:                           <span>Khớp Chính Xác</span>
587:                         </span>
588:                       )}
589:                       {shipment.match_status === 'matched_fuzzy' && (
590:                         <span className="badge-warn text-xs">
591:                           <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
592:                           <span>Khớp Mờ COD</span>
593:                         </span>
594:                       )}
595:                       {shipment.match_status === 'unmatched' && (
596:                         <span className="badge-info text-xs">Chưa Khớp</span>
597:                       )}
598:                     </td>
599: 
600:                     {/* Column 6: COD Amount */}
601:                     <td className="text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">
602:                       {shipment.cod_amount > 0 ? (
603:                         <Money amount={shipment.cod_amount} state="pending" />
604:                       ) : (
605:                         <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-normal">Không COD</span>
606:                       )}
607:                     </td>
608: 
609:                     {/* Column 7: Actionable Open Case Links */}
610:                     <td>
611:                       {shipment.has_open_exception && (
612:                         <button
613:                           type="button"
614:                           onClick={() => onNavigateToTab && onNavigateToTab('exceptions')}
615:                           className="badge-risk text-xs cursor-pointer hover:bg-rose-100 transition inline-flex items-center gap-1"
616:                           title="Bấm để chuyển sang Hộp việc cứu đơn xử lý ngay"
617:                         >
618:                           <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600" />
619:                           <span>Cần cứu đơn</span>
620:                           <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
621:                         </button>
622:                       )}
623: 
624:                       {shipment.has_open_discrepancy && !shipment.has_open_exception && (
625:                         <button
626:                           type="button"
627:                           onClick={() => onNavigateToTab && onNavigateToTab('reconciliation')}
628:                           className="badge-warn text-xs cursor-pointer hover:bg-amber-100 transition inline-flex items-center gap-1"
629:                         >
630:                           <DollarSign className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
631:                           <span>Lệch cước/COD</span>
632:                         </button>
633:                       )}
634: 
635:                       {shipment.has_open_claim &&
636:                         !shipment.has_open_exception &&
637:                         !shipment.has_open_discrepancy && (
638:                           <button
639:                             type="button"
640:                             onClick={() => onNavigateToTab && onNavigateToTab('claims')}
641:                             className="badge-info text-xs cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-200 transition inline-flex items-center gap-1"
642:                           >
643:                             <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
644:                             <span>Hồ sơ bồi thường</span>
645:                           </button>
646:                         )}
647: 
648:                       {!shipment.has_open_exception &&
649:                         !shipment.has_open_discrepancy &&
650:                         !shipment.has_open_claim && (
651:                           <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
652:                             <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
653:                             <span>Bình thường</span>
654:                           </span>
655:                         )}
656:                     </td>
657: 
658:                     {/* Column 8: Details CTA */}
659:                     <td className="text-right">
660:                       <button
661:                         type="button"
662:                         onClick={() => onOpenTrackingModal(shipment.tracking_code)}
663:                         className="btn-secondary text-xs py-1.5 px-3"
664:                       >
665:                         Chi Tiết
666:                       </button>
667:                     </td>
668:                   </tr>
669:                 );
670:               })}
671: 
672:               {paginatedShipments.length === 0 && (
673:                 <tr>
674:                   <td colSpan={8} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
675:                     <Package className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 text-slate-300" />
676:                     <p className="font-semibold text-slate-600">
677:                       Không tìm thấy bưu kiện nào phù hợp với bộ lọc hiện tại.
678:                     </p>
679:                     {hasActiveFilters && (
680:                       <button
681:                         type="button"
682:                         onClick={handleResetFilters}
683:                         className="mt-3 btn-secondary text-xs"
684:                       >
685:                         Xóa toàn bộ bộ lọc
686:                       </button>
687:                     )}
688:                   </td>
689:                 </tr>
690:               )}
691:             </tbody>
692:           </table>
693:         </div>
694: 
695:         {/* Cursor Pagination Bar */}
696:         <div className="px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
697:           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
698:             <span>
699:               Hiển thị{' '}
700:               <strong className="text-slate-900">{totalCount > 0 ? cursorIndex + 1 : 0}</strong> –{' '}
701:               <strong className="text-slate-900">
702:                 {Math.min(cursorIndex + pageSize, totalCount)}
703:               </strong>{' '}
704:               trên tổng <strong className="text-slate-900">{totalCount}</strong> bưu kiện
705:             </span>
706: 
707:             <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
708:               <span className="text-slate-400">|</span>
709:               <span>Dòng/trang:</span>
710:               <select
711:                 value={pageSize}
712:                 onChange={(e) => {
713:                   setPageSize(Number(e.target.value));
714:                   setCursorIndex(0);
715:                 }}
716:                 className="px-2 py-1 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white font-semibold text-xs"
717:               >
718:                 <option value={20}>20</option>
719:                 <option value={50}>50</option>
720:                 <option value={100}>100</option>
721:               </select>
722:             </div>
723:           </div>
724: 
725:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
726:             <button
727:               type="button"
728:               onClick={handlePrevPage}
729:               disabled={!hasPrevPage}
730:               className="btn-secondary text-xs py-1.5 px-3"
731:             >
732:               <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
733:               <span>Trang Trước</span>
734:             </button>
735: 
736:             <button
737:               type="button"
738:               onClick={handleNextPage}
739:               disabled={!hasNextPage}
740:               className="btn-secondary text-xs py-1.5 px-3"
741:             >
742:               <span>Trang Sau</span>
743:               <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
744:             </button>
745:           </div>
746:         </div>
747:       </div>
748:     </div>
749:   );
750: };

 213: /** 403 status codes that must surface as dedicated login states (FEAT-AUTH-03 CD-6). */
 214: const STATUS_GATE_CODES = [
 215:   'AUTH_PENDING_VERIFICATION',
 216:   'AUTH_ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED',
 217:   'AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED',
 218:   'AUTH_INVITATION_PENDING',
 219: ];
 220: 
 221: function parseDate(value: unknown): Date {
 222:   if (value instanceof Date) return value;
 223:   const parsed = new Date(String(value ?? ''));
 224:   return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? new Date() : parsed;
 225: }
 226: 
 227: function mapUser(raw: any): User {
 228:   if (!raw) return raw;
 229:   return { ...raw, created_at: parseDate(raw.created_at ?? raw.createdAt) };
 230: }
 231: 
 232: function mapMerchant(raw: any): Merchant {
 233:   if (!raw) return raw;
 234:   return { ...raw, created_at: parseDate(raw.created_at ?? raw.createdAt) };
 235: }
 236: 
 237: interface ExtractedError {
 238:   code?: string;
 239:   message?: string;
 240:   nextAction?: string;
 241:   retryAfter?: number;
 242: }
 243: 
 244: function extractError(body: any): ExtractedError {
 245:   return {
 246:     code: body?.error?.code,
 247:     message: body?.error?.message,
 248:     nextAction: body?.error?.next_action,
 249:     retryAfter: body?.error?.retry_after ?? body?.error?.cooldown_seconds,
 250:   };
 251: }
 252: 
 253: // A stored (setup or access) token whose exp claim is in the past must never be replayed.
 254: function isStoredTokenExpired(jwt: string): boolean {
 255:   try {
 256:     const payload = jwt.split('.')[1];
 257:     if (!payload) return false;
 258:     const json = JSON.parse(atob(payload.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')));
 259:     return typeof json.exp === 'number' && json.exp * 1000 <= Date.now();
 260:   } catch {
 261:     return false;
 262:   }
 263: }

 265: const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

 267: export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
 268:   const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
 269:   const [merchant, setMerchant] = useState<Merchant | null>(null);
 270:   const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
 271:   const [isHydrating, setIsHydrating] = useState(true);
 272: 
 273:   // Restore a persisted session when present. No fabricated default session:
 274:   // FEAT-AUTH-03 (CD-10) removes the prototype's mock auto-login.
 275:   // isHydrating starts true and resolves false in finally, so a signed-out
 276:   // visitor never sits on a loading skeleton (BRAIN.md rule 4).
 277:   useEffect(() => {
 278:     Promise.resolve().then(() => {
 279:       try {
 280:         const savedUser = localStorage.getItem('shipde_user');
 281:         const savedMerchant = localStorage.getItem('shipde_merchant');
 282:         const savedToken = localStorage.getItem('shipde_token');
 283: 
 284:         if (savedToken && isStoredTokenExpired(savedToken)) {
 285:           localStorage.removeItem('shipde_user');
 286:           localStorage.removeItem('shipde_merchant');
 287:           localStorage.removeItem('shipde_token');
 288:         } else if (savedUser && savedMerchant && savedToken) {
 289:           setUser(mapUser(JSON.parse(savedUser)));
 290:           setMerchant(mapMerchant(JSON.parse(savedMerchant)));
 291:           setToken(savedToken);
 292:         }
 293:       } catch {
 294:         localStorage.removeItem('shipde_user');
 295:         localStorage.removeItem('shipde_merchant');
 296:         localStorage.removeItem('shipde_token');
 297:       } finally {
 298:         setIsHydrating(false);
 299:       }
 300:     });
 301:   }, []);
 302: 
 303:   const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 304: 
 305:   const applySession = (data: any) => {
 306:     const nextUser = mapUser(data?.user);
 307:     const nextMerchant = mapMerchant(data?.merchant);
 308:     const accessToken = String(data?.access_token ?? '');
 309: 
 310:     setUser(nextUser);
 311:     setMerchant(nextMerchant);
 312:     setToken(accessToken);
 313: 
 314:     localStorage.setItem('shipde_user', JSON.stringify(nextUser));
 315:     localStorage.setItem('shipde_merchant', JSON.stringify(nextMerchant));
 316:     localStorage.setItem('shipde_token', accessToken);
 317:   };
 318: 
 319:   const login = async (emailOrPhone: string, pass: string, rememberDevice = true) => {
 320:     try {
 321:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/login`, {
 322:         method: 'POST',
 323:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 324:         body: JSON.stringify({
 325:           identifier: emailOrPhone,
 326:           password: pass,
 327:           remember_device: rememberDevice,
 328:         }),
 329:       });
 330: 
 331:       const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
 332:       if (!res.ok) {
 333:         const err = extractError(body);
 334:         if (err.code === 'MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED') {
 335:           const setupTok = (body?.error?.setup_token || body?.error?.access_token || '') as string;
 336:           if (setupTok) {
 337:             setToken(setupTok);
 338:             localStorage.setItem('shipde_token', setupTok);
 339:           }
 340:           return {
 341:             success: false,
 342:             code: 'MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED',
 343:             error: err.message || 'Tài khoản yêu cầu thiết lập xác thực hai yếu tố (MFA).',
 344:             mfaEnrollmentRequired: true,
 345:             setupToken: setupTok,
 346:             expiresIn: body?.error?.expires_in,
 347:           };
 348:         }
 349:         if (STATUS_GATE_CODES.includes(err.code ?? '')) {
 350:           return {
 351:             success: false,
 352:             error: err.message || 'Tài khoản của bạn hiện không thể đăng nhập.',
 353:             code: err.code,
 354:             statusBlock: {
 355:               code: err.code ?? '',
 356:               message: err.message ?? '',
 357:               nextAction: err.nextAction,
 358:             },
 359:           };
 360:         }
 361:         return {
 362:           success: false,
 363:           error: err.message || 'Đăng nhập không thành công.',
 364:           code: err.code || 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 365:           retryAfterSeconds: err.retryAfter,
 366:         };
 367:       }
 368: 
 369:       if (body?.data?.status === 'MFA_REQUIRED') {
 370:         return {
 371:           success: false,
 372:           mfaRequired: true,
 373:           challengeId: body.data.challenge_id,
 374:           expiresIn: body.data.expires_in,
 375:         };
 376:       }
 377: 
 378:       applySession(body.data);
 379:       return { success: true };
 380:     } catch {
 381:       return {
 382:         success: false,
 383:         error: 'Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra đường truyền mạng.',
 384:         code: 'NETWORK_ERROR',
 385:       };
 386:     }
 387:   };
 388: 
 389:   const requestLoginOtp = async (identifier: string) => {
 390:     try {
 391:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/login/otp/request`, {
 392:         method: 'POST',
 393:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 394:         body: JSON.stringify({ identifier }),
 395:       });
 396: 
 397:       const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
 398:       if (!res.ok) {
 399:         const err = extractError(body);
 400:         return {
 401:           success: false,
 402:           error: err.message || 'Không gửi được mã OTP.',
 403:           code: err.code || 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 404:           retryAfterSeconds: err.retryAfter,
 405:         };
 406:       }
 407: 
 408:       return {
 409:         success: true,
 410:         maskedIdentifier: body.data?.recipient_masked,
 411:         channel: body.data?.channel,
 412:         expiresIn: body.data?.expires_in_seconds,
 413:         cooldownSeconds: body.data?.cooldown_seconds,
 414:       };
 415:     } catch {
 416:       return {
 417:         success: false,
 418:         error: 'Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra đường truyền mạng.',
 419:         code: 'NETWORK_ERROR',
 420:       };
 421:     }
 422:   };
 423: 
 424:   const verifyLoginOtp = async (identifier: string, otp: string) => {
 425:     try {
 426:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/login/otp/verify`, {
 427:         method: 'POST',
 428:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 429:         body: JSON.stringify({ identifier, otp }),
 430:       });
 431: 
 432:       const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
 433:       if (!res.ok) {
 434:         const err = extractError(body);
 435:         if (err.code === 'MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED') {
 436:           const setupTok = (body?.error?.setup_token || body?.error?.access_token || '') as string;
 437:           if (setupTok) {
 438:             setToken(setupTok);
 439:             localStorage.setItem('shipde_token', setupTok);
 440:           }
 441:           return {
 442:             success: false,
 443:             code: 'MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED',
 444:             error: err.message || 'Tài khoản yêu cầu thiết lập xác thực hai yếu tố (MFA).',
 445:             mfaEnrollmentRequired: true,
 446:             setupToken: setupTok,
 447:             expiresIn: body?.error?.expires_in,
 448:           };
 449:         }
 450:         if (STATUS_GATE_CODES.includes(err.code ?? '')) {
 451:           return {
 452:             success: false,
 453:             error: err.message || 'Tài khoản của bạn hiện không thể đăng nhập.',
 454:             code: err.code,
 455:             statusBlock: {
 456:               code: err.code ?? '',
 457:               message: err.message ?? '',
 458:               nextAction: err.nextAction,
 459:             },
 460:           };
 461:         }
 462:         return {
 463:           success: false,
 464:           error: err.message || 'Mã OTP không chính xác hoặc đã hết hạn.',
 465:           code: err.code || 'INVALID_OTP',
 466:           retryAfterSeconds: err.retryAfter,
 467:         };
 468:       }
 469: 
 470:       if (body?.data?.status === 'MFA_REQUIRED') {
 471:         return {
 472:           success: false,
 473:           mfaRequired: true,
 474:           challengeId: body.data.challenge_id,
 475:           expiresIn: body.data.expires_in,
 476:         };
 477:       }
 478: 
 479:       applySession(body.data);
 480:       return { success: true };
 481:     } catch {
 482:       return {
 483:         success: false,
 484:         error: 'Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra đường truyền mạng.',
 485:         code: 'NETWORK_ERROR',
 486:       };
 487:     }
 488:   };
 489: 
 490:   const register = async (payload: {
 491:     merchantName: string;
 492:     fullName: string;
 493:     email?: string;
 494:     phone?: string;
 495:     password: string;
 496:     termsAccepted: boolean;
 497:     termsVersion?: string;
 498:   }) => {
 499:     try {
 500:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/register`, {
 501:         method: 'POST',
 502:         headers: {
 503:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 504:         },
 505:         body: JSON.stringify({
 506:           merchant_name: payload.merchantName,
 507:           full_name: payload.fullName,
 508:           email: payload.email || undefined,
 509:           phone: payload.phone || undefined,
 510:           password: payload.password,
 511:           terms_accepted: payload.termsAccepted,
 512:           terms_version: payload.termsVersion || '2026.1',
 513:         }),
 514:       });
 515: 
 516:       const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
 517: 
 518:       if (!res.ok) {
 519:         return {
 520:           success: false,
 521:           error: body?.error?.message || 'Đăng ký không thành công. Vui lòng thử lại.',
 522:           code: body?.error?.code || 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 523:           fields: body?.error?.fields || [],
 524:           nextAction: body?.error?.next_action,
 525:         };
 526:       }
 527: 
 528:       return {
 529:         success: true,
 530:         data: body.data,
 531:       };
 532:     } catch (err: any) {
 533:       return {
 534:         success: false,
 535:         error: 'Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra đường truyền mạng.',
 536:         code: 'NETWORK_ERROR',
 537:       };
 538:     }
 539:   };
 540: 
 541:   const verifyEmail = async (token: string) => {
 542:     try {
 543:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/verify-email`, {
 544:         method: 'POST',
 545:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 546:         body: JSON.stringify({ token }),
 547:       });
 548: 
 549:       const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
 550:       if (!res.ok) {
 551:         return {
 552:           success: false,
 553:           error: body?.error?.message || 'Xác thực email thất bại',
 554:           code: body?.error?.code || 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 555:           nextAction: body?.error?.next_action,
 556:         };
 557:       }
 558: 
 559:       return { success: true, data: body.data };
 560:     } catch {
 561:       return { success: false, error: 'Lỗi kết nối máy chủ', code: 'NETWORK_ERROR' };
 562:     }
 563:   };

 984:         getProfile,

 987:       }}
 988:     >
 989:       {children}

 991:   );
 992: };

 994: export const useAuth = () => {

 826:   // 13f. Production activation handler (handleSearchResultActivation from page.tsx):
 827:   // Proves genuine routing, state updates, history pushes, consecutive activations, and ZERO fake toasts
 828:   const activationState = {

 832:     selectedOrderCode: null as string | null,
 833:     selectedBatchId: null as string | null,
 834:     selectedCaseId: null as string | null,
 835:     selectedClaimId: null as string | null,
 836:     selectedClaimCode: null as string | null,
 837:     selectedDiscrepancyId: null as string | null,
 838:     pushedUrls: [] as string[],
 839:     spiedToasts: [] as string[],
 840:   };
 841: 
 842:   const actions = {

 845:     },
 846:     setSelectedGlobalTracking: (code: string | null) => {
 847:       activationState.selectedGlobalTracking = code;
 848:     },

 851:     },

 854:     },
 855:     setSelectedBatchId: (id: string | null) => {

 857:     },

 859:       activationState.selectedCaseId = id;
 860:     },

 862:       activationState.selectedClaimId = id;
 863:     },

 866:     },

 868:       activationState.selectedDiscrepancyId = id;
 869:     },
 870:     pushUrl: (url: string) => {
 871:       activationState.pushedUrls.push(url);
 872:     },
 873:     showToast: (msg: string) => {
 874:       activationState.spiedToasts.push(msg);
 875:     },
 876:   };

 878:   // 1. WAYBILL activation: opens tracking modal, pushes URL
 879:   const waybillItem: SearchResultItem = {
 880:     id: 'shp_001',

1007:   assert.strictEqual(

1016:   );
1017: 
1018:   // 7. CONSECUTIVE ACTIVATION TEST (Batch -> Transaction -> Batch):
1019:   // Proves mounted reconciliation tab reacts cleanly without lingering previous record
1020:   handleSearchResultActivation(batchItem, actions);
1021:   assert.strictEqual(
1022:     activationState.selectedBatchId,
1023:     'stmt-5555-6666',
1024:     'Consecutive: batch is selected again'
1025:   );
1026:   assert.strictEqual(

1028:     null,
1029:     'Consecutive: discrepancy ID is cleanly cleared'
1030:   );
1031: 
1032:   const consecutiveBatchHtml1 = renderToStaticMarkup(
1033:     React.createElement(ReconciliationTab, {
1034:       selectedBatchId: activationState.selectedBatchId,
1035:       selectedDiscrepancyId: activationState.selectedDiscrepancyId,
1036:     })
1037:   );
1038:   assert.ok(
1039:     consecutiveBatchHtml1.includes('data-selected-batch="true"'),
1040:     'Consecutive: batch 1 is decorated on mounted ReconciliationTab'
1041:   );
1042:   assert.ok(
1043:     !consecutiveBatchHtml1.includes('data-selected="true"'),
1044:     'Consecutive: discrepancy is not highlighted during batch activation'
1045:   );
1046: 
1047:   handleSearchResultActivation(txItem, actions);

1050:     'disc_001',
1051:     'Consecutive: discrepancy is selected again'
1052:   );
1053:   assert.strictEqual(

1056:     'Consecutive: batch ID is cleanly cleared'

1058: 
1059:   const consecutiveTxHtml = renderToStaticMarkup(

1071:     'Consecutive: discrepancy disc_001 is highlighted on mounted ReconciliationTab'
1072:   );
1073:   assert.ok(

1075:     'Consecutive: discrepancy testid is present'

1091:     'Consecutive: discrepancy is cleanly cleared on mounted ReconciliationTab'
1092:   );

1094:   // Verify all 9 activation URLs were pushed to history

1101:   // Verify ZERO fake toasts were emitted during production activation
1102:   assert.strictEqual(

240: `verifiedAt` denotes the inspection date (UTC day marker), not tool execution. Entries with `registrationPending: true` and `toolId: null` are incomplete contract records: no matching manifest entry exists. They remain DECLARED pending a separately scoped manifest registration; this item cannot edit the shared manifest. Existing IDs and evidence references reuse item 1.
241: 
242: ## Existing callers and boundaries
243: 
244: Trigger: existing app/scripts/test infrastructure. No duplicate adapters, fake skills, rewrite or major upgrade.
245: 
246: | Tool          | Caller/config                                                                                                    | Input ? output; limitation                                                       |
247: | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
248: | Git           | scripts/ai/bootstrap-worktrees.ps1                                                                               | ref ? worktree; host presence only                                               |
249: | Node          | package.json:engines                                                                                             | script ? exit/output; product not executed                                       |
250: | pnpm          | package.json:packageManager; pnpm-workspace.yaml; pnpm-lock.yaml                                                 | manifests/lock ? dependencies; SBOM not generated                                |
251: | Compose       | infra/docker/compose.yml; infra/docker/wait.ts                                                                   | environment ? services/readiness; not started                                    |
252: | NestJS        | apps/api/src/main.ts; apps/api/package.json                                                                      | config ? server; not started                                                     |
253: | Prisma        | prisma/schema.prisma; package.json:scripts.db:generate                                                           | schema ? client; not generated/migrated                                          |
254: | BullMQ        | apps/worker/package.json; apps/worker/src/queue/smoke.worker.ts; apps/worker/src/dispatcher/outbox.dispatcher.ts | outbox/job ? processing; idempotency/retry not verified                          |
255: | Turbo         | turbo.json; package.json:scripts.test                                                                            | graph/cache inputs ? task results; cache not exercised                           |
256: | Lefthook      | lefthook.yml                                                                                                     | staged index ? guard/secret verdict; hook and unstaged preservation not verified |
257: | OpenTelemetry | packages/config/src/telemetry.ts; apps/api/package.json                                                          | config ? spans; Work Item/run/attempt correlation not demonstrated               |
258: 
259: Host observations 2026-10-17: `git --version` returned `git version 2.49.0.windows.1`; `node --version` returned `v24.15.0`. Repository package manager pin: `pnpm@11.23.0`. PowerShell pnpm invocation was blocked by execution policy. Host observations do not promote repository states. BullMQ dependency exists in apps/worker/package.json but lacks manifest registration, so this declaration cannot claim INSTALLED. Existing pinned tools are conservatively INSTALLED only; callers alone do not prove execution.
260: 
261: ## Verification and limitations

266: 
267: Local verification on 2026-10-17: group test plus shared evidence test passed 10/10 (zero failures); documentation validation passed with 193 markdown files, 130 feature IDs, 251 delivery rows and 1210 unique identifiers. PR contract deferred to Claude after commit, as requested.

<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/AGENT-CONTRACT-DETAILS.md">
  1: # Ship Dễ — Shared Agent Contract
  2: 
  3: `TASK-AI-161` preserves the original root `AGENTS.md` text from commit `c6e71fcb9354cd2b14d1f5dcaed794abff306991` verbatim below. The short operating card remains root `AGENTS.md`; no rule is rewritten, dropped or weakened. In the preserved text, "this file" still refers to root `AGENTS.md`, and paths remain relative to the repository root. Source-of-truth precedence is unchanged.
  4: 
  5: ## Section map
  6: 
  7: | Former `AGENTS.md` section | Location in this file |
  8: |---|---|
  9: | Opening paragraph | [Opening paragraph](#opening-paragraph) |
 10: | Source of truth | [Source of truth](#source-of-truth) |
 11: | Repository baseline | [Repository baseline](#repository-baseline) |
 12: | Semi-automatic workspaces | [Semi-automatic workspaces](#semi-automatic-workspaces) |
 13: | Role separation | [Role separation](#role-separation) |
 14: | Author routing | [Author routing](#author-routing) |
 15: | Unit of delivery | [Unit of delivery](#unit-of-delivery) |
 16: | Definition of a complete feature | [Definition of a complete feature](#definition-of-a-complete-feature) |
 17: | UI quality rule | [UI quality rule](#ui-quality-rule) |
 18: | 9Router request policy | [9Router request policy](#9router-request-policy) |
 19: | Foundation verification commands | [Foundation verification commands](#foundation-verification-commands) |
 20: | Pull Request evidence | [Pull Request evidence](#pull-request-evidence) |
 21: | Code review rules | [Code review rules](#code-review-rules) |
 22: | Code review rules / Business completeness | [Business completeness](#business-completeness) |
 23: | Code review rules / Carrier integrations | [Carrier integrations](#carrier-integrations) |
 24: | Code review rules / Money and reconciliation | [Money and reconciliation](#money-and-reconciliation) |
 25: | Code review rules / Security and tenancy | [Security and tenancy](#security-and-tenancy) |
 26: | Code review rules / User experience | [User experience](#user-experience) |
 27: | Code review rules / Verification | [Verification](#verification) |
 28: | Required handoff documents | [Required handoff documents](#required-handoff-documents) |
 29: | Closing hardcode line | [Closing hardcode line](#closing-hardcode-line) |
 30: 
 31: ## Opening paragraph
 32: 
 33: This is the operating contract for every AI and human working in the Ship Dễ repository. Delivery is human-gated and semi-automatic: GitHub is the durable handoff channel, the versioned controller derives the next safe stage, implementation authors work in isolated worktrees, CI verifies every Pull Request, and a fresh Codex task independently reviews each Work Item before the human merges it.
 34: 
 35: ## Source of truth
 36: 
 37: Read these sources before changing code, in this precedence order:
 38: 
 39: 1. `docs/product-spec/docs/00-control/BASELINE-AND-DECISIONS.md`
 40: 2. `docs/product-spec/docs/01-product/PRODUCT-VISION-SCOPE.md`
 41: 3. `docs/product-spec/docs/01-product/MASTER-FEATURE-CATALOG.md`
 42: 4. Business rules, state machines, API/data contracts and screen specifications under `docs/product-spec/docs/`
 43: 5. The current Work Item and its acceptance matrix
 44: 6. Existing code
 45: 
 46: Existing code is implementation evidence, not business authority. If code and specification conflict, stop and record the conflict; do not silently choose one.
 47: 
 48: ## Repository baseline
 49: 
 50: The current root application is a Next.js/React/Prisma prototype. A visible screen, mock array, hard-coded quote, simulated carrier action or in-memory mutation is not proof that a feature is complete. The target architecture is defined in `docs/product-spec/docs/07-ai-build/TECH-STACK-REPOSITORY.md` and must be reached through reviewed foundation Work Items without discarding useful UI behavior.
 51: 
 52: Before the foundation migration, validate with the commands present in the current root `package.json`. After migration, the root commands in the target stack document become authoritative. Any command change must update this file and CI in the same Pull Request.
 53: 
 54: ## Semi-automatic workspaces
 55: 
 56: - `shipde-platform` / `main`: integration baseline; implementation agents must not edit it directly.
 57: - `shipde-claude`: Claude analysis and host-authenticated Claude Code CLI author/repair workspace.
 58: - `shipde-dsh`: low-risk author using DSH/OpenCode through 9Router.
 59: - `shipde-gemini`: primary implementation author.
 60: - `shipde-codex`: independent planning, documentation and review workspace.
 61: 
 62: Never assume chat history is shared. The Work Item, branch, commits, Pull Request, CI evidence and review comments are the complete handoff package. `scripts/ai/control.ps1` may route these artifacts, but it may not invent product meaning, bypass a dirty worktree, approve a failed gate or merge.
 63: 
 64: ## Role separation
 65: 
 66: - **Claude — analyst, secondary author and reviewer fallback:** authenticated natively on the host machine via Claude Code CLI (`~/.claude/.credentials.json`, never third-party API quotas). Authorized to provide independent code review fallback when cloud reviewers hit rate limits, and authorized to act as code repair / assistant author for addressing review findings or authoring assigned Work Items.
 67: - **Codex — planner/document owner:** selects the next dependency-ready item, prepares its complete Work Item from approved sources, chooses `GEMINI`, `CLAUDE`, or `9ROUTER` as author, and changes the register to `READY_FOR_AUTHOR`. It does not implement production code during planning.
 68: - **9Router worker — constrained author:** handles only explicitly assigned, low-risk, deterministic work such as fixtures, mocks, types, small CRUD, focused tests, lint or mechanical changes. It must stop when scope reaches architecture, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, money, carrier side effects, database ownership or product UX decisions.
 69: - **Gemini — primary author:** plans and implements complete foundation or vertical product Work Items, adds evidence and opens/updates the Pull Request.
 70: - **Codex — independent reviewer:** uses a fresh review-only task, checks the full Pull Request against the Work Item and source specifications, and returns `PASS`, `CHANGES_REQUIRED` or `BLOCKED`. It does not merge or silently fix the author's branch during review.
 71: - **Human — product and merge owner:** resolves product decisions, triggers each controller gate, accepts residual risk and merges only after CI is green and Codex returns `PASS`. Under decision `HUMAN-DECISION-ORCHESTRATOR-CORE-PRIORITY-2026-09-08` and Work Item `TASK-AI-13`, the deterministic controller is authorized to execute an exact-HEAD auto-merge after `READY_FOR_HUMAN_MERGE` only when strict preflight passes (exact 40-character commit OID, required GitHub Actions `SUCCESS` checks, trusted `chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]` `PASS` verdict, zero unresolved review threads, and `expectedHeadOid` squash mutation). Human merge remains authoritative for the bootstrap of TASK-AI-13 itself and whenever any preflight signal fails.
 72: 
 73: The author never approves its own work. A feature is not complete because an author says it is complete.
 74: 
 75: ## Author routing
 76: 
 77: Assign `9ROUTER` only when all of the following are true:
 78: 
 79: - behavior is already fully specified;
 80: - allowed files and expected output are bounded;
 81: - deterministic tests can prove completion;
 82: - no high-risk domain listed above is touched;
 83: - failure can be safely escalated to Gemini without partial external effects.
 84: 
 85: Assign `GEMINI` for all foundation migrations, complete product features, cross-layer work, UI composition and any task that does not satisfy every 9Router condition. Two failed 9Router attempts require escalation; do not keep retrying to save credits.
 86: 
 87: ## Unit of delivery
 88: 
 89: - One branch and one Pull Request contain exactly one `FEAT-*`, `TASK-FOUND-*`, `TASK-AI-*` or Controller goal item `GOAL-<GOAL>-<n>` Work Item.
 90: - Branch: `feat/<lowercase-work-item-id>-<short-slug>` or `fix/<lowercase-work-item-id>-<short-slug>`.
 91: - Pull Request title: `[<WORK_ITEM_ID>] <business outcome>`.
 92: - Do not combine unrelated cleanup, refactoring or another feature.
 93: - Keep each PR under ~400 changed lines as an advisory target excluding lockfiles and generated files. Keep API-before-UI as implementation ordering inside one vertical Work Item; do not require separate API/UI Pull Requests.
 94: - Keep one active implementation Work Item until the workflow is proven stable.
 95: 
 96: Required status flow:
 97: 
 98: `BACKLOG -> BLOCKED_BY_FOUNDATION/BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY -> READY_FOR_AUTHOR -> IN_PROGRESS -> READY_FOR_CODEX -> CHANGES_REQUIRED -> READY_FOR_CODEX -> CODEX_PASS -> MERGED`
 99: 
100: `BLOCKED` may be entered from any active state with a written reason and evidence.
101: 
102: ## Definition of a complete feature
103: 
104: A feature is vertical, not UI-only. Where applicable it includes:
105: 
106: - user-visible flow and loading, empty, validation, error, forbidden, partial, success and recovery states;
107: - API/application behavior and canonical errors;
108: - persistence, migrations and seed/test fixtures;
109: - tenant scope, authorization, audit and sensitive-data handling;
110: - external adapter behavior, timeout, idempotency, reconciliation and manual fallback;
111: - unit, integration and end-to-end acceptance evidence;
112: - OpenAPI/schema, traceability and operational documentation updates.
113: 
114: No fake primary action, production hardcode, hidden TODO or success toast without a real committed outcome is allowed.
115: 
116: ## UI quality rule
117: 
118: Do not use Ponytail or another global minimalism/taste prompt as product or UX authority. Reuse existing components only when they satisfy the approved screen specification and full state coverage. User-facing work must follow `DESIGN.md` once approved and, until then, `docs/product-spec/docs/03-ux/DESIGN-SYSTEM-UX-RULES.md` plus the relevant screen specification. Generic AI dashboards, disconnected controls and missing recovery paths must be rejected.
119: 
120: ## 9Router request policy
121: 
122: The 9Router endpoint used by DSH must keep Ponytail, Caveman, Headroom and request logging disabled. RTK may compress tool output only for assigned low-risk work and must be disabled while investigating failed tests, full logs or evidence-sensitive diffs. No router optimization may alter the Work Item, business rules, acceptance evidence or UI state coverage.
123: 
124: ## Foundation verification commands
125: 
126: Following `TASK-FOUND-02` monorepo migration, use the authoritative workspace root commands:
127: 
128: - `pnpm install --prod --frozen-lockfile` (production-install regression gate; run from a clean checkout)
129: - `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
130: - `pnpm db:generate`
131: - `pnpm lint`
132: - `pnpm format:check`
133: - `pnpm typecheck`
134: - `pnpm test`
135: - `pnpm test:e2e`
136: - `pnpm test:baseline`
137: - `pnpm test:brain`
138: - `pnpm security:secrets`
139: - `pnpm build`
140: 
141: ## Pull Request evidence
142: 
143: Every Pull Request must contain:
144: 
145: - exactly one Work Item ID and Feature ID;
146: - assigned implementation author and reviewed commit;
147: - source document links and business outcome;
148: - acceptance matrix with pass/fail evidence;
149: - files, migrations, API routes, jobs and screens changed;
150: - commands run and exact results;
151: - screenshots for changed user-facing states;
152: - external API evidence level and fallback behavior;
153: - security, tenancy, idempotency and regression notes;
154: - known limitations; an empty section must explicitly say `None`.
155: 
156: ## Code review rules
157: 
158: ### Business completeness
159: 
160: - Reject an implementation that covers only the happy path or only the screen while the Work Item requires backend, persistence, permission, state or tests.
161: - Reject behavior that contradicts the feature's rule, state machine, actor or acceptance scenario even if the code is clean.
162: - Reject completion claims based on simulation, hard-coded production behavior or client-only state.
163: - Hardcoded model/score/provider data or attempt caps are rejected; data must come from live sources.
164: 
165: ### Carrier integrations
166: 
167: - Never infer carrier capability. Unsupported, unavailable, unverified and timed-out are distinct outcomes.
168: - A timed-out create, cancel, redelivery or claim command must reconcile remote state before retry; blind retries that can duplicate an external effect are prohibited.
169: - Carrier quote, approved contract rate and final settlement deduction remain separate evidence layers.
170: 
171: ### Money and reconciliation
172: 
173: - VND must not use floating-point arithmetic.
174: - Processing status and financial findings are separate dimensions.
175: - Suspected, verified, carrier-accepted and bank-received amounts must not be collapsed.
176: - Bank receipt is required before money is called received.
177: 
178: ### Security and tenancy
179: 
180: - Every tenant-owned read and write is scoped server-side; never trust client-supplied ownership.
181: - Secrets and unnecessary PII must not appear in logs, snapshots, errors or fixtures.
182: - High-risk actions require the approval and audit behavior defined in the specifications.
183: 
184: ### User experience
185: 
186: - Reject disconnected buttons, placeholder data presented as live, inaccessible controls or mobile layouts that block the primary task.
187: - When no carrier can serve an address, explain known reasons and offer edit, retry, draft or documented manual fallback; API failure must not be shown as route unsupported.
188: 
189: ### Verification
190: 
191: - New behavior requires tests at the lowest useful level plus the Work Item acceptance path.
192: - A changed contract requires consumer, schema and compatibility checks.
193: - Formatting and lint belong to CI; review focuses on consequential correctness, security and specification gaps.
194: 
195: ## Required handoff documents
196: 
197: - Workflow: `docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/SEMI-MANUAL-AI-WORKFLOW.md`
198: - Queue: `docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/FEATURE-DELIVERY-REGISTER.csv`
199: - Work Item template: `docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/WORK-ITEM-TEMPLATE.md`
200: - Codex planning prompt: `docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/CODEX-PLANNING-PROMPT.md`
201: - Gemini prompt: `docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/GEMINI-START-PROMPT.md`
202: - 9Router prompt: `docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/NINEROUTER-START-PROMPT.md`
203: - Codex review prompt: `docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/CODEX-REVIEW-PROMPT.md`
204: - Toolchain decisions: `docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/AI-TOOLCHAIN-DECISIONS.md`
205: - Repository and CLI manifest: `docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/REPOSITORY-CLI-MANIFEST.md`
206: - Windows setup runbook: `docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/WINDOWS-SETUP-RUNBOOK.md`
207: - Safe control scripts: `scripts/ai/README.md`
208: 
209: ## Closing hardcode line
210: 
211: No production hardcode: scripts/ai/check-no-hardcode.mjs must pass
</file>

<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/WORK-ITEM-TEMPLATE.md">
  1: # <WORK_ITEM_ID> — <Outcome>
  2: 
  3: ## Control
  4: 
  5: | Field | Value |
  6: |---|---|
  7: | Work Item ID | `<WORK_ITEM_ID>` |
  8: | Feature ID | `<FEAT-ID or N/A>` |
  9: | Status | `READY_FOR_AUTHOR` |
 10: | Delivery order | `<number>` |
 11: | Dependencies | `<merged IDs>` |
 12: | Assigned author | `<GEMINI or 9ROUTER>` |
 13: | Risk | `<LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH>` |
 14: | Allowed paths | `<explicit paths>` |
 15: | Reviewer | `Codex — fresh independent task` |
 16: | Branch | `<branch>` |
 17: | Pull Request | `<URL>` |
 18: 
 19: ## Business outcome
 20: 
 21: State what becomes possible for which actor and why the product needs it.
 22: 
 23: ## Source references
 24: 
 25: List exact feature, actor, rule, use case, screen, API, entity, state and acceptance IDs. A filename without a relevant heading or ID is insufficient.
 26: 
 27: ## Preconditions and dependencies
 28: 
 29: List technical and business prerequisites with evidence that they are merged or available under an approved deterministic mock.
 30: 
 31: ## Ambiguity and clarification markers
 32: 
 33: Every ambiguous requirement, rule gap, unresolved dependency, or unverified assumption must be explicitly tagged with `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]`. If an unresolved `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` marker remains when assigned, the author must STOP immediately and mark the item `BLOCKED` with written evidence; the author must never guess, assume intent, or silently choose an interpretation.
 34: 
 35: ## Author boundary
 36: 
 37: Explain why the selected author is appropriate. For `9ROUTER`, enumerate allowed files, deterministic proof and every prohibited boundary. For `GEMINI`, identify consequential architecture/security/product decisions that still require human approval.
 38: 
 39: ## Slice sizing rule
 40: 
 41: Keep each Work Item Pull Request a single vertical delivery (one Work Item, one branch, one Pull Request per AGENTS.md) sized to cut review rounds and prevent reviewer fatigue:
 42: - Target ~400 changed lines (excluding lockfiles, generated fixtures, and migration snapshots) per Work Item Pull Request.
 43: - API/backend work precedes UI work as implementation ordering inside the same Pull Request (failing tests -> API/backend -> UI); one Work Item is never split into a backend Pull Request plus a separate UI Pull Request.
 44: - If the work cannot stay within the budget while remaining vertical, the planner splits it before authoring into independently scoped prerequisite Work Items: each successor gets its own Work Item file, register row, branch, Pull Request and acceptance matrix; the register `dependencies` field links each successor to its prerequisites; and no predecessor or intermediate item may declare the overall feature complete until the terminal dependent Work Item is `MERGED`.
 45: 
 46: ## In scope
 47: 
 48: List observable behaviors, including frontend, backend, persistence, permission, errors, audit and tests where applicable.
 49: 
 50: ## Out of scope
 51: 
 52: Explicitly list adjacent behavior that must not be added in this Pull Request.
 53: 
 54: ## Business rules and edge cases
 55: 
 56: Use rule IDs and include negative, timeout, duplicate, permission and recovery behavior.
 57: 
 58: ## Constitution check
 59: 
 60: Pre-implementation quality and safety invariants verified by author before coding and by Codex during review:
 61: 
 62: - [ ] **Tenant scope**: Every database query and mutation is strictly scoped to the authenticated tenant server-side; client-supplied tenant ownership is never trusted.
 63: - [ ] **RBAC & permissions**: Every route and action verifies actor roles and permissions explicitly; unauthorized access returns canonical forbidden responses.
 64: - [ ] **Audit & sensitive data**: PII, tokens, and secrets are masked in logs, audits, and error outputs; sensitive actions record audit events.
 65: - [ ] **VND integer arithmetic**: All monetary amounts in VND use integer arithmetic only (no floating-point calculations).
 66: - [ ] **Carrier reconciliation**: External carrier operations (create, cancel, redelivery, claim) reconcile remote state before retry; timeouts never trigger blind retries.
 67: - [ ] **Tests at the lowest useful level, test-first where executable**: Each acceptance row declares its evidence level (`unit`, `integration`, `e2e`, `docs-inspection`, `screenshot` or `log`). Rows with an executable level have their tests written and observed failing before production implementation begins, per AGENTS.md ("lowest useful level plus the Work Item acceptance path"). Rows with a non-executable level (e.g. documentation-only, screenshot-only) instead record `test not applicable: <justification>` in the acceptance matrix; no universal unit-plus-integration gate applies.
 68: 
 69: ## UI states
 70: 
 71: Define loading, empty, validation, error, forbidden, partial, success and recovery states for affected screens.
 72: 
 73: ## API, event and data impact
 74: 
 75: Describe commands/queries, idempotency, errors, migrations, entities, events, jobs and compatibility impact.
 76: 
 77: ## Acceptance matrix
 78: 
 79: | AC/Test ID | Scenario | Expected result | Evidence required |
 80: |---|---|---|---|
 81: | `<ID>` | `<Given/When>` | `<Then>` | `<unit/integration/e2e test, docs-inspection, screenshot or log; "test not applicable: <justification>" if the row is non-executable>` |
 82: 
 83: ## Task breakdown
 84: 
 85: Numbered implementation sequence ordered API/backend before UI, with the failing-test task for each executable acceptance row placed before the implementation task it covers. Independent tasks that can be developed or executed in parallel are tagged with `[P]`:
 86: 
 87: - [ ] `T01` [P] Write failing tests at the lowest useful level for each executable acceptance row `<AC-ID>`; for non-executable rows record `test not applicable: <justification>` in the acceptance matrix.
 88: - [ ] `T02` Implement API/backend domain logic, persistence, and authorization to pass `T01`.
 89: - [ ] `T03` [P] Write failing component/journey tests for UI rows that are executable.
 90: - [ ] `T04` Implement UI screens and state transitions to pass `T03`.
 91: - [ ] `T05` Run full verification suite, verify no hardcoded production values, and attach evidence.
 92: 
 93: ## Author checklist
 94: 
 95: - [ ] Run pnpm ai:check and paste its summary in the PR.
 96: 
 97: ## Verification commands
 98: 
 99: List exact repository commands. All must run from a clean checkout.
100: 
101: ## Codex review record
102: 
103: | Review round | Commit | Verdict | Findings resolved |
104: |---|---|---|---|
105: | 1 | `<sha>` | `<PASS/CHANGES_REQUIRED/BLOCKED>` | `<links>` |
106: 
107: ## Residual limitations
108: 
109: Write `None` or list each limitation with owner, risk, next action and human acceptance.
</file>
