  1: /**
  2:  * @shipde/config
  3:  * Shared workspace configuration, environment validation, correlation, and structured logging.
  4:  */
  5: import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
  6: 
  7: export const WORKSPACE_ENV = {
  8:   DEFAULT_NODE_VERSION: '24',
  9:   DEFAULT_PNPM_VERSION: '11.23.0',
 10:   DEFAULT_TIMEZONE: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
 11:   DEFAULT_CURRENCY: 'VND',
 12:   DEFAULT_RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS: 1000,
 13:   DEFAULT_RBAC_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS: 10,
 14:   DEFAULT_RBAC_SEED_BACKOFF_FACTOR: 1.5,
 15: } as const;
 16: 
 17: export type WorkspaceEnvironment = typeof WORKSPACE_ENV;
 18: 
 19: export type EnvironmentMode = 'development' | 'production' | 'test';
 20: export type CarrierMode = 'disabled' | 'mock' | 'live';
 21: export type LogLevel = 'debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error';
 22: 
 23: export interface AppConfig {
 24:   NODE_ENV: EnvironmentMode;
 25:   PORT: number;
 26:   WORKER_HEALTH_PORT: number;
 27:   DATABASE_URL: string;
 28:   REDIS_HOST: string;
 29:   REDIS_PORT: number;
 30:   REDIS_PASSWORD?: string;
 31:   S3_ENDPOINT: string;
 32:   S3_REGION: string;
 33:   S3_ACCESS_KEY: string;
 34:   S3_SECRET_KEY: string;
 35:   S3_BUCKET: string;
 36:   S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: boolean;
 37:   CARRIER_MODE: CarrierMode;
 38:   LOG_LEVEL: LogLevel;
 39:   /** HMAC secret for access-token signing (FEAT-AUTH-03). Required in production (>= 32 chars). */
 40:   AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET?: string;
 41:   /** Access token TTL in seconds (default 43200 = 12h). */
 42:   AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS: number;
 43:   /** Passwordless OTP login alternative (SCR-AUTH-01 "if configured"); default false. */
 44:   AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED: boolean;
 45:   /** Password reset token TTL in seconds */
 46:   PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECONDS: number;
 47:   /** Frontend URL for building links in emails/SMS */
 48:   FRONTEND_URL: string;
 49:   /** HMAC secret for audit log identifier hashes. Required in production. */
 50:   AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY: string;
 51:   /** Number of trusted reverse proxies for Express 'trust proxy'. Defaults to 0. */
 52:   TRUST_PROXY_HOPS: number;
 53:   /** Dedicated encryption key for MFA factor seeds at rest (FEAT-AUTH-05). Required in production (>= 32 chars). */
 54:   MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY?: string;
 55:   /** Initial retry interval for RBAC platform seed in ms */
 56:   RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS?: number;
 57:   /** Maximum retry attempts for RBAC platform seed */
 58:   RBAC_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS?: number;
 59:   /** Backoff multiplier for RBAC platform seed */
 60:   RBAC_SEED_BACKOFF_FACTOR?: number;
 61: }
 62: 
 63: export class ConfigValidationError extends Error {
 64:   public readonly invalidFields: string[];
 65: 
 66:   constructor(invalidFields: string[], message?: string) {
 67:     super(message || `Configuration validation failed for fields: ${invalidFields.join(', ')}`);
 68:     this.name = 'ConfigValidationError';
 69:     this.invalidFields = invalidFields;
 70:   }
 71: }
 72: 
 73: function parseStrictPort(val: string | undefined, defaultVal: number): number | null {
 74:   if (val === undefined || val === '') return defaultVal;
 75:   if (!/^\d+$/.test(val)) return null;
 76:   const num = Number(val);
 77:   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(num) || num < 1 || num > 65535) return null;
 78:   return num;
 79: }
 80: 
 81: /**
 82:  * Validates runtime environment configuration fail-closed.
 83:  * Guarantees that sensitive values are NEVER exposed in error messages.
 84:  */
 85: export function validateConfig(rawEnv: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): AppConfig {
 86:   const invalidFields: string[] = [];
 87: 
 88:   const nodeEnvRaw = rawEnv.NODE_ENV || 'development';
 89:   if (!['development', 'production', 'test'].includes(nodeEnvRaw)) {
 90:     invalidFields.push('NODE_ENV (must be development, production, or test)');
 91:   }
 92:   const NODE_ENV = nodeEnvRaw as EnvironmentMode;
 93: 
 94:   const portParsed = parseStrictPort(rawEnv.PORT, 3001);
 95:   if (portParsed === null) {
 96:     invalidFields.push(
 97:       'PORT (must be a valid port number 1-65535 without trailing characters or whitespace)'
 98:     );
 99:   }
100:   const PORT = portParsed ?? 3001;
101: 
102:   const workerHealthPortParsed = parseStrictPort(rawEnv.WORKER_HEALTH_PORT, 3002);
103:   if (workerHealthPortParsed === null) {
104:     invalidFields.push(
105:       'WORKER_HEALTH_PORT (must be a valid port number 1-65535 without trailing characters or whitespace)'
106:     );
107:   }
108:   const WORKER_HEALTH_PORT = workerHealthPortParsed ?? 3002;
109: 
110:   const databaseUrlRaw = rawEnv.DATABASE_URL;
111:   if (!databaseUrlRaw) {
112:     invalidFields.push('DATABASE_URL (must be a valid postgresql:// connection string)');
113:   } else {
114:     try {
115:       const parsedUrl = new URL(databaseUrlRaw);
116:       if (parsedUrl.protocol !== 'postgresql:' && parsedUrl.protocol !== 'postgres:') {
117:         invalidFields.push('DATABASE_URL (protocol must be postgresql: or postgres:)');
118:       } else if (!parsedUrl.hostname || parsedUrl.hostname.trim().length === 0) {
119:         invalidFields.push('DATABASE_URL (must specify a valid host)');
120:       }
121:     } catch {
122:       invalidFields.push('DATABASE_URL (must be a valid postgresql:// connection string)');
123:     }
124:   }
125:   const DATABASE_URL = databaseUrlRaw || '';
126: 
127:   if (NODE_ENV === 'production') {
128:     if (!rawEnv.REDIS_HOST || rawEnv.REDIS_HOST.trim().length === 0) {
129:       invalidFields.push('REDIS_HOST (required in production)');
130:     }
131:     if (!rawEnv.REDIS_PORT || rawEnv.REDIS_PORT.trim().length === 0) {
132:       invalidFields.push('REDIS_PORT (required in production)');
133:     }
134:     if (!rawEnv.S3_ENDPOINT || rawEnv.S3_ENDPOINT.trim().length === 0) {
135:       invalidFields.push('S3_ENDPOINT (required in production)');
136:     }
137:     if (!rawEnv.S3_REGION || rawEnv.S3_REGION.trim().length === 0) {
138:       invalidFields.push('S3_REGION (required in production)');
139:     }
140:     if (!rawEnv.S3_ACCESS_KEY || rawEnv.S3_ACCESS_KEY.trim().length === 0) {
141:       invalidFields.push('S3_ACCESS_KEY (required in production)');
142:     }
143:     if (!rawEnv.S3_SECRET_KEY || rawEnv.S3_SECRET_KEY.trim().length === 0) {
144:       invalidFields.push('S3_SECRET_KEY (required in production)');
145:     }
146:     if (!rawEnv.S3_BUCKET || rawEnv.S3_BUCKET.trim().length === 0) {
147:       invalidFields.push('S3_BUCKET (required in production)');
148:     }
149:   }
150: 
151:   const REDIS_HOST = rawEnv.REDIS_HOST || 'localhost';
152:   if (!REDIS_HOST || REDIS_HOST.trim().length === 0) {
153:     invalidFields.push('REDIS_HOST (cannot be empty)');
154:   }
155: 
156:   const redisPortParsed = parseStrictPort(rawEnv.REDIS_PORT, 6379);
157:   if (redisPortParsed === null) {
158:     invalidFields.push(
159:       'REDIS_PORT (must be a valid port number 1-65535 without trailing characters or whitespace)'
160:     );
161:   }
162:   const REDIS_PORT = redisPortParsed ?? 6379;
163: 
164:   const REDIS_PASSWORD = rawEnv.REDIS_PASSWORD || undefined;
165: 
166:   const S3_ENDPOINT = rawEnv.S3_ENDPOINT || 'http://localhost:9000';
167:   try {
168:     const parsedS3 = new URL(S3_ENDPOINT);
169:     if (parsedS3.protocol !== 'http:' && parsedS3.protocol !== 'https:') {
170:       invalidFields.push('S3_ENDPOINT (must start with http:// or https://)');
171:     } else if (!parsedS3.hostname || parsedS3.hostname.trim().length === 0) {
172:       invalidFields.push('S3_ENDPOINT (must specify a valid host)');
173:     }
174:   } catch {
175:     invalidFields.push('S3_ENDPOINT (must be a valid, parseable URL)');
176:   }
177: 
178:   const S3_REGION = rawEnv.S3_REGION || 'us-east-1';
179: 
180:   const rawAccessKey = rawEnv['S3_ACCESS_KEY'];
181:   if (NODE_ENV !== 'production' && (!rawAccessKey || rawAccessKey.trim().length === 0)) {
182:     invalidFields.push('S3_ACCESS_KEY (cannot be empty)');
183:   }
184:   const S3_ACCESS_KEY = rawAccessKey || '';
185: 
186:   const rawSecretKey = rawEnv['S3_SECRET_KEY'];
187:   if (NODE_ENV !== 'production' && (!rawSecretKey || rawSecretKey.trim().length === 0)) {
188:     invalidFields.push('S3_SECRET_KEY (cannot be empty)');
189:   }
190:   const S3_SECRET_KEY = rawSecretKey || '';
191: 
192:   const S3_BUCKET = rawEnv.S3_BUCKET || 'shipde-local';
193: 
194:   const s3ForcePathStyleRaw = rawEnv.S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE;
195:   if (
196:     s3ForcePathStyleRaw !== undefined &&
197:     s3ForcePathStyleRaw !== 'true' &&
198:     s3ForcePathStyleRaw !== 'false'
199:   ) {
200:     invalidFields.push('S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE (must be explicit true or false)');
201:   }
202:   const S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE =
203:     s3ForcePathStyleRaw === undefined ? true : s3ForcePathStyleRaw === 'true';
204: 
205:   const carrierModeRaw = (rawEnv.CARRIER_MODE || 'disabled').toLowerCase();
206:   if (!['disabled', 'mock', 'live'].includes(carrierModeRaw)) {
207:     invalidFields.push('CARRIER_MODE (must be disabled, mock, or live)');
208:   }
209:   // Production must strictly reject mock mode
210:   if (NODE_ENV === 'production' && carrierModeRaw === 'mock') {
211:     invalidFields.push('CARRIER_MODE (mock mode is strictly prohibited in production)');
212:   }
213:   const CARRIER_MODE = carrierModeRaw as CarrierMode;
214: 
215:   const logLevelRaw = (rawEnv.LOG_LEVEL || 'info').toLowerCase();
216:   if (!['debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error'].includes(logLevelRaw)) {
217:     invalidFields.push('LOG_LEVEL (must be debug, info, warn, or error)');
218:   }
219:   const LOG_LEVEL = logLevelRaw as LogLevel;
220: 
221:   // --- FEAT-AUTH-03: session token secret + TTL + OTP login gate ---
222:   const authTokenSecretRaw = rawEnv.AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET;
223:   if (NODE_ENV === 'production') {
224:     if (!authTokenSecretRaw || authTokenSecretRaw.trim().length < 32) {
225:       invalidFields.push('AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET (required in production with at least 32 characters)');
226:     }
227:   }
228:   const AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET = authTokenSecretRaw || undefined;
229: 
230:   const authTokenTtlRaw = rawEnv.AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS;
231:   let authTokenTtlParsed: number | null = 43200;
232:   if (authTokenTtlRaw !== undefined && authTokenTtlRaw !== '') {
233:     if (!/^\d+$/.test(authTokenTtlRaw)) {
234:       authTokenTtlParsed = null;
235:     } else {
236:       const ttlNum = Number(authTokenTtlRaw);
237:       if (!Number.isSafeInteger(ttlNum) || ttlNum < 60 || ttlNum > 30 * 24 * 3600) {
238:         authTokenTtlParsed = null;
239:       } else {
240:         authTokenTtlParsed = ttlNum;
241:       }
242:     }
243:   }
244:   if (authTokenTtlParsed === null) {
245:     invalidFields.push(
246:       'AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS (must be an integer number of seconds between 60 and 2592000 when provided)'
247:     );
248:   }
249:   const AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = authTokenTtlParsed ?? 43200;
250: 
251:   const authLoginOtpRaw = rawEnv.AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED;
252:   if (authLoginOtpRaw !== undefined && authLoginOtpRaw !== 'true' && authLoginOtpRaw !== 'false') {
253:     invalidFields.push('AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED (must be explicit true or false)');
254:   }
255:   const AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED = authLoginOtpRaw === 'true';
256: 
257:   // --- FEAT-AUTH-05: dedicated MFA encryption key ---
258:   const mfaEncryptionKeyRaw = rawEnv.MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY;
259:   if (NODE_ENV === 'production') {

263:       );
264:     }
265:   }
266:   const MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY = mfaEncryptionKeyRaw || undefined;
267: 
268:   const passwordResetTtlRaw = rawEnv.PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECONDS || '3600';
269:   const PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECONDS = parseInt(passwordResetTtlRaw, 10);
270:   if (isNaN(PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECONDS) || PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECONDS <= 0) {
271:     invalidFields.push('PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECONDS (must be positive number)');
272:   }

274:   const auditHmacKeyRaw = rawEnv.AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY;
275:   if (NODE_ENV === 'production') {

277:       invalidFields.push(
278:         'AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY (required in production with at least 32 characters)'
279:       );
280:     }
281:   }
282:   const AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY =
283:     auditHmacKeyRaw || 'default-dev-audit-hmac-key-override-32-chars';
284: 
285:   const trustProxyRaw = rawEnv.TRUST_PROXY_HOPS;
286:   let TRUST_PROXY_HOPS = 0;
287:   if (trustProxyRaw !== undefined && trustProxyRaw !== '') {
288:     const hopsParsed = parseInt(trustProxyRaw, 10);
289:     if (isNaN(hopsParsed) || hopsParsed < 0) {
290:       invalidFields.push('TRUST_PROXY_HOPS (must be a non-negative integer)');
291:     } else {
292:       TRUST_PROXY_HOPS = hopsParsed;
293:     }
294:   }
295: 
296:   const FRONTEND_URL =
297:     rawEnv.FRONTEND_URL ||
298:     (NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'https://shipde.vn' : 'http://localhost:3000');
299: 
300:   const rbacRetryIntervalRaw = rawEnv.RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS;
301:   let RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS: number = WORKSPACE_ENV.DEFAULT_RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS;
302:   if (rbacRetryIntervalRaw !== undefined && rbacRetryIntervalRaw !== '') {
303:     if (!/^\d+$/.test(rbacRetryIntervalRaw)) {
304:       invalidFields.push('RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS (must be a positive integer)');
305:     } else {
306:       const parsed = Number(rbacRetryIntervalRaw);
307:       if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
308:         invalidFields.push('RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS (must be a positive integer)');
309:       } else {
310:         RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS = parsed;
311:       }
312:     }
313:   }
314: 
315:   const rbacMaxAttemptsRaw = rawEnv.RBAC_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS;
316:   let RBAC_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS: number = WORKSPACE_ENV.DEFAULT_RBAC_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS;
317:   if (rbacMaxAttemptsRaw !== undefined && rbacMaxAttemptsRaw !== '') {
318:     if (!/^\d+$/.test(rbacMaxAttemptsRaw)) {
319:       invalidFields.push('RBAC_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS (must be a positive integer)');
320:     } else {
321:       const parsed = Number(rbacMaxAttemptsRaw);
322:       if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
323:         invalidFields.push('RBAC_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS (must be a positive integer)');
324:       } else {
325:         RBAC_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS = parsed;
326:       }

330:   const rbacBackoffFactorRaw = rawEnv.RBAC_SEED_BACKOFF_FACTOR;

332:   if (rbacBackoffFactorRaw !== undefined && rbacBackoffFactorRaw !== '') {
333:     if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(rbacBackoffFactorRaw)) {

335:     } else {

339:       } else {
340:         RBAC_SEED_BACKOFF_FACTOR = parsed;
341:       }
342:     }
343:   }
344: 
345:   if (invalidFields.length > 0) {
346:     throw new ConfigValidationError(invalidFields);
347:   }

378: 
379: // --- Correlation Identification ---
380: export const CORRELATION_ID_HEADER = 'x-correlation-id' as const;
381: 
382: /**
383:  * Validates whether an incoming correlation identifier adheres to format and safety constraints.
384:  * Safe format: 8 to 128 characters, alphanumeric, hyphen, underscore.
385:  */
386: export function isValidCorrelationId(id: unknown): id is string {
387:   if (typeof id !== 'string') return false;
388:   if (id.length < 8 || id.length > 128) return false;
389:   return /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(id);
390: }
391: 
392: /**
393:  * Normalizes an incoming correlation ID, or generates a new secure UUID v4 if absent or invalid.
394:  */
395: export function normalizeCorrelationId(candidate?: string | null): string {
396:   if (candidate && isValidCorrelationId(candidate.trim())) {
397:     return candidate.trim();
398:   }
399:   return randomUUID();
400: }
401: 
402: // --- Structured Logging & Secret Redaction ---
403: const SENSITIVE_PATTERNS = [
404:   /password/i,
405:   /secret/i,
406:   /token/i,
407:   /auth/i,
408:   /credential/i,
409:   /key/i,
410:   /bearer/i,
411:   /cookie/i,
412:   /connection.*string/i,
413:   /identifier/i,
414:   /email/i,
415:   /phone/i,
416: ];
417: 
418: import { getCurrentTraceAndSpanId } from './telemetry.js';
419: 
420: const REDACTED_MARKER = '[REDACTED]';
421: 
422: /**
423:  * Recursively redacts sensitive keys and values from objects, arrays, and error metadata.
424:  * Completely redacts database connection strings (PostgreSQL, Redis, etc.) and credential URIs (Finding 8).
425:  */
426: export function redactSensitiveData(data: unknown): unknown {
427:   if (data === null || data === undefined) return data;
428:   if (typeof data === 'string') {
429:     let sanitized = data;
430:     // Redact complete connection string URIs (PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, AMQP)
431:     sanitized = sanitized.replace(
432:       /(postgresql|postgres|redis|rediss|mongodb|mongodb\+srv|amqp|amqps):\/\/[^\s"',;]+/gi,
433:       REDACTED_MARKER
434:     );
435:     // Redact any other URI containing credentials (user:pass@host)
436:     if (sanitized.includes('://') && sanitized.includes('@')) {
437:       sanitized = sanitized.replace(
438:         /[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:\/\/[^\s"',;]*@[^\s"',;]+/g,
439:         REDACTED_MARKER
440:       );
441:     }
442:     // Redact Bearer tokens
443:     sanitized = sanitized.replace(/(bearer\s+)([^\s,;]+)/gi, `$1${REDACTED_MARKER}`);
444:     // Redact inline secrets, passwords, and tokens
445:     sanitized = sanitized.replace(
446:       /(password|passwd|secret|token|api_?key|access_?key|credential)([:=\s]+)([^\s,;]+)/gi,
447:       `$1$2${REDACTED_MARKER}`
448:     );
449:     return sanitized;
450:   }
451:   if (typeof data !== 'object') return data;
452: 
453:   if (Array.isArray(data)) {
454:     return data.map((item) => redactSensitiveData(item));
455:   }
456: 
457:   const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
458:   for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(data as Record<string, unknown>)) {
459:     const isSensitiveKey = SENSITIVE_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(key));
460:     if (isSensitiveKey) {
461:       result[key] = REDACTED_MARKER;
462:     } else if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
463:       result[key] = redactSensitiveData(value);
464:     } else if (typeof value === 'string') {
465:       result[key] = redactSensitiveData(value);
466:     } else {
467:       result[key] = value;
468:     }
469:   }
470:   return result;
471: }
472: 
473: /**
474:  * Safely sanitizes an error message or object by stripping passwords, tokens, and credentials (P1 Finding 2)
475:  */
476: export function sanitizeErrorMessage(err: unknown): string {
477:   if (!err) return 'Unknown error';
478:   const rawMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
479:   return redactSensitiveData(rawMsg) as string;
480: }
481: 
482: export interface StructuredLogEntry {
483:   level: LogLevel;
484:   service: string;
485:   message: string;
486:   correlationId?: string;
487:   traceId?: string;
488:   spanId?: string;
489:   timestamp?: string;
490:   metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
491: }
492: 
493: /**
494:  * Formats a log entry into a single line of sanitized, machine-parseable JSON.
495:  * Redacts both metadata AND message text to prevent accidental credential leakage (Finding 2).
496:  * Integrates distributed tracing correlation with traceId and spanId (Finding 10).
497:  */
498: export function formatStructuredLog(entry: StructuredLogEntry): string {
499:   const sanitizedMetadata = entry.metadata
500:     ? (redactSensitiveData(entry.metadata) as Record<string, unknown>)
501:     : undefined;
502: 
503:   const sanitizedMessage =
504:     typeof entry.message === 'string'
505:       ? (redactSensitiveData(entry.message) as string)
506:       : entry.message;
507: 
508:   const activeIds = getCurrentTraceAndSpanId();
509:   const traceId = entry.traceId || activeIds.traceId;
510:   const spanId = entry.spanId || activeIds.spanId;
511: 
512:   const logObject = {
513:     level: entry.level,
514:     time: entry.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
515:     service: entry.service,
516:     correlationId: entry.correlationId,
517:     ...(traceId ? { traceId } : {}),
518:     ...(spanId ? { spanId } : {}),
519:     message: sanitizedMessage,
520:     ...(sanitizedMetadata && Object.keys(sanitizedMetadata).length > 0
521:       ? { metadata: sanitizedMetadata }
522:       : {}),
523:   };
524: 
525:   return JSON.stringify(logObject);
526: }
527: 
528: export * from './telemetry.js';
529: 
530: let ephemeralMfaKey: string | undefined;
531: export function resolveMfaEncryptionKey(configuredKey?: string): string {
532:   if (configuredKey && configuredKey.trim().length >= 32) {
533:     return configuredKey.trim();
534:   }
535:   if (!ephemeralMfaKey) {
536:     ephemeralMfaKey = 'shipde_dev_mfa_encryption_key_32bytes_aes256gcm_secret!';
537:   }
538:   return ephemeralMfaKey;
539: }
</file>

 1: 'use strict';
 2: const { test } = require('node:test');
 3: const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
 4: const fs = require('node:fs');
 5: const os = require('node:os');
 6: const path = require('node:path');
 7: const { createContextPack, resolveRepomix } = require('../context-pack');
 8: 
 9: function tempRoot() {
10:   const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'ctxpack-'));
11:   fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, 'src'));
12:   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'src', 'a.js'), 'module.exports = 1;\n');
13:   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'src', 'b.js'), 'module.exports = 2;\n');
14:   return root;
15: }
16: 
17: test('resolveRepomix prefers SHIPDE_REPOMIX_BIN and ignores missing paths', () => {
18:   const root = tempRoot();
19:   const bin = path.join(root, 'fake-repomix');
20:   fs.writeFileSync(bin, '');
21:   assert.equal(resolveRepomix(root, { SHIPDE_REPOMIX_BIN: bin }), bin);
22:   assert.equal(resolveRepomix(root, { SHIPDE_REPOMIX_BIN: path.join(root, 'nope') }), null);
23:   assert.equal(resolveRepomix(root, {}), null);
24: });
25: 
26: test('a pack without repomix says so instead of passing as a repomix pack', () => {
27:   const root = tempRoot();
28:   const saved = process.env.SHIPDE_REPOMIX_BIN;
29:   delete process.env.SHIPDE_REPOMIX_BIN;
30:   try {
31:     const pack = createContextPack([{ allowedPaths: ['src/a.js'] }], {
32:       root,
33:       outputDir: path.join(root, 'out'),
34:     });
35:     assert.equal(pack.packer, 'fallback');
36:     assert.equal(pack.packerReason, 'REPOMIX_NOT_INSTALLED');
37:     assert.deepEqual(pack.files, ['src/a.js']);
38:     assert.ok(!pack.content.includes('src/b.js'));
39:   } finally {
40:     if (saved !== undefined) process.env.SHIPDE_REPOMIX_BIN = saved;
41:   }
42: });
43: 
44: test('fake repomix package with .cmd and package.json bin', () => {
45:   const root = tempRoot();
46:   const bin = path.join(root, 'node_modules', '.bin');
47:   const dir = path.join(root, 'node_modules', 'repomix');
48:   fs.mkdirSync(bin, { recursive: true });
49:   fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
50:   fs.writeFileSync(
51:     path.join(dir, 'cli.js'),
52:     'const fs=require("node:fs");if(process.env.M_FAIL)process.exit(1);' +
53:       'const o=process.argv[process.argv.indexOf("--output")+1];if(o)fs.writeFileSync(o,"# p");\n'
54:   );
55:   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'package.json'), '{"name":"repomix","bin":"./cli.js"}');
56:   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(bin, 'repomix.cmd'), '@echo off\n');
57:   const saved = process.env.SHIPDE_REPOMIX_BIN;
58:   delete process.env.SHIPDE_REPOMIX_BIN;
59:   try {
60:     const pack = createContextPack([{ allowedPaths: ['src/a.js'] }], {
61:       root,
62:       outputDir: path.join(root, 'o1'),
63:     });
64:     assert.equal(pack.packer, 'repomix');
65:     assert.ok(pack.content.includes('# p'));
66:     process.env.M_FAIL = '1';
67:     const fail = createContextPack([{ allowedPaths: ['src/a.js'] }], {
68:       root,
69:       outputDir: path.join(root, 'o2'),
70:     });
71:     assert.equal(fail.packer, 'fallback');
72:     assert.equal(fail.packerReason, 'REPOMIX_FAILED');
73:   } finally {
74:     delete process.env.M_FAIL;
75:     if (saved !== undefined) process.env.SHIPDE_REPOMIX_BIN = saved;
76:   }
77: });
</file>

 189:           .map((rp) => ({
 190:             role_id: rp.role_id,
 191:             permission_id: rp.permission_id,
 192:             permission: this.permissions.find((p) => p.id === rp.permission_id),
 193:           })),
 194:       };
 195:     },
 196:     findFirst: async (args: any) => {
 197:       if (this.shouldFailRoleFindFirst) {
 198:         throw new Error('Database connection failed during role lookup');
 199:       }
 200:       const r = this.roles.find((r) => {
 201:         if (args?.where?.id && r.id !== args.where.id) return false;
 202:         if (args?.where?.code && r.code !== args.where.code) return false;
 203:         if (args?.where?.is_system !== undefined && r.is_system !== args.where.is_system)
 204:           return false;
 205:         if (args?.where?.merchant_id && r.merchant_id !== args.where.merchant_id) return false;
 206:         if (args?.where?.id?.not && r.id === args.where.id.not) return false;
 207:         if (args?.where?.name?.equals) {
 208:           const matches =
 209:             r.name.trim().toLowerCase() === args.where.name.equals.trim().toLowerCase();
 210:           if (!matches) return false;
 211:         }
 212:         return true;
 213:       });
 214:       if (!r) return null;
 215:       if (args?.include?.permissions) {
 216:         return {
 217:           ...r,
 218:           permissions: this.rolePermissions
 219:             .filter((rp) => rp.role_id === r.id)
 220:             .map((rp) => ({
 221:               role_id: rp.role_id,
 222:               permission_id: rp.permission_id,
 223:               permission: this.permissions.find((p) => p.id === rp.permission_id),
 224:             })),
 225:         };
 226:       }
 227:       return r;
 228:     },
 229:     create: async (args: any) => {
 230:       const nameLower = (args.data.name_lower || args.data.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
 231:       const duplicate = this.roles.find(
 232:         (r) =>
 233:           r.merchant_id === args.data.merchant_id &&
 234:           (r.name_lower || r.name).trim().toLowerCase() === nameLower
 235:       );
 236:       if (duplicate) {
 237:         const error: any = new Error(
 238:           'Unique constraint failed on the constraint: roles_merchant_id_name_lower_key'
 239:         );
 240:         error.code = 'P2002';
 241:         throw error;
 242:       }
 243:       const created = {
 244:         id: args.data.id || `custom-role-${this.roles.length + 1}`,
 245:         ...args.data,
 246:         name_lower: nameLower,
 247:         created_at: new Date(),
 248:         updated_at: new Date(),
 249:       };
 250:       this.roles.push(created);
 251:       return created;
 252:     },
 253:     update: async (args: any) => {
 254:       const idx = this.roles.findIndex((r) => r.id === args.where.id);
 255:       if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Not found');
 256:       const updatedName = args.data.name;
 257:       const nameLower = (args.data.name_lower || updatedName || '').trim().toLowerCase();
 258:       if (updatedName) {
 259:         const duplicate = this.roles.find(
 260:           (r) =>
 261:             r.id !== args.where.id &&
 262:             r.merchant_id === this.roles[idx].merchant_id &&
 263:             (r.name_lower || r.name).trim().toLowerCase() === nameLower
 264:         );
 265:         if (duplicate) {
 266:           const error: any = new Error(
 267:             'Unique constraint failed on the constraint: roles_merchant_id_name_lower_key'
 268:           );
 269:           error.code = 'P2002';
 270:           throw error;
 271:         }
 272:       }
 273:       this.roles[idx] = {
 274:         ...this.roles[idx],
 275:         ...args.data,
 276:         ...(updatedName ? { name_lower: nameLower } : {}),
 277:         updated_at: new Date(),
 278:       };
 279:       return this.roles[idx];
 280:     },
 281:     delete: async (args: any) => {
 282:       const assignedUser = this.users.find((u) => u.custom_role_id === args.where.id);
 283:       if (assignedUser) {
 284:         const error: any = new Error(
 285:           'Foreign key constraint failed on the field: users_custom_role_id_fkey'
 286:         );
 287:         error.code = 'P2003';
 288:         throw error;
 289:       }
 290:       const idx = this.roles.findIndex((r) => r.id === args.where.id);
 291:       if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Not found');
 292:       const deleted = this.roles.splice(idx, 1)[0];
 293:       return deleted;
 294:     },
 295:     upsert: async (args: any) => {
 296:       const idx = this.roles.findIndex((r) => r.code === args.where.code);
 297:       if (idx !== -1) {
 298:         this.roles[idx] = {
 299:           ...this.roles[idx],
 300:           ...args.update,
 301:           updated_at: new Date(),
 302:         };
 303:         return this.roles[idx];
 304:       }
 305:       const created = {
 306:         id: args.create.id || `role-${this.roles.length + 1}`,
 307:         ...args.create,
 308:         created_at: new Date(),
 309:         updated_at: new Date(),
 310:       };
 311:       this.roles.push(created);
 312:       return created;
 313:     },
 314:   };
 315: 
 316:   rolePermission = {
 317:     findMany: async (args?: any) => {
 318:       let items = this.rolePermissions;
 319:       if (args?.where?.role_id) {
 320:         items = items.filter((rp) => rp.role_id === args.where.role_id);
 321:       }
 322:       if (args?.include?.permission) {
 323:         return items.map((rp) => ({
 324:           ...rp,
 325:           permission: this.permissions.find((p) => p.id === rp.permission_id),
 326:         }));
 327:       }
 328:       return items;
 329:     },
 330:     create: async (args: any) => {
 331:       if (this.shouldFailRolePermissionUnique) {
 332:         const err: any = new Error(
 333:           'Unique constraint failed on the constraint: role_permissions_role_id_permission_id_key'
 334:         );
 335:         err.code = 'P2002';
 336:         err.meta = { target: ['role_id', 'permission_id'] };
 337:         throw err;
 338:       }
 339:       const created = { id: `rp-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`, ...args.data };
 340:       this.rolePermissions.push(created);
 341:       return created;
 342:     },
 343:     deleteMany: async (args: any) => {
 344:       if (args?.where?.role_id && args?.where?.permission_id?.in) {
 345:         this.rolePermissions = this.rolePermissions.filter(
 346:           (rp) =>
 347:             !(
 348:               rp.role_id === args.where.role_id &&
 349:               args.where.permission_id.in.includes(rp.permission_id)
 350:             )
 351:         );
 352:       } else if (args?.where?.role_id) {
 353:         this.rolePermissions = this.rolePermissions.filter(
 354:           (rp) => rp.role_id !== args.where.role_id
 355:         );
 356:       }
 357:     },
 358:     upsert: async (args: any) => {
 359:       const existing = this.rolePermissions.find(
 360:         (rp) =>
 361:           rp.role_id === args.where.role_id_permission_id.role_id &&
 362:           rp.permission_id === args.where.role_id_permission_id.permission_id
 363:       );
 364:       if (existing) return existing;
 365:       const created = { id: `rp-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`, ...args.create };
 366:       this.rolePermissions.push(created);
 367:       return created;
 368:     },
 369:   };
 370: 
 371:   user = {
 372:     groupBy: async (args: any) => {
 373:       if (this.shouldFailUserCount) {
 374:         throw new Error('Simulated database user count error');
 375:       }
 376:       const map = new Map<
 377:         string,
 378:         { role: string; custom_role_id: string | null; _count: { _all: number } }
 379:       >();
 380:       for (const u of this.users) {
 381:         if (args?.where?.merchant_id && u.merchant_id !== args.where.merchant_id) continue;
 382:         if (args?.where?.status) {
 383:           const filter = args.where.status;
 384:           const expected = typeof filter === 'string' ? filter : filter.equals;
 385:           if (expected && u.status?.toLowerCase() !== expected.toLowerCase()) continue;
 386:         }
 387:         const key = `${u.role}:::${u.custom_role_id}`;
 388:         if (!map.has(key)) {
 389:           map.set(key, { role: u.role, custom_role_id: u.custom_role_id, _count: { _all: 0 } });
 390:         }
 391:         map.get(key)!._count._all++;
 392:       }
 393:       return Array.from(map.values());
 394:     },
 395:     count: async (args: any) => {
 396:       if (this.shouldFailUserCount) {
 397:         throw new Error('Simulated database user count error');
 398:       }
 399:       let count = 0;
 400:       for (const u of this.users) {
 401:         if (args.where.merchant_id && u.merchant_id !== args.where.merchant_id) continue;
 402:         if (args.where.status) {
 403:           const filter = args.where.status;
 404:           const expected = typeof filter === 'string' ? filter : filter.equals;
 405:           if (expected && u.status?.toLowerCase() !== expected.toLowerCase()) continue;
 406:         }
 407:         if (
 408:           args.where.custom_role_id !== undefined &&
 409:           u.custom_role_id !== args.where.custom_role_id
 410:         )
 411:           continue;
 412:         if (args.where.role && u.role !== args.where.role) continue;
 413:         count++;
 414:       }
 415:       return count;
 416:     },
 417:     findUnique: async (args: any) => {
 418:       return this.users.find((u) => u.id === args.where.id) || null;
 419:     },
 420:     updateMany: async (args: any) => {
 421:       let updatedCount = 0;
 422:       for (const u of this.users) {
 423:         if (args.where.merchant_id && u.merchant_id !== args.where.merchant_id) continue;
 424:         if (
 425:           args.where.custom_role_id !== undefined &&
 426:           u.custom_role_id !== args.where.custom_role_id
 427:         )
 428:           continue;
 429:         if (args.data.custom_role_id !== undefined) {
 430:           u.custom_role_id = args.data.custom_role_id;
 431:         }
 432:         updatedCount++;
 433:       }
 434:       return { count: updatedCount };
 435:     },
 436:     update: async (args: any) => {
 437:       const idx = this.users.findIndex((u) => u.id === args.where.id);
 438:       if (idx === -1) throw new Error('User not found');
 439:       this.users[idx] = {
 440:         ...this.users[idx],
 441:         ...args.data,
 442:       };
 443:       return this.users[idx];
 444:     },
 445:   };
 446: 
 447:   auditLog = {
 448:     create: async (args: any) => {
 449:       if (this.shouldFailAudit) {
 450:         throw new Error('Simulated auditLog database storage failure');
 451:       }
 452:       const entry = { id: `audit-${Date.now()}`, ...args.data, created_at: new Date() };
 453:       this.auditLogs.push(entry);
 454:       return entry;
 455:     },
 456:   };
 457: 
 458:   deviceSession = {
 459:     findUnique: async (args: any) => {
 460:       const s = this.deviceSessions.find((x) => x.id === args?.where?.id);
 461:       return s || null;
 462:     },
 463:   };
 464: 
 465:   rawQueries: string[] = [];
 466:   $queryRaw = async (strings: TemplateStringsArray, ...values: any[]) => {
 467:     const sql = strings.join('?');
 468:     this.rawQueries.push(sql);
 469:     if (sql.includes('FROM roles') && sql.includes('FOR UPDATE')) {
 470:       const roleId = values[0];
 471:       const merchantId = values[1];
 472:       const r = this.roles.find(
 473:         (x) => x.id === roleId && (x.is_system || !merchantId || x.merchant_id === merchantId)
 474:       );
 475:       return r
 476:         ? [
 477:             {
 478:               id: r.id,
 479:               name: r.name,
 480:               description: r.description,
 481:               merchant_id: r.merchant_id,
 482:               is_system: Boolean(r.is_system),
 483:               code: r.code,
 484:             },
 485:           ]
 486:         : [];
 487:     }
 488:     if (sql.includes('FROM role_permissions') && sql.includes('FOR UPDATE')) {
 489:       const roleId = values[0];
 490:       return this.rolePermissions
 491:         .filter((rp) => rp.role_id === roleId)
 492:         .map((rp) => ({ id: rp.id, role_id: rp.role_id, permission_id: rp.permission_id }));
 493:     }
 494:     if (sql.includes('FROM users') && sql.includes('FOR UPDATE')) {
 495:       if (sql.includes('WHERE id =')) {
 496:         const actorUserId = values[0];
 497:         const u = this.users.find((x) => x.id === actorUserId);
 498:         return u
 499:           ? [
 500:               {
 501:                 id: u.id,
 502:                 status: u.status,
 503:                 role: u.role,
 504:                 custom_role_id: u.custom_role_id,
 505:                 merchant_id: u.merchant_id,
 506:               },
 507:             ]
 508:           : [];
 509:       }
 510:       const customRoleId = values[0];
 511:       return this.users
 512:         .filter((u) => u.custom_role_id === customRoleId)
 513:         .map((u) => ({
 514:           id: u.id,
 515:           status: u.status,
 516:           role: u.role,
 517:           custom_role_id: u.custom_role_id,
 518:           merchant_id: u.merchant_id,
 519:         }));
 520:     }
 521:     if (sql.includes('FROM device_sessions') && sql.includes('FOR UPDATE')) {
 522:       const sessionId = values[0];
 523:       const userId = values[1];
 524:       const s = this.deviceSessions.find((x) => x.id === sessionId && x.user_id === userId);
 525:       return s ? [s] : [];
 526:     }
 527:     return [];
 528:   };
 529: 
 530:   $transaction = async (fn: (tx: any) => Promise<any>) => {
 531:     // Snapshot state for atomic rollback simulation
 532:     const snapshotPermissions = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.permissions));
 533:     const snapshotRoles = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.roles));
 534:     const snapshotRolePerms = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.rolePermissions));
 535:     const snapshotAuditLogs = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.auditLogs));
 536:     const snapshotUsers = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.users));
 537: 
 538:     try {
 539:       return await fn(this);
 540:     } catch (err) {
 541:       // Rollback state on error
 542:       this.permissions = snapshotPermissions;
 543:       this.roles = snapshotRoles;
 544:       this.rolePermissions = snapshotRolePerms;
 545:       this.auditLogs = snapshotAuditLogs;
 546:       this.users = snapshotUsers;
 547:       throw err;
 548:     }
 549:   };
 550: }

 580:   // AC-RBAC-01-01

1252:     const managerRoleRes = await service.createRole(

1272:       status: 'ACTIVE',

1274: 
1275:     // 3. Simulate concurrent grant to the role of reconciliation:approve_rate_policy (which OPS_CSKH lacks)
1276:     const financePerm = mockPrisma.permissions.find(

1400:   // Finding 3 Proving Test (Round 6): Move change out of auth.service.ts; auth CanonicalApiException unmodified while RbacExceptionFilter maps fields to details
1401:   test('Finding 3 / Round 6 / Scope Integrity: CanonicalApiException in auth has no details duplicate; RbacExceptionFilter maps fields to details for RBAC endpoints', async () => {
1402:     // 1. Instantiate CanonicalApiException from auth.service directly
1403:     const authException = new BaseCanonicalApiException(
1404:       400,
1405:       'AUTH_ERROR',
1406:       'Test Auth Error',
1407:       false,
1408:       undefined,
1409:       [{ field: 'email', code: 'INVALID', message: 'Email invalid' }]
1410:     );
1411:     const authPayload: any = authException.getResponse();
1412:     assert.strictEqual(
1413:       authPayload.error.details,
1414:       undefined,
1415:       'Base CanonicalApiException in auth must NOT contain details duplicate'
1416:     );
1417:     assert.ok(
1418:       Array.isArray(authPayload.error.fields),
1419:       'Base CanonicalApiException must retain fields'
1420:     );
1421: 
1422:     // 2. Test RbacExceptionFilter mapping
1423:     const filter = new RbacExceptionFilter();
1424:     let sentStatus: number | undefined;
1425:     let sentJson: any;
1426:     const mockResponse: any = {
1427:       status: (s: number) => {
1428:         sentStatus = s;
1429:         return {
1430:           json: (j: any) => {
1431:             sentJson = j;
1432:           },
1433:         };
1434:       },
1435:       setHeader: () => {},
1436:     };
1437:     const mockHost: any = {
1438:       switchToHttp: () => ({
1439:         getResponse: () => mockResponse,
1440:       }),
1441:     };
1442: 
1443:     filter.catch(authException, mockHost);
1444:     assert.strictEqual(sentStatus, 400);
1445:     assert.deepStrictEqual(sentJson.error.details, authPayload.error.fields);
1446:   });

1507:           assert.strictEqual(err.getStatus(), 500, 'Must stay 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, NOT 400');
1508:           assert.strictEqual(err.code, 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR', 'Must NOT map to ROLE_NAME_EXISTS');
1509:           return true;
1510:         }
1511:       );
1512: 
1513:       // DB Proof: Role permissions remain unchanged
1514:       const rps = mockPrisma.rolePermissions.filter(

1516:       );
1517:       const permIds = rps.map((rp) => rp.permission_id);
1518:       const orderViewPerm = mockPrisma.permissions.find((p) => p.code === 'order:view_create');
1519:       assert.ok(

1523:     } finally {

1525:     }

1836:     mockPrisma.users.push({

2330:     const permsBefore = await service.getActorPermissions(delegatedActor);

2333:     // 4. Demote the delegated role in DB to remove shipment:quote_carrier
2334:     const demotedPerms = mockPrisma.permissions.filter(

2681:   // Finding 2 Proving Test (Round 9): Consistent lock order everywhere and deadlock/serialization mapped to retryable CONFLICT
2682:   test('Finding 2 / Round 9 / BR-RBAC-02 / BR-RBAC-03: updateRole and deleteRole execute locks in ONE global order (actor user -> actor role -> role_permissions -> target role -> assignees) and map deadlock/serialization to retryable CONFLICT', async () => {

2700:       const sql = strings.join('?');
2701:       if (sql.includes('FOR UPDATE')) {
2702:         if (sql.includes('FROM users WHERE id =')) {
2703:           executedLocksUpdate.push('actor_user');
2704:         } else if (sql.includes('FROM roles WHERE id =')) {
2705:           executedLocksUpdate.push(values[0] === roleId ? 'target_role' : 'actor_role');
2706:         } else if (sql.includes('FROM role_permissions WHERE role_id =')) {
2707:           executedLocksUpdate.push(
2708:             values[0] === roleId ? 'target_role_permissions' : 'actor_role_permissions'

2711:           executedLocksUpdate.push('assignees');

2715:     };
2716: 
2717:     await service.updateRole(
2718:       roleId,
2719:       { description: 'Mô tả mới' },

2721:       '127.0.0.1',
2722:       'corr-r9-f2-update'
2723:     );
2724: 
2725:     // Verify updateRole lock order: actor_user -> actor_role -> actor_role_permissions -> target_role -> target_role_permissions
2726:     assert.strictEqual(executedLocksUpdate[0], 'actor_user', 'First lock must be actor user');
2727:     const targetRoleIndex = executedLocksUpdate.indexOf('target_role');

2730: 
2731:     // 3. Track executed $queryRaw locks in deleteRole

2737:           executedLocksDelete.push('actor_user');
2738:         } else if (sql.includes('FROM roles WHERE id =')) {
2739:           executedLocksDelete.push(values[0] === roleId ? 'target_role' : 'actor_role');
2740:         } else if (sql.includes('FROM role_permissions WHERE role_id =')) {
2741:           executedLocksDelete.push(

2751:     await service.deleteRole(roleId, OWNER_ACTOR, '127.0.0.1', 'corr-r9-f2-delete');

2753:     // Verify deleteRole lock order: actor_user -> ... -> target_role -> ... -> assignees

3066:   // Finding 1 (Round 11): Step-up MFA assurance: PASSWORD session with old MFA timestamp rejected, session row locked in tx, recompute sensitive delta
3067:   test('Finding 1 (Round 11): PASSWORD session with stale or active mfaVerifiedAt rejected with 403 MFA_FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED; locked update recomputes sensitive delta', async () => {
3068:     // 1. Password session with a truthy old MFA timestamp must be rejected (authAssurance === 'PASSWORD')
3069:     const staleMfaPasswordActor = {
3070:       ...OWNER_ACTOR,
3071:       sessionId: 'session-password-owner',
3072:     };
3073: 
3074:     try {
3075:       await service.createRole(
3076:         {
3077:           name: 'Stale MFA PII Role',
3078:           permissions: ['pii:unmask'],

3081:         '127.0.0.1',

3085:     } catch (err: any) {
3086:       assert.ok(err instanceof CanonicalApiException);
3087:       assert.strictEqual(err.getStatus(), 403);
3088:       assert.strictEqual(err.code, 'MFA_FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED');
3089:     }
3090: 
3091:     // 2. In updateRole: Role initially has pii:unmask. Pre-lock it looks like no new sensitive grant is added.
3092:     // Concurrently, pii:unmask is removed before lock. Locked update must recompute from locked before-image and reject password session.
3093:     const concurrentTargetRoleId = 'role-r11-concurrent-sensitive';
3094:     const pOrder = mockPrisma.permissions.find((p) => p.code === 'order:view_create')!;
3095:     const pPii = mockPrisma.permissions.find((p) => p.code === 'pii:unmask')!;
3096:     mockPrisma.roles.push({
3097:       id: concurrentTargetRoleId,
3098:       merchant_id: MERCHANT_A,
3099:       code: null,
3100:       name: 'Concurrent Sensitive Role',
3101:       name_lower: 'concurrent sensitive role',
3102:       description: 'Role with PII',
3103:       is_system: false,
3104:       permissions: [{ permission: pOrder }, { permission: pPii }],
3105:       created_at: new Date(),
3106:       updated_at: new Date(),
3107:     });
3108: 
3109:     // Intercept query to remove pii:unmask concurrently before row lock
3110:     const origQueryRaw = mockPrisma.$queryRaw.bind(mockPrisma);
3111:     mockPrisma.$queryRaw = async (strings: TemplateStringsArray, ...values: any[]) => {
3112:       const sql = strings.join('?');
3113:       if (sql.includes('FROM roles') && sql.includes('FOR UPDATE')) {
3114:         const target = mockPrisma.roles.find((r) => r.id === concurrentTargetRoleId);
3115:         if (target) {
3116:           // Concurrently strip pii:unmask
3117:           target.permissions = [{ permission: pOrder }];
3118:         }
3119:       }
3120:       return origQueryRaw(strings, ...values);
3121:     };
3122: 
3123:     try {
3124:       await service.updateRole(
3125:         concurrentTargetRoleId,
3126:         {
3127:           permissions: ['order:view_create', 'pii:unmask'],
3128:         },
3129:         staleMfaPasswordActor,
3130:         '127.0.0.1',
3131:         'corr-r11-f1-concurrent-patch'
3132:       );
3133:       assert.fail(
3134:         'Locked update must recompute newly added sensitive codes and reject with MFA_FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED'
3135:       );
3136:     } catch (err: any) {
3137:       assert.ok(err instanceof CanonicalApiException);
3138:       assert.strictEqual(err.getStatus(), 403);
3139:       assert.strictEqual(err.code, 'MFA_FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED');
3140:     } finally {
3141:       mockPrisma.$queryRaw = origQueryRaw;
3142:     }
3143:   });

4441:   // Seed Resilience & Fail-Closed Suite (FEAT-RBAC-01 / AC-FOUND-03-04 / AC-FOUND-03-06)
4442:   test('RBAC platform seed: failure logged via structured logger with no secrets on DB failure', async () => {
4443:     const errorLogs: string[] = [];
4444:     const originalConsoleError = console.error;
4445:     console.error = (msg?: any) => {
4446:       errorLogs.push(String(msg));
4447:     };
4448: 
4449:     try {
4450:       const testPrisma = new MockPrismaService();
4451:       testPrisma.shouldFailPermissionFindMany = true;
4452:       const testService = new RbacService(testPrisma as any, {
4453:         ...createValidTestConfig(),
4454:         RBAC_SEED_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS: 10,

4456:         RBAC_SEED_BACKOFF_FACTOR: 1.0,
4457:       });
4458: 
4459:       await testService.executePlatformSeedWithRetry();
4460: 
4461:       assert.strictEqual(
4462:         testService.isReady(),
4463:         false,
4464:         'Service must not be ready when seed failed'
4465:       );
4466:       assert.ok(errorLogs.length >= 2, 'Should have logged each retry attempt failure');
4467: 
4468:       // Parse structured log
4469:       const firstLog = JSON.parse(errorLogs[0]);
4470:       assert.strictEqual(firstLog.level, 'error');
4471:       assert.strictEqual(firstLog.service, 'api');
4472:       assert.ok(firstLog.message.includes('RBAC platform seed attempt 1/2 failed'));
4473:       assert.strictEqual(firstLog.metadata.attempt, 1);
4474:       assert.strictEqual(firstLog.metadata.maxAttempts, 2);
4475: 
4476:       // Verify no sensitive credentials or tokens
4477:       for (const log of errorLogs) {
4478:         assertNoSensitiveData(log);
4479:       }
4480:       testService.onModuleDestroy();
4481:     } finally {
4482:       console.error = originalConsoleError;
4483:     }
4484:   });

4667:       });

<file path="apps/api/src/session/session.service.ts">
  1: import {
  2:   Injectable,
  3:   Inject,
  4:   ForbiddenException,
  5:   NotFoundException,
  6:   OnApplicationBootstrap,
  7: } from '@nestjs/common';
  8: import { randomBytes, createHash, createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
  9: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
 10: import { SessionStatusEnum } from '@prisma/client';
 11: import { formatStructuredLog } from '@shipde/config';
 12: 
 13: export interface RevokeAllDto {
 14:   include_current?: boolean;
 15: }
 16: 
 17: const ABSOLUTE_LIFETIME_DAYS = 90;
 18: const INACTIVITY_DAYS = 30;
 19: 
 20: @Injectable()
 21: export class SessionService implements OnApplicationBootstrap {
 22:   constructor(@Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {
 23:     this.wrapPrismaTransactionForAudit(prisma);
 24:   }
 25: 
 26:   private wrapPrismaTransactionForAudit(prisma: any) {
 27:     if (!prisma || prisma.__auditWrapped) return;
 28:     const origTransaction = prisma.$transaction?.bind(prisma);
 29:     if (!origTransaction) return;
 30: 
 31:     prisma.$transaction = async (...args: any[]) => {
 32:       const [arg1, arg2] = args;
 33:       if (typeof arg1 === 'function') {
 34:         const onCommitHooks: Array<() => void> = [];
 35:         const result = await origTransaction(async (tx: any) => {
 36:           if (tx && !tx.__onCommitHooks) {
 37:             tx.__onCommitHooks = onCommitHooks;
 38:           }
 39:           return arg1(tx);
 40:         }, arg2);
 41: 
 42:         for (const hook of onCommitHooks) {
 43:           try {
 44:             hook();
 45:           } catch (e) {
 46:             console.error('Audit onCommit hook error:', e);
 47:           }
 48:         }
 49:         return result;
 50:       }
 51:       return origTransaction(...args);
 52:     };
 53:     prisma.__auditWrapped = true;
 54:   }
 55: 
 56:   onApplicationBootstrap() {
 57:     this.wrapPrismaTransactionForAudit(this.prisma);
 58:     const key = process.env.AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY;
 59:     if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && (!key || key.trim().length === 0)) {
 60:       throw new Error(
 61:         'AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY is required in production for IP pseudonymization; refusing to start application'
 62:       );
 63:     }
 64:   }
 65: 
 66:   /**
 67:    * Internal creation of session records during successful login (AC-SESS-01).
 68:    * Persists device session with SHA-256 token hash, 90-day absolute expiry,
 69:    * current last_active_at timestamp, and ACTIVE status.
 70:    */
 71:   async create(data: {
 72:     sessionId?: string;
 73:     userId: string;
 74:     merchantId: string;
 75:     token: string;
 76:     deviceId?: string;
 77:     deviceModel?: string;
 78:     userAgent?: string;
 79:     ipAddress?: string;
 80:     authAssurance?: string;
 81:     mfaVerifiedAt?: Date | null;
 82:   }) {
 83:     const tokenHash = createHash('sha256').update(data.token).digest('hex');
 84:     const now = new Date();
 85:     const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + ABSOLUTE_LIFETIME_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
 86: 
 87:     return this.prisma.deviceSession.create({
 88:       data: {
 89:         id: data.sessionId,
 90:         user_id: data.userId,
 91:         merchant_id: data.merchantId,
 92:         session_token_hash: tokenHash,
 93:         device_id: data.deviceId ?? 'web-session',
 94:         device_model: data.deviceModel,
 95:         user_agent: data.userAgent,
 96:         ip_address: data.ipAddress ? this.hashIp(data.ipAddress) : null,
 97:         status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,
 98:         last_active_at: now,
 99:         expires_at: expiresAt,
100:         auth_assurance: data.authAssurance ?? 'PASSWORD',
101:         mfa_verified_at: data.mfaVerifiedAt,
102:       },
103:     });
104:   }
105: 
106:   async list(
107:     userId: string,
108:     merchantId: string | null,
109:     currentSessionTokenHash?: string,
110:     correlationId?: string
111:   ) {
112:     const now = new Date();
113:     const sessions = await this.prisma.deviceSession.findMany({
114:       where: {
115:         merchant_id: merchantId,
116:         user_id: userId,
117:         status: { in: [SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE, SessionStatusEnum.EXPIRED] },
118:       },
119:       orderBy: { last_active_at: 'desc' },
120:     });
121: 
122:     const inactivityThreshold = new Date(now.getTime() - INACTIVITY_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
123: 
124:     const results = sessions.map((s) => {
125:       const isExpiredByInactivity = s.last_active_at <= inactivityThreshold;
126:       const isExpiredByAbsolute = s.expires_at <= now;
127:       const isExpired = isExpiredByInactivity || isExpiredByAbsolute;
128:       const effectiveStatus = isExpired ? SessionStatusEnum.EXPIRED : s.status;
129: 
130:       return {
131:         session_id: s.id,
132:         device_id: s.device_id,
133:         device_model: s.device_model,
134:         user_agent: s.user_agent,
135:         ip_address: this.resolveSafeIpForDisplay(s.ip_address),
136:         status: effectiveStatus,
137:         last_active_at: s.last_active_at.toISOString(),
138:         expires_at: s.expires_at.toISOString(),
139:         created_at: s.created_at.toISOString(),
140:         is_current:
141:           currentSessionTokenHash != null && s.session_token_hash === currentSessionTokenHash,
142:       };
143:     });
144: 
145:     return {
146:       data: results,
147:       meta: { total: results.length, correlation_id: correlationId || 'system' },
148:     };
149:   }
150: 
151:   /**
152:    * Validates an active device session by its SHA-256 token hash strictly scoped
153:    * by user and merchant tenant (BR-SESS-01).
154:    * Unscoped session lookups are strictly prohibited to prevent cross-tenant token exploitation.
155:    */
156:   async validateSession(
157:     tokenHash: string,
158:     scope: { userId: string; merchantId?: string | null }
159:   ): Promise<{
160:     userId: string;
161:     merchantId: string | null;
162:     sessionId: string;
163:     authAssurance: string;
164:     mfaVerifiedAt: Date | null;
165:   } | null> {
166:     if (!scope || !scope.userId) {
167:       return null;
168:     }
169: 
170:     const now = new Date();
171:     const inactivityThreshold = new Date(now.getTime() - INACTIVITY_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
172: 
173:     const where: {
174:       session_token_hash: string;
175:       user_id: string;
176:       merchant_id?: string | null;
177:     } = {
178:       session_token_hash: tokenHash,
179:       user_id: scope.userId,
180:     };
181: 
182:     if (scope.merchantId !== undefined) {
183:       where.merchant_id = scope.merchantId;
184:     }
185: 
186:     const session = await this.prisma.deviceSession.findFirst({
187:       where,
188:     });
189: 
190:     if (!session || session.status !== SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE) {
191:       return null;
192:     }
193: 
194:     const isExpired = session.expires_at <= now || session.last_active_at <= inactivityThreshold;
195:     if (isExpired) {
196:       // BR-SESS-03 / BR-SESS-04: Persist EXPIRED status to DB at guard time (Finding 6)
197:       await this.prisma.deviceSession.updateMany({
198:         where: { id: session.id, status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE },
199:         data: { status: SessionStatusEnum.EXPIRED },
200:       });
201:       return null;
202:     }
203: 
204:     return {
205:       userId: session.user_id,
206:       merchantId: session.merchant_id,
207:       sessionId: session.id,
208:       authAssurance: session.auth_assurance,
209:       mfaVerifiedAt: session.mfa_verified_at,
210:     };
211:   }
212: 
213:   async revoke(
214:     sessionId: string,
215:     userId: string,
216:     merchantId: string | null,
217:     correlationId: string,
218:     reason = 'User requested revocation',
219:     ipAddress?: string
220:   ) {
221:     const session = await this.prisma.deviceSession.findUnique({
222:       where: { id: sessionId },
223:     });
224: 
225:     if (!session) {
226:       throw new NotFoundException({
227:         error: {
228:           code: 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND',
229:           message: 'Không tìm thấy phiên làm việc',
230:           retryable: false,
231:         },
232:       });
233:     }
234: 
235:     if (session.merchant_id !== merchantId) {
236:       throw new ForbiddenException({
237:         error: {
238:           code: 'FORBIDDEN',
239:           message: 'Không có quyền truy cập phiên của cửa hàng khác',
240:           retryable: false,
241:         },
242:       });
243:     }
244: 
245:     if (session.user_id !== userId) {
246:       throw new ForbiddenException({
247:         error: {
248:           code: 'FORBIDDEN',
249:           message: 'Không có quyền cập nhật phiên của người dùng khác',
250:           retryable: false,
251:         },
252:       });
253:     }
254: 
255:     if (
256:       session.status === SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED ||
257:       session.status === SessionStatusEnum.EXPIRED
258:     ) {
259:       return {
260:         session_id: session.id,
261:         status: session.status,
262:         message:
263:           session.status === SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED
264:             ? 'Phiên đã được thu hồi trước đó'
265:             : 'Phiên đã hết hạn',
266:       };
267:     }
268: 
269:     let auditLogAction: (() => void) | null = null;
270:     try {
271:       const result = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
272:         // Concurrency-safe exclusive write lock (BR-SESS-07 / AC-SESS-07):
273:         // SELECT ... FOR UPDATE locks the row against concurrent modifications.
274:         if (typeof (tx as any).$queryRaw === 'function') {
275:           try {
276:             await (tx as any)
277:               .$queryRaw`SELECT id, status FROM "device_sessions" WHERE id = ${sessionId}::uuid FOR UPDATE`;
278:           } catch (lockErr: any) {
279:             // Rethrow on Postgres; only skip where documented unsupported (e.g. SQLite or mock drivers lacking Postgres syntax support)
280:             const dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL || '';
281:             const isPostgres =
282:               dbUrl.startsWith('postgresql:') ||
283:               dbUrl.startsWith('postgres:') ||
284:               (!dbUrl && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production');
285:             const errorMessage = String(lockErr?.message || lockErr || '');
286:             const isDocumentedUnsupported =
287:               errorMessage.includes('NOT_IMPLEMENTED_FOR_UPDATE') ||
288:               errorMessage.includes('sqlite') ||
289:               errorMessage.includes('near "FOR": syntax error') ||
290:               errorMessage.includes('near "::": syntax error');
291: 
292:             if (isPostgres && !isDocumentedUnsupported) {
293:               console.error(
294:                 formatStructuredLog({
295:                   level: 'error',
296:                   service: 'api',
297:                   message: `ROW_LOCK_FAILED: Failed to acquire exclusive lock on session ${sessionId}`,
298:                   metadata: { sessionId, error: this.sanitizeError(lockErr) },
299:                 })
300:               );
301:               throw lockErr;
302:             }
303:           }
304:         }
305: 
306:         // Concurrency-safe atomic transition: only update if currently ACTIVE
307:         const updateResult = await tx.deviceSession.updateMany({
308:           where: {
309:             id: sessionId,
310:             user_id: userId,
311:             merchant_id: merchantId,
312:             status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,
313:           },
314:           data: {
315:             status: SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED,
316:             is_revoked: true,
317:             revoked_at: new Date(),
318:             revoked_by: userId,
319:             revoke_reason: reason,
320:           },
321:         });
322: 
323:         if (updateResult.count > 0) {
324:           auditLogAction = await this.logAudit(
325:             {
326:               merchantId,
327:               userId,
328:               actor: userId,
329:               action: 'SESSION_REVOKED',
330:               resource: `Session:${sessionId}`,
331:               details: { reason, device_id: session.device_id },
332:               correlationId,
333:               ipAddress,
334:             },
335:             tx
336:           );
337: 
338:           return {
339:             session_id: sessionId,
340:             status: SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED,
341:             message: 'Phiên đã được thu hồi',
342:           };
343:         }
344: 
345:         // If count is 0, a concurrent request already transitioned the session.
346:         // Fetch latest status to respond idempotently without duplicate audit logs or timestamp mutations.
347:         const latest =
348:           typeof tx.deviceSession.findUnique === 'function'
349:             ? await tx.deviceSession.findUnique({ where: { id: sessionId } })
350:             : await this.prisma.deviceSession.findUnique({ where: { id: sessionId } });
351: 
352:         return {
353:           session_id: sessionId,
354:           status: latest?.status ?? SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED,
355:           message:
356:             latest?.status === SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED
357:               ? 'Phiên đã được thu hồi trước đó'
358:               : 'Phiên đã hết hạn',
359:         };
360:       });
361: 
362:       // Emitted only after transaction successfully commits
363:       const emitAction = auditLogAction as (() => void) | null;
364:       if (emitAction) {
365:         emitAction();
366:       }
367:       return result;
368:     } catch (err) {
369:       const isAuditFailure =
370:         (err as any)?.message?.includes('AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY') ||
371:         (err as any)?.message?.toLowerCase().includes('audit');
372:       console.error(
373:         formatStructuredLog({
374:           level: 'error',
375:           service: 'api',
376:           message: isAuditFailure
377:             ? `AUDIT_ROLLBACK: Transaction rolled back during revocation of Session:${sessionId}`
378:             : `SESSION_REVOCATION_ROLLBACK: Transaction rolled back during revocation of Session:${sessionId}`,
379:           metadata: {
380:             sessionId,
381:             merchantId,
382:             userId,
383:             correlationId,
384:             error: this.sanitizeError(err),
385:           },
386:         })
387:       );
388:       throw err;
389:     }
390:   }
391: 
392:   async revokeAll(
393:     userId: string,
394:     merchantId: string | null,
395:     currentSessionId: string | undefined,
396:     dto: RevokeAllDto,
397:     correlationId: string,
398:     ipAddress?: string
399:   ) {
400:     const includeCurrent = dto.include_current === true;
401:     const now = new Date();
402: 
403:     let auditLogAction: (() => void) | null = null;
404:     try {
405:       const result = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
406:         const where: Record<string, unknown> = {
407:           merchant_id: merchantId,
408:           user_id: userId,
409:           status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,
410:         };
411: 
412:         if (!includeCurrent && currentSessionId) {
413:           where.id = { not: currentSessionId };
414:         }
415: 
416:         const updateResult = await tx.deviceSession.updateMany({
417:           where,
418:           data: {
419:             status: SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED,
420:             is_revoked: true,
421:             revoked_at: now,
422:             revoked_by: userId,
423:             revoke_reason: 'Revoke all sessions',
424:           },
425:         });
426: 
427:         if (updateResult.count === 0) {
428:           return { revoked_count: 0, message: 'Không có phiên nào cần thu hồi' };
429:         }
430: 
431:         auditLogAction = await this.logAudit(
432:           {
433:             merchantId,
434:             userId,
435:             actor: userId,
436:             action: 'SESSIONS_REVOKED_ALL',
437:             resource: `User:${userId}`,
438:             details: { revoked_count: updateResult.count, include_current: includeCurrent },
439:             correlationId,
440:             ipAddress,
441:           },
442:           tx
443:         );
444: 
445:         return {
446:           revoked_count: updateResult.count,
447:           message: `Đã thu hồi ${updateResult.count} phiên`,
448:         };
449:       });
450: 
451:       // Emitted only after transaction successfully commits
452:       const emitAction = auditLogAction as (() => void) | null;
453:       if (emitAction) {
454:         emitAction();
455:       }
456:       return result;
457:     } catch (err) {
458:       const isAuditFailure =
459:         (err as any)?.message?.includes('AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY') ||
460:         (err as any)?.message?.toLowerCase().includes('audit');
461:       console.error(
462:         formatStructuredLog({
463:           level: 'error',
464:           service: 'api',
465:           message: isAuditFailure
466:             ? `AUDIT_ROLLBACK: Transaction rolled back during revoke-all for User:${userId}`
467:             : `SESSION_REVOCATION_ROLLBACK: Transaction rolled back during revoke-all for User:${userId}`,
468:           metadata: {
469:             merchantId,
470:             userId,
471:             correlationId,
472:             error: this.sanitizeError(err),
473:           },
474:         })
475:       );
476:       throw err;
477:     }
478:   }
479: 
480:   /**
481:    * Revoke all sessions for a specific target user in the tenant (FEAT-AUTH-05 Admin MFA Reset).
482:    * Ensures atomic revocation and audit log creation inside a Prisma transaction (BR-SESS-07).
483:    */
484:   async revokeTargetUserSessions(
485:     targetUserId: string,
486:     merchantId: string,
487:     actorUserId: string,
488:     reason: string,
489:     correlationId: string,
490:     ipAddress?: string,
491:     tx?: any
492:   ): Promise<number> {
493:     const executeInTransaction = async (prismaTx: any) => {
494:       const now = new Date();
495:       const updateResult = await prismaTx.deviceSession.updateMany({
496:         where: {
497:           merchant_id: merchantId,
498:           user_id: targetUserId,
499:           status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,
500:         },
501:         data: {
502:           status: SessionStatusEnum.REVOKED,
503:           is_revoked: true,
504:           revoked_at: now,
505:           revoked_by: actorUserId,
506:           revoke_reason: reason,
507:         },
508:       });
509: 
510:       if (updateResult.count === 0) {
511:         return { count: 0, emitLog: null };
512:       }
513: 
514:       const emitLog = await this.logAudit(
515:         {
516:           merchantId,
517:           userId: targetUserId,
518:           actor: actorUserId,
519:           action: 'SESSIONS_REVOKED_ALL',
520:           resource: `User:${targetUserId}`,
521:           details: { revoked_count: updateResult.count, reason },
522:           correlationId,
523:           ipAddress,
524:         },
525:         prismaTx
526:       );
527: 
528:       return { count: updateResult.count, emitLog };
529:     };
530: 
531:     if (tx) {
532:       const result = await executeInTransaction(tx);
533:       // BR-SESS-07: Never emit audit log before outer transaction commits.
534:       if (Array.isArray((tx as any).__onCommitHooks) && typeof result.emitLog === 'function') {
535:         (tx as any).__onCommitHooks.push(result.emitLog);
536:       } else if (
537:         typeof (tx as any).onCommit === 'function' &&
538:         typeof result.emitLog === 'function'
539:       ) {
540:         (tx as any).onCommit(result.emitLog);
541:       }
542:       return result.count;
543:     }
544: 
545:     let auditAction: (() => void) | null = null;
546:     const count = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (prismaTx) => {
547:       const result = await executeInTransaction(prismaTx);
548:       auditAction = result.emitLog;
549:       return result.count;
550:     });
551: 
552:     if (typeof auditAction === 'function') {
553:       (auditAction as () => void)();
554:     }
555: 
556:     return count;
557:   }
558:   async heartbeat(
559:     sessionId: string,
560:     userId: string,
561:     merchantId: string | null,
562:     currentSessionId?: string
563:   ) {
564:     const session = await this.prisma.deviceSession.findUnique({
565:       where: { id: sessionId },
566:     });
567: 
568:     if (!session) {
569:       throw new NotFoundException({
570:         error: {
571:           code: 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND',
572:           message: 'Không tìm thấy phiên làm việc',
573:           retryable: false,
574:         },
575:       });
576:     }
577: 
578:     if (session.merchant_id !== merchantId) {
579:       throw new ForbiddenException({
580:         error: {
581:           code: 'FORBIDDEN',
582:           message: 'Không có quyền truy cập phiên của cửa hàng khác',
583:           retryable: false,
584:         },
585:       });
586:     }
587: 
588:     if (session.user_id !== userId) {
589:       throw new ForbiddenException({
590:         error: {
591:           code: 'FORBIDDEN',
592:           message: 'Không có quyền cập nhật phiên của người dùng khác',
593:           retryable: false,
594:         },
595:       });
596:     }
597: 
598:     const now = new Date();
599:     const inactivityThreshold = new Date(now.getTime() - INACTIVITY_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
600:     const isExpired = session.expires_at <= now || session.last_active_at <= inactivityThreshold;
601: 
602:     if (session.status !== SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE || isExpired) {
603:       if (session.status === SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE && isExpired) {
604:         // BR-SESS-03: an expired row is stored as EXPIRED in DB
605:         await this.prisma.deviceSession.updateMany({
606:           where: {
607:             id: sessionId,
608:             merchant_id: merchantId,
609:             user_id: userId,
610:             status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,
611:           },
612:           data: { status: SessionStatusEnum.EXPIRED },
613:         });
614:       }
615:       throw new ForbiddenException({
616:         error: {
617:           code: 'SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE',
618:           message: 'Phiên không còn hoạt động',
619:           retryable: false,
620:         },
621:       });
622:     }
623: 
624:     if (currentSessionId && sessionId !== currentSessionId) {
625:       throw new ForbiddenException({
626:         error: {
627:           code: 'FORBIDDEN',
628:           message: 'Chỉ có thể cập nhật trạng thái hoạt động cho phiên hiện tại',
629:           retryable: false,
630:         },
631:       });
632:     }
633: 
634:     // Atomic update scoped to merchant_id, user_id, ACTIVE status, and validity thresholds (BR-SESS-01, BR-SESS-05)
635:     const updateResult = await this.prisma.deviceSession.updateMany({
636:       where: {
637:         id: sessionId,
638:         merchant_id: merchantId,
639:         user_id: userId,
640:         status: SessionStatusEnum.ACTIVE,
641:         expires_at: { gt: now },
642:         last_active_at: { gt: inactivityThreshold },
643:       },
644:       data: { last_active_at: now },
645:     });
646: 
647:     if (updateResult.count === 0) {
648:       // Concurrently revoked or expired between read and update
649:       throw new ForbiddenException({
650:         error: {
651:           code: 'SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE',
652:           message: 'Phiên không còn hoạt động',
653:           retryable: false,
654:         },
655:       });
656:     }
657: 
658:     return {
659:       session_id: sessionId,
660:       last_active_at: now.toISOString(),
661:     };
662:   }
663: 
664:   /**
665:    * BR-SESS-09 / AC-SESS-21: Zero Secret / PII Disclosure.
666:    * Client-facing list responses must never return IP data derived from raw values (no masking of raw IPs).
667:    * Device sessions store HMAC-SHA256 hashed IPs in the database.
668:    * Per zero disclosure, raw IPs are never echoed or masked; returns null for all client-facing responses.
669:    */
670:   private resolveSafeIpForDisplay(_ip: string | null | undefined): string | null {
671:     return null;
672:   }
673: 
674:   private hashIp(ip: string): string {
675:     const key = process.env.AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY;
676:     if (!key || key.trim().length === 0) {
677:       throw new Error(
678:         'AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY is required for IP pseudonymization; refusing to fallback to predictable key'
679:       );
680:     }
681:     return createHmac('sha256', key.trim()).update(ip).digest('hex');
682:   }
683: 
684:   private async logAudit(
685:     meta: {
686:       merchantId?: string | null;
687:       userId?: string;
688:       actor: string;
689:       action: string;
690:       resource: string;
691:       details?: Record<string, unknown>;
692:       correlationId?: string;
693:       ipAddress?: string;
694:     },
695:     tx: any = this.prisma
696:   ): Promise<() => void> {
697:     const hashedIp = meta.ipAddress ? this.hashIp(meta.ipAddress) : null;
698:     const { ipAddress: _rawIp, ...safeMeta } = meta;
699: 
700:     const emitLog = () => {
701:       console.log(
702:         formatStructuredLog({
703:           level: 'info',
704:           service: 'api',
705:           message: `AUDIT: ${meta.action} on ${meta.resource} by ${meta.actor}`,
706:           metadata: { ...safeMeta, ipAddress: hashedIp, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
707:         })
708:       );
709:     };
710: 
711:     try {
712:       await tx.auditLog.create({
713:         data: {
714:           merchant_id: meta.merchantId || null,
715:           user_id: meta.userId || null,
716:           action: meta.action,
717:           entity_type: meta.resource.split(':')[0] || 'Session',
718:           entity_id: meta.resource.split(':')[1] || meta.userId || 'system',
719:           new_value: meta.details ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(meta.details)) : null,
720:           ip_address: hashedIp,
721:         },
722:       });
723:     } catch (err) {
724:       console.error(
725:         formatStructuredLog({
726:           level: 'error',
727:           service: 'api',
728:           message: `AUDIT_FAILED: Failed to persist audit log for ${meta.action} on ${meta.resource}`,
729:           metadata: { ...safeMeta, ipAddress: hashedIp, error: this.sanitizeError(err) },
730:         })
731:       );
732:       throw err;
733:     }
734: 
735:     return emitLog;
736:   }
737: 
738:   private sanitizeError(err: unknown): string {
739:     if (!err) return 'UNKNOWN_ERROR';
740:     const anyErr = err as any;
741:     if (anyErr?.code && typeof anyErr.code === 'string' && anyErr.code.startsWith('P')) {
742:       return `PRISMA_${anyErr.code}`;
743:     }
744:     if (anyErr?.name && typeof anyErr.name === 'string') {
745:       if (anyErr.name.includes('Prisma')) {
746:         return anyErr.code ? `PRISMA_${anyErr.code}` : 'PRISMA_DATABASE_ERROR';
747:       }
748:       return anyErr.name;
749:     }
750:     if (typeof anyErr?.message === 'string') {
751:       if (anyErr.message.includes('AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY')) {
752:         return 'AUDIT_IDENTIFIER_HMAC_KEY_MISSING';
753:       }
754:       if (anyErr.message.toLowerCase().includes('audit')) {
755:         return 'AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_FAILED';
756:       }
757:       if (
758:         anyErr.message.toLowerCase().includes('pool') ||
759:         anyErr.message.toLowerCase().includes('connection')
760:       ) {
761:         return 'DATABASE_CONNECTION_ERROR';
762:       }
763:     }
764:     return 'INTERNAL_ERROR';
765:   }
766: }
