<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/00-control/BASELINE-AND-DECISIONS.md">
 1: # Baseline and Decisions
 2: 
 3: ## Baseline statement
 4: 
 5: This repository supersedes the earlier PoV-only Dev Pack. The current baseline is the full Ship Dễ product. A file-first, single-shop settlement audit remains a valid validation slice, not the product boundary.
 6: 
 7: ## Decision statuses
 8: 
 9: - DECIDED: implementation may proceed.
10: - CONDITIONAL: implementation proceeds behind capability/configuration checks.
11: - CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: adapter/stub may be built, but production behavior requires partner evidence.
12: - PROHIBITED: implementation must reject the behavior.
13: 
14: ## Product decisions
15: 
16: | ID | Status | Decision | Consequence |
17: |---|---|---|---|
18: | DEC-001 | DECIDED | Ship Dễ covers before, during and after shipment. | Pre-shipment and operational modules are CORE. |
19: | DEC-002 | DECIDED | Shops use their own carrier accounts/contracts by default. | Quotes and actions are account-scoped. |
20: | DEC-003 | DECIDED | Carrier serviceability API decides route availability when supported. | API failure is UNKNOWN, not UNSUPPORTED. |
21: | DEC-004 | DECIDED | Live quote, contract rate and settlement deduction are three evidence layers. | Store quote snapshot and rate version. |
22: | DEC-005 | DECIDED | No automatic blind retry for create/cancel/redelivery/claim commands. | Reconcile remote state first. |
23: | DEC-006 | DECIDED | Human selection and configurable auto-routing are both supported. | Recommendations remain explainable and overridable. |
24: | DEC-007 | DECIDED | Recipient experience is channel-neutral, web/PWA first. | Native app can reuse the same API later. |
25: | DEC-008 | CONDITIONAL | Claim submission can be manual-confirmed or policy-authorized automatic. | High-confidence rules, limits and audit are mandatory. |
26: | DEC-009 | DECIDED | Ship Dễ provides a COD ledger and bank reconciliation. | Carrier report alone cannot prove receipt. |
27: | DEC-010 | PROHIBITED | Ship Dễ must not directly hold/route customer COD without an approved licensed model. | Use a licensed partner integration if money movement is added. |
28: | DEC-011 | DECIDED | Ship Dễ may manage shop/partner warehouse and delivery workflows without owning physical assets. | Software capability is not removed by asset boundary. |
29: | DEC-012 | DECIDED | One waybill is billed once per carrier account at first conclusive audit. | Rerun/carry-forward/claim follow-up is not billed again. |
30: | DEC-013 | DECIDED | A rule author cannot approve the same rate/policy version. | Maker-checker enforcement is required. |
31: | DEC-014 | DECIDED | Processing status and findings are independent. | A matched waybill can carry many findings. |
32: | DEC-015 | DECIDED | Four monetary evidence levels are never summed together. | Separate reporting measures are mandatory. |
33: | DEC-016 | DECIDED | TypeScript monorepo is the default implementation stack. | Shared schemas/types and one-language handover. |
34: | DEC-017 | DECIDED | Concurrent implementation ceiling is fixed at one (AI-TOOL-03) as a stability measure. | Raising the ceiling requires an explicit governed decision (DEC-* or HUMAN-DECISION-*), never an unvetted runtime setting. |
35: | HUMAN-DECISION-CONCURRENCY-CEILING-2026-09-22 | DECIDED | The concurrent implementation ceiling rises from one to three, superseding the fixed value in DEC-017. | Operator instruction on 2026-09-22 to run feature Work Items in parallel overnight. Repairs of an open Pull Request and planning/documentation runs do not count towards the ceiling; only new implementation Work Items do. The controller must still keep one Work Item per branch and per Pull Request. |
36: | HUMAN-DECISION-FEAT-COM-09-2026-10-31 | DECIDED | Operator approved the six FEAT-COM-09 gap resolutions as recorded in the Work Item: D1 bounded S01 first delivery with one live producer (`EVT-COM-09-01`, invite/identity/security change) and versioned `EVT-COM-09-02`…`EVT-COM-09-14` fixture-only contracts whose future owners are `FEAT-CAR-05`, `FEAT-AVL-01`, `FEAT-CAR-07`, `FEAT-SHP-01`, `FEAT-SHP-02`, `FEAT-EXC-01`, `FEAT-RET-01`, `FEAT-IMP-02`, `FEAT-BNK-01`, `FEAT-AUD-07`, `FEAT-BNK-01`, `FEAT-CLM-01` and `FEAT-CLM-04` in that order; D2 notification center `SCR-COM-09` at `/settings/notifications` with per-recipient server-side read state, explicit idempotent read actions, cursor pagination and permission-free deep links; D3 protected events (`security_alerts`, `create_unknown`, `claim_deadline_warning`) always delivered in-app, write-time rejection of disabling them, and truthful `SKIPPED_NO_VERIFIED_EMAIL` email outcomes; D4 per-(tenant, recipient) ownership, the per-event role/capability/scope eligibility table, recipient-only inbox endpoints, no support inbox in this item, and sanitized immutable audit; D5 `provider_submission_id` captured before the provider call, `UNKNOWN` held with no automatic retry when no message id or lookup support exists, recovery delivery listing endpoint `GET /api/v1/admin/notification-deliveries` (authorized for OWNER/bound operator, returning masked email, attempt and submission id preconditions), operator outcomes limited to `MARK_SENT` or `RELEASE_FOR_RETRY` through `POST /api/v1/admin/notification-deliveries/{delivery_id}/redeliver` with `expected_attempt`, `expected_provider_submission_id`, and `idempotency_key` preconditions (stale replays reject with `409 CONFLICT`) on `SCR-COM-09-JOBS` at `/admin/jobs/notification-deliveries`, and prohibited reuse of the simulated verification adapter; D6 frozen `Notification`/`NotificationChannelDelivery` fields including source scope ids and provider ids, separation of outbox transport identity from notification grouping, resolution envelope targeting (`target_group_key`, `resolution_id`), credential incident identity (`incident_id` for `EVT-COM-09-02` in payload and active transport key `carrier_account_id:condition:incident_id` to prevent recurrence suppression across resolved incidents), recurring-window digest identities (`digest_window`, `queue_revision` for `EVT-COM-09-10`), the 14 required payload and fingerprint rows, policy-driven retention and the 16-row acceptance matrix. Owner: operator, 2026-10-31. | Work Item `docs/product-spec/work-items/FEAT-COM-09.md` is READY_FOR_AUTHOR for GEMINI (Slices A then B, one implementation PR); implementation must stay inside its frozen allowed paths and re-verify the merged baseline. The 13 fixture-only categories stay fixture-only until their named producer Work Items emit them. `FEAT-SEC-02` owns any later support read. D5 configuration defaults are reviewed as configuration data in the implementation PR. |
37: | HUMAN-DECISION-FEAT-SUP-01-2026-10-31 | DECIDED | Approval of contextual support request workflow, explicit consent boundary, independent state machine, RBAC capabilities, private attachments, and vertical slice architecture for [FEAT-SUP-01](../../work-items/FEAT-SUP-01.md). Date: 2026-10-31. Owner: operator. | Operator approval on 2026-10-31 resolves all planning gaps G01–G09: authenticated shop requests with typed context and clean attachment linkage (G01); dedicated UI routes `/support`, `/support/new`, `/support/:id`, operator queue (G02); independent state machine OPEN → IN_PROGRESS → WAITING_FOR_SHOP → RESOLVED (G03); granular RBAC capabilities and SHOP_OWNER consent delegation, including explicit operator read/reply permissions and platform triage queue scope separate from tenant-isolated shop access, plus native domain capability authorization (order:view_create, shipment:track_exceptions, reconciliation:run_review_audit, claim:verify_submit) for shop context data inspection (G04); private attachment upload staging lifecycle with presigned upload URLs, staging ownership, consistent null-until-commit staging linkage with validated target-ticket scope, synchronous malware scan verification with protected promotion to immutable storage (support/clean/*), cryptographic SHA-256 and S3 version ID binding, and atomic ticket/reply linkage with malware quarantine (G05); time-bound, named operator, scoped read-only consent grants with instant revocation and dedicated consented inspection path `GET /api/v1/support/requests/:id/context-data` producing immutable `SUPPORT_OPERATOR_ACCESS` audit logs with masked PII (G06); vertical slice architecture defining Slice A (API/Data/Contracts/RBAC) and Slice B (UI/E2E) aligned with COM-06 and SEC-02 boundaries (G07); tenant-scoped API contracts mapped to Merchant/merchant_id (G08); and test traceability with synthetic fixtures, deferring external notifications/SLA (G09). Work Item marked READY_FOR_AUTHOR. |
38: | HUMAN-DECISION-FEAT-CAR-01-2026-10-31 | DECIDED | Operator approval on 2026-10-31 (owner = operator) resolves all blocking gaps CAR-GAP-01 through CAR-GAP-07 for [FEAT-CAR-01](../../work-items/FEAT-CAR-01.md): (1) Platform-owned, versioned read-only carrier catalog with mutation UI deferred to FEAT-ADM-01, with multi-revision coexistence guaranteed via revision-scoped composite unique constraints `[catalogRevision, code]` and UUID primary keys across all reference models (`Carrier`, `CarrierService`, `CanonicalStatusReference`, `FeeComponentReference`, `CatalogCompatibilityMapping`); (2) Dedicated read-only catalog tab at `/settings/carriers` (`SCR-CAR-01`); (3) Canonical permission `iam:carrier_catalog:read` for OWNER, OPS_MANAGER, ORDER_OPERATOR, FINANCE, with platform writes reserved for admin audit; (4) Canonical carrier codes `GHN` ('Giao Hàng Nhanh'), `GHTK`, `VIETTEL_POST`, `JT` matching Prisma/contracts, with boundary alias normalization (`VTP` -> `VIETTEL_POST`, `JT_EXPRESS` -> `JT`); (5) Dedicated `/api/v1/carrier-catalog` API with 4 reference schemas (carriers, services, canonical statuses, fee components) and decoupled command vs operational shipment lifecycle; (6) Raw provider status and fee keys preserved with official carrier evidence (GHTK raw status `20` maps to canonical `RETURNING` per official GHTK documentation `https://docs.giaohangtietkiem.vn/`, GHTK raw status `13` 'Đơn hàng bồi thường' resolves to `UNMAPPED` / `null` to avoid conflating compensation with damage), unknown raw values resolve to unmapped rather than defaulting to IN_TRANSIT; (7) Initial baseline dataset with official public evidence for GHN/GHTK and confirmation-required flags for VIETTEL_POST/JT under OI-001/002. | Work Item [FEAT-CAR-01](../../work-items/FEAT-CAR-01.md) unblocked and set to `READY_FOR_AUTHOR`. Establishes the authoritative carrier taxonomy baseline for downstream account connection (FEAT-CAR-02), quoting, tracking, and settlement audit without provider code leakage. |
39: 
40: ## Evidence levels
41: 
42: | Level | Meaning |
43: |---|---|
44: | VERIFIED_OFFICIAL | Current official public provider documentation observed |
45: | VERIFIED_PARTNER | Confirmed in partner portal/contract/sandbox by the shop or Ship Dễ |
46: | COMMUNITY_INDICATION | Non-official technical evidence; not production-authoritative |
47: | UNVERIFIED | No adequate evidence |
48: 
49: ## Change control
50: 
51: Any change affecting money, state transitions, external commands, PII, billing or tenant isolation requires:
52: 
53: 1. New decision-log entry.
54: 2. Impacted requirement identifiers.
55: 3. Updated API/data/test contracts.
56: 4. Regression test.
57: 5. Human approval before merge.
</file>

<file path="AGENTS.md">
 1: # Ship Dễ — Operating card
 2: 
 3: ## Source of truth
 4: 
 5: Read these sources before changing code, in this precedence order:
 6: 
 7: 1. `docs/product-spec/docs/00-control/BASELINE-AND-DECISIONS.md`
 8: 2. `docs/product-spec/docs/01-product/PRODUCT-VISION-SCOPE.md`
 9: 3. `docs/product-spec/docs/01-product/MASTER-FEATURE-CATALOG.md`
10: 4. Business rules, state machines, API/data contracts and screen specifications under `docs/product-spec/docs/`
11: 5. The current Work Item and its acceptance matrix
12: 6. Existing code
13: 
14: Existing code is implementation evidence, not business authority. If code and specification conflict, stop and record the conflict; do not silently choose one.
15: 
16: ## One Work Item per branch and Pull Request
17: 
18: - One branch and one Pull Request contain exactly one `FEAT-*`, `TASK-FOUND-*`, `TASK-AI-*` or Controller goal item `GOAL-<GOAL>-<n>` Work Item.
19: - Branch: `feat/<lowercase-work-item-id>-<short-slug>` or `fix/<lowercase-work-item-id>-<short-slug>`.
20: - Pull Request title: `[<WORK_ITEM_ID>] <business outcome>`.
21: - Do not combine unrelated cleanup, refactoring or another feature.
22: 
23: ## Verification commands
24: 
25: - `pnpm install --prod --frozen-lockfile` (production-install regression gate; run from a clean checkout)
26: - `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
27: - `pnpm db:generate`
28: - `pnpm lint`
29: - `pnpm format:check`
30: - `pnpm typecheck`
31: - `pnpm test`
32: - `pnpm test:e2e`
33: - `pnpm test:baseline`
34: - `pnpm test:brain`
35: - `pnpm security:secrets`
36: - `pnpm build`
37: 
38: ## Definition of Done
39: 
40: A feature is vertical, not UI-only. Where applicable it includes:
41: 
42: - [ ] user-visible flow and loading, empty, validation, error, forbidden, partial, success and recovery states;
43: - [ ] API/application behavior and canonical errors;
44: - [ ] persistence, migrations and seed/test fixtures;
45: - [ ] tenant scope, authorization, audit and sensitive-data handling;
46: - [ ] external adapter behavior, timeout, idempotency, reconciliation and manual fallback;
47: - [ ] unit, integration and end-to-end acceptance evidence;
48: - [ ] OpenAPI/schema, traceability and operational documentation updates.
49: 
50: - [ ] No fake primary action, production hardcode, hidden TODO or success toast without a real committed outcome is allowed.
51: - [ ] New behavior requires tests at the lowest useful level plus the Work Item acceptance path.
52: - [ ] A changed contract requires consumer, schema and compatibility checks.
53: - [ ] Pull Request evidence includes every [required item](docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/AGENT-CONTRACT-DETAILS.md#pull-request-evidence).
54: - [ ] `scripts/ai/check-no-hardcode.mjs` passes.
55: 
56: ## Hard prohibitions
57: 
58: - Secrets and unnecessary PII must not appear in logs, snapshots, errors or fixtures.
59: - Every tenant-owned read and write is scoped server-side; never trust client-supplied ownership.
60: - VND must not use floating-point arithmetic.
61: - A timed-out create, cancel, redelivery or claim command must reconcile remote state before retry; blind retries that can duplicate an external effect are prohibited.
62: - No fake primary action.
63: - Never touch gate configs, allowlists, baselines, semgrep, or `.github/` without explicit approval.
64: - The author never approves its own work. A feature is not complete because an author says it is complete.
65: 
66: ## Role separation
67: 
68: - **Claude — analyst, secondary author and reviewer fallback:** host-authenticated Claude Code CLI only; independent review fallback when cloud reviewers hit rate limits and assigned repair/authoring; never third-party API quotas.
69: - **Codex — planner/document owner:** prepares the dependency-ready Work Item from approved sources, chooses `GEMINI`, `CLAUDE`, or `9ROUTER`, sets the register to `READY_FOR_AUTHOR`; no production code during planning.
70: - **9Router worker — constrained author:** assigned low-risk deterministic work only; stop at architecture, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, money, carrier side effects, database ownership or product UX decisions.
71: - **Gemini — primary author:** plans and implements complete foundation or vertical Work Items, adds evidence and opens/updates the Pull Request.
72: - **Codex — independent reviewer:** fresh review-only task against the full Pull Request, Work Item and sources; `PASS`, `CHANGES_REQUIRED` or `BLOCKED`; does not merge or silently fix. **Human — product and merge owner:** resolves decisions, triggers gates, accepts residual risk and merges only after green CI and Codex `PASS`; the [existing conditional controller merge authorization](docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/AGENT-CONTRACT-DETAILS.md#role-separation) remains unchanged.
73: 
74: ## Detailed contract
75: 
76: - [Full contract and section map](docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/AGENT-CONTRACT-DETAILS.md)
77: - [Workflow](docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/SEMI-MANUAL-AI-WORKFLOW.md), [register](docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/FEATURE-DELIVERY-REGISTER.csv), [Work Item template](docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/WORK-ITEM-TEMPLATE.md)
78: - [Planning, author and review prompts; toolchain, CLI manifest and Windows setup](docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/AGENT-CONTRACT-DETAILS.md#required-handoff-documents)
79: - [Shared code-context MCP setup](tools/ctx-tools/README.md)
80: - [Agent toolkit registry](tools/ctx-tools/toolkit.json)
81: - [Agent prompt tools generator](tools/ctx-tools/prompt-block.js)
82: - [Safe control scripts](scripts/ai/README.md)
</file>

   1: import 'reflect-metadata';
   2: import * as assert from 'node:assert';
   3: import * as path from 'node:path';
   4: import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';

   6: import request from 'supertest';
   7: import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
   8: import { AppModule } from '../app.module';
   9: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
  10: import { APP_CONFIG } from '../config.token';
  11: import { VERIFICATION_ADAPTER } from '../auth/auth.tokens';
  12: import { signAccessToken, resolveAccessTokenSecret } from '../auth/token.util';
  13: import {
  14:   MockVerificationDeliveryAdapter,
  15:   createValidTestConfig,
  16:   assertNoSensitiveData,
  17: } from '@shipde/testkit';
  18: import { seedDatabase, SEED_MERCHANT_ID } from '../../../../infra/docker/seed';
  19: import { SYSTEM_ROLE_IDS, RbacService } from './rbac.service';
  20: import { PLATFORM_PERMISSIONS } from './rbac.constants';
  21: import { RoleEnum } from '@prisma/client';
  22: 
  23: /**
  24:  * FEAT-RBAC-01 — Supertest HTTP Integration Test Suite
  25:  * Covers AC-RBAC-01-01 through AC-RBAC-01-16 against live NestJS HTTP endpoints and PostgreSQL DB.
  26:  */
  27: const OWNER_ID = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1';
  28: const OPS_ID = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2';
  29: const DELEGATED_ADMIN_ID = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3';
  30: const ASSIGNED_USER_ID = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a4';
  31: const OTHER_TENANT_OWNER_ID = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1';
  32: const OTHER_MERCHANT_ID = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000f2';
  33: 
  34: async function main() {
  35:   const databaseUrl =
  36:     process.env.DATABASE_URL ||
  37:     'postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5433/shipde_dev?schema=public';
  38:   process.env.DATABASE_URL = databaseUrl;
  39: 
  40:   const testConfig = createValidTestConfig({
  41:     DATABASE_URL: databaseUrl,
  42:     PORT: 3098,
  43:     WORKER_HEALTH_PORT: 3099,
  44:     CARRIER_MODE: 'disabled',
  45:     AUTH_LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED: false,
  46:     TRUST_PROXY_HOPS: 1,
  47:   });
  48: 
  49:   const moduleFixture: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
  50:     .overrideProvider(APP_CONFIG)
  51:     .useValue(testConfig)
  52:     .overrideProvider(VERIFICATION_ADAPTER)
  53:     .useValue(new MockVerificationDeliveryAdapter())
  54:     .compile();
  55: 
  56:   const app = moduleFixture.createNestApplication();
  57:   await app.init();
  58:   const server = app.getHttpServer();
  59:   const prisma = (app.get(RbacService) as any).prisma || app.get(PrismaService);
  60: 
  61:   if ((await prisma.checkReadiness()) !== 'up') {
  62:     await app.close();
  63:     throw new Error(
  64:       `Database must be reachable at ${databaseUrl} for RBAC Supertest HTTP suite; failing closed.`
  65:     );
  66:   }
  67: 
  68:   // Ensure seed data exists
  69:   await seedDatabase();
  70: 
  71:   // Deploy real migrations against the test database (Finding 3 / Round 12)
  72:   execSync('npx prisma migrate deploy', {
  73:     env: { ...process.env, DATABASE_URL: databaseUrl },
  74:     cwd: path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../'),
  75:     stdio: 'pipe',
  76:   });
  77: 
  78:   // Reconcile platform seed once migrations are deployed
  79:   await app.get(RbacService).ensurePlatformSeed();
  80: 
  81:   // Create additional tenant for cross-tenant testing (AC-11)
  82:   await prisma.merchant.upsert({
  83:     where: { id: OTHER_MERCHANT_ID },
  84:     update: {},
  85:     create: {
  86:       id: OTHER_MERCHANT_ID,
  87:       name: 'Other Tenant Store Supertest',
  88:       code: 'TENANT_SUPERTEST_OTHER',
  89:       status: 'active',
  90:     },
  91:   });
  92: 
  93:   // Setup fixture users
  94:   for (const [id, mId, email, role] of [
  95:     [OWNER_ID, SEED_MERCHANT_ID, 'owner-rbac@shipde.vn', RoleEnum.OWNER],
  96:     [OPS_ID, SEED_MERCHANT_ID, 'ops-rbac@shipde.vn', RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH],
  97:     [DELEGATED_ADMIN_ID, SEED_MERCHANT_ID, 'delegated-admin-rbac@shipde.vn', RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH],
  98:     [ASSIGNED_USER_ID, SEED_MERCHANT_ID, 'assigned-user-rbac@shipde.vn', RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH],
  99:     [OTHER_TENANT_OWNER_ID, OTHER_MERCHANT_ID, 'other-owner@shipde.vn', RoleEnum.OWNER],
 100:   ] as const) {
 101:     await prisma.user.upsert({
 102:       where: { id },
 103:       update: {
 104:         merchant_id: mId,
 105:         full_name: 'RBAC Fixture User',
 106:         password_hash: 'x',
 107:         status: 'active',
 108:         role,
 109:         custom_role_id: null,
 110:       },
 111:       create: {
 112:         id,
 113:         merchant_id: mId,
 114:         email,
 115:         full_name: 'RBAC Fixture User',
 116:         password_hash: 'x',
 117:         status: 'active',
 118:         role,
 119:         custom_role_id: null,
 120:       },
 121:     });
 122:   }
 123: 
 124:   // Helper to create active device session & bearer token
 125:   const createSession = async (
 126:     userId: string,
 127:     merchantId: string,
 128:     authAssurance: 'PASSWORD' | 'MFA' = 'PASSWORD',
 129:     mfaVerifiedAt: Date | null = null,
 130:     role?: RoleEnum
 131:   ): Promise<string> => {
 132:     let effectiveRole = role;
 133:     if (!effectiveRole) {
 134:       const u = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId }, select: { role: true } });
 135:       effectiveRole = u?.role ?? RoleEnum.OWNER;
 136:     }
 137:     const sid = randomUUID();
 138:     const secret = resolveAccessTokenSecret(process.env.AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET);
 139:     const { token } = signAccessToken(
 140:       {
 141:         sub: userId,
 142:         sid,
 143:         mid: merchantId,
 144:         role: effectiveRole,
 145:         st: 'ACTIVE',
 146:         auth_assurance: authAssurance,
 147:         mfa_verified_at: mfaVerifiedAt ? mfaVerifiedAt.toISOString() : undefined,
 148:       },
 149:       secret,
 150:       43200
 151:     );
 152:     const hash = createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
 153:     await prisma.deviceSession.upsert({
 154:       where: { session_token_hash: hash },
 155:       update: {
 156:         status: 'ACTIVE',
 157:         auth_assurance: authAssurance,
 158:         mfa_verified_at: mfaVerifiedAt,
 159:         last_active_at: new Date(),
 160:         expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
 161:       },
 162:       create: {
 163:         id: sid,
 164:         user_id: userId,
 165:         merchant_id: merchantId,
 166:         session_token_hash: hash,
 167:         device_id: 'test_supertest_device',
 168:         device_model: 'Supertest',
 169:         user_agent: 'Supertest',
 170:         ip_address: '127.0.0.1',
 171:         status: 'ACTIVE',
 172:         auth_assurance: authAssurance,
 173:         mfa_verified_at: mfaVerifiedAt,
 174:         last_active_at: new Date(),
 175:         expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
 176:       },
 177:     });
 178:     return token;
 179:   };
 180: 
 181:   const ownerToken = await createSession(
 182:     OWNER_ID,
 183:     SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
 184:     'PASSWORD',
 185:     null,
 186:     RoleEnum.OWNER
 187:   );
 188:   const ownerMfaToken = await createSession(
 189:     OWNER_ID,
 190:     SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
 191:     'MFA',
 192:     new Date(),
 193:     RoleEnum.OWNER
 194:   );
 195:   const opsToken = await createSession(
 196:     OPS_ID,
 197:     SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
 198:     'PASSWORD',
 199:     null,
 200:     RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH
 201:   );
 202:   const otherOwnerToken = await createSession(
 203:     OTHER_TENANT_OWNER_ID,
 204:     OTHER_MERCHANT_ID,
 205:     'PASSWORD',
 206:     null,
 207:     RoleEnum.OWNER
 208:   );
 209: 
 210:   // Cleanup previous test roles if any
 211:   await prisma.role.deleteMany({
 212:     where: {
 213:       merchant_id: SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
 214:       name: {
 215:         in: [
 216:           'Supertest Custom Role',
 217:           'Supertest Custom Role Updated',
 218:           'Delegated Manager Role',
 219:           'Escalation Attempt Role',
 220:           'Audit Rollback Test Role',
 221:           'Cross Tenant Custom Role',
 222:         ],
 223:       },
 224:     },
 225:   });
 226: 
 227:   console.log('--- Running RBAC Supertest End-to-End HTTP tests ---');
 228: 
 229:   // =========================================================================
 230:   // AC-RBAC-01-01: List permissions returns all canonical permissions across categories
 231:   // =========================================================================
 232:   const permRes = await request(server)
 233:     .get('/api/v1/permissions')
 234:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)
 235:     .expect(200);
 236:   assert.strictEqual(permRes.body.data.permissions.length, PLATFORM_PERMISSIONS.length);
 237:   assert.deepStrictEqual(
 238:     permRes.body.data.permissions.map((permission: { code: string }) => permission.code).sort(),
 239:     PLATFORM_PERMISSIONS.map((permission) => permission.code).sort()
 240:   );
 241:   assert.ok(permRes.body.data.categories.length >= 6);
 242: 
 243:   // =========================================================================
 244:   // AC-RBAC-01-02: List roles returns system roles plus tenant custom roles, and strictly isolates other merchant custom roles (Finding 4 / Round 10)
 245:   // =========================================================================
 246:   const ac02Suffix = randomBytes(4).toString('hex');
 247:   const ac02OtherRole = await prisma.role.create({
 248:     data: {
 249:       merchant_id: OTHER_MERCHANT_ID,
 250:       name: `Other Merchant Role ${ac02Suffix}`,
 251:       name_lower: `other merchant role ${ac02Suffix}`,
 252:       description: 'Cross merchant role to verify exclusion',
 253:       is_system: false,
 254:     },
 255:   });
 256:   const ac02OwnRole = await prisma.role.create({
 257:     data: {
 258:       merchant_id: SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
 259:       name: `Own Merchant Role ${ac02Suffix}`,
 260:       name_lower: `own merchant role ${ac02Suffix}`,
 261:       description: 'Own merchant custom role',
 262:       is_system: false,
 263:     },
 264:   });
 265: 
 266:   const rolesRes = await request(server)
 267:     .get('/api/v1/roles')
 268:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)
 269:     .expect(200);
 270: 
 271:   const returnedRoles = rolesRes.body.data.roles;
 272:   assert.ok(returnedRoles.length >= 6);
 273:   assert.ok(
 274:     returnedRoles.some((r: any) => r.id === ac02OwnRole.id),
 275:     'Own merchant custom role must be present in GET /roles'
 276:   );
 277:   assert.ok(
 278:     !returnedRoles.some((r: any) => r.id === ac02OtherRole.id),
 279:     'Other merchant custom role must be strictly absent from GET /roles'
 280:   );
 281:   for (const r of returnedRoles) {
 282:     if (!r.is_system) {
 283:       assert.strictEqual(
 284:         r.merchant_id,
 285:         SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
 286:         'Custom role returned must belong exclusively to actor merchant'
 287:       );
 288:     }
 289:   }

 291:   // =========================================================================
 292:   // AC-RBAC-01-03: Create custom role persists role, permissions, and audit log
 293:   // =========================================================================
 294:   const testCorrelationId = 'test-corr-create-role-123';
 295:   const createRes = await request(server)
 296:     .post('/api/v1/roles')
 297:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)
 298:     .set('x-correlation-id', testCorrelationId)
 299:     .send({
 300:       name: 'Supertest Custom Role',
 301:       description: 'Role created via Supertest',
 302:       permissions: ['order:view_create', 'shipment:quote_carrier'],
 303:     })
 304:     .expect(201);
 305:   const createdRoleId = createRes.body.data.role.id;
 306:   assert.strictEqual(createRes.body.data.role.is_system, false);
 307:   assert.strictEqual(createRes.body.data.role.name, 'Supertest Custom Role');
 308: 
 309:   // DB and Audit assertion for AC-03
 310:   const dbRole = await prisma.role.findUnique({
 311:     where: { id: createdRoleId },
 312:     include: { permissions: { include: { permission: true } } },
 313:   });
 314:   assert.ok(dbRole, 'Role must be persisted in DB');
 315:   assert.strictEqual(dbRole?.permissions.length, 2);
 316:   const createdPermCodes = dbRole?.permissions.map((p) => p.permission.code).sort();
 317:   assert.deepStrictEqual(createdPermCodes, ['order:view_create', 'shipment:quote_carrier']);
 318: 
 319:   const createAudit = await prisma.auditLog.findFirst({
 320:     where: {
 321:       action: 'ROLE_CREATED',
 322:       entity_id: createdRoleId,
 323:       entity_type: 'Role',
 324:     },

 326:   });
 327:   assert.ok(createAudit, 'Audit log for ROLE_CREATED must exist');
 328:   assert.strictEqual(createAudit?.user_id, OWNER_ID);
 329:   assert.strictEqual(createAudit?.merchant_id, SEED_MERCHANT_ID);
 330:   assert.strictEqual((createAudit?.new_value as any)?.correlation_id, testCorrelationId);
 331: 
 332:   // =========================================================================
 333:   // AC-RBAC-01-04: Duplicate role name returns 400 ROLE_NAME_EXISTS
 334:   // =========================================================================
 335:   const dupRes = await request(server)
 336:     .post('/api/v1/roles')
 337:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)
 338:     .send({
 339:       name: 'Supertest Custom Role',
 340:       permissions: ['order:view_create'],
 341:     })
 342:     .expect(400);
 343:   assert.strictEqual(dupRes.body.error.code, 'ROLE_NAME_EXISTS');
 344: 
 345:   // Case-insensitive duplicate check
 346:   const dupCaseRes = await request(server)
 347:     .post('/api/v1/roles')
 348:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)
 349:     .send({
 350:       name: 'supertest custom role',
 351:       permissions: ['order:view_create'],
 352:     })
 353:     .expect(400);
 354:   assert.strictEqual(dupCaseRes.body.error.code, 'ROLE_NAME_EXISTS');
 355: 
 356:   // DB Proof for Finding 7: Database unique constraint roles_merchant_id_name_lower_key rejects duplicate name_lower
 357:   let dbUniqueViolationCaught = false;
 358:   try {
 359:     await prisma.role.create({
 360:       data: {
 361:         name: 'SUPERTEST CUSTOM ROLE',
 362:         name_lower: 'supertest custom role',
 363:         merchant_id: SEED_MERCHANT_ID,
 364:         is_system: false,
 365:       },
 366:     });
 367:   } catch (err: any) {
 368:     if (err?.code === 'P2002' || /unique/i.test(err?.message || '')) {
 369:       dbUniqueViolationCaught = true;
 370:     }
 371:   }
 372:   assert.strictEqual(
 373:     dbUniqueViolationCaught,

 375:     'Database unique constraint roles_merchant_id_name_lower_key must reject case-insensitive duplicate in DB'
 376:   );

 378:   // =========================================================================
 379:   // Finding 1 (Round 11): Step-up MFA assurance: PASSWORD session cannot create or patch sensitive grants
 380:   // =========================================================================
 381:   const pwdCreateRes = await request(server)
 382:     .post('/api/v1/roles')
 383:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)

 391:   // MFA session succeeds creating sensitive grant

 393:   const mfaCreateRes = await request(server)

 404:   const pwdPatchRes = await request(server)

 417:   // =========================================================================
 418:   // AC-RBAC-01-05: Non-owner actor attempts to create role with permissions beyond ceiling -> 403 PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED
 419:   // =========================================================================
 420:   const delegRole = await prisma.role.create({
 421:     data: {
 422:       name: 'Delegated Manager Role',

 429:   await prisma.rolePermission.createMany({

 441:   const escalRes = await request(server)
 442:     .post('/api/v1/roles')
 443:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${delegatedToken}`)

 445:       name: 'Escalation Attempt Role',

 447:     })
 448:     .expect(403);
 449:   assert.strictEqual(escalRes.body.error.code, 'PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED');

 451:   // DB Proof for AC-05: No row created in DB
 452:   const escDb = await prisma.role.findFirst({ where: { name: 'Escalation Attempt Role' } });
 453:   assert.strictEqual(escDb, null, 'Escalation attempt role must not exist in DB');
 454: 
 455:   // =========================================================================
 456:   // AC-RBAC-01-06: System role cannot be modified (403 SYSTEM_ROLE_IMMUTABLE)
 457:   // =========================================================================
 458:   const patchSysRes = await request(server)

 460:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)

 465:   // DB Proof for AC-06: System role remains unchanged
 466:   const sysRoleAfter = await prisma.role.findUnique({ where: { id: SYSTEM_ROLE_IDS.OWNER } });
 467:   assert.strictEqual(

 473:   // =========================================================================
 474:   // AC-RBAC-01-07: System role cannot be deleted (403 SYSTEM_ROLE_IMMUTABLE)
 475:   // =========================================================================

 477:     .delete(`/api/v1/roles/${SYSTEM_ROLE_IDS.OWNER}`)
 478:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)

 482:   // DB Proof for AC-07: System role preserved in DB
 483:   const sysRoleStillExists = await prisma.role.findUnique({ where: { id: SYSTEM_ROLE_IDS.OWNER } });
 484:   assert.ok(sysRoleStillExists, 'System role must still exist in DB');

 486:   // =========================================================================

 488:   // =========================================================================
 489:   const updateCorrelationId = 'test-corr-update-role-456';
 490:   const patchRes = await request(server)
 491:     .patch(`/api/v1/roles/${createdRoleId}`)
 492:     .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${ownerToken}`)

 501:   // DB and Audit assertion for AC-08
 502:   const updatedDbRole = await prisma.role.findUnique({
 503:     where: { id: createdRoleId },

 506:   assert.strictEqual(updatedDbRole?.name, 'Supertest Custom Role Updated');

 510:   const updateAudit = await prisma.auditLog.findFirst({

 755:   const origTransaction = prisma.$transaction.bind(prisma);

 48:       normalizeCorrelationId()

 52:   /**

 56:   @Get()

 88:     const correlationId = (req as any).correlationId || normalizeCorrelationId();

 96: 
 97:     return this.usersService.updateUserScopes(

 99:       merchantId,

111:   @Post('check-scope')

122:    * GET /api/v1/users/:id (and /users/:id)

   1: import { Injectable, Inject, Optional, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
   2: import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';

   9: import { CanonicalApiException } from '../auth/auth.service';
  10: import { RoleEnum } from '@prisma/client';
  11: import { isActiveStatus } from '@shipde/contracts';
  12: import {
  13:   ListUsersQueryDto,
  14:   UpdateUserDto,

  16:   ActivateUserDto,
  17:   DeactivateUserDto,

  19:

  32: export interface UpdateUserScopesDto {
  33:   store_scopes?: string[];
  34:   warehouse_scopes?: string[];
  35:   carrier_account_scopes?: string[];
  36: }
  37: 
  38: export const FORBIDDEN_CHARACTERS_REGEX = /[<>\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/;
  39: 
  40: /**
  41:  * Validates array bounds, element types, and rejects control characters/HTML tags.
  42:  */
  43: export function validateScopeArray(
  44:   scopes: any,
  45:   fieldName: 'store_scopes' | 'warehouse_scopes' | 'carrier_account_scopes',
  46:   maxCount = 50,
  47:   maxLength = 64
  48: ): void {
  49:   if (scopes === undefined || scopes === null) return;
  50:   if (!Array.isArray(scopes)) {
  51:     throw new CanonicalApiException(
  52:       HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
  53:       'VALIDATION_ERROR',
  54:       `${fieldName} phải là một mảng chuỗi`,
  55:       false,
  56:       undefined,
  57:       [{ field: fieldName, code: 'INVALID_TYPE', message: `${fieldName} phải là một mảng chuỗi` }]
  58:     );
  59:   }
  60:   if (scopes.length > maxCount) {
  61:     throw new CanonicalApiException(
  62:       HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
  63:       'VALIDATION_ERROR',
  64:       `Số lượng phần tử trong ${fieldName} không được vượt quá ${maxCount}`,
  65:       false,
  66:       undefined,
  67:       [{ field: fieldName, code: 'ARRAY_TOO_LONG', message: `Tối đa ${maxCount} phần tử` }]
  68:     );
  69:   }
  70:   for (let i = 0; i < scopes.length; i++) {
  71:     const item = scopes[i];
  72:     if (typeof item !== 'string') {
  73:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
  74:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
  75:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
  76:         `Phần tử thứ ${i + 1} trong ${fieldName} phải là chuỗi ký tự`,
  77:         false,
  78:         undefined,
  79:         [{ field: `${fieldName}[${i}]`, code: 'INVALID_TYPE', message: 'Phải là chuỗi ký tự' }]
  80:       );
  81:     }
  82:     const trimmed = item.trim();
  83:     if (trimmed.length === 0) {
  84:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
  85:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
  86:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
  87:         `Phần tử trong ${fieldName} không được để trống`,
  88:         false,
  89:         undefined,
  90:         [{ field: `${fieldName}[${i}]`, code: 'EMPTY_STRING', message: 'Không được để trống' }]
  91:       );
  92:     }
  93:     if (trimmed.length > maxLength) {
  94:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
  95:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
  96:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
  97:         `Phần tử trong ${fieldName} không được vượt quá ${maxLength} ký tự`,
  98:         false,
  99:         undefined,
 100:         [
 101:           {
 102:             field: `${fieldName}[${i}]`,
 103:             code: 'STRING_TOO_LONG',
 104:             message: `Tối đa ${maxLength} ký tự`,
 105:           },
 106:         ]
 107:       );
 108:     }
 109:     if (
 110:       FORBIDDEN_CHARACTERS_REGEX.test(item) ||
 111:       (trimmed !== '*' && !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+$/.test(trimmed)) ||
 112:       item !== trimmed
 113:     ) {
 114:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 115:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 116:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 117:         `Phần tử trong ${fieldName} chứa ký tự không hợp lệ`,
 118:         false,
 119:         undefined,
 120:         [
 121:           {
 122:             field: `${fieldName}[${i}]`,
 123:             code: 'INVALID_CHARACTERS',
 124:             message: 'Chứa ký tự không hợp lệ',
 125:           },
 126:         ]
 127:       );
 128:     }
 129:   }
 130: }

 132: /**
 133:  * Enforces scope privilege ceiling: an actor cannot grant scopes they do not possess.
 134:  */
 135: export function enforceScopePrivilegeCeiling(
 136:   dto: UpdateUserScopesDto,
 137:   actor: {
 138:     role?: string;
 139:     store_scopes: string[];
 140:     warehouse_scopes: string[];
 141:     carrier_account_scopes: string[];
 142:   }
 143: ): void {
 144:   // Owner has universal privilege ceiling
 145:   if (actor.role === RoleEnum.OWNER || actor.role === 'OWNER') {
 146:     return;
 147:   }
 148: 
 149:   // 1. Branch / store scopes
 150:   if (dto.store_scopes !== undefined) {
 151:     const actorStores = new Set(actor.store_scopes || []);
 152:     const actorHasWildcard = actorStores.has('*');
 153:     if (!actorHasWildcard) {
 154:       if (dto.store_scopes.includes('*')) {
 155:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 156:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 157:           'PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED',
 158:           'Bạn không có quyền toàn bộ chi nhánh để cấp quyền wildcard (*)',
 159:           false
 160:         );
 161:       }
 162:       for (const store of dto.store_scopes) {
 163:         if (!actorStores.has(store)) {
 164:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 165:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 166:             'PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED',
 167:             `Bạn không thể cấp quyền truy cập chi nhánh [${store}] vì không thuộc phạm vi của bạn`,
 168:             false
 169:           );
 170:         }
 171:       }
 172:     }
 173:   }
 174: 
 175:   // 2. Warehouse scopes
 176:   if (dto.warehouse_scopes !== undefined) {
 177:     const actorWarehouses = new Set(actor.warehouse_scopes || []);
 178:     const actorHasWildcard = actorWarehouses.has('*');
 179:     if (!actorHasWildcard) {
 180:       if (dto.warehouse_scopes.includes('*')) {
 181:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 182:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 183:           'PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED',
 184:           'Bạn không có quyền toàn bộ kho hàng để cấp quyền wildcard (*)',
 185:           false
 186:         );
 187:       }
 188:       for (const wh of dto.warehouse_scopes) {
 189:         if (!actorWarehouses.has(wh)) {
 190:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 191:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 192:             'PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED',
 193:             `Bạn không thể cấp quyền truy cập kho hàng [${wh}] vì không thuộc phạm vi của bạn`,
 194:             false
 195:           );
 196:         }
 197:       }
 198:     }
 199:   }
 200: 
 201:   // 3. Carrier account scopes
 202:   if (dto.carrier_account_scopes !== undefined) {
 203:     const actorCarrierAccounts = new Set(actor.carrier_account_scopes || []);
 204:     const actorHasWildcard = actorCarrierAccounts.has('*');
 205:     if (!actorHasWildcard) {
 206:       if (dto.carrier_account_scopes.includes('*')) {
 207:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 208:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 209:           'PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED',
 210:           'Bạn không có quyền toàn bộ tài khoản vận chuyển để cấp quyền wildcard (*)',
 211:           false
 212:         );
 213:       }
 214:       for (const ca of dto.carrier_account_scopes) {
 215:         if (!actorCarrierAccounts.has(ca)) {
 216:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 217:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 218:             'PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_DENIED',
 219:             `Bạn không thể cấp quyền truy cập tài khoản vận chuyển [${ca}] vì không thuộc phạm vi của bạn`,
 220:             false
 221:           );
 222:         }
 223:       }
 224:     }
 225:   }
 226: }

 228: @Injectable()
 229: @Injectable()
 230: export class UsersService {
 231:   constructor(
 232:     @Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
 233:     @Inject(SessionService) private readonly sessionService: SessionService,
 234:     @Optional() @Inject(RbacService) private readonly rbacService?: RbacService
 235:   ) {}
 236: 
 237:   public async checkActorManageUsersPermission(actor: {
 238:     userId: string;
 239:     merchantId: string;
 240:     role?: string;
 241:   }): Promise<void> {
 242:     if (actor.role === RoleEnum.OWNER || actor.role === 'OWNER') {
 243:       return;
 244:     }
 245: 
 246:     const dbActor = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
 247:       where: { id: actor.userId, merchant_id: actor.merchantId },
 248:     });
 249:     if (!dbActor) {
 250:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 251:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 252:         'FORBIDDEN',
 253:         'Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc cửa hàng này',
 254:         false
 255:       );
 256:     }
 257:     if (dbActor.role === RoleEnum.OWNER) {
 258:       return;
 259:     }
 260: 
 261:     if (this.rbacService) {
 262:       const actorContext = await this.rbacService.resolveActorFromSession({
 263:         userId: actor.userId,
 264:         merchantId: actor.merchantId,
 265:         userRole: dbActor.role,
 266:         customRoleId: dbActor.custom_role_id || undefined,
 267:       });
 268:       const hasPermission = await this.rbacService.actorHasPermissions(actorContext, [
 269:         'iam:manage_users',
 270:       ]);
 271:       if (hasPermission) {
 272:         return;
 273:       }
 274:     }
 275: 
 276:     throw new CanonicalApiException(
 277:       HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 278:       'FORBIDDEN',
 279:       'Bạn không có quyền quản lý người dùng và vai trò',
 280:       false,
 281:       'Vui lòng liên hệ Chủ Shop để được cấp quyền'
 282:     );
 283:   }
 284: 
 285:   /**
 286:    * GET /api/v1/users — List merchant users with pagination and filters (AC-USR-02-01).
 287:    * Strictly scopes by caller merchant_id; passwords and tokens are never returned.
 288:    */
 289: 
 290:   /**
 291:    * Validate that all non-wildcard carrier account IDs exist and belong to the tenant.
 292:    */
 293:   async validateCarrierAccountScopes(
 294:     carrierAccountScopes: string[] | undefined,
 295:     merchantId: string,
 296:     txClient?: any
 297:   ): Promise<void> {
 298:     if (!carrierAccountScopes || carrierAccountScopes.length === 0) return;
 299:     const concreteIds = carrierAccountScopes.filter((id) => id !== '*');
 300:     if (concreteIds.length === 0) return;
 301: 
 302:     const client = txClient || this.prisma;
 303:     const existingAccounts = await client.carrierAccount.findMany({
 304:       where: {
 305:         merchant_id: merchantId,
 306:         id: { in: concreteIds },
 307:       },
 308:       select: { id: true },
 309:     });
 310: 
 311:     const existingSet = new Set(existingAccounts.map((a: { id: string }) => a.id));
 312:     const invalidIds = concreteIds.filter((id) => !existingSet.has(id));
 313:     if (invalidIds.length > 0) {
 314:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 315:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 316:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 317:         `Tài khoản vận chuyển không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc cửa hàng này: ${invalidIds.join(', ')}`,
 318:         false,
 319:         undefined,
 320:         [
 321:           {
 322:             field: 'carrier_account_scopes',
 323:             code: 'INVALID_CARRIER_ACCOUNT',
 324:             message: `Tài khoản ${invalidIds[0]} không hợp lệ`,
 325:           },
 326:         ]
 327:       );
 328:     }
 329:   }
 330: 
 331:   /**
 332:    * GET /api/v1/users — List merchant users with pagination and filters (AC-USR-02-01, FEAT-RBAC-02).
 333:    * Strictly scopes by caller merchant_id; passwords and tokens are never returned.
 334:    */
 335:   async listUsers(
 336:     merchantId: string,
 337:     queryOrCorrelationId?: ListUsersQueryDto | string,
 338:     maybeCorrelationId?: string
 339:   ) {
 340:     const isQuery = typeof queryOrCorrelationId === 'object' && queryOrCorrelationId !== null;
 341:     const query: ListUsersQueryDto = isQuery ? queryOrCorrelationId : {};
 342:     const correlationId = isQuery
 343:       ? maybeCorrelationId || ''
 344:       : typeof queryOrCorrelationId === 'string'
 345:         ? queryOrCorrelationId
 346:         : '';
 347: 
 348:     const page = Math.max(1, Number(query.page) || 1);
 349:     const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Number(query.limit) || 20));
 350:     const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
 351: 
 352:     const where: any = {
 353:       merchant_id: merchantId,
 354:     };
 355: 
 356:     if (query.role) {
 357:       where.role = query.role as RoleEnum;
 358:     }
 359: 
 360:     if (query.status) {
 361:       where.status = {
 362:         equals: query.status.trim(),
 363:         mode: 'insensitive',
 364:       };
 365:     }
 366: 
 367:     if (query.search && query.search.trim().length > 0) {
 368:       const search = query.search.trim();
 369:       where.OR = [
 370:         { full_name: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
 371:         { email: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
 372:         { phone: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
 373:       ];
 374:     }
 375: 
 376:     const [total, users] = await Promise.all([
 377:       this.prisma.user.count({ where }),
 378:       this.prisma.user.findMany({
 379:         where,
 380:         skip,
 381:         take: limit,
 382:         orderBy: { created_at: 'desc' },
 383:         select: {
 384:           id: true,
 385:           full_name: true,
 386:           email: true,
 387:           phone: true,
 388:           role: true,
 389:           custom_role_id: true,
 390:           status: true,
 391:           store_scopes: true,
 392:           warehouse_scopes: true,
 393:           carrier_account_scopes: true,
 394:           created_at: true,
 395:           device_sessions: {
 396:             take: 1,
 397:             orderBy: { last_active_at: 'desc' },
 398:             select: { last_active_at: true },
 399:           },
 400:         },
 401:       }),
 402:     ]);
 403: 
 404:     const customRoleIds = Array.from(
 405:       new Set(users.map((u) => u.custom_role_id).filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id)))
 406:     );
 407: 
 408:     const customRolesMap = new Map();
 409:     if (
 410:       customRoleIds.length > 0 &&
 411:       this.prisma.role &&
 412:       typeof this.prisma.role.findMany === 'function'
 413:     ) {
 414:       const roles = await this.prisma.role.findMany({
 415:         where: { id: { in: customRoleIds } },
 416:         select: { id: true, name: true },
 417:       });
 418:       for (const r of roles) {
 419:         customRolesMap.set(r.id, r.name);
 420:       }
 421:     }
 422: 
 423:     const formattedUsers = users.map((u) => ({
 424:       id: u.id,
 425:       full_name: u.full_name,
 426:       email: u.email,
 427:       phone: u.phone,
 428:       role: u.role,
 429:       custom_role_id: u.custom_role_id,
 430:       custom_role: u.custom_role_id
 431:         ? {
 432:             id: u.custom_role_id,
 433:             name: customRolesMap.get(u.custom_role_id) || 'Tùy chỉnh',
 434:           }
 435:         : null,
 436:       status: (u.status || 'ACTIVE').toUpperCase(),
 437:       store_scopes: u.store_scopes || [],
 438:       warehouse_scopes: u.warehouse_scopes || [],
 439:       carrier_account_scopes: u.carrier_account_scopes || [],
 440:       created_at: u.created_at.toISOString(),
 441:       last_active_at: u.device_sessions?.[0]?.last_active_at?.toISOString() || null,
 442:     }));
 443: 
 444:     return {
 445:       data: formattedUsers,
 446:       meta: {
 447:         page,
 448:         limit,
 449:         total,
 450:         total_pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) || 1,
 451:         correlation_id: correlationId,
 452:       },
 453:     };
 454:   }

 471:         role: true,

 473:         status: true,

 575:   /**
 576:    * PATCH /api/v1/users/:id — Update user profile and scopes (AC-USR-02-03, AC-USR-02-14).
 577:    */
 578:   async updateUser(
 579:     targetUserId: string,
 580:     dto: UpdateUserDto,
 581:     actor: { userId: string; merchantId: string; role?: string },
 582:     clientIp: string,
 583:     correlationId: string
 584:   ) {
 585:     await this.checkActorManageUsersPermission(actor);
 586: 
 587:     const targetUser = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
 588:       where: {
 589:         id: targetUserId,
 590:         merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 591:       },
 592:     });
 593: 
 594:     if (!targetUser) {
 595:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 596:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 597:         'FORBIDDEN',
 598:         'Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc cửa hàng này',
 599:         false
 600:       );
 601:     }
 602: 
 603:     const actorUser = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
 604:       where: { id: actor.userId, merchant_id: actor.merchantId },
 605:     });
 606:     const isActorOwner = String(actorUser?.role) === 'OWNER';
 607: 
 608:     if (String(targetUser.role) === 'OWNER' && !isActorOwner) {
 609:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 610:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 611:         'FORBIDDEN',
 612:         'Vượt quá hạn mức phân quyền: Bạn không có quyền sửa đổi thông tin của Chủ cửa hàng',
 613:         false
 614:       );
 615:     }
 616: 
 617:     const dataToUpdate: any = {};
 618: 
 619:     if (dto.full_name !== undefined) {
 620:       if (
 621:         typeof dto.full_name !== 'string' ||
 622:         dto.full_name.trim().length === 0 ||
 623:         dto.full_name.length > 255
 624:       ) {
 625:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 626:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 627:           'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 628:           'Họ và tên người dùng không hợp lệ',
 629:           false,
 630:           'Vui lòng nhập họ và tên từ 1 đến 255 ký tự',
 631:           [{ field: 'full_name', code: 'INVALID', message: 'Họ và tên không được để trống' }]
 632:         );
 633:       }
 634:       dataToUpdate.full_name = dto.full_name.trim();
 635:     }
 636: 
 637:     if (dto.role !== undefined) {
 638:       const validRoles = Object.values(RoleEnum);
 639:       if (!validRoles.includes(dto.role as RoleEnum)) {
 640:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
 641:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 642:           'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 643:           'Vai trò không hợp lệ',
 644:           false,
 645:           `Vai trò phải thuộc danh sách: ${validRoles.join(', ')}`,
 646:           [{ field: 'role', code: 'INVALID', message: 'Vai trò người dùng không hợp lệ' }]
 647:         );
 648:       }
 649: 
 650:       // Privilege ceiling: Non-owner cannot assign OWNER role (BR-USR-05, AC-USR-02-14)
 651:       if (!isActorOwner) {
 652:         if (String(dto.role) === 'OWNER') {
 653:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 654:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 655:             'FORBIDDEN',
 656:             'Vượt quá hạn mức phân quyền: Bạn không có quyền chỉ định vai trò Chủ cửa hàng (OWNER)',
 657:             false
 658:           );
 659:         }
 660:         if (dto.role !== actorUser?.role) {
 661:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 662:             HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 663:             'FORBIDDEN',
 664:             `Vượt quá hạn mức phân quyền: Bạn không thể phân quyền vai trò ${dto.role} vượt quá quyền hạn của mình`,
 665:             false
 666:           );
 667:         }
 668:       }
 669: 
 670:       // Last Owner Invariant (BR-USR-01): Demoting sole remaining active owner is prohibited
 671:       if (
 672:         String(targetUser.role) === 'OWNER' &&
 673:         dto.role !== RoleEnum.OWNER &&
 674:         isActiveStatus(targetUser.status)
 675:       ) {
 676:         const activeOwnersCount = await this.prisma.user.count({
 677:           where: {
 678:             merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 679:             role: RoleEnum.OWNER,
 680:             status: { in: ['active', 'ACTIVE'] },
 681:           },
 682:         });
 683:         if (activeOwnersCount <= 1) {
 684:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 685:             HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
 686:             'CANNOT_REMOVE_LAST_OWNER',
 687:             'Không thể hạ quyền chủ sở hữu duy nhất còn hoạt động của cửa hàng',
 688:             false,
 689:             'Vui lòng chỉ định một chủ sở hữu (Owner) khác trước khi thực hiện thao tác này'
 690:           );
 691:         }
 692:       }
 693: 
 694:       dataToUpdate.role = dto.role as RoleEnum;
 695:     }
 696: 
 697:     // Shared scope validation, ceiling, and carrier account ownership (BR-SCOPE-03, BR-SCOPE-06, BR-SCOPE-07)
 698:     const hasScopeUpdate =
 699:       dto.store_scopes !== undefined ||
 700:       dto.warehouse_scopes !== undefined ||
 701:       dto.carrier_account_scopes !== undefined;
 702: 
 703:     if (hasScopeUpdate) {
 704:       validateScopeArray(dto.store_scopes, 'store_scopes');
 705:       validateScopeArray(dto.warehouse_scopes, 'warehouse_scopes');
 706:       validateScopeArray(dto.carrier_account_scopes, 'carrier_account_scopes');
 707: 
 708:       enforceScopePrivilegeCeiling(
 709:         {
 710:           store_scopes: dto.store_scopes,
 711:           warehouse_scopes: dto.warehouse_scopes,
 712:           carrier_account_scopes: dto.carrier_account_scopes,
 713:         },
 714:         {
 715:           role: actorUser?.role,
 716:           store_scopes: actorUser?.store_scopes || [],
 717:           warehouse_scopes: actorUser?.warehouse_scopes || [],
 718:           carrier_account_scopes: actorUser?.carrier_account_scopes || [],
 719:         }
 720:       );
 721: 
 722:       if (dto.carrier_account_scopes !== undefined) {
 723:         await this.validateCarrierAccountScopes(dto.carrier_account_scopes, actor.merchantId);
 724:       }
 725: 
 726:       if (dto.store_scopes !== undefined) {
 727:         dataToUpdate.store_scopes = Array.from(new Set(dto.store_scopes.map((s) => s.trim())));
 728:       }
 729:       if (dto.warehouse_scopes !== undefined) {
 730:         dataToUpdate.warehouse_scopes = Array.from(
 731:           new Set(dto.warehouse_scopes.map((w) => w.trim()))
 732:         );
 733:       }
 734:       if (dto.carrier_account_scopes !== undefined) {
 735:         dataToUpdate.carrier_account_scopes = Array.from(
 736:           new Set(dto.carrier_account_scopes.map((c) => c.trim()))
 737:         );
 738:       }
 739:     }
 740: 
 741:     let updatedUser: any;
 742:     try {
 743:       updatedUser = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 744:         let lockedTargetUser: any;
 745:         try {
 746:           if (typeof tx.$queryRaw === 'function') {
 747:             const lockedRows = await tx.$queryRaw<any[]>`
 748:               SELECT id, merchant_id, full_name, email, phone, role, status, custom_role_id, store_scopes, warehouse_scopes, carrier_account_scopes
 749:               FROM users
 750:               WHERE id = ${targetUserId}::uuid AND merchant_id = ${actor.merchantId}::uuid
 751:               FOR UPDATE
 752:             `;
 753:             if (lockedRows && lockedRows.length > 0) {
 754:               lockedTargetUser = lockedRows[0];
 755:             }
 756:           } else {
 757:             lockedTargetUser = await tx.user.findFirst({
 758:               where: { id: targetUserId, merchant_id: actor.merchantId },
 759:             });
 760:           }
 761:         } catch (err: any) {
 762:           if (isDeadlockOrSerializationError(err)) {
 763:             throw createConcurrencyConflictException();
 764:           }
 765:           throw err;
 766:         }
 767: 
 768:         if (!lockedTargetUser) {
 769:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 770:             HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
 771:             'USER_NOT_FOUND',
 772:             'Không tìm thấy người dùng được chỉ định',
 773:             false
 774:           );
 775:         }
 776: 
 777:         const updated = await tx.user.update({
 778:           where: { id: targetUserId },
 779:           data: dataToUpdate,
 780:         });
 781: 
 782:         if (hasScopeUpdate) {
 783:           await tx.auditLog.create({
 784:             data: {
 785:               merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 786:               user_id: actor.userId,
 787:               action: 'USER_SCOPE_UPDATED',
 788:               entity_type: 'User',
 789:               entity_id: targetUserId,
 790:               ip_address: clientIp,
 791:               old_value: {
 792:                 store_scopes: lockedTargetUser.store_scopes || [],
 793:                 warehouse_scopes: lockedTargetUser.warehouse_scopes || [],
 794:                 carrier_account_scopes: lockedTargetUser.carrier_account_scopes || [],
 795:               },
 796:               new_value: {
 797:                 store_scopes: updated.store_scopes || [],
 798:                 warehouse_scopes: updated.warehouse_scopes || [],
 799:                 carrier_account_scopes: updated.carrier_account_scopes || [],
 800:                 correlation_id: correlationId,
 801:               },
 802:             },
 803:           });
 804:         }
 805: 
 806:         await tx.auditLog.create({
 807:           data: {
 808:             merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
 809:             user_id: actor.userId,
 810:             action: 'USER_UPDATED',
 811:             entity_type: 'User',
 812:             entity_id: targetUserId,
 813:             reason: 'Cập nhật thông tin và phân quyền người dùng',
 814:             ip_address: clientIp,
 815:             old_value: {
 816:               full_name: lockedTargetUser.full_name,
 817:               role: lockedTargetUser.role,
 818:               store_scopes: lockedTargetUser.store_scopes,
 819:               warehouse_scopes: lockedTargetUser.warehouse_scopes,
 820:               carrier_account_scopes: lockedTargetUser.carrier_account_scopes,
 821:             },
 822:             new_value: {
 823:               full_name: updated.full_name,
 824:               role: updated.role,
 825:               store_scopes: updated.store_scopes,
 826:               warehouse_scopes: updated.warehouse_scopes,
 827:               carrier_account_scopes: updated.carrier_account_scopes,
 828:               correlation_id: correlationId,
 829:             },
 830:           },
 831:         });
 832: 
 833:         return updated;
 834:       });
 835:     } catch (err: any) {
 836:       if (err instanceof CanonicalApiException) throw err;
 837:       if (isDeadlockOrSerializationError(err)) throw createConcurrencyConflictException();
 838:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 839:         HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 840:         'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
 841:         'Cập nhật người dùng thất bại do lỗi hệ thống',
 842:         false
 843:       );
 844:     }
 845: 
 846:     return {
 847:       data: {
 848:         id: updatedUser.id,
 849:         merchant_id: updatedUser.merchant_id,
 850:         full_name: updatedUser.full_name,
 851:         email: updatedUser.email,
 852:         phone: updatedUser.phone,
 853:         role: updatedUser.role,
 854:         status: (updatedUser.status || 'ACTIVE').toUpperCase(),
 855:         store_scopes: updatedUser.store_scopes || [],
 856:         warehouse_scopes: updatedUser.warehouse_scopes || [],
 857:         carrier_account_scopes: updatedUser.carrier_account_scopes || [],
 858:         created_at: updatedUser.created_at.toISOString(),
 859:         updated_at: updatedUser.updated_at.toISOString(),
 860:         last_active_at: null,
 861:       },
 862:       meta: {
 863:         correlation_id: correlationId,
 864:       },
 865:     };
 866:   }

 868:   /**
 869:    * Update scope assignments for a tenant user with transaction locking and audit trail.
 870:    */
 871:   async updateUserScopes(
 872:     targetUserId: string,
 873:     merchantId: string,
 874:     dto: UpdateUserScopesDto,
 875:     actor: {
 876:       userId: string;
 877:       merchantId: string;
 878:       role?: string;
 879:     },
 880:     correlationId: string,
 881:     clientIp: string
 882:   ) {
 883:     // 1. Array validation
 884:     validateScopeArray(dto.store_scopes, 'store_scopes');
 885:     validateScopeArray(dto.warehouse_scopes, 'warehouse_scopes');
 886:     validateScopeArray(dto.carrier_account_scopes, 'carrier_account_scopes');
 887: 
 888:     // 2. Fetch actor user scopes for privilege ceiling check
 889:     const actorUser = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
 890:       where: { id: actor.userId, merchant_id: merchantId },
 891:       select: {
 892:         id: true,
 893:         role: true,
 894:         store_scopes: true,
 895:         warehouse_scopes: true,
 896:         carrier_account_scopes: true,
 897:       },
 898:     });
 899: 
 900:     if (!actorUser) {
 901:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
 902:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
 903:         'FORBIDDEN',
 904:         'Người thực hiện không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc cửa hàng này',
 905:         false
 906:       );
 907:     }
 908: 
 909:     // 3. Enforce privilege ceiling
 910:     enforceScopePrivilegeCeiling(dto, {
 911:       role: actorUser.role,
 912:       store_scopes: actorUser.store_scopes || [],
 913:       warehouse_scopes: actorUser.warehouse_scopes || [],
 914:       carrier_account_scopes: actorUser.carrier_account_scopes || [],
 915:     });
 916: 
 917:     // 4. Validate carrier accounts belong to merchant
 918:     await this.validateCarrierAccountScopes(dto.carrier_account_scopes, merchantId);
 919: 
 920:     // 5. Atomic transaction with row locking
 921:     try {
 922:       return await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 923:         let targetUser: any;
 924:         try {
 925:           if (typeof tx.$queryRaw === 'function') {
 926:             const lockedRows = await tx.$queryRaw<any[]>`
 927:               SELECT id, merchant_id, role, custom_role_id, store_scopes, warehouse_scopes, carrier_account_scopes
 928:               FROM users
 929:               WHERE id = ${targetUserId}::uuid AND merchant_id = ${merchantId}::uuid
 930:               FOR UPDATE
 931:             `;
 932:             if (lockedRows && lockedRows.length > 0) {
 933:               targetUser = lockedRows[0];
 934:             }
 935:           } else {
 936:             targetUser = await tx.user.findFirst({
 937:               where: { id: targetUserId, merchant_id: merchantId },
 938:             });
 939:           }
 940:         } catch (err: any) {
 941:           if (isDeadlockOrSerializationError(err)) {
 942:             throw createConcurrencyConflictException();
 943:           }
 944:           throw err;
 945:         }
 946: 
 947:         if (!targetUser) {
 948:           throw new CanonicalApiException(
 949:             HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
 950:             'USER_NOT_FOUND',
 951:             'Không tìm thấy người dùng được chỉ định',
 952:             false
 953:           );
 954:         }
 955: 
 956:         const beforeScopes = {
 957:           store_scopes: targetUser.store_scopes || [],
 958:           warehouse_scopes: targetUser.warehouse_scopes || [],
 959:           carrier_account_scopes: targetUser.carrier_account_scopes || [],
 960:         };
 961: 
 962:         const newStoreScopes =
 963:           dto.store_scopes !== undefined
 964:             ? Array.from(new Set(dto.store_scopes.map((s) => s.trim())))
 965:             : beforeScopes.store_scopes;
 966:         const newWarehouseScopes =
 967:           dto.warehouse_scopes !== undefined
 968:             ? Array.from(new Set(dto.warehouse_scopes.map((w) => w.trim())))
 969:             : beforeScopes.warehouse_scopes;
 970:         const newCarrierAccountScopes =
 971:           dto.carrier_account_scopes !== undefined
 972:             ? Array.from(new Set(dto.carrier_account_scopes.map((c) => c.trim())))
 973:             : beforeScopes.carrier_account_scopes;
 974: 
 975:         const updatedUser = await tx.user.update({
 976:           where: { id: targetUserId },
 977:           data: {
 978:             store_scopes: newStoreScopes,
 979:             warehouse_scopes: newWarehouseScopes,
 980:             carrier_account_scopes: newCarrierAccountScopes,
 981:           },
 982:           select: {
 983:             id: true,
 984:             role: true,
 985:             custom_role_id: true,
 986:             store_scopes: true,
 987:             warehouse_scopes: true,
 988:             carrier_account_scopes: true,
 989:           },
 990:         });
 991: 
 992:         // Write immutable audit log
 993:         await tx.auditLog.create({
 994:           data: {
 995:             merchant_id: merchantId,
 996:             user_id: actor.userId,
 997:             action: 'USER_SCOPE_UPDATED',
 998:             entity_type: 'User',
 999:             entity_id: targetUserId,
1000:             ip_address: clientIp,
1001:             old_value: beforeScopes,
1002:             new_value: {
1003:               store_scopes: newStoreScopes,
1004:               warehouse_scopes: newWarehouseScopes,
1005:               carrier_account_scopes: newCarrierAccountScopes,
1006:               correlation_id: correlationId,
1007:             },
1008:           },
1009:         });
1010: 
1011:         return {
1012:           data: {
1013:             id: updatedUser.id,
1014:             role: updatedUser.role,
1015:             custom_role_id: updatedUser.custom_role_id,
1016:             store_scopes: updatedUser.store_scopes,
1017:             warehouse_scopes: updatedUser.warehouse_scopes,

1041:   /**
1042:    * POST /api/v1/users/:id/suspend — Suspend active user and atomically revoke device sessions (AC-USR-02-04).
1043:    */
1044:   async suspendUser(
1045:     targetUserId: string,
1046:     dto: SuspendUserDto,
1047:     actor: { userId: string; merchantId: string; role?: string },
1048:     clientIp: string,
1049:     correlationId: string
1050:   ) {
1051:     // 1. Mandatory Suspension Reason (BR-USR-07, AC-USR-02-12)
1052:     if (!dto?.reason || typeof dto.reason !== 'string' || dto.reason.trim().length === 0) {
1053:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1054:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1055:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1056:         'Lý do tạm dừng người dùng là bắt buộc',
1057:         false,
1058:         'Vui lòng nhập lý do tạm dừng hợp lệ',
1059:         [{ field: 'reason', code: 'REQUIRED', message: 'Lý do tạm dừng không được để trống' }]
1060:       );
1061:     }
1062: 
1063:     // 2. Self-Disruption Prohibition (BR-USR-02, AC-USR-02-10)
1064:     if (targetUserId === actor.userId) {
1065:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1066:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1067:         'SELF_SUSPENSION_PROHIBITED',
1068:         'Bạn không thể tự tạm dừng tài khoản của chính mình',
1069:         false,
1070:         'Vui lòng yêu cầu một quản trị viên khác thực hiện thao tác này'
1071:       );
1072:     }
1073: 
1074:     // 3. Actor Permission Check (AC-USR-02-16)
1075:     await this.checkActorManageUsersPermission(actor);
1076: 
1077:     // 4. Strict Tenant Scoping (BR-USR-06, AC-USR-02-15)
1078:     const targetUser = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
1079:       where: {
1080:         id: targetUserId,
1081:         merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
1082:       },
1083:     });
1084: 
1085:     if (!targetUser) {
1086:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1087:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1088:         'FORBIDDEN',
1089:         'Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc cửa hàng này',
1090:         false
1091:       );
1092:     }
1093: 
1094:     const actorUser = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
1095:       where: { id: actor.userId, merchant_id: actor.merchantId },
1096:     });
1097:     const isActorOwner = String(actorUser?.role) === 'OWNER';
1098: 
1099:     if (String(targetUser.role) === 'OWNER' && !isActorOwner) {
1100:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1101:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1102:         'FORBIDDEN',
1103:         'Vượt quá hạn mức phân quyền: Bạn không có quyền tạm dừng tài khoản của Chủ cửa hàng',
1104:         false
1105:       );
1106:     }
1107: 
1108:     // 5. Status Transition Safety: only ACTIVE -> SUSPENDED (BR-USR-04, AC-USR-02-13)
1109:     if (!isActiveStatus(targetUser.status)) {
1110:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1111:         HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
1112:         'INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION',
1113:         `Không thể tạm dừng người dùng có trạng thái hiện tại là ${targetUser.status.toUpperCase()}`,
1114:         false,
1115:         'Chỉ có thể tạm dừng tài khoản đang ở trạng thái ACTIVE'
1116:       );
1117:     }
1118: 
1119:     // 6. Sole Owner Protection (BR-USR-01, AC-USR-02-11)
1120:     if (String(targetUser.role) === 'OWNER') {
1121:       const activeOwnersCount = await this.prisma.user.count({
1122:         where: {
1123:           merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
1124:           role: RoleEnum.OWNER,
1125:           status: { in: ['active', 'ACTIVE'] },
1126:         },
1127:       });
1128:       if (activeOwnersCount <= 1) {
1129:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
1130:           HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1131:           'CANNOT_REMOVE_LAST_OWNER',
1132:           'Không thể tạm dừng chủ sở hữu duy nhất còn hoạt động của cửa hàng',
1133:           false,
1134:           'Vui lòng chỉ định một chủ sở hữu (Owner) khác trước khi thực hiện thao tác này'
1135:         );
1136:       }
1137:     }
1138: 
1139:     // 7. Atomic Execution in Database Transaction (BR-USR-03, BR-USR-08, AC-USR-02-04, AC-USR-02-17)
1140:     let result: any;
1141:     try {
1142:       result = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
1143:         await tx.user.update({
1144:           where: { id: targetUserId },
1145:           data: { status: 'suspended' },
1146:         });
1147: 
1148:         const revokedCount = await this.sessionService.revokeTargetUserSessions(
1149:           targetUserId,
1150:           actor.merchantId,
1151:           actor.userId,
1152:           `Admin suspended: ${dto.reason.trim()}`,
1153:           correlationId,
1154:           clientIp,
1155:           tx
1156:         );
1157: 
1158:         await tx.auditLog.create({
1159:           data: {
1160:             merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
1161:             user_id: actor.userId,
1162:             action: 'USER_SUSPENDED',
1163:             entity_type: 'User',
1164:             entity_id: targetUserId,
1165:             reason: dto.reason.trim(),
1166:             ip_address: clientIp,
1167:             old_value: { status: targetUser.status.toUpperCase() },
1168:             new_value: {
1169:               status: 'SUSPENDED',
1170:               target_user_id: targetUserId,
1171:               actor_user_id: actor.userId,
1172:               revoked_sessions_count: revokedCount,
1173:               correlation_id: correlationId,
1174:             },
1175:           },
1176:         });
1177: 
1178:         return {
1179:           id: targetUserId,
1180:           status: 'SUSPENDED',
1181:           revoked_sessions_count: revokedCount,
1182:           message: 'Đã tạm dừng người dùng thành công',
1183:         };
1184:       });
1185:     } catch (err: any) {
1186:       if (err instanceof CanonicalApiException) throw err;
1187:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1188:         HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
1189:         'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
1190:         'Thao tác tạm dừng người dùng thất bại do lỗi hệ thống',
1191:         false
1192:       );
1193:     }
1194: 
1195:     return {
1196:       data: result,
1197:       meta: {
1198:         correlation_id: correlationId,
1199:       },
1200:     };
1201:   }
