1458:   /**
1459:    * Scope authorization enforcement (AC-USR-01, AC-USR-01-17, AC-RBAC-02-09..16, BR-RBAC)
1460:    * Validates if the authenticated user has access to a specific warehouse, store, or carrier account scope.
1461:    */
1462:   async checkScopeAccess(
1463:     userId: string,
1464:     merchantId: string,
1465:     requestedScope: CheckScopeDto,
1466:     correlationId: string
1467:   ) {
1468:     const user = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
1469:       where: { id: userId, merchant_id: merchantId },
1470:     });
1471: 
1472:     if (!user) {
1473:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1474:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1475:         'FORBIDDEN',
1476:         'Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc cửa hàng này',
1477:         false
1478:       );
1479:     }
1480: 
1481:     if (!isActiveStatus(user.status)) {
1482:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1483:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1484:         'FORBIDDEN',
1485:         'Tài khoản người dùng chưa kích hoạt hoặc đã bị khóa',
1486:         false
1487:       );
1488:     }
1489: 
1490:     // Validate at least one scope target is requested
1491:     if (
1492:       !requestedScope.warehouse_id &&
1493:       !requestedScope.store_id &&
1494:       !requestedScope.carrier_account_id
1495:     ) {
1496:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1497:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1498:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1499:         'Yêu cầu phải chỉ định ít nhất store_id, warehouse_id hoặc carrier_account_id để kiểm tra phạm vi quyền hạn',
1500:         false
1501:       );
1502:     }
1503: 
1504:     const userWarehouseScopes = user.warehouse_scopes || [];
1505:     const userStoreScopes = user.store_scopes || [];
1506:     const userCarrierAccountScopes = user.carrier_account_scopes || [];
1507: 
1508:     // Owner role has full access across all stores, warehouses, and carrier accounts
1509:     if (user.role === RoleEnum.OWNER) {
1510:       return {
1511:         data: {
1512:           authorized: true,
1513:           user_id: user.id,
1514:           role: user.role,
1515:           store_scopes: userStoreScopes,
1516:           warehouse_scopes: userWarehouseScopes,
1517:           carrier_account_scopes: userCarrierAccountScopes,
1518:         },
1519:         meta: {
1520:           correlation_id: correlationId,
1521:         },
1522:       };
1523:     }
1524: 
1525:     // Warehouse scope enforcement (* or explicit membership)
1526:     if (requestedScope.warehouse_id) {
1527:       const allowed =
1528:         userWarehouseScopes.includes('*') ||
1529:         userWarehouseScopes.includes(requestedScope.warehouse_id);
1530:       if (!allowed) {
1531:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
1532:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1533:           'FORBIDDEN',
1534:           'Người dùng không có quyền truy cập kho hàng được yêu cầu',
1535:           false
1536:         );
1537:       }
1538:     }
1539: 
1540:     // Store scope enforcement (* or explicit membership)
1541:     if (requestedScope.store_id) {
1542:       const allowed =
1543:         userStoreScopes.includes('*') || userStoreScopes.includes(requestedScope.store_id);
1544:       if (!allowed) {
1545:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
1546:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1547:           'FORBIDDEN',
1548:           'Người dùng không có quyền truy cập chi nhánh cửa hàng được yêu cầu',
1549:           false
1550:         );
1551:       }
1552:     }
1553: 
1554:     // Carrier account scope enforcement (* or explicit membership)
1555:     if (requestedScope.carrier_account_id) {
1556:       const allowed =
1557:         userCarrierAccountScopes.includes('*') ||
1558:         userCarrierAccountScopes.includes(requestedScope.carrier_account_id);
1559:       if (!allowed) {
1560:         throw new CanonicalApiException(
1561:           HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1562:           'FORBIDDEN',
1563:           'Người dùng không có quyền truy cập tài khoản vận chuyển được yêu cầu',
1564:           false
1565:         );
1566:       }
1567:     }
1568: 
1569:     return {
1570:       data: {
1571:         authorized: true,
1572:         user_id: user.id,
1573:         role: user.role,
1574:         store_scopes: userStoreScopes,
1575:         warehouse_scopes: userWarehouseScopes,
1576:         carrier_account_scopes: userCarrierAccountScopes,
1577:       },
1578:       meta: {
1579:         correlation_id: correlationId,
1580:       },
1581:     };
1582:   }
1583: 
1584:   /**
1585:    * Tenant-scoped admin reset of another user's lost factor (BR-AUTH-19, AC-AUTH-05-14..15, AC-AUTH-05-21).
1586:    */
1587:   async adminResetMfa(
1588:     targetUserId: string,
1589:     dto: AdminResetMfaDto,
1590:     actor: {
1591:       userId: string;
1592:       merchantId: string;
1593:       role?: string;
1594:       authAssurance?: string;
1595:       mfaVerifiedAt?: Date | string | null;
1596:     },
1597:     idempotencyKey: string,
1598:     clientIp: string,
1599:     correlationId: string
1600:   ) {
1601:     // 1. Validate reason (BR-AUTH-19)
1602:     if (!dto.reason || dto.reason.trim().length === 0) {
1603:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1604:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1605:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1606:         'Lý do đặt lại MFA là bắt buộc',
1607:         false,
1608:         'Vui lòng nhập lý do hợp lệ'
1609:       );
1610:     }
1611: 
1612:     // 2. Prohibit self-reset (AC-AUTH-05-15)
1613:     if (actor.userId === targetUserId) {
1614:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1615:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1616:         'FORBIDDEN',
1617:         'Không thể tự đặt lại MFA cho chính mình qua tính năng quản trị',
1618:         false,
1619:         'Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên khác của cửa hàng'
1620:       );
1621:     }
1622: 
1623:     // 3. Actor authorization: must be OWNER or OPS_CSKH
1624:     const isOwner = actor.role === RoleEnum.OWNER || actor.role === 'OWNER';
1625:     const isOps = actor.role === RoleEnum.OPS_CSKH || actor.role === 'OPS_CSKH';
1626:     if (!isOwner && !isOps) {
1627:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1628:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1629:         'FORBIDDEN',
1630:         'Bạn không có quyền quản trị để đặt lại MFA cho người dùng',
1631:         false
1632:       );
1633:     }
1634: 
1635:     // 4. Actor MFA assurance: actor must have completed MFA in the current session (BR-AUTH-19)
1636:     const hasMfa = actor.authAssurance === 'MFA' || Boolean(actor.mfaVerifiedAt);
1637:     if (!hasMfa) {
1638:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1639:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1640:         'MFA_FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED',
1641:         'Thao tác quản trị nhạy cảm yêu cầu phiên làm việc đã xác thực MFA',
1642:         false,
1643:         'Vui lòng đăng nhập lại với xác thực hai yếu tố'
1644:       );
1645:     }
1646: 
1647:     // 5. Idempotency Key validation and conflict check (AC-AUTH-05-21)
1648:     if (!idempotencyKey || idempotencyKey.trim().length === 0) {
1649:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1650:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1651:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1652:         'Header Idempotency-Key là bắt buộc đối với thao tác này'
1653:       );
1654:     }
1655: 
1656:     const replay = await this.findIdempotentReplay(
1657:       actor.merchantId,
1658:       idempotencyKey.trim(),
1659:       targetUserId,
1660:       dto.reason.trim()
1661:     );
1662:     if (replay) {
1663:       return replay;
1664:     }
1665: 
1666:     // 6. Target lookup with strict tenant scoping (AC-AUTH-05-15 non-leaking FORBIDDEN)
1667:     const targetUser = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({
1668:       where: {
1669:         id: targetUserId,
1670:         merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
1671:       },
1672:     });
1673: 
1674:     if (!targetUser) {
1675:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1676:         HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
1677:         'FORBIDDEN',
1678:         'Bạn không có quyền quản trị để đặt lại MFA cho người dùng',
1679:         false
1680:       );
1681:     }
1682: 
1683:     // 7. Target must have an active or pending factor (AC-AUTH-05-15)
1684:     const targetFactors = await this.prisma.mfaFactor.findMany({
1685:       where: {
1686:         user_id: targetUserId,
1687:         status: { in: ['ACTIVE', 'PENDING'] },
1688:       },
1689:     });
1690: 
1691:     if (targetFactors.length === 0) {
1692:       throw new CanonicalApiException(
1693:         HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
1694:         'VALIDATION_ERROR',
1695:         'Người dùng không có yếu tố xác thực MFA nào đang hoạt động hoặc chờ kích hoạt'
1696:       );
1697:     }
1698: 
1699:     // 8. Atomic execution inside database transaction
1700:     const now = new Date();
1701:     const factorIds = targetFactors.map((f) => f.id);
1702: 
1703:     let response: any;
1704:     try {
1705:       response = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
1706:         // A. Invalidate/Reset factors
1707:         await tx.mfaFactor.updateMany({
1708:           where: { id: { in: factorIds } },
1709:           data: {
1710:             status: 'RESET',
1711:             reset_at: now,
1712:             updated_by: actor.userId,
1713:           },
1714:         });
1715: 
1716:         // B. Delete/Invalidate recovery codes
1717:         await tx.mfaRecoveryCode.deleteMany({
1718:           where: { factor_id: { in: factorIds } },
1719:         });
1720: 
1721:         // C. Invalidate outstanding MFA challenges
1722:         await tx.mfaChallenge.updateMany({
1723:           where: {
1724:             user_id: targetUserId,
1725:             consumed_at: null,
1726:             invalidated_at: null,
1727:           },
1728:           data: {
1729:             invalidated_at: now,
1730:           },
1731:         });
1732: 
1733:         // D. Revoke all target sessions using SessionService helper
1734:         const revokedCount = await this.sessionService.revokeTargetUserSessions(
1735:           targetUserId,
1736:           actor.merchantId,
1737:           actor.userId,
1738:           `Admin MFA Reset: ${dto.reason.trim()}`,
1739:           correlationId,
1740:           clientIp,
1741:           tx
1742:         );
1743: 
1744:         // E. Write immutable audit log
1745:         await tx.auditLog.create({
1746:           data: {
1747:             merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
1748:             user_id: actor.userId,
1749:             action: 'AUTH_MFA_ADMIN_RESET',
1750:             entity_type: 'User',
1751:             entity_id: targetUserId,
1752:             reason: dto.reason.trim(),
1753:             ip_address: clientIp,
1754:             new_value: {
1755:               target_user_id: targetUserId,
1756:               actor_user_id: actor.userId,
1757:               factors_reset_count: targetFactors.length,
1758:               revoked_sessions_count: revokedCount,
1759:               correlation_id: correlationId,
1760:             },
1761:           },
1762:         });
1763: 
1764:         const result = {
1765:           data: {
1766:             target_user_id: targetUserId,
1767:             reset: true,
1768:             revoked_sessions_count: revokedCount,
1769:             message: 'Đã đặt lại xác thực hai yếu tố cho người dùng thành công',
1770:           },
1771:           meta: {
1772:             correlation_id: correlationId,
1773:           },
1774:         };
1775: 
1776:         await tx.mfaAdminResetIdempotency.create({
1777:           data: {
1778:             merchant_id: actor.merchantId,
1779:             idempotency_key: idempotencyKey.trim(),
1780:             actor_user_id: actor.userId,
1781:             target_user_id: targetUserId,
1782:             reason: dto.reason.trim(),
1783:             response: result,
1784:           },
1785:         });
1786: 
1787:         return result;
1788:       });
1789:     } catch (err: any) {
1790:       if (err?.code === 'P2002') {
1791:         const replay = await this.findIdempotentReplay(
1792:           actor.merchantId,
1793:           idempotencyKey.trim(),
1794:           targetUserId,
1795:           dto.reason.trim()
1796:         );
1797:         if (replay) {
1798:           return replay;
1799:         }
1800:       }
1801:       throw err;
1802:     }
1803: 
1804:     return response;
1805:   }
1806: 
1807:   private async findIdempotentReplay(
1808:     merchantId: string,
1809:     idempotencyKey: string,
1810:     targetUserId: string,
1811:     reason: string
1812:   ) {
1813:     const record = await this.prisma.mfaAdminResetIdempotency.findUnique({
1814:       where: {
1815:         merchant_id_idempotency_key: { merchant_id: merchantId, idempotency_key: idempotencyKey },
1816:       },
1817:     });
1818:     if (!record) {
1819:       return null;
1820:     }
1821:     if (record.target_user_id === targetUserId && record.reason === reason) {
1822:       return record.response;
1823:     }
1824:     throw new CanonicalApiException(
1825:       HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
1826:       'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT',
1827:       'Khóa Idempotency-Key đã được sử dụng cho một yêu cầu khác'
1828:     );
1829:   }
1830: }
</file>

 104: export function isManageUsersForbidden(userRole?: string | null): boolean {
 105:   if (!userRole) return true;
 106:   return userRole !== 'OWNER' && userRole !== 'OPS_CSKH';
 107: }
 108: 
 109: export type UsersUIState = 'forbidden' | 'error' | 'loading' | 'empty' | 'ready';
 110: 
 111: export function resolveUsersUIState(params: {
 112:   isForbidden: boolean;
 113:   error: string | null;
 114:   loading: boolean;
 115:   itemCount: number;
 116: }): UsersUIState {
 117:   if (params.isForbidden) return 'forbidden';
 118:   if (params.error) return 'error';
 119:   if (params.loading) return 'loading';
 120:   if (params.itemCount === 0) return 'empty';
 121:   return 'ready';
 122: }
 123: 
 124: export function shouldDisplayUsersEmptyState(params: {
 125:   error: string | null;
 126:   loading: boolean;
 127:   itemCount: number;
 128: }): boolean {
 129:   return !params.error && !params.loading && params.itemCount === 0;
 130: }
 131: 
 132: export type InvitationsUIState = 'forbidden' | 'error' | 'loading' | 'empty' | 'ready';
 133: 
 134: export function resolveInvitationsUIState(params: {
 135:   isForbidden: boolean;
 136:   error: string | null;
 137:   loading: boolean;
 138:   itemCount: number;
 139: }): InvitationsUIState {
 140:   if (params.isForbidden) return 'forbidden';
 141:   if (params.error) return 'error';
 142:   if (params.loading) return 'loading';
 143:   if (params.itemCount === 0) return 'empty';
 144:   return 'ready';
 145: }

 147: /**
 148:  * Empty state contract helper (Round 11 Finding 3 / SCR-USR-01):
 149:  * Never show empty copy during an outage or error; empty state is only shown
 150:  * when the request succeeded with zero rows.
 151:  */
 152: export function shouldDisplayInvitationsEmptyState(params: {
 153:   error: string | null;
 154:   loading: boolean;
 155:   itemCount: number;
 156: }): boolean {
 157:   return !params.error && !params.loading && params.itemCount === 0;
 158: }

 204: /**
 205:  * Maps canonical API error response (fields/details) onto field-error-* dictionary.
 206:  * Supports canonical error.fields from validateScopeArray/validateCarrierAccountScopes,
 207:  * as well as legacy/fallback details/fields formats.
 208:  */
 209: export function mapCanonicalFieldErrors(
 210:   errorData: any,
 211:   fallbackMessage = 'Đã có lỗi xảy ra'
 212: ): Record<string, string> {
 213:   const fields =
 214:     errorData?.error?.fields ||
 215:     errorData?.fields ||
 216:     errorData?.error?.details ||
 217:     errorData?.details;
 218: 
 219:   if (!Array.isArray(fields)) return {};
 220: 
 221:   const map: Record<string, string> = {};
 222:   for (const d of fields) {
 223:     if (d && d.field) {
 224:       const baseField = d.field.replace(/\[\d+\]$/, '');
 225:       const msg = d.message || errorData?.error?.message || errorData?.message || fallbackMessage;
 226:       map[baseField] = msg;
 227:       map[d.field] = msg;
 228:       if (baseField === 'carrier_account_scopes') {
 229:         map['carrier_scopes'] = msg;
 230:       } else if (baseField === 'carrier_scopes') {
 231:         map['carrier_account_scopes'] = msg;
 232:       }
 233:     }
 234:   }
 235:   return map;
 236: }

 244:   initialToastMessage?: string | null;
 245:   initialScopeError?: string | null;
 246:   initialScopeLoading?: boolean;
 247:   initialScopeErrorBody?: any;
 248:   initialFieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
 249:   initialActiveSubTab?: 'matrix' | 'stores' | 'members' | 'devices' | 'invitations';
 250:   initialSubTab?: 'matrix' | 'stores' | 'members' | 'devices' | 'invitations';

 253: export const UserManagementTab: React.FC<UserManagementTabProps> = (props = {}) => {
 254:   const { token, user } = useAuth();
 255:   const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<
 256:     'matrix' | 'stores' | 'members' | 'devices' | 'invitations'
 257:   >(props.initialActiveSubTab ?? props.initialSubTab ?? 'members');
 258:   const [isInviteOpen, setIsInviteOpen] = useState(false);
 259:   const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(
 260:     props.initialToastMessage ?? null
 261:   );
 262: 
 263:   // Invitations state (FEAT-USR-01)
 264:   const [invitations, setInvitations] = useState<any[]>([]);
 265:   const [invitationsLoading, setInvitationsLoading] = useState(false);
 266:   const [invitationsError, setInvitationsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 267:   const [invitationsStatusFilter, setInvitationsStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
 268:   const [actionLoadingId, setActionLoadingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
 269: 
 270:   const isForbidden =
 271:     props.initialForbidden !== undefined
 272:       ? props.initialForbidden
 273:       : user
 274:         ? isManageUsersForbidden(user.role)
 275:         : false;
 276: 
 277:   const fetchInvitations = useCallback(async () => {
 278:     if (isForbidden) return;
 279:     setInvitationsLoading(true);
 280:     setInvitationsError(null);
 281:     try {
 282:       const apiBase = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 283:       const url = new URL(`${apiBase}/api/v1/invitations`);
 284:       if (invitationsStatusFilter !== 'ALL') {
 285:         url.searchParams.set('status', invitationsStatusFilter);
 286:       }
 287:       const res = await fetch(url.toString(), {
 288:         headers: {
 289:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 290:           ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
 291:         },
 292:       });
 293:       const data = await res.json();
 294:       if (!res.ok) {
 295:         throw new Error(data.error?.message || 'Không thể tải danh sách lời mời');
 296:       }
 297:       setInvitations(data.data || []);
 298:     } catch (err: any) {
 299:       setInvitationsError(err.message || 'Lỗi kết nối khi tải lời mời');
 300:     } finally {
 301:       setInvitationsLoading(false);
 302:     }
 303:   }, [token, invitationsStatusFilter, isForbidden]);
 304: 
 305:   useEffect(() => {
 306:     if (activeSubTab === 'invitations') {
 307:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- Client-side invitations list initial fetch
 308:       void fetchInvitations();
 309:     }
 310:   }, [activeSubTab, fetchInvitations]);
 311: 
 312:   const handleResendInvite = async (inviteId: string) => {
 313:     setActionLoadingId(inviteId);
 314:     setInvitationsError(null);
 315:     try {
 316:       const apiBase = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 317:       const res = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/v1/invitations/${inviteId}/resend`, {
 318:         method: 'POST',
 319:         headers: {
 320:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 321:           ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
 322:         },
 323:       });
 324:       const data = await res.json();
 325:       if (!res.ok) {
 326:         throw new Error(data.error?.message || 'Không thể gửi lại lời mời');
 327:       }
 328:       setToastMessage('Đã cấp lại lời mời thành công và gia hạn 7 ngày');
 329:       void fetchInvitations();
 330:     } catch (err: any) {
 331:       setInvitationsError(err.message || 'Thao tác gửi lại lời mời thất bại. Vui lòng thử lại.');
 332:     } finally {
 333:       setActionLoadingId(null);
 334:     }
 335:   };
 336: 
 337:   const handleCancelInvite = async (inviteId: string) => {
 338:     if (!confirm('Bạn có chắc chắn muốn hủy lời mời này?')) return;
 339:     setActionLoadingId(inviteId);
 340:     setInvitationsError(null);
 341:     try {
 342:       const apiBase = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 343:       const res = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/v1/invitations/${inviteId}/cancel`, {
 344:         method: 'POST',
 345:         headers: {
 346:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 347:           ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
 348:         },
 349:       });
 350:       const data = await res.json();
 351:       if (!res.ok) {
 352:         throw new Error(data.error?.message || 'Không thể hủy lời mời');
 353:       }
 354:       setToastMessage('Đã hủy lời mời thành công');
 355:       void fetchInvitations();
 356:     } catch (err: any) {
 357:       setInvitationsError(err.message || 'Thao tác hủy lời mời thất bại. Vui lòng thử lại.');
 358:     } finally {
 359:       setActionLoadingId(null);
 360:     }
 361:   };
 362: 
 363:   // Users list and filter state (FEAT-USR-02)
 364:   const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserListItem[]>(() => {
 365:     if (!props.initialUsers) return [];
 366:     return (props.initialUsers as any[]).map((u) => ({
 367:       ...u,
 368:       store_scopes: u.store_scopes || u.assigned_stores || [],
 369:       warehouse_scopes: u.warehouse_scopes || [],
 370:       carrier_account_scopes: u.carrier_account_scopes || [],
 371:     })) as UserListItem[];
 372:   });
 373:   const [usersLoading, setUsersLoading] = useState<boolean>(
 374:     props.initialLoading ?? !props.initialUsers
 375:   );
 376:   const [usersError, setUsersError] = useState<string | null>(props.initialError || null);
 377:   const [userSearch, setUserSearch] = useState<string>('');
 378:   const [userRoleFilter, setUserRoleFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
 379:   const [userStatusFilter, setUserStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
 380:   const [stores, setStores] = useState<StoreItem[]>(DEFAULT_STORES);
 381: 
 382:   // Modal new store state
 383:   const [isNewStoreModalOpen, setIsNewStoreModalOpen] = useState(false);
 384:   const [newStoreName, setNewStoreName] = useState('');
 385:   const [newStoreCode, setNewStoreCode] = useState('');
 386:   const [newStoreAddress, setNewStoreAddress] = useState('');
 387:   const [newStorePhone, setNewStorePhone] = useState('0908889999');
 388: 
 389:   // Modal edit user state
 390:   const [editingUser, setEditingUser] = useState<any | null>(props.initialEditingUser ?? null);
 391:   const [editFullName, setEditFullName] = useState<string>(
 392:     props.initialEditingUser?.full_name || ''
 393:   );
 394:   const [editRole, setEditRole] = useState<string>(props.initialEditingUser?.role || 'OPS_CSKH');
 395:   const [editStoreScopes, setEditStoreScopes] = useState<string[]>(
 396:     (props.initialEditingUser as any)?.store_scopes ||
 397:       (props.initialEditingUser as any)?.assigned_stores ||
 398:       []
 399:   );
 400:   const [editWarehouseScopes, setEditWarehouseScopes] = useState<string[]>(
 401:     props.initialEditingUser?.warehouse_scopes || []
 402:   );
 403:   const [editCarrierScopes, setEditCarrierScopes] = useState<string[]>(
 404:     (props.initialEditingUser as any)?.carrier_account_scopes || []
 405:   );
 406:   const [editError, setEditError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 407:   const [scopeSaveError, setScopeSaveError] = useState<string | null>(
 408:     props.initialScopeError ??
 409:       props.initialScopeErrorBody?.error?.message ??
 410:       props.initialScopeErrorBody?.message ??
 411:       null
 412:   );
 413:   const [scopeSaveLoading, setScopeSaveLoading] = useState<boolean>(
 414:     props.initialScopeLoading ?? false
 415:   );
 416:   const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() => {
 417:     if (props.initialFieldErrors) return props.initialFieldErrors;
 418:     if (props.initialScopeErrorBody) {
 419:       return mapCanonicalFieldErrors(props.initialScopeErrorBody);
 420:     }
 421:     return {};
 422:   });
 423: 
 424:   // Modal suspend user state
 425:   const [suspendingUser, setSuspendingUser] = useState<UserListItem | null>(null);
 426:   const [suspensionReason, setSuspensionReason] = useState<string>('');
 427:   const [suspensionError, setSuspensionError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 428: 
 429:   // Modal activate user state
 430:   const [activatingUser, setActivatingUser] = useState<UserListItem | null>(null);
 431: 
 432:   // Modal deactivate user state
 433:   const [deactivatingUser, setDeactivatingUser] = useState<UserListItem | null>(null);
 434:   const [deactivationReason, setDeactivationReason] = useState<string>('');
 435: 
 436:   const [mutationLoading, setMutationLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
 437: 
 438:   const fetchUsers = useCallback(async () => {
 439:     if (isForbidden) {
 440:       setUsersLoading(false);
 441:       return;
 442:     }
 443:     setUsersLoading(true);
 444:     setUsersError(null);
 445:     try {
 446:       const apiBase = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 447:       const url = new URL(`${apiBase}/api/v1/users`);
 448:       if (userRoleFilter && userRoleFilter !== 'ALL') {
 449:         url.searchParams.set('role', userRoleFilter);
 450:       }
 451:       if (userStatusFilter && userStatusFilter !== 'ALL') {
 452:         url.searchParams.set('status', userStatusFilter);
 453:       }
 454:       if (userSearch && userSearch.trim().length > 0) {
 455:         url.searchParams.set('search', userSearch.trim());
 456:       }
 457:       const res = await fetch(url.toString(), {
 458:         headers: {
 459:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 460:           ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
 461:         },
 462:       });
 463:       const data = await res.json();
 464:       if (!res.ok) {
 465:         throw new Error(data.error?.message || 'Không thể tải danh sách người dùng');
 466:       }
 467:       setUsers(data.data || []);
 468:     } catch (err: any) {
 469:       setUsersError(err.message || 'Lỗi kết nối khi tải danh sách người dùng');
 470:     } finally {
 471:       setUsersLoading(false);
 472:     }
 473:   }, [token, isForbidden, userRoleFilter, userStatusFilter, userSearch]);
 474: 
 475:   useEffect(() => {
 476:     if (activeSubTab === 'members' && !props.initialUsers) {
 477:       // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- Client-side users list initial fetch
 478:       void fetchUsers();
 479:     }
 480:   }, [activeSubTab, fetchUsers, props.initialUsers]);
 481: 
 482:   const handleOpenEdit = (u: any) => {
 483:     setEditingUser(u);
 484:     setEditFullName(u.full_name || '');
 485:     setEditRole(u.role || '');
 486:     setEditStoreScopes(u.store_scopes || u.assigned_stores || []);
 487:     setEditWarehouseScopes(u.warehouse_scopes || []);
 488:     setEditCarrierScopes(u.carrier_account_scopes || []);
 489:     setEditError(null);
 490:     setScopeSaveError(null);
 491:     setFieldErrors({});
 492:   };
 493: 
 494:   const handleSaveUserPermissions = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 495:     e.preventDefault();
 496:     if (!editingUser) return;
 497: 
 498:     if (!editFullName || editFullName.trim().length === 0) {
 499:       setEditError('Họ và tên không được để trống');
 500:       setFieldErrors({ full_name: 'Họ và tên không được để trống' });
 501:       return;
 502:     }
 503: 
 504:     setMutationLoading(true);
 505:     setScopeSaveLoading(true);
 506:     setEditError(null);
 507:     setScopeSaveError(null);
 508:     setFieldErrors({});
 509: 
 510:     try {
 511:       const apiBase = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 512: 
 513:       // 1. Save scopes to dedicated scopes endpoint (PATCH /api/v1/users/:id/scopes) (AC-RBAC-02-20)
 514:       const scopesRes = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/v1/users/${editingUser.id}/scopes`, {
 515:         method: 'PATCH',
 516:         headers: {
 517:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 518:           ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
 519:         },
 520:         body: JSON.stringify({
 521:           store_scopes: editStoreScopes,
 522:           warehouse_scopes: editWarehouseScopes,
 523:           carrier_account_scopes: editCarrierScopes,
 524:         }),
 525:       });
 526: 
 527:       if (!scopesRes.ok) {
 528:         const errorData = await scopesRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
 529:         const msg =
 530:           errorData.error?.message || errorData.message || 'Không thể cập nhật phạm vi quyền hạn';
 531:         setScopeSaveError(msg);
 532: 
 533:         // Map field validation errors from canonical error body's fields array (AC-RBAC-02-20)
 534:         const map = mapCanonicalFieldErrors(errorData, msg);
 535:         if (Object.keys(map).length > 0) {
 536:           setFieldErrors(map);
 537:         }
 538:         return;
 539:       }
 540: 
 541:       // 2. Save user profile & role to PATCH /api/v1/users/:id
 542:       const userRes = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/v1/users/${editingUser.id}`, {
 543:         method: 'PATCH',
 544:         headers: {
 545:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 546:           ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
 547:         },
 548:         body: JSON.stringify({
 549:           full_name: editFullName.trim(),
 550:           role: editRole,
 551:           store_scopes: editStoreScopes,
 552:           warehouse_scopes: editWarehouseScopes,
 553:           carrier_account_scopes: editCarrierScopes,
 554:         }),
 555:       });
 556: 
 557:       if (!userRes.ok) {
 558:         const errorData = await userRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
 559:         const msg =
 560:           errorData.error?.message ||
 561:           errorData.message ||
 562:           'Không thể cập nhật thông tin người dùng';
 563:         setEditError(msg);
 564:         const map = mapCanonicalFieldErrors(errorData, msg);
 565:         if (Object.keys(map).length > 0) {
 566:           setFieldErrors(map);
 567:         }
 568:         return;
 569:       }
 570: 
 571:       // Success toast only after 200 OK
 572:       setToastMessage(USERS_SCOPE_SUCCESS_TOAST);
 573:       setEditingUser(null);
 574:       void fetchUsers();
 575:       setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 4000);
 576:     } catch (err: any) {
 577:       setScopeSaveError(err.message || 'Lỗi khi cập nhật phạm vi quyền hạn');
 578:       setEditError(err.message || 'Lỗi khi cập nhật người dùng');
 579:     } finally {

 755:   // Fetch live roles from GET /api/v1/roles (Finding 10)
 756:   const fetchLiveRoles = useCallback(async () => {
 757:     setMatrixLoading(true);
 758:     setMatrixError(null);
 759:     try {
 760:       const token = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('shipde_token') : null;
 761:       const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
 762:       const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 763:         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 764:       };
 765:       if (token) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
 766:       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/v1/roles`, { headers });
 767:       if (!res.ok) {
 768:         const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => null);
 769:         throw new Error(errJson?.error?.message || 'Không thể tải danh sách vai trò từ máy chủ');
 770:       }
 771:       const json = await res.json();
 772:       if (json?.data?.roles) {
 773:         setLiveRoles(json.data.roles);
 774:       }
 775:     } catch (err: any) {
 776:       setMatrixError(err.message || 'Lỗi kết nối khi đồng bộ vai trò từ máy chủ');
 777:     } finally {
 778:       setMatrixLoading(false);
 779:     }
 780:   }, []);

1111:                       const isAllStores = userStores.includes('*');

1117:

1122:                       const isSoleActiveOwner =

1126: 
1127:                       const normalizedStatus = (u.status || 'ACTIVE').toUpperCase();
1128: 
1129:                       return (
1130:                         <tr

1315:                               {normalizedStatus === 'ACTIVE' && (

1389:       {/* SUBTAB: INVITATIONS (FEAT-USR-01) */}
1390:       {activeSubTab === 'invitations' && (

1394:               <ShieldAlert className="w-10 h-10 text-amber-600 mx-auto" />

1482:               {!(invitationsError && invitations.length === 0) && (

2520:                   className="modern-input w-full text-xs"
2521:                   required

2525:               <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-end gap-2.5">
2526:                 <button

2542:       {/* MODAL: INVITE USER */}
2543:       <InviteUserModal
2544:         isOpen={isInviteOpen}
2545:         onClose={() => setIsInviteOpen(false)}
2546:         onUserInvited={(_invited: any) => {
2547:           setIsInviteOpen(false);
2548:           setToastMessage(INVITE_SUCCESS_TOAST);
2549:           setActiveSubTab('invitations');
2550:           void fetchInvitations();
2551:           setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 5000);
2552:         }}
2553:       />
2554:     </div>
2555:   );
2556: };
2557: 
2558: export function resolveMatrixForLiveRoles(
2559:   liveRoles: RoleItem[],
2560:   matrixRows: Array<{ id: string; code: string; feature: string; name?: string }>
2561: ) {
2562:   return matrixRows.map((row) => {
2563:     const rolePermissions: Record<string, boolean> = {};
2564:     for (const role of liveRoles) {
2565:       rolePermissions[role.id] = (role.permissions || []).some(
2566:         (p) => p.code === row.code || p.id === row.id
2567:       );
2568:     }
2569:     return {
2570:       id: row.id,
2571:       code: row.code,
2572:       name: row.name || row.feature,
2573:       feature: row.feature,
2574:       roles: rolePermissions,
2575:     };
2576:   });
2577: }
</file>

 49: export interface SearchActivationActions {
 50:   setActiveTab: (tab: string) => void;
 51:   setSelectedGlobalTracking: (code: string | null) => void;
 52:   setSelectedOrderId: (id: string | null) => void;
 53:   setSelectedOrderCode: (code: string | null) => void;
 54:   setSelectedBatchId: (id: string | null) => void;
 55:   setSelectedCaseId: (id: string | null) => void;
 56:   setSelectedClaimId: (id: string | null) => void;
 57:   setSelectedClaimCode: (code: string | null) => void;
 58:   setSelectedDiscrepancyId: (id: string | null) => void;
 59:   pushUrl?: (url: string) => void;
 60:   showToast?: (message: string) => void;

 63: export function handleSearchResultActivation(
 64:   item: {
 65:     id: string;
 66:     type: string;
 67:     code: string;
 68:     url?: string;
 69:     title?: string;
 70:     metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
 71:   },
 72:   actions: SearchActivationActions
 73: ) {
 74:   // Follow result URL in browser history
 75:   if (actions.pushUrl && item.url) {
 76:     actions.pushUrl(item.url);
 77:   } else if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && item.url) {
 78:     window.history.pushState(null, '', item.url);
 79:   }
 80: 
 81:   // Clear previous selections across all entity types so consecutive activations do not leave stale selections
 82:   actions.setSelectedGlobalTracking(null);
 83:   actions.setSelectedOrderId(null);
 84:   actions.setSelectedOrderCode(null);
 85:   actions.setSelectedBatchId(null);
 86:   actions.setSelectedCaseId(null);
 87:   actions.setSelectedClaimId(null);
 88:   actions.setSelectedClaimCode(null);
 89:   actions.setSelectedDiscrepancyId(null);
 90: 
 91:   if (item.type === 'WAYBILL') {
 92:     actions.setSelectedGlobalTracking(item.code);
 93:   } else if (item.type === 'ORDER') {
 94:     actions.setActiveTab('shipments');
 95:     actions.setSelectedOrderId(item.id);
 96:     actions.setSelectedOrderCode(item.code);
 97:   } else if (item.type === 'BATCH') {
 98:     actions.setActiveTab('reconciliation');
 99:     actions.setSelectedBatchId(item.id);
100:   } else if (item.type === 'CASE') {
101:     const isClaim =
102:       item.url?.startsWith('/claims/') ||
103:       Boolean(item.metadata && 'claim_type' in item.metadata) ||
104:       item.title?.toLowerCase().includes('bồi thường');
105:     if (isClaim) {
106:       actions.setActiveTab('claims');
107:       actions.setSelectedClaimId(item.id);
108:       actions.setSelectedClaimCode(item.code);
109:     } else {
110:       actions.setActiveTab('exceptions');
111:       actions.setSelectedCaseId(item.id);
112:     }
113:   } else if (item.type === 'TRANSACTION') {
114:     actions.setActiveTab('reconciliation');
115:     actions.setSelectedDiscrepancyId(item.id);
116:   }
117: }

<file path="docs/product-spec/docs/10-ai-collaboration/AI-TOOLCHAIN-DECISIONS.md">
  1: # Ship Dễ AI Toolchain Decisions
  2: 
  3: ## Shared author pre-push check (TASK-AI-162)
  4: 
  5: Operator approved on 2026-11-02. Every writer lane (Gemini, Claude, 9Router and directly assigned Codex authors) runs `pnpm ai:check` before committing/pushing and pastes its summary in the PR. This local helper calls the existing CI gate scripts; **CI remains the authority**, and a local PASS is not independent review or permission to merge.
  6: 
  7: The checker runs `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm security:secrets`, `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`, then tests, sequentially and failing fast. It pins the existing incremental scripts' base to `origin/main`, including their existing working-tree checks. It does not fetch; keep that ref current before starting work. Missing dependencies, Git history or native Gitleaks fail the relevant gate.
  8: 
  9: For tests, pnpm's since filter selects workspaces changed from the merge-base of `origin/main` and `HEAD`, plus their dependents. Before narrowing tests, the checker verifies that these workspace directories cover every committed, staged and unstaged changed path, including deletions and both sides of renames. Root/shared changes, untracked files, an empty selection, incomplete metadata or unavailable filtering conservatively fall back to full `pnpm test`.
 10: 
 11: When Turbo's affected dry-run contains runnable tests for every selected workspace, the checker uses `turbo run test --affected` to preserve its build graph. Empty, non-runnable or incomplete task sets require full tests, as does a successful probe with missing or malformed output. Only valid JSON with an optional Turbo version banner is accepted; a failed Turbo process may use the already verified pnpm filter. A failing test command is a failure, never a fallback trigger. Lint, typecheck and secrets retain their existing scope. The whitespace command checks committed changes; authors should also check their staged diff before committing.
 12: 
 13: The summary has one PASS/FAIL line per executed gate followed by `PASS ai:check` or `FAIL ai:check`; failure exits nonzero. Child output and exception text are suppressed because any gate can print sensitive source or environment data. The failed gate's name identifies the command to diagnose locally; never paste raw secrets or environment values into PR evidence.
 14: 
 15: Local hook installation remains optional and explicit: after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, run `pnpm lefthook install`. Installed pre-push hooks invoke the shared command by default. The supported exception is the explicit, hook-only variable `SHIPDE_SKIP_AI_CHECK=1`; record why the local hook was skipped in PR evidence and still run the author checklist. Direct `pnpm ai:check` ignores the skip variable. Existing pre-commit and no-hardcode hooks are unchanged. No CI workflow, gate configuration, allowlist, baseline or Semgrep rule is relaxed.
 16: 
 17: On PowerShell systems that block `.ps1` shims, use `pnpm.cmd` for the same commands. Offline regression tests: `node --test tools/ai-brain/test/task-ai-162-prepush-check.test.js` (also discovered by the existing `pnpm test:brain` command).
 18: 
 19: ## Objective
 20: 
 21: Use the lowest-cost capable author without reducing business completeness, UI quality, security or evidence. GitHub artifacts are the shared memory; no agent framework may replace the approved product specification, Work Item or independent review.
 22: 
 23: The complete installation classification is maintained in `REPOSITORY-CLI-MANIFEST.md`. Only the Ship Dễ product repository is cloned; upstream projects are installed through their supported package, image, action or reviewed guidance mechanism.
 24: 
 25: ## Adopted toolchain
 26: 
 27: | Tool or repository                                                                        | Decision                         | Purpose                                                                      | Boundary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
 28: | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
 29: | Git, GitHub and Git worktrees                                                             | USE NOW                          | Isolated workspaces, durable handoff, CI and review                          | `main` is never an implementation workspace                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
 30: | Claude app and Claude Code                                                                | USE NOW                          | Business and solution analysis                                               | Interactive analysis stays in `shipde-claude`; unattended AO uses the governed 9Router launcher; no self-approval                                                                                                                                         |
 31: | AgentRouter                                                                               | USE NOW                          | Claude Code-compatible provider and routing runtime                          | Keep upstream credentials outside Git; unattended AO routes via the localhost 9Router endpoint (port 20128) using `%USERPROFILE%\.claude-9router`, while direct AgentRouter access is reserved for the manual `%USERPROFILE%\.claude-orchestrator` diagnostic profile |
 32: | Codex app and Codex CLI                                                                   | USE NOW                          | Work Item planning, documentation and fresh independent review               | Planning and review are separate tasks; no author self-review                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
 33: | Gemini app, Antigravity CLI and [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli) | USE NOW                          | Primary implementation for complete vertical and high-risk work              | Prefer authenticated `agy`; `gemini` is the fallback; one prepared Work Item and branch at a time                                                                                                                                                             |
 34: | [9Router](https://github.com/decolua/9router)                                             | USE NOW                          | Local OpenAI-compatible gateway, free-model fallback and usage visibility    | Localhost only; Ponytail and Caveman disabled                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
 35: | [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)                       | USE NOW, PIN                     | Controlled 9Router author workspace                                          | Developer preview; keep `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2` until an upgrade is tested                                                                                                                                                                              |
 36: | pnpm 11 and Docker Desktop/Compose                                                        | INSTALL NOW                      | Prepare the Node 24 machine for the target monorepo and local infrastructure | Do not migrate the current npm prototype outside its Foundation Work Item                                                                                                                                                                                     |
 37: | [Playwright](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright)                                     | ADOPT IN `TASK-FOUND-04`         | Browser E2E, trace/video evidence and screenshot comparison                  | Golden images require human-approved baselines                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
 38: | [Storybook](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook)                                     | ADOPT IN `TASK-FOUND-04`         | Visible catalog of component states and interaction/accessibility checks     | It documents approved UI; it does not invent the design                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
 39: | [axe-core](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core)                                         | ADOPT IN `TASK-FOUND-04`         | Automated accessibility checks in rendered UI                                | Automated checks supplement, not replace, manual UX review                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
 40: | [MSW](https://github.com/mswjs/msw)                                                       | ADOPT IN `TASK-FOUND-04`         | Deterministic API and carrier response states for UI/testing                 | Mock behavior is labeled and never presented as live production evidence                                                                                                                                                                                      |
 41: | [Lighthouse CI](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse-ci)                            | ADOPT IN `TASK-FOUND-04`         | Performance budgets for critical approved routes                             | Targeted CI only; do not consume every local iteration                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
 42: | [Vercel agent skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills)                        | AUDIT AND PIN IN `TASK-FOUND-04` | React performance and UI review guidance                                     | Only `react-best-practices` and `web-design-guidelines`; Ship Dễ UX sources remain authoritative                                                                                                                                                              |
 43: | [qodo-ai/pr-agent](https://github.com/qodo-ai/pr-agent)                                   | USE NOW (ADVISORY)               | Advisory first-pass PR reviewer                                              | Operator approved 2026-10-31; advisory pre-review to cut CHANGES_REQUIRED rounds; does not replace independent Codex review; configured via repository secrets PR_AGENT_API_BASE, PR_AGENT_API_KEY, PR_AGENT_MODEL                          |
 44: 
 45: ## External orchestration layer
 46: 
 47: [Agent Orchestrator](https://github.com/Untrivial-ai/agent-orchestrator) is the control layer around the adopted ecosystem, not another adopted repository/provider. Ship Dễ pins the installed Windows runtime at `0.13.0` (raised from `0.12.12`, see AI-AO-PIN-2026-09-16), checks it with `ao status --json`, and starts it only through `scripts/ai/start-agent-orchestrator.ps1`. Its provenance is recorded in the top-level `orchestrator_runtime` object of `tools/ecosystem-manifest.json`, outside `adopted`.
 48: 
 49: ## Explicitly not adopted
 50: 
 51: | Tool family                                                                         | Decision          | Reason                                                                                                                                 |
 52: | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
 53: | Ponytail                                                                            | REJECT            | It biases toward minimal output and previously produced generic, incomplete Ship Dễ UI. Disable both repository and 9Router injection. |
 54: | Caveman output mode                                                                 | REJECT            | Terse output removes reasoning and handoff evidence needed by a BA/product owner.                                                      |
 55: | Headroom semantic compression                                                       | DEFER             | Adds another local service and may alter context. Reconsider only after measured evaluation.                                           |
 56: | BMAD, Spec Kit, SuperClaude, Superpowers or another general orchestration framework | REJECT FOR NOW    | Duplicates approved specification and role contracts; Spec Kit patterns adopted docs-only without tooling (TASK-AI-157).              |
 57: | Generic dashboard/theme repositories                                                | REJECT            | Ship Dễ UI must come from approved screen states and design sources, not a transplanted AI theme.                                      |
 58: | Unreviewed DSH or public agent-skill collections                                    | REJECT BY DEFAULT | Plugins and skills execute or inject trusted instructions. Add only through a reviewed, commit-pinned Work Item.                       |
 59: | Global Nest, Prisma, Turbo, Playwright, Storybook or test CLIs                      | REJECT            | Project tools must be lockfile-pinned and invoked through root package scripts.                                                        |
 60: | Native PostgreSQL, Redis or MinIO installation                                      | REJECT            | Docker Compose owns reproducible local services and avoids conflicting Windows services.                                               |
 61: | WSL/Ubuntu as a baseline requirement                                                | REJECT            | The current Windows 10 Pro workflow is native; use WSL only if a future verified tool cannot operate safely without it.                |
 62: 
 63: ## 9Router endpoint policy
 64: 
 65: Use one local endpoint:
 66: 
 67: - Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1`
 68: - DSH custom Provider ID: `9router`
 69: - API protocol: `openai-completions`
 70: - API key: enter through the DSH UI; never write it in this repository
 71: - Request logging: OFF by default
 72: - Ponytail: OFF
 73: - Caveman: OFF
 74: - Headroom: OFF
 75: - RTK: ON only for low-risk implementation; turn it OFF when diagnosing logs, diffs or failed tests
 76: 
 77: DSH stores credentials outside the project and keeps only a credential reference in settings. The provider ID is permanent, so use exactly `9router`.
 78: 
 79: ## AgentRouter provider policy
 80: 
 81: AgentRouter provides Claude model access under two separate topologies:
 82: 
 83: 1. **Manual direct profile (`%USERPROFILE%\.claude-orchestrator`):** Used directly by Claude Code for manual business and solution analysis. Its token is stored only in the user's credential environment and injected into the Claude process by an untracked local launcher. It connects directly to AgentRouter upstream without chaining through 9Router, and is not an implementation-author route. Its promotional balance is treated as temporary capacity rather than a permanent free entitlement. The repository stores no token, provider session or request log.
 84: 2. **Unattended routed topology (`%USERPROFILE%\.claude-9router`):** Used by unattended AO sessions. AO routes requests through the local 9Router endpoint at `http://localhost:20128/v1`, which manages provider fallback without manual token handling.
 85: 
 86: ### Gateway routing record (TASK-AI-44)
 87: 
 88: Two gateways exist and they are not interchangeable. The name `AgentRouter` is reserved for the cloud endpoint; the local endpoint is `9Router`. The names in code follow this table.
 89: 
 90: | Gateway | Endpoint | Credential | Code names in this repository | Serves |
 91: |---|---|---|---|---|
 92: | AgentRouter (cloud) | `https://agentrouter.org/` (no `/v1`) | `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY`, User environment | `doctor.ps1` AgentRouter credential probe | Manual Claude Code business/solution analysis; the Claude and Codex fallback route |
 93: | 9Router (local) | `http://localhost:20128/v1` | local token | `$script:NineRouterProfile`, `$script:NineRouterPort`, `Get-ShipDeNineRouterProfilePath`, `Assert-ShipDeNineRouterProfile`, `Assert-ShipDeNineRouterProfileBaseUrl`, `Test-ShipDeNineRouterEndpoint`, `Ensure-ShipDeNineRouterRuntime`, `Get-ShipDeNineRouterFailureSince` | Unattended AO sessions (`.claude-9router` profile), Gemini, dsh |
 94: 
 95: Fallback routing, as implemented:
 96: 
 97: - **Codex review fails** -> `Invoke-ShipDeClaudeReviewFallback` runs the host-authenticated native Claude Code CLI after clearing `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. It uses neither gateway; it spends the Claude subscription quota. The function was previously named after AgentRouter, which it never called.
 98: - **An AO worker's provider fails** -> the local 9Router falls back across its configured upstreams; after every approved route is exhausted, TASK-AI-07 replaces the harness.
 99: - **AgentRouter credential** -> reported available only after a live probe authenticates (`AI-44-R01`); a rejected key is a `doctor.ps1` failure, never "configured" (`AI-44-R02`). Only a 16-character SHA-256 prefix of the key is cached; the key itself is never written to a log, report or dashboard (`AI-44-R04`).
100: 
101: `scripts/ai/start-agent-orchestrator.ps1` still names its port parameter `-AgentRouterPort` while it addresses 9Router's port 20128; renaming that file is outside this Work Item's allowed paths (see the Work Item's Residual limitations).
102: 
103: ### AO version pin raised to 0.13.0 (AI-AO-PIN-2026-09-16)
104: 
105: HUMAN-DECISION: operator approved AO 0.13.0 on 2026-09-16. The supervisor refused to start with `AO ProductVersion '0.13.0' does not match pinned version 0.12.12`; the operator chose raising the pin over reinstalling 0.12.12.
106: 
107: Compatibility verified on this host before the pin moved:
108: 
109: | Surface used by `control.ps1` | AO 0.13.0 result |
110: |---|---|
111: | `ao spawn --project --kind --name --branch --harness --prompt --mode` | every flag present in `ao spawn --help`; `agy`, `claude-code`, `codex`, `cline` remain valid harnesses |
112: | `ao session ls --project --json` | accepted; response keeps the `{ data, meta }` shape with `id`, `status`, `activity`, `isTerminated`, `harness`, `branch`, `prs` |
113: | `ao session get <id> --project --json` | accepted |
114: | `ao session kill <id> --project` | accepted |
115: | `ao review ls <session> --json` | accepted |
116: | `ao status --json` | accepted; returns `state: ready` |
117: 
118: Not verified: a live `ao spawn` end to end under 0.13.0. `ao version` on the daemon binary prints `dev`, so the desktop executable's ProductVersion remains the version source. Historical `0.12.12` references in TASK-AI-06/07 records and fixture comments describe what was observed then and are left unchanged.
119: 
120: ## Low-cost model route
121: 
122: Create a 9Router combo named `shipde-low-risk`. Select only model IDs currently returned by `GET /v1/models`, in this preference order when available:
123: 
124: 1. `oc/deepseek-v4-flash-free`
125: 2. `oc/mimo-v2.5-free`
126: 3. `oc/nemotron-3-ultra-free`
127: 
128: Free catalogs change. The health check reports missing candidates; never silently substitute an unknown model. This combo is not permitted for architecture, authentication, authorization, tenancy, money, database ownership, carrier side effects or final UI decisions.
129: 
130: ## Upgrade rule
131: 
132: Do not auto-upgrade 9Router, DSH, Codex CLI, Gemini/Antigravity CLI, Claude Code or an agent plugin during an active Work Item. `install-clis.ps1` installs only missing tools. Record current versions, upgrade in a dedicated low-risk task, run the doctor, execute a disposable test branch and verify prompt injection settings before promoting the version.
133: 
134: ## Codex CLI version dependency (TASK-AI-16)
135: 
136: Observed on 2026-09-14: `codex-cli 0.154.0`, installed as `@openai/codex@0.154.0`.
137: `tools/ecosystem-manifest.json` still pins `0.151.0`; reconciling that drift is a
138: human decision under the upgrade rule above and is deliberately not made here.
139: 
140: What this version accepts and refuses was established by probing each `-c`
141: override separately (`docs/product-spec/work-items/TASK-AI-16-FINDINGS.md`):
142: 
143: - All four hook overrides — `hooks.SessionStart`, `hooks.UserPromptSubmit`,
144:   `hooks.PermissionRequest`, `hooks.Stop` — are accepted. No hook needs to be
145:   dropped or reshaped.
146: - The `projects` override is refused when the path contains Windows
147:   backslashes: they are consumed as escape sequences, so the value reaches the
148:   parser as a string where a map was expected. The identical override with
149:   forward slashes is accepted.
150: - Doubling the backslashes is **accepted** when the argument reaches the CLI
151:   intact, and rejected when the same text is routed through `cmd.exe` /
152:   PowerShell quoting. The original probe took the second route, which is why it
153:   read the doubling result backwards. An escaping fix at the call site is
154:   therefore not ruled out by that evidence; the fix still belongs upstream
155:   because AO ships as a closed binary. Measured by
156:   `tools/ai-brain/acceptance/ac-16-03-codex-flag-refusal.js`.
157: 
158: The defect therefore sits in whatever builds Agent Orchestrator's command line,
159: not in the hook configuration and not in a CLI flag-surface change. AO ships as
160: a closed binary at `C:\Program Files\agent-orchestrator`, so the fix belongs
161: upstream; what this repository owns is an accurate diagnosis.
162: 
163: `doctor.ps1` carries two checks for this. The first probes the overrides
164: individually and names the one refused. The second reads the AO ledger at
165: `~/.ao/data/ao.db` and reports whether any Codex session has recorded activity,
166: because a flag that parses is not a hook that fired — a launch command exiting
167: zero proves neither. An unreadable ledger reports "cannot verify" and never a
168: pass.

170: ## Ecosystem manifest reconciliation against reality (TASK-AI-17)
171: 
172: On 2026-09-14, the automated manifest audit (`node tools/ai-brain/cli.js manifest`)
173: evaluated all 37 declared adopted repositories in `tools/ecosystem-manifest.json`
174: against reality on the machine and in the monorepo workspace. The audit found:
175: 
176: - 37 repositories declared, 27 checkable, 19 present, 8 missing.
177: - 7 ERRORS `QUALITY_GATE_MISSING` as first reported: `lighthouse-ci`,
178:   `agent-scan`, `token-tracker`, `lefthook`, `gitleaks`, `axe-core`, `trivy`.
179:   Six of those were genuinely absent. The seventh, `gitleaks`, was a false
180:   positive and is treated separately below.
181: - 1 WARNING `DECLARED_ADOPTED_BUT_ABSENT`: `storybook` — declared `ADOPTED`,
182:   but absent from workspace dependencies.
183: - Pin drift: `codex-cli` pinned at `0.151.0` while `0.154.0` is installed.
184: 
185: Verdict: the manifest overclaimed reality. A quality gate believed to be running
186: when absent is worse than one openly missing, because the pipeline and operators
187: assume automated enforcement is active.
188: 
189: ### `gitleaks` was never absent, and the check was wrong
190: 
191: The audit probes a `system` tool with `where` / `which` on the local host, which
192: cannot see a tool the CI runner provides. `gitleaks` is installed at the pinned
193: `8.24.0` by `.github/workflows/security-baseline.yml` and again by
194: `.github/workflows/current-application.yml`, and enforced as a blocking gate on
195: every Pull Request and push to `main`. It was running at the moment the audit
196: called it missing.
197: 
198: Downgrading it to `PENDING` would have documented a live blocking gate as
199: absent — understatement of exactly the kind this reconciliation exists to
200: prevent, running backwards. So the check was fixed instead of the record:
201: `gitleaks` stays `ADOPTED` / `BLOCKING_GATE` / `default_enabled: true` and moves
202: from `install_method: system` to `ci-provisioned`, a class the audit verifies
203: against the workflow that installs it. `TASK-AI-35` therefore evaluates
204: replacing a working gate with Betterleaks; it does not install a missing one.
205: 
206: ### The seven that were genuinely absent

209: machine truth; an agent may never flip flags to make an audit pass. The 7
210: genuinely absent entries — six failed gates plus `storybook` — are truthfully
211: downgraded from `ADOPTED` to `PENDING` with `default_enabled: false` and
212: `blocking_policy: "NON_BLOCKING"`, unblocking focused downstream Work Items:

328: ### Beads runs in shadow mode (TASK-AI-33)
329: 
330: `gastownhall/beads` is adopted for multi-agent coordination, but it does not own the dependency graph. `FEATURE-DELIVERY-REGISTER.csv` is the only authority for which Work Item waits on which.
331: 
332: - `node tools/ai-brain/cli.js shadow --project` writes a deterministic projection of the register's graph to a local store (default `.ai-local/shadow/dependency-graph.json`, untracked). `--compare` reports every `MISSING_IN_SHADOW` and `EXTRA_IN_SHADOW` edge by name and exits 1 on any divergence.
333: - Edges are parsed by the reconciler's own `parseDependencies`; there is no second parser.
334: - A shadow pass never writes the register. Each pass hashes the register's bytes before and after and fails if they differ. A divergence is fixed in the shadow or investigated in the register, never resolved by editing the register to match.
335: - The pass is local and offline. The upstream Beads binary is not installed, not required, and not exercised; a green comparison means a projection of the register agrees with the register, not that Beads does.
