337: ## Activation Profiles
338: 
339: Tool usage is governed by 9 task-based activation profiles defined in `tools/ecosystem-profiles.json`:
340: 
341: - `FOUNDATION`: Monorepo structure, tooling baseline, shared packages, repository quality gates.
342: - `BACKEND_FEATURE`: API routes, background workers, database models, transactions, business rule services.
343: - `CARRIER_INTEGRATION`: Carrier connectors, tracking adapters, quote normalization, idempotent webhooks.
344: - `COD_AND_SETTLEMENT`: Three-ledger reconciliation, statement parsing, settlement batches, financial audit.
345: - `UI_FEATURE`: Next.js pages, accessible components, user journeys, responsive layouts, UI state flows.
346: - `SECURITY_REVIEW`: Secret scanning, vulnerability audit, AST patterns, dependency hygiene, tenant boundary checks.
347: - `RESEARCH_ONLY`: Read-only exploration, architecture analysis, documentation, specification research.
348: - `PR_REVIEW`: Independent Codex review, immutable HEAD verification, contract checks, quality gates.
349: - `NIGHTLY_MAINTENANCE`: Scheduled maintenance, dependency health, full secret scans, testkit assertions.
350: 
351: Profiles enforce concurrency limits (maximum 1 implementation author and 1 research agent concurrently; 1 writer per Work Item) and invoke automated post-task cleanup (`Stop-ShipDeOptionalServices`).
352: 
353: ## Ecosystem Policies (`AI-TOOL-01` to `AI-TOOL-15`)
354: 
355: 1. **AI-TOOL-01**: Installed does not imply integrated, enabled or blocking.
356: 2. **AI-TOOL-02**: Optional services and MCP servers are stopped by default and after profile completion.
357: 3. **AI-TOOL-03**: Only one implementation agent and one research agent may run concurrently; the same Work Item never has parallel writers.
358: 4. **AI-TOOL-04**: 9Router is localhost-only, authenticated, request logging/cloud sync off, and never routes Codex review verdicts.
359: 5. **AI-TOOL-05**: Skills/content are commit-pinned, admission-scanned and loaded only by task trigger; no blanket prompt injection.
360: 6. **AI-TOOL-06**: Hermes memory and self-created skills are untrusted until human-reviewed into shipde-brain; no PII or credential persistence.
361: 7. **AI-TOOL-07**: Playwright Test is acceptance evidence; Playwright CLI is token-efficient agent interaction; Playwright MCP is stateful exploration; Chrome DevTools MCP is deep runtime diagnosis.
362: 8. **AI-TOOL-08**: MSW owns behavioral mocks and Prism owns schema validation. Neither silently becomes production carrier evidence.
363: 9. **AI-TOOL-09**: Community Vietnamese address data is a versioned input, not legal or carrier source of truth; import requires provenance and validation.
364: 10. **AI-TOOL-10**: A failed or partial installation reports exact state and rollback; it must not be recorded as installed or healthy.
365: 11. **AI-TOOL-11**: A supplied authoritative version/ref/path is fail closed; no fallback to latest, another branch or a broader filesystem path.
366: 12. **AI-TOOL-12**: GitHub merged state is reconciled by PR identity and merge SHA; repeated synchronization is a no-op and never rewrites unrelated rows.
367: 13. **AI-TOOL-13**: AO is a separately versioned external orchestration runtime with canonical source and health check; it is not counted in `adopted`.
368: 14. **AI-TOOL-14**: TASK-AI-06 through TASK-AI-12 add no repositories or providers. Profile compilation resolves only governed manifest IDs and stops fail-closed when a required capability is absent.
369: 15. **AI-TOOL-15**: The final unattended entrypoint is `control.ps1 -Action Resume`; `Supervise` remains a stage-specific recovery action until TASK-AI-12 completes convergence.
370: 
371: ## Orchestrator Supervisor Policy (`AI-SUP-01` to `AI-SUP-21`)
372: 
373: The deterministic orchestrator supervisor (`scripts/ai/control.ps1 -Action Supervise`) automates routine Work Item processing while preserving human merge authority and fail-closed safety. It is a PowerShell state machine, not an LLM agent loop.
374: 
375: ### Core principles
376: 
377: 1. **AI-SUP-01**: The supervisor is a deterministic PowerShell loop, not an LLM agent.
378: 2. **AI-SUP-02**: Only one Work Item is active at a time; parallel orchestration is not supported.
379: 3. **AI-SUP-03**: The supervisor uses only supported public AO CLI commands; it does not modify AO internals.
380: 4. **AI-SUP-04**: Implementation/test failures are NOT provider failures; they return to the author.
381: 5. **AI-SUP-05**: Governed exact-HEAD auto-merge is authorized only through `TASK-AI-13` under `HUMAN-DECISION-ORCHESTRATOR-CORE-PRIORITY-2026-09-08` after `READY_FOR_HUMAN_MERGE` when strict single-snapshot preflight passes (exact 40-character commit OID, required GitHub Actions `SUCCESS` checks, trusted `chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]` `PASS` verdict, zero unresolved review threads, mergeable status, and `expectedHeadOid` squash mutation); human merge remains required for the bootstrap of TASK-AI-13 itself and whenever any preflight signal fails.
382: 
383: ### 9Router-backed orchestration and lifecycle
384: 
385: 6. **AI-SUP-06**: AO uses its own 9Router profile directory for unattended orchestration, `%USERPROFILE%\.claude-9router` by default (overridable with `-NineRouterProfilePath` or `SHIPDE_NINEROUTER_PROFILE`). The default is never the operator's native `%USERPROFILE%\.claude` Claude Code profile, which a self-test enforces; an explicit override remains an operator decision. The direct `.claude-orchestrator` profile is not used by unattended mode.
386: 7. **AI-SUP-07**: 9Router owns Claude/provider quota fallback below AO; surfaced exhaustion means all approved routes failed and the supervisor stops fail-closed.
387: 8. **AI-SUP-08**: Inactivity timeout is configurable (default 10 minutes).
388: 9. **AI-SUP-09**: Maximum 1 nudge attempt per inactivity window before reporting stalled.
389: 10. **AI-SUP-10**: The supervisor respects existing controller gates (CI must pass, Codex must approve).
390: 11. **AI-SUP-11**: Starting `Supervise` repairs AO runtime drift by relaunching AO through 9Router before consuming a Work Item.
391: 12. **AI-SUP-12**: Manual bootstrap review requires an exact PR number when more than one implementation PR is open.
392: 13. **AI-SUP-13**: AO is an external control layer with pinned provenance and health check; it is never silently counted as an adopted repository/provider.
393: 14. **AI-SUP-14**: Manual bootstrap review uses Codex's non-interactive custom-review contract with machine-readable schema output and parses that contract; stale output is deleted, and the local file never authorizes the supervisor gate.
394: 15. **AI-SUP-15**: An open implementation PR belongs to the active Work Item only when both the Work Item ID and exact governed head branch match; zero, ambiguous, or wrong-branch matches fail closed.
395: 16. **AI-SUP-16**: GitHub check attempts are grouped by name and provider identity; only the unambiguous newest attempt in each group participates, and required gates must come from GitHub Actions.
396: 17. **AI-SUP-17**: An AO review trigger is checkpointed with its timestamp and must reach a supported terminal state within the configured bounded timeout.
397: 18. **AI-SUP-18**: Bounded 9Router error records are diagnostic metadata after a terminal AO state. One failed request never proves that every fallback route was exhausted, and AO session DTO text is not treated as a provider transcript.
398: 19. **AI-SUP-19**: Post-merge synchronization may recover Codex's exact-commit verdict from GitHub's durable Pull Request review collection when the AO session is no longer available.
399: 20. **AI-SUP-20**: The governed launcher and controller prefer semantic build metadata from the live AO CLI matching the manifest pin; when AO reports `dev`, the observed ProductVersion from the canonical executable must match the manifest pin.
400: 21. **AI-SUP-21**: Durable GitHub review evidence is accepted only from the exact allowlisted Codex GitHub App identity `chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]`; review-shaped text from any other author (including the repository owner or PR author) is untrusted. The one exception is the machine-authenticated fallback reviewer `TASK-AI-14` approved, whose verdict is recorded as `FALLBACK_PASS` rather than disguised as Codex, and which is admitted only on the terms `AI-19-R05` states: the reviewer is named in the evidence and the commit it read equals the evidence head. The exception exists because Codex is reachable only through a budget pool that can be exhausted, and a review gate that cannot be reached stops being a gate and becomes a stall; it does not extend to the repository owner or the PR author, who remain untrusted as reviewers of their own work.
401: 
402: ### Provider and harness policy
403: 
404: Unattended AO sessions always use the dedicated 9Router profile directory (`%USERPROFILE%\.claude-9router` by default), whose `env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` is the localhost 9Router endpoint (`http://localhost:20128/v1`). The operator's `%USERPROFILE%\.claude` profile stays natively authenticated Claude Code and must not carry that override, so the two profiles are split; the launcher and the supervisor both resolve the AO profile through `Get-ShipDeNineRouterProfilePath` and validate it through `Assert-ShipDeNineRouterProfileBaseUrl`, which fails closed with an actionable error naming the profile file when `settings.json`, its `env` block, or the base URL is missing or wrong. `Invoke-ShipDeClaudeReviewFallback` is deliberately outside this split: it keeps running under the native login with `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` cleared. The AO profile directory is local machine state created by the operator, never repository state, and no credential is copied into it from the native profile. The direct `%USERPROFILE%\.claude-orchestrator` profile is a separate manual profile reserved for explicit operator diagnosis, not the unattended path. Gemini implementation uses the supported `agy` harness; the unadvertised `gemini` AO harness is not attempted. Cross-harness replacement after 9Router exhausts every approved route belongs to TASK-AI-07 and must preserve the same Work Item, branch, and worktree. Consumer accounts are never aggregated or rotated to bypass provider limits; fallback uses approved providers and credentials within their terms.
405: 
406: ### Transient failure classification
407: 
408: 9Router handles transient provider failures internally. In accordance with AI-SUP-18, bounded 9Router error records are diagnostic metadata captured after a terminal AO state; one failed request never proves that every fallback route was exhausted. If a terminal provider failure or exhaustion reaches the supervisor, delivery stops fail-closed; implementation failures still return to the author:
409: 
410: | Classification            | Trigger failover | Return to author |
411: | ------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------- |
412: | Quota exhausted           | Yes              | No               |
413: | Rate limited (429)        | Yes              | No               |
414: | Authentication error      | Yes (immediate)  | No               |
415: | Model unavailable         | Yes              | No               |
416: | Timeout (>30s)            | Yes              | No               |
417: | Non-zero exit (transient) | Yes              | No               |
418: | Lint/type/test failure    | No               | Yes              |
419: | Assertion failure         | No               | Yes              |
420: | User code exception       | No               | Yes              |
421: 
422: ### TASK-AI-25 — qualifiedRoles feedback rule (2026-09-18)
423: 
424: `TASK-AI-25` records an author-attempt outcome per `accountId::model + role` and may narrow `qualifiedRoles` from measured evidence. The decision rule is the only place that rule lives, in `tools/ai-brain/acceptance/lib/role-feedback.js`. The three aggregates the rule may act on, and only those three, are:
425: 
426: 1. **PASS rate** per merged item over the window (floor 0.5).
427: 2. **Median retries** per merged item over the window (ceiling 3).
428: 3. **Median tokens** per merged item over the window (ceiling 500 000).
429: 
430: A narrowing requires **two of three** breaches in the same window with at least the floor sample count. The rule never narrows on cost, quota percentage, grade, quality, or preference. The rule is narrowing-only: a removed role returns only through `TASK-AI-30` / `TASK-AI-31` re-qualification. Restoration through any other path, including a stale operator-declared entry, is forbidden — staleness is a read-time refusal (`EVIDENCE_STALE`), not a re-add trigger.
431: 
432: ### TASK-AI-31 — Qualification gate grant rule (2026-09-18)
433: 
434: `TASK-AI-31` reads the probe result written by `TASK-AI-30` and grants `qualifiedRoles` into the account registry only when the probe outcome was `pass` and the result is within the grant cache window (4 hours). The grant rule lives in exactly one place: `tools/ai-brain/acceptance/lib/qualification-gate.js`, re-exported by reference from `tools/ai-brain/qualification-gate.js` — never copied.
435: 
436: Four properties make the gate safe:
437: 
438: 1. **Grant is bounded** — the gate adds a role to `qualifiedRoles`; it never removes one (removal is `TASK-AI-25`'s narrowing rule).
439: 2. **Grant requires source** — every written entry carries `{ roleId, grantedAt, source: 'qualification-gate', probeOutcome: 'pass' }` so the origin of every grant is auditable.
440: 3. **Grant is field-constrained** — the gate writes only `qualifiedRoles` and `qualificationHistory`; it never writes grade, quality, preference, limits, tier, cost, capabilities, forbiddenDomains, or any credential.
441: 4. **Grant is outcome-gated** — only `outcome: 'pass'` within the cache window grants; `fail`, `timeout`, `refused` and stale results never grant.
442: 
443: ### TASK-AI-32 — Serena read-only code retrieval pilot (2026-09-20)
444: 
445: `TASK-AI-32` implements the read-only code retrieval pilot for `oraios/serena` under ecosystem profile `RESEARCH_ONLY` and permission boundary `ast-index-read`. The pilot provides authors (Gemini, Claude, 9Router) with symbol and reference lookup rather than loading whole files into context, evaluated against the `TokenPerMergedItem` efficiency metric.
446: 
447: The single-source pilot invariants live in `tools/ai-brain/acceptance/lib/serena-pilot.js` and `tools/ai-brain/serena.js`:
448: 
449: 1. **Read-only invariant (`AI-32-R01`)**: Serena retrieval operations are strictly read-only. Any attempt to pass mutation or write flags (`write: true`, `mutate: true`, `--write`) throws or exits with `MUTATION_REFUSED`.
450: 2. **Source of truth boundary (`AI-32-R02`)**: Serena is a code analysis assistant; output is implementation evidence, never business authority.
451: 3. **TokenPerMergedItem efficiency (`AI-32-R03`)**: Symbol and reference retrieval is measured against full-file context ingestion, targeting prompt token reduction under `TOKENS_PER_MERGED_CEILING` (500,000 tokens from `TASK-AI-25`).
452: 4. **Deterministic extraction (`AI-32-R04`)**: Symbol definitions report accurate line bounds (`startLine`, `endLine`), declarations, and code slices.
453: 5. **Reference resolution (`AI-32-R05`)**: Resolves symbol usages across codebase files.
454: 6. **Fail-closed on missing sources (`AI-32-R06`)**: Non-existent files or directories report `SOURCE_MISSING` and fail gracefully.
455: 
456: 
457: ### Permission boundaries (TASK-AI-10+)
458: 
459: The supervisor operates with least-privilege permissions:
460: 
461: **Allowed (routine operations):**
462: 
463: - Read files and repository state
464: - Run lint, typecheck, test commands
465: - Create commits and push to feature branches
466: - Create and update Pull Requests
467: - Inspect CI status and review comments
468: - Send messages to AO sessions
469: 
470: **Explicitly denied:**
471: 
472: - Auto-merge any Pull Request
473: - Force-push or rewrite history
474: - Delete branches or worktrees destructively
475: - Bypass CI or review gates
476: - Broad unrestricted shell access
477: - Install, remove, or upgrade machine tools
478: 
479: ## Git hook manager: Lefthook (TASK-AI-36)
480: 
481: Git hooks are the developer and agent front line for repository safety: they
482: refuse a commit when another live session already holds the branch (the
483: single-writer invariant, `AI-TOOL-03`) and when a credential has been staged
484: into the git index (`AI-36-R05`). Until this Work Item those hooks depended on
485: a hand-set `core.hooksPath = .githooks` override, which is a per-checkout
486: manual step that fails silently when it is skipped: a checkout with the path
487: set and no `pre-commit` in it commits unguarded, and a checkout with neither
488: has no hook at all.
489: 
490: The override is replaced with Lefthook (`evilmartians/lefthook`), pinned at
491: exact version `1.11.3` as a root devDependency, and configured in
492: version-controlled `lefthook.yml`:
493: 
494: - The `pre-commit` stage declares two commands, run sequentially.
495:   - `writer-claim` runs `node tools/ai-guard/cli.js check` — the same command
496:     the bespoke hook ran, so the guard behaviour is unchanged.
497:   - `staged-secret-scan` runs `node tools/ai-guard/cli.js staged-secrets`, which
498:     reads the git index (not the working tree) and evaluates `.gitleaks.toml`
499:     rules in Node.
500: - The authoritative secret barrier is unchanged: Gitleaks `8.24.0` remains a
501:   blocking CI gate provisioned by the GitHub Actions workflows. The staged
502:   scanner is local defence in depth, and it exists because on a clean Windows
503:   workstation `pnpm security:secrets` answers with operational exit code 2 when
504:   the Gitleaks binary is not on PATH — an answer a pre-commit hook cannot act
505:   on, since it distinguishes neither clean nor leaked.
506: - Installation is explicit, never implicit. Repository supply-chain policy
507:   forbids all four install lifecycle scripts (`preinstall`, `install`,
508:   `postinstall`, `prepare`) in the root and workspace manifests, so `pnpm
509:   install` never registers a hook. The `lefthook` npm package’s own
510:   `postinstall` runs `lefthook install -f`, which is exactly that forbidden
511:   behaviour, so its build script is denied in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
512:   (`lefthook: false`); the binary is still resolved from the pinned
513:   `lefthook-windows-x64` optional dependency. Hook installation stays an
514:   explicit `pnpm lefthook install`, wired into
515:   `scripts/ai/bootstrap-worktrees.ps1`, with the pinned fallback
516:   `npx lefthook@1.11.3 install`. A bare `npx lefthook install` is forbidden
517:   under `AI-TOOL-11` because it would run whatever version the registry serves
518:   today.
519: - `scripts/ai/doctor.ps1` verifies that the binary resolves from the workspace
520:   pin, that the staged scanner answers, that the Lefthook `pre-commit` hook is
521:   installed in the repository’s git common dir, and that no `core.hooksPath`
522:   override is left in place to shadow it.
523: - A deliberate exception stays available and auditable: `git commit --no-verify`
524:   or `LEFTHOOK=0`. Lefthook does not tamper with Git’s own bypass flags
525:   (`AI-36-R07`).
526: 
527: `lefthook` moves from `PENDING` to `ADOPTED` / `BLOCKING_GATE` /
528: `default_enabled: true` in `tools/ecosystem-manifest.json` only because the
529: gating artifact landed in the same change: the exact `"lefthook": "1.11.3"` root
530: devDependency pin that the manifest audit probes as `dependency "lefthook"`
531: (`AI-36-R08`).
532: ## Planner / executor split (TASK-AI-24)
533: 
534: - `tools/ai-brain/scheduler.js` (`planDispatch`) plans and never launches; it references no process-launching API (`AC-AI-24-06`).
535: - `tools/ai-brain/executor.js` (`executePlan`) is the only consumer of a plan and its only side effect is one `ao spawn` per `plan.assignments[]` entry, with the argument vector of `New-ShipDeAoSpawnArguments` in `scripts/ai/control.ps1` (`AC-AI-24-02`), passed as an array without a shell.
536: - Dry run is the default (`node tools/ai-brain/cli.js dispatch`); launching requires `--execute`. Deferred entries and alternatives are never launched, a second writer or an implementation beyond `plan.utilisation.maxImplementation` is refused, and any AO failure is `FAILED`, never `LAUNCHED`, with no in-call retry.
537: - A provider without a harness the controller already uses (`antigravity`/`gemini` → `agy`, `9router`/`anthropic`/`claude` → `claude-code`) is refused as `INCOMPLETE_ASSIGNMENT` rather than guessed.
538: - The controller keeps its own launch path; switching it to the executor is a separate Work Item.
539: 
540: ## Concurrent implementation ceiling decision (TASK-AI-42)
541: 
542: - Under `AI-TOOL-03` and `AGENTS.md` ("Keep one active implementation Work Item until the workflow is proven stable"), the concurrent implementation ceiling is fixed at one (`1`) as a stability measure (`DEC-017`).
543: - Raising the implementation ceiling is a **governed decision, not an unvetted runtime setting**. An operator, caller, or runtime context cannot raise `maxImplementationAgents` via an arbitrary configuration knob.
544: - In `tools/ai-brain/scheduler.js` (`planDispatch`), `maxImplementationAgents` defaults to 1. Any attempt to request `maxImplementationAgents > 1` without an approved governed decision identifier (`DEC-*` or `HUMAN-DECISION-*`) is rejected and clamped to 1, preserving the `AI-TOOL-03` stability measure.
545: - The single-writer invariant (exactly one writer per Work Item / branch) remains absolute and non-configurable, holding permanently even when a governed decision raises concurrency across different Work Items.
546: - In `tools/ai-brain/executor.js` (`executePlan`), `maxImplementation` is read from `plan.utilisation.maxImplementation` (defaulting to 1) and enforces `IMPLEMENTATION_CEILING` on any attempt to exceed it.
547: 
548: ## Spec Kit pattern adoption (TASK-AI-157)
549: 
550: Under operator approval (2026-10-31), Ship Dễ adopts useful specification patterns from [GitHub Spec Kit](https://github.com/github/spec-kit) (MIT License, Copyright (c) GitHub, Inc.) into its existing Work Item workflow as documentation-only standards, without installing Spec Kit tooling, CLI, or altering repository status flows:
551: 
552: 1. **Ambiguity / `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers**: Any ambiguous requirement, rule gap, or unverified assumption must be explicitly tagged. Authors must stop and mark `BLOCKED` rather than guessing.
553: 2. **Pre-implementation Constitution check**: Explicit verification of non-negotiable invariants (tenant scope, RBAC, audit masking, VND integer math, carrier reconciliation, tests at the lowest useful level with test-first ordering for executable acceptance rows and justified non-applicability for non-executable rows).
554: 3. **Numbered task breakdown**: Execution ordered API/backend before UI and test-first for executable acceptance rows, with `[P]` markers indicating parallel-safe independent tasks.
555: 4. **Slice sizing rule**: Each Work Item Pull Request stays a single vertical delivery of ~400 changed lines (API/backend before UI inside the same PR). Work that does not fit is split at planning time into independently scoped prerequisite Work Items, never into horizontal backend/UI slices of one feature.
556: 
557: Upstream CLI and framework tooling remain uninstalled; Ship Dễ's Work Item and Controller workflow remains authoritative.
558: 
559: ## Advisory first-pass PR review: qodo-ai/pr-agent (TASK-AI-156)
560: 
561: Operator approved on 2026-10-31 as an advisory pre-reviewer running via `.github/workflows/pr-agent.yml` and configured at `.pr_agent.toml`.
562: 
563: ### Purpose
564: Provide automated first-pass feedback on Pull Requests across `/review` and `/improve` commands to identify common specification and code quality issues early—such as server-side tenant scoping violations, empty tenant scope bypasses, missing endpoint RBAC guards, unmasked PII or credentials in logs/audit events, floating-point math on VND currency, unreconciled carrier timeout side effects, and lack of test coverage for new behaviors. This surfaces defects before human or independent reviewer cycles, directly cutting down iterative `CHANGES_REQUIRED` rounds.
565: 
566: ### Advisory boundary
567: - **Does not replace independent review:** `pr-agent` is strictly advisory. It never replaces the independent Codex-family review (or authorized Claude fallback) mandated by `AGENTS.md` and `AI-SUP-21`. The official merge gate remains the independent review-only Codex task returning `PASS`.
568: - **Non-blocking gate isolation:** The workflow runs with `continue-on-error: true` and a 20-minute timeout. It is not added to required GitHub Actions status checks and can never block a PR merge or controller progression.
569: - **Strict least-privilege permissions:** Workflow permissions are strictly limited to `contents: read` and `pull-requests: write`.
570: 
571: ### Operator secrets and configuration
572: The action connects to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint using credentials provided exclusively via repository secrets. No model or API key is hardcoded in repository files. The operator must configure the following repository secrets in GitHub:
573: - `PR_AGENT_API_BASE`: The base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API endpoint (e.g., `https://api.openai.com/v1` or an approved gateway URL).
574: - `PR_AGENT_API_KEY`: The API key or token for authenticating against the endpoint.
575: - `PR_AGENT_MODEL`: The model name to execute reviews and suggestions (e.g., `gpt-4o`, `gpt-4o-mini`, or provider model ID).
576: 
577: If any of these secrets are absent, or if the Pull Request originates from a fork, `.github/workflows/pr-agent.yml` skips execution cleanly, posts an informational notice, and completes successfully without failing.
578: 
579: ## Focused context packing: yamadashy/repomix (TASK-AI-158)
580: 
581: Operator approved on 2026-11-01. Ship Dễ uses [repomix](https://github.com/yamadashy/repomix) (MIT License) as a root devDependency to pack a focused, token-budgeted repository context for writer and reviewer prompts.
582: 
583: ### Purpose
584: 
585: A full-tree prompt wastes quota and review rounds. `pnpm ai:pack` packs only the paths that matter for one prompt (for example the files in a Pull Request diff plus its Work Item) into one XML file, with a hard token ceiling, so the next writer or reviewer turn stays smaller and still complete.
586: 
587: ### Usage
588: 
589: ```bash
590: pnpm ai:pack -- --paths "apps/api/src/**/*.ts,docs/product-spec/work-items/TASK-AI-158.md" --out .oc/context.xml --max-tokens 40000
591: ```
592: 
593: The command prints only a summary (`files`, estimated tokens, output path). It never prints packed file contents. It exits non-zero when the pack exceeds `--max-tokens` or when repomix's built-in secret check finds anything. Root `repomix.config.json` keeps comments, includes `apps/**`, `packages/**`, `prisma/**` and `docs/product-spec/docs/**`, and ignores `node_modules`, lockfiles, build output, `.worktrees`, `.env*`, secrets, generated clients, test snapshots and binary assets.
594: 
595: ### Secrets
596: 
597: The pack never includes secrets or `.env` files. Ignore patterns drop every `.env` variant at the root and in nested directories, including `.env.example`, with no exception. The nested pattern is `**/**/.env*` because repomix 1.18.1 rewrites `**/.env*` as a directory-only pattern. Key and certificate files are also ignored, and `security.enableSecurityCheck` is on. A secret hit fails the command.
598: 
599: ### Boundary
600: 
601: Advisory tooling only. A packed context does not change a gate, an allowlist, a baseline, a review verdict or the status flow. Authors and reviewers still read the Work Item and the source specifications.
602: ## Affected-only PR CI caching and merge queue (TASK-AI-165)
603: 
604: Operator explicitly approved modifying `.github/` for this item on 2026-11-02.
605: 
606: ### What Changed
607: 1. **Affected-only PR CI with Turborepo**:
608:    - In `.github/workflows/current-application.yml`, configured `actions/checkout` with `fetch-depth: 0`, cached pnpm store (`pnpm/action-setup` before `actions/setup-node` with `cache: pnpm`), and restored Turborepo filesystem cache via `actions/cache@v4` on `.turbo`.
609:    - On `pull_request` events, runs `turbo run lint typecheck test build --affected` with `TURBO_SCM_BASE = ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}`, followed by root scripts linting (`pnpm exec eslint scripts`).
610:    - On `push` to `main` and on `merge_group` events, executes full non-affected runs (`pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`) to guarantee complete mainline integrity.
611:    - Preserves all required status check job names (`application-gate`, `contract`) and required verification steps (Prisma client generation, migrations, database services, integration tests, contract verification, secrets scanning, ast-grep, formatting negative proofs).
612: 2. **Merge queue triggers**:
613:    - Added `merge_group` trigger to both workflows that provide required status checks:
614:      - `.github/workflows/current-application.yml` (provides required status check `application-gate`)
615:      - `.github/workflows/feature-contract-gate.yml` (provides required status check `contract`)
616:    - Added `push: branches: [main]` trigger to `.github/workflows/current-application.yml` to ensure Turborepo cache is populated on main and master runs are validated.
617: 
618: ### Expected Effect
619: - **Substantially faster PR verification**: Rather than running full lint, typecheck, test, and build across all monorepo packages, PR CI runs only against packages directly affected by the PR diff relative to the PR base commit (`TURBO_SCM_BASE`), reducing CI duration and worker waiting times.
620: - **Cache reuse**: Monorepo package outputs and hashes are cached in `.turbo`, allowing unchanged dependencies to be restored instantly.
621: - **Concurrent agent PR throughput**: GitHub Merge Queue allows concurrent agent PRs to be queued and validated in parallel against speculative merged results without serial human rebase bottlenecks.
622: - **Zero weakening of required gates**: Required status checks (`application-gate` and `contract`) remain strictly enforced with identical names.
623: 
624: ### Operator Step to Enable Merge Queue in Branch Protection
625: To enable the merge queue in GitHub repository settings (not executed by this PR):
626: 1. Navigate to repository settings on GitHub: **Settings > Branches**.
627: 2. Under **Branch protection rules**, edit the rule for branch `main`.
628: 3. Check the box **Require merge queue**.
629: 4. Configure merge queue parameters:
630:    - **Merge method**: Squash and merge.
631:    - **Build concurrency**: 2 to 5 (adjust based on GitHub Actions concurrency limit).
632:    - **Minimum / Maximum pull requests to merge**: 1 to 5.
633:    - **Status checks**: Ensure required checks `contract` and `application-gate` are selected.
634: 5. Save changes.
</file>

<file path="scripts/ai/pack-context.mjs">
  1: #!/usr/bin/env node
  2: 'use strict';
  3: 
  4: /**
  5:  * Ship Dễ — Pack focused repo context with repomix (TASK-AI-158)
  6:  *
  7:  * Reference: github.com/yamadashy/repomix (MIT License) - options, security check and output path handling
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
 11: import fs from 'node:fs';
 12: import path from 'node:path';
 13: import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
 14: 
 15: import { parseArgs, sameFileIdentity } from './parse-args.mjs';
 16: import {
 17:   ALLOWED_OUTPUT_DIR,
 18:   DEFAULT_OUTPUT_FILE,
 19:   resolveExistingAncestorsAndAliases,
 20:   validateOutputPath,
 21: } from './output-path.mjs';
 22: import {
 23:   estimateTokens,
 24:   looksLikeSecretFailure,
 25:   looksLikeBudgetFailure,
 26:   resolveRepomixEntry,
 27:   loadBaseConfig,
 28:   buildFocusedConfig,
 29:   combinedOutput,
 30: } from './config.mjs';
 31: import { countFiles, publishOutput } from './publish.mjs';
 32: 
 33: export {
 34:   parseArgs,
 35:   sameFileIdentity,
 36:   ALLOWED_OUTPUT_DIR,
 37:   DEFAULT_OUTPUT_FILE,
 38:   resolveExistingAncestorsAndAliases,
 39:   validateOutputPath,
 40:   estimateTokens,
 41:   looksLikeSecretFailure,
 42:   looksLikeBudgetFailure,
 43:   resolveRepomixEntry,
 44:   loadBaseConfig,
 45:   buildFocusedConfig,
 46:   combinedOutput,
 47:   countFiles,
 48:   publishOutput,
 49: };
 50: 
 51: const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
 52: const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
 53: const REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
 54: 
 55: export function runRepomix({ root, paths, maxTokens }) {
 56:   const entry = resolveRepomixEntry(root);
 57:   const tmpDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(root, '.repomix-tmp-'));
 58:   const tempOutputFile = path.join(tmpDir, 'repomix-output.xml');
 59:   const tmpConfigPath = path.join(tmpDir, 'config.json');
 60: 
 61:   try {
 62:     const config = buildFocusedConfig(loadBaseConfig(root), paths, tempOutputFile);
 63:     fs.writeFileSync(tmpConfigPath, JSON.stringify(config, null, 2), 'utf8');
 64: 
 65:     const args = [entry, '--config', tmpConfigPath];
 66:     if (maxTokens !== null) {
 67:       args.push('--token-budget', String(maxTokens));
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     const stdout = execFileSync(process.execPath, args, {
 71:       cwd: root,
 72:       encoding: 'utf8',
 73:       stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
 74:       timeout: 120_000,
 75:       windowsHide: true,
 76:     });
 77:     if (looksLikeSecretFailure(stdout)) {
 78:       throw new Error('secret-check');
 79:     }
 80:     if (!fs.existsSync(tempOutputFile)) {
 81:       throw new Error('output-missing');
 82:     }
 83:     return { tmpDir, tempOutputFile };
 84:   } catch (err) {
 85:     fs.rmSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
 86:     if (err.message === 'secret-check') throw err;
 87:     if (err.message === 'output-missing') throw err;
 88:     const text = combinedOutput(err);
 89:     if (looksLikeSecretFailure(text)) throw new Error('secret-check');
 90:     if (looksLikeBudgetFailure(text)) throw new Error('token-budget');
 91:     const error = new Error('repomix-failed');
 92:     error.exitCode = err.status ?? null;
 93:     throw error;
 94:   }
 95: }
 96: 
 97: export async function main(argv, options = {}) {
 98:   const root = options.root ? path.resolve(options.root) : REPO_ROOT;
 99:   const log = options.log || ((line) => console.log(line));
100:   const logError = options.logError || ((line) => console.error(line));
101: 
102:   let args;
103:   try {
104:     args = parseArgs(argv);
105:   } catch (err) {
106:     logError(`[pack-context] ERROR: ${err.message}`);
107:     logError(
108:       'Usage: node scripts/ai/pack-context.mjs --paths <glob,...> --out <file> [--max-tokens N]',
109:     );
110:     return 1;
111:   }
112: 
113:   let outputPath;
114:   try {
115:     outputPath = validateOutputPath(root, args.out, args.paths);
116:   } catch (err) {
117:     logError(`[pack-context] ERROR: ${err.message}`);
118:     return 1;
119:   }
120: 
121:   let repomixResult;
122:   try {
123:     repomixResult = runRepomix({
124:       root,
125:       paths: args.paths,
126:       maxTokens: args.maxTokens,
127:     });
128:   } catch (err) {
129:     if (err.message === 'secret-check') {
130:       logError('[pack-context] FAIL: repomix security check found suspicious content.');
131:       logError('[pack-context] Review the flagged files before packing.');
132:       return 1;
133:     }
134:     if (err.message === 'token-budget') {
135:       logError(
136:         `[pack-context] FAIL: packed output exceeds --max-tokens ${args.maxTokens}.`,
137:       );
138:       logError('[pack-context] Narrow --paths or raise the limit.');
139:       return 1;
140:     }
141:     const detail =
142:       err.exitCode !== null && err.exitCode !== undefined
143:         ? ` (exit code ${err.exitCode})`
144:         : err.message && err.message !== 'repomix-failed'
145:           ? `: ${err.message}`
146:           : '';
147:     logError(`[pack-context] ERROR: repomix failed${detail}.`);
148:     return 1;
149:   }
150: 
151:   const { tmpDir, tempOutputFile } = repomixResult;
152:   try {
153:     publishOutput(tempOutputFile, outputPath, options);
154:   } catch (err) {
155:     logError(`[pack-context] ERROR: failed to publish output: ${err.message}`);
156:     return 1;
157:   } finally {
158:     fs.rmSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
159:   }
160: 
161:   if (!fs.existsSync(outputPath)) {
162:     logError(`[pack-context] ERROR: repomix did not create output file: ${args.out}`);
163:     return 1;
164:   }
165: 
166:   const stat = fs.statSync(outputPath);
167:   const tokens = estimateTokens(stat.size);
168:   const fileCount = countFiles(fs.readFileSync(outputPath, 'utf8'));
169: 
170:   log(`[pack-context] OK: ${fileCount} files, ~${tokens} tokens, ${args.out}`);
171:   return 0;
172: }
173: 
174: const isMain = process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === path.resolve(__filename);
175: if (isMain) {
176:   main(process.argv.slice(2)).then((code) => process.exit(code));
177: }
</file>

 34: /**
 35:  * Shared helper to verify if a user status string represents an active account.
 36:  * Case-insensitive comparison matching DATA-DICTIONARY ('ACTIVE') and legacy/in-flight ('active').
 37:  * AC-USR-01-17 / DATA-DICTIONARY User.status
 38:  */
 39: export function isActiveStatus(status?: string | null): boolean {
 40:   return typeof status === 'string' && status.trim().toLowerCase() === 'active';
 41: }

567:   WAREHOUSE_CODE_EXISTS: 'WAREHOUSE_CODE_EXISTS',
568:   WAREHOUSE_SCOPE_UNAUTHORIZED: 'WAREHOUSE_SCOPE_UNAUTHORIZED',
569:   FORBIDDEN: 'FORBIDDEN',
570:   VALIDATION_ERROR: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',

574: export type Warehouse = components['schemas']['Warehouse'];
575: export type CreateWarehouseInput = components['schemas']['CreateWarehouseInput'];
576: export type UpdateWarehouseInput = components['schemas']['UpdateWarehouseInput'];
577: export type WarehouseResponse = components['schemas']['WarehouseResponse'];
578: export type ListWarehousesResponse = components['schemas']['ListWarehousesResponse'];
579: 
580: export const WAREHOUSE_CODE_REGEX = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,64}$/;
581: export const WAREHOUSE_PHONE_REGEX = /^(0|\+84)[35789][0-9]{8}$/;
582: export const WAREHOUSE_CUTOFF_TIME_REGEX = /^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$/;
583: export const ALLOWED_WAREHOUSE_PAPER_SIZES = ['A6', 'A5', 'A4', 'K80'] as const;
584: export const ALLOWED_WAREHOUSE_DPIS = [203, 300] as const;
585: 
586: export function isValidWarehouseCode(code: unknown): boolean {
587:   if (typeof code !== 'string') return false;
588:   return WAREHOUSE_CODE_REGEX.test(code.trim());
589: }
590: 
591: export function isValidWarehousePhone(phone: unknown): boolean {
592:   if (typeof phone !== 'string') return false;
593:   const cleanPhone = phone.trim().replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
594:   return WAREHOUSE_PHONE_REGEX.test(cleanPhone);
595: }
596: 
597: export function isValidCutoffTime(time: unknown): boolean {
598:   if (!time || typeof time !== 'string') return false;
599:   return WAREHOUSE_CUTOFF_TIME_REGEX.test(time.trim());
600: }
601: 
602: export interface WarehouseFormState {
603:   name: string;
604:   code: string;
605:   status: 'active' | 'inactive';
606:   is_default: boolean;
607:   contact_name: string;
608:   contact_phone: string;
609:   contact_email: string;
610:   address_line: string;
611:   ward: string;
612:   district: string;
613:   city: string;
614:   postal_code: string;
615:   use_different_return_address: boolean;
616:   return_contact_name: string;
617:   return_contact_phone: string;
618:   return_address_line: string;
619:   return_ward: string;
620:   return_district: string;
621:   return_city: string;
622:   cutoff_time: string;
623:   schedule_notes: string;
624:   printer_paper_size: 'A6' | 'A5' | 'A4' | 'K80';
625:   printer_dpi: 203 | 300;
626:   printer_name: string;
627:   printer_auto_print: boolean;
628: }
629: 
630: export function validateWarehouseForm(form: WarehouseFormState): {
631:   isValid: boolean;
632:   errors: Record<string, string>;
633: } {
634:   const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
635: 
636:   if (!form.name || form.name.trim().length < 2) {
637:     errors.name = 'Tên kho hàng là bắt buộc và phải có ít nhất 2 ký tự';
638:   } else if (form.name.trim().length > 255) {
639:     errors.name = 'Tên kho hàng không được vượt quá 255 ký tự';
640:   }
641: 
642:   if (form.code && form.code.trim().length > 0) {
643:     if (!isValidWarehouseCode(form.code)) {
644:       errors.code = 'Mã kho hàng phải từ 2 đến 64 ký tự (chữ cái, số, "-" hoặc "_")';
645:     }
646:   }
647: 
648:   if (!form.contact_name || form.contact_name.trim().length < 2) {
649:     errors.contact_name = 'Tên người liên hệ kho là bắt buộc và phải từ 2 đến 255 ký tự';
650:   } else if (form.contact_name.trim().length > 255) {
651:     errors.contact_name = 'Tên người liên hệ kho không được vượt quá 255 ký tự';
652:   }
653: 
654:   if (!form.contact_phone || !isValidWarehousePhone(form.contact_phone)) {
655:     errors.contact_phone = 'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ theo định dạng Việt Nam';
656:   }
657: 
658:   if (form.contact_email && form.contact_email.trim().length > 0) {
659:     const trimmed = form.contact_email.trim();
660:     if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmed) || trimmed.length > 255) {
661:       errors.contact_email = 'Email liên hệ không đúng định dạng';
662:     }
663:   }
664: 
665:   if (!form.address_line || form.address_line.trim().length < 3) {
666:     errors.address_line = 'Địa chỉ lấy hàng phải từ 3 đến 500 ký tự';
667:   } else if (form.address_line.trim().length > 500) {
668:     errors.address_line = 'Địa chỉ lấy hàng không được vượt quá 500 ký tự';
669:   }
670: 
671:   if (!form.district || form.district.trim().length === 0) {
672:     errors.district = 'Quận/Huyện lấy hàng không được để trống';
673:   }
674: 
675:   if (!form.city || form.city.trim().length === 0) {
676:     errors.city = 'Tỉnh/Thành phố lấy hàng không được để trống';
677:   }
678: 
679:   if (form.use_different_return_address) {
680:     if (!form.return_contact_name || form.return_contact_name.trim().length < 2) {
681:       errors.return_contact_name = 'Tên người nhận hoàn là bắt buộc';
682:     } else if (form.return_contact_name.trim().length > 255) {
683:       errors.return_contact_name = 'Tên người nhận hoàn không được vượt quá 255 ký tự';
684:     }
685: 
686:     if (!form.return_contact_phone || !isValidWarehousePhone(form.return_contact_phone)) {
687:       errors.return_contact_phone = 'Số điện thoại nhận hoàn không hợp lệ theo định dạng Việt Nam';
688:     }
689: 
690:     if (!form.return_address_line || form.return_address_line.trim().length < 3) {
691:       errors.return_address_line = 'Địa chỉ nhận hoàn là bắt buộc';
692:     } else if (form.return_address_line.trim().length > 500) {
693:       errors.return_address_line = 'Địa chỉ nhận hoàn không được vượt quá 500 ký tự';
694:     }
695: 
696:     if (!form.return_district || form.return_district.trim().length === 0) {
697:       errors.return_district = 'Quận/Huyện nhận hoàn không được để trống';
698:     }
699: 
700:     if (!form.return_city || form.return_city.trim().length === 0) {
701:       errors.return_city = 'Tỉnh/Thành phố nhận hoàn không được để trống';
702:     }
703:   }
704: 
705:   if (form.cutoff_time && form.cutoff_time.trim().length > 0) {
706:     if (!isValidCutoffTime(form.cutoff_time)) {
707:       errors.cutoff_time = 'Giờ cắt ca lấy hàng phải có định dạng HH:mm (ví dụ: 16:00)';
708:     }
709:   }
710: 
711:   if (form.printer_paper_size && !ALLOWED_WAREHOUSE_PAPER_SIZES.includes(form.printer_paper_size)) {
712:     errors.printer_paper_size = `Khổ giấy in không hợp lệ. Cho phép: ${ALLOWED_WAREHOUSE_PAPER_SIZES.join(', ')}`;
713:   }
714: 
715:   if (form.printer_dpi && !ALLOWED_WAREHOUSE_DPIS.includes(form.printer_dpi)) {
716:     errors.printer_dpi = `Độ phân giải máy in không hợp lệ. Cho phép: ${ALLOWED_WAREHOUSE_DPIS.join(', ')}`;
717:   }
718: 
719:   return {
720:     isValid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0,
721:     errors,
722:   };
723: }

725: // --- Canonical Timezones (FEAT-ORG-01) ---
726: export interface SupportedTimeZoneOption {
727:   value: string;
728:   label: string;
729: }
730: 
731: export const SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES: readonly SupportedTimeZoneOption[] = [
732:   { value: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', label: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh (UTC+7)' },
733:   { value: 'UTC', label: 'UTC (UTC+0)' },
734: ] as const;
735: 
736: export const SUPPORTED_TIMEZONE_VALUES: readonly string[] = SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES.map(
737:   (tz) => tz.value
738: );
739: 
740: export function isValidTimeZone(tz: unknown): boolean {
741:   if (!tz || typeof tz !== 'string') return false;
742:   const trimmed = tz.trim();
743:   if (!SUPPORTED_TIMEZONE_VALUES.includes(trimmed)) return false;
744:   try {
745:     new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { timeZone: trimmed });
746:     return true;
747:   } catch {
748:     return false;
749:   }
750: }

903: export type ListBranchesResponse = components['schemas']['ListBranchesResponse'];

906: export const BRANCH_CODE_REGEX = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,64}$/;
907: export const VIETNAMESE_PHONE_REGEX = /^(0|\+84)[35789][0-9]{8}$/;
908: 
909: export function isValidBranchCode(code: unknown): boolean {
910:   if (typeof code !== 'string') return false;
911:   return BRANCH_CODE_REGEX.test(code.trim());
912: }
913: 
914: export function isValidBranchPhone(phone: unknown): boolean {
915:   if (typeof phone !== 'string') return false;
916:   const cleanPhone = phone.trim().replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
917:   return cleanPhone.length === 0 || VIETNAMESE_PHONE_REGEX.test(cleanPhone);
918: }

920: export interface BranchFormState {
921:   name: string;
922:   code: string;
923:   address: string;
924:   phone: string;
925:   is_default: boolean;
926:   status: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE';
927: }
928: 
929: export function validateBranchForm(form: BranchFormState): {
930:   isValid: boolean;
931:   errors: Record<string, string>;
932: } {
933:   const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
934: 
935:   if (!form.name || form.name.trim().length < 2) {
936:     errors.name = 'Tên chi nhánh là bắt buộc và phải có ít nhất 2 ký tự';
937:   } else if (form.name.trim().length > 255) {
938:     errors.name = 'Tên chi nhánh không được vượt quá 255 ký tự';
939:   }
940: 
941:   if (!form.code || !isValidBranchCode(form.code)) {
942:     errors.code = 'Mã chi nhánh là bắt buộc, từ 2 đến 64 ký tự (chữ, số, "-" hoặc "_")';
943:   }
944: 
945:   if (form.address && form.address.trim().length > 1000) {
946:     errors.address = 'Địa chỉ chi nhánh không được vượt quá 1000 ký tự';
947:   }
948: 
949:   if (form.phone && form.phone.trim()) {
950:     const cleanPhone = form.phone.trim().replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
951:     if (!VIETNAMESE_PHONE_REGEX.test(cleanPhone)) {
952:       errors.phone = 'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ theo định dạng Việt Nam';
953:     }
954:   }
955: 
956:   if (form.status && form.status !== 'ACTIVE' && form.status !== 'INACTIVE') {
957:     errors.status = 'Trạng thái chi nhánh chỉ có thể là ACTIVE hoặc INACTIVE';
958:   }
959: 
960:   return {
961:     isValid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0,
962:     errors,
963:   };
964: }

   2: // Ship Dễ — Database Schema for PostgreSQL 16+ (Tập 1, 2, 4)
   3: // Thiết kế bảo đảm: Append-only Events, Multi-tenant Isolation, Immutable Audits,
   4: // Maker-Checker Segregation, 6 Discrepancy Rules & Optimistic Locking.
   5: // ============================================================================
   6: 
   7: datasource db {
   8:   provider = "postgresql"
   9:   url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
  10: }
  11: 
  12: generator client {
  13:   provider = "prisma-client-js"
  14: }
  15: 
  16: enum RoleEnum {
  17:   OWNER
  18:   OPS_CSKH
  19:   WAREHOUSE
  20:   ACCOUNTANT
  21:   PLATFORM_ADMIN
  22: }
  23: 
  24: enum CarrierCodeEnum {
  25:   GHN
  26:   GHTK
  27:   VIETTEL_POST
  28:   JT
  29: }
  30: 
  31: enum CarrierTierEnum {
  32:   L0_OBSERVE
  33:   L1_ASSIST
  34:   L2_EXECUTE
  35: }
  36: 
  37: enum ShipmentStatusEnum {
  38:   DRAFT
  39:   PICKING
  40:   IN_TRANSIT
  41:   OUT_FOR_DELIVERY
  42:   DELIVERED
  43:   RETURNING
  44:   RETURNED
  45:   CANCELLED
  46:   LOST
  47:   DAMAGED
  48: }
  49: 
  50: enum ExceptionTypeEnum {
  51:   PICKUP_DELAY
  52:   STUCK_IN_TRANSIT
  53:   DELIVERY_FAIL
  54:   STATUS_MISMATCH
  55: }
  56: 
  57: enum ExceptionCaseStatusEnum {
  58:   OPEN
  59:   ASSIGNED
  60:   CONTACTING
  61:   WAITING_CUSTOMER
  62:   REATTEMPT_REQUESTED
  63:   WAITING_REATTEMPT
  64:   RESCUED
  65:   RETURNING
  66:   RETURNED
  67:   UNRESOLVED
  68: }
  69: 
  70: enum MatchingStatusEnum {
  71:   MATCHED_EXACT
  72:   MATCHED_FUZZY
  73:   UNMATCHED
  74:   AMBIGUOUS
  75: }
  76: 
  77: enum DiscrepancyTypeEnum {
  78:   D1_WEIGHT
  79:   D2_FREIGHT
  80:   D3_SURCHARGE
  81:   D4_DUPLICATE
  82:   D5_COD_MISMATCH
  83:   D6_OVERDUE_COD
  84:   D7_MISSING
  85: }
  86: 
  87: enum DiscrepancyStatusEnum {
  88:   OPEN
  89:   CONFIRMED
  90:   DISPUTED
  91:   WAIVED
  92:   CARRIED_FORWARD
  93:   RESOLVED
  94: }
  95: 
  96: enum ClaimStatusEnum {
  97:   DRAFT
  98:   SUBMITTED
  99:   IN_REVIEW
 100:   ACCEPTED
 101:   REJECTED
 102:   CLOSED
 103: }
 104: 
 105: enum SessionStatusEnum {
 106:   ACTIVE
 107:   REVOKED
 108:   EXPIRED
 109:   INACTIVE
 110: }
 111: 
 112: enum InvitationStatusEnum {
 113:   PENDING
 114:   ACCEPTED
 115:   EXPIRED
 116:   CANCELLED
 117: }
 118: 
 119: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 120: // 1. IAM & Multi-tenant Organization
 121: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 122: 
 123: model Merchant {
 124:   id                String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 125:   name              String            @db.VarChar(255)
 126:   code              String            @unique @db.VarChar(64)
 127:   status            String            @default("active") @db.VarChar(32)
 128:   created_at        DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 129:   updated_at        DateTime          @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz
 130: 
 131:   // Shop profile (FEAT-ORG-01: legal, billing, and operating defaults)
 132:   legal_name          String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 133:   tax_code            String?           @db.VarChar(32)
 134:   contact_email       String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 135:   contact_phone       String?           @db.VarChar(32)
 136:   legal_address       String?           @db.Text
 137:   billing_email       String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 138:   billing_address     String?           @db.Text
 139:   bank_name           String?           @db.VarChar(128)
 140:   bank_account_number String?           @db.VarChar(64)
 141:   bank_account_name   String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 142:   bank_branch         String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 143:   timezone            String            @default("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh") @db.VarChar(64)
 144:   currency            String            @default("VND") @db.VarChar(16)
 145:   default_fee_payer   String            @default("SHOP") @db.VarChar(32)
 146:   default_weight_unit String            @default("g") @db.VarChar(16)
 147:   auto_routing_enabled Boolean          @default(false)
 148:   operating_notes     String?           @db.VarChar(1000)
 149: 
 150:   users             User[]
 151:   carrier_accounts  CarrierAccount[]
 152:   rate_cards        RateCard[]
 153:   orders            Order[]
 154:   shipments         Shipment[]
 155:   exception_cases   ExceptionCase[]
 156:   return_records    ReturnRecord[]
 157:   statements        CarrierStatement[]
 158:   discrepancies     Discrepancy[]
 159:   claims            Claim[]
 160:   audit_logs        AuditLog[]
 161:   device_sessions   DeviceSession[]
 162:   mfa_factors       MfaFactor[]
 163:   mfa_challenges    MfaChallenge[]
 164:   mfa_admin_reset_idempotency MfaAdminResetIdempotency[]
 165:   invitations       Invitation[]
 166:   roles             Role[]
 167:   onboarding_state  OnboardingState?
 168:   branches          Branch[]
 169:   warehouses        Warehouse[]
 170: 
 171:   @@index([tax_code])
 172:   @@map("merchants")
 173: }
 174: 
 175: model OnboardingState {
 176:   id              String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 177:   merchant_id     String            @unique @db.Uuid
 178:   status          String            @default("IN_PROGRESS") @db.VarChar(32)
 179:   current_step    String            @default("SHOP_PROFILE") @db.VarChar(64)
 180:   completed_steps String[]          @default([])
 181:   skipped_steps   String[]          @default([])
 182:   step_data       Json?             @db.JsonB
 183:   reset_at        DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 184:   completed_at    DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 185:   created_at      DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 186:   updated_at      DateTime          @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz
 187: 
 188:   merchant        Merchant          @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 189: 
 190:   @@index([merchant_id, status])
 191:   @@map("onboarding_states")
 192: }
 193: 
 194: model Branch {
 195:   id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 196:   merchant_id String   @db.Uuid
 197:   name        String   @db.VarChar(255)
 198:   code        String   @db.VarChar(64)
 199:   address     String?  @db.Text
 200:   phone       String?  @db.VarChar(32)
 201:   is_default  Boolean  @default(false)
 202:   status      String   @default("ACTIVE") @db.VarChar(32)
 203:   created_at  DateTime @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 204:   updated_at  DateTime @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz
 205: 
 206:   merchant    Merchant @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 207: 
 208:   @@unique([merchant_id, code])
 209:   @@index([merchant_id, status])
 210:   @@map("branches")
 211: }
 212: model User {
 213:   id                String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 214:   merchant_id       String?           @db.Uuid
 215:   email             String?           @unique @db.VarChar(255)
 216:   phone             String?           @unique @db.VarChar(32)
 217:   full_name         String            @db.VarChar(255)
 218:   password_hash     String            @db.VarChar(255)
 219:   role              RoleEnum
 220:   store_scopes            String[]          @default([])
 221:   warehouse_scopes        String[]          @default([])
 222:   carrier_account_scopes  String[]          @default([])
 223:   status            String            @default("pending_verification") @db.VarChar(32)
 224:   email_verified_at DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 225:   phone_verified_at DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 226:   terms_accepted_at DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 227:   terms_version     String?           @db.VarChar(32)
 228:   // Database-ownership / BR-RBAC-04: FK users_custom_role_id_fkey is defined authoritatively in migration.sql as
 229:   // ON DELETE NO ACTION DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED (so merchant cascade and in-use role delete have one defined outcome).
 230:   // Kept unmanaged by Prisma relation to ensure prisma db push / migrate diff cannot replace or drop the deferrable constraint.
 231:   custom_role_id    String?           @db.Uuid
 232:   avatar_url        String?           @db.VarChar(512)
 233:   language          String            @default("vi") @db.VarChar(10)
 234:   timezone          String            @default("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh") @db.VarChar(64)
 235:   notification_preferences Json?          @db.JsonB
 236:   default_warehouse_id String?          @db.Uuid
 237:   created_at        DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 238:   updated_at        DateTime          @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz
 239: 
 240:   merchant              Merchant?             @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 241:   assigned_cases        ExceptionCase[]       @relation("CaseAssignee")
 242:   contact_logs          ExceptionContactLog[]
 243:   device_sessions       DeviceSession[]
 244:   verification_tokens   VerificationToken[]
 245:   password_reset_tokens PasswordResetToken[]
 246:   mfa_factors           MfaFactor[]
 247:   mfa_challenges        MfaChallenge[]
 248:   invitations_sent      Invitation[]          @relation("InvitationsSent")
 249: 
 250:   @@index([merchant_id, role])
 251:   @@index([merchant_id, custom_role_id])
 252:   @@map("users")
 253: }
 254: 
 255: model VerificationToken {
 256:   id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 257:   user_id     String    @db.Uuid
 258:   token       String    @unique @db.VarChar(255)
 259:   channel     String    @db.VarChar(16)
 260:   identifier  String    @db.VarChar(255)
 261:   otp         String?   @db.VarChar(64)
 262:   // FEAT-AUTH-03: VERIFICATION tokens activate an account; LOGIN tokens authorize an OTP login.
 263:   purpose     String    @default("VERIFICATION") @db.VarChar(32)
 264:   expires_at  DateTime  @db.Timestamptz
 265:   consumed_at DateTime? @db.Timestamptz
 266:   created_at  DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 267: 
 268:   user        User      @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 269: 
 270:   @@index([user_id])
 271:   @@index([identifier, channel])
 272:   @@index([purpose])
 273:   @@map("verification_tokens")
 274: }
 275: 
 276: model PasswordResetToken {
 277:   id           String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 278:   user_id      String    @db.Uuid
 279:   token        String    @unique @db.VarChar(255)
 280:   channel      String    @db.VarChar(16)
 281:   identifier   String    @db.VarChar(255)
 282:   expires_at   DateTime  @db.Timestamptz
 283:   consumed_at  DateTime? @db.Timestamptz
 284:   created_at   DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 285: 
 286:   user         User      @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 287: 
 288:   @@index([user_id])
 289:   @@index([identifier, channel])
 290:   @@map("password_reset_tokens")
 291: }
 292: 
 293: model Invitation {
 294:   id                 String               @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 295:   merchant_id        String               @db.Uuid
 296:   email              String?              @db.VarChar(255)
 297:   phone              String?              @db.VarChar(32)
 298:   role               RoleEnum
 299:   store_scopes            String[]             @default([])
 300:   warehouse_scopes        String[]             @default([])
 301:   carrier_account_scopes  String[]             @default([])
 302:   token_hash         String               @unique @db.VarChar(255)
 303:   status             InvitationStatusEnum @default(PENDING)
 304:   invited_by_user_id String?              @db.Uuid
 305:   expires_at         DateTime             @db.Timestamptz
 306:   consumed_at        DateTime?            @db.Timestamptz
 307:   created_at         DateTime             @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 308:   updated_at         DateTime             @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz
 309: 
 310:   merchant           Merchant             @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 311:   invited_by         User?                @relation("InvitationsSent", fields: [invited_by_user_id], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
 312: 
 313:   // Authoritative schema & migration path (Round 6 Finding 8 / BR-INV-08) (Round 10 Finding 1):
 314:   // Partial unique indexes "invitations_merchant_pending_email_unique" and
 315:   // "invitations_merchant_pending_phone_unique" (WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND email/phone IS NOT NULL)
 316:   // are created exclusively via PostgreSQL migration DDL in prisma/migrations/...
 317:   // They are strictly omitted from schema.prisma because Prisma does not support partial indexes;
 318:   // declaring non-unique @@index with these names would drop the partial unique constraints.
 319:   // Guarded against drift by migration-guard.ts and CI validation.
 320:   @@index([merchant_id, status])
 321:   @@index([expires_at])
 322:   @@map("invitations")
 323: }
 324: 
 325: model DeviceSession {
 326:   id                 String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 327:   user_id            String            @db.Uuid
 328:   merchant_id        String?           @db.Uuid
 329:   session_token_hash String            @unique @db.VarChar(512)
 330:   device_id          String            @db.VarChar(255)
 331:   device_model       String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 332:   user_agent         String?           @db.Text
 333:   ip_address         String?           @db.VarChar(64)
 334:   fcm_token          String?           @db.Text
 335:   is_revoked         Boolean           @default(false)
 336:   status             SessionStatusEnum @default(ACTIVE)
 337:   last_active_at     DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 338:   expires_at         DateTime          @db.Timestamptz
 339:   revoked_at         DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 340:   revoked_by         String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 341:   revoke_reason      String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 342:   mfa_verified_at    DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 343:   auth_assurance     String            @default("PASSWORD") @db.VarChar(32)
 344:   created_at         DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 345: 
 346:   user               User              @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 347:   merchant           Merchant?         @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 348: 
 349:   @@index([merchant_id, user_id, status])
 350:   @@index([user_id, status])
 351:   @@index([user_id, is_revoked])
 352:   @@map("device_sessions")
 353: }
 354:
