 356: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 357: // 1b. Two-Factor Authentication (FEAT-AUTH-05: ENT-MFA-FACTOR, ENT-MFA-RECOVERY-CODE, ENT-MFA-CHALLENGE)
 358: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 359: 
 360: model MfaFactor {
 361:   id                 String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 362:   user_id            String            @db.Uuid
 363:   merchant_id        String            @db.Uuid
 364:   type               String            @default("TOTP") @db.VarChar(32)
 365:   status             String            @default("PENDING") @db.VarChar(32) // PENDING | ACTIVE | RESET
 366:   secret_ciphertext  String            @db.Text
 367:   key_version        Int               @default(1)
 368:   setup_expires_at   DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 369:   activated_at       DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 370:   reset_at           DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 371:   last_accepted_step BigInt?
 372:   created_by         String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 373:   updated_by         String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 374:   created_at         DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 375:   updated_at         DateTime          @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz
 376: 
 377:   user               User              @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 378:   merchant           Merchant          @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 379:   recovery_codes     MfaRecoveryCode[]
 380: 
 381:   @@index([user_id, status])
 382:   @@index([merchant_id, user_id])
 383:   @@map("mfa_factors")
 384: }
 385: 
 386: model MfaAdminResetIdempotency {
 387:   id              String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 388:   merchant_id     String   @db.Uuid
 389:   idempotency_key String   @db.VarChar(128)
 390:   actor_user_id   String   @db.Uuid
 391:   target_user_id  String   @db.Uuid
 392:   reason          String   @db.Text
 393:   response        Json
 394:   created_at      DateTime @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 395: 
 396:   merchant        Merchant @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 397: 
 398:   @@unique([merchant_id, idempotency_key])
 399:   @@map("mfa_admin_reset_idempotency")
 400: }
 401: 
 402: model MfaRecoveryCode {
 403:   id                      String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 404:   factor_id               String    @db.Uuid
 405:   code_hash               String    @db.VarChar(255)
 406:   consumed_at             DateTime? @db.Timestamptz
 407:   consumed_by_session_id  String?   @db.VarChar(255)
 408:   consumed_correlation_id String?   @db.VarChar(255)
 409:   created_at              DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 410: 
 411:   factor                  MfaFactor @relation(fields: [factor_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 412: 
 413:   @@index([factor_id, consumed_at])
 414:   @@index([code_hash])
 415:   @@map("mfa_recovery_codes")
 416: }
 417: 
 418: model MfaChallenge {
 419:   id                    String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 420:   challenge_hash        String    @unique @db.VarChar(255)
 421:   user_id               String    @db.Uuid
 422:   merchant_id           String    @db.Uuid
 423:   login_transaction_ref String?   @db.VarChar(255)
 424:   purpose               String    @default("MFA_LOGIN") @db.VarChar(32)
 425:   expires_at            DateTime  @db.Timestamptz
 426:   failed_attempts       Int       @default(0)
 427:   consumed_at           DateTime? @db.Timestamptz
 428:   invalidated_at        DateTime? @db.Timestamptz
 429:   correlation_id        String?   @db.VarChar(255)
 430:   created_at            DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 431: 
 432:   user                  User      @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 433:   merchant              Merchant  @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 434: 
 435:   @@index([user_id, consumed_at, expires_at])
 436:   @@index([challenge_hash])
 437:   @@map("mfa_challenges")
 438: }
 439: 
 440: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 441: // 1c. Roles & Permissions (FEAT-RBAC-01: Role, Permission, RolePermission)
 442: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 443: 
 444: model Role {
 445:   id                String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 446:   merchant_id       String?           @db.Uuid
 447:   code              String?           @unique @db.VarChar(64)
 448:   name              String            @db.VarChar(255)
 449:   name_lower        String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 450:   description       String?           @db.Text
 451:   is_system         Boolean           @default(false)
 452:   created_at        DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 453:   updated_at        DateTime          @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz
 454: 
 455:   merchant          Merchant?         @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 456:   permissions       RolePermission[]
 457: 
 458:   @@unique([merchant_id, name_lower])
 459:   @@index([merchant_id, is_system])
 460:   @@map("roles")
 461: }
 462: 
 463: model Permission {
 464:   id                String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 465:   code              String            @unique @db.VarChar(128)
 466:   name              String            @db.VarChar(255)
 467:   description       String?           @db.Text
 468:   category          String            @db.VarChar(64)
 469:   created_at        DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 470: 
 471:   role_permissions  RolePermission[]
 472: 
 473:   @@index([category])
 474:   @@map("permissions")
 475: }
 476: 
 477: model RolePermission {
 478:   id                String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 479:   role_id           String            @db.Uuid
 480:   permission_id     String            @db.Uuid
 481:   created_at        DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 482: 
 483:   role              Role              @relation(fields: [role_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 484:   permission        Permission        @relation(fields: [permission_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 485: 
 486:   @@unique([role_id, permission_id])
 487:   @@index([role_id])
 488:   @@index([permission_id])
 489:   @@map("role_permissions")
 490: }
 491: 
 492: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 493: // 1.1 Warehouses (FEAT-WH-01: Pickup/Return address, schedule, contacts, printer defaults)
 494: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 495: 
 496: model Warehouse {
 497:   id                          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 498:   merchant_id                 String    @db.Uuid
 499:   name                        String    @db.VarChar(255)
 500:   code                        String    @db.VarChar(64)
 501:   status                      String    @default("active") @db.VarChar(32)
 502:   is_default                  Boolean   @default(false)
 503: 
 504:   // Pickup address
 505:   contact_name                String    @db.VarChar(255)
 506:   contact_phone               String    @db.VarChar(32)
 507:   contact_email               String?   @db.VarChar(255)
 508:   address_line                String    @db.Text
 509:   ward                        String?   @db.VarChar(128)
 510:   district                    String    @db.VarChar(128)
 511:   city                        String    @db.VarChar(128)
 512:   postal_code                 String?   @db.VarChar(32)
 513:   address_json                Json      @db.JsonB
 514: 
 515:   // Return address (custom if use_different_return_address is true, else mirrors pickup)
 516:   use_different_return_address Boolean   @default(false)
 517:   return_contact_name         String?   @db.VarChar(255)
 518:   return_contact_phone        String?   @db.VarChar(32)
 519:   return_address_line         String?   @db.Text
 520:   return_ward                 String?   @db.VarChar(128)
 521:   return_district             String?   @db.VarChar(128)
 522:   return_city                 String?   @db.VarChar(128)
 523:   return_address_json         Json?     @db.JsonB
 524: 
 525:   // Schedule & operating hours
 526:   operating_hours             Json?     @db.JsonB
 527:   cutoff_time                 String?   @db.VarChar(10)
 528:   schedule_notes              String?   @db.VarChar(500)
 529: 
 530:   // Contacts (secondary/escalation contacts)
 531:   contacts_json               Json?     @db.JsonB
 532: 
 533:   // Printer defaults
 534:   printer_paper_size          String    @default("A6") @db.VarChar(32)
 535:   printer_dpi                 Int       @default(203)
 536:   printer_name                String?   @db.VarChar(255)
 537:   printer_auto_print          Boolean   @default(false)
 538:   printer_config              Json?     @db.JsonB
 539: 
 540:   created_at                  DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 541:   updated_at                  DateTime  @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz
 542: 
 543:   merchant                    Merchant  @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 544: 
 545:   @@unique([merchant_id, code])
 546:   @@unique([id, merchant_id])
 547:   @@index([merchant_id, status])
 548:   @@index([merchant_id, is_default])
 549:   @@map("warehouses")
 550: }
 551: 
 552: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 553: // 2. Carrier Accounts & Versioned Rate Cards
 554: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 555: 
 556: model CarrierAccount {
 557:   id                String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 558:   merchant_id       String            @db.Uuid
 559:   carrier_code      CarrierCodeEnum
 560:   label             String            @db.VarChar(128)
 561:   encrypted_credentials String        @db.Text // Encrypted with master key outside DB
 562:   tier              CarrierTierEnum   @default(L1_ASSIST)
 563:   status            String            @default("active") @db.VarChar(32)
 564:   created_at        DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 565:   expires_at        DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 566: 
 567:   merchant          Merchant          @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 568:   rate_cards        RateCard[]
 569:   shipments         Shipment[]
 570:   statements        CarrierStatement[]
 571: 
 572:   @@unique([merchant_id, label])
 573:   @@index([merchant_id, carrier_code])
 574:   @@map("carrier_accounts")
 575: }
 576: 
 577: model RateCard {
 578:   id                   String         @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 579:   merchant_id          String         @db.Uuid
 580:   carrier_account_id   String         @db.Uuid
 581:   version              Int            @default(1)
 582:   effective_from       DateTime       @db.Date
 583:   effective_to         DateTime?      @db.Date
 584:   volumetric_divisor   Int            @default(5000) // 5000 hoặc 6000
 585:   cod_payout_sla_days  Int            @default(3)    // Hạn chuyển COD (ngày)
 586:   checksum             String         @db.VarChar(64)
 587:   created_at           DateTime       @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 588: 
 589:   merchant             Merchant       @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 590:   carrier_account      CarrierAccount @relation(fields: [carrier_account_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 591:   tiers                RateTier[]
 592: 
 593:   @@index([carrier_account_id, effective_from, effective_to])
 594:   @@map("rate_cards")
 595: }
 596: 
 597: model RateTier {
 598:   id                   String         @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 599:   rate_card_id         String         @db.Uuid
 600:   route_type           String         @db.VarChar(32) // INTRA_PROVINCE, INTER_PROVINCE, SPECIAL
 601:   weight_from_g        Int
 602:   weight_to_g          Int
 603:   base_fee             BigInt         // Đơn vị VNĐ
 604:   step_fee             BigInt         @default(0)
 605:   step_weight_g        Int            @default(0)
 606: 
 607:   rate_card            RateCard       @relation(fields: [rate_card_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 608: 
 609:   @@index([rate_card_id, route_type, weight_from_g, weight_to_g])
 610:   @@map("rate_tiers")
 611: }
 612: 
 613: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 614: // 3. Orders & Shipment Ledger (Append-Only Events)
 615: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 616: 
 617: model Order {
 618:   id                   String         @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 619:   merchant_id          String         @db.Uuid
 620:   branch_id            String?        @db.VarChar(128)
 621:   warehouse_id         String?        @db.VarChar(128)
 622:   source_type          String         @default("pancake") @db.VarChar(32)
 623:   order_code           String         @db.VarChar(128)
 624:   created_at           DateTime       @db.Timestamptz
 625:   cod_amount           BigInt         @default(0)
 626:   declared_weight_g    Int            @default(0)
 627:   dimensions           Json?          // { length, width, height }
 628:   recipient_name       String         @db.VarChar(255)
 629:   recipient_phone      String         @db.VarChar(32)
 630:   recipient_province   String         @db.VarChar(128)
 631:   recipient_address    String         @db.Text
 632:   item_value           BigInt?        @default(0)
 633: 
 634:   merchant             Merchant       @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 635:   shipments            Shipment[]
 636: 
 637:   @@unique([merchant_id, order_code])
 638:   @@index([merchant_id, created_at])
 639:   @@map("orders")
 640: }
 641: 
 642: model Shipment {
 643:   id                   String             @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 644:   merchant_id          String             @db.Uuid
 645:   branch_id            String?            @db.VarChar(128)
 646:   warehouse_id         String?            @db.VarChar(128)
 647:   order_id             String             @db.Uuid
 648:   order_code           String             @db.VarChar(128)
 649:   carrier_code         CarrierCodeEnum
 650:   carrier_account_id   String             @db.Uuid
 651:   tracking_code        String             @db.VarChar(128) // Chuẩn hóa viết hoa, không khoảng trắng
 652:   current_status       ShipmentStatusEnum @default(DRAFT)
 653:   declared_weight_g    Int                @default(0)
 654:   charged_weight_g     Int?
 655:   dimensions           Json?
 656:   quoted_fee           BigInt             @default(0)
 657:   charged_fee          BigInt?
 658:   cod_amount           BigInt             @default(0)
 659:   cod_collected        BigInt?
 660:   cod_paid_at          DateTime?          @db.Timestamptz
 661:   delivered_at         DateTime?          @db.Timestamptz
 662:   created_at           DateTime           @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 663:   version              Int                @default(1) // Khóa lạc quan BR-27
 664:   last_modified_by     String?            @db.VarChar(255)
 665: 
 666:   merchant             Merchant           @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 667:   order                Order              @relation(fields: [order_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 668:   carrier_account      CarrierAccount     @relation(fields: [carrier_account_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 669:   events               ShipmentEvent[]
 670:   exceptions           ExceptionCase[]
 671:   return_record        ReturnRecord?
 672:   discrepancies        Discrepancy[]
 673:   claims               Claim[]
 674: 
 675:   @@unique([merchant_id, tracking_code])
 676:   @@index([merchant_id, current_status])
 677:   @@index([merchant_id, delivered_at])
 678:   @@map("shipments")
 679: }
 680: 
 681: model ShipmentEvent {
 682:   id                   String             @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 683:   shipment_id          String             @db.Uuid
 684:   raw_status           String             @db.VarChar(128)
 685:   normalized_status    ShipmentStatusEnum
 686:   occurred_at          DateTime           @db.Timestamptz // Cột quyết định trạng thái (BR-03, BR-32)
 687:   received_at          DateTime           @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 688:   source               String             @db.VarChar(32) // WEBHOOK, POLLING
 689:   raw_payload          Json?
 690: 
 691:   shipment             Shipment           @relation(fields: [shipment_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 692: 
 693:   @@unique([shipment_id, raw_status, occurred_at]) // Chống trùng sự kiện (BR-17)
 694:   @@index([shipment_id, occurred_at])
 695:   @@map("shipment_events")
 696: }
 697: 
 698: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 699: // 4. Exception Cases & Rescuing (BR-31, BR-32, BR-33)
 700: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 701: 
 702: model ExceptionCase {
 703:   id                   String                  @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 704:   merchant_id          String                  @db.Uuid
 705:   branch_id            String?                 @db.VarChar(128)
 706:   warehouse_id         String?                 @db.VarChar(128)
 707:   shipment_id          String                  @db.Uuid
 708:   tracking_code        String                  @db.VarChar(128)
 709:   exception_type       ExceptionTypeEnum
 710:   status               ExceptionCaseStatusEnum @default(OPEN)
 711:   assigned_to          String?                 @db.Uuid
 712:   locked_until         DateTime?               @db.Timestamptz // Khóa mềm 30 phút (CN-09)
 713:   deadline_at          DateTime                @db.Timestamptz // Tính từ occurred_at của hãng
 714:   priority_score       Int                     @default(0)
 715:   carrier_raw_reason   String?                 @db.Text
 716:   standard_reason      String?                 @db.VarChar(255)
 717:   version              Int                     @default(1)     // Khóa lạc quan
 718:   created_at           DateTime                @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 719:   updated_at           DateTime                @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz
 720: 
 721:   merchant             Merchant                @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 722:   shipment             Shipment                @relation(fields: [shipment_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 723:   assignee             User?                   @relation("CaseAssignee", fields: [assigned_to], references: [id])
 724:   contact_logs         ExceptionContactLog[]
 725: 
 726:   @@unique([shipment_id, exception_type]) // Ràng buộc duy nhất 1 hồ sơ mở cho mỗi cặp (BR-31)
 727:   @@index([merchant_id, status, deadline_at])
 728:   @@map("exception_cases")
 729: }
 730: 
 731: model ExceptionContactLog {
 732:   id                   String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 733:   case_id              String            @db.Uuid
 734:   user_id              String            @db.Uuid
 735:   channel              String            @db.VarChar(32) // PHONE, ZALO, SMS
 736:   result               String            @db.VarChar(32) // ANSWERED, NO_ANSWER, WRONG_NUMBER, REFUSED
 737:   note                 String            @db.Text
 738:   created_at           DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 739: 
 740:   exception_case       ExceptionCase     @relation(fields: [case_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 741:   user                 User              @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 742: 
 743:   @@index([case_id, created_at])
 744:   @@map("exception_contact_logs")
 745: }
 746: 
 747: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 748: // 5. Return Management & Scanning (BR-35, BR-36, BR-40)
 749: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 750: 
 751: model ReturnRecord {
 752:   id                   String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 753:   merchant_id          String            @db.Uuid
 754:   shipment_id          String            @unique @db.Uuid
 755:   tracking_code        String            @db.VarChar(128)
 756:   return_warehouse_id  String?           @db.VarChar(128)
 757:   expected_return_at   DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 758:   received_at          DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 759:   condition            String?           @db.VarChar(32) // INTACT, DAMAGED, MISSING_ITEM
 760:   evidence_urls        String[]          @default([])
 761:   evidence_checksum    String?           @db.VarChar(64)
 762:   received_by          String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 763:   created_at           DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 764: 
 765:   merchant             Merchant          @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 766:   shipment             Shipment          @relation(fields: [shipment_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 767: 
 768:   @@index([merchant_id, expected_return_at])
 769:   @@map("return_records")
 770: }
 771: 
 772: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 773: // 6. Reconciliation, Statements & Discrepancies (BR-11, BR-12, D1-D7)
 774: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 775: 
 776: model CarrierStatement {
 777:   id                   String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 778:   merchant_id          String            @db.Uuid
 779:   branch_id            String?           @db.VarChar(128)
 780:   warehouse_id         String?           @db.VarChar(128)
 781:   carrier_account_id   String            @db.Uuid
 782:   period_start         DateTime          @db.Date
 783:   period_end           DateTime          @db.Date
 784:   checksum             String            @db.VarChar(64) // SHA-256 file gốc (BR-02, CN-13)
 785:   file_storage_key     String            @db.VarChar(512)
 786:   total_rows           Int               @default(0)
 787:   total_cod_collected  BigInt            @default(0)
 788:   total_fees           BigInt            @default(0)
 789:   status               String            @default("DRAFT") @db.VarChar(32) // DRAFT, RECONCILED, CLOSED
 790:   closed_at            DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 791:   closed_by            String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 792:   created_at           DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 793: 
 794:   merchant             Merchant          @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 795:   carrier_account      CarrierAccount    @relation(fields: [carrier_account_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 796:   rows                 StatementRow[]
 797: 
 798:   @@unique([merchant_id, carrier_account_id, checksum]) // Từ chối file trùng (CN-13)
 799:   @@index([merchant_id, period_start, period_end])
 800:   @@map("carrier_statements")
 801: }
 802: 
 803: model StatementRow {
 804:   id                   String              @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 805:   statement_id         String              @db.Uuid
 806:   line_number          Int
 807:   tracking_code        String              @db.VarChar(128)
 808:   order_code           String?             @db.VarChar(128)
 809:   fee_type             String              @db.VarChar(64)
 810:   charged_weight_g     Int                 @default(0)
 811:   charged_fee          BigInt              @default(0)
 812:   cod_collected        BigInt              @default(0)
 813:   cod_paid_at          DateTime?           @db.Date
 814:   raw_data             Json
 815:   match_status         MatchingStatusEnum  @default(UNMATCHED)
 816:   matched_shipment_id  String?             @db.Uuid
 817: 
 818:   statement            CarrierStatement    @relation(fields: [statement_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 819:   discrepancies        Discrepancy[]
 820: 
 821:   @@index([statement_id, tracking_code])
 822:   @@map("statement_rows")
 823: }
 824: 
 825: model Discrepancy {
 826:   id                   String                @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 827:   merchant_id          String                @db.Uuid
 828:   branch_id            String?               @db.VarChar(128)
 829:   warehouse_id         String?               @db.VarChar(128)
 830:   statement_row_id     String?               @db.Uuid
 831:   shipment_id          String                @db.Uuid
 832:   tracking_code        String                @db.VarChar(128)
 833:   type                 DiscrepancyTypeEnum
 834:   amount               BigInt                @default(0) // Số tiền chênh lệch (VNĐ)
 835:   status               DiscrepancyStatusEnum @default(OPEN)
 836:   reason               String?               @db.Text   // Bắt buộc khi waive/resolve (BR-22)
 837:   resolved_by          String?               @db.VarChar(255)
 838:   resolved_at          DateTime?             @db.Timestamptz
 839:   evidence_files       String[]              @default([])
 840:   version              Int                   @default(1)
 841:   created_at           DateTime              @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 842: 
 843:   merchant             Merchant              @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 844:   statement_row        StatementRow?         @relation(fields: [statement_row_id], references: [id])
 845:   shipment             Shipment              @relation(fields: [shipment_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 846:   claims               Claim[]
 847: 
 848:   @@index([merchant_id, status, type])
 849:   @@map("discrepancies")
 850: }
 851: 
 852: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 853: // 7. Claims & Immutable Audit Logs (BR-21, BR-47, BR-48)
 854: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 855: 
 856: model Claim {
 857:   id                   String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 858:   merchant_id          String            @db.Uuid
 859:   branch_id            String?           @db.VarChar(128)
 860:   warehouse_id         String?           @db.VarChar(128)
 861:   shipment_id          String            @db.Uuid
 862:   discrepancy_id       String?           @db.Uuid
 863:   claim_type           String            @db.VarChar(32) // LOST, DAMAGED, FEE, COD
 864:   carrier_ticket       String?           @db.VarChar(128)
 865:   requested_amount     BigInt            @default(0)
 866:   accepted_amount      BigInt            @default(0)
 867:   recovered_amount     BigInt            @default(0) // Chỉ ghi khi tiền thực về (Sổ 1)
 868:   status               ClaimStatusEnum   @default(DRAFT)
 869:   deadline_at          DateTime          @db.Timestamptz
 870:   evidence_pack_url    String?           @db.VarChar(512)
 871:   created_at           DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 872:   updated_at           DateTime          @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz
 873: 
 874:   merchant             Merchant          @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 875:   shipment             Shipment          @relation(fields: [shipment_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 876:   discrepancy          Discrepancy?      @relation(fields: [discrepancy_id], references: [id])
 877: 
 878:   @@index([merchant_id, status, deadline_at])
 879:   @@map("claims")
 880: }
 881: 
 882: model AuditLog {
 883:   id                   String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 884:   // merchant_id is nullable strictly for platform-level system audit events (such as system role seed reconciliation).
 885:   // All tenant-scoped actions (roles, users, sessions) strictly require and populate merchant_id (Finding 1 / Round 14 / BR-RBAC-07 / BR-RBAC-04).
 886:   merchant_id          String?           @db.Uuid
 887:   user_id              String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 888:   actor                String?           @db.VarChar(255)
 889:   action               String            @db.VarChar(128)
 890:   entity_type          String            @db.VarChar(64)
 891:   entity_id            String            @db.VarChar(255)
 892:   old_value            Json?
 893:   new_value            Json?
 894:   reason               String?           @db.Text
 895:   ip_address           String?           @db.VarChar(64)
 896:   created_at           DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz // Bất biến (BR-02, BR-21)
 897: 
 898:   merchant             Merchant?         @relation(fields: [merchant_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 899: 
 900:   @@index([merchant_id, entity_type, entity_id])
 901:   @@index([merchant_id, created_at])
 902:   @@map("audit_logs")
 903: }
 904: 
 905: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 906: // 8. Technical Outbox & Durable Dispatch Foundation (ENT-FOUND-OUTBOX)
 907: // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 908: 
 909: enum OutboxStatusEnum {
 910:   PENDING
 911:   PROCESSING
 912:   PUBLISHED
 913:   FAILED
 914: }
 915: 
 916: model OutboxEvent {
 917:   id              String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 918:   event_type      String            @db.VarChar(128)
 919:   payload         Json
 920:   correlation_id  String            @db.VarChar(128)
 921:   status          OutboxStatusEnum  @default(PENDING)
 922:   attempts        Int               @default(0)
 923:   last_error      String?           @db.Text
 924:   idempotency_key String?           @unique @db.VarChar(128)
 925:   created_at      DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 926:   scheduled_at    DateTime          @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz
 927:   published_at    DateTime?         @db.Timestamptz
 928: 
 929:   @@index([status, scheduled_at])
 930:   @@index([correlation_id])
 931:   @@map("outbox_events")
 932: }
 933: 
 934: // ============================================================================
 935: // 9. Platform Carrier Catalog & Taxonomy Reference (FEAT-CAR-01)
 936: // ============================================================================
 937: 
 938: model Carrier {
 939:   id              String           @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 940:   catalogRevision String           @map("catalog_revision") @db.VarChar(40)
 941:   code            CarrierCodeEnum
 942:   name            String           @db.VarChar(100)
 943:   logoUrl         String?          @map("logo_url") @db.VarChar(500)
 944:   isActive        Boolean          @default(true) @map("is_active")
 945:   evidenceLevel   String           @map("evidence_level") @db.VarChar(50)
 946:   description     String?          @db.Text
 947:   createdAt       DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
 948:   updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
 949:   services        CarrierService[]
 950: 
 951:   @@unique([catalogRevision, code])
 952:   @@index([catalogRevision])
 953:   @@map("carriers")
 954: }
 955: 
 956: model CarrierService {
 957:   id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 958:   carrierId       String          @map("carrier_id") @db.Uuid
 959:   catalogRevision String          @map("catalog_revision") @db.VarChar(40)
 960:   carrierCode     CarrierCodeEnum @map("carrier_code")
 961:   code            String          @db.VarChar(100)
 962:   name            String          @db.VarChar(150)
 963:   serviceType     String          @map("service_type") @db.VarChar(50)
 964:   description     String          @db.Text
 965:   isActive        Boolean         @default(true) @map("is_active")
 966:   evidenceLevel   String          @map("evidence_level") @db.VarChar(50)
 967:   sourceRevision  String          @map("source_revision") @db.VarChar(80)
 968:   createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
 969:   updatedAt       DateTime        @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
 970:   carrier         Carrier         @relation(fields: [carrierId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
 971: 
 972:   @@unique([catalogRevision, carrierCode, code])
 973:   @@index([carrierId])
 974:   @@index([catalogRevision, carrierCode])
 975:   @@map("carrier_services")
 976: }
 977: 
 978: model CanonicalStatusReference {
 979:   id              String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 980:   catalogRevision String   @map("catalog_revision") @db.VarChar(40)
 981:   code            String   @db.VarChar(50)
 982:   category        String   @db.VarChar(50)
 983:   label           String   @db.VarChar(100)
 984:   description     String   @db.Text
 985:   stageOrder      Int      @map("stage_order")
 986:   createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
 987:   updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
 988: 
 989:   @@unique([catalogRevision, code])
 990:   @@index([catalogRevision])
 991:   @@map("canonical_status_references")
 992: }
 993: 
 994: model FeeComponentReference {
 995:   id              String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
 996:   catalogRevision String   @map("catalog_revision") @db.VarChar(40)
 997:   code            String   @db.VarChar(50)
 998:   name            String   @db.VarChar(100)
 999:   category        String   @db.VarChar(50)
1000:   description     String   @db.Text
1001:   isRefundable    Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_refundable")
1002:   vatApplicable   Boolean  @default(true) @map("vat_applicable")
1003:   createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
1004:   updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
1005: 
1006:   @@unique([catalogRevision, code])
1007:   @@index([catalogRevision])
1008:   @@map("fee_component_references")
1009: }
1010: 
1011: model CatalogCompatibilityMapping {
1012:   id              String           @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
1013:   catalogRevision String           @map("catalog_revision") @db.VarChar(40)
1014:   carrierCode     CarrierCodeEnum? @map("carrier_code")
1015:   domain          String           @db.VarChar(20)
1016:   rawKey          String           @map("raw_key") @db.VarChar(100)

 19: ## Business outcome
 20: 
 21: Writers and reviewers can pack only the files a prompt needs (a Pull Request diff plus its Work Item) into one secret-checked, token-capped XML file. Smaller complete context cuts review rounds and quota use. The pack is advisory and does not change any gate.

 69: ## Business rules and edge cases

156: ## Historical review repair evidence (through `2466e28b45d68e58c5794411c1d1a8fc4082074d`)
157: - Round 28 Finding 10 (P1 — destination aliases bypass collision protection): `resolveExistingAncestorsAndAliases` resolves the canonical destination and all existing ancestors before validation. Repository containment is checked against canonical root for both lexical and canonical paths. Input/output collisions are checked across lexical relative path, canonical relative path, exact canonical path resolution, `sameFileIdentity` (inode and device comparison), glob pattern matching, and input normalization (handling `./` prefixes and redundant slashes). Automated negative tests cover symlinks to source files, directory aliases to source folders, symlinked directories pointing outside the repository, destination aliases when input path uses `./` prefix, and hardlink aliases to source files. Source files are strictly preserved.
158: - Round 28 Finding 11 (P2 — publication failure can destroy existing destination): `publishOutput` now publishes packs through a temporary sibling file (`.<filename>.tmp-<pid>-<ts>-<rand>`) in the destination directory and performs atomic replacement via `fs.renameSync`. If copying to the sibling or replacing the destination fails, the sibling is removed and the original destination file is completely untouched. Automated negative tests prove that existing files survive simulated rename and copy publication failures.
159: - Round 28 Finding 4 (P2 — contradictory handoff evidence): Marked historical CI evidence with its exact reviewed SHA `4e2ec65df747ccf9ac5857e05379c8fbe2add34b` and documented its resolution in `53f3059d8d78f94bc93e52a790e4af000d145874` where allowed paths were expanded to include `GROUP-7-PRODUCT-TOOLCHAIN.md`. Updated review history tracking to include rounds 26, 27, and 28.
160: - Round 27 Finding 4 (P2 — missing argument value): `parseArgs` strictly validates all flag values. When a flag (`--paths`, `--out`, `--max-tokens`) is followed by end-of-arguments or another flag (e.g. `--paths src/** --out --max-tokens 100`), it throws a descriptive required-value error instead of silently adopting the next flag name as a value. Duplicate flags and unexpected positional arguments throw immediately. Automated negative tests cover all cases.
161: - Round 27 Finding 10 (P1 — failure cleanup deletes existing file): `pack-context.mjs` no longer resolves an unrestricted `--out` and removes it in catch blocks. Destination paths are validated via `validateOutputPath` (confined to repo root, not `.git`, not directory, regular file, and no input/output collision where `--out` matches `--paths` inputs). Repomix writes to a temporary output file inside an invocation-owned `.repomix-tmp-*` directory. If execution fails for any reason (launch failure, missing binary, token budget exceeded, detected secret), only the invocation's temporary output is cleaned up; the pre-existing user output path is never touched. On success, the temporary output is published via atomic replacement. Automated negative tests prove existing files survive launch failures and budget overruns, and unsafe destinations / input-output collisions are rejected.
162: - P1 (CI failing — `ai-brain-tests`): Root devDependency `repomix: 1.18.1` caused `tools/ai-brain/test/repo-integration-group-7.test.js:68` to fail because `GROUP-7-PRODUCT-TOOLCHAIN.md` devDependencies snapshots (`prisma`, `turbo`, `lefthook`) lacked `repomix: 1.18.1`. Synced the snapshots to match root `package.json:devDependencies`. `repo-integration-group-7.test.js` passes 3/3 (negative proof: without `repomix` in `GROUP-7-PRODUCT-TOOLCHAIN.md`, test fails with ERR_ASSERTION).
163: - P1 (CI failing — `contract`): PR contract validator (`validate_pr_contract.py`) flagged required template placeholders (`<...>` in CLI argument documentation) and unchecked mandatory checklist items in PR body. Cleaned all placeholders, completed mandatory checklist items, and verified PR contract compliance locally.
164: - P1: remove the `.env.example` exception and exclude every `.env*` file at the root and recursively. Repomix 1.18.1 rewrites `**/.env*` as a directory-only ignore, so the config uses `.env*` and `**/**/.env*` to exclude files.
165: - Negative proof: both new real-packer tests fail against the reviewed script/config at `4e2ec65df747ccf9ac5857e05379c8fbe2add34b` in a verified temporary copy (`Packed .envrc`); the naive recursive pattern also failed (`Packed .env.example`). The final config passes all 19 packer tests, with nine root/nested variants selected by both explicit paths and globs. Markers are harmless, so exclusion is proved independently of secretlint detection.
166: - Blank/comma-only selections deny without creating a pack. Existing token-limit and secret-check negative tests still pass and verify that contents are absent from logs and failed output is removed.
167: - PR contract: the original local body reproduces `required template placeholders` and `unchecked mandatory checklist items`. The corrected draft passes the unchanged validator with 9 changed files inspected. It uses concrete CLI arguments and records the product E2E path as explicitly N/A with real CLI acceptance evidence; the remote body is unchanged.
168: - Local checks: `pnpm lint` passes all 12 Turbo tasks and root scripts ESLint; `pnpm typecheck` passes the root check and all 12 Turbo tasks. `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` and `git diff --check` pass. The no-hardcode guard passes. Windows commands use the installed `pnpm.cmd` shim.
169: - `pnpm format:check` reports only the pre-existing, untouched `.oc/pr-body-template.md`; the modified local body is formatted. The root formatting gate has not been changed.
170: - API verification: With local database services running, foundational API, authentication, session lifecycle, invitations, and user management unit and Supertest suites pass locally (one unrelated assertion in `rbac.unit.spec.ts` expects Unix `\n` line endings in `openapi.yaml`, which checks out as CRLF on Windows; that file is outside TASK-AI-158 allowed paths).
